chapters.title: Chapter 1: Cultivation Realms and treasures (No Spoilers to MC cultivation)
chapters.content:
Earthly Realm - There are 9 stages In all cultivation realms, the earthly realm consists of taking energy to refine your body, from your skin to your internal organs muscles and bones, at this cultivation realm you can learn weak techniques such as conjuring fire.
Heavenly Realm- At this realm, you start to strengthen your soul and learn how to use telepathy, the power difference between an earthly and heavenly realm practitioner consists in that this realm your soul gets stronger and you get in touch with inner ki, which makes a huge difference between these two cultivation realms.
Ki Cultivating Realm: In this realm, you start to cultivate your inner ki and gain the ability to strengthen your body again, but from here it would be your ki pathways, you can learn a lot more techniques at this realm as it's one of the most important ones in the early stages of cultivation.
King Realm: At this point in the cultivation sense you are a king on the battlefield, all below you won't be able to do anything besides bowing their heads in sub servitude, your soul gains a kingly quality to it and it's very hard to be controlled, here soul magics that pertain to forceful control lose their effectivity.
Emperor Realm: The emperor realm is the peak of the mortal plane, at this point, you would be strongest in all wars, your techniques are unrivaled and your power is above anyone else, however that is in the mortal realm, you can also gain access to flying in this realm, ki weapons can be created which are indestructible to anyone below your realm.
Sage Realm: You arrive at the sage realm after you go to the realm above the mortal realm, there are two realms that exist in the universe while there's a third one that one is only accessible to people who broke down the fetters of the universe, at the sage realm you gain an avatar that can grow as strong as you.
God Realm: At this stage, you fuse with your avatar after you both reached the peak of the sage realm entering in a godly state where you can control the laws of the universe, however, there is a limited amount of laws you can control as the universe is still restraining you - MC was at this point when he died.
True Realm - The realm above the god realm, the strongest and ultimate realm known to everyone, Buddha, Hades and other types of gods that reached the ultimate peak have reached this realm, much isn't known about it, nor how you are supposed to reach this realm, however, the rumor of the spirit realm says that you would need to break the fetters of your universe and absorb it to reach the true realm, the powers of the true realm are unknown.
There are four types of treasures:
Soul enchanting, Body strengthening attack and defensive ones, they are pretty self-explanatory, each realm can create their own treasures that are only effective at their own realm, depending on the skills and materials the quality of the treasures may vary:
Ordinary < Special < Strong < Overwhelming < Godly < True
Just like the cultivation realms, each treasure has its own powers, soul enchanting ones strengthen and heal the soul of the wielder making it a perfect treasure for soul bodies, body strengthening is useful for everyone so I won't comment about this one, as for attack and defensive ones any other explanation is needed?
If you have read any other cultivation novel you should know what they do.
In conclusion, these are the cultivation realms and treasures, for other things they will be explained in the novel chapters.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Can I die again?
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was a man of many talents and titles such as "evil overlord of the blood throne", "crazy maniac", "perverted old fool", and many more that I wouldn't have time to list.
His universe one of the many that exist in his world was just like all of the other cultivation worlds out there, strong eat the weak, famous young masters who will throw you out because you looked at them for a nanosecond, and others such miscellaneous things.
Yun Jhin himself thought that the more someone cultivated the dumber they become, fortunately for him, he removed this problem by fusing with all of his former reincarnations, he was a man with no scruples when it came to victory and with his wits and skills.
He took the leadership of the throne of blood, the greatest evil organization known to man in his universe.
He drained the blood of countless virgins in his ying-yang activities and made them his concubines, even the greatest women of the celestial sects bowed down to his greatest little brother, to him life was going so well he thought that nothing would make him unable to achieve eternal life.
But like always the man plans and heaven disagrees, the universe wouldn't let a mortal become its equal, try as he might Yun Jhin just couldn't achieve eternal life.
He extended his life using multiple methods until he became nothing more than a fossil, he tried all of the cultivation techniques he gained through his whole host of reincarnations, he tried everything he could, elixirs, stealing constitutions from fortuned people.
Be they just born or already have reached the peak, but all they did was prolong his lifespan, he thought that after so many failed reincarnations where he either fell before he could reach his full power or just died like now by this time he would have been able to reach eternal life!
Unfortunately for him, the universe he was currently in would never let him achieve his dream no matter how many more times he would reincarnate, even though he reached the peak of cultivation he still wasn't at the true at the end of the road if we would put it in percentages he would be in the top 20%.
There were still people out there that were stronger than him, however, these people weren't restricted by the universe they were in, Yun Jhin was restricted by his home universe, he was just an unlucky guy in the end.
Now as an old man who outlived all of his descendants, wives, and concubines he stood in his great palace all alone, dying on his bed that was created with the softest silk ever known to man, beast, or hybrid.
His breathing was roughed as his skin was pretty much falling from his bones, he was so old you couldn't recognize him at all, you would think he was a patch of skin instead of a human, you could see his sickly white bones sticking out of his putrid skin, suddenly the prone form of the strongest man known in his universe started to cough as blood dripped down from the corners of his mouth.
Old age combined with all of his attempts at gaining eternal life wore down his body to the point he wasn't practically 'human' anymore, his days were numbered that was for sure.
Above his head, the sands of time were wearing down in a clepsydra made of silver, this was the time he had left on the mortal plane before he would be taken back to the spirit plane and reincarnated for the hundred thousandth time.
As a man with extreme experience in reincarnation he wasn't that sad he was dying but he was disappointed as he muttered to himself with the last vestiges of his strength:
"One more time? maybe one more time will I reach the peak then?"
That's what he told himself every time he reached the end of the line, one more time, would he reach the peak then? But he failed, and failed, and failed so many times he didn't know. His intelligence and wisdom were just a drop in the ocean compared to his inexperience.
He never thought that the universe itself was shackling him down, he always thought that a better bloodline would help him, a better cultivation technique, a better physique.
In the end, everything failed. Yun Jhin coughed out one last time before his spirit left his body and entered the reincarnation cycle for another time. However, something different happened to his spirit this time around. A fat jolly bald man who wore a kasaya robe and prayer beads around his neck took a hold of his spirit and examined it and said:
"Such evil putrid karma, reincarnating as a pig or a dog would be something that would be too good for you."
He was one of the experts that achieved cultivation above Yun Jhin, he was the peak of righteousness and light the ascended being with the perfect moral compass: the Buddha!
Suddenly behind the Buddha, a man ensconced in the darkness appeared as he tried to take Yun Jhin's spirit back from the Buddha but the Buddha clapped his hands together and pushed the shadow back.
The man cursed as he swore:
"You dumb fatty what do you think you are doing with my champion?"
Buddha looked at the spirit in his eyes then at the man who tried to assassinate him and laughed joyfully:
"Oh, Hades? He is your disciple? Why don't I see anything like that in his memories?"
Hades grumbled under his breath, well after so many reincarnations he thought Yun Jhin would make a good disciple, he was finally going to teach him the way to break through the Universe's borders and ascend, he needed a helper anyways and Yun Jhin would make a good right-hand man for Hades or so he thought.
The jolly Buddha shook his head repeatedly as he pushed the spirit down in his palms, Yun Jhin knew something was wrong with the reincarnation process as the eyes of his spirit opened wide open as he saw the giant palm starting to squish him.
Suddenly he transformed into a small being, a being so small he wouldn't even look at, Buddha laughed as Hades tried to stop him but the Buddha threw him down from the spirit realm to be reincarnated again, forcefully and earlier than intended!
No blood nor anything was felt around Yun Jhin, he could feel only heat and darkness, what was this feeling? Was he going to get reborn so soon? Was the bald fat giant just a fever dream created from the reincarnation cycle? This never happened before Yun Jhin felt something wasn't right, he felt so small so weak, so hungry...
Suddenly he felt something break, his long green body broke through the layers of a humid but weak flesh trapping, he immediately looked around and the site in front of him made his nonexistent eyes widen, a bunch of small eggs so small they couldn't be seen with the naked eye were all around him.
He was the first to hatch, but what kind of creature hatched from such big eggs, what was I reincarnated into? Yu Jhin thought, however, the eggs weren't that big, they were actually very small, they just looked big due to his size.
Suddenly in front of him, a blaring green screen appeared which said:
[Caterpillar system activated.]
[Host is advised to eat leaves to restore strength.]
Did I become a caterpillar? Yu Jhin said the following words after his thoughts:
"Can I die again?" But out of his nonexistent mouth came no sound as he was a caterpillar only a few pews were heard.
And so the story of Yun Jhin started, as a normal tree caterpillar with no cultivation powers, he was going to be an easy target to the birds of prey.
But this wasn't going to happen anytime soon, right now Yun Jhin had to put his pride down and do something he would never have thought to do before, eat leaves!
There were multiple leaves down on the ground left by the mother of the bunch of larvae, Yun Jhin felt especially weak as he was forcefully reincarnated and he started to eat and eat, till he ate all of the leaves down, he became as full as he could, transforming from the small shape that he was formerly into a fat caterpillar that could barely move because of its weight.
Suddenly some words appeared in front of him which said:
[Host consumed many leaves and is advised to begin the first evolutionary phase from his larvae form to his child caterpillar form.]
As much knowledge as he had from his previous lives Yun Jhin knew that caterpillars had very few growth phases and the last one made them into a butterfly finally cutting off their evolutionary path.
Yun Jhin looked around himself and realized that he couldn't do anything, he was too weak, he needed to gain strength before he could leave the nest, and as a larva, he couldn't.
He would need to reach the last phase of being a caterpillar before he found himself to be strong enough to leave the tree and see where he was situated.
He decided to use this system he acquired to his advantage, he cultivated countless strange techniques before and he wasn't going to inquire much about the system, after all, he had similar experiences in the past but they were either weaker or hallucinogen involved.
But for now, the system looked pretty solid to him.
Yun Jhin laid down his fat caterpillar body and started to sleep, this was what his body told him to do so he could evolve the last words he saw before his consciousness faded were:
[Host begins the evolutionary process of Larva > Caterpillar Rank 1]

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Fratricide is the new leaf
chapters.content:
In his sleep, Yun Jhin saw scenes that happened in his former reincarnations, at first he was a young handsome teen who was strutting around a huge palace, in another one he was a poor beggar with a glint in his eyes that showed he wasn't that normal, and there were some he wasn't even human, with help and cultivation techniques he evolved to the point he became akin to one, but in the end, he was never something so weak as a caterpillar, all the times he wasn't a human he was still considered a beast capable of cultivating and not a weak insect such as a caterpillar.
Technically speaking not all beasts could cultivate just like not all humans could, humans needed a physique or talent to learn how to cultivate while beasts needed an adequate bloodline which caterpillars lacked, of course not all caterpillars couldn't cultivate but from what he inferred when he looked around the size and consistency of the eggs Yun Jhin realized that he was just the most normal caterpillar type that ever was.
In the end, the evolutionary process of a caterpillar would end at the butterfly and so the talent of his current life was extremely weak, Yun Jhin was considering suicide he didn't want to bother himself trying to evolve from a caterpillar it was too much work!
Suddenly he woke up as his skin started to molt and he grew up from his larvae form to a little bigger and stronger form, now he could move around instead of just staying on the same spot, he saw some new leaves were added on the ground and he immediately went to eat them not leaving anything behind for the future larvae. Yun Jhin could care less about some weak caterpillars he was a peak cultivator and he would eat as many leaves as he wanted!
Suddenly some notifications appeared in front of him from the system:
[If the host dies he won't reincarnate again]
[Host is full again, eat 5 more times to reach Caterpillar Rank 2]
[Caterpillars have 3 ranks and afterward, the host will have to evolve into a butterfly unless certain conditions are met]
Yun Jhin's nonexisting eyes widened as he read the system notifications as he thought what do you mean no more reincarnations? what the hell was this bullshit? I have reincarnated countless times with no problems this was the first time I was getting denied!
He wanted to ask the system whatever it meant but it didn't respond at all, seems like he didn't have any control over it or he just wasn't strong enough to make it respond to him.
Nothing happened as he waited for more leaves, Yun Jhin felt like he wouldn't survive outside without reaching the max rank of a caterpillar he needed to eat more to evolve!
Evolution, evolution just like in his past lives all needed to be done by evolution, Yun Jhin thought hard about some of his past information, non cultivating animals were things that he didn't care much about so, he had almost no information about them, but there was a chance for normal animals to gain cultivation talent, they needed to eat a cultivation treasure and be lucky enough to not explode from its power.
Yun Jhin didn't have many skills he could use in the body of a caterpillar, his soul got thinned and weakened from the reincarnation process so if he overused it in the caterpillar body it might even explode!
He needed a strong enough body to be able to use his soul powers properly, and now that was the thing he lacked the most if he would put the humans at 1 he would be -1 in terms of strength agility, and vitality, however, his intelligence was top notch! but what use would be the intelligence without any power to use it? he would need to have at least a 1 in vitality before he could use his soul power properly.
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked around, there wasn't anything he could after he ate all of the leaves, but he looked at the egg sacks that haven't hatched yet, it wasn't the first time he would have done cannibalism, would the sacks help him evolve?
He tore down on the sacks and started to eat them opening up his small mouth and taking bites out of the egg sacks till none were left, his body felt full and disproportioned as a notification appeared in front of him:
[Host has eaten it's brothers and sisters and directly skips all other evolutionary processes to reach Rank 3]
Suddenly Yun Jhin blacked out for what felt like hours on end as memories started to play again in his mind when he woke up he was now a proper adult Caterpillar, he directly left the nest and started to walk slowly on the tree's surface, as he looked around he realized that he was in a cemetery!
Some humans who wore dark gowns were talking under the tree near a tomb:
"The sect master gave us such a shitty job, why do we have to kill the revenants, shouldn't that be the job of the newbies?"
The other human said in a high pitched tone of voice towards his companion:
"You shut up, we only got in this problem because you couldn't keep your d*ick in your pants when you saw Hall Master Yuria."
The man chuckled awkwardly, he was caught beating the meat near Hall Master Yuria's place, and unfortunately for his friend who was coincidently walking by he got implicated by the pervert.
Yun Jhin listened deeply to what they were talking about, it seemed there was a sect situated nearby, and from the looks of it, it wasn't a friendly one as it dealt in death decay, and necromancy. But this was just like home for Yun Jhin, well he had many lives where dealt in such practices and it could be said he enjoyed the evil branch of cultivation the most, after all, the evil cultivation was superior in his opinion.
However, he decided to retreat to a higher vantage point as there was nothing he could do he was a caterpillar with no power, all he could do was try to eat new things and see if he could evolve into something else besides a normal butterfly, He evolved faster due to eating his unborn siblings, he tried to eat some leaves and got the following notification:
[Eat 100 more leaves before you can evolve into a butterfly.]
Eating more leaves was out of the question for Yun Jhin now, after all, he didn't want to become a butterfly with no future, he needed something else, but what else could he eat? he needed to eat something, he tried some tree bark and after a long time he finally ate some and he gained another notification:
{Eat 100 more tree bark pieces to evolve into a tree butterfly.]
Tree butterflies were a variation of normal butterflies still not being cultivation worthy, he needed a variant that he could cultivate with, as long as he could get his hands on one such variant he would be able to find a cultivation technique, after all, with so much time passing by and so many reincarnations he got too many cultivations techniques, he could find one for even the lowliest beings that could cultivate, unfortunately, he was in a body that couldn't cultivate!
Yun Jhin sighed inside as he looked around and he couldn't see anything else that he could eat, what could he do, in the corner of his unexisting eyes, he finally saw the duo move as a withered arm started to get out of the tomb nearby them breaking through the cement and trying to leave it's resting place.
Maybe eating some undead could help, in his memories, Yun Jhin remembered a caterpillar known as corpse eater, it could cultivate, but he couldn't get near the undead unless it wouldn't move, there were also the maggots inside the body of the undead that were stronger than he was.
What could he do? normally disciples would thoroughly destroy the body to get rid of such cases...
Yun Jhin thought a bit about it and his small body started to move down the tree he quickly got to the earth and hid as well as he could, the disciples made quicky work of the corpse and were ready to incinerate it when Yun Jhin suddenly made a strange sound that seemingly came from the tree, he used his soul to send out a wave that made the apprentices think that there was a sound coming from the tree.
Almost exhausted to death Yun Jhin crawled towards the corpse while the apprentices started to look at the tree and inspected it, this was a sound they never heard in their lives and different from the grunts and moans of the undead.
Yun Jhin took a quick bite of the corpse and his body froze as he looked at the notification in front of him:
[Eat a whole corpse before you can evolve into the corpse devouring caterpillar.]
This was practically impossible! Yun Jhin retreated as the apprentices came back and they thoroughly destroyed the undead corpse then left the area disappearing in the bunch of tombs to find a new target.
Yun Jhin thought that it wasn't practically possible to eat a whole body, he only took a very small bite that wasn't even worthy of an ant bite and he needed to eat a whole adult body to become a corpse devouring caterpillar.
The only way to do that would be to distract the disciples from a body for days or even weeks even maybe months.
Yun Jhin got a headache, in his previous lives everything was extremely easy for him, he got his hands on the best cultivation resources as long as he showed his talent no matter the sect he was in, as long as he got a good to use body he would pump it with the highest quality cultivation technique till it became a worthy physique to him.
But now he needed to use his brain more than before! even though he had a lot of information and 'wisdom' he never used more than he needed because everything fell in his palms at the first moment he showed his talent or the moment he cultivated for a good enough while.
And for now, he would have to create a good enough plan to divert the attention of the corpse cleaning apprentices for months? This was what the grunts he had did for him or else they died.
Yun Jhin sighed as he started to think, the best way was to create a fake treasure and make them look for it but how? Then a lightbulb lit up in his mind as he said to himself:
"Even though I would tire myself to almost die every time I do it I should be able to use that technique albeit barely, I would need to do it many times but in the end, it would be worth it."
Yun Jhin knew what he had to do and immediately went to work, of course only after he ate enough and slept to restore his weary caterpillar body, his soul was weaker than before but it could recover with time however no matter how strong the soul was it couldn't be used at its full potential without a strong enough body.
[Host needs to engage in the evolutionary process himself even if he eats the required amount of materials.]
This was what Yun Jhin wanted to hear as he already quite a lot of leaves, he made a gamble, after all after eating and resting his body would feel refreshed and like new, this might have been another effect of the system.
Yun Jhin looked down from the tree as the apprentices appeared again and sighed, he needed time to enact his plan so he could only start when these guys left.
But suddenly the apprentice threw his clothes away and pinned the other apprentice down on the ground, Yun Jhin took a better look and realized that the other apprentice was female.
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked down at his caterpillar form, he now had no little friend down there and that made him sad as he remembered his former glory days.
He decided to go back into the nest and ignore the people down. He thought he would have his fun in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 3: One plan to eat a corpse
chapters.content:
After the apprentice duo finished their 'business' I decided to leave my nest after I heard no more sounds, I crawled outside and saw them just putting their clothes back, the woman had a short pixie cut and looked like a tomboy she looked wronged as she looked at the man with short black hair which was shadowing his eyes as she said with a tear streaking down her face:
"You animal you didn't even spare me..."
The man chuckled as he looked at her and said:
"Of course I didn't you were the only one that escaped my clutches in the outer sect, be a good girl and don't tell anyone or my uncle will use you just like I did, and let me tell he won't be as gentle as I was."
The woman's face whitened at the mentions of his uncle and she put her clothes back on her body quickly while running away when suddenly an arm clutched her ankle from the ground, an angry expression took her face as she stomped on the undead's arm and destroyed it quickly with a bunch of weak fire that shot out of her hands.
The undead arm was destroyed but the corpse didn't make itself visible as he seemingly knew it was going to get destroyed if it left its hiding place. (...)
I looked around and saw the man chuckling to himself as he started smoking a tobacco pipe, he felt refreshed after he put down such a fierce lady and reminisced his past accomplishments, I knew that look because I would look like that when I was thinking back on how I conquered so many celestial ladies.
This guy would make the perfect bite, I started to use my soul to create a delayed sound, from what I could infer from his body language he would come around here again and pin the woman down at the same place just to humiliate her further and make her his slave.
I have done many similar things in the past and knew how these people thought, even though he lacked finesse in his actions at the core they were the same, the creation of the delayed sounds would persist since he would come again, looking at his age and build I guessed he would come back with her in tow after a few hours.
As I waited I munched on leaves to restore my power while I also half slept keeping half of my soul awake to continue creating the delayed sounds, if I wasn't wrong they would come back around...
After a few more minutes of waiting they finally came back, it was approximately 4 hours since they finished their first round, It wasn't that impressive as I had already done around 10 thousand concubines at the same time, but this kid wasn't bad for his low cultivation base, I might even have taken him as an apprentice if I wasn't a caterpillar.
I sighed as I finally let the delayed sounds appear, by now another undead appeared which was quickly killed before I could let the sounds out, just like I calculated. (...)
Yun Jhin looked down at the undead's body as the sounds started to appear around the cemetery, the man eyes widened in surprise and delight as he slapped the woman unconscious, he didn't even get his pants back up as he suddenly ran towards the location of the sound.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he took back his thought of taking the young man as an apprentice, no apprentice of his would run around with his pants down. Yun Jhin crawled down from the tree and approached the unmoving corpse on the ground and the unconscious woman, he started eating the corpse slowly as the woman came back to her consciousness and ignore the corpse on the ground.
Her ears perked up as she heard the sound from before and just like the young man she started to run in its direction, after a short while the sound stopped but the duo never came back. (...)
As I started to dig into the corpse, the decayed blood entered my mouth and I didn't think like a caterpillar, so I thought I wouldn't feel anything but I felt disgusted, I wasn't sure why, In the past, I did eat a lot of corpses before, maybe caterpillars weren't intended to eat meat, but I stopped thinking about such things and continued eating.
Fortunately, the system helped me with this as normally a caterpillar wouldn't be able to eat meat. the decayed meat that was as grey as it could be, the dead fried maggots around the body, the crunching of the bones under my altered Caterpillar mouth, time passed by as I slept in the body but just like I calculated no one else came.
I ate and ate fell full and slept, as It continued my body changed it became stronger, faster and I could eat longer and longer, finally, after 2 months of eating at the corpse I finally finished it, blood maggots bones and everything else, I ate everything! (...)
Strange changes happened to Yun Jhin's little caterpillar body as it started to grow in height and weight, suddenly a notification from the system appeared, instead of the green screen that appeared before now it turned into a deep decaying purple as it said:
[Corpse fully digested, Host is ready for the Corpse devouring caterpillar evolution!]
It was time to change from this weak caterpillar form that incapable of cultivation to a similarly weak caterpillar form but one which could give me way more many paths of growth!
Yun Jhin took his fat bloated body towards the nest and found it to be full of leaves, a grieving butterfly could be seen inside it, seeing one of its children being alive and well it finally made a strange sound as it approached but then it smelled a different scent on it as it started to screech.
Butterflies could screech? Yun Jhin thought, but well he did eat his siblings, however, this butterfly looked like it wanted to attack as it waved his wings towards Yun Jhin and tried to throw him off the nest, fortunately, Yun Jhin's was now too fat for the feeble butterfly to throw him out!
He was almost like a rotund ball as he didn't digest everything yet, he rolled on the butterfly and squashed it into a mush which he also ate!
{Conditions met for a variant of corpse-eating Caterpillar, changed to family eating Caterpillar!]
Yun Jhin didn't think he would be so lucky he would be able to eat his mother, he knew of the variant of family eating caterpillar, it was different kind of caterpillar which evolved from eating its siblings and parents, it was one of the vilest caterpillar known to the cultivation bestiaries, however, in the end, it was still a caterpillar that even the lowest cultivators would scorn at.
However, for Yun Jhin, even the smallest improvement would make a huge change in the future as he had tons of cultivation techniques. Yun Jhin chuckled inside as he went to sleep in the nest.
Eating a corpse and his mother made him feel so full like he couldn't eat anything again, he started sleeping as his caterpillar form started to change it's color from a normal green to a deep dark, he started to grow from the length of an infant's finger to the height to an adult ring finger, a skull pattern appeared on his back that could only be discernible if he grew up to his full length.
Finally, after 30 hours of sleeping Yun Jhin woke up as refreshed as he could be as suddenly his stomach started growling! As a family eating caterpillar he was cursed with eternal hunger but since he was in a cemetery he would do a favor to the corpse cleaning apprentices and make the cemetery his buffet!
Family eating caterpillars were different from normal caterpillars as they were as quarter as strong as a normal human child, meaning that as long as Yun Jhin could get near a corpse be it moving or not he could eat it if he made a good enough plan.
And even though he wasn't extremely smart when it came to plans he was a genius with multiple reincarnations which made him very experienced when it came to combat to a point where he would act instinctively when it came to dodging, he would drill into the earth and hide into the shadows where he would devour unsuspecting undead!
As Yun Jhin made his plan he quickly drilled into the earth using his new corpse-eating teeth they were sharp enough to slash meat and bone and eat them at a way faster pace compared to the 3 months it took him to first finish that one body, he dropped into the catacombs below the cemetery as he looked around, mindless undead humans were sleeping here and there.
The cemetery was cleaned so very few undead were still intact, most of them were destroyed and cleansed, they were the results of failed corpse refining experiments of the nearby sect. (...)
I started munching on one nearby undead and finished his whole body in ten hours, I got bloated as I hid deeper in the earth to fully consume his nutrients when a notification took me away from my musings:
[Eat 100 bodies to achieve rank 2, the family eating caterpillar has 9 ranks you have to go through before you can evolve into a Death Butterfly.] (...)
The Death Butterfly was the next evolution of the family eating caterpillar Yun Jhin also knew of the next evolutions about the Death Butterfly, which was Flesh-Eating Butterfly and Monstrous Butterfly, but he didn't intend to go down this path, he needed to unlock a higher level bloodline, he needed to devour something else to change from family eating caterpillar to a different type of caterpillar, he needed to become a devilish caterpillar the highest bloodline known to the caterpillar kind!
However to do that he guessed he would need to devour high demons and devils, right now he couldn't even devour a hell salamander so he put that thought away. Right now he would have to reach rank 9 of the family eating caterpillar before he found a substitute to evolve into a different caterpillar, he wouldn't go down the butterfly evolution path until he gained the best bloodline!
Yun Jhin started to sleep as his soul kept replaying information that he would need in the future, due to Hades's intervention his memories didn't get fully wiped but he still lost quite a few of them...
Yun Jhin slept unknowingly to him his soul was bleeding out some memories, even though they weren't that important as long as he didn't heal his soul quickly he might even start losing important ones!

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Soul leakage
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin woke up from his dream with a feeling of cold sweat on his caterpillar body but it was just a hollow feeling as he couldn't truly sweat, he stood there unmoving as he started to analyze his soul and he said slowly in his mind:
"A soul leakage... this reincarnation is more and more problematic, how can I fix the hole in my soul?"
Yun Jhin knew of many ways to fix it but he needed the proper materials, unfortunately for him, most of the materials were either extremely rare or expensive or just out of his proverbial hands right now.
Yun Jhin knew that if he lost memories he would continue to lose them to the point his soul would become empty like one of a newborn he would transform into an idiot for the rest of his life!
Because the hole would remain there no matter what he would learn in the future it would leak from there slowly and transform him back into what he was before.
Yun Jhin slowly pondered what to do as his body was now full of energy, there was a more primitive way to fix the problem, and since he was in the right place to fix his soul he guessed he could only take this one.
He started to look around and he ignored the sleeping undead, he needed to find souls!
Souls were of the energy plane and they could be used to heal someone's else wounded soul through a certain technique he knew, however, this technique put a huge burden on the user and if he wasn't in his right mind there was a chance to develop a multiple personality disorder or even explode!
Luckily for Yun Jhin, he had mastered this technique back in one of his older reincarnations, as he looked around he finally spotted a darkened patch of energy, it was a tortured soul of the undead, it became an evil spirit after being unable to achieve reincarnation up till now, Yun Jhin quickly approached him and opened his 'mouth' and immediately the soul went directly into his body where his soul started to refine the soul who was screeching and shouting.
Dark Soul flames came out of Yun Jhin's soul as he refined the weaker soul however the soul was too weak and he couldn't patch the hole at all, it helped him but it was only a temporary seal, he needed a stronger soul, but where could he find such a soul?
This was a cemetery meant for the failed experiments of the nearby sect, there was no way Yun Jhin would find a good enough soul to fix his soul leakage problem when suddenly a notification from the Caterpillar system appeared:
[Soul devoured, devour 100 more souls to transform into a soul-devouring caterpillar.]
[Soul devouring caterpillar gets the ability to self heal through eating other souls, however, if you evolve to the soul-devouring caterpillar you can't revert to your family eating caterpillar.] (...)
I could care less what this damned system told me if I needed to become a soul-devouring caterpillar to fix my soul it didn't matter, my memories were more important than this body, the soul-devouring caterpillar was still a cultivating insect so I could still make do with that evolution, it had fewer evolutions than the family eating caterpillar but I didn't mean to evolve from this weak caterpillars anyway.
I continuously searched the catacombs for souls and fortunately, the souls hid from the apprentices of above, unlike the dumb ghouls the souls had a little bit of clarity in them that scared them away from the apprentices who would harvest them for soul pills.
Instead of becoming soul pills, they would become my food! (...)
Yun Jhin searched and devoured, searched, and devoured, always walking forward, there was no taste nor crunches, it felt hollow as he continuously refined the souls, it was just like a chore for him, it was harder to find the souls rather than refining them. After a few days of searching the catacombs, he finally refined 100 souls!
He created a cocoon over himself as the system said in his ears:
[Evolving from family eating caterpillar to soul-devouring caterpillar, power changed, the body adapted to better capture souls, strength reduced, vitality reduced, agility increased, rank reset to 1.]
Yun Jhin shook his head as he left the cocoon, now he changed to a blue spectral caterpillar with strange purple dots as its eyes, his length remained the same but he grew wings and he felt faster than before, the power of the family eating caterpillar and soul-devouring caterpillar was equal it's just that the family eating caterpillar was a mutant among its kin and it could evolve more times, so it had better potential. Unlike the family eating caterpillar, the soul-devouring one could only reach rank 6 instead of 9.
The higher the rank the caterpillar could reach before evolving the better it was, at maximum, it could reach the rank of 10,000. However those were the devilish and godly caterpillars of legends that Yun Jhin haven't met even when he reached the peak of his power, they were elusive creatures that liked to hibernate for the time when they would evolve in their butterfly form. The hibernation period of such creatures was in the millions of years or even tens of millions, technically speaking these types of beings were the best for Yun Jhin as he wanted a longer and longer life expectancy.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he cleared his mind using a mantra he knew from his previous life, he looked down at his body as he felt that now with the help of his constitution he could fix a patch in his soul as long as he ate enough souls, even notified him with the number:
[To fix the host's soul 1000 weak souls are needed, 100 medium souls or 1 strong soul.]
Weak souls came from people without any cultivation, medium souls came from people withing the first cultivation realms while strong souls came from those within the middle, there was no way to get any of those, even if he could drag some cultivators into the tombs there wasn't a good way for him to kill them and absorb their souls. Only if he could control the ghouls...
Suddenly a flash appeared in his purple eyes, maybe as a soul-devouring caterpillar he could control the zombies!
He found a sleeping zombie and used his mind to imprint a contract into the zombie's empty mind, suddenly the zombie's eyes opened as it stood there without moving, his wide eyes were looking at Yun Jhin without saying anything, Yun Jhin gave him some mental commands and he moved as he intended. Yun Jhin started laughing as he looked at the zombie but all that came out of his body was a high-pitched chirp sound.
Yun Jhin ignored the chirping sound and then he continued to enslave more and more zombies, unfortunately, his soul was injured and he needed to enslave only a limited number, he thought that 20 zombies were enough to deal with the weaklings outside as long as he controlled them, he was a master in battle formations and the apprentices shouldn't know any techniques besides conjuring fire.
Yun Jhin grinned as he looked at his zombie squadron and then made them drag some apprentices under the ground along with his help and soul cries they dragged two unsuspecting apprentices under the ground they were unknown to Yun Jhin but he could care less, he immediately sent a soul cry inside the duo's mind and shook the membrane of their souls making them both nauseous, as a soul-devouring caterpillar he gained the ability to control his soul better however his body still wasn't strong enough to fully handle it, at the same time it was also injured so he could only use what he dubbed as 'parlor tricks'.
However, these 'parlor tricks' of his were most deadly to newbies who only entered the first level of the earthly domain, they could barely conjure some flames with their inner qi as they tried to defeat the zombies while their soul shook, unfortunately for the duo the zombies bit them hard scratched at them and even ripped one of their arms off before they both died.
They died a painful death and their souls were full of vengeance towards these beings that dragged them under the catacombs where they found their resting place, a thing for them as the vengeful soul was the favorite snack of Yun Jhin, he opened his 'mouth' and absorbed both souls he now just needed 98 more!
Yun Jhin knew how evil sects acted, at most, they would send more people to investigate, if they still didn't find anything after they lost enough people they would just 'recruit' more people and send them here, in the end, if they didn't find anything they would finally put a middle level to investigate, by then he would have already fixed his soul and left the cemetery!
Yun Jhin chuckled as he waited for more apprentices to enter the cemetery, to him they were the sweetest nectar and the best nourishment to his injured soul, his soul wasn't even at 1% of his original power or else these souls wouldn't do a damn thing to heal it. But for him, it was a stroke of luck and a curse at the same time that he was reborn as a caterpillar if he got reincarnated anywhere else with this soul leakage he would have most likely become an idiot.
Yun Jhin sighed as he enslaved the duo's bodies, due to the dark energy in the cemetery most bodies thrown here would become undead after a while, to not waste his time Yun Jhin already put two contract seals in their memory sea, when their body fully turned into undead he would have already controlled them!
Yun Jhin waited for hours and hours that turned into days before some other apprentices were sent out to investigate, now there were 3 more making their number 5 in total.
Yun Jhin just took it as extra food as his two new cronies were already up and ready, he killed two of his normal zombies and changed them with the cultivator ones who had a sturdier body.
Yun Jhin knew when to attack, suddenly when the team of 5 people got under Jhin's location one of the now undead cultivators immediately dragged an unsuspecting apprentice to his death, Jhin immediately killed him and absorbed his soul refining it into his own.
The other apprentices weren't so easy to trick as they already knew where to look, their leader looked at the ground and shouted:
"They are in the catacombs be wary of the hands!"
Yun Jhin shook his head, the man's warning wouldn't do anything, they were doomed to join his soul as nutrients so he could repair the leakage, just like everyone else that appeared in front, be it either friend or foe, Yun Jhin was a man who would get what he wanted no matter the price or the actions he needed to take.
Suddenly one of the apprentices from above shot a fireball that immediately incinerated one of the zombies.
Yun Jhin narrowed his purple dots that acted as his eyes as he looked up, it was time to show these people what a reincarnated cultivator could do.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Underestimation
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin started to give out orders to the zombies making them spread out so they wouldn't all catch on fire by a lucky strike from the apprentices from above, they were now huddled together back to back trying to see any movement below, waiting to strike again with a fireball. Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the four people outside and he suddenly threw out a wave of soul power-infused attacks immediately rattling the apprentice's brains.
Another hand popped out of the ground dragging another fellow down into the catacombs, the zombies swarmed him like a horde, his soul left his body as Yun Jhin absorbed it quietly delighted at the taste of the soul of a cultivator which was way tastier to him compared to normal souls.
He would have licked his lips if he had a tongue and for the matter lips as well, he did the same thing as before, however, unlike before a fireball suddenly hit nearby almost hitting Yun Jhin head-on and ending his reincarnation cycle forever, cold sweat appeared on his soul form as he looked up and sensed the people above.
They were all scared and one of them randomly threw a fireball that almost ended his life! Angry at his complacence and the other party's luck he immediately sent out his most powerful soul wave stunning the trio, dragged underground while being stunned they were light work, the souls devoured, strengthening Yun Jhin's soul and with the medium souls he acquired he even was ready to rank up as the system notification appeared:
[Ready to rank up to soul-devouring caterpillar Rank 2]
It would be quite sometime before another patrol party would come up to give themselves on a silver platter to the overlord caterpillar so he decided to take the notification seriously and he started his evolution process directly while being guarded by his new zombies, he already used his soul technique to enslave the other would-be zombies and ghouls.
After 6 days of incubation Yun Jhin finally broke through again reaching the soul-devouring caterpillar rank of 2, he could feel his soul mending at a quicker speed as he grew stronger and bigger, his wings turned transparent and his 'eyes' glowed with a deeper purple color, his body color also changed to a deep dark blue, his length increased to the length of two adult fingers, his width that of a kids palm.
Yun Jhin wasn't interested in his outer appearance as he looked at his newly risen slaves and nodded to himself, with the boost from being rank 2 he would need fewer souls to fix his soul and he would also devour them faster, the power of the soul-devouring caterpillar was useful for him now but in the future, after he fixed his soul leakage he would immediately abandon it.
He couldn't start cultivating either, he needed the body to be at the peak of its cultivation capability before he started, that meant rank 6 but if he changed his race his progress would be reset and he would need to rank up again, he didn't know if his cultivation would reset as well, he first needed to get to rank 6 and cultivate a bit before he changed his race to know what would happen.
Fortunately for Yun Jhin the patrol team this time came in the tens, but it obvious these people were all people who just started to refine their bodies, they were cultivators but they were the weakest of them all.
None of them took Yun Jhin's attention they were all weaklings, he immediately gave some orders to the zombies as he now sent out his soul waves at a certain group of three people who were huddled together, immediately they were dragged down and devoured by Yun Jhin, the others were scared like chickens, only one of them looked down and seemingly saw Yun Jhin's form in his pupils as he muttered:
"Soul devouring caterpillar?"
When Yun Jhin heard the teen's voice through his mental network he immediately became interested, he sent out a few mental waves towards the teen and his brain shook as he fell to the underground.
The teen wore the same dark outfit as the others, his dark green hair was peculiar as his gray pale orbs, he wasn't handsome by any other case but he looked quite different due to the uniqueness of his hair color and eyes. Suddenly he got up and a fire started to immolate the nearest zombies, fortunately, they weren't the ones made from cultivator corpses, it seemed him falling was a feint, he used this to make himself look vulnerable before counterattacking!
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he observed the green-haired youth better, could there something different about him? he was in the earthly realm that was for sure, not that high either, at most the 3rd refining, he must have learned how to create flames just recently, there was something strange about him that made Yun Jhin attracted to him, like devouring him would give him a huge boost that would give him a big difference in his future evolutions, did the kid have a special bloodline or physique? (...)
I looked at the kid with narrowed eyes as I controlled the cultivator bodies to attack him when suddenly from above some fireballs dropped directly on a few other zombies and one even almost hit me as well, I flew deeper into the catacombs as I gave orders to the remaining zombies to kill the green-haired youth, I made them take a circular formation and hug him at the same time if he tried to immolate the zombies he would burn himself as well!
The youth smile disappeared from his face as I made the zombies bite into his flesh and drag him towards me, it seemed the mental connection he had with his teammates broke off as no more fireballs were sent down, either that or they ran out of energy. (...)
It was a bit strange considering they hit so many zombies accurately, the teen must have a treasure on him that was for sure, there was no way an earthly realm fledgling had such a strong soul that he could communicate with others, this could only be done at the heavenly realm and above.
Yun Jhin slowly approached the teen as he flew near him when the teen's voice entered his ears:
"Caught you."
Suddenly a bunch of fireballs fell from above almost immediately engulfing Yun Jhin's frail caterpillar form!
Almost dead and burnt to a crisp Yun Jhin sent his orders angrily at the zombies killing the green-haired youth, as fast as his little body let him he devoured the man's soul and body, leaving behind only a special type of conch shell, fortunately, he already reached rank 2 and his body was sturdy enough to survive the fireballs, however, if anything else hit him right now he would instantly die, he needed to recover, he left the zombies behind as he crawled away not caring if they were annihilated or not.
[Host situation is critical, host devoured a special kind of body and a soul artifact, due to the soul artifact your soul can be mended, the special fortuned constitution is added to the collection, devour 1000 fortuned ones to become a fortuned caterpillar, the system recommends to the host to find a hidden place to recover the host's physical strength and mend his soul!]
Yun Jhin already knew that he didn't need the system to remind him, he knew he felt something strange coming from the teen's body, that was the fortuned energy!
Fortuned people were extremely rare people that were loved by the universe, they tended to go pretty far in their cultivation if they weren't found out, however, most of the time old monsters like Yun Jhin would find out they have fortune energy in their body and try to assimilate them for themselves, but Yun Jhin tried this many times before but he couldn't just take a hold of the energy it would always slip between his fingers, as the universe's hatred for him increased every time he has slain one more fortuned person, maybe that was also one of the reasons he couldn't breakthrough.
He could hear the zombies moan behind him, they were becoming undead effigies as they burnt to the ground due to the efforts of the apprentices, he couldn't control them anymore and he let them do as they saw fit, even though a lot of them died almost 18, they still brought down 2 other apprentices, however, that left Yun Jhin to deal with at least 17 more. Yun Jhin knew there was no chance he could deal with them by himself and he already gained what he needed.
Now he needed to find a quiet place where he could undergo his soul mending and recovery of his physical strength, being a caterpillar with wings he was quite fast as he drilled down into the earth then he hid as deeply as he could rolling himself into a ball and starting the healing process.
He could hear footsteps above him, the disciples didn't look down as they started to run rampant in the catacombs, Yun Jhin frowned he won't be able to use the same strategy as before as it seemed they were ready to destroy all of the remaining corpses in one fell swoop!
He didn't need their help anymore, now he just needed to find another evolution he could hang on to after he mended his soul.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he used the artifact and the soul of the fortuned green-haired youth to mend the hole in his soul, slowly but surely his physical strength and mental one was restoring themselves at a quick speed, after he woke up he could feel that his powers were back to normal, his soul wasn't leaking memories anymore, fortunately, he only lost some of his earliest reincarnations that weren't that useful, even though he also lost some knowledge about some type of caterpillars it wasn't anything big.
Yun Jhin sighed as he got out of from the ground and looked around, he didn' see any zombies as he flew around, only smoldering ashes were left behind, the bodies of the cultivators were of the same state as the zombies, it seemed they knew there was something below the ground that was more terrifying than the zombies, Yun Jhin knew that he couldn't stay under the catacombs any longer or else the higher-ups of the sect might come to investigate and he wasn't ready at all for something like that!
Yun Jhin drilled out of the ground and flew away from the catacombs, as he looked around he saw the sect that stood nearby the cemetery, it was full of dull black painted houses that were almost ready to fall, they looked like the houses of commoners of the lowest rung lived in.
But those were only the one at the outskirts of the sect, there were also better houses and even a palace in the middle of the sect, the palace was painted brown purple and Yun Jhin could feel the power of a peak earthly expert living in there, hidden he could even feel a heavenly expert.
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked around, maybe he could hide inside the dilapidated houses, with some luck he could find a starving disciple that he could enslave with his soul will.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Mind controlling caterpillar
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin flew quickly, looking around the dilapidated houses with his soul will, he tried to find a very weak soul that he could take control of, he needed one human to control so he would be able to infiltrate the sect and get his hands on better materials that he needed to eat to evolve, as for the fortuned caterpillar evolution, where could he find 1000 fortuned people?
Fortuned people were people that the universe loved and they were as rare as phoenix feathers and qilin horns, he decided to stop thinking about the fortuned caterpillar form as it wasn't even remotely possible to put his hands on it, technically speaking the fortuned caterpillar was a higher existence compared to the celestial and devilish ones, after all, it would be the most loved caterpillar of the universe.
But the universe was currently directly hating Yun Jhin for how many 'sons and daughters' he slaughtered, how could the system transform him into a fortuned caterpillar he didn't know, was the system above the universal laws? that wasn't right at all.
He shook his head as he stopped thinking about such things, he finally found a weak will enough he could take control of and flew directly into the dilapidated house that was ready to fall on its inhabitant's head.
It was a poor boy that looked to be around 8 years old, he looked sick as his countenance was so pale it was almost transparent, his stomach was grumbling as he looked around trying to see any bug or thing he could eat, suddenly he saw Yun Jhin and jumped directly at him with a weak attempt to try to capture and eat him.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he saw the youths attempt at capturing him, he was too weak from starvation to do anything to him, he entered the youth's ear as a wet squelch was heard, as he entered the boy's cranium and bit into his brain a notification appeared:
[Due to your actions a different branch of the soul-devouring caterpillar has been unlocked, mind-controlling caterpillar!]
[Do you wish to undergo evolution right now?]
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as a cocoon started to form inside the boy's mind, he was pretty much braindead right now, after Yun Jhin bit into his brain, he made it stop functioning, the youth was like the living dead as he collapsed on the ground, however, his stomach kept on growling even though his brain was dead his body was alive, as an evil sect which was proficient in undead Yun Jhin couldn't take control of a dead body, he needed to keep this boy alive, he sent some of his nutrients in the boy's body to keep it alive while he continued his evolution, afterward, he would try his best to get his hands on some food for his new body.
After what felt like days of waiting for the transformation, it was finally was done, breaking out of his cocoon which also enveloped the boy's brain he was now connected to it by a sharp stinger, he could now see what they boy saw but not feel, so he wasn't hungry, but the body still gave him warnings when it would be injured or well hungry. His body shrank to not burden the boy's cranium and his length and width were just a bit bigger than a normal caterpillar now, his rank was reset to 1, the mind-controlling caterpillar was a variant of the soul-devouring one and it could gain rank 7, his soul was already basically devoured after he bit into the boy's brain but his body was still alive.
The boy's stomach continued growling as the hunger was still there, the nutrients Yun Jhin gave him were enough to keep him alive but not sate his hunger. The boy got up from the ground as he looked at his hands. (...)
Finally a familiar body, I thought to myself, even though I will have to discard it in the future it was better than being a caterpillar, fortunately, this system was extremely useful and it gave me what I needed to grow stronger and evolve, at least in instructions.
The boy was emaciated and small from starvation, his brown hair was also very long reaching his waist, he wore nothing but ragged clothes, he was one of the kidnapped people who didn't have a talent for cultivation but this could change now with me in control.
However, first I needed to get this body some food, afterward, I can start cultivating, a notification appeared in front of me:
[Mind controlling caterpillars share their cultivation with their hosts and can absorb it back into their bodies if they wish to leave the host's body]
Very convenient I thought to myself. (...)
Yun Jhin shook his head as he left the dilapidated house and walked around looking for another weak signal of life, he knew what he needed to do to fill his belly, he quickly found another weak signal, it was a little girl around the same age as the boy, her eyes widened in surprise seeing the boy as she said:
"Kintaro, how can you walk? did you get some food?"
Her eyes were hopeful as she looked at him, it seemed the little girl knew the boy named Kintaro, however now there wasn't a Kintaro anymore, just Yun Jhin!
Kintaro smiled at the little girl, as he devoured his soul he gained some of the boy's memories which he was now looking through:
"Yun-Yun I have gained some food, you just stay there quietly as I will feed it to you."
The girl known as Yun-Yun smiled weakly at the boy as she waited, Yun Jhin kept his hands behind him as he walked closer to her, thinking that the food was behind his back she thought that he was going to give her a surprise, and a surprise he did gave her.
Before he entered the house he got his hands on a sharp rock which he immediately sent through her soft skull as he got as near as possible to her, her visage was blocked into the same weak smile as before as her gray matter splattered on the ground, Yun Jhin smiled at his handy work and then quickly went to work with the rock, he cut strips of her flesh and started to devour them raw where he used one of his cultivation techniques to transform them into pure energy that sailed through his body.
As he finally finished the young girl's body and cleaned the area with her clothes he could feel the strength within himself, it was the first stage of the earthly realm, organ tempering! to be able to sustain the other temperings the body would first strengthen the organs before moving to bones muscles and lastly skin.
Yun Jhin's human skin started to itch but he chose to ignore it, but he couldn't ignore his caterpillar body as he thrashed a little inside the brain, dead skin left his body as he threw it outside the head, form the ears of Kintaro's body a bunch of dead skin appeared which he picked up and ate.
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he checked his inner situation properly, he was at the first stage of the earthly realm and his internal organs were changing, a caterpillar didn't have many internal organs so he skipped directly to skin tempering, however technically speaking he was still a stage 1 practitioner.
He used the Devil human devouring cultivation technique combined with Kintaro's body he easily achieved stage 1 and he was ready for stage 2, he only needed to devour more bodies to reach that stage.
Yun Jhin's smile appeared on Kinator's body it was a scary smile someone wouldn't want to see even in their worst nightmares, something so vile that couldn't be explained with words alone, it was the smile of an apex predator ready to hunt.
Then he shook his head as he felt Kinataro's body shake as he coughed up a mouthful of black blood, these were the impurities that made his body unable to cultivate, he cleaned his mouth as he looked down at the black blood and left the dilapidated house, no one knew what he did here, the official apprentices wouldn't bother themselves checking the house of slaves.
Speaking from experience, kidnapped people who couldn't cultivate would be either enslaved or thrown to the beasts that the sect reared, Kintaro was lucky and unlucky at the same time as he was sent to die slowly in these houses that were almost ready to fall on them, as Yun Jhin looked at the body's former house, it finally fell after he breathed towards it a bit too hard.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the house, now that he could cultivate he could join the sect officially, it was a thing he didn't really like, him the greatest leader of the throne of blood, to join a backwater sect that held only one heavenly realm expert?
But he immediately strangled his pride as he walked towards an apprentice who was supposed to watch the slaves, he was there to make sure no one ran away and properly died in their homes so they could be thrown in the cemetery to create more zombies, those zombies based on quality would either be taken back or a patrol would come to exterminate them, however, 95% of the time they would be exterminated.
The apprentice's eyes narrowed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Halt where do you think you are going, slave!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he creates a small flame in his palms and then faked that he collapsed, the apprentice eyes widened in surprise, a slave cultivated to the earthly realm? this never happened before!
He quickly carried Kintaro's feeble body away towards the sect medicine hall where he told the doctor what happened, the doctor was an old man with a blind eye who wore a white gown and brown sandals, he looked at Yun Jhin's body and checked his pulse as he said:
"Yes, hmm, yes the first stage of the earthly realm, newly entered his body is over exhausted and starved, he needs to eat, as a cultivator we need to at least give him the bare needs, unlike those trash slaves, get him some food and some robes, you will take care of him until he wakes up."
He carried me towards his house which was only a little better compared to the dilapidated house that Kintaro lived before, Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the house with his eyes narrowed, he waited for the man to give him some food and water before he woke up, the man walked up to him with a friendly gaze as he said:
"Hello there junior brother, you gave me a scare back there, who would know that a slave could learn how to cultivate by themselves?"
This was something that never happened before in their sect but it did happen in some nearby sects so the medicine hall elder didn't investigate, after all, it was only a lowly disciple who broke through the first stage of the earthly realm by luck. (...)
I got up from the bed and weakly smiled at the man as I said:
"Might I know your name elder brother?"
The man laughed as he said:
"My name's Chu Mang, what's your name junior brother? Just so you know I was assigned by the medicine elder to look after you till you get better, I also got some robes for you."
He pointed near the bed where a black robe made for my small size was neatly arranged, I faked a blush as the man turned around and put the robes on my body, it looked just like the other apprentices, I nodded to myself and said:
"You can turn now elder brother Chu Mang, I'm done changing, also my name is Kintaro."
The man heaved a chuckle as he said:
"Ok then, if you feel better we can go to the mission hall to get you registered what do you say?"
I nodded my head at him but suddenly faked a tumble as I fell from the bed, the man quickly caught me before I could fall and put me back in the bed as he said:
"It seems you aren't ready yet, go rest for a while, I will come with some food so you can recover your strength, after all, I know what you went through."
A dark light went through Chu Mangs's eyes as he said that, it seemed he was a former slave himself.
I looked at his back as he left the house and thought:
"I cannot kill and devour him for my cultivation, they would investigate, it's not like he is one of the slaves, I would need to stealthily go back and eat more slaves, but if I eat too many they would realize... I need to get the job of a corpse disposer." (...)
Yun Jhin knew that most of these types of sects had a corpse disposer, one of the weakest disciples who were the ones that had to carry the corpses to the cemetery, he needed to get this job so he could eat them to further his cultivation!

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Corpse disposer
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin sat on the bed appearing sickly on the outside as he waited for the man to come back with his food, after a short while he became with a tray of dark porridge and a glass of water, he quickly ate the food to make himself look famished and waited for the nutrients to settle in his body before talking to Chu Mang:
"Thanks for the food elder brother, I think after I rest a bit we could go to get me registered in the sect what do you say?"
Chu Mang just nodded and left, he had his duties to do and he only came to his house very rarely, he only had a house in name as most of the time he had to warily sleep at his job, that's why he had big dark bags under his eyes that showed that he currently lacking sleep. Yun Jhin started thinking about what he should say and do to get his hands on the corpse dispenser job, they didn't know anything about him as the body he was using was just a slave one, so if he played his cards right he might be able to get the job easily, after all, there would never be too many corpse dispensers, every day people would die in the outer sect and their bodies would need to be disposed of. (...)
I sat cross-legged on the bed as I started to do a breathing exercise, even though the exercise wouldn't be as effective as devouring bodies it was still useful to further my cultivation and make me feel rested at the same time, due to the body's low talent it could only be trained with extreme cultivation techniques for it to get any results. It was unfortunate I had to possess such a talentless body but there was not much I could do about it right now, I was too weak, it was impossible to currently possess anyone else besides mortals.
I got up from the bed and waited, slowly time trickled as Chu Mang returned, his eyes widened as he already saw me up and about but he smiled as he looked at me:
"You recovered quite fast, it seems you can't wait to get registered, after all, it's an honor for mortals such as us to learn cultivation and join a sect like our Corpse Refining sect." Even though he said those words I could see that he didn't mean them, he was angry at the sect, angry that he got kidnapped and given such a shitty job, maybe the man had a wife a son, or daughter out there, now they were all alone to fend for themselves after he got kidnapped and thrown into the sect against his will.
Maybe he would be useful in the future, I thought to myself as I started following him to the place where I could register in the sect. (...)
Chu Mang walked slowly as Yun Jhin followed behind him, after a short while of walking they left the low leveled area of the sect and entered in the middle area, there they walked to a dark color painted pavilion with the inscriptions of some low-level formations here and there. There they met with a young man who helped them register, the man had a hooked aquiline nose and deep green eyes, his countenance was pale and he was hunchbacked, he looked to be around 25 years old as he made Yun Jhin drop some blood on a contract then he asked:
"Do you have any opinions on the job you want to get?"
The hunchbacked young man only asked in passing and he wouldn't do as Yun Jhin would say, after all, he thought that the young man would want an easy job that he could laze around in just like Chu Mang.
Chu Mang knew the hunchbacked young man talked about him when he asked Yun Jhin about what kind of job he wanted and didn't say anything as he put his head down, this hunchbacked young man had a good backing in the sect and he also had a cultivation of the 4th stage in the earthly realm, he couldn't say anything in his defense or he would be challenging the man's authority and he might even become a corpse later.
Yun Jhin slowly opened his mouth as a wronged expression appeared on his face:
"I wish.. I wish I could let my former mates from the low area to their resting place, I know it's a bit too much to ask but I feel like I owe it to them."
The hunchbacked young man eyes narrowed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"You want the corpse dispenser job? this is one of the harsher jobs for the 1st stage newbies, you might even get attacked by the zombies from the cemetery, and your former mates will become zombies that you will have to destroy in the future, do you think you can do that?"
The hunchbacked young man was testing the will of Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin's eyes started to water and shake as he said with conviction in his tone, seemingly as if he was ready to put his life on the line to get this job:
"I already lost someone important to me, and I couldn't let her body to her final resting place, my father and mother usually told me that this is the most important ritual so they could get to the afterlife safely, please let me do it for the others."
The hunchbacked young man laughed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"You won't last long in this sect with your mindset, very good, go haul some corpses, they should be still warm throw them in the cemetery after you hauled 100 corpses you can come to get some pills."
He waved some pills as he held them in his finger, they were food pills that were supposed to keep you full, they were better than normal food as they didn't need to be chewed and could instantly keep your stomach full for days.
Yun Jhin scoffed inside, such low-quality food pills he wouldn't even have fed his slaves in his dungeon in his former lives, Yun Jhin's eyes were curious as he looked at the food pill, the hunchbacked young man started to explain the benefits of the food pill then said:
"My name is Gamp Ping, remember the name kid, you will see me every time you haul 100 corpses, however, you only get food pills the first time, afterward you get normal food, so I suggest you keep these food pills for dark days."
Yun Jhin nodded his head quickly as Gamp Ping waved his hand indicating they could leave, Chu Mang walked away and Yun Jhin followed him slowly, Chu Mang face scrunched as he looked behind then he spat on the ground saying:
"Make sure to collect some belongings from the dead or that guy will cut your contributions, you will need proof or he will overwork you, *sigh* if I knew this before I wouldn't have accepted the guard job, he is basically making me work for free and only gives me the most basic amount of food, in the future little brother could you share some of your food with me?"
As Yun Jhin took a better look at Chu Mang he realized that he seemed quite thin under his robes and nodded his head, making friends with Chu Mang was one of his plans at manipulating the man, he needed some help inside the sect, as long as he continued cultivating inside in the future he could even take control of the sect leader and get a hold of the treasury of the sect, no matter how poor the sect was it should have some good things he could use towards his evolution. (...)
After I finished talking with Chu Mang about some miscellaneous things I went back towards the dilapidated houses and directly went and searched through each of them taking one corpse after another and throwing them outside, afterward I took the grouped corpses and started to carry them to the cemetery, Chu Mang looked with steely eyes at the sight and nodded his head at me, this only one of the few low-level places, as I walked towards the cemetery I met with other corpse dispensers who nodded at me as they threw the corpse away when we finally reached the cemetery.
Down below a mountain of rotting corpses could be seen, some of their skins were green and blistered full of pus, some of them were already skeletons, the smell that was coming from the mountain of dead bodies was nauseating, some of them even started to move, below I could feel the power of a formation pumping the corpses with death energy that could reanimate them.
I needed fresh blood and meat so I could only eat recently dead bodies for the corpse devouring cultivation technique, I ignored the decayed bodies and quickly devoured the corpse that I carried, the flesh was good but the body was also rather crunchy and dry, after all, it was a body which starved to death.
I would need at least 10 more before I could reach the second stage of the earthly realm, I licked my lips to clean them off the blood and got up from the hidden place where I devoured the corpse. (...)
Yun Jhin then continued back and forth devouring one corpse after another, after a while he was already at the second level of the earthly realm, bone-strengthening!
One needed tough internal organs then strong bones to handle the muscles that came afterward, another batch of impurities was spat out as black blood remained there it suddenly was absorbed by the ground, Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked down at the ground that absorbed his blood, the formation from below would use them to create a corpse toxin zombie, he looked forward to seeing this zombie kill some more apprentices, eating cultivators would make him stronger at a way faster pace!
Right now Yun Jhin was using the fastest and cruelest way possible to cultivate, he couldn't wait due to his status as a caterpillar, even though he was controlling the body who knew when the body's potential would end? it might not even reach the peak of the earthly realm, Yun Jhin could feel the body start to creak the stronger he made it, after all the cultivation technique he used right now was devilish and pretty taxing on the will, as the body had no will as he became a living dead that was controlled by Yun Jhin so the body couldn't cultivate the technique properly.
Technically speaking, Yun Jhin was forcefully making the body to cultivate the technique due to his connection with it, however, it might not be able to resist much further, the body had almost wasted all of his talents and without a true soul housing the body it would self destruct soon enough. (...)
Chu Mang could make a great new body, I could also reach Rank 2 or 3 of the mind-controlling caterpillar if I took ahold of him, but let's not waste this body yet, until it will explode I will still have use for it, Chu Mang body had a higher talent than Kitaro's body if it wasn't for my intervention he would have never been able to cultivate. But Chu Mang passed the talent test and even reached the second level of the earthly realm on his own. (...)
Yun Jhin already knew the next body that he would snatch. he chuckled as he finally finished carrying bodies for the day and he did as Chu Mang instructed taking some keepsakes from them and presented them to Gamp Ping, Gamp Ping grumbled under his breath as he presented the unknown caterpillar with a food pill and then waved his hand angrily telling him to leave, it seemed like Chu Mang would get in trouble for telling Yun Jhin about the keepsakes.
It was a good thing for Yun Jhin as the weaker the target the higher the chances for him to control their body, he felt glad that Chu Mang was such a fool who looked out for others, he would capitulate on that and take his body for his own!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Chu Mang
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin walked back to Chu Mang's home as he didn't get assigned one yet and sat down on the bed, Chu Mang came home rarely so he didn't come back even though he knew that Yun Jhin would stay in his house. Yun Jhin observed the food pill in his hand and shook his head, such a low-quality pill won't be useful for him, but he could use it on Chu Mang's body after he took over it. Yun Jhin waited and waited, as he controlled the body and cultivated his caterpillar form was changing Kitaro's cranium.
