Yun Jhin hated this persistent and prideful types, most of the time they wouldn't break down to torture and they would take important information down with them, sometimes not even the most painful sensation would defeat the wills of such warriors, they could be killed but not humiliated and Miao Suiren was one of these types of annoying people. (...)
I looked at the fool's prone form as he sat on the ground trying to regulate his breathing, what a waste of a fully useful servant, I shook my head as my arm directly went through his chest, torturing him would be a waste of time, I withdrew my arm and cleaned it off his filthy blood, Miedo was looking at me with wide eyes as he smiled and said:
"I knew father would defeat them easily, haha!"
I nodded in Miedo's direction as I looked down at Suiren's body and shook my head, creating another corpse king would take a year at most and I would have to waste resources too, it would be better to put those resources to increasing my strength rather than getting another subordinate, I would have minded if the fool gave me his allegiance but since he was stubborn only death could follow him. (...)
Yun Jhin picked up Suiren's body as he could devour it, even though he wouldn't be able to break through to the 2nd stage with his main body it could help him cultivate Sun Sishgeng's body into a true living undead.
As a living undead he could cultivate and think for himself, well he couldn't truly do it anymore as Yun Jhin controlled his body but hypothetically speaking if Sun Sisheng got his hands on the technique that could transform him into a living undead he could have thought for himself and still had his consciousness intact, he could devour others to quickly increase his cultivation base, his body would have been way sturdier he would have lived for a much longer time. The only downside would be that he couldn't procreate anymore, even as an undead he wouldn't have had the weakness that normal undead would have, that was the specialness of the yin constitution combined with the cultivation technique.
Yun Jhin got interested in the devil detonation technique he saw Miao Suiren use, it made him remember of the days he was dueling with the monarchs of the 9th hell, they would sometimes host wars between the lower hells and Yun Jhin would be there to spectate from time to time.
Only devil generals or above could impart such techniques to the devil slaves, but technically speaking this region was too backwater for the devil's attention to be garnered, there wasn't even a Ki Cultivating realm expert here which was the basic realm of the cultivation world, only from the Ki Cultivating realm and above you could be considered an 'expert' in the world.
Yun Jhin sighed as he devoured the body and then looked towards the direction of the sword devil sect, he would need to visit immediately!
Any devils he could find no matter how low level they would be, they would help him evolve into a devilish caterpillar, and that's was what he needed the most, that or either the fortuned or heavenly caterpillar transformations but it was very unlikely to achieve the other two, it was easy to sin but hard to become pure.
Yun Jhin told Miedo to keep the things under warps and announce how he captured one of the patriarch's killed the sect masters and annihilated the other patriarch, the other sects needed to know that now they were under the leadership of Yun Jhin's iron fist!
He would quickly go towards the sword devil sect to appoint a new patriarch no matter the cultivation he had and also investigate the devil presence there.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: The sword devil sect
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was ready to leave the Corpse refining sect and go directly to the sword devil sect and see what happened there for the patriarch of the sect to acquire such an 'interesting' technique, but first, he had to take care of some of the things at his sect before he went, after he finished everything he had to take care off he directly left the sect.
As he finally left the sect location he could finally see how it was outside, the sect was situated in the middle of the woods where heavy fog surrounded it, most of the time the fog would ensnare poor civilians who were courageous enough to venture so far into the forest before they became corpses for the Corpse refining sect, those were the rare cases as most of the time the sect members went by themselves to procure fresh corpses.
To get to the sword devil sect Yun Jhin had to get outside the forest and go to a nearby river, he needed to follow the river tail till he found a waterfall, there above the waterfall he would find the sword devil sect, at first, the sect wasn't called sword devil sect, but sword devil slaying sect, not much was known about why the sect's name changed but Yun Jhin knew as he absorbed some of Miao Suiren's memories, the thing was the memories of him learning the technique were missing seemingly erased, that why Yun Jhin wanted to go and investigate the sect.
Yun Jhin frowned as he ran out of the forest and found the river that led to the sect, as he ran alongside the river bed he thought to himself:
"Missing memories can mean just one thing, a Ki Cultivator or above expert, but he should have already left by now, a devil Ki Cultivator is above the normal standard when it comes to fighting power, fortunately, he shouldn't be at the sect anymore if it showed anything the Ki Cultivator devil should have been injured when he arrived at the sword devil sect..."
As he thought about it a clear image appeared in his head, the devil was injured but still strong enough to deal with the others, however, to not aggravate his injuries he bewitched the sword devil sect patriarch and the others taught them some techniques in exchange of resources that he could heal himself with.
But due to his cautious nature, in the end, the devil deleted all of the memories regarding himself, but he let them have the techniques as promised, they must have signed a contract, devils must always adhere to a soul signed contract, it was their only weakness, making them sign the contract was another thing.
Yun Jhin finally reached the waterfall's location after a few tens of minutes of running alongside the river bed, there he easily scaled it till he reached the sword devil sect, the sword devil sect was minimalistic as it had huts instead of palaces and pagodas, on the surface, it seemed way poorer than the corpse refining sect.
Yun Jhin snorted inside, this was a good way to make others think they were poor but with the memories of the patriarch, he knew that their resources were quite plentiful even after they gave some to the passing devil, as not many things would interest a Ki Cultivator, at his stage the resources on this patch of land would have quite a tiny effect on his body and cultivation base. (...)
The sentry that stood nearby the waterfall to wait for intruders immediately sounded a war bugle as I approached but when he saw my figure he froze up and his sword started to tremble in his grasp, I grabbed his sword and put it back in the disciple's sheath.
I looked over at him and said:
"Your patriarch is dead and now I'm your leader, call all of the disciples and elders, I'm here to appoint a new patriarch to control the sect while I'm not here, do you understand?"
Most of the disciples beside the new ones knew how the patriarchs of the other sects looked, so when the disciple saw me he almost pissed himself in fear, after all, he was only a stage 2 earthly realm rookie. I nodded at him then motioned with my hand, now his voice combined with the earlier bugle call it finally took the attention of the whole sect.
After the elders and other disciples came out of their huts I immediately jumped up on a nearby tree and made all of them look at me as I said with a loud tone:
"As of now I'm the patriarch of all of the three sects in the nearby vicinity, but my headquarters are at the corpse refining sect, I'm looking for the strongest elder in the sect to take the helm as the new patriarch while I'm at the headquarters." (...)
The elders started to talk among themselves as they whispered to each other:
"The patriarch and sect master is dead, no way!"
"They must be, Sun Sisheng wouldn't have come this way leaving his sect alone, *sigh* It seems our sect lost all our prestige and now we are the slaves of another."
Another young-looking elder looked indignant as he said:
"Why would we let ourselves be conquered by him, he is one man and we are many, let's fight him to death!"
An older elder slapped the younger elder on the head and said in a raspy tone:
"Shut your dumb ass up, you just advanced to the 6th stage of the earthly realm and you don't know anything about the heavenly realm, he must have broken through the 3rd level that's why our patriarch lost, we are pretty much doomed no matter how many earthly realm experts we throw at him, we would need heavenly experts to deal with him!"
The young-looking elder sulked as he looked at his feet and nursed the back of his head where the older man hit him, As Yun Jhin was already hearing whatever they were speaking he suddenly interjected:
"I was waiting for you to decide whoever is stronger not to gossip about my strength, if you won't choose by yourself I will choose myself."
His soul willpower engulfed the bunch of elders and then he pointed at a middle-aged man with sideburns and a small mustache as he said:
"You are at the 8th stage of the earthly realm and the current strongest elder, you will be the patriarch under my absence, come here and make your allegiance!"
The man wanted to say something but a formless power dragged him towards Yun Jhin and made him kneel, his soul space was opened as his consciousness and psyche were invaded by Yun Jhin's soul willpower, unlike heavenly realm experts, earthly realm rookies could be forcefully enslaved.
The man started kowtowing immediately as he was on his knees and said:
"Oh lord Sun Sisheng, might the heavens let you live a life as long as them, I Mandred Branco will follow your lordship anywhere I can go!"
Yun Jhin nodded his head as his eyes trained over the others and then he threw a pill he refined while at the corpse refining sect and said:
"Eat this pill and you should break through the 9th stage, there you won't have any opposition from the others."
Branco immediately ate the pill without any hesitation as strange sounds came from his skin bones and organs as they were all strengthened at the same time, a bright red aura enveloped him as he broke through to the 9th stage of the earthly realm!
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he said:
"All of you go back to whatever you were doing, I will have to check up on something in the treasury and I don't want to be disturbed, Branco keep guard for me!"
Branco nodded his head like a loyal dog, if he had a tail right now he would be wagging it furiously to show how happy he was to serve his new master. Yun Jhin climbed towards a man-made cave under the sect near the waterfall, that's where the treasury was located and the things Yun Jhin needed for his cultivation base to advance a bit.
Yun Jhin finally entered the cave and disabled the weak formations that were guarding it, he then looked around and nodded his head as he saw that the riches the sword devil sect had were more abundant than what the poor corpse refining sect had, he didn't need spirit stones nor certain pills, what he needed were some spiritual plants the sword devil patriarch encountered a certain while ago. As he looked through the piles of spirit stones pills and trinkets he finally found what he needed, 3 eyes grass, 2 forks snake chrysanthemums, and one blood devil rose, they could be used to make a pill which would propel him directly to the second stage of the heavenly realm. However he wasn't here just for these, he looked around for some more in the treasury until he found an old tablet bathed in crimson blood.
The engravings on it were the cultivation techniques of the devil detonating technique, as he looked at the engravings he muttered:
"Not Asmophel descendant, not Mulciler either, Brotokus? no Brotokus descendants don't know how to write at all, they are all dumb brutes, Milizhaus? maybe but not probably, Milizhaus hates humans and he would never let his tribe out of hell."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he tried to thread on which devil monarch let his descendant out of hell, but he shook his head continuously as he couldn't identify the caligraphy, that either meant the devil wasn't from royalty or he was a traitor who didn't want his identity to be leaked, all royals wrote the same calligraphic, and the common calligraphy in hell wouldn't let someone inscribe such engravings easily..."
A traitor from the devil royalty, interesting, Yun Jhin mused as he used his soul to inspect the engravings better when he noticed the crimson blood that looked fresh suddenly dry up, he frowned as he took a better look and he shook his head as he said:
"He died, what a pity, if he was still alive I could have used his blood to track him down when I was strong enough."
When such engravings dried up that meant the one who wrote them died.
Yun Jhin kept the engravings as he could teach them to the cannon fodder of the sects, the devil detonation technique was one of the techniques he recognized and could teach but if he had the cultivation technique inscribed directly he didn't have to waste his time engraving such a tablet himself as it would take quite a while. As he looked around and noticed he didn't need anything else he left the treasury and notified the sect that he will leave.
The sect elders and disciples took a deep breath as they watched Yun Jhin's receding figure and finally restarted their daily activities such as sparring cultivating and fishing.
Yun Jhin looked back at the sword devil sect as he now walked towards the direction of the fairies sect, he had to visit their treasury as well!
There was something useful there that he had to get his hands on, an artifact that would increase the speed of mending his soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 17: A female only sect
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin left the sword devil sect behind him as he started to travel towards the fairies sect, the fairies sect stood at a bigger distance as it was the most remote sect in the distance, it stood in a distant clearing in the forest almost at the end of it, while the corpse refining sect stood in the middle and the sword devil sect stood outside.
Yun Jhin started to run towards the fairies sect without any rest as he had to get his hands on the artifact that would help to mend his soul faster, he would be able to increase his cultivation speed with the artifact, atleast in the heavenly realm. As he controlled the fairies sect master he had all of his memories so he already had a mental map with the location of the sect.
It took him almost 4 hours to get to the sect location and he there he met with a bunch of frightened females, most of them didn't know why their sect master would come back alone and he immediately put them to gather materials, most of the time their sect master took great care of them.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the clueless females and he sent a mental command to Nao Mao to immediately explain what happened. Nao Mao came out of the main building of the sect which was a white temple and sent out an announcement to everyone:
"The leadership of the sect has changed hands, I am now serving leader Sun Sisheng of the corpse refining sect, he has come to visit come and kneel to him!"
Yun Jhin jumped directly near the temple building and Nao Mao went to his knees directly as he put his forehead to the ground, the females of the sect were wide-eyed as they saw their sect master kneeling to someone.
Most of the females were rather sheltered and they only came to learn cultivation for beautifying reasons, the sect master accepted them and thus a sect was created, as time passed the sect master finally found someone who could take his mantle, it was the warrior woman that was killed at the Corpse refining sect.
The sect was pretty much useless now as its only combatant was Nao Mao, the women were only good for gathering jobs as they didn't have much combat ability, it was because they didn't like fighting they just didn't want to cultivate for fighting reasons, they came here because they wanted to lead a longer life and look younger for more time.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the women eyeing him, some of them were ready to try and seduce him but he sent a command to Nao Mao, the feminized man got from his kneeling position and said:
"Go and find the herbs and materials I have sent you to find, master Sisheng needs them, don't loiter around here!"
Yun Jhin nodded and then left Nao Mao as he directly went to the sect treasury and looked around, even though it wasn't poor it wasn't as rich as the sword devil sect's, he quickly found what he came for, it was a blue marble that looked like it had liquid inside of it.
One of the disciples found it when she went for a walk, she thought it looked cute so she took it, when the sect master found about it he thought that it was special but he didn't know what uses the marble had so he left it in the treasury, but Yun Jhin knew.
It was a low ranked natural treasure that could help the heavenly realm practitioners refine their soul faster, it was useless after the heavenly realm and it was of low rank so the increase of speed wasn't anything phenomenal but even a mosquito was still meat, no matter how tiny the increase was it was still an increase in speed.
He found another useful plant that he took from the treasury, it was an ice lotus. After he got what he wanted he left the fairies sect behind and went back to the corpse refining sect where he started to use the materials he gathered. (...)
First I must concoct the pill and use it at the same time with the soul marble to increase the speed of cultivation, to reach stage 2 the pill is useful, afterward if they find the plants that I need I could concoct more pills that would get me through the heavenly realm but up till then I will have to cultivate by myself with this marble. I sighed as I looked down at the marble, I was currently in the Corpse refining sect treasury as I used a cauldron to concoct the soul rising pill, it was a one time use pill to rise the cultivation level by 1 level, but for me, the 1 stage rise was something that couldn't be compared to others.
I finished concocting the pill after a few hours of toiling under the heat of the cauldron. (...)
The pill was a deep red color as Yun Jhin's main body came out of the patriarch's ear and ate the pill a change directly happened to his caterpillar body as flames started to engulf it, impurities seeped through his skin as his cultivation started to slowly inch towards the second stage of the heavenly realm. After his skin burned off and a new layer of skin appeared he directly went back to the patriarch's cranium where he entered a session of cultivation that lasted almost 2 weeks.
After 2 weeks of cultivating, he finally entered the second stage of the heavenly realm. Yun Jhin sighed as the host body couldn't eat the pill so he didn't gain anything from this session since it was a one time pill if he had more materials he could concoct another one for the body. He looked at the remaining plants, the ice lotus, and the blood devil rose.
He needed 5 more components to start on the corpse transforming pill all of yin nature, he already gave out the order for them to be found but they were considered pretty rare around these parts, unless he got lucky he would have to leave the sect behind and go on a journey himself to find the rest, as long as his cultivation advanced to a certain range he would surely leave the sect behind, there was no reason to keep himself tied to this sect, there were no benefits as the place was too trashy.
Even though the concentration of ki in the air wasn't bad he was lacking too many resources to further his cultivation. He also needed certain body constitutions and or materials so he could evolve his main body those were extremely rare even where his past life came from, he would surely not find them here. Yun Jhin shook his head, there was not much for him to do so he entered a normal long closed-door cultivation session.
Months passed by in cultivation as he breathed in and out the ki of the world, with the help of the marble, the rate at which he mended his main's body soul increased every day, by the time he reached the peak stage of the heavenly realm he might be even able to use 1% of his former soul power.
However the progress towards the 3rd level of the heavenly realm was too slow, the caterpillar's potential wasn't high enough to his liking but the others didn't find the materials he needed to upgrade his main body, he was left out with only waiting.
Suddenly outside the sect, a big commotion started.
A young girl looking to be around 16 to 17 years old was killing disciples left and right, her eyes were red with malevolence as a blood-red color aura enveloped her body as she shouted:
"Where is the man you kidnapped, where is Chu Mang? WHERE IS MY FATHER!"
She shouted as he threw a giant fireball onto one of the tattered buildings at the outer area and thoroughly burned it down, she started rampaging inside the sect as if it was her backyard, the blood-red aura intensifying with every kill.
Startled out of his cultivation by Miedo, Yun Jhin could only go outside and see what happened, when he heard the girl's cries of Chu Mang, he realized that the young woman was the daughter he saw on the man's pendant, Chu Mang was talented and it seemed his daughter inherited some of the man's talent. Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he observed the blood-red flame-like aura enveloping the young girl and a smile appeared on his lips as he muttered:
"So he didn't die but got assimilated instead, strange very strange, did the resources from the sword devil sect didn't heal him properly?"
Getting assimilated was the same dying for a devil, however when getting assimilated there was a chance for the host to be enthralled and enslaved by the devil's will and lose their mind to the devil's control.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he approached the young lady, the aura she exuded looked like something a Ki Cultivating realm would have but on that was only on the surface, it was the waning power of the devil that she somehow assimilated when the young girl saw Yun Jhin she almost attacked him instinctively but Yun Jhin's words struck her out of her stupor:
"I know where Chu Mang is, he is one of our dear elders, as he already advanced at the 9th stage of the earthly realm, this young lady does want to go meet him?"
The aura on the young girl started to subside as she heard those words, but suddenly she seemingly heard something that made her blood turn cold as her eyes glared at Yun Jhin:
"YOU ARE A LIAR, YOU KILLED MY FATHER!"
Yun Jhin frowned as he used his soul to observe what happened in the young girl's consciousness and like he guessed a devil was sitting cross-legged inside her psyche, he was whispering words trying to influence her thoughts as he healed the nasty sword scar that almost bisected him.
Yun Jhin's soul was stealthily investigating while the devil was healing himself and trying to influence the girl at the same time so he didn't get found out. Yun Jhin frowned, it seemed the devil found out he was lying using his clan's techniques, it was a racial thing as all devils knew when someone lied to them, it was quite a bullshit ability that could only be countered if the one who lied to the devil had a higher cultivation than the devil.
The young girl was ready to attack Yun Jhin but a thunderous snort directly attacked her consciousness space as it made the devil act and block the attack, his wound was ready to open as he had to block the soul attack and Yun Jhin said with a righteous air around him:
"Your body hosts a devil coming from hell, you are a sinner and you should be exterminated, but I can help you expunge the devil out of your body and forgive you for killing some of my disciples, Chu Mang, your father betrayed the sect and almost assassinated me trying to steal our newly created corpse king, it's not my fault I had to fight back to save myself, it was all done in self-defense."
The young girl frowned as she looked at Yun Jhin, the devil was silent and that meant he was telling the truth, technically it was the truth as Yun Jhin was speaking using the body of Sun Sisheng.
The girl, however, didn't react as reasonable as she should as rage smoldered deeply in her soul finding that her father was dead only added fuel to the fire as she suddenly appeared near Yun Jhin and thrust her arm like a spear directly to his heart.
Yun Jhin dodged at the last nick of time as he looked at the girl and said:
"Don't say that I didn't give you a way out girl, as you are possessed by the devil it won't be much time before your body gives out, from what I see you are only a second stage earthly realm, abusing the power that the devil gave you, the devil will either absorb your consciousness and take over your body or cripple you!"
However the girl wasn't listening to any of that as her mind was now fully controlled by the devil's whispers, she was trying to kill Yun Jhin before her body gave out, the devil inside her wanted to use her body to jump into Yun Jhin's and take over it!
That was what Yun Jhin was betting on...

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Outsmarting a devil
chapters.content:
As devil was currently controlling the girl no words would shake her out of her stupor, maybe only if Chu Mang was here but that wasn't going to happen but Yun Jhin still had a plan as he mimicked Chu Mang's voice and he said:
"Darling remember when we first got you to the fields so you can see a rabbit?"
Tears started to drip out of the girl's eyes unconsciously as the voice struck a chord in her heart and she whispered:
"Papa?"
Suddenly Yun Jhin appeared in front of her as he cut one of her arms off! The girl clutched her stump as the devil directly ignored her soul and took control of her body as a raspy voice came out of the girl's mouth:
"Aren't you a smart human cultivator, taking advantage of the girl's weakness and then disfiguring her instantly, I like you human, your body would be a very much needed aid to my recovery."
Yun Jhin snorted as he looked at the devil as he said:
"Thinking you can take my body devil? I know what you have done to the sword devil sect, I have the cultivation technique you left behind right here and I already taught it to some of my disciples."
Some disciples came forward as they inched closers to the controlled girl's body, they were glowing red as if seemingly ready to explode. The girl frowned as he observed the canon fodder disciples inch closer to her body, the devil shook his head as he looked at the disciples and said:
"So the sword devil sect changed hands, whatever, I know how to easily counter the technique."
He snapped his fingers as the glow on the disciple's bodies faded away, the disciples looked down at their hands wondering what happened to their technique. Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he said:
"What have you done devil?"
The devil chuckled as he didn't say anything and started attacking again, using the girl's body he savagely tried to choke Yun Jhin's body, the speed increase of the girl's body was exponentially bigger than before as her skin started to melt and drip on the ground near, some of the skin even dropped on Yun Jhin's robe and hardened immediately.
Suddenly from the girl's forehead, a devilish red face quickly entered the consciousness space of the patriarch to only find nothing there, a chuckle came out in the empty consciousness space as soul willpower directly struck the devil's body, the wounds on his body opened immediately as he shrieked in pain, his physical body was ejected from the patriarch's consciousness as it appeared on the ground near the dying girl's body.
The girl dying throes were ignored by Yun Jhin as he got up from the ground dusted himself scrapping the dead petrified skin from his robe easily, he looked down at the devil that was clutching his wounds, he looked like an insect with sharp claws and teeth, no maw could be seen as only his teeth were visible, he had wings on his back and as he stood down there on his back he looked like a cockroach who couldn't get up after falling on it's back.
Yun Jhin's hand directly hit a meridian point in the body of the thing, clogging his blood flow and slowing his regenerative abilities to nothing, he stood there writhing in pain as Yun Jhin told the disciples to disperse, the corpse of a devil was very useful to the current Yun Jhin, especially that he was a Ki cultivating expert.
Yun Jhin dragged the body back to the treasury under the wide-eyed stares of everyone, elders and disciples alike, even his 'son' Miedo didn't know what to say to his father as the door to the treasury locked itself.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked down at the downed devil and his arm directly went to the being's skull as it crushed it and he absorbed the soul, the information from the soul wasn't very useful as bits and fragments here and there were destroyed, it seemed not only was his body injured so was his soul, Yun Jhin grumbled as he didn't find the information he wanted, the current location of the entrance to hell!
The entrance to hell would shift locations every 100 years and he wasn't sure how much time passed since he was reincarnated so he wouldn't waste his time to go and find the former entrance to hell as there was a chance his journey would be in vain!
The soul of the devil didn't have much information so after he fully absorbed it he used the remainder of the soul energy to mend his soul by quite a bit, even though it was damaged and fragmented he felt that he was halfway to the third stage of the heavenly realm.
As his main body left the patriarch's body he immediately went to devour the devil, the taste of the meat was different from humans, it was acrid and it smelled horribly, the bones were though and hard to crunch, the blood was acidic, the wings tasted like sandpaper, devils weren't things that he liked to eat, even in his former lives, only devils found other devils to be delicious, but when they got ahold of human meat they even stopped eating themselves as they found each other to be too disgusting.
As he finished the devil's body he felt that he was only a hair away from breaking through to the third level, as he used his nutrients to quicken the mending of his soul instead of strengthening his body, he was already at the max rank of the current caterpillar form so he didn't need anything else before evolving.
[Host devoured a middle-level devilish entity at the Ki Refining realm, body extremely damaged, nutrients insufficient for the host to evolve to a devilish caterpillar, host needs to eat 500 whole devils above the host's current cultivation base to evolve into a devilish caterpillar!]
The devilish caterpillar could reach rank 9,500 and it was one of the strongest known caterpillars, however, it wasn't the strongest, there was still the celestial caterpillar which could reach rank 9,999 and the fortuned caterpillar which was the strongest caterpillar that could reach the max rank at 10,000.
However, to reach these caterpillars was impossible as technically speaking he had to eat celestial beings at the god realm, there weren't even that many celestial beings in existence, there was a very low chance for him to become a celestial caterpillar as for becoming a fortuned caterpillar that was out the question as well.
Where would he find 999 other fortuned ones to devour? technically speaking fortuned ones were born each 500 years, so that meant he would have to live for 500,000 years to be able to devour 1000 fortuned ones.
The average lifespan of a god realm cultivator was 100,000 years and the most Yun Jhin reached in his former lives was 200,000 years, that was with the cultivation of multiple bloodlines and constitutions that he stole, he was basically at the peak of longevity that a human could reach, even though he could technically live more being a caterpillar he still couldn't live to 500,000 years, let's not even speak about the fortuned one's locations, even though he could identify them when he saw them, he would have to see them first!
As Yun Jhin looked down at the ground where the body of the devil stood he shook his head, the devil had nothing on him anymore, all of his belongings were either used up or destroyed when he fought with the one that injured him, Yun Jhin could use more materials from hell to hasten this current body of his into the transformation of the living undead, he would mostly have to use this body until he could either find a more talented one or evolved from his mind-transforming caterpillar form.
Yun Jhin took a hold of the opportunity of devouring the devil and strived to break through to the third level of the heavenly realm, with the marble in his hand he used it to mend his soul faster as he sat cross-legged.
After 3 months of continuous cultivation, he finally reached the 3rd stage of the heavenly realm and sighed as Sun Sisheng's body reached the 4th level. He knew that he couldn't get stronger anymore in this environment, it was too poor!
He might even need to leave the sects earlier than he planned, due to the good fortune in form of the devil's body and soul he became way stronger than before and gained another stage of cultivation, however, the material that he sough-after wasn't found at all, he thought that his subordinates were mostly useless, how couldn't they find the plants he needed?
He just needed a few more plants to be able to concoct the pill so he could transform Sun Sisheng's body into a living undead. Yun Jhin sighed as it was time to take the bull by the horns and go into a plant harvesting adventure himself, his subordinates weren't reliable at all when suddenly Miedo banged on the door of the treasury as he said with joy in his voice:
"Father, one of the disciples from the fairies sect found one of the plants that you wanted, she came here and awaits for your orders!"
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he heard that, this was an interesting coincidence, the moment he wanted to go adventuring himself, one of the plants he sought was sent to his door, he left the treasury and met with the woman that got her hands on the plant, she was a small woman that stood at 1,57 meters and she had a fair complexion due to the cultivation technique she trained in.
Her body wasn't that hot as her chest area was as flat as a board and her thighs weren't thick, she looked like a little school girl that hasn't matured yet, the girl's hands were trembling as she presented Yun Jhin the dark flower that he needed, it was a Yin Corpse flower that required the gathering of both Yin ice energy and Yin corpse energy to grow.
Yun Jhin patted the girl's head and indicated for her that she could leave. The girl didn't even say an eep as she left with her head down, she bit her lips and left the palace. Yun Jhin looked at her receding back and said:
"Give her 5 food pills and 10 spirit stones, also do her one favor."
Even though Yun Jhin was an evil overlord he couldn't keep his subordinates starved if they put in good work or else they would revolt against him, he did try that once in a former life and he had to kill all of his subordinates in the revolt making him having a harder time gathering information and resources.
Yun Jhin then went back to the treasury as he left the plant with the others, now he was only missing a dragon flower, white ginseng, an undead worm flower and a maggot of the highest level. These were the main ingredients needed to create the corpse transforming pill combined with the others that he already had such as the blood devil rose and the ice lotus, now that he had Yin Corpse flower he was closer and closer to his goal of transforming Sun Sisheng's body.
Even though one of the ingredients was found Yun Jhin didn't want to loiter around waiting for the other's to be found as one year or so already passed since he gave the order for the materials to be found and only one of them was found after such a long time!
He needed to take on the fields himself and find the materials, his lifespan was limited and he couldn't waste it on waiting, he already learned this from his former lives, no matter what he did the faster the better!
In the end, death would come no matter in what form, death on the battlefield, death peacefully in your bed, death by assassination, etc.
So rushing to complete your goals was the best way of cultivating, of course, rushing cultivation would leave sequelae and impurities but with the pieces of knowledge, he gained from his former lives Yun Jhin could neutralize all of them!
After he made sure he kept the ingredients in a good location he left the sect behind as he exited the forest and went to a nearby city, maybe there he could find some of the ingredients he needed, as they couldn't be found in the wild that meant either mercenaries or herb pickers might have picked them by accident thinking that they could be valuable, he already visited both sects and took as many spirit stones as he could.
He needed to get his hands on a spatial bag these days.

chapters.title: Chapter 19: First time in the city
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin knew where the city was as he devoured the memories of multiple people, even though some didn't leave their sects in their life, some of the others did travel before they settled down in their sects, with the help of those memories Yun Jhin immediately made a mental map that could lead him to the nearest city.
As he left the forest Yun Jhin realized that the city stood almost 1000 or so kilometers away from the forest entrance, it would take him almost 3 hours of running at his quickest speed to reach the city, but it didn't matter much for him, as long as he found what he needed in the city.
Yun Jhin running speed was quite normal for the body's cultivation realm, but as he used a technique his speed increased by quite a high deal, instead of reaching the city in 3 hours he would need 1 hour and a half now, Yun Jhin nodded to himself as he continuously used the technique without regards of the usage of his ki, after all, he had some food pills with him that he could use to quickly regain his ki, even though they wouldn't be useful to advance his cultivation with them they could increase the ki recovery.
As Yun Jhin approached the city he finally met with it, it didn't have any high walls protecting it, it looked a little like a village instead of a city, it seemed the place he got reincarnated in was a backwater place of the highest degree and one of the worse parts of the empire he currently lived in. Before he went to the apothecary to find if they have any of the plants he needed he first had to get his hands on some important information that he couldn't find in the sect patriarch's memories.
He found a rogue gathering quite quickly as the city locations were easily identifiable to him, the rogue gathering immediately became respectful after he unleashed his full cultivation base showing them that he was at the 4th stage of the heavenly realm, as strong as their city lord, the rogue captain immediately came forward and asked:
"What does this patriarch want with our small rogue gathering?"
Yun Jhin nodded at the man as he said:
"I just want some up to date information about the empire and nearby cities, as well as a map of the empire."
The rogue captain frowned as he said slowly:
"While information about the empire and cities is doable a map of the whole empire isn't something we little people could get our hands on, if you want one you would have to talk with the city lord."
Yun Jhin just nodded and waved one spirit stone in his hand, the rogue captain gulped seeing the spirit stone and he said quickly:
"The emperor is currently recovering after a war against our neighbor empire, his son has taken the crown and is doing a great job as a supplicant emperor, the nearby cities had high unrest as they heard about the emperor's injuries and it looks like they might riot soon, after all, the son is too young and most people don't think he could take care of the whole empire by himself, some say they should let the right minister take control of the dynasty until the prince becomes of age."
His eyes dilated as he looked at the spirit stone and continued:
"As for our small city, the city lord decided to not put himself in an awkward situation and didn't join any side as he remained neutral, Long Sunwing, the city lord is a banished royal from the imperial palace, he was banished due to unknown reasons to us small people, this is the most recent information we have, could I have my payment now?"
Yun Jhin nodded as he split the spirit stone into two and threw one part at the rogue captain, the rogue captain wanted to say something but Yun Jhin's words made his throat stop:
"You would have gotten one spirit stone if you would have a map of the empire, however, it seems your rogue guild is lacking, forgive me for not giving you the full payment, but if you want some more spirit stones you would have to do some jobs for me which you couldn't deliver."
The rogue captain started to sweat as he heard Yun Jhin's cold tone and he took the half of the spirit stone and retreated as he bowed and left hiding through the shadows. Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked back and directly went to the apothecary's location.
He would make sure he got his hands on the empire's map after he found if the apothecary had the plants he needed, as he walked around the small city he saw that most buildings were either dilapidated or directly broken down, most of the city's population was looking to be starving from their skinny bodies, beggars could be seen on the streets keeping their hands out, most of them gazed into a single place as they were dead, from time to time some patrols would come and take the beggars bodies away, most of the normal people would avoid the beggars, even the unmoving ones.
In the past, some of the beggars would go crazy and even eat human flesh, directly attacking their brethren to survive. After a short while of walking, Yun Jhin found the apothecary's place, it looked quite better compared to the other buildings, seemingly as if it was new, with the words 'apothecary' painted on a board above the entrance of the building, Yun Jhin entered the place and met with a young man who stood behind the desk, the young man had clean white clothes and a face mask over his face of the same color, mortals couldn't breathe in too many odors of different plants or else there might be a strange reaction that could happen in their body.
Yun Jhin immediately listed on all of the plants that he needed and waited for the young man to do the inventory, with good luck Yun Jhin got his hands on most of the things he needed the dragon flower, white ginseng, and undead worm flower, however, the highest quality maggot couldn't be found at the apothecary, it would most of the time be found inside either a high-quality corpse that has rotten for a long time or if a maggot was especially fed a type of body part until it burst apart when it burst apart there was a low chance it would lay its progenies, then if you were lucky one of those progenies would have a chance to grow into a high-quality maggot.
It would be better if he could find a tomb with a cultivator of the same stage as him, that would make him save a lot of time, as the young man packed Yun Jhin's plants and gave out the price Yun Jhin frowned, the price would almost take away all of his spirit stones but he didn't say anything as he paid for it in full, he didn't have the strength to go against the empire yet, he wasn't even a ki cultivating expert yet so he could only adhere to the law, however, if he could have he would have stolen the whole apothecary, unfortunately, he didn't have the space mirror that he used to strut around with. In his previous life if he saw something he liked he would throw it in the mirror's space!
Yun Jhin left the apothecary, then directly went to the city lord's house, he didn't waste any time as the guards at the front pointed their sabers at him and inquired why did he approach the lord's house when his cultivation base aura struck the guards and made them whimper like dogs, they immediately entered the courtyard of the house and came back with the captain of the guards who bowed and said:
"Might I inquire why is this hero coming to the city lords house?"
Yun Jhin didn't beat around the bush and said that he had been in closed-door cultivation for a long time and he needed some fresh information that only the city lord would know. The captain left and came back after a few minutes then invited Yun Jhin in.
The city lord was a spirited middle-aged man with a strong figure, he had a small beard on his face and long black hair tied in a ponytail at his back, he wore normal official clothes which consisted in a big yellow robe with the words of 'city lord' on them.
The city lord warmly invited Yun Jhin to tea inside his house and said:
"What do respect do I commend for the corpse refining sect patriarch to visit my humble abode?"
Yun Jhin didn't bother with the formalities and said directly:
"You should know that I don't usually leave my sect, I just want some information about the empire and the map, it would be helpful for me if you didn't know I already subdued the other two sects near me, the sword devil sect and the fairies sect."
The city lord nodded his head seemingly knowing what happened, after all, he still had scouts inside the woods who would report on the happenings of the sects, sects were most of the time lawly abiding the empire but the strongest sects would look down on 'mortal empires' such as the one that Yun Jhin lived in currently and invade them just for the disciples to have a good time, most of the elders would look down on the treasures of such empires and they would keep the powerhouses of the empire in check while the disciples would run amock.
As Yun Jhin waited for the man to explain the situation in the empire he suddenly heard a dark chuckle coming from the man's mouth:
"Don't you feel a little bit lightheaded, Sun Sisheng?"
Yun Jhin drank the tea the city lord offered and his eyes narrowed as he looked insides his host body, it was a chunk of poison that he immediately eliminated, Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked at Long Sunwing and said:
"Nice, very nice, I see why you were exiled, however unfortunately for you such weak poisons don't work on me, it seems I was a fool trying to work this peacefully, *sigh* well the dynasty can't blame me."
Long Sunwing looked confused as he looked at Yun Jhin's host and he was ready to attack with a hidden weapon when Yun Jhin spat a senbon needle out of his mouth which impacted the man's throat and killed him, the body snatcher then refined the man into a corpse and slung him over his shoulder, since he decided to take things like this he would take them to the end, but based on the way the man was exiled and isolated to such a shit place nothing would happen to Yun Jhin, he would maybe even get rewarded, the royal house forbade siblicide in the open but that didn't mean the siblings couldn't hire someone to kill each other.
After he looked around the city lord's house Yun Jhin left with a spatial bag full of spirit stones and some high-quality food pills, also a new possible corpse king, as they were both at the level 4 he could rush the corpse king creation at the cost of a cultivation stage, it wasn't worth to do so with stage 2 and 1 experts so he ate their bodies before. Their strength would reduce too much and even peak 9th stage earthly realm rookies could deal with such corpses.
The guards looked horrified as they saw Yun Jhin leave the house with their boss slung over his shoulder like a bag of potatoes, the dark grey skin of their boss indicated that he was now an undead!
Yun Jhin smiled as he devoured the man's soul and got his memories, he now knew exactly how the empire worked, even though he was a low-ranking imperial he still had some good information about the inner circle of the Long empire.
The guards didn't dare to attack Yun Jhin as he already killed their boss so they could only look to the other side when Yun Jhin walked by them and whistle, Yun Jhin liked how the guards kept their place and patted both of them on their shoulder and said:
"Good job keeping watch, your city lord had great guards, you are however now relived of your posts."
He threw half a spirit stone to each and went to his way, with the number of spirit stones he got right now one spirit stone didn't mean anything to him, he just felt happy that he got a spatial bag and the information he needed directly without any problems so he decided to make a good act out of his infinite benevolence.
As he left the city behind him, Yun Jhin continued to absorb the memories and see how the man offended his superiors and make sure there will be no problems in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: How to get a high-quality maggot
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin entered the forest with the city lords body slung across his shoulder, he hummed a happy little tune that he learned in his previous lives as he walked towards the corpse refining sect, now that he had the body of a relatively high-quality practitioner he could create his maggot!
However not any maggot would do, he needed to find the fattest one that he could in the sea of corpses, it would also need to be deep green indicating that it ate quite many cultivators' bodies.
After he got back to the sect he left the body back into the treasury, Miedo and the elders didn't let out a peep as he came with a body slung over his shoulder, it didn't matter that the body wore the outfit of a city lord, they knew better than to question their patriarch as they still remembered how the corpse king decapitated the traitors. Even Miedo was quite shaken inside at that moment.
Yun Jhin made his way to the corpse sea and started freely swimming in it as he looked for the special maggot, his soul willpower engulfed the whole mountain of corpses as he searched for the peculiar feeling that the green maggot would exude, after a long while of searching he finally found what he was looking for, the green maggot, however, it was too small it seemed to be almost dead as well but Yun Jhin knew what to do to resurrect it.
He immediately took it to the city lord's body and made it eat some flesh, then miraculously the maggot started to peep as it came back alive, it drilled into the man's skull and started to eat him from the inside slowly, it would be better to get the maggot for the pill instead of making him a corpse king, after all, if the dynasty wanted to put the crime on him he would just deny it because there was no evidence, and the duo guards from before would keep their mouth shut for sure unless they thought they could relocate their families and relatives by themselves.
Yun Jhin was currently an overlord in this backwater place, he already sent Miedo to take over the city, and a message came back that he successfully became the new city lord as the citizens wouldn't riot, with things being like this no messages could leak to the higher-ups of the dynasty, and even if some did, they wouldn't investigate or send someone that strong to such a lowly place as it would be a waste of resources, even though the war with the nearby kingdom was 'done' on paper that didn't stop the kingdom from sending assassins and other hidden attacks to disrupt the peace of the dynasty.
It was unknown what happened as the kingdom was way smaller than the dynasty but supposedly the kingdom was owned by a sect with the same strength as the empire, the sect was angered as the empire attacked their kingdom and now they were ready for revenge! That's how the emperor got injured and why most of the officials didn't look favourably on the prince's position, most of them wanted to give up on the throne and the empire and join the sect! After all, their strongest expert was defeated and almost killed!
Yun Jhin pondered what happened in the empire as he heard the maggot gorging itself on Long Sunwing body and he caressed his host's short beard that he let grow. He could profit from this, as the clam and sandpiper fought the fisherman would catch both. However he needed to finish the transformation of the yin body and cultivate it to the qi cultivating realm and above, he atleast needed to reach the peak of the body's potential which was the king realm before he could contend with the sect and the empire.
However as long as he transformed the body he would be able to go on a devouring spree, the yin body needed fresh flesh and blood to cultivate it to completion, most of the people who went on this path were fiendish killers with no way out to advance their cultivation, but what Yun Jhin wanted was the quickness that the cultivators of this path attained.
Yun Jhin kept slowly cultivating as he waited for the maggot to grow to its full length and potential, months passed by as the maggot grew to 1 meter tall and fully ate the man's body, the maggot started pewing aggressively as it threw itself at Yun Jhin ready to tear into his body as well but a finger stopped it as it fell on it's back and it started shrieking. Yun Jhin immediately poked it three times in its fat tummy making it stop moving.
The high-quality maggot looked almost dead as it stopped wriggling and Yun Jhin nodded to himself as he took out all of the ingredients from his new spatial bag, he then used the cauldron as he heated it and he started putting the ingredients in one by one, lastly, he would put in the green fat maggot and a vial of his blood and stir them together, as the fire intensified under the cauldron the combination started to coagulate and harden into a form of a half green half white pill.
Yun Jhin smiled as he took the pill from the cauldron and observed it, then he used a cultivation technique to inscribe it with a few formations lines and infused it with a bit of ki. Suddenly the pill started to glow with an ethereal half and half-light, one part deeply green while the other white.
As he observed the pill for any impurities he nodded to himself as he put it in his mouth and directly swallowed it, inside Sun Sisheng's body strange changes happened, his skin broke as he became a red man his flesh and blood ready for all to see, but after a while, new gray flesh with a certain armored pattern appeared on his body, his heart stopped pumping fresh blood as the blood transformed into a deep grey color, his canine teeth grew to fangs that protruded out of his mouth, his hair turned a deep silver color as his eyes turned red. His hands became claws as the armor pattern on his skin turned into tattoos, finally, after a few months, the bodily changes stopped as the body cultivation peaked at the 5th stage of the heavenly realm.
Even though the body achieved a cultivation breakthrough, Yun Jhin's main one was still at the 3rd stage even though he advanced in it he didn't gain anything from the body breaking through, while his cultivation would be shared with the body vice versa wasn't possible, but it did increase his cultivation speed even though it was even below the marble's increase.
Yun Jhin took a mirror out of the pile of treasures and looked at his host's new body, he nodded and opened his mouth as he looked at his tongue which now had a hole in it, this was the way the living corpse would feed, with the hole in his tongue he would extract the nutrients from his targets body till it would turn into a dry corpse and it transformed into dust.
The pill fully transformed him into a living undead, as he looked at his claws that would grow stronger along with his cultivation, he even hit his chest a few times to see how though was his new body, it sounded just like a piece iron hitting another piece of iron.
Yun Jhin threw the mirror away as he took all of the spirit stones out of the corpse refining sect treasury and initiated a meet up with all of the elders of the sects, from the fairies sect to the sword devil one, everyone was invited, he made the excuse that he broke through and he needed all of his subordinates to hold out a giant banquet.
After a few days, everyone was gathered, when they saw Yun Jhin coming out of the treasury looking like a corpse monster everyone took a few steps backward, but then the formation of the palace he inscribed a few days priorly activated and made them all trapped like turtles in a jar.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he walked down near the elders and said:
"I shall let the banquet commence right now, the first and only food that would be served would be... all of you."
Yun Jhin's tongue shot of his mouth as it impaled an elder and drained him all of his nutrients, the man couldn't even scream as he became a dry corpse then turned into dust, all the elders started panicking, as the one who berated the young elder at the sword devil sect trembled and said:
"We are done, we are done, the patriarch cultivated an evil technique that requires human sacrifices!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the elder, the man was smart but unfortunately, this was the fastest way for the body to reach the 9th stage of the heavenly realm, afterward, he could just go hunt other sects while the empire was in disarray and get stronger and stronger!
He never intended to keep the sect's alive after he finished the transformation of his living undead corpse.
Most of the elders tried to run away and escape using the doors but they were all closed and wouldn't budge due to the formation, Yun Jhin's tongue started to drain elders of their nutrients as more and more piles of dust appeared in the hall, Miedo fell to his knees as he kowtowed and said:
"Father please spare me, father please spare me."
He had gigantic tears in his eyes as they flowed freely down to his chin and he said:
"Think about what mother would say in this situation father, please spare me for the sake of my mother's request, before she died of that illness!"
Yun Jhin seemingly pondered for a second but then his tongue impaled Miedo in his chest as his nutrients were drained but with his last amount of power Miedo said:
"Why?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked down in his eyes and said as he was transforming into dust:
"Because I'm not your father fool."
Dying knowing the truth Miedo's eyes widened as he fully transformed into dust.
The elders were like headless chickens as they tried every possible escape route, they even tried to dig through the foundation of the palace and escape!
Yun Jhin continued feeding as he ate more and more elders, finally, after a while only Nao Mao and the corpse king were left, Nao Mao and the corpse king were both on their knees as they waited, Yun Jhin made a swift motion with his tongue as they both transformed into dust.
Dark eerie energy engulfed Yun Jhin's body as his cultivation base increased, the 6th stage, the 7th stage, and the peak 9th stage!
There it stopped as Yun Jhin breathed out a dark mist that immediately corroded the pillars of the palace!
He left the palace behind as he left the sect's surroundings.
Then he left for the sword devil sect as he emptied the treasury of the most important items, and he did the same with the fairies sect treasury.
Afterward, he left the forest through the northern parts where the fairies sect was based, according to the map he gained from the city lord, his city was located at the southernmost place of the dynasty, to get to the capital he had to go north!
The capital was where he would unleash himself without any consequences, all of the higher elites ki cultivating masters were either dealing with the sect fighters or the assassination attempts, they could at most dispatch some early-stage elites that he could use to break through the body to the ki cultivating realm!
Even though his main body lagging in cultivation as long as he had Sun Sishengs body slowly but surely he could catch up, and if he could find hell's entrance it would be even better!
However it was very unlikely, as the empire had at most a middle to early level King Realm expert so it couldn't even be called a middle-level organization, and only god realm or above organizations were privy to hell's entrance!
There was a chance for such information to be had by middle level or below organizations only if they were favored as a subordinate of a god-level organization but from what it seemed the Long Empire didn't have such luck, nor did the sect with the same power as the empire. If they were favored the god level organization would have already intervened and made the other organization bow down.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he thought about these things and made sure he was on the right way to the capital, as it had the highest population of cultivators, there he could either accumulate enough resources or eat a ki cultivating expert!

chapters.title: Chapter 21: On the way to the capital
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin checked the map again as he walked on a forest trail, he was quite far away from the capital and even at his fastest speed it would take him up to a month to get to it on foot, Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the map and muttered to himself:
"If I had my dragon mount..." If he had his dragon mount he would have arrived at the capital in nanoseconds, but that was just him reminiscing about his past he knew there was no chance to get his dragon mount back as it wasn't even dried bones anymore by now.
Yun Jhin kept running at a quick speed as his surroundings changed around him, the trees became sparser as he left the forest and entered a plain, there he met with a merchant caravan that he ignored and continued on his way to the capital, however, to get to the capital he had to go through a few cities that he couldn't avoid, or else it would take him a long time to get to the capital and Yun Jhin was a caterpillar that didn't dilly dally around.
He wanted to avoid cities due to his monstrous form that he was hiding using a cloak, unless he got to the ki cultivating realm he couldn't use his technique to hide his living corpse features, at the ki cultivating realm experts could start to transform their body using ki making them able to change their physical features, but that was only for the people who got their hands on such cultivation techniques.
Yun Jhin entered his first city after a few days of traveling and looked around, even though it looked better than the one near his sect it was still a pretty run-down city, he shook his head as he quickly looked around and found nothing worth noting of the city and left.
As he traveled Yun Jhin found more similar cities and as he got closer and closer to the capital he realized that the cities got better and better in quality of architecture and the living conditions of the people, the closer he was the more he realized how the empire worked, it was pretty much a normal monarchy where the nobles were kings and the civilians were treated worse than shit.
This was one of his favorite type of empires, most of the emperors of such empires were pretty self-centered and selfish, they would only look out for themselves making it easier to do things outside their bubble if Yun Jhin took a hold of the sects nearby the capital as long as he didn't attack the capital immediately he could grow in power enough to take over the empire by himself.
But he couldn't alert the sect that was fighting with the empire or else there would be problems, after all, the sect wanted to take over the empire unless the king realm expert fought and injured each other he would lay low no matter what, the emperor of the empire was already injured but that didn't mean he would go down when he was going to be attacked, he should have some aces up his sleeve.
Yun Jhin stopped at another city on the way to the capital where he found some plants that he ate with his main body, those plants strengthened his soul mending speed and put him closer to the fourth level of the heavenly realm.
After he looked around the city some more and found nothing else that could help his main body he tried to leave but somehow the city lord got a hold of his location and invited him to his palace.
Yun Jhin didn't refuse as he met with the city lord, just like the former city lord his family name was Long, all city lords were imperials, and the closer they were situated to the capital the more favored they were by the true imperial family.
This guy was quite close to the capital so he must be a quite important fellow to the imperial family, Yun Jhin wondered why he would get invited as he didn't do anything in the city but when he met with the man and heard his words he smiled inside, it seemed he was right.
Long Mansing was your average greedy fatty, he looked oiled up with dark slick back hair, he wore a flowered robe and had an amiable smile on his face, his small goatee and stature enhanced his funny look.
The man smiled as he immediately went to the subject and said:
"Sect leader Sun Sisheng of the Corpse Refining sect, my men heard how your son took over that city south of here, what was it called again? Slums something or whatever, we don't care about such a lowly city but we also heard you have killed the former city lord."
The man smiled as he walked forward to Sun Sisheng, how did he know about what happened was pretty normal, the rogues of the city must have put the information for auction and after it was bought it shared with everyone of importance.
Long Mansing stood up near the window of his office and said:
"You might have heard that the former city lord was isolated there as punishment, you have done a great favor to the right minister by silencing the man, even if you didn't know, I'm not sure why you are traveling to the capital but the right minister is looking forward to your visit, he also said that you can visit him at the palace at any time as he needs people of your caliber on his side."
The man smiled as he slid Yun Jhin a spatial bag that Yun Jhin grabbed and nodded at him, under his hood his red eyes were observing the fatty as he said:
"I might wonder if this city lord has any new information about the capital?"
The fat city lord chuckled as he kept his hands behind his back and said:
"Of course, as my city is quite close to the capital I get news way faster than the others, might I inquire what this sect master needs?"
By the looks of it, the dynasty was pretty desperate if they wanted to rope in sects from all over the counties.
After all, not all patriarchs reached the heavenly realm in such sects, most of them were at the peak of the earthly realm stuck there, even though the place Yun Jhin considered backwater was pretty bad there were worse places out there, Yun Jhin eyed the fat man before asking:
"I have heard the emperor is injured, might I know if he will come out of seclusion soon, I'm worried about the safety of the empire."
The fatty snorted as he looked at Yun Jhin's hood that was covering his face and said:
"Our emperor was injured due to the traitorous actions of one our generals, but he was already executed, as for his injuries he should heal himself soon enough, by that time the people who threaten our empire should be dealt with."
The man was full of bullshit, from what he could hear in his tone he was trying to force himself to think that it was true, from his tremblings lips it seemed that the emperor was injured quite lethally, Yun Jhin nodded to himself, the harder the fall of the emperor the harder he would hit the aggressor back when he would come to execute him.
Yun Jhin was ready to take his leave as he cupped his fists to the city lord, the city lord smiled and did the same gesture as he waved to Yun Jhin and let him leave as he muttered:
"To think that the empire fell so low we have to recruit this savage patriarch's from these lowly sects without even a ki cultivating realm expert *sigh* will the empire fall?"
Unknowingly to him, Yun Jhin heard every word that he muttered, Yun Jhin left the man's office and then the city as he shook his head, it seemed it wasn't going to be easy to eliminate the emperor and the other party, as he thought about it he realized that the emperor might not be the only king realm expert of the empire, however, he didn't have any further information, the only way to get more would be to join a faction in the capital.
Yun Jhin wasn't against joining factions, as he could leave them whenever he wanted, even if his temporary body would die he could just onto another one, but for now he would need to get more materials to evolve his mind-transforming caterpillar into a higher tier of the same race.
There were still some types of mind caterpillars that he could reach but he needed special material's such as white soul ginseng, death water of middle quality, and some eyes of a spiritual creature.
Those weren't rare materials but considering the location, he was in they might as well be extinct to him.
Yun Jhin frowned as he left the city and looked on the map, only a few more days before he would reach capital!
He walked through plains, he walked through some mountain zones and some other forest trails until he finally reached the capital.
The capital wasn't that beautiful but it exuded opulence, the giant gates that were open as they weren't in war times officially, Yun Jhin shook his head as he observed the opulence of the capital, with the money and resources they wasted to beautify the capital they could have created some more experts!
He looked around as he counted the materials used, golden sand, soul marble, dainty ice, dragon scales rock.
The gates were painted with two dragons intertwined, one was red and one green, they looked like they were fighting and embracing at the same time, Yun Jhin wasn't sure what did they signify as he didn't research the history of the empire.
After a while of traveling, Yun Jhin finally reached the capital!
Coincidentally as soon as he reached the capital he met with an allay of people who were carrying a sedan chair with an extremely beautiful woman on it, her white baby clear skin, blue eyes, and long flowing blonde hair made her look sexy and innocent at the same time, Yun Jhin stopped a nearby netizen of the capital and asked him about the event:
"It's the main princess, Long Mumu, the one that the emperor dotes the most on, ah, just look at her beauty, it says that after her mother died the emperor went into such grief that he almost killed himself, but when she smiled at him all his grief went away and he returned to being the same emperor as before, maybe even more benevolent!"
Yun Jhin shook his head, what a good way to brainwash the citizens he thought, then he eyed the allay that was going deeper and deeper into the capital and approached the main palace. Yun Jhin's eyes sparkled as he thought about a plan to get inside the palace faster, this was one of the former abilities that lead him through hard times when he was weak.
But with his current body's appearance he couldn't do it, he needed to first break through the ki cultivating realm, after he made sure he memorized the layout of the capital he walked towards a shop that sold information and asked:
"I would like to know about the nearby sects, would this brother be so kind."
He waved a spirit stone in the air and the man at the desk nodded his head as he said:
"Well there are 5 sects that are nearby the capital, as for this brother's heroic aura I would recommend the Divine Feather's sect they are the strongest sect nearby and they have a patriarch at the 5th stage of the Ki cultivating realm."
That took the Divine Feather's sect out of his list as he couldn't attack the sect, or his body might get destroyed, he couldn't deal with a ki cultivating expert at the 5th stage.
Yun Jhin continued to look at the man as he waited for the information of the 4 other sects, the man continued by saying:
"The second sect would be The righteous sword sect their patriarch is at the 4th stage, then the beast taming sect, 3rd stage patriarch, the reliance sect with a patriarch at the 2nd stage and most lastly the dragon eating sect, this one of the sect's that I wouldn't recommend this brother to join."
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed at the name, dragon eating, that meant the sect was directly going against the imperial family, quite an interesting thing.
As Yun Jhin inquired about the sect's name the shopkeeper was ready to tell him the story as he eyed the spirit stone and said:
"This friend would have to pay the whole spirit stone for all the information."
Yun Jhin nodded at him and threw him the spirit stone, then the man cupped his fists and started his story.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: The tale of the dragon eating sect
chapters.content:
The information shopkeep started to talk about the dragon eating sect:
"It's the other son of the emperor, he, well he got jealous of the crown prince and tried to attack him, so he went and created this dragon eating sect as a type of revenge on his brother gaining the throne after his father went into seclusion."
The shopkeep shook his head as he said:
"The sect can't even be called a sect, the young man created it out of spite and he has some of his loyal subordinates protecting him, it's more like a child playing house, but he sent some flyers here and there saying they recruit, most of the free practitioners wouldn't approach his sect though."
Yun Jhin nodded at the shopkeeper as he left the shop and thought to himself:
"A very good way to infiltrate the palace, I can kill the son and take over his identity after I get this body to the ki cultivating realm, it's way better than trying to seduce the princess, it's simpler and takes a shorter time too."
As Yun Jhin finished his plan he left the capital and directly went to the headquarters of the dragon eating sect, there he met with some guards that looked like they came straight out of the empire's military because they did, they were subordinates of the general who had to take care of the second prince.
They immediately shouted at Yun Jhin:
"Halt who dares to trespass into the territory of the dragon eating sect, state your name and business!"
Yun Jhin stopped and put his hands up as he said:
"I'm a now wandering pugilist called Sun Sisheng, I have heard this sect requires personnel and I would like to join it!"
The guards looked at each other, and thought, did this guy read one of their flyers? one stood at the gate as he observed Yun Jhin and said:
"Our sect master will invite you for an interview if he agrees for you to join."
The other guard came back after a while and said:
"The sect master agreed and he would like you to come inside."
The inside of the sect wasn't anything grand as the second prince didn't have enough time to create a proper sect, inside the main hall of the shabbily built palace stood the second prince on his throne, he was a well built tall young man looking to be around 17-18 years old, he had short silver hair and a fair countenance, he also had deep blue eyes and wore a yellow imperial robe.
Behind him stood a man that burst with muscle, his face was hidden under a samurai mask and his heavy armor didn't do anything to impend his muscles as it seemingly plied on his body, he was the general that was supposed to protect the second prince, he was one of the weaker generals as the prince fell out of grace so he was only at the 1st level of the Ki Cultivating realm.
The prince got up from his sect as he looked Yun Jhin up and down and said:
"You have come to join my sect but it seems you aren't that honest with me, what's with that cloak hiding your body? Do you have something to hide?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"I have trained in a special undead technique, sect master please bear with my looks."
He dropped the cloak from his body showing his horrid visage to the prince and the general behind him, the prince observed him with a critical eye while the general's eyes looked as steely as before, as he identified his cultivation realm which stood at the peak of the heavenly realm.
The second prince clapped as he looked at Yun Jhin's body and marveled:
"How interesting, such a corpse technique existed in this world? you are living undead, very interesting, very interesting, why would you want to join this prince though? You should have heard what happened between me and my elder brother."
Yun Jhin nodded as he opened his mouth said:
"Yes I have heard what happened between your highness and your royal brother, but I have also heard Long Sunwing was the one who offended you, I know you are good friends with the minister of the right, even though the minister invited me directly to his home I'm of lowly standing and I didn't even break through to the Ki cultivating realm yet so I'm too ashamed to present myself to the minister of the right like this."
At the mention of Long Sunwing the prince's eyes clouded over as he finally remembered the name and laughed:
"Oh, I remember now I got a report saying that Long Sunwing was killed, so you were the one who did it? marvelous indeed he was a cousin of mine so I couldn't kill him myself as it would have angered royal father, but you killed him so it has nothing to do with me right?"
He winked at me and said:
"So you want to connect yourself to the minister of right through me? Quite smart of you, you are also at the peak of the heavenly realm from what my guard told to me, with the resources of the imperial palace we could make you a ki cultivating expert."
Yun Jhin bowed as he kept his fists cupped at the prince and said:
"Your highness, my cultivation technique requires special nutritious objects, I want to join the war efforts and serve the dynasty as a soldier, I know this is a sudden request that shouldn't be even appointed towards your highness, but I do not want to go through the normal joining efforts, I would like to join your highness personal guards."
The prince looked at Yun Jhin and took a pondering look on his face, he would need a special unit with Yun Jhin at the head, from his observation he realized that Yun Jhin was stronger than the average 9th stage heavenly realm and he didn't break through the Ki cultivating realm yet, how strong would he be then?
The prince continued looking at Yun Jhin as he waved his hand at the general behind him and said:
"Welcome our friend to the dragon eating sect, however for his other requests I would have to ponder some more by myself, get him something to cover himself in our sect colors, also make sure you help him break through to the Ki cultivating realm sooner than later, at that time based on the results I will give him a satisfactory answer."
Yun Jhin bowed again and followed the general that waved to him, the body snatcher followed the general towards a rather luxurious room as he said:
"You are one of the first disciples with such a high cultivation base, so you can be the second sect master, here in the room you will find a robe of our sect, I will send a maid to modify it so you could hide your appearance, I will need some time to get the needed materials to help you breakthrough, what do you need?"
Yun Jhin's passive face turned into a deep smile as he said:
