"Any corpses at the 9th stage or above, a corpse of a Ki cultivating realm expert would immediately propel me near the Ki cultivating realm."
The general nodded his head as he looked at me through the slits of the helmet and said:
"Quite a strange cultivation technique you have there my friend, you wouldn't mind if I."
Suddenly he attacked with lightning quickness as his hand directly went to Yun Jhin's neck, the man clasped Yun Jhin by the neck and picked him like one would pick a little chick. The man's eyes narrowed as he said:
"I Bong Susang never saw such a peculiar cultivation technique that can transform one into a living undead, where are you from Sun Sisheng, you can't be a normal patriarch from a small sect at the borders of the empire, you also came to the capital fast based on your cultivation base, you are trying to infiltrate the imperial family?"
He sneered as he clutched his neck harder and said:
"Tell me who sent you? The Heavenly turtle sect? the Bagan Empire?"
Yun Jhin shook his head and said, he didn't need air as a corpse as he unclasped the man's hands from his neck using his superior body strength, the man didn't use his Ki as he thought he could easily deal with a 9th stage heavenly realm practitioner.
Bong Susang's eyes widened as he looked at his hand and then at Yun Jhin as he said:
"I have underestimated you, but that won't mean I'm done with you."
He started powering up his ki as he was ready to start a fight here and there when Yun Jhin opened his mouth:
"I have gained this cultivation technique during one of my travels outside the sect, I have based my sect on the borders because I have heard about a tomb of an expert in corpse refining, luckily with tens of years of searching I finally found the tomb with the corpse technique, I'm not sent by anyone, you can ask the spies you have near that region, this is my first time in years I have left the sect grounds."
Bong Susang narrowed his eyes as he took his helmet off his head showing his scarred bald head and mutilated face then he said:
"If you aren't a spy then I will give you my apologies, but up till then my men will keep an eye on you."
Bong Susang lived through countless wars since he was a young man, he became extremely paranoid and immediately suspected something when he saw such a high-level patriarch would like to join the army, most of the time patriarch's from small sects would be too prideful to do such things on their initiative, as they would rather be the head of a snake than the backside of a dragon.
The general would immediately get in touch with the spies at the border to make sure what Yun Jhin said was the truth, the man abhorred traitors and spies as a traitor that turned out to be a spy was the one who got the emperor injured. As most of the soldiers from the army were brainwashed into loving their emperor, especially as the emperor had quite a high martial might, most of them wanted to be taken as apprentices by the emperor so they could learn the imperial cultivation technique.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he entered the room and cracked his neck, even though the hold on his neck didn't hurt him it made his neck rather stiff. He knew such things would happen if he tried to suddenly join the imperial family but the best way to destroy them would be from the inside. He just had to go through some screens but they wouldn't be able to find anything on him as his past was pretty clean, the disciples didn't even know the elders were eaten as they thought they were all in closed-door cultivation, and the patriarch left for greener pastures so they could do whatever they wanted.
Yun Jhin knew he was already in the army at this point, he just needed to wait for a little to get his confirmation.

chapters.title: Chapter 23: The second prince's worries
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin cultivated in his room after the maid came and changed his outfit to fit him better, Bong Susang was making his way towards the communication place, there he directly connected with the spies at the border of the empire and asked them about Sun Sisheng.
However he came out empty-handed as the information he gained gave Yun Jhin a very strong alibi and confirmed his words, the general shook his head, maybe he overthought this, he went back to Yun Jhin's room where he knocked a few times then said without entering the room:
"I'm sorry for my previous actions and I welcome friend Sun Sisheng in the army! As for your request, I will try to do my best to get my hands on the goods."
Yun Jhin followed by responding:
"No hard feelings general, after all, you just tried to protect the benefits of the imperial family and I can respect that I will wait for goods news from you."
Yun Jhin kept himself in his room as the general left and met with the prince who said:
"So is he a spy?"
Susang shook his head as a strange light appeared in his eyes and responded to his liege:
"Most likely not but there is something fishy about him, I would like to continue observing him if his highness agrees, what does your highness have to say about this?"
The second prince looked at his most trusted general and shook his head as he said:
"If you keep your men observing him who will protect me from the assassination attempts? Do you know my elder brother almost lost his head yesterday if it wasn't for eldest uncle timely help?"
The general wanted to say that he wasn't as important as his eldest brother but he kept his tongue as it would only anger the young prince, then he shook his head and left the prince alone, it would be quite bad for him if he angered the prince for no reason, after all, he was still the man's guard.
Yun Jhin eyes opened as he stopped eavesdropping on their conversation and nodded his head and thought:
"It seems the imperial family isn't dumb when it comes to their safety, this would make my job harder, hmm."
He thought about taking over the prince's body but if he did he wouldn't be able to leave the sect grounds or they would realize the man is braindead afterward, he needed to evolve to a stronger caterpillar form before he took over his body!
While the second prince was worrying for his safety Yun Jhin concocted a plan on how to take over the man's body, but he would need the general to be away so he wouldn't be able to sense the soul fluctuations.
Yun Jhin kept himself in his room as he waited for the bodies that were supposed to be delivered to him, after a few days of waiting for some bodies were delivered by a soldier from the army, before he soldier left Yun Jhin stopped him and said:
"I would also require some of these materials, a soul white ginseng, yin strengthening paste, death water of middle quality, and some amplifying paste."
Yun Jhin didn't know the formula of stronger caterpillars but he analyzed the powers and characteristics of the caterpillar forms he knew and then he thought about the materials that could technically make his current caterpillar form go into the direction that he wanted. It didn't take him much time to finish what he said when the man scratched his head awkwardly and said:
"Death water is a quite rare material, brother Sun I will have to report to the general first, the other things can be given as fast as possible but the death water..."
Yun Jhin nodded his head and waved his hand indicating he wanted to be left alone, as his mouth opened sickly crunching sounds could be heard behind the door as the man started to shake and ran away sweating heavily.
Bang Susang snorted as he heard the soldier's report and said:
"Death water of middle quality? where does he think he lives, does he think he is a member of the imperial family? Second prince, what I should do with his request?"
The second prince looked at his nails as he cleaned them with a knife and said after he finished:
"If he wants death water it should be to advance his undead physique, just like all cultivators all he wants is to further his cultivation, it's quite normal in my opinion, we can give him the death water, I already have a batch waiting for me at home, but can we give it to him for free? Soldiers should work for their meal!"
Yun Jhin finished the bodies as he looked towards the second prince's location and narrowed his eyes, putting me to work huh, he thought.
Yun Jhin wasn't lazy but he didn't want to go on any suicidal missions if he got any mission that was out of his scope he would directly leave and try to steal the death water, afterward he would come back and take over the prince's body!
Before he could reformulate a plan the general's voice was heard outside his door as he said:
"I have heard your request and the second prince is inviting you to a briefing."
As Yun Jhin finished the bodies he decided to follow the general to see the second prince, he left his room behind as he met with the prince in the main building, the prince was admiring his nail's as he didn't even look at Yun Jhin as he said:
"If you want death water I have a job for you that you must do before I can give it to you."
Yun Jhin waited for the man to say what he wanted before he responded, the prince took the silence as an affirmative response and he said:
"You see my good general here identified some rebels inside the Heavenly Feather's sect, they work for the heavenly turtle sect if you didn't know the heavenly turtle sect is the sect that backs up the kingdom that we went to war with, we are in this situation due to their interference."
The man frowned as he said:
"The sect patriarch protects his subordinates even though we have hard evidence against them, it's because they are his foster sons, I have one job for you, go and assassinate them and the death water is yours, they deserve death for betraying the empire and becoming such traitorous dogs, even though sects aren't under the empire's hands, on paper, they live on empire's land and they are the empire's citizens."
The prince frowned as he continued:
"Betraying the empire is the highest grade of crime that currently exists, so they have to take capital punishment, do you understand Sun Sisheng? I want their heads presented to me before I will give you the death water, you can refuse this mission but who knows when there will be another easy mission like this? With such a huge reward to boot!"
Death water was used in many things, formations, pill refining, healing, etc. It was a very important material that the imperial family wouldn't easily part with, technically speaking, what the second prince wanted from Yun Jhin was extremely simple as the other people from the imperial family wouldn't give away their quota of death water even if they were held at sword point.
Yun Jhin knew that the Divine Feather's sect had a 5th stage patriarch, if he offended the man he was pretty much lost, he looked at the prince and said:
"What if the patriarch realizes I was the one who killed his foster sons and wants to kill me? Who will protect me?"
The second prince shook his head as he said:
"As I said I won't force you to do the mission, maybe if you broke through to the Ki cultivating realm you could easily deal with the traitors as you could shape yourself with this cultivation technique."
He waved a book in front of his face as he used it as a fan, but then he coughed as a bunch of dust left the old tome and entered in his mouth, then he threw the book away as he shouted at the general:
"Damn it Susang, didn't I tell you to get me a fresh copy?"
Susang shook his head as he said:
"This is the freshest copy my liege, no one touched the library section of the body transformation techniques in years, not everyone has the constitution to use these type of techniques."
Yun Jhin snorted inside, it wasn't the constitution but the inability of those people to understand the technique, he grabbed the tome from the ground and looked through it, he shook his head inside, it wasn't that they were dumb. The technique they used was broken, it was fragmented and it couldn't be used no matter how talented the man who trained in it was. It was a useless piece of garbage.
But he didn't say anything as he pocketed the book and bowed to the prince:
"After I break through to the ki cultivating realm I might be able to train in this technique, with my living undead physique I should be able to do it!"
The prince smiled as he looked at me and said:
"Then I will do my best to get you the 1st stage Ki cultivating realm body that you need, Susang, I know my elder brother got his hands on a body of an elder from the Heavenly turtle sect, it was the assassin that uncle dealt with, make him spit it out, tell him what happened here, he will understand, right now he can't send anyone to assassinate these two curs but with the help of Sisheng here things are now doable."
Susang nodded and left after he bowed to the prince, the prince then looked at Yun Jhin and started to chat with him about his past, Yun Jhin used Sun Sisheng's memories perfectly and even had to act here and there to make things look true on his part.
After a few hours of waiting the prince got bored with chatting and told Yun Jhin that he could go back to his room.
After a day of waiting Susang still didn't come back, 2 days, 3 days, 4 days...
After 2 weeks Susang finally came back, coincidentally Yun Jhin broke through to the 4th stage of the heavenly realm with his body that day.
Slung over his shoulder in a body bag stood the corpse of the elder that attacked the crown prince, he looked embarrassed as he scratched his bald head and said:
"I'm sorry, second prince but your elder brother couldn't be convinced easily, he said that he wanted to show the body to his father as a trophy but with the help of the right minister after a lot of arguing and going back and forth I could finally get my hands on the body, I'm sorry again for making you wait so much."
Technically speaking without the interference of the right minister Susang wouldn't have ever got his hands on the elder's body because it would assist the second prince to grow in favor in the eyes of the emperor after he heard of his deeds, this was something the eldest prince wouldn't ever want to see, he already got a hold of the taste of power and he wouldn't let go of it easily.
He might even break the rules directly and he would go himself to kill his brother, after all, the cultivation difference between the eldest brother and the second prince was enormous, while the second prince was at the 7th level of the heavenly realm the eldest prince was as strong as the patriarch of the Heavenly Feather's sect!
Busang excused himself as he delivered the body to Yun Jhin's room.
Busang then left as he didn't want to watch the grisly scene of a monster like Yun Jhin eating the body of another human being, even though he killed countless people in his time, there was a difference between killing and eating humans.
Yun Jhin looked at the corpse of the elder and licked his lips, this was his ticket to the 1st stage of the Ki cultivating realm, afterwards, he could finally start moving freely in the capital!
Well as freely as he could under the 'protection' of the second prince.

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Ki cultivating realm 1st stage
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin started feasting on the body as his teeth started to rip and shred the meat of the bones, he swallowed and munched on the meat as his body started to glow a peculiar red light, the bones crunched under his sharp fangs, a sickly sound could be heard as he drank the blood like it was water, the meat was hard but his teeth were sharp so he could chew it easily.
After the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm the body will be refined again using the inner ki one would cultivate at this stage, it was way stronger than the outer ki you would use to cultivate your body at the earthly realm as it was of higher quality.
As Yun Jhin feasted on the body inner ki started to appear in his ki pathways around his body, a fire started to burn inside his stomach area that went and extended to his whole body, at first the blue fire was weak but as he feasted on the body parts and reached the bones the fire increased it's an intensity to a point that his ki pathways started to visible harden, they became just like pipes in a machine that couldn't be dislodged, this was a benefit of the living undead constitution.
His ki pathways couldn't be broken by inner ki attacks that would attack his organs so his ki circulation couldn't be disturbed reducing any ki deviation and inner injuries.
As the body was finished Yun Jhin sat cross-legged on the ground and he started to cultivate, the inner ki started to quickly work in his body's ki pathways, as it spun faster and faster his face and skin tone started to change his fangs disappeared as the claws retracted, he returned to his former appearance, but then it changed again!
He became a hunchbacked old man with white hair, his voice became hoarse and he looked like he had one foot in the grave, he nodded to himself as he felt the transformation and reverted to his former appearance as he left his room, he met with general Susang and said:
"I have finished cultivating, I'm ready to set out and deal with the traitors."
Susang looked at Yun Jhin up and down and nodded his head as his appearance thoroughly changed and he could feel the 1st stage ki fluctuations from his body and said:
"I will inform his majesty, I will go and get the map of the layout of the heavenly feather's sect, and also some information about the habits of the men you have to kill."
He looked around before saying:
"We can also give you some weapons to make the assassination easier, we have quite a lot of hidden weapons that could help you in this situation, just tell us what you are more experienced with."
Yun Jhin got some hidden weapons from Susang and the map and a scroll with information about the targets.
As he read through them he burned the map and the information scroll afterward then made sure all of the weapons were hidden properly on his body, then he left for the heavenly feathers sect. it was nearby the capital for about a 50 minutes walk but with Yun Jhin's new speed and power he got to the sect in 1 minute.
He stood in the shadows as he observed the sect and according to the layout he used the surroundings to hide, the formations around him were no problem as he easily saw holes through them that he exploited, as he thought about the formations he sneered:
"They didn't give me information about the formations, they thought that they could test me here and even get rid of me, I will make sure to reward them properly later."
He easily dodged the formations and got near a courtyard where the men were supposed to be relaxing, as they were under the protection of the sect master they had guards near the courtyard's door 24/7 but Yun Jhin didn't need to go through the door, his body turned spectral as he went through the wall!
Assassination techniques weren't his favorite but he had quite a high proficiency in them as one of his former lives embraced this type of attacking technique, however, due to the limitations of the techniques the former life ended dying before he even achieved the god realm, which was pretty much a failure in Yun Jhin's opinion.
Yun Jhin looked as two men were doing a certain activity inside the courtyard and shook his head, a different type of people exist everywhere and he wouldn't judge them but he came at the right time to end them, while they were distracted with their 'wrestling' Yun Jhin threw two kunai's direct to their necks, their arteries easily cut as two fountains of blood worth amount of blood appeared on the ground, he looked at the disgusting scene and nodded his head as he left, turning spectral again he left through the shadows.
Suddenly as there was no more sound coming from the room behind them the guards entered the verify if anything happened to the darlings of the sect master and he gagged as he saw what happened, not only was the image disturbing to the guard, two men, atop of each other naked with their throats slit, but the guard immediately stopped thinking about the image and started trembling!
He was dead as well, the foster sons of the patriarch were dead and he was going into their footsteps soon!
Instead of letting his death be arbitrated by the sect master he took his sword and driven it through his stomach committing suicide.
Yun Jhin was already away from the sect quickly reaching the dragon eating sect grounds as his form changed from the hunchbacked old man that he used to kill the traitorous duo and went to his normal human form of Sun Sisheng.
He met with the second prince and bowed as he said:
"The deed is done, you can send some spies to confirm, I couldn't take their heads as it would have alerted the patriarch of my presence, their location was littered with formations that could have been triggered if I entered unknowingly."
The second prince smiled as he nodded his head and said:
"After the kills will be confirmed I will get someone to send you the death water, of course, their death is very sad, our empire lost two great men."
He sarcastically said as he waved his hand indicating that Yun Jhin could leave him alone, Yun Jhin bowed again as he left after he got his hands on the death water combined with the other materials he could finally evolve his main body's form again!
Susang came quickly as he approached the prince and kneeled as a victorious smile appeared on his face:
"Sisheng didn't lie, he did it, our spies in the sect confirmed the duo's death, um it was a little bit strange but their death was confirmed anyway, will you truly give him the death water? Your highness, you should know that the water would be useful for you as well."
The second prince shook his head as he said:
"I promised him the death water and I cannot go back on it if I will my future subordinates believe in me? It's just some death water, next month there will be another batch."
Susang nodded his head as he looked at his liege and asked:
"Should I go and collect this month's worth for you?"
The prince nodded and waved his hand indicating that the general should go and as he said. The general bowed and left the prince behind.
Yun Jhin nodded his head inside his room as he eavesdropped on their conversation, he was ready to go and kill the duo if they refused, he would take control of the prince using his remote control and eat the general, then he would use a fodder soldier to get the death water.
Yun Jhin waited as Susang entered the palace after a few hours of waiting but his face was red with anger as he reported to his liege:
"I'm sorry my liege I... I failed you, such a simple request, the princess said that she wanted some beautifying pills and she took your death water quota, when I came there she was just retrieving the death water and I couldn't stop her or else she could have even tried to execute me."
He dropped to his knees as he started kowtowing and shouted:
"Please punish this subordinate."
The second prince frowned as he looked at Susang and said:
"Sister Mumu? I remember she doted on me when I was small, why would she?"
He frowned as he thought about it and then he shook his head as he said:
"Did she got roped into elder brother's faction?"
Susang stopped kowtowing as the prince waved his hand and said:
"I'm not sure how are we supposed to explain things to Sun Sisheng, after all, he did his job and we don't have the pay for him, this will turn things awkward between us, as cultivator who practices such an evil incantation I'm not sure how he will react to this, after all, I know that such techniques tend to warp the user's emotions quite a lot, even if he is at the early stages."
The second prince frowned as he started to think about what he could do to help Yun Jhin get his death water, he looked at Susang and asked:
"Is the black market selling any contraband death water?"
Susang frowned as he looked at this liege and said:
"Your highness you know that the contraband death water is extremely expensive, it might even cost us 90% of our funds."
The second prince frowned as he heard this, he still needed funds to rope in other cultivators in his sect, this was a job the right minister gave him to infiltrate in the inner circle of the outside sect and invite them towards the side of the empire, his job was to get the sect's to fight the enemy kingdom and defend the empire if he did that he might get a chance to overthrow his elder brother as the crown prince.
That was the promise the right minister gave him!
Yun Jhin frowned inside his room, the princess took a hold of the share of the second prince death water, this was a troublesome matter to him, but he broke through the ki cultivating realm so he could act on his first plan, he had a lot of seducing techniques in his arsenal and the young princess shouldn't be able to resist his charm, after all, Sun Sisheng wasn't an ugly man.
Yun Jhin left his room as he seemingly got in the moment the duo was talking about how to get him his reward, the imperial duo looked awkwardly at each other as they spotted Yun Jhin entering the hall and they coughed awkwardly as they said:
"You didn't hear our conversation did you?"
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the duo, his expression told them what they needed to know and they sighed as the second prince said:
"I cannot do much about what happened, friend Sisheng, please don't get mad, I will try my best to get my hands on another death water vial."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the man, he knew he was just bluffing right now, he wouldn't want to waste his money on a 'subordinate' like him, even though he did his job they were skimping on payment, it wasn't their fault but Yun Jhin was still quite angry, but he decided to rein in his anger as he said:
"I wonder if the second prince could make me and princess Long Mumu meet, I might be able to persuade her to give back the death water and even join the right minister's side."
Susang frowned as he said:
"You eavesdropped on the whole conversation."
Yun Jhin just smiled at the man's words, Susang shook his head, they were in the wrong on this one so it didn't matter if Yun Jhin eavesdropped, these were things he needed to know anyways. The second prince took a better look at Yun Jhin and said:
"You want to talk with my sister? It can be done quite easily, but my sister is quite fickled and ill-tempered, I wonder how will you charm her into giving you the death water and even betray my eldest brother?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he said:
"I have my ways second prince, just leave it to me, you might even have to call me brother in law in the future."
The second prince chuckled himself as he said:
"Susang, arrange a meeting between my sister and my future brother-in-law here."
He looked quite skeptical as he chuckled but since Yun Jhin offered himself to do this he didn't refuse, after all, it would save him time work and money if Yun Jhin got his reward himself.
Yun Jhin thought about thanking the princess if she didn't take the second princes' death water he wouldn't have been able to get near her as easily!

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Seducing one princess
chapters.content:
Things went quickly the following days Yun Jhin could go and meet with princess Long Mumu, due to his heroic act and hard work for the empire, it wasn't known what kind of act he had done and why he wanted his reward to be meeting the princess.
The second prince looked at Yun Jhin as he changed his outfit to a yukata for the 'date' with the princess, his hair was done in a ponytail at his back and he gave off a suave air that could entrance younger women like the princess.
The second prince clapped a few times as he said:
"If I liked men I would have been entranced by you as well, good job, my sister like's pretty boys that dress like this, you have a high chance to get in her bed, but getting her heart? That's another thing that I cannot say."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"We will see your highness."
Susang looked Yun Jhin up and down and narrowed his eyes, then he escorted him to meet princess Mumu inside the capital and then into the main palace. There they took a few winding pathways as they entered the inner garden of the palace where Long Mumu was waiting with her back to them. She wore a short blue dress that accentuated her curves and a white hair clip that kept her hair tied up.
She walked forward and her eyes shined as she looked at Yun Jhin and she said:
"General Susang you can leave us alone, go back to my second brother, I will see what this gentleman has to talk with me."
Yun Jhin smiled at Mumu gently as he held her hand kissed it with the same amount of gentleness as his smile as he said:
"Your beauty is more mystifying at a closer proximity princess Mumu, ever since I entered the capital I have dreamed of meeting you."
Mumu blushed, most of the men she met would directly court her to the bedroom and they wouldn't act like gentlemen to her, after all, most of them didn't care about her and they wanted to use her to get into the government. Yun Jhin has seen countless such cases and knew if he gave her some attention and listened to her problems she would easily fall to him and believe whatever he said to her, after all, she has been heartbroken many times.
Mumu shily blushed at the man's actions, even though she was experienced in bed she was a child at the matters of the heart such as romance, and Yun Jhin's words and actions touched her scared heart in a way no other did.
Yun Jhin walked closer to her as he said:
"Why don't you tell me how your days have been your highness? I'm a good listener and I might be able to share some of your burdens."
Long Mumu started to talk about her daily activities such as the normal stuff, cultivating, reading, and other normal things that a girl of her age would do, Yun Jhin listened and said:
"Your life is pretty normal your highness, ah you couldn' even think you are a royal but just a normal girl."
At this comment, she shook her head as she started to talk about the political meetings she had to attend from time to time how she was used as a token of exchange between nobles and how even her brother forsaken her in exchange for benefits.
Yun Jhin hugged her and she started to cry in his Yukata, he let her fully exert all of her sadness before he used his hands to clean her face and he cupped it slowly as he approached it and said:
"This is something you can easily solve, just become stronger, stronger than your brother, and stronger than anyone who wants to hurt you!"
Mumu chuckled sadly as she looked down and she chuckled the hems of her skirt as she said:
"Easier said than done Sisheng, my cultivation talent isn't that good, I'm just at the 2nd stage of the heavenly realm, I know you are a ki cultivating expert, but I don't think you can help me with anything regarding cultivation."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"I have a cultivation technique perfectly suitable for your body, why don't you try it."
He started to impart her the cultivation technique and she quickly absorbed it, her eyes widened and sparkled as her cultivation started to work by itself, her soul cleaning and refining speed increased by 200%!
Mumu embraced Yun Jhin as she said:
"Thank you thank you!"
Yun Jhin's smile was as kind as before but if you would observe it there was something hidden in it, he patted her back as he said:
"I heard you have got your hands on some death water? I know how to increase the speed of your cultivation even further, I know how to concoct a pill with the death water that should surely get you to the 7th stage of the heavenly realm in a few months!"
The princess's eyes widened at my words and she immediately shouted for a maid to get her the death water and a cauldron. Yun Jhin smiled at her as he waited for the maid when the maid came with the death water and the cauldron Yun Jhin continued:
"The other materials for the pill, I have them with me, you don't need to send for anything else."
The princess looked down at her feet, she knew Yun Jhin was a recruit in the army and that he didn't have much money, the materials would be very expensive for him, she shook her head as she said:
"I have an idea after you concoct the pill you can take the rest of the death water as payment,"
Yun Jhin gasped as he said:
"Your highness, do you know how expensive the death water is? I couldn't, after all, they are just some complementary material's with a few months of hard work I can just make the cost of them back, I'm just a lowly newly recruit, I might become a general as I have broken through the ki cultivating realm and get even higher pay, I don't want to you to get in trouble!"
The princess shook her head stubbornly as she said with a finality in her tone:
"We don't have many pill refiners, take this as payment for refining the pill!"
Yun Jhin wanted to say something else but a mischievous smile appeared on the girl's face as she said:
"This is an order from your princess, soldier so you better obey!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he started the concocting session and put on an act making it look like it was very hard for him to concoct the pill and that he almost failed through the concoction multiple times!
As she watched him struggle to concoct the pill she realized that Yun Jhin didn't lie, if the pill was that hard to concoct that meant the results will be genuine!
Yun Jhin smiled as he scratched the back of his hand and gave the princess the pill, it was deep blue, he told her that she just could eat it now and see the effects.
She ate the pill and her cultivation immediately saw a boost in the wind ki gathering area, as she could gather wind ki faster and purify her soul. She squealed as she hugged him then gave him a deep kiss.
Yun Jhin reciprocated the kiss and she was ready to throw her clothes off when he stopped her and said:
"Princess, I'm not after your body, I just thought you were an interesting woman when I first saw you, after all, we don't know each other that well, it's too early to jump to such actions."
This was the first time Mumu found a man that wasn't interested in sex, her eyes sparkled as she looked at Yun Jhin and thought that she finally found her 'prince in shining armor' then she stopped what she was doing and Yun Jhin told her:
"With this death water I could achieve another breakthrough in my techniques, I recommend you go and cultivate as well Mumu, the pill's effects are temporary and you should hurry up and use them as long as you can."
Mumu nodded her head as she giggled and skipped away from him, a maid then escorted him out of the palace where he met with Susang, he looked him up and down and then asked:
"Any luck?"
Yun Jhin waved the container that was resealed and Susang's eyes widened, the proud Mumu was conquered that easily? Susang wanted to bow to Yun Jhin and ask him to teach him his ways, he was still a virgin up to till this day due to his ugly looks, not even peasant women wanted to be with him, and he wasn't such a beast that he would force himself onto an unwilling woman.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he heard the man's question and said:
"Your appearance is a big deterrence, I can teach you a technique that would fix your scars."
The man clapped his hands as he threw one arm over Yun Jhin's shoulder and said:
"Aren't you a good brother, thanks for helping me out, after all, from now on we will be both generals under the second prince, it seems you stabilized yourself in the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm."
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he made the man take his arm from his shoulder and said:
"I will teach you the technique before I enter closed-door cultivation to refine this death water and the other materials, let's go back to the dragon eating sect grounds."
Susang nodded his head as he left with Yun Jhin in tow, they were back into the hall as they reported to the second prince, the second prince was thoroughly surprised that Yun Jhin could steal his sister's heart but then he shook his head and decided to not bother with it. Even though Yun Jhin didn't get her to be on the right minister's side yet.
Yun Jhin said that it will be a slow endeavor so he didn't bother to question him.
After Yun Jhin taught the face altering technique to Susang he entered his room and closed it. He laid down some formations to make sure no one would be eavesdropping or spying on him, then his main body left through Sun Sisheng's nose as he looked at all the materials that were in front of him.
The next caterpillar form would reach a rank of 100! it was a qualitative increase due to all of the materials he got his hands on, he would be able to reach the max rank quickly as his host body was now at the ki cultivating stage.
As he ate the materials on the ground the system finally appeared after a long while:
[Special materials devoured by the host, the host can evolve into the true mind caterpillar]
[True mind caterpillar can remotely control people regardless of range as long as they have enough soul power, they can reach rank 100 on the caterpillar evolution tree and their body is sturdier, stronger, and faster than the previous evolutions, this is the peak of the soul and mind caterpillar tree!]
Yun Jhin smiled as he returned to Sun Sisheng's cranium and started his sleep, from here on he would truly be able to start his plan on taking over the empire!

chapters.title: Chapter 26: True Mind Caterpillar (Flashback Chap)
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin's body went through one of the most important evolutions in his life, his soul wandered around his former lives experiences, back when he was a small kid, how he easily killed adults that thought he would be an easy target, how one time his reincarnation led him into a bad position and he was *redacted*, as he reincarnated he was both a man and a woman in the past but he realized that he preferred being a man after all of his memories fused, he just felt freer in a way that he couldn't explain.
The cocoon inside Sun Sisheng's head was growing into a deep blueish purple color as it started to leak green fluids his evolution skipped through some of the other caterpillar forms so these green leaking fluids were representing his liquified body remains that he had to excrete, they were the extra things that he didn't need, with the help of the evolutionary process he was shedding them, reaching the peak of his life form.
Yun Jhin's main body was moving continuously inside the cocoon as it evolved, his form was changing into something far greater than he was before, something that would help him to achieve his objectives inside the Long Empire.
As he slowly evolved inside his cocoon, he reminisced to let the time go by faster, suddenly he was back in one of his former reincarnations, the one where he was the evil emperor, the previous one before he became a caterpillar.
Yun Jhin thought that this was one of his most effective reincarnations but he still knew he didn't do enough.
A man with silver hair who wore a dark cloak was sitting on a throne made of bones of different species besides him stood a woman that kneeled and she was *redacted* after the woman finished she got up bowed and left with a smile on her face. Yun Jhin was bored, while he was entertained by one of his concubines he waited for his subordinates to get him any news of fortuned constitutions.
By time went by and no one came, 10 years, 100 years, 1000 years, finally some news came by but it was quite late, the fortune constitution brat already grew up into an overlord but Yun Jhin smiled as he got up from the throne of bones, his dark boots left footprints into the bones as they caved in under his weight, giant bones refined into a throne with special god ki, and they were destroyed under his fleshly bodyweight alone.
As Yun Jhin walked he suddenly disappeared to only appear near a tavern at a crossroad, there he slowly walked inside, all the people who saw his robe and his face immediately bowed down to the ground while shaking in fear, only one man who drank some cheap ale at the bar didn't say anything.
As he continued to drink Yun Jhin observed the man's body, he was scrawny and he wore peasant clothes, he had a shabby katana tied to his waist and his face was dirty with mud, he had a stalk of an unknown plant in his mouth as he drank the ale some of it dropped on his clothes dirtying them further.
Yun Jhin slowly got near the bar and said:
"Don't you know to greet your seniors? Kaze Camino."
Camino laughed a bit and he started coughing as the ale went on the wrong pipe, then he hit his chest a few times and said:
"Yun Jhin from the throne of blood, what are you doing here? I haven't offended you."
Yun Jhin smiled to him as he waved his hands in the air and said:
"No you didn't, but you didn't come to pay respects either when you advanced to the god realm, don't you think you are a little too presumptuous?"
The man chuckled as he finished his ale and unsheathed his katana:
"Presumptuous for not licking your ass your highness?"
Yun Jhin laughed and said:
"I like your mouth, it's pretty sharp."
Suddenly a spatial tear appeared near Camino's mouth almost tearing it apart:
"I want to have it on my wall."
Yun Jhin's smile turned up as he said that then his arm directly went into the void as he took out a fully dark sword, the sheath and the body of the blade were both dark, as he unsheathed it you could see that the edge of the blade had flame-like patterns on it, it was a katana as long as Camino's.
Yun Jhin thrust his sword forward immediately impaling Camino and then slashed the man's katana away throwing it away making it embedded into the wall behind Camino and killing the scared barman.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at Camino:
"1st stage vs 9th stage, not a fight you can take pipsqueak, thanks for the fortuned constitution."
A mouth opened inside Yun Jhin's palm as it started devouring Camino's frozen body after his katana was thrown out of his grasp, his body was infiltrated with darkness energy from Yun Jhin's katana which paralyzed him, as the mouth inside Yun Jhin's hand ate at him both his soul and body were tortured due to the pain of being eaten alive!
Even though he was paralyzed he could still feel everything his senses were amplified during this!
Yun Jhin shook his head as his body was fully consumed and looked down at the mouth in his hand that licked it's 'lips' then closed transforming his palm into a normal-looking fair palm. He looked around himself and saw a wasteland, an area around him for millions of kilometers was destroyed, the earth was scared and lava was ready to shoot out.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he teleported away and like time itself was reverted things started to go backward, everything was as before Yun Jhin came but the only difference was that no one remembered Camino coming to the inn, nor that he existed!
Yun Jhin returned to his throne of bones as he stood down, another concubine ready to serve him.
Yun Jhin scoffed as he looked at the man then backhanded her killing her instantly as she transformed into dust and muttered:
"No transformation, after so many fortuned constitutions? 999, I'm running out of time."
His face started to scrunch up as it started to seemingly dry up, he looked older in an instant as his silver hair lost it's luster and became a dry white, his hands started to tremble as wrinkles appeared on them, his muscles dried up and his back bent he coughed a mouthful of blood as he cursed:
"Oh you darn time, I thought I could have attained eternal life already!"
His hand returned into the void as an infant appeared in his arms, suddenly he plunged his hand in his chest and took out its young heart he looked at it for no more than a nanosecond as his mouth opened and he gulped it up with gusto as it was seemingly the best food in the universe. He coughed up a bit as he said:
"*Sigh* even though this would give me another hour, I cannot die yet!"
His skin returned to its peak as his muscles build up again, he left the throne behind as he shouted to the skies:
"I WON'T DIE YET, ETERNAL LIFE IS MINE, YOU SHALL SEE YOU DAMN WORLD!"
But in the end, he failed, he was now alone, as he ate more and more infant hearts to extend his lifespan forcefully he realized that his sins accumulated, all his subordinates and concubines died due to the retaliation of his enemies, some of them died to old age.
He chuckled as he sat on his death bed, the same image as he saw before, the clepsydra above his head, the sands of time washing him away, death and reincarnation, but the images stopped here.
He didn't see Buddha or Hades as he was forcefully woken up by the evolution of his main body!
His body started to break through the cocoon, as he slowly broke through the cocoon his main body finally reached the 5th stage of the heavenly realm!
He looked down at his new body and realized that he gained some arms that looked similar to a humanoids, and he could feel that his head was heavier than before, he used his new arms to touch his head and felt that it was way bigger than before!
Even though his size didn't increase much his power, speed, stamina, and physical endurance have increased by a lot, also his rank at his 'rebirth' was 10!
Yun Jhin left Sun Sisheng's cranium as he looked in a mirror he had in his room, he was now a deep dark color as his bulging head was the first thing he observed, the veins on it were pulsing as he now developed a big brain to help him with controlling people regardless of range!
Yun Jhin then looked at his new 'arms' he didn't know why the true mind caterpillar needed arms but he would see in the nearby future, as he finished looking at the new appearance of his body. he returned inside Sun Sisheng's cranium through his nose and took control of the body which was way easier than before, he also felt that he could now control the body regardless if he was inside it or not,
Even though he lost his stinger at the end of his body, he now had a different connection to Sun Sisheng's body, a mental imprint was left in his empty sea of consciousness and with the help of his now gigantic brain, he could easily control the man's body as if it was his own!
Yun Jhin smiled as he used some of the remaining death water to fully stabilize his host's body in the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm and increase his cultivation realm by a bit.
Then he finally left his closed-door cultivation, and according to his calculations almost 6 months passed by!
Susang was immediately happy to meet with him as he patted his back and said:
"I almost thought you wouldn't make it in time for my marriage ceremony brother Sisheng, I want you to be my best man!"
Yun Jhin smiled at Susang but sneered inside as he responded to the man:
"Sure brother Susang, you go finish your preparations and send me a mental notice when you are ready, I'm going to talk with the second prince, with the death water I gained from him I'm sure that I can easily break through to the second stage, but I still need some materials."
Susang didn't care about that as he smiled like a fool and said:
"Whatever brother, live a little, don't focus on cultivation day in day night, I heard from my spies that your wife died while giving birth to your son, why don't I introduce you with some fine ladies, or you might even want to visit princess Mumu, she has been talking and asking about you ever since she left closed-door cultivation one month earlier than you."
Yun Jhin continued to smile as he said:
"I will consider it but first I will have to talk with the second prince about some matters, as I said before you go do your stuff."
Susang nodded his head as he didn't think Yun Jhin would do anything to the second prince as he now trusted the man with his back and his liege's safety due to his actions, he thought that Yun Jhin only had the best intentions for the second prince's party.
Yun Jhin 'inside sneer' continued to lengthen as he looked at Susang and then he left him behind as he entered the hall and saw the prince on his throne, it seemed he was lucky that he found him there, he approached the prince and bowed as he said:
"This subordinate was lucky to refine the Death water, but I still need some help from your highness, I just need one more thing before I'm sure I could finally stabilize myself in the Long Empire and the capital."
The second prince smiled kindly at Yun Jhin as he asked:
"What else would you need my friend Sisheng?"
Yun Jhin smiled cryptically as he said slowly:
"Your body your highness."
The formations that were supposed to protect the prince suddenly faltered as when the prince and Susang were away he already tampered with them, the ordinary soldiers protecting the hall wouldn't even realize what was done to the formations.
Suddenly a soul attack invaded the man's consciousness and devoured it!
A soul imprint entered the man's body as his glazed eyes returned to normal and he chuckled as he said:
"Good joke Sisheng but we both know that you and I like women, what else would you need?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"Nothing much your highness, just another batch of death water would be useful."
The 'second prince' frowned as he said:
"I cannot give any more water unless you gain merit on the battlefield!"
Yun Jhin bowed his head and said:
"Then let me on the battlefield, your highness."
A strange light appeared in the second princes' eyes as he said:
"Of course, you will now be I, Long Manison personal guard along with general Susang, I have fully accepted you after all you have done for my party!"
Yun Jhin smiled as he bowed his head down, a similar type of light as the one that appeared in the princes' eyes appeared in his eyes, and afterward, he left the hall.
Yun Jhin finally accomplished the first step in infiltrating the imperial family!

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Joining the war for merit?
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin left the hall behind him he could feel the connection that he had made with the second princes' body, it felt just like having a second character that he could control, but the body itself would do its normal actions without the need of him to fully control it, it was like a mental slave without a personal will.
Yun Jhin went back to his room as he took both of his spatial bags and then met with Susang as he said:
"Well Susang, you see the prince finally let me join the war efforts after I reported my cultivation improvement, I think I cannot be your best man at the wedding, I'm sorry."
A pure disappointed look appeared on Susang's face as he patted Yun Jhin's shoulder and said slowly:
"Well protecting the empire comes before such a little man like myself, I will join you at the front soon after I finish my wedding, after 6 months the Heavenly Turtle sect decided to take the war into the open, aye I hope I won't on the front and let my newlywed wife become an early widow."
He shook his head as he left Yun Jhin behind and started to walk inside the capital, Yun Jhin shook his head as he left towards the military barracks, The second princes' body already sent out a military letter and with his identity confirmed he was led inside to join the war effort under a general.
Susang was one of the weakest generals so he could only be under the 10 legions great generals which had a cultivation of the 2nd stage of the ki cultivating realm or above. Every stage in the ki cultivating realm was a high difference in fighting power so normally speaking not many could surpass stages and in this realm. It could be done in the lower realms as the difference wasn't that huge but in the ki cultivating realm, it was different.
The ki quality of different stages was too huge to be compared, the same could be said about quantity, if the first stage was a small spring then the second stage was a river!
However, Yun Jhin had some techniques that he could use combined with his Yin body he could defeat people 1 cultivation stage above his own if he used some forbidden techniques he could even defeat people 2 stages above his cultivation stage.
Most of the generals were condescending to him as he came from the second princes' faction which was looked down upon in the capital. Some of them called him a dog of a dying party and some of them called him hick that got lucky to hug the second princes' thigh. Yun Jhin ignored all of them as he directly went to the first legion general who had the cultivation of a 5th stage, Ki cultivating realm, he was as strong as the crown prince!
Yun Jhin bowed to the man as he said:
"I would like to join the 1st legion to protect the empire with the best extent of my abilities!"
The man was quite tall with a strong aura around him, he didn't care about the others said as he was impartial to background or origins, as long as the man he put his eyes on was strong and loyal he could care less from where he came from or who he was backed by!
The general of the 1st legion was called Mono Sukehiro he was of humble origins from an unknown county near the eastern borders of the empire, with his talent in cultivation and hard work he became the general of the 1st legion of the empire!
He had a short black beard and a bald head, he wore dark military armor and he had two swords tied to his back, he was a dual sword user, he was also quite tall around 1,96 meters. His aura gave off a feeling of experience and maturity.
Suddenly his finger went directly towards Yun Jhin's throat but at the last second before his finger could puncture Yun Jhin's throat Yun Jhin moved his head backward and avoided the deadly finger.
The man gave a boorish smile as he clasped Yun Jhin on the shoulder and laughed while saying:
"Welcome to the 1st legion, make sure to make your empire proud!"
He wasn't sure how old Yun Jhin was but he looked middle-aged to him, even though he was a bit older he saw Yun Jhin as a comrade and not as a subordinate as they were in the same realm of cultivation so he gave him some respect.
Yun Jhin nodded towards Mono Sukehiro and saluted him, a hidden smile could be found under his serious visage that not even the experienced general could discern, as he left the military building Yun Jhin took a turn and walked towards the palace, he was invited in the palace by the princess and he couldn't turn her down.
As he met with princess Long Mumu she told her maids to leave them alone, Yun Jhin looked around and shook his head he couldn't mess with the formations with Long Mumu present and he didn't want to be seen or felt that he attacked the princess, he couldn't take over her body, yet.
The princess started to pester him with words and how happy she was due to his pill she broke through to the 7th stage of the heavenly realm as he said, she also said that she felt that she would break through to the 8th stage soon!
The princess kept talking and talking and Yun Jhin sat there near her and nodded his head seemingly enjoying listening to her, but inside he was as annoyed as he could be, her use to him was already done and he couldn't wait till he could devour her soul and take over her body, she was annoying and useless right now, as he looked at her he realized that she might not even be able to break through the ki cultivating realm!
He kept a straight smile at her as he from time to time would respond to her questions and give some of his own, after a few hours of talking or 'wasting time' as Yun Jhin dubbed it, he left her alone and then exited the palace.
Yun Jhin looked behind and shook his head as he walked back towards the military building where he met again with the general of the 1st legion, the general smiled at him as he patted his back and said:
"You got the attention of her highness Long Mumu, if you don't die in this war you are going to lead a good life as you would become royalty."
Yun Jhin shook his head, the man was simple, he knew that while the crown prince would let him have her body he would never marry her to him due to his political views! He would need her to be a political asset that he could use whenever he wanted and he understood the man perfectly as he would the same if he was in his situation, he didn't care about her anyway but he had to play the role for now.
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he looked normal on the outside:
"Don't patronize me general. I had a wife and a son once, it isn't that I like her but she became attached to me because I helped her a bit some months ago."
The general cringed as he looked at me and said:
"I'm sorry for your wife and son, and I heard how you helped her highness with her cultivation problems, I see then, you don't want to break her heart, you are a good man Sisheng, I will make sure you come back alive from the battlefield."
He patted Yun Jhin on the shoulder as he coughed then said:
"We will take some warhorses towards the first battlefront, we are trying to push the invaders back, they are a combination of the Heavenly Turtle sect and the Earth Kingdom."
He looked towards the other generals and recruits as he created a map with his ki and pointed at it:
"We are here at the capital the battlefield is around 800 kilometers away to the northeast, we got invaded and they are so far inside the empire, that means we have traitors near the border as they didn't report anything!"
The man scrunched his brows as he mentioned traitors then he said:
"This is all the information we have, there have been no sightings of elders from either the kingdom or the sect, however, they are most likely waiting for us to begin an ambush!"
He shook his head as he continued:
"We cannot abandon so many cities or we would lose both prestige and land, we have to break through their ambush and kill our way towards the battlefield, the other 6 legions are already out there and we are the only ones that remained in the capital, you as generals are only sent out during the highest war times."
He pointed to himself as he said:
"I'll make sure I will save as many of you as I can, hopefully, they won't send people above the 5th stage or we will be in trouble, we would need the military minister's help then, however he is in secluded-cultivation."
He shook his head as he mentioned that then continued with a short sentence:
"We have to leave right now, let's go!"
He walked outside and everyone else followed as he went to the stables of the military building, there Yun Jhin found quite a lot of warhorses, they were clad in bronze armor that was supposed to slow them down but they still looked full of life and energy, they were a cultivating breed of horse!
They were around the 6-9th stage of the earthly realm, Mono took the strongest horse and made himself comfortable in the saddle as he looked at everyone else and said:
"Let's go men! To protect the empire and it's people!"
They all shouted in unison as they all took the reins of their horses and followed the general who hyped them up for war, at the rate the horses ran they would reach battlefront in a few hours!
As they ran in a forest region deep in the trees two unknown people were talking, from their hidden aura's you couldn't surely say what their cultivation base was:
"This is the empire's army? pretty strong, however, they are meant to never reach the battlefield, tch they even sent out their first general, this will be troublesome, we will need Elder Fung Hui to stop him, hopefully, the old man won't die at this guy's hands."
The other silhouette said:
"I could care less about old man Fung Hui if he dies and we can take even half of their army down we would have won the war!"
The other silhouette chuckled as he continued from where the other one stopped:
"I guess we could call him our Martyr of the Earth Kingdom, couldn't we?"
"It seems the Earth Kingdom didn't really like being under the Heavenly Turtle sect."
Another voice broke the duo's concentration and discussion as they both froze on the spot and looked up, a young woman was above them with a giant black cleaver that transformed the duo into butchered pigs, their entrails fell along with other organs, the seemingly young woman looked at the duo and scoffed:
"Trash, you dare to conspire against your betters, It's good that the Heavenly turtle sect didn't send out Elder Fung Hui alone, psch."
Her eyes seemingly saw the warhorses galloping towards the battlefield as she whispered behind her:
"Are you ready to take care of these peasants elder?"
An old man who wore a robe that hidden his whole body besides his head bowed towards the young woman and said:
"Of course young lady, immediately!"
The young woman laughed as he watched the man run towards to intercept the warhorses and slowly followed him from behind, she would make sure no one escaped from her cleaver!
She licked the blood from the blade of the cleaver and moaned as she looked down at the war horses.
Yun Jhin looked up and saw the hidden duo but decided against saying anything, Mono stopped his warhorse as he shouted:
"Everyone stop! We have entered their ambush!"
A shrill laugh of an old man was heard as Fung Hui appeared and directly attacked Mono stopping him from trying to take any other action.
Suddenly a giant black cleaver appeared above Yun Jhin's head as a shrill crazy voice of a woman was heard:
"You are the weakest here, it seems you broke through the ki cultivating realm some months prior didn't you, shrimp?"
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed, it seemed this woman took the wrong target, he would make sure her body would be properly digested after he finished her. However his eyes narrowed as he dodged her attack, the horse under him became two halves as it's organs fell down.
Her cultivation was at the 3rd stage of the Ki cultivating realm. He frowned as his body started to heat up, making him have to use a forbidden technique already, tch, how infuriating he thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: First fight for merit
chapters.content:
The woman frowned as she looked down at Yun Jhin's body and felt the aura that was raging on his body then she dashed directly at him ready to slash him in two with her cleaver, Yun Jhin closed his eyes as his arms muscles bulged up and he caught the cleaver with his hands, due to his strengthened body as a living undead the cleaver couldn't cut them off even though he started bleeding a little.
The girl frowned as Yun Jhin headbutted her, drops of blood started to fall from her nose and she let go of her cleaver, Yun Jhin looked at the cleaver for a moment and then immediately let a slash go forward to the woman who was now clutching her nose in pain.
Mono planted his fist inside the elder's stomach as he coughed up some bile and then backed off from him, he looked at the girl and shouted:
"Yu'er run away, that guy isn't normal, look at his aura!"
Yu'er gritted her teeth as she looked at her cleaver and then at the elder and started running away, Yun Jhin scoffed as he looked at her back and jumped above the horse and ran after her.
The elder backed off slowly into the forest as he tried to run away as they failed their ambush, but suddenly Mono planted his feet on the ground as he put his hands together and channeled a ball of lightning that he threw at the elder like a baseball.
The lightning ball hit him directly in the head knocking him over and putting a dent in the man's head. Mono shook his head, he was still alive but unconscious, he wouldn't kill him yet as he wanted to extract some information from him.
Yun Jhin used the drops of blood that dripped from the woman to easily identify where she went, even though she hid her aura Yun Jhin could still feel her faint life aura through the drops of blood she left behind, he clutched the cleaver and suddenly threw it behind him, a gasp could be heard as the woman was almost decapitated by the cleaver, she tried to unpray it from the tree that was stuck in.
Yun Jhin knew that it was a strong artifact so she wanted to get it back, that was what he hoped for, the woman also seemed to lack in battle experience so she was going to be good nutrients for him.
As Yun Jhin ran towards her he suddenly turned transparent as he disappeared from her view she started panicking as she looked around and then she shouted:
"Don't get near me! I'm the daughter of the sect master of the Heavenly Tortoise sect! He is a 2nd stage King Realm expert!"
Suddenly behind her, an arm entered her back and came out of her chest with a still-beating heart in hand. Yun Jhin sneered loudly as he looked at her and he whispered in her ear:
"Think that you can attack me and get away with it? Why would I care your father is the sect master, you came to a battlefield and you should expect death!"
Yun Jhin took his arm back as her body dropped down, he immediately unhinged his jaw like a deadly predator and swallowed the body whole, he almost collapsed as he fell to his knees and started panting hard, one of his arms almost popped like a balloon from the stress of the forbidden technique.
He frowned as he started to devour her nutrients and ki, healing himself and pushing his cultivation base further, he would need to find a good place where he could fully heal himself and breakthrough to the second stage of the ki cultivating realm. Her body was full of unrefined helpful materials, it seemed she grew like a sheltered flower, fed with the best cultivation materials.
Yun Jhin laughed as he got up from his kneeling position and looked at the cleaver, he couldn't use it or the sect mater would realize that he was the one who killed his daughter, but if he left it behind he could use divination to know what happened. Yun Jhin took the cleaver and then started burrowing in the ground as he borrowed further and further he reached the place where magma existed.
He threw the cleaver down inside and then left, it took him a few hours but he made sure no one could trace the woman's death back to him. Yun Jhin sighed as he continued his way towards the battlefield, he met midway with Mono and the others as they were questioning the elder.
The elder's eyes widened visibly as he looked at Yun Jhin's blood-soaked form, but then he shook his head as he didn't think his young lady would die at Yun Jhin's hands, he looked at Mono with a sneer as he said:
"Kill me but I won't tell you anything, you peasant piece of trash from the Long Empire!"
Mono was ready to slap him again when Yun Jhin came forward and put a hand on his shoulder as he said:
"I have some techniques that could make him talk, what do you say, general?"
Mono Sukehiro looked Yun Jhin up and down and asked slowly:
"Are you sure you are up to it? It seems you have lost that woman and got injured as well."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"I have enough energy to take care of him, he is tied up by your ki and he can't even use his ki, he will scream like a pig soon enough."
Mono knew that Yun Jhin cultivated a special corpse technique as the letter from the second prince indicated that, so his eyes didn't change when he saw Yun Jhin's hand transform into a wretched claw, the others however gasped and looked at Yun Jhin with strange eyes.
Yun Jhin claw was then engulfed in purple energy, it was poisonous yin ki from his undead body, it was one of the few active abilities that the yin body gave, Yun Jhin smiled at the old man as his claw didn't even slap him, he just put it slowly on the man's chest then retracted it.
The man laughed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Was that a love tap you kid? What do you think that will do to me? Trash!"
Yun Jhin didn't say anything as he continued to smile at him and started to count down:
"5, 4, 3, 2..."
The man frowned as he said quickly:
"What are you counting down for stupid? ugh!"
He started to roll on the ground as his restrainments didn't stop him from doing that, he started banging his head on the ground till it bleeds severely. He then started to shout till his throat almost gave out on him, all of the remaining soldiers and generals' eyes wandered between the tortured man and Yun Jhin as they thought that they would never incur his wrath. Mono narrowed his eyes but didn't say anything as he waited.
After a while, the poison finally wore off under Yun Jhin's command as he was ready to put another batch on the man, the elder cried as hot tears started to pour out of his eyes as he said:
"No more please, please no more!", he tried to huddle into a ball as he moved back and forth like a lunatic, the pain inflicted was on his body as well as his soul.
Yun Jhin walked forward to him and was ready to pat him a second time when he shouted:
"You want information?? I can give you all the information, please no more!"
His eyes were dilated and it seemed that if he took another dose of the poison he would die from the pain excess, Yun Jhin looked at Mono then nodded his head while saying:
"It's ok you can ask him whatever you want now, I will have to go and rest for a bit, as you can see I'm quite wounded, tell me when we are ready to move to the battlefield."
Mono started to question the man as Yun Jhin went to rest under a tree, most of the other people were looking at him with fear in their eyes as they avoided him, but that was something Yun Jhin wanted so he was extremely pleased with his act.
Mono started questioning the elder and the answers he gave him made him pale as he shouted:
"We need to quickly get to the battlefield, a powerhouse on the same level as me is already there and wreaking havoc on our troops! Yun Jhin, we cannot wait any more, I know you are wounded but I will give you a very important mission, please get rid of this elder for us, he is useless right now as he told us everything he knows."
He got back on his horse and whipped it as he made the others follow him away, Yun Jhin smiled devilishly as he looked the receding figures of the horses and then at the old man that was tied on the ground as he approached him slowly.
The old man looked at Yun Jhin and he could feel the man's aura suffocate him, it felt just like a beast ready to devour, no it wasn't a beast, it was more of a demon or devil to him!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked down at the old man's lone form and he said:
"What should I do with you... I'm already three-quarters full, I haven't digested her yet *sigh* I cannot let you die either, it would just be a waste of a perfectly fine body at the 4th stage of the ki cultivating realm."
The old man trembled as he heard Yun Jhin's voice that looked just like the shouts of demons and devils in his ears, he looked down at his pants only to see them wet, Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the old man and said:
"Can't handle your bowels anymore old man?"
The old man naturally nodded his head as fast as he could thinking that Yun Jhin would become disgusted with him but suddenly his head flew into the air as he was decapitated, his corpse was burnt to a crispy brown level with his ki and Yun Jhin bowed as he said:
"Thanks for the meal."
He ate the man just like one would do a rotisserie chicken and frowned after he finished:
"I lost quite a bit of ki from burning him but atleast I didn't waste a lot if I killed him normally his ki would have dissipated way faster, *sigh* whatever let's try to break through, even though I cannot reach the third stage I should be able to stabilize myself easily into the second stage and reach the middle parts of it."
Yun Jhin went back to the same tree that he sat under before and stood unmoving cross-legged. His ki started to increase as he was ready for another breakthrough, his body was devouring the nutrients and ki from the woman and the elder at a frightening pace as his ki continuously increasing breaking through his cultivation barriers.
His host body was ready for another breakthrough due to this lucky encounter!

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Another day another break through
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's energy started to fluctuate as he broke through to the second stage of the ki cultivating realm, his ki amount increased and its purity did the same, his eyes glowed with a peculiar red-black color as his body under his normal disguise got some changes. His claws strengthened as did his skin which took a darker shade of grey.
Yun Jhin made sure his internal situation was ok as he used the remaining nutrients and ki from the bodies to stabilize himself in the second stage of the ki cultivating realm, however from all he did his main body was still at the 5th stage, however, with a little bit of luck he would break through to the 6th stage in a few weeks.
Yun Jhin looked around and found that no one was spying on him with his soul willpower, then he started running towards the battlefield at his fastest speed, it took him almost 3 days to break through and stabilize his body, it was fortunate the Heavenly Turtle sect thought that the elder and the woman would be enough to tie and maybe even kill the whole squad of generals.
However, by now they should have realized they are both dead as they didn't report in a long while. Yun Jhin ran towards the battlefield at his quickest speed as he finally left the forest, in front of him appeared a battlefield full of dead bodies, some were burnt some decapitated and some cut in two.
Some of them were diced into small bits and some of them were just ashes, as Yun Jhin looked around he licked his lips as he felt the abundant death ki around and took in a deep breath as the ki entered his body it started to swell up then deflate a few seconds later.
He looked around and realized that the fight was pretty equal between the empire, kingdom, and sect, Mono was tying with a 5th level ki cultivator and making sure he didn't attack the lower leveled cultivators while the low-leveled ones were fighting to the death.
Yun Jhin looked from afar and then jumped directly into the battlefield! His attacks were swift and without mercy, as he plucked heads and hearts on the battlefield, his hands were fast precise and deadly as he dealt with a multitude of heavenly realm peak elites, he even one shot 1st stage ki cultivating experts if they got too close to him.
From time to time, pieces of meat would end up in his mouth as he would swallow them, diced meat, whole heads, or even hearts that he would extract from the enemies, the others were too distracted to realize what he was doing or they would have become disgusted and scared of him long ago.
Only Mono realized what Yun Jhin was doing but the prince also said that eating corpses would further his cultivation, even though this type of cultivation was frowned upon in most kingdoms the Long Empire accepted anyone regardless of cultivation technique or origins as long as they were loyal.
However, that meant some bad apples would appear here and there, as long as their cultivation got high enough they would surely strike back towards the empire regardless of how they were treated. And Yun Jhin was one of those apples, however, unlike the others, he knew how to act before his power was enough.
Yun Jhin's smile widened as he massacred one soldier after another until he met with a stage 3 cultivator who punched him in the stomach and threw him away while he had a great time.
Yun Jhin frowned as he put a hand over his stomach as he got up from the ground, the ground under him broke into splinters as his immense speed propelled him directly into the man's face and broke his jaw, he let his guard down thinking no one could disturb him while the 5th stage cultivator was taken care of.
Technically speaking it was the truth, the punch from the 3rd stage guy made him take no damage and only enraged him, Yun Jhin's hand immediately went to his head as he cracked it at weird angle immediately killing him, he opened his jaw like a whale and inhaled the corpse.
All the others finally saw what he did and looked at him with fear in their eyes, even his allies were perturbed and backed away from him, Yun Jhin ignored them and continued to attack the alliance of the Earth Kingdom and the Heavenly turtle sect as they pushed them out of the battlefield.
Mono was having a hard time with his opponent but then he shook his head as he unsheathed one sword from his back and said:
"One sword style: darkness slash."
He appeared behind his opponent as a shower of blood splurted upwards from the man's chest. As Yun Jhin took a better look at the man he saw his features, he was a brutish man with an extreme amount of bodily hair, his hair was done into an afro and his thick dark skin showed he was a foreigner, he had an afro as his hairstyle and he fought aggressively, even though he took a head-on hit from Mono's darkness slash attack it only made him spurt blood as the wound quickly closed itself.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked over and thought to himself:
"It's a beast physique but which one? bear? leopard? lion?"
Yun Jhin took a better look at the man and saw how his muscles bulged up from time to time and how his ki enveloped him to increase his physical strength and he realized that he had a bear beast physique, some physiques needed you to have a constitution to be developed while others you were just born with, bear physiques gave you innate strength since the moment you were born.
Yun Jhin knew Mono wouldn't be able to defeat him easily as his self-regeneration abilities and defense were too much for a normal human cultivator without any bloodline or constitutions like him.
However Yun Jhin's eyes widened as he saw Mono draw out his other sword, a different air appeared around him as he kept his swords around his body, he looked like a predator ready to hunt, even the afro guy started to frown, he could feel that Mono's aura changed somewhat after he unsheathed his second sword, he defended himself as he watched Mono charge at him.
Suddenly Mono started to flicker around the battlefield as after images of him appeared, his swords multiplied somehow as he struck the man in 5 places at the same time, lungs spleen heart neck and spine.
The man looked down at his chest as he saw it spurting with a huge amount of blood then he retreated slowly to the back, Mono breathed hardly as the technique took a lot of ki out of him.
However unluckily for him, the man wasn't finished yet!
The man's hands turned into bear paws as he swatted Mono away, then he looked down at his body that spurted blood from time to time and decisively ran away!
He knew that even though he could kill Mono, he could be teamed upon latter by the others and killed as well, he didn't want to give his life to take all of the others down with him so he ran away!
Yun Jhin looked at his receding figure as he ran away quickly from the plains where the battlefield was. He knew that he couldn't follow the man, even though he was injured he was at the 5th stage and he would defeat him even when injured, he might be able to kill the man but in the end, he would lose this host body which wasn't worth it.
Yun Jhin quickly ran towards Mono and supported him, he wanted to eat the man but he still needed him later, also his body wouldn't be able to break through again so fast, he would need a while for the body to adapt to the second stage, even though he ate many people on the battlefield they weren't enough to get to the 3rd stage, he was halfway there because he ate one third stage expert, he would need atleast 2 or 3 more before he could advance again, and that's after his body adapted.
Mono got up and patted Yun Jhin on the back as he saw how he was cached in blood and ashes from the fight, however, all the blood wasn't Yun Jhin's, Mono nodded at Yun Jhin and said:
"You did a good job, thanks for the help here, *sigh* it's good that he ran away, I was betting on him being too scared to continue fighting and I won, let's clean up."
