The other enemies were immediately taken care of as their leader ran away, even though some ran away they were only weaklings. Yun Jhin walked inside the newly risen tent where Mono was resting as he said immediately:
"You should know why I'm here general Mono."
Mono stood up from his cross-legged position on the mat and he said:
"You can have the 1st stage ki cultivating bodies, for 2nd stage and above I cannot give them to you unless you want to use your military merit to them, they are useful to the empire as well."
As Yun Jhin would fight in more such skirmishes as the war wasn't even halfway done he didn't more bodies, he was content with getting the 1st stage ki cultivators, with them he would be 75% on the way to the 3rd stage.
Yun Jhin bowed to Mono but before he could leave Mono stopped him as he said:
"Good job out there Sisheng, I see why the second prince recommended you, his party might be revived with you at the helm!"
Yun Jhin laughed slowly as he shook his head as he said:
"Maybe it will, who knows?"
Mono didn't know what he meant by those words but he joined in the laughter and said:
"You can go now, I have to rest to recover my ki, we will move 3 days from now, you should go and rest as well, we need all of you to be at full capacity before we move to the next battlefield."
Yun Jhin nodded his head but he stopped mere centimeters before he left the tent and said:
"About the 1st stage ki bodies.. can I eat those that were on our side as well?"
Mono frowned as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"I.. can let you but your reputation among the soldiers will take a huge hit, they already fear you but now they will hate you as well if you do that."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he left the tent and then went to eat the bodies, the men that looked at him were disgusted to the point some even vomited and when his hands went towards his 'comrades' bodies some shouted at him and said:
"What are you doing?!"
Yun Jhin looked at the man coldly and said:
"Ask general Mono, he should give you a good explanation."
The man feared Yun Jhin too much to do anything else besides shouting once at him and backed off, but the others looked at Yun Jhin with hatred in their eyes now, some of them were even planning to let him die on the next battlefield, it was one thing to be so arrogant but to eat the bodies of your comrades?
Some of them were cursing him under their breath as a monster or a demon and pervert. But Yun Jhin ignored them as he feasted with a giant grin on his face, which disturbed the others even more.
Mono shook his head as he felt what happened outside with his soul willpower and said to himself:
"You are a weird one, but atleast you are reliable, you are lucky you were born in the Long Empire."
He sighed as he looked down at the pendant that hanged at his neck, he gritted his teeth and clutched it in his hand before he made sure it was hidden. Then he went back to restoring his ki.
Yun Jhin finished eating and burped loudly letting out an acidic gas that almost broke down the skin of some unlucky fellows that were in the way, he laughed to himself as he left towards his tent while patting his stomach.
Yun Jhin got back into his tent and his satisfied look transformed into a cold one as he muttered:
"This act should make them fear me enough, combined with their prior lack of knowledge this personality should be good enough to put them on a tight leash."
Yun Jhin nodded to himself as he sat on the ground and started to do his breathing exercises slowly to help his body adapt quickly to the second stage of the ki cultivating realm. With all the extra bodies from his 'comrades', he was ready to break through again with his host's body. As for his main body, it was a hair away from breaking through the 6th stage!

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Push back the invasion
chapters.content:
While Yun Jhin was resting Mono got an important message in his tent from the dynasty, he clutched his pendant as he looked down at his hands and muttered:
"We have to go already..."
Yun Jhin just finished his first cultivation session as he got up from the ground when Mono's voice appeared around the whole camp:
"Get up, we have to go to the next battlefield, orders from above, we have to push the invaders back!"
Yun Jhin didn't mind as he was already at full energy but the others groaned as they didn't have enough time to heal themselves and restore their ki, Mono got on another horse as the one at the 9th stage died. He took the horse's reins as he looked around and waited for everyone to follow him.
Yun Jhin was the first who found himself a horse and followed behind Mono, Mono nodded at him and smiled as he waited for everyone to get ready, he looked at Yun Jhin and while they waited he decided to make some conversation:
"So uh, why have you joined the army Sisheng?"
Yun Jhin kept a straight face as he responded shortly:
"For merit."
Things started to quickly get awkward between them as Yun Jhin didn't continue the conversation and they just waited in silence after a few minutes everyone was ready and the horses started to run to the north towards the border, they needed to push the invaders back as they already conquered a bit of land under the traitors lead.
Yun Jhin made sure to memorize the layout of the army for later, as their surroundings changed they approached a giant lake, as they neared the border of the empire they neared the big water bodies, beyond the empire at the north stood an ocean, beyond the ocean, stood the Earth Kingdom, and in the ocean dwelled the Heavenly Turtle sect!
The Earth Kingdom was using the Heavenly Turtle's sect formations to cross the ocean and attack the Empire.
Mono continued to look forward as he had things on his mind, but he still kept his eyes and ears open towards any other ambushes so he wouldn't be taken by surprise, Yun Jhin was cultivating while on horseback, he wanted to quickly adapt his host's body so he could break through again.
The lake's water was as clean as it could be, it was transparent and you could even see the lake bed near the shore. Yun Jhin looked around as he used his soul willpower to look for any enemies, he shook his head as he found none and Mono continued to control his horse so they could avoid the lake.
This was just an in-between place before they got to a port city that was taken over, it was their new job to reclaim all of the cities according to the crown prince's wish, Mono didn't support the crown prince but he still had to take orders for him which made him quite angry, but he hid all of his anger under a mask of coldness and simultaneous friendliness, he was friendly to those that could approach him but cold to those who couldn't.
While Mono was internalizing his anger towards the crown prince, Yun Jhin kept a cold expression as he waited for the horse to take him to the battlefield. As time passed their surroundings changed again as they finally got near a city, the city wasn't big for any standards, if you compared it to the capital it wasn't even as big as 1/5 of it.
The flag of the Earth Kingdom was used instead of the Long Empire, that meant the city has been taken over, Mono stopped all of the horses and slowly said:
"Depending on who is guarding the city we have only two ways of attacking, loud and stupid or stealthy, what do you guys think would be the best approach."
Yun Jhin got down from the horse as he said:
"I can go scout ahead and come back with information general Mono, wait for me."
His form turned ghostly as he suddenly disappeared from everyone's eyes and perception, he ran towards the city and eyed the formation's that were supposed to protect the city and walked straight through them, as he stealthily laid out his soul willpower like a spider's web around the city he felt all of the cultivators inside of it.
Yun Jhin looked around with his soul willpower as he frowned inside and thought:
"Too many, there are 2 Stage 5 ki cultivating experts here? Why this is only a small city... there should be something to station two powerhouses."
As Yun Jhin focused on the two auras he felt that one of them was familiar as it was weakened, it must have been the dark-skinned man from before, it seems he came here before them to heal himself.
Yun Jhin kept himself still as he felt the fluctuation of their cultivation bases and realized that with their army there was no way they could attack, Mono was fool thinking attacking normally would work, it seemed the man was distracted by something as he wouldn't have put up such a dumb suggestion.
Yun Jhin knew he couldn't bite more than he could chew here so he started to retreat, his technique was peak grade so even though these two were three levels ahead of him in the cultivation stages they couldn't find him out even though he even released such a high amount of spiritual power, as long as it didn't touch them directly and only observed them from a distance they couldn't find out.
Mono kept a passive face as he waited for Yun Jhin to return and then he smiled at him as he saw him materialize near his horse, Yun Jhin shook his head at Mono and said slowly:
"The guy from before is here in addition to another unknown stage 5 cultivator, if you think you can fight 2 people at the same stage, one even though albeit injured, I'm sure you haven't recovered fully as well."
Yun Jhin's words hit Mono were it hurt it was true he was only around 50% recovered according to his ki capacity, Mono looked at his men and then said:
"We will have to avoid this city, we need reinforcements from the military minister, he will need to send his private army if he wants to push out all of the invading forces *sigh* I'm sure the unknown cultivator must be from the Heavenly Turtle sect, they should have techniques on par with the imperial family."
Mono Sukehiro frowned, as he used a technique that could only be called decent, unlike the ones that the imperial family practiced and rarely let out of their hands, even if someone gathered enough merit they could only take low-level techniques out of their treasury.
Mono frown never left his face as he instructed the horses to avoid the city, Yun Jhin continued to cultivate on horseback as they left the city behind them. Back at the city, the dark-skinned man frowned as he looked in their direction and said to a pale man with his hair done in braids, the man wore a robe with the symbol of a rainbow tortoise on his chest and his features were above average.
The dark-skinned man growled as he looked at him and said:
"Suigo, you should have felt them retreating, should we follow?"
Suigo smiled leisurely as he said:
"From what I felt, they only have 1 5th stage ki cultivating expert, you are injured and this guy isn't at full power from the amount of ki he was emitting, I'm not sure what they were up to but it seems they knew they couldn't take over the city."
The man's smile dropped off as he said:
"Are there still Long Empire vermin in the city that warned them?"
His aura intensified in strength as his soul willpower encroached on the city, however, he didn't feel anything wrong, he could only feel his subordinates and the one from the Earth Kingdom, he frowned as he looked at the dark-skinned man and said:
"Think there are any traitors among our ranks?"
The dark-skinned man responded with the same facial expression as the other man as he said:
"Think someone from my squad betrayed us? No chance! The long Empire invaded us why would they defect to their side?"
This made sense, the man continued frowning as he continued to look around but he didn't feel anything, something really strange was going on.
Yun Jhin kept his back straight as his body was adapting to the changes the second stage ki cultivating realm were doing to his body, as he cultivated time passed and after a few days on horseback they finally saw a second city.
Mono waited for a little before he looked towards Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin knew hat Mono wanted him to do and he didn't say anything before he became invisible and walked towards the city, after some investigation, he found out that the city was thoroughly lacking in defense even though it has been taken over. Yun Jhin's speculations were correct, there must have been something at that city if it needed 2, 5th stage ki cultivating experts.
With the help of the army Yun Jhin easily took over the city, Mono narrowed his eyes as he looked around and came to the same conclusion as Yun Jhin, he took a strange-looking stone from the spatial bag that he had tied at his waist and talked into it:
"Hello-hello, general of the 1st legion Mono here, I have something to report, I need reinforcements quickly at City Horobros, the nearby city Boroso is under the control of 2, 5th stage ki cultivating experts, I need atleast someone around my strength or 10 4th stage Ki cultivating experts as reinforcements."
Mono nodded his head as he heard the words he wanted from the stone as he smiled at everyone and said:
"We will wait 5 days here for the reinforcements, then we will march directly to Boroso!"
It seemed there really was something important at City Boroso, if not why would the military minister send out a 5th stage expert out so easily? The military minister was at the 8th stage and he had very few 5th stage experts under him, at most he could have 4, and with the capital infested with spies, they needed all of their manpower there.
There must be something really important in that city if they could spare manpower... Yun Jhin looked towards the direction of city Boroso and shook his head, what could it be? If it was a treasure he wouldn't be interested, treasures were temporary things as he grew in strength they would become useless later, but if it was a rare material...
He kept his back straight as he looked to the horizon then left towards the house he was given to rest in, most of the people who lived in the city were massacred so after they took over it, it remained empty.
Yun Jhin sat on the bed as his head started to shine, his main body was ready to break through to the 6th stage of the heavenly realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 31: A change in plans
chapters.content:
Sun Sisheng's forehead started to glow in a certain blinding light as his main body was breaking through to the 6th stage of the heavenly realm, his caterpillar rank was continuously increasing as well, from the 10th rank to the 20th, 30th, 40th, it finally stopped at the 65th rank as tones of shredded skin came out of his hosts head.
The skin of a 6th stage heavenly realm caterpillar wouldn't have enough nutrients for a 2nd stage ki cultivating realm expert so he just burned the skins away instead of eating them like in the past. Yun Jhin kept a straight face as he looked down at his hands.
After he inspected his main body and his soul he directly went back to cultivating his host's body, just a little more and he could break through the 3rd stage if he did he could fight the 5th stage practitioners, and with some 'luck' he would be the only survivor in the city!
As Yun Jhin was making his plan, Mono was sharpening his swords in his house, he kept a straight face but his anger was still spilling out of him, it was visible as his aura was distorted and it burned with a certain vengeful attribute.
Mono muttered to him in a quiet voice:
"He should be the one who comes, yes, my revenge should come, for my sister..."
He opened his pendant which showed a young girl with black hair, he clutched the pendant as his eyes turned fiery and continued to mutter:
"After we take care of the enemies, I shall unleash it then."
Yun Jhin didn't know anything about what Mono planned, he kept cultivating in his room as if he was entranced suddenly his body started to contort and increase in height as he started to forcefully break through the 3rd stage, he felt the body adapted enough, even though it was way earlier than when he was supposed to break through, Yun Jhin decided to forgo waiting.
He could just get his hands on another body, but he felt the thing that these people were guarding could help his main body.
After a few days of waiting a sole male finally appeared in the city, he had blonde hair and an arrogant smirk on his face, his face was oval with a small nose, his pupils glowed with a deep green color and he wore the normal military uniform of the empire.
He walked slowly towards Mono's house as he waited, then Mono came out and his eyes couldn't hide his anger anymore as he slowly said:
"Long Minimus, you piece of trash..."
Minimus laughed as tears suddenly appeared at his eyes and he said:
"Sukehiro, you piece of crap, you are the one who requested reinforcements? I knew something was fishy when the military minister didn't say who I was supposed to help, and now I know why."
Minimus and Mono had extremely bad blood between them, Minimus abused Mono's younger sister to death when he was on a mission, as he thought that as imperial royalty he could do anything, and well the crown prince took over the case and closed it making Mono get no justice in the end.
Mono's hatred for the crown prince was great due to that, but his hatred was even higher at Minimus!
The man unsheathed both swords as he was seemingly ready to fight there and then but Yun Jhin walked out of his house and said with a cold tone of voice:
"General Mono, what are you doing? Fighting with the reinforcements?"
Minimus laughed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Oh, who is this fool? I quite like him already!"
Yun Jhin didn't respond to Minimus as he walked towards Mono and said:
"You can take care of him after we liberate the city, I feel these enemies aren't there for a random reason."
Minimus frowned as he looked at Yun Jhin up and down again as he said:
"Well aren't you a smart little soldier."
Yun Jhin looked at Minimus and said:
"I should be a general by now, however, due to the circumstances I couldn't get my medals."
Minimus looked at Yun Jhin as he felt his 3rd stage rampaging ki and he said:
"Oho, you have broken through the 3rd stage?"
Even Mono was startled as he looked at Yun Jhin and said slowly:
"But you have just broken through the 2nd stage a weak or so ago, you..."
Minimus eyes narrowed as he heard that and he changed the subject:
"As this guy here said, the Empire's needs come before yours Sukehiro, you should have known that since you joined the army."
A vile smile appeared on his face as he continued:
"Of course you should have also known what would happen to such a beautiful woman with no cultivation as well!"
Mono gritted his teeth so hard that blood flowed from his mouth but Yun Jhin patted him on the shoulder and said:
"It's not worth it."
Yun Jhin tried to play it off so he could use these two, but it seemed there has been a change of plans for him as Mono suddenly unsheathed his sword and his aura pushed Yun Jhin back.
Before Minimus could react a sword light immediately went towards his throat!
Minimus tried to react quickly but the light grazed his neck and it started to spurt blood, he put a hand on his jugular to try and calm the bleeding down but it wouldn't stop, more and more blood would flow out.
Mono put his guard down as he started to breathe extremely roughly as if he would fall down the next second, he looked at the dying man's eyes as the light started to fade from them and he said:
"This is for my sister you little son of a bitch."
He fell to his knees and then used his swords to support himself up, he looked around and smiled at Yun Jhin but when he looked at the location he blew him away to he realized he wasn't there anymore!
He looked down at his chest to only see a bloodied beating heart and a pendant, his eyes clouded over with his last strength he looked behind him to only see two red eyes staring into his soul:
"You have made things way easier for me Mono Sukehiro, I shall use your body well."
Mono chuckled as he said with his last breath:
"I was expecting you..."
But before he could finish his body fell on the ground, without breath.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he devoured both of their souls, his soul started mending at an extremely quick speed, combined with the souls from the other two cultivators, the woman and the elder he was ready for another breakthrough with his main body.
His Jaw opened up and both of the bodies entered in his stomach as they dissolved into nutrients for him, and with the memories, he gained from Minimus he realized what the guys at the city were protected, he smiled to himself as he went around killing the other generals and devouring them, he used his assassination technique so none of them realized they were dead. It was basically like dying in their sleep to them, however, their souls didn't have the same luck.
Yun Jhin finished the whole city in 3 hours, he chuckled as he sat cross-legged in the middle of the city, there was no one there anymore, the city was empty, of anything, empty houses laid around as a ghastly wind would breeze by from time to time.
Yun Jhin looked towards the horizon as he murmured to himself:
"Dragon stone?"
Yun Jhin got up from the ground and walked away from the city, he needed to get his hands on the dragon stone, he knew of a way that could break him away from his current weak caterpillar form!
And all he needed to do was get his hands on the dragon stone, even though he wouldn't be able to immediately use it, with his new plan in mind he knew what to do.
He threw away the communication stone from Mono's and Minimus's spatial bags as they were used for tracking as well and then took all of their belongings, after he finished sorting through everything on the way to the Boroso city, he made sure his body was in tip-top shape before he went head to head with two, stage 5 experts.
He pushed his body again as he ignored it's warnings, breaking through the 4th stage of the ki cultivating realm, at this rate his host body might not even be able to break through to the king realm anymore.
But Yun Jhin didn't care, all he cared about was the progress of his main body, and the dragon stone was something that would help him on his journey to true immortality, it was a thing that he had an utmost need of!
Yun Jhin used the strongest horse that remained alive, it was Minimus's mount, and with its extraordinary speed he reached city Boroso, however, he realized there was no one there anymore!
That meant they should have already excavated the dragon stone and they left Yun Jhin in the dust!
Yun Jhin face transformed into a gigantic scowl as he looked around, the dragon stone was vital to his plans!
With it, he could reach a caterpillar form that was around the 5,000 ranks!
He would be able to get rid of the host body and make his way into the world using his own!
He didn't hate using the host body but he disliked being cooped up inside a cranium, he wanted to use his own body!
It would give him way more satisfaction and he wouldn't have to act so much. Also, he would be able to gain strong wings in that form that could make it easy for him to roam around the world!
Yun Jhin unleashed his soul willpower at the fullest capacity as he used it to analyze how much time ago they left. Using the experience's from his previous lives along with logic and the things he found in the city he realized that they should have left 1 day ago.
Yun Jhin frowned as he continued to look around then found which direction they took, they directly walked into the sea!
Yun Jhin didn't even bat an eyelid as he quickly jumped into the sea and started to swim, he didn't need to use any techniques to breathe underwater as he was a living undead, he didn't need air to breathe!
He looked around and extended his soul willpower without any abandon to find their steps. He needed to get the dragon stone before they reached the Heavenly Turtle sect, or else he would have other problems to tackle then.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked in front of him, it seemed they were going deeper, deeper, and deeper inside the ocean.
Yun Jhin knew about the underwater sects so he didn't bat an eyelid as he continued to swim down, luckily for him, the other's didn't meet with their transport yet so after a few hours of swimming, he cloaked himself in his stealth technique as he observed the 5th stage duo from before and a 4th stage unknown person.
Yun Jhin made sure he was at his strongest as his muscles tensed up and his power increased, his hidden aura started fluctuating as he activated the forbidden technique he used before, he needed to kill all three of them in one strike and steal the dragon stone!

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Failure
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin knew he had to do things quickly or else he might fail in his endeavor, he was a person that hated failure so he wouldn't be able to look at himself anymore if he failed such an easy job. Yun Jhin aura started to increase as his muscles bulged up, veins started to appear on them, his breathing quickened his blood flow did the same, his undead heart started to beat as his putrid blood started to rush in his veins.
His red eyes glowed with a peculiar color and he gritted his teeth as he made sure his wild aura didn't leak at all, his perfect control over his host's ki made it possible, combined with his stealth technique the trio ahead of him didn't realize they were stalked by a predator that could gulp them up in seconds.
Small shockwaves started to appear around Yun Jhin's body as he speeds up, he immediately went directly to the unknown guy with the cultivation of the 4th stage, his hand was made into a spear motion as he made sure he would direct it into his chest and take his heart. This was one of his favorite finishing moves, it was also one of the quickest ones, taking out the heart directly was the best way to know someone was dead, that or decapitating.
However the 4th stage unknown guy smiled to himself as he dodged Yun Jhin's attack at the last second, however, Yun Jhin still grabbed him by the arm and ripped the appendage off!
The man continued laughing as he looked at the fountain of blood that came out of his stump and said:
"Digo, Bango, GO TAKE CARE OF HIM!"
Yun Jhin frowned as the dark-skinned man and the other 5th stage practitioner made a pincer attack towards him, however, his breakthroughs combined with his use of the forbidden technique and his constitution made him able to fight a 6th stage cultivator, while 2 5th stage ones would be troublesome he could still deal with them for some time and even kill them both if they didn't get reinforcements!
As Yun Jhin failed with his attack he made sure he didn't leave the 4th stage cultivator alive as he grunted and sent 2 dark-colored balls of ki at the man, the balls collided with his body and electrocuted him to death, the dark electricity spread to the 5th stage duo and Yun Jhin himself, but while the duo got fried Yun Jhin took no damage!
His aura changed as electricity started to run around his body, he didn't like open combat but that didn't mean he was weak in it!
His body disappeared as his meridians burst with electricity increasing the speed of the body to an immense degree, due to the body's sturdiness even though his meridians started cracking they held well.
The dark-skinned man was called Digo and his body was very sturdy, he wouldn't be able to kill him one shoot but the other guy looked quite frail, he decided to attack him while he dodged a straight claw attack that came from Digo.
Digo furrowed his brows as his claw missed, he was strong and steady but not fast, Yun Jhin's figure appeared near Bango as his hand went directly to his chest, ready to pierce through and take out his heart!
Yun Jhin's attack hit home but the man dissipated as if he was an illusion, Yun Jhin looked around and his hand went directly to an empty area behind him, a cough could be heard as blood started to appear in the clear water, Yun Jhin smiled as he retracted his hand, a heart that was slowly stopping it's beating was in his hand. His hand quickly went directly to the man's spatial bag but he frowned as he found that it didn't have the dragon stone.
He looked at the dark-skinned man and he launched himself directly at him but before he could do anything light started to shine on his body, Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the formation and realized that it was a teleportation one!
Such a weak sect with only a King Realm expert had a formation master that could lay teleportation formations?
Yun Jhin frowned as he sent out a long slash of energy that struck at the man's spatial bag destroying it and spilling all of its contents, Yun Jhin saw the stone and lunged towards it, he grabbed it as the man disappeared but a big smile was on his face as he pointed towards his pants and he pulled a similar-looking stone out of them.
Yun Jhin cursed as he watched the man vanish and roared in the sea as the water around him started to evaporate due to his anger, he broke the fake dragon stone into little bits with his hand as he unleashed a giant beam out of his mouth that destroyed the seafloor.
He started to control himself and said:
"I have let my anger take a hold of me, *sigh* I didn't think there would be a teleportation formation on that guy's body, did they stay in this region to charge it?"
Yun Jhin could feel that this region had quite a lot of spatial ki in it, that meant his guess was right, only if he could have gotten here faster...
The only way for him to get his hands on the dragon stone would be to directly infiltrate the Heavenly Turtle sect, but it was currently impossible, he would need to switch bodies, even though he could change his outer form with the ki technique, the sect must have some ki detecting formation that he couldn't fool, even though his main body wouldn't be found, his host's body would surely will.
Yun Jhin frowned as he left the sea and returned to the city, he broke his own arm and hit himself in the stomach as he laid down seemingly 'dying' on the ground, after a few hours of waiting a squadron of fighters from the empire found him and took him away.
After 'regaining consciousness' Yun Jhin found himself into a medical tent, the doctor there walked forward to him and said:
"The minister of the military has sent out 2 other generals besides Minimus after he found out Minimus died, they found you unconscious and half-dead at the city with no one else in sight, could you tell us what happened? Wait for a little so the generals can come."
The medic rushed out of the tent and later came with two imposing men full of muscles that looked the same, it seemed they were twins, both of them were bald and wore the imperial armor of the minister of military showing that they stood in his camp, the minister of the military worked with the minister of the left who supported the crown prince.
The duo talked in unison as they questioned Yun Jhin:
"General Sisheng, would you mind telling us what happened?"
Yun Jhin coughed a bit as some blood welled up from his throat and stained his clothes, his hand was dangling in front of him as it didn't heal properly yet, it seemed they didn't apply the treatment for him, Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as he looked at them and said slowly:
"Ah I'm quite injured you see, maybe could you fix my arm first before I can give my report?"
The duo frowned then they motioned for the medic to enter back, then he settled Yun Jhin's arm back into its socket and gave him a pill which immediately healed some of his self inflicted injuries.
The twins then came slowly in front of Yun Jhin and glared at him while saying:
"Now that you are healed, could you tell us what happened to general Mono, General Minimus, and all of the other troops?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he started his story when general Minimus came:
"General Minimus and General Mono started off by fighting each other at the base, then after they settled their differences, *cough* I and some other soldiers had to stop Mono before he dealt a fatal blow to Minimus."
Yun Jhin's coughing worsened as he coughed up another mouthful of blood and continued:
"After we made sure Mono and Minimus were at full power we ran at our quickest speed towards the city, there we met with two 5th stage ki cultivating experts, Minimus was fatally wounded by one of them and then... General Mono gave the finishing blow taking General Minimus's life."
The duo frowned as they looked at each other then nodded seemingly beliving the story, they knew the story behind Minimus's and Mono's hatred, so it wasn't surprising to them that Mono would do such a thing. Yun Jhin didn't technically lie to them there.
As he continued his story Yun Jhin coughed a few more times and the medic had to stabilize his condition, even though he needed to rest from what the medic said, the twin duo didn't want to let him go before he finished his report:
"After Mono killed Minimus he fought a deadly 1v2 fight, in the end, he took one down but the dark-skinned man he fought before made him meet his end, as for me and the others, there was a back up at the 4th stage that fatally injured me and then he killed the others, fortunately, I faked my death using my corpse technique if not I wouldn't be here to report this to you."
Yun Jhin finished his report as he 'collapsed' on the bed and he coughed one more mouthful of dark blood, the medic quickly came to him and started resuscitating him with lightning ki, after a while the doctor felt that he wouldn't die, he knew that he cultivated a special corpse technique, but he could still feel his life force, as it wasn't decreasing anymore he thought that he wouldn't die.
Yun Jhin stopped controlling the level of his life force as he smirked inside, he fooled these empire dogs but he grimaced as he thought about his failure, to get his hands on the dragon stone wouldn't be easy.
However, before he could cultivate under the guise of resting a palm smacked him in the face as he was seemingly 'awakened' by it.
He looked up at one of the twins which hit him in the face and gritted his teeth as he made himself look like he was unable to get up and said:
"What's wrong I told you everything!"
The man laughed as he said:
"True I couldn't see any lie in your story, however, there's one thing you forgot to tell me!"
He put a paper that had the image of the dragon stone on it and shouted in his ear:
"DID YOU SEE THIS STONE?"
Yun Jhin squinted his eyes then widened them as he said:
"Yes, yes, I saw the dark-skinned man take it in his spatial bag, when we got there they just excavated it from the city lord's house, I wonder why would the city lord keep such a thing under his house.."
The man frowned as he heard Yun Jhin's words then he looked at his brother and said to Yun Jhin:
"You did a great job out there peasant, I will make sure the crown prince hears of your merit."
The man gave a creepy smile to Yun Jhin as he said those words, Yun Jhin knew the man was going to embezzle his merits but he just nodded his head and made it look like he was too tired and injured to realize that.
The twin brothers laughed in unison as they left the medical tent behind, the medic from before continued to tent to Yun Jhin's body as he monitored his life force, as he felt that it was increasing steadily he left the tent and went to do other miscellaneous jobs.
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt the damage done around his body, the self-inflicted damage was only on the surface, as for the attacks from the others they didn't faze him much, the most damage that he got was from the forbidden technique and his forceful breakthroughs.
He frowned as he felt that he would need atleast 2 years to heal this normally, the damage from the forbidden technique could be healed faster, but if he didn't take care of the sequelae from forcefully breaking through he would have to abandon this body, not because it wouldn't be able to fight anymore, but because it wouldn't be able to get him to the King Realm!
He deeply frowned inside as he kept his unconscious act up, he thought about what herbs he needed to heal his body quickly and then made sure those were the things he would ask for with his merit, as for the dragon stone, he would make sure he got his hands on it sooner or later.
As long as Yun Jhin wanted something, he would be able to get his hands on it, he would also need to show these two bald muscle heads who was boss afterward, even if the emblazed his rewards, he would make sure they coughed up double of what they took at the minimum!

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Get rid of Sun Sisheng?
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin was recovering inside the medical tent, the twins reported Yun Jhin's story to the crown prince, the crown prince responded to them with these words:
"Sun Sisheng might still be useful, however, my younger brother enrolled him into the army, you have said he reached the 4th stage of the ki cultivating realm? If he shows his allegiance to me you can spare him, but if he says that he will still be under my brother.. you know what to do, get rid of him while he is still weak!"
The twin's nodded at each other as they responded into the communication stone:
"Yes your highness, we will see to it!"
The duo smiled at each other as they went directly to Yun Jhin without any other stops, they woke him up the same way as before but instead of looking at an arm like before he now saw a sword near his neck, one of the brothers said with a deep laugh:
"You trash, you now have 2 options, join the crown prince's party or die, we will let you think about your choice."
Yun Jhin immediately said nonchalantly:
"I will join."
The duo guffawed as they looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"So easy?"
The twins then immediately reported to the crown prince, the crown prince frowned as he looked at his communication stone and then gave out the order:
"I have a peculiar mission that he can do in the capital, send him back, and make sure that he is fully healed."
The duo gave out an affirmative response and then closed the link with the communication stone, afterward they took some herbs from their spatial bags and made Yun Jhin eat them, Yun Jhin complied and ate them, they were supposed to be poisonous but they wouldn't do anything to his undead body.
However he put on an act as his countenance paled, then the duo smiled as they weaved their hands in some strange hand seals and inserted their ki inside his body. It was a poisonous formation that Yun Jhin easily neutralized in such a way that the duo thought that it was still in effect.
Afterward, they chuckled as they told him:
"The crown prince just got a new dog, but you will have to work for us when the crown prince doesn't order you around you trash!"
Yun Jhin smiled at them when suddenly he disappeared from the bed and appeared behind the two of them, he poked both of them in the same meridian point at the neck freezing their bodies, they looked at Yun Jhin with terror in their eyes as they realized they provoke a calamity on themselves, but Yun Jhin just patted the duo on their shoulders and said slowly:
"You see, I don't really like being controlled, especially by two pieces of trash like you, you aren't even true imperials, I will only do what the crown prince says, and to make sure you don't say anything to him."
He returned them the favor by inserting a poisonous formation in both of their bodies, one trigger from him made the pain and certain death arrive on their heads slowly.
As they experienced the first taste of the formation they nodded with all of their might as Yun Jhin unfroze their bodies then they kowtowed to him and said:
"Lord Sisheng is strong and mighty, we will make sure the crown prince doesn't hear about this!"
Yun Jhin nodded at them and then asked:
"Do you have anything special for me to ride back to the capital?"
The duo nodded hastily as they guided him to one of their mounts, it was a giant lizard at the first stage of the heavenly realm, it was pretty tame and Yun Jhin immediately jumped on its saddle and made it move towards the capital.
The twins looked at each other as they smiled ruefully and said:
"We kicked a hornet's nest."
"Yeah."
"We are his slaves now."
"Yeah."
"Can you say anything besides yeah?"
"No."
While the duo was having their conversation Yun Jhin's surroundings were changing at an amazing speed as he was getting nearer and nearer to the capital. After a few hours of the lizard running at full speed, he got to the capital's gates!
There he met with a guard that immediately ushered him into the imperial palace, there inside a secret room he met with the crown prince and the left minister.
The crown prince was a tall man around 2 meters tall, he had a long blonde mane tied in a ponytail, he wore blue imperial robes with the characters of 'ruler' and 'crown prince' on them, he had an angular face and deep blue eyes, the minister of left wore official robes, he was a thin old man around 1,70 meters with braided white hair and a small mustache on his face.
He stood behind the prince as he waited for him to talk. The prince looked Yun Jhin up and down for a little while before he said:
"I do not believe that you have betrayed my brother, my mission to you is simple, go to the dragon eating sect and assassinate him, I want to see his head!"
Yun Jhin nodded his head slowly as he looked at the crown prince and said:
"I can do that but I have taken quite the hard injuries fighting for the country, If I assassinate him I would like to be able to cash all of my merits afterward."
A glint appeared in the crown prince's eyes as he looked at Yun Jhin and he laughed as he opened his mouth and said:
"Of course, of course, as a mighty general from the army how could I deny your merits? Do your job and you should be able to get your hands on anything on the treasury as long as you have enough merits."
Yun Jhin put his hands in his robe as he took out a list of materials and said:
"I need all of the herbs on this list."
The crown prince looked at the list and nodded his head, some of them were fairly rare but he could use his authority to get them if he didn't reward his subordinates the other ones might riot on him and that was the last thing he needed during the invasion of the Earth Kingdom and the Heavenly Turtle sect.
Yun Jhin left the palace in a hurry as he returned to the dragon eating sect grounds, he quickly decapitated the second prince's body and incinerated the remains, afterward he got back to the palace and showed the crown prince his brother's head!
The crown prince clapped slowly as he observed the head and made sure it wasn't a fake one, then he took it from Yun Jhin's hands and evaporated it with ki. His mouth curved upwards slowly as he said:
"Oh second brother, would you have ever thought that offending me to such a high degree would make even your subordinates betray you? Hahahahaha!"
As the prince was enjoying his familial victory, the minister of the left whispered something to a guard, the guard came later with a spatial bag that contained all of the herbs that Yun Jhin required, the crown prince took the spatial bag and weighted it as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Here's a reward for a job well done, all your merits are now clean!"
Yun Jhin frowned as he caught the bag and looked inside of it, even though the herbs were quite rare they wouldn't be worth that much, it meant that he was charging him more for the herbs but he didn't say anything, in the end, they would all be the sheep that he would slaughter, he would just need to break through the king realm and get his hands on the dragon stone, and he would be the ruler of the Long empire!
He bowed his head as he left the imperial palace, princess Mumu wanted to catch up, but Yun Jhin slowly denied her advances and said he was injured and that he needed to recover, Mumu looked at him with love-filled eyes as she traced her finger on his chest and said:
"Of course, how silly of me, go and recover, I heard you had done many things for the empire."
Yun Jhin blew her a kiss as he left, making her blush deeply as she entered back into the palace, Yun Jhin frowned inside as he looked at the dumb woman that kept pestering him, he couldn't get rid of her near the palace, and she wouldn't leave the palace grounds much either, however, to him she was just a nuisance that he could ignore.
Yun Jhin went back to the dragon eating sect grounds and dismissed everyone there, as Yun Jhin was way stronger than before they all listened to him, especially the ones that saw him decapitate the second prince, in the main hall where the prince's throne was he met Susang.
He looked a bit better than before, it seemed his marriage bloomed, however, he had tears in his eyes as he looked at Yun Jhin and shouted:
"How could you have betrayed his highness? He took care of you and took you in his sect, he gave you opportunities and sent you in the army so you can gain merit! You are an animal!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at Susang and said slowly:
"It was either me or him Susang, you should understand that all people would look after their lives instead of others, you should understand, the crown prince had me at his mercy, it was either killing the second prince or dying myself, I have gone so far with my cultivation and I feel this isn't the end of my progress, you should feel it yourself."
Yun Jhin's aura engulfed Susang as he looked at him with cold eyes, Susang eyes widened in surprise and then into fear as they looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"You, you are a cultivating monster! You are already at the 4th stage of the ki cultivating realm? How many months has it been since you came to the capital?"
He moved backward in fear, as he stepped away from Yun Jhin, but Yun Jhin slowly walked towards him putting more and more pressure on his body, as Susang finally felt that he would die, all of the dark aurae returned to Yun Jhin, he walked ahead ignoring Susang as he went to his old room.
Susang gasped for air as he looked at Yun Jhin's back and he said:
"It seems you still have some humanity left in you, I can understand that the crown prince gave the order..."
But before he could say anything else his head flew up into the air, the head looked down at its body as his life disappeared from his eyes, they turned a dull grey as the last remaining words left his mouth:
"But I still consider you my friend..."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said to himself:
"Friends? Why would I need that, friends can betray you, friends can hurt you, friends can steal from you, there is no such thing as friends in this cold cultivation world, it will always be an exchange of benefits between two parties, if one party doesn't benefit anymore from the second one, that party will get disposed of immediately!"
He walked inside his room as he left the body there, a 1st stage ki cultivating realm expert was of no use to him anymore, only those at his realm and above would give him enough nutrients and ki.
Just like Susang thought, his newly wedded wife became a widow, but not because he went to war and never came back, but because he was foolish enough to confront Yun Jhin after he killed the prince!

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Healing and killing
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin entered his former room as he took a deep breath and opened his spatial bag, out of there he took all of the herbs he needed and mashed them together using his hands, as he cupped his hands together with the mashed herbs a purple flame appears in his hands. As the flame intensity increased a multitude of impurities were extracted from the herb mush.
Then he used the herb mush to clean his body, the soothing feeling of the hot herb mush immediately gave him a good feeling, his tense torn muscles started to mend and relax, his hidden injuries started to slowly heal, after he made sure he finished with his outer body, he took the mush of herbs and heated them again.
After he finished heating the herbs again, he took a cauldron out of his spatial bag and threw the herbs inside, then he put a lid on the cauldron and increased the heat from his flames, the heat of the flames was way higher than before as the herbs started to liquify in the cauldron, the liquid then started to harden in the form of a multicolored pill.
After a few hours of creating the pill, he finally stopped heating the cauldron. Opening the lid of the cauldron he looked inside and smiled as he took the pill in his hands, he then scribbled the pill with some little formation runes and inserted his ki in it. After he finished with everything he opened his mouth and ate the pill!
The pill dissolved into his stomach as a smile appeared on his face, all of his hidden injuries started to heal at extreme speed as he kept a cold expression on his face, after a few days of resting and letting all of the medicinal effects heal him fully he walked outside the headquarters of the dragon eating sect, then as he looked backward he let loose a barrage of flames that engulfed the headquarters and destroyed it!
There was no need for the headquarters to exist as the sect master was dead, Susang's body was still in there and it burnt to cinders along with the headquarters, Yun Jhin gave him a flame funeral.
He slowly started to walk towards the capital after he finished everything at the headquarters, the body snatcher knew that the crown prince would send for him sooner or later, so he decided to go by himself if he was lucky he might get appointed to the dragon stone retrieval team.
As Yun Jhin entered the capital he met with a guard which directly invited him to meet the crown prince, Yun Jhin shook his head inside, the crown prince was very previsible in his opinion.
Yun Jhin went directly to the imperial palace and met with the crown prince and the left minister again, the crown prince looked like he didn't sleep well for some days as there were dark bags under his eyes, he smiled faintly at Yun Jhin as he entered the room and he said:
"You are the last one who saw the dragon stone, might you tell me in which direction the one who stole it went?"
Yun Jhin knew the twins must have reported what he said to the crown prince by now but the crown prince wanted to see if I omitted anything or lied. Yun Jhin opened his mouth and said:
"I'm not sure your highness, they walked towards the docks of the city, they could have gone into the ocean, maybe that's where their sect is located?"
The crown prince's eyes widened as he looked the left minister and slowly said:
"Under the ocean? Yes, I see I see now!"
The crown prince always wondered how such a small kingdom like the Earth Kingdom could travel the sea to attack them in such a way, but with the help of the underwater sect, things would be way easier for them!
The crown prince kept a warm smile on his face as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Thanks for the extra information Sisheng, I see why my second brother believed in you, fortunately, you made the right decision and sided with me, anyways my little sister asked for you and I wouldn't want to keep her waiting, you should go and meet her, afterward, come back because I have an important mission for you..."
The crown prince left the room and walked towards the imperial hall where the throne was then he disappeared from Yun Jhin's view, Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the hall and said to himself:
"Formation behind the throne, I guess that's where the emperor is currently residing to heal himself... I cannot attack yet, I would need to be atleast at the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm."
He shook his head as he went to talk with princess Mumu for a while then Yun Jhin left her alone, the princess felt very wronged as she wanted to give her body to him but Yun Jhin wasn't interested at all, after all, his true body was a caterpillar and his host's body was living undead, the only disadvantage of a living undead body would be its erectile dysfunction, however, Yun Jhin could have cared less about this weakness when he made the host's body eat the pill.
If Sun Sisheng soul was still alive he would have cried seeing how Yun Jhin handled his little brother.
Not long after he finished dealing with the princess he met with the left minister, the old man nodded at Yun Jhin as he said slowly:
"The crown prince is left attending some important matters with his imperial father, he told me to give you the mission instead, and it's going to be a very important one."
The older man had a strange glint in his eyes as he looked at Yun Jhin and opened his mouth again:
"Your file says that you have a very strong stealth technique, the crown prince told me that you should go and scout out the Heavenly Turtle's sect location if you do that you would gain unpreceded merit!"
Yun Jhin laughed inside as he heard the older man, they were sending him to death!
Even if he did find the Heavenly Turtle sect location there was a very high chance he could trigger a formation if he wasn't careful enough, after all, the sect had a formation master!
He was a formation master in his previous lives, even though he was one of the highest grades formation masters, it remained that a long time passed since he was last reincarnated, some formations would change forms in time and new formations would be birthed, thus he would have to take some time to reread and observe new formations in action before he could say he was up to date with all of the new formation information from this era.
He wasn't sure how much time passed since his last reincarnation but he thought that it must have been quite a long while as he didn't hear anything or read anything about the Blood Throne his former sect, they were one of the strongest Godly Sects out there of the evil alignment, everyone would tremble in front of their actions and reputation, they have done countless evil things under the guise of attaining eternal life.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he stopped thinking about these things, as long as he observed the formation of that formation master enough time he would be able to decipher it and make sure he wouldn't trigger it no matter what happened!
Yun Jhin nodded at the left minister and the man chuckled inside as he looked at Yun Jhin but he didn't let anything spill on his outside expression as he patted Yun Jhin's shoulder and said:
"You are a great general of our empire, I will make sure your deeds will be known by everyone in our empire when you come back with the information!"
Yun Jhin was ready to kill this old fart in front of him right here and then, but he was at the 7th level of the ki cultivating realm and he was also inside the imperial palace, it wasn't worth it.
Yun Jhin was then sent back to the city on the lizard mount, he wasn't given anything besides a communication stone and some reinvigoration pills. Yun Jhin looked around as he entered the dock city and met with the twins, the twins immediately bowed to him as they said:
"Moro and Toro are greeting lord Sisheng."
Yun Jhin waved at them and then he looked around as he retraced his steps and told the duo:
"You stay here and protect the city, I have a special mission from the crown prince, I have to go alone."
Moro and Toro nodded simultaneously and then went back to their jobs. Yun Jhin looked at their receding figures as he shook his head if it came to a deadly situation he would use the formation he planted into their bodies to extract all of their nutrients and ki to send them to his host's body, they weren't only poisonous formations, they were long-range transfer formations as well!
Yun Jhin jumped into the ocean as he started to swim back to the location where the dark-skinned man was teleported, he could trace the teleportation back to the location using the coordinates left behind by the formation ki, however for that he would need quite a lot of time and concentration, he didn't do that before because it would make the others suspicious if everyone was wiped out.
As Yun Jhin concentrated the underwater currents started to beat his body, he ignored them as they wouldn't do anything to his tempered undead body, light sparks started to appear around him that he traced using his soul willpower.
His soul willpower was quickly exhausting itself doing this, this was the power of the king realm that he was using at the ki cultivating realm!
Yun Jhin's face scrunched up as his sou willpower weakened but he continued using it to find the coordinates of the sect. Almost when his soul willpower emptied he finally found out the coordinates, it was quite a long way from him and he would need to swim for almost 2 months to get to it!
However his job was done, he knew where the sect was located, he wanted to go there himself but he lacked in materials and cultivation base to create a teleportation formation, he would need to go with the others from the empire, that way while the others fought their hearts out with the Heavenly Turtle sect, he could be the fisherman who would catch both the sandpiper and clam.
Yun Jhin started swimming out of the ocean at a slow speed as he recovered his soul willpower, he clutched the bead from the fairies sect then he opened his mouth and ate it!
The energy of the treasure directly entered into his soul and increase the speed of his soul willpower recovery, the treasure was useless for him and the only way to make a use for it was by extracting the soul liquid inside of it.
He breathed out as he finally swam out of the ocean and went back to the city, there he called the crown prince and told him the location of the Heavenly Turtle sect, the crown prince was at first perturbed that he location was found this fast but he decided to believe in Yun Jhin's words and he sent out his private squad full with elites!
He also sent out some aquatic mounts that could reduce the traveling time, when Yun Jhin said that he wanted to join the operation the crown prince told him that he was welcomed to join along with the twins, but inside the crown prince took them as cannon fodder that would help his elites to recover the dragon stone.
But Yun Jhin already had a plan in mind that would make him gain everything he needed from this journey, as long as the elites did as he guessed, he would fake his death and get his hands on the dragon stone as well!
After he became strong enough he would come back with the dragon stone and take over the Long Empire to fully enact the plan he concocted when he found out about the existence of the stone in question.

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Invade the Heavenly Turtle sect
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin waited inside a tent with the twins, his face was a cold mask that didn't betray any of his emotions as he looked at the duo and asked them with a monotone tone:
"Any information about the elite squad of the crown prince?"
The duo sweated intensely as they looked at Yun Jhin's expression that didn't tell them anything and they bowed quickly as they immediately started to spill the information:
"The elite squad consists of 25 people with the cultivation of 6th stage ki cultivating realm and above, they are consisting in 10 attack roles 10 defending roles and 5 support roles, 5 attack roles are for short-range and 5 for long-range, the defending roles are full of people who focused on cultivating iron ki and refining their bodies, as for the support roles they have focused on plants and healing ki, they all have handpicked cultivation techniques from the imperial treasury."
The duo kept their face straight as they continued their report:
"As for the captain he has reached the peak of the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm and it's said as long as he gets enough merit on the battlefield, the emperor might help him break through to the legendary King Realm!"
Yun Jhin waved his hand indicating that they could shut up, he caressed his chin as he thought what he would need to do to make sure his host's body was going to survive this endeavor, he needed to make sure his main body was safe too, he decided that he would hide his main body in the ground before they went to the Heavenly Turtle sect grounds.
Before the elite squad came Yun Jhin hid his main body inside the ground 20 kilometers down, he hid his aura and soul fluctuations to make sure no one could find his body as he would have to put all his concentration on controlling the body at long-range.
Sun Sisheng's body then walked back to the tent and waited with the duo for the squad to come, after a day of waiting the squad of people came, the captain was a short unsightly man with crossed eyes, his pale sickly skin tone showed that he wasn't alright physically, his thick grey hair showed that his life force was imbalanced and used even though it seemed he wasn't that old.
The captain wore a strange imperial armor that consisted of a big chest piece that covered his whole body like a suit, his eyes were covered by half a helmet that looked like some devil's horns. Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he observed the captain, but suddenly the captain pointed his finger at Yun Jhin and said:
"You, you have to show us the way to the sect!"
The captain said those words then didn't say anything else, he was a strange man, Yun Jhin nodded at the man and then looked around at the other squad members, but none of the other's looked peculiar or strange, everyone else looked and acted normally.
The captain waved his hands to his subordinates as they opened their special spatial bags and let out the water horses, they then let them into the water to regain their strengths, the water horse was an aquatic horse with gills and no nose holes, they were deep blue had scales over their bodies and had no tails, but besides those changes, there wasn't any difference in appearance with a normal horse.
The captain immediately went over to a water horse and took hold of its rains as he pointed at Yun Jhin again and then pointed at a horse indicating that he should take that one.
Yun Jhin went over to the pointed horse and the other's from the squad took over their horses as well, the twins stood behind Yun Jhin and waited for the captain's orders.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes for a little before making sure everything was already in his host's body and then made the water horse moved forward, as the surroundings changed Yun Jhin looked around and saw that all of his 'colleagues' were using ki to support their breathing, Yun Jhin nodded to himself, this way they wouldn't be at full power when they got to the sect, however, the captain used a bubble artifact that let him breathe underwater.
Yun Jhin frowned inside as he looked at the artifact, he knew that the man would conserve his ki for the big fights out there, and unless the sect master came out to deal with them they would be able to rampage around the sect, the man looked like he had a unique physique and strange bloodline that increased his battle power, he might even be able to fight with a 1st stage King realm, of course, being able to fight didn't mean he could win nor run away, in the end, the difference between realms was too high.
Only Yun Jhin could fight between realms and maybe win, but he would need to be on home advantage and use formations with this body, the higher the talent of the body the higher the battle power, while Sun Sisheng's body was pretty talented considering the location, he was still far away from reaching the apex.
Yun Jhin kept a straight face as he sat on the horse and cultivated, while the others would chat and joke from time to time they would all ignore Yun Jhin as he was cannon fodder to them. However, they would talk with twins and even joke with them, it seemed they knew each other from previous meetings with the crown prince.
Yun Jhin cultivated with his eyes closed as he waited to reach the Heavenly turtle's sect grounds, while he cultivated the strange captain seemingly dozed off, but Yun Jhin knew that the man wasn't actually sleeping as he felt his soul willpower looking out for any ambushes.
The body snatcher kept a neutral expression on his face as he closed his eyes and cultivated while he made sure his horse kept going the right way, with the coordinates he gained from using his soul willpower he could easily imprint them in the horse's mind and make it go the way he wanted.
Finally, after 15 days of swimming the 'elite team' of the Long Empire reached the Heavenly Turtle sect location.
As they finally reached their location Yun Jhin slowly opened his eyes as he looked around and put his plan in action as he looked at the captain and said:
"I have done my job."
The man chuckled ominously as he released his 9th stage ki cultivating power directly at Yun Jhin, the man's aura engulfed him as it stopped him from moving, his aura was so strong that it started crushing his body slowly signs of the man reaching the gate of the king realm.
While Yun Jhin was struggling to keep himself steadily on the horse the man looked directly at him and said:
"I heard from a little birdie that you have very good stealth technique, you go ahead and scout things up, your job here isn't done at all!"
Yun Jhin frowned as he said slowly to the man:
"There is a formation around the perimeter, I will need time to locate a weak spot."
The man kept steady on his water horse as he put his hand up and showed 5 fingers:
"You have 5 hours."
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he looked at the formation, he didn't need 5 hours, he could crack it in 2, even though the formation master did a great job, it seemed he just broke through the formation master realm and didn't specialize in defensive formations.
Yun Jhin looked around at the sect, the buildings were created from differently colored corals, most of the corals consisted of red and blue but there were some green scattered here and there too, most of the buildings were tall and they spanned across the ocean floor, it seemed that no one stood outside the protective formation as Yun Jhin and the others watched from afar.
Yun Jhin observed the formation for a while and said softly to the captain after 5 hours:
"I have found a weak point and I'm ready to go in, I should be able to find some information quickly depending on the people that I can capture."
Yun Jhin entered through the gap in the formation and found himself inside the sect, he became transparent as he used his stealth technique and he looked around for someone that looked like he was important enough around the sect.
As he kept looking around he finally found a woman that kept her head up as she sneered at the other disciples around her, she was a beauty of the considerable standard but Yun Jhin just narrowed his eyes as he started tailing her, finally after a while she entered her cultivation dwelling and Yun Jhin followed behind.
The woman jumped on her fluffy bed as she sighed and slowly said:
"It's so tough keeping a cold appearance to these disciples, but I must keep it up so I can inspire them to train harder!"
It seemed the Heavenly Turtle sect was a mostly female sect with 60% females and 40% males from what Yun Jhin saw, his form was transparent as he approached her bed from behind and he looked down at her, his hand directly latched on her throat making her unable to let out even a peep, she was at the 1st stage of the ki cultivating stage so there was no way she could do anything to him.
The soul willpower that he kept inside Sun Sisheng's body immediately entered the woman's sea of consciousness and devoured her memories and soul, Yun Jhin nodded to himself as he now knew the sect, he got a free map and information about the sect from the woman's memories and discarded the useless ones.
Yun Jhin left the woman's cultivation dwelling as he patted his stomach and left, he waved his way around the disciples and left the sect where he met outside with the invading elite team.
He took out a map that he created inside the woman's dwelling and gave it to the captain, the captain took the map and looked at it for a few seconds before taking a better look at the sect, even though the sect was as big as the imperial capital, maybe even a little bigger, the map was extremely detailed showing the whole sect.
The captain nodded at Yun Jhin and then said:
"You go in again and we will follow you from behind, it seems we are at the middle sect grounds, we will have to enter deeper to get to the treasury to retrieve the dragon stone."
Yun Jhin abided to the man's instructions and entered ahead, but instead of letting them follow him he disappeared, he then took control of an earthly realm newbie and put her to stay near the hole in the formation, there she immediately shrieked as she saw burly men and a strange-looking old man appear from nowhere.
The captain tsked as he now had the hand of the woman in his hands and said:
"We will have to rush to the treasury immediately, it seems we were unlucky and an earthly realm newbie saw us."
Yun Jhin made it so the woman would appear at the location the moment they entered so it looked just like a coincidence.
The captain looked at Yun Jhin and nodded his head as he said:
"You and the twins make sure you keep us ahead as we go further into the sect, we will need you to supply information and scout, so go forward, your technique should be shared with others right?"
Yun Jhin nodded as he made the twins transparent and made them follow him, he chuckled inside as he looked at the old man following slowly from behind, with the information he got from that 1st stage ki cultivating woman he would make sure they entered into the lion's den, after all, the map he gave them was tampered with.
Yun Jhin made to keep a steady distance between them as he lured them to an inconspicuous looking house, where he became visible as he made some motions with his hands and indicated that this should be the treasury.
The captain looked at the map and then saw that this building was highlighted so he just walked directly to it without any thought that it would be a trap!

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Grand Elder Xue Piao
chapters.content:
The moment the captain wandered too close to the building a hairy old man that looked like a gorilla came out of the building and punched the captain directly in the head throwing him away from the building.
Yun Jhin was already invisible and a long way from the building as he watched the elder angrily look around then he shouted:
"Invaders from the Long Empire? You bunches of trash!"
The elder wore a short open white robe that showed his muscles and hairy body, it was also quite disheveled so that meant before he was interrupted he must have had some fun with a fellow elder or a disciple.
He immediately shouted as he released his aura and became a killing god as he rushed into the formation of elites, as they stopped the elder and pushed him back, the captain got up from the rubble as he cleaned some blood from his head and appeared in front of the elder.
The elder countered with a ball of lightning to the face that the captain easily negated with his own, his power started spiking as he punched the elder in the stomach, that threw the elder back into the building which destroyed half of it, the elder then came out covered in blood, but it wasn't his own!
The elder said with gritted teeth:
"How dare you! I grand elder Xue Piao will make you suffer for killing my disciple!"
Technically speaking Xue Piao killed the disciple himself as his body collided with hers, it seemed she was really weak if such a collision transformed her body into mush.
Yun Jhin kept himself out of their way as he made sure he walked towards the right direction of the treasury, this commotion should startle the whole sect and make them rush towards this location.
The captain frowned as he looked around trying to see Yun Jhin then his brows furrowed under his helmet and he shouted:
"There's a chance Sun Sisheng betrayed us! Make sure you kill him on sight!"
The elites clamored as they shouted a yes in unison and started to help their captain to deal with elder Xue Piao. However, the elder was a tough nut that couldn't be cracked easily, he easily kept all of them at bay even though he was injured, he was waiting for reinforcements!
Yun Jhin stopped looking at the fight as he quickly ran away towards the treasury, a small building appeared in front of him after he dodged around the frantic disciples for a long while, he chuckled inside as he looked at the treasury and entered, the formation there was the same as the one that covered the sect, it had a hole in it which could be easily exploited for him. The twins were already dead as he extracted their nutrients with the formation he put on them.
They would drag him down and make him use extra ki to keep their cover-up so he just disposed of them, he kept the extra ki and nutrients in his body just in case he needed a burst to heal up any sudden injuries that might make him unable to escape.
There was a very high chance the captain and the elite squad would be buried on the Heavenly Turtle's sect grounds.
As he entered the treasury a visible frown appeared on his face, things weren't as easy as entering and leaving!
He had to alter some formations to continue inside the treasury, and there were physical traps as well, he had to dodge the physical traps and disable the formation which made him waste quite a lot of time.
By the time he got to the place where the dragon stone was almost 2 hours passed! He knew he had to rush so he quickly pocketed the Dragon stone and left, there was no way he could continue staying inside the treasury and take anything else as he felt people approach the treasury, Yun Jhin kept himself near the wall and used his stealth technique.
The door of the treasury opened as a man that looked to be around his forties walked in, he gave out terrifying energy as he looked around and narrowed his eyes, Yun Jhin knew the man was a King Realm expert!
Yun Jhin made sure to control his life energy so he wouldn't be able to discover anything, he couldn't breathe anyway and the stealth techniques made him thoroughly invisible, the man continued to walk inside the treasury and Yun Jhin quickly left through the open door that closed itself afterward. Yun Jhin made sure to leave a fake dragon stone behind, just as payback for what happened with the dark-skinned man.
He knew he finished the operation but that didn't mean he was safe yet, he looked around and saw the strewn corpses of the elite squad and the decapitated head of the captain that looked at his killer with wide eyes and deep hatred.
Yun Jhin ignored the bodies and left the sect grounds, fortunately, most of the water horses were still ok, Yun Jhin jumped on the quickest one and left!
He knew he couldn't return to the Long Empire, it would be strange if a 9th stage ki cultivating expert fell and Yun Jhin came back, he would be the first culprit that they thought of. Yun Jhin urged the water horse away from the sect grounds and towards the surface, according to the memories he gained from the woman, he could go to the Earth Kingdom if he rode the current he was currently in.
There he could change his identity and made use of the Dragon stone first, the Long Empire was more ideal for his plan as it had a bigger population but he couldn't go back there yet, he would first need to go to the Earth Kingdom and move to the Long Empire later.
Yun Jhin rode the water horse for a few months as he finally left the ocean and looked around the coast, he let the horse leave back into the ocean and walked towards the Earth Kingdom's location according to the stolen memories.
As he walked to the Earth Kingdom he looked around and realized that this kingdom was extremely bland and poor, the Kingdom was created in the middle of the desert and there was no way they could grow any grains or something similar, the earth was too poor.
Yun Jhin wasn't even sure why would the Long Empire want to invade this poor country, as he looked around the only living beings he could detect with his soul willpower would be some mole rats.
He kept his pace steady as he went from village to village and inspected the population and lives of the Earth Kingdom, most of them grew what they dubbed as 'dessert cabbage' and they gained their proteins from eating mole rats, that's what all the villagers ate, cabbages and mole rats.
As he went deeper and deeper into the kingdom he found that most of the population didn't know about cultivation, and only those that were around the edges of the royal capital would know about cultivation.
Yun Jhin decided against going to the capital to initiate his plan, he wanted to create his own sect and spread out cultivation in the Earth Kingdom first!
He went to a border town where he enslaved the population and made them his first disciples, he imparted to them the least demanding cultivation technique he knew and made them cultivate and spread the news about his new cultivation school!
After some time passed people came from far and wide to the Earth Sticks village to learn from the grandmaster Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin decided to use his real name as Sun Sisheng's was known in the Earth Kingdom, he also changed his appearance. His main body was still resting on the borders of the ocean city but there was no chance for anything to happen to it as he already predicted what would happen next according to his immense experience, his main body would awaken by itself if it would sense anything around the area that would put it in danger.
Yun Jhin was now a spirited middle-aged man with a clever look around him, he had an air of nobility and a cute looking face for his middle-aged look, his hair was done in a bun atop his head and he wore the normal garb of the Earth Kingdom which consisted of a grey and yellow robe with earthen colored rock designs at the seams.
He was inside his sect grounds teaching a youngster a cultivation technique:
"You see here, this is how you should circulate your energy so you can gather the earthly ki faster to temper your body, you should also eat plenty of dessert cabbages and mole rats so you can improve faster."
The youngster bowed to Yun Jhin and left the sect grounds, most of the people that came didn't want to cultivate around Yun Jhin but he didn't mind, in the end, they would all come to him. Yun Jhin smoked a pipe made from a rocky material as he looked at a space beside him and said:
"What might I owe the visit of a royal messenger?"
A man jumped out of the ground and bowed towards Yun Jhin and he said:
"Might I inquire why master Yun Jhin decided to teach peasants cultivation?"
The man had a small mustache and wore a simple cloth outfit, if you looked at him you wouldn't put the words royal and messenger together.
Yun Jhin looked the man up and down and he said slowly:
"I have opened this cultivation grounds for the people of the earth kingdom who couldn't get to the royal capital due to their material reasons, I have fought in the war with the Wind Kingdom and I decided to retire, but I felt that I could teach people of the same standing as me how to become strong, after all, I was a peasant myself once."
The messenger kept a smile on his face as he looked at Yun Jhin, he knew that the body snatcher had a high cultivation base as he couldn't see through it.
Yun Jhin waved towards the man and imparted him some secrets that could boost his cultivation base and sent him on his way, then he chuckled as he muttered:
"This should hook the royals of the capital here."
He knew that the royals would try to extort his secrets but when they would come here he would be gone!
He needed to go back and retrieve his main body after so much time passed the waters should have calmed down and he could get near the dock city by now, he left the Earth Kingdom and went to the ocean where he called his water horse, he already controlled it's mind when he let it go.
