Yun Jhin made his way back to the dock city as he dug into the earth and took out his main body which crawled back into Sun Sisheng's cranium. He chuckled slowly as he said:
"It's good to be back home! Now to get back to the Earth Kingdom, they should be pretty antsy as they couldn't find me, Hahaha."
Yun Jhin chuckled blew into a burst of full-on laughter as he rode the water horse, back to the Earth Kingdom then he ran to Earth Sticks village, a bunch of people that looked like they had stuck up their ass was waiting in front of his abandoned sect.
Most of them looked angry and disappointed at the same time, Yun Jhin kept a smile on his face as he yawned and walked towards the sect grounds and opened them, the people at the entrance looked at him with wide eyes as they questioned:
"You are Yun Jhin?"
Yun Jhin just kept his smile on his face as he walked inside his sect grounds and sat cross-legged in the middle of the courtyard on an old tree stump and said three words:
"Yes I am!"

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Get inside the royal capital
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin observed the 'royals' that came to him to demand his cultivation techniques, but he knew these people were weaklings with their royal house's in decline, he made the messenger think that he was around the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm which made the messenger respect him but not to a high degree as he met people at higher cultivation stages.
His main body broke through to the 7th stage of the heavenly realm while his host's body stood at the peak of the 4th stage of the ki cultivating realm. He looked as the royals walked towards him and demanded:
"You should tell us your cultivation secrets immediately! We are royalty and we demand you peasant tell us what cultivation technique you are using!"
He told the messenger that he was a peasant himself in the past to draw out the dumb royals of the capital, with their bodies he would be able to infiltrate the capital easily, he wasn't sure if the Kingdom truly had a King Realm master, he was only guessing back then but they should have had an expert at the 7th stage or above holding the fort.
Yun Jhin wasn't strong enough to deal with such a guy yet, he would need to break through atleast 2 times to be sure he would be able to take over the Earth Kingdom.
He looked at the royals and shook his head as he pointed at them, their souls were immediately devoured as their bodies were taken over, they were weaklings at the 9th stage of the earthly realm so he didn't need to do much to kill them.
Using their bodies he granted his host body a new identity and moved to the royal capital as the new guard captain and teacher of the house of Fong!
Yun Jhin looked around his new courtyard as he shooed the maid away from it, he didn't need anyone else besides himself inside, he looked at the mental map he gained from devouring the souls of the royals, he pinpointed the location of the royal palace and then he seemingly started wandering around the city.
From time to time some royal would disappear in the capital and people would talk, thinking that there was something strange going on around the forementioned place, Yun Jhin kept devouring royals until he found one that knew the cultivation of the king and it's royal guards, the king stood at the 8th stage and the royal captain at the 7th stage of the ki refining realm.
With the information gained there were no more royals disappearing, Yun Jhin now had to cultivate seriously to break through and take over the kingdom.
From time to time he would leave the capital and search for special herbs, even though the dessert was barren on the outside in the earth some special herbs were growing deep inside, some cultivation rocks that could increase his cultivation base depending on the grams used in pills.
With the help of a few herbs and rocks he created a pill that helped him break through to the 5th stage, he decided that it was enough to help him on this endeavor as he was ready to abandon his host body, with the help of the dragon stone, he would become a dragon caterpillar that could reach the 5,000th rank, this kind of caterpillar could reach up to the Emperor realm.
Yun Jhin walked slowly through the capital as he looked at the rustic buildings surrounding him, he walked into the palace as his host's muscles started to contract and expand his appearance turned to his corpse one, now he had a full-on armor on his body created from his skin, his crimson eyes turned a deep blue as his ki was ignited.
His hair turned purple as his veins started to move like earthworms around his body, he appeared directly inside the royal palace in the place where the king kept his throne, the king eyes widened as he saw Yun Jhin's appearance and immediately got up from his throne and knew it was an attempt on his life.
The king immediately struck down on the ground, a giant boulder came out of the ground and attacked Yun Jhin, but Yun Jhin used his claws and cut the boulder in two, he didn't have much time before this body gave up so he immediately went to the king's location and struck him in the stomach, the king didn't think that his opponent would be this fast, his entrails colored the palace red before he could say anything to Yun Jhin his body was decapitated.
The guard captain entered the place the same moment that the king was decapitated and he shouted in anger and grief!
But before he could do anything or even attempt to attack Yun Jhin his head flew into the air as well!
Yun Jhin laid out an instant attack formation the moment he crashed into the palace, fuelling it with his burning ki it immediately killed the distracted man before he could do anything, Yun Jhin's true body escaped Sun Sisheng's body as it started to break apart into dust, he immediately used his main body to eat the two bodies and then hid.
----------------------------------------------------------------
The queen cried for her late husband as she kneeled beside the throne, she knew the man was dead all the investigations lead to this. Unknowingly to her Yun Jhin's true body was breaking through to the peak 9th stage of the heavenly realm after he overate, it has been almost 2 months since the investigation began and the queen would come here daily to mourn her husband and her lover the guard captain.
Suddenly out of the throne a small caterpillar entered the woman's nose and before she could say anything else or cry her expression changed, she got up from the ground and looked at her own hands as she chuckled:
"Great success, the queen has only given birth to a son a few years ago and he can't lead the country, I will improve this body's cultivation forcefully and make everyone listen to her, with the dragon stone in hand I should be able to do this experiment!"
Yun Jhin now using the body of the queen Kino Atomi, walked around the palace's halls and went back to 'her' room there his main body forcefully injected her body with a cultivation technique that swelled her cultivation base to the 3rd stage of the ki cultivating realm and shortened the body's lifespan to 2 a remaining of 2 years, her body started to age extremely fast, from a young woman in her thirties she became a doddering grandmother in her 80s.
But Yun Jhin used his body-altering technique to make her look the same as before and then he announced to the whole Kingdom!
Telling the people that she found a cultivation resource that could be shared with everyone, the dragon stone. Her announcement became big after she explained what the cultivation resource did and that he let anyone use it as it had unlimited uses!
The dragon stone could indeed be used unlimited times but it wasn't a very good resource, the amount of dragon bloodline it gave out was minuscule to the point that it wasn't that useful and it could only give a 10-15% of cultivation speed increase. To Yun Jhin it was worse than trash but to the poor people of the kingdom, it was like a divine item!
Yun Jhin let everyone use the stone so they could gain the dragon bloodline, it didn't matter who touched it, however, it couldn't be moved, Yun Jhin used extremely strong formations to keep it in place so no one could steal it.
After 2 years the queen died and her son became the successor of the kingdom, of course, Yun Jhin took the son's body the moment his mother died. He then continued to act as the puppet ruler as his main body continued to cultivate inside his new host's cranium.
As time passed, 3 years after the queen died the little king was assassinated! Yun Jhin escaped from the little boy's body and took over the attackers, he let the kid die and took over the 1st stage ki cultivating assassins body.
With this body in arms, he used another forbidden technique to defeat the currently strongest being in the kingdom and take over his body as well, afterward he reinstated himself as the king using the new host body, he just acted naturally seemingly as if things went how they should be, but under the guise of a new kingdom, Yun Jhin was still the ruler!
1 year after the little king's assassination passed the new king made a gathering of all of the people with the 6th stage heavenly realm and above that touched the dragon stone to meet at the royal palace!
Yun Jhin stood on his throne as the palace filled up with people, he got up from the throne as he looked around and then started talking:
"Our Earth Kingdom entered into a time of cultivation with the help of the dragon stone, this seemingly miracle artifact was one that gave you all that you have today."
The crowd nodded to Yun Jhin as they looked at him and thought why would the king ask for such a high amount of people to come to the palace, but Yun Jhin's next words made them realize why:
"I thank all of you for coming to the palace, with all of you people, I can finally attain a decent form!"
The crowd panicked as they didn't understand their King's words, they even wanted to ask him what he meant by that but the formation that he worked on for years activated, Yun Jhin kept a passive face as he looked at all of the people dying around him, the blood, limbs and bodies, all of them just stood there waiting for Yun Jhin to devour them, all of the people in this palace were 10% of the kingdoms cultivators!
Yun Jhin's main body left from his new host's corpse and started to feast!
Crunch splash splish, blood, and meat, bones and organs, feast a giant feast for Yun Jhin!
[Host has eaten a body that contains an extremely small amount of dragon ki, eat 50,000 bodies to be able to evolve into the dragon caterpillar!]
Finally after a long, while the system was heard again, Yun Jhin almost forgot he had such an ability in him, after all, what he ate up till now didn't give him a caterpillar form that was above his current one so the system ignored everything unless a higher caterpillar form was achieved than his current one he would be notified.
There were around 55,000 corpses around so Yun Jhin had plenty to eat, he kept eating, his body increasing in size, as he ate more and more the bones crunched and the room started to smell more and more of blood, the blood started to rot as time went by and people would come to investigate what happened but they would join the corpse pile!
As Yun Jhin eat more and more corpses, after a few weeks he finally finished and he met with another notification:
[Host has eaten enough bodies that contain dragon ki, would host like to evolve into a dragon caterpillar? Even the weakest dragon caterpillar can reach the 5,000th rank and the strongest can reach the 7,500 ranks.]
Yun Jhin hid inside his host's body as he made it move away from the blood cacked hall inside the hidden cultivation chambers of the king.
This was the last time he would be using a host body, from now on he would move around with his real body, as a new dragon caterpillar!
He started to sleep inside his host's cranium as he started the evolutionary process, the next time he would wake up he would have broken through the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm and became a new species!
Yun Jhin went into a deep sleep as a different past life appeared inside his dreams, this was one of his first ones...

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Yun Jhin
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin found himself looking at a small child, the kid was around 5-6 years old and he was huddled in a dark alleyway, his knees to his chin, the snow around him almost buried him alive, his life was slowly disappearing from his tiny body, but he held on with strong willpower, but willpower wouldn't help him from frostbite and his constant reduction of life force.
Yun Jhin looked at the small child with an apathetic expression on his face as he said slowly:
"I have been quite unlucky in a few lives as well."
The child didn't die, a rough middle-aged obese man saved him from the snow, he grabbed him by his long brown hair and dragged him towards a nearby house, inside the house Yun Jhin's former self stopped shivering as the man came to him and dropped a blanket to heat his little body.
Yun Jhin continued to observe what happened as he shook his head, his young self looked with dazed eyes at the man as he said:
"Sir, why would you help me..."
The obese middle-aged man laughed as he patted the little kid's head and said:
"Ah you see it's my hobby to help those young and in need, I have had quite a lot of young children like you in my care."
The man then smiled wretchedly as he felt that the kid's body heated up enough and then his hand started to snake around the young child's undeveloped body, Yun Jhin shook his head as he forcefully cut the image that came afterward, even though he vividly remembered the moment he didn't want to live it out again.
The scene changed, a draped blanket was the only thing that kept Yun Jhin's little body from not being naked, near him stood the corpse of the middle-aged man, a knife implanted in his stomach, he bled out to death.
The kid then started to move backward in fear apprehension and disgust of the older man, he kept his distance from him as he started rocking back and forth, it was his mechanism to cope with what happened, out of the man's closet a bunch of dead bodies fell out, they were poor young men and women just like Yun Jhin, however, the difference between them is that they were corpses and he was alive.
Yun Jhin ran out of the man's house and shouted so hard all of his neighbors were alarmed when they came and saw the grisly sight they immediately called the authorities to investigate. Yun Jhin was taken into custody by the authorities and then sent to an orphanage...
Yun Jhin's life wasn't good at all, he kept bumping into problems, most of the other foster children were beating him up most of the time, even though the staff of the orphanage didn't mistreat him the other children would steal his food and toys.
Till one day when the military came and found out that Yun Jhin had a high talent for cultivation, they enrolled him into the military and gave him a cultivation technique. However, things didn't turn out as well as Yun Jhin thought.
As he grew he thought that he would keep his distance from everyone, that he would be able to keep a steel heart in front of every person he would know and knew, but this woman he met, it melted his heart and his defenses, she was beautiful and kind to him, they worked in the same squadron and they deeply fell in love.
But just like all tales, he had a rival, this rival of his didn't like to play nice and due to an accident on the battlefield, his future lover perished under friendly fire... Yun Jhin was heartbroken and became mad, he killed all of his teammates and defected.
He started to dabble into dark cultivation technique as he thought he could revive his former lover, necromancy, death decay, that was what he lived in for hundreds of years, in the end, he revived his former lover, but her soul was gone, she was an empty shell that he crushed under his boots as he realized that all of his humanity perished the moment she died.
The only woman that was good to him, the only woman he loved, killed by his rival due to jealousy and an unfortunate accident.
He then started to seek further cultivation, but his body gave out on him and he died...
His next life he tried again, and again, and again, but he died as well. He failed every time as he became numb through reincarnations and realized that he couldn't do anything, he gave up on his goal, he didn't care about his only light as it snuffed out, he became a monster, he realized that the weak were preyed upon by the strong.
He realized that he couldn't believe anyone, he realized that hatred was his only friend, hatred, and power!
His hatred changed from people as he continued to cultivate, he realized that people weren't the things that he hated the most, they could be controlled, manipulated and used however he wanted, but the thing was, he couldn't control death, he couldn't live as much as he wanted to, in the end, he would one day become white sparkling bones that everyone would forget after a certain time, no matter how many accomplishments he had in his life.
He realized that to become something, to become the something that he wanted, his distorted personality made him seek eternal life, from a normal human his life was always wretched which in turn transformed him into a monster, that's what he thought but when Yun Jhin thought about it back then.
He enjoyed killing... the moment the knife entered the obese man's belly he felt exhilarated and full of life, the moment he killed his comrades made him happier than when he was loved by that woman, the moment he resurrected her, he realized that he could give her soul back, but he didn't.
He knew that if he did that his humanity might have a chance of coming back, and his dark twisted soul didn't want that, he was evil to the bones and that was his nature, people would think that the environment you lived in would shape your personality and this was true for most of the people, however, sometimes there would be people who would have an innate quality that wouldn't change no matter what happened.
Yun Jhin kept a passive face as he looked at his former lives take place in front of his eyes, he kept looking and shook his head as he saw a particular memory.
After so much time passed in Yun Jhin's first life he finally reached the Emperor realm, he thought of himself invincible in the world only to get killed later in a fight with a fellow Emperor realm expert, Yun Jhin chuckled as he saw that memory and said:
"Ah, I was so foolish, but that was my first life anyways..."
He kept looking as he saw his former lives continue and then he stopped, all the images stopped, everything stopped, his breathing stopped, his blood circulation, even his life.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked around and then his heart started to beat again, bum bum bum, new blood started to circulate in his body, it was a strange feeling like he was something he was never before, the feeling of evolution was strange and familiar at the same time.
Yun Jhin's main body started to change as it grew up to 2 meters in length and 500 kilograms in weight, his body was as thick as two adult men put together and it grew yellow scales over it, even though he was still a caterpillar he wasn' any normal caterpillar.
He grew dark-colored eyes and scaled wings, horns grew out of his head and he also gained claws instead of the normal caterpillar feet, he exuded an aura of majesty and power as his power increased.
His ki started to appear in his body, it was a deep imperial yellow color, the character for 'dragon' was imprinted on his back as his evolution stopped, but he didn't wake up as he didn't finish his breakthrough in the ki cultivating realm.
There weren't any things such as heavenly tribulations in cultivation, however, there were tribulations of self, only talented people could trigger these tribulations and if you passed them, the cultivation speed of the realm they were in would be way faster than normal.
Yun Jhin encountered such a tribulation, it was the past self tribulation that only reincarnators got, however this type of tribulation was almost nonexistent in Yun Jhin's eyes, he has reincarnated for countless years and lives, technically speaking the more you reincarnated the stronger the tribulation, but with Yun Jhin's experience, the tribulation couldn't do anything to him anymore.
Yun Jhin sighed as he felt his new body generate tons of ki, as his body was quite long and strong, the amount of ki it stored inside was way higher than a human or even some other special cultivation beasts.
His host body was already destroyed into a shower of blood as he grew out of his skull into a big dragon caterpillar.
His eyes were still closed but then suddenly they snapped open, his dark-colored sclera was like a mirror, nothing remained around him, the whole royal palace broke down into cinders as he opened his new mouth and incinerated the place with his dragon flames.
The palace burned down into cinders even though it made out of stone and not wood, the fire took the attention of every survivor in the capital and they rushed to see what's happening, however, all the saw was Yun Jhin's new majestic body take flight from the palace and flying into the direction of the ocean.
A system notification came when he started flying towards the ocean:
[Host has successfully evolved into a dragon caterpillar (weak form), the host can reach rank 5,000]
[If the host wants to evolve the dragon bloodline further, the host has to eat 100,000 cultivators with a dragon bloodline at the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm or above!]
Yun Jhin looked at the notification as his new face didn't betray any of his emotions, but a smile appeared on it as he said:
"It seems the Long Empire will have to be useful as well..."
He started flying towards the Long Empire's location as he flapped his wings faster, he concocted a new plan combined with his former one he knew what to do, the dragon stone was in his spatial bag and he was ready to deliver it to the Long Empire pronto.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Becoming a pet
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's big body flew above the ocean as he looked down at it from time to time, getting to the long empire while flying would be faster than swimming with the water horses but it would still take him almost 7 to 8 days, while Yun Jhin flew towards the empire, the empire was in an internal crisis.
The crown prince had a haggard expression on his face as he kneeled beside another young-looking man, the man's aura engulfed the whole imperial palace as he glared at the crown prince, the man then opened his mouth and said:
"I have finished healing and I even broke through, but you tell me you lost your elite squad and the dragon stone as well? You are very lucky the Heavenly turtle sect hadn't retaliated for your dumb act yet! If they attacked while I was healing the empire would have been done for!"
His aura intensified as the kneeling crown prince fell to the ground, the ground started cracking due to the intensity of the aura and the crown prince's bones started to make crunching sounds as they were breaking due to the pressure. The crown prince wanted to get up and kowtow to his father but he couldn't due to the aura.
Long Huang frowned as he looked at his eldest son and said slowly:
"I even heard you assassinated your younger brother with the help of an outsider that died during the dragon stone recovery mission, I'm extremely disappointed!"
The man pointed at the downed crown prince as he continued to berate him:
"It doesn't matter that you killed that weakling but you didn't even make good use of the assassin either, you even let spies in your party that told me about what you have done, my disappointment is unmeasurable and my happy day is ruined."
The emperor wanted to throw out a banquet for healing and having his breakthrough but the right minister immediately contacted him and told him everything that happened while he was in seclusion, the failures that the crown prince had made soured his mood to the point that he almost thought of killing his son!
His anger subsided as he looked at his son's downed form and remembered about his late wife, even though he had more concubines that gave him children, the crown prince was the most talented and had a chance to follow him into the King Realm even though it was a very low chance.
His aura dissipated as he looked at his son and said:
'Jun'er your father isn't making things tough for you on purpose, you have failed consecutively so many times so I have to punish you."
The emperor shook his head as the crown prince started shaking in fright, he pointed towards him and gave out his final verdict:
"Due to everything that happened up till now, unless you gain enormous merit you will have to be exiled out of the capital, your crown prince title is removed, you cannot come back unless you get the dragon stone back or something equivalent to it!"
The crown prince started kowtowing with tears in his eyes as he was thrown outside of the capital, the man grumbled as he looked down at his feet and left, his eyes wandered around as he found himself in the forest near the capital and he shouted:
"GODDAMIT GODDAMIT, SUN SISHENG HOW COULD YOU HAVE FAILED!"
The crown prince blamed Yun Jhin for everything that happened, he most likely thought Yun Jhin betrayed them and the heavenly turtle sect killed him as well after they made use of him, he couldn't take revenge on Yun Jhin even if he wanted to, he tried to find his family or sect but after some investigations, he found out that the sect was full of weaklings that weren't even at the heavenly realm and his family was dead!
The crown prince fell to his knees as he punched the ground multiple times in anger, his face looked like a malevolent spirit's as it distorted his beautiful features, suddenly he heard a growling coming from the forest.
He ran towards the growling regardless of consequences, he felt that the aura that the owner of the growl emanated was 4 stages below his, as he walked slowly into the forest he found out a long dragon caterpillar with a wound in its sides, near it stood the dragons stone!
The crown prince eye's widened in delight and surprise as his body started shaking and he said slowly:
"Do the heavens want me to become the emperor? this is..."
He examined the injured dragon caterpillar and then the dragon stone, he slowly approached both of them but the dragon caterpillar growled as it started talking:
"Don't come near me human! I will burn you to a crisp!"
Inside the dragon caterpillar's mouth, fierce flames started to appear and he pointed his mouth directly to the Long Jun's body, the flames were so strong that they could even burn his body that was strengthened to the 5th level of the ki cultivating realm, he was even close to the 6th level after so many years of training.
The crown prince backed away from the dragon caterpillar as he looked at it, of course, it was Yun Jhin who made up this act was to try and get close to the crown prince and the emperor in his current new form, they would try to contract with him and make him their pet.
Yun Jhin continued to growl as he looked at the crown prince's small form, his wings started to flutter, but the crown prince slowly got closer and closer to Yun Jhin and he said slowly with a scared look on his face:
"I see you are wounded, please let me take care of you..."
The dragon caterpillar snorted as his big frame moved a little bit showing his wound to the crown prince better, however his mouth was still full of flames if the man decided to attack him while he showed him his weakness he would be burnt to a crisp!
Long Jun backed away as he said:
"I know that most likely a human injured you, but not all humans are the same, please let me help you, I just want to be able to use the dragon stone in your possession."
If he gained any amount of dragon bloodline his imperial father would welcome him back with open arms, the right minister and his party wouldn't be able to say anything as well, and he could even leak the location and existence of the dragon caterpillar while he was at it!
Yun Jhin's body started shaking in pain as his wound opened up and fresh yellow blood started to pour out of it, however, he kept his dragon face serious, the crown prince approached his body and started to tend to him, Yun Jhin kept his mouth aimed at him the whole time.
The crown prince didn't lie as he started to help him to heal, even though he didn't need it, it was just an act to get near the crown prince, after a few months Yun Jhin was as good as new, but he sneered inside as he looked at the giddy crown prince and he lent him the dragons stone.
The dragon stone glowed a deep yellow light as it engulfed the crown prince, the higher the cultivation the better the effects, after a few hours the dragon stone stopped glowing and out of the light came the crown prince who broke through the 6th stage of the ki cultivating realm!
The crown prince laughed as he patted Yun Jhin's big body and he said slowly:
"What's your name dragon friend? would you mind if we made a contract?"
Yun Jhin kept his pitch-black eyes narrowed as he looked at the crown prince and said in a distrustful tone:
"What kind of contract?"
Cultivation beasts could make contracts with humans to get what they needed peacefully, however, most of the cultivation beasts would never let their pride down to accept such contracts, but Yun Jhin made himself look more humble because the crown prince 'healed' him.
The crown prince Long Jun smiled as he looked at the dragon caterpillar and thought to himself:
"I helped him heal, he should trust me enough, for now, I should be able to come back to the capital with the dragon caterpillar and stone in tow!"
The man approached Yun Jhin's body as he used his soul willpower to transfer the contract to Yun Jhin's consciousness space, there Yun Jhin looked over it and he sneered inside, even though on the surface it looked like a contract that would benefit both parties, there was a hidden clause that would make him a slave if it was broken!
Yun Jhin smiled inside as he looked at the contract, with his proficiency in soul manipulation he could easily change the contract in such a way that the other party wouldn't realize, after he finished changing the contract to his liking he signed it!
The contract returned to Long Jun's consciousness space as he looked over it, seeing nothing wrong with it he signed it as well as he smiled devilishly inside, then he patted Yun Jhin's body as he said:
"Your name is Yun Jhin, right? The soul contract showed me your true name."
Yun Jhin leaked his name to make him more trustful, but it didn't matter, he never used this name in this life besides in the Earth Kingdom, and they wouldn't link a gigantic dragon caterpillar to a now-dead human, besides where would they get the news of what happened in the Earth Kingdom? The heavenly turtle sect would surely not leak those type of news.
Long Jun jumped on Yun Jhin's body as he said slowly:
"Let's make a great entrance, to the capital, my new friend!"
Yun Jhin complied with his order as he started flying directly inside the capital, the capital wasn't that far away so they got there very quickly, Long Jun had the dragon stone in his hand as he made Yun Jhin fly above a certain courtyard of the palace and land there.
After a very short while the Emperor quickly walked inside the courtyard as he looked at his son with wide appreciative eyes, he walked forward as he patted Yun Jhin's thick body and then looked at the dragon stone in his son's hand, he thought that his son might never come back into the capital again, after all, how could a young man below the King Realm invade the heavenly turtle sect to get the dragon stone back?
However, it seemed luck was on his son's side as he found not only the dragon stone but a guardian beast for the Empire, The dragon caterpillar!
The emperor appreciated Yun Jhin's big thick body as he looked at it up and down and then he took the dragon stone from his son's outstretched hands as he ruffled his hair and said:
"The other's can't say anything about your failures anymore son, actually you should be rewarded as you came in with something extra!"
Yun Jhin's voice was heard after the duo finished talking:
"I was promised cultivation resources."
The emperor laughed as he patted Yun Jhin's body again as he said:
"Of course my draconic friend, we need you to be strong to be the guardian beast of the empire, in future invasions we will need your help, and that might be quite soon, fortunately, I have some draconic herbs that would agree with your bloodline perfectly!"
Even though the draconic herbs were meant for him, a dragon caterpillar had a better battle power than most humans, if he increased his cultivation quickly he might even be able to fight peak human experts that were at the 4th or 5th stage of the ki cultivating realm!
The emperor left leaving Yun Jhin and the crown prince alone, Long Jun looked at his new friend as he started to pat his body fondly while saying:
"You have done great Yun Jhin, I'm very happy that I found you, my father should come with those herbs sooner or later, actually if I look at you more, you are even cute, you might be able to soothe the broken heart of my little sister."
Long Mumu became brokenhearted when she heard that her sweetheart Sun Sisheng died in the retrieval mission and she hid in her room ever since.
Now with Yun Jhin's arrival, the crown prince wanted to use him as a pet to help her out of her depression.
Yun Jhin didn't say anything but he narrowed his eyes inside, he didn't like that woman very much, but until he reached atleast the 8th stage of the ki cultivating realm he would need to put up with the imperial family's antics, after all, he was here to advance his dragon bloodline.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Draconic herbs
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin frowned inside as he looked at Long Mumu's figure, she was crying in her hands with her brother behind her, then her brother told her something that made her look forward, her eyes started sparkling as she saw the dragon caterpillar and she ran towards it with an excited look on her face. It has been quite a long time, did princess Mumu missed him so much that she was grieving even now? Well it was normal as he was quite charming when he wanted to.
Yun Jhin wanted to burn her to a crisp but the crown prince shook his head as he pointed at his hand, Yun Jhin stopped charging his breath seemingly looking at the prince's palm and nodding his head at him. The crown prince then said:
"Mumu, he is my friend, but he is wary of strangers so please do not aggravate him."
The princess nodded her head slowly as her eyes sparkled while she looked at the big dragon caterpillar, she petted his big body as she took a better look at him, Yun Jhin just stood there on his side as he waited for the draconic herbs to make their way to him, this was why he created organizations in his previous lives, for them to gather resources for him, as long as he was important enough to the organization he joined he would also get resources for free.
It wasn't that Yun Jhin was lazy but some type of resources would take too much time to gather, time that he could use by cultivating instead, it would be may more effective to cultivate and wait for the resources instead of just searching for them.
While Yun Jhin was waiting, the princess kept herself preoccupied with his cute chubby body, even though he looked awe-inspiring, the way he sat on the ground right now just made him seem like a dog that wanted belly rubs, the princess stood with him for a few hours before she left, even though she still seemed rather sad her complexion took a turn for the better.
The crown prince coughed as he looked at the dragon caterpillar and he said:
"My father said that he will get the draconic herbs to you in a short while, you should cultivate until then, I have some work to do as I was reinstated as the crown prince and I don't have time to accompany you, I will visit you later with my father."
Yun Jhin nodded at him and closed his eyes, the crown prince left the courtyard that was now Yun Jhin's, Yun Jhin looked around before he started cultivating, he knew that he was observed by the crown prince so he had to act up.
While he cultivated he thought on how to find hell's portal, as he was now a decent enough caterpillar, and he would become a stronger one later as long as his plan in the Long Empire was fulfilled, he needed to know where the entrance to hell was!
Demons and devil are dwelling in hell, demons were of lower class and devil's of the higher class, he needed to become a devilish caterpillar to reach the peak of his talent, however, to do that he would need to reach the 6th or 7th layer of hell to be able to eat so many devils, that would need him to be around the middle stages of the Emperor realm.
Cultivating became harder as one reached the king realm, even now at the ki cultivating realm, after he got those draconic herbs there might be a chance for him to break through the second stage, and to break through further he would need more and more resources, the body of a dragon caterpillar required countless nutrition amounts, even though he could get this nutrition from eating humans they would need to be of the higher realm than he was.
After all, a dragon caterpillar battle power was around 4-5 times stronger than a human's, it was additional battle power not multiplying one, after all, the dragon caterpillar wasn' a true dragon.
If Yun Jhin was at the 1st stage he could battle 4th 5th and even 6th stage cultivators with his current body, however, that would mean only 1 of each, if there were more they could give him trouble.
Fortunately for Yun Jhin, he lived near the top of the lower continents, which meant there was a big lack of experts around, there weren't even Emperor sects around, let's not talk about Sagely or Godly sects.
The planet Yun Jhin lived in was one of the many in his universe, he pretty much reincarnated on every liveable planet there was, and he knew most of them like the palm of his hand, he was currently on the Draconic planet Longo, that's why there were dragon stones around such lowly places, the planet itself housed true dragons. It was one of the 4 strongest planets in the universe, the other being the Phoenix Planet Yuro, The Dark Tortoise Planet Ruko, and the White Tiger Planet Suro.
They were all equal in power and they had their special planetary formation as they were in alliance with each other, even though they were the strongest they were in the top ten and were around the 5th to 9th ranks.
Yun Jhin knew to get to hell he would need to analyze all of the planets of the universe and find the location of the entrance, or well just find a devil and get the location from him, however, most devil's would rather self destruct than leak the entrance, after all, their ruler's didn't like unwanted guests, most of them couldn't leave the 9th layer of hell without the hellish will of the place letting them.
Most of the Godly Patriarchs of hell, were considered to be the hell's children and hell wouldn't let them leave the 9th layer unless the place itself was in peril, and such a thing didn't happen for millions of years.
While Yun Jhin thought on how to get to hell, time passed by quickly, he cultivated while he thought as he stabilized his cultivation in the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm and made way for his breakthrough with the help of the draconic herbs.
While Yun Jhin was thinking about the future and making plans, so was the Long family!
Long Huang looked at his son as he squinted his eyes at him and then he laughed:
"Good job fooling that dragon caterpillar, as long as he goes against that clause you put in the contract he would be our slave, good very good!"
The crown prince smiled bashfully at his father's compliment then he said:
"It's ok, imperial father, however, the dragon caterpillar isn't at its full potential yet, we should go and give him those draconic herbs so they could stimulate his bloodline, he might even breakthrough!"
Long Huang caressed his chin as he thought about it if the dragon caterpillar broke through they would have a pawn equal to the 6th level of the ki cultivating stage which would be very useful for them, after all, they lost quite a bit of manpower during the attack of the heavenly turtle sect and they needed to create a new elite squad, but that would take tens of years or even hundreds!
Suddenly Long Huang eye's started to sparkle with deep red color as he said:
"I remembered something, a dragon caterpillar sense of talent is way higher than a human's with its help we could go around the empire and recruit the most talented youths!"
The crown prince nodded at his father and waited for further instructions, Long Huang left the throne room as he went to treasury and came out with a few herbs that took the form of the head of a dragon, they exuded pure draconic ki of a deep imperial yellow color.
The duo left the throne room and went directly to Yun Jhin's courtyard where they saw him cultivating, the duo didn't stop him as they watched him cultivate, deep blue ki engulfed his body as he opened his mouth to devour it little by little, both of them took inspiration from his cultivating technique and waited till he finished.
Yun Jhin knew the duo came inside his courtyard but kept ignoring them, seemingly as if he was in deep cultivation, the duo waited for Yun Jhin to finish staying in the courtyard for almost 20 days, Yun Jhin suddenly woke up as his black eyes looked at directly at the duo.
The emperor and his progeny nodded at Yun Jhin, with their observation of how Yun Jhin cultivated they made great harvests and they would be able to increase their cultivation speed by quite a high deal.
Long Huang unsealed the draconic herbs and presented them to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin opened his big mouth and said:
"Leave them near and you can go, It will take me around 2 months to fully refine these herbs, I hope that I won't be disturbed during that time."
The emperor laughed and left with his son in tow, Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes inwardly as he looked at the leaving duo and made sure to investigate if they tampered with the herbs, to his surprise the herbs were clean!
Yun Jhin opened his mouth as he blew fire on the herbs transforming them into liquid! Then he absorbed the liquid in his mouth as he slowly used the flames to harden the liquid, from time to time he would spit out some impurities, Yun Jhin was using his body as a cauldron to refine a draconic pill!
This was a technique that he didn't use before, after all, most of his reincarnations were humans or humanoid forms, only certain cultivation beasts would be able to use this technique of refining pills in the body.
This was Yun Jhin's first reincarnation as a pure cultivation beast, while the pill was forming in his body the Emperor and his son observed the courtyard using formations, they both were surprised inwardly as they saw Yun Jhin's way of refining pills and they said in unison:
"Such a way to refine pills... get the imperial refiners here and let them observe!"
Quickly some old men who wore robes with pills engravings etched on them came and kowtowed to the imperial duo as they waited for instructions, the Emperor told them to observe Yun Jhin's way of refining and the old men squad shook their head in unison as they said the same thing:
"There is no way for a human to refine like this your imperial majesty."
"Yes your highness, it seems this a cultivation beast special way of refining pills."
"Your highness, we humans have frail bodies compared to beasts, this beast seems especially sturdy and I could guess not even many of his kind could employ such a special technique."
The duo furrowed their brows as they looked at the old men and dismissed them, Yun Jhin laughed inside as his soul willpower observed their attempt at replicating his technique, he showed this unique talent so he could get even more benefits, after all, who would kill the goose who could lay golden eggs?
This was his way to cement his position in the empire as best as he could, in the future even if the emperor had to choose between his son and Yun Jhin, he might choose Yun Jhin instead!
After a long while of refining, Yun Jhin finished refining the pill and he vomited a pile of slag that he burnt to cinders, then a round yellow pill appeared in front of him it looked flawless and spotless as dragon howls could be heard from it.
It was a high-quality dragon herb pill, it was good at tempering the body and ki of the user and even king realm experts at the 1st stage could use it, however, it was useless for those at the 2nd stage of cultivation and above.
The emperor sighed as he looked at the pill and lamented:
"Oh, if we could have found this dragon caterpillar earlier, he might have been able to make me a pill and I wouldn't have been injured by the patriarch of the Heavenly Turtle sect."
Yun Jhin then ate the pill as it dissolved in his mouth and currents of herbal draconic energy started to seep into his body, his new organs started to cheer as they got strengthened by the pill.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he entered into closed-door cultivation, the duo looked away as they already knew how Yun Jhin cultivated and closed the formation, they had things to do and prepare while Yun Jhin was cultivating.

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Heavenly Turtle retaliation
chapters.content:
While Yun Jhin was cultivating peacefully in his courtyard, things weren't so peaceful under the ocean, a middle-aged man with graying hair looked down at his subordinate that kneeled with a deep fearful look on her face, the man waved his hand and the woman disappeared in a cloud of ashes.
The man shook his head as he looked down from the blue throne that he stood on and he sighed while saying:
"We lost the dragon stone and these fools couldn't find it in such a long time, is it possible I missed someone when I went to inspect the treasury? When I touched the dragon stone it turned into bits, someone should have stolen it but who?"
The man scratched his chin as he then gave out a command:
"There's a big chance the stone is back into the Long Empire's hands, we will attack with full force to recover it, it's time to end this charade, that poor emperor should still be in seclusion, I injured him quite heavily."
The man got up from his throne and disappeared into a swirl of blue water, back in the Empire Long Huang and his son were giving out commands for the army to gather, they were ready to invade the Heavenly Turtle sect again, and with the help of the dragon caterpillar, they were sure they were going to win, as a dragon caterpillar could fight with atleast 6-7 same cultivation realm adversaries, they also knew that as long as it ate enough it could grow in cultivation, they would make sure that all the high-level Ki cultivating enemies would end up in its stomach!
Long Huang opened his mouth to tell all of his ministers and officials:
"It's time for us to end this hidden war with the Heavenly Turtle sect, these petty fools thought that because we attacked their subordinate that they had a good reason to attack back, but I know they had been eyeing our dragon stone for a long while, they coveted it, and I made a foolish mistake that gave them a good reason to retaliate..."
The emperor admitted his mistakes as he looked at his subordinates and continued:
"However! This is also an opportunity for us, an opportunity to expand our empire and take over the Heavenly Turtle sect, I will go immediately to 'invite' all of the rogue sects around the empire and enroll them into our service, of course, benefits need to be dolled out or else they would rebel."
The ministers and officials nodded their heads like chicks pecking at rice, they didn't dare to talk back or say anything to their emperor, after all, he broke through to the second stage of the King Realm!
The right minister didn't like the crown prince but that didn't mean he was against the imperial family, he was supporting the Emperor but he thought that the crown prince wasn't a good enough descendant and he felt that if the emperor fell he shouldn't take over the throne.
After the emperor finished talking everyone dismissed as he waved his hand, only Long Huang and his son remained in the throne room, they looked at each other as they surveyed a military map, Long Huang opened his mouth and told his son:
"I shall teach you some military tactics, in my youth I was known as the best military tactician, the only one who I could call equal would be the minister of the military, but his sharp edge started to dull as he hasn't been on the battlefield for a long time."
Long Huang started to point at some important points on the map when suddenly the formations at the border of the ocean were triggered, even though the capital was far away the Emperor made sure to connect all of the important formations to his soul so he knew when their borders were attacked.
Long Huang frowned as he looked down at his son and said:
"It seems we don't have to invade them, they already came!"
The crown prince gasped as he said:
"Imperial father, the heavenly turtle sect came already?"
His father didn't bother to respond as he should already know the answer, then he immediately sent out a message to recruit all of the sects, mobilize the army and make way to the battlefield!
The emperor was ready to wake up Yun Jhin.
In Yun Jhin's courtyard, different transformations happened inside his big body, his ki transformed from a little spring into a lake as his whole body started to fill up with ki, a peculiar yellow golden aura started to encase Yun Jhin's draconic body, his power increased by quite a high deal as both his body and ki passageways were strengthened by the medicinal power of the draconic pill, even his bloodline was stimulated somewhat and strengthened, but the bloodline strengthening was negligible at best.
Yun Jhin opened his dark eyes as he looked in front of him and saw the father-son duo ready to wake up him, they smiled awkwardly at each other as the crown prince went forward and said:
"Yun Jhin, I'm sorry but we need your help, we are invaded by the Heavenly Turtle sect and we need to employ your flying ability to get to the battlefield quickly, the other troops are ready to go there, with your giant body you should be able to drag all of them along with this boat me made."
As the crown prince explained things, hot air came out of Yun Jhin's nostrils as he looked at the duo and said:
"I can do that, but I will need some more draconic herbs."
The emperor smiled as he saw Yun Jhin's attitude, even though the dragons were proud beings, that pride wouldn't fully transfer to halflings or quarterings, it seemed to the emperor that Yun Jhin was a practical cultivation beast who knew what was best for it.
The duo jumped on his back as they made him fly to the army's headquarters there they tied 50 big boats to his body which weren't a big strain to Yun Jhin's new body, he wasn't that long but most of the boats were tied in one spot which didn't take much space.
Yun Jhin started flying at quick speeds according to the instructions of the Emperor as Long Huang closed his eyes and felt the responses of the formations Yun Jhin flew accordingly.
Finally, after a moderate amount of traveling they all dropped on the battlefield surprising the army of the Heavenly Turtle sect with an aerial ambush!
Yun Jhin kept flying up above then he looked at the crown prince and the Emperor as they dropped down on the ground, the Emperor looked around and frowned as he didn't spot the patriarch of the Heavenly Turtle sect.
He ordered the army to attack and a bloodbath ensued, limbs and organs flew around the battlefield as the Heavenly Turtle sect was massacred, however, something wasn't right, most of the disciples were too low level for them to start this war, this was most likely to be a diversion!
Yun Jhin didn't say anything as he opened his mouth and inhaled a bunch of disciples in the heavenly realm, he made sure to look like he was working. The Emperor frowned as he looked around, then his eyes widened as a sword stuck out of his thigh and a snort was heard:
"It seems you have broken through, lucky for you, you almost dodged the attack fully!"
The middle-aged greying man appeared near the Emperor and out of the sea a barrage of water blasts shot out, the water blasts pushed back a lot of the army and hastily recruited sect members, some of them even drowned and died.
The Emperor frowned as his thigh wound closed up and healed then he said:
"Luo Sunfeng, I didn't know you would be so underhanded that you would do such a sneak attack."
Luo Sunfeng laughed as he pointed up at the sky where Yun Jhin was flying around:
"I didn't know you got your hands on a dragon caterpillar, I see now why you called yourself and your empire Long, unluckily for you I will kill you and take both the caterpillar and the dragon stone for myself!"
While the King's fought there was no space for small fries around, The emperor pushed the crown prince away then threw him directly on Yun Jhin's back, Yun Jhin looked down at the duo and waited, if things went out as he planned he would profit immensely from their fight!
The emperor and the patriarch looked at each other as they sneered, lightning clashed in the middle as they glared at each other. Long Huang immediately attacked, taking a sword out of his spatial bag he went to the offensive as he made an overhead slash trying to directly cut the patriarch into two pieces.
The patriarch waved around the slash as if he was dancing and took his weapon out, it was a simple blue trident with some turtle engravings on it, Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked at the trident, those engravings were familiar, could the heavenly turtle sect be connected to the Black Turtle planet?
Yun Jhin flew further away from the battlefield as he didn't want the shockwaves from the fight to hit him, he would need to be at full power to be able to take advantage of the duo's weak moment.
The crown prince looked at his father fight with wide eyes as he seemingly couldn't look away, even though he couldn't make out what happened with his eyes, his soul willpower boosted with his inner ki could make him keep up a little and understand what happened.
The patriarch's aura intensified as he waved his trident and a giant wave of water appeared and started to engulf Long Huang, however, Long Huang grasped his sword with both hands as he slashed the wave into two, he dashed inside the opening he made but Luo Sunfeng chuckled as he put his hand forward and clenched it!
The wave closed in and buried Long Huang inside of it, but a barrier of sword slashes stopped him from being crushed inside the water currents, Long Huang coughed out a bit of water as he looked at Luo Sunfeng and he said:
"It seems your control of the Sea Turtle sutra has increased even further..."
Luo Sunfeng didn't say anything as he waved his hands in some peculiar hand seals then slammed his palms on the ground, out of the ground a giant geyser of hot water rushed directly at Long Huang, but Long Huang jumped away as soon as he felt the earth tremble, he knew most of the patriarch's tricks as this wasn't the first time he fought him head-on.
Long Huang took out a second sword as he dashed directly to the patriarch cutting through the water geysers that would spawn from time to time, he engulfed his body in a deep red aura that kept him safe from the attacks of the patriarch, when the emperor was almost head to head with the patriarch, Luo Sunfeng suddenly smiled as he got up from his kneeling position and the trident appeared in his hands again, he thrust his trident forward at an extremely quick speed ready to impale Long Huang in the heart and take his life!
Long Huang crossed his swords at the last moment and he was pushed back for tens of meters until he got control of his body, the technique that he used with the trident sent a shockwave through his swords directly into his body unbalancing it, if it hit his chest and his heart the shockwave would have directly destroyed it killing him instantly!
Long Huang frowned as he looked at the patriarch and muttered to himself:
"Even though he didn't break through to the 3rd stage, the improvement of his technique is something that I can barely keep up with... have I made a mistake here?"
Before he could say anything else, Luo Sunfeng dashed at him as he got into melee range, the man was so confident of the new techniques which he mastered that he challenged the emperor in the area he was the most confident in!
But the patriarch wasn't the only one who learned and mastered some new techniques!
Long Huang put both of his swords forward as he suddenly disappeared from where he was, Luo Sunfeng's eyes widened as he looked down at his chest as a current of wind threw him away into the sky and a rain of blood appeared where he previously stood.
The emperor looked at the sky as he said slowly:
"Dragon style swordsmanship: wind slash stage 1"
He jumped after the patriarch as he was ready to use his swordsmanship combo on him when suddenly the crown prince's scream could be heard up from the sky!
Long Huang cursed as he used his ki to enter into a stance of pseudo flying, he needed to be faster to get to his son, it seemed he made a mistake when he threw Luo Sunfeng into the sky, he didn't think that Yun Jhin would be still flying in the same place!

chapters.title: Chapter 42: A single death doesn't change a thing
chapters.content:
The battlefield on the plains was a grisly sight, for both the Long empire and the Heavenly Turtle sect, even though the sect has gotten some reinforcements, due to the aerial ambush from the empire, most of the turtle sect cannon fodder has already died, rivers of fresh blood were flowing on the plains, the green grass on the ground turned a deep fresh red, organs were scattered here and there along with decapitated heads and human body parts, it wasn't a pretty sight.
Yun Jhin chuckled inside as he looked at the patriarch picking up the crown prince like a little chick, he grabbed him by the neck as he held him up and floated there, however after he floated for a bit he let himself fall, it took too much out of a King Realm expert to fly, even though they could pseudo-fly they wouldn't be able to truly fly at their realm.
He dived into Long Huang's direction with one hand holding his son with the other holding the trusty trident, he looked ready to skewer the man who was exhausting his energy to save his son.
Yun Jhin smiled to himself as he was ignored by the man, he was an important beast that wouldn't be killed unless he would be obstinate to the point that he couldn't be tamed. Yun Jhin looked down at the ground as he heard the sound of steel clashing, blood splashing, and lives ending, it was a symphony of death.
A symphony that he enjoyed very much, he kept his eyes trained on the duo as they clashed again, using his dual swords Long Huang tried to save his son from Luo Sunfeng's hand, they both plummeted to the ground as their ki couldn't let them float anymore, there was a saying in the cultivation world, while a king can look at the sky an emperor can embrace it, and it applied to the cultivation realms as well.
While a king could float using his ki an emperor could truly fly!
They both fell to the ground on their legs, even though they fell from a high distance in the air nothing happened to them due to their tempered bodies and strong constitutions, anyone that got to the king realm and above would have a strong bloodline or unique constitution, or else they wouldn't have been able to go this far on the cultivation path.
The dragon caterpillar looked down as Luo Sunfeng threatened Long Huang with his son's life, his hand which was on his neck started to clench, the crown prince couldn't do anything, even let out a peep as his neck bones were slowly getting crushed, if they broke he would instantly die!
Long Huang growled as he threw his swords down and said:
"Ok, I admit defeat, what do you want to let him go?"
Luo Sunfeng laughed as he stopped clenching his neck but kept a tight grip on him, he opened his mouth and started telling his conditions:
"I do not want your land or resources, I just want two things, the dragon stone, and the dragon caterpillar!"
Long Huang gritted his teeth as he said:
"You already took one dragon stone and you want to take the second one too?"
Luo Sunfeng frowned as he said:
"The one we took was stolen and changed with a fake, I'm not sure how you got yours but I don't care either, now hand it over!"
Yun Jhin lent the dragon stone to the emperor when he got his draconic herbs, he knew something like this would happen sooner or later so he didn't want to become a target. The emperor opened his spatial bag as he took out the dragon stone.
The patriarch laughed heartily as he kept his eyes on the dragon stone and said:
"Get the dragon caterpillar down too, I want to make a contract with it, don't forget to erase yours from its consciousness space."
The emperor frowned as he kept his hold on the dragon stone and told him:
"The contract was made by Jun'er, you will have to let him go if you want him to destroy the contract."
Luo Sunfeng frowned as he looked as his captive's face and then he put his trident away and waved his free hand while saying:
"Throw the dragon stone here and I will release him, make sure it isn't a fake or I'm killing him immediately!"
Long Huang gritted his teeth so hard they started cracking as he looked at the dragon stone and then at his son, he threw the dragon stone in Luo Sunfeng's empty hand, the patriarch caught it easily as he looked at it to make sure it's genuine then he frowned:
"You don't treasure your son's life do you, Long Huang?"
The emperor laughed as he looked at him and said:
"A single death won't affect the future of my Long Empire, not even the crown prince's, as long as I'm alive I can sire more descendants."
Suddenly two swords drilled from the earth and directly pinned the man's feet to the ground, Luo Sunfeng growled as he clenched Long Jun's neck, easily breaking all of his bones and effectively killing him.
His head dropped to the side like a broken doll's and the luster in his eyes turned grey, however, Luo Sunfeng met with the cold sharp edge of a sword that was ready to cut him into two parts!
The patriarch laughed as he watched the sword get nearer to his head and then he shouted as his aura increased in volatility and depth, he escaped from the swords that were pinning him to the ground by jumping up, even though this action leads the swords to cut some of his bones and heavily injuring his feet, atleast he didn't die.
His trident appeared in his hands as he grasped it tightly then thrust it in front of him at extreme speeds even dislocating his arms in the process due to the speed he used, this was a blitzkrieg strategy, by using strength his body couldn't handle he wanted to end the emperor!
However, the trident missed his heart by a few centimeters, but the tri-pronged weapon still hit both of his lungs and made them collapse.
Long Huang vomited a mouthful of blood as his lungs started to fill with the same substance, Luo Sunfeng laughed loudly but then he cringed as he looked at his feet and used some of his ki like bandages to wrap up his feet in them so the injury wouldn't worsen.
Long Huang did the same with his inner injuries, as a King realm expert even though his lungs have been perforated he could still live due to the high vitality the King realm gave to the practitioner who reached the realm, even deadly injuries to those below the realm could be healed by Kingly experts, however, that didn't mean the injury wasn't deadly!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he stopped observing, he looked down at the battlefield as both sides stopped fighting, but the surroundings were bloody and full of corpses and death, organs and the other things, Yun Jhin laughed to himself as he looked around, he flew around the surroundings as he used his claw to make peculiar hand seals.
Those hand seals weren't normal as from the seals different type of runes started to etch themselves into the air, he ran along with the air, the space above the battlefield was engulfed with his runes, after a short while a formation that looked like a devil's skull appeared, with horns and all.
Using the bodies blood and injured cultivators Yun Jhin started to chant:
"Oh Zolal, Amon, Shacono, I give you these petty sacrifices to hit those two injured King realms down there, if you kill them you can even take their corpses!"
The formation started to light up with a peculiar red devilish light, the skull started to move as it seemingly laughed in delight, it's mouth opened as all of the gore and bodies on the battlefield started to disappear as they were transported to hell!
Even though Yun Jhin could create such formations to connect to hell, he knew that devils were very cunning and they would never leak hell's entrance location, at most he could make them do some work for him if they were interested in the sacrifice.
A creepy laugh could be heard as a pure black hand struck directly at the emperor and the patriarch hitting them directly, then a soul-chilling voice could be heard coming from the formation:
"Storm of blades!"
Blades of different lengths and colors, both physical and made of ki started to rain on the duo as they were cut up, they were both injured and on their last legs considering mobility, one had injured lungs and the other had skewered feet.
The rain of armaments cut them up pretty good as they were on their last legs, the pitch-black arm went directly to take a hold of the duo as it started to crush their bones, the emperor and the patriarch looked at each other as they shouted in unison and powered their auras to their maximum, furthering the injuries they escaped from the hand as a 'tch' sound could be heard from the skull formation.
The other cannon fodder down were absorbed into the formation as they died, the injured ones went first as even some of the healthy ones were absorbed, the formation was just like a vacuum!
After the formation had its fill of flesh and blood the skull stopped laughing and it transformed into ashes that drifted in the wind, a disappointed voice could be heard coming from the formation as it fully transformed into ashes:
"Two king realm experts, such abundant flesh and blood, you are a lucky one contractor..."
Yun Jhin ignored the voice as his big body flew down, he looked at the dying sect patriarch and emperor, they both looked at his dark eyes as the emperor wanted to get up and he said:
"Good, good come here Yun Jhin, help me up and kill this pig, he killed my son Jun'er!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the man's attempt of getting up and he said:
"He killed your Jun'er? You might as well have killed him yourself."
Long Huang eyes widened as he heard Yun Jhin's tone, he didn't know who activated the formation but he never thought that Yun Jhin would be behind it, after all, he was a beast, and cultivation beasts had the worst talent for formations!
Humans and elves were the best at formations and beasts were the worst! As for the other races they were all average but that didn't mean geniuses from these races wouldn't rise and create new ways of using formations, it was possible but had a very low chance of happening.
Yun Jhin slowly approached them as his claws struck the both of them in the chest sealing the deal, they were slowly dying and Yun Jhin put the nail in their coffin.
Long Huang looked with wide eyes at Yun Jhin's figure but Luo Sunfeng laughed loudly as blood flowed freely from his mouth and he said:
"Fooled by a beast! We were both played by a beast!"
Long Huang didn't want to believe those words but he realized that his enemy was right, they were both played by Yun Jhin!
Yun Jhin kept a straight face as he took the real dragon stone from Long Huang's spatial bag and he looked at his dying form as he said:
"What you have said is true, it doesn't matter who dies, it won't change my future, however the amount of deaths matter!"
He grabbed the dragon stone as it flowed with a red light, the light entered in both of their bodies as they forcefully gained the dragon bloodline!
They screamed in pain as their bloodlines were forcefully changed by Yun Jhin's claws, doing such a thing while injured and on the verge of death exuded both of their life force, even though their bodies gained the dragon bloodline they immediately died!
Yun Jhin opened his mouth as he devoured both of their bodies, but things became problematic as he chewed on their hards bodies, King realm practitioners bodies were remodeled after they reached this cultivation realm, their toughness increased and Yun Jhin was actually having a hard time eating them!
Yun Jhin frowned as he tried to eat them but he realized that he couldn't!
Their bodies were too hard, his fangs almost cracked as he tried to continuously bite and chew on their hard meat and skin, he frowned as he looked at the bodies and used a free spatial bag to store both of the bodies, this wasn't a thing he liked, eating them sooner was better but his teeth weren't sharp enough to chew through their though bodies!
He needs to break through to the 3rd stage to be able to slowly chew through their bodies and he might not even be able to eat the bones!
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the empty battlefield, all of the elites and cannon fodder of the empire and the Heavenly Turtle sect perished here, their armies were dead but that didn't mean these places lacked cultivators, there were still the ones who dealt in logistics and other miscellaneous stuff, not everyone was talented at doing battle.
Yun Jhin frowned as he rushed towards the Long Empire, he needed to the treasury and enter a hidden place, with the memories he gained from both the emperor and the patriarch, he knew that he had to visit both treasuries, they had things that would help him, however, he needed to quickly eat the bodies or they would lose a high deal of nutritional ki!
Yun Jhin's big body flew at the highest speeds back to the empire, even though the ministers were still alive he could shrink his body and use the stealth technique to get inside the treasury, with the emperor dead there was nothing else he needed to fear!
Unknowingly to Yun Jhin back the formation entrance, a black hand grasped the firm space there and tried to slash it with his long dark nails, however another 'tch' could be heard as the voice complained:
"The dragon planet, the space is so hard there, goddammit! I would have wanted to rampage there for a while... but the entrance to the human world is so far away from that planet, not worth it..."
Space there returned to normal as the voice disappeared, the devil gave up on invading for now...

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Another day another empire
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin kept his body steady as he flew at his fastest speed towards the imperial capital, as he flew he thought on how to use the corpses, he shook his head as he realized that he couldn't make in time, they would lose too much ki.
Yun Jhin dropped to the ground in a nearby forest as he took both of the corpses out of his spatial bag, he needed to turn them both into sarira beads so they wouldn't lose more ki, his eyes narrowed as his draconic flames turned green.
His green flames engulfed both of the corpses as they started to melt and contract into two deep red sarira beads, this was basically like pickling them so they would last longer, Yun Jhin grabbed both of the sarira beads with his claws and attempted to chew on them again, but unfortunately even though the bodies have been melted his teeth still weren't strong enough and if he swallowed the beads it wasn't known if his digestive system could melt them.
Yun Jhin kept the sariras in his spatial bag as he resumed his flying to the capital. However at the capital, things weren't that good, the left and right minister made an emergency meeting the moment the Emperor's life crystal broke, their ruler was dead!
That meant they would die soon as well if they didn't surrender to their invaders, the left minister frowned as he said:
"We cannot do anything anymore, if the emperor died his son should have as well, after all, they left together on the dragon caterpillar, we must surrender even though it's shameful, atleast the empire will continue to exist."
The right minister didn't say anything, he was a man of few words and it seemed that he agreed with the left minister's words, the military minister had no army to lead anymore so he kept his mouth sealed, the other officials were of a lower standard than those three so they couldn't butt in this conversation as well.
The princess was cleaning her cheeks of tears, hearing that both her father and big brother died made her extremely sad but now she was the only imperial alive that was also old enough to lead, there was also her smallest brother but he was a baby!
Technically speaking she was the last in line to inherit the throne in the future when her little brother grew up a little, but now she had to become empress!
The left and right ministers supported her as the new empress as they said:
"Empress Mumu, you will have to lead the peace talks with the patriarch of the heavenly turtle sect, I heard he is an understanding man when it comes to the fairer sex.", The left minister winked as her as he waved his hands.
Mumu frowned as she looked at the men inside the meeting place, they were all eyeing her and thinking how they could use her to save their hide.
Suddenly a woosh sound could be heard as the doors of the palace opened, but there was no one there...
The left and right ministers were thoroughly scared by what happened, and the military minister looked around the palace but he couldn't find anything.
Yun Jhin was basically in their face as he laughed at them, he shrank to a size of 1 meter long using his body ki manipulating technique and waved slowly at them as he walked towards the treasury room.
The Long Empire's treasury was pretty rich considering they took taxes from 95% of the population, the 5% consisted of nobility that didn't have to pay taxes.
The treasury was full of herbs, spirit stones, armors, weapons, scrolls with techniques and other unique things, Yun Jhin ignored everything around him as he walked further inside the treasury.
The things he needed weren't those flimsy things, as he walked further into the treasury, the mountains of spirit stones herbs and other things started to thin, in front of him appeared a giant skull of a dragon!
The Long Empire was founded when the ancestor of the Imperial family found the skull of a dragon, with the help of a forbidden technique he extracted the last semblance of the bloodline from it and bestowed it upon his descendants, however, such a long time passed that the bloodline thinned out to the point that they wouldn't realize they got one. However this was where the dragon stone intervened, for the royal family it didn't grant them the bloodline, it refreshed and activated it!
This is why the Emperor wanted to get his hands on the dragon stone so bad, in the end, his bloodline was activated, but not at a fortunate moment.
Yun Jhin took a good look at the skull, this should help him advance further into the dragon caterpillar race tree. He walked towards it and easily disarmed the formation that was protecting it, then he opened his maw as an attracting force sucked the skull inside Yun Jhin's body.
Crunching sounds could be heard from his body as the old dragon skull disappeared from existence, it wasn't known at what realm it was when he lived but with so much time passing by it didn't matter as it became weak enough for Yun Jhin to digest.
The system made clear that it didn't disappear as a notification appeared in Yun Jhin's face:
[Eat 3 more dragon skulls, if the host cannot gain more dragon skulls, to evolve further, the host would need to eat 50,000 more humans with dragon bloodline, their cultivation should be atleast at the 1st stage of the ki cultivating realm.]
Yun Jhin looked at the system notification as he asked it:
"What if I ate 2 King realm sariras at the 2nd stage?"
The system took some time to respond as another notification appeared in front of him:
[Host would still need to eat atleast 5,000 more humans based on the ki intensity remaining in the sariras.]
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he dismissed the notification, he was getting closer and closer to his goal of reaching the peak of the draconic race tree, however, this wouldn't be the peak of his evolution, he wanted more and more, but he first needed to increase his cultivation for that...
The dragon head was consumed and even though his cultivation didn't reach the 3rd stage, with some help of the herbs inside the treasury he could still get there.
He made sure to get his claws on the rarest types that were beneficial to him and he made a pill that he immediately ate, with the pill in his body his cultivation was ready to break through to the 3rd stage.
He closed his eyes as his body filled up with ki again, this ki was purer than the last stage and the increase was substantial, he could feel his ki pathways strengthening along with his body, his soul was also engulfed in ki as it was purified and mended further. Yun Jhin could control the breakthrough to strengthen all of his attributes but if he did that it would take him long to finish.
But he didn't care as he would be extremely safe inside the treasury, no one would enter for a long while as they would be too scared of the retribution of the Heavenly Turtle sect.
While Yun Jhin was cultivating inside the treasury, outside things were in a pandemonium, Long Mumu's fair skin was bloody as the left minister held her hostage, the right minister had a smoking pipe in his mouth as he narrowed his eyes at the other older man and said:
"You want to escape with her highness? Such a sudden betrayal from you, the lackey of the crown prince, and the most supportive of the imperial family."
The left minister laughed as he watched the right minister movements, ready to retaliate and even kill Long Mumu if the man got closer to him, he looked at him and opened his mouth to say:
"Don't give me that bullshit Fuo Song, I know you wanted to kidnap her the moment you heard the Emperor fell, I saw it in your eyes, I just got to her first!"
The left minister thought that he could curry favor with the Heavenly Turtle sect if he gave them the most important current living imperial. The right minister shook his head as he looked at the left minister and said:
"I'm sorry Mumu."
His pipe grew to a length of 1 meter as it transformed into a sword going through both the left minister and Long Mumu's heart, he looked down at them as they both fell to the ground in a pool of blood and said slowly:
"It doesn't hurt to tell you this now, I have always been a spy from the Heavenly Turtle sect, and I'm disappointed to say that both the patriarch and your emperor fell in battle, I'm not sure who did it but both sides were fooled, however, that doesn't mean I will have to let the enemy live."
The left minister coughed mouthful of blood after mouthful of blood he wanted to say something but his eyes turned grey and lifeless as he took his last breath.
