Fuo Song shook his head as he looked at the grisly sight in front of him and he took the sword out of his mouth as he pointed it at the downed bodies and incinerated them with a fireball that shot out of the tip of the weapon.
Unknowingly to him, while he finished the ministers and the other's in the imperial palace, Yun Jhin was quickly finishing his breakthrough, even though it took him longer than normal, it wasn't a breakthrough from a realm to another so it wouldn't take days or months, however, with the amount of time he used to finish his breakthrough his body still needed to adapt to the stage he was in for quite a while before another breakthrough.
He opened his dark eyes as he looked around and used his soul willpower to feel what happened around the palace, his willpower saw how the right minister finished the last official, Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the man and immediately realized that he was a traitor, how else would the sect know where the dragon stone was located?
Yun Jhin took his body out of the treasury as he stealthily walked towards the right minister, however, the man shook his head as he looked directly at the place Yun Jhin was and he said:
"I know where you are, dragon caterpillar, I'm not sure how you got back to the capital and why you have such a strong stealth technique on you, but I guess you will tell me later."
The man unleashed his aura which put him at the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm, but there was also something strange but similar in his aura, his bloodline reeked of the tortoise smell, that's what Yun Jhin thought, he smelled like a tortoise!
It was impressive he could see through Yun Jhin's stealth technique, only those who cultivated the 4 beast's eyes or similar technique could see through his stealth, and that was because he wasn't at his full potential.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the man, his shorter body immediately expanded to its full length as he looked at the right minister and said:
"Well aren't you special, seeing through my stealth technique, are you descendant of the Black Tortoise?"
The man decline in saying anything as he observed Yun Jhin and said:
"Your dragon bloodline isn't that thick but it's consistent, a dragon caterpillar is a rather rare creature, I would like to know why would you put yourself in service to this pitiful empire, doesn't your pride stop your from doing that?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at him and said:
"The cycle of life and death continues, I will live they will die."
The man frowned as he looked at Yun Jhin and tried to understand what he meant by that, but out of the corner of his eye, he saw a dark claw that immediately clutched him!
Yun Jhin used the same formation as before, summoning a devil to do his bidding, he used all of the corpses that the man didn't bother to dispose of, of course with fewer corpses meant a weaker devil accepted the contract.
The man broke through the claws constraints but it was too late, Yun Jhin aimed a breath attack to him which hit him head-on, but Yun Jhin failed to kill him.
The man breathed hard as he fell out of a water defensive technique which took the form of a bubble, the devil seeped him of his ki when he clutched him in his claw, this was a natural talent of the devils, if you made physical contact with them, they could seep your ki and use it for themselves.
Fuo Song frowned as he felt his internal condition and decided he had to flee! He didn't live for such a long time to be killed here! He got baptized with the black tortoise blood and became an inheritor of its will, he couldn't die here!
However, Yun Jhin would never let pray to escape from him, his claws formed a few other handseals as the formation of the palace was triggered, but it wasn't the same as before, it was slightly modified.
Strong gravitational pressure applied to the right minister's body as Yun Jhin slowly got close to him and said:
"You should understand my previous words now right?"
The man chuckled then shook his head as he laid down on the ground, he accepted his death.
Yun Jhin smiled as he opened his mouth and ate him in one big mouthful.
The man tried to trash or even attack Yun Jhin's insides but unfortunately for him anything that entered in Yun Jhin's body wouldn't be able to leave.
Another notification appeared in Yun Jhin's face as he finished digesting the man:
[Black Tortoise bloodline found, Dragon bloodline found, lacking Vermilion Bird, White Tiger and Azure Dragon bloodline, the artificial celestial caterpillar can be created when all bloodlines are united! Artificial celestial caterpillar can reach rank 10,000 as long as it keeps consuming fully bodied members of the 4 sacred races.]
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the notification, he didn't know about this!

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Lack of information
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin frowned as he thought about the artificial celestial caterpillar and shook his head as he realized that his memories contained no information about such a thing!
He looked at the notification screen as it dissipated and thought about the new form that he gained knowledge off, he ignored the half-destroyed palace as he pondered about the new form, the system said that it could reach the 10,000th rank which meant it could grow to have the potential of a fortuned caterpillar.
Fortuned caterpillars were very peculiar to the point that Yun Jhin didn't know their appearance or powers, he just knew they were one of the most loved insects in the universe when they evolved into their fortuned butterfly form, the universe would cheer them on and open so they could leave and ascend.
He didn't know anything about the artificial celestial butterfly so he wasn't sure if he wanted to follow this path in the future, Yun Jhin stopped thinking about such a thing as there was no way he would be able to eat so many dragons/tortoises/vermillion birds/azure tigers so that he could evolve into the A-C-C.
To begin with, there weren't that many pure-blooded sacred beasts and their descendants, secondly, pure sacred beasts were born at the Sage Realm and Yun Jhin wasn't even a king realm expert yet, a sacred beast cub could breathe in his direction and he would disintegrate, thirdly he would need to eat atleast 2 pure-blooded sacred beasts to transform into an A-C-C, there was no chance he could do that.
Most sacred beasts had a connection to their kin so if one of them died by someone's hands they would know who did it unless the one who killed their kin was of a way higher cultivation base than they were, that would just make them vigilant and they would do their best to hide.
Finally, Yun Jhin didn't want to make enemies with the 4 planets unless it would be his last standing, besides the sacred beasts themselves, they had human counterparts that they blessed with their bloodline at the God realm, even if Yun Jhin could take care of the beasts themselves that didn't mean the humans wouldn't intervene, even if he was at the peak God realm, back in his previous life he didn't want to fight these planets and their sacred beasts.
They were also quite vengeful. Yun Jhin started looking around the palace as he cleared his head, he had killed a spy from the Black Turtle planet, that was both a good thing and a bad thing, the good thing was that he took care of a variable that could have hit him hard in the future.
The bad thing was that he got the attention of the one's who sent out the spy, however, they couldn't invade the dragon planet willy nilly, after all, the true imperial family that lived in the upper continents had a one or two god realm experts themselves, let's not even talk about the other sects that lived in the upper continents.
Most dragons were free and liked to live to the fullest, they all came from the same imperial family on this planet, they were all related but that didn't mean they were all friendly with each other, most of them took diverging paths, while others decided to live normally as their ancestors did, this is what Yun Jhin knew from his previous life and he wasn't sure what happened now, he needed to move to the upper continents to learn about it.
However it wasn't time yet, he would need to be atleast a King Realm expert first. Yun Jhin made use of the deaths of the Emperor and his family to take over the empire, he did it slowly but surely, as he was a dragon caterpillar and now the only strongest person in the empire, considering the others died in the war with the heavenly turtle sect and he had a dragon bloodline the population decided to abide by his rule.
Yun Jhin lent the dragon stone to the population just like in the Earth Kingdom, he created the same formation as before and let it in a public place in the capital so people could visit and touch it to gain the draconic bloodline. After he finished everything he made sure to let some of his new subordinates take care of the empire while he left to subdue the Heavenly Turtle sect as well.
Yun Jhin flew in the ocean as he approached the sect grounds of the Heavenly Turtle sect after a while of swimming, he easily broke through the formation that protected the sect and started a rampage in its ranks, the new patriarch and sect master tried to stop him but easily took care of them and enslaved the sect. No hidden experts or anything was protecting the sect, only the weak members remained after Yun Jhin took care of their elites and leaders.
Just like the empire the sect slowly slid into Yun Jhin's control, but Yun Jhin didn't let them stay in the sect grounds, he took the treasury with him using multiple spatial bags and relocated all of the people inside the empire!
With all of the people from the Heavenly Turtle sect that were relocated to the empire's land the empire got a huge population influx, but with Yun Jhin's abilities he easily quelled any unrest due to the population influx, he gave food herbs and spirit stones out of the treasury to the needy and made his public image to be pristine.
With the help of some special underwater herbs from the Heavenly Turtle sect treasury, his body adapted to the 3rd stage of the ki cultivating realm at a quicker pace, and in a few weeks, he would be able to eat the sarira beads created from the two King Realm experts.
Yun Jhin looked at the capital from his spot atop the palace, he created a room big enough to house his body with the help of his new subordinates and now he was at its balcony overlooking the capital with his soul willpower, his eyes were closed as he muttered:
"With enough time, everyone should be able to gain the draconic bloodline, however, the dragon stone seems to be reaching its limits, this is strange, wasn't it supposedly indestructible?"
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt the condition of the dragon stone, it started to crack here and there as it's dragon bloodline started to leak out of it, people would get influenced by it easier, they thought that it was a blessing but Yun Jhin knew that leak was due to overuse, the stone could heal itself if left alone.
However, the stone was used every day by thousands of people that meant no matter how indestructible it was it still got exhausted, as long as it was used in moderation it could be used an unlimited amount of times.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he shook his head and said:
"Let them use it more, the explosion should create radiation that should create even more draconic bloodlines and even of a purer range than this one, even though I would lose a lot of meat because of it, it doesn't matter much."
Yun Jhin opened his spatial bag as he eyed the two beads, his mouth unhatched like a python ready to swallow his prey as his teeth broke through the hard layer of the beads, dark blood red seeped out slowly of the beads that Yun Jhin drank merrily.
Changes could be seen on Yun Jhin's body, he grew smaller and more compact as his fat turned into streamlined muscles, his dark eyes started to change color into a deep red as his draconic horns changed from their original color into an indigo color.
It took him almost 2 weeks to finish one bead and afterward he opened the second one as he started with the shell... another change happened to his body as his bloodline evolved, he could now reach rank 5,500 even though his bloodline didn't finish evolving, the benefits of eating two experts at the 2nd stage of the king realm with a draconic bloodline were very visible.
Yun Jhin clenched his claws as his muscles started rippling, his skin turned a deep azure color as his cultivation was ready to do a breakthrough in the 4th stage whenever he wanted, but he kept his body soft as he didn't attempt a breakthrough.
He needed to fully assimilate the benefits from the two sariras before he broke through, Yun Jhin closed his eyes as the remaining bits of energy from the sariras washed his whole body and ki pathways, strengthening them further increasing their durability and purifying the body, until the Sage Realm there would always be impurities in the body that could be extracted using techniques or cultivating, those impurities would limit the potential of the body.
While Yun Jhin was cultivating in his new room, the population of the empire was praising Yun Jhin as a benevolent emperor who put the citizens before himself! Even though they knew he was a cultivation beast they thought that he was a better human than the former emperor who only thought about himself and the imperial family!
Yun Jhin didn't truly care about the public sentiment as he would hate to eat a lot of them in the future, but now he had to wait for them to mature, so if he was seen as a good emperor the better for him.
In an alleyway near the dragon stone location a child that stood at the height of 1,45 meters clutched the hem of his shirt as he slowly closed into the dragon stone location, he thought that the emperor said that everyone could touch the dragon stone to get its blessings so he wanted to try his luck.
The small child didn't look special at all as he got closer and closer to the dragon stone location when his hand touched the dragon stone nothing happened seemingly as if the dragon stone didn't want to bless the little guy with its special powers.
However, after a few seconds when the child wanted to leave with a disappointed look on his face, the dragon stone started to turn a deep red color!
After so many people touching it, the dragon stone finally reached its limit as it started to power up, the dragon stone red exterior started to burn with bloodline flames.
The bloodline flames started to engulf the child as he cried out in pain and fright, then the flames started to spread around the dragon stone's surroundings, the stone started shaking, seemingly as if it was angered by the overuse the humans put on it, it endured the abuse in the Earth Kingdom but the difference in population between the kingdom and the empire was too big!
The dragon stone shaking intensified as the cry of a dragon was heard, it was crying howl of a desperate being that was on its last throes, a death cry of a warrior on his death bed. Suddenly the dragon stone exploded into a shower of pieces that took the child along with half of the capital along with it!
Yun Jhin made sure the dragon stone wasn't the imperial palace so he didn't feel anything besides the tremor and the sound of the explosion.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he looked at the red radiation at the location of the dragon stone near the slums, the radiation spread among the still-living people, some had missing limbs but they were still breathing.
Some of them started to grow draconic limbs out of their stumps as they cried out in pain, some of them grew dragon eyes or tails, the radiation was so strong that it mutated their outer appearance into half draconic beings.
Yun Jhin laughed as he watched everything happen outside and said:
"You want to cultivate so I let you cultivate, you wanted a draconic bloodline so I gave it to you, now you have even been blessed by the shards of the dragon stone, aren't I a benevolent ruler?"
He ignored the deaths of the hundreds of thousands of people that lived in the capital as he looked at the living people in the slums, they were the future nutrients that would help him evolve on the draconic tree!
The dragon caterpillar went back to cultivating as he stopped looking outside, it would be quite a long time before they matured enough for him to consider them snacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Empires are like sand castles
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin started to enter into a deep sleep as his body circulated his ki cultivating technique by itself, by doing this he could cultivate faster and if anyone approached his formations he could wake up easily, but if he were to wake up too late he could be in trouble if someone with a higher cultivation base attacked him.
But Yun Jhin didn't do things without a backup plan, if anyone attacked his body they would trigger a formation that would instantly crush them to the ground due to increased gravity giving him enough time to wake up.
Yun Jhin looked down at this human form as he shook his head:
"Another review of memories?"
Yun Jhin looked as images appeared in front of him, darkness, blood, limbs his former lives came and went fast by his eyes, death, decay.
Lives lost, power gained, death by old age, hatred, a lot of hatred towards the universe at large.
Hatred for others, jealousy, power hunger, deep soul injuries that have been created through repeated reincarnations, his personality split and ruptured, craziness, death, reset.
Yun Jhin laughed as the images stopped appearing around him, he started meeting with his former personalities, most of them shouted at him clawed at his spiritual body and even tried to posses him to get ahold of his new body.
Yun Jhin stripped them of their memories transforming them into inner demons that he used to temper his soul with, however, they were now akin to poison but he didn't care as he looked at them almost brush their claws around his spiritual body.
Even if an older personality took over his body the memories from before would enter in the mold that was the empty personality and recreate his current personality, they were just empty egos he couldn't get rid of, they were useless and had no way to escape from his soul space.
Yun Jhin actually pitied them, after all, they were his former lives, the only one that he could pity would be himself, he always felt that the universe was against him, that he was unliked and unloved, he lashed out at people and said that he hated them but as he reincarnated more and more he realized that he was childish.
He didn't hate people, he hated circumstances, he hated how he was forced to act, he hated how he lived, as he grew stronger and stronger he became intoxicated with the feeling of power and being in control, that's what happened with most cultivators that reached the God Realm.
As he got into control of his destiny his further reincarnations reached the God Realm further and further, until his last one where he reached the peak of the God Realm, when he mastered all of the laws of creation that he could he looked back into his soul and opened the key that was locking his former reincarnations in place.
Pandemonium went loose, but Yun Jhin was stronger than all of the former reincarnations combined, he slashed their heads open metaphorically speaking and took out their memories.
All of his memories overloaded his soul to the point that it almost burst, but he went through with the help of some devils, he used the souls of 50 million people as a sacrifice to use the soul regulator machine of hell.
Of course, the devils almost killed him in his attempts to regain his sanity, after all, the devil's rarely made themselves sign contracts and the oldest devils could also break through them at a price, they thought that they would gain more than the price they paid for breaking the contract.
But they failed, Yun Jhin fused all of his memories and he became invincible, he slaughtered all of the devils that went against him and fed on their carcasses restoring the lifespan that he used to maneuver the soul regulator.
He left hell a complete man, he went on a rampage across the land finding all of the hiding fortuned people and slaughtering them like sheep, he even fought for years on with the peak God Realm fortuned people.
In the end, he didn't live enough to taste the last fortuned one and gain his way to breakthrough.
Eyes opened wide, Yun Jhin looked at his human arms as he muttered:
"Not done yet?"
Behind him a voluptuous woman with a big smirk on her face embraced him as she said slowly:
"Enjoyed the ride, honey?"
Suddenly the image broke up into a million pieces as he was thrown inside a deep blue ocean that cooled his mind, Yun Jhin looked around as he said:
"Such fragmented memories, it seems the soul leakage did some damage."
This wasn't supposed to happen, it seemed even though he closed the hole in his soul some of his memories were still gone, they seemed important too, but at the time he could have cared less...
What was so important?
Yun Jhin looked around the ocean as he sank to the ocean floor, but there was only darkness, nothing else, countless yellow eyes opened as claws went towards Yun Jhin, some of his former lives were here too, but they were deformed, broken shattered, nothing like the ones above the ocean, Yun Jhin knew the cause of this but he couldn't do anything about it.
The man sighed as he looked at the broken apparitions and then he closed his eyes. He disappeared from the ocean as he woke up in his room in the palace, 2 years went by since he went into that deep sleep and no one bothered him, his cultivation was ready to break through the 4th stage but he just needed a little push.
Yun Jhin unleashed his soul willpower around the whole capital as a wide smile appeared on his face:
"So many, so dense, such a fine bloodline amount... the explosion was a huge success."
Even though some of the cultivators went above his cultivation realm he had things planned for that as well.
After all, he killed King realm experts, why would some people around the 6-7th stage of the ki cultivating realm matter to him, even though they had draconic bloodlines they could only fight 1 or 2 stages above their own cultivation base, compared to Yun Jhin they weren't that strong, he could fight 4-5 stages above!
Yun Jhin made an announcement for a tournament to be held, rich resources were added as rewards and even imperial titles, Yun Jhin even said that he may appoint a successor to the throne from this tournament.
While the people were running towards the capital from around the country, Yun Jhin was busy settling many types of formations around the gigantic battle arena he created with the help of his subordinates, even though they grew stronger they already lent their souls to Yun Jhin or else he might have just killed them on the spot.
Countless amounts of people joined in the capital, a dark-haired young man that stood in the sea of men and women reminisced about the past as he thought:
"To think that explosion would do this to me..."
It was the same young man that triggered the dragon stone explosion, it wasn't known how he survived but somehow here he was, he didn't look different from a human, but there was an aura around him that made him different from the ones who only had an arm or a leg changed into a draconic one.
The young man followed the crowd towards the palace, and Yun Jhin went out to welcome them, his draconic body looked much more majestic now as he smiled towards his people as he said with a clear tone of voice:
"I welcome you, my people, to the tournament that I have decided to hold due to one reason!"
Yun Jhin stopped talking as he looked around for a little while before continuing:
"I wish to enter into a prolonged session of closed-door cultivation that would take too long, I need someone to act as the emperor while I'm gone, the session might even take my whole life for all I know, I seek to do multiple breakthroughs to reach the King Realm."
"With the information that I have spread around you should know all of the cultivations realms, I shall thank all of those who decided to join the tournament, the rules should already be known they weren't changed and they are the same as my subordinates have relayed to you."
Yun Jhin closed his mouth as he pointed with his claws towards a giant arena near the palace, his next shout rumbled as some weaker cultivators held their ears in pain:
"LET THE BATTLE ROYALE COMMENCE!"
The young man was the first to enter the arena, he had a smug smile on his face as he looked at all of his 'competition', he thought that he would become the first and inherit the throne for sure. After all, he wasn't a small rabble like most of them were.
Yun Jhin looked at them as they started fighting, punches kicks, cultivation techniques stacked to their full potential, draconic abilities thrown around, breath attacks, swords, halberds, fans, and other weapons strewn around the arena.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes for a brief moment before he opened them up again, the formation started roaring to life as it engulfed the downed unconscious bodies of 99% of the contestants, the only one who was up and about was the same young man that entered first, the one who triggered the explosion and brought forth this era of draconic cultivators.
Yun Jhin smiled as the young man looked around in puzzlement and anger as all of his opponents were sucked into the formation and transformed into beads of blood, he shouted towards Yun Jhin:
"WHAT ARE YOU DOING?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he appeared in the arena, the formations didn't do anything to him.
The young man looked down at his chest as he saw a claw sliding out of it, his body was then sucked by the attraction force from the formation, he shouted as he clawed towards Yun Jhin, he had a crazed expression on his face as he said:
"WHYYY? DON'T YOU REALIZE THAT YOU HAVE CRIPPLED YOUR EMPIRE?"
Yun Jhin looked at the sky as some clouds went by and he said:
"Empire's ah, for me they are just like sandcastles, if I go to the beach, I can build a lot, and all it takes from me is one wave of the hand to destroy them, they are fragile but beautiful at the same time, and you get an accomplished feeling when you finish your sandcastle don't you?"
The young man didn't know what Yun Jhin talked about, he looked at him like he would look at a mad man, the formation was already sucking the blood out of him and transforming his body into the bead, he shouted as he tried to resist but Yun Jhin hit in the chest disabled his main acupoint where ki would go through.
The man cursed as his appearance changed, wings appeared out of his back as scales grew on his skin, his mouth became the muzzle of a dragon as his eyes turned into deep yellow slits, he groaned as the attraction force from the formation intensified.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he told him:
"You have just doomed yourself, I created this formation in mind that those with a higher concentration of draconic bloodline would get sucked faster inside than the others, you could have just hidden your bloodline and escaped, maybe..."
Yun Jhin was giving the young man false hope as he saw him struggling, but he realized he was already done, a vicious expression appeared on his face as he tried to self detonate his body, as he became a half draconic being.
He gained a draconic core in exchange for his human heart, draconic cores could be exploded if the dragons were in a perilous situation where they couldn't escape, they could take their foes down with them!
Yun Jhin smiled as he looked at his last attempt to get at him and he did a few hand seals, those hand seals manifested in a form of some runes that entered directly inside his body and sealed his draconic core.
Yun Jhin waved at him as he was transformed into a blood bead by the formation, Yun Jhin looked around as everyone that didn't go inside the arena looked horrified at his actions.
But he didn't care much, he took all of the beads inside his spatial bag and looked behind at the empire, they could still make more draconic bloodline descendants but with the dragon stone destroyed and most of the residue already absorbed, there was a very low chance for them to be talented.
The most talented was the young man he just absorbed inside his formation, he left the arena as he basked in the fearful gazes that looked at him, he decided to leave the empire alone, he had made use of them, with the help of so many draconic blood beads he would be able to evolve again, however, to go further down the path of the dragon he would need to eat pure draconic beings...
Pure draconic beings could morph into the form of the human and hide well in human society but Yun Jhin knew their hideout, however knowing their hideout and entering it were two different things.
Yun Jhin flew as he kept his spatial bags tied tight to him, there was no reason for him to stay in the Long Empire anymore, he had gained everything he could and the remaining things in the treasury had no use to him, he already razed them of their best herbs and spirit stones before he even did his announcement.
It was time to leave the lower continents and go for greener pastures. The number of benefits he gained here wasn't low but he was still disappointed, his greed was unmeasurable, but he thought he would feel better when he reached the upper continents.
But a hidden part of him always asked him: would he?
This was a question that Yun Jhin couldn't answer, he was a broken machine that tried to achieve his last goal, this was his last life, according to the system.
If he couldn't achieve eternal life this time, there wouldn't be a next, but in a small part of his consciousness he would welcome eternal rest, but the small part was overwhelmed by the insane desire of achieving true immortality.
Yun Jhin was truly a deranged individual but he grew to embrace that part of him, that's what made him truly strong.
That's what made him who he currently was.

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Middle regions
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin left the capital behind as he traveled for around 50,000 kilometers before he stopped to catch his breath, he wasn't sure if the Empire's backer would notice what happened up till now as he sealed the news but with him gone pandemonium would rise, the Heavenly Turtle sect backer wouldn't be able to do anything anyway as it was a spy sect and revealing themselves in the territory of the dragons would be a really unwise move.
Yun Jhin looked around as he spotted a mountain nearby, he flew directly to the base of the mountain where he dug a cave, he settled himself nicely there as he put up some formations to keep himself safe while he would be evolving again.
Yun Jhin opened his spatial bag and took out all of the blood beads that he created using the formation and nodded his head as he looked at their quality, the highest quality one was from the man who tried to go against him in his last struggles, but failed miserably in the end.
Yun Jhin opened his mouth as he inhaled blood bead after blood bead, impurities were extracted from his bloodline, from time to time he would vomit black blood in form of those impurities, he was getting nearer the perfect dragon caterpillar form with every bead consumed.
A cocoon started to engulf him as he finished the last blood bead and a notification appeared in front of him:
[Host has consumed enough draconic blood to evolve into the peak form of the dragon caterpillar tree, a pure dragon caterpillar of the highest bloodline rank, however as you are a mixed-blood no matter how high your bloodline is you will still feel suffocated in front of a true dragon.]
Yun Jhin knew about bloodline suppressions but with the purity of his evolving bloodline, only the highest royalty of dragons could suppress him, after all, not all dragons bloodline continued to be the same after they split up, some regressed and some strengthened.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he felt his body evolve again, his caterpillar height weight and length remained the same, but his skin transformed into scales as his body changed form, his body was still that of a caterpillar but he gained the maw of a dragon, his horns became sharper and turned crystalline.
He continuously slept as his form changed nothing woke him up as his body evolved and his bloodline strengthened, his cultivation broke through to the 5th stage of the ki cultivating realm in one go due to reaching the peak of the caterpillar evolutionary tree, but due to that happening his further breakthroughs would become harder.
The more talented the body the more energy it would require to breakthrough. It was the law of equivalent exchange, while the universe blessed him with a talented body and gave him higher battle power, it also made him have a harder time to break through into new realms, however that didn't mean his future breakthroughs would be limited, he would just need to gain more energy than normal experts.
While Yun Jhin was cultivating and breaking through, in the middle regions, a border sect received some news.
The grand elder of the sect looked at the news and shook his head:
"The Long Empire is in pandemonium? *puh* Why would the disciples send us this lowly information, do they think that we from the Middle continent care about this lowly bunch?"
The elder was ready to destroy the news when a hand stopped him, a rather youthful woman appeared near him as he took the news from his hand and read it more carefully then she shook her head and said:
"I thought it would be something interesting but it's just the normal emperor slaughtering their people to breakthrough, this damn savages from the lower continents with trash talent always use this technique to further their breakthroughs, how sad."
The grand elder bowed to the youthful woman and said:
"Should I go and investigate since madam is interested in this news?"
The woman shook her head but the grand elder knew that this meant she wanted to investigate, but not as an individual from their sect, the woman couldn't technically give orders to sect elders yet but the grand elder knew what kind of position she had in the sect master and patriarch's hearts.
He nodded as he left the hall he was currently in and left the sect grounds disappearing over the horizon.
The woman shook her head as she burned the bamboo slip that contained the news and muttered:
"A dragon caterpillar became the emperor of the Long Empire?"
Yun Jhin continued his evolution, he knew that the news of the empire being in pandemonium should have got to the border of the middle regions by now but he could care less, he took a different path to the one on the capital and hid the cave he dug very well, combined with his formations there was a very low chance of being found.
But just to be sure he also laid some strange poisonous plants that he got from the treasury of the heavenly turtle at the entrance, even 7th stage ki cultivating people who touched them would wither and die, experts would naturally recognize these plants and avoid the place.
Yun Jhin's body finished it's transformations as his wings could be now retracted into his body, he now looked half-draconic half-caterpillar, his big eyes turned a deep pure blue that would make him look cute but also a little bit ferocious in the face of female disciples.
While Yun Jhin was testing his new body and checking his internal cultivation state, the grand elder from the border sect was currently flying above the mountain!
The man looked down as an excited expression came over his face and he said:
"Poisonous Mondergartens and Dandriols."
It seemed the grand elder either trained in a poisonous technique or liked to refine gu's using poisonous plants, the man slowly descended to the cave's entrance as he got his hands on the plants using a special ki technique that made it look like he was wearing special white gloves, his cultivation base was still unknown as he didn't release his aura fully.
Yun Jhin felt the disturbance from above but kept himself calm, he just waited for the man to leave, unless he found the formations he wouldn't think there was anything else in the cave.
However, the man seemed to like poisonous plants as he went further and further into the cave until he hit a formation!
The formation made the man furrow his brows as he pushed it with his hand, the floating runes rebound pushing him back but he smiled as he looked at the runes and he shouted inside the cave:
"I wonder which friend is cultivating in this cave? Might I join you to talk about our experiences?"
The voice revealed the man's cultivation base, it was around the 3rd stage of the King Realm, Yun Jhin frowned as he felt the man's power, even though he broke through and was at the 5th stage of the ki cultivating realm that didn't mean he could clash head-on with a King Realm expert.
Only with tricks and formations, he killed those two king realm experts, they were exhausted and injured combined with the fact that the devil absorbed their last amount of ki and crushed their bones a little bit was the only reason they couldn't retaliate and kill Yun Jhin on the spot, that was also the reason they couldn't reject the forceful bloodline alteration from the dragon stone.
Yun Jhin knew that the man would become suspicious if he didn't respond so he talked back:
"Might I know where this friend is from and what are his intentions in visiting my dwelling?"
The grand elder laughed as he said:
"Well I have seen some poisonous plants at the entrance of the cave and I might wonder if this brother has more? After all, there should be more the deeper you go into the cave, this brother should know about the specifics of the plants right?"
Yun Jhin cursed inside as he heard the man's words, it seemed he knew his way around poisonous plants, he planted those specific ones in the mountain cave because with the right conditions they could grow inside such a cave.
Yun Jhin knew that if he gave away the other plants the man would realize that he was weak and there was a high chance he would be attacked, if he let him in he would see his body and cultivation base and he would attack as well.
The only way for him to not get captured would be to bluff:
"You know I might have some more plants of this type, but I have had quite the hard time picking them up."
The grand elder laughed again as he responded:
"This brother doesn't have to think much, I would like to trade with you, might you be able to tell me what do you require?"
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he said:
"Any kind of draconic herbs would do fine, after all, I left my home in search of these."
The grand elder frowned inside as he now had to think about Yun Jhin's background, what if he was from somewhere important?
They weren't nearly at the border of the middle regions but they were pretty close, what if he was from a stronger sect than his own? The difference of one level between King Realm experts made it that a 2nd stage would most likely easily get killed by a 3rd stage if they didn't have a strong treasure or body.
The grand elder said with a more respectful tone:
"Might I ask where this brother is from?"
Yun Jhin frowned as he scanned his memories for a sect name that he could use, but a long time passed and he wasn't sure if the sects existed anymore, Yun Jhin finally knew what to say as he opened his maw and said:
"If you want to know I guess I can entertain you, I'm from a subsidiary clan of the true dragons."
Yun Jhin unleashed his new bloodline aura sending it to the man so he could analyze it, the man frowned as he felt the aura, it truly was from a subsidiary clan of the true dragon race!
Subsidiary clans tended to live in the upper continents as servants or disciples of the true dragons. That was on the surface but in truth, most of them were bastards sons or daughters of the true dragons.
Most dragons wouldn't care with who they mated, after all, true descendants were harder to conceive than mixed ones, there was a 7/10 chance for a mixed-blood to be born then there was a 2/10 chance for a pureblood to be born.
Most of the population of the upper continents consisted of mixed-blood dragons, they mated with all type of creatures that could cultivate consisting from humans to insects, elves and other beings, however, dragons couldn't mix with all races so some mixes tended to be born dead or die along with their mothers. In female dragon situations, the male wouldn't last enough to fill her with enough sperm so that she could conceive a child and they would die of exhaustion.
The grand elder knew that what he felt was a mixed aura of a high-class dragon, from what he knew this should have been the aura of a dragon caterpillar of the imperial rank or above!
The grand elder coughed as he waved his sleeve and said:
"Actually if you think about it more, I don't think I want this brother's plants at all, I have a job to do anyways gotta go!"
The grand elder flew away from the mountain cave at top speed as he didn't look back, he didn't want to trigger the behemoth that stood beside Yun Jhin, or so he thought.
Yun Jhin didn't have any backer if you didn't count the Throne of blood sect that might or might not exist anymore.
Yun Jhin sighed as he felt the man's aura disappear from his senses, he quickly took care of all the formations around and left in the opposite direction the man went in.
Even though he was bold he wasn't dumb, he didn't have the right preparations to take on a King Realm expert that was also at a higher stage than the ones he dealt with.
For now, he would retreat and try to find a real backer, after all, with his talent and techniques anyone would like to recruit him, but he wouldn't settle for any weak sect, Yun Jhin only wanted the best regardless of their ethics or beliefs.
Yun Jhin passed the border of the middle regions after a few days of flying, he finally reached another step up in his new cultivation life.
For now, what he planned was to reach the upper continents and join the true imperial family, there as long as he conducted himself well he could break through to the Emperor realm and leave the planet, but first, he would make sure he had his fill of true dragons for the system...

chapters.title: Chapter 47: One thing leads to another
chapters.content:
The grand elder that met with Yun Jhin finally reached the Long Empire and questioned some of the people with a higher cultivation base that didn't mature enough to get into Yun Jhin's 'tournament'.
Those people didn't know much besides that their emperor was a dragon caterpillar, they also didn't see what happened at the capital so they couldn't say for sure what happened. Yun Jhin made sure to take care of all the eyewitnesses before he left.
While the grand elder was frowning trying to get any leads on Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin was making contact with the first city in the middle regions.
The city stood at the border of the entrance of the middle region so it was pretty poor compared to the ones at the center, however, the difference between continents could be seen the moment Yun Jhin entered the city, it wasn't much different from the Long Empire's capital!
The capital of a lower continent was only equal to a border city in the middle continent!
Yun Jhin wasn't surprised by this, the difference between continents would always be enormous no matter the planet he would be on, this was how things were meant to be, the weak remained weak while the strong got stronger.
Even if people that had less talent were born in the upper continents they would still look down on the talented people from the lower continents and scoff at them, this is how most silk pants young masters acted, most of them were weak trash with a great backer.
Yun Jhin strolled around the city using his ki transforming technique to morph into a humanoid form then he hid his draconic features with a brown cloak.
The dragon caterpillar wasn't up to date with the information about the dragon planet, if he got it right it had been almost 500,000 years since his last life, most of the people he knew would have died by now and the draconic planet and it's people weren't that warm to Yun Jhin in the first place.
Yun Jhin went to a booth where he could buy information of today's happenings and a planetary map, even though the planet environment shouldn't have changed, it has been almost 500,000 years.
The man at the desk was dozing off when Yun Jhin woke him up by punching his desk, the man got up frightened as he looked at Yun Jhin's cloak and he said:
"Dear customer, what would you need?"
Yun Jhin went directly to the subject and asked for a planetary map and the current happenings around the planet, the man chuckled as he opened a drawer below his desk and took out a map and a jade slip.
He pointed to them and said:
"20 middle-grade spirit stones or 200 low-grade ones."
Yun Jhin threw 200 low-grade spirit stones on the man's desk as he took the jade slip and map, he took a good look over them to make sure they were genuine then he nodded at the man behind the desk and left.
The man started to count the spirit stones and after finding out they were all genuine as well he sighed, there were times he was fooled and he had to hire some people from the Assassination sect.
Yun Jhin found himself a nice restaurant where he ordered some food and wine then he opened the map and examined it thoroughly, even though some places changed and some were erased much didn't change.
As for the news that happened recently, there had been a tournament in the upper continent which let the mixed-bloods join the main clans depending on their talent and battle power, Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the date, it had happened 3 weeks prior and the winner was already announced, this was a golden opportunity for him that he missed!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he continued reading news, even though he missed an opportunity that meant he just had to create one himself!
The news said that had been an increase of mutated cultivation beasts that went out of control nearby and that mercenaries could join the extermination operation handled by the Zither Sect.
There was also other news regarding royal and imperial clans of the middle regions along with which sects recruited these times of the year, Yun Jhin skimmed trough all of the information before he destroyed the jade slip and burned the map, he didn't need them anymore as he memorized everything.
Then the food came and Yun Jhin enjoyed himself a little bit, even though people at his cultivation base didn't need to eat food as they could live by breathing ki. From the Ki cultivating stage and above bodily needs ceased to exist, meaning you didn't need to eat drink or defecate.
But that didn't mean people would stop eating and drinking, for them, food was merely eaten for enjoyment, Yun Jhin was a big gourmet in his previous life as he ate countless rare animals and humans with different constitutions, of course, some of them weren't eaten for taste.
After finishing his food Yun Jhin got up from his table and left the restaurant, he visited some other places inside the city such as the herbal store and the auction house, to break through further in his cultivation he needed to either massacre a lot of people, which he couldn't do yet as there should be peak 9th stage King realm experts in the middle continents.
Or find rare herbs that he could concoct into pills, or by an accumulation of eating a lot of pills, accumulation was the longest type of cultivation that Yun Jhin didn't enjoy at all, he was always a man of action that wanted the best and fastest way to reach immortality, however, he realized in his countless lives that slow and steady wasn't wrong as well.
While Yun Jhin was visiting the city and buying herbs, the grand elder of the border sect came back to the sect and met with the voluptuous woman from before, he kneeled to her and said:
"I have failed the Zither Sect, young lady please punish me!"
The woman frowned as he looked at the grand elder and said:
"You haven't found anything? Anything at all?"
The grand elder remembered the peculiar meeting with the draconic expert at the mountain and narrated it to the woman, the woman frowned as he listened to the man's story, and then she said:
"I thought you were a smart man Grand elder Mu Gong, the draconic expert should have been the dragon caterpillar! He should have escaped from the Long Empire in fear of their backer from the middle regions!"
The man looked at her with a questioning gaze as he said:
"But your excellency, you should know that the Long Empire didn't have any backers..."
The woman frowned as he looked at him and said:
"I wondered if your cultivation base was the only reason you became a great elder in our sect and your words right now made me realize that it was."
Mu Gong coughed awkwardly as he waited for the woman to tell him what she meant by that:
"You see, while I do know that they don't have a backer how would the dragon caterpillar know? Just use your damn small brain that's filled with muscles and poisonous incantations you damn fool!"
The man scratched the back of his head as he looked at her and said:
"Suo'er you should know that your uncle isn't the tactical type."
The woman now identified as Suo shook her head as she said:
"Actually it's my fault that I sent you, whatever, he should have escaped by now and entered the middle regions, we can't find him anymore, he might even have a backer and it would be dumb for us to make an enemy out of him."
Suo shook her head as she waved her hands and made the grand elder leave her alone. She looked down at a jade scroll as she thought:
"A dragon caterpillar heart should be able to save father, even though it wouldn't be as effective as a dragon heart, we could never get a dragon heart..."
Killing dragons was strictly forbidden on the azure dragon planet, anyone who killed a dragon would get marked with a curse from the Dragon Emperor and had his whole bloodline, sect, and friends annihilated!
However, mixed-bloods didn't have the protection of the Dragon Emperor, the draconic monarch didn't care at all about the offsprings of the dragons that weren't pure-blooded, of course, most humans still feared of killing anything with dragon blood.
But some bold humans killed a mixed-blood once secretly and found out they didn't get cursed so, from time to time traveling mixed-bloods would disappear.
In the end, draconic organs, scales, claws and everything from a member of the draconic race was valuable to humans, they could create weapons armors pills and other things with their bodies, they might even derivate new techniques from their bones and breakthrough their cultivation bottlenecks, even life-saving medicine could be created with dragon hearts.
***
Yun Jhin left the city as he flew further inside the middle continents, there he found a gigantic forest that was called "Giants Forest" it was a relatively simple-looking forest if you ignored the trees that were thousands of meters long, it was a forest that was inhabited by the giant tribe.
Yun Jhin went to this forest for one reason, giants had way more ki in their flesh and blood and they were scorned by both humans and dragons, their gigantic stature made the dragons think that they were challenged and they were feared by the humans due to the same thing.
Yun Jhin knew that even though he couldn't attack humans and dragons, he could still attack and devour the tribes that were hated by both parties. While they thought he would do them a favor, in the end they would become his food as well.
Yun Jhin slowly flew down in the forest as he concealed himself using his stealth technique, the higher the cultivation base, the better the stealth technique became, now at the 5th stage of the ki cultivating realm, he could erase both his presence and become transparent as well to the point no one could see through him.
He reined in his aura as he made his way through the forest, he made sure to be in his humanoid form, the giants were scared of the dragons but they would unleash their hatred on the humans if they found out some of their tribesmen were killed by them.
Yun Jhin wanted to do the same thing as before with the Heavenly Turtle sect and the Long Empire, he wanted to be the fisherman who benefited by taking care of both sides!
He masqueraded as a human as he invaded the giant's living place, he ran quickly in the forest as he tried to find a giant village.
The giant's villages weren't hard to find in the first hours of searching Yun Jhin found atleast 3, but most of them had chieftains with cultivations at the King Realm and above so he wouldn't be able to attack them without preparations.
The dragon caterpillar ran and used his soul willpower as well to scan around the Giant's forest to find a run-down village that he could attack. He went back and forth into the forest as he finally found one at the northern borders.
What he found there made his mouth curve up, there were quite a few giants in the village, around 100,000. But most of them were starved so much that only skin and bones remained of them, unlike humans giants still needed to eat until the King Realm, those at the ki cultivating realm needed to eat less but they still had to eat.
Surprisingly most of the giants were at the ki cultivating realm but there was no one at the King realm, there were a few 9th stage ones here and there but there was no sight of King realm experts.
Yun Jhin laughed to himself as he looked at the village, this was a perfect prime target!
Even the smallest giant was over 10 meters tall, his gut would be overflowing with ki flesh and blood after he ate 100,000 giants!
In the village, children of various ages were surrounding an old giant that was 20 meters tall, the children were around 6-8 meters tall, most of them looked malnourished, and those that didn't look like that were feeling like they could fall down at any moment due to starving.
A giant girl looked at the elder as she said:
"Grandpa, why do the other tribes hate us?"
The man sighed as he looked at his granddaughter then at the other children, he opened his mouth to tell a story...

chapters.title: Chapter 48: The giant tribe
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin kept his breathing steady as he disappeared from his spot and approached the giant gathering, he kept himself well hidden as his aura disappeared as well, he waited for the opportune time to strike!
While he waited the old giant started to tell his tale:
"Ah you see children, our village wasn't marginalized since the start, one of our women was kidnapped by a dragon and gave birth to his child, unfortunately, the other tribes didn't like that so we were thrown here."
The old man started the story and ended it quickly as well, he sighed as he looked at the children who didn't understand his story much, after all, they weren't that old, the old man started to explain the story in a better fashion so the children could understand better.
He was one of the older men of the tribe who were supposed to take care of the children, but he was one of the most awkward ones, the children found him funny.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he kept his soul willpower on the older giant as he was the strongest out of the bunch and thought about the characteristics of the giants.
Giants were loved by nature and their bodies were harder and stronger according to their height, the bigger they were the stronger, but this affected their speed by a lot, they also had the same vital points as humans as their body structure was the same besides being way taller than humans.
They were proficient in the earth and water techniques as most of them were born wielding these elements, most of the time cultivators were born with a specific element in their bodies, those cultivators would have a higher attack power compared to those who were born element-less.
However that didn't mean element-less people were weaker, Yun Jhin himself has always been born element-less!
Elements were tied to the soul and personality, not the body, however, souls tended to change as they reincarnated, memories wiped away and new ones coming, Yun Jhin was a different type of soul, not many could reincarnate for so many times and keep their memories intact in a backlog that they could access if lucky.
Giants were inherently loved by nature so their elemental powers were above humans and only the elven and dwarfen race could rival the intensity of their power.
While people tended to be born to certain elements, Yun Jhin thought these people were weaklings, being element-less was the best as he could switch between elements as he liked!
Due to his ki having no former elemental attribute he could transform it into whatever attribute he wanted using his memories and techniques he learned in his previous life, technically speaking every element-less person could do this, but the amount of training and techniques they needed to learn to do this was astronomical!
Only Yun Jhin was able to do this due to his former life memories combined with his meticulous control coming from his 9th stage God Realm soul, that even though was injured it was still way stronger than people in the same realm as him.
The giant elder finished his explanation as he looked at the children, but most of them weren't listening or playing around, even though they were poor and malnourished they tried their best to enjoy their lives.
The elder giant didn't get angry as he smiled at the children, he felt that even though their village was in precarious situations they could pull through in the future!
The moment the elder smiled a wind sword immediately flashed towards his throat, the elder was at his weakest as he thought about his future and looked at the children, even though he was at the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm he was weakened and distracted!
The elder fell in a gigantic pool of blood as the children shrieked in fear and ran away, the other giants were alarmed as they ran towards the dead elder. Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the giants, as they were a race loved by nature he couldn't use formations against them, after all, formations used nature to the cultivator's advantage. If he used formations the giants might just break through them with ease.
However, formations weren't the only things he was good at!
Yun Jhin opened his mouth as he spat out a purple fog, this was a poisonous pill that he cultivated using his inner draconic energies and highly poisonous plants. Giants tended to not lose ki at all after death and the ki in their bodies could last for hundreds of years before it dissipated. As they were loved by nature, nature would find it hard to decompose their bodies and destroy their darlings.
Yun Jhin smiled as he saw the giants fall to the ground, this was a paralyzing poison and not a deadly one, what was deadly here was Yun Jhin.
He slowly made his way to the downed giants and started to rip into them with gusto, eating them alive was the best way to gain the most amount of nutrients from their flesh blood, and ki!
The giants were paralyzed but you could see the anguish and pain in their eyes!
Even though 100,000 giants lived in the village, the village grounds were huge and it would take them quite some time before more would come, he would use the same strategy and eat the whole giant village!
The giant children wanted to shriek but they couldn't, a cloaked small being was digging in their grandfather's body as it ate it like a ravenous beast which hadn't eaten in months, even though they were starved and emaciated, they still had a lot of flesh and blood, the quality was low but the quantity was high!
Yun Jhin finished the elder's body in about 3 minutes before he moved on to the other adults, the sickly sound of blood being drunk and bones crunching entered the young giant children heads, tears started to pour out of their eyes as they stood in the same paralyzed position as before. Yun Jhin looked at the children as he made a motion with his hands indicating that he would come for them after he finished the others.
The children wanted to sob but they couldn't they wanted to cry more but they couldn't, their paralyzed bodies made their minds explode, they were going insane, they even wanted to laugh right now but they just couldn't!
Yun Jhin chuckled a bit as he looked at the changing facial expressions of the children and he thought to himself:
"Despair induced targets taste the sweetest, especially the children."
Yun Jhin continued to feast upon the corpses of the downed giants and after an hour of nonstop extremely quick eating he finally finished all of the adult's bodies, his body was bloated and huge now, but after he burped his body turned to normal proportions.
The paralyzation effect started to wear off as the children stumbled and tried to back off from Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin's mouth could be seen through the edge of the hood, big blood stains stained his lips and teeth as he gave them a big smile, just like a wolf when seeing a sheep.
The children cried or laughed as they shivered and hugged each other, there wasn't much time Yun Jhin thought as he could feel the other giants rush towards the village, he killed and ate almost 500 giants and on the way came more than 1500!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he suddenly disappeared from the children's view and appeared behind them, his jaw unhinged to the maximum as his head increased in size and he gulped down on all of the children in an instant!
He turned transparent as he hid inside a nearby ravaged house of a giant and waited in silence.
The other giants ran in the border part of the village as they shouted:
"Ghulu, Parto, Sadko?"
These were the names of the three strongest giants with the cultivation at the level of the 9th stage.
They looked around but all could they see were disheveled bloody clothes on the ground and huge bloodstains, there was even a huge blood pool on the ground where the children were usually playing and learning!
The giants all frowned in unison as they looked around, Yun Jhin's attack was fast accurate and he didn't give them any clues as he ate the bodies.
Yun Jhin's ki was overflowing as he quickly used the nutrients and extra ki from eating the bodies in stabilizing his body and paving a way to break through to the 6th stage of the ki cultivating realm.
As long as he ate the whole village he would be almost there!
The giants inspected the bloodstains and the quickly drying blood pool, the captain of the squad frowned as he looked around and said:
"This isn't right, even though the other tribes hate us, nature strictly forbids an inter tribe genocide."
Nature loved the giants so much that it made them unable to kill each other, if they did the aggressors would be the ones to follow the dead ones as they would explode into pieces of gore!
The captain frowned even further as he looked around again and said:
"There is no flesh or gore, even if there would have been a suicidal squad they would have left something behind..."
Yun Jhin smirked as he looked at the man, he blew another cloud of poison towards them immediately paralyzing them.
Yun Jhin walked forward out of the house as he directly went to chomp on another body when the giant captain made a sudden motion with his hand trying to capture him while saying:
"A crafty human!"
It seemed the giant was a rare breed who was born with poison resistance, Yun Jhin laughed as he looked at him, even though he was born with poison resistance it was a very low one, he could barely stand straight before him!
And he wasn't even a peak expert at the 9th stage, he was the 7th to 8th stage!
Yun Jhin created another wind sword that he grasped with his hand as he ran upwards the giant body and dodged the man's attempts to swat him away, he had a huge speed advantage, the giants were innately slow combined with the paralyzing poison in his nervous system that slowed him even further he couldn't catch Yun Jhin even if he let him!
Yun Jhin's eyes spun as the giant tried to throw him away by shaking his body like a dog after he took a bath, but Yun Jhin grabbed on his thick skin as he threw himself at the giant's eyes and impaled both of them as he created another wind sword and threw both in the man's eyes!
The giant cried in anguish as he had been blinded, he tried to bite Yun Jhin as he inclined his head to him, but Yun Jhin fell towards his neck and created another wind sword shooting it in the man's neck creating a big hole in it and killing him instantly!
Yun Jhin jumped down from the body as he started eating, while giants had harder skin bones and organs compared to any other race, Yun Jhin's teeth were enhanced a great deal after he evolved to the peak dragon caterpillar form, even though he couldn't bite through 4th stage or above King Realm bodies yet, he could through the 3rd stage and below, but that was only if they didn't protect themselves with their inner ki.
While Yun Jhin was feasting, a gigantic half-human half-dragon woman was flying towards the village our dragon caterpillar was raiding.
She wasn't that beautiful as she had the head of a dragon and the body of a giant, however her body was quite sensual to look at, she was 40 meters tall and she wore a red imperial armor with dragons painted on it, it looked like she was an army general from her armor.
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt some power at the 4th King Realm or above approaching the village, he had his soul willpower out at all times and he could feel the unleashed ki of the 4th King Realm expert assaulting his senses.
He couldn't finish the other bodies or he would be caught red-handed!
He left an item that would lead the giants to think that a human did all of this as he ran away from the village at a quick speed.
The moment he left the village border was the moment the woman with a dragon head entered and saw the massacre!
Some giants were still alive and only paralyzed as Yun Jhin couldn't finish them, the dragon-headed woman quickly came and helped them up as she still felt a life force from them and expunged the poison out of their bodies.
The men coughed out black blood as they looked at their comrades and tears dripped from their eyes, they looked at the woman and said:
"Susu you came back... but your grandfather and the others... you see..."
The men were both sad and fearful at the same time, sad for what happened and fearful of the woman that came back!
The woman was the granddaughter of the grand elder that Yun Jhin killed first.
She looked around as she finally spotted the item that Yun Jhin threw down, it was a coat of arms that Yun Jhin copied when he looked at the sect symbols on the map, it seemed to be from the Zither sect!
The woman frowned as some gigantic tears fell from her eyes, she looked down at her downed brethren, some of them were only halves as they were eaten in a hurry by Yun Jhin.
She shouted to the heavens:
"I SWEAR I WILL DESTROY WHOEVER DID THIS, I SWEAR ON MY MOTHER'S AND FATHER'S BLOODLINE!"
A draconic cry came from her head as a giant's howl came from her body, blood beads were extracted from her pore that fell and incinerated all of the half-eaten dead bodies to nothing.
She gritted her teeth as she looked towards the direction of the forest where Yun Jhin ran, she could feel some lingering aura but it was dispersing so quickly she couldn't track it, but she made sure to remember it!
Yun Jhin looked behind him as he sweated internally, the being he felt had a special crossed bloodline just like him and she had a way higher cultivation base than him, it would have been suicide to remain there!
From what he felt it was a half-dragon and half-giant, that meant he couldn't use formations against him/her in the future!
Things would get tricky if the being back there found he was the one who massacred the giants, fortunately, he left the symbol of the Zither sect there, Yun Jhin was playing the fisherman game again!

chapters.title: Chapter 49: The fisherman looks at them fight
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked behind him as he didn't sense that King Realm expert anymore and he sighed while thinking:
"If I was caught I could have been a goner there."
Yun Jhin feared death to the point that it became an obsession, this was why he always made plans and fought secretly, he also had a flair for theatrics, he liked to spew nonsense to muddle his opponent's thoughts and make them easier to kill.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked behind, he could feel a strong curse trying to approach his body and enter his soul, it seemed the King Realm expert cursed him, he easily deflected the curse and threw it away from his soul, he grasped the curse energy in his hands as he thought where he could send it.
Yun Jhin remembered about that one elder who took some of his poisonous plants and made a mental note of his ki signature, then with the precision of an experienced surgeon he injected a mimicked ki signature into the curse energy and threw it away, he watched it fly away as he chuckled to himself:
"Ok hook bait and switch, let's see who will act first."
The curse energy flew at high speeds as it went by cities, forests, lakes, and finally reached the Zither sect grounds, there it went inside a green colored pavilion and impacted the Grand elder's forehead!
A muffled boom escaped the man's head as he coughed a mouthful of blood and he shrieked:
"A draconic expert, no a giant expert, no both! A curse from both!"
The shout of the man alarmed the voluptuous woman from before, the grand elder was the brother of the sect master and her uncle, she lived with her uncle because her father became 'gravely ill' after he offended a draconic expert.
The woman frowned as she ran towards her uncle, Suo watched as her uncle shook like he had a seizure, blood appeared to pour out of all of his seven apertures, after 20 minutes of shaking he finally stopped as he got up from the ground and said:
"This damn... I'm not sure why he would send a curse to me, I haven't offended anyone from the dragon and giant race!"
He frowned as he felt the curse that took place in his soul, it was tracking his location as well!
The man frowned as he left the pavilion and Suo just stood there with her mouth agape, the situation in the sect was bad enough with their sect master out of the picture but if one of their elders fell as well, things wouldn't be that pretty, after all, they had quite a lot of competition.
The giant woman dragon kowtowed to a makeshift grave, on the grave was printed the picture of the old giant that Yun Jhin killed, she kowtowed three more times before she got up from kneeling position and muttered to herself:
"I swear I will find your killer and avenge you, grandfather!"
She looked down at her hands that were clenched extremely hard, blood dripped down from her palms hitting the ground and the makeshift grave.
The survivors that she saved from the poison stood behind her with their heads down as they sang a song that the giants usually sang during their high ranking funerals.
The woman smiled as she heard the song, atleast, even though she doomed her family and closed ones to live at the border of the forest and be hated by anyone she could still mend things over as long as she became strong enough!
The woman walked away as she looked back one more time to the grave, her eyes narrowed as the curse energy finally hit home and she frowned:
"He made such a long-distance so fast? He must be atleast as strong as me!"
She looked at the survivors and gave them orders:
"Go back and inform the chieftain that I came back from the upper continent, tell him about my cultivation, and that I will give him a visit in 2 days!"
The man stuttered as he was scared of her:
"Mijil.. you see, we were banished to ever get near the main tribe..."
The giant draconic woman known as Mijil furrowed her brows as she looked in the horizon at the location of the main tribe and said:
"It seems I will have to go and visit sooner, you wait here, I will get some justice for you and my grandfather, first from the tribe and then from his killer and his sect!"
The woman grew wings behind her back as she flew at high speeds further into the forest, after a short while she entered the location of the main tribe, the strongest and the most prideful tribe of giants.
She didn't do anything as her aura made the guards at the front of the village kneel, she easily entered and her aura and presence alerted the whole village, the main village, unlike the weak border one, had many King Realm experts and most of the villagers were at the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm, however, there was no peak King realm.
The woman walked forward as giants that wore heavy armor on their bodies pointed their spears and swords at her, but she easily deflected them using her wings as a shield and walked forward, until she stopped at the front of a giant pavilion.
The giant pavilion opened and out of it came a giant that was a little taller than her standing at 60 meters or so.
The giant man frowned as he looked at her and said:
"My niece, what do I owe the pleasure of this visit?"
The draconic giant woman laughed as her face scrunched up and said:
"You shouldn't know as you don't care at all about the border tribes, but some of our people were massacred by humans!"
The man frowned as he didn't feel she was lying but he countered:
"How could humans kill even the weakest of our race? You know they fear us and their battle power is nothing to write about."
The woman frowned as she shook her head and said:
"It doesn't matter the presence there felt human and he even dropped his sect identification, I want you to help me take revenge for grandfather's death!"
The man frowned as Mijil threw him a coat of arms that had the sect symbol on it, he shook his head as he threw it back and said:
"Why should I help an exile like yourself?"
The woman gave out a chilling smile as she took something out of the pocket of her inner armor, a token in the form of a draconic head that exuded intense imperial ki buffeted the man's face, the giant's face turned green as he looked at the token and asked:
"You are mixed blood, how could you? Don't tell me you won that tournament?"
Mijil laughed and that was the only response the giant got, his thick brows furrowed as his bald head shined in the sun and he said:
"Ok I will help you, send word for the fighters and hunters of the tribe to come back, we will leave some guards behind to protect the civilians, we don't need too many people, I know this sect, their sect master is bed-ridden and their patriarch is in secluded cultivation, trying to break through and extend his lifespan."
A war camp was immediately created in the village, Mijil and the chieftain talked about the plan and then headed out along with the soldiers and hunters of the tribe...
Yun Jhin stopped in a nearby city as he waited for news, he went to an assassin guild and waited there for a while before a black-garbed woman came forward with a jade slip with information.
Yun Jhin paid her and read the jade slip, his lips turned upwards as he crushed the jade slip into pieces and he muttered:
"Already looking for? Very good."
The jade slip also had the exact location of the Zither sect, even though the map he bought before showed where they were supposed to be it wasn't accurate, after all, he bought it from a street stall and not the assassin guild.
Yun Jhin left the building as he started to fly into the direction of the Zither sect, he flew there at his quickest speed, and then he hid nearby as he waited for the army of the giants to attack the sect!
After one day of waiting a small army of giants could be seen running towards the sect gates, most of them were around the 1st stage of the King realm, and the only different ones were the chieftain and his niece Mijil. He was at the 6th stage and she was at the 4th stage.
Yun Jhin watched as Mijil looked at the sect gates with pure anger in her eyes, a deep red aura engulfed her body as fire spewed out of her draconic head incinerating the gates, a shriek could be heard as the guards that stood near the gates were burned alive turning into dust!
A shriek like alarm started to sound in the whole sect, the voluptuous woman Suo walked outside her pavilion and narrowed her eyes when she saw all of the giants attacking.
Her uncle didn't leave her father's headquarters for a long while already and she wasn't sure what he was doing, she needed to defend along with the Elder of medicine and Elder of martial discipline!
The two elders in question appeared in front of her both bowing as they said:
"Sect lady Suo, what should we do?"
Suo frowned as she looked at the giants and said:
"Formations won't work on them, elemental techniques won't work on the giant woman because of her draconic bloodline, but on the other giants they should be of great use, Elder of martial disciple I want you to handle the woman while I and the elder of medicine will take care of the chieftain of the giants, It seemed the curse that uncle was afflicted with was from that woman."
Suo frowned as she looked at Mijil and said loudly:
"I think there is a misunderstanding between us!"
Mijil looked at Suo and shook her head as she said:
"There is no misunderstanding, a member of your sect massacred my grandfather and relatives! My curse went directly to him as I used the energy he left behind to shoot it at him!"
Suo brows furrowed deeply as she heard what the other woman said, this curse technique couldn't be deflected or neutralized unless the other party had higher knowledge and mastery in curses. But her uncle was meditating in the green pavilion most of the time, she knew that because she did the same and she never felt his aura leaving it unless she told him to!
Suo shouted:
"There must be a misunderstanding! Please wait for my uncle to explain."
Mijil shook her head as she waved her hand and shouted:
"Kill to the last man woman, dog, and pig! LEAVE NONE ALIVE!"
Suo frowned as she and the Elder of medicine started to tangle with Mijil, while the Elder of martial disciple jumped directly to fight with the chieftain, it looked quite funny, as seemingly two ants tried to bite a human.
Yun Jhin observed the fight with calculative eyes, whenever the two parties showed weak spots he would throw around some hidden attacks, he wasn't idle while he waited for the giants to come, he created formations using the ones the Zither sect created. Even though formations wouldn't be useful on the giants, there was still the afterthought of the sect winning, if the sect won they would do so at quite the terrible price.
And when they would celebrate and cry in happiness that everything was over, Yun Jhin would jump in and annihilate them using their own modified formations!

chapters.title: Chapter 50: As they fight
chapters.content:
Suo, the elder of medicine and Mijil started fighting, while the Elder of martial disciple could hardly defend against the giant chieftain attacks, his height made him easy to dodge but if even one hit from him made home with the Elder of the martial disciple he would become a meat pancake.
Suo and the elder of medicine tried their best to fight Mijil but they were easily overwhelmed by the hybrid, even though they were both at the King Realm their strengths were insufficient to deal with such an advanced opponent.
Yun Jhin was rubbing his hands like a merchant ready to strike a huge deal as he watched them fight, he knew that they would turn desperate and put their lives on the line soon enough, injuring both sides, hopefully fatally.
