Mijil threw her fists around as quickly as she could but due to her big size, her fists were easily telegraphed by the duo from the Zither sect. The same could be said about the high chieftain attacks, the Zither sect focused on speed and long-range attacks so they easily dodged most of the attacks, their disciples fought it out with the hunters and troops of the giants.
However the disciples weren't as strong or lucky as the upper echelons and most of them were getting crushed and eaten by the giants, Suo's heart bleeds as she looked at the disciples, they were basically family, in a sect like hers she would look out for all of her juniors, seeing them die like this cut her heart open.
Mijil grew angered with their dodging as she engulfed herself in a deep red aura, she started to spew flames everywhere engulfing the buildings and the alive disciples that weren't fast enough to dodge her berserk attack.
Suo failed to dodge in time as her left part of the face got singed and burned disfiguring her, she clutched her face as she screamed from the extreme pain of having her face burned.
A distinct blue aura appeared around her as she took out a Zither from her spatial bag and started playing, the sound from the Zither traveled along attacking the eardrums of everyone besides her allies, she was a prodigy of the Zither as she was supposed to be the next sect mistress.
The Zither made the giant troops drop down like dead flies, blood coming out of their ears, eyes, and noses.
Mijil used ki to protect her ears but the sound waves still made her unbalanced, the moment her balance faltered, the medicine elder jumped on her shoulder leaving behind a big cloud of dust that hid Suo's form.
The medicine elder spewed a cloud of deadly poison that he infused with his ki coagulating it and trapping Mijil's head.
However Mijil opened her mouth and blew out another wave of fire destroying the hardened cloud of poison, she grabbed the man from her shoulder and crushed him into meat paste, then she opened her mouth and swallowed!
She knew that her tribemates and her grandfather were eaten as well so she just returned the favor!
Suo shouted as the dust disappeared, behind her an illusory giant Zither appeared, it's strings started to move as a deadly song engulfed the whole battlefield, 50% of the giant troops fell, most of the disciples of the Zither sect were already dead but the ones that survived felt their wounds closing up and their morale increased, Suo shouted towards the survivors:
"RUN AWAY!"
The disciples wanted to fight for their sect but realized there was no way they could win here so they ran away, unfortunately for them they ran inside the formation that Yun Jhin planted, they became a cloud of gore that was absorbed by Yun Jhin.
Suo's eyes widened as she saw what happened to the disciples, she looked around with critical eyes but she couldn't see or sense who did that.
Mijil frowned as she looked around as well, she realized that she might have been fooled here!
No one from her people had acted to kill these running disciples, most of them couldn't make it in time or were dead, the Elder of martial discipline was still holding her uncle down as well.
Well holding down was an overstatement, he just made it so he couldn't attack the others by annoying him incessantly.
Mijil frowned as she looked at Suo, Suo's eyes met with Mijil's and they seemingly realized at the same time that they were fooled!
Yun Jhin frowned as he saw Mijil stop her troops, she started to look around with Suo's help trying to identify what happened, Yun Jhin chuckled as he saw them search in unison, women's intuition was quite frightening.
But he could care less about that, he took control of a body of a downed giant and made it attack Suo!
Suo used her illusory Zither to destroy the giant's body into pieces, Mijil frowned deeply at Suo's actions, it seemed they were ready to fight again, but then Mijil smiled as she shouted:
"NICE TRY, BUT WE KNOW YOU DID THAT, SHOW YOURSELF, YOU COWARD!"
Yun Jhin knew he made a mistake there, but he thought they wouldn't realize because of the intense fighting, it seemed the chieftain and the elder of martial discipline stopped fighting as well. Yun Jhin looked around at the fighting and kept himself hidden as best as he could.
They could continue thinking that there was someone who made them fight, but if they couldn't find anything they would have to go back to fighting!
They put too much on the plate here, both sides had disastrous loses and when Suo's uncle came back he would surely come to attack and not negotiate!
They all started to search around, but their soul willpower, and their eyes couldn't tell them anything, Mijil even used a special technique that turned her eyes a deep black color and looked around for Yun Jhin but she couldn't find anything.
Suddenly Suo used her Zither to create a non-lethal sound wave that traveled around the place, Yun Jhin frowned as he dodged the sound wave, this was the one weakness that his stealth technique had at his current level, he could mitigate it when he would reach the King Realm and make himself be able to slip in and out of the shadow realm.
The shadow realm was a special plane of existence that those who trained in this technique could access, with the connection in the shadow realm he could also create shadow soldiers that would have 100% of his physical attributes, but depending on the ki he pumped into them they couldn't last much time.
His stealth technique also had offensive techniques in it but they would appear at the later cultivation realms.
Yun Jhin continued to dodge the sound waves, the only thing his technique couldn't currently erase was his life force, if the sound wave hit him and revealed his life force, the theory of the two women could be proven correct and they would stop fighting and attack him!
Yun Jhin never thought that Mijil would be so observant, after all, she was doing her best to control her ki to protect her ears and body from Suo's Zither, technically speaking she shouldn't have even given a damn if the disciples of the Zither sect suddenly died.
While Yun Jhin was dodging the sound waves that threatened to reveal his position, Mijil frowned deeply as she looked at Suo and thought that maybe she was wrong, Suo did look extremely relieved when she put a stop to their attack but what if it was all an act?
Her hatred from before started to cloud her reasoning, she wanted to quickly kill her grandfather's murderer and put an end to things, after all, she still had to go back to the upper regions and return to the imperial dragon clan for her training, even though she loved her family she was still selfish, all cultivators were.
Suo eyed Mijil while she used the illusory Zither behind her to continuously discharge sound waves and try to find the true culprit, while the duo watched each other's actions with a critical eye, Yun Jhin made sure to get in a blind spot where the sound waves wouldn't get to him and observe what happened on the battlefield.
He sent his soul will near Mijil's and observed her mental state, a grin appeared on Yun Jhin's face as he said to himself:
"Feeling a little bit of hatred don't we here?"
Yun Jhin created a needle with his soul willpower that he immediately injected into her, this was a soul that would enhance the owner's most prominent negative emotions by 100%.
Mijil's eyes turned slack for a moment before darkness started to invade her mind and eat at her reasoning:
"Mijil, I know you are scared but you must do this for our tribe."
Scenes from the past started to appear in her mind, her grandfather that looked healthy and stalwart patted her shoulders as he smiled at her and said:
"Make sure you get to the upper continents and meet your father, even though he didn't take you with him back then, he should be able to see that you are truly talented, after all, your head morphed into a dragon's!"
Mijil clutched her new horns and felt the huge difference in her head structure, she smiled at her grandfather as best as she could and said:
"Yes grandfather, I will change the fate of our tribe!"
She looked back at her grandfather's frame that disappeared, she didn't look back only forward...
When she came back her grandfather didn't exist anymore, not even his bones she couldn't burry anything, she couldn't grieve for anyone, her mother died when she gave birth to her and her brother the current chieftain dragged her and his father out of the main tribe and threw them out, he also forbid them from ever coming back and banished them to the border village...
Mijil heart started to beat faster and faster as she recalled those scenes, her consciousness started to blank as her eyes turned a deep vengeful dark color, only her dark sclera remained as her pupils disappeared.
She growled as her muscles started to pump up and down, her body shook, the veins across her body popped and cracked as they became visible, her canine teeth elongated, she grew 5 more meters as a deep dark aura engulfed her body, her previous red aura morphed into something evil.
Yun Jhin laughed as he clapped and said:
"Very good, such a huge amount of hatred, bottled up in such a tiny and fragile soul... go and rampage for your grandfather and mother's sake little Mijil, make sure you take care of your uncle as well!"
Yun Jhin saw the same images as her as he kept his soul willpower for a little more while near hers and know how she was treated and what happened back then, he even modified some of the memories a bit to increase her hatred and make sure she went berserk.
Her cultivation base forcefully broke through to the 5th stage of the King Realm as her bodily changes finally finished, her dark eyes glowed with the same peculiar light as she looked at Suo and her relatively slow speed from before wasn't found at all!
She clutched Suo in her hand as the illusory Zither behind her started to waver, Suo knew that something was wrong with Mijil she used her soundwaves to try and wake her up from her trance but nothing happened!
Her eyes glowered the same black as before as her muscles shook, but some words could be heard coming from her gritted teeth:
"Re.. ve... n...g...e... f... o... r... t..r..u...e... f....a....m...i...l...y..."
She clutched Suo in her hand, Suo couldn't do anything besides struggle, and with an easy tight closing of her hand, Suo became a rain of gore that engulfed the ground, Yun Jhin made sure to use the formations to take her flesh and blood to him, it couldn't be wasted!
The elder of medicine and martial discipline tried to take Suo back but they failed spectacularly as they weren't fast enough, they both tried to attack the new Mijil but both of them became prisoners in her hands.
Suddenly out of the biggest pavilion that still stood up in the sect grounds came a voice:
"MY NIECE, AND MY SECT YOU WILL PAY FOR WHAT YOU HAVE DONE, YOU FREAK OF NATURE!"
The grand elder and Suo's uncle finally got rid of the curse from Mijil, but he came way too late, his sect was in ruins, and his disciples and family dead.
The man had red eyes as he looked around, his muscles tightened as his gown exploded, showing his well-sculpted muscles, a deep blue aura engulfed him, the aura had streaks of electricity inside it, his cultivation broke through to the 6th stage of the King Realm as blood started to pour out of his nose and ears.
He softly said:
"I will defend the sect master and patriarch, I will meet you soon Suo, as long as they stay alive they can recreate the glory days of the Zither sect!"
He threw himself at supersonic speeds towards Mijil, but he missed one factor!
The chieftain jumped in front of his niece with a big smile on his face as he intercepted the small human, he caught him in his hands as he laughed seeing victory in the horizon, but then he looked down at his chest seeing a scaled arm sticking out of it.
He looked behind him to see his niece looking at him with her hatred filled dark eyes, a soft voice entered her ears:
"Y...o...u a...r...e..n..t f...a.m...i...l..y."
This was how the main chieftain of the giants found himself in dangerous life and death situation, unfortunately for him, he wouldn't be able to escape.
Yun Jhin was still looming around ready to strike!

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Drinking in victory,weeping in defeat
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked at Mijil as she inserted her other arm inside her uncle's chest and with a great heave ripped him in two parts!
Organs and a fountain of blood exploded on the battlefield, Mijil eyes remained dark as her face turned to the grand elder, the elder in question was clutching his chest as he got up from the ground after the chieftain exploded into a rain of gore due to her niece's actions, the grand elder fell in the ruins of the sect combined with the flesh of the giants.
Mijil found him quickly due to his inflated aura, he was using his life force to forcefully keep this state of his on, He disappeared from her senses as the electricity around his body fully engulfed him.
His speed increased by a dozen more times but his veins started to pop due to the forceful increase of speed, blood started to quickly fall from his body as he zipped around Mijil's vision trying to find an opening and attack her.
He didn't know why she would attack her allies but from the look of things she seemed to have gone berserk, if he didn't take this chance he would die for nothing!
He already went past the point of reconciliation as he used a forbidden technique to forcefully increase his cultivation, at the end of the technique he would burst like a balloon and die!
The grand elder muscles squirmed like worms as he continued channeling the forbidden technique, if he couldn't kill her in the next 5 minutes he would have died in vain.
He appeared near her leg as he made a knife-hand hitting directly at the space between her leg and foot, he tried to sever a ligament and incapacitate her walking ability.
Unfortunately for him, a dragon giant skin was very tough and he could only cut the surface, not even reaching the bone. Unknowingly to both of them, the flesh and blood in the surroundings started to wriggle towards a hidden location, Yun Jhin opened his mouth as all of the organs, flesh, and blood of the casualties of the battlefield appeared in front of him.
It was an enormous amount to the point that Yun Jhin couldn't count how many tons of meat there was.
He opened his mouth wider as he started to suck in everything like a vacuum, it would take him quite a long while to finish everything here, but after he finished everything he would have broken through the 6th stage, stabilized his cultivation there and made way to the 7th stage, even though he couldn't break through if he ate Mijil or the grand elder he would surely reach the 7th stage!
The grand elder vomited a mouthful of blood as more veins popped, his eyes turned a deep red as they filled with blood that almost blinded him, his knife-hand was engulfed in lightning as he finally got through the skin and reached a small ligament which he severed.
With his speed he easily jumped backward, evading the giant arm that almost caught him. Mijil roared to the skies as she almost fell, one of her ligaments was severed and she became unbalanced. Finding an opening The grand elder rushed along her arm, reaching her head, his knife-hand size increased as a lightning sword appeared.
He drove his lightning sword towards his blackened eyes, but a sudden howl combined with sound waves made him lose his footing, the sword grazed her eyes and cut her ear off instead of impaling her in the eye.
However, even though the move wasn't fatal it still practically blinded her!
But anything below fatal wasn't something that the grand elder could afford, the man fell weakly as his body started to expand, but before he could hit the ground he was caught by two giant hands, those hands clutched his body and then the body exploded into pieces before the hands could do anything to it.
Mijil howled and roared as she looked at the smear of gore in her hands, it seemed she realized that she couldn't deal the last blow in her mind, even though she was consumed by hatred a semblance of her past self remained, she still thirsted for revenge deep inside.
Yun Jhin came out of hiding as he looked at the giant half-dragon woman, he tsked as he slowly approached her and his soul injected a different type of energy inside her making her wake up.
She looked around with wide eyes and then at her own hands, it seemed she remembered everything that she did.
Her eyes widened as she saw Yun Jhin, she immediately realized that he was the one who was behind everything, she wanted to go and kill him but she stumbled and fell, making the ground shake because of her enormous weight. She looked down at her leg and remembered that the grand elder severed some ligaments.
Yun Jhin looked at her and shook his head as he said:
"Poor thing, do you want to know how your grandfather died?"
Her eyes widened in pure anger as she heard those words, she tried to get up but Yun Jhin shot a bunch of pressured air in the open wound at her leg severing more ligaments and making her howl in pain, the howl was so loud that some people from the nearby city heard it.
Mijil gritted her teeth as she tried to get up from the ground, however, the pain from her leg made her unable to, the adrenaline from her escapade wore off, the same could be said about her hatred induced state, she became the same as before, even her draconic head started to fade away!
After a short while, the draconic head changed to a normal human head, it seemed even though she had a dragon bloodline it wasn't that strong, to simulate it she would constantly need to use her ki, it was impressive she could fight so well and continuously use her ki to keep her appearance.
She was a beautiful woman by Yun Jhin's standards, and his standards were very high, he looked at her and shook his head, maybe if he wasn't of a different race and in a hurry to breakthrough he may have kept her as a slave. Unfortunately for her, he needed her flesh and blood.
He motioned with his hand as he took the bunch of gore from her hand and devoured it, his cultivation base broke through to the 6th stage and started to stabilize itself after he finished his meal in a few seconds.
Mijil couldn't believe what she felt, she was still partially blinded from the elder's attacks but she could practically see with her soul willpower, she felt how Yun Jhin ate the elder's remains and became stronger immediately, what kind of monster was he?
Yun Jhin's techniques were very peculiar because there weren't many evil sects on the four beasts planet, Mijil couldn't have heard about them even if she lived in the upper regions, maybe only people around the Sage realm could realize what techniques Yun Jhin was using.
Yun Jhin looked at Mijil's fearful expression, her ki reserve was empty, she was injured and without power, her leg was crippled and she was also partially blinded, her size made her just a big target.
The patriarch and sect master of the Zither sect seemed to be keeping a blind eye to everything that happened currently, seemingly both of them either encountered cultivation deviation due to anger or they tried their best to solve their hidden injuries.
Yun Jhin could care less about what happened to them, as long as they didn't do anything he would make sure he razed all of the bodies on the battlefield to the ground.
Some giants were still alive, but they were either injured or resting, Yun Jhin ignored them as they couldn't see him anyway.
He walked closer to Mijil, so close that her hand could catch him easily, he even walked on her palm, he was still in his humanoid form so Mijil still thought he was a human his aura was also hidden.
Mijil thought he was taunting her and she was right, Yun Jhin was taunting her by giving her a chance to injure or even kill him!
She tried to clench her hand and turn him into a meat patty, but Yun Jhin three points along her arm as he ran on her body towards her head. Her whole arm became paralyzed and fell to the ground creating a deep crater.
Yun Jhin slowly made his way to her forehead and put his hand on it sending some images inside her soul space, they were the images of him slaughtering her cousins, grandfather, and some other family members that even she couldn't fully recognize anymore.
She started to trash on the ground creating a huge dust cloud, some of the nearby giants tried to approach her but they backed off seeing her condition, they were also scared that they would end like the chieftain so they continued to back off and observe.
Mijil shouted as she clutched her forehead:
"You monster, you evil being, how could you do these things! THEY WERE CHILDREN, OLD AND WEAK PEOPLE!"
Deep hatred dripped off Mijil's words, she was ready to turn Yun Jhin into a piece of gore herself, but she just couldn't her body was over exhausted and her life force was very weak, she could barely move anymore after she struggled for some time.
She gritted her teeth till the blood flowed out of her gums, she even tried to shake Yun Jhin off her forehead and swallow him alive, but Yun Jhin kept a steady footing on her forehead as seemingly nothing could throw him off.
He looked at her big blank eyes and said:
"Do you realize why have I shown you these images?"
How could she realize? All the time she thought that he was mocking her, even though he indeed was mocking her there was another reason he did that.
He opened his mouth and regurgitated a piece of flesh, the aura from that flesh was extremely familiar to Mijil, it was a piece of flesh from her grandfather!
She starting thrashing again, as she seemed to have gained some new energy from an unknown source, but all her thrashing did nothing besides opening her wounds and putting her further near death.
Her angry and vengeful stare was pointed at Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin ignored her gaze as he infused the piece of flesh with his ki, then he dropped it in Mijil's mouth!
Mijil wanted to immediately spit it out but Yun Jhin sealed her mouth!
The small bit of flesh infused with Yun Jhin's ki quickly reached her stomach, there the ki exploded into a supernova that destroyed her stomach and insides.
She vomited a mouthful of blood as her eyes turned scarlet, she became fully crazed as she thrashed around.
Yun Jhin jumped away from her body and watched as ki flames engulfed her body, they were deep purple flames with runic bodies running through them, the flesh from Miji's grandfather combined with his ki and her state of mind created the current situation.
As if her leg wasn't wounded at all she got up from the ground, but she fell to her knees afterward, she tried to get up again but her stomach burst open as a baby dragon that stood at 1,5 meter tall came out of her, the baby dragon was fully purple with big dark horns on his head.
He looked extremely cute at first sight, his deep ruby-colored eyes would make your heart melt, at first sight, he pewed like a baby chick as he looked around.
Suddenly his irises turned into slits as he saw his 'mother' he went directly back to her and opened his maw, fresh blood dripped down his body as he feasted on his mother's body, Yun Jhin clapped as the dragon stopped and flew towards him.
He stood in front of him like a loyal dog as he wagged his small tail, he pewed again and licked Yun Jhin's hand showing that he was friendly. Yun Jhin smiled at the baby dragon and petted his head, the dragon started purring.
Yun Jhin looked around the ruins of the sect and absorbed the remnants of Mijil's body in his mouth, devouring the remaining amounts of energy and ki.
The dragon ate a lot of her body very quickly, only her legs remained intact.
The baby dragon wasn't a normal dragon, Yun Jhin used her extreme hatred combined with the flesh of a relative and his ki to create him, he forcefully extracted her bloodline with the ki supernova that exploded in her stomach, he was a fully blooded artificial dragon!
Because he was created using Yun Jhin's ki he would be the only one who could fully control him, even though he looked like a cute baby on the outside, inside he was a fiendish monster that was on the same level of evilness as Yun Jhin!
The dragon's height started to lower as he became as tall as an average cat and nestled in Yun Jhin's robe.
Yun Jhin scanned the dragon's cultivation base and nodded his head, he was born at the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm, he couldn't go beyond the emperor realm with his artificial body but he would be a good pet to have, Yun Jhin would need to be in two places in the future and needed someone he could trust, that's why he created the little guy.
Yun Jhin made another scan of the battlefield and found that he didn't miss any bodies, then he used his soul willpower to scan the only standing building remaining in the Zither sect and narrowed his eyes.
However, a smile quickly appeared on his face shortly after he finished scanning the building then he said:
"What an interesting affliction, think you two can escape from me?"
Not even the patriarch and the sect master of the Zither sect were safe from Yun Jhin's machinations.

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Infectious disease
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he opened his spiritual senses to feel better, he closed his eyes and used his soul willpower to scan deep into the last remaining building. The building was surrounded with formations that kept it out of dangers way, however, they were no cracked due to the intense fight, and were ready to explode.
Yun Jhin disabled them easily as he walked towards the building and entered it, no one was inside, but Yun Jhin knew that he had to go deeper to find who he wanted.
The baby dragon was nuzzling himself inside Yun Jhin's clothes and from time to time his head would pop out of his cloak and look around with interested eyes.
Yun Jhin let him do as he pleased as he continued to enter deeper into the building, after a while, he found the stairs that led to the underground site of the building, it was like a cellar but not quite so, it was remodeled into a cultivation chamber and a middle-aged man sat cross logged in the middle of a healing formation.
The man's life force indicated that he wasn't that old but his face and body were full of wrinkles, his hair was also half white half black.
The man opened his eyes as he looked at Yun Jhin but didn't say anything, he was sweating black gunk intensely, suddenly he vomited a mouthful of dark blood, Yun Jhin looked as the dark blood started to sizzle and a purple gas appeared, the gas dissipated after some time and the man's face turned paler than it already was, he also gained some new wrinkles.
Yun Jhin got closer to the formation and looked it up and down, he shook his head and said:
"Your formation is quite decent, unfortunately, you won't live more than a few weeks from now, the curse inside you is etched too deeply."
The man's eyes widened but he kept his mouth shut, it seemed if he lost any concentration, the curse would relapse and kill him instantly.
Yun Jhin didn't beat around the bush as he looked the man in the eyes and he said:
"Do you want to live?"
"I know you can't answer, but I will give you a chance to live, however, you will have to be my slave from now on."
The man's eyes showed that he wouldn't ever become someones else's slave, even though his cultivation aura was pretty weak currently, it seemed he was a powerhouse at the 8th King Realm or above, if he wasn't weakened like he was right now, the whole giant army would have ended up defeated by him alone!
Unfortunately for the Zither sect, their patriarch was afflicted with a strange curse that needed a dragon heart to cure, thus they were eliminated...
The sect master knew that all of his sect's members were dead, after all, he observed the whole fight with his soul willpower and knew that it was all Yun Jhin's fault, but if Yun Jhin decided to attack him right now he would be dead, there was nothing he could do currently besides lying down and waiting for death.
He was the reason Suo sent out the grand elder to the Long Empire to find the dragon caterpillar. Even though a dragon caterpillar was a half-dragon, there was still a 50% chance of healing him so they took it. Unfortunately, the grand elder mistook Yun Jhin as a passing dragon royalty and he didn't go through with the plan.
This led to the sect master's current situation, on his death bed, vomiting dark blood, even if he wanted to save his sect he couldn't, his fate was to watch his closed ones die in front of him.
Yun Jhin watched as he man's eyes changed from time to time, he was pondering Yun Jhin's proposal very hard, seemingly he was ready to accept it!
Yun Jhin inserted his soul willpower into the man's consciousness where he was viciously attacked by him, however, he easily backed away from the soul space, even if the man had a stronger soul than what he currently had he couldn't be able to kill Yun Jhin.
The most ineffective attacks against Yun Jhin would be soul ones after he mended his soul back in the catacombs of the Corpse sect it's recovery boosted itself, combined with all of the souls he ate along the way up till now, he could use 1% of his former soul abilities.
Even though 1% seemed insignificant, at his peak Yun Jhin was a God Realm 9th stage expert, with very few equal people to him.
Yun Jhin looked down as the man started to wretch and vomit even more blood, he tried to kill Yun Jhin and absorb his memories thinking he could get the cure that way, but he just hastened his death, he failed and the curse backlash hit him even harder.
Yun Jhin wanted a slave at the 8th stage of the King Realm but it seemed he wouldn't be lucky enough today.
The man started to melt into a pool of meat and blood, a decaying stench immediately filled the room as the formation broke and corroded by itself, Yun Jhin watched pensively, unfortunately, he couldn't eat the man due to his situation, he would have to first cure him and he had no more time.
Due to the sect master's actions, he wouldn't be able to eat him or enslave him, Yun Jhin found it to be a great pity. As the man transformed into a puddle of smelly gore on the ground Yun Jhin bypassed the remnants of the formation and entered deeper.
He walked further inside until he reached a dead end, there he clicked on the wall tiles in a particular way that made them open, it was the password to get to the patriarch's cultivation room, Yun Jhin gained it after he devoured Suo's soul, whoever died in his hands would have the fate of their soul being devoured as well.
Yun Jhin entered the room and looked around, it was full of Zithers of different colors and sizes, inside in the middle of the room stood the patriarch, he looked so old that you would think he was a corpse, his body was emaciated and he had no hair left on his whole body.
His eyes were closed as he stood there, his hunched back trembled from time to time indicating that he was breathing but he didn't have much time left, his weak aura indicated that he was at the 9th stage of the King realm, and the peak of the stage as well!
The man tried to break through the Sage Realm and gain some more longevity. Yun Jhin sympathized with the man, he tried the same thing in his former lives after he reached the peak, he remembered everything like it was yesterday, unfortunately, sometimes hard work didn't give you the results you wanted or needed.
Yun Jhin observed the way he circulated his life force and shook his head, the man wasn't going to live for much either, it seemed he was just like his relative in the other room, his days were numbered and the only thing he could do was watch them go away.
Yun Jhin became a bit nostalgic as he watched the mummified man, then he shook his head and his arm became a sharp weapon that he inserted into the old man's chest, the old man coughed a mouthful of blood and died instantly, Yun Jhin opened his mouth and ate him quickly or else he would have dissipated into dust.
Cultivators that live enough to die of old age transform into dust and return to nature everything that they took from it, that's how new cultivators can be born, that was also why no one truly reached true immortality, God Realm practitioners only reached half immortality of unable to be killed, and that was those who reached the 9th stage, they still aged and died like normal commoners, they just lived longer.
Yun Jhin stabilized himself fully into the 7th stage of the Ki cultivating realm and was even ready to break through into the 8th stage, but he lacked a certain factor, and no it wasn't more energy, after some self-inspection, it seemed his caterpillar body rank wasn't high enough!
He wanted to ask the system what was his caterpillar rank but a notification appeared by itself:
[Dragon Caterpillar (Mature Royalty): Rank 2500/7500, for further breakthroughs Rank 3000 is needed or above.]
To increase the rank of the caterpillar body Yun Jhin needed energy, some did seep into his body but he used most of it towards his cultivation base instead of refining his body, in most of his previous lives he never encountered such a situation so he didn't know how to act.
But now that he knew he needed to find some other nutritional corpses to increase his body's rank, he let some giants run back to the tribe, maybe they would come with reinforcements? But it wasn't likely to happen.
Their main chieftain and their most talented youngster died here, they would be dumb to try and attack again, after all, there was no one here anymore either so they would be just waiting time, they would surely think that the one who orchestrated everything would have already left by now.
Yun Jhin walked by the puddle of gore again as he tried to leave the underground area, but the baby dragon inside his cloak started to sniff around, Yun Jhin looked as the dragon jumped down from his bosom and ate the whole puddle of gore in one big gulp, this was the first time Yun Jhin used such a technique so he wasn't sure how the dragon worked, all he had was the theory he learned.
Yun Jhin watched the little dragon eat the puddle of gore, his cultivation base started to fluctuate as he became very sleepy, it seemed he was ready to break through to the King realm!
Yun Jhin made a mental note to look further into the artificial dragon's behavior and body structure while he slept, he needed to make sure he knew what he had on his hands.
The dragon caterpillar left the buildings then the sect grounds with his baby dragon sleeping neatly in his cloak.
After he made sure the baby dragon slept soundly in the cloak, he grew wings then flew to a nearby city, where he would plan his next move, which sect he would attack or subjugate to gain enough nutrients to break through his body rank.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: A different approach with the same results
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was flying steadily towards the nearby city, but he stopped in a nearby mountain range and entered a naturally created cave.
The cave was pretty spacious so besides putting some formations around it he didn't dig further, he let the baby dragon out of his cloak and observed its body more closely.
The baby dragon's scales had some strange patterns on it but they were very small to the point that Yun Jhin had to enhance his eyesight with ki to see them.
The patterns looked like clouds and waves at the same time, but they were a deep purple color with a sun-like proportion in the middle of them.
The dragon was sleeping soundly as Yun Jhin observed it with his eyes, then he used his soul willpower to directly enter into his consciousness space, his consciousness was currently sleeping so nothing happened when he entered his mind.
Yun Jhin looked around and finally identified his soul body, he looked at it for a while and shook his head he couldn't identify anything from it like this.
He left the dragon's mind space and created a scalpel with his ki, he started operating on him cutting his chest open and looking inside him, the dragon was still sleeping soundly unless his soul was damaged Yun Jhin could patch him right back up, even though his body wasn't immortal such a weak type of injury won't do anything to him.
He looked at his internal organs and realized that they were quite different compared to what the theories said, Yun Jhin couldn't put it in words but he realized the dragon was special, and not in a good way.
As he observed the patterns in which the organs were arranged he realized that they were arranged in a formation, a strange formation per se, he used his formation knowledge to see what it could do and his eyes widened.
The formation was supposed to liberate his soul in the future, this was quite strange considering how he was created. Yun Jhin took a better look at the organs as he poked them with his scalpel which made the young dragon start to thrash around.
His organs started to glow with dark energy that radiated hatred, it was the residual soul willpower of Mijil!
This woman was of dragon descent and she should have known about the peculiarities of an artificial dragon, after all, Yun Jhin got this skill from killing an azure dragon from the evil faction.
It seemed the evil faction was disbanded and the skill was kept by the imperial family then it was shared with every pure dragon. Since a pure dragon was Mijil's father that meant that she got her hands on the technique one way or another.
There was a formation to free the artificial dragon's soul in the scriptures that he read, that's why Yun Jhin recognized the formation rather quickly, it seemed with her last grasp of spiritual power she entered the body of the little dragon while her own body was eaten alive and altered his internal organs into this formation.
Maybe she thought that the dragon would betray Yun Jhin in the future and be his demise, but she severely underestimated Yun Jhin due to her lack of knowledge.
Yun Jhin smirked as he looked at the formation and used his scalpel to rearrange the organs on how they were supposed to be, using the knowledge of the technique he made a different formation using the organs.
A self-destruction one, with one thought of his the dragon, would self destruct and even take out peak King Realm experts after he broke through to the 1st stage of said realm.
He patched up the baby dragon using a ki sewing needle and then he cauterized the wounds, after a short while the wounds started healing by themselves as the ki circulation in the dragon's body restored.
Yun Jhin put the baby dragon back into his cloak, destroyed the formations that he laid around the cave, and left towards the nearby city.
After he went to the city he walked into a restaurant where he ordered some food and tea, he was currently in the biggest restaurant in the city, where the latest gossip was talked about.
"Have you heard? The giant tribe and the Zither sect almost killed each other!"
"Well that's half right, the giant tribe only lost their main chieftain along with most of their soldiers and hunters, I also heard the new prodigy from the dragon clan also fell at the Zither Sect!"
"The one who won the bloodline tournament? Wow, I'm sure that her father won't be happy, isn't he an outer general in the imperial army? Isn't he a 3rd stage Emperor realm expert?"
"Yeah, I heard he killed 20 subordinates who were dumb enough to enter his tent after he heard the news."
"I wonder who killed them, did the Zither sect patriarch and sect master ended their closed-door cultivation?"
"Maybe, who knows? What we know is that Kong Luo is extremely angry for the death of his daughter."
"Aren't you a little too presumptuous to use his name?"
The man who said the outer general's name started sweating as he looked around, but then he shook his head and left the restaurant.
Yun Jhin ate the food and drank the tea then paid, afterward he left the restaurant and the city, he knew that from what these people said, Mijil's father would come to investigate about what happened!
Fortunately, he didn't leave anyone alive that saw his face or sensed his aura, at most they would think that the one who attacked was the sect master or patriarch of the Zither sect who exited closed-door cultivation to save the sect but was too late, so he unleashed his anger on all of the giants and the general's daughter without thinking about the consequences.
Yun Jhin decided to ignore whatever happened next, after all if he was just a bystander that did his job there was a lower chance of them thinking that he had anything to do with what happened.
He needed to find a sect that specialized in body refinement and either take over it or steal some resources that could help him finish his body refinement, he wanted to get to the maximum rank of 7500 so in the future, he wouldn't come across such cultivation bottlenecks as he did now.
Yun Jhin started to think about the sect's information that he memorized and knew there was one such sect in the middle continent that focused on body refinement, it was one of the middle-ranked sects with a patriarch at the 5th or 6th level of the King Realm, but he had a higher battle power due to his extremely tough body so he could fight 7th King Realm experts.
Taking over the sect would be impossible with the patriarch not being in closed-door cultivation, and unfortunately for Yun Jhin the man was extremely active when it came to sect activities, it was also because body cultivation didn't require much time to practice and only lot's of resources, the stronger the body the more ki it could accumulate and of higher purity as well, the higher the purity the bigger the density of ki.
The denser the ki the more output, in conclusion, if two people clashed the one with denser ki would surely win, and not by little, more like by a landslide, body refinement also increased lifespan but not as much as ki cultivation, just like cultivation beasts the human body could reach 10,000 in rank, cultivation beasts innately cultivated their body along with their ki.
This was why they had way tougher bodies than human's naturally, but that didn't mean humans couldn't train their bodies, it was a more expensive thing for them to do, it was also very painful.
Yun Jhin left the city behind him as he flew towards the sect grounds of the Stone Body sect, the sect was named after their main body refining technique that everyone could get their hands on regardless if they joined the sect, or not, it was a free technique that anyone who was interested in body refining could get their hands on.
This was how the sect was attracting youths to join it, they thought that a free technique meant that everyone could cultivate but the thing was, body cultivation was extremely painful and only those with high willpower could withstand it if their body wasn't of a high rank nor did it have a good constitution they wouldn't be able to go far on this cultivation path either.
As long as their body was good for refinement they would also have a good talent for ki cultivation.
Most of the time bodies that ranked between 5000-7000 would reach the Emperor realm, things were different for Yun Jhin as his body needed to be refined first before he could breakthrough, while the others could train ki normally and breakthrough without body refining, however, Yun Jhin's body started as a normal caterpillar and he was a special case.
The rank his body was at was where he could breakthrough with his ki cultivation if he reached the 7,500 range which was the maximum for his current species, he would be able to reach the peak of the Emperor Realm and if he was lucky, he might even break through to the Sage realm. However, for a guarantee to break through to the Sage realm, he would need a body that could reach rank 8000 at the least.
There was a huge difference for bodies that could reach rank 8000 and above, those kinds of bodies had the chance to learn godly laws and achieve the God Realm, however, the higher the body rank the easier they would learn the laws, Yun Jhin's former body in his last life reached the rank of 9,999 through multiple experimentations and forbidden techniques, however he couldn't reach rank 10,000 which was the breakthrough to reaching a realm above the God one.
He always lamented his failures, but now with the system in his hand which was easily helping him evolve, he would be able to reach the 10,000 ranks!
Yun Jhin slowed his flying speed as he reached the sect grounds of the Stone body sect, he didn't need their techniques as he already had his own, but what he needed were the special herbs and liquids they were monopolizing. There were no other body refining sects that rivaled them, so they bought all of the body refining materials in masse at cheap prices.
Even if Yun Jhin wanted to buy some materials he would have to go to their sect and they would surely overcharge him making him join the sect so he could gain 'discounts', that's how they made rogue body refiners join them.
Sects had many tactics to gain disciples, some were underhanded and some were orthodox, but most sects prided themselves in being the 'good guys' however, 90% of them were hypocrites, in all of his lives Yun Jhin only saw like 3 sects that were truly righteous and lived to help others, most of them were destroyed immediately after Yun Jhin found them, and only 1 survived. It was unknown if that sect survived up today.
After all, Yun Jhin's organization was so strong and had numerous disciples but it faded away in the sands of time.
Yun Jhin looked at the sect's entrance, the sect itself was as big as a capital city almost 50,000 kilometers long with millions of disciples, the Zither sect was also middle-ranked but it was smaller than the Stone body sect due to their stringent requirements.
Yun Jhin easily slipped around the guards that were staying at the entrance, he didn't even need to use much of his stealth technique, he easily entered the sect grounds and made himself fully invisible.
He looked around and found that the sect was very lively, disciples had stalls as they shouted at each other to buy their wares, most of them were body refining herbs of low quality some of them were of middling quality but they were useless to Yun Jhin's current body.
Most middle-ranked sects had two or three treasuries but Yun Jhin didn't need to enter their treasuries to gain what he wanted, most of the herbs and body refining liquids were kept in special places that kept them fresh, while the treasuries kept the rarer treasures and herbs most of them were things that increased the ki cultivation base and that didn't change for sects that focused on body refining as well.
After all body refining was a practice that helped you cultivate ki easier, it was a crutch for untalented people to grow stronger and a boost to the talented people's battle power.
After searching the huge sect grounds for a long while Yun Jhin finally found a place where some high-ranking herbs could be found, it was an ice cave in the outer skirts of the sect.
The naturally formed ice ki would keep the herbs nice and cool for those who needed them, this was just one of the ways to temper the body, there was also self-immolation type of body refining but this sect didn't seem to have such a type of technique.
Yun Jhin entered the cave but then he jumped on the ceiling and stuck to it like a spider, there were some fluctuations coming from the inner parts of the cave.
It seemed someone else was here to get herbs...
Yun Jhin kept himself tightly on the frozen ceiling and waited for the unknown person to make himself/herself visible.
Out of the inner parts of the cave, a cute sneeze could be heard...

chapters.title: Chapter 54: An unexpected but pleasant surprise
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin stuck to the ceiling like a spider as he waited for the people inside the cave to leave, but the signature inside the cave wouldn't move at all, it was actually stationary from the moment Yun Jhin sensed it up till now, and almost 2 hours passed!
Yun Jhin realized that the one inside was either cultivating or waiting for something since there was no other way the dragon caterpillar decided it was time to enter directly regardless of consequences, after all, there was an extremely low chance of him to be found out.
Yun Jhin entered the spacious ice cave and looked around, seeing heaps of herbs and bottles with special body refining liquids of different colors ranging from white to black, rainbow-colored, etc.
Inside an exquisitely carved cell stood a woman with an extremely pale complexion, she had two long ears and wore nothing but a see-through green dress, she was shivering and the cute sneeze from before should have come from her.
The woman looked around with a strange look on her face, as Yun Jhin took a better look at her, she had deep forest green eyes and her lithe figure was something that most men would appreciate, her chest area wasn't big but not small either, she had a special natural aura around her that kept her body from freezing as it seemed she didn't have a high cultivation base.
From what Yun Jhin could infer she was at most a peak earthly realm practitioner, as he observed her better and confirmed her characteristics he realized that she was a nature spirit!
Nature spirits looked just like elves but were different, their souls and bodies were different, they weren't good at cultivation as a race, but they were special as their blood could be used to cultivate strong bodies, most of the time these type of race would be found accompanying the tree-huggers known as elves.
Nature spirits were a rather rare species as for every 10 elves born from the world tree there would be a 1% chance for a nature spirit to be born, nature spirits were kind in nature but that was because 90% of the time they were taken care of by the elves if nature spirits were handled wrongly they could transform into evil spirits that devoured souls and flesh, their body enhancing ability would increase by a lot but their reasoning would be lost, they would also get a huge boost in cultivation base to the point that the nature spirit that Yun Jhin was currently looking at could break through to the 7th stage of the king realm if she transformed.
Nature spirits were darlings of the world tree that gave birth to the elves, however, due to their weakness they were exploited by the elves, and in some instances where they were almost bleed to death, they transformed into such beings razing down the elf villages.
Yun Jhin continued to observe the nature spirit in the cell and realized that she wasn't mistreated in any way, she just looked quite lonely, the nature spirit in question was sighing as she looked around and muttered to herself:
"That feeling I had... that almost inexistent life force, was it just me?"
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked at her, Nature spirits had the best ability to detect life force, it was quite a feat to detect his life force while he used his stealth techniques by feeling alone, after all, she couldn't use her soul force yet, she wasn't even a heavenly realm expert.
Yun Jhin thought what to do about her, he couldn't aggravate her or she would become a mass-murdering evil spirit, the best way would be to fool her and kill her quickly to use her body, but she was a bit too weak for his tastes, she would need to atleast break through to the peak stage of the heavenly realm before she could be of use to him, in the end, the higher the cultivation of the natural spirit the better body refining it would give.
Yun Jhin calculated that with the amount of blood a natural spirit at the peak stage of the heavenly had, he could refine his body to the max rank of 7500, but nurturing her to that state would be very hard, natural spirits had a very hard way of breaking through, they didn't need normal energy as other cultivators did, they needed destiny, they needed to rob others of their destiny and due to their mostly meek nature they wouldn't be able to do so, that's why they were stuck at low cultivation bases.
Most of the time they would leech 1% of the destiny of their most loved person due to the way they attached to them, Yun Jhin eyes started to sparkle as he thought about it, his destiny was immense, so big that it couldn't be quantified, after all, he reincarnated for thousands of lives so the combined destiny resides in his soul after he fused his former lives memories.
If he could make this natural spirit woman think that he was her most loved person, she would be able to seep some of his destiny, he didn't care about it, destiny was a fleeting thing that he realized how to control at this point, he could even get it back in double after he slaughtered and ate her.
But first, he would need to create a scenario so that the natural spirit would believe him, he slowly walked inside the cave making himself look as shifty as possible, the natural spirit's eyes started to glow as she looked at Yun Jhin, she waved at him to get his attention.
Yun Jhin's eyes widened in surprise as he saw her and approached her slowly, making sure to dodge any traps or formations along the way, he approached her cell and looked at her in the eyes, the woman blushed as she saw under Yun Jhin's hood, he made himself look a bit more handsome than normal using his ki technique.
The woman whispered to Yun Jhin:
"Stranger, I'm sure you aren't from the Stone Body sect, I don't feel their technique life force changes on you, you must be an outsider, how have you got here?"
Yun Jhin smiled to reassure her as he approached closer and said:
"I have come with one reason, but the moment I saw you I got another one."
The woman blushed, most natural spirits were pretty weak when it came to romance, after all, even their closest kin, the elves, treated them quite badly and separated them, most likely this spirit was sold to the Stone Body sect.
Yun Jhin hand went between the bars of the cell and held her hand as he said:
"To be truthful with you, I came to steal some body-refining herbs from these people, they have a monopoly of them and they supercharge the price when it comes to outsiders, I'm a free spirit and I don't want to join their sect, fortunately, I have a stealth technique that let me wander in here."
The woman frowned as she heard his explanation but it did make sense for her, as a natural spirit she looked down upon thievery killing and other such stuff, even though she knew sometimes these types of things were needed that didn't mean she wouldn't look down on such people.
However, she ignored that part as she was really starved of freedom, she had lived here since she was a little girl and even though the people that came around to chat with her were nice, she felt that they were pretty cold inside and that they didn't mean what they said, Yun Jhin gave her a good vibe, something that she could trust, only if she knew Yun Jhin was only putting an act up what would she think?
Yun Jhin walked towards the cell and opened it up as it was controlled by a formation, the woman started to smile as she jumped out of the cell like a bunny, she walked towards Yun Jhin and held her hand towards him as she said:
"My name is Mariela of the fifth natural spirits tribe, would you give me the pleasure of knowing your name?"
Yun Jhin gave her a big smile as he accepted her handshake and responded to her:
"Yun Jhin, anyways, first let me get ahold of some of these herbs before I take you out, could you wait for a few minutes?"
Mariela smiled to Yun Jhin and nodded at him then waited in a corner to make herself look as unsuspicious as she could, her antics were pretty cute considering she was hiding the wrong way making her whole body visible and only a part of her face was hidden.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he opened his spatial bag and filled it with body refining herbs after he made sure he got enough he waved towards Mariela and said:
"Come and jump on my back, my stealth technique needs you to be near me so it can cover both of us."
Mariela didn't think anything about his request as she jumped on his back quite easily, Yun Jhin and Mariela both turned transparent as they walked away from the cave, but at the entrance, they met with a couple of disciples who were chatting:
"*Sigh* why do we have to entertain that natural spirit, couldn't it have been someone else?"
"Man she is quite a beauty, I don't understand why don't you like to chat with her."
"She is quite beautiful indeed, but she is pretty bland and boring, we can't even touch her anyway, why would I look at a doll in a cage and talk with it?"
Mariela's eyes widened as she listened in to their conversation, she realized that her feeling was right and that they didn't truly care about her, even though she suspected that it still hurt her, she recognized the people that were walking towards the cave and knew that they were the people that she thought of as friends.
Mariela's tears started to dampen Yun Jhin's cloak but Yun Jhin ignored it as he whispered to her:
"It's ok Mariela, I know they aren't your true friends, but I guess I could be your friend."
Mariela stopped crying after she heard Yun Jhin's words, she didn't know what to say as she heard what Yun Jhin told her, never in her life did someone say that he would be her friend so readily and easily, she was flustered as she kept tight on Yun Jhin's back.
Yun Jhin kept her tightly on his back as he said:
"Don't move much or there's a chance my stealth technique would be broken, after all, I didn't get to have much training with two people at once."
This was of course a lie from Yun Jhin, if his cultivation base was high enough he could stealth atleast 20,000 people with him.
Yun Jhin kept dodging and weaving away from the disciples who were either walking, talking, or selling their wares around the sect grounds.
Suddenly his stealth technique broke at the entrance of the sect making the two guards look at him in suspicion and apprehension, one of them shot him with a fireball that made it's way to Mariela on his back, but he took the brunt of it by jumping face forward it, he gritted his teeth as he ran away.
The duo at the entrance didn't recognize Mariela as they were lowly guards, they just found Yun Jhin weird and they were spooked by the way he suddenly appeared in front of them, that's why they attacked randomly out of fright.
Mariela looked at Yun Jhin's singed clothes and realized that his arm was pretty burnt up, tears started to well up in her eyes as she realized that she saved her without another thought, even though the two people at the gate were weaklings in Yun Jhin's eyes, the fireball would have been fatal to Mariela.
She hugged his back really hard as she used her special healing talents to resolve the burn that was on Yun Jhin's left arm.
The burn started to fade away, Yun Jhin could have healed it himself but that would mean spoiling the plan. Yun Jhin sighed as they finally got away from the sect location and let Mariela down on the ground, he flexed his arm a bit and smiled towards Mariela and said:
"Thanks for healing me Mariela, good job!"
Mariela stopped sniffling as she cleared her eyes and said with a trembling voice:
"You wouldn't have gotten hurt in the first place if you didn't save me, I'm sorry!"
Yun Jhin patted her shoulder and said:
"No problem, after all, how could I let such a beautiful woman to be kept in such a cold and lonely cell? You are free now you can go wherever you want, do you want me to get you to a nearby city or?"
Mariela shook her head as her green colored eyes looked at Yun Jhin's and she said:
"Mister Yun Jhin if you wouldn't mind, could I accompany you from now on?"
Yun Jhin laughed heartily as he hugged her and said:
"Of course you can, how could I refuse such a beautiful lady?"
Mariela reciprocated the hug, she herself wanted to give him one but she was pretty awkward when it came to such interactions, she was glad that Yun Jhin took the lead and hugged her, it made it easier for her to hug him back.
Yun Jhin looked at her in the eyes as he said:
"I'm going into closed-door cultivation in a nearby cave 500 kilometers from here, that's the plan, jump on my back again, and let's go!"
The woman nodded as she jumped on Yun Jhin's back and Yun Jhin started to run at quick speeds towards the cave, after a while of running he finally reached the cave and entered it.
He let Mariela down gently as he walked inside the cave and put down some formations, Mariela looked around herself checking out the cave and it's surroundings then she walked towards Yun Jhin and said:
"I can wait for you to cultivate, however, can I stay near you? I'm quite scared of such types of locations."
Yun Jhin understood where her fear came from so he sat cross-legged on the ground and patted the spot beside him then told her:
"You can stay near me then, don't worry I don't bite."
Mariela laughed at his joke and sat near him, Yun Jhin took herbs out of his bag as he started to use them for his cultivation, he would from time to time make pills and eat them, som herbs were better eaten raw, and he would meditate and do breathing exercises to absorb the energy into his body.
Then he would do physical exercises to temper his body, the cave had a waterfall inside of it, he would meditate under the waterfall whenever he felt like it, and Mariela would look at him, most of the time, however, she would snuggle near him when he meditated.
She even met the sleeping baby dragon that she found extremely cute, and she couldn't wait for him to wake up.
She was a pretty hearty girl, she started to slowly fall in love with Yun Jhin and the simple lifestyle they had, whenever she was hungry Yun Jhin would go out and get her some food, Nature spirits didn't eat meat so he had to get her some weak herbs, the ones that he had were too strong for her and her body would explode if she used them.
Mariela looked at Yun Jhin as he finished the mountain worth of herbs that he stole from the Stone body sect, his body rank now reached almost 4,000 and he broke through the 8th stage of the ki cultivating realm as well. Mariela was happy for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Interested but cautious
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin found himself into a sticky situation this time, but that's what he wanted, he planned this since the moment he killed the man's daughter.
Yun Jhin wanted to say something but the sword placed near his neck made him unable to, one singular movement from his throat would make the blade go deeper inside and cut an important artery, the middle-aged man was pretty bored himself and he was ready to let go of the sword.
Letting go of it with the help of a little bit of gravity would immediately decapitate Yun Jhin, the middle-aged man was taller than Yun Jhin and the positioning of the sword near his throat made it so letting go of it would detach Yun Jhin head from his body.
Yun Jhin wanted to gulp down a mouthful of saliva but he couldn't even do that or else his adam apple would go in the front and his artery would be sliced by the sword.
The middle-aged man was ready to let the sword go when Yun Jhin waved his hands in a way that didn't move his neck at all, the middle-aged man looked at him and ignored his frantic actions as his hand almost left the handle of the sword, suddenly Yun Jhin let out his mixed-blood aura regarding him as one of the few mixed-blood nobilities.
The dragon of the east general of the 3rd imperial army, Kong Luo, he had many sons and daughters but none of them were as talented as Mijil was, he was extremely angry and disappointed when he heard of her death, that was the sole reason his imperial body would even decide to descend on the middle regions, most of the people of the upper continent considered the humans and other races to be inferior to them, and they would only recognize people from the other 3 sacred races.
Dragons were the most prideful of the 4 races and the ones that were the most strict regarding hierarchy and bloodline, meaning that even if one was talented with a lowly bloodline they could be despised due to their lowly bloodline, but this could happen very rarely as dragon bloodlines would be 90% of the time transferred fully, which meant only the very mixed bloodlines were despised.
Kong Luo retracted his sword as drops of blue blood dripped from Yun Jhin's throat, after a few seconds the wound closed and there was no injury left, Kong Luo appreciated Yun Jhin's regeneration ability with a critical eye as he looked at him, he suddenly clenched Yun Jhin's arm as he inserted a needle into it then he muttered to himself, but his mutter was quite loud so even his guards could hear him:
"Bone age of around... 20 or so years, cultivation base 8th stage of the ki cultivating realm, hmm a very sturdy body, extremely sturdy, I could say it even broke through its normal potential to reach a special state, he surely has a dragon bloodline but what is the other one..."
The imperial general drew some blood again from Yun Jhin as he observed it with energy-filled eyes, his eyes transformed into two ruby-like entities as he looked at the blood, then he tasted it and said:
"This... caterpillar bloodline is unrecognizable, as for the bloodline, is it from Lord Skulpto? No, it's very thick, it's almost perfect, it's at the level of her Majesty Azalea, but her Majesty couldn't find a man worthy enough to impregnate her, very strange."
Kong Luo looked at Yun Jhin with a questioning look on his face, he didn't know from what branch of the family Yun Jhin gained the bloodline he had, his caterpillar bloodline was also unknown, it was a mix of other caterpillars, but they were so muddled and mixed that he couldn't recognize which caterpillar races it belonged to, how could someone have such an unpure and pure bloodline at the same time in one body?
Kong Luo observed Yun Jhin further as he realized that his cultivation base was rather refined, his ki was pure and strong, it was also very malleable under his grasp, it felt like the perfect type of ki that could transform into whatever techniques one desired, Kong Luo eyes widened:
"No element in the ki, that's... 99% of dragons and hybrids have elemental ki!"
This truly put the imperial general on thought, Yun Jhin was a very strange and rare specimen in his eyes, someone that could fill the void of his daughter's death, even though he didn't have a high cultivation base, it was most likely because he lived in these trash conditions and he didn't have enough energy to break through after all his body was extremely strong!
He wasn't sure if he got the needed enlightenment of the level but enlightenment was easily given from an expert to the other, after all, all roads led to Rome, even though not everyone had the same experiences, they could be shared and enlightenment from them could be created. Yun Jhin didn't need enlightenment at all as he was a reincarnated being with fully acquired memories, but he could play the part if he needed to.
Kong Luo grasped Yun Jhin's hand as he took the needle out and his inspecting ki, he was a man with emperor ki which was above king ki, his ki was overwhelming and Yun Jhin couldn't even move away if he wanted to, so he stood petrified there and waited for the man to finish. Normally speaking Yun Jhin's aura should have been tainted from killing Mijil and Kong Luo should have recognized it, but Yun Jhin fully devoured these types of curses and soul imprints to mend his soul faster.
Soul attacks were the thing he least feared, of course, if a Sage Realm expert decided to soul attack him he would be in a precarious position but he wouldn't die from it, at most his soul would get paralyzed or he would blackout. Only God Realm souls could give him trouble.
Kong Luo's soul willpower entered Yun Jhin's soul space and looked around, however, it didn't find anything wrong as Yun Jhin only let him read surface memories he created, some of them were true, some were fake.
Kong Luo eyes started shining as he looked at Yun Jhin's body and he said:
"You have refined the heart of a natural spirit? I see then, I see why your body is so abnormally strong, you lucky bastard, I wish I could dissect you and take that heart back to use it, *sigh* but it seems you fully devoured the energy, whatever."
Kong Luo patted our dragon caterpillar on the shoulder making him almost tremble and fall to his knees due to the sudden weight that the man put on his pat, but Yun Jhin held on due to his refined body, Kong Luo made a 'tsk' sound as he said:
"Yes, indeed quite the refined body, young man, from what I saw from your soul space want to join me in going to the upper continents don't you?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he took an expectant look on his face:
"I have heard that the great general Kong Luo has appeared in the middle regions and I wanted to try my luck after I absorbed the natural spirit's heart I thought that my talent would even shine among the upper continents."
Kong Luo nodded his head slowly as he said:
"Your bodily and ki talent is top-notch, that's true and you would be a top disciple even in the imperial family, regarding talent that it, but your cultivation base is, how could I put it nicely? Very trashy."
Kong Luo shook his head as he continued:
"However I know it's not your fault, your body is lacking quite a lot of energy needed for breakthroughs, even though your foundation is stable, it's pretty dry, it seems you haven't consumed any special herbs in your cultivation and you only got to here with hard work."
The man wasn't wrong, after all, he ate very few pills, but the number of bodies he ate could be in the hundreds of thousands, bodies, unlike herbs, didn't leave behind any impurities, it was just like eating, the only impurities that remained could be removed by tempering the body.
You could argue that Yun Jhin's method of cultivation was superior, but most people found it unethical, that didn't mean people like Yun Jhin didn't exist, there were quite a lot of people similar to him, but they were either in hiding because they were too rampant or dead, not everyone had the experience of countless lives backing them in their plans to eternal life or world domination.
Kong Luo looked at his guards and whispered something to them before getting his gaze back to Yun Jhin:
"I can handle for you to enter the upper regions, but there is something I need to do before that since my daughter Mijil could only enter the upper continents after she won the bloodline tournament, It would be an abuse of my rank to let you enter just because you are talented, your talent is only a little above my late daughter's."
He frowned as he recalled his daughter and then he continued:
"I would have to host another tournament and you would have to win it before you are granted entry legally in the upper continents, you would also get a chance to join the imperial army or the imperial family, however, I would suggest joining the army as it has no politics and it's simpler to live in the army compared to the imperial palace."
Kong Luo was a straight forward man so after he said that he started to walk away, it was already quite some time since he looked for his daughter's killer and there were no leads as both the Zither sect, sect master and patriarch were seemingly gone from the face of the earth.
They just disappeared, he made countless attempts at getting leads at the sect grounds but he couldn't find anything, he was also angering the upper ranked sects of the middle continents by extending his investigation, some of the sects already took the region that the Zither sect stood in to be theirs, and they were ready to move in and reconstruct.
Even though the Zither sect was small it had quite the sizeable amount of natural resources around their region. The upper sects, sect masters were as strong as Kong Luo so he didn't want to offend them, even though he was a general in the imperial army, just like all organizations there was a lot of infighting.
The infighting was even stronger due to the pride of the draconic race, unless someone overwhelmingly stronger would become their ruler and stop them from acting like this, they would pretty much continue to be like this.
Yun Jhin followed quickly behind Kong Luo and asked:
"Might I know when the tournament will start?"
Kong Luo whispered something to his entourage again and said:
"One month from now, just follow me around and you won't miss out, with my help you might even break through to the King Realm before the tournament starts, it's a very low chance of happening but I have a friend who owes me some favours and I heard he just unearthed a good treasure that could help you."
Yun Jhin nodded at his explanation and continued to follow behind, even though Kong Luo acted like he found a treasure that he wanted to nurture he was extremely puzzled inside, where did this hybrid come from?
He would make sure to keep an eye on Yun Jhin and do some further investigations when he got back to the upper continents.
Yun Jhin continued to ask Kong Luo about the imperial army, how will the tournament be, the rules, etc.
He acted just like a young man who hasn't seen the world, Kong Luo almost fallen for his act thinking he might have just overreacted but he was a willy old fox and his instincts told him that Yun Jhin wasn't was what he showed. However, he wouldn't act on his instincts without any proof.
Kong Luo started to tell Yun Jhin bits and pieces that he thought were important such as that the Emperor and the Empress of the dragons were in different factions, the Empress controlled the palace while the Emperor controlled the army, however, the Empress also owned a small part of the army but it was insignificant compared to the Emperor's control.
The duo of old dragons was against each other for unknown reasons, but Kong Luo had insider information that said that the Empress was mad at the Emperor due to his erectile dysfunction, she badly wanted a child so she went around the upper continents and procreated everything that moved, and a had a decent amount of talent.
However, unluckily for her, she never found a man strong enough to handle her and give her enough 'juice' that she could become pregnant. Kong Luo knew that this was just gossip as the Emperor had multiple children but they were all mixed-bloods.
The Empress was just mad due to the low fertility between True dragons, no matter how much the Emperor fought with her, she couldn't bear a child!
Thus she decided to try with someone else and this enraged the Emperor, a lot, however, just like he wanted to punish the ones that 'defiled' his wife, he realized that they were all dead... her wife done them in herself, he wasn't sure if they died in bliss or were scared as they died by becoming withered mummies.
Kong Luo shook his head as he said those words, it was common knowledge in the upper continents and it even leaked in the middle continents, even the Emperor couldn't punish someone if they talked about it, he just agreed to disagree and entered into a deadly squabble with his wife instead.
The squabble turned to the afferent organizations that they controlled thus making the infighting in the Dynasty so big that some sects were eyeing them like prey, but the Dynasty was so strong and it also had quite a few decent allies, so they weren't attacked yet.
But Kong Luo didn't know how much this peace would last, at most 500 years at the least 150 or 100.
Mijil was his successor as she could be groomed into an Emperor realm expert in 100 years the quickest and she might even reach the peak of the Emperor Realm in 500 years, even though he looked middle-aged he was quite old and he wanted to use his remaining life span to break through to the peak of the emperor realm then try his hand at the sage realm. However, he needed someone to take over his Army general position.
Since Mijil was now dead, he put his sights on Yun Jhin! Even though he had suspicious origins he was plenty talented and someone with draconic blood, so he couldn't be a spy from an opposing planet, it was imperial blood in his veins so he couldn't be from some sects that betrayed the Dynasty either.
While Kong Luo was contemplating about Yun Jhin's bloodline and origins, the man in question was cultivating while following him, at the pace they were travelling they would reach the borders of the upper continents in approximatively 5 days, at the border there was an arena where tournaments for mixed-bloods would be held.
The one who won such tournaments would be granted entry and based on their performance they might even be able to join the army or the palace. Yun Jhin was going to win to further his plans and nothing would go in his way, he knew that Kong Luo suspected him but he would act so well that he would even fool himself into thinking that he was who he acted to be!
Yun Jhin didn't calculate the pitstop that they had to do to talk with the friendly acquaintance of the general, the man was a sect master of the upper ranked Blood Damnation sect and when the general asked him about his treasure the man started beating around the bush and invited him to leave.
If the general made a scene where he would lose quite a lot of face as he came uninvited, so he gritted his teeth and left, he looked at Yun Jhin and apologized:
"I'm sorry young friend Yun Jhin, but it seems this old fellow is rather wishy-washy when it comes to his treasure, I can give you something to increase your cultivation base but it won't be as effective as that old man's treasure."
It wasn't that Kong Luo was stingy, but the treasure of the Blood Damnation sect master could be used continuously like the dragon stone that Yun Jhin had before, however, his treasure could be only used once and it didn't have the same effectiveness as the treasure in question.
But Yun Jhin's talent won him over so he decided to gamble and use the treasure on him, they stopped at a nearby forest and excavated into the earth to create a makeshift cultivation grotto, there Kong Luo made his entourage guard the grotto as he took out a peculiar looking treasure from his spatial bag...
Yun Jhin eyed the treasure and his eyes started glowing, with the treasure's help even though he couldn't get to the King Realm he would still be able to reach the peak of the 9th stage and stabilize himself in it.
With the rules of the tournament, he would be able to gain enough energy to break through the king realm as well...
Yun Jhin looked at the treasure and sat cross-legged on the ground as he waited for Kong Luo to use it on him, Kong Luo gritted his teeth but then he shook his head, he knew that the treasure had no use for him and it wouldn't have helped Mijil much either, there was no other talented youth that the general could think off so he bet all of his money on Yun Jhin!
Kong Luo narrowed his eyes as he put the treasure on Yun Jhin's forehead and he started to insert his ki into it as he muttered very slowly to the point that not even Yun Jhin could hear him correctly even though he was peeking and listening to him with his soul willpower:
"Hopefully, you won't die like my damn daughter, my wish to breakthrough the Sage Realm will go with you, Yun Jhin, don't disappoint me!"

chapters.title: Chapter 57: A bloody tournament
chapters.content:
The energy from the treasure entered Yun Jhin's head as it traveled inside his body, his cultivation was slowly getting pushed towards the 9th stage of the ki cultivating realm, his physical body didn't go through many changes but his soul was quickly mending itself.
