Lulu stopped her sword training as she bowed, there was some reluctance in her gaze but she approved of what her mother told her:
"I will do my best mother, when should I go?"
The Empress's eyes filled up with light as she said:
"He will surely be sent to temper himself in the upper continents, it doesn't matter that he lived a rather hard life in the lower continents and the middle ones, he will be sent in a danger zone, I think he will be first sent into one in the middle levels for him to accommodate then he will be summoned into one in the upper levels, you will join him with a few others, make sure you win his heart and sleep with him!"
Lulu nodded her head as the Empress waved her hand and she disappeared.
Back with the Emperor after everyone finished their meal, the man got up from the table and said:
"It's time to talk about business, I don't think you know this but as a reincarnated one the best way to draw out your former life memories is to put you into dangerous situations in special places, to be frank with you, we would love to have another God Realm expert among us as some of the other nations started to threaten us with war, even though we have 2 God Realm experts having 3 would mean we could start expanding the Empire's borders."
A strange glint appeared in his eyes as he said those words and he continued:
"You see, our Dragon Empire is one of the strongest in the Upper continents, but there are other kingdoms and nations that have God Realm experts and if we don't tread well they could ally with each other and try to attack our Empire."
The Emperor continued to talk about how things would be if the Empire would fall but Yun Jhin only listened to him on the surface, he used these kinds of speeches on his subordinates in his previous lives as well, they were meant to create a sense of belonging to the organization/nation and make them sacrifice themselves or give their best during wars, it seemed the safe times of the Empire were going to end.
The Emperor let them leave after he finished his speech and left them with these words:
"10 days from now you will go to the Demonic forest in the middle regions, we aren't sure what kind of trees are those in the Demonic forest but they release a type of energy that devils and demons love and benefit from, you will go there to temper yourself along with some other strong prospective youths of the Empire from both the military and the nobility, you can go now."
Yun Jhin followed Kong Luo out of the palace and walked towards his barracks after they arrived at his division, Kong Luo was distracted by something so he didn't talk with Yun Jhin anymore.
Yun Jhin entered his quarters as he thought to himself:
"This situation could be a good way to see where hell's entrance could be locked, the Demonic forest must be the one that has the Dark ebonite trees, if I could find that demon and eat his soul I could find where the entrance to hell was located..."
Yun Jhin would also not refuse the free meal considering of the Empire's youths, he couldn't eat all of them but during such expeditions, there was no way there could be no 'accidents' Yun Jhin also knew that the others would try to target him during the training expedition, but that was the last thing they would do in their lives.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he started meditating and strengthening his first jewel, to further go into the King Realm one had to first fully refine and strengthen their jewels before creating new ones, just like cultivation stages there were 9 stages in jewel refinement, they were called early middle and late stages, 1-4 were early, 5-7 middle and 8-9 late.
Yun Jhin was currently at the second stage so he was in the early level, strengthening the jewels wouldn't take much time for him, after all, he didn't need enlightenment like most other cultivators but due to his modified body from the system, he would need a little bit more energy than normal.
Even though the system helped him a lot the thing was that it couldn't create a perfect bloodline, that's why when Kong Luo scanned his bloodline he realized that his caterpillar part was very muddled as it was fused with a lot of bloodlines, this wasn't something Yun Jhin could control, maybe once he reached the late stages of the God Realm but up till then he would have to bear the increased cost of resource consumption.
There was also the fact that he would need to actively strengthen the jewels with star power which meant that eating people wouldn't cut it anymore when it came to his cultivation, he would need to eat their crown which meant eating their souls whole, this was something Yun Jhin enjoyed so he didn't feel burdened at all but absorbing anyone below the King Realm wouldn't be of help to him anymore.
He would also need to be quite selective when it came to his new 'food' after all, he would only be able to use high-quality starlight to temper his jewels.
But there was no lack of geniuses in the cultivation world, the only thing that to be geniuses would lack was techniques, however, he would be able to change that in the future, he would just need time.
While Yun Jhin was planning and cultivating, Lulu was sharpening herself as she prepared for the training, she wasn't sure why she would even go , after all, she was at the 6th stage of the King Realm at the moment, she wouldn't go if she could, there were no benefits to her but her mother forced her to go due to Yun Jhin.
She gritted her teeth as she continued to sharpen her sword, her eyes glinted with a dangerous light as she looked in the void seemingly waiting for her mother's instructions.
In all other corners of the Imperial capital, young geniuses were preparing for the special training in the danger zones, most of them didn't have much experience when it came to life and death battles as they were trained in their homes up till the King Realm.
In the Imperial Capital, only those that reached the King Realm could be considered adults and experts.
Yun Jhin sat in meditation as he cultivated and waited for the set date to come...

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Meeting the others
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's meditation time passed quickly as he was interrupted by a knock on his door, Yun Jhin frowned as he got up from the cross-legged position on the ground, his empty room made him easily walk towards the door and open it.
Kong Luo was there with a big smile on his face as he said:
"It's time to go Yun Jhin, I have also got you a present."
He took out an exquisite silver ring and gave it to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin put it on his ring finger and admired it for a bit, he knew that it was a spatial ring, it was an advanced version of storage compared to the spatial bag, it was smaller than the spatial bag but more things could be stuffed into it due to the exquisite formations at work.
Yun Jhin didn't have time to craft himself a spatial ring so this was a nice present, Yun Jhin made a little bow but Kong Luo stopped him midway as he said:
"There's no need to, as your 'guardian' I need to give you atleast something like this, after all, all of the other young geniuses would have a spatial ring with them, the Emperor said that whatever you find in the forest will be yours to take, danger zones tend to be full of strange herbs that are either beneficial or poisonous or both, I know you have some experiences with poisons from that time I scanned your memories so I don't need you to instruct in what to do."
The man patted Yun Jhin's shoulder as and then took him to the teleportation formation, they would go back to the wall and after that Kong Luo would be the one who will escort the youths to the Demonic Forest.
After a short while the duo arrived at the teleportation formation and they met with another participant there, he was a fat young man and he had a spatial ring on each of his fingers, he looked like the nouveau rich type who liked to waste money, a silver-spoon young master.
The fatty didn't say anything as he was drooling at his maid, the maid was the only one who was currently escorting him but she was an Emperor Realm expert at the least, it seemed some families sent out their own Emperor Experts to guard their prodigies until they reached the Demonic Forest.
Kong Luo and Yun Jhin entered the formation along with the fatty and the maid, after a short while they arrived at the wall but they didn't meet Pei Fong again, it seemed he was currently somewhere else but the guard that replaced him wasn't allowed to say much.
Kong Luo sighed as his party and the fatties were the first to arrive, he needed to wait for the others to arrive before he set out.
After a few hours of waiting another youth appeared out of the teleportation formation, his muscles were easily visible from his gown and he was also quite tall, but his face looked average, he had no one else with him, after he saw Kong Luo he did a small bow and then took a spot near the wall where he waited for the others.
Ten minutes later another light appeared from the formation, this time it was a woman, unsurprisingly it was the Empress youngest daughter Lulu, her face was devoid of emotion as she got near her wall and sat cross-legged, she didn't say anything nor greet anyone as she went to cultivate.
Afterward, more and more people started to stream in from the formation, as Yun Jhin counted he realized that in total they were 75 youths, 20 females and 55 males with him included.
Kong Luo coughed a bit to gather everyone's attention then he said:
"Since everyone is here it's time to go to the Demonic Forest, I see that some of you have your bodyguards so we will join forces to create a flying formation so we can quickly take you to the forest, don't forget that we will wait for you at the edges of the forest to take you back to the capital after you are done with the training."
Kong Luo waved his hands as he created a ship out of ki, he jumped on the ship and the fatty's maid along with another short old man jumped on it, they started to pump their ki into the ship as it became corporeal from its illusory state and Kong Luo invited all of the young geniuses on it.
Yun Jhin jumped at the front near Kong Luo while the others went to the back, the only one who was also invited in the front was the fatty and Lulu.
The fatty was drooling at Lulu's beauty, she resembled her mother quite a bit so even though she was rather young in the future she would be a great beauty, she looked to be around 17-18 years old but with cultivators, it was never known how old they actually were, but from her life aura, Yun Jhin knew that she truly was around the age she looked to be.
He knew that she was eyeing him from time to time and her eyes didn't look friendly at all in the beginning, but as she observed him more her icy look started to change, she thought that all she did was in secret but Yun Jhin knew whatever she did, after all, they were quite close only a few meters apart and Yun Jhin's soul willpower and perception were extremely strong.
The fatty himself started a conversation as he was bored:
"Your highness Lulu, might I inquire why have you joined this training, aren't you at the 6th stage of the King Realm?"
The fatty was quite blunt and it seemed he didn't care much about etiquette as his saliva dripped everywhere as he googled Lulu's chest, Lulu was ready to butcher the man like the pig he was but the maid from his family intervened as she appeared in front of him and said:
"Young Master Sumo please don't bother her majesty."
She bowed deeply to Lulu as she apologized:
"My deep apologies your highness, my young master can't control himself when he sees beautiful young women he... eeek!"
The fatty known as Sumo grabbed one of her plump cheeks that's why she squealed like that, the maid faced him but afterward another eek was heard as he grabbed her chest, the maid got away from him blushing deeply as she said:
"Young master you!"
Sumo nodded his head like a sage as he said:
"Very firm, it seems your qualities have improved since the last time I checked them."
The maid shook her head as she muttered:
"You have checked them this morning..."
Yun Jhin looked at the amusing scene in front of him but he didn't laugh, his face was an icy cold mask as he thought:
"This fatty should be the first target, he seems the dumbest and the weakest of the group, but I can sense that his crown jewel is full of starlight, he might have used a treasure that he still didn't fully digest, I should be able to get my hands on it..."
Lulu frowned at the Sumo's antics but her eyes strayed to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin ignored the situation after he glanced around once and then he looked into the horizon waiting to reach the Demonic Forest, he had 2 objectives in the forest, one meet the demon and devour his soul, 2 kill as many geniuses as he could to refine his jewel.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes but he was startled as Lulu approached him and sat near him then she said:
"My name's Lulu, you should have heard of me..."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"I'm sorry but I didn't you see, I'm quite new in the capital.."
Lulu's face scrunched but she decided to introduce herself fully:
"Song Lulu, 4th princess and daughter of the Empire."
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes inside as he heard her, it seemed the Empress couldn't hold long with her plans, he knew what she wanted to do, most likely she wanted her daughter to have a child with him to secure his pure draconic bloodline, Yun Jhin smiled inside, this was one way he could infiltrate the Imperial family.
Yun Jhin nodded at her as he said:
"I have heard of the most talented young daughter of the Empress, so it was you?"
Lulu nodded, this was how most men acted when they met her, they would try to act cool on the surface but inside they would jump at a chance to prove themselves in front of her.
Yun Jhin didn't continue the conversation as he continued to look into the horizon, this threw her off, wasn't it the time for him to fawn and try to impress her?
He looked at him and she realized that he started to close his eyes, he was trying to cultivate right now! During their conversation!
Lulu huffed as she got up and left him alone, she was offended by his acts but also intrigued inside, she was a princess who pretty much trained most her life, she was also courted from time to time due to her mother insistence, but all of the young geniuses in the capital seemed like trash to her.
This was the first time a man acted like he didn't care about her and she found it to be 'interesting', Lulu decided to meditate herself as she waited for the ship to reach the Demonic Forest.
The fatty from before was obscenely acting against his maid but no one gave him any more laughs or looks most of them thought that there was a problem with his head as he salivated continuously.
However, Yun Jhin was observing him stealthily, there was the chance the fatty could try to fool the others, feigning to be a pig to eat the tiger.
Yun Jhin put him as an easy target but that didn't mean he wouldn't be on his guard against him, after all, he was one stage above him being at the 2nd stage.
The maid seemed very embarrassed as her chest was played with and from time to time her buttocks would be smacked, even the ship almost crashed a few times as her ki was acting up due to her mental state, finally, Kong Luo couldn't endure anymore and he grabbed the fatty by the ear and put him to reflect on his actions, the other old man sighed as he looked at the fatty and said:
"The Drop clan will end to the dogs with such a young master..."
Kong Luo heard that and shook his head as he didn't comment, they were getting nearer and nearer to the demonic forest and he needed to control the ship or the demonic energy from the trees might invade it and make them crash.
Yun Jhin breathed in slowly as he could feel the smell of demonic energy, it smelled like cinnamon, he wasn't a fan of demons and devils, in his last life even though he was 'friends' with them, he was also trying to kill them at any point, just like they did to him, however, on the surface, he had to play nice or else they would invade his sect, both of their organizations made them unable to act against each other, that was also around the time that the demons started to be marginalized by the devils, unfortunately, Yun Jhin couldn't intervene back then as he was too old at the time.
Yun Jhin looked down as Ebony black trees appeared in his sight, it was the Demonic Forest, quite a simple name but it showed what it was, truly a demonic forest, the plants looked normal but if anything got too close to them they would eat you, Yun Jhin watched a devil fly landed on a plant and was eaten, suddenly the plant exploded into a bunch of pieces as the fly morphed into a bigger version of itself with a maw and then started to eat the plants remains.
However, the mutated fly died soon after as it became purple and transformed into a pile of goo.
Yun Jhin watched with interest, he knew what kind of plants they were but they seemed to have mutated even further since his times, after all, 500,000 years passed since then.
Kong Luo dropped everyone on the ground at the entrance of the forest and shared a map with each genius then said:
"You will all enter alone and you are allowed to make team when you meet with each other, it doesn't matter as long as you live in the forest for 6 months and can get out by yourselves you have passed this training and you will be able to join the Imperial Army that the Emperor will create soon..."
The geniuses started to talk with each other, most of them were here for the chance of applying to the special unit created by the Emperor, Yun Jhin heard about it on the way to the demonic forest but he wasn't that interested until he heard that even the lowliest positions in the special unit would have higher political power and say in the empire even compared to the normal generals.
Yun Jhin wanted to infiltrate the Empire and became a high ranked official or army commander so he would be able to start eating pure dragon's without them realizing, and even if they realized they wouldn't do anything to him as long as he didn't touch anyone important, that was the power of political immunity!
Yun Jhin skipped this things in the lower continents and the middle ones as he had enough strength and he could also fool them well enough, but he wouldn't be able to do the same in an Empire that had 2 God Realm experts and maybe even some hidden reserves, there was no way the Empire would be so feared with only 2 God Realm experts, Yun Jhin guessed the other nations will try to poke around soon enough to see if their hidden reserves were still available.
Kong Luo cleared his throat as he continued talking:
"You can forfeit the training by coming out of the forest before 6 months, there are high chances you could die in the forest so if you want to give up now just come and stay here, you will wait with us.", He pointed towards himself the maid and the old man.
Yun Jhin watched as no one forfeited their chance at joining the new Imperial unit, then Kong Luo waved his hand and said:
"Ok then, since everyone is ready to go into the forest, I will make sure you guys get a head start."
Kong Luo created a gigantic palm that scooped the young geniuses then threw them at random inside the forest, Kong Luo made sure that even though they were thrown randomly he wouldn't choose the regions infested with very strong demonic beings, only those that were only deadly fatal, and not a 100% death factor.
Yun Jhin was grabbed by the palm and thrown into the forest like the others, he rolled like a ball as he impacted a tree making it shake, a brown snake dropped on his head and immediately went to bite his neck but Yun Jhin opened his maw and ate the snake whole.
He puked out black blood that came from the snake's poison and cleaned his mouth then stretched out his soul willpower and frowned:
"The radius of my soul willpower is a bit shortened due to the interference of all of these Dark Ebonite trees... but I can make sure I find the lair of the demon."
Yun Jhin knew that the demon must use some formations around his lair so he started to walk towards the direction with more natural ki, the more natural ki the better and sturdier the formation would end up, the same could be applied to demonic formations as well.
Yun Jhin's silhouette disappeared into the forest as he walked towards the highest concentration of Demonic natural ki that he could sense...

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Kong Luo's thoughts
chapters.content:
Kong Luo sat cross-legged at the entrance of the formation, on the surface he was meditating while keeping a straight face but inside he was pretty frustrated, he thought that he could use Yun Jhin's former memories to help him break through the limits of his talent but the Emperor saw trough him and summoned him to the palace in those 10 days that Yun Jhin had to wait.
Kong Luo bowed as the Emperor said:
"You should know why I have summoned you right now Kong Luo, and I will have to tell you to stop thinking about it."
Kong Luo's eyes widened in surprise, he never thought about his plans in front of the emperor so how could he know?
The Emperor smiled as he said:
"It's easy to know, after all, how could your ambition stop at the Sage Realm? You think you can strong-arm his knowledge out of him when he recovers his memories?"
Kong Luo didn't say anything but his silence was also a type of approval as he didn't shake his head, the Emperor continued to talk:
"Let me tell you something, if there was a way to help you, I would have done that already, do you think that I'm withholding cultivation secrets from you because you think I would fear you reaching the God Realm?"
Kong Luo shook his head frantically but The Emperor ignored his actions as he got up from his throne and walked slowly to him, in a few nanoseconds he was in front of him as he put his finger on his forehead, a bunch of information was directly transferred to Kong Luo's soul as his whole body shuddered.
He kneeled to the Emperor as he said:
"Thank you for making things clear to me your majesty!"
The information that the Emperor transferred to him told him whatever he needed to break through the Sage Realm in the future combined with a cultivation technique for the Sage Realm, it also told him why he wouldn't be able to reach the God Realm.
The Emperor sighed as he said:
"Just act the same with Yun Jhin, it doesn't matter how you act with him as his personality will change massively after he unlocks his former life memories, all I can say is that the only ones he will fear would be people as strong as I and my wife are, also I shouldn't even need to tell you but you know this information should be kept confidential, right?"
Kong Luo nodded his head, then he was dismissed by the Emperor, he knew that he couldn't do anything to Yun Jhin now, and even if he got the knowledge from him it didn't mean he would be able to use it.
Kong Luo sighed as he remembered what happened then he ignored everything else as he circulated the cultivation technique that the Emperor gave him, even though it was for a Sage Realm expert, he could still use it to hasten his cultivation progress in the Emperor Realm, after all, it was a superior technique to the one he used beforehand.
*******
Yun Jhin was walking around the woods of the demonic forest, he kept his eyes closed from time to time as he chose different directions, the smell in the woods was tantalizing and the aura in the air was trying to bewitch Yun Jhin to go into the directions it wanted.
The demonic forest was full of predators but Yun Jhin easily avoided them, from time to time he would also kill some new specimens that he didn't recognize and ate them to analyze their insides.
Yun Jhin ignored the temptations of the woods quite easily due to his strong mentality and willpower but the others wouldn't be able to do the same in his situation, atleast in the deep region that he was in, maybe only Lulu could resist.
Yun Jhin walked deeper into the woods as he chased the higher concentrations of natural energy, after a few hours of walking he finally reached a dark clearing in the forest, there was nothing inside it, it was so empty that you would think that nothing lived in this forest.
But Yun Jhin knew that it was only an illusion as he felt the clearing to be covered with formations, he wasn't sure if the demon was home but he would need to investigate regardless if he was here or not, as long as he was stealthy he could insure his life.
Yun Jhin frowned as he analyzed the formations around the clearing, they were some pretty high ranked demonic formations from hell, even though Yun Jhin was 'friends' with demons and devils that didn't mean they would share their formations with him, fortunately, he got his hands on all of the basic formations of hell and with his knowledge, he could reverse engineer the formation to the most basic form that he knew, however, that would take him quite a while. But the thing that he lacked now the least was time.
Even if the demon left or entered the clearing, with his current cultivation base his stealth technique would make him invisible to everyone below the 5th stage of the Sage Realm.
Yun Jhin continued to reverse engineer the formation while other things happened in the forest...
The fatty was currently 'attacking' one of his colleagues, she was a female that couldn't escape the fatty's grasp, unfortunately for her, the fatty didn't let her go until he was satisfied, she was of a noble family and she abhorred the fatty but she couldn't do anything besides crying and trying to push him away, it seemed the fatty's cultivation was quite high as the female was at the 2nd stage of the King Realm.
This was the scene that Lulu saw when she walked a bit deeper in the woods, she took a long sword out of her spatial ring as she lunged at the fatty ready to cut his member in half!
The fatty disappeared into a bunch of mist as he retreated into the woods, his eyes were deep red, it seemed he couldn't control himself due to the temptations of the woods and he attacked the first female he saw.
Lulu frowned as she looked at his glazed red eyes and then averted her eyes away from him as he was still naked, the female colleague that was attacked got up slowly while still shaking from fear and disgust, Lulu protected her while she got herself some new clothes from her spatial ring and they looked as the fatty disappeared in the woods, Lulu sighed as she said:
"It seems the fatty's mental aptitude is quite bad, even though he is lecherous I'm not sure if he would do that by himself..."
The female colleague glare at the fatty's direction then she grabbed Lulu's sleeve as she said:
"Could I follow you from now princess Lulu? what if I'm attacked by such a type of beast again?"
Lulu nodded her head at her then she patted her shoulder to comfort her, the woman wasn't a virgin but being attacked in such a ferocious way could leave a lasting mark on her, it would have been even worse if it was her first time, atleast she looked less shaken now.
Lulu found out that women weren't the only thing the fatty fancied as he found some naked men with their butts up here and there as well, they were moaning in pain as they had been deflowered by a 'crazy red-eyed fatty'. It seemed the fatty wouldn't be able to control himself and he would pierce everything that moved...
As Lulu walked further in the forest she even saw poisonous animals such as spiders, lizards, and some huge bugs laying down in exhaustion. She was getting more and more disgusted with the fatty, most of the wood's temptations only accentuated the sins in one's heart, could the fatty be such a big pervert?
Fortunately, as she went further inside the forest she finally started to see less and less of that perverted fatty's rampage.
She promised herself that even though the fatty was influenced by the forest, she would still cut his tool so he wouldn't be able to hurt anyone else in the future!
There was quite the crowd behind her now but it was still within her means to protect, as the princess of the Empire she thought that protecting her people was something that she needed to do.
While the fatty was piercing everything under the heavens, Yun Jhin was finishing the reverse engineering of the demonic formations, he was just one step away from finishing when he heard the rough breathing of a pig-like animal behind him.
As he turned his head back to see what it was he realized that it was a naked fatty! His eyes were red and glazed as he looked at Yun Jhin like he was a piece of meat, Yun Jhin frowned as he threw out his baby dragon which grew a little bit compared to before.
The fatty immediately went and pinned down the dragon before he took his tool to attack the backside of the poor thing, the dragon immediately started to blew fire breaths towards the fatty, the fatty started to sweat as the fire, roasted his body turning it a deep red color.
The baby dragon was currently at the second stage of the King Realm but his fire couldn't do much to the fatty!
While the fatty was preoccupied with piercing the dragon Yun Jhin appeared behind him and stabbed his hand in his back, however, before he could withdraw his hand with the prized possession he realized that he was stuck in the fatty's layers of fat!
Yun Jhin frowned as he unleashed a dark green fire inside the fatty's chest burning all of his fat away while he took his heart out of his chest, Yun Jhin looked down at the fatty's heart as he threw it towards the dragon who ate it happily, the stiff body of the fatty was still trying to do the 'act' to the dragon who was now getting away from the body.
Yun Jhin's eyes glowed as he devoured the fatty's soul and gained some success in the refining of his first jewel, reaching the 3rd stage of refining in one go and he was almost ready for the 4th one.
Yun Jhin sighed as the baby dragon ate the body of the fatty leaving nothing behind, what a crazy fatty he was, he even wanted to pin down an artificial dragon, fortunately, the dragon didn't have a gender nor did he have any bodily needs, since the fatty couldn't find any hole at the back he then wanted to go to the front, that was the moment he started to get roasted by the dragon fire.
The fatty's memories were a blur to Yun Jhin, most of them seemed to happen when he wasn't even conscious, it seemed the fatty was missing a part of his soul for some reason and that's why he had such a one-sided mind.
Yun Jhin ignored all of the useless memories from the fatty and finished reverse engineering the formation, then he entered it after he put the baby dragon back into his spatial ring.
Yun Jhin realized that the clearing was only an illusion but he didn't think he would enter a cave, the cave was very spacious and it was pitch black, as Yun Jhin walked further inside, strange images started to pop in his head, but they were all empty!
Yun Jhin realized that this was the innate-aura of the demon nobility, this type of aura would try to bewitch the demon's enemies to make them weaker before they attacked, it shown the deepest desire that the person envisioned, since Yun Jhin didn't know how true eternal life looked all he got was blank images, he didn't even imagine it and even if he did, people with such type of desires wouldn't fall easily to the demon's aura.
The aura would be more useful against people like that fatty or greedy people.
Yun Jhin walked further into the cave until he reached a deep room inside, on a steel spikes bed sat a old man in a cross-legged position.
He wore a dark uniform and a cape, his white hair dropped to his shoulders, he had a curved nose that looked like the beak of a raven his eyes were closed and his arms wasn't visible, but Yun Jhin could feel a deep demonic presence from his left one.
Yun Jhin took a better look at the old man as he thought:
"It seems the demon took over this old man's body... he must be injured as only his arm remained..."
Demons could live as long as their soul wasn't destroyed, it would be even better if a part of their body remained as they could parasitize a host and use it to recreate his body.
However it seemed that the old man didn't want to give up fighting the demon, his eyes opened a dark green flame-like energy burned into them, he looked around but then he shook his head as he said:
"Since this demon got to me I always think that I'm watched by someone..."
It seemed his intuition wasn't wrong this time as Yun Jhin was truly looking at him, but due to his stealth technique unless he revealed himself the old man wouldn't be able to see him, or that's what he thought...
Suddenly under Yun Jhin a demonic eye appeared, it was of the same color as the old man's it blinked for a few times before it exploded quicker than Yun Jhin could act, a very small piece of Yun Jhin's soul threatened to be removed but Yun Jhin held onto it.
Yun Jhin frowned deeply as the old man opened his eyes and said:
"It seems I wasn't wrong, who knew that being paranoic would help?"
He made his left arm visible as an invisible attraction force threatened Yun Jhin's location, the man chuckled as he said:
"Let's see which rat scurried in here..."
Yun Jhin couldn't dodge the force in time and he was struck by it, suddenly the man's demonic hand was almost near his neck!
Yun Jhin realized that he made a mistake in this situation, he couldn't be familiar with each demon's unique ability and that cost him a bit here...
But he could feel that the old man didn't have a very high cultivation base, as long as he played it well he would be able to escape.
The man's demonic hand grasped Yun Jhin's neck as Yun Jhin's invisibility turned off, the man frowned as he looked at Yun Jhin's body and said:
"A little halfling dared to enter my den?"
The man exerted his green demonic arm as he wanted to rip Yun Jhin's soul out of his body!
Yun Jhin's eyes glowed as this was a good time to counter-attack, while the man thought that everything was in his palm, Yun Jhin charged his own soul attack that directly went to the man's forehead!

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Fight
chapters.content:
Demons had special unique abilities that they were born it and evolved according to their cultivation base, even though Yun Jhin fought a multitude of demons in his past lives, it didn't mean he would be able to remember all of the abilities they exhibited, after all, would you remember the ability of an ant you squashed under your foot?
Yun Jhin's mental attack transformed into an invisible bullet-shaped soul attack that hurled directly to the man's forehead, it hit him directly shaking his soul and making him drop Yun Jhin from his grip, Yun Jhin became invisible as he used his stealth technique again and hid in the shadows.
The man's eyes widened as the dark green flames in them intensified, he shouted:
"You don't know what you have done you little rat!"
Dark feathered wings grew out of his back as his dark aura intensified, his power increased as he shot out 5 bolts of energy out of his demonic hand, the eldritch energy rampaged around the cave, like an unleashed beast as it hit the ground randomly.
Yun Jhin dodged the energy bolts by a hair width as some of them almost impaled him on the ground, he couldn't throw out his baby dragon as it would be useless in this fight, he gritted his teeth as a lightning bolt appeared above his hand, the energy used by Yun Jhin alerted the half-demon and he shot more energy bolts at him.
Yun Jhin took two bolts to the stomach as his lightning bolt skewered the now raven-looking man, it hit him directly in the chest as a cloud of blood appeared.
The cloud of blood crystallized then broke into the form of the elder man, he didn't seem injured at all but there was something different about him, a demonic voice could be heard out of his mouth:
"Thanks for your help little halfling, the way you dealt him such a delicious blow, it made me able to control his body for some time..."
Yun Jhin ignored the mad ravings of the demon, his lightning only temporarily disabled the man's body, even though the demon was talking like nothing was wrong, his veins could be seen pulsing in an attempt to try and move his body.
Yun Jhin charged directly to the man as he punched him while he was immobilized, the punch made him fly into the ceiling of the cave and beyond, the cave started to collapse as Yun Jhin followed the man through the gravel, both of them appeared outside the cave in the demonic forest.
The ruckus startled the demonic animals and attracted predators, but the formations laid down by the old man were still active, dozens of mutated animals fell like flies as they died, their blood essence was devoured by the formation and in return gave to the old man.
The old man smiled as his injuries healed but then he frowned as he clutched his face and shouted:
"NO I JUST GOT OUT TO PLAY, YOU CAN'T PUT ME BACK IN THERE!"
A grunt could be heard as the man's personality changed back to what it was before, he coughed a mouthful of dark blood as he glared at his left arm, he looked at Yun Jhin's injured body and said:
"It seems I did a number on you."
Yun Jhin ignored him, it seemed the man wasn't stable at all when he attacked him in the cave, he seemed to be calmer now and less offended.
The man sat down on the ground which puzzled Yun Jhin, then he opened his mouth and said:
"I'm sorry if I frightened you, where are you from young man?"
Yun Jhin wasn't sure if the man was trying to fool him or if it was anything else, but Yun Jhin decided to play along as his injuries healed, it was a fight between two old foxes trying to outsmart each other at this point, Yun Jhin opened his mouth and asked:
"Shouldn't you introduce yourself first?"
The man laughed as he said:
"Yes, how rude of me, my name is Sardo, former general of the 1st legion of the Empire, tell me boy you are from the Empire as well aren't you?"
There were a few empires in the upper region and so Yun Jhin wasn't sure which one he was talking about, but there was a high chance of it being the one he joined recently...
Yun Jhin talked a little bit about the Empire and the man's fiery eyes intensified, there was hatred and also disappointment in them as he said:
"So you are from the Zumo Empire, that goddamn old Emperor Zumo Taicheng he even sent assassins out for me!"
The man demonic hand reacted as an attraction force started to appear around Yun Jhin again, but Yun Jhin jumped out of the attraction force area and shot a few energy bullets at the old man trying to pin him down to the ground, the energy bullets were shaped in the form of sharp sticks, if the impaled him to the ground he would be able to kill him instantly by decapitation.
The man's arm created a forcefield around him that deflected all of the energy bullets, the bullets hit some trees behind him that made them groan seemingly like they were alive.
Yun Jhin ignored the Dark Ebonite trees groans as he circled the old man, from what he said the man was a former general of the Empire, but his cultivation base was quite low, he should have been crippled in action and exiled by the emperor for his hatred to be this accentuated to the empire.
Yun Jhin watched as the man's arm continued to glow with an eerie dark green energy, he seemed to struggle controlling it as the demon from inside wanted to take control again, this was a good opportunity for attacking!
Yun Jhin dashed and seemingly teleported behind the man's back but he heard a chuckle coming from his front:
"You thought that it could be this easy to kill me, boy?"
The same wings as before unfurled on his back as a dark green aura engulfed the man, the aura started to stretch and engulf Yun Jhin as well, Yun Jhin's vitality started to drop as his life force was forcefully drained by the man.
Yun Jhin quickly jumped away from the old man's aura area but an attractive force pulled him back inside it, after the attractive force stopped, eldritch dark green energy bolts assaulted his weak body which created a pool of blood below him.
This was the hardest fight Yun Jhin went through since his reincarnation, and that was because the man was lucky enough that his demonic eye that he shot at random in the cave revealed him.
Yun Jhin was quite injured and he couldn't trigger his forbidden technique again, but suddenly a shout could be heard coming from ahead of him, Lulu jumped down from a tree as she tried to bisect the old man but she only clipped off one of his dark wings.
The man howled into agony as more bolts of energy tried to engulf Lulu, but she dodged easily by jumping backward making a big space between her and the demon, Yun Jhin took this opportunity to launch three big blue fireballs at the old man, the fireballs met with their destination as the man was burned quite badly by them.
Seeing an obvious opening Lulu dashed inside the man's aura sacrificing a bit of life force to cut his chest open!
Lulu appeared behind him as she grabbed Yun Jhin and tried to run away but an attraction force stopped both of them from leaving and dragged the duo into the man's aura field, the aura started to drain the boh of them of life force as the man's injuries started to heal, however, it seemed he was running low on ki.
Even though the aura stole life force it didn't recover the man's ki.
But it wasn't of much help to Yun Jhin and Lulu at the moment, Lulu came alone as she left everyone behind as they would be baggage to her, so there weren't going to be any reinforcements.
Lulu gritted her teeth as she took a second sword out of her spatial ring and took a stance, her left foot was in front and her right a little back, she stood with her head down as both of her swords were held vertically in front of her body.
She disappeared from where she stood as fire engulfed the old man's body when she appeared a white aura was around her and she vomited one mouthful of blood.
She looked as the man was immolated and dropped to the ground thinking that everything was done, but Yun Jhin and she were out of his aura range so he wouldn't be able to heal any more, and the technique she used wouldn't stop until his body would become ashes!
She started to lose consciousness as Yun Jhin approached the burning man as his life draining aura stopped working, her eyes closed but in the last moment, she saw how Yun Jhin severed the man's strange arm away from him and kept it inside his spatial ring.
Yun Jhin looked down at the ashes remaining from the man's body and shook his head, he wanted to give the body to the little dragon so he could improve his strength, but it seemed he couldn't now.
The dragon caterpillar walked slowly towards Lulu's downed form and put her on his back, he wanted to devour her but the Empress must have put her soul under surveillance, anyone who killed her would be marked by her consciousness and hunted down, this wasn't something he wanted.
He would also need to use her to get into the imperial family, she still had her uses so he decided to let her live for now.
Yun Jhin met with the others and most of them were either scared or trying to be brave, as they didn't have much experience, even though they killed some beasts here and there with the help of Lulu, their thoughts were still very shallow.
Most of them were glaring at Yun Jhin as he came back with Lulu on his back, the women didn't care much but the men were glowering in hatred, after all, the woman on his back was a beauty!
Her two mounds were pressing on Yun Jhin's back and it made the men glare harder at Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin ignored their gazes as he walked away from their group, some wanted to stop him but seeing the injured form of the princess they stopped, Yun Jhin didn't know much about the princess but according to her previous interactions with him, he wouldn't make a good impression of her if he sent her to the protectors outside the forest as it would disqualify her.
Yun Jhin found an empty clearing where he prepared a camp and used a healing technique on her to help her wake up faster, after a few hours of meditating the woman finally woke up to Yun Jhin's visage that looked over her.
Lulu frowned as she looked around and realized that they won the fight and sighed, then she asked Yun Jhin:
"How come you found this guy in the forest and you didn't ask for help before engaging him?"
Yun Jhin chuckled awkwardly as he said:
"Well he found me before I could call for reinforcements, but there was also some luck involved for him."
Lulu frowned as she thought that Yun Jhin's abilities weren't as much as her mother made them be, but then she remembered how he slashed away the man's demonic arm and didn't comment, even though his cultivation base wasn't high he was ruthless and knew when to take openings meaning he had extensive battle experience, so what he said couldn't be a lie.
Lulu got up from the ground but she grimaced as she looked at her hands, the technique she used broke her fingers and injured her cultivation base a bit, she would need quite a while to recover from her injuries.
Yun Jhin got up and stopped looking at her as he said:
"Since you woke up my job here is done, You saved my life and I saved yours, if I let you there you would have been food for the animals of the forest."
Lulu frowned as she looked at Yun Jhin's back, was this man so heartless that she would let such a beautiful woman as her alone and injured inside a dangerous demonic forest?
Yun Jhin's silhouette started to disappear as he walked away from her, it seemed the answer was yes.
Lulu grimaced as she took out some healing herbs from her spatial ring and started chewing on them, as she thought:
"Atleast the clearing he found is pretty safe..."
Yun Jhin tried to find a place where he could absorb the demonic arm and gain its memories, it seemed the man's soul also refuged into it as he could feel the arm move inside the spatial ring, it was a battle for supremacy between the demon and the old man, he didn't care who won as the one who did would absorb the memories of the one who lost.
In the end, their memories would be his along with their soul power that he could use to refine his crown jewels further.
Yun Jhin started digging in the earth around a rather poor place where no animals or humans would want to go, then he covered himself in the dirt around 200 meters inside the earth.
Even though the soil of the demonic forest was quite hard, Yun Jhin's body was very sturdy and he could easily live underground like a mole, Yun Jhin took out the demonic arm and inspected it before he started to absorb its quintessence and refine the two souls inside of it.
Soul screams that sounded like wraiths came out of the arm, because it had no host anymore, both of the souls were rather weak and easy to refine, but it would still take him a little while as the soul's willpower wasn't broken.
He would grind them down, bit by bit, and then absorb both of them as no winner was made between them up till now. It was better for Yun Jhin anyways, he would be able to enjoy more starlight from their souls so he could refine his jewel further, he might even break through the middle stages.
Yun Jhin continued to refine the arm with closed eyes, he wanted to know where the entrance to hell was located, even though it would be a long while before he would go for it knowing the direction he had to go would be very good, even if the entrance disappeared, he would be able to find the remaining demons or devils around the area and scour their souls for the new entrance!

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Another batch of memories
chapters.content:
The demonic arm started to fizzle and pop as Yun Jhin refined it using his ki, the old man's soul was slowly getting refined and absorbed by Yun Jhin's and his first jewel was getting clearer and shinier, slowly but surely he reached the middle stages of the 1st jewel, he now sat around the 5th stage.
Memories started to flicker around Yun Jhin's face as he looked through the old man's life for useful information:
"Born as a noble, trained as a general, lived a long life but one mistake made me lose my cultivation base and position in the Empire."
"Countless nations fell to their knees as I attacked them with the 1st legion, increasing the Empire's land to the current one, reaching the peak of the Emperor realm, breaking through the Sage Realm..."
"One loss against a 14-year-old girl with three swords, left alone to die on the battlefield by my subordinates. A demonic raven approached me to eat my almost dead carcass, but what I could see in its eyes was the soul of an injured demon."
"The being tried to take my body but I resisted with all my will power and sealed him inside my left arm."
"I went back to the Empire, only for the emperor to call me a criminal who betrayed the Empire and its people, cultivation crippled and banished to the middle regions, I lived a life of a cripple of three years before the demon started to act up and heal my broken meridians..."
"Slowly but surely my body accepted the demonic ki that the thing was feeding me, transforming my quintessence into something half-dragon, half-demon."
"In the end, I started to rely on him..."
Images popped up one after another, since the man's youth to the man's death, Yun Jhin frowned as his quintessence flesh and blood would have helped kickstart his evolution to an artificial caterpillar, atleast he would have a rather pure draconic essence to work with.
Most of the memories of the old man consisted of battles and wars, he was once called the grand general as he didn't lose one battle until he met that 14-year-old girl, her image was blurred in his memories, maybe it was his way to cope with the fact he got almost killed by a teen girl, but that girl defeated a Sage Realm expert at the 3rd stage, even though the fight was rather close, the age difference was enormous.
Yun Jhin frowned as he recalled that woman, it had been 200 years since that battle happened, she must have grown by an extreme amount by now, her innate talent would be on the level of top-ranked executives even in his former sect.
The memories didn't tell him much as some of them were suppressed or missing, the man's mental power was in disarray when he died, it might have been due to the similar way of his death and near-death situation, both by swordsman women.
Yun Jhin made a mental note of the woman and decided he would ask around later, he needed to know who he had to avoid and who he could confront.
After he fully finished devouring the old man's soul he moved onto the demons, the demon's soul was shivering inside the husk of an arm as it pleaded to Yun Jhin:
"Please don't refine me, I will take you as my master!"
"I will do whatever you want, please don't kill me!"
Demons embraced life and hated death, they liked to provoke pain and suffering on others but abhorred the same happening to them, they were the ultimate hypocrites, the same could be said about devils, but unlike the demons, they hid their tendencies on a front of posh etiquette and contracts.
Yun Jhin knew the demon was faking this act, if he let him go or tried to enslave him, he would immediately go and try to devour his soul, he wouldn't be able to, but Yun Jhin didn't want to waste time with him.
The demon's soul started screeching in pain as it distorted, it was originally of green color, but now it turned a deep red one, its eyes were full of malice as it cursed at Yun Jhin:
"I curse you to die a death worse than mine by one million times! I curse you, you damn piece of trash, we will meet again in hell!"
Yun Jhin face couldn't be more passive as he said:
"No, we won't."
The demon's soul quintessence and memory broke up into energy that Yun Jhin devoured using his innate jewel skill, multiple different memories started to swim in his mind, the egg chamber, the sweet embrace of the demonic egg...
Escaping from the egg before dying of suffocation, devouring your siblings to survive... death, decay, a burning wasteland, cliffs...
The early memories of a demon were all the same, in the context that most of them were born weak and through devouring, they became stronger and improved their talent, in the end, the demon ended up breaking through the King Realm and gained a name, a cultivation technique, and met with the devils, the devils abhorred him and threw him to the demon's city.
The city wasn't something the demon was accustomed to so he left hell after tens of years of slaving into the city for the information of the location of Hell's gate.
He went out of hell and the location in the mortal plane was... Yun Jhin's eyes widened as he didn't recognize the place where Hell's entrance was, but after he replayed the memory more times he finally started to get an inkling of where it was supposed to be.
It seemed the blood throne sect perished without him!
Hell's entrance was in the former headquarters of his sect, however, they were deserted and looked like hell itself descended on them, he could only recognize that it was his former sect's headquarters after he inspected all of the small details, such as the building placements, ruins, runes, and the destroyed formations.
Yun Jhin didn't care much about the sect as it was only a means to an end, from what he saw, it seemed hell decided to ride his sect after they heard he died, well it wasn't the wrong thing to do from their perspective, after all, he cheated them of quite a few contracts, the devil arch lords were fuming and he also ate some demon lords... He would be more surprised if nothing happened to the blood throne sect while he was gone.
The demonic arm in his grasp finally turned into ashes as nothing sustained it anymore, Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he dug out of the earth and looked around, there was no one around so he filled the ground again and left, he didn't leave any ki behind so no one would know what he did here.
Yun Jhin started to wander around the forest but didn't go very far into it, he would from time to time, harvest some herbs or kill some mutated demonic beats and keep their hearts or their other useful organs, from his inner clock he could say that almost 24 days passed since they entered the forest, unfortunately, he couldn't go and kill some of the geniuses as he wanted to, it seemed they were all gathered up by Lulu and she was protecting them.
He could see that because there weren't many demonic beasts anymore and only the useful herbs that they couldn't identify remained, Yun Jhin didn't mind much that he couldn't eat them, he found it to be more of an annoyance, after all, they were mostly half-lings in this batch, there were very few pure dragons left and Yun Jhin needed to eat them. However, this Empire was one of the relatively weak Empires in the upper continents.
From the old man's memories, he got to know that there were other 2 Empire's divided by a sea and a gigantic jungle, both of them had peak god realm experts, even though they only had 1 each, A peak god realm expert could kill any other God Realm expert below the 9th stage no matter what.
The Empire he was currently in was the brother of the Empire from over the ocean, and also a vassal of it, the Emperor was the son of the peak God Realm expert, and the name of the main Empire was the Luo Empire, the jungle one was called the Bumi Empire and both were named after their peak god realm experts.
Yun Jhin could count himself lucky that he ended up in the weaker empire as he could still eat pure dragon's if he was crafty enough, but if he ended versus a peak god realm expert, he could kiss goodbye his only remaining chance of breaking through the shackles of the universe and reaching true eternal life!
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt someone approach him and he turned his head back to look who was coming from behind him, it unsurprisingly was Lulu.
Lulu walked a little bit closer to him as she said:
"I have been looking all over for you, it's almost time to leave, there are 6 days left and the others were wondering where you went, also thank you for the healing back there."
The girl flicked her hair behind her as she put her hand on Yun Jhin's shoulder and her eyes hardened:
"Might I know what have you done with that demonic arm?"
Yun Jhin nonchalantly responded to her as if it wasn't a big deal:
"Would you believe I refined it?"
Lulu frowned as she didn't know about Yun Jhin's reincarnated status, so looking at his cultivation base she thought that he was lying, after all, to refine a demonic entity would require strong willpower and a cultivation base of atleast 5th stage of the King Realm, at the 5th stage you would get a jewel that would immensely increase your soul and mental capabilities, that's why one would need to refine demonic entities at this stage, or else there was a chance they would be entranced by the sweet promises of the demon and led to the demonic path.
Most organizations hated hell and anyone who dealt with them, so it was normal Lulu looked a little bit concerned after she heard that Yun Jhin refined a demonic arm by himself.
Yun Jhin looked at her and then said:
"If you are concerned something's wrong with me, you can come to the Emperor with me and make him inspect me, I won't oppose that."
Lulu stopped frowning as she heard his words then took a few steps back, she looked a bit startled by something but Yun Jhin couldn't really see what it was, did she fall for him already?
But that wasn't it, atleast yet, Lulu grasped her spatial ring as she took out a communication stone and looked in it, her eyes widened as she said:
"Our colleagues got attacked by a... it doesn't say what they got attacked by, it seems the communication stone got interfered with at the last message, we need to rush back to help them!"
Yun Jhin looked at Lulu then stopped her by grasping her shoulder, Lulu looked puzzled at him and Yun Jhin opened his mouth and said:
"This is a survival exercise meant to toughen up all of them, you should realize that accidents are bound to happen, you can't save everyone nor you have to, what will you do if the demonic entity that attacked them is stronger than you are? Would you lie your life down for people that you barely know?"
Lulu shook her arm from his grasp as she glared at him and said:
"As one of the princesses of the Empire, I must take arms like every other talented cultivator and protect my people, regardless if they are weak or strong and regardless of the opponent even if he or she is beyond my abilities, I would rather die on the battlefield than let some of my people die when I could do something, I thought you are a pretty different guy than the others, but all I see in you is a coward!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he responded to her:
"Call me a coward would you? Ok, I will go with you, there was nothing I had to do anyways since you love your people so much I will help you save them."
Lulu calmed a little after she heard his response but her face was still icy, but then she remembered that Yun Jhin was an outsider as he came to the Empire with the help of general Kong Luo, of course, he wouldn't be attached to the Empire or its people!
He must have lived a hard life, Lulu's eyes softened as she looked at Yun Jhin follow her from behind, she used her fastest speed and he could somehow keep up with her, she was interested in what other kinds of tricks he had up his sleeve besides his elemental attacks.
After moving through the forest for tens of minutes they finally reached the camp where most of the 'genius' cultivators waited for Lulu, the camp was in shambles as bloodstains were scattered here and there, there were even some limbs scattered around, but there were no heads or internal organs, from what Yun Jhin could see, some of them must have been crippled to make an example.
It seemed that what attacked the camp wasn't any normal demonic beast.
Lulu looked around and came with the same conjecture as Yun Jhin and her face paled, however, her pride didn't let her go out of the forest and ask for the people outside for help as she would technically be disqualified, she didn't want to throw out the chance of shining in her mother's eyes for the lives of others, even though she talked about saving the others she was also selfish in her kind of way, she would rather throw away her life than disappoint her mother.
Yun Jhin looked at the conflicted expression on her face and patted her shoulder then said:
"Let's go, they left a lot of marks behind, we can easily track them, and yes I know it might be a trap, but didn't you say half an hour ago that you needed to save them regardless of the opponent or situation?"
Lulu nodded at him and wanted to go ahead but Yun Jhin stopped her and said:
"Let me go ahead, stay behind me, I have a special stealth technique that will make the both of us invisible so we won't fall into the enemies trap, Ok?"
Both of them disappeared as Lulu stood near him, both of their bodies almost brushed by each other and Lulu found this to be an unknown experience to her, after all, she talked to men before but never touched one this intimately.
Lulu took her mind of these things as she had to help the captured 'geniuses'.
Yun Jhin slowly followed the blood marks left on the ground as he reached an indigenous camp after a few hours of tracking.
There he found the captured 'geniuses' along with some natives of the forest, and the natives were currently boiling the 'geniuses' into a gigantic black cauldron while patting their bellies and waiting for the feast.
Yun Jhin found the image to be quite funny. Lulu didn't and she almost ran out of Yun Jhin's stealth zone to attack directly, her youthful hot-headedness took a hold of her but Yun Jhin stopped her in the nick of time and said:
"We need a plan to get in there, atleast a diversion would be needed, we can't go there and hope to kill everyone easily, there is a high chance they might just kill the others or threaten us with their lives."
Lulu nodded as she was ashamed of her act, then waited for Yun Jhin to give her the plan.
Yun Jhin thought for a few moments before he opened his mouth to tell her the plan he concocted.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Natives
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin told his plan, it was a fairly simple one:
"I will be the bait and you will go and take your colleagues out of the cauldron."
Lulu nodded her head at Yun Jhin, the plan was very simple but she would lie if she didn't think about his safety so she asked:
"Are you sure about this? What if they catch you?"
Yun Jhin smiled at her and waved at her indicating that it wouldn't be a problem at all, he already scanned their cultivation bases and most of them were around the 2nd to 3rd stage, the reason the geniuses were caught was that most of them were around the 1st stage with a few over the 2nd and reaching the 3rd.
It would have been better if Lulu would have been the bait but if the natives weren't dumb they would realize her cultivation base was higher than theirs, from the looks of it even though they weren't as dumb as animals they weren't that far from it, however, due to living in the forest their instincts must be extra sharp so they should know they would enter a trap if they followed someone with a higher cultivation base than theirs.
But if it was someone with a lower cultivation base they wouldn't think much about it, they would just think it was someone they missed when they caught the others.
Yun Jhin made himself visible as he let out a little bit of his aura leak, the natives smelled the air like animals would and they started salivating as they spoke in their language:
"There should be another one we missed, I can smell his aura!"
"Yes, this one seems special, like a fat piggy!"
"Should we go and investigate?"
"The others are tied up and boiling, they won't be able to do much."
They nodded at each other as they left in unison leaving the 'geniuses' all alone in the cauldron, Yun Jhin slowly walked away from the camp leading the others by leaking his aura here and there, Lulu jumped towards the cauldron and cut the ropes that kept all of them tied together.
Most of them started crying, as some of them were armless or legless, some of them were just a torso and after they were cut from each other fell in the cauldron and almost drowned in the soup broth, but the others caught them and dragged them out.
Lulu sighed as she looked at their miserable appearance, even though only a few of them got crippled that meant their futures were over, only Sage Realm practitioners could recover their limbs after they were cut off and it would take them quite a bit of internal ki to do that.
Lulu helped all of them away as she looked in the direction that Yun Jhin took the natives, she would first get the people on her side to a safe place before she followed him to help!
Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the natives run around in circles around him, it was very easy to play with these dumb natives that worked only on instincts, they were too dumb to realize they have been led away from their 'food'.
Yun Jhin finally made himself fully visible to them making them hoot and holler in happiness, they threw themselves directly at him trying to catch him, they took out a bunch of dark ropes from their grass skirts and attacked him!
Yun Jhin made a few dodges as the native's attempts at catching him were rather poor, his speed was more than double theirs and his skill was also quite above, even though their cultivation base was higher it didn't mean much to Yun Jhin as they weren't trained in an orthodox way, to him who trained in peak cultivation techniques they were country hicks while he was an Emperor.
After waiting for enough time Yun Jhin guessed that Lulu should have saved all of them so there was no reason to play with these people anymore, Yun Jhin made a few handseals as formations surrounded the natives and started crushing them.
The natives hollered and cursed in their language as they tried to get away, but the gravity formation just continued to crush them into the ground, after a short while they all became meat patties on the ground. Yun Jhin devoured their spirits, but they were very lacking in quality even though there were around 20 natives in total, all their souls did was only refine his 5th stage jewel by a quarter, this was very disappointing considering they were all above his cultivation base, but they didn't know any techniques, Yun Jhin wondered how did the others get caught? Were these 'geniuses' really trash?
Before he left he let his little dragon out to eat the meat patties on the ground so he could get some nutrients.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he walked away trying to track the others, after a short while of wondering in the woods he found some marked places, Lulu should have marked them so when he came back he would follow them to their new camp.
After tracking the signs for a short while he finally found the camp, Lulu was ready to set out and come to help him but when she found out he came back alone with no injuries, she was really surprised.
She came forward to him and patted him on the shoulder, looking him up and down then said:
"It seems I have underestimated you again, you sure are a strong guy, did you kill all of them?"
Yun Jhin nodded at her then said:
"You owe me one for this, I will go now..."
Lulu tried to stop him and so did the crowd of geniuses who all walked forward and bowed at the same time while saying in unison:
"We wish to thank you Yun Jhin, you have put forward your life to save ours and we are grateful, please stay with us we want to give you something."
Yun Jhin shook his head and said:
"I have to say one thing to you all, what kind of trash geniuses are you?"
The crowd immediately became sour as they heard Yun Jhin's words, comparing to him they were indeed trash geniuses, they were so many but they got abducted by around 20 natives with their sophisticated cultivation techniques how could they have lost so bad to a bunch of mutated native trash?
The others wanted to defend themselves but a tall genius around the 3rd stage of the King Realm came forward, he missed an arm and his face was still a bit bloody from the torture that he went through and he didn't have time to clean it up till now. He bowed to Yun Jhin again and said:
"I know we are all trash and we didn't deserve your help, this is all I can say for me and my colleagues, however, due to your actions you made quite a few friends in the capital, even though most of our families don't have pure-blooded patriarchs, we are nobility after all, and when you will need help, regarding politics or anything else, you can come to my Luo household."
The others interfered as well, but some people also held grudges because Yun Jhin called them trash, however, even though they were weak they weren't dumb, most of them lived in a politic heavy environment and they recognized Yun Jhin's heavy martial talent, in the end, no matter how many politics were involved, in a world such as theirs, the heavier fist won, not the more eloquent mouth.
Yun Jhin nodded at them but didn't say anything else, he left them behind but Lulu followed him as she said:
"You know, you don't have to go, you can stay with us. Only 6 days are remaining until we can leave and I'm not sure if any other natives will appear, after all, we can't be sure those twenty were the only ones who live in this gigantic demonic forest. There must be a village full of them and we need to protect each other!"
Yun Jhin chuckle turned into a burst of full-blown laughter as he heard her words and then told her with a cold voice:
"Protect each other? Your highness Lulu, do you understand that what you are doing is counterproductive to the actual meaning of this training?"
Lulu shook her head as she said:
"What do you mean I..."
Yun Jhin cut her off as he continued speaking:
"Let me tell you something, Lulu, most of the people here were meant to die, I and you are the only exceptions, most of them are trash, you should have looked at them, I'm pretty sure they are the dead-last talented in their families and they were sent here to become food for the natives, their families wanted to get rid of them in the form of a 'training exercise'. How can you be so blind?"
Lulu's frame shook as she heard his words and then said:
"No you are wrong... you are wrong, I'm supposed to protect them, even though I have been sent here to do other things I can't let my people die in front of me!"
Yun Jhin shook his head, the Empress didn't educate her in such matters as she only trained her rigorously and let her personality develop by herself, Yun Jhin didn't know what kind of experiences she had in her childhood that made her such a protecting fool.
Yun Jhin opened his mouth and said:
"I met countless people like you on my journey from the lower continents, do you know what happened to them?"
Even though her personality was like that, that didn't mean she was dumb, she smiled self depreciatingly as she said:
"They are all dead right?"
Yun Jhin nodded and said:
"Not even their bones remained, in such a world like ours it would be better to stop thinking about the others and think more about yourself, I'm only telling you this because you are the daughter of the Empress, if you were anyone else, I would have just let you die the moment you came to help me fight that old man, do you know why?"
Lulu shook her head then looked at Yun Jhin in the eyes as she said:
"I don't care about your reasons, I know that you are rather detached from life and the well being of others due to the things you went through, I can't force you to change nor I can but you shouldn't force your beliefs in other's throats."
Yun Jhin laughed again as he heard her words and Lulu was suddenly on the ground as a gravity formation popped under her, Yun Jhin walked slowly in front of her as he looked at her from above and said:
"My 'beliefs' you said? These aren't beliefs, this is what you need to survive in this world! You are strong, smart but dumb at the same time, this can only be lead from being inexperienced, I'm only a little bit older than you but what I have gone through shaped me into what I'm today, I can only tell you this, I'm different from you in more ways than one."
She struggled to her knees as she got up forcefully in the gravity formation but Yun Jhin placed a palm on her shoulder which made her fall to her knees again, then he turned off the gravity formation as he walked away, with his back facing her he waved and said:
"We will meet again when we leave the forest, also all I can say was that it was a dumb decision to save these people, you will see when we return to the capital, they will either die due to an accident or poisoned."
Lulu shook her head, she didn't believe in Yun Jhin's words, after all, her mother never taught her anything about politics yet.
Yun Jhin silhouette disappeared in the forest as Lulu returned to the camp, she helped patch up the others and then went hunting some mutated animals.
Yun Jhin did the same as her as he went around killing animals and taking herbs, some of them would be useful for pills in the future.
Time went by quickly as the 30th day passed and they were ready to leave the forest.
Due to the entrance being on the same path, Yun Jhin and Lulu met each other quite early but they didn't talk at all, only Lulu glared once at Yun Jhin then ignored him. The others tried to curry favour with Yun Jhin but he ignored them, they were dead men and women after all.
After a short while of walking, they finally reached the entrance and meet with Kong Luo, the elder and the maid from the Song family. The maid was visibly happy as she didn't see the fatty come out of the forest.
Kong Luo nodded at Yun Jhin, he could see that there was something different about him but he couldn't point what, maybe he unlocked some of his former memories?
The Emperor would be extremely happy if that happened, maybe he would even get his retirement earlier so he could go into closed-door cultivation.
Kong Luo created another flying boat out of ki as the maid and the old man infused it with ki, both the maid and the old man had creases on their foreheads as they counted the returning disciples, they were too many!
But they didn't say anything as they made all of them jump on the boat and return to the capital.
They would take care of them back home then...

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Back to the capital
chapters.content:
The journey back to the capital was silent, no one talked about what happened in the forest, most of them were traumatized by the events, Yun Jhin scoffed seeing their blocked visages, the more they thought about what happened the more their PTSD intensified.
Lulu herself didn't get to see what other horrors the others did when they were kidnapped so she was pretty much ok, the only thing that bothered her was Yun Jhin's actions and words, how could her people do something like that?
Since she was young she saw herself as a hero in shining armor that would protect her mother and her subordinates which led to her wanting to protect everyone in the capital.
Yun Jhin looked at her troubled expression and chuckled inside, she will be hit very hard when she will see that he was right.
Kong Luo maneuvered the ki ship easily as they approached the giant wall that divided the middle and upper continents, the teleportation formation was ready and Pei Fong was also here now, the man talked a little bit with Kong Luo before he told him that he wanted to talk with Yun Jhin by himself.
Kong Luo didn't know what to tell Pei Fong, after all, Yun Jhin was pretty much a national treasure at this point, anyone that could reach the god realm would be heavily invested into.
The general also couldn't tell him the true reason he couldn't waste Yun Jhin's time, after all, the Emperor said that no one else should know of this without his permission. Kong Luo liked his head on his shoulders.
So he refused Pei Fong and left the wall using the teleportation formation along with Yun Jhin and the others.
Immediately when they appeared inside the capital, some of the royal guards were led to the formation and invited Yun Jhin to the palace, the other 'geniuses' thought that the invitation would be lent to them as well, after all, they still thought that surviving the training course would let them join a special unit that the Emperor would create.
However, the first thing that happened when they returned was that some of their family members came and took them back to their families, most of them weren't sure why they were rushed back to their families but they didn't dare to question their relatives.
The maid chuckled happily as she returned to the Song family to report her success, the old man sighed and left by himself going to his own family, and Kong Luo went back to the army brigade as he wasn't invited along with Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin entered the palace and met with the Emperor who questioned him on his endeavor, Yun Jhin told him that he unlocked some his memories but they were very faint, he even gave him a cultivation technique to make it look true, he only gave him the first half and told him the other part was too blurred to understand.
The Emperor believed him for half, and the other half doubted him thinking that he didn't want to share the whole cultivation technique with him, even though he wasn't lacking in techniques, it was still quite an impressive one even for his standards, even though he couldn't cultivate it, he could give it to one of his halfling sons, however, he would need the second half for that to happen.
Yun Jhin told him that he would send the other half as soon as he deciphered it. The Emperor wanted to get the other half of the technique as soon as it was possible so he gave Yun Jhin a room in the outer skirts of the palace and told him to cultivate in there before he would be assigned another training course.
Yun Jhin entered his new room and chased away the half-naked maids from his bed, he wasn't in the mood currently.
He was ready to close into the 6th stage of the refinery of his jewel, his accumulation from the natives wasn't anything great, but with it combined with a little bit of cultivation could make him reach the 6th stage.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he sat cross-legged on the bed and attracted the starlight from the outer atmosphere of the planet, the starlight fell directly on his head as it fused with his jewel, the jewel shined with peculiar green energy, as the wraiths inside of it howled and cried in panic and pain, seemingly as if they understood that after Yun Jhin reached the 9th stage and refined his jewel fully, they would all perish and be absorbed fully by the jewel.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he finally reached the 6th stage, he made a small progress from the training course that the Emperor gave to him, he also gained the location of hell's entrance, but going back to the blood throne sect was an endeavor that wouldn't be easily achievable, at the least he would need to be a Sage Realm expert.
The Blood Throne sect was created around the southern hemisphere of the universe, the 4 symbols planets of the 4 sacred beasts were situated around the northern center, the dimensional portals he would have to control and use would need him to be at the Sage Realm to utilize.
There was also the fact that only Sage Realm cultivators could survive outer space without any treasure's help. He would also need the approval of the overlord of the planet to leave it, that meant gaining huge merit or currying favor.
