Yun Jhin sighed only if he was stronger... He would just massacre everyone and take what he wanted, only if he had this system in his previous life, he would have sacrificed everything to devour the needed amounts of races to evolve into something akin to a fortuned constitution.
Even though there was only a chance a fortuned constitution could break through the limits of the universe he had to take it!
After all, he already tried everything else that could be done and he failed, the only other way would be to gain a body that could reach the rank 10,000.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as some knocks could be heard at his door, he could feel the aura of Lulu behind the door!
Lulu entered before he could say anything, she looked like she cried for a bit, she approached Yun Jhin and wanted to talk but Yun Jhin interrupted her:
"Did they already start executing them?"
Lulu nodded she wanted to cry her grief to Yun Jhin but she was interrupted again:
"Did your mother scold you because of what you did?"
Lulu's eyes widened as she looked at Yun Jhin, her tears dried a little as she looked at him and wondered how he could see through her so easily, then she remembered his words and shook her head, he already told her what would happen but she ignored him thinking that it was only his negative side speaking. Now she realized that all of his experience wasn't for show.
Lulu approached him and bit her lips, she wore very light clothing that highlighted her curves, her tender white skin, her peach-like lips, her sizeable bosom that waved up and down, it seemed her mother sent her here to seduce Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin chuckled inside as she looked at her attempts to get near to him, for others, such a cute side of a woman would trigger their innate beasts and she would have gulped up by now if it was anyone else, but Yun Jhin could control his desires and even exterminate them if needed so.
That didn't mean he didn't enjoy the sensation, he just could decide when he wanted to do it and he couldn't be forced to do it.
Yun Jhin waved his hand at her and said:
"Your mother should have told you the other reason that she wanted you to pursue me besides my pure bloodline right?"
Lulu nodded her head as her body shook and she said:
"Mother said that you are a reincarnated cultivator, is it true?"
Yun Jhin nodded nonchalantly and said:
"From what the Emperor and the Empress told me it should be this way, it's the only reason I can explain the memories seeping through my mind, they aren't my own but it feels like they belong to my soul. It's truly strange you know?"
Lulu shook her head and tried to approach Yun Jhin but he stopped her and said:
"Even though I admire you as the opposite sex, this isn't the way to build a relationship, Lulu it's a bit too early to move this far, don't you agree with me?"
Lulu nodded her head as tears seeped again from her eyes, she ran towards Yun Jhin but not in the same way as before, she cried a little bit in his bosom to unload herself, this was the first time her mother was so hard on her and forced her to do something without her input on the thing at all.
She just told her:
"You will have his child and this isn't something you can argue about, now go and make me a grandmother, make sure you gulp his seed till he can't move any more!"
At first, she was embarrassed then she realized how her mother was forcing her on a relative stranger that she only knew very less about, Yun Jhin wasn't ugly he was talented and had a bright future to him, but she didn't know much about him besides the rumors that flew about.
Yun Jhin sighed as he patted her back and let her unload then he asked her:
"How could you come here, this is the territory of the emperor and I'm sure he still holds a grudge for what happened at the dinner from a while ago."
Lulu explained how she didn't find any resistance as she was dropped to his courtyard then let near his room, it seemed that even the Emperor approved of the Empress youngest daughter to end up with him.
It looked like they wanted to see what his child's bloodline would look like. Yun Jhin wouldn't mind satisfying their curiosity as long as he got benefits out of it, but it was still a bit too early for that, Lulu would also bear a grudge on him if he forced himself on her right now, and he needed her to be cooperating in the future.
After Yun Jhin finished comforting her and all of her tears dried up he told her the following:
"You should go back to your mother and tell her that even though I like you, it's a bit too early for this type of relationship, I'm also more interested to unlocking my former life memories first before anything like this will happen in the future, go now, I have to meditate."
Lulu nodded her head slowly as she left his room and then disappeared, she reappeared back in the Empress's garden and she stood in front of her, the Empress looked at her with narrowed eyes as she listened to the message from Yun Jhin and she snorted:
"That little bastard doesn't know that his personality might be altered once he fully recovers his memories, would he even look at you after he regains his pride as a God Realm cultivator?"
But what Yun Jhin said was also reasonable, he didn't know Lulu for a lot of time, when it came to arranged marriages the woman could say no and nothing would happen, but if the man said no the marriage could fall and break, so even though men could force themselves on women, women couldn't, unless they were stronger or had a bigger backing. This was just how a society based on strength worked, even the Empress forced herself on countless men due to their innate talent, some of them were unwilling but the Empress didn't take a no from them.
The Empress wanted Lulu to take the same approach, but unfortunately, her youngest daughter wasn't overwhelmingly stronger than Yun Jhin so she couldn't force herself on him, and even if she did, if Yun Jhin was unwilling and complained to the Emperor things could go ugly for her, she would need to cough up some resources and benefits to cool her husband's temper.
When she talked with him regarding the union of her daughter and Yun Jhin, he only agreed if Yun Jhin was willing!
This was giving face to a future pillar of the Empire, since the Emperor was sure that Yun Jhin would fully unlock his memories and reach the God Realm.
The Empress thought the same and that was why she wanted to secure his bloodline so she could have something over him in the future as she wanted his support as well.
She looked at her daughter then said:
"From now on follow him wherever he goes, make him fall in love with you regardless of what you have to do, do you understand? We need to secure his bloodline!"
Lulu bit her lips but in the end, she nodded her head and didn't disobey her mother, she just couldn't, her whole life she thought that her mother wanted the best for her and this was the only time she thought that her mother didn't know what she wanted. It wasn't that she hated Yun Jhin or wasn't interested in a relationship with him, but this was too forced for her!
...
Yun Jhin left his room as he wandered the capital, he looked around and gathered information, he needed to know about the danger zones in the upper regions, even though he recognized some of them from his memories, there were also some new ones that he didn't know about.
He would be sent to a new danger zone until he would unlock all of his memories or die, that's what the Emperor wanted from him, Yun Jhin already had all of his memories but he wouldn't tell them or they would suspect him and his reasons for joining the Empire, after all, would a God Realm expert want to be the subordinate of anyone else even if he couldn't help it?
The answer was of course not!
Even though the danger zones wouldn't unlock him further memories he could still benefit from such expeditions, after all, danger zones were full of benefits, herbs, and animals that have been mutated by the environment that Yun Jhin could use.
He already gained some herbs that he could use to concoct a pill that could jumpstart his first jewel refinery to the 9th stage in one go, but he still lacked a few ingredients that couldn't be found in the capital, the Emperor would also not give them to him if he asked about it, in the hopes that he could get them by himself when he was sent to a danger zone and help him unlock his memories.
Yun Jhin sighed as he finally finished gaining all of the information about the danger zones then went back to the outer skirts palace room, he would first go through the new information before waiting for news from Black Blood, he would come soon with the new location he would be sent to, if he guessed right, only him and Lulu would be sent there for 'tempering' purposes.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Danger zones
chapters.content:
There were around 5-6 danger zones in the upper continents, 2-3 in the middle continents, and 1 in the lower continents.
The danger zones in the upper continents were the most deadly and beast infested zones, most of them stood at the apex of elemental concentration, just like the Demonic Forest stood at the apex of demonic energy stored into the mortal realm.
A danger zone was called a danger zone because only the top 10% of cultivators could benefit from it, those being the ones at the Sage Realm or above, while the others below could technically survive in such conditions it wouldn't be beneficial for them at all.
Take Lulu, for example, if she lived in the demonic forest for a long time she might end up like those natives if she didn't protect her body constantly with her ki. Being infested with demonic ki wasn't necessarily a bad thing, but when the world was filled with self-righteous people who denounced the demonic path, it could as well be deadly.
Yun Jhin finished reading on the new danger zones, he knew of the first four but the last two were new, one was under the ocean that separated the Empire that Yun Jhin was with its brother the Luo Empire.
The other one was in the jungle near the Bumi Empire.
There wasn't much news about these two danger zones as they newly appeared one hundred years ago, some rogue cultivators found them while they searched for treasures, All three Empires tried to send men to them but only very few came back and most of them became crazy after they returned.
With Yun Jhin's experience, he knew what these two danger zones could entail, one of them was either the birth of a new hybrid while the other must be a tomb. Most tombs had formations that would turn the intruders crazy, as for the hybrid, it must be a special mental based race that strengthened itself countless times, this types of hybrids were different as they couldn't take human form, they were born with a body around the rank of 8,500 and they couldn't improve it further.
Their cultivation would also stagnate around the 9th stage of the Sage Realm but they would be born in the Sage Realm and they would have a very high battle power to the point that they could fight weaker God Realm experts.
Yun Jhin crossed both of these zones out of being sent to, one was too dangerous for him, and the other couldn't be reached normally, it would mean sending him to the Luo Empire then the Luo Empire would need to smuggle him in the jungle which was the territory of the Bumi Empire.
The remaining four danger zones were based on the four elements, they had an excess of elemental power in them that made them extremely dangerous, the four zones consisted of the Volcanic Region, The dead Earth Region, The Violent wind Region, and the Icy Water Ocean.
All of them reached the extremes of the four elements and they weren't habitable environments, just like the demonic forest the one who enters these regions would have to continuously use their ki as a shield to protect their bodies and souls from being battered by the intense elemental ki that assaulted their senses, souls, and bodies.
Yun Jhin's soul wouldn't have a problem to endure in such conditions but his body was weak, he would need to continuously use his ki like everyone else.
He sighed as he marked the zones that had the materials that he could use, he wouldn't be sent very far in the danger zones so he could only gather herbs from the fringes, but even those were considered rather rare and extraordinary in the eyes of those below the Sage Realm.
While Yun Jhin was making his plan inside his room, Black Blood was talking with the Emperor inside the palace:
"Your majesty, are you sure you want to send Yun Jhin and her highness Lulu to all of the danger zones available to us?"
The Emperor nodded at Black Blood as he responded to the Eunuch:
"They will stay in each zone for 10 days each I will send in them formations that would lock them into the zone once they enter it, you follow them around but don't send them to the zones, they should go by themselves, the tempering of the four elemental zones was something I and my wife did in our youths as well."
Black Blood nodded and didn't comment as the Emperor waved his hand at him and said:
"Go and summon both that girl Lulu and Yun Jhin, I will install the formation in them right now and then send them on their way, Yun Jhin needs to unlock his memories before our brother Empire gets the news of us having a reincarnated person in our ranks..."
The Emperor still had ambitions to break off from his father's empire and officially stop being a vassal.
Yun Jhin and Lulu entered the throne room at the same time and the Emperor didn't even bother to talk with them as he inserted two inscribed energy cores into the bodies, they easily fused with them and the Emperor said:
"Black Blood should have explained to you how things will go through with this training exercise, good luck to both of you!"
Yun Jhin nodded and before he left the throne room he used his soul willpower to give the other half of the cultivation technique he presented to the Emperor beforehand, Lulu bowed meekly then left as well.
Yun Jhin had changed his outfit and applied formations on it that strengthened it's resistance to the four elements. He now wore a black tunic, gray armored pants, and military boots, over his body he wore a green cloak with the symbols of the four elements in a circle on it's back.
Lulu wore a special red armor with small patches here and there, these patches radiated elemental energy and seemed like they could absorb and release elemental energy.
She also had both of her swords on her back instead of her spatial ring for quick accessibility.
Yun Jhin didn't have a weapon as he didn't need to use one up till now, besides using the weapons of the previous bodies that he possed, he didn't get to use many weapons, the first thing was because he couldn't find a good enough weapon for his main body, the second thing being was that he didn't need to use one up till now.
But the cultivation beasts and animals living in the four danger zones would need specifically enchanted weapons to be slain, they could also be slain with your bare hands but it would take more time and it would be less efficient.
So Yun Jhin decided to craft his weapon before he left for the first danger zone, the Emperor didn't truly say when he was supposed to leave, even though he sent them away he didn't throw them out of the capital.
Yun Jhin went inside his room on the outskirts of the palace, Lulu followed behind him without saying anything as he already explained to her that he needed to make a weapon that would help them during this new training session.
Lulu wanted to assist and observe how he created the weapon as she thought that it would help her on her swordsmanship path.
Black Blood stood in the shadows as he observed as well, he was curious about Yun Jhin's weapon refining technique.
Yun Jhin started with a bunch of handseals as he opened his spatial ring and started to throw in herbs and metals he found in the demonic forest, he already moved all of his other materials from his spatial bag into the ring so he had everything he needed with him.
Beast cores, poisonous herbs, different colored metals that corresponded to the four elements, spirit stones.
All of them melted inside the formation as Yun Jhin used his inner ki fire to burn them and refine them, quite a lot of slag was extracted from them as they were purified by his inner fire.
He threw the slag away as when it left the formation it turned into dust then disappeared.
Only a multicolored piece of metal remained inside the formation, Yun Jhin started to shape it into a katana's shape, the body was of a normal steel color with fire wave patterns on the back, it had a red handle and an average height for a katana, on the handle appeared a black stone with four colors on it, the current part of the stone was on red but then it changed to blue, so its handle changed to the blue color as the fire wave patterns from its back changed to water wave patterns.
Yun Jhin nodded at his weapon, it would be a useful weapon for the current situation and he wouldn't have to worry even if he ran out of ki as he could use the sword to protect his body.
The formation stopped as the katana hovered to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin already had a sheath prepared for it, as the katana entered the sheath, the sheath turned into the same color as the handle but with a lighter color.
Lulu didn't stop observing until the end, she was pretty impressed by Yun Jhin's blacksmithing technique, she didn't have much experience with blacksmithing but she could understand that what Yun Jhin did here showed that he was a very experienced blacksmith.
Yun Jhin dabbled in countless professions in his countless lives, he knew a lot of everything so he could pretty much do whatever he needed to survive in whatever situation that popped up.
Black Blood realized that Yun Jhin held some information from the Emperor but it was only natural, after all, how could Yun Jhin trust the Emperor up till now, as the man didn't do anything that would warranty the young man's trust.
Yun Jhin tied the katana to his hip and then left the capital with Lulu, Black Blood followed them from behind like a shadow to make sure they went to the destination.
Lulu and Yun Jhin already memorized the location of the four danger zones so they didn't stray from the right path at all, after a few days of walking the air started to heat up as they reached a plain.
In the middle of the plain, a lava river stood, and beyond the lava river, a gigantic Volcano stood proudly there as lava flowed down from it to the river, near the river stood some animals that drank from the river.
The animals looked like lava golems made from melted rocks, as some of the lava they drank dripped from their empty eyes or the cracks in their bodies.
This was how the animals that lived on this plain evolved since the Volcano appeared.
Yun Jhin looked around for a short while before he went into the direction of the lava river, he would need to pass the river to be considered in the danger zone as the formation core inside his body didn't trigger yet.
Lulu followed slowly behind him as Black Blood roasted some meat and watched from afar, the Emperor didn't say he couldn't have a few snacks while the youngsters trained.
Yun Jhin finally reached the lava river but the animals there didn't get scared and run away, instead they started to growl as lava started to fall on the ground burning it to cinders and widening the lava river by a small amount.
Yun Jhin didn't say anything as he unsheathed his katana as its handle turned a deep blue color, he slashed the animals so fast that they didn't realize what happened before they turned into frost sculptures broke, and died, their pure fire energy cores stood where they died and Yun Jhin picked them up and put them inside his spatial ring.
Lulu narrowed her eyes inside as she saw Yun Jhin's sword skills, she realized that she couldn't truly see through them!
Yun Jhin snapped his fingers to take her attention as he waved his sword again creating an ice bridge over the lava river, as they were both King Realm experts they couldn't truly fly yet, the river was quite wide and they wouldn't have enough ki to support their pseudo flying capability until the end so they would instead fall in the river and burn to death.
Yun Jhin took the front as he walked on the ice bridge and Lulu followed slowly behind him, Black Blood felt pretty impressed by the abilities of Yun Jhin's katana and he thought that he should ask to make him a weapon as well after they returned from this training expedition.
After around 10 minutes of walking, they finally went to the other shore of the lava river and were officially inside the danger zone, both of their formation cores started to tick inside their bodies, after they stopped ticking that meant 10 days would have passed and they would be able to leave.
Yun Jhin sighed as he started walking towards the direction of the gigantic Volcano, he wouldn't dare to approach it too much, but the good herbs and beast cores wouldn't lay near the shores of the lava river, as the concentration of fire energy was the smallest there.
Lulu didn't say anything as she followed behind him, she was there to temper herself while trying to win Yun Jhin's heart at the same time, she knew that talking with him wouldn't win his heart so she was ready to launch an attack the moment a strong opponent would come. The few animals at the outer rings of the lava river didn't count as they weren't even in the King Realm so she didn't bother to deal with them.
Yun Jhin also ignored the weaker beasts and animals, unless they attacked him he wouldn't deal with them.
After a short while he finally found a herb that he could use for his pill, it was guarded by a 4th stage King Realm short ape that salivated lava near the herb, it was ready to eat it.
But Yun Jhin and Lulu intervened, after she saw Yun Jhin lunge towards the beast, she decided to make a quick work of it to show how useful she could be!

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Fighting the elements (1)
chapters.content:
Lulu wanted to directly slice the short ape into two and end it but the ape looked up from the fire herb on the ground and started to beat it's chest as it showed its rock fangs to them and shouted:
"OHOHOHOH AHHHH"
It seemed it wasn't an intelligent animal as it couldn't talk, even though its cultivation was relatively high it seemed to not develop intelligence at all, it had the average IQ of a normal ape.
Lulu's sword slashes directly went to the rock animal's neck but her sword got stuck inside its thick neck.
Lulu frowned as she tried to recover her sword, but its big rock paws swiped towards her head and tried to choke her, she backed away and let go of her sword. The sword now sat in the things neck and Lulu had only one sword on her back now.
Lulu didn't understand how her premium strong sword couldn't slash through the ape's neck, even though it was made of rock, if she put her whole force in her slash she could slash through two or three mountains!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he saw Lulu's poor attempt at killing the beast, he gave her a try to see more of her abilities, he knew about her trump card but wasn't acquainted with all of her other abilities, it seemed he overestimated her, she didn't even realize that her swords weren't going to do well in this type of environment even after he saw him forge a new sword.
Yun Jhin unsheathed his katana as he slid his fingers on the blade dripping three drops of blood on it from his cut fingers, the blade started to emanate a cold wave of energy as it turned into a frost blade.
The cold energy started to anger the ape as it beat it's chest and took out the sword from its neck and started to wield it, it didn't have a good swordsmanship form and it only took the sword to try and imitate Yun Jhin and Lulu.
The ape jumped creating a small crater where it stood previously and appeared in front of Yun Jhin.
But Yun Jhin wasn't in the same spot as before, he appeared where the ape stood and quickly unearthed the fire herb that the ape eyed and stuffed it into his spatial ring after he used his ki to seal its properties.
The ape became extremely angry as it saw its food being taken away, it slapped its chest aggressively as he used the sword to slash at Lulu as she was nearby, Lulu took a defensive stance but she was almost sent flying by the ape, even though it was 2 cultivation realms below her, it's innate strength was higher.
That didn't stop Lulu, she gritted her teeth as she closed her eyes for a split second before breathing in and out, when she opened her eyes she was behind the ape and the ape now had three deep cuts on its chest that dripped lava.
The ape looked at the cuts then started screeching like the mad animal it was, it threw the sword away as it rushed towards Lulu its mouth was open as it tried to bite Lulu's head off.
Lulu wasn't scared as she flashed around the ape trying to disorient it, she picked her sword from the ground where the ape threw it and clashed both swords together, she was ready to use another attack. However, her eyes widened as she saw the slashes on the ape's chest heal up.
Yun Jhin decided he had seen enough after he saw the ape starting to heal, if Lulu would have had some appropriate weapons the ape would have been dead by now, she did well enough, Yun Jhin appeared in front of the ape and thrust his katana deep into his chest before he rotated it, an explosion of ice occurred inside the ape's chest as it transformed into an ice sculpture starting from its fiery insides.
The ice sculpture broke seconds later as a shiny beast core dropped to the ground, the beast core started to melt the ice pieces that remained from the ape, Yun Jhin used his ki to cover his hand then picked up the core. Then he used a caging technique to seal the core and he put it in his spatial ring.
Lulu was breathing quite hard as the environment started to take a toll on her, she sheathed her swords as she looked at Yun Jhin and asked:
"What do you think we should do now?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he took out a pill from his spatial ring and threw it to her then told her:
"Eat this pill, it should quickly recover the ki that you used, we are going to search for more herbs, this is only one that I need, we still have 10 days of waiting in this region before we have to move to the next one, I'm also feeling pretty unthreatened at the fringes of the region, we will need to go in further."
Lulu nodded slowly at him then she asked with a meek tone:
"Could you help me enchant my swords with some frost formations... I don't think they would be able to last long in this environment."
Her premium strong swords were almost getting melted by the heat around, only her ki reshaped them into a normal form. Yun Jhin took both swords from her and did a few hand seals, some ice formations were inscribed on the blade of the swords which made them resistant to the heat. They would also do more damage to the living beings inside the danger zone.
Lulu gave Yun Jhin a big smile and a peck on the cheek after she got her swords back, Yun Jhin ignored her kiss and then said:
"Now that I enchanted your swords we will go further in, I'm very interested to see which kind of memories I will unlock now."
Lulu kept quiet as they started to walk further into the region, one day passed this way, on the way to the volcano they met with a few beasts similar to the ape that they dealt with, they also got the other herbs that Yun Jhin needed, he only needed 1 more before he could say that he gained whatever he could from the region considering his cultivation base.
Yun Jhin played on the Emperor's hands on the surface, but the reason he truly wanted to go to the four danger zones was that the second stage of the King Realm required the four elements to be inscribed in his jewel, with the four elements in one jewel he would be able to expand on his abilities in the future and gain a perfect elemental body, while his body might change and evolve since the crown was fused with his soul, his perfect elemental body would transfer.
The pill he would create with the herbs and inner beast cores from the four regions would make him able to rush to the 9th stage of the refinery of the first jewel and maybe even break through the second stage of the King Realm, the pill also helped with creating the four elements jewels, technically speaking, most other King Realm practitioners would get to have 1 jewel per element and that would take space on the crown limiting their future potential and battle power.
Lulu was this way, she already embedded her crown with 4 elements and was on the 6th stage, the 1st stage was the awakening of the most important ability, the 2-5th stage would be the four elemental jewels, the 6th one would be the bodily strength enhancement, the 7th the soul one, the 8th would be another ability that would strengthen the battle power of the practitioner and the last one would be the coup de grace of the King Realm expert.
The 9th stage would combine the former abilities and enhancements from all of the former jewels and strengthen them up to a factor of x3, granting an overall boost to the practitioner's body and soul while also giving him a new combined ability, this is why King Realm experts at the 9th stage were called true kings, they were so powerful no other people in the same realm would be able to do anything to them and they could kill whole armies of people under the 9th stage.
As Yun Jhin went further inside the danger zone, Lulu could observe that his clothing was special just like his sword, it protected him from the innate heat of the lava around them as well as the arid environment meaning he didn't even sweat, her armor was different in the sense that it absorbed all of the fire elemental energy in the air and released it when she battled with the mutated beasts, however, it was detrimental for her as the elemental energy made them heal up and strengthen themselves. So Yun Jhin told her to suppress the release part of the armor in fights.
Such an armor would have been quite useful in normal fights, but in such an environment it would be useless to deal with the mutated beasts born from fire and molten lava.
Yun Jhin and Lulu were around 1000 kilometers away from the volcano and they couldn't go further as the heat that bared upon the duo was making them sweat intensely even with the help of their special treasures.
Yun Jhin looked around as a deep blue light appeared in his eyes, he was searching for the final herb, even though 10 days already passed he didn't leave the danger zone as he needed to gather the herb, the Emperor also didn't say that they specifically needed to leave the danger zone after 10 days went by.
Black Blood himself was quite puzzled why the duo didn't leave the danger zone as he observed them using his soul willpower, he saw how they gathered herbs and killed beasts here and there but the Empire already had such herbs and they could ask for them from the Emperor after the training expedition ended, why would they risk their lives for herbs?
Yun Jhin looked around for a short while before he spotted the herb he needed, it was shaped like a red snake and it lived in a nearby lava puddle, it was hissing intensely as it sensed Yun Jhin's gaze, the herb was special as it was alive and dead at the same time, once it left the lava it would become inanimate but as long as it sat in it, it would act just like a normal living snake.
Yun Jhin watched as the snake dove into the puddle and made itself unseen, however with the help of his eye technique he could see that it was still in the puddle hiding, taking the snake out of the lava would be quite an annoying ordeal but he could do it.
He slapped his arm a few times as countless frost formations took over it, then he took a black glove out of his spatial ring and put it on his left hand, the glove contracted on his hand with a swish sound as it turned deep blue, an icy crystal appeared in the middle of it as Yun Jhin quickly plunged his hand in the lava puddle.
The snake hissed as it tried to bite Yun Jhin's gloved hand but that was what Yun Jhin wanted, the snake hisses turned from aggressive into those one made in pain as it's little body turned into frost, Yun Jhin took it's body out of the lava puddle as the glove burned to ashes and his arm along with it, he grasped the icy snake with his right hand as he burned the ice layer off and then caged the snake inside a formation, even though it looked dead on the surface, it could revive in any moment in this type of environment.
He put the snake inside his spatial ring and looked as Lulu's eyes wandered to his missing arm, he chuckled as he patted his armless shoulder and said:
"It will grow back."
Lulu didn't question him, after all, his current body wasn't his true one, it was just his body being compressed into an ideal form that he wanted using ki techniques, he wasn't at this full potential in this form but he could use quite a lot of techniques easier, even though he was lacking in raw strength in this form, he could make it up with quite a lot of techniques, this was the difference between humans and cultivation beasts it was skill vs strength.
Yun Jhin and Lulu started to retreat from the danger zone and after a long while they exited it successfully without a hitch, they were stopped by some other mutated animals along the way but they made quick work off them, however, Yun Jhin's arm still didn't grow back.
Yun Jhin knew how to restore his arm even while being under the Sage Realm, he was a God Realm expert in his former life and even though it wouldn't grow back under normal circumstances, he had countless ways to restore it.
Even though he was missing one arm, Yun Jhin didn't seem any different, Lulu questioned him a few times on the way why his arm didn't grow back, but Yun Jhin replied that it just wasn't time yet.
Lulu became skeptical after a few days passed and they neared the earth danger zone, would Yun Jhin's arm truly grow back? Wasn't that the power only those at the Sage Realm and above enjoyed?
But Lulu decided to not comment further, in the end, they had two God Realm experts holding the fort, they must have a way to restore his missing arm right?
Yun Jhin knew what Lulu was thinking about and it made him happy that she started to think like that about him, that meant he was slowly entering her heart without her knowing it, sooner or later he would be able to enjoy himself as the Imperial Prince in the Empire, then he would be able to move way easier in the upper continents as long as he said that he didn't run for the throne, as long as he knew where to thread the enemies of the Empire wouldn't be able to touch him.
Lulu exclaimed as she looked down at the giant canyon in front of her and said:
"What a big hole... do we have to jump down in it and live inside there for 10 days?"
"Yes."
The formation cores inside their bodies were already reacting, seemingly as if they tried to push them from the cliff directly inside the canyon!
Yun Jhin patted Lulu's shoulder then pushed her forward making her free fall down from the preposterous cliff then jumped himself soon after while he said:
"Ladies first!"
Angry shouts could be heard from below him, some were even threats but Yun Jhin ignored them as at one point he used his ki to slow his fall then he gripped a big rock slab that stuck out from the canyon wall and looked below him, Lulu was also gripping one such slab as she glared at him then freed one hand to give him the middle finger.
Yun Jhin ignored her childish attempts at angering him then started to climb down using more rock slabs that appeared more and more on the way down.
Slowly but surely the formation cores inside both his and Lulu's bodies were starting to act up, meaning they would soon reach the outskirts of the earth danger zone!

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Fighting the elements (2)
chapters.content:
The underground of the canyon was dark and wet, the earth element danger zone was one of the oldest danger zones on the upper continents as it was the first which appeared.
It went like this, earth>water>wind>fire, the four elements amplified and restrained each other the earth came to create life but life couldn't be sustained without water, then oxygen was needed so air came and with air came the wind, the fire was the least, humans found it when the wind was too harsh on them, the combination of wind and water created ice then winter, for the ancient beings to survive they needed heat so fire appeared.
Since the earth element danger zone was the oldest it didn't mean it was the most dangerous one, on the contrary, it was the meekest one due to the nature of earth being accepting towards everyone.
Most of the beings that lived in the dark canyon were giant bats and yellow gigantic moles, the bats would hunger for blood from time to time, but as long as you didn't attract the mole's attention they wouldn't do anything to you as they were workaholics.
As long as they could create tunnels they wouldn't bother with anything else, the earth region also regenerated by itself so the tunnels that the moles made disappeared with time, but that didn't stop the moles, they loved to work more for some reason and they took the earth regenerating as a test of that Gaia the Earth Goddess gave them.
Yun Jhin didn't come here for the beings inside anyways, he came for the rare herbs infused with earthen energy hidden deep inside the canyon, and well the training expedition the Emperor forced him to take on.
As soon as Yun Jhin and Lulu's feet touched the ground a gravity field appeared that started to push down on them, while Yun Jhin was ok Lulu fell to her knees and started gasping for air, Yun Jhin's body was refined to beyond even it's maximum capability but for Lulu, only her ki cultivation was something noteworthy.
Yun Jhin sighed as he watched her struggle to get up from her knees but this was sort of tempering for her as well so he didn't help her as he started to walk further inside the canyon, Lulu gritted her teeth as she forcefully got up from the ground injuring her internal organs in the process, a little bit of blood seeped from the corner of her mouth as she followed Yun Jhin's footsteps.
Yun Jhin looked behind and he wasn't surprised seeing her following him, but her complexion was quite pale and she didn't bother to clean the blood seeping from her mouth as she used all of her willpower to follow him, she was trying to show him that she could endure everything that he would throw at her.
Yun Jhin liked this kind of attitude in a woman, it meant that she could do everything for him and she was easy to manipulate.
Yun Jhin decided to give her a helping hand as he threw her a pill from his spatial ring, she ate it without asking anything as she started to trust Yun Jhin, she didn't think that the pill he gave her would do anything to harm her.
The pill indeed healed her damaged internal organs and helped her to breathe easier in the high gravity environment.
Her body strengthened a bit due to the energy of the pill in combination with the heavy gravity.
Lulu smiled at Yun Jhin showing her pearly white teeth and then continued to follow behind him, she was quite disappointed as Yun Jhin ignored her smile but decided to do her best in any future confrontations.
Lulu frowned as she looked around, it's been almost 3 days and they found nothing, no herbs, and no living beings!
Yun Jhin knew where the moles and bats where but he didn't want to fight them, he didn't need Earth cores for the pill and only the herbs but due to the pill not needing earth cores for the pill composition to be balanced meant he needed rarer herbs or a higher quantity of them and he didn't find any herb up till now!
Yun Jhin frowned as he used his soul willpower to scan around the dark canyon, he couldn't identify any scent or spiritual energy that would resemble an earthen herb, all he could find where the moles underground them and the bats above them, however, the distance between them was very long so if he didn't aggravate them they wouldn't do anything to him.
Yun Jhin wasn't sure on what to do here, going in further would be the right idea but they were already quite far in, Yun Jhin wasn't sure if Black Blood was even following them anymore at this point, the surrounding gravity and darkness made his soul willpower quite fuzzy, even though his soul was quite strong right now it still wasn't up to par.
The gravity was tearing and slowing his soul willpower so he couldn't look in his surroundings for much time.
Lulu was in the same situation but it was way harder for her, the first time she released her soul willpower she collapsed to the ground and almost choked on blood, her soul was garbage compared to Yun Jhin's, even her body couldn't stand in the gravity for much time without Yun Jhin's and her armor help, how would her weaker soul fare?
Maybe she would be able to handle it after she constructed her soul jewel, but right now she was unable to.
Lulu wanted to sit down and rest for a bit but Yun Jhin didn't wait for her as he walked further and further away, Lulu frowned as he watched his silhouette disappear from her eyes then she gritted her teeth and continued to walk catching up to him.
Yun Jhin enjoyed 'training' Lulu it was quite the good past time activity besides searching for herbs and not finding any, it made him a bit happier.
After 7 days from the entrance, they finally found one herb that Yun Jhin could use but it was in a quite poor condition, but with some formation magic Yun Jhin restored it to its former glory and put it in his spatial ring, he could only do so because of the surroundings that were heavily infused with earth elemental energy, he also had to keep the herb grounded for the time he used his formation on it if it was removed before he finished nourishing it his efforts would be wasted.
Fortunately, the herb was quite of high quality after he restored it to its original power and he would only need a second one for his pill, however, after 3 more days passed he couldn't find any anymore!
He couldn't go further in or even his body would start to fail him and he would need to use his ki to protect it, meaning his battle power would take a hit, Yun Jhin knew that deeper inside the earth danger zones were gigantic demon toxins scorpions and he didn't want to deal with them.
He was missing an arm and his battle power would also drop the moment he went past a certain boundary, Lulu was already baggage and she wouldn't be of much help, but he also needed one last herb...
He could use his stealth to go inside but it would waste even more ki to keep it up, Yun Jhin looked at Lulu then told her:
"I will have to go in further and you will wait for me here, don't follow me as I will be unable to help you if you would encounter a deadly situation, I will use my stealth technique to go search for the last herb I need, just stay here and don't make any movements while you wait for me, meditate to heal yourself and restore your ki and take his pill."
He threw her the aforementioned pill and disappeared from her eyes as he went further inside the canyon, things started to change, from darkness, some light appeared here and there as certain fungi would lighten up the damp environment, however, the gravity also increased exponentially and even Yun Jhin's internal organs started to cry pitifully.
Yun Jhin ignored their cries and went further until he found what he needed, another earthen herb!
This herb was just like the snake from before, but instead of it being shaped like a snake it was shaped like a grey frog.
The frog was currently sleeping but Yun Jhin didn't believe it was this easy to gain a sentient herb, his soul willpower searched around the herb and his eyes narrowed as he thought:
"A demonic toxins scorpion is waiting underground for anyone to touch the herb, what a tricky situation, maybe if I take Lulu and throw her in as bait?"
Yun Jhin thought of taking Lulu and using her as bait to gain the herb, Black Blood wasn't seeing this so he could report to the Emperor whatever he felt like saying, the Empress also had another daughter, even though she was less talented they still wanted Yun Jhin's bloodline and it was for two reasons, it's purity and questionable origins plus his memories of his past life.
Yun Jhin made up his mind and went back to Lulu, she did as he instructed her and she immediately opened her eyes and got up from her cross-legged position on the ground when she sensed him, she gave him a small smile as she asked cheekily:
"Need my help?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he told her:
"You see I need you to take the herb, I'm not sure I could do it myself as my cultivation base is lacking, even though my body is strong there is a natural restriction there that I can't get through, don't worry about the gravity as I will protect you with my ki, I just need you to get near the herb so I can use a technique to seal it and take it away."
Lulu smiled as he patted his shoulder and puffed her chest forward giving a clear show of her cleavage as she said:
"Then let this little sister here to help you out."
Lulu had a big smile inside as she thought this would be the first time he would be of help in this training expedition, she didn't count the time back when she helped him fight the old man as she realized from her observations that he could have done in the old man by himself, it would only have taken him more effort.
As Lulu followed him she realized that his expression took a turn for the worse as he was using his ki to protect her, she made a vow to make sure she would take the herb for him, she told her that it would be used towards his cultivation base and she didn't doubt him, after all, he was a former God Realm expert, why would he need to lie to her?
Yun Jhin watched as they reached the location of the herb, it was still there 'sleeping', Yun Jhin pointed towards the frog and said:
"This is the herb, we are lucky that it's currently sleeping, go slowly near it and don't touch it, just hover your hand over it and I will do the rest."
Lulu complied with his request as she slowly got near the frog and put her hand over it, Yun Jhin used her as a conductor for his ki, the ki from his body went through hers then transformed into a formation that absorbed the frog into it, the frog immediately started shrieking like it was on its death bed and it didn't want to go yet.
But Yun Jhin easily retracted the formation as it flew towards him then into his spatial ring.
Lulu smiled as she watched this happening, she felt that it was something strange as she didn't feel any 'natural barrier' but she thought that Yun Jhin took care of it the same way as the time he used his ki to protect her.
Suddenly her vision started swimming as she looked down at her stomach and saw a giant claw inside of it, a mouthful of blood was vomited one after another, her vision started to darken as she looked a little bit upwards and saw the owner of the claw, a gigantic dark scorpion with a green stinger and countless eyes was looking at her, green saliva dripping from its toothless maw.
She slowly craned her neck to look behind her and saw Yun Jhin taking his katana out, she gave out a weak smile as she tried to say:
"R...u....n...."
So Yun Jhin did it, the moment he heard this word he ran away so fast that she couldn't see his silhouette anymore.
She chuckled sadly as tears fell off her cheeks, the scorpion opened it's maw and swallowed her alive!
Yun Jhin looked behind and muttered:
"You had to be used so early, quite a pity but I guess I will try to woo your sister."
The scorpion shrieked as it saw its second prey disappearing and then it shook its stinger, but it realized that it left it's sensing perimeters, it was quite angry it's luring bait was taken away but there was not much he could do now, he didn't want to leave the high gravity environment as it would make it uncomfortable.
Also, it running underground would trigger the moles, and the moles were in quite a high number, even though it would be able to kill thousands of them, it would die itself soon after in a sea of naked yellow moles, he would kill even more with his poisonous body but he would die in the end, he thought that it wasn't worth it.
So he decided to digest his current prey and go hibernate.
Yun Jhin sighed as he saw the scorpion not following him, that thing was a peak King Realm cultivation beast and had some intelligence, the peak King Realm scorpions were the most often met so it wasn't surprising one would try such a tactic to catch its prey. Yun Jhin was lucky he had a partner that he could use or else he wouldn't have been able to gain the herb he needed.
Hopefully, he wouldn't need to use anyone else in the other two locations or else he would have to think of a way to lure King Realm experts into the danger zones and make use of them.
Yun Jhin didn't do it in this zone because he already someone he could use without any repercussions, what if the one he lured was a big shot that would wage war on the Empire?
Even though the Empress might be heartbroken, she wouldn't kill him due to the two factors that made her sent her daughter in his hands, she might even ignore her death and send her second daughter to him instead, if she died as well then she might become suspicious.
Yun Jhin sighed as he reached the wall from before and started scaling it, as he reached the half of it he looked down at the darkness that engulfed everything and said:
"This is goodbye, Lulu."
After a short while, he reached the cliff then left towards the direction of the wind danger zone.
Hopefully, the next danger zone would have the herbs he needed.
Black Blood eyes widened in surprise and dread as he looked at Yun Jhin leaving the earth elemental danger zone then he sent a message to the Emperor:
"Your highness, there's bad news, Yun Jhin came alone from the Earth Elemental danger zone."
A sigh could be heard coming from the other part as he said:
"Don't you think I would know? I'm the one who inserted these formations core in them and Lulu's broke, that means she is dead, I already informed my wife and she seemingly took the news quite well, it's almost strange how well she took them, I will have to keep my eyes on her for a while from now on, just keep observing Yun Jhin and make sure he doesn't run away, if he does that means he is guilty."
Black Blood observed Yun Jhin's expression and saw how it morphed from anger to helplessness then to sadness then he sighed as he muttered to a volume that Black Blood could hear if he concentrated enough:
"These damn demonic toxic scorpions, I'm sorry Lulu..."
Black Blood reported his sighting to the Emperor but the Emperor said:
"He might have unlocked further memories in the danger zone, there's a chance he is acting, but for now there is nothing we can do, these types of training can turn deadly and we can only swallow our loss, fortunately even though Lulu is talented she isn't one of our core talents, she might have given birth to good descendants but her sister still exists, she might be missing 5 stages of cultivation base compared to Lulu but her bloodline is still the Empress's."
Black Blood finished reporting and continued to follow Yun Jhin from afar, he saw how he sighed continuously on the way until he steeled himself and stopped being emotional, to Black Blood all of it seemed pretty real, after all, he thought that Yun Jhin was hard on the outside and soft inside.
That's how he portrayed himself around Lulu and that's the personality that Black Blood thought he had, after all, if he truly didn't care about her he wouldn't have given her those pills to heal herself.
Black Blood sighed as he did a small prayer and bowed towards the earth elemental danger zone while saying slowly:
"I hope you will find happiness in the otherworld or you will be reincarnated in a better position your highness princess Lulu..."
Black Blood didn't have any beef with Lulu and even saw her as a granddaughter, after all, the Empress and Emperor didn't hate each other all the time, from time to time they would make some conjugal visits to each other and Black Blood was a guard, one of those times was when he met Lulu and played with her, she stuck to his heart a little bit as he couldn't have children or grandchildren himself.
Black Blood sighed as he buried those memories then made sure he knew which direction Yun Jhin took before he continued to follow him.
Today the Empire lost a big talent, not a vital one, but quite a big one, she will be dearly missed by those that she knew and loved.
Only Yun Jhin was smiling inside as he assessed the herbs he gained and counted how many others he would need to create the pill that would help him create the 4 elements jewel, just 2 more danger zones and he would be able to create the pill then he would reach the second stage of the King Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Fighting the elements (3)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked at the wind that took form around him, he finally reached the wind danger zone after a few days of traveling, the wind danger zone was the most special as it was always moving in a random pattern.
Sometimes it would even hit villages or cities, destroying them with ease, but to combat this the Emperor created a formation that would tell everyone where the wind danger zone would hit again, after that, the place that was targeted would be warned, luckily, the danger zone only moved around the borders of the Empire so it didn't hit the truly important regions.
Yun Jhin watched the wind take a physical form, the speed and density of the wind were quite high so if Yun Jhin wanted to jump into the zone he would have to fully cloak his body with ki and then use his katana to cut through the wind to make a path.
Yun Jhin's body was engulfed into a white aura that conformed to the wind elemental energy then took out the katana, he would do a combination of trying to reach the eye of the storm and cutting through if he got near enough to enter the weak spot of the danger zone he would be able to drift away into its neutral zones where the wind wouldn't batter him every second.
Yun Jhin breathed in and out as he put his sword in front of him then slashed downwards, a void was created in front of him as all of the wind and air disappeared, then he dashed directly inside!
Yun Jhin entered inside the danger zone and the wind restored itself. Afterward, the wind started to attack his body and soul trying to cut him into pieces, seemingly as if it was angry Yun Jhin created a void of air a few seconds ago.
Yun Jhin endured the pain of his body being slashed by thousands of wind blades with ease, after all, his constitution was superior.
After a while of flowing with the wind he finally reached the neutral zones and was dropped there, being in the danger zone was just like being into a palace made of wind, right now he was around 20,000 meters away from the ground, he sighed as he looked around and found one herb that he could use.
Herbs in the wind danger zone were the hardest to gather as they were made of pure wind and were not truly 'herbs' in a sense, they could be called crystallized wind energy.
Yun Jhin started to do to some handseals as he approached the crystal flower in front of him, suddenly his eyes narrowed as he backed away and disappeared.
Three men and one woman were taken by the wind to the same neutral area he stood in before minutes ago, their cultivation bases were around the 5th to 6th stage and their aura was quite bountiful, meaning that they were actual experts! They were people that were even above Lulu's power and not because of experience they just had a higher innate talent, their talent was even above Yun Jhin's!
Yun Jhin stealthily used his soul willpower to scan them and realized all of them had a pure draconic aura, they were pure dragon experts!
All of them were very young, looking to be around 15-16 years old, they were newborn infants in a pure dragons age, most dragons lived around 50,000 years when they were in the King Realm, they had more life span than humans and halflings.
The draconic newcomers started to look around then they shouted with joy as they saw the crystallized flower that Yun Jhin wanted to take, Yun Jhin frowned as he backed away from the flower and kept steady breathing, he kept his aura, life force, and presence hid to not attract their attention if any of those leaked out he would be doomed!
After all, who knew if they were good or bad people, the percentage of bad people in the cultivation world was higher than the good ones so he had to be on his toes around everyone that he didn't know.
The quartet approached the crystal flower then took a premade formation out of their spatial ring, the formation engulfed the crystalline flower making it look like it now sat neatly inside a yellow bottle.
One of the men took the bottle and put it in their spatial ring then bowed towards the woman as he said:
"We are quite lucky to get such a rare crystal flower so easily, it must be because you are with us Zula."
Zula frowned as he looked at the man and said:
"Don't call me by my first name, we aren't that familiar, if it wasn't for my father asking to invite you to this expedition you wouldn't be here!"
The man scratched the back of his head as he said:
"Ok, ok madam Lu, do you want some music to entertain yourself during this nice evening?"
It was obvious the man was making fun of Zula, but she nodded her head at him with a serious expression as she said:
"Play the Zither for me and I will leave you with your fingers."
The man coughed and took out a zither, he made a joke now, and if he didn't play his zither that crazy woman would cut off his fingers!
Fortunately, he knew how to play the zither quite adequately.
Yun Jhin ignored the man's song as he observed the other two men talking:
"Man what a bore, we have to listen to Zucco's song, whatever, we got a crystal herb, we will just need to get a few more before we can leave, I don't really want to stay near Zula..."
Zula narrowed her eyes as she heard some of their conversations and questioned:
"What was that?"
The man chuckled and said it was nothing. Zula decided to ignore them as she listened to Zucco's song.
While the group talked Yun Jhin was made a strategical retreat running away as far as he could from the area, he wasn't sure if they were from the main Luo Empire or the Bumi Empire but they were more advanced than those he met in the Zumo empire.
Well, he wasn't sure about the true geniuses that were hiding in closed-door cultivation, but the ones he saw were too trash to be called 'geniuses'.
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked around and scanned the new region of the danger zone he was.
Hopefully, these fellows would take a different region.
Yun Jhin's eyes sparkled as he found another crystallized herb and immediately took it, he created a similar formation to the one the others used then put the herb into his spatial ring, he became invisible again just as a precaution as he wandered around the wind danger zone, from time to time he would go further in then retreat as he saw those four didn't leave the beginning area already.
It seemed Zula heard what they said about wanting to not stay around her and she forced them to stay with her in the first region...
Yun Jhin continued to take different routes around the danger zones and found some herbs here and there but he was still lacking one main herb that he needed to use for his pill, so he decided to go in further into the wind palace, he met with some wind crystal beasts but he easily avoided the stronger ones and slaughtered the weaker ones taking their beast cores.
Searching high and low in the danger zone until he hit a wall, not a proverbial one but a true one, it was a wind wall, it seemed he reached a part of the wind palace that he couldn't go through so he had to go back, but when he looked behind his sharp ears caught the trace of talking, who else could it be but those 4?
The men laughed while Zula kept to herself, Yun Jhin kept himself near the wind wall as he turned transparent but he didn't touch the wall or else it would shred him to pieces, the wind wasn't very merciful as they were quite far in the wind palace.
Suddenly Zula narrowed her eyes as she walked closer to the wall, her face was close to Yun Jhin's and he could almost smell her breath, Yun Jhin wanted to move back but the wind wall was behind him, any wrong step and he would become slashed meat!
Zula watched the wall for a few more seconds before she turned back and shook her head as she said:
"This is not the secret entrance, father did say that it would be a wall but I can't feel the energy gathering formation, let's go search for some more time and if we can't find it till the night we will go camp to take a rest."
Zula was the 'captain' of this unit so she was the one who gave out the orders, Yun Jhin watched as Zula left with the three men and sighed, in the end his stealth technique didn't betray him.
Yun Jhin waited for a while before he made sure they weren't around and left the dead end, he walked around the wind palace for a long while, he didn't admire the surroundings as he was too stressed by these four people, he needed to find the last herb and get away from the wind danger zone, there was also around 5 more days till the formation inside him would let him leave, but he didn't think that would be a problem.
He searched and searched but he didn't find anything besides more dead ends, the winds grew harsher, stronger, faster, they tore at his cloak and clothes, at his body, his ki was running low but whenever that happened he would eat a pill from his spatial ring and continue further.
Finally, after two more days, he found a wall that wasn't like the others, it was the wall Zula was talking about, he could sense a gathering formation near the wall that would open it for the one who put his/hers ki inside it.
Yun Jhin knew that his ki would be no good for the formation, so he decided to wait in stealth for the others to arrive, it would be a lie if Yun Jhin said he wasn't interested in what was behind the wall, he also didn't find the herb he needed, maybe there would be more herbs inside the wall and he could take some while the others would be preoccupied with the true treasure.
After a short while of waiting the quartet party arrived, Zula walked forward and put her hand on the wall, unsurprisingly the sharp wind wall didn't tear her hand apart as a dark green formation appeared on it and started to suck the ki out of her.
Her complexion started to pale as her ki was forcefully sucked out of her, after three minutes she almost collapsed but the wall also opened.
Zucco gave her a pill then helped her up, Zula nodded at him then entered the wall along with others, Yun Jhin followed them behind like a shadow.
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he looked around, the pure white wind was all around him, as he followed behind them he realized that the place was really narrow and only two people could walk shoulder to shoulder inside the wall.
Yun Jhin made sure there wasn't any physical contact with any of them as he kept himself as behind as he could from their party.
After a short while of walking forward, they reached an open place as the walls widened around, the place looked to be touched by a cultivators hand as there were different things around, special crystallized herbs, treasured weapons, rugs of different colors, this room he was in gave out a homely feel.
There was no one in the room Zula looked around then said:
"Walk in further and press the painting on the wall, click on it 3 times right, 2 times left and 1 time down, the true treasure should be inside that hidden room."
Yun Jhin watched as they disappeared behind a painting, fortunately for him, the herb he needed was growing inside the room, unfortunately, was that he couldn't harvest it while invisible, the formation that he created would take a bit out of him ki wise, and he also needed to concentrate, unlike the others, he couldn't create formations that could be used later as he didn't have the ingredients needed to do that.
Yun Jhin quickly started to do handseals as he tried to take the herb he needed, after a short while the herb was bottled then he put it in his spatial ring but at the same time, the quartet left the secret room and spotted him!
Yun Jhin only had one thought right now:
"S-H-I-T!"
Yun Jhin didn't know what to say so he only waved awkwardly before he was apprehended by two of the men.
He really was in deep trouble right now, but he had a way to get himself out, the first step would be charming Zula as she was the captain.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Fighting the elements (4)
chapters.content:
Zula looked down at Yun Jhin and took in his appearance, so Yun Jhin did the same but he wasn't that brazen while looking at her, or else who knew what will that woman accuse him of?
Zula wore red fiery clothes with flame patterns around the hems, she had her hair done in a bun behind her back and her deep orange eyes were gazing deeply into Yun Jhin seemingly as if she was trying to see through all of his secrets.
Yun Jhin ignored her insistent gaze as he watched her point at his spatial ring and said:
"You have taken a crystal herb from here, boys confiscate his spatial ring."
Zucco came closer to him and took his spatial ring, on the surface Yun Jhin had a very sad expression but inside he was cold as ice, he wore a decoy spatial ring for this type of situations, all of his important stuff was hidden in his spatial bag, he already transferred the other herbs in the spatial bag and he hid it on his person, unless they checked his body thoroughly they wouldn't know, of course, he let the crystal herb inside the spatial ring to not trigger their suspicion.
Yun Jhin wanted to struggle and take his spatial ring away but the two men kept a strong grip on his arm and shoulders, one of them even mocked him:
"What does one-arm halfling trash like you doing in the wind danger zone?"
The man spat on Yun Jhin's head as he looked at him from above, halflings were often looked down upon by pure draconic beings due to their innate pride and thinking that the higher and purer the bloodline the better someone would be, their innate qualities made them extremely narcissistic when it came to their race.
Yun Jhin didn't say anything but he was gritting his teeth, Zula observed his expression and gave him a mocking smile as she said:
"You are quite brazen to follow behind us and try to steal from my father's secret stash, however, it's quite strange, how did you enter? I'm sure I closed the door behind us."
Yun Jhin kept his mouth shut but Zula's eyes narrowed as she made a gesture with her hand then thrust it inside his stump, fresh yellow blood started to drip from his stump as Zula said:
"Your wound is quite fresh, even though it has been cauterized, I can easily open it up with my torture technique, speak up before I will start digging in."
Yun Jhin's face morphed as he felt the pain travel through his whole body, he looked directly in Zula's eyes and said:
"I have followed behind you using my stealth technique..."
Zula smiled at him as she patted his injured shoulder making even more blood splatter down from it and she said:
"That wasn't hard, was it? Now give me the stealth cultivation technique and I might bother throwing you out of here alive, what do you say?"
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes inside, this woman was quite greedy, Yun Jhin liked that at women, Yun Jhin opened his mouth to tell her the cultivation technique when suddenly he spewed some elemental aura from his mouth, burning the duo's arms and hands away from him and disappearing.
The duo was a little bit shocked after they saw their arms burning but they easily stopped the flame from extending to their bodies, Zucco looked down at his hand only to see the spatial ring that he had put on his finger disappear, along with his finger!
Zucco shouted as he threw a fireball randomly in anger but he didn't hit anything, Yun Jhin couldn't be felt anywhere, his aura disappeared, technically speaking, Yun Jhin was a turtle in a jar in this situation, he couldn't beat them head-on so he had to resort to trickery. Zucco looked down and saw his bloodied finger on the ground, he grasped it with his arm then reattached it to his hand, afterward he cauterized the wound using his innate flame ki. While only Sage Realm experts could recover limbs, that didn't mean those below this rank couldn't reattach them if they were whole.
He gritted his teeth from the pain but endured it, his eyes were literally spewing flames as he tried to look around with his special eye technique and find Yun Jhin's traces.
However his eye technique wasn't up to far, he couldn't find Yun Jhin anywhere!
Yun Jhin frowned as he sat near the painting, while the others were looking around for him, the moment all of them faced a different direction from the picture he pressed it in the same pattern that Zula said before and disappeared in the secret room!
The secret room was small, that must have been one of the reasons they left it so fast, it was decorated sparsely with a meditation mat on the ground an incense burner near it, there was also an empty pedestal a few centimeters away from the mat, the pedestal was empty but from the looks of it, the thing that sat in it must have been something rotund like a ball.
Yun Jhin sat on the meditation mat and waited, they would try to enter here for sure but he was already invisible, if they tried to look around he would stay still and wait until they left.
Yun Jhin waited for a little time before Zula entered the hidden room and looked around, her eyes were spewing flames just like Zucco's but her eyes were spewing blue flames instead of normal red-colored.
She tried to touch the room randomly as she couldn't see Yun Jhin, but with some incredible flexibility, Yun Jhin made it so whenever she would almost grasp him she would miss by a hair, Yun Jhin saw an opening as she turned his back and stealthily approached her before she placed his katana on her neck.
Zula smiled as she turned back to Yun Jhin, now his katana laid on her jugular as she said:
"Aren't you daring to try to assassinate me?"
Suddenly blue flames pushed Yun Jhin away into the pedestal breaking it and creating a vacuum where air started to gather, the air started slashing into Yun Jhin as Zula threw fire at him, the combination of fire and wind was ready to incinerate Yun Jhin to ashes when suddenly the wind started to suck everything out of the room, Yun Jhin disappeared and Zula shouted in disbelief as she was sucked out of the room as well.
The room was destroyed as the formation that held it intact broke down, Zucco and the other two tried to enter the room as they didn't hear anything from Zula for a while but they realized they couldn't!
When they tried to enter the wind currents would batter them and slash at their bodies until they turned bloody.
In an unknown location inside the wind danger zone, Yun Jhin woke up as he looked around, he saw beside him Zula who was bleeding profusely then he looked down at his body, it was both burnt and slashed, however, none of his vital points were struck, his body was quite strong so he survived, due to the bodily strength he also recovered faster than her and woke up sooner.
Yun Jhin placed a few restraining formations on her body, then touched her here and there, he looked a little bit more and realized she was a virgin.
Just the good thing for him as he needed the vital Yin of a King Realm expert or above to restore his arm, it would be a bonus to recover from his current injuries as well.
Yun Jhin looked down at her prone body and invited himself...
After a long while Yun Jhin's body was now fully recovered a new arm sprouted from his stump and he moved it here and there to make it adapt to his body, Zula was wearing clothes and she looked the same as before, even her injuries seemed to have healed, after all, Yun Jhin couldn't stop his vital yang from helping her, his vital yang was rather potent due to his strong body and her injuries weren't that bad so they got healed pretty quickly after she absorbed it.
Her injuries were healed and she was pretty much in a perfect state right now, her eyes opened as she glared at Yun Jhin, she felt that she lacked her vital Yin she tried to get up but she couldn't then she shouted at him with a pained look on her face:
"YOU BEAST, HOW COULD YOU!"
Even though she was a scheming woman she was still a woman, in the end, she would care deeply about her body and she felt that she had been wronged that she was taken advantage of.
Yun Jhin didn't bother to listen to her as he got near to her and grabbed her hair before he picked her up and made her look into his eyes:
"Listen here, due to you and your little friends I'm not even sure where we are currently, also tell me one good reason why would I let you off here?"
Zula gritted her teeth as she spat into Yun Jhin's face, Yun Jhin chuckled as he dodged the spit and then punched her in the face giving her a nose bleed.
Zula wanted to get up and fight him but she was powerless due to the restraining formations he put on her, as long as Yun Jhin could get near someone and had enough time to put restraining formations even an 8th stage King Realm expert would fall to him, however from the 9th and above even his formations wouldn't work unless he was at the same cultivation base.
Yun Jhin looked at her as her face became a deep red, was it from anger or embarrassment? Maybe both.
Zula decided that it was time to take a compromise as she looked around, she didn't recognize what place they were in so she told him what he wanted to know:
"I'm from the Bumi Empire, I have been sent along with my cousin Zucco and the other two to gather a special treasure left behind by my grandfather, in his youth he trained in the four danger zones and he left a special place where he cultivated inside the wind one..."
She explained how her family was of quite a high standing in the Bumi Empire, they stood in the top 10 rankings, even though they were the last in the tenth place her family wasn't anyone could fight with as the families in the top 10 rankings had God Realm experts in their ranks, from the 10th to the 2nd they only had one god realm expert, but the 1st which was the imperial family had 2 high-level God Realm experts!
The ranking was based on the stage the patriarchs of the families were at.
So if the Bumi Empire had the 9th stage God Realm expert that meant the 10th family had a half-god expert, the half-god was a stage between the Sage realm 10th stage and the God Realm 1st stage.
Yun Jhin listened with to her with his eyes closed, he couldn't kill her as he would be surely blamed if she didn't return from this expedition, the other three knew and god knows where they were at now.
What he could do was keep the restrictions on her body and try to find a way out of the wind danger zone, he would drop her somewhere and let the formations dissipate on their own, then she could leave, he was unhappy that he couldn't deal with this problem but as long as he didn't kill them or take their secret object they wouldn't be able to escalate things.
After all, in all empires, there were fights between factions, and Yun Jhin had the Emperor behind him which had a cultivation base of around the 5th stage of the God Realm, the 10th ranked family, in the end, even if things escalated, the Bumi Empire wouldn't be able to threaten the Sumo Empire as they had the Luo Empire backing them.
Especially for some people of the younger generation who didn't even die nor they had their treasures stolen, at most they would write it off as a scuffle between the younger generation, also since he took her virginity there was a chance they would send her to marry him as an alliance between the Empires.
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked down at her then readjusted the formation to let her be able to move around but he gave her the ability to fight around the 9th stage of the heavenly realm, she wouldn't be able to do anything to him she would also die if they found some elemental that she couldn't fight and Yun Jhin didn't protect her.
Zula got up from the white ground and glared at Yun Jhin, her orange fiery eyes turned blue as she jumped at Yun Jhin and tried to kill him!
But Yun Jhin easily grabbed her arm and put it behind her back as he said:
"You want another round now that you are conscious?"
Zula face reddened again as she tried to spit at him again but Yun Jhin pushed her down and pinned her to the ground as his face got close to hers then he said:
"I let you move around so we can find a way to get out of here, don't think that I took advantage of you because I like you or something like that, but your vital yin was very useful to me."
Zula's eyes wandered to his regenerated arm and she realized why he used her like that, but that didn't mean she accepted it, however, the victor was king since she couldn't do anything to him she might as well follow his lead.
Yun Jhin smiled as she turned meek then got up letting her get up as well, then he looked around and asked:
"Your grandfather should have given you a map of the wind danger zone, bring it up, and tell me where we are."
Zula nodded and took a grey map out of her spatial ring. She realized that Yun Jhin didn't steal anything from her ring as she saw everything in order, this gave her a better impression of Yun Jhin, but she would still backstab him if she could, the hatred between them wouldn't be erased this easily, just because he didn't steal her things when she was down. But it did give her a better impression of how he acted.
Zula opened the map and showed it to Yun Jhin then he nodded and pointed at the middle of the map, his eyes narrowed as he saw their location and his face turned grave.
They were in deep trouble if they didn't move away from their location.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Fighting the elements (5)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked around as Zula started to panic, she realized where they were after Yun Jhin pointed it out, she might have been able to sail through the region if she was lucky but her strength was now restricted!
She slowly got closer to Yun Jhin and stood behind him as she looked around, Yun Jhin was the only one who could protect her in this situation, she didn't imagine that Yun Jhin would let her restrictions go, he would be a fool in her eyes if he did that.
Yun Jhin didn't move a muscle, the region they were currently in was populated by wind orcas, these relatively small but deadly animals, they live under the wind palace wind walls and they hunted based on the movement of the air around them, Yun Jhin's stealth technique would be useful here as he could erase his aura and life force to the point he would mend with the surroundings but doing that meant he would have to use the technique first.
What if a wind orca would be nearby and sense him? he wouldn't want to bet his life on it, after all, wind orcas were extremely fast and deadly, they would puncture him like a block of swiss cheese.
Wind orcas were around 25 centimeters in height and had a sharp stinger as their nose, they were of transparent color so you wouldn't be able to see them in the wind walls.
Zula knew about the wind orcas as well, she looked around and kept near Yun Jhin but didn't do any sudden movements or that would doom the both of them, Yun Jhin sent a soul strand into her mind palace as he told her:
