"I have a stealth technique that could get us out of here but I need to make sure there are no wind orcas nearby or we would become goners."
Zula gritted her teeth as she glared at him under her eyes and responded using his soul strand:
"How can I be of any help with my strength restricted, its everything on you, do you want me to become a decoy so you can run away or what?"
Yun Jhin wouldn't mind that at all, however, in this situation if she died he would be surely blamed and there was a big chance of him being handed to the Bumi Empire as a tribute if he didn't reveal some of his secrets, then the Bumi Empire might just wage war on the Luo Empire if the Luo Empire protected him, there was a high chance the Luo Empire would poach him from their brother the Sumo Empire.
Yun Jhin didn't want that, the Luo Empire had a 9th stage God Realm expert that might be able to see through his memories and secrets forcefully, after all, his soul wasn't recovered to its peak, God Realm experts couldn't see through anyone souls but once they reached the 9th stage a whole new world would appear in front of them, this world gave them the capability of doing things those below the 9th stage couldn't do.
However, if anyone below the 9th stage tried to look into Yun Jhin's soul they would be thrown out, but if they forced his soul it could also explode, but a ninth stage expert would be able to stop his soul from exploding and steal his memories forcefully while alive!
They wouldn't kill him due to his memories but if they had them what use would there be an outsider that could reach the God Realm if they couldn't fully control him?
So for a smooth future, he had to take Zula out of the wind danger zone alive or things wouldn't end up well for him, of course, if the other three would have died along the way he would just be able to escape by himself but it was very unlikely and he wouldn't bet his life and future on such an unstable gamble.
Yun Jhin kept his soul willpower concentrated around the pure white region around him to make sure there were no wind orcas but the stealth of the wind orcas was quite good if they didn't reveal themselves Yun Jhin wouldn't be able to sense them with his current soul willpower.
Zula didn't do much besides staying near Yun Jhin, in her situation she could only be moral support at best.
Suddenly Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he told her using the soul strand he sent in her mind palace:
"I think there might be one or two wind orcas eyeing us, fortunately as long as we don't move they will leave after a while, we aren't deep in their nest at most at the outer fringes or else we might have already become food for them."
Zula didn't say anything as she strained her eyes to look around the white region but she couldn't see anything, she frowned but didn't comment she just kept a tight grip on Yun Jhin's shoulders, she was using him as a human shield, if the wind orcas attacked she thought they would pierce through him first giving her a little time that she could use to escape. However, if Yun Jhin died she would surely die as well, she knew that but she just didn't want to die first, she was scared of death just like all other cultivators.
Yun Jhin made a short move to unleash his stealth technique but suddenly a sharp object entered his thigh and exited on the other part, a pool of blood already appeared down at his feet as the wind orcas started to smell the blood.
They could see through movement and smell blood, however in rest they were practically blind deaf and couldn't smell anything else, but in such a pure white environment any movement would be easily seen by them so in the wind danger zone they could be considered deadly predators that only peak king realm experts could escape from, and that was only from those of the middle or lower packs, the upper packs could even send an Emperor Realm expert running.
Yun Jhin gritted his teeth as he used his inner flame ki to cauterize his wound, the stealth technique unveiled as it covered but him and Zula, he sighed as he started to run away with Zula on his back, the wind orcas were swimming in the air as they looked around and then attacked the pool of blood on the ground, then they started to kill each other and gnaw at their comrade's bodies. They weren't smart creatures, if they would be compared to the Toxic Scorpions in the earth elemental danger zone the comparison would be the Toxic Scorpions intelligence would be 5 and the orcas would be 0.5.
Fortunately, Yun Jhin knew a technique to escape from this situation, or else both of them would have met their maker here.
Yun Jhin gave out a small sigh as he ran away from the deadly region behind him, Zula just gripped his shoulders tightly, or else she would fall at the speed Yun Jhin was using.
After a short while, they were finally out of the wind orcas territory, however, they were still quite deep inside the wind danger zone so they weren't in a safe place yet.
Suddenly a wind arrow launched itself towards Yun Jhin from an unseen place, but Yun Jhin sidestepped it then looked around with narrowed eyes, there was no second arrow but Yun Jhin knew that something or someone launched that arrow, it wouldn't be a formation nor a naturally occurring event, because the wind arrow had elemental energy different from the one around the danger zone.
The danger zone had very pure wind energy but the one that was shot was less refined and had a small degree of purity, that was why Yun Jhin could dodge it rather easily.
There could also be natives living in the wind danger zone but it was unlikely, it must be someone who got stuck around this region and didn't know how to escape, Yun Jhin didn't wait for the other party to reveal itself as he became invisible again and ran away, a curse could be heard behind him but Yun Jhin ignored the raspy voice that he heard behind him and made away from the region at his fastest speed.
Zula frowned as she was interested in the man sounding voice behind them but since Yun Jhin didn't want to investigate she just let it go since her life was in his hands she would just follow along.
After more traveling in the wind danger zone, they finally reached the outer edge of the danger zone then they started to fall.
Since the air didn't support them anymore they fell and fell but Yun Jhin used his ki to create a pseudo-flying state where they fell very slowly so they wouldn't be hurt by the fall.
In the end, they reached the ground and Yun Jhin unceremoniously dropped Zula on the ground and put a timer on the restrictions, after a certain while they would disappear, even though they were near the danger zone, the zone would leave and as long as she didn't get near it she wouldn't be sucked into the zone again if she wasn't dumb she wouldn't court death.
Zula grumbled as she got up from the ground and dusted her clothes, she glared at Yun Jhin but Yun Jhin already left, leaving nothing behind as he used his stealth technique.
Black Blood looked with strange eyes at what happened, who was that young lady and what did Yun Jhin do to her?
Black Blood didn't follow him inside the danger zones but made sure he entered them, the formation core inside him wouldn't let him leave anyway, it had been almost 30 days since Yun Jhin entered the danger zone and Black Blood didn't know what to report, after all, this was the first time Yun Jhin stayed triple the allocated time, but since he finally got out he let his old heart rest, if Yun Jhin died as well the Emperor wouldn't be really happy, Lulu's death already angered the Empress even though on the surface everything was sunshine and rainbows.
The Empress was just grieving in silence, it was partly her fault as well as she threw her daughter at Yun Jhin as she didn't think that the outer edges of the danger zone could be fatal to her talented 6th stage King Realm daughter.
Black Blood sighed as he followed Yun Jhin, he was impressed with the lad's stealth technique as he needed to use some of his ki to track him, it seemed if Yun Jhin broke through the Emperor realm, no even before that, if he became a 9th stage King Realm expert he wouldn't be able to see through his stealth if he didn't use his ocular technique!
Black Blood muttered to himself as he followed Yun Jhin towards the last danger zone:
"It seemed he must have unlocked more memories, who knows what he encountered in that danger zone?"
Yun Jhin knew that Black Blood would think that he unlocked more memories due to his stealth technique, only two people in the Empire knew about it, the ex-soon to be wife Lulu was one of the few that knew, the other would be Kong Luo.
There was only one danger zone left, considerably speaking it was the most perilous one, it was located in the ocean that separated the Luo and Sumo Empire and it was also the most visited for tempering.
It was called the underwater temple and it sat on the ocean floor around 20,000 kilometers away from the shore, the ocean was so long that it couldn't be measured as the Sumo and Luo Empire used teleportation formations to meet and trade with each other, there were very few who traveled the whole ocean and the one who did was the current Emperor of the Luo Empire, Luo Binfeng!
Yun Jhin reached the shore of the ocean around after 30-40 days of traveling, due to the wind danger zone moving randomly he was quite far away from the ocean, and he would still need around 10-15 more days to walk swim 20,000 kilometers.
Black Blood kept tailing him and after the 10-15 more days they both reached the underwater danger zone entrance.
Black Blood sat cross-legged on the ocean floor as he looked at Yun Jhin enter the cave that led to the underwater temple and sighed:
"The last danger zone that we can access currently, hopefully, he would have unlocked enough memories to let him go through what's to come."
Yun Jhin could feel the water pressure around him intensify as he entered the water danger zone, the underwater temple had 10x to 20x the normal water pressure compared to the normal ocean, the benefits were that the water elemental energy here was extremely pure but also deadly, just like the ocean, normal humans couldn't drink salt water, so cultivators couldn't use the elemental energy here. It needed to be purified first before it could be used.
Using a little elemental energy wouldn't kill you but your meridians could be damaged, using more could cripple you and if you were crazy enough to absorb a lot of it you would explode.
Yun Jhin's world stopped spinning as the water pressure stabilized around him, after a while of spinning, Yun Jhin finally landed into the underwater temple, his surroundings were covered with marble and when he looked behind him he could see the exit of the temple.
Pillars supported an immense building, from afar Yun Jhin could see that it was infested with Yakshas and other types of evil fish-men, these type of fish-men were born into this environment and the toxic water energy didn't affect them as much as it did the outsiders, they could cultivate with it in moderation and they had above average intelligence if they were compared with the previous toxic scorpion they would be around a 7.5 of intelligence.
Yun Jhin made sure to not be seen but a shout and a quick figure that ran into him along with a bunch of fish-men made it so he wouldn't be able to start things stealthily as he wanted.
The figure ignored Yun Jhin as he stumbled and ran away leaving Yun Jhin to deal with the fish-men who now put their attention on him, fortunately, their strength was around the 9th stage of the heavenly realm, so with one palm attack he killed all of them.
The figure from before looked behind him then saw Yun Jhin's easy victory against the fish-men and his eyes started to glitter as a plan was made in his mind.
He walked back to Yun Jhin and tried to introduce himself but Yun Jhin's arm was already into his chest as he heard:
"Trying to take advantage of me you damn punk? Let's see what goods you stole, those fish-men wouldn't have followed you for no reason."
The man's eyes started to darken as he saw his own heart being extracted from his chest, Yun Jhin opened his maw like a deadly predator and ate the heart then licked his fingers, the lifeless body dropped to the ground and Yun Jhin took his spatial ring, no one saw him doing the killing so even if the man had some important background how could they pin the blame on him?
Yun Jhin hoped the man had something worth his while in the spatial ring as he opened it and looked inside...

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Fighting the elements (6)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked through the spatial ring but was disappointed by what he found inside, it was a few herbs that were meant for those around the ki cultivating realm, it made sense that the heavenly realm guy would risk his life for them but Yun Jhin found it disappointing.
There weren't many things he could use in the spatial ring but he took what he could then he crushed the ring in his hand transforming it into ashes, the heartless body on the ground transformed into ashes as Yun Jhin glared at it.
There was no time to waste around the outer edges of the underwater palace, the palace had 3 parts, the outer edges, the inner palace, and the most dangerous Naga Nest, the Naga nest was full of aquatic beasts around the Sage Realm and there were even rumors of a God Realm beast hiding deep inside the palace, but it was slumbering 95% of the time.
Yun Jhin left the outer edges of the underwater palace and strode further inside, he would see people here and there fight fish-men and yakshas to harvest their internal organs or cores but Yun Jhin didn't need those, he needed two herbs: A dragon serpent lily, a toxic water lotus and lastly he would need something that wasn't a herb, it would be the purified salt from the inner palace.
Fish-men and other aquatic races create this type of purified salt with formations and store it inside the inner palace, it could be used for cultivation, body refining, and soul refining depending on its quality it could do all three at the same time.
Yun Jhin didn't need much time to find the dragon serpent lily and the toxic water lotus, he had to fight some aquatic monsters for them but he didn't even break a sweat even though they were around his cultivation base.
The further he went into the underwater palace the more cultivators he met, of course, he didn't show himself to them, the outer edges had few visitors as there weren't many around the heavenly realm that were courageous enough to venture into the danger zone. But the further inside the palace the higher the cultivation base, those with higher cultivation bases were bolder thus they thought they could conquer the danger zone.
A lot of young men and women died this way daily, Yun Jhin already saw around 10,20 people getting mauled to death by the aquatic monsters but he couldn't care less about them. What he wanted to do now was entered the inner palace and steal some high-quality purified salt.
Getting nearer to the palace meant more monsters, the underwater palace was considered the most dangerous zone due to it being filled with monsters even at its outer edges, most of the other danger zones had monsters that didn't have a cultivation base or wouldn't bother you if you didn't bother them, but the underwater palace monsters were extremely aggressive. There was also the fact that the underwater temple housed a lot of herbs that could be found easily compared to the other danger zones.
The earth danger zone was starting to show signs of being fully depleted of herbs due to it having almost no difficulty if you didn't enter the deeper zones.
However, the underwater palace won't have this problem even in 100,000 years or more at the rate it was going.
Yun Jhin approached the inner palace zone and cloaked himself using his stealth technique, becoming transparent, what he needed from here couldn't be easily taken as most of the salt urns were protected by a 5th stage King realm Yakshas.
But Yun Jhin could deal with them, after all, they only had a relatively average intelligence that could be easily abused by scheming humans.
Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as he saw a few others trying to steal the salt, it seemed he had competition!
The group tried to distract the guard Yaksha but they were repelled in the end, then some reinforcements came and made a quick work of them, their plan wasn't bad but they didn't execute it properly.
Yun Jhin watched with interest as another group approached then did the same thing, however, this group got a bit of salt and two of them escaped compared to the other one which was fully annihilated.
While he watched he was also creating a formation that would paralyze the King Yaksha for a few minutes when he walked by him, after the formation was finished Yun Jhin slowly got near the yaksha and put the formation to action, but the Yaksha turned his fish nose into the air then stabbed directly to Yun Jhin's direction.
Yun Jhin frowned then he plastered the formation over the Yaksha making him unable to move, however, it seemed the Yaksha was angered as it tried to break from the formation, it wanted to shout for reinforcements but it couldn't, so Yun Jhin unceremoniously went to the salt urn and put it into his spatial ring!
Suddenly the Yaksha broke through the formation binding him and started to shriek like it was possessed, Yun Jhin didn't want to wait for anything to happen to him as he continued using his stealth and retreated.
The place was fully engulfed by Yakshas suddenly a fish-headed old looking man came and berated the Yaksha then he ate him in one gulp!
Yun Jhin observed what happened before he started running away, he didn't want to become the next meal for the old Fishman.
Yun Jhin wasn't sure how the Fishman knew where he was located, it might have been his innate talent that let him do that but fortunately for him, he had already had the formation ready, even though it didn't last as much as he wanted to.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked behind him, he felt someone was following him!
But it couldn't be possible, he was in his stealth technique, up till now he didn't find anyone capable of seeing through his stealth technique, but there were always exceptions.
Yun Jhin kept swimming at high speeds but the one that was on his steps didn't let up as he ran after him and caught up with him.
It was an average looking man that looked to be around 26 years old, he had black shaggy hair and wore a martial artist outfit that consisted of a white gi and pants with a black belt that kept them on. He was barefoot, Yun Jhin took a better look at his face and he realized that the man had no eyes! Both of them were empty sockets.
Yun Jhin frowned, there was one way to counter his stealth technique and that was having an extremely enhanced sense of hearing, however, this type of trait was extremely rare as you would have to be born with it, and it also couldn't be stolen like constitutions and bloodline, it was bound to the soul and even if the soul of the one that had it was refined one wouldn't be able to steal it.
Yun Jhin only found 3 people who were born this way in his previous life, all of them died at his hands and became his puppets.
The man ears moved but Yun Jhin didn't move nor breath as he stood motionlessly, the man smiled as he said:
"This friend, I have heard what happened with the Yakshas, wouldn't you mind to share some of the salt you got with me? After all, you took the whole urn."
Yun Jhin was right the man was one of those very rare with enhanced hearing, he even heard him picking up the urn, even though his stealth technique minimized sound to it being almost unintelligible if heard, even if someone truly heard something they would dismiss it as they wouldn't be able to see it, most people thought that what they couldn't see wasn't real this didn't apply to most cultivators but they could become careless as cultivators were extremely reliant on their senses as they trained them to their peak if they couldn't hear something they would try to see it if they couldn't either they would try to smell it, touch it and some even tasted the air to try and find opponents in stealth.
Yun Jhin frowned, the man suddenly appeared near him as he grabbed him by the arm and threw him down, then he mounted Yun Jhin and put his arm behind his back as he pushed his head into the marble ground of the underwater temple and said:
"Trying to be silent, are you? The thing is you can't silence your heartbeat no matter how much you try to!"
Yun Jhin tried his best to stop his heartbeat but he couldn't, his stealth technique didn't let him do that yet, in the end, he was restricted by his cultivation base.
Yun Jhin frowned as he tried to get up from the ground but he realized that he was bound tightly by the man, it seemed his physical strength was above his!
This could mean only one thing, the man had cultivated his body and was of a higher cultivation base than Yun Jhin.
Cultivating the body was the art that scaled along with the ki cultivation of the user if someone strengthened their body to a certain rank then increased their ki cultivation their bodily strength would increase again along with their recovery abilities, there were no demerits to cultivating the body besides taking a long time and resources, Yun Jhin was fortunate enough to be able to get that heart of the natural spirit, but if he evolved his body again his bodily rank would reset and he would have to strengthen his body again.
Yun Jhin struggled to get up from the stranger's grip but he just couldn't the man must be atleast at the 5th stage or above.
The unknown man fondled Yun Jhin here and there seemingly looking for something before he went towards his hand and took off his spatial ring, Yun Jhin frowned but atleast there wasn't anything important in the spatial ring beside the salt, he didn't have time to put the salt into his secret spatial bag, but everything else was already inside.
The man bowed to Yun Jhin then said:
"I shall thank you in advance for getting me this salt, after all, such a blind man like myself would have a hard time to take it myself, I shall hear you later, we can be friends when we meet again!"
The man started running in the wrong direction then he rotated and started to run in the exit's direction.
Yun Jhin got up from the ground and frowned while he checked his body for any tracking formations or anything else that the man could have inserted while he incapacitated him.
Yun Jhin realized that there was nothing else inside his body but his mood was extremely sour due to this random eye-less man stealing his salt, he thought that he would only have to wait for a few more days before the formation core inside him dissipated so he could leave back to the Empire but it seemed he wasn't that lucky.
Yun Jhin frowned as he walked back into the inner palace but he realized that there were no more salt urns around, the one he took was the last in the inner palace! This was extremely unlucky for him!
It seemed the other urns were stolen some time ago and only the cannon fodder remained to try and take the last urn which had the worst quality of salt, that was why so many dumb cultivators threw themselves to death for the urn, only the dumb ones remained as the smart ones already took whatever they could!
Yun Jhin was extremely angry right now but there wasn't much he could do besides going inside the Naga region and betting his life on taking some salt from there.
Or he could just go back to the Empire and hope the Emperor had some salt inside his treasury which he would unceremoniously give him due to his successful training.
Yun Jhin was a careful man, careful to the point bold ones would call him a coward, but his 'cowardly' attitude let him live to the utmost in his last life, while he was weak he would act cowardly but if he was strong he would act like he was god, he was that type of guy who would fear the strong and bully the weak.
So he didn't want to throw away his life as there was a chance of not even getting the salt in the Naga region, he decided to wait it out then return to the Empire and ask for the salt from the Emperor. Even though it was a shameless thing to do Yun Jhin didn't mind being shameless.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Back to the Empire
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin sighed as he felt the formation core inside of him starting to dissipate, after he went to the four locations and lived in them for atleast 10 days each the formation disappeared by itself just like it was supposed to, Yun Jhin was surprised by that thinking that the Emperor put up some hidden mechanic inside of the formation but it seemed he was wrong.
After he got attacked by the eye-less man Yun Jhin sat cross-legged near the exit in stealth and now that the formation disappeared from his body he was ready to leave.
Yun Jhin exited the underwater palace easily as the world started to flip and rotate around him, after a little while he was back into the ocean and he started to swim back to the shore.
Black Blood looked as Yun Jhin exited the danger zone immediately after the allocated time passed and he was quite surprised, did he had some difficulties during his last training as he didn't stay more, or did he get what he needed from the location faster?
Black Blood decided he observed for enough, he disappeared from where he stood and appeared in front of Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin put on a startled expression on his face but then he made a small bow as he said:
"Oh, it's senior Black Blood, did the Emperor sent you to take me to the capital after I finished the elemental trials?"
Black Blood nodded his head at him, he didn't explain to him that he followed him around during the training, who knew what reaction he would have after he unlocked more of his memories? Most God Realm experts were eccentric fellows, who knew if some of his former life traits already entered his mind?
Black Blood engulfed Yun Jhin with his aura as he started to fly at quick speeds, zooming directly to the capital location, even though he was a Sage Realm expert around the 2nd to 3rd stage he still needed a bit of time to get to the capital from the ocean, it took him almost 3 days to travel to the capital with Yun Jhin in tow, he could have gone faster but he thought that Yun Jhin's body wouldn't be able to handle the true speed of a Sage Realm cultivator.
Yun Jhin meditated the whole journey and only opened his eyes after they reached the capital, if he had the purified salt he would have immediately gone into seclusion to refine his four elements pill, but now he would have to go to the Emperor to report to him and ask for some salt...
Black Blood did ask him if he wanted to rest first but Yun Jhin insisted that he wanted to meet the Emperor to give a report, he also hinted that he unlocked some new memories that could be useful to the empire.
Black Blood didn't dare to disagree when he understood the fact that Yun Jhin's new memories could help the Empire so he immediately went with him to the palace then ushered him into the throne room.
The Emperor just stood there, Sumo Tiancheng looked like quite an average middle-aged man but inside he was a schemer of great proportions, The Emperor looked down at Yun Jhin and Black Blood then rose from his throne and walked to them with open arms as he said:
"Ah, you have returned junior Yun Jhin might I know if your traveling went well?"
The Emperor didn't even mention Lulu and Yun Jhin didn't find it surprising, she should have had an item that was linked to her soul, and the moment she died both the Emperor who installed the formation cored inside her and her mother would know.
The Emperor was fishing for information with his question and Yun Jhin gave it to him in the form of a soul message, the Emperor's eyes narrowed then a big smile appeared on his face, Yun Jhin sent him some beneficial information for the God Realm, even though it wasn't enough for him to even see a breakthrough in 20,000 thousand years, it was still progress for him!
This type of information made the Emperor realize that Yun Jhin's memories didn't come from an ordinary God Realm expert, that surely meant his cultivation was above his and he might even have been an advanced God Realm practitioner that might have even stood around the 7th to 8th stage!
There was both greed and respect in the Emperor's eyes, after all, very few reincarnated cultivators would be able to unlock their memories after their soul went through the cycle of reincarnation as Yun Jhin did, most of the time their memories would be tightly sealed by something that not even they could understand.
Yun Jhin wanted to ask the Emperor for some salt but the Emperor asked him something with a strange look on his face before he could inquire about the thing he needed:
"My wife would like to know how her daughter died, she should come soon so spit out whatever you want to say before she arrives."
Yun Jhin went directly to the subject and asked for some salt, but the Emperor's face turned strange again as he said:
"You are in luck considering there is some salt in the Empire's borders, but you are also unlucky at the same time considering that the salt is in my wife's hands, I mean she would have surely given it to you if you returned with Lulu alive, but now you would have to give her something equal in exchange, and let me tell you, my wife won't accept information, you should know what she wants."
The Emperor got back to the throne and told Black Blood that he was dismissed, the Empress appeared in the throne room and her eyes immediately went to Yun Jhin, there wasn't hatred or anger in her eyes, but they were filled mostly with disappointment, both in Yun Jhin and her late daughter.
Yun Jhin bowed to the Empress and her voice reverberated in the palace:
"Yun Jhin tell me how did my daughter die?"
Yun Jhin didn't lie or beat around the bush as he said:
"I and your esteemed daughter ventured deep into the Earth elemental danger zone, I wanted to get a herb but due to my low cultivation base I wasn't able to reach it, Lulu wanting to impress me decided that she would go to harvest the herb, unfortunately, a toxic scorpion was using the herb as bait and Lulu was killed... Her last words for me was to run as her life disappeared from her eyes, I knew she was done for so I ran away, most likely the poison from the scorpion already done her in before her eyes even started to lose their light. I'm sorry your highness, I couldn't protect her."
The Empress shook her head a few times as she sighed deeply and looked at Yun Jhin, again and again, to make sure he wasn't lying, but Yun Jhin was technically speaking the truth while just omitting a few facts so the Empress could only say that he was genuinely telling the truth.
She frowned as she looked at him and said:
"I have heard from my husband that you want salt from the underwater temple, I'm the possession of half an urn of salt and I can trade it for some of your 'services', my oldest daughter should be around your cultivation base and she just turned 34 this year, you can meet her near outside of my garden and I can take you to her right now, what do you say?"
Yun Jhin beat around the bush with Lulu as he wanted her to have more uses, but her eldest daughter wasn't that useful, her bloodline was inferior so was her talent and the Empress only hoped that she would give birth to a good descendant using Yun Jhin's bloodline, there was also the fact that she wanted to rope him in her faction using marriage and the child between the two.
The Emperor didn't say anything, on the surface, the marriage between factions would create an inner peace between the factions that hasn't been attained up till now, the marriage and child between Yun Jhin and her eldest daughter was something that the Emperor didn't reject,atleast he wouldn't be cuckolded by someone of the younger generation.
Yun Jhin seemingly thought about it for a few minutes before he reluctantly nodded his head and took the Empress's hand. The Empress gave him a smile then they disappeared, The Emperor looked at the spot that they sat in and sighed:
"Let's hope this thing will go better, the inner turmoil in the Empire would finally be fixed if this goes well, atleast our subordinates will see it as an auspicious thing."
The Emperor and the Empress were technically from two different factions after they were unable to conceive a child together, that was what the masses thought, but it wasn't fully true, the Emperor was just a little bit mad that the Empress went ahead and cuckolded him, in the first place, the Emperor didn't even have any concubines, but he took a few thousand of them in after he found out she cheated on him.
Yun Jhin appeared in the Empress's garden and he was quite impressed by it, it was quite artistic and there was also a formation under the earth that protected it, Yun Jhin could tell that if the Empress controlled it she might even be able to fight it out with a 6th stage God Realm cultivator for a while.
Yun Jhin was then led to the Empress's daughter by Fairy Song, the Empress returned to her gazebo but her eyes never looked away from Yun Jhin's figure as she muttered slowly to herself:
"Let's see if your descendants would be good, hopefully, this good for nothing daughter of mine would have her use now, if I didn't put that formation on her stopping her from having a child up till now she would have been impregnated countless times..."
Fairy Song took him to a building that was around 20 kilometers away from the flower garden and then left him alone when he entered it, but before she left, she told him the name of the Empress's oldest daughter and some of her quirks, she also gave him a quick wink before she disappeared from his view and senses.
The building wasn't that big, it could house up to four persons and it had two bedrooms, a bath, and a kitchen. Most cultivators would forsake such things as they lived based on the ki of heaven and earth, not needing to eat sleep, take baths, or have any other needs.
It seemed that the person that lived here had quite the peculiar temperament.
Out of the bedroom came out a woman that could be called a half-mature beauty, her bosom wasn't either big or small, it was around the perfect size, her legs were long and her pink cherry lips invited one in, she had deep red hair tied in a ponytail behind her back and she wore nothing but a bathrobe currently.
She waved her finger in Yun Jhin's direction and gave him a slutty smile her bathrobe was slowly falling from her sexy body as she retracted into the bedroom.
Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as she disappeared into the bedroom, it seemed the Empress's oldest daughter was quite experienced in the ways of men and women, she could even be called a vixen, unfortunately for her, those things wouldn't work on Yun Jhin, but due to the things he needed he would have to do as she wanted.
Yun Jhin slowly walked to the bedroom and put his hand on the handle of the door to the room and turned it, he would have to impregnate this woman and that meant quite a bit of sex, after all, the higher the cultivation base the harder for one to have a child, this combined with their pure bloodline made the imperial couple unable to have any children.
But to Yun Jhin only meant one day and night of sex, he wasn't at that point of purity and high cultivation base.
The door slowly opened as Yun Jhin laid his eyes on the woman that sat with her legs spread open on the bed, she was readily inviting him to take action and Yun Jhin considered it to be rude to refuse her invitation.
Sophia gave Yun Jhin another slutty smile as the door behind him closed as she said:
"Come for me, hopefully in more ways than one."

chapters.title: Chapter 78: The 2nd stage of the King Realm
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin got up from the bed, behind him Sophia embraced him as she purred with a sly look on her face as she said:
"Aren't you a little beast, you pleased me for such a long amount of time.."
Yun Jhin ignored her remarks as he got up, not having anymore support Sophia flailed around and fell on her face on the bed, Yun Jhin put on his clothes and then left the house.
Sophia huffed as she got up and looked at his form until he disappeared and said:
"You will have to come when I will give birth to your child!"
Yun Jhin walked away from the house as Fairy Song appeared and took him to the Empress, the Empress was still in her gazebo, gazing at her flower garden, her eyes moved only when Yun Jhin arrived, she looked him up and down then gave him a thumbs-up as she said:
"Your stamina is quite impressive, I already checked on Sophia and if nothing untoward happens to her she should be expecting."
The Empress smiled as she waved her hand and an urn of salt appeared in her hands, the urn floated to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin took it in his hands weighed it then put it in his spatial ring, he bowed slowly to her then Fairy Song took him and disappeared.
The Empress sighed as she looked towards the house's direction where Sophie was still grumbling about Yun Jhi ignoring her after he did all of those things to her. The Empress's eyes wandered as she thought:
"If he unlocked some of his more important memories he won't care about his descendant that much... atleast we secured his peculiar bloodline, in the end, there is no reason for him to become an enemy to our empire."
The Empress saw how Yun Jhin didn't care about Sophie at all, after all, there were no emotions between them, and if feelings could be cultivated, God Realm cultivators wouldn't be swayed by their emotion at all, the higher the cultivation base the easier it was to control your emotions, even though you could still feel them you could decide if you wanted to act on them or not.
Yun Jhin arrived at the Emperor's palace and announced that he would enter into closed-door cultivation for a while, the Emperor and Empress didn't say anything as they already knew, after the training zones, they thought that he got some more experience, coupled with the items he gained and his memories he should be able to make a breakthrough at the least.
Yun Jhin sat cross-legged in his room as he started doing some handseals, all of his ingredients started to float around him, the snake, the frog, the crystalline herb, the underwater herbs, the beast cores, and lastly the salt, he first purified the salt to his maximum capacity reducing its quantity to only a handful.
Then he created a formation in which he started throwing the ingredients in a certain pattern, the pattern wasn't random as he used the theory of creation behind it, he first put the earth, then the water, then the air, and lastly the flame ingredients.
After he finished combining all of the ingredients, he added the salt as a catalyst that fused all of the ingredients and purified the sludge that would soon be a pill.
The sludge was at first of random colors that moved as if they were alive, but the colors started to stabilize after, the colors resembled the four elements as they took a circular shape transforming into a pill, then the salt that fused them extracted the impurities from the pill, even though it was only a handful, due to its now high quality 100% of the impurities were removed.
The pill sat there, glistening and pure, Yun Jhin took it in his hand as he admired it for a split second before he broke it into dust and inhaled it, starlight started to fall from the sky at his command as the pill dust entered his body then accelerated towards his soul.
The pill dust refined his first soul jewel then the starlight came to stabilize its sudden growth, slowly but surely he reached the 9th stage of refinery and his first soul jewel became pure and shining, all of its impurities and soul wraiths which were inhabiting it died, they shrieked for the last time before they transformed into a white light that the jewel absorbed, his first jewel became of a pure white color that just sat on his crown.
Yun Jhin used the remainder of the dust on the empty slot on his crown, the second jewel started to appear as the dust started to crystallize in a starlit jewel, then the jewel started to be filled with the four elements gaining four different colors in each segment.
The colors were barely discernible and muddled but along with more refinery to the jewel, they would start shining.
The dust from the pill was finally used up as Yun Jhin started to call down even more starlight to refine his 4 elements jewel, after a long time of refining the colors were a little bit more discernible and less muddled, Yun Jhin reached the 2nd refinery in one go and stopped calling starlight from the sky.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as his body was engulfed in four different colors, this was one of the benefits of having a four elements jewel, the four elemental body!
Yun Jhin's body became transparent as his organs, bones muscles, skin, they all were strengthened simultaneously, his body's rank started to surge up, 8,100, 8200, 8300, 8400, 8500.
It forcefully stopped at 8500, it could have increased more but Yun Jhin started to bleed from 4 of the seven apertures and if he forcefully broke through further he would have self-imploded.
This was the limit placed on his current bloodline, there were chains placed on his DNA helix that wouldn't let him break through further into his body refinement, the same thing would happen to his ki cultivation when he tried to break through to the Sage Realm, however, it would be less dangerous and he had a way to safely breakthrough.
Yun Jhin flexed his arms and then started to do some stretching exercises to feel all of his body and the improvements from his four elemental jewel.
He could feel that if he fought the same guy that robbed him at the underwater temple he would be surely able to fight back and even win if the guy didn't keep his guard up around him.
In theory, he should be able to fight with a 6th stage King Realm cultivator after his breakthrough.
Now all he needed to do was put it in practice.
He didn't meet with Kong Luo in quite a long time so he decided to give him a visit and request a sparring partner from his army division.
Yun Jhin left his room and Black Blood reported to the Emperor, he also told him that he was successful in his breakthrough reaching the 2nd stage of the King Realm, as for the refinement of his jewel he didn't know, only the owners of the crown would know.
Yun Jhin quickly arrived at the general's army division and met up with him, Kong Luo was happy to meet with Yun Jhin and hear about his training expedition, Yun Jhin only told him about the surface events and then asked him to find him someone who could he spar against. Kong Luo saw that he broke through to the 2nd stage of the King Realm and patted him on the shoulder while congratulating him.
Then he sent an announcement to the whole squad division that the vice-general returned and that he wanted to spar with someone!
This announcement put the whole squad on fire, but then they realized that it was Yun Jhin, Kong Luo was talking about and not their true vice-general, most of them still looked down on Yun Jhin as they didn't get any news from the former training expedition, nor from this one, after all, only Yun Jhin and Lulu were supposed to train at the four elemental danger zones.
Kong Luo led him to the sparring area of the army squad division and there were already quite a lot of people watching, most of them wanted to boo when they saw Yun Jhin but Kong Luo was with him so all they could do was grith their teeth and wait for Kong Luo to give the signal for the start of the challenges.
Yun Jhin stood in the sparring area with his eyes closed as Kong Luo told that anyone could challenge him if they were under the 9th stage of the King Realm, this was Yun Jhin's request and Kong Luo decided to abide it, after all, he was a reincarnated God Realm expert with multiple aces up his sleeve, so he wouldn't babysit him.
Yun Jhin didn't have to wait for much time as a 3rd stage King Realm expert took to the sparring area but Yun Jhin shook his head and pushed his hand forward, the man was startled by his action but he immediately fell away from the sparring area, he was bleeding from the mouth but he wasn't that injured, his eyes widened in surprise and horror as he didn't go back to the area, he just left with his head down and his whole body shaking.
The others thought that he was scared and some others tried, then the cultivation of the challengers started to increase, the 4th stage and the 5th stage, but for them, Yun Jhin only had to apply a little more force to his push before they started to bleed internally and they left as well.
Finally, a 6th stage King Realm cultivator got up to the stage and entered a fighting stance, he didn't dare to underestimate Yun Jhin because his previous display even made him unsure if he could win 100%, at most he would have a 40% chance.
Yun Jhin finally put a serious expression on his face as he entered his fighting stance, the four elements were roaming around his body like armor.
The man didn't say anything as he launched himself at Yun Jhin, his fist ready to break through his armor and strike him directly in the chest, the man's speed was quite high as it seemed he was specializing in the trait.
But Yun Jhin could easily see through the man's martial technique, he sidestepped his punch and hit him in the stomach knocking the wind out of him, his strike was enchanted with the four elements and the man's internal organs started to burn as his skin was frozen, then he was stuck to the earth as the frozen skin was cut open by the wind applied by Yun Jhin's fist technique.
The man didn't look down on Yun Jhin but he was still surprised by the intricate attack that combined all of the four elements into one, he coughed up a mouthful of blood then put his hand up as he gave up, there was no reason to fight Yun Jhin anymore if the fight continued since Yun Jhin had the first strike advantage he would surely lose as he was injured and some of his inner ki seeped away.
Yun Jhin didn't make things hard for him as he let him off the sparring area, but suddenly there was a clapping sound coming from the exit of the sparring area, a middle-aged man who wore a military uniform and had the vice-general sign on his chest near the heart area entered.
The man had blonde short hair and deep green eyes, his skin was rough and his build was muscular, he wasn't that tall standing around 1,76 centimeters being of average height even among humans.
His aura was calm like a deep pond as he walked towards the sparring area and he said:
"I didn't think the new vice-general would be so talented in your fist techniques, I would like to swap some pointers with this new younger brother, I don't think general Kong Luo would mind?"
Kong Luo wanted to interfere, the vice-general was quite old compared to Yun Jhin and due to his outside training he finally broke through to the 9th stage of the King Realm, even though he wasn't the strongest vice-general in the army currently, he could be counted in the top 15 after his breakthrough.
Yun Jhin looked at the general and said:
"I would like to spar with this older brother but the discrepancy between our cultivations is quite high, if you restricted your cultivation to around the 7th or even 8th stage I would fight you, also you can't use your innate 9th stage technique."
The vice-general smiled as he replied:
"Seems pretty fair to me considering your lack of cultivation base, I'm older after all, and I should abate to these rules, after all, I don't want to bully the younger generation for no reason, I'm just quite interested in your fist technique, don't take it as an offense younger brother Yun Jhin."
Since Yun Jhin agreed to it Kong Luo didn't say anything as he let the vice-general on the sparring area, the vice-general gave a small greeting bow as he said:
"My name is Lu Shen and I would like to get some guidance from younger brother's Yun Jhin fist technique."
Yun Jhin reciprocated the gesture and entered his fighting stage as Lu Shen's cultivation base started to drop around the 6th stage of the King Realm however his momentum was extremely different compared to the former opponent at the 6th stage, there was also an experienced air around him that very few in the army had.
Lu Shen entered into his fighting stance and waited for Yun Jhin to attack, it seemed he played it passively waiting to counter-attack depending on what type of attack Yun Jhin would do.
Yun Jhin kept his ground as he stared at the older man, he would be a good guinea pig for his new elemental technique.
Yun Jhin smiled inside as he started charging his inner ki into a certain pattern inside his body. He would unleash one of his rather commonly used attacks from his previous life.

chapters.title: Chapter 79: The four elements jewel shines
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin started his charge while being fully covered by a transparent four colored armor, Lu Shen's eyes narrowed as he saw Yun Jhin's sloppy form of attacking, it looked like it came from an amateur but he didn't counter-attack as he sat there.
Suddenly when Yun Jhin was 2 meters away from him he moved his hands and pushed them forward, a left hook zoomed towards Yun Jhin's head at an extremely quick speed, Yun Jhin smiled as the left hook hit something solid and the man backed away then looked at his fist which was burned, frozen, and lacerated then his wound was infested with earth ki poison.
Lu Shen shook his hand as the laceration closed off, his frostbite disappeared along with his burnt skin, and the earth ki poison was removed into a dark green ball which he threw away, it landed on the earth of the sparring area and it created a deep hole inside it that recovered itself after a short while.
While Lu Shen shook his hand Yun Jhin entered his personal space and tried to plant a kick into his stomach, when his kick reached the man's abdomen he realized that his stomach wasn't there!
Lu Shen sucked in his stomach then he launched his kick hitting Yun Jhin's leg and trying to break it.
Yun Jhin retreated two steps by jumping on one leg then put the one that stood up down, the kick created a crater on the earth as Yun Jhin used the momentum to dash forward to Lu Shen, Lu Shen dashed forward as well as a smile appeared on his face.
Yun Jhin punched him in the chest but Lu Shen blocked it with his forearm then tried to hit Yun Jhin in the head, however, the invisible 'wall' from before appeared and stopped his attack before it could land on Yun Jhin's forehead by around 5 centimeters.
Lu Shen frowned as he backed away and shook his hand again, but he realized that it got harder to heal his hand and remove the earth ki poison, Yun Jhin was improving in real-time in his fight against him!
Lu Shen didn't know what to say, after all, he didn't meet such geniuses even in his travels, there weren't many people who could improve while fighting someone.
Yun Jhin wasn't improving while fighting him, he was just rusty as he didn't use this technique in a long while, so he was just recovering his previous experience.
Lu Shen disappeared as he transformed into a ray of light that shot itself at Yun Jhin, the ray of light was extremely sharp and if it hit Yun Jhin in a vital point there was a high chance of death for him, but Lu Shen wasn't that bold to try and attack mortally with Kong Luo viewing, so he went for Yun Jhin's right arm.
Yun Jhin didn't want to use formations in this fight, after all, it wasn't a life or death fight and he wanted to see how much his cultivation improved, so the invisible armor that covered his body started to become visible as he turned it on at full capacity.
The armor had four colors, in each color, there was the character of Earth, Wind, Fire, and Water in the respective colors, black, silver, red, and blue.
Lu Shen eyes widened as he looked at the armor and questioned:
"This technique... it needs the four elemental jewels to be executed, you are at the 2nd stage how can you do this?"
Yun Jhin smiled but he didn't respond, Lu Shen knew everyone had their secrets, especially in such a world where one fortuitous encounter could change a man's/woman's fate, no one would want to share their secrets.
Yun Jhin armor made him invincible to those below the 9th stage in defense, that meant he could run away but not beat them, as he fought Lu Shen increased his cultivation base slowly but he realized that he couldn't penetrate through Yun Jhin's armor, it defended all of his weak spots like it was alive.
The armor was partially alive considering Yun Jhin used a lot of the souls he refined from the first jewel to construct this one, even though the souls disappeared that didn't mean they got their rest, they were recycled. Yun Jhin would never waste some good souls.
Lu Shen frowned as his aura finally reached the peak of the 8th stage and he said:
"If this attack still can't break through your defenses it will be my defeat younger brother Yun Jhin, you can even have the official title of vice-general, I came back to the capital because I will soon break through the Emperor realm and I will get a division of my own."
Kong Luo wasn't surprised by his words, Lu Shen was a talented man who worked it up the ranks with grit and tenacity along with his natural talent in cultivation, Kong Luo would miss him as a subordinate but it could also be good to have an ally that would talk for him in the court later down the road.
Yun Jhin braced himself for Lu Shen's ultimate attack, he was sure that it wouldn't be able to do much to his armor but he didn't want to have any surprises.
Lu Shen started giving out a strange aura as all of his ki started to go inward, his aura started to slowly disappear seemingly as if he turned into a mortal man without any cultivation, then he opened his mouth and a giant wave of energy came out of his mouth which traveled quickly towards Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin didn't have enough time to dodge the wave of energy as it's speed was very quick, maybe if he was atleast at the 5th to 6th stage he would have been able to dodge it but since he was at the 2nd there was no way he could with his current physical body, but he could tank it!
The wave of energy hit him head-on, but a gigantic projection of his armor appeared in front of him and took the brunt of the energy wave, the projection started to crack after a short while and broke but the armor on his body was still intact without any scratches, the remainder of the attack struck his armored body and then it was reflected into the sky where it disappeared.
Lu Shen started to breathe heavily as this technique took a lot out of him, but he recovered quickly since he didn't use his ultimate technique at its full potential due to the self-limitations of his cultivation base.
Lu Shen gave out a weak smile as he said:
"This is a technique I derived from my ultimate jewel skill, it seems in the future the Empire will have another Sage Realm expert at the least, with your potential and youth you could surely reach that realm."
Yun Jhin bowed slowly as he said:
"You flatter me elder brother Lu Shen, thank you for the spar."
Lu Shen continued to smile as he reciprocated the gesture, it was nice to find such a young person who was both talented and humble, most people his age would have their nose so up in the sky that they couldn't see their feet if they had the same amount of talent he had, he saw countless such 'young masters' and 'young mistresses' in his travels outside the Empire.
Lu Shen took his leave as he talked a bit with Kong Luo, most of the army was present besides those outside that went on missions, they saw Yun Jhin's might all of them started to respect him, after all, might make right in this world, the stronger you are the more respect and fear you would garner from the people around you.
Kong Luo clapped for a little bit before he congratulated Yun Jhin on his breakthrough again, Yun Jhin gave him a small smile then left, he knew where he sat with his normal battle power right now, even if he couldn't fight a 9th stage King Realm practitioner head-on, he could survive him if he didn't use his true ultimate skill, and even if he did use his ultimate skill he could run away using formations.
Yun Jhin returned to his room only to be interrupted by Black Blood who said that the Emperor sent for him, Yun Jhin couldn't refuse so he followed Black Blood to the throne room.
The Emperor sat on his throne as he said:
"You have been in closed-door cultivations for almost 5 to 6 months, the first princess Sophia is pregnant and she is going to expect your child in a few months, no this isn't the reason why I called you here, I have some good news and bad news."
The Emperor sighed as he took a letter out of his chest pocket and read it there weren't many words but all of them were heavy:
"Our firstborn daughter Zula, of the Muzan household, has been violated by someone from your Empire and we demand satisfaction!"
Yun Jhin knew this was going to happen sooner or later, it seems it happened sooner, the Emperor asked him what this was about and Yun Jhin agreed that he was the one who did the deed, after all, the letter also had his portrait below the message, there was no reason to lie to the Emperor.
The Emperor sighed as he burned the letter to cinders and then he said:
"Well you took the opportunity when you could, you healed yourself and you even took the herb that was needed to the pill that you wanted to concoct, I can't say that you have done is wrong as I would have done the same in your shoes, fortunately, you haven't killed any of them and this dispute can be easily resolved."
The Emperor looked straight into Yun Jhin's eyes as he said:
"You will either marry her or get strong enough to defeat the head of her house, these are the conditions that the Zipher household had put forth, let me give you a hint, the head of her house is a half-god expert."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he responded:
"So I guess I could only marry her then, after all, how could I defeat the head of the house as I'm right now?"
The Emperor nodded at him and said:
"It's good that you understand the bigger picture, Zula is quite a beauty, and having a marriage with one of the ten top houses of the Bumi Empire isn't a bad thing, even though the Luo and Bumi Empire don't see face to face they aren't irreconcilable enemies either, they said that the wedding must be done as soon as possible because you already took her vital yin."
Yun Jhin didn't mind it one bit, he didn't care much about Zula or her opinion, having a political marriage like this would get him some benefits in the form of a dowry, he just wasn't sure what he would get.
Since Yun Jhin accepted extremely easily the Emperor immediately sent word using a communication formation and he got a response in the same moment that said:
"We will come to the Sumo Empire in ten days and we will marry them in the same day of the arrival, be ready!"
In such a patriarchal society like the cultivation one, marrying off a daughter wasn't of high importance, but who she was married off too was important.
Having a political alliance with the Sumo Empire would be a good thing for the least ranked family as they would get some support from the Emperor, having a backer in the form of a god realm expert would make sure that they didn't fall from the top 10 even if their head of the house died, it seemed there was a high chance the head of the house would try to break through the God Realm and he wanted insurance that his house wouldn't fall if he died.
Yun Jhin left the throne room and returned to his room where he sat cross-legged on his bed.
His were closed as he meditated, all he could do right now was continued refining his four elemental jewel while he waited for his wife, father, and mother in law to arrive.
Fortunately to a cultivator time would fly by extremely fast and he was summoned to the throne room exactly ten days later as the message stated.
Black Blood came to take him and helped him choose a red wedding suit then took him to the throne room.
There Zula stood near the Emperor, she had a red wedding dress on her body and a red veil was covering her face.
The Emperor stood up a few meters away just like a priest while a middle-aged man and woman stood near Zula, both of them were glaring at Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin found it strange that both of them weren't the head of the house, it seemed Zula was just talented and her parents weren't of high standing so the head of the house must have adopted her.
Yun Jhin slowly walked towards Zula, he had a small smile on his face as he stood in front of her, the veil couldn't stop the glare that was filled with both hatred and poison but there was nothing she could do as she took his hand in hers and waited for the Emperor to start talking. She was forced to marry the man that defiled her but there was nothing she could say against her adoptive father's wishes, and if her biological parents spoke up there was a high chance of both of them being executed.
All she could do was grith her teeth and curse herself for not being strong enough.
Finally, after both Yun Jhin and Zula stood in front of the Emperor, he opened his mouth to start the ceremony, everything became quiet until the Empress arrived with a pregnant Sophia in tow.

chapters.title: Chapter 80: Wedding crashers
chapters.content:
Both of Yun Jhin's in-laws were angry seeing the Empress barge in uninvited in their daughter's wedding, but a voice transmission from the Emperor made both of them sweat internally.
The Emperor told them that she was his wife and also a god realm expert of the Empire, thus they knew that they couldn't say anything if she wanted to observe their daughter's wedding.
But they couldn't keep their eyes of Sophia's pregnant form, they wondered why would the Empress barge in with a pregnant woman?
Then the woman's eyes widened as she looked at Sophia then at Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin's mother in law was quite sharp and she realized the Empress came with someone Yun Jhin had a child with to show that their daughter wouldn't be the main wife!
After all, the main wife could change faster than anyone anticipated in such type of relationships, both parents didn't want their only daughter to be a concubine but since it seemed that she wasn't married off to Yun Jhin yet as she didn't have a ring, there was still time for their daughter to become the main wife, she just needed to give birth to a boy!
The Emperor smiled at his wife's antics then started the ceremony.
The ceremony didn't last long after it was finished they worshipped the heaven and earth then they exchanged their vows and rings, Black Blood came quickly and gave Yun Jhin the case with the rings, he put a jade ring on her finger while she put a white opal ring on his.
Finally, Yun Jhin kissed the wife and the ceremony was over, The Emperor gave out a hearty laugh as he said:
"Isn't it time for the esteemed guest to stop hiding?"
Out of nowhere a green-haired woman who wore simple clothes appeared, she had three swords tied at her hip and two scars ran over both of her black colored eyes, her green hair was cut short and messy and she gave out a wanderer aura.
Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as he saw her, she was the same girl from the dead general's memories!
It seemed she was from the Bumi Empire and she grew up to become a half-god expert, he could tell from her aura even though it was hidden, she could hide it from others but someone with his experience could tell it, the Emperor and Empress could tell as well.
The woman made a small bow as she smiled at Zula and Yun Jhin while saying:
"I should be the first one to congratulate this young couple, I'm going to go in closed-door cultivation for an imminent breakthrough very soon and I would like to be the first one to give the wedding gift."
The woman took something out of her spatial ring, it was an exquisitely carved box with dragons imprints on it, she opened it a little and a wonderful aroma escaped it, if Yun Jhin could guess from the smell alone it was a hearty starlight pill, very useful for those in the King Realm it could speed up the jewelry refinement by 50% to 80%.
The woman gave out a small smile as she said:
"Since both of you are in the King Realm I decided that this would be a rather good wedding gift for the two of you."
The Emperor coughed and took a small pearl out of his robes then gave it to the biological parents of Zula, this was a token of his appreciation and it would be quite awkward if he didn't give anything as he was supposed to be Yun Jhin's guardian in this situation.
The parents didn't know what to say and only grasped the pearl, in this type of situation only the bride's family would gift things, they didn't even get to the dowry yet!
The green-haired swordswoman then took out another thing from her spatial ring, it was a strange half-black and half-white rock, she chucked it to Yun Jhin and said via voice transmission:
"Boy this is your dowry, I won't say much about it besides that its a Ying-Yang stone, you should know what it is, after all, you are a reincarnated God Realm expert aren't you?"
It seemed Yun Jhin's secret wasn't a secret anymore, after all, to create this alliance some secrets needed to spill out, but Yun Jhin was sure they made her unable to tell this to anyone else, and even if she did, she wouldn't get benefits, she might even be killed because she made such an alliance, technically speaking she was now allying with 3 God Realm experts! Even though one still needed to mature.
The Empress started clapping as she walked forward and scrutinized the green-haired woman up and down, the woman gave out a weak smile as she said:
"I'm honored to meet the Empress of the Sumo Empire, my name is Surr Zara, I hope our alliance will be long and prospering."
The Empress smiled as she patted Zara's shoulder, however, this made Zara pale heavily, she didn't know why the Empress would act like this on their first meeting. The pregnant Sophia just looked around and didn't say anything, she knew she was only a puzzle piece for her mother so she just stood there nicely with her chest out and her big belly in front. She did her job splendidly.
Zara's eyes narrowed as she watched Sophia puff out her chest but then she continued smiling as she retreated towards the Emperor's side.
The Emperor gave out a small cough indicating that this was enough, this was something the Emperor talked with the Empress before, even though they were allies Zara should know where she stood in this alliance, they were the stronger party and she had to play to their tune, in return they would give her and her house the protection she needed.
Zara bowed to the Emperor then told Zula via voice transmission:
"Kid you are our only hope if I die in my closed-door cultivation, just please this Yun Jhin as best as you can and both of your parents and other relatives will be okay, do you understand?"
Zula gave her affirmation using the same voice transmission channel then Zara gave out a big smile as she teleported away with her parents in tow.
Zula was now alone between strangers, she didn't know what to say, the only one that she knew here was Yun Jhin and she hated him to the bone.
The Emperor gave out a wry smile as he saw Zula glare at Yun Jhin then said:
"Well since the wedding is done you two love birds can go have your privacy, darling you should go as well, don't let Sophia's baby get influenced by the unfortunate air around my palace."
The Empress humphed then left along with Sophia, Yun Jhin left with Azula towards his new room which Black Blood outfitted for his and his new wife's needs.
Yun Jhin entered the room and Zula was ready to attack him with fire but Yun Jhin easily slapped her aside and sealed her power, her eyes widened as she looked at him and said:
"You have grown so strong already? HOW!?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he changed his clothes, he didn't like the stuffy groom suit, he changed back into the clothes he used for his training expedition, they were renewed and fixed with the help of formations so they looked bright new, Yun Jhin also reinforced their defenses with the help of his four elemental jewel.
Zula glared as her bindings were undone, Yun Jhin looked at her in the eyes and said:
"Just be a nice wife and act properly, you don't have to like me or anything, you don't even have to stay in the same room as me, after all, this was just a political marriage, do what you want as long as you don't affect the bigger picture of the Empire and your family, you should understand that right?"
Zula gritted her teeth then looked down, tears started to fall down her cheeks as she hiccuped and said:
"I already liked someone... but I was forced to marry you..."
Yun Jhin gave her a side glance and said:
"That's rough buddy."
Zula frowned but didn't say anything as she cleared her eyes after she finished crying, she was a strong woman and this was one of the rare times that she would show her sensitive side to someone, she just felt so weak and unwanted... but it seemed she wouldn't get anything from showing this side of hers to Yun Jhin, after all, he was a cold and calculative man and what he said was the truth, there was no feeling between them and it was only a political marriage.
Zula looked at Yun Jhin but didn't leave the room as she jumped on the bed and then changed her clothes in front of him, Yun Jhin didn't mind as he already saw her whole body and took her vital yin so it didn't matter to him, Zula knew that already so she didn't hide needlessly, they were 'husband and wife' now anyways.
Yun Jhin took out a hearty starlight pill from the box that Zara gave as a wedding gift, he observed it for a short while before he concluded that they weren't tampered with, with this whole box he would be able to fully refine his second jewel and with the ying-yang stone he would be able to create a ying-yang jewel which would lead to an easier time when learning the death and life laws at the Sage and God Realm.
Yun Jhin turned one starlight pill into a liquid form which he swallowed, the liquid ran around his body for a short while before it entered into his soul and moved directly to the second jewel to refine it further.
Zula didn't disturb Yun Jhin cultivation as she started to cultivate herself, she had her box of starlight pills that Zara gave to her before the wedding.
One pill two pills, six pills... Yun Jhin's refinery stage jumped up the more pills he used the higher his stage went, after he used half the box he finally reached the peak of the 9th stage of his second jewel refinery and along with it the peak of the 2nd stage of the King Realm.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes and looked around, Zula was still cultivating so he didn't bother her as he took out the Ying-Yang stone, there was one way to assimilate the stone and it was very simple.
Yun Jhin put his hand into his chest as he ripped it open, blood fell but his organs were tightly knit into his body due to their refinement, after a short while the blood also stopped and his chest was starting to slowly heal, but Yun Jhin took the Ying-Yang stone and gritted his teeth as he pushed the stone into his heart!
He wanted to scream but he didn't, he endured higher pain than this before, however, this one still hurt like a bitch!
His heart started beating at extreme speeds as it was swallowing the stone, his chest was also recovering at extreme speeds as it closed.
Yun Jhin's body was full of cold sweat as the stone was fully swallowed by his heart, then his heart turned black and white as it was inscribed with some scriptures that were hidden in the stone.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as the pain receded, then he used the scriptures along with his new blood that pumped through his body to create his next jewel!
His blood was now full of Ying-Yang properties meaning it was both hot and cold at the same time, both dead and alive, it was a strange state of being that not many could achieve normally, but it could be achieved artificially if one gained a Ying-Yang stone, the benefits weren't many for this state, your ki will be a little purer and you would have better future prospects, but the biggest benefit would be creating a jewel that could contain both Ying and Yang inside of it, giving your crown slots for more jewels.
A half-white half-dark jewel appeared on the next slot of Yun Jhin's crown, this was the Ying-Yang jewel!
The Ying-Yang jewel gave him strength and enlightenment of life and death, but it wasn't that useful for him as he already knew those things, he was only missing the cultivation base to employ them.
After he fully finished creating his Ying-Yang jewel he took out the rest of the hearty starlight pills and used them to refine his 3rd jewel, however, the more you used the less effective they will be so he could only reach the 4th stage of refinement of his 3rd jewel and he couldn't go further unless he got more pure starlight, with time he could absorb it from the sky but it would take a lot of time, also Zula was shaking him right now so he had to see what she wanted.
Yun Jhin woke up and looked at Zula who was shaking his shoulder, she immediately flinched as she saw the black and white color that flashed through his eyes for a brief moment before she said:
"Black Blood is looking for you, he said something about visiting the Bumi Empire with the Emperor, it seems that my head of the family passed away..."
8 months passed since Yun Jhin entered into closed-door cultivation and it seemed Zara failed to break through the God Realm.
He understood why The Emperor would have to go to the Empire to fulfill his promise but why did he want him to go as well?
Well, all he could do now was look for him to see what he wanted, his child should have also been born by now, but he didn't care that much about it if possible he didn't want to meet him or her at all or else he would just become disappointed.
Yun Jhin got up from his cross-legged position on the floor and opened his door as he left towards the throne room.
Black Blood was waiting for him at the gigantic doors as he told Yun Jhin:
"Yun Jhin, the Emperor already left to the Bumi Empire but he told me to leave you this letter."
Yun Jhin took the letter and opened it only to see...

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Useless warning
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin eyes wandered on the latter after he opened it, but his brows furrowed as he saw that the paper was blank!
Black Blood coughed to take his attention then told him:
"His highness told me that you should open the letter in your room away from prying eyes, I'm sorry I didn't tell you earlier but you opened it quite fast, anyways you can go now."
Yun Jhin put the letter in his cloak and left to his room, Zula was meditating when he entered but she immediately got up from her cross-legged position on the bed after she heard the door open.
Yun Jhin took out the letter from his cloak and looked at it again, words started to appear on the letter, they were written hastily but still had beautiful calligraphy which showed the Emperor's control of his powers.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he fully read the letter then burnt it to ashes with his inner flame ki, he looked towards Zula and told her:
"Your head of the house has died while she tried to break through the God Realm and the Emperor had to go and protect your house from the prying hands of the other families."
Zula's eyes widened as some tears started to bud in them but she cleared them with her hand immediately after, she needed to be strong for Zara's sake, she wouldn' want her to cry right now.
Yun Jhin looked at her reaction with no emotion in his eyes as he thought about the other half of the letter which told him about the fact that his presence was also needed in the Bumi Empire, Yun Jhin wasn't sure why but the Emperor told him that he shouldn't go that's why he left alone.
Yun Jhin couldn't do much anymore besides cultivating so unless Black Blood would need his presence again he would just continue to cultivate.
Starlight fell from the sky as Yun Jhin absorbed it, 1 day passed, 2 days passed, 3 days passed, 1 week, 2 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 month passed.
Then he was shaken out of his cultivation by a firm but fair hand, the owner of the hand was surprisingly the Empress!
She glared at Yun Jhin with coquettish eyes as she said:
"Your daughter has been born a few months ago and all you do is cultivate, why don't you come to visit her?"
Yun Jhin looked at the Empress in the eyes and responded:
"Your highness, I find cultivating more important than meeting with my spawn, if you would be kind could you let me go so I can continue?"
The Empress gave out a small giggle as she grabbed Yun Jhin by the collar and her eyes hardened as she said:
"I didn't give you my salt for nothing boy, my husband isn't here anymore so that means he wouldn't know if I jumped you right now."
Yun Jhin gulped as she looked at the Empress, Zula was nowhere to be found as the Empress should have taken care of her, sending her away.
The Empress gave a sultry smile as she pushed Yun Jhin on the bed and immobilized him with some ki ropes.
Then she licked her lips and said:
"I should enjoy this..."
Yun Jhin trembled as the Empress finally left after being satisfied for half a month, she glared at the spot she disappeared from, he didn't like being taken advantage of but there wasn't much he could do anyways. He just hoped the Emperor wouldn't go crazy if he ever found out.
The Empress was satisfied but Yun Jhin was sure she wasn't pregnant, she only left because Yun Jhin couldn't handle her anymore, and there was news that the Emperor was on his way back home.
Yun Jhin sighed as the door of his room opened and Zula entered, she looked quite pitiful as she glared at Yun Jhin and said:
"You only bring problems to me, that Empress kept me tied in the courtyard under a stealth formation up till now!"
Yun Jhin ignored her as he stretched his body, he was still naked but he didn't care about Zula, even though Zula's body was seen by Yun Jhin, this was the first time Zula saw a man's naked body so she was pretty embarrassed.
Yun Jhin put on his clothes after he finished stretching and Zula's face turned to its normal color.
Before he was interrupted so suddenly by the Empress Yun Jhin almost got to reach the 6th stage of the refinery of his 3rd jewel.
Yun Jhin sighed as he sat cross-legged on the floor again then continued to summon starlight from the sky, with a little bit more starlight he finally finished the refinery of the 6th stage.
Yun Jhin sighed as he opened his eyes and looked at Zula who was in his face, she was observing him with critical eyes as she said:
"What kind of monster are you?"
She saw how easily and what type of quantity and quality of starlight he summoned from the sky, she didn't know anyone in her age range that could do the same as him, older peopel that she knew were of higher cultivation base and she wasn't sure how they compared in their youth to Yun Jhin. She was surprised because Zara didn't tell her that he was a reincarnated God Realm cultivator, if she knew she would have tried to curry favor with him instead of only hating him, she would still hate him but she would also try to fish for benefits.
Yun Jhin pushed her out of his personal space as he walked outside the room, he knew the Emperor must have come back by now so he went directly to the throne room.
Black Blood didn't say anything as he was led into the throne room. The Emperor stood on his throne as he looked down at Yun Jhin with a small smile and said:
