"You want to know what happened at the Bumi Empire right?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head and the Emperor responded:
"I have fended off the greedy hands that wanted to go for Zara's family and assets, however, the Emperor of the Bumi Empire was alarmed by my presence and he had to interfere, in the end, we came to a consense."
"I'm not sure how they know of you, but the good news is that they don't know that you are a reincarnated God Realm cultivator, some news must have slipped from the other people that were with Zula, they must think that you are very talented and have something unique about you, or else Zula wouldn't have been betrothed to you, that's why they wanted to see you in person."
Yun Jhin wasn't sure who the Emperor was talking about but his next words clarified everything:
"It's one of the top ten families, the Blood Hound family at the top 7, their disciples had a scuffle with Zula's cousin and some words about you slipped, they became interested considering our Empire never had such a young genius like you in a long time... you might not be aware but our Empire is eyed by both of the other Empire's, they want to keep us in check."
Yun Jhin found this to be pretty normal, the other two empires were already fighting with each other in the dark and they didn't want a third competitor, as the saying went when two fought the third won.
Unfortunately, the Sumo Empire was too weak to compete with the other two, it was also suppressed as back in time some of the geniuses were poached by both Empires.
The Emperor frowned as he looked at the communication formation near his throne then his eyes widened as he looked at Yun Jhin:
"The Luo Empire got news about you as well... this is bad for us, this hasn't happened in a long while but I'm sure they will try to poach you from us..."
Suddenly a light appeared in the throne room as two people appeared, one appeared on the left and one on the right.
The one on the left was dressed in black and white clothes that had a ying-yang pattern on the front and back, he was quite old, looking to be almost as old as Black Blood. The other person that stood on the right was pretty short and had a youthful aura, but he had white hair and wore blue robes, his face was hidden behind a demonic mask that covered only his eyes.
Both talked at the same time:
"The Bumi/Luo Empire is sending their regards!"
The masked man immediately said:
"I'm the messenger from the Luo Empire and I came in regards to the new genius of the Sumo Empire called Yun Jhin, our Zhu household would like to invite this young genius into its folds so he can have a better environment where he can grow!"
The old man gave out a cryptic smile as he said:
"I have come from the Bumi Empire, I'm the messenger from the Blood Hound family and I came with the same intentions as the one from the Luo Empire."
His eyes wandered directly to Yun Jhin as he appeared in front of him and said:
"I would like to talk with this young man about a few things, Yun Jhin wasn't it?"
Yun Jhin wanted to deny but the man's smile told him that he already knew who he was, Yun Jhin gave out a weak smile as he looked at the Emperor, but the Emperor himself didn't know what to do, both houses had Emperor's stronger than he was so he could only bow his head and don't interfere, he could only watch as they fought between themselves and hoped that Yun Jhin would still remember his good intentions when he was sent to the other Empires.
The masked man frowned as he appeared behind the old man and sent out of a palm in greeting.
The old man turned to the masked man by jumping and meeting his palm with his own, Yun Jhin was protected by a barrier that the Emperor hastily created but Black Blood wasn't as lucky, Black Blood coughed a mouthful of blood as he retreated from the battlefield, both of the messengers were around the 7th to 8th stage of the Sage Realm.
The masked man frowned then shook his head as he said:
"The Sumo Empire has some deep connections with our Luo Empire, I know that they have made an alliance with the weaker house of your Bumi Empire, but you should know that the current Emperor of the Sumo Empire is the son of your Emperor!"
There wasn't much the Bumi Empire messenger could argue about, after all, he only came here to try his luck, the old man gave out a creepy smile and glare to Yun Jhin as he disappeared, Yun Jhin knew what that meant:
"If we can't have you, then no one can!"
Yun Jhin's early happy days would end by now, considering that from now on assassins from the Bumi Empire would move for him if he left the Empire.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the masked man, but the masked man just smiled as he patted Yun Jhin on the shoulder and said:
"Good lad, I can see you refined your body to the maximum capacity and beyond, your aura is also rich with the four elements and ying-yang, very good very good, please come with me."
The man grasped Yun Jhin's shoulder as they both disappeared into a ray of light, The Emperor gave out a big frown as he looked at the spot they have disappeared from and sighed while thinking:
"I'm the first one that found this gem but unfortunately I won't be the one who gets to enjoy looking at it, fortunately, I didn't make him do things that he didn't want or offended him, hopefully in the future he would look for my Empire if he survives the Luo Empire..."
The Emperor called for Black Blood and sent out a ray of light which healed his internal injuries then told him:
"Since Yun Jhin isn't officially ours anymore, you can go and dispose of that Zula, also our alliance with the Bumi Empire is gone and null! Yun Jhin's disappearance made everything collapse on paper and I don't want to offend the Blood Hound house any further, go!"
Black Blood nodded his head and soonly returned with the head of Zula, The Emperor nodded and then the head exploded into ashes that drifted into nothingness, Black Blood didn't say anything as he bowed and left, the Emperor's eyes glazed over as his gaze seemingly went beyond the palace's walls and he murmured:
"Good luck out there Yun Jhin, you will certainly need it, unlocked God's memories or not."
Yun Jhin was currently into a spatial tunnel that was sending him to the Zhu household of the Luo Empire, at this point he was both interested and cautious, after all, going to the Luo Empire would mean more chances to get his hands on pure-blooded dragons that he could devour!
He still needed to eat dragons/phoenixes/dark tortoises and white tigers to evolve into an artificial caterpillar, up till now he had no good opportunities to get one, but from now on he would reach the middle of the upper continents where the pure draconic beings were the most numerous!
Even though he couldn't kill and devour people from the Luo Empire openly, he could do it in the dark, there was also the Bumi Empire!
Since they were going to sent assassins for him, he would welcome them with open arms as long as they were pure-blooded dragons.
Yun Jhin sighed as he saw the light at the end of the spatial tunnel, they were almost at their destination!

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Curbed and humiliated
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin found himself in a hall full of people, they were eying him like someone would do an animal at the zoo.
Some sneered at him, others looked interested, but most of them had disdain on their faces, that was because most of them were purebred draconic beings, and just it was mentioned before, pure draconic beings looked down heavily upon halflings.
Yun Jhin ignored their gazes, but one peculiar gaze was looking at him with sympathy, and what seemed to be understanding?
Yun Jhin eyes turned to that peculiar gaze he felt, it was a weak-looking young man with shaggy hair and a trashy bloodline, his cultivation base was around the 2nd stage of the King Realm and he seemed to be understanding of his feelings even though he didn't put any on his face.
The masked man that took Yun Jhin to the Zhu household gave out a big smile as he clapped his hands to take everyone's attention:
"This is Yun Jhin from the Sumo Empire, please welcome him to our Zhu Household, don't be shy."
The weak-looking young man walked forward, but suddenly one of the other spectators struck him in the back, he was a tall burly looking man of around the same age as the weak-looking young man, however, due to his big figure and manly looking face he looked older.
The man sneered as he placed his knee on the young man's neck and said:
"You want to befriend the new hotshot so you won't be bullied anymore don't you?"
The weak-looking young man wanted to shake his head vehemently but he couldn't due to the knee that was on his neck, if he made any sudden movement his neck would snap and he would be a goner.
Yun Jhin looked on coldly, but the burly man waved his hand at him and said:
"If you want to be accepted here you should what we say, after all, we have seniority in the Zhu household."
The man gave out a smile as the others nodded, then he pointed at Yun Jhin and then pointed at the man below him:
"Humiliate this trashy brat, look at his bloodline, you are a halfling and your blood is even purer than his by around 200 times or so from the intensity of your aura."
The masked man watched on with cold eyes, he couldn't care less about the trash brat, even though his parents were both of high standing and talented, they were both dead and their savings passed around his relatives, he was at his weakest now and everyone bullied him, however, this wouldn't have happened if he wasn't born with such a trashy bloodline.
Yun Jhin walked slowly towards the downed young man, the burly man got up from the man's neck and Yun Jhin crouched down to be eye to eye with the young man, the young man gave out a weak smile as he saw Yun Jhin's offered hand.
The others were glaring and were almost ready to boo Yun Jhin and spit at him, but when the young man took Yun Jhin's hand, Yun Jhin's other arm that stood behind quickly appeared, his hand turned into a punch as his fist hit the man's head directly making him bleed.
The hit wasn't that strong so he didn't become unconscious, but it was made at such an angle that it made him bleed quite severely.
The young man gritted his teeth as he got up from the ground and shouted:
"I Zhu Ling won't ever forgive all of you even if I become a ghost!"
He glared at Yun Jhin with hate-filled eyes as he said:
"EVEN YOU NEW GUY, HOW ARE ALL OF YOU THE SAME?"
Yun Jhin shut him up by punching him in the mouth breaking all of his teeth, a knee in the stomach, followed by another punch in the face, the young man fell but he wasn't dead, Yun Jhin was ready to deliver the finishing strike when the masked man coughed a bit and said:
"Even though such type of events happens regularly around the Zhu household, we don't condone the killing of other clanmates, even though he is a cripple now from what you have done to his inner ki pathways, he is still a clanmate, you cannot kill him."
Yun Jhin stopped his palm that was ready to go on the man's forehead, he looked down at him and spit on his face then looked away and left. The others left with Yun Jhin leaving the young-man downed there, the masked man shook his head as he murmured while he left:
"Such brilliant parents, such a trashy son, disappointing!"
Zhu Ling eyes turned misty as he started crying and crying, he coughed a mouthful of blood and almost collapsed as he tried to get back to his feet, his whole body was aching and his ki pathways were crippled, his bloodline was trashy and now even his ki cultivation was taken away from him!
Zhu Ling clutched a strange silver pendant that he had under his clothes and he took his beaten form towards his room, he wasn't sure if the burly man or Yun Jhin would come to him to end his life despite what the masked man said, as long as he wasn't present who would care if he died?
Zhu Ling got to his room and took out his clothes and other necessities then left the Zhu household and swore revenge on everyone there.
Yun Jhin was taking a tour of the gigantic household as the Burly man who introduced himself as Zhu Mingo showed him around, the household was bigger than the Emperor's palace and that said quite a bit, there were 3 main houses and 3 outer houses, each half of the size of the palace, meaning that the whole household was around 3 times bigger than the palace!
Yun Jhin was then sent to his room where he meditated for a bit before he was summoned by the masked man to talk with the head of the Zhu Household.
The head of the house was a middle-aged man with a buzzcut, he had an athletic build and wore a nothing but some white robes.
The man's cultivation base was around the 5th stage of the God Realm, he was equal to the Emperor.
The man had a small smile on his face as he said:
"I heard you had been introduced to the house by our Mingo, he is a good child but he has a heavy temper, I also heard you crippled Zhu Ling, you don't have to worry about him, he was set to be crippled a few days from now anyway, I think I should even reward you for that!"
He clapped his hands as an attendant came with a box filled with different items and said:
"You can take one item from the box."
Yun Jhin looked inside the box and saw a few weapons, armors herbs, and pills, he looked through the pills one by one but he couldn't find anything that could help him at the moment, then he looked through the herbs and he found some supplementary herbs for a pill that he could use so he took them and bowed to the head of the house.
The head of the house gave out some more perfunctory words before he let Yun Jhin go back to his room so he could rest, he also informed him that there would be a tournament that all of the top 10 houses would attend in a few months and that he should focus on cultivating.
The masked man looked at the head of the house and asked:
"Bundo, should I send some assassins for that Ling?"
The head of the house was called Zhu Bundo, the man shook his head as he looked outside the window of his room and said:
"There is no reason to waste assassins on that trash, as he is crippled he might go ahead and die to any wild beast, we should focus on training the young generation for the tournament, that's why I sent you to take that Yun Jhin, this tournament is of utmost importance to us and you should know why."
The masked man nodded then bowed and left.
The head of the house shook his head as he looked at the sky from his window and sighed:
"Such high expectations from Ling, such a failure."
Zhu Ling hiccuped as he was now in the city, he didn't know what to do so he went ahead to meet with one his friends in the Bing family, he hoped that he could house him for some time up till found what he could do with his life as a cripple.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he felt a peculiar aura getting intertwined with his, this was very strange, this type of aura intertwining wouldn't happen unless some type of fortuned one would take him as an enemy.
Yun Jhin's eyes widened, could that trashy brat be a fortuned one? It was highly unlikely considering his aura said otherwise, however, there were instances where one's fortune energy would be transferred to someone else through objects.
Yun Jhin frowned as he didn't recall seeing anything of worth on the man, but he felt like he made a strong enemy so the first thing he wanted to do was find where Zhu Ling went and kill him!
Fortuned ones were extremely annoying opponents as the universe itself helped them to achieve what they wanted, this type of protection would only wear off when one reached the God Realm.
Yun Jhin frowned as he went to an elder of the Zhu household and asked about Zhu Ling, however, he came up empty-handed as not many people liked or knew much about Zhu Ling besides the basics, then he just went to the man that bullied him the most, Zhu Mingo!
This is where he came in luck as the man himself wanted to kill him, he was ready to head out as he knew where Zhu Ling would most likely go and he became quite happy when Yun Jhin came to him and asked about his whereabouts, Mingo responded with a smile on his face:
"So you want to kill him as well? I know the little twerp was annoying, but he annoyed you so hard from the first beating? Just follow me he has a fatty trash friend in the 7th ranked Bing family, since we are higher ranked the family won't help him if they know what happened to him."
Yun Jhin nodded his head and hurried the man on, the more seconds the man was left alone, the higher the chance he would get some fortune from the heavens to help him!
Yun Jhin didn't know why he got his aura intertwined only at this moment, after all, he beat the tar out of him quite a while ago, their aura should intertwine the moment he became enemies with him, this was truly strange!
Yun Jhin cursed this shitty universe, it wouldn't let him get eternal life, and now it sent him some fortuned trash that would trouble him.
While Yun Jhin and Mingo were going to the Bing Family, Zhu Ling was clutching his pendant with shining eyes inside the room of his friend Bing Jung as he muttered:
"Such a cultivation technique, it could even repair my broken inner ki pathways and improve my bloodline, my parents died to get this... I..."
Tears started to stream down his face as he started cultivating the technique.
Yun Jhin could feel the intertwining aura intensifying around him, that meant the fortuned energy of that fellow was getting stronger and that wasn't anything good!
Yun Jhin slapped Mingo and grabbed him like a sack of potatoes as he said:
"Just tell me the direction and I will take us there faster."
Mingo didn't say anything as he complied with Yun Jhin, he became very scared as he was easily picked up by him like a little chick, might make right, so he could only tremble in his boots and comply with Yun Jhin.
After a short while of running Yun Jhin finally reached the Bing Family, he ignored the guards that told him to stop and ran directly towards the fortuned aura that he could feel.
Hopefully, he won't be too late!
Yun Jhin frowned as the aura intensified and crimson energy exploded from Zhu Ling's friend house, this type of energy alerted everyone, Yun Jhin looked on with a hardened gaze as Zhu Ling came out of the house and gave Yun Jhin a small smile that said 'You are too late'.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Stopped at the beginning
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin ignored the man's smile as he dropped Mingo unceremoniously on the ground, Mingo wanted to say something but when he felt Yun Jhin's and Ling's auras clashing directly in mid-air he just closed his mouth.
Yun Jhin couldn't wait for any more as he dashed directly to Ling's face hitting him in the chest making him vomit a mouthful of blood, but he could fell his hand sinking in his chest further as he was rebound, it felt like he just hit a rubber wall, his fist rebound as he was pushed backward.
Ling chuckled as he jumped backward for a little then dashed forward to throw a punch towards Yun Jhin's chest, the punch hit home but Yun Jhin didn't fell much from it, Ling's eyes clouded over as some information from the pendant came back to him.
His eyes widened as he wanted to escape, the pendant just told him that even though the technique he was cultivating was giving him good defense, due to his low cultivation base he couldn't access the offensive techniques yet!
Yun Jhin chuckled as he saw through the man's plight, suddenly 4 colors started to jump across Yun Jhin's right hand as they morphed into a gauntlet, Yun Jhin couldn't put on the full elemental armor as his cultivation base wasn't enough, when he fought the vice-general he could only wear a chest piece but his defense was boosted through the roof, combined with his defensive martial techniques he couldn't be beaten normally, but now he threw away defense and focused on the attack technique of his armor!
Zhu Ling grimaced as he wanted to escape from Yun Jhin's grasp, his armored hand was clutching the man's left arm, and after a sickening crunch was heard his arm was now hanging limply on the left side of his body, his arm was crippled!
Yun Jhin frowned as he watched Zhu Ling grith his teeth, he wanted to run away as he used a technique that made his body start emitting steam, his skin turned pink due to the extreme circulation of blood in his body, his speed increased as he easily dodged Yun Jhin's gauntleted hand but even though his speed was increased by a lot. His cultivation base only recovered to the 1st stage of the King Realm because Yun Jhin broke his internal ki pathways, thus some of his internal ki was scattered and it would take him some time to recover it.
Yun Jhin's figure disappeared as he intercepted him, Mingo gritted his teeth as he watched and he jumped after them, the guards of the Bing Family only watched helplessly, they knew one of the young masters decided to hide the trash of the Zhu family but they didn't think trouble would come this fast.
They were only at the ki cultivating realm, they got the guard job because their parents were low elders in the Bing Family's elder assembly, being a guard wasn't a glamorous job but it got them the resources they needed, and as long as they broke through the King Realm before they turned 30 they would be able to enjoy the position of outer elder in the family, however, now a sudden calamity struck them while they were on guard duty and they didn't know what to do!
Mingo ignored the guards as he passed by them and followed Yun Jhin and Ling, a short fatty came out of the house as he looked around just like a weasel would, he was scared but he still wanted to follow Mingo, Yun Jhin, and Ling, however, a fat middle-aged man that only taller than him by a few centimeters came out and picked him up by his collar while saying:
"You have already repaid the Zhu family trash by letting him live in our household until he recovered, he is unlucky that he offended so many people."
The fat middle-aged man looked towards the direction that the fight was continuing and he narrowed his eyes as he felt Ling's and Yun Jhin's auras intertwining, he could feel something strange from the both of them but he couldn't put his finger on it, after all, he was only around the 3rd stage of the Emperor Realm and he didn't know many secrets, he barely learned how to fly normally a few years ago.
Yun Jhin clashed and fought with Ling in the air as they skipped around the city, they made sure to not destroy any of the buildings or hurt the passerby's, Yun Jhin didn't want trouble who knew if a hidden young master was out on a stroll?
Technically speaking such an encounter was close to nil, but fortuned ones would steal the luck of their adversaries due to their special constitution and the help of the universe, Yun Jhin's luck wasn't anything special, his destiny was due to his former lives memories, his luck was average at best, the only reason Yun Jhin was avoiding crowds was that his luck turned from average to bad.
Ling wanted to get some attention of the crowds but Yun Jhin would jolt his broken arm the closer he got to a crowd, he almost ripped it off when he tried to shout for help, most of the cultivators around the city didn't look for trouble so unless they were asked for help with benefits they wouldn't interfere in such type of situations.
After a while, Yun Jhin chased Ling out of the city and they reached a nearby stream, Ling seemingly saw the light at the end of the tunnel as he was the stream, it was flowing to the south and Ling was ready to jump into it when Yun Jhin tackled him to the ground at quick speeds and mounted his face in the dirt.
His gauntleted hand was over his head as a bunch of ki was gathered into it and launched into his skull.
Ling's skull was cracking at a high speed due to the ki but it wasn't truly breaking as it was mending at the same speed.
Yun Jhin frowned heavily as he could feel that behind Mingo was the aura of Ling's friend, the short fatty, and behind the fatty was the fatty's father.
Yun Jhin knew that if Ling was still alive when they arrived his father would interfere, Yun Jhin continued to bombard his skull with ki, but the fatty's father along with the fatty was getting closer and closer, Mingo was already nearby and watched with wide eyes what happened before him.
So close to death, Ling's life force was getting lower and lower as his ki was exhausted using his cultivation technique to recover his constantly cracking skull, if he lived from this ordeal his skull would surely get stronger.
Yun Jhin could feel that the fatty's father was almost here, his eyes turned red as he used a forbidden technique and made his gauntleted hand into a sword shape as he drilled his hand into Ling's brain, grey matter along with his soul were starting to splash around the ground, Yun Jhin's first jewel glowed on his crown as Ling's soul was absorbed into it along with his fortuned aura.
A deep voice was heard behind him that scolded the fatty:
"You brat, do you see? He died, even if I want to do anything right now I can't, I also cannot attack the brat from the Zhu household as I'm from the older generation, if he killed your friend there is a high chance you won't be able to do anything, wasn't he a 2nd stage King Realm? You are even below him!"
The fatty sobbed as his scarlet eyes targeted Yun Jhin's back but Yun Jhin ignored him as he held Ling's pendant in his gauntleted arm, he looked it up and down before he crushed it into smithereens.
The fatty's father walked forward and cupped his fists as he said:
"This young friend from the Zhu household, might you be able to spare that trash's body? He was my son's friend and I would like to give him a proper burial on the account that he helped my son a few years ago."
Yun Jhin got up from the now cold body of Ling and looked at the fatty, he was pretty short standing around 1,63 meters, he wore a simple outfit considering of a large grey shirt and black pants, he had black sandals on his feet and he sported a small beard.
Yun Jhin stopped looking at him after he analyzed him, he ignored Ling's body that he already sucked dry of everything that could be useful then he cupped his fists to the middle-aged fatty and said:
"I will let this elder do the funeral operations, unfortunately, you had to witness such a grisly sight, however, this man was a criminal from our Zhu household, I'm sure he didn't tell you why he was expelled, but he is the highest suspect in the case of robbing a few important pills."
The middle-aged fatty held his son back as he started to shout obscenities at Yun Jhin along with the words:
"Brother Zhu Ling would never steal you lier!"
"He was a good man of high moral upstanding!"
"How dare you defile his memory after you brutally killed him!"
Yun Jhin ignored the incessant insults and chatter from the small round ball that was the fatty, he looked at Mingo and said:
"Mingo let's go back to the family, we took care of our internal problems, what they do with the corpse isn't our business anymore."
But before he left Yun Jhin made one motion with his hand, the broken head was removed from the body and the fatty's expression turned livid as he wanted to say more but Yun Jhin beat him to it:
"I was just making sure he was truly dead, I wouldn't want to have a zombie outbreak due to not being 100% sure."
The fatty was ready to jump again after he saw his best friend's corpse being done dirty like that, he was killed and he couldn't even have a whole corpse to bury!
The fat middle-aged man didn't say anything but he only had one thought:
"What a vicious fellow those from the Zhu Household found, and his bloodline aura isn't losing to those high ranked disciples, a pitty that he is a halfling..."
Yun Jhin left along with Mingo as they returned to the Zhu Household in the city, Mingo wanted to show Yun Jhin around the capital but Yun Jhin said that he had enough for today and that he might do it tomorrow.
Yun Jhin returned to his room and sat cross-legged on his bed as he took in Zhu Ling's memories and cultivation technique.
Yun Jhin looked through the cultivation technique and realized that it was one that he didn't know!
It was a special body refining technique that combined both body refining and ki cultivating at the same time, it gave one's body into a rubber-like attribute along with the ability to increase the blood flow to extreme speeds without much backlash if used properly, it gave the body extremely high defensive capabilities versus blunt damage and with constant strengthening, even blades or other sharp things would bounce away!
Yun Jhin looked more through the cultivation technique, he compared it to the technique that he got from the pendant and realized that the one he stole from the pendant was wrong!
If he cultivated the technique from the pendant he would surely transform into a ball of human rubber that could barely move. It seemed the pendant had a mechanism that gave out the cultivation technique only to the people that had the right bloodline, fortunately, Yun Jhin got the right technique from his memories, the sad thing is that he only got the body technique and no offensive techniques because Zhu Ling's cultivation base was too low to reach that part of the pendant.
He also destroyed the pendant but he didn't regret it, even though it was a particularly obscure technique that he didn't know, he still had a few techniques that could rival it, however, he couldn't cultivate them now due to their heavy restrictions, this technique was special due to its low requirements, Yun Jhin wondered where did that guy's parents get their hands on such a particular technique...
Could have they raided the tomb of the former Azure Emperor, Ming Sheng?
Yun Jhin shook his head, even if he wanted to go there right now he wouldn't be able to, if his memories didn't betray him the Former Azure Empire sat where the Bumi Empire is now, so his tomb would most likely be there, it might even be the new danger zone that was sparsely investigated now due to the heavy losses of those who tried to learn information about it.
Yun Jhin decided to cultivate the technique, it wouldn't hurt to transform his body in such a way, after all even though his ki was strong it wasn't limitless, his 4 elemental armor ran on ki, so if he ever ran out of ki in a fight his defenses would be down making him vulnerable.
Yun Jhin was a man with a plan within a plan, so he didn't mind having an extra ace up his sleeve.
Yun Jhin sat on the bed as he started to cultivate his ki in the same pattern that the cultivation technique showed him but he felt something wrong, it was like his ki pathways were giving him a warning!
Yun Jhin frowned as he stopped cultivating the technique, he made a few calculations and his eyes narrowed as he said:
"This technique... you would first need your pathways to be crippled before you could use it... it would also reshape your soul to have the same attribute along with destroying your crown and creating a new one.."
This wasn't a bad thing for a cripple like Zhu Ling, but this wasn't something good for Yun Jhin at all!
If he continued to cultivate it his ki pathways would break then restore themselves along with his soul crown, he was already on a pretty sure path to the God Realm and he wouldn't take another one unless he would be forced to...
Yun Jhin discarded the technique, he didn't realize that it would do that to his body until he started cultivating it, there weren't any warnings or things like that in Zhu Ling's memories, nor the pendant. Did his parents foresee that he would be crippled?
Yun Jhin sighed as he was broken out of his musings by a knock on his door. Yun Jhin frowned as he got up from his bed and opened his door.
Zhu Mingo stood there with a small smile on his face as he told Yun Jhin:
"The head of the house said that there is some special training for us before the tournament, he told me to come and get you because I was one of the first ones to know you..."
Yun Jhin nodded his head, it seemed the head of the house was ready to throw some resources on Yun Jhin's way, very good!

chapters.title: Chapter 84: The geniuses of the Zhu Family
chapters.content:
Mingo and Yun Jhin walked towards the training grounds of the family, there were some formation dummies and logs made so the young geniuses of the Zhu Family could test out their destructive techniques without problems.
Yun Jhin eyed the formations and realized that they were quite strong as they could handle attacks up to the 2nd stage of the Emperor realm, this also inadvertently showed that the highest cultivation of the youths of the Zhu Family was at the 2nd stage of the Emperor realm.
Yun Jhin and Mingo waited on the training grounds and soon more people started to fill the place, most of them eyed Yun Jhin and Mingo with competitiveness, while very few looked at them with fear.
Suddenly there was a commotion as two youths entered shoulder to shoulder, both of them were very similar in appearance and had the same cultivation base, around the 8th stage of the King Realm, they were both very close to the peak of the king realm as they needed only a small push to reach the 9th stage.
Suddenly another person entered and appeared in front of the twins, he had a head full of red hair and wore a dark suit that covered his whole body, he had a small mask on his face that covered his eyes, from the looks of it he was trying to emulate the man who took Yun Jhin to the Zhu family, he could be a relative of his or he might just be openly admiring the man.
The red-haired youth didn't say anything but he walked in front of the twins then ignored them, showing them that he couldn't bother with the duo, the twins became angry and they were ready to attack but a formation activated that paralyzed the both of them as the voice of the head of the house was heard:
"No fighting before my announcement!"
The twins glared at the red-haired youth and said in unison:
"Just you wait Zhu Du Fei, We will make sure you will respect us after this training tournament!"
Zhu Du Fei chuckled as he looked down on both of them and said:
"Let's see how will that happen!"
Yun Jhin didn't know their story nor did he care but Mingo started to tell him:
"These three were good friends in their youths, but since Du Fei started to idolize our grand elder they started to become distant, I'm not sure about the inside information, but I think these twins might be..."
Yun Jhin stopped him from talking, he didn't care about them, even though they were a bit too strong for him to defeat in open combat right now, that didn't mean he couldn't beat them using tricks, after all, after he assimilated the ying-yang stone, he could guarantee that there was a very high chance that he could defeat a peak king realm expert in a 1v1 situation, however, more than 1 and he would have to run, 10 people would even make him unable to escape unharmed and if there were, even more, he might even lose his life...
Yun Jhin sighed as he waited for more people to arrive, unlike the other three, most of the people had cultivations around the 5th to 6th stage, very few were at the 7th stage, and only those three were at the 8th stage.
A lazy looking man entered the training grounds as he yawned and walked towards a tree, then he sat on the ground and immediately went to sleep. Mingo whispered to Yun Jhin:
"This guy is known as Zhu Sumen, he is at the 9th stage of the King Realm and his strength isn't something that the others would look down upon, even though he looks lazy once he enters a fight... he is still lazy even when he fights, but it's very infuriating to fight him."
Mingo continued to introduce people that entered but Yun Jhin only remembered the information of those above the 7th stage, after all, he could defeat the others quite easily unless they had special techniques or constitutions, but those were very rare and from what he could see in this crowd, there were only around 3 people who had strong constitutions and were below the 8th stage.
Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as he felt a power that easily dwarfed his entering the training ground, Yun Jhin's body wanted to instinctively bow towards the power that appeared, it was the Emperor realm expert, he was fully unleashing his aura and engulfing everyone with it, and his cultivation wasn't at the first stage, but at the 2nd!
It was the strongest youth cultivator of the Zhu Family!
Finally, the youth revealed himself, he was around 25 years old with green hair and he wore normal white robes that showed his strong chest, he had baggy pants and sandals on his feet, his pupils were yellow slits and his bloodline aura was through the roof! He was 100% a purebred dragon, even though all of the others were also full descendants of the dragon race and they weren't mixed blood that didn't mean all their bloodlines were pure.
Just like how Yun Jhin's bloodline was stronger than Zhu Lings even though he was a halfling, the purity of bloodline meant how close you were to the origin of bloodline, Yun Jhin's system would allow his body to reach the highest bloodline possible considering the things he ate to fuel the system's power.
Even though he ate what could only be considered trash in the upper continents, all of the bloodline chains that he extracted from their bodies were fused by the system inside his body then purified by thousands of times over and over before they fully installed themselves in his DNA helix code.
The Emperor realm expert was called Zhu Cheng, his eyes scanned over the whole crowd and his eyes narrowed as he watched Yun Jhin hold fast under his bloodline and cultivation pressure, he was interested in him but unfortunately, since he was at the Emperor realm he wouldn't be able to fight him in the upcoming tournament.
He only came to see if there was a chance for those at the 9th realm of the King Realm to break through the Emperor realm but he was quite disappointed, none of them gave out the aura that they reached the peak of the 9th stage, he still had to wait for quite a while before the actual tournament hosted by the Emperor began and he would be able to fight with those around his cultivation base.
Zhu Cheng sighed as he walked towards one of the training logs and he leaned on it waiting for the fights to start.
Another 9th stage cultivator entered then the voice of the head of the house was heard:
"You might not all know why you were all summoned because you just came back from training outside, 3 months from now the Emperor will host a tournament to decide which house will be able to enter the Imperial tombs, you should know what the Imperial tombs entail so I won't explain."
Mingo started explaining to Yun Jhin, the Imperial tombs were where the former Emperors of the Luo Empire were buried, most of the Emperors were buried with quite a lot of treasures ranging from pills and herbs to weapons and techniques.
The Imperial tombs would open by themselves once every 10 years and the Emperor would host a tournament to give quotas to the top 10 houses of the capital, depending on what rank those houses would attain they could get a max or 3 quotas, and only the top 5 were awarded quotas.
Top 1 was awarded 3 quotas, Top 2 was awarded 2 quotas, and from there to the 5th place, only 1 quota was awarded.
The special thing about the Imperial tombs was that those who won in the tournament could allow one elder to come with them, they made the younger generation fight in a tournament because anything else would break the fragile balance between the houses and instigate an internal war between the houses of the Empire. This wasn't a thing the Emperor wanted to see as the Bumi Empire was watching over them like a hawk would their prey, they were pretty equal in power but anything could break the balance of power at this point.
Yun Jhin waited as the head of the house continued his speech:
"To help all of you get a better chance at winning a spot for our house I decided to do our little tournament with prizes that could help you break through further in your cultivation, and don't worry Zhu Cheng is forbidden from participating as he gets his rewards just for being at the Emperor realm at such a young age."
No one said anything, it was Zhu Cheng's ability to reach such a high cultivation base while being so young, him getting rewards for that alone wasn't a thing that any of them could question.
Yun Jhin looked at Zhu Cheng from the corner of his eye, he knew that he must have had a very good cultivation technique paired with his bloodline to get himself so far in cultivation so early in his life, he would have also used quite a lot of resources of the family, Yun Jhin made a mental note to be on his good side in the future, he didn't want needless trouble inside his faction.
The head of the house crisp voice was heard as he announced that the tournament would start shortly, everyone was made to draw lots and then a metal arena popped out of the ground.
Yun Jhin drew the lots for fighting group F and he was paired against the lazy looking youth called Zhu Sumen.
Yun Jhin looked at the man who slept under the tree and he didn't know what to make out of him, he tried to send some of his soul willpower to investigate his opponent but his soul willpower was repelled!
The man had a defensive aura around him that repelled all soul willpowers that tried to investigate him while he slept, Yun Jhin realized one thing after this endeavor, the lazy youth was quite smart. Smart people were annoying, Yun Jhin would rather fight a hot-blooded justice induced dumb person rather than a smart lazy person, but since he drew the lot he had to give his all and win, the rewards of the tournament were quite attractive to him.
Some of the rewards could be used so he could maybe reach the peak refinery of his 3rd stage King Realm cultivation, others would be useful in the future.
Unlike normal tournaments, this tournament awarded rewards the more people you beat, so Yun Jhin didn't have to get to the top 10 to get rewarded. One of the reasons was because the more people the Zhu family enlisted in the tournament, the higher the chance for them to get an extra quota, so they gave their all during this training tournament.
Before the matches started the head of the family's voice appeared again and said:
"Everything is permitted in matches besides killing and crippling your opponent, now we will start with group A's fights!"
Yun Jhin watched group A fight, then Group B, Group C... finally it was the time for his Group F, however, he wasn't the first in the group, it could be either called a coincidence or being unlucky, but Yun Jhin's group had all the 9th stage King Realm experts, the first fight was between the twins!
The twins knew that the head of the house would cancel their reward if they didn't fight so they went up to the arena.
Yun Jhin watched them fight but he was disappointed, they were mostly putting up a front so the reward of the one who won wasn't canceled, finally one of them won after a while of fighting and he was rewarded a bunch of Emperor moonlight ladybugs.
Yun Jhin watched as the twin high-fived his brother and both of them left the arena and waited below for the next fight.
Yun Jhin looked on as the next fight was between the red-haired masked youth Zhu Du Fei and Mingo!
Mingo wasn't strong nor important in the family he was only around the 4th stage of the King realm, he was one of those people who feared the strong and bullied the weak, he only became true friends with Yun Jhin after he saw how he took care of Zhu Ling, he was more like Yun Jhin's underling right now.
Mingo didn't want to get beaten too badly so he gave up after Du Fei almost pushed him out of the arena with the wind created from him punching the air.
Finally, it was Yun Jhin's turn to get on the arena, he jumped directly on it as Zhu Sumen woke up and groggily got up on the arena by himself.
Zhu Sumen gave out a dry cough as he took a jar of water from his spatial ring and drank it all in one gulp.
The referee of the fight knew about Zhu Sumen's quirks so he didn't say anything as he looked at Yun Jhin then at Sumen and said:
"If both parties are ready, we can fight! 1,2,3 GO!"
Yun Jhin entered into a defensive stance as he waited for Sumen to start the fight, Sumen scratched the back of his head as he muttered:
"So troublesome."
Yun Jhin felt something wasn't right as his eyes wandered to his feet and he saw his shadow turning into spikes and attacking him!
Yun Jhin couldn't have dodged the attacks if he didn't get his hands on the ying-yang stone but now this was a different situation. He channeled some yang energy in his shadow and made it disappear!
Sumen eyes narrowed as he saw Yun Jhin's shadow disappear and he said:
"You are an interesting opponent, but can you get rid of every shadow that exists in this area?"
Yun Jhin frowned, his cultivation base was too low so he couldn't do that yet, however, he had other aces up his sleeve.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Shadow battle
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin frowned as another shadow needle appeared from the opponent's shadow and rushed at him at extremely fast speeds.
The needle speed was almost at a level that he couldn't dodge, light and darkness attribute attacks were very fast if they were executed in their respective environments, Yun Jhin knew that the man's technique would become extremely slow if there were no shadows left around for him to use.
Sumen watched on as Yun Jhin barely dodged the shadow needles, he was very impressed considering Yun Jhin was so many cultivation levels below him, among with the fact that he had a high battle power even around those with the same cultivation base due to his shadow techniques.
Yun Jhin staggered as a shadow needle pinned his foot to the arena, to counter Yun Jhin's senses, he made smaller and smaller needles, but due to this, the needles didn't do as much damage as before.
Yun Jhin armor covered his chest and his vital areas, but his feet were open to being attacked affecting his movement, countless needles attacked his vital points but they were reflected by his armor, Sumen frowned for the first time since they started the fight, he didn't think that Yun Jhin's elemental armor would have such a high defensive ability that his needles couldn't pierce through it at all, that meant he had to fight a battle of attrition with Yun Jhin.
Sumen opened his mouth and said:
"So troublesome, however, you should have lost here, after all, I'm a stage 9 expert while you are at stage 3, the difference between our ki quantities is quite large, why don't you give up and save me the headache of dealing with you?"
Yun Jhin smiled as he responded:
"Instead of talking you should look behind you."
Sumen looked behind him only to see nothing, suddenly Yun Jhin appeared in front of him as his armor transferred from his body into gauntlet form, the gauntlet started to absorb energy from Yun Jhin's body as a big ball of energy was ejected from it and hit Sumen directly in the chest almost blasting him away from the arena.
Sumen dusted himself as he got up from the ground, but then he fell to his knees as blood seeped out the corner of his mouth and said:
"Very tricky."
It wasn't a big trick, it was a kindergartner level trick, Yun Jhin didn't even think that he would fall for it, but trying didn't hurt. It seemed while the youth was smart, he wasn't wise, he mustn't have got many battles under his belt.
Yun Jhin disappeared from the arena as he used his stealth technique, Sumen eyes widened as he couldn't feel, see or sense Yun Jhin anywhere, he created a barricade of shadows around him as he eyed the surroundings warily.
He didn't know what to do in this situation, attacking randomly wouldn't be that helpful as he would waste his ki, even though his shadow technique was useful it used quite a lot of ki being a Yang type ability, it was also derived from the ultimate skill of his jewel.
Yun Jhin remained passive as he circled the shadow barrage, suddenly a white light appeared from his body as it circled his gauntlet, the light broke his stealth, then he launched himself in the shadow barricade breaking through it like it was made of soft tofu.
Yun Jhin fist met Sumen's face as his nose bleed and knocked him unconscious, however, there was no sound or impact when his fist hit his face, it was due to the Yin attribute that he inserted into his gauntlet, the Yin attribute was soft and flexible unlike the domineering and hard Yang attribute, it struck his soul very lightly and knocked him unconscious, there was no physical damage and the nose bleed came from his soul injury.
Yun Jhin coughed a bit as his ki reserves were drained, he looked down at his palm and saw a little bit of blood that started to evaporate, the referee made sure Sumen was knocked out before he gave Yun Jhin the win.
Yun Jhin left the arena with a bunch of herbs and pills.
He sat cross-legged in the resting area as he took a few pills and mashed some herbs along with water to help him recover his ki and heal his mild internal injuries.
The others eyed Yun Jhin warily considering he beat one of their top candidates for the main tournament.
Yun Jhin ignored most of their gazes and only focused on the gaze of one of them.
Zhu Cheng was eyeing him with interest, it seemed his battle made him want to recruit him.
Yun Jhin wouldn't mind being his subordinate as long as he got benefits, in the end, it wouldn't matter.
Yun Jhin fought for a few more matches with those that were under the 9th stage and he easily won, piquing the interest of the referee and making the head of the house glad that he sent the masked man to get him to the Zhu Family, he was another insurance that they could get a slot to the Imperial tombs!
Yun Jhin left the tournament with a few boxes of herbs, materials for weapon and armor refinement along with one technique that he wasn't that much interested in, but he cultivated it anyways as it took him only a few glances to master it, he needed to play the role of a country bumpkin that didn't see too many techniques due to his origins.
After the tournament ended with Yun Jhin not having to fight any other stage 9 cultivator due to a lucky drawing of lots, he ended up going back to his room.
But he didn't even get to rest or refine his pill when a knock could be heard, Yun Jhin knew who it was as he opened the room and invited the person in while saying:
"Brother Cheng wasn't it?"
Zhu Cheng gave out an amiable smile as he walked inside Yun Jhin's room and looked around, the room didn't have much besides the things that the Zhu Clan already left inside, Zhu Cheng raised his eyebrows inwardly and praised Yun Jhin's minimalistic personality, having an attachment to earthly possesions could halt one progress in cultivation.
Yun Jhin watched on as Zhu Cheng cleared his throat and said:
"As someone new to the family you might not know about the factions of the younger generation, I came to invite you to mine and I can say you won't lose out, members of my faction are heavily rewarded for being members only and you would get heavy respect from the younger generation of the other families if you tell them you are for my faction, you will have an easier time in the city next time you go out, these are only one of the few benefits you will get from joining, what do you say?"
Zhu Cheng came out himself instead of sending someone to recruit Yun Jhin, because of Yun Jhin's capabilities of defeating someone at the 9th stage of the King Realm, even though Zhu Cheng's faction had quite a few people inside it, it didn't have any at the 9th stage, only because those at the 9th stage wouldn't lower their heads to Zhu Cheng due to their pride, they knew they couldn't beat him but they wouldn't be his lackeys.
Yun Jhin made himself look like he pondered the question for a while before he responded with a question:
"Might I ask what kind of tangible benefits would I get after I joined?"
Yun Jhin made a small motion with his hand that indicated what he was talking about, Zhu Cheng gave a big smile as he identified Yun Jhin as someone who cared about wealth even though he put a minimalistic look on the surface. Zhu Cheng took a bag out of his spatial ring and passed it to Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin opened the bag and his eyes widened as he opened it and saw a beating heart inside of it!
Zhu Cheng gave out a small chuckle as he remembered that Yun Jhin was a country bumpkin that came from their brother empire and he told him the functions of the heart:
"It's a medium demonic heart that can be concocted using a heavy starlight herb and stone, it should be useful for those below the 6th stage of the King Realm and it should be able to boost your cultivation speed by a lot, I can give you enough hearts until you reach the 6th stage, the remaining ingredients cannot be given out for free, however, I can tell you where you can gather them."
Zhu Cheng was giving Yun Jhin an offer that he couldn't refuse if he cared about his cultivation base, Zhu Cheng knew how to manipulate cultivators quite easily as they were all interested in furthering their cultivation as long as the price they had to give wasn't over what they could pay.
Yun Jhin took the heart and put it in his spatial ring, this action made Zhu Cheng smile as he put his hand forward for a handshake, Yun Jhin gave out a small polite smile as he shook his hand and Zhu Cheng laughed as he said:
"Welcome to my faction Yun Jhin, it's called the Demonic Killers, you won't regret joining us, you will even get a chance to spar with high stage cultivators from the other top 10 clans, we have a monthly gathering that should happen a week from now if you would like to come you are always welcome."
Zhu Cheng waved as he left Yun Jhin alone in his room, Yun Jhin didn't say anything as he took the demonic heart out of his spatial ring and he scrutinized it, then he opened his mouth and gave it a few licks, he frowned as he tasted the fresh blood coming out of the heart and muttered:
"Truly a demonic heart, unfortunately not a devil one, can't be used for my evolution, fortunately, I can do what Zhu Cheng said and use it to cultivate my ki cultivation base."
Yun Jhin thought that there could be some devilish bloodline in the heart as demon and devil's heart were similar in looks and could only be discerned by different techniques, one of the simplest ones was ingesting some blood from the heart.
Yun Jhin put the heart back into his spatial ring, fortunately for him, the herbs that he needed for the concoction were won from the tournament so he didn't need to go out and buy or search for some, however, the unfortunate part was that he could only create 3 pills with them, and he would still have half a heart left.
3 pills would make him able to reach the 7th stage of refinement of his 3rd jewel, maybe even the 8th stage, with 3 more he would be able to reach the peak.
Yun Jhin slowly got to work as he created a formation and took out a cauldron from his spatial ring, he was ready to concoct some pills!
A knock came from his door almost as soon as he started, it was Mingo, Yun Jhin asked him what he wanted and Mingo told him that he heard that he joined Zhu Cheng's faction, so he wondered if Yun Jhin would be able to get him inside as well.
Yun Jhin gave out a small smile to him and patted his shoulder and told him he would put in a good word for him when he talked next with Zhu Cheng, but it was up to Zhu Cheng himself if he wanted to invite him or not.
Mingo didn't say anything as he left, he knew from Yun Jhin's word that there was a very low chance of him being invited so he left to train.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he watched the poor man's figure disappear from his vision and muttered:
"Aren't you overestimating yourself?"
Yun Jhin locked the door and put a sign with do not disturb created from a formation on the door.
Yun Jhin got back to concocting the pill as he regained the concentration from before, all he needed to do was put the ingredients in the right order and turn on the formation so he could create his 3 pills...
So he started, he first cut a chunk of meat from the heart and afterward put the herbs in a certain order as he drew a pattern with his hands in the air.
After a short while and activation of the formation, Yun Jhin now had 3 glistening crimson and black pills in his hand ready for consumption, and it only took him almost 2 days of refining. It was quite a bargain for him as he didn't have to search for any ingredients.
Yun Jhin eyed the pills for a bit before he popped up one in his mouth and started cultivating, he was ready to continue refining his 3rd jewel and further his ki cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: Cultivation and races
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin eyes were closed as he refined the pills he made, refining a jewel was easier than crafting it and inserting it into one's crown slot, Yun Jhin was effortlessly extracting the energy from the pills and used it to refine his jewel.
Just like he guessed, he reached around the 7th stage of the refinery after he finished refining all 3 pills he had.
However, he didn't leave his room as by his calculations he still had quite some time before the gathering of the factions of the younger generation would start, so he wanted to cultivate some more as there wasn't anything more that he could do at this point.
Cultivation had its ups and downs but at its core was quite simple and meant for those that had the talent for it, one would gather ki into one's body, and then it was up to the person if one could start cultivating using the ki or not.
The King realm consisted of creating a king's crown and filling it with jewels of different elements and aspects of the universe, Yun Jhin had already mixed quite a lot of aspects in few jewels giving him a lot of other slots that could be filled with stronger jewels that contained laws that one couldn't touch at the King realm.
From the 4th stage and above he would start comprehending again the laws of life, death, time, and space, afterward at the 8th stage he would have to gather life essence from a strong being of high bloodline and use it to create his jewel, most experts would use their bloodline to create the jewel and Yun Jhin would do the same in the future, as for the last jewel, it would be automatically created after he mixed all of his current jewels abilities into one to create an ultimate skill.
The universe was fair as it was cruel, it gave other races higher life spans than humans but it took away their ability to normally reproduce, while humans lived the least even when they reached the peak of the god realm, they could extend their lives more than others and they had an easier time reproducing, they also didn't have bloodlines and their battle power relied on their constitutions, in this situation cultivation beasts could be considered stronger than humans as well.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he felt that it was around one week since he started cultivating so the gathering of the youth's faction should start soon enough. He wasn't interested in meeting the other youths from the other families but at these types of gatherings, resources could be traded quite easily along with bets and other types of activities that could make Yun Jhin able to easily gather what he needed to further his cultivation base.
Yun Jhin went ahead and left his room but he quickly met with Zhu Cheng who was coming to his room, Zhu Cheng had a smile on his face as he patted Yun Jhin's shoulder and said:
"Brother Jhin, I was ready to come and invite you out but it seems you are more eager to get to the gathering than I am, let's go together, the others are waiting for me to lead them to our usual gathering spot."
Yun Jhin walked with Zhu Cheng shoulder to shoulder as they met with the other members of Zhu Cheng's faction, most of them were around the 7th to 8th stage and there were very few around the 6th stage, there were none at the 9th stage, in total there were around 6 7th stage persons, 3 8th stage ones and around 25 6th stage.
In total the Demonic Killers faction had around 36 people with Yun Jhin and Zhu Cheng included, the faction didn't have many people in it but the quality of the members was leagues ahead of the other factions.
Zhu Cheng didn't have to introduce Yun Jhin as all of the people here participated in the tournament and some of them even lost at Yun Jhin's hands, Zhu Cheng cleared his throat as he made an announcement:
"Since brother Yun Jhin's battle power is at the 9th stage he will be the general under me for the time being, I don't think there would be any disapprovals of this will there?"
Everyone kept mum, they were already beaten black and blue by Yun Jhin, and from what they could see, his aura was a little bit stronger than before, they wouldn't court problems for no reason as Yun Jhin's general position was deserved.
Zhu Cheng looked around to see if anyone disagreed then nodded his head when he saw that everyone kept quiet, he waved his hand and told them:
"Let's get to the usual place, the Sikong family said that they have a great surprise for us."
While they walked towards the city and their usual hanging spot, Zhu Cheng sent some information to Yun Jhin:
"Since you are new and didn't have much time to make connections in the city, I will tell you the rankings of the families of the city in the order of highest to lowest.
1st: Sikong family.
2nd: Bugo Family.
3rd: Shin Family.
4th: Our Zhu Family.
5th: Shen Family.
6th: Xero Family.
7th: Bing Family.
8th: Wutang Family.
9th: Xing Family.
10th: Rath Family."
"This should help you understand where our family stands in the inner circle of nobility, we are quite high ranked with only other 3 families above us, their younger generation isn't that strong as they each have an Emperor Realm cultivator around my age, two of them are at the 1st stage and one of them at 2nd just like me."
"I'm just telling you this so you will know who you can offend and who you cannot, I will be backing you as long as you don't pick a fight with the faction of the Sikong family, even though we are friends on the surface they are just like a poisonous viper who would like to bite all of us."
"Anyways you can go wild on all of the other families as I will protect you from the Emperor realm experts, we need to show them that the Zhu family isn't lacking in younger generation combatants, if we do well and break their morale we will have a higher chance to get more slots in the tournament hosted by the imperial family."
Yun Jhin kept silent as he took in all of the information from Zhu Cheng, he finally nodded after Zhu Cheng stopped talking and continued to walk along with him.
After a while they finally reached the meeting place, it was a beautiful restaurant at the edges of the city that was decorated festively, it even had a gambling place for the hedonistic silk pants young masters along with beauties who wouldn't mind if they were taken advantage off.
The restaurant was booked by the Sikong family and all the top ten families were invited to the gathering, Zhu Cheng didn't need to flash any identity token or invitation as the guards at the entrance let him Yun Jhin and the others inside very easily, Zhu Cheng was very popular in the capital.
Yun Jhin looked around and saw quite a few young masters 'playing' with the maids of the restaurant, he shook his head, Zhu Cheng saw him shaking his head and chuckled then said:
"These trashes are here only to make up numbers, the true geniuses of the capital are further in, follow me I want to introduce you to the others, we can also have a few betting and friendly spars while we are at it, some of the people around here have the herbs you need to create your pills."
"I will point you to the ones that I know and you beat them, our faction gets popularity and prestige while you get resources, isn't it a very good trade with no loses?"
Zhu Cheng had a merchant smile on his face as he walked deeper into the restaurant.
There he waved at the Emperor Realm experts and the other leaders of their factions, however, he was visibly colder to the leaders that were under the Emperor Realm, so that meant around 70% of the people in the room.
The Emperor Realm experts at the 1st stage were quite average looking but they had a deep aura to them and a smile on their face that showed that they were quite charismatic, the other Emperor Realm expert at the 2nd stage was a beauty of considerable standards, she had long straight legs and a curvy figure, her pink lips were very enchanting as she pursed them when Zhu Cheng entered the room.
The other leaders also had all of their unique qualities to them, they weren't the leader of their clan youth factions for nothing, however, none of them were extremely good looking, it seemed Zhu Cheng was the only one that could be considered good looking in this room, Yun Jhin wasn't good looking but he was manly looking in his humanoid form.
Zhu Cheng smiled as he introduced Yun Jhin to everyone:
"This is a new brother of our Zhu Family, he is called Yun Jhin and he was recruited from the Sumo Empire, you might not believe it but his battle power is so high that he can even beat people around the 9th stage of the King realm."
The female from the Sikong Clan smiled lightly as she eyed Yun Jhin and she said:
"Zhu Cheng, you aren't bluffing to buff your morale are you?"
Zhu Cheng gave out a small smile as he looked at the Sikong woman and said:
"Sikong Cui, you will see if his strength is genuine or not, weren't you making fun of me because I didn't have any subordinate at the 9th stage? Why don't you let out your general to battle mine, and to make things a little bit interesting I will bet 5000 high-grade spirit stones on Yun Jhin, your Sikong family is rich in herbs and resources, why don't you bet some heavy starlight herb and some stones worth 5000 high-grade spirit stones."
Sikong Cui knew that Zhu Cheng wanted to extort some high-quality herbs from her, but that didn't mean she wasn't curious about Yun Jhin's battle power, some herbs weren't worth much to her as she could have as many as she wanted, being the prized daughter of the matriarch of the house.
Sikong Cui gave out a smile as she threw the herbs on the table that she was on and Zhu Cheng threw a spatial ring filled with 5000 spirit stones on the same table.
Sikong Cui looked behind her as another female walked forward and bowed to her, she had starlight in her eyes as she looked at Sikong Cui with admiration and said:
"I will teach this brat from the county how the people in the Luo capital fight my lady."
Sikong Cui gave out a small smile as she patted the young woman's head and told her:
"Sun Sun, it doesn't matter if you win or lose, just make him sweat a bit for me, I want to see what's so special to him that Zhu Cheng would call him 'his general', do your best understood?"
"Yes my lady, I shall give out 110% of my power!"
Yun Jhin let them talk, there was an arena in the restaurant that was created for them after they made this place was their usual gathering spot, the owner of the restaurant was even happy that they wanted to fight within it if they broke anything their families would pay for it! Since their families were rich they would pay more than the thing they broke was worth.
Yun Jhin stretched as his bones cracked, he moved his head a bit and watched as the woman called Sikong Sun Sun walked up to the arena and glared at him with her starlight filled gaze.
Yun Jhin chuckled inside, others might not know but the starlight from her eyes meant that she would soon suffer from cultivation deviation, starlight was leaking from one of her gems because of her hasty refining, Yun Jhin didn't know nor care why would someone rush in refining their jewel but this allowed him to easily deal with her.
Yun Jhin soul gave out a ripple as he sent a message to Zhu Cheng that told him of Sun Sun's situation, Zhu Cheng was smiling deviously on the inside as he heard what Yun Jhin told him and he responded to him using the same strand of the soul:
"Cripple her, make it look like an accident and I will give my all to get you enough herbs and hearts until you reach the 6th stage of the King Realm, crippling her will give us a big advantage in the coming tournament and it will show that bitch Sikong Cui who has the better subordinate now."
Yun Jhin sent an affirmative response to Zhu Cheng, doing dirty work for hearty rewards was one of his favourite part-time activities when he was a small-time thug like now.
Sikong Sun Sun looked at Yun Jhin and entered a stance as she prepared for the fight, Yun Jhin entered his fighting stance as well as he made up a plan to make Sun Sun's crippling look like an accident, atleast on the surface he needed to act, who cared if they knew he did it on purpose?
Accidents were prone to happen in such sparring matches.
Yun Jhin launched himself directly at her while showing her an opening to make her let her guard down.
Sun Sun chuckled inside as she watched him rush at her with an opening, she thought that Yun Jhin was truly a country bumpkin that didn't have much fighting experience even though his battle power was high.
This would be the last and most deadly mistake she would do as a cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Crippling
chapters.content:
Sun Sun thought that this will be an easy fight for her considering that Yun Jhin gave her such a big opening that she could exploit, she quickly made a motion with her hand and tried to poke one of Yun Jhin's meridians and paralyze him to humiliate him in front of Sikong Cui to make Zhu Cheng lose face.
Yun Jhin smiled inside as Sun Sun easily fell into his trap, the moment her finger touched the meridian that he exposed she immediately felt something wasn't right as Yun Jhin still moved forward.
Her eyes widened in horror as his hand went directly towards her head poking her forehead softly.
Inside her soul, her last soul jewel which was around the 8th stage of the refinery, the jewel started to crack as starlight poured out of it slowly.
Her starlit eyes intensified in color as she gripped her head in pain and horror, her eyes were dilated as she started screaming.
Yun Jhin watched on as the chain reaction started, as soon as he touched her forehead and inserted a little bit of extra starlight inside her soul jewel in the wrong way it broke the already unbalanced situation inside her crown.
Sun Sun growled and shouted like an animal as she fell to the ground and writhed like an animal, starlight fell from her body in quick succession, Sikong Cui frowned as she wanted to get up and do something but Zhu Cheng got in front of her and said:
"Watch on, the fight isn't done yet, is it? Or do you want to forfeit?"
Sikong Cui gritted her teeth and jumped on the arena to check on Sun Sun, she didn't care about the loss of the herbs as she saw from the corner of her eye Zhu Cheng taking everything on the table, she knew that she lost this one.
She checked Sun Sun's situation and she realized what happened, she was crippled and her cultivation was steadily dropping from the 9th stage of the King realm as her jewels combusted and exploded inside of her soul since the crown was on the head of the soul which was the center of the soul's thinking, she immediately became an idiot the first jewel exploded, most races had the center of their soul around the head, but some peculiar races had it at different parts of their soul bodies, the demons and devils for examples had it in their chest area around their hearts.
Yun Jhin watched on coldly as Sun Sun moved and writhed on the ground like a dying worm, Sikong Cui glared at him but he ignored her glare quite easily, she tried to create a ki weapon out of her sleeve and threw it at Yun Jhin, but Zhu Cheng was behind her with a similar type of weapon held at her neck.
Sikong Cui looked behind her and Zhu Cheng gave her a sunny smile that you wouldn't ever find on someone ready to murder you in a second.
Sikong Cui looked down at Sun Sun and sighed as she put her hand on her forehead, Sun Sun's body started to dissipate into dust as one moment of clarity passed through her murky eyes and some words fell from her mouth in the last seconds of her life:
"Thank you.... young lady..."
The others looked on without saying anything, those that didn't have an Emperor realm expert in their faction couldn't even comment on what happened or else they might offend Zhu Cheng and Sikong Cui and if they still wanted to have a table in the restaurant they would rather shut their mouths tight and watch on instead of commenting and inviting calamity.
Only the duo of other Emperor realm experts was talking in hushed tones, they were respectively from the 2nd and 3rd ranked clans, they were called Bugo Shun and Shin Xuan
Bugo Shun whispered to Shin Xuan slowly:
"Isn't this new general of the Zhu family quite ruthless, crippling such a beauty to the point she can't even be used in the bed anymore, what a pity, who would like to use a writhing crazy woman?"
Shin Xuan smiled and responded to him:
"Speak for yourself Bugo Shun, if Sikong Cui didn't end her I would have paid her a fair price to take her in as my slave."
Sikong Cui cultivation base was above them and they didn't hide their conversation so she could hear both of them quite well, she gritted her teeth as she left the arena and the restaurant all together with other people from her faction, she just gave Zhu Cheng one last glare before he left and mouthed something to him that looked like:
"I will make sure you will get what you deserve."
Zhu Cheng ignored her, he was happy as he hugged Yun Jhin and said:
"Brothers its inevitable accidents will happen in sparring, unfortunately, it seems that Sikong Sun Sun suffered from cultivation deviation, she must have rushed the refinement of her jewel and my compatriot here must have struck her too hard, we must drink in respect of Sun Sun's passing and have a moment of silence."
Zhu Cheng was quite hypocritical but no one pointed out that he was the one who told Yun Jhin to cripple Sun Sun, even the other Emperor realm experts kept mum and toasted with Zhu Cheng, they didn't fear Sikong Cui because she was a woman, even though she had a temper she wouldn't be able to do much to them because Zhu Cheng will protect them in the face of 'righteousness' since they talked about her now they were in cahoots with Zhu Cheng, and they didn't mind it, Zhu Cheng's momentum was increasing every day in the capital and people thought that the Zhu Family would replace the Sikong family as the first place soon enough as long as their ancestor succeeded in their closed-door cultivation.
The Sikong family was quite older compared to the Zhu Family and it was unknown if their ancestor was still alive or not, the same could be said about the Zhu Family's ancestor, even though she was a little younger than the Sikong Family ancestor, people were unsure if she was alive or not, but the Zhu family put on a strong front that made them think that their ancestor was still alive, they didn't dare to see if they were bluffing or not, after all, the ancestors of the top four houses were all equals before they went into closed-door cultivation.
While they were drinking, Zhu Cheng passed Yun Jhin the herbs along with a few more demonic hearts from his spatial ring, the others didn't bat an eyelid at what Zhu Cheng was doing, they realized that it was the reward for crippling Sun Sun.
They just drank and chatted merrily, suddenly while they were drinking Sikong Cui came back along with another youth, he had a mohawk haircut and wore an open robe that showed his muscular frame, he was around 2 meters tall and dwarfed Sikong Cui easily however his aura was weaker than Sikong Cui by quite a lot as he was at the 9th stage of the King Realm, but his aura had a blood quality with it which showed that he killed a lot of people.
Yun Jhin looked at the youth with narrowed eyes as he channeled some ki to his eyes and saw that he was hiding a bit of his cultivation base, he was a half a step away from the Emperor realm!
Sikong Cui glared at Zhu Cheng who was drinking merrily with the others and coughed to get his attention, Zhu Cheng already knew they were here but he was ignoring her on purpose just to make her madder.
Zhu Cheng put a surprised look on his face as he looked at the youth near Sikong Cui and asked:
"This brother is?"
Sikong Cui introduced the youth to everyone:
"This is Sun Sun's fiancee, he is called Sikong Mindu and he is very heartbroken to hear what happened with his fiancee, he came to ask revenge from Yun Jhin on the sparring arena."
Zhu Cheng frowned as he looked at Sikong Mindu and said:
"Accidents can happen in sparring, Yun Jhin can't be taken responsible from what happened, he didn't even hit her very hard, she mostly collapsed on her own, everyone here can attest to that."
Most of the people at the table nodded but didn't look at Sikong Cui in the eyes, Zhu Cheng smiled as he saw everyone going with his words, it meant that he cemented his position as the head of the youth gatherings in the capital.
Sikong Cui frowned but Mindu put a hand in front of her and walked directly to Yun Jhin as he glared at him from above and said in a booming voice:
"I know accidents happen in sparring but I would still like to spar with this brother here, after all, my fiancee wasn't weak and I would like to spar pointers with someone who could so easily see through her cultivation problems, might I be bold enough to ask for a spar with you?"
Yun Jhin would welcome him in a fight, even though he might not be able to beat him easily, there was a very low chance of losing as well, Zhu Cheng looked at him and then at Sikong Cui as he said:
"You know, my general is a busy man, he was supposed to go back and refine some pills so he could cultivate some more for the upcoming tournament, I'm not sure if he wants to fight anymore, maybe if you sweetened the deal for us, he could accept."
Sikong Cui gritted her teeth, this was openly disrespecting her along with trying to extort her of her riches, Yun Jhin opened his mouth to interject:
"I don't want much, just give me enough heavy starlight herbs and stones to the point that I can reach the 6th stage of the King Realm."
Sikong Cui guffawed at his shameless request, this would make her even some of her contribution points in her house along with her allowance for almost 4 months, there was no way she could accept this!
Zhu Cheng saw her expression then he yawned as he put a hand on Yun Jhin's shoulder and said:
"It seems Miss Sikong doesn't have enough money to accept this bet, brother Yun Jhin, let's go back to the house, we have partied enough and we should go back to cultivating, after all, there isn't much time left before the tournament, what was it again? 2 months?"
Sikong Cui knew that Zhu Cheng was trying to force her to accept, but she wasn't sure if Sikong Mindu could cripple Yun Jhin, what happened before was extremely quick and she couldn't get a grasp of his full battle power, she gritted her teeth as she watched Zhu Cheng leave with his people, but she didn't dare to do anything to him besides glaring and cursing him openly:
"We will see what happens in the tournament Zhu Cheng, you can't protect Yun Jhin then!"
Zhu Cheng gave out a hearty laugh as he left the restaurant and his voice traveled back to her:
"Your people should be wary of Yun Jhin in the future not the other way around!"
