Yun Jhin and Zhu Cheng went back to their family's compound, after Zhu Cheng stocked on some more hearts that he sent to Yun Jhin personally, he congratulated him again by patting him on the back and telling him:
"You did very well today, if you continue like this you might get noticed by the leader, it's not like he doesn't have his eye on you already, but if I recommended you to him, he might increase your monthly allowance and even let you browse our martial depository for free!"
Zhu Cheng was using the carrot and the stick to stimulate Yun Jhin and make him work harder for him, however, if Yun Jhin ever failed Zhu Cheng would discard him just as Sikong Cui did to Sun Sun, Sikong Cui did it more of pitty rather than feeling that Sun Sun became useless, but Zhu Cheng wasn't as soft as Sikong Cui, he might even delight himself in the fact that someone crippled Yun Jhin.
He was a hearty and good fellow on the surface, but his words and actions had venomous underlying, he was a wolf in sheep's clothing.
Yun Jhin interacted with so many people like him that he lost count, he knew how to play to their tunes and backstab them the moment they found it the least possible, he didn't mind being his puppet as long as he didn't make him do something that would put him in peril.
Yun Jhin entered his room and Zhu Cheng watched him for a short while as he returned to his room as well.
His room was different from Yun Jhin's as it was as big and wide as the leader of the house, he was the next leader of the house as long as he reached the god realm.
His plump secretary was waiting for him with a document with information that she gave to him, Zhu Cheng bend her over and took the document, he read it while he was doing his 'job':
"Sumo empire, lower continents, hmm, he is such a country bumpkin that he came from the lower continents, but his bloodline is quite pure, it seemed he must be a pawn planted by the Sumo empire that they retrieved later and now they faked his recordings... whatever, he got recruited by the Zhu household and he would be our pawn now, that Sumo Emperor while strong he is only equal to our leader of the house and way below our ancestor."
After around 20 minutes he finished his 'job' with his secretary and went to his private room to cultivate, he already made a plan on how to use Yun Jhin fully to his advantage even in the upcoming tournament hosted by the imperial family.
Yun Jhin was unaware of what Zhu Cheng had thought out for him, and he wouldn't care much even if he knew, in the end, all of those that plotted against him ended up in two ways, killed or assimilated.
Now all he cared about was finishing another cauldron of pills that he could use to reach the fourth stage of the King Realm, if he got a slot to the Imperial tomb party it would be even better, who knew what type of things could be found inside the Imperial tomb of an Empire ruled by former pure Azure Dragons?
One thing was certain, the treasures inside would be of great help to the current Yun Jhin, who knows? Maybe he could even find some herbs that were created from some of the leftover essences of those previous God Realm experts that lived their last moments in the tombs, even though God Realm cultivators bodies would disappear once they died, some of them would leave some of their essences in the form of herbs or ores near the spots that they died.
Yun Jhin wouldn't mind getting his hands on some of these herbs, he could use them to further his cultivation after the pills he was currently using lost their effectivity, and they were doing it quite fast, he might not even reach the 6th stage of the King Realm as he wanted to, maybe at most the peak of the 4th stage.
He could feel that his body was innately resisting their medicinal properties along with his soul who was getting used to them, this was a thing about cultivators that refined their body that Yun Jhin didn't particularly like, they would get used to the pills effect faster, however, this also meant they had way fewer impurities left from pills in their bodies to the point that their refined bodies would innately reject this type of impurities automatically.
Yun Jhin sighed as he finished another cauldron of pills, it was time to refine his third jewel to the peak of its refinery stage and break through the 4th stage of the King Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 88: 4th stage King Realm
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin had his eyes closed as he finished refining the last pill that he created, his 3rd jewel was shining extremely brightly on his crown as he reached the 9th stage of the refinery.
He was ready to make a breakthrough to the 4th stage of the King Realm!
To construct a life jewel he wouldn't need any special ingredients what he would need would be knowledge, a lot of knowledge about life. However, this was the thing that Yun Jhin lacked the least, he lived countless lives and went through tons of adversity.
He knew how life worked in the back of his palm, his yellow-colored life jewel was quickly taking form while spinning inside his soul space, it didn't take much time for it to be fully formed, it was octagonal and it had the character of life inscribed on it automatically by Yun Jhin's soul.
Without any fanfare, the jewel was inserted into his fourth slot on the crown, his body started shining as it filled with a high amount of life force to the point his skin peeled multiple times and regrew, his body rank didn't increase but its strength increase was of an extreme amount as it was filled with life force, with the current life force flowing through his body he was sure that he could live for at least 30,000 years, normally a King Realm expert around his cultivation base would live for around 10,000 years if he was a human.
Since he was a halfling he would live around 15,000 years, but the life force coming from his life jewel double that amount!
Yun Jhin clenched his fists as he could feel the pure life force coursing through his veins for a certain amount of time before it became tame and meek as his body was fully accustomed to the change.
Now that he was at the 4th stage of the King Realm he was sure that he would get a slot in the upcoming imperial tournament, as long as he didn't have to fight an Emperor realm expert, there were none in the King Realm that could defeat him currently unless they had a refined body as good as his along with a very peculiar jewel combination as his, so if there wasn't a second Yun Jhin existing in the Empire there was no chance he wouldn't get a slot!
The Zhu family had a high chance to get 2 slots for the tournament as Zhu Cheng had a high chance of defeating the Emperor realm bracket while Yun Jhin could get a slot as well, unfortunately, only one person could get a place each, so Yun Jhin couldn't hog all of the other slots, in total the Zhu Family could have 5 slots in total, that meant they could get in 5 young geniuses and 5 elders if they won the tournament as Yun Jhin thought.
Yun Jhin breathed out a small cloud of impurities that disintegrated in the air very quickly, there wasn't anything much to do now besides waiting for more hearts and herbs to be sent to him, while hearts would easy to get as Zhu Cheng was sending in a steady supply of them weekly, herbs were scarcer as the Zhu Family didn't have a high monopoly of the capital's herbs, the most profitable businesses were in the hands of the Sikong Family.
Yun Jhin sighed as he left his room, since there wasn't anything to do besides of slowly accumulating starlight he decided that he shouldn't waste his time on such an endeavor.
Unfortunately, the last pills couldn't help him refine his new jewel and it sat at the 1st stage of the refinery currently.
Yun Jhin walked around the Zhu household and observed the training youths that used the public training areas, he observed the formations that surrounded the building and tried to find any weak points if somehow in the future he would become enemies with the Zhu Family and he would need to do a quick getaway.
While he walked around the place, Zhu Cheng was getting reports about his previous exploits:
"Lived in the danger zones for 10 days and above? took over an empire? made the giant tribe and a local sect fight to the death? Hmm, it seems the Sumo Empire made him do quite a few things while he was undercover, I wonder what does this mean, does the Sump Empire want to expand their territory to the middle continents and below? Very unlikely they are too poor..."
Zhu Cheng shook his head as he looked at the freshest report that said Yun Jhin went out of closed-door cultivation, it was around 3 weeks left before the tournament began and it seemed Yun Jhin couldn't stay still anymore.
Zhu Cheng decided to leave his chambers as well, he wanted to see how much did his 'friend' improve during his closed-door cultivation, he coincidentally met with Yun Jhin as he made it look like he was wandering around the family compounds just like Yun Jhin was doing.
Zhu Cheng greeted Yun Jhin with a smile and the following words:
"Oh, brother Yun Jhin, it seems you have improved your cultivation again, it wasn't even a long time ago since you came to the family and you already improved in 1 stage, aren't you talented?"
Yun Jhin gave out a small smile but inside he was sneering heavily, he knew that Zhu Cheng wanted to test his battle power and he might even invite him to another 'youth gathering' like the previous one.
And he did just as Yun Jhin suspected, along with promising him that he would get him some herbs if he did what he said again, Yun Jhin accepted and this reinforced Zhu Cheng's thought that Yun Jhin could be easily manipulated using resources which made him grown into a bigger fool and country bumpkin in his eyes.
Yun Jhin followed Zhu Cheng around the capital but instead of going to the same restaurant as before they now went to the compound of the Bugo family where they met with Bugo Shun.
Bugo Shun invited them in the house and asked why did Zhu Cheng contact him, when he heard that he wanted Yun Jhin to spar with one of his general he just gave out a small smile and said that all of his general were in closed-door cultivation, he saw what happened to Sikong Cui's subordinate and knew that Zhu Cheng came here to make trouble for him, even though he technically on his side in the imperial tournament no one would hold back anything unless they were from the same family.
Zhu Cheng couldn't force him to make a general spar with Yun Jhin so he just gave him a silent smile that meant he wouldn't have a good time if he met him during the Imperial Tournament.
Zhu Cheng came increasingly depressed as no one wanted to spar with Yun Jhin and they returned swiftly to the Zhu Family household, Zhu Cheng didn't say anything as he returned to his room without even telling Yun Jhin goodbye, Yun Jhin knew that Zhu Cheng felt that his authority among the younger generation was challenged as no one did what he told them to.
However, why would they? Even though they respected him on the surface everyone still hated and loathed him, even though Sikong Cui was cold and annoying at least she wasn't a pain in the ass as Zhu Cheng was, he was petty prone to anger, and very vengeful, this could be already seen as he contacted Yun Jhin and told him to assassinate some of the low-level disciples of their families.
Yun Jhin of course just said that he doesn't have time to do that as he got some enlightenment and had to rush back to closed-door cultivation and he might not be able to exit before the tournament began.
Zhu Cheng was almost frothing at the mouth as Yun Jhin didn't accept his order as a good dog would, but on the surface, he was calm as an old well.
He knew he couldn't put all of his eggs in one basket by making Yun Jhin his only general so he decided to confront the twins as they were the more easily swayed ones in the Zhu Family.
When Zhu Cheng met with the twins they were playing chess in their room, Zhu Cheng closed the room's door behind him, the twins got up from their cross-legged positions on the ground and glared at Zhu Cheng but before they could say anything an Imperial aura enveloped the both of them and sent them to the ground.
Zhu Cheng tried to forcefully recruit them into his faction but the twins held fast under the pressure and didn't relent even though their bones cracked and their internal organs were getting squished, the sole reason Zhu Cheng wasn't very respected in the family was that he was an outsider like Yun Jhin, he was taken in the family by the patriarch after he saw his potential in a fighting pit below the capital.
Even though he was strong and young the others looked down on him due to him not being of the same blood as them, especially since he entered the family he was extremely violent and had no manners, with time he grew accustomed to the customs of nobility but inside he was the same violent brute that used to fight in the pits under the capital.
Zhu Cheng gritted his teeth till they bleed as he left the twins room, he knew that the patriarch was watching what he was doing, while he didn't interfere he wasn't sure if he was supportive of what he was doing.
Zhu Cheng sighed, he wasn't very smart as he didn't have a good education since young, he was street smart at best and he only started to start scheming after he got taken in to be nobility, however, he was still very prone to anger and he realized what he did was an enormous mistake, he slicked back his hair as he returned to his room and decided to cultivate for the next 3 weeks until the imperial tournament started so he could cool off his head.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he knew it was time to go, he could feel that some attendant from the family was here to wake him up and tell him that the tournament would begin soon.
Yun Jhin opened the door of his room as he frightened the attendant that was ready to knock on the door, the attendant bowed his head low as he told Yun Jhin that the tournament would be starting soon and the head of the house was ready to take them to the imperial palace where the tournament would be hosted.
Yun Jhin ignored the attendant as he went to the open area inside the compound of the family, there were hundreds of cultivators at the 9th stage as every cultivator at the 9th stage at the King realm returned to the family.
Yun Jhin was the only exception as his cultivation was only at the 4th stage but no one pointed at him or laughed as Zhu Cheng was behind him and coming slowly to hug him. The hug was quite forceful as Yun Jhin's bones made cracking sounds for a bit.
Yun Jhin gave a forced smile as Zhu Cheng patted him on the shoulder and said:
"Let's make sure we both do our best in this tournament alright?"
His smile was as fake as it could get, it seemed his cultivation session didn't cool off his head fully.
The head of the family shook his head as he saw Zhu Cheng's acting, he was only putting up with him because he was very talented, he knew that his personality needed fixing and he tried countless times but all he did was make him hide his personality inside, he wasn't sure why his true personality was resurfacing but what he was sure off was that it wasn't a good thing.
Yun Jhin and the crowd were taken to the imperial palace and there they met with the others, Yun Jhin only had eyes for those at the Emperor realm as he didn't care about those at the King Realm anymore, unfortunately, there wasn't any surprise as Sikong Cui and the two others were the only ones at the Emperor realm along with Zhu Cheng. He wanted to see if he could defeat a newly broken through Emperor realm expert but it seemed there was no luck.
Zhu Cheng gave out a hearty smile as he saw Sikong Cui and asked her:
"Did Miss Cui's cultivation base advanced in these three months?"
Sikong Cui didn't say anything as she ignored him, the other two chatted for a little bit with Zhu Cheng before the Emperor appeared.
The Luo Emperor was a hearty man with a robust build and blue colored hair, his imperial robe was adorned with moons and stars and his aura was pure and peaceful, you wouldn't think that this man was a powerhouse at the peak of the God Realm who could control the elements and all of the lives of the people in front of him.
The Emperor didn't give any speech or anything, he just waved his hand and two arenas appeared, one was for the Emperor realm of the younger generation while the other was for the King Realm.
The Emperor realm experts would secure the 1st spot and the other spots would be distributed to those at the King Realm.
Yun Jhin watched as his soul aura was scanned and then randomly intertwined with someone from the crowd, this was the way people would be matched up to fight.
His aura was intertwined with a skinny man with a pale complexion, he was coughing constantly as he stood there and you wouldn't think he would be of the younger generation by his complexion, but his life force said otherwise.
Yun Jhin was one of the first people that had to fight so he jumped on the arena after a few fights went by, the sickly man jumped on the arena as well but he almost fell because he couldn't control his body properly.
Yun Jhin knew that this was an act as he tried to act like a pig to eat the tiger, Yun Jhin decided to play along with him as he would be a pig as well.
Yun Jhin wasn't very popular in the capital but a lot of people still heard of him and his exploits at the younger generation gathering, so the sickly man didn't bite into Yun Jhin's act at first and kept a defensive stance.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at him, acting up and then not following? Quite disappointing, Yun Jhin told him directly:
"I guess I will send you on your way if you don't want to play."
The man frowned as he didn't understand what Yun Jhin meant but then his eyes widened as he looked down and realized that he was pushed off the arena before he felt what happened!

chapters.title: Chapter 89: A interesting tournament
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin watched as the man flailed before he fell outside of the arena, the impact from the air to the ground wasn't that hard but he still vomited a mouthful of blood and became unconscious.
Most of the people that viewed the fight had a keen eye so they recognized the fact that Yun Jhin injected some wind energy into him that cut his insides after it pushed him off the arena, most of them thought that he was a vicious individual for what he had done and they didn't want to meet him during the tournament.
Yun Jhin watched from above as someone else jumped on the arena to replace the sickly man, things went on the same, Yun Jhin's cultivation base put him ahead of any King Realm cultivator, and no matter what they did they wouldn't be able to shake his position or even make him move half a step behind.
The King Realm tournament ended up with Yun Jhin winning it and he naturally took the second prize getting 2 slots for the upcoming expedition in the imperial tombs. The 3rd, 4th, and 5th places were won by the Sikong, Shen, and Shin families.
Yun Jhin left the arena and looked towards the Emperor Realm fighters, in the end, it was still the fight between Sikong Cui and Zhu Cheng, even though the other two fought valiantly against each other, Sikong Cui and Zhu Cheng only needed to slap them to take them out of the competition, so instead of making a joke out of themselves after they had to fight the duo of 2nd stage Emperor realm they forfeited.
It was now the main fight that everyone looked out for, the fight between two young prodigies at the 2nd stage of the Emperor Realm.
Zhu Cheng smiled lightly at Sikong Cui, but while his face was kind his whole body was exhausting fighting energy, his veins were visible as they quickly pumped blood through his body, his teeth were gritting against each other as he watched Sikong Cui, he hated people like her, people that were born into good families if he wasn't lucky enough for the head of the Zhu Family to take him in he might have just died in the pit fights below the city, a street rat that no one would have cared bout.
Even though he hated Yun Jhin for disobeying him he also understood him somewhat, even though he thought he was a pawn planted by the Sumo Empire for something, in the end, he was a country bumpkin compared to him and he didn't find him threatening.
Sikong Cui was a different story, ever since he entered the Zhu Family he tried to pursue her a few times, but all his attempts ended up with her laughing in his face, after a while he got over his crush on her and he started to hate her because he looked down on him because of his birth, he trained hard to overtake her cultivation base and succeeded!
Only for her uncle to luckily find a herb that helped her breakthrough to the same realm as him!
She was supposed to be at the 1st stage, not the second stage like him!
Sikong Cui knew about Zhu Cheng's hatred for her, he was quite unstable emotionally and her looking down upon him in the past didn't help his self-esteem. She felt bad about what happened back then, but only because Zhu Cheng grew into such a strong man.
The fight began soundlessly as Zhu Cheng released his imperial aura all over the arena, his breathing evened out as his hot breath went out of his mouth looking like mist descended on the arena.
Sikong Cui eyes widened, such a hot breath meant his blood was boiling, how angry was he?
Zhu Cheng smile turned strange as he looked at her, his teeth turned sharp as he disappeared from where he stood, when he appeared he was in front of Sikong Cui and had a longsword made of ki in his hand, the longsword color was a deep crimson and it was stabbing directly to her stomach trying to sever her ki pathways!
Sikong Cui dodged hastily by jumping backward but Zhu Cheng put his leg behind hers and tripped her making her fall on her butt.
Sikong Cui rolled as she narrowly dodged the sword that was ready to now impale her stomach, Zhu Cheng was aiming to cripple her but no one was saying anything about it!
The Emperor looked down at the fights from his throne in the palace, he was observing from his throne room and didn't say anything as he just looked on, sometimes his eyes would close as he would contemplate something, from time to time his eyes would wander towards Yun Jhin's figure who was also observing the fight between Zhu Cheng and Sikong Cui, his eyes would glow every time he would look at him.
Sikong Cui gritted her teeth as she finally went on the offensive, she created a purple scythe out of her ki and used it to slash diagonally trying to slash Zhu Cheng into two!
Zhu Cheng easily parried with his longsword almost making her scythe break, Sikong Cui wasn't proficient in close range combat but the arena was restricting her movements, if she was thrown out it would also be considered a loss!
Sikong Cui closed her eyes and then opened them revealing that their color changed to a deep purple, her scythe was removed in favor of a bow, she started to masterfully dodge his anger-filled attacks and nocked an arrow on her ki bow.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes seeing that arrow and watched on to see what Zhu Cheng would do to dodge it.,
Zhu Cheng's fighting instincts told him that this arrow would be able to injure him quite heavily so he intended to dodge it at all costs!
Zhu Cheng tried to attack her before she could let go of the arrow but the moment he tried to move he felt that her deep purple eyes locked on his head and her fingers were a few centimeters away from the string of the bow!
Zhu Cheng frowned as he dissipated the longsword and created a tower shield to protect himself from the deadly arrow, however, he miscalculated as a small smile appeared on Sikong Cui's face.
Her lips curved upwards as she opened her mouth and whispered:
"It's my win..."
She let go of the string of the bow and the arrow flew so fast that no one below the Emperor Realm could even see where it went, even Yun Jhin had to strain his eyes to see it's trajectory.
The arrow directly went through Zhu Cheng's tower shield and hit his forehead!
The tower shield disappeared as Zhu Cheng appeared with an arrow in his forehead, his head was hung down as blood dripped down on the arena, the referee walked slowly towards Zhu Cheng and tried to see if he was still alive.
Zhu Cheng's aura was fluctuating wildly and his lifeforce did the same, suddenly the arrow lodged in his forehead transformed into dust as it was forcefully destroyed by Zhu Cheng's inner ki.
His eyes turned a deeper crimson than before as they turned into slits and his pupils reappeared in his eyes, he regained some of his wits after he was hit in the head with the arrow, even though his soul was injured in the process it made him sober up.
He breathed out again but his blood wasn't boiling as before, it started to turn a little colder than usual, Zhu Cheng form started to morph as he transformed into a 5 meters long dragon!
There was a dot scar on his forehead from the arrow but it was slowly closing, Sikong Cui's eyes widened as he saw him using his true form and she hastily tried to transform into hers as well, she started growing in size to prepare herself for her transformation.
Unfortunately for her, Zhu Cheng didn't let her, he flew towards her at unimaginable speeds as not even after images were left behind, she looked down at her chest and saw Zhu Cheng's claw inside of it, his claw turned to the left as he grasped her innards and wanted to rip them out, but the referee quickly appeared between them, this was a fatal injury and if he didn't stop it he would be held responsible by the Sikong family.
The referee tried to make Zhu Cheng let go of her innards but Zhu Cheng just smiled at him, the referee thought that he understood what he meant but underneath that smile was a ghastly visage that he kept hidden.
Zhu Cheng did let go of her innards, only after he jumped backward and out of the arena.
Sikong Cui innards were rolling all around the arena as she coughed multiple mouthfuls of blood, she wasn't crippled, she was dying!
The Emperor didn't say anything about killing, so technically it was allowed, but it was also an unspoken rule that killing was banned, officially you could kill but only if you were ready to accept what came after.
Zhu Cheng transformed into his human form as he looked at Sikong Cui's dying frame with cold eyes, his crimson eyes turned back into a blue crystalline color as his aura turned peaceful, as Sikong Cui was dying Zhu Cheng's cultivation base was stabilizing and growing, it seemed Sikong Cui was Zhu Cheng's heart devil that stopped him from improving his cultivation base.
Yun Jhin clicked his tongue as he saw Zhu Cheng's cultivation increase and thought:
"This brat would have made a good young master in the Blood Throne sect, fortunately, it was destroyed, if they knew of me reincarnating I don't think they would have let me go before they dissected my soul and took all of my memories."
Yun Jhin was the former leader of the Blood Throne sect but considering what kind of people he recruited into the sect it was a certain thing that if they found him while he was weak they would try to take all of his memories from him along with whatever treasures he had on him.
Yun Jhin watched as Zhu Cheng approached him and gave him a genuine smile, it seemed some of his anger was burned away along with the death of Sikong Cui, Yun Jhin could see from the corner of the eye an elder from the Sikong family coming and taking the corpse away with a hardened face, he glared at the patriarch of the Zhu family and made a motion with his thumb over his neck, the patriarch just gave out a small smile in response and waved his hand.
This made the elder extremely uncomfortable as he hastily left with his young mistress body to be buried.
The Emperor came out of the palace to give out congratulations along with announcing the quotas and which family had them, The Zhu family had the most standing at 5 slots, that meant 10 people from the Zhu Family would enter the imperial tomb.
Most of the other families started to butter them up, after all, who knew if the items from the tomb would make them soar like a carp over the dragon gate?
The Emperor smiled cryptically and then disappeared after he announced everything, very few understood the Emperor's smile and one of them was the patriarch of the Zhu Family, he had a grave expression on his face as he returned with all of the disciples back to the family and created an emergency meeting.
Yun Jhin and Zhu Cheng were invited to the meeting along with the sage realm elders of the family.
The Zhu patriarch took a deep breath as he said:
"I'm not sure if we should enter the tomb this time."
Most of the elders were puzzled along with Zhu Cheng, Yun Jhin wasn't sure what the Emperor's smile meant but he caught a glimpse of it and his instincts told him it wasn't anything nice.
The Zhu patriarch told them about a legend of the tomb:
"There's a random occurring in the tomb when the souls of the former Emperor's come back as wraiths, up till now 4 of the former 20 Emperor soul wraiths were captured, however, it took the death of other 2 Emperor's along with the extermination of their souls to capture those 4!"
Everyone's eyes widened as they heard this, did the Emperor's smile meant that they had to deal with soul wraiths again?
The patriarch continued to explain:
"His smile could mean many things but every Emperor smiled this way when the Soul wraiths appeared, and it isn't voluntary, some of the Emperors who died explained before their souls scattered that their mouths moved on their own as if they were possessed, the imperial family might be cursed I'm not sure about the specifics and I don't dare to investigate either."
This could be quite the unfortunate thing as the Zhu Family finally got so many slots after hundreds of years of only getting one or failing.
The patriarch instated this meeting because he wanted to know the opinion of others, would they want to enter or not, after all, as the patriarch who needed to protect the house while others were away he wouldn't be able to enter and he didn't want to force anyone if he did he would lose their loyalty and the house would be in peril from external forces.
Yun Jhin knew about such occurring, they weren't random, they were man-made, the first emperor must have created the soul murking formation when he created the tomb and hid it from his descendants, this was quite the devilish Azure dragon.
The soul murking formation was meant to use the souls of God Realm experts to mend and restore the destroyed soul of a dead God Realm expert. This was a way for those dead God Realm experts whose souls were destroyed to reincarnate, there was never a true death in a sense, but losing your physical body and being forced to recultivate was extremely annoying and time consuming that was why Yun Jhin was searching for true eternal life, among with other reasons that became muddled during his countless reincarnations.
Yun Jhin knew that he had to get inside the tomb, he knew the outline of the soul murking formation and if he was lucky he would be able to find the main node of the formation, there he could insert his soul in the formation and refine the souls of the other God Realm experts to restore his soul capabilities to at least 50% or more! It all depended on how many soul remains were murked from the remaining 16.
Yun Jhin watched as the elders voted and most of them decided that they wanted to go inside the tomb, the treasures were just too alluring.
The patriarch didn't look very happy at what was happening but he respected their decision as he said:
"Zhu Cheng will have to select two other of the younger generation and Yun Jhin one, after that Yun Jhin Zhu Cheng and the other three people will select an elder each and they will go to the tomb's entrance on the day of its opening which is around 5 days from now, make the good choices, I will have to go now."
A lot of elders started to swarm Yun Jhin and Zhu Cheng as they tried to impress them with their cultivation bases so they could be chosen to accompany them in the tomb.
Yun Jhin scanned each elder with his soul willpower and they didn't complain, he wasn't that interested in most of them but a certain peculiar elder that blocked his soul willpower took his attention.
His eyes glowed as he looked at the man, his actions piqued his interest along with his looks and the aura he exuded, he knew that the elder must have done it on purpose but he did have the power that Yun Jhin needed.
Yun Jhin neared the elder and asked him:
"Elder, might you be able to tell me your esteemed name?"
The elder gave a burst of hearty laughter as he looked at Yun Jhin, his plan worked!
The elder opened his mouth to give out his name...

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Imperial Tombs
chapters.content:
The elder puffed up his chest to make himself look bigger and pointed to his face as he said:
"My name is Sun Takijo, remember it well kid, I'm the strongest elder in the Zhu Family."
Chatter could be heard around after Takijo made his statement:
"Strongest? Most likely not, shameless old fool."
Takijo's eyes narrowed as he looked around and said:
"Oh, I'm not the strongest? Then let's all fight right here and now to see who is!"
The one who spoke averted his eyes, he spoke like that but he was weaker than Takijo, he only thought that there were others stronger than him who would speak up after he spoke first.
However, no one spoke up and it became very awkward for him.
Yun Jhin could feel that his cultivation base was quite refined but he looked to be quite unintelligent, however, this was the better thing for Yun Jhin, he didn't need someone smart to accompany him as he would have to look out for betrayals, someone simple would be easier to manipulate, his cultivation base wasn't bad standing around the 6th stage of the Sage Realm, he was an eminent elder quite above the normal elders at the emperor realm, his rank was high even amongst eminent elders, he would be in top 5, but his statement of being the strongest was also a lie.
The others started muttering:
"You will see what the other 4 will say when they will get out of closed-door cultivation, they should be out any minute now!"
3 male elders and one female elder appeared the moment the other elder finished his words, they were all above Takijo in strength, however, from their eyes, you could see that they were the normal old curs who schemed, lied, and backstabbed, he couldn't see the same thing in Takijo's eyes, he could see some greed but no scheming.
The female elder was the strongest and she quickly walked towards Zhu Cheng and said:
"I will be the one to accompany young master Zhu Cheng for this time, please leave."
The other three looked around and saw how Takijo took Yun Jhin so they waited for the other youngsters to appear, they didn't care much as everyone would have an equal chance of getting treasures as long as they got a spot, there were three spots left and who would fight them to get their hands on the spots?
Zhu Cheng appointed the twins as the other youths to join them in the Imperial tombs while Yun Jhin appointed the lazy man that could control shadows, Zhu Sumen!
The other three elders got the slots that they wanted and the other's dispersed from the place, the elders started to talk amongst themselves with Sun Takijo talking the loudest, however, it was obvious the other elders were looking down on him, after all, his family name was Sun and not Zhu!
He was an external elder that joined the head of the house so the elders that had the Zhu family name looked down on him thinking that he was an opportunist, only the head of the house knew why Sun Takijo joined the family.
Even though the others looked down on him they were still polite on the surface due to his high cultivation base.
Zhu Sumen sighed as he watched the elders talk with each other and said:
"Why did you choose me? Do you want to bury me in the imperial tomb?"
Yun Jhin shook his head, this man had quite a good imagination, he only chose him because his battle power was very high and his shadow techniques would be useful in the tomb which was mostly full of death yang energy, the younger generation would explore with the younger generation while the older generation would explore with the older generation, heads of the house wouldn't join as there was a chance their houses would be attacked if they weren't present, the deterrent of the head of the house was almost bigger than the whole elder assembly.
Yun Jhin left for his room while Zhu Sumen was quite annoyed that he was ignored, but he sighed and accepted it, after all, he was one of the strongest in the family and Yun Jhin fought him before, so it was only logical he would be chosen, he didn't like it but he begrudgingly accepted it and left.
Zhu Cheng was the last one to leave the room along with the twins, the twins looked at him with a puzzled expression, they still vividly remembered how he forced them on the ground with his aura and tried to force them into being his subordinates, they wondered why would he allow them getting stronger when they were his enemies?
Zhu Cheng gave out his famous smile as they were quite far away from the elder assembly and his aura unleashed itself on them, they fell to their knees as they started gasping for air and Zhu Cheng's voice was heard:
"You wonder why I gave you this opportunity right? Let me tell you, I heard the Imperial Tomb had quite a few formations traps installed here and there, I would need some help to unarm them and the two of you are perfect for that kind of job."
They weren't proficient in formations, Zhu Cheng just wanted to push them ahead and use the excuse of the formation killing them to get rid of them, he knew that due to their twin sibling bond the moment the both of them would break through to the Emperor realm if they fought him together there was a chance for them to win!
Their battle power would double when they fought together.
Since he made them into enemies he wanted to silence them before they became strong enough to threaten him, unfortunately for the duo as they still didn't break through the Emperor realm they couldn't do much against Zhu Cheng, even if they reported to the head of the house, the head might just ignore them in favor of Zhu Cheng!
Yun Jhin watched from under his stealth technique, his eyes scanned everything that happened in front of him and he chuckled inside and shook his head then left, there was no reason to intervene here.
Zhu Sumen watched from behind the corner of a house what happened, he found it extremely troublesome and ignored what happened while leaving, he needed to prepare himself for the Imperial tomb.
5 days passed by extremely fast and the elders took the younger generations to the entrance of the Imperial Tomb, the Imperial Tomb was built underground and the entrance looked like one of a normal cellar, the gates were just made of cyan dragon jade and inscribed with grandiose words along with some history of the Empire.
Yun Jhin watched as the Emperor opened the gates easily by swinging his hand, there was a dark formation engulfing the entrance and it slowly dissipated, it was the formation meant to keep outsiders out while the soul murking formation worked on the souls of the deceased Emperors, it disappearing meant that it was ready to accept new souls.
The Emperor disappeared in the depths of the tomb while not saying anything, the elders and youths that won the tournament entered, Sun Takijo left while waving to Yun Jhin and telling him:
"If we meet inside we will team up."
Yun Jhin entered along with Zhu Cheng and the others and they could feel the darkness of the formation engulfing them, Yun Jhin shuddered as he felt a cold chill spreading through his body and analyzing his whole being.
Zhu Cheng and the others did the same, they felt something was wrong when they entered the tomb but they couldn't place their fingers on what specifically.
Since they entered in groups the elders ended up in the same random place while the youths did the same, the entrance to the tombs wasn't big enough to handle all of them squeezing together, so the elders went with the elders and the youths with the youths, this way the elders could protect themselves, the youths knew this would leave them exposed to the dangers of the tomb but since their cultivation base was relatively low, the murked souls wouldn't sense and attack them first, as for the formation traps, this was something the others already talked about and taught their young charges.
Yun Jhin looked around, the darkness in the tomb wasn't impeding his vision but it did send a chill down his spine once in a while, the walls of the tomb were inscribed with ancient dragon language that told the history of up to 500,000 years ago.
Yun Jhin's eyes widened as he looked at an inscription of the first ancestors of the dragon race.
The other youths were as captivated as he was, the inscription told the story of two brothers, the Azure dragons were known as Luo Shang and Bumi Ming, they were the respective ancestors of the two empires.
The story talked about how the azure dragons were free of emotions and thoughts at first, but humans hatred of their strong bodies and bloodlines made them poison the two azure dragons forcing them to fight each other in the end. Luo Shang became the darkness yang dragon and Bum Ming resisted the poison and achieved enlightenment becoming the light Yin dragon.
Some of the stories were destroyed by time so Yun Jhin couldn't know surely what happened but one thing he was sure of was that both of them died by old age by his current time, even pure Azure dragons would live at most 300,000 years or so, azure dragons, black tortoises, vermilion birds, and white tigers were the darlings of the universe, they were born from the first chaos of the universe and had the purest bloodlines, however, their descendants couldn't handle their bloodlines fully and with time their blood diluted, even though the Emperor's of today's age still had the blood of the sacred beast flowing through their veins, they were at most 10% of their ancestor's purity.
Yun Jhin knew that the black dragon became insane after he was corrupted by the human's thought severing poison, he tried to eat his brother in an attempt to break through the ultimate realm above the God Realm, he was defeated and sealed in the end, however, from what it seemed the sealing only made him create this soul murking formation and he controlled his descendants to enter the tomb to slaughter them!
The formation was still at work as it used the former Emperor's souls as fuel and it seemed it also worked on the current Emperor, even though some of the souls were taken back by the Empire, there was also a high chance it was done on purpose by the last soul fragment of the dark dragon.
Yun Jhin knew that the situation in the tomb was deadly, but if he could get to the core of the formation and absorb that remaining soul fragment...
Yun Jhin walked while he disarmed some of the weaker trap formations around, the others stood behind him and saw how he easily took care of the trap formations with wide eyes, Zhu Cheng was also quite interested in Yun Jhin's trap disarming skills but also disappointed that he couldn't send the twins into the traps to kill them.
The youths from the other families were wary of those from the Zhu Family so they banded together, however, they knew that if Zhu Cheng made a move all of them would die.
Zhu Cheng ignored the others as he followed behind Yun Jhin while keeping an eye on the twins.
Zhu Sumen didn't look as sleepy as before as he concentrated on his surroundings, he knew that any sudden movement would kill them!
Yun Jhin was surveying the structure of the formation in his head as he was guiding all of them towards the core of the formation, he wanted to sacrifice them to get inside the core and absorb the last soul fragment of the dark dragon!
While Yun Jhin was guiding them to their doom Zhu Cheng felt that something wasn't right, he could feel that the surroundings started to get colder and colder and his keen sense of danger told him that it wouldn't end well if he continued to follow Yun Jhin.
So he appeared in front of Yun Jhin and kneed him in the stomach making him fall to the ground.
Yun Jhin cursed, it seemed he underestimated Zhu Cheng's instincts, he thought that he would follow him if he showed good skills in formations but it seemed Zhu Cheng saw through his intentions.
Zhu Cheng grabbed Yun Jhin by the arm and made him get up as he said while pointing to the opposite direction:
"We will go that way, disarm the formations in those parts."
Zhu Cheng started to order Yun Jhin as if he was his slave and there wasn't anything that Yun Jhin could do, the formations took a little bit of time to disarm and if he tried to run away from Zhu Cheng he would trigger them and it won't end well, he couldn't fight Zhu Cheng due to the realm gap, so all he could do was comply with his words with gritted teeth.
Yun Jhin started to listen to Zhu Cheng's instruction but inside he sneered, even if Zhu Cheng wanted to avoid the core of the formation, in the end, he would still end up there with his help, he just had to do it in a more roundabout manner instead of the direct manner from before.
From time to time, they would find some God Herbs left from the essence of the corpses of the dead God Realm experts of the Imperial family, Zhu Cheng would immediately snatch them and not leave anything for anyone, not even those from the Zhu Family.
The one time that the Sikong Family youth tried to say something Zhu Cheng stopped Yun Jhin and threw him into the formation traps transforming him into a meat patty that was absorbed by the ground, his soul could be seen being shredded and absorbed by the dark surroundings.
Zhu Cheng then casually told Yun Jhin to continue, Yun Jhin was visibly upset on the outside but inside he was sneering as he could feel the will of the formation waking up, it seemed this would be the last Emperor that could restore the soul fragment of the dark dragon to what it was before.
Yun Jhin knew that he had to get to the core before the Emperor was fully absorbed by the formation or else all of them would die inside the tombs, used to reconstruct the dark's dragon body, it would be something similar to his ability to eat others to evolve, but instead, he would forcefully rip the bloodlines out of the bodies of those present to create himself a body with talent comparable to his first one, However, with the purity of the current descendant's bloodlines, he would need to massacre the whole capital of the Luo Empire to create a body with cultivation around the God Realm, this included all of the other God Realm experts and he might not even reach the 7th stage of the God Realm.
Yun Jhin sensed that Zhu Cheng was checking his surroundings every second for danger, he didn't want Yun Jhin to trick him and put him in the same danger zone as before.
After a while of disarming formations, they finally reached the death place of a former emperor, a shining golden sword sat on the ground untouched, it was an artifact of the godly quality!
Zhu Cheng didn't understand the power of the artifact but seeing how it was shiny and the powerful aura it was emanating he pulled the twins from where they stood and kicked them towards the sword while saying:
"The two of you shall make yourself useful and take that sword for me!"
The twins complied while cursing Zhu Cheng inside, they slowly got closer towards the sword and both of them grabbed the sword at the same time, suddenly glaring golden radiance fell from the sword and engulfed the twin's bodies!

chapters.title: Chapter 91: The twins level up
chapters.content:
The twin's bodies that were engulfed with golden light started to levitate as their auras started to increase in power and intensity.
Zhu Cheng eyes widened as he jumped up trying to stop what was happening, they all realized that the twins were breaking through the Emperor realm at the same time!
It seemed the godly treasure was a catalyst left behind from the god realm expert, he left there some of his enlightenment along with ki so that someone would get a guaranteed breakthrough of one level, even if they were at the Sage Realm, however, it wouldn't be useful for those at the God Realm.
It seemed quite wasteful the energy was used on the twins but it was their luck to get it, Zhu Cheng teeth made sounds like they were ready to break as he tried to break the twins away from the sword but the few seconds when he jumped to the moment that his hand touched the sword was enough for both of them to assimilate the energy and breakthrough, even though they forced their breakthrough the sequelae from it could be healed with the resources of the Zhu Family.
Yun Jhin watched as the twins opened their eyes at the same time and tried to unsheath the sword only for it to drop out their hands and zap both of them, it was a godly weapon, even those at the sage realm would barely be able to use it.
Since they couldn't use the sword the duo directly attacked Zhu Cheng, they were fighting as one as Zhu Cheng had to dodge their palms and fist attacks, their combined battle power was pretty similar to his!
Zhu Cheng eyes became red as he took a glance at the sword, he could have broken through to the 3rd stage of the Emperor realm with that sword, the veins of his head started to become visible as they moved like earthworms, he was thoroughly angry at this point!
The twins created a katana each and they wielded as if it was one person attacking and not two, Zhu Cheng started to get overwhelmed as he fought two people at once and his face got slashed a bit, blood dripped slowly from the cut on his cheek and his expression became terrifying.
Zhu Cheng's anger couldn't be explained in words as he transformed into his true form and used his claws to slash the duo into nothing, however, the twins transformed into their true form as well, they were sky dragons with strange blue patterns running across their snake-like bodies, their wings were small and they seemed like they wouldn't be able to support their long bodies enough to fly.
Yun Jhin was already breaking away from the group as he took a safe distance away from the fight, the shockwaves would disrupt his concentration and might even trigger some traps that he didn't disarm.
Zhu Cheng knew that there were some traps left so he didn't unleash his full strength, the twins did the same, they weren't ready to use their lives to trade it for Zhu Chengs, they were only showing the fact that they were strong enough to keep him in check.
The fight didn't last that long as they both reverted to their humanoid forms, Zhu Cheng face was as cold as a 10,000-year-old glacier as he glared at the twins, one of them grasped the sword from where they dropped but didn't dare to unsheath it again.
Zhu Cheng fiery eyes turned to Yun Jhin, but he already disappeared!
Yun Jhin was quickly disarming traps along while walking in the tomb as he made his way towards the direction of the core of the formation while being in stealth.
He frowned as he could feel the coldness entering his body so he had to use his life law jewel along with his yang and 4 elemental jewel to expel the coldness from his body.
He knew that he was getting closer to the core of the formation but what he found strange was that the traps started to lower in number and he could feel no auras around!
This surely meant that the Emperor must have been on this path.
Yun Jhin slowed down but in the end, he still arrived in the main tomb area where the core of the formation stood.
The core of the formation was a sarcophagus that was shaped in the form of a dark dragon, it stood high on a platform that one had to scale to get to the sarcophagus, the platform was almost 10 meters tall and it was made from dark Yang jade of the highest quality.
Yun Jhin could feel the soul fragment of the dark dragon metamorphosing inside the sarcophagus, it was slowly coming alive!
Yun Jhin felt a hand grasping his neck as he looked behind him and saw the Emperor picking him up like he was a sack of potatoes!
The Emperor heaved a hearty chuckle as he patted Yun Jhin on the head and said:
"Youngster, don't you think you are quite far away from the place that you are supposed to explore?"
Yun Jhin knew that he was only playing with him as his eyes turned cold and he said:
"You might have fooled the others but my vision is special even amongst the latest Emperors, I can see that your soul is extremely old even though fragmented, you are a reincarnated one!"
Reaching the peak of the god realm would give someone abilities that others would call unfair or even world-altering, it was a simple thing for the Emperor to see through Yun Jhin's soul.
Yun Jhin wanted to struggle but his whole body was paralyzed, the Emperor looked directly into his eyes as he forcefully tried to remove some of his memories.
Suddenly the sarcophagus started moving as it opened, out of it 16 murked souls came out, they all looked similar to each other as all of their individuality was destroyed by the formation, the Emperor dropped Yun Jhin as he clutched his arm and 4 other souls left the sleeve of his robes.
The Emperor's eyes widened as he clapped his hands and another 2 God Realm experts that sat at the 7th and 8th stage respectively appeared, they all ignored Yun Jhin as they had a grave expression on their face looking at the formation of the 20 murked souls.
The murked souls then returned to the sarcophagus as a deep voice could be heard:
"Return to me, my descendants!"
The closer one was to the bloodline of the primogenitor the higher the bloodline chains would tighten in their bodies and control them, the three god realm experts' eyes became glazed but inside they were ferociously trying to stop their bodies from walking towards the sarcophagus.
The moment one of them reached the dark yang jade his body slowly started to wither and age as his life force was absorbed by it.
The Emperor broke through the spell after a short while, his face was full of cold sweat and he didn't even have time to look for Yun Jhin who now disappeared.
He looked at the sarcophagus and he could feel a gaze that locked deeply on his soul, he felt the same gaze some times before when he entered the tomb but now it was so strong!
Both of his attendants were no longer alive as their souls left their bodies and were dragged to the sarcophagus where they became as dark as the night then absorbed inside, the red eyes of the sarcophagus glowed deeply as the intense control on the Emperor's body increased.
The Emperor did his best to resist as he even used some of his life force to break away, but his bloodline was too closely linked to the dark dragon's!
The moment the Emperor stepped on the dark jade his life force started to leave him and he grew old at a visible rate.
He bellowed as he threw away all of his life force for a chance of his soul to escape and be reincarnated, his soul tried to fly away from the formation but it was quickly engulfed by the formation and absorbed into the sarcophagus, the dark jade that glowed deeply stopped and the sarcophagus eyes did the same, everything became quiet.
Yun Jhin appeared as he started scaling the steps up to the sarcophagus, his stealth technique was covering him as he got close to the sarcophagus and he opened it, the moment he opened it he could hear heavy heartbeats as the appearance of a handsome middle-aged man was starting to appear in the sarcophagus, he had deep dark violet hair along with sword-like brows and his being gave out the aura of an important person of a high standing along with the feeling that he saw through worldly needs.
The dark dragon was currently absorbing the murked souls and it was at it's weakest at this time, Yun Jhin slowly approached him but he could feel someone behind him again.
Zhu Cheng and the twins appeared as they slapped Yun Jhin away from the sarcophagus, they had eyes full of greed as they looked at the soul, they knew it was special the moment they saw the imperial robe left on the steps of dark jade.
They didn't see Yun Jhin or feel him but the moment they got close they felt something in front of them and slapped it away.
It was unknown if the elders perished or were thrown out of the tomb by the traps.
Yun Jhin gritted his teeth as he fell to the bottom of the dark jade platform.
These fools would doom them all!
Zhu Cheng thrust his arm inside the soul only for his whole being to age immediately and die only his clothes remained.
The twin's eyes widened in horror as they wanted to run away but the dark dragon's eyes opened, the gaze alone paralyzed the twins, the man's incomplete body moved a little but he didn't leave the sarcophagus, the twins were absorbed as well... as for the others as they weren't here they might as well have died at the hands of Zhu Cheng and the twins.
Yun Jhin's eyes widened as the man's gaze turned from the downed people to his form at the bottom of the platform.
His body didn't have a high purity of blood and his bloodline also wasn't close to the dark dragons but he could feel his body slowly escaping from his control as he scaled the platform, he stood in front of the dark dragon as his hand went ahead to caress Yun Jhin's cheek.
Yun Jhin knew the moment the hand touched his cheek he would become a bunch of ash that would disappear just like the Emperor and the others!
Yun Jhin's eyes widened in horror as the hand was centimeters away from his cheek when suddenly...

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Little dragon
chapters.content:
The dark dragon's hand was almost upon Yun Jhin's cheek, he could feel the same sensation that he always felt when he was near death, and he didn't like it one bit.
He gritted his teeth as his eyes started to shine, out of his spatial bag a little dragon popped out and went through the dark dragon's incomplete body.
This surprised the dark dragon and his concentration upon Yun Jhin's body faltered, Yun Jhin took a few steps behind making some distance between them as he smiled.
The little dragon looked around with curiosity on his small face when suddenly on his body a bunch of runic formations started to appear, the formations were strange to the point that the dark dragon didn't understand what they meant, his eyes narrowed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"Think you can refine my soul with this failed artificial dragon?"
Yun Jhin gave out a small smile as he did a few hand seals, the dark dragon's eyes widened as he looked at the little dragon where a suction force appeared, Yun Jhin told him slowly:
"I'm not intending to absorb your soul, you already went ahead to the soul composition form and if I absorbed you into my soul palace you would be able to beat my soul out of it and take control of my body, do you think I'm dumb? I have a better proposition for you."
Yun Jhin's aura changed heavily as a rain of blood appeared behind him, the dark dragon's eyes widened as he shouted:
"Yun Jhin of the Blood Throne sect? You finally reincarnated again? And onto my planet?"
Yun Jhin's cultivation technique preceded him, while the duo of dragon brothers was born Yun Jhin was on his death bed, however his reputation was extremely resounding through the whole universe and the brothers were wary of his history of capturing universal wonders so they must have investigated him by a lot.
The dark dragon's soul was slowly getting absorbed by the formation on the little dragon, the dark dragon tried to struggle out of it but he felt weak for some reason, Yun Jhin looked down on him and said:
"Feeling weak aren't we?"
Instead of asking why he was feeling weak the dark dragon tried to control the soul murking formation to attack Yun Jhin but he felt that his connection was quickly slipping away from it from some unknown reason, Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at the robe of the Emperor which was halfway from the top of the platform and did a quick bow to it then pointed at it:
"You should thank your descendant for that, even though you managed to absorb him he used his last vestiges of soul power to cut the connection of your soul with the formation when he tried to escape, I gave him some of my memories when he tried to scan my soul back then along with my former identity, he bet the future of his Empire on me!"
The dark dragon's eyes widened as only his head remained as the rest of his body was getting sucked into the little dragon's body, he suddenly realized what the formation on the little dragon's body was for and he shouted:
"No, no, no, I don't want to be reborn this way, into such a body, such a weak body...!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as the head disappeared, suddenly the little dragon's closed eyes turned crimson as his whole body became a deep black color, his bloodline was getting enchanted multiple times to the point his body almost enlarged and exploded, he gained a gender along with the soul as he became a living being and not a weapon anymore.
The little dragon gave out a small roar as he launched himself at Yun Jhin while cursing:
"You damn mother*****, I didn't want such a trashy body, Yun Jhin from the Blood Throne sect, let's see what you got in this life you piece of ****."
The dragon had quite a mouth on him, Yun Jhin couldn't absorb or fight his soul or else there was a chance for him to hijack his body, but he could easily protect himself from his soul attacks if his soul was bound to a body, which wasn't his, after all, his soul willpower and energy got locked to the body's cultivation base as it became fragmented, he wasn't even as 20% as strong as when he was just a soul!
Yun Jhin watched as the little dragon launched himself at him only for him to easily grab him by the tail and smash him into the dark jade below him, the little dragon spurted a mouthful of blood as he cursed Yun Jhin with the same fervor as before while trying to escape.
However the little dragon's body was modified personally by Yun Jhin so he could easily control it, the dark dragon would need some time of adjusting and working through his internal organs before Yun Jhin's control over his body would disappear.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he grasped the little dragon by the skull and told him:
"Luo Shang you should behave yourself, you got a body and revived isn't this what you wanted?"
Luo Shang immediately spits in his face which Yun Jhin easily dodged and said:
"**** your mother you piece of ****"
Yun Jhin was quite speechless, did the years of being into suspended animation turn this man into an idiot who could only swear?
Yun Jhin shook his head as he imprinted some memories into Luo Shang's new brain, the memories came quite fast to him but after he understood them he looked at Yun Jhin with strange eyes as he said:
"True eternal life? Aren't your goals a bit too lofty? I only wanted to revive because I wanted to continue my life as I reincarnated, I also want to get equal with that ***** Bumi Ming, *ptuui* what a brother."
The little dragon spat on the ground the moment he mentioned his brother, technically speaking they were brothers only on the surface, they weren't blood-related they were only born around the same time.
Luo Shang started a tirade:
"That damn trash, he thought that I was the one poisoned but he was! What justice, what benevolence, we live in a world of cultivators, those things can be eaten by the dogs and no one would miss them, I wish I would have my hands on his firm and soft neck so I could..."
It seemed the years of being alone made the man quite a chatterbox, the little dragon's body was at the 1st stage of the King Realm so Yun Jhin could easily defeat him as he had the same means of a peak God Realm expert like him, both he and Yun Jhin were at the peak when it came to battle power so one level difference meant a lot to experts such as them.
Yun Jhin patted Luo Shang's head and mocked him:
"Did the big baby lose his bottle?"
Luo Shang stomach growled at the same time, he looked quite embarrassed as he scratched his head, Yun Jhin never fed the baby dragon because he didn't need it, however now that it went through so many transformations he needed to absorb some energy to fully change his body.
Yun Jhin gave him a small smile as he took out some herbs from his spatial ring and waved them in front of his face, Luo Shang jumped up to take them only to be thrown back on the dark jade below him headfirst.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he grabbed the golden sword that was the only thing left from the twin's bodies and put it in his spatial ring, the little dragon got up from the ground and glared at Yun Jhin only for Yun Jhin to return the glare and say:
"What can I do with you now, the Empire is Emperorless and you are useless and greedy, they also lost two high leveled God Realm experts, the Bumi Empire might attack any time now."
Yun Jhin was still too weak and he couldn't make any use of the little dragon, he could wait for him to grow but that meant if he grew too much he would be doomed as well, however, considering that he was his senior and he had quite the trouble to break through due to not having enough resources the same could be said about him as well, he was 3 stages above him and this wasn't something that could be overcome overnight.
Luo Shang wanted to curse Yun Jhin again but Yun Jhin's face turned serious as he told him:
"You had enough time to acclimatize to your new body right? Stop acting and tell me if you have anything to say for yourself."
The dark dragon's face scrunched up as he eyed Yun Jhin and told him:
"We can make use of the soul murking formation to defend ourselves if we are attacked by that damn trash descendants, it innately repels anyone that has his bloodline, you don't have to worry, also there are some special things left in the treasury of the Empire, getting them would be a huge problem though, I'm sure I left a puppet there that's around the 9th stage of the God Realm and it wouldn't be able to recognize me anymore as I'm you know..."
Yun Jhin shook his head, even getting in the treasury would be a problem, reaching its depths would be out of the question, the Empress must have realized by now that her husband was dead and she would immediately go to take his power in her hands, the Emperor had no children as he refused to mate with someone who didn't have a pure draconic bloodline as his.
The Empress had many children but they were all puppets in her hands, the Emperor would never appoint them as a crown prince, Yun Jhin didn't know much about the Empress, all he knew was fragmented information that he gathered by listening around the gossip of the capital.
Yun Jhin sighed as Luo Shang jumped on his shoulder and glared at him:
"Since you have such a lofty dream dear senior Yun Jhin, let me help you a little bit with it."
There wasn't much fanfare between trades of those at the God Realm, Luo Shang innately understood why Yun Jhin left him alive so he immediately sent his cultivation technique in Yun Jhin's soul via a soul link.
Yun Jhin eyes narrowed as he looked through the cultivation technique, even though his cultivation techniques were useful they weren't meant for his current draconic body so he could exhibit around 70% of his usual cultivation speed, it was faster than most other cultivators but it was too slow for him.
He needed a high-quality cultivation technique that rivaled his current one that also agreed with his body and Luo Shang sent him what he needed without asking for anything in return!
Luo Shang fidgeted his body as his stomach growled again and asked:
"Could I have that herb now?"
Yun Jhin threw him the herb before he started to go towards the exit, Luo Shang sighed as he looked behind him at the sarcophagus, he knew he couldn't fully control the formation anymore as his cultivation base was too low, he would need to be at the Emperor realm to be able to open and close the formation and he knew that there weren't enough resources left after the continuous pillaging of his descendants, Yun Jhin was there with him too so he knew it was impossible to cultivate alone without any impediments.
So he didn't say anything as Yun Jhin left the tomb while contemplating the cultivation technique he gave him.
He didn't give him a fake or broken one, after all, those at their standing could innately see through such things, Luo Shang wanted to fully cooperate with him.
Yun Jhin looked at Luo Shang from time to time and shook his head because he pulled him into the little dragon's body he wasn't technically pure-blooded enough for him to trigger the system, so he couldn't use him to fuel the needed dragon part of his next evolution.
He sighed as he could feel the darkness disappearing, he was outside the tomb, but all he could see in front of him was one lone old man with a hunched back who was giving out strange smile as he saw Yun Jhin and Luo Shang, he opened his mouth and said:
"Your highness, it seems it's true, your husband died indeed, however, two rats survived isn't it interesting?"
A peal of hearty laughter was heard but no one was visible, the voice then turned deeply cold as it said:
"Let's see what they have to say for themselves eunuch Simbad."
The eunuch squinted his eyes as he suddenly appeared in front of Yun Jhin and grabbed him by the neck while lifting him into the air, his other hand grasped Luo Shang tightly then he bowed to the air:
"Your highness, please appear and lead your judgment on these two sinners who planned the death of our dear Emperor!"
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he saw the figure of a woman appear suddenly, it was the Empress and it looked like both him and Luo Shang were in trouble.
But this was something he expected to happen, after all, they were the only survivors, they needed some scapegoats to pacify their citizens.
The Empress wasn't ugly nor beautiful, she was simple and plain looking but her face was quite malevolent looking and it looked like she was a deep schemer, she gave the eunuch a side glance which meant that he could drop both of them.
Yun Jhin grasped his neck as he took in air and his ki resumed its circulation in his body, the Empress's foot landed on his head as she asked:
"Tell me what you know you peasant..."
Luo Shang wanted to laugh but the Empress's other leg landed upon his head as well as she said:
"I didn't forget you, I know you aren't a simple artificial dragon, I feel some fear by sensing your aura, what are you?"
This time the Empress's eyes turned scary as she watched Luo Shang she became interested into him, she wondered what would happen if she dissected him, being interesting in front of the Empress wasn't a good thing.
Luo Shang wanted to struggle and curse her but one glance from Yun Jhin shut him up, he knew he had to let Yun Jhin do the talking, as he was born at the God Realm he didn't have much social etiquette and didn't know what to say, he always said what came to his mind and he was vulgar and like a barbarian at the same time.
Yun Jhin opened his mouth and said with a deferential tone that showed that he was trying to kiss her ass:
"This dear majesty you see we didn't do anything bad, might you let these lowly ones tell their side of the story before we are annihilated below your mighty feet?"
The Empress gave out a hearty chuckled as she took her foot from Yun Jhin's head and said:
"I like this one, actually I want him to be my new toy."
Yun Jhin started sweating while Luo Shang gloated inside, then the next words made him pale:
"As for this other one, send him to the underground torture room and do whatever is necessary to take all of the information out of him, then throw his carcass to the mutated Icy Toxic Scorpions to feast on."
It seemed that both of them wouldn't have a good end if Yun Jhin didn't come up with a good story that the Empress would like.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Trickery
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin didn't dare to look up at the Empress so he sat there kneeling and waiting for the Empress to permit him to talk, the Empress looked at him and the little dragon for a few seconds before she said:
"Come on tell me, what happened to my husband?"
It seemed she wasn't that interested, on the surface but the words that Yun Jhin would say would determine his future.
The little dragon Luo Shang didn't say anything as he thought that he might break things further if he opened his mouth, even though he didn't have much social EQ that didn't mean he didn't know when to talk or not.
Yun Jhin started to tell her about the events in the tomb while leaving out a few important subjects that would make him an even bigger target, the Empress's eyes narrowed as she said:
"My husband died due to the formation of the tomb? That's what you tell me?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head repeatedly while making himself look as small as possible in her eyes, the Empress didn't feel he was lying, unfortunately for her she wasn't a peak God Realm expert so she couldn't go through their memories, only her husband was the sole peak God expert and now he was dead.
The Empress caressed Yun Jhin's cheek as she made him look deep into her eyes, Yun Jhin face turned slack as he gazed into her eyes and she gave out a big smile as she asked:
"Have you said the truth?"
Yun Jhin nodded his head while keeping the slack expression on his face, the little dragon was inwardly giving a big thumbs up at his acting ability, the Empress took her eyes off Yun Jhin only to gaze directly at the little dragon, the little dragon's heart almost jumped out of his chest as the Empress appeared in front of him and grasped his skull while she said:
"Now let's see what you are, why do I have a feeling your bloodline suppresses mine? This shouldn't be possible at all..."
The little dragon coughed wanting to get Yun Jhin's help, Yun Jhin seemingly broke through the Empress's spell and meekly told her:
"He is my companion that followed me since I was in the lower continents, please spare him, only with his help I have achieved what I have today."
The Empress's eyes narrowed, could this youth have such a stroke of great luck, the eunuch that now stood behind her didn't say anything as he eyed both the little dragon and Yun Jhin then he told his empress:
"Your majesty, we should pardon them, after all, with the lowly cultivation bases they have they wouldn't have been able to save his majesty anyways, they are lucky they are alive, they must have likely scuttled around when the fight began and hid thus saving themselves, they might be cowards but least they survived and got the news back to us, you know that we must protect the news from leaking out our the Bumi Empire might attack without notice if they get wind of happened here."
The Empress grip on Luo Shang's skull softened as she dropped him to the ground, Luo Shang was cursing her inwardly so hard that even the most perverted fellows would want to take notes from his colorful vocabulary.
The Empress moved a little bit backward as she said:
"Even though they have got us the news, their cowardice should be punished, don't you say Simbad?"
Simbad looked at the imploring faces of the duo and said coldly:
"Your majesty, you should administer the punishment, however, I recommend you to keep them alive, after all, they must have gotten somethings that they assimilated from the tomb, they are also young geniuses of the Empire and the Emperor would have surely left them alive as well if something similar happened."
The Empress gritted her teeth when the Emperor was mentioned but then her face straightened as she said:
"Ok then, you two will have to infiltrate the Bumi Empire and make sure to send back news whenever you would see something suspicious happening, now go immediately!"
The Empress disappeared along with the Eunuch, but before she did, she left two tracing formations on their bodies to make sure they wouldn't run away or try to trick her any other way, fortunately, the tracking formations couldn't read their thoughts or hear their words.
After going back to the Zhu Family and sending the news to the head of the house who was almost livid in anger they went back for a little rest in Yun Jhin's room.
The head of the house lost his strongest elders today and his anger was through the roof, fortunately, the other houses also lost some of their strong elders and it counterbalanced what happened, he didn't know about the Emperor's death but he was informed of the fact that Yun Jhin had to go to the Bumi Empire undercover and he just let it be since it was an order from the imperial family.
Yun Jhin checked his equipment before making sure that everything was alright and leaving, the little dragon was lazily sitting on his bed but if you would observe closely you could see that he was cultivating even while staying around.
Yun Jhin could do the same now because of the cultivation technique from Luo Shang, it was a special passive cultivation state that one could induce oneself in, only those of the four sacred beasts had such a cultivation technique and today's descendants didn't have it as it was lost in time.
The little dragon jumped on Yun Jhin's shoulder after Yun Jhin finished checking everything and he said:
"That piece of trash Empress will be the first one I will assimilate after I break through the God Realm."
Yun Jhin shook his head if they didn't get any fortuitous encounters any soon, breaking through the god realm will be a huge endeavor, after all, they weren't even in the late stages of the King Realm!
Yun Jhin and the little dragon left the capital of the Luo Empire behind as they started their journey towards the Bumi Empire even though they didn't want to, the Empress would realize they disobeyed once they removed the formations on their bodies and they didn't want to be wanted fugitives of the Luo Empire.
The Bumi Empire sat inside the biggest jungle on the Azure Dragon planet, it was quite far away from the Luo Empire but stood on the same piece of land, only the Sumo Empire was a huge distance away as you would need to use a teleportation formation to move between the Luo and Sumo Empires.
The Bumi Empire wasn't hard to get to as it was an open Empire just like the Luo one, as long as you were strong enough you would be welcomed to join both Empires.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang took around 2 months of traveling at their quickest speeds to reach the Bumi Empire in the jungle, around them stood tall trees that were around the height of 90 to 100 meters.
The Bumi Empire was hidden deep in the jungle, Yun Jhin had to kill quite a few beasts along to get to the Bumi Empire but fortunately, they weren't attacked by any cultivator along the way, that was until they reached the borders of the empire and met with a scout team which coincidently found them, the scout team wasn't that strong but they let out a flare with their techniques which alerted the nearby city.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang then had to hide after they killed the scouting team and make sure they avoided any type of open areas, fortunately, they didn't know how they looked nor how their auras were so they could change their appearance to look like natives of the Bumi Empire and make their way to the capital.
It took them around one more month before they reached the capital disguised as youths who wanted to open a business in the capital with their meager savings, Luo Shang changed himself into a dark-haired youth with a big smile on his plain face, he wore clothes similar to Yun Jhin's but instead of the five elements look which Yun Jhin had he only wore dark ones.
