They easily slipped into the capital with their identifies and opened up an antique identifying shop, this type of shop would be able to work with both information and they could also make some money on the side, there was also the chance they could truly find some good antiques that they could scam out of their customers.
Yun Jhin was smoking a tobacco pipe as he waited at the door of his new shop, Luo Shang was inside cleaning the floor and the receiving desk.
While Yun Jhin waited a dirty looking youth quickly made it's way to Yun Jhin and asked:
"This brother, is this a antiques identifying shop? Might I be able to inquire if my badge has anything of value so I could sell it?"
The youth took a badge out of his dirty clothes with shaking hands, Yun Jhin took a quick closer look at it and shook his head as h said:
"No value, get out of my face!"
The youth left with his head down and his stomach grumbling, he was both hungry and disappointed as he disappeared in an alleyway of the capital.
The capital of the Bumi Empire was as boisterous as the Luo Empire's capital, however, Yun Jhin opened his shop on the outer edges of the capital to not attract bad attention.
Yun Jhin continued to smoke his pipe as he waited for another customer, the sign on the front of the shop also said that it dealt with information and gossip, they wanted to use the poor people of the outer edges of the capital to get information in exchange of food and spirit stones, which Yun Jhin wasn't lacking.
Yun Jhin watched people move along in front of his shop as he waited for another customer...
The same youth from before came quickly as he said:
"I have some information for you."
Yun Jhin's eyes shined as he looked at the dirty youth and said:
"What type?"
The youth scratched the back of his head as he said:
"Important."
Yun Jhin nodded and invited him to the inside of his establishment and closed the doors behind him.
Hopefully, the youth wasn't trying to scam Yun Jhin or he wouldn't leave the building alive.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Information
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin invited the youth in, the inside of the shop was quite clean and neat compared to the worn-out outside, this was the handy work of Luo Shang who was still cleaning around using his ki.
The youth eyes widened as he saw Luo Shang's application of ki to cleaning, and knew that the duo was way stronger than him.
Yun Jhin motioned for the youth to stay on an empty seat as he asked:
"What information do you have?"
The youth knew that the man in front of him wasn't that kind as he was looking on the surface, surviving on the outer edges of the capital toughened him and made him able to scan the feelings of those around him.
Yun Jhin could naturally make him unable to know what he felt but decided to let his feelings in the open to intimidate him.
The youth opened his dry lips and said:
"You see I heard about this while I was out umm 'patrolling' the middle regions of the city."
"There is a chance the Bumi Empire might go to war soon!"
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed inside, this was quite blunt and fast, were there traitors in the Luo Empire?
Well, it wasn't very surprising, even if 99% of them were loyal to the Emperor, now that he was dead the traitors could instigate the others to overthrow the Empress.
But how did they realize the Emperor was dead? That was a question that he couldn't answer as he didn't know much about the inner workings of the capital, but he guessed that a Eunuch or someone from the inside of the palace sold them out, however, there was a chance the Bumi Empire was just testing out the waters.
Yun Jhin tried to probe the youth more:
"War? There hasn't been a war for tens of thousands of years from what I know, how come there will be war now?"
The youth eyes started sparkling as he thought he may fill his belly with this type of information and continued to spout what he heard:
"Well mister, I heard it from a guy who wore a military uniform so there is a high chance the information is true!"
Yun Jhin frowned, then he grasped the youth in front of him with his left arm lifting him into the air, his eyes peered into the youth's and they turned slack as his memories were forcefully taken out of his mind.
Yun Jhin frowned as the youth's body dropped to the ground then transformed into ashes, Luo Shang frowned as he blew the ashes away and said:
"You could have done this in the back where I haven't had time to clean yet, now I have to clean here again."
Yun Jhin ignored his words and said:
"There is a high chance the Bumi Empire is testing the waters against the Luo Empire, they might know about the history behind your tomb."
Luo Shang frowned as he said:
"The only one who knows about the tomb would be that old fool, Bumi Ming, himself, there is a chance he left some information to his descendants..."
Luo Shang had an angered expression on his face when he mentioned Bumi Ming, it seemed he wasn't that happy about the past with his brother.
Yun Jhin knew that this information was vital and directly sent it back to the Empress via a communication stone.
The Empress stood on the throne of the Emperor as she lazed around with closed eyes, she looked like a kitten who was relaxing after it ate to its satisfaction.
The Empress opened her eyes and looked in front of her as she watched a Eunuch appear in front of her, he was short with a small beard on his face, he was almost bald with only random spots of hair on his head and he had liver spots on his face. He wore the normal Eunuch robes and he bowed deeply to the Empress as he said:
"News from the spies sent to the Bumi Empire."
The Empress waved her hand as the stone which appeared in the Eunuch's hands directly appeared in her hand and the words came out of the stone:
"Extremely high chance of the Bumi Empire testing the waters of our Empire very soon, they might try to instigate a war where the Emperor will have to come out, there is a chance they know of the properties of the tomb."
The message wasn't that long, it had the needed information, the Empress frowned as she tightened her grip on the communication stone but she didn't break it as she spoke into it for a short while before she threw it at the Eunuch who disappeared quickly from the room.
The Empress looked at the painting of the former Emperor which was hanged on the wall behind her and sighed:
"Husband, you have left this little wife with a lot of problems after your passing."
She snapped her fingers and the painting turned into dust and disappeared leaving an empty spot on the wall.
She walked through the wall as if nothing was there and disappeared leaving the throne room empty.
Yun Jhin ears perked up as he looked at the communication stone in his hands which started to glow a deep red, meaning there was a message being sent back:
"Sabotage the troops below the Emperor realm and come back to the Luo Empire, your punishment could be said to be done, after all, you have done such a great service to our Empire while pushing yourselves and putting your lives on the line behind enemy lines."
The message ended. Yun Jhin faces turned scary as he heard the first part of the message while Luo Shang who was behind him also looked pretty grim, sabotaging a camp full of King Realm experts would be very easy but if they did this in the capital they would be easily spotted and killed by the countless experts, Yun Jhin could even feel that there were peak sage realm experts in the outer ranges of the capital and this wasn't good!
They must be from the 10th ranked house in the capital, the house which Zula was from, it seemed they didn't get annihilated, it must have been because of the temporary help of the Sumo Emperor but their wealth should have been surely plundered.
Remembering the incident with Zula gave Yun Jhin some ideas, they could join the King Realm fighting force as impostors and then kill them from the inside when they were moving towards the location where they wanted to start the war.
Yun Jhin transmitted the plan to Luo Shang and Luo Shang just went along with it, there wasn't much he could do as Yun Jhin was keeping him on empty without any herbs or pills that could increase his cultivation, his strength was currently around the 4th stage of the King Realm because he couldn't break through to the 2nd stage of the King Realm due to the lack of resources.
Yun Jhin made some headway in the 4th stage nearing the 8th stage of refinement with hard work and the last remaining ingredients in his spatial ring, right now he only had spirit stones remaining in his spatial equipment which weren't that useful to cultivation, they also weren't many enough for him to buy other resources.
Yun Jhin disappeared along with Luo Shang as the building behind them restored itself to the looks it had before they arrived.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang then went to the middle of the capital and looked around trying to find two targets that were part of the King Realm war camp so they could kill them and take over their identities.
It didn't take much time to find two fellows who were just coming out of a restaurant, they were both quite drunk after they indulged themselves in a lot of spiritual wine.
The duo walked slowly as they took a corner and entered an alleyway, both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang were already waiting in the alleyway under Yun Jhin's stealth technique.
The duo started to talk:
"Man, I really can't believe we were conscripted, I was ready to have some fun with my fiancee when the recruiter entered my house and stepped on my balls!"
The other man looked at the other one as if he was an idiot and didn't try to talk with him, suddenly they both grasped their necks as they saw both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang appearing in front of them, and this was the last sight they saw.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang absorbed their ki signatures and mimicked their life force then their bodies morphed into theirs slowly.
Yun Jhin was now a bald young man with thick eyebrows who wore the normal militaristic uniform of the Bumi Empire, which consisted of a brown leather armor that shined a little bit under the sun.
Luo Shang was now a long-haired middle-aged man who had his hair done in a ponytail, he had streaks of white hair around his temples and he had a sage-like air around him, he wore the same outfit as Yun Jhin, both of them absorbed their memories and knew that their names were respectively, Shung Saishen and Ling Mammon.
Yun Jhin cracked his neck when he heard Luo Shang complaining behind him:
"Why did you give me the role of the guy who got his balls stepped on? I don't like it!"
Yun Jhin ignored him like usual and decided to follow Shung Saishen memories to walk directly to the camp of the King Realm experts and meld with the others, Luo Shang naturally followed behind him while sometimes complaining or cursing, just like Ling Mammon would.
Both of them were very good actors.
It didn't take much time to get to the war camp and there they met with the recruiter which was a female Emperor Realm expert, the recruiter gave out a warm smile at both of them as he patted their back forcefully which made them almost face plant on the ground.
The recruiter then said:
"You two lazy bugs are quite late, it won't be much time before we leave the capital and you still didn't even meet your companions, you need to forge a good bond with them before heading out to war so you could use the formation the army gives you more proficiently!"
Both Luo Shang and Yun Jhin got up from the grounds and saluted, the recruiter then pointed to the many barracks around as he shouted:
"Everyone, let's practice the formation again as there are two newbies who took too much time to come!"
There were a lot of groans coming from the barracks but they didn't complain as a lot of people came out of them, there were around 50,000 to 75,000 at first glance.
Yun Jhin sweated as he watched everyone glare at him and Luo Shang but he gave out a weak smile as he waved his hand:
"Let's all do our best for the future of the Bumi Empire."
Then he pumped his fist in the air enthusiastically, even though he looked like a hooligan those who knew him, knew that this was his usual personality, vibrant and ready to give his all for the Bumi Empire.
The others got influenced by his personality so they started to pump their fists in the air and shouted:
"For the Bumi Empire!!!"
Yun Jhin smiled inwardly, he was already making his infiltration successful, Luo Shang gave out a small bow to the recruiter and said in a whisper:
"Might you be able to step on my balls again later?"
The recruiter blushed brightly for a few seconds before she punched Luo Shang into the ground again and left in a hurry.
Luo Shang got himself out of the hole on the ground while bleeding from the head and his eyes, he cursed inwardly as he had to play the role of a pervert, he couldn't help it, he had to follow the memories that he devoured as some people knew him in the crowd of practitioners.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang then went ahead to practice the formation with the others, Yun Jhin and Luo Shang both had great smiles on their faces, the crowd thought their smiles came from different reasons, one Yun Jhin being able to serve his Empire and two Luo Shang getting beaten by the cute recruiter.
However, both of them smiled because they found openings in the formation that they could exploit to kill all of them during the time they would be traveling.
The recruiter came back and now she looked fairly normal as she said while jabbing a finger in her chest proudly:
"There are some new from the higher-ups, it was intended for all of you to go by yourselves to the war zone but I will have to follow you, for now, I'm don't have the details but you guys will enjoy the protection of a 2nd stage Emperor Realm expert!"
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang frowned inwardly, this would complicate things quite a bit...

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Brother
chapters.content:
Both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang complied with the instructions of the female recruiter which was named Yui Yanchen.
It didn't take them much time to fully exploit the formation and learn all of its blind spots, after all, there wasn't such a thing as a perfect formation.
And both of them were old monsters who had seen countless formations in their lives, even though they weren't people that dabbled into formations, Yun Jhin had a lot of experience under his belt due to the number of reincarnations he went through and Luo Shang just had the critical eye of a former peak God Realm expert that let him see through all the weakness of a formation below the godly level.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang were given the same room as they were the last ones to arrive at the camp, Yun Jhin silently transmitted his thoughts to Luo Shang so even if someone tried to intercept their telepathy session they wouldn't be able to hear anything:
"Luo Shang, there is one way we can kill that woman, but it will be hard considering she should be able to fly and create ki weapons, I have a formation here that we can use in tandem with theirs to absorb all of the ki in the surroundings to boost our battle power to the point we can kill her together, afterward killing the others should be a piece of cake."
Luo Shang eyes widened as he felt the information coming to his brain, he then gave out a small smile as he transmitted back:
"Aren't you devious? I see why everyone in the mortal realm hated you back then to the point that they wanted to search for you even on your deathbed, ah such beautiful stories my brother used to tell me..."
At the mention of his brother his muscles tightened as veins appeared over his face, his eyes turned a deep scarlet but this transformation reverted rather quickly, he looked around and took a deep breath as he said:
"Sorry for the outburst, but being near his descendants combined with this horrid smell, I can feel his bloodline everywhere and I cannot control myself while we are alone."
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he meditated ignoring him, as long as he controlled himself while he was with others he didn't care what he did or said, he was his superior in battle power and he couldn't do anything about it.
Yun Jhin left his guard open but Luo Shang knew that if he tried to even more a little bit forward to loop his head off from his shoulders he would find himself in an extremely precarious position.
He couldn't help it, he was his underling right now and he was a former peak God Realm expert, he hated himself for falling into his trap even though he was the former peak overlord of the dark faction, the lord of the Blood Throne!
By the time he was born Yun Jhin was dying so he didn't see his cruelty and power with his eyes, he heard countless stories about him but he thought that they were inflated to make him look scarier.
Yun Jhin's left eye opened as he looked at Luo Shang who was contemplating and told him in a bone-chilling tone that left shivers down his spine:
"Don't mistake my kindness for weakness Luo Shang, I only let you live because you are useful, you already gave me your cultivation technique, you might have more information that could be useful for me but I could end you right now, do you understand?"
Cold sweat dripped from Luo Shang's forehead, his life flashed past his eyes as he looked directly on Yun Jhin's opened eye, he could feel an innate fear from his soul, this was the fear one had from a stronger creature!
This didn't have anything to do with bloodline or physical power, Yun Jhin's experience from his thousands of lifetime condensed into an aura that could paralyze those that were below his cultivation base for a few brief seconds, experience combined with cultivation created a monster that could intimidate others just by looking at them!
Luo Shang didn't go through the usual problems of those that were born normally, he was a prized son of the heavens as he was born at the God Realm and easily advanced through levels while he grew, he was one of those people that Yun Jhin envied the most in some of his previous lives, he still hated these type of beings, he slaughtered them every time he could see them, he drank their blood and ate their flesh as if it was the best delicacy, he spat onto their dead faces as they were favored by the universe which hated him!
Yun Jhin closed his left eye and went back to meditation, he needed to prepare himself for the fight that would come and he needed to be at full power to deal with someone so far ahead of him in cultivation.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang left their barracks as soon as they heard the voice of the recruiter, they were then trained for a few more days before they were going to the war zone.
Along the way, they went through plains and a few cities, finally, they reached a forest where Yun Jhin felt that they could use the formation to it's fullest potential.
He stopped for a few seconds and the recruiter asked him what was the problem Yun Jhin motioned with his hand for her to get closer and she did, suddenly runic formations appeared around Yun Jhin and Luo Shang, those runic formations combined with the whole formation of the King Realm experts and took ahold of its power as the ki that was in the surroundings started to fill both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang.
Luo Shang breathing went rough as he broke through the 2nd stage and almost to the 3rd stage of the King Realm, Yun Jhin ignored him, the breakthroughs would affect his foundation as they were done with inferior ki, however, he still kept an eye out if he tried to do something fishy.
Yui Yanchen knew something was up with these two the moment they stopped, the other King Realm experts tried to see what was happening but their knees went numb with weakness as they could feel that their ki was sapped, their physical forms were crumbling as they fell to their knees and couldn't move.
Yui Yanchen's eyes widened in surprise as she looked around and suddenly both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang disappeared!
She watched as her whole unit of King Realm experts disappeared in her face, their bodies just ceased to exist like they were gobbled up by a gigantic beast, Yun Jhin body almost expanded as he ate so many King Realm experts along with their souls, he could feel his soul mending itself at quick speeds as it reached 10% of his former capabilities then stopped there as his cultivation was hindering it from growing further.
He would need time to digest all of the bodies but if he did well he would be able to break through the 5th stage of the King Realm and refine his next jewel for quite a bit, this wasn't taking into account that he would eat the Emperor Realm expert as well!
Yui Yanchen immediately created a ki sword and went ahead to slice and kill both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang, however, their speed was tremendous even making her flinch, but she could follow them with her eyes and if her eyes faltered she had other senses!
Her ki sword started to rotate at a high speed as she threw one and created another trying to pin them under it and then deal them the finishing blow.
Yun Jhin could dodge the swords but Luo Shang didn't have as much experience and he was still digesting the changes done to his new body.
Sword slashed on his body and blood fell to the ground slowing him, Yun Jhin watched along and Luo Shang cursed at him:
"Protect me you piece of shit!"
Yun Jhin gave him a small smile and decided to give him a helping hand in this situation, he still had his uses.
Yun Jhin disappeared and appeared above the woman's head only to have his crotch grazed by the ki sword, he almost lost his little brother there!
Yun Jhin's body unconsciously started to emit cold sweat as he watched her actions with narrowed eyes, he needed to predict where she would launch her swords and then lop off her head and eat her soul!
Yun Jhin fell quickly to the ground as lightning fell from his hands towards the woman, however, the woman absorbed the lightning with her ki sword which turned it into a deep purple, the sword absorbed Yun Jhin's lightning and increased it's speed as it narrowly grazed his cheek drawing out blood.
Yun Jhin put a finger on his cheek and the wound disappeared afterward, then his went limp as his eyes glazed over.
The sword from Yui Yanchen was centimeters away from decapitating him but he suddenly cocked his head to the side making it miss by a centimeter.
Yui Yanchen's eyes widened in horror as she looked down at her stomach, she could feel Yun Jhin's hand going through it and clenching her innards, she wanted to scream, she wanted to do anything but if Yun Jhin moved even a millimeter her innards would explode and kill her instantly!
She knew she failed but she wanted to live, she wanted to!
All living beings had the innate instinct of living, no one wanted to die a premature death, especially cultivators who pursued the oh so elusive eternal life.
She wanted to say anything to stop Yun Jhin's actions, but before Yun Jhin could kill her Luo Shang appeared behind her and decapitated her using his hand as a sword!
Yun Jhin lifeless gaze turned over her body and it slowly disappeared, just like all of the other bodies of the King Realm experts he was absorbing her using the first innate skill of his crown's jewel, her soul shuddered and tried to escape away from him but it was fruitless, Yun Jhin's soul was gigantic even though wounded and not fully whole it was a soul of a titan!
Such a soul grabbed the small soul of Yui Yanchen and slowly took it to his transparent mouth, then a crunch could be heard as her head was eaten, then along with the rest of the body, Yui Yanchen died and lost all hopes of reincarnation.
Yun Jhin's soul body glowed and the glow remained on it, he could use the energy from her soul to mend his incomplete soul more but for that he would have to first increase his cultivation base, in the King Realm he could at most gain 15% of his former soul powers.
Yun Jhin eyes turned back to Luo Shang and there was the same feeling of oppression he felt from before, suddenly his hand went directly to his cheek as he was slapped, he flew for a few meters hitting trees along the way and Yun Jhin said:
"Who told you, you could give her the finishing blow?"
Luo Shang vomited a mouthful of blood and teeth as he got up from the ground and jumped back to Yun Jhin's location, his eyes were full of hatred and puzzlement, why would Yun Jhin care about who gave out the final blow?
Yun Jhin saw that his eyes were questioning his actions so he decided to be nice for once and explained to him:
"You mustn't have killed many people when you had your former body right?"
Luo Shang nodded his head
Yun Jhin gave him a pitying look as if he was looking at a wounded animal, Luo Shang didn't like that gaze at all, his eyes turned red as his muscles inflated, his form turned back to his normal one as he shouted:
"THAT GAZE, THAT GAZE!!! WHY ARE YOU LOOKING AT ME LIKE MY BROTHER!"
Yun Jhin gave a swift kick to his head which made him faceplant into the ground, a gigantic crater 20 meters in diameter appeared as Luo Shang almost went unconscious, Yun Jhin grabbed him by the hair and made him look right into his eyes as he said:
"Dealing the finishing blow on a cultivator steals their destiny, do you understand me? As a fellow former peak God Realm expert you should understand what I mean..."
Destiny, the thing that one needed the most when one cultivated, luck was only secondary or even tertiary, the most important thing would be destiny, even with a weak body it could be improved to a certain extent if you had destiny on your side, Yun Jhin was cultivating a technique that could steal the destiny of those he killed and absorbed, but for him to fully absorb someone's destiny he would have to be the one who dealt the final blow.
The fortuned constitutions weren't anything but an immense accumulation of destiny on the person, it was a blessing of the universe, the same could be said about the fortuned cultivation beats, regardless if it was man or beast, being blessed with a fortuned constitution meant the universe dotted on you as it's darling!
Technically speaking it was impossible to gain the fortuned constitution by killing those that had it, it was also impossible for one to kill billions or trillions of people and absorb their destiny to gain it, Yun Jhin tried, but he was stopped by the righteous forces, he couldn't go on a mass killing spree as mortals and the lower cultivators were the cornerstones of future cultivators.
However that didn't stop him from creating this technique and going on a killing spree, even though in the end he was repelled and wounded in the process he gained quite a lot of destiny, that's why everything went alright for him regardless of what he did, combined with his intellect and sharp wits nothing could go wrong for him. His immense destiny that he robbed in his countless reincarnations was currently brewing in his soul keeping him safe from harm, however, if he went directly in the harm's way he could still die, destiny just made sure he would be able to implement his plans.
Yun Jhin sighed as Luo Shang calmed himself, the man was very temperamental and the hatred for his brother ran deep, after all, it was the man which sealed him.
Yun Jhin left him to drop to the ground as he looked around, he felt that something wasn't right, the ground below them started to crack as it fell, Yun Jhin tried to grab Luo Shang and leave but he felt a suction force coming down from the ground.
Luo Shang was almost unconscious from the kick to the head but his eyes widened in anger and hatred as he looked down at the cracked ground that was trying to absorb them:
"YOU PIECE OF SHIT? WHAT DID YOU LEAVE HERE?"
It seemed unknowingly both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang had wandered to the place of the tomb where the Yin dragon of light rested, Bumi Ming!

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Perilous situation
chapters.content:
Falling into the ground was something that Yun Jhin had experienced quite a lot of time previously but this time it was a situation that made even him furrow his brows in worry.
Yun Jhin could feel himself being absorbed by the ground as if it was quicksand and he could also feel that his connection to the surrounding ki was swiftly being cut off by a formation!
Luo Shang was saying some muffled curses as they both fell to the underground and became paralyzed.
Yun Jhin could feel his lungs contracting as his oxygen supply was cut off by something, he wasn't sure what maybe it was the formation as well?
Fortunately, his body was refined to a high degree so he didn't need much oxygen, Luo Shang's body was also created from a puppet dragon that didn't need oxygen as well, even though the puppet gained some organs after Luo Shang inhibited it, he could discard them if he wished to and continue living.
Yun Jhin gritted his teeth as he could feel the surrounding gravity pushing down on him, he didn't know where they were supposed to be but Luo Shang shouted something about his brother leaving something behind.
Yun Jhin crawled slowly towards him and slapped his chest, Luo Shang glared at Yun Jhin and sent him an explanation via his soul willpower:
"I'm not sure where we are but I can feel the surroundings being infested by that fool's aura, all I can tell you is that we are in his territory!"
Luo Shang wasn't sure if his brother took the same actions as he did to keep a piece of his soul to resurrect but it was most unlikely considering the changes he went through after he was poisoned by that human expert.
Yun Jhin's body finally acclimated to the surrounding environment and slowly got up from the ground, he and Luo Shang were now both running on their inner ki and they couldn't recover it from their surroundings anymore.
However, Yun Jhin had a huge surplus of energy after he ate those 50 to 70 thousand King Realm experts along with the Emperor realm woman and he could use it to recover, however, he didn't know what kind of dangers were inside this underground place so he decided to break through first.
He did a few hand seals and Luo Shang became limp as a noodle as he fell to the ground paralyzed, he just acclimated himself to the environment as well and he got up from the ground only to fall again due to Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin sat cross-legged on the ground as he put his attention on his soul's crown.
Muffled screams could be heard from Luo Shang as he cursed all Yun Jhin's ancestors.
Yun Jhin started to use the surplus of energy inside of him to create his next jewel, the law of death that was memorized in his soul left it and transformed into the character for death, it was brown and it flowed smoothly through Yun Jhin's inner soul space.
Yun Jhin took the death character and started hammering it with his soul willpower to the point that it liquified then he used his inner soul flame to harden it, after that he slowly but surely transformed it into a shining jewel after the jewel was finished he inscribed the character for death on it.
The jewel was bedazzling to the eye but it was so cold that you would think it came from an iceberg, if anyone else besides Yun Jhin would hold it, they would surely become ice statues.
Yun Jhin's soul willpower easily picked the death jewel and slowly pushed it into the 5th empty slot on his soul crown.
A dark light engulfed his soul crown as the jewel easily inserted itself in the slot after Yun Jhin pushed it near.
Yun Jhin's physical eyes suddenly opened as they glowed with a dark light, his whole body was going through transformations along with his ki, his ki was gaining a cold dark attribute that would freeze both the souls and bodies of his enemies.
His body was also hardening akin to undead but his life force remained the same, he wasn't transforming into an undead nor into a living undead but he was gaining the qualities of one, at least his outer body did.
Yun Jhin decided against refining his new jewel as he needed the remaining surplus of energy to continue running through his body and replace any ki he lost.
Yun Jhin got up from the ground and looked at Luo Shang who was also finishing cultivating, even though he was angry that Yun Jhin tied him up like this he also understood that Yun Jhin didn't trust him at all, so he decided to finish his breakthroughs so they wouldn't give him any hidden sequelae.
Yun Jhin did a few more hand seals and Luo Shang could finally move again. Luo Shang didn't comment again as he followed Yun Jhin, their surroundings were cold, damp, and dark, Yun Jhin tried to illuminate them but the formation that surrounded them immediately stopped the outside ki, Yun Jhin realized that he could only use his ki to strengthen his body in a fight and wouldn't be able to shoot it outside of his body, however it was enough for him.
Luo Shang cursed his brother viciously under his breath as he looked around, he wasn't familiar with his brother's formations anymore as they all changed their forms after he was poisoned.
Yun Jhin also didn't understand the intricacy of the formation, even though he was a connoisseur of the art that didn't mean he knew every formation in existence, after all, the righteous sects out there wouldn't let him get his hands on their formations and from what it seemed Bumi Ming's formation was an orthodox sect formation that Yun Jhin wasn't familiar with at all!
Yun Jhin sighed as he walked in the front and Luo Shang in the back, after a certain while of walking they finally reached a wall that they couldn't move, they were blocked and Yun Jhin could feel that his surroundings were getting smaller and smaller!
They walked into a trap!
Yun Jhin's eye started glowing as he infused them with his ki and he looked around to see if there was any weak spot in the formation so they could escape from their predicament.
Luo Shang didn't know much about formations so he would only attack the spot Yun Jhin would attack to help him.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked around and then shook his head while saying:
"I can't believe I say this but this is a flawless formation, I'm not sure if we can escape from here."
Luo Shang gritted his teeth, he just revived and he was going to die again? This wasn't what he wanted!
At least he would be able to reincarnate now.
Luo Shang sighed as he accepted his fate but Yun Jhin couldn't, if he died now he would die forever!
Yun Jhin looked at Luo Shang and an idea came to mind, maybe the formation would react to Luo Shang's blood?
Yun Jhin easily got in front of him as he slashed his arm open making blood to drop freely from it, Luo Shang glared at Yun Jhin but then his eyes widened in surprise as he could feel that their surroundings weren't closing in anymore, actually he could see light coming from the ceiling!
Yun Jhin looked around and saw that they were in a similar place to the tomb of Luo Shang, however, there were no inscriptions to the walls nor any treasures around, it was eerily empty.
Suddenly they were teleported away from the corridor that they were in into an open room, there wasn't anything in the room beside a light wisp that sat on a small throne, the wisp stood there as an aged voice could be heard coming from it:
"Brother, it seems your plan has gone well..."
Luo Shang's eyes widened both in anger and surprise as he shouted:
"YOU, YOU, HOW DID YOU SURVIVE!"
The voice could be heard chuckling as it said sadly:
"I only survived to this day so I could stop you from reviving, after all, you are pure evil!"
Then the voice changed, it didn't have hatred in it, nor any other emotion besides being cold, hard, and judging.
Yun Jhin could understand something from their conversation and chuckle inside, it seemed that Luo Shang was right, the poison didn't affect him much but it affected Bumi Ming a lot, such type of judging attitude couldn't be born in a dragon, dragon's were pure and emotional creatures, there was no way a dragon could lose his emotions by normal means, even in their death beds they would sigh with emotions and think about their past.
Luo Shang shouted to him:
"YOU DON'T SEE THAT YOU WERE THE ONE MOST AFFECTED BY THE POISON, WAKE UP BROTHER!"
Yun Jhin clobbered him on the head making him shut up, the light wisp moved a bit as the aged voice stated, still emotionless:
"And who is this, Luo Shang?"
Luo Shang hated Yun Jhin but he hated Bumi Ming even more so he kept his mouth shut and didn't say anything.
Yun Jhin looked at the light wisp and a small smile appeared on his face as he said:
"My name is Yun Jhin, your highness might have heard of my exploits, even though I would have been dead by the time you heard of me."
The light wisp started to turn a blue color as it said:
"You are... you are even worse than the devils and demons! So many lives lost, so much hatred, Yun Jhin!"
Yun Jhin's reputation preceded him again, in this situation it put him tightly on the spot, he could feel his surroundings tightening again as his body was crushed under the invisible pressure, the voice stated in an emotionless voice:
"Your crimes are way worse than my little brother's, I shall execute you first!"
Yun Jhin's eyes widened in fear as he took two steps backward but his back hit an invisible barrier to separated him from Luo Shang, Luo Shang tried to break the barrier but his fist remained bloodied as he hit it a few times.
Yun Jhin clutched his throat as he could feel someone grabbing it, an image of an old man appeared, he was like a twig, his complexion was dry as the dessert and his beard hit the ground, he wore nothing but white robes that had the character for judgment on them inscribed countless times over, seemingly as if someone possessed him to write these characters on the robes.
Yun Jhin clawed at the hand that was grabbing his throat but he could feel his consciousness slipping away, he could see the man's other hand making a chopping motion as he was ready to decapitate Yun Jhin!
Yun Jhin's eyes glowed for a brief moment before his head flew into the air and a pool of blood started to gather onto the ground.
Luo Shang fell onto the ground as he looked at the grisly sight in front of him, he wasn't scared because of what happened to Yun Jhin, but what will happen to him!
Luo Shang back was full of sweat as he said:
"Brother let's not be hasty, after all, we are brothers, I didn't even do that many evil things, could you please pardon me?"
The old man shook his head slowly as he took a few more steps forward, however, something changed, his transparent face scrunched up as he looked down at the ground.
Yun Jhin's blood pool dropped through the formation that surrounded him and transformed into a hexagonal formation on the ground which trapped him inside just like he did to the two of them!
A voice could be heard into Luo Shang's head that forced him to move:
"Throw your heart blood into the formation!"
As if he was possessed Luo Shang split his chest open and made a small opening on his heart, then he threw the blood through the formation that was surrounding him and it went unobstructed!
The drops of blood flew down onto the hexagonal formation and it started to glow with an ominous light.
Bumi Ming's face started to morph from terror as he looked down at the formation and finally deciphered its use!
Bumi Ming tried his best to struggle out of the formation but the heart blood from Luo Shang activated itself as it entered his body, weakening him making him unable to escape for a few seconds.
And that was all Yun Jhin needed.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Fall
chapters.content:
Bumi Ming wanted to scream but he couldn't, he could feel his strength being sapped by the formation, Yun Jhin's headless body moved as he took his head back and fixed it on his body, his eyes glowed with a dark green color as he could feel his leaving soul returning to his body.
Luo Shang just sat there with his chest open, flabbergasted at what was currently happening around him, after a short while his chest started to recover itself slowly as it mended to close.
Yun Jhin put his hand over his neck and the deep cut on it slowly healed, Bumi Mings figure was starting to slowly disappear as his quintessence was used to heal Yun Jhin's injuries, the formation below him was created the moment Yun Jhin realized that he wanted to cut his head, when his eyes glowed he was creating a formation in his body using his blood cells.
Once his headless body would fall down his blood cells would activate the formation that has been inscribed into them and automatically create the hexagonal shape onto the ground to trap Bumi Ming inside it.
However he needed a catalyst to bind Bumi Ming to the formation as he could easily leave it if he wanted to, so he used the leftover formations in Luo Shang's body to make him throw away some of his heart blood into the formation, his peculiarly strong bloodline that invaded the little dragon's bloodline once his soul entered in it was extremely helpful against Bumi Ming. They were brothers but also opposites so they could counter each other.
Yun Jhin's neck made strange cracking sounds as it moved around as if it didn't have bones anymore, Bumi Ming eyes trembled as darkness started to cloud his vision and he asked slowly:
"How?"
Yun Jhin looked him up and down and said:
"Aren't you a pitiful thing, accusing your brother of something you have already gone through, absolute justice is the worst thing that could have poisoned your soul you fool!"
Bumi Ming didn't understand anything that Yun Jhin said, after all, he was a believer of absolute justice after his soul was altered with so he was just thinking that Yun Jhin was talking jibberish to him so he would die unknowingly.
The fact stood here, the only reason Yun Jhin was even able to fool the soul was that the fragment of Bumi Ming's soul was even smaller than what Luo Shang had, unlike Luo Shang who used his descendants to fuel his soul recovery, Bumi Ming used an even more exquisite formation to freeze his soul piece inside of it.
However, that meant the soul piece couldn't recover even though it would deteriorate slower with time, Bumi Ming's soul piece was slowly deteriorating and if it was left alone it would crumble along with the formation 10,000 years later.
Yun Jhin bathed inside Bumi Ming's remaining energy as the formation around them started to crumble, his neck injury finally sealed itself as Bumi MIng's soul shadow started to turn dim and almost disappear, he took one last look at Luo Shang and said with his last breath as revelation appeared on his face:
"Maybe I was wrong, you were always a pure child, was I the one influenced?"
The soul shadow slowly started to disappear and Luo Shang watched it go with indifferent eyes, his hatred for him wouldn't be abated because his last vestige of life died in front of him, after all, he almost went insane while he was sealed into the tomb for so many years, all alone, only meeting someone when his descendants entered the tomb, and those people he had to absorb to boot!
Yun Jhin started to inspect the room they were in as he took control of the last remaining vestiges of the formation's energy using his soul willpower.
Luo Shang sat there as his chest was slowly closing and his wounds healing, however, his loss of heart blood would put him back from cultivating for quite a while unless he found something that could replace the heart blood he lost.
Yun Jhin took a look at the throne that Bumi Ming sat on and slowly walked towards it, he winced as he felt phantom pain from his neck, even though his body didn't die immediately after he was decapitated if he was later even a few seconds in putting his head back he would be now visiting buddha again.
Yun Jhin trailed his fingers on the surface of the throne as he muttered something under his breath, the throne split itself in two as a shining cultivation manual could be found under it, Yun Jhin wanted to laugh but his neck couldn't let him right now, he grabbed the cultivation manual from the ground and took a better look at it.
The cultivation manual was hastily written and the handwriting could be even considered ugly but Yun Jhin was savoring its contents with gusto, it was the Yin half of Luo Shang's cultivation technique, Bumi Ming and Luo Shang weren't blood brothers but they were born around the same time by the universe, even though they didn't share blood, in their younger days they shared everything else, even the cultivation technique.
After the duo split up so did their cultivation technique, since they weren't harmonious with each other anymore, their cultivation started to fail so they had to cut the part that was basically 'poison' to them and leave only the things they could use.
However Yun Jhin didn't have the same problem as them and he could cultivate both, his ideologies could change however he wanted, his countless experiences made him able to change what he thought or felt like he was a robot who could install different emotion apps on his interface.
Yun Jhin started to cultivate both of the techniques as he used the last remaining energy from the formation as a catalyst.
Yun Jhin's main body started to change as his humanoid form reverted itself to his dragon caterpillar form.
His horns grew longer and changed color into one white and one black, his form shrunk to around 2 meters in length and 2 meters in height, his weight reduced to 300 kilograms. His eyes also become heterochromatic just like his dragon horns.
The same happened to his wings, he looked just like a Ying Yang pin now, Yun Jhin's eyes pinned themselves to Luo Shang as he said:
"Tell me what else you can do for me before I annihilate you right now."
Luo Shang tried to scramble away from Yun Jhin but his chest injury opened as blood started to quickly drip from it, if he moved further his chest could open again and his organs would slip from his body if his soul was left into the open Yun Jhin could capture it and seal it into something else now.
The cultivation techniques from the brothers were changing his whole being, soul included, even though he wasn't supposed to be able to mend his soul further due to the lack of his cultivation base, due to the balanced state his cultivation base achieved from training in both of the Yin and Yang techniques, he reached a state where his soul had recovered almost 20% of its former might.
Now if he tortured then stabilized Luo Shang's soul for a while, he would be able to absorb it whole without a problem!
Luo Shang opened his mouth and vomited dark blood as he fell to his knees, his head hitting the cold stone floor below them while he said:
"Please don't kill me, I have information on the other planets that you could use, I know that your base was quite far away from the four symbols galaxy, you don't have all of the information needed and I could also be your henchman, I can even swear onto my bloodline!"
Luo Shang knew that if Yun Jhin got a hold of his soul after he absorbed his brother's he would be a goner, he wouldn't be able to escape and reincarnate, even though he didn't want to die, he would kill himself if he would be able to reincarnate, however, that wasn't possible with Yun Jhin monitoring himself 24/7, and if he swore onto his bloodline he wouldn't be able to do much besides serving Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin looked at Luo Shang and reverted to his human form, his human form became a young man looking to be around 24 years old with the same features as his caterpillar form, which meant his hair was both white and black along with his eyes, however, he didn't have horns and his physique remained the same, standing almost at 2 meters tall with a build that maximized both speed and strength, not too bulky nor too skinny.
His clothes were the same, the ones he forged for the 4 danger zones training, he looked down at them and realized that he should change them as his cultivation base kind of exhausted their use, he needed to get some crafting ingredients to create some better clothes, as for his katana he would be able to reforge it using his laws to increase its treasure grade.
Yun Jhin hand motioned to Luo Shang's downed body as it suddenly floated towards him, Luo Shang kept himself in the kneeling position as he swore:
"I swear under my bloodline to never disobey an order from my master Yun Jhin!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he looked at him and patted his head, inserting some Ying-Yang energy into his body which accelerated his healing process, even though he was an evil overlord in his previous life, he knew when to reward his henchmen or else they might riot against him, of course, he didn't have to reward his death guards as they would all do what he wanted regardless if he rewarded them or not, but he was in a good mood right now.
Yun Jhin looked at Luo Shang as he got up from the floor and patted his head, he already had some thoughts on how he could use him.
Swearing onto one's bloodline was a thing that cultivation beasts wouldn't do unless they had no other alternative, some of them would also rather die than swear onto their bloodline, however that also depended if they fought someone who could absorb souls like Yun Jhin.
If one went ahead and broke the swear made upon their bloodline, their bloodline would activate itself and swallow their soul-making them unable to reincarnate forever!
Yun Jhin realized that there wasn't anything else left in Bumi Ming's tomb so it was time to leave, however, there was only one exit and he wasn't sure where it leads and after he used it the tomb would implode thus alerting the Bumi Empire's people.
Yun Jhin sighed as he disappeared from the room along with Luo Shang.
He just hoped the exit would be in the same place they entered, or at least not in the vicinity of the Bumi Empire.
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang both found themselves in an unknown plain, they have never been here before but they could hear shouts going around them along with the thick smell of blood, the dying cries of the unlucky soldiers who fell due to friendly fire, or the fact that they walked to centimeters to the right and their heads were exposed to the firepower of the enemies ki attacks.
They were both on a battlefield!
Yun Jhin quickly dived towards the ground and looked towards both sides while using his stealth technique, fortunately, two more people appearing in the midst of the fight didn't alarm anyone as their appearance didn't come with any flashes of light or any peculiar sounds.
Yun Jhin then realized that most of the fighters were at the Emperor Realm or above, with very few being under the Emperor realm and standing at the King Realm.
He looked towards his left and realized that this was a fight between the Bumi and Luo Empire as he recognized the military badges of both sides.
It seemed his luck was quite good as the tomb's formation gave him an exit directly to the intended war zone.
The unlucky thing was the fact that a giant fiery ki hammer was thrown his way to kill the people that were jumping and shouting around him.
He was in the midst of the Bumi Empire forces so that meant that if he was hit by the ki hammer he would die due to friendly fire.
Yun Jhin grabbed Luo Shang and narrowly dodged the ki hammer while he ran towards the camp of the Luo Empire, he was sure they would recognize him even though his facial features changed a bit, at least he could call the Empress and avoid a misunderstanding.
Yun Jhin sighed as he dodged the attacks from both sides masterfully, from time to time some attacks would narrowly touch his vitals and Luo Shang almost lost his limbs one time, but Yun Jhin's movement techniques improved by a huge deal after he cultivated the combined techniques of the dragon brothers.
For now, he would even be able to fight an Emperor realm expert head-on and make him run, even though his cultivation base didn't increase by much as he was still a 5th stage King Realm with only 1 stage of the refinery, he could use the battlefield to gain enough ki to increase his refinery stage, however, he would first need to identify himself with one of the upper echelons or else there was the chance he might be mistaken for a spy.
Finally, after narrowly dodging death blows from both sides he finally reached the camp of the Luo Empire, he could already feel some auras that sat at the Sage Realm patrolling around the camp, they were the back up meant to take action if the enemies came with their own Sage Realm experts.
Yun Jhin slowly made his way towards the camp and dropped his stealth, it was time to join another war so he could consolidate his cultivation base and increase it!

chapters.title: Chapter 98: Rejected
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin and Luo Shang were easily spotted by the patroling Sage Realm expert and they were almost annihilated on the spot since they were looking quite suspicious, however, Yun Jhin dropped his guard and shouted:
"We are agents of her majesty and we just came back from an important mission."
The elderly sage realm expert stopped his finger attack that almost penetrated Yun Jhin's forehead, he attacked him first because his aura was stronger.
The sage realm expert opened his mouth and said:
"Then call the Empress and verify your claims."
Yun Jhin took a communication stone out of his spatial equipment and then talked a little bit into it, afterward, the Empress's voice came out it:
"Suichi let them be, they have done a great job in their assassination mission, they are the reason we are winning the current war so easily."
The elder Suichi bowed towards the communication stone and then eyed both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang for a bit before he said:
"What are your orders, your majesty?"
The voice of the Empress came again out of the stone and told the elder:
"Let them rest at the camp for some time before sending them back to the Empire, they already have done their jobs and the upcoming battlefields aren't for youths like them."
Suichi bowed again as the communication stone turned silent and Yun Jhin put it back into his storage equipment.
Suichi invited them to the biggest tent in the camp and let them rest there, afterward he left the tent to continue his patrol duty while also keeping an eye on the battlefield for any Sage Realm enemies.
Yun Jhin sighed as he sat on the bed and Luo Shang looked at him with a questioning gaze, even though he was his death sworn now that didn't mean he lost his reasoning.
Yun Jhin decided to enlighten him on the problem:
"The Empress immediately declined my request to participate in the war, I'm not sure why but it seems she knows something..."
Yun Jhin eyes widened in understanding as he looked inwards in his organs he could see the small formation that the Empress implanted in them to make sure they would do their jobs, at first glance the formation only looked to be monitoring their position and it was cut off when they were in the tomb, however, this was only one of the reasons the Empress wanted Yun Jhin back in the Empire.
Yun Jhin's spiritual eyes started to glow with their heterochromatic color, one white one black as he looked further into the formation, at first glance he still found nothing but if he focused hard enough to the point his soul started to heat up he could see very small runes inside the compound runes that formed the formation.
This was a special type of formation into a formation!
After he saw the runes his heart started beating faster as he realized what their use was, it was meant to view his body changes, if he would ever make a breakthrough or anything else would have changed his body the Empress would know!
That meant she knew that he gained something from this mission that she gave him, along with the fact that they disappeared from her senses for a few hours meant she must have guessed what happened to them, the fact that they were alive made her hungry for whatever good fortune they acquired.
Yun Jhin grabbed Luo Shang and hit 4 of his chest acupoints three times each, in a strange rhythm, after he finished Luo Shang spurted a mouthful of blood as the formation was forcefully extracted from his body, Yun Jhin clenched the formation orb into his hand as it broke and did the same thing on his body.
Soonly afterward the Sage Realm expert came back to see what they were doing and seeing that they were still resting he narrowed his eyes and left the building, after he was a good distance away from it he responded to the Empress's call on his communication stone:
"Yes your majesty they didn't run away, might I inquire what offense they did?"
The Empress's silky voice came out of the communication stone responding to his question:
"No, if they are still there let them rest for a few days before sending them away, make sure to send one early Sage Realm person from the camp to escort them to the capital, they are very important youths of our empire and their safety is the second most important priority besides the war!"
The sage realm expert Suichi nodded then closed the communication stone when all the sounds ceased to appear from it.
Yun Jhin grimaced as he looked at Luo Shang and said:
"We will have to play along with the Empress now, we will need to at least give her something that would look like it came from your brother, I gained some of his memories after I absorbed that part of his soul but they are incomplete due to the heavy corrupted and broken state his soul shard was in, I need some of your memories to make it up for it!"
Luo Shang immediately kneeled in front of Yun Jhin and left himself defenseless as Yun Jhin inserted his hand directly through his skull!
It seemed like Luo Shang was a phantasm as Yun Jhin phased his hand through his skull as if nothing was there, suddenly blue wisps of energy started to leave Luo Shang's head before they traveled along Yun Jhin's arms to his head, then the wisps returned to Luo Shang, however, before they were jumping around while looking full of vitality, now they were weaker and almost withered.
Even though Luo Shang easily gave up his memories for Yun Jhin, because of the lack of their cultivation base the party that gave up their memories will have to suffer some injuries to their soul's quintessence, fortunately for Luo Shang, his soul was quite strong even though he was missing in cultivation base so he would be able to heal from the damage quite easy as long as he got enough souls to feed on.
Yun Jhin nodded his head as he fully gained Luo Shang's memories and sorted through them, he gained quite a few cultivation techniques that he discarded, the main cultivation technique was already in his hands and he didn't have anything else that he needed, but they would be useful to fool the Empress.
Yun Jhin then made a small compilation of the fragmented memories of Bumi Ming and inserted some of the parts from Luo Shang's memories inside to fill the gaps along with the cultivation techniques and then he fragmented the technique that he learned from the manual and put some hints in the memories here and there.
Yun Jhin sighed as he opened his eyes and looked at Suichi who was staying in front of him with an unkind gaze on his face that said 'You have to go.', it seemed the time for rest passed quite quickly while he created those fake memories.
Suichi immediately threw them out of the camp along with a relatively younger Sage Realm expert, younger didn't mean he was that young, he just wasn't an old fart like Suichi, he was still middle-aged looking and his true age couldn't be discerned by his looks.
The middle-aged Sage Realm expert didn't say anything as he took the lead and strung the two behind him while he quickly flew towards the Empire.
With the speed of a Sage Realm expert, they arrived at the Empire in half a month and they were thrown beside the Empress's feet in ten seconds after they reached the capital.
The Empress sat high on her throne as she looked down at the duo which was apprehended and thrown to her by one of her weaker Sage Realm experts.
She waved her hand indicating for the eunuchs as well as the middle-aged sage realm expert to leave the room.
She slowly got down from the throne as she swayed her hips while walking towards the downed Yun Jhin and Luo Shang.
Her fair hand moved slowly towards Yun Jhin as she grasped his hand and picked him up while looking at him.
Yun Jhin's body was paralyzed the moment he entered the throne room and he couldn't do anything, he could only look into her eyes which were smiling at him.
Her hand inched closer to his cheek as she touched it, her face got closer and closer to his as she whispered into his ear:
"It seems your gains weren't small."
She licked her lips as her hand traveled from his cheek to his head and she pressed her finger into his forehead forcefully, a small hole opened there as her finger continued to travel into his skull piercing his brain.
The moment his brain was pierced the fake memory compilation he created burst forward as they entered into the Empress's finger and traveled to her own brain.
The Empress started to breathe roughly as the information entered her brain and soul, her quick hot breaths turned into mist as her expression changed and the smile on her face turned into a crazed expression.
She started laughing as Yun Jhin fell the ground with a hole in his forehead, she clutched her head as dark and white energy started to circulate her before she coughed a mouthful of blood and almost collapsed to the ground, her eyes turned bloodshot as she looked down at Yun Jhin and frowned while muttering:
"I took his memories so they aren't wrong, it really seems he only got a fragmented technique from Bumi Ming's soul fragment!"
She sighed as her temperament changed back to normal and the blood she coughed disappeared into red mist, she looked down at Yun Jhin's body and her eyes narrowed as she still felt life force coming from it, wasn't he a tenacious little bastard?
However, since he came back and didn't try to run away she decided to let him live, she waved her sleeves and returned to her throne as she said to the air:
"Get him to the jade dragon pool and throw him in there, as for the other, let him wait outside the room for his friend since I didn't injure him he doesn't need to use the jade dragon pool."
The eunuch which was waiting outside the throne room for instructions immediately appeared inside with his head kept down as to not sully the Empress's appearance with his eyes, he grabbed both Yun Jhin and Luo Shang like they were little chicks and disappeared from the room.
The Empress almost collapsed on her throne as she grabbed her chest and took out a small pill from her spatial ring that she immediately ate.
She stopped clutching her heart as she looked down at her shaking hands and said:
"Forcefully cultivating the broken technique did a number on my body, I will need to retreat the warriors from war and barricade the whole capital with its ancestral formation... it seems we will have to give up a lot of territories, damn you husband!"
Even though it was her fault for forcefully cultivating the technique she was still mad at her late husband for dying inside the tombs, even though she didn't love him very much, he was still the pillar that kept the Empire from imploding, once the news of his death spread a bit more widely the Bumi Empire won't even need to lift a hand before the top house's ancestors would try to dethrone and kill her.
All she could do now was hope that they would die in closed-door cultivation and not break through to the peak of the God Realm.
She could also try to assassinate them but their cultivation abodes would surely be protected by some strong formations, coupled with the fact that she was injured internally now all she could do was pray and wait...
The Empress's body disappeared from the throne while the throne room turned silent and empty once more.
Yun Jhin's naked body got up as he felt the pure jade-colored energy infiltrating his soul and body, the injury on his forehead was faked and it closed already without any scar left behind, however, he decided to make a fake scar appeared to deceive the Empress the next time she saw him, after all, it would be strange if the forceful removal of memories from a God Realm expert wouldn't even leave an unhealing scar behind.
Yun Jhin dived down in the pool of energy as he made way towards the bottom where he sat cross-legged and started to do some breathing exercises, he was conscious during the whole time the Empress talked so he knew that this pool of energy was quite important to the imperial family, he didn't need to know anything else as he started to greedily absorb the energy of the pool.
Giving her fake memories while injuring her as well for some special and rare energy that would make him breakthrough one or maybe more times was quite the bargain!

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Forging
chapters.content:
The jade dragon pool was a special recuperative item of the Empire, Yun Jhin was sure that both Empires had this type of jade dragon pool and their quality must vary on their location, but from what he theorized and saw, The jade dragon pool of the Luo Empire was a little bit better!
Yun Jhin's naked body was fully absorbing the surrounding energy from the jade dragon pool which was clear to the point that if one looked from above they would be able to see Yun Jhin's figure neatly seated cross-legged at the bottom of the pool.
It was so clear that it was fully transparent, Yun Jhin's breathing pattern changed from time to time as his chest expanded and returned to its initial size a few times.
The 5th gem inside of him was quickly taking high-quality energy from the pool and was getting refined by Yun Jhin's deployed cultivation methods.
The jade dragon pool was around 5 meters tall and it was full when Yun Jhin entered it but now the quantity of the pool was getting lower by the minute.
Yun Jhin's body was like a sponge that could absorb endless energy. As the energy in the pool was getting absorbed Yun Jhin's jewel refinery stage started increasing, 3rd stage, 5th stage it jumped directly to the 9th and peak stage of refinery!
Yun Jhin breathed out a bunch of impurities as he looked down at his hands while he sat cross-legged in the pool, he could feel that his strength increased by a high deal but there was still a lot of energy in the pool left that he could use. It was time for another breakthrough!
Yun Jhin could now choose between space and time laws to insert them into one of his jewels, space was easier to grasp at right now, as the time law would require him to be a little bit stronger, so that meant it was reserved for the 7th stage of the King Realm.
Yun Jhin's soul slowly unveiled beside his body as a small hole appeared in it and out of the hole came an arrow, the arrow was translucent with the same color as his soul, on it there were inscriptions of spatial language along with a few sparkling wisps of space energy.
Yun Jhin took the arrow and melded it the same way he did with the character for death, only this time it was a little bit easier compared to the death character, death was above space but since he had the Ying-Yang jewel he could learn death earlier, combined with the fact that he had the laws memorized from his previous lives made him able to get the death jewel first.
While he was transforming the arrow into a jewel, his body started to flicker in, and out of view seems as if there was an intense battle in it, conquering the space law wasn't easy but with his experience, he could easily negate all of the negative effects.
His body stabilized shortly without even the need of using energy from the jade dragon pool.
However, while stabilizing his body didn't take energy, creating the new jewel took energy, and the jade dragon pool energy was slowly getting exhausted by Yun Jhin, the higher the level of cultivation the more energy was needed, it was the law of equivalent exchange that not even God Realm experts would be able to ignore, they could learn and master it to gain a higher rate of energy conversion but they still couldn't do something without using energy no matter how little the energy is given back.
The arrow was finally melded into a jewel and inserted into his crown, it made a whooshing sound as it entered the empty slot and Yun Jhin could feel his body adapting extremely quickly to the surrounding space around him, he cleaved his hand forward for a little bit and a small pocket space appeared in front of him, with this new ability he could now throw away the need of spatial rings or any type of spatial equipment. This was only one of the abilities of the space jewel and it was also a secondary effect without much impact overall the main law.
The jade dragon pool energy started to get lower and lower as Yun Jhin started to refine his 6th jewel, after he refined it to the 9th stage he realized that he was not submerged in the water-like energy anymore, his head was above the water and there was a small amount of water below his waist.
He could also feel that his body adapted too much to the energy and it couldn't be of much use to him anymore, he might be able to use it to heal any future injuries but for cultivation, the effects would be null, however, the amount of water energy wouldn't be able to help him create his next jewel, he would need an enormous amount of energy to gather the time law and meld it into a jewel, after all, the time law was absolute and Yun Jhin could only learn a fragment of it, however even that fragment would make him able to fight Emperor Realm experts around the 2nd to 3rd stage easily, right now he might be able to fight the first Stage Emperor Realm experts and kill them if he used a forbidden technique.
However, even though he wouldn't be able to kill them he would still be able to escape and fight it out with them evenly.
Yun Jhin looked at the remaining energy inside the pool and felt pity to leave it here for the uses of others, there was still quite a bit of energy inside the remaining water that he could use for something else.
He stretched his whole body as he made some exercises and jumped out of the pool, he then clenched his arms as he used his ki to take all of the water from the pool.
The water was now levitating one meter above Yun Jhin as he started to do some hand seals and his inner ki flame appeared, even though all he had with him were spirit stones he could use them for what he wanted to do next.
The inner ki flame rushed below the water as it started burning brightly, more hand seals from Yun Jhin created a formation between the fire and the water that started to engulf the water only leaving a small opening at the top, the formation took the form of a bright red cauldron that was becoming even redder from the inner ki flame heating it.
Yun Jhin breathed in and out as he took all of the remaining spirit stones from his spatial zone and threw all of them into the cauldron.
He waved his hands left and right as a lid made out of formation characters appeared and sealed the cauldron.
The cauldron slowly started rotating as there were sloshing sounds coming out of it from time to time.
Yun Jhin's face took an expression of total concentration as he closed his eyes and continued to do hand seals to control the spins of the cauldron.
After a few hours, the cauldron's lid opened as Yun Jhin poured out a bunch of hardened energy that had the texture and hardness of cold dragon iron but was also flexible to not hinder movement.
Yun Jhin sighed as he cleared the sweat from his forehead and dismantled the cauldron to transform the formation into an anvil, he was ready to create some new clothes and a weapon for himself!
With his left-hand hammering using a formation hammer, with his right hand controlling his inner flame ki, breathing in and out simultaneously, the iron-like substance on the anvil started to take form!
In a short time of 5 days, Yun Jhin created a whole outfit, a dark yellow jacket with white pants along with black combat boots, there was also a black sash that he would tie around his waist.
He sighed as he donned on his new clothes and looked at the remaining iron-like substance, it could be used to create one weapon, the quantity already shrank when he tempered it and fused it in the cauldron so he didn't have much of it left.
Yun Jhin sighed as he rested for a bit as he needed to use his full concentration to create these clothes, they were quite special as they would be able to fend off one attack from a God Realm expert below the 9th stage, they could also regenerate themselves as long as they weren't destroyed fully and the effect of fending off one attack from a God Realm expert could repeat itself after 500 hours passed since the last attack, it was a life-saving treasure that even God Realm experts would have coveted, the clothes could also change their looks based on what the wearer wanted but Yun Jhin liked the current outfit and there wasn't a chance he would change it any time soon.
Yun Jhin started to change his forging technique as it was time to forge a weapon, however before he started he took a thoughtful expression as he started to ponder which type of weapon could bring out his full potential. The katana was a good weapon but it wasn't his favorite type of weapon, all types of swords were good for him but he didn't feel like they were unleashing their full potential in his hands.
Yun Jhin started to search in his memories to see if he ever encountered a weapon that he connected with and after a short while of searching his eyes lighted up, it was an unusual weapon even among God Realm experts as most would use the sword, very few the cudgel and only one or two would delve into obscure weapons.
A halberd! This type of weapon was almost extinct even during Yun Jhin's former reincarnations lives, people always loved swords and sword fighting to the point that other weapons were getting shadowed and forgotten, very few weapons fighting techniques survived and only the sword remained supreme, however, Yun Jhin was a master of all weapons due to his former reincarnations always trying something different.
Yun Jhin sighed as he went to work using the remaining water to create the halberd, it didn't take him much time to create the body of the weapon which was around 1.6 meters with an ax blade topped with a spike mounted at the top of the body, with a hook at the back of the ax blade.
The halberd was a deep red color and it glowed after Yun Jhin finished it, Yun Jhin slashed his finger open and dripped a few drops of blood onto it before it started to cool down at a fast rate.
Yun Jhin picked up the halberd which was a little bit smaller than he was in height and did a few practice frontal slashes with it, he could feel as if the halberd was one with his body, the shape, the weight, they all felt natural in his hands.
Yun Jhin stored the halberd in his new spacial zone and decided it was time to leave the room he was in.
He could easily spot a door a few meters away from the pool and even though it was closed Yun Jhin knew that it wasn't locked.
Yun Jhin made his way to the door but before he could open it, it opened itself!
An old man slowly made his way into the pool room and looked around before he spotted Yun Jhin's now conscious and the empty jade dragon pool behind him.
The old man was the same person which threw Yun Jhin into the pool, he looked between Yun Jhin and the pool a few times before he sighed and said:
"It seems your soul injury was quite deep if you exhausted the whole jade dragon pool, but it matters not as the Empress didn't say anything if you emptied the pool or not."
"The Empress didn't give any more instructions about you and your friend so you are free to go for now."
The old man shook his head as he left the room leaving the door open, Yun Jhin followed him outside the room and found himself to be in a long and wide corridor, Luo Shang was meditating near the door and immediately woke up from his meditation after he stepped out of the room since the old man disappeared he went onto one knee and said:
"You are back master."
Yun Jhin waved his hand and made him get up this wasn't the time for bootlicking.
Since they were technically free Yun Jhin decided it was time to get the hell out of the capital for the time being, who knew when the Empress decided she wanted to take a bath in the jade dragon pool to heal her injuries and found out it was empty and that she had to wait for a few years before it refilled itself?
It took Yun Jhin almost 4 months of closed-door cultivation to finish the whole pool and a lot of things changed at that time.
For one he could see the whole capital being engulfed by a giant formation and also the fact that quite a lot of people of the Bumi Empire were banging on the formation wanting to storm in.
It seemed he wouldn't be able to get out of the capital even if he wanted to in this situation.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Betrayal
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin had a headache due to his current situation, with things going on like this the Luo empire would surely fall sooner than later. In this situation Yun Jhin most likely wanted to jump boat and defect to the Bumi Empire, however, there was a high chance they would get rid of him after he helped them to get inside the capital.
There was also the fact that he couldn't get through the formation barrier that was protecting the capital, no one got in nor anyone got out. To break through the barrier he would need someone around the former Emperor's power, which meant the Emperor from the Bumi Empire would surely come, all he could do now was take advantage of the mass panic to gorge on the pure-blooded dragons in the capital!
That was the main reason he came so far on the draconic planet anyways, he needed draconic blood for the system so he could evolve into an artificial celestial caterpillar, around 10,000 maybe 100,000 bodies of pure-blooded beings.
With the current situation where everything was in pandemonium due to the attack from the Bumi Empire every requirement for Yun Jhin to start his rampage was fulfilled. He didn't know how much time was left before the Emperor of the Bumi Empire emerged but he only hoped he had enough time.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as he started stretching his body, the people around him were looking at him weirdly, what was he stretching for? There was no way the barrier would collapse and they had to fight right?
While most of the civilians ran away in fright some brave ones remained around the outer edges of the barrier observing the army of the Bumi Empire from a closer place.
Those were the first victims that fell to Yun Jhin's hands, Yun Jhin white and dark eyes looked down at the clump of bodies downed in front of him, his hands were so red that it looked like they were bathed in blood for hundreds of years, the first jewel in his crown activated itself as the whole clump of bodies below him whithered into nothing but ashes and a system notification appeared in front of him after a long time:
[99,950 pure draconic beings are needed before the azure dragon bloodline can be stimulated.]
Yun Jhin had a feral grin on his face that even scared Luo Shang who stood near him, he never saw Yun Jhin looking like that in the time he lived with him.
Yun Jhin's body disappeared as Luo Shang followed him, countless people fell at his hands as he started to run through the civilians that didn't escape, anyone that fell under his hand would soon wither into nothing but ashes as his life energy, cultivation, and bloodline would be absorbed by the jewel of Yun Jhin's crown.
