The two males at the 1st stage could be considered rather handsome with chiseled jaws and athletic builds, however, their faces still didn't match Yun Jhin's.
The one at the 2nd stage was buff but had an exquisite face with a good temperament that made him look like a scholar, he also wore glasses, and the combination of a scholar body and a bodybuilder's made an interesting look.
"My name is Zhao Changeng and these are my associates, Zhao Bumgu and Zhao Zindu, we heard from some reliable sources that you have become the partner of miss Zhao Qinghe and we would like to welcome you to our clique."
Changeng had a big smile on his face as he said those words but his actions were different, his hand immediately disappeared as it shot towards Yun Jhin's abdomen in the form of a punch.
It seemed they wanted to beat the newbie and show him his place around, they wanted to show that even though he was favored by a high-ranked female in the sect that he would still be below them because of his cultivation base weakness!
Most males were insecure due to the way they were treated on the planet, they would bow and scrape against the females but they would show their talons and teeth at their compatriots as long as they were weaker than they were. They were all people like Yun Jhin but just not as bold nor as scheming.
Yun Jhin easily caught the man's fist and pushed him back telling him:
"Zhao Changeng was it? I thank you for the invitation to your clique and I will make sure to come to all party invitations from now on, please accept my greetings!"
Yun Jhin's aura unleashed at full strength as it pushed against the trio, suddenly time seemed to move a little bit faster around Yun Jhin as he disappeared and appeared behind them, this wasn't speed! It was like he teleported there!
All three of them looked down at their stomach and put a hand over it, they could feel a bruise quickly appearing on it and they had a sweet aftertaste in their throat meaning that they took a little bit of internal damage. While males were allowed to fight they wouldn't be allowed to hit each other's faces or else that would anger the females and they might be even discarded!
Even though they were envious of Yun Jhin they didn't attack his face as they knew how hard it would be for him if he was discarded by such a high-ranking female. While they were envious and wanted to teach him a lesson they weren't that bad intentioned if you would look at it from their point of view. They were just petty and narrow-minded.
The trio immediately backed a bit from Yun Jhin, they realized that he was an expert with strong battle power, after all, most male phoenixes had high battle power and there were some geniuses out there that could fight between realms and from what they realized, Yun Jhin was one of them!
Strength was respected everywhere regardless of customs or if the society was matriarchal or patriarchal, as long as you were strong enough you could break customs and do whatever the hell you wanted!
Zhao Changeng lip was trembling a bit from the pain but he endured and gave a bow then said:
"I welcome Zhao Yun to the male's quarters!"
The other two said the same thing in unison as they decided to quickly run away, Yun Jhin looked at their backs disappearing as they went to their buildings and decided to enter his own.
Back at the pavilion, Nattaha was getting a massage from the same man as before, he was extremely pale compared to before and his eyes were dropping due to exhaustion, his stamina was truly exhausted and if he was forced more his life force would be expanded instead of his stamina, so Nattaha gave him some rest.
She was looking at Yun Jhin through a formation, observing his actions and how he behaved in the new building he got, from what she saw after he left her sister to enter closed-door cultivation he seemed to want to cultivate himself.
Nattaha yawned as she watched him cultivate, it was the normal cultivation technique that all-male phoenixes employed so her doubts about him started to lessen after he employed it, he just thought that he was a male that found his way into the sect and hoped he would be taken in, this was fairly normal and tens of thousands of men were either slaughtered or thrown out due to this as not many were as good looking or as strong as Yun Jhin, however, they still tried their luck.
They all thought that they were good looking enough to impress a disciple of the sect and make her take him in, hoping that they could change their life.
Nattaha stopped employing the formation after a while, she closed her eyes and took in the massage from her man while cultivating at the same time.
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he felt that the formation surrounding him stopped, so he stopped faking cultivating.
While he was currently at the most upper buildings in the male's quarters he got a good look of those below, they lived almost in the same conditions as the other quarters, from what he glanced about when he got up he realized that they had some furniture and bare cultivation resources so they were better than the others.
However, those people below were mostly looking average or just could be barely called handsome.
Yun Jhin put his target on them, while the most handsome men in the sect counted for 800, those below counted in the tens of thousands, if Yun Jhin made an approximation they were around 30,000.
While he wouldn't be able to eat too many of them or else the females would realize something was fishy, this was a good place where he could start harvesting!
Yun Jhin licked his lips for a little bit as he looked out his window at the quarters that were below him, his eyes were glinting with evil intentions.

chapters.title: Chapter 108: First victims
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin looked through the window towards those below him, he decided to wait until nightfall before he would act. After all, in the night those women would want to act up and there would surely be those like him who had their woman in closed-door cultivation, he could just give them a little visit.
Nightfall came quickly as Yun Jhin just cultivated for a while before night set, he decided to go for a stroll in the poor moonlight outside, most cultivators would either be cultivating or doing something else at these hours as they didn't need sleep, there were also nocturnal ones who liked to travel or do different such things, but considering how things worked on the Phoenix planet, most male cultivators would be just cultivating right now as they weren't allowed to leave too far from their women.
Yun Jhin already reached the lower buildings after a very short while, others weren't that interested to offend him after he used his strength on the three fellows yesterday so he was left alone for the night, he also didn't feel Qinghe's sister spying on him so he would be able to do whatever he wanted right now.
He entered the first house that he felt was populated and immediately decapitated the meditating male, he wasn't handsome but not ugly either and his cultivation base was very close to the king realm. A small black thread left Yun Jhin's palm as the remains of the male were sucked into his body and the system finally appeared again:
[Phoenix DNA acquired, to continue with the simulation of the artificial celestial caterpillar you need to acquire 99,999 more similar samples.]
Yun Jhin ignored the system, he already knew that, he left the building behind him as the door closed by itself and found another victim, unfortunately, this one woke up as soon as Yun Jhin appeared and wanted to shout and ask what the hell would he be doing in his home.
But Yun Jhin easily slipped in front of him and put a finger on his lips making him unable to say anything, his eyes widened becoming as big as saucers as he saw Yun Jhin's hand going towards his chest, then he felt only darkness as he collapsed to the floor but there was no blood gushing from his wound.
Yun Jhin had his heart in his hand as he used the same method as before to absorb it along with his body.
He decided to not go overboard for the day as he only went and killed 8 more, he still had a lot of time left and if he killed too many he would be suspected, after all, he just appeared and some males started to disappear? It would be pretty suspicious, and the suspicions would increase even more if he killed too many, he needed to play it smart for some time, unfortunately unlike the azure dragon planet where he could kill civilians most of the people on the phoenix planet weren't as open as the dragon planet.
That meant there weren't many if any hybrids at all and most males and females would be able to cultivate meaning the civilians were almost inexistent, from what Yun Jhin saw there were lots of organizations in the city and while the one he was in might be the strongest on the surface that must be because they had connections with the Phoenix Empress or Queen or President, he wasn't sure what type of governing they had.
Yun Jhin found himself back in his room as he looked through the same window, he wanted to leave and tour the city maybe find some more victims that he could absorb but he would first need to cement his identity in the sect so even if more people disappeared he wouldn't be suspected, he wanted to play it as low profile as possible so when it was time to leave he wouldn't have to do it the same way as the azure dragon planet.
Dawn appeared as the light of the day came, it was soon enough found out that 10 males from the lower districts disappeared, and talking started to spread:
"Could they have run away?"
"Most unlikely, you know what happens to those who run away right? And we aren't even treated that badly, it's not like we are the man of the head-mistress older daughter..."
"Shhh, you want to go and experience how is it to be her man? Don't talk about it!"
Yun Jhin moved through the male district unimpeded due to his strength show, the others were quite strong and the strongest person in the male district wouldn't attack Yun Jhin for no reason due to pride and there was also the fact that he would be scolded by his female. While Nattaha wouldn't interfere in fights that were around the 2nd stage of the Emperor realm those that were around the 5th to 6th stage wouldn't be able to touch Yun Jhin, after all, she needed to look after her little sister's man. She didn't want such a handsome man to get his face or well-toned body trashed, it would be a big waste in her opinion.
So while Yun Jhin could be threatened, due to his quick wits and use of strength he minimalized any damages that could be done to him.
After making sure he heard all of the rumors he decided against hunting again on the second day, it would be too soon and he might attract attention, so he decided to cultivate as he needed to refine his 7th jewel as it was at the 1st stage of the refinery.
Due to the lower population and higher bloodline purity and density on the phoenix planet, the ki circulating in the air was of a higher quality and quantity compared to the Azure dragon planet, while the azure dragon planet was strong, due to the innate characteristics of dragons (high libido) they have mated with quite a lot of beings and their bloodline got quite mixed, there was also the fact that they had tons of children and the population of the planet was higher than that of the phoenix planet.
While phoenixes could be said to have more sexual escapades they only made one or two eggs in their lives so they kept their population at a good amount meaning their atmospheric ki wasn't polluted nor were they lacking any.
Yun Jhin found the ki to be to his liking as he absorbed it into his jewel trying to slowly refine it, little time passed and all of the talking disappeared, there were only a few men of the lowlier female disciples, while the female disciples were quite angry as they thought their men ran away, they quickly found more to fill the empty spots that the others left, there were quite a few males inside the city that wanted to join the sect.
As the pure fire ki entered his body then his soul he could feel his jewel being purified and refined at a rapid pace, it was way quicker compared to the normal speed on the azure dragon planet.
He could feel that he could reach the 2nd stage in around 1 or 2 months, so by the time he reached a small breakthrough, Qinghe would come out of closed-door cultivation, and he needed her to further his plans, after all, she had quite the connections in the sect as she was the supposed daughter of the matriarch, as long as he made a continuously good impression on her he wouldn't be suspected of any crimes even if he continuously does them.
The time jewel was pretty important to Yun Jhin so he decided to fully focus on it, it could increase his battle power to the point that those at the 3rd to 4th stage of the Emperor realm wouldn't be much of a match to him, of course, if they were geniuses like him they would be able to fight back, but those type of geniuses wouldn't exist in such relatively small city, so he could run rampant where he wanted if he didn't get the attention of the older generation.
As he continued to cultivate time passed outside, it was currently summer and autumn was quickly coming, but due to the hot climate of the planet there were no signs of actual autumn, it looked just like a normal summer day and this was what the phoenixes enjoyed.
In Yun Jhin's building, light could be seen traveling along his body to his head as he finally refined his 7th jewel to the 2nd stage.
Before he could open his eyes properly he could hear a knock on his door, he got up and opened it only to see Qinghe who was different from before, her hair turned a deep crimson the same color as her eyes, she wore a tight fit dress and her fat seemingly melted from her body, she looked as hot and sexy as her older sister did.
Yun Jhin looked Qinghe up and down, and Qinghe started to blush as she waved her hand to him and said:
"Oh come on, you are literally making me blush, so embarrassing looking at me like that."
She coughed a bit before she entered the house and said:
"You might ask why I have lost so many weights right?"
Before Yun Jhin could ask Qinghe reverted to her usual heavy set form, but now she was just a little bit slimmer, Yun Jhin realized this because he had been close to her many times and knew how fat she was, but if it was anyone else they would think she would look the same.
As Yun Jhin examined her further he realized that she used a rather peculiar Buddhist school technique that he heard rumors about in his previous lives, considering the Buddhist school was pretty much out there to annihilate him he didn't know many things about the technique, when he died the Buddhist school was still flourishing. While they tried to kill him many times, they failed in the end but he still died due to old age, however, their school still prospered because Yun Jhin was too scared to attack their headquarters, they had a special formation that would be able to injure him.
Seeing this technique made him recount some things of his past, seeing that he spaced out Qinghe grasped him by the shoulder and said:
"It's ok, this was the same reaction my first man had when he saw me, but after I reach grand completion in the Fat Sumo Buddha expansion technique I should be able to return to my normal form and break through the Emperor Realm, unfortunately, I haven't been able to stabilize the technique and I failed... Nattaha will be pretty mad about this."
She gave out a big smile as her cheeks moved up and down and she said:
"You could also be the reason for my failure, I just couldn't get you out of my head, your words so sweat and your body so... hot!"
She immediately jumped on him and they went at it for a few days before Qinghe was satisfied.
Yun Jhin sighed inside and then left his house with Qinghe in tow, she said she had some news from her sister about something that would come up these days and that she had to attend it, Yun Jhin didn't have to but considering how sticky Qinghe was to him he had to go as well.
It didn't take them much time to appear at the same pavilion as before, entering the first room they met with Qinghe who was now wearing some clothes, seeing how her sister didn't break through she admonished her for a few minutes before she looked at me and shook her head as she said:
"It's ok if you want to take him with you but mother insisted for you to go alone, after all, you are supposed to get your main husband tomorrow, you can still fool around with him for some time but he would just become your Concubinator, from what I saw his bloodline is decent, but her highness wants to have his first son given to you!"
Qinghe knew this would be a great matter, this was also the reason her first man disappeared suddenly as she grew too attached to him.
Qinghe gave Yun Jhin a side-eye and seeing how he wasn't panicking or anything decided to say:
"But I love Zhao Yun.."
Nattaha shook her head and told her:
"You can still love him as much as you want, but he won't be your main husband!"
Nattaha said with finality as she crossed her arms and waited for a bit, Yun Jhin could feel the aura of a Sage Realm expert quickly approaching, it seemed he was going to meet Qinghe's and Nattaha's mother already.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Shallow connections
chapters.content:
As the aura approached, Yun Jhin finally saw Qinghe's mother, she was a middle-aged woman that had her blonde hair made in two buns behind her back, she had wrinkles around her eyes and her forehead, showing that she was indeed quite old, if Yun Jhin estimated she should be more than 200,000 years old considering the average life span of the phoenix race.
The woman gave out a gentle smile towards her daughters but then she narrowed her eyes as she looked at him and asked Qinghe:
"So this is your second man? While he might be a little better than your previous one from what I heard, he still isn't someone who you can put before Prince Hanzen."
Qinghe pouted making her fat cheeks roll a few times, her mother knew that she tried to get herself out of this arranged marriage but she wouldn't have any of it!
The middle-aged woman grabbed Qinghe by her big and flabby arms and decided to leave with her ignoring Yun Jhin in the process, after all, why would she care what would a male say in this situation?
Qinghe almost started crying as tears dripped slowly to her cheeks as she shouted:
"NO I DON'T WANT TO MARRY PRINCE HANZEN, WHY CAN HE HAVE MULTIPLE WIVES AS A MALE! I DON'T WANT TO BE A CONCUBINE!"
Yun Jhin found the thing pretty ironic and also hypocritical coming from their society but he watched on as the middle-aged woman eyes softened a bit and she said:
"You might not know but males can mate an unlimited amount of times during their lives and the prince's bloodline is very thick, thus her highness announced that she would let the prince become a breeding stallion for her closest friends so our progenitors can have the imperial blood flowing through them, do you understand? This is for the good of the planet and our family, we would become imperials!"
Qinghe frowned as she watched her mother and asked:
"Why can't elder sister go?"
This was a good question that was answered by Nattaha:
"While the prince is indeed a breeding stallion, he was quite pampered by the Empress during his youth due to his highly concentrated bloodline, he fancies young women and as you know I'm around 4 thousand years old you are also more talented than me, even though I'm considered young by normal standards, I'm not young enough."
She sighed as she remembered one other bit of information and she said:
"Also the prince likes women that haven't been with a lot of mates, considering you only had two and the relationship between our mother and her highness you must have realized why you have been chosen by mother. You should also know that I don't really remember the number of mates I had up till now. The prince might be a breeding stallion per se, but the Empress won't force him to mate with women he doesn't like or there is a chance he might withhold his seed from being passed on."
Qinghe knew what they meant, while she was young she wasn't dumb and her mother taught her a little bit of politics here and there just in case something like this would happen.
But Qinghe didn't like that one little bit even though she understood the situation, even since she was born she had been taught that males are inferior to females and that she could play with them however she liked. This made her a little bit conceited until she had her first man and realized that males are the same as females, she became a little bit more caring and thought about what the opposite sex would want or not.
Unfortunately for her, her mother already sealed the deal with the Empress, and considering how she was growing attached to her first male, her mother decided to dispose of him quietly.
Qinghe started to struggle out of her mother's arms but it was quite futile considering her mother was an expert at the sage realm, her mother frowned as he looked at Yun Jhin and her eyes hardened, it seemed that she thought that Yun Jhin must have said some things to her daughter which made him a disposable target!
Yun Jhin recognized the look in her eyes, he had it countless times when he was in a position of power of any kind.
He fell to his knees as he kowtowed to her mother and said:
"Grand elder, please spare this little one, I will make sure to keep my distance from Qinghe, I just hope that she will end up alright and I don't want to drag her down from becoming the consort of the high first prince!"
Qinghe became disappointed in Yun Jhin's lack of spine, but she also understood him, her mother would certainly kill him if he fought for her and he only became her male due to the benefits that came with it.
Qinghe looked at her mother in the eyes and didn't know what to say she shook her head and decided to follow her mother to the capital, there was nothing she could do in this situation and all she could do was give birth to one or two children if she was unlucky before she was free to do whatever she wanted.
However, she still had some lingering feelings for Yun Jhin as she waved her hand at him sadly, both her mother and Qinghe then disappeared.
Nattaha looked Yun Jhin up and down as she licked her lips sensually and approached him at a speed that he could barely recognize, her hands were moving around his body as she undressed him.
If Qinghe was here she would feel quite betrayed, she didn't even reach the capital yet and her sister was making a move on her ex-man already?
Seeing that Yun Jhin wasn't struggling or saying anything made Nattaha lose interest in him as he pushed him away and said:
"You truly lack a spine, why don't you struggle? You already don't see yourself as my sister's man anymore?"
Yun Jhin got up from the ground and said while shaking his head:
"If you want to take me what can I do? You are a female and I'm a male since your sister was taken away by her highness the grand elder I won't be her man anymore even if I shouted to the skies or did anything else, considering that I'm free I don't mind becoming your man."
Nattaha laughed as she looked at Yun Jhin and made him look in her eyes as she told him:
"Aren't you an opportunistic fellow? I like males like you but would your stamina endure?"
Nattha took his clothes off and hers as well as she jumped him.
1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 4 months, 5 months, 6 months. After half a year of nonstop dual cultivation, even Yun Jhin could feel that his yang essence was getting exhausted, fortunately for him he had enough techniques to make himself last longer and because Nattaha wasn't in the god realm, she couldn't exhaust his yang essence before he could recover it.
So he hanged on for 6 months before Nattaha got bored of him and decided to throw him out of the pavilion saying that he would be her man from now on and that he should come when she invites him in the future.
Yun Jhin looked to be gaunt and skinny on the surface after dual-cultivating for such a long while, but on the inside, he was almost the same as before, there was also the fact he reached the 3rd stage of refinement on the 7th jewel with the constant dual-cultivation.
Yun Jhin gave out a breath that contained some extra yin energy and his gaunt form returned to his normal self as he decided to take a stroll in the lower male's quarters.
After he took the stroll the male's quarters were 50 men short and Yun Jhin was 60 bodies closer to finishing his quest.
Yun Jhin found himself back in his building as he looked to the window, he sighed, this was too slow for him, he wanted to get rid of his current identity and maybe go on a rampage to finish the requirements of the phoenix planet but he still needed to lay low, this was quite the annoying thing for him. And it all stemmed from his low cultivation base, while the resources he got from becoming Nattaha's man were better than when he was Qinghe's he still felt that they were lacking, and he was sure they weren't giving him the best things because he was a male, the truly good stuff would be reserved for the female disciples.
Yun Jhin knew a few things about the phoenix planet but he wasn't sure if they were still up to date, he needed to get some information and buy a map to make sure things were as he knew, fortunately as he now had the identity of the head disciple's man he could easily get those.
He used his connections with the few males he knew in the upper quarters and got what he needed without having to pay a spirit stone, after all, they were fearing him and now that he got higher in rank they wanted to curry favor with him to increase their standing. Even the top 1 male would have to give him some face considering he was the man of the head disciple who could become the sect mistress in the future.
Grand Elders were only a little bit weaker than the sect mistress and they were the pillars of the sect, so it wasn't wrong to say that any child of the grand elders could achieve the sect mistress position if they were talented enough,and Nattaha was.
As Yun Jhin looked over the map of the phoenix planet and the information the others gathered it seemed some of the things he knew changed by quite a lot, but some places didn't change.
He had a small smile on his face when he closed the map and burned it into cinders, he knew where he had to go to increase his cultivation base, it was a location with something akin to the jade dragon pool energy from the azure dragon planet.
The location was monopolized by the imperial family but considering his connections with Qinghe he could do something about it and maybe get to the Fiery Phoenix Pool to further his cultivation, by his calculations with it he should be able to increase his cultivation by 5 if not 6 levels and even upgrade his clothes and Halberd, up till now he didn't find an opponent who had to make him use it, but considering the location he was in, it only made sense he didn't have to use it. He was a man that would rather make his way out with words instead of violence. Violence was a last resort strategy for him, but that didn't mean he was bad at it.
Yun Jhin waited for a few more months to let thing settle down after he killed 50 more males, he thought that he might have been able to clear all of them but it seemed that while the females looked down on males quite a lot, they also treasured them in their own strange way just like a possession that they couldn't live without, but could also somewhat replace at the same time, it was strange for others but Yun Jhin kind of understood them. Empathy was a thing one needed to infiltrate and Yun Jhin mastered this emotion, he just controlled it to his advantage and didn't act on it.
To leave the sect he had to apply to Nattaha but considering their current close relationship, Nattaha only narrowed her eyes at him and asked him some questions before she let him leave.
Yun Jhin hopped that after his current plan completed he wouldn't have to come back here, maybe after this he could even move on to the next planet if things went well!

chapters.title: Chapter 110: You should turn back
chapters.content:
After making sure everything was alright Yun Jhin left the sect and started to travel towards the location of the Fiery Phoenix pool.
It was in the capital and unlike the Jade Dragon pool, it was open to the public, public as in females only.
They also had to use quite a few spirit stones to be let in and it was akin to hot springs for the females of the phoenix race, it would reinvigorate them and heal them, however, they weren't allowed to absorb too much of the energy, they would be allowed to absorb energy based on the rank of spirit stones they gave, the highest-ranked spirit stones would let them absorb as much as their body could let them.
However finding these type of stones was easier said than done, Yun Jhin only had none of those on the azure dragon planet, right now he was pretty much penniless, he had a few marine herbs that he could use to create pills but they weren't worth that much...
Remembering about pills gave Yun Jhin a simple idea, he could use his pill making abilities to get enough money then use his connections with Qinghe to get into the Fiery Phoenix pool to absorb its whole contents.
This way he would be able to do it legitimately and get very close to breaking through to the Emperor realm, after he broke through he would be able to kill and absorb the remaining people quite easily as his stealth skill would improve quite a lot, even sage realm experts wouldn't be able to detect him properly and if he played his cards well he wouldn't even have to meet God Realm practitioners.
The capital was quite far away from the ocean city that Yun Jhin ended up at, at full speed traveling took him almost 2 months, fortunately, the phoenix planet had a different layout compared to the azure dragon one.
The capital was two to three times bigger than the city he left behind, it was full of red buildings as phoenix women loved the color red, pavilions, pagodas, even some western and modern type of buildings could be seen here and there, the architecture evolved a small bit since Yun Jhin last saw it, it seemed that the azure dragon planet was also lagging in this regard as they had the same type of buildings as 500,000 years prior.
It didn't take him much time to find a shop that specialized in selling medicinal pills, the thing was that the moment he entered it he was thrown outside even after he showed his skills, the woman who ran the shop gave him the stink eye and said:
"A male like yourself, trying to make money without your female knowing? Don't you think that we had enough of you running around trying to make themselves look important? Your skills may be genuine but since you came without your female you might as well give up on trying this type of stuff in the capital!"
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked around seeing women looking at him and giggling under their breath, the men which stood behind the women were giving him sympathizing looks as they shook their head.
It seemed he miscalculated something here, the sexism in the capital was considerably stronger than the one in the ocean city he came from, he wasn't sure how this worked, but he realized it might be due to them being more prideful as the capital had the Empress in it, they thought that as females who were near the Empress they were better even compared to other females.
Yun Jhin sighed as he got up from the ground, it seemed he needed to use his connections with Qinghe already, if he needed to use them for such a small matter how was he able to get inside the Fiery Phoenix Pool? What did he need to do?
Finding Qinghe didn't take him much time considering the location of the imperial visits was publicized, even though Qinghe was supposed to meet the main prince she wasn't let in the huge palace that stood before the rather small visiting building.
Yun Jhin found her playing a flute and sobbing, when she found Yun Jhin's intentionally leaked aura she immediately ushered him into her room at a light speed.
She hugged him forcefully almost squeezing the lungs out of him as she cried while whispering:
"The young prince said that I was fatter than a Uxidrow and that he didn't really want to touch me at all... only after the Empress persuaded him did he relent but he said that he would only touch me after I finished completing my cultivation technique, and then he won't touch me again after I became pregnant."
She hiccuped from time to time as hot tears dripped down from her cheeks on Yun Jhin's clothes, Yun Jhin decided to comfort her, it seemed her mother was still in the palace doing god knows what and she let her daughter out first.
After discharging all of the emotions out of her she finally asked:
"What are you doing in the capital Zhao Yun?"
Yun Jhin coughed a bit as he said:
"I was missing you, your sister already made me her man but I didn't feel the same as with you, I just feel bad that we can't continue our relationship so I wanted to see you one last time."
Qinghe smiled sadly as she continued to hug Yun Jhin, it seemed that they shared the same sentiments.
Yun Jhin faked a few tears as he reciprocated the hug and told her:
"I'm sorry that we can't be together but in our type of society we can't do much about it..."
Qinghe nodded, she felt quite sad as well, but then her eyes started to lighten as she said:
"Then why don't we run away?"
Yun Jhin frowned, he didn't think she would be that bold, this was a peak God Realm expert she wanted to run away from! After all, her mother already gave the word that she would give birth to at least 1 child!
Yun Jhin opened his mouth to dissuade her:
"While we might be able to run away, think about it a little, your mother already gave her word and the Empress is a God Realm expert, what do you think will happen to us the moment she senses you leaving?"
Seeing Yun Jhin's hard logic made Qinghe start to think, she wasn't dumb and understood what she meant, dying at this stage meant that they wouldn't be together and she truly liked him, not because of his sweet words but because he seemed truthful and empathetic to her, this was something that even her sister and mother weren't with her, while they were truthful they never empathized with her, trying to understand how she felt, but Yun Jhin words and actions gave her that feeling.
Yun Jhin smiled inside, it seemed his plan worked, he patted her fat shoulders as he tilted his head to the side and said:
"Your plan might work, I have mastered a technique that would let me become completely invisible to those around the sage realm, but I need to break through to the Emperor Realm for that.. you see.."
Yun Jhin told him about the things he found out and how he needed to make money to be able to enter the Fiery Phoenix Pool, he also wondered if she could help him in both regards, if his plan worked they would be able to run away!
At least that's what Qinghe was thinking right now, her eyes light up as she looked at Yun Jhin and a small smile blossomed on her face, while her mother would surely run after them, the Empress looked quite indifferent when she pursued her son to mate with her, maybe there was a chance for them!
Seeing how easily Qinghe got manipulated, Yun Jhin gave her a genuine smiled that made her think that he was really thinking about them with the contents of the conversation still flashing through her mind at quick speeds.
Qinghe decided to accompany Yun Jhin to a pill selling shop and give her approval of him working there, they chose a different shop to make things go easier.
After he got employed Yun Jhin was made to work like a pack mule as he got the hardest jobs because he was a male, however, he easily did them and got promoted quite quickly, 4 months passed since he was in the capital and he already was a senior pill refiner, even the females who were coming and going through the shop would take a peek at his public work, the boss of the shop even praised him and wanted to take him out for a few sessions, but Yun Jhin declined her saying that he was loyal to Qinghe.
This made the boss of the shop even more impressed with him and gave him a salary raise.
Due to his high position and the way he was quickly making money for the shop, his salary was quite big and it contained a few highest-ranked spirit stones, the way he was making business boom made the boss give him the highest salary in the shop regardless of his gender, he was that good!
It also helped he used sweet words and sometimes would sigh and act like he missed Qinghe, women loved these type of tragic stories the most and they felt like they should do something when they saw such type of lovebirds, something to help them.
Thus his salary was increased above normal measures, especially when some of his plans leaked, it was nothing serious to tell her some rumors that made her think what she wanted.
After 4 months Qinghe still didn't break through, she was now intentionally failing her breakthrough and waiting for Yun Jhin to make the money so they could escape together.
Her mother suspected something going on after she visited her the last time, but Qinghe faked her failed breakthroughs too well, after all the technique she was cultivating came from a Buddhist school and they were one of the harder techniques to master out there, also this was a type of technique that needed accumulation and not enlightenment, so her mother couldn't truly rush her in this regard.
More time passed, a year went by at lightning speed as Yun Jhin found himself with enough money to empty the Fiery Phoenix pool, but for now, he had to wait till the pool was at full capacity before he would enter as he needed its max capacity to unleash his potential to his best capability, while he said that his cultivation base might increase by 4-6 levels this was only an estimation, who truly knew how much energy he would need to break through to the Emperor realm?
He wasn't sure about that himself because of the high quality of his jewels it might take more energy for him to breakthrough, but one thing was guaranteed, with the energy of this pool he would be able to reach the Emperor realm!
First, he told Qinghe that he finished gathering money and that he would soon need her help to get inside the Fiery Phoenix pool, after all, as a male it was a very low chance he would be able to enter it by himself.
Qinghe found a way to enter, sometimes couples would be able to enter and dual cultivate into the pool and with Qinghe's special position she was let to enter with Yun Jhin, her mother was still inside the palace at the time so nothing happened, Qinghe wasn't sure what her mother was doing inside the palace as she didn't tell her anything when she came to visit, it was actually quite strange.
Yun Jhin's eyes laid on the fiery pool that was full of crimson lava-like energy, he told Qinghe who was behind him:
"You just keep a lookout while I cultivate, I will need all of the energy inside the pool to make my breakthrough, after I breakthrough we can leave, we can use the jumping pad formation and leave this planet behind us!"
Qinghe had a faint smile on her face, her eyes were red and it seemed she had been crying more lately, most likely because her mother was berating her on her breakthrough failures, even though her mother understood her, she was still frustrated at her daughter's incompetence.
Yun Jhin started to slowly get into the pool as he swam down to the bottom, he closed his eyes as he sat cross-legged and started to do his breathing exercises, he was ready to use the energy from the pool to refine himself and breakthrough even further in his cultivation!
Qinghe just looked at him with a big smile on her face as she fantasized about what was to come, she hoped that her children would be with Yun Jhin and not with that prince, at least Yun Jhin loved her even though she was fat...
Yun Jhin closed all of his senses as he focused on cultivation, he only left a opening for Qinghe to awaken him if anything happened, for now, he would do his best to cultivate.

chapters.title: Chapter 111: Cultivation jump
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's eyes remained closed as he used his breathing technique to absorb the fiery energy that was surrounding his whole body, Qinghe made sure there wouldn't be any interruptions as she kept watch.
As the energy in the pool started to revolve around Yun Jhin, he could feel that the energy was cleansing his body and soul, it was of a higher quality compared to the jade dragon pool of the azure dragon planet, that was for sure.
Atop of Yun Jhin's soul, his ki crown was reacting to the energy that it was given, and it started to devour it at a quick speed as the 7th jewel was currently going through a rapid refinement.
4th stage of refinement, 6th stage, 9th stage, full refinement!
The 7th jewel that contained the time law was now resplendent and glittery on the crown.
Since the 7th jewel was fully refined it was time to go and create the 8th jewel!
The 8th jewel could be filled with a multitude of things that would affect the ultimate 9th jewel which would give Yun Jhin a special killing technique only that he could use.
Yun Jhin already knew what he wanted to infuse his jewel with, he could use his own bloodline to fill it and create a bloodline jewel that would accordingly change when his body evolved or changed in any way, this was something that couldn't happen normally, but since Yun Jhin had the system he would be the only one who could do it.
Yun Jhin's blood started to slowly boil into the fiery pool as he extracted it from his body and refined it using the energy of the pool turning it crystalline and without any impurities, it didn't have many, to begin with so it didn't take him much time at all to finish that.
After the blood was fully refined he used his soul willpower to absorb it into his soul space then started to carve the crystalline blood into a red jewel, the character for bloodline slowly appeared on it as he carved it.
The jewel would have given an intense bloody smell in the open, but considering the jewel was already in Yun Jhin's soul space it didn't attract any attention.
He slowly slid the jewel into the 8th slot and it made a small clinking sound as it entered the slot perfectly, Yun Jhin's body started to change as his drained blood returned at a quick speed, his pale face returned to a normal healthy rosy color.
As his bloodline purified itself at quick speeds due to the jewel's properties Yun Jhin could feel that his stagnant body refining started to increase, but this was only for his internal organs and blood, they were getting strengthened at quick speeds until they stopped suddenly.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he examined his insides and nodded to himself, it was time to continue the breakthrough as he didn't even use 10% of the total energy in the pool, at most he used around 7% in total.
Considering how much energy he had left, he decided to go directly to the next breakthrough, unlike before with the current body refining state he didn't need to wait for his body to acclimatize to the breakthrough.
Now the last thing he had to do was fuse all of the jewels into a big multicolored jewel and remodel the crown into it having only a big slot.
This would take him more time than all of the previous breakthroughs so he decided to tell Qinghe to keep her eyes open for anything suspicious, if he was interrupted during this breakthrough there was a chance his crown may break, and repairing it would take a few years.
As he kept his eyes closed his soul willpower was rampaging in his soul space as it transformed into hands that started to meld the crown and fuse the jewels at the same time.
Time passed slowly as Yun Jhin made the crown into a smaller one which only had one big slot, after he finished remodeling the crown he turned all of the jewels into a liquid-like state and started to mix all of them.
After mixing them for a few months, Yun Jhin created a 'soup' of multicolored liquids that he started to harden using his soul flame at an immensely high temperature, but not that high as to not crack them or destroy them by accident.
After the jewels fused into one shiny jewel with different colors on all its sides, Yun Jhin made a hand using his soul willpower to insert it into the big slot that remained on the crown, his body started to shake as if he had a seizure as information from the jewel was inserted into his soul forcefully:
"I see, life and death, time and space, bloodline, the 4 elements, Ying and Yang just like my previous lives, this is the best combination!"
He had a big smile on his face as the unique technique revealed itself, with it Yun Jhin could create a supernova combined with all of the previously stated things to destroy his opponent both inside and outside, the supernova could also be contained into a very small and destructive form like a ball, or create a dangerously big one that could even hit the core of a planet and make it explode.
It was akin to a nuclear bomb but stronger, however, for the big one it would take time to charge and the small one was a little bit too destructive on the living things, so it could only be used when Yun Jhin wanted to truly destroy an opponent without absorbing him or enslaving him, it was a perfect killing technique with no counter!
Well, the only counter would be dodging it, but that was easier said than done.
Yun Jhin's body stopped trembling as he puffed out a small cloud of impurities that burned into the pool and disappeared.
Now he used around 25% of the energy of the pool and the energy started to decrease in height, the pool was full before but now a quarter was gone and if Yun Jhin stood up his head might be visible through the pool.
As things stood, Yun Jhin knew that he might be able to break through the Emperor Realm but he wasn't sure if he could reach the 2nd stage.
Yun Jhin continued his breakthroughs as he concentrated on absorbing the energy from the pool.
50%, 60%, 75% he stopped around at 78% as his body started to glow with both a fiery gold and a clear azure, the energy that he absorbed from the jade dragon pool was now resonating with the one from the Fiery Phoenix pool.
Yun Jhin's eyes formed a smile as he used both of the energies to break through into the Emperor Realm.
The Emperor Realm was very different compared to the King Realm, in this realm, one could actually start flying without getting exhausted and one could also create ki weapons that they could superimpose with their actual weapons to create a mass destructive ability that even though while not comparable with the innate technique they awakened at the 9th stage of the King Realm, it would still be equal to around 25-35% of its destructive power, however, this was also dependent on the user's ability with the weapon of their choosing.
Yun Jhin's weapon of choosing was the halberd, so he used the combination of jade energy and fiery energy to create half white and half red halberd that he grasped with his hand, the halberd solidified as Yun Jhin started to swing it and slash with it at high speeds, sometimes he would also poke around the pool with it, as the pool started to lose more energy Yun Jhin was solidifying his breakthrough in his realm.
In the first stage, one can fly freely and condense his spiritual ki weapon.
In the second stage, one is needed to strengthen the spiritual ki weapon.
In the third stage, one is acquiring a spiritual imperial armor that's similar to the ki weapon.
In the fourth stage, one is acquiring a spiritual imperial steed that would increase one's speed, the steed can also fly and increases one's flying capabilities by 100%.
In the fifth stage, one acquired the cape of an Emperor which furtherly increases the defensive capabilities of the spiritual imperial armor.
In the sixth stage, one acquired the ability to create ki troops that they could command as a true emperor.
in the seventh stage, one acquired the ability to summon a war banner that would explosively increase the might of their ki troops.
in the eight-stage, one acquired the ability to fuse with their troops and become a gigantic weapon of mass destruction, a punch from such a gigantic entity that was tens of thousands of meters tall would be able to destroy mountains with a single hit or even throw away small heavenly bodies to fight, such as moons or meteors.
In the ninth stage, one finally finished their cultivation in the Emperor realm and acquired an evolved version of their bloodline to increase their lifespan and physical battle power to the peak.
Yun Jhin was currently in the first stage and his ki halberd was slowly getting refined into the weapon he wanted to have.
After more time passed he finally finished refining the ki halberd and if he wanted to reach the 2nd stage of the Emperor Realm he had to refine the halberd using the energy in the pool and his innate ki flame.
Fortunately, there was still enough energy for that to happen, after he exhausted almost all of the energy inside the pool he barely reached the 2nd stage of the Emperor Realm, unlike the King Realm there was no stage of refinery like the jewels, once one attained the perfect stage of the weapon you could be considered to have broken through to the 2nd stage.
And for Yun Jhin it didn't take much time but a lot of energy!
There was still some amount of energy left on the bottom so Yun Jhin took it and infused his physical halberd and the special clothes he created using the jade dragon pool energy, he thus strengthened them even further and gave them another energy of the four sacred beasts.
He had some plans to get the energy pools from the black tortoise and white tiger planets as well, like this he would be able to create an outfit and weapon that could follow him even when he reached the peak of the god realm, from what he saw both the weapon and his clothes were at the Overwhelming grade, and from his calculations he could see that they might evolve to the Godly grade if he finished fusing them with the energy of the two other pools.
Yun Jhin jumped from the pool and almost startled Qinghe who was still keeping her eyes on the door.
Almost 6 more months passed since they entered the fiery phoenix pool and Qinghe's nerves were stretched taut for waiting and keeping watch for such a long time.
Qinghe was now a little bit slimmer than before as she couldn't stop her cultivation from breaking through anymore, and because she was so near the fiery dragon pool she unconsciously used some of the energy while she breathed in and out, Yun Jhin embraced her from behind as she told her:
"You can break through now, use this environment, and after that we can run away!"
She started to smile as she stopped blocking her breakthrough and decided to reach the Emperor Realm just like her beloved!
Yun Jhin watched as she formed her own ki weapon which was a sword, it wasn't that surprising, the sword was the most beloved weapon of the cultivators and one of the relatively easier to use, so it was normal she would choose it as her ki weapon.
Yun Jhin started to use his stealth technique as they both disappeared and left the capital behind them, a shout full of rage could be heard as her mother finally left the palace and went to visit her again:
"WHERE HAVE YOU GONE? YOU UNFILIAL DAUGHTER!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he grasped Qinghe's now slim hand, she was quite the beauty after she lost all of her weight and she could be used and manipulated for him to absorb all of those remaining phoenix-kin.
Seeing how she was so madly in love with him due to reasons know only to her, Yun Jhin decided to spare her, she could be very useful and also pleasing to the eye, keeping her alive and besides him wouldn't trouble him that much now that he reached the Emperor Realm, he might only discard her if she became useless or if his life was in danger. But for now, he would let her follow him.

chapters.title: Chapter 112: The truth
chapters.content:
Qinghe was holding Yun Jhin's hand very tightly as they ran under his stealth technique, she could feel that something strange was going on and realized it was because she was practically invisible.
They ran through the full streets of the capital and no one could even see them! She was rather impressed by her beloved technique, she had a big smile on her face during the whole ordeal as they ran away from the capital, but her mother's scream could be heard even after they ran away 50 kilometers.
Qinghe was rather scared when she heard it but Yun Jhin put a hand on her shoulder and comforted her with some words that she needed to hear right now:
"It's ok, she can't find us, and even if she ever will I will make sure that you won't get back there!"
Qinghe's tears started to slowly drip from her eyes as she heard his words, these were the words she wanted to hear from her beloved and he didn't disappoint, he was the man that she ever envisioned in her dreams, the man that would protect her. Being born in a matriarchal society took a toll on Qinghe's mind, even though she was supposed to be loved and protected only the reverse happened to her, with all of the bad things she heard about men, and as she compared the way she was treated by her fellow women, she felt that men were more trustworthy!
As they were always nice to her and they always told her what she wanted to hear, but not all of them were sincere, her last man which was also her first was one of the few sincere ones that she took in, but his end made her extremely sad and almost depressed, only after Yun Jhin came along she became happier, but then her mother made a move and this almost crushed her soul.
But now that Yun Jhin saved her and took her away from her mother, she became as happy as she could be.
After a while, they finally couldn't see the capital walls anymore and they reached an uninhabited forest where they decided to take a rest.
Qinghe was rather attached to Yun Jhin as she rested her head on his shoulder while he slowly meditated to recover his ki, it wouldn't take him much time to recover it, however, the consumption of the stealth technique was quite big considering he was using the advanced form to make sure the sage realm experts wouldn't be able to locate him, so that meant he still had to rest from time to time.
Qinghe eyed his resting form for a bit as she giggled under her breath, she truly felt quite happy running away with him.
Seeing that they were alone and free for now Qinghe moved a little bit closer and gave him a peck on the cheek as she said:
"Thanks for everything you are doing Zhao Yun."
Yun Jhin shook his head and said:
"My name is not Zhao Yun, please call me by my real name."
Qinghe cocked her head to the side and asked:
"Your real name?"
Yun Jhin nodded and told her his real name:
"My name is Yun Jhin and you see I'm not actually from the phoenix race."
His disguise unveiled in front of her as he returned to his ying-yang look, Qinghe gasped as she moved a few feet back from him, she was both puzzled and scared at what happened, Yun Jhin shook his head seeing her reaction before he quickly embraced her and said:
"It's ok, I'm still the same person, you see I have run away from the azure dragon planet as it was currently in a civil war and I have landed on this planet, I wasn't sure what to do at first so I hid."
"At first I have tried to hid in plain sight as I saw that males were treated differently on this planet so I guessed hiding in the strongest sect in the city was a good way to not attract attention by being plain."
"However, you found me quite fast and took me in as your man, I haven't had many interactions with many females before and you could be said to have been rather unique even amongst those that I interacted with."
He coughed a bit after he said those words, he felt rather awkward to call her 'unique'.
"My feelings for you are still true, regardless of race and how males are saw on your planet."
He kneeled in front of her as he took her fair hand into his and landed a gentle kiss on it, Qinghe started to blush like mad, even though his former looks were handsome, this part of Yun Jhin was both handsome and unique looking, his ying-yang looks gave him an exotic look that Qinghe found rather attractive.
Seeing how he easily calmed her, Yun Jhin smiled inside before he continued:
"I'm sorry to have frightened you with my sudden reveal, after all, I didn't know how to break it to you that I'm not from the phoenix race, if you don't like me anymore because of that I should help you get to a safe location before I shall excuse myself."
He gave her a small bow to show how sorry he was, this made Qinghe quickly grab him by the arm and hold him as she said with trembling eyes:
"Don't say that! I don't care about your race and why you have escaped from the azure dragon planet, I know who you are, I heard my big sister talk about an intruder but I couldn't care more about that, I love you because of who you are! A nice person who sees through the outer appearance of someone and loves them for who they are under their skin!"
What Qinghe said wasn't wrong, but Yun Jhin had more than one meaning for what she said.
Seeing that she was still so in love with him made Yun Jhin cut the thought of getting rid of her, her current looks would be rather useful for his plan.
He motioned for her to jump on his back as his ki returned to full capacity, Qinghe jumped on his broad back and felt his muscles, he blushed a bit, she was still like a schoolgirl that found her first love even though they already had intercourse for more than a few times.
Afterward, Yun Jhin used his stealth technique and started to run at high speeds leaving the forest behind them, now that he placated her Yun Jhin needed a plan on how to use her to lure some males to him, he needed to absorb them and the amount he required wasn't that small.
He looked to the front as he asked Qinghe who was embracing his back:
"Do you know any remote villages that we could run to? Considering your mother she might know we will run away and she must have put some guards towards the jumping pad formation, we need to lay low for a while, maybe in a location where there are more males, I could use a technique to hide your female features so we can hide."
Qinghe put a finger on her chin as she thought about it, she was rather knowledgeable of the phoenix planet layout, even though Yun Jhin got a map, he wanted a location that wasn't on the map.
As they passed a cave Qinghe finally opened her mouth to say:
"I think I know a location, most males that are abandoned are thrown there and there is a low chance for anyone to find us there if you have that technique to hide me."
Yun Jhin got the location from her and decided to follow her directions as he ran towards the village at even quicker speeds than what he was usually using.
He reached the village after 5 days of running without any stops, he was rather exhausted when he reached the village but he quickly got rid of the exhaustion as he looked around.
The village was rather rustic and could even be called primitive as they had huts made from clay and other materials that weren't that sturdy, most of the males were seen wearing rather poor clothes and some of them even wore nothing but some cloth that covered their private parts, most of them were emaciated and crippled considering cultivation base.
Qinghe felt rather sorry for them and Yun Jhin looked at them with narrowed eyes as he told Qinghe:
"I think this is no way for someone to live, Qinghe what you say we purify this village and let all of these poor people go free?"
Qinghe was rather surprised by what Yun Jhin said. He didn't think he was that type of person, but seeing how hard it was living for the males around she felt that his words weren't that wrong. Naturally, Qinghe would disagree with such a thing but Yun Jhin was currently messing with her thoughts using his superior soul willpower, making her see things from his perspective.
At first, he would need to do this to her so later she would accept his plans when she would have to become bait. The village wasn't that big and there were at most 200 males in it.
Yun Jhin razed it to the ground rather easily and absorbed all of them while Qinghe didn't watch, she was a rather soft person and didn't like fighting or killing, when she looked again if she didn't know there was a village where she might have thought that it was just a normal plain.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he patted her head and told her:
"It's ok, it wasn't right for them to live like this, unfortunately, your society doesn't allow all males to have equal opportunities, I'm quite sad about that..."
Hearing about her society made Qinghe quite mad, both at herself and other females, this rage was induced by Yun Jhin's soul willpower which was still messing with her thoughts and emotions at a very small level. He didn't have to do much as she was still madly in love with him which meant his manipulation would work by 200% effectivity.
After seeing her eyes cloud over Yun Jhin chuckled and put her on his back again as he asked her:
"Any more villages like these exist darling? We should liberate all of them as they are in more suffering living like this, don't you agree?"
Qinghe started to mutter the names and locations of the villages as Yun Jhin's eyes gained an evil glint in them, he successfully manipulated her with ease, and it didn't take him much time either!
He was currently laughing inside as he made his way towards the next villages, all he had to do now was absorb all of them, but from what he could see there weren't that many in existence, all males knew how to make themselves useful and there were very few that were discarded in such away.
From his calculations, he realized that he at most would gain around 5-8 thousand and he would still need to absorb 95-92 thousand to finish his phoenix bloodline acquisition, thus after he finished raiding the villages he still needed to use Qinghe to her full potential.
After being mentally manipulated for a while without her even knowing her consciousness started to grow fuzzy as she started to sleep on Yun Jhin's back, she had a content smile on her face as she thought she was doing the right thing informing Yun Jhin about the locations of the villages, she thought that she was actually saving these people, only if she knew she was damning them to an eternity without even being able to reincarnate, what would her expression be?
Yun Jhin knew about it, he chuckled again as he turned his head a bit and looked at her sleeping form and told her with a loving tone:
"You are going to be quite the hero from now on darling, hope you will enjoy your reputation..."

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Revelation
chapters.content:
While Yun Jhin and his new girlfriend were torching villages and massacring poor males who already had it hard out there. Qinghe's mother was rampaging inside the capital trying to find her daughter with no results whatsoever.
Qinghe's mother was sweating intensely as she returned to the palace and met up with the Empress, she fell to her knees as she started to tremble so much that you might think she was having a seizure.
The Empress knew that something was wrong and knew what it was as well, it could be easily seen by the expression on Qinghe's mother face:
"Martata, it seems your daughter had run away."
Martata didn't say anything as she kept her head held down and started to kowtow to the Empress while saying:
"Please forgive me!"
The Empress shook her head as she waved her hand and a handsome young man appeared he was half-naked and flustered but seeing it was his mother who summoned him his face returned to normal shortly while he was surprised it also seemed that he was used to such things as well. She asked him:
"Did you instruct the guards to not look after Qinghe?"
Prince Hanzen nodded and told his mother:
"Mother you saw her yourself, even if she lost all her fat she wouldn't have been that beautiful, I already have hundreds of women more beautiful than her, why would it matter if she became my concubine or not?"
The Empress sighed, it didn't matter much, she was only doing a favor to one of her former generals, and seeing that her son didn't want Qinghe she couldn't do much about it either.
However, since she gave her word to Martata she would still need to show at least a little bit of concern on this matter or she might lose her support, one general didn't matter much for her but what if she rallied more? She also didn't do anything wrong as her son was the one who intervened in this so basically she couldn't be punished or executed.
The Empress was a rather smart woman, she was the one who created this matriarchal society and made it work, she was also the one who stopped the war plaguing the planet since the humans attacked a long time ago, she was quite old herself even though she looked middle-aged at best, her son was conceived at a later age so he was still quite young and full of vigor, that's why he wanted to use him as a breeding horse to continue the imperial line, a male could mate multiple times but a female couldn't give birth to more than two children, innately phoenixes had the weakest bodies compared to the other 3 beasts, however, they had a special ability to revive themselves if a big piece of their DNA remained intact, but the process was quite lengthy and it didn't work if they died of old age.
The Empress let out a long sigh, she couldn't make a sage realm expert go after the princess and her lover, after all, they would be quite mad to be interrupted from cultivating, they were all trying to improve and maybe even reach the God Realm and the Empress understood their struggle, he could make Martata go after her own daughter but the reason she stayed in the palace for such long whiles was the same as the others.
The phoenix palace was special as it could be used to hasten the cultivation speed of those at the Sage Realm and above, anyone would want to stay continuously in it and not leave it after they tasted the benefits, it was created with a special fire magma stone that would increase the circulation of the phoenix bloodline of those who lived in it. Martata thought that she could casually cultivate inside and wait for her daughter to breakthrough, after all, her daughter never disobeyed her once in her whole life, how could she know that she would do it now, for a man to boot!
The Empress waved her hand indicating that Martata could get up from her kneeling position, her eyes shifted to her son and she asked:
"Do you still have that battle regiment of Emperors I gave you?"
Hanzen nodded at her question and said:
"Should I let them out to play, for now, mother?"
The Empress nodded and said:
"Go and tell them to find Qinghe and her lover, what was his name? Zhao Yun?"
Her gaze moved to Martata for confirmation and Martata nodded continuously at the question.
After that, she made sure to emphasize how Yun Jhin looked but considering his stealth skills and the way he changed himself there was a very low chance for him to be found by a battalion of Emperors even if they were high ranked ones.
Hanzen gave out an order through a communication stone and afterward bowed to his mother and asked:
"Can I go back to what I was doing, mother?"
The Empress nodded and waved her hand as the prince disappeared from the spot only to end up in his room back with his hundreds of concubines.
Martata left the Empress alone as she went to a cultivation room, for now, all she wanted to do was wait for her daughter to come back and accept her fate, all she had to do was give birth to one or two children, was it that hard?
Yun Jhin was now finishing all of the poor male villages and ended up with almost 7,000 kills in total.
He sighed as he needed 93,000 more, he now needed to go with phase two of his plan, he needed to go towards a populated city and use Qinghe as bait to make some males think they have hit the jackpot and that they are going to be owned by a beautiful woman who would improve their lives, only for her to bait them to him so he could absorb them!
He changed both his and her looks to look handsome but not very as to not attract too much attention, however, their face structure and their height and weight were different from before, combined with the masked life force they wouldn't be recognized by anyone, if Martata would look at Qinghe now she would think she was a stranger she never met in her life.
Manipulating Qinghe was rather easy as the seed of doubt was the place in her mind already, who was she supposed to believe in? Her mother's teachings for almost 18 years or Yun Jhin the love of her life for one year or so?
It could be said that love made fools out of people and in Qinghe's case it was totally true, she decided to go with what Yun Jhin told her, and that was he needed to liberate as many males as possible from this dictatorship of sexes, they were all brainwashed and they needed to be freed!
If Qinghe's mind was right she would have countered with the fact that he could help them by actually teaching them his ideologies and helping them get stronger, but now she was so far in love with him that she would take anything he said as the truth, and love wasn't the only factor that made her so foolish, Yun Jhin messed with her soul and brain a bit so she was more receptive to his thoughts and personality which was slowly influencing her's as well. This was what she got for fully opening her heart to him.
Yun Jhin gave her a small peck on the lips as he pushed her from behind, they were now in a random city Yun Jhin chose, they were in a big crowd and he made her seem as if she looked for males to add to her reverse harem, most female phoenixes had at least 5 males in their harems, and only the most impressive ones were allowed to impregnate them, the others were used as toys. Having a kid with them would increase their social standing and it could even explode if it was a daughter. The man could hold his head up and say, I have a daughter!
It didn't take much time for Qinghe to come back to Yun Jhin who was now in an alleyway waiting for her, the few men that followed her were puzzled as to why they were led here but before they could say anything at all their mouths opened in horror as they saw Yun Jhin moving towards them.
He already killed a few batches by now and his hands were bloody, combined with the strange look in his eyes made the meek males behind her so scared that they almost fainted.
Yun Jhin looked down at his hands and saw three heads in them, the corpses behind Qinghe fell soundlessly as they dissipated and the heads in his hands did the same along with the blood on his hands.
In total Yun Jhin reached around 8,000 of them now. Things were a bit too slow for him but considering how scattered they were this was the best he could do, if he killed females the authorities of the planet would actually start to move, as long as he kept the killing of males balanced enough and at random places among the planet it wouldn't trigger any response.
Qinghe felt like she had a pit in her stomach seeing her beloved actions, but when he looked into her eyes that pit disappeared as if it was filled with the boundless love she had for him, Yun Jhin slowly approached her as he grabbed her now thin waist and her lips inched closer to her ear as he gave her praise:
"You did very well my darling, we shall continue with two thousand more, right?"
Qinghe's eyes glossed over as Yun Jhin's mind control intensified, she just nodded her head as the information of a new alleyway appeared, doing the crime too many times in one spot could be risky, so Yun Jhin marked abandoned alleyways that they could use and decided to swap between them after they killed a certain number of males.
Yun Jhin licked his lips as he saw Qinghe coming with another batch, this was supposed to be the last one in this city as if he killed any more he would gather attention, with them he would reach 10,000 and that would mean he fulfilled 10% of the requirements of the system!
Yun Jhin gave out a gentle smile to Qinghe, the puzzled males behind her were still wondering why were they led to an abandoned alleyway, was her house around these parts?
Yun Jhin was looking prim and proper in their eyes as he didn't brutalize the others like he did the first time, after a few tens of brutalized kills he got bored of it and decided to go ahead and do it quickly and cleanly.
Their heads flew into the air and no drops of blood splattered anywhere as the corpses and heads disappeared at the same time.
Yun Jhin patted his back and Qinghe jumped on it as he disappeared from the city using his speed and stealth technique.
He decided to recover his ki at a preplanned place and decided to continue her brainwashing as he talked with her:
"You have done a great job there darling, we are done with 10% of our goal, don't you think that's great?"
Qinghe had a cute smile on her face as she grasped Yun Jhin's hand and told him with a meek tone:
"Whatever I can do for you, darling..."
Yun Jhin patted her head and gave her a small peck on the lips as he said:
"You want us to do anything now darling?"
Qinghe shook her head as she told him with an earnest expression:
"No, first we have to liberate more males from their oppression, just like you told me to, we can do this type of stuff later when we have finished!"
Yun Jhin's eyes flickered for half a second as he patted her head again and muttered:
"Good girl, a very good girl, keep it up like this, and I might not even have to discard you..."
Qinghe was too happy being called a good girl to hear the later parts of Yun Jhin's sentence, it seemed she was thoroughly brainwashed...

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Puzzled Battle Regiment
chapters.content:
A battle regiment of 50 female Emperors was currently running around in circles trying to find where Yun Jhin was, they were frustrated considering Yun Jhin left some ways for him to be tracked so he could mess with them before he suddenly cut them making them walk into circles or having to search randomly afterward.
The battle regiment was made of mostly elites at the middle stages of the Emperor Realm and but that didn't mean they were adepts at tracking, their battle power was strong that was all, it seemed Prince Hanzen really didn't want Qinghe back as he assigned them a tracking mission without a proper tracking unit.
The captain of the battle regiment was fully covered in armor that made her face unseeable, however, her body structure and voice made it sure that she was female. She was currently in a city trying to interrogate the citizens to find out if anyone saw Yun Jhin or Qinghe, but it seemed there was no luck for them as no one saw them at all, the captain grumbled under her breath, they couldn't leave the planet as the launching pad formation was blocked, how could they hide so well?
She tried more than a few cities and even tried some remote villages but she couldn't find anything, then suddenly she got an idea:
"Maybe they are going to hide into these godforsaken male-only villages..."
The captain took her unit as she quickly flew out of the current city they were in towards the villages, however, when she came there and saw how no villages were remaining in all of the locations she knew she immediately became both puzzled and vigilant as she reported to the prince:
"Your highness, something strange is going on, all of the banished male villages have been razed to the ground and nothing remained!"
The lazy voice of the prince came out of the communication stone:
"Whatever, if you don't find them in a few days just come back and entertain me some more, I'm quite bored without you, the others are quite good at their jobs, but you lot are especially good at what you are doing."
The captain blushed under her helmet but continued with a strict tone:
"Sir, should I report this to the Empress?"
The lazy voice said before closing the connection:
"Sure do whatever you want, I don't care."
It seemed Prince Hanzen was the ultimate form of a hedonistic silk pants young master.
The captain of the unit then contacted the Empress, she waited a bit before the communication stone turned a deep red fiery color and the majestic voice of the Empress could be heard coming from it:
"Why have you contacted me? Shouldn't have you contacted Prince Hanzen, you came with any important news that my ears have to hear?"
Even though she wasn't present the Empress was giving out a certain pressure with her voice alone, The captain immediately told her about what she saw and the Empress frowned as she thought:
"Killing the banished males? Who would do that and why?"
"This has never happened before, I think I will need them to investigate this."
"You go ahead and investigate what happened at the banished male villages, then you can go back and track Zhao Yun and Zhao Qinghe, do you understand?"
The captain gave out a respectful yes and then the Empress closed the connection, now having orders the captain immediately went to investigate what happened but considering Yun Jhin's capabilities of destroying all evidence it seemed that the Emperor unit didn't have much luck in finding anything incriminatory or a hint or where the criminal must have gone to next.
This gave the captain a massive headache, she was the one responsible if she failed this investigation, things wouldn't have been bad if she didn't report to the Empress but considering things were already done all she could do was grith her teeth and do whatever she could do find the culprit.
For starters, she needed to learn what would the culprit get out of this, why would he kill males and raze their villages, what was his reasoning, this was the first thing she needed to do, but think as she may she never got any ideas of why someone would do this, there were no benefits to get from here!
Almost all cultivators were running for benefits and very few would do something that wouldn't benefit them, thus the captain's brain almost fried tried to think what kind of benefits would one get from razing a few villages of abandoned males, the males were totally useless!
Considering the current cultivation techniques that were employed on the phoenix planet she would never think that someone would use living beings as cultivation resources so she never got at that point of thinking only running circles in her thinking as well.
While the captain was frying her brains trying to understand Yun Jhin's motives, Yun Jhin was in another city trying to gather more phoenix males to absorb, considering news didn't move from city to city Yun Jhin easily gained another 1,000 lives before he moved cities again.
However, something happened that made the males in the next city quite vigilant to the point that he could only get around 200 lives, Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at Qinghe, her appeal was the same as always but men started to flock less to her, what happened?
Yun Jhin sent Qinghe out to gather some fresh information and waited in a restaurant for her to come back, he enjoyed some delicacies that were regular on the phoenix planet and waited for Qinghe's news.
