This made prince Hanzen widen his eyes, how could they have not lost any sages? It was pretty much impossible considering the defensive structures they installed at the formation, what could they have done to take the females by surprise? Even if they were doing their usual activities, they still had a formation meant to alarm them when someone got too close, there were also those marine creatures that would attack the males to weaken them.
The Empress shook her head seeing him not understanding how they could have won the formation's location without any struggle, he decided to use her soul willpower to divination what happened at that time using a little bit of her life, around 2 to 3 years, she didn't have many left anyway so she didn't want to be surprised when they attacked the capital:
"I see, I see, however, this technique can be disturbed if I do that, Hanzen!"
Hanzen immediately stood straight as his mother told him:
"Put down a formation according to these instructions, it should meld with the current defensive formation and create something that will trouble the rebels with doing the same tactic as before, we might even be able to surprise them!"
Hanzen nodded and went ahead to do as his mother told him.
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt his destiny being peaked into for a few minutes, he looked towards the direction of the capital, he was currently in a different camp created by the rebels and met up with Ghin and the others, the other peak sage realm expert was also there and waiting for instructions.
Yun Jhin decided to scrap the plan that made use of his stealth as he announced:
"That old crone, the Empress got news of my stealth technique through some divination, fortunately, she is getting considerably weaker so I could identify her will spying on me, so we will have to change the plan a bit, I'm also sure they have changed the defensive formation meaning that we will be at a disadvantage even though our numbers have increased by quite a lot."
"Here is what we will do for now."
Yun Jhin told them the new plan that he devised quite easily, there will be multiple teams at work during this war, Yun Jhin Ghin and the first peak sage realm expert would be the first and most important team, while the other teams would be used to divide and conquer, the war would start for real and the first team will only act officially after they have conquered a good part of the planet.
Yun Jhin decided to get with guerilla warfare tactics, he couldn't do the same thing as before, the Empress knew that he wanted to absorb people so she would surely control her army again and make them self-destruct, he wanted to attack all of the weaker cities and conquer them, they were already weakened pretty hard considering the males revolted everywhere, even though a lot of them had been caught or killed, some escaped and joined the rebellion.
Yun Jhin looked at the map of the planet as he pointed at the most important cities.
"We shall attack those first, I'm not sure if the Empress will try to do the same thing as she did before, so I will only contact you if I feel something isn't right, but you should contact me first before you attack the cities, Ok?"
The second sage realm expert nodded before he flew away with his team.
The first sage realm expert remained with Yun Jhin and waited for news before they would then go together to the capital later.
It took around 1 day before he got a confirmation that the teams reached the important cities, since he felt that no one was peeking into his destiny anymore that meant that while this could be guessed they shouldn't be sure about it, combined with the fact that they needed to protect the capital Yun Jhin gave the order:
"You are free to attack the cities, do not kill the females, capture them, understood?"
A few understood came from the multiple communication stones that were around Yun Jhin, the real and final war would start now!

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Simple war but complicated schemes
chapters.content:
Guerilla warfare was especially effective in this current situation, the Empress had gathered her strongest followers in the capital and left the weaker ones to protect the cities, thus Yun Jhin could attack the more important cities and conquer them.
While this wouldn't trigger a chain reaction as good as conquering the capital, it would still break morale for quite a lot of female supremacists. After all, the females had grown weaker with time, their battle power got lower due to the peace they had to go through, they had almost perfect lives the moment they were born, so they didn't go through adversities and they became weak.
In contrast, males were pitied against each other so they could get better lives, they would always try to be stronger, better looking, and have a better vocabulary compared to their competitors, they tried their best to become stronger in all aspects to please the females, thus they had a stronger aura around them that intimidated the females when they were releasing it consciously.
Most males were wanting the revolution but there were quite a lot of men who also were too brainwashed to break through the problem, they didn't make more than 20% of the whole male population but that was still a considerably large amount. It couldn't be helped, they lived like this for too much time.
Yun Jhin was giving orders through the communication stones that were laying in front of him, the second and third teams were slowly encroaching on the cities that they have been given to capture.
"Team two here, we are slowly capturing Baylon city, we have captured around half and I can say that the resistance is very weak, they have some brainwashed males that they are using as cannon fodder.. we tried to weak them up, however..."
Yun Jhin's eyes lit up as he asked:
"How many of them are there? Have you tried everything you could?"
"There are around, 2,000 left, unfortunately, we had to kill some to scare them, we did try most of the things you taught us but it didn't work, what should we do with the remaining captives?"
Yun Jhin told him in a gentle tone:
"Come back with them to the camp, I will try my best to break the brainwashing, however, If I cannot do anything regarding that I shall send them on their way properly, We cannot let them die as long as I haven't tried everything I could on them!"
The captain of the second team gave an affirmative answer as they continued to kill the females and capture the city, after a while a notification came from the captain as he told Yun Jhin that the city had been captured and they left some males behind to control it before they moved on the next one.
The third team also came with similar questions to Yun Jhin regarding the brainwashed males and Yun Jhin gave them the same answer, to send them back by escorting them with a few Emperors, the brainwashed males were only the weaker ones that remained, the stronger ones had to be unfortunately killed.
The third team then captured the Skiddolo city, leaving only 4 more important cities to conquer.
After a few days, almost 10,000 brainwashed males were sent to Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin made some experiments on them while showing everyone how good he was with the brainwashed males even though some of them spit on him or even attacked him rabidly while he tried to heal their affections.
In the end, Yun Jhin absorbed all 10,000 of them reaching 30,000 absorptions as he told everyone that they couldn't be saved, he tried everything he could and this made the males of the camp look upon him with even better light, they looked at him just like someone would look at a saint who tried to save the world from poverty and sin.
Ghin came forward and bowed to Yun Jhin who was currently meditating while keeping an ear open for the communication stones:
"Yun, we have all prepared for the capital mission, we are waiting for your signal."
Yun Jhin nodded at him and waited, it was slow but they were almost reaching the end of the divide and conquer strategy, they couldn't use all of their personnel on this but capturing the most important city hubs would give the capital a strong blow, they wouldn't be able to trade anymore and the citizens would start to grow restless as they would be boxed in the capital. Maybe they would even start to pin the blame on the Empress and her army. People were fickle with emotions and phoenix females and males were even more so, due to their fiery attributes they were easier to sway and manipulate using their emotions.
Yun Jhin waited for a little bit more before he got some news:
"We have caught Szayeren city..."
"We have captured Dirron city..."
"We have captured Balton city..."
"We have captured Tangolo city..."
Finally, all of the important cities had been captured and the capital was now boxed in its bounds, their trade routes had been cut and now they had to use their resources to survive, while the cultivators would have it better, some citizens couldn't cultivate, they weren't in high numbers but they did exist and they were also rather important, they did the work that cultivators wouldn't normally do and if they rioted the well-oiled machine that was the capital could jam and break.
Yun Jhin was using such tactics to destroy the capital from inside, after all, he was at a numerical disadvantage and he wanted to play things as safe as possible, he looked down at his chopped arm that was still slowly recovering and frowned, after he absorbed these 10,000 brainwashed males the recovery of his arm increased by only a very little bit as the majority of the energy was absorbed by the system. He disliked having such an obvious injury that could be abused by his future opponents, however, he knew that it could heal before he left the planet, but it could still trouble him in the final battle.
The Empress was livid as she got up from her throne, her shaking body was almost ready to fall due to her immense anger, her son Hanzen was supporting her as she gave him the order to let her on the outer edges of the palace, even though she couldn't live the grounds of the palace she could go to the edges of it.
Her life was tied to the palace and the formation that covered it kept her alive, the combination of the location and the formation kept her alive and her injuries suppressed, but if she moved the palace the formation would break and the auspicious location would vanish killing her instantly. The god male phoenix would be laughing gleefully in his reincarnation if he knew how hard the Empress was living right now.
The Empress's body steadied itself as she reached the outer edges of the palace, she was now on one of the corners of the palace where the view of the capital could be seen at the best angle.
She sighed as she looked down at everything she worked hard for, she looked at the scared civilians and the tense weaker cultivators, she blinked her eyes as she moved her gaze towards Hanzen who immediately looked down at his feet as her eyes moved to his. He put her fingers on his chin as he made him look in her eyes and asked him:
"Was I wrong Hanzen? Have I done the wrong thing making males our subordinates?"
Asking male such questions was quite ironic in Hanzen's opinion, especially one you had in your palm and had been manipulating your whole life to do whatever you wanted him to. Hanzen wasn't dumb, he was just prideful, he actually realized that the male slaves he sent after Yun Jhin could potentially die, he didn't know that there was someone so proficient in formations that he could break the slave collars. After all, formation masters were rare... his mother was one but she couldn't work on them anymore due to her weakened body, so she only gave him instructions on how to do it.
He shook his head as he told her truthfully, he didn't care much about life and death at this junction:
"I think equality based on strength would have been better, it shouldn't matter if one is male or female, but how hard one's fist is! You have suppressed the males too hard... this is why they rebel now, to be honest if I wasn't in your control I might have actually joined them."
The Empress shook her head as she laughed like the old crone she was, she patted Hanzen's shoulder as she told him:
"Maybe I should have just let your explosion remain the same, reverting time was a mistake back then, but I got such a bad gut feeling when I looked at their commander Zhao Yun, I'm not sure why It was like I was looking at something that I can't understand."
Is a peak God Realm expert unable to understand something? That was pretty much impossible at one point, but the old crone couldn't fully see-through Yun Jhin!
Their cultivation difference was immense so this made the crone quite uncomfortable to the point she used time reversal, especially his glittering eyes, they were making her feel like he had thousand of schemes behind them.
She returned by herself to her throne as Hanzen stood there and watched the changes in the capital and shook his head while muttering:
"We have gathered everyone here, every sage realm and Emperor Realm expert, our army is mighty but... can we defeat them? They might have a number disadvantage but they are all males... should I just give up and let them in.. they already captured the nearby cities and boxed us in, mother should have realized the same thing, that should be why she left her throne, to see her self-made empire for the last time..."
"Whatever... we will see..."
He entered the palace as his silhouette disappeared, he needed to do a bit more thinking.
Yun Jhin laughed triumphantly as he met up with all of the sage realm experts near the capital, he was now supposed to go through with the first team to destroy the formation and then contact everyone else to jump in and trash the capital.
But there were problems with this plan now, Yun Jhin could feel that the formation would expose him if he went through in stealth, to break the formation he had to get near it and find the weak point, last time Ghin had been familiar with the formation as he lived in the capital and had to run one errand in the capital for the prince before. That made him get in contact with the formation.
But now things were different, the formation was systematically changed to the point that Yun Jhin had to be in contact with it for some time before he could decipher how to break it like before, attacking before the formation broke would get too many casualties and if Yun Jhin made them do that he would lose a bit of their trust and lower their morale.
Yun Jhin sighed, the first team wasn't that big, they were twenty in number and they had a few middle stage sage experts, 1 peak expert, and Ghin with him.
They had to create both a distraction and get in contact with the formation at the same time, Yun Jhin was the one who had to touch the formation so the others had to be the distraction.
Yun Jhin's plan was thus put to work, he disguised himself as a female and got near the capital while the others immediately started to make a ruckus and attack the formation trying to break it, this made the females stationed on the wall inform the higher-ups and make them run here in full force.
The team waited for a little bit before they ran away leaving the coming females puzzled.
A red-haired female with an average build with a ditzy look on her almost fell from the wall as she was grasped from the back by a strongly built female then patted her back while saying:
"Peuh, you almost fell there, I guess these males scared you good huh?"
The red-haired female nodded multiple times while the woman asked:
"Hmm.. seems you are around the 3rd stage of the Emperor realm, you will have to fight later, so don't make such mistakes again!"
The red-haired girl nodded multiple times while keeping an awkward smile on her face.
When the strongly built female turned around, the red-haired female's eyes turned cold and dark without any emotions as she walked along the walls, she was moving closer towards the first small formation core.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Breaking the formation and the morale
chapters.content:
The red-haired ditzy girl ran along the walls as she approached the formation core which was guarded by 5 strong females at the peak of the Emperor Realm.
The red-haired girl frowned as she looked at the women that were protecting the formation, she wasn't sure if she was able to break through them and destroy the formation.
While this unknown woman was going through an internal struggle, Yun Jhin finally reached the walls of the capital, he had to dig through the hard reinforced ground to not get spotted and avoid formation links everywhere to reach the wall undetected, it took him almost 6 hours and he exhausted quite a bit of his ki.
Yun Jhin got out of the ground as he looked around, he had marked a blind spot on the wall and revealed himself there, he was now a young woman around 20 years old with black hair done into braids, he wore a black battle dress and military boots. His body also changed to resemble a female more but his chest was flat.
He easily got through the formation as he changed his ki aura to resemble a female, easily getting him access to the inside of the formation, he climbed the wall at a point that there were no patrols then blended in.
He slowly made his way around the walls, making it look like he was patrolling and making sure no males were attacking, from time to time he would look towards the important guarded locations trying to identify which one had the most important formation core which he had to destroy.
Out of the corner of his eyes, he saw a ditzy red-haired girl patrolling around, from time to time her eyes would also wander towards a peculiar place, Yun Jhin realized that she was also scouting that specific formation core.
Yun Jhin found it strange but also interesting at the same time, he easily made it so he got to meet her at an opportune moment by bumping into her by accident when he did his usual patrols.
The red-haired girl almost fell from the wall because of the bump and Yun Jhin easily caught her and placed her right back on the wall, the red-haired girl shook her head as she scratched her hair awkwardly, this was the second time she was saved from falling to the ground.
Yun Jhin eyes moved to her crimson eyes as a telepathic message was sent:
"Who are you?"
The red-haired girls' eyes narrowed, she could feel that Yun Jhin was rather strange, suddenly she felt her head hurting, she glared at Yun Jhin and told him:
"Aren't you interesting? Being able to injure my soul so cleanly with one stroke, who am I? who are you?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he inserted some of his original phoenix aurae into her senses, she immediately looked at Yun Jhin's eyes, she realized he was a male and possible rebel, Yun Jhin then asked her:
"You are also eyeing the formation cores, right? Do you want to join the rebellion?"
The woman snorted but she didn't deny it, it seemed there was something different about this woman, Yun Jhin couldn't actually properly see through her, there was something strange at her that reminded him of himself, maybe she was a reincarnated one!
The woman had the same feeling coming from Yun Jhin, generally, reincarnated ones could see through one another better, but due to Yun Jhin's huge amount of reincarnations the red-haired woman could barely see through Yun Jhin, he was still mostly covered in a layer of mystery to her.
The woman decided to not beat around the bush as she told Yun Jhin:
"Yes, I indeed wish to join the rebellion, I was always an advocate for gender equality but most of my friends laughed at me when I was spewing such things, now that the males finally grew a backbone I decided to join the resistance, I might even be the first female who did this."
Yun Jhin knew that she was spewing both truths and lies at the same time, he decided to believe her for some time, he needed her help to break through the guards and destroy the formation core, he alone could do it but there would be some complications.
Yun Jhin decided to let her into the plan and the woman immediately acted upon it after she heard it, it was a plan superior to hers. Yun Jhin face turned to a neutral stare as he looked at the woman slowly made her way towards the guards of the particular formation core. It seemed his instincts told him the truth, he gave her only half the plan and omitted some important things here and there, who knew if she was a spy planted by the Empress?
Fortunately, she was going according to the plan.
The woman made her way towards the guards and fell on her face in front of them, the female guards immediately went to her to see what happened, Yun Jhin slowly made his patrol towards the guards as well, seeing him approaching made the guards tense up for no reason.
Suddenly the guards felt something as they looked at the downed body of the red-haired woman, they felt that their breathing had been cut.
Yun Jhin made his way along with the guards as they fell to the ground like flies, they were all dead and quickly being absorbed by Yun Jhin's body.
The red-haired woman's eyes widened in both surprise and puzzlement as she looked at Yun Jhin's actions, she didn't understand what cultivation technique he was using, but then some memories hit her and she understood a bit, it was a demonic technique!
Yun Jhin ignored her as he entered the formation core and destroyed it swiftly, the formation started to weaken as Yun Jhin made some analyzes and then sent the information towards the attack teams, they were ready to break through the formation!
The formation started to slowly crack and break as the males approached the capital and attacked with all of their strongest attacks.
The red-haired woman followed Yun Jhin off the wall as they met with the peak sage realm experts, Ghin and the others.
The males were pretty surprised and also suspicious after they saw Yun Jhin come back with a woman, Yun Jhin then told them that she was trustable as she was the one who helped him to break the formation, he also sent them some telepathic messages saying that she was different and she wasn't what she looked to be on the surface.
The red-haired woman decided to introduce herself:
"My name is Bai Yun."
All of the males found it strange, Bai Yun was a male's name, was the woman not really a woman?
But from her vital energy which she wasn't hiding it was obvious she was a female, she also didn't seem to be packing any hidden weapons either, in this type of society there was no chance a parent would give a woman the name of a man as it would demean her, this was very strange.
Yun Jhin looked at Bai Yun if he was right she should have been a male in her previous life and wanted to keep her initial name, he usually did the same most of the time unless he really had to change his name for certain actions or plans, his name didn't have any meaning to him but he felt familiar with it and didn't want to change it for no reason.
The war started again as the Emperor realm experts from both sides started to fight, prince Hanzen immediately appeared the moment the barrier broke and saw Yun Jhin and Bai Yun disappearing in the horde of males.
He shook his head, he made an appearance too late, but who would guess they had a mole and an infiltrator at the same time?
The Empress decided to take action as she took control of all of the females on the battlefield, this included the red-haired woman, but suddenly dark and fiery energy exploded from her as the Empress's shouts could be heard from the palace:
"DAMN YOU BAI YUN, I WAS SURE I DESTROYED YOUR SOUL!!"
Yun Jhin saw how Bai Yun destroyed the control technique that was cast upon him, from his understanding this woman should be the former top god realm expert of the males.
The other males were looking at Bai Yun with strange gazes but considering she didn't do anything to them and she still seemed friendly they decided to trust her for this once as she broke through the control of the Empress.
Yun Jhin looked at the battlefield, the males had learned their lesson and avoided the women who were self-destructing, however, it was not truly possible to avoid all of them, while the destruction ensued on the battlefield Prince Hanzen made his way towards the leaders of the rebellion, he looked at the peak sage realm experts and Yun Jhin before he fell to his knees and said:
"I surrender!"
Yun Jhin motioned for the peak sage realm expert to go closer to him, when he did Prince Hanzen eyes glazed over as he looked down at his body, his chest was pierced by a sharp pike from the peak sage realm expert, his life force was slowly disintegrating as he opened his mouth to say something only for his head to fall to the side and his eyes to remain wide open, however, before all of the energy in his body dissipated his lips turned upward in a small smile.
Yun Jhin approached his body as he shook his head and said:
"We couldn't make the mistake of believing him, what if he decided to self-destruct?"
All of the people with Yun Jhin nodded, seeing the child of the Empress surrendering then being executed destroyed the morale of the army, even brainwashed and controlled some of them started to fight back, the males that were too brainwashed also felt something was wrong with this here, why would the prince surrender?
As time passed the war continued but self-destructions started to disappear as the females broke through the control of the Empress and started to run away in all directions, fleeing for their lives!
Yun Jhin watched everything happen with an impassive expression on his face, he wasn't sure why but the peak sage realm experts women weren't attacking, they seemed to be pondering something atop the walls as they watched the fight go on, all of the sage experts were free so they started to massacre the Emperor women and brainwashed men.
The sage realm women finally made their way towards the battlefield and decided to surrender.
Yun Jhin frowned deeply seeing everything happen like this, this felt wrong, it was way too easy, what had the Empress done in 2 years of preparation for the final war?
Yun Jhin looked at Bai Yun from the corner of his eyes, she seemed to be as surprised as he was, what was wrong here?
A cough started to echo across the battlefield as a decrepit woman appeared in the skies, her face was starting to melt at high speeds as her skull became visible, the skull had a small crack across the forehead and her body was slowly becoming skeletal as well.
She looked in the direction of Yun Jhin and Bai Yun, her empty eye sockets were boring in their souls as she wanted to see through their secrets, Yun Jhin grunted as he coughed a mouthful of blood, and Bai Yun did the same.
It seemed the old crone was going to use her life for the final attack!
Yun Jhin frowned as he unraveled his strengthened defensive clothes, after he upgraded them with the fiery phoenix pool energy they could protect him from the dying peak god realm woman, her cultivation was actually regressing quickly after she left the palace and capital, it was around the 7th stage of the God Realm right now!
A sigh could be heard echoing in everyone's ears:
"It seemed I made a mistake back then and allowed this wretched person to come back... unfortunate, if that Zhao Yun was alone I might have been able to do something about him, but the combined destiny of the two working towards the same objective is too much for me to bear..."
Yun Jhin frowned as he activated the defensive power of his clothes while he activated the Emperor ki armor to surround his whole body.
Bai Yun activated her own defensive treasures as countless auras engulfed her as she activated her ki armor as well.
The Empress was only a clothed skeleton right now, her cultivation base dropped to the 2nd stage of the God Realm and the skeleton was slowly transforming into ashes.
The pressure on both of them was increasing continuously to the point that their bones started to crunch and crack, Yun Jhin fell to his knees as a breath filled with death and decay came from the Empress's skeleton while it slowly transformed into ashes.
The breath was going directly for Yun Jhin and Bai Yun!

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Brushing shoulders with death
chapters.content:
The breath that contained death and decay was very slow in the eyes of those who saw it coming towards Yun Jhin and Bai Yun, but only the two of them knew that no matter how slow it was, it was supposed to hit them both head-on!
Their bodies were too heavy to move due to the suppressive might that the skeleton put on them, even though the skeleton turned into ashes, the suppressive might was still there and holding on strong!
Blood started to drip from Yun Jhin's eyes as he gritted his teeth and tried to get up and dodge, the ki armor on his body was slowly cracking along with the remaining good bones in his body.
Bai Yun looked at Yun Jhin's actions from the corner of her eyes, she knew that things would end up bad for the both of them if the attack hit them, she knew there were almost no ways for them to escape, the difference in cultivation was too big even though the moment the Empress died her cultivation regressed to the 1st stage of the God Realm.
Bai Yun eyes started to drip blood as well as she thought:
"I didn't reincarnate to die here, at the hands of the same person no less! If I work with him... maybe..."
She sent Yun Jhin a telepathic message:
"The death breath is almost on us, use all of your strength to get near me, if we share our Yin and Yang energies we should be able to break through this weakening suppressive might and dodge the attack!"
Yun Jhin was a paranoid person who didn't trust others easily and he always had back-up plans for those he trusted, but in this situation, there was nothing he could do besides trust Bai Yun!
He frowned as he couldn't control the situation, he hated this type of occurs, rare they were, but in this life, they happened a bit too many times for his taste.
Yun Jhin's body cracked as he slowly moved, step by step towards Bai Yun, his hand was slowly reaching for hers as flowing Yang energy was being exhausted by his right arm.
Bai Yun's body started to crack as well as she started to move closer to Yun Jhin, they were both Emperors and they shouldn't be able to move under the suppressive might, but it was slowly dissipating, however, the death breath was almost touching them as well!
"Closer, closer almost there!"
"Just one more centimeter!"
Yun Jhin's and Bai Yun's hands finally interlocked as a fiendish aura engulfed the both of them as they exchanged their Ying and Yang energies, their cracked bones slowly started to heal as they used each other strengths to throw themselves out of the way of the death breath.
Yun Jhin finally heaved a sigh and so did Bai Yun, until the death breath slowly moved and hit both of them by the corners of their bodies!
Yun Jhin's right arm got hit as it started to dissipate fortunately the breath didn't hit his whole body or he would have been ashes right now.
Bai Yun lost her left leg but they both survived, Yun Jhin now was practically armless as one of them was slowly healing and one of them disappeared, the death energy also infested the wound and it wouldn't heal normally anymore, he needed to break through to the sage realm first for that to happen.
Yun Jhin coughed a few times as the death energy entered the earth and lava started to spurt out of the ground like a volcano!
Yun Jhin dodged the lava and Bai Yun jumped on one leg to avoid the eruption.
The death breath moved way faster in the earth and it reached the core of the planet quite quickly creating an eruption of lava.
Yun Jhin watched the battlefield, everything was slowly finishing, the females were giving up, their Empress was dead and their prince was the same, things were settling down slowly.
Yun Jhin approached Bai Yun and sent her a voice transmission:
"Your Yin energy is very strong, do you want to share it a little bit more?"
Yun Jhin could feel that the fusion of their Yin and Yang energy could help his left arm to recover fully, his right arm was gone for now and he still needed one arm to regain up to 85% of his battle power.
Bai Yun is a former male who didn't know what to say in this situation, but considering they could remove some of the death energy from their wounds this way to help them recover faster when they broke through the sage realm she decided to go along with it later.
Yun Jhin helped her up as they looked around the battlefield, Ghin came limping towards them, his right leg was injured but he had a big smile on his face as he bowed to both of them:
"We have won!"
Yun Jhin nodded, it seemed that they have won, he gave out a small smile towards him as the sage realm experts gathered with the captured female sages and asked:
"What should we do with them?"
Yun Jhin looked over the females and said shortly:
"Do the same thing they did to us, enslave them, but don't do the same thing to the weaker females, after all, we are advocating equality."
The males nodded to each other, they wanted to show the females that they were better than them, but if the upper-echelons walked scot-free away from this would make them look weak. So they enslaved the females at the sage realm and let everyone else below free.
Yun Jhin walked around the battlefield as countless corpses started to disappear, even though the Empress used to self-destruct the females, the ones who broke through the mind control and were too late to escape still died, there were also quite a lot of male corpses here and there.
Their disappearance puzzled the survivors but they decided against commenting, they were all too weak and exhausted to do anything about it anyways.
Yun Jhin's eyes were concentrated on the system page that appeared in front of him:
"25,000,26,000..... 30,000.....45,000...."
Only 45,000 Yun Jhin sighed, it couldn't be helped, there was too much self-destruction and after the females surrendered the casualties dropped by quite a lot.
Yun Jhin still needed 55,000 corpses to absorb and he knew where to go, he just needed to wait for the others to start celebrating and he could move to a random city and unleash a massacre on both the females and males, the strongest people were the peak sages and he could easily avoid them if he played smart.
Yun Jhin walked into the capital along with Bai Yun and a few other sage realm experts that weren't currently concentrating on enslaving the female sages.
Yun Jhin's voice moved through the whole capital:
"The revolution has ended, the males had won and now we will create an equal Empire where talent and opportunities will be shared with everyone regardless of gender!"
The males cheered while the females kept quiet, they knew they lost this war and they couldn't do anything anymore, any revolution from them will be quickly stomped out and they would all be killed, they heard and saw what happened, both at the capital and the nearby cities.
Bai Yun looked at Yun Jhin through the corner of her eyes as she asked:
"Now that everything is done you want to exchange Ying-Yang now?"
Yun Jhin nodded, they both found a private area and exchanged their Ying and Yang with each other, Yun Jhin's left arm finally healed as he flexed it while the death aura that was inhabiting his right side of the body was a little bit tamer compared to before.
Bai Yun had a wondering expression on her face as they both left the building behind.
Yun Jhin waved at Bai Yun indicating that he would leave, Bai Yun had her own devices she had to get to so she waved back and left as well, there were no reasons for them to continue interacting anymore so they went on their way.
Yun Jhin met with the peak sage realm experts and saw how they enslaved all of the female sages and nodded, he looked over the whole army that finally rested enough and took over the capital as he transmitted to them:
"This day should be known as the Male Revolutionary day and it shall be a new holiday, from now on, on this day of the year we shall celebrate this day!"
Shouts of agreement and cheers of happiness could be heard from every male in the capital and a gigantic party ensued!
Yun Jhin partied for a few hours before he disappeared in the dark of night, the party continued for ten days and ten nights continuously as they ate and drank, while the sage experts were training their slaves Yun Jhin was free to do as he wanted.
The news came after that 55,000 disapparitions around the planet appeared, the investigations led to a dead-end and since there weren't any new disapparitions after a while they decided to close the investigations.
Yun Jhin looked at the system notification in front of him, he finally had gained enough bloodlines to create a pure Phoenix bloodline that he could fuse with the other ones to become an artificial celestial caterpillar!
[100,000/100,000 Phoenix bodies consumed, Pure Phoenix Bloodline had been created and added to the stock, for the host to continue on the way of the artificial celestial caterpillar host needs bloodlines from the white tiger and the black tortoise!]
Yun Jhin sighed, it seemed his life on the Phoenix planet was slowly coming to an end, he decided to meet with Qinghe one last time before he left.
Yun Jhin arrived at the house in the woods and Qinghe with his son came quickly to welcome him back.
Yun Jhin smiled as he gave a one-armed hug to the both of them, Qinghe tears started to flow as she watched him recover his left arm and lose his right one, she clutched the back of his clothes tightly as she said:
"At least you are alive, at least you are alive!"
Yun Lao's eyes were shining as he looked at his 'father' he had his little sister in his hands as he gave her to his father while saying:
"This is Yun Qinghe father, you should introduce yourself to her properly."
His eyes were still shining as he said that.
Yun Jhin gave out a good-natured chuckle as he took the little bundle into his arm, Yun Qinghe immediately started crying the moment she felt herself to be in Yun Jhin's arm, however, she slowly started to get used to Yun Jhin's grasp, but that was only because Yun Jhin was removing a part of her soul and inserting some of his soul will inside her to control her, this was the same reason Yun Lao was so smart, he had some of Yun Jhin's memories and his soul was also in his control.
Qinghe didn't know what was happening as she smiled at her husband:
"It seems she only needed a little bit of time to get used to her father."
She cocked her head to the side as she said that and the family was now fully complete.
They all entered the house to have a good talk as laughs could be heard coming from inside the house from time to time.
Yun Jhin let Yun Qinghe rest in her new baby bed before he walked towards Qinghe and decided to talk with her about the future:
"Darling... I will have to leave the planet soon."
Qinghe's eyes started to tremble as she looked at Yun Jhin and said with sorrow:
"Why... why do you have to leave us? Your daughter, your son, and me?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he transferred some information in her brain instead of using words, she would understand better this way.
"You want to leave us for cultivation? I don't understand!"
Yun Jhin shook his head, of course, she wouldn't, she was that type of cultivator who was content with her life and didn't want to increase her cultivation further, however, Yun Jhin was obsessed with cultivating and could never settle for such a life.
Yun Jhin slowly made his way towards the door of the house as he told her:
"You have both Yun Lao and Yun Qinghe to keep you company, you are not alone, just think of me when you look at them."
Qinghe grabbed Yun Jhin from behind as she hugged his chest, but Yun Jhin already disappeared, she only grasped the air as she fell to the ground and started to cry.
Yun Lao approached her and comforted her as he said:
"It's ok mom, you still have us."
Qinghe sniffed as she hugged Yun Lao, it was true, at least she had her children.
Yun Jhin was already flying towards the jumping pad formation when he stopped and said:
"Ok you can come out, you want to leave the planet too, I guess?"

chapters.title: Chapter 124: White tigers are infighting
chapters.content:
Bai Yun slowly manifested 10 meters away from Yun Jhin, her eyes were analyzing Yun Jhin's form, she had seen how he left his family behind, this strengthened her guess of him being a reincarnated one, reincarnated ones usually didn't care about the people around them as they should have transcended the concept of relationships as they continued to live through different lives. All that remained for these people were profits and schemes to reach their dreams.
"Indeed, I decided to leave the planet, that damn bitch had already wasted all the potential this planet had to create another peak god realm expert... I need to find another planet where I can relearn the laws in the future."
Yun Jhin could feel that she said the truth, the laws of the planet were very thin even though the ki in the air was thick with energy, it seemed the Empress didn't release the laws for the future generations to learn when she died, only her ki returned to the earth.
It would take a lot of time for the laws of the planet to restore themselves because of her actions, this was a way for the Empress to take revenge on Bai Yun after her death, she decided to make things harder for her when she tried to achieve her breakthrough in the God Realm.
But it didn't make sense for her to leave yet, she wasn't even a sage realm expert yet, Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he questioned her:
"You are still quite weak... why would you want to leave around the same time as I am?"
Bai Yun chuckled as she launched herself at Yun Jhin, her body fully equipped with her ki weapon and ki armor, Yun Jhin retaliated as he activated his weapon and armor. His armor was different from hers as it was filled with the 4 elements.
Yun Jhin easily slipped behind her as he gave her a punch towards the chest, her armor absorbed the impact but she retaliated with her ki weapon which was a bo staff, the staff hit Yun Jhin squarely in the jaw disorientating him.
Yun Jhin jumped backward to make some space between them as he created his own ki weapon, he thrust his halberd forward at full strength breaking through her bo staff at full strength. However, the halberd lost strength after he broke her bo staff and so she could dodge and recreate her weapon, but she also wasted some ki in this situation.
"So you attack me without any explanation? You want to test my strength?"
Bai Yun smiled but didn't say anything, her eyes indicated that what Yun Jhin said was the truth.
Yun Jhin didn't like being tested but Bai Yun's battle strength was quite high, even though not similar to his he would still have to exert a bit of strength to defeat her here.
Yun Jhin's aura changed as darkness and light enveloped him, he used both the Ying-Yang abilities fused with the darkness and light abilities to create an aura that enchanted his stealth ability making him disappear from Bai Yun's senses.
Bai Yun frowned as she looked around, suddenly she looked down at her chest as she could feel a heavy strike landing there. The heavy strike made her armor crack and she crashed down falling from the sky.
Yun Jhin appeared as he flew to the ground, he looked at Bai Yun's downed form on the ground then jumped up as another Bai Yun appeared from the ground trying to hit him between the legs with her bo staff.
"Weren't you a male previously? Why are you attacking so viciously?"
Bai Yun decided against commenting as she continued to attack, Yun Jhin finally got bored of playing with her as he disappeared, his halberd was held in front of him as he sped up, suddenly the halberd entered through Bai Yun's front and left her back, breaking her armor and injuring her a high deal, but Bai Yun's body dissipated into dust as another Bai Yun appeared, however, she was visibly exhausted.
Yun Jhin looked down at her as he asked:
"Got enough?"
Her lips trembled as she asked:
"Who are you? There are very few reincarnated persons who can equal my power let's not even talk about defeating me..."
"Guess."
Bai Yun didn't know what to say, in her last life she was born after Yun Jhin died and it's been quite a long time since then, she also didn't listen much to rumors so she couldn't know who Yun Jhin was.
"Are you the ice Emperor of the humans?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he left her there, she couldn't be of much use to him anymore, absorbing people besides for their bloodlines couldn't be of much use anymore to him, at this level only energy from heaven and earth could be used to enhance himself, the Emperor Realm needed the acknowledgment of the heaven and earth before they could do anything else.
Bai Yun got up from the ground as she pitifully followed Yun Jhin, she felt wrong, this was the first time she had been defeated in this life and so thoroughly to boot as well, she didn't know what to do, when she was at the peak god realm she wouldn't have seen herself feeling the need to follow someone in her life, but now she felt vulnerable. Then some more of her memories got unlocked as she shook her head, her eyes hardened, it seemed she was an incomplete reincarnated as she didn't get her full memories.
Yun Jhin looked behind him and said:
"Got some more of your memories now? Don't follow me, reincarnated people shouldn't act with each other, you should understand why we already defied heaven and earth by forcefully reincarnating against the wishes of the universe, thus we can move towards the same destination but we shouldn't go on the same path."
Bai Yun narrowed her eyes as she looked at Yun Jhin's back, she knew that if she followed him she could have a big chance to return to her full strength, he seemed to have unlocked his full memories and he could be helpful for her to unlock hers.
Yun Jhin looked at the formation ahead of him, they already flew above the ocean and were rapidly approaching the formation, the males had already reinstalled the formation to deter the stronger fishes in the ocean so Yun Jhin didn't have to his stealth technique, but that also meant Bai Yun could easily follow him, Yun Jhin also didn't have any reason to kill her, she might have some treasures on her but they were useless to him, he filled his quota for phoenixes as well.
Yun Jhin sighed as he arrived at the formation and looked at Bai Yun who was waiting for the formation to activate, he did a few hand seals to activate the formation as the energy in the surroundings started to enter the formation and power it up.
The formation started to whirl to life as the energy from the surroundings combined with the spirit stone Yun Jhin inserted in the formation previously activated the formation fully!
Yun Jhin looked at the surrounding formation as he was sent directly into space!
Bai Yun was also sent into space behind him, he ignored her as he looked towards the other two planets, he decided to choose the white tiger planet next, from what he knew about black tortoises they will be tricky to get and he decided to leave them for last.
Yun Jhin's body started to drop quickly to the location of the white tiger planet, it was fully white, that meant the planet was a glacial one and that it was winter in it 24/7, the planet environment was very harsh but the population of tigers was living quite well, this showed that their bodies were special and strong since they were born.
Yun Jhin looked behind him and noticed that Bai Yun didn't follow him, this was good, he didn't want to deal with a reincarnated one, her battle strength was high enough and she could awaken more memories the closer she was to die, she might even self-destruct if he fought her to death, there was no reason to fight with such an opponent, she didn't have anything he wanted or needed. He would only work with her if she had things that he could use, also two reincarnated ones being near each other could bring trouble, the universe rather hated reincarnated ones.
Yun Jhin's destiny was already immense enough if two people with high destiny lived around each other for a long enough time the universe would decide to mess up with them, the universe wasn't conscious but it would react instinctively when some types of energies clashed or mixed around.
Yun Jhin's body fell through the atmosphere of the white tiger planet, the harsh winds and ice assailed his body continuously to the point that blood was falling from his body and being frozen immediately at the same time.
His teeth started to chatter innately as he felt the cold seeping into his body, then he used his life and Yang abilities to slowly heat his body so he could adapt to the environment, as he fell through the upper layers of the planet the temperature started to slowly increase, the higher in the clouds the lower the temperature.
Yun Jhin's body was slowly adapting to the coldness as his body refinement was at the peak, combined with his abilities that he could heat his body to the point that the coldness wasn't affecting him.
He fell to the snowy ground leaving a small hole in it, he got up from the hole and looked around only to hear shouts and battles going all around him:
"YOU ARE COURTING DEATH!"
"YOU ARE COURTING DEATH FOR TELLING ME THAT I COURT DEATH!"
"NO, YOU!"
Multiple voices were shouting at each other as battles were going around, Yun Jhin entered back into the hole then he looked around, the white tiger's innate camouflaging ability in the snow was quite perfect but Yun Jhin could still see them, there were tens of youths around the Emperor Realm fighting here and there, some of them had different stripe patterns and Yun Jhin could infer from this that they were from different tribes.
It seemed there was an inter-tribal war ongoing!
Yun Jhin frowned, how come 3/4 planets of the four guardian beasts were rife with inner trouble?
The females and males on the phoenix planet were at each other's throats after he was done with the planet, even though the situation was better than before it would take a long while for things to settle down.
The dragon planet also got settled down but things weren't going well there anyway.
And now the white tigers were also infighting?
There was the smell of a conspiracy going down here, could the same person who had poisoned the dragon brothers have done something to the other planets inhabitants as well? Could they have taken the same poison as the brothers?
It could be most likely, after all, the four guardian beasts were a very strong race if they combined forces, they could have even become the strongest in the universe if they fused their efforts to conquer the universe. However, they were proud and didn't have good relationships with each other, but they weren't infighting, they were actually closely tied when it came to people of their own race.
Yun Jhin thought a little about it as he easily maneuvered through the snow to dodge stray attacks that could have hit him.
This type of scheming reminded him of those old righteous fools who put up the mask of righteousness on their face while they were almost as bad as him, truly hypocrites. Yun Jhin found their actions strange, why act good when you are bad? Even though he could be considered the scummiest person alive at least he was honest with who he was.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the ongoing fight, he decided to not interfere with them, he needed to get information, he looked around and tried to find some weaker white tiger he could ambush and kill to absorb his soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 125: Fishy situation
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin slowly looked around for a white tiger that was further away from the others so he could assassinate him. He found the current situation of the four sacred beasts planet to be quite fishy, it did look like the hand of those old fogies from the Radiance and Light sect, however, that meant they should have reincarnated as well and that meant things would turn ugly if they found and recognized him.
From the memories of that hell creature he absorbed years ago, he saw that hells entrance was currently in the headquarters of the former blood throne sect, if the Radiance and Light sect found him he would become the most wanted person in the world and he would have no backing as well!
Yun Jhin slowly walked through the heavy snow while concealing his presence as he finally saw a younger white tiger looking at the fights from a distance, his eyes were curious as he observed the fights between his kin, it seemed like he wanted to join in the fights as well.
Yun Jhin suddenly appeared behind him as his hands slowly made their way towards his neck, the tiger felt something was wrong as he suddenly turned backward with a spin only to see only snow behind him, he frowned as he felt something was still wrong but he couldn't put his finger on it.
His head fell to the side with a sickening crunch as he thought about it, his body and soul were silently absorbed as Yun Jhin gained the information he needed and he frowned.
There were two strong tiger tribes on the planet and they were infighting for reasons unknown to those of the lower echelons, this tiger he absorbed was from a smaller tribe that wasn't under the two tribes.
The tribes were rather paranoid and they wouldn't accept outsiders from the smaller tribes thinking they could be spies. Yun Jhin also found out that there were 2 peak God Realm experts on this planet, they were the leaders of the tribes and they would fight from time to time to see who was stronger.
The tribes were stuck in a perpetual fight against each other but they didn't seem to be ill-intended, they were fighting to improve themselves but deaths could still be occasionally seen here and there.
Yun Jhin found it strange... it was like they just didn't want to leave their planet, or maybe they weren't allowed to? The young tiger he absorbed didn't have much knowledge, he only know the most basic things, he didn't even know the whole planet!
Yun Jhin looked at the older tigers who were still fighting, a death had been spotted as one of the tiger's throat was slashed open and he bled to death on the ground, the winning tiger didn't care to look at his dying face as he continued to fight with the other tigers, from the tiger stripe patterns on their bodies it could be seen the two fighting parties were from the stronger tribes.
The tigers were rather simple, Yun Jhin thought. They only pursued strength and from what he gathered their civilization was quite backward, they didn't evolve at all in that aspect, they were all savages and lived like prehistoric humans. Yun Jhin wasn't sure what they were wearing because they were all fighting in their tiger forms right now but he was sure it was something along the lines of Uxi-Mammoth skin or something similar.
Yun Jhin then decided to wait for the winners to be decided, he would strike afterward and absorb the bodies and the souls of the winners, maybe they could have more information that he could use, after all, they were quite a bit stronger compared to the youth he absorbed.
A slash here, and a bite there, the snow didn't do much to cover the fighting aura of the tigers, Yun Jhin watched as they fought bloodily, in the end, the tigers from the Hao tribe won, the name of the tribes were Hao and Mao and their strengths were currently unknown to Yun Jhin, but if he guessed by the current situation, the Hao tribe should be a little bit stronger.
Yun Jhin watched as the winning 3 tigers looked at the corpse of their comrades and decided to leave them there to be buried in the snow, Yun Jhin appeared in front of them in the snow, the leader of the tiger's eyes widened as he didn't feel Yun Jhin approach at all, looking at the stranger who had weird clothes on his body made the 3 tigers fall back a bit, his aura was equal to theirs and he was an unknown factor.
The moment they fell back one of the tiger's head flew in the air as blood sprayed to the ground.
The other two didn't cry in anguish, they got angered as Yun Jhin fought dirty, he didn't even issue a challenge!
Yun Jhin knew from the memories of the youngster that issuing challenges was a normal event in those types of fights, thus the tigers let their guard down in front of Yun Jhin because he didn't issue a challenge immediately after appearing. It seemed the Tigers were both honest and dumb folk.
Yun Jhin's image started to flicker as the snow-covered him, the second head flew into the air and the strongest tiger remained alive, he returned to his human form as he tried to reason with Yun Jhin:
"You shameless person stop!"
Yun Jhin looked at the man up and down and nodded, he was wearing an Uxi-Mammoth skin, the man's head flew into the air as their bodies dissipated along with the dead ones that were laying in the snow.
Yun Jhin face remained impassive as the information entered his soul and he muttered:
"It won't be good to join one of the stronger tribes, they are too paranoid, even if I infiltrate as someone I killed there is a chance they would know..."
Tigers had a very keen sense of smell and it was enhanced even more around those of the same blood as theirs, while Yun Jhin could fake the smell of a white tiger if a relative smelled him and found his smell funny he could be found out, each beast had their special attributes and trick under their sleeves that Yun Jhin was somewhat familiar with.
Azure dragons had very high compatibility to mate everything and create hybrids, however, due to this pure breeds would be harder to create, Phoenixes could revive if any part of their bodies was kept safe for a rather long time, however, this didn't work if the phoenix was dying of old age.
White tigers had very keen senses, their strongest was their sense of smell so stealth and infiltration didn't work properly against them, Yun Jhin stealth worked here because the tigers didn't keep their guards up and they were rather exhausted, combined with the fact that Yun Jhin's killing experience was unrivaled in this universe it made them be easy targets.
The black tortoises were rather unknown, they were hermits and Yun Jhin knew very little about them, all he knew is that they had the longest longevity in the universe nearing 600,000 years and that during their older years they would go and hibernate to conserve energy.
Yun Jhin shook his head, he also gained the map of the planet, the surface was a battlefield and the inside of the planet was where Tigers would rest, the inside of the planet was hot and the energy nearing the core helped tigers recover faster, while the outside was meant to temper the body, the inside was used for recovery. There was also the fact that no civilians existed on this planet, every person was a cultivator!
Those that had no potential were already dead and mummified in the ice of the planet, young tiger cubs would be thrown outside and made to survive the harsh environment of the ice planet. Most people who could survive this would become cultivators, due to this the white tiger population wasn't that big, they had the lowest population of the 4 sacred beasts but also the highest battle power.
Yun Jhin looked around for a while before he left, he disguised himself as a tiger from a small tribe as he walked towards one of the small tribes. The person which led this tribe was at most a sage realm expert around the 4th stage, they were barely allowed to get a den inside the planet and they weren't allowed near the hotter areas.
Yun Jhin decided to go to this tribe because they were welcoming of outsiders, they needed manpower for hunting and farming, they were one of the few lucky lower tribes who got their hands on a plot of land inside the planet that could be used for farming, and if they made a successful planting they would be able to eat for a long while without having to put their warriors lives in peril on the outside. While hunting wasn't that hard if you got the right target.
However, there was a high chance to meet other tribes, and if you met the strongest tribes during hunting all you could do was fight valiantly until you bled to death or your head fell to the ground.
Yun Jhin entered the bounders of the tribe and one of the guards immediately looked him up and down before asking:
"This brother is unfamiliar, might I inquire from where are you from?"
As long as a tiger didn't have the patterns of a stronger tribe and their cultivation wasn't too high or too low while they also looked for work, the smaller tribes would accept them. Yun Jhin fit the criteria perfectly so the guard didn't shoo him away nor did he trigger any type of alarm.
Yun Jhin told him that he came from a tribe that got annihilated recently when he came back from hunting he saw all his brethren slain, he put on an angry expression and sorrowful expression on his face as he told his story to the guard. The guard understood this could happen everyday, smaller tribes were numerous and they could be annihilated overnight, however, new tribes would spring up and take over their locations this way.
Unlike dragons and phoenixes, tigers could easily mate multiple times and have pure bloodlines, but their blood didn't mix that easily with others so hybrids couldn't normally exist.
After Yun Jhin told his story he was let into the tribe and given a hut, he wasn't given any food as he was told he would have to go hunting tomorrow to get any food, or he could help with farming but up till now, there wasn't any success in that regard, he would also be punished if he failed to make any breakthroughs in farming, after all, they didn't have many seeds left and getting more would be more perilous than hunting.
Yun Jhin decided to go and see what kind of farming the tigers were doing, he almost wanted to laugh out loud when he saw how the tigers farmed, they were obviously muscle brains who only knew how to cultivate, even farming was hard for them!
He watched one tiger hit the ground many times with a hoe and another one using a pickaxe to split open seeds, later he was taken away by the guards, and roars of anger could be heard:
"No, they should grow now that I split them open! Let me go so I can watch them grow!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the remaining intact seeds, he made small holes into the fertile ground below him before putting them inside the ground, then he created spiritual ki water using his own ki and watered the seeds.
It didn't take much time for the seeds to start growing quickly, small leaves popped out of the ground and the other tigers immediately looked at Yun Jhin as if he was a genius of unparalleled intelligence.
He was immediately summoned to the chief of the tribe that asked him:
"Oh, who are you, one so intelligent and wise in the ways of farming?"
Yun Jhin told him a fake name that was normally used for tigers from small tribes:
"My name is Gao Yating."
Most tigers from the small tribes were named Gao, this were the rules of the two stronger tribes, they wouldn't be allowed to have names similar to theirs as this would go against the pride of the strong!
Yun Jhin waited for a response from the chief as he kept his head down in respect, but inside he was sneering and waiting, he was creating new plans that could help him take over the tribe since the tigers were dumb all he had to do was play smart and create his own tribe, creating the third strongest tribe on the planet!

chapters.title: Chapter 126: How to strengthen a faction 101
chapters.content:
The leader of the tribe looked Yun Jhin up and down as he asked:
"So your name is Gao Yating? From your looks it seems you have fought for a long while, you even lost an arm! You must be a strong warrior then. How come you know about farming?"
The question didn't seem to have any tricks in it, the leader was genuinely surprised by Yun Jhin's ability and knowledge of farming.
Yun Jhin decided to make himself look just a little bit more intelligent than normal, this way he would be considered a genius in the white tiger tribe and there was a high chance he could become the advisor of the tribe leader, thus he would be able to control the leader indirectly through his advice.
Yun Jhin decided to explain it shortly:
"I saw the other ways of planting and decided to do differently."
The leader scratched his stubbled chin, he was a man of tall height standing around 2,20 meters, he taller and stronger than Yun Jhin, he wore the normal Uxi-Mammoth skin around his body but his was bigger and had more skins sewn around showing that he killed way more mammoths than the average white tiger.
"You are quite smart... It's been a long while since I have met someone as smart as you, only those in the two top tribes usually have people as smart as you."
"The leaders of the tribes make them something called advesors? I think."
"Would you like to be my advesor? I think with your help our tribe could flourish!"
Yun Jhin seemed to be undecided as he looked at the leader, the leader then came forward and patted him on the back forcefully almost making him fall to the ground:
"You have fought enough, you are also missing your right arm, you can't fight well in this situation, just tell us what to do and if you do well you won't be executed!"
Yun Jhin nodded, finally deciding to take the role of advisor in the tribe, the leader smiled, he thought that he could use Yun Jhin's genius to make his tribe better!
Yun Jhin then decided to tell him how he should act from now on, he should focus on growing the crops according to his instructions, the spiritual food that he planted would bear more seeds and after they could plant all of the seeds into the fertile earth they had, they could continuously grow stronger without any danger, so he could conquer the other tribes after they strengthened their tribe for a longer while, continuously increasing the tribe's size, taking more fertile earth and getting spots where they could farm.
The leader didn't understand the plan that well, after all, his brain wasn't that developed, he only knew how to smash, his brain couldn't handle such type of planning, but he decided to go along with it, while he didn't know how to plan but he knew how to execute.
He made the whole tribe enter closed-door cultivation and with Yun Jhin's help they planet all of the seeds in the earth creating a gigantic garden for special ki food.
It took them almost 2 years before the garden born fruits and vegetables, then with Yun Jhin's distribution they strengthened the people that needed the fruits and vegetables, they used the food they had in reserve to feed the weaker people while the others used the ki in the heaven and earth to survive.
At first, some tribesmen didn't like how Yun Jhin distributed the food and fought him thinking that if they defeated him they could become the new advisors, but they got their ass handed to them by Yun Jhin, and afterward, they shut up.
As Yun Jhin continued with the planting their crops increased in number, there were so many crops that they didn't have any more patches of fertile earth to plant seeds in them. As the amount of food increased so did the average cultivation of the tribe, the leader even increase his cultivation to the 6th stage of the sage realm with the bountiful amount of food they had.
Yun Jhin also increased his cultivation to the 4th stage of the Emperor realm and he was nearing the 5th stage of the Emperor realm, but his body started to gain resistance to the food they currently had, if he wanted to increase his cultivation further he either had to get a different type of food or find the Icy White Tiger pool.
Yun Jhin became the most trusted person in the tribe as he strengthened it whole just by planting and farming. Then it was time for them to increase their tribe's resources and personnel.
They went to war with other tribes that were inside the planet!
Due to the increase in cultivation, the tribe became so strong that they could be ranked in the top 100, thus they got deeper and deeper into the earth as they gained more fertile earth and increase their population by capturing the people they defeated.
Yun Jhin started to different kinds of seeds that he used to plant and farm, years passed as Yun Jhin increased the size of the tribe considerably to the point that the two tribes took notice of the things happening!
Yun Jhin was now around the 6th stage of the Emperor realm and his cultivation couldn't increase anymore from foodstuffs, he now needed the Icy White Tiger pool to increase his cultivation further.
As he fought against different tribesmen and killed them he absorbed almost 45,000 of them in total.
As stated previously the number of white tigers was smaller compared to the other two planets due to their traditions. So even though Yun Jhin captured and killed quite a bit of tribesman from the other tribes, he was only around halfway to the completion of absorptions.
Yun Jhin now wore the best Uxi-mammoth skin and he was the most respected person in the tribe which now had around 100,000 plus members, the other two tribes had around 500,000 tribesmen in total.
The planet was very big but the population was concentrated in one spot due to the low numbers, in total there would be around 2,500,000 people living on the planet, but there were no people below the Emperor realm!
Only the newborn youngsters would be that weak and they would quickly grow strong as time passed if they were talented, if not they would die due to the harsh environment.
At first, Yun Jhin's tribe only had around 500 people in it, from this it could be seen that Yun Jhin worked very hard to create the current tribe, calculating by how many people he absorbed, he had fought up to 200 plus or so wars up till now.
Yun Jhin was currently massaged by the finest women in the tribe, he sat on his big mammoth pet as the other tribe leaders asked him for advice.
Suddenly every shut up as a person entered the building that the tribes and Yun Jhin were in, he was a peak sage realm expert from the two strongest tribes!
Most of the other leaders weren't intimidated by him, with Yun Jhin's help they were all around the peak of the sage realm and some of them even started to feel the laws of the planet approaching them, however, compared to the tribes that each had a peak god realm expert they were still considerably weak.
Yun Jhin just sat on his mammoth pet as he looked down at the envoy from the two strongest tribes and asked:
"Have the two strongest tribes of the planet came to acknowledge our existence?"
The peak sage realm expert started to sweat bullets as all of the other peak sage realm experts used their cultivation to pressure him, he could feel that he was at a big disadvantage here and he would surely die if he offended Yun Jhin here, he bowed and asked:
"My master wanted to confirm one thing, are you the one who helped them to this position Gao Yating?"
Yun Jhin nodded, the peak sage realm had an amiable smile on his face as he asked that question, seeing Yun Jhin nod expanded his smile as he asked:
"My master said that you are welcomed in our tribe, with your strategic mind and high intelligence you could surely help us to defeat the other tribe!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he continued to look down at the envoy, then he said:
"Tell your master that I have no want to join any of the two tribes!"
This put the envoy in a tight situation as he looked around, he could see the leaders that were now pretty much Yun Jhin's subordinates glare at him. At this point, he knew that if he decided to push the invitation he would be attacked.
He bowed again as he left, he continued to go deeper into the core of the planet reaching temperatures over thousand of degrees, other white tigers could be seen lazing around and recovering their bodies riddled with multiple types of injuries.
After he walked for a rather long while, he finally arrived at a gigantic stone door, he kneeled before it before shouting:
"This subordinate is incompetent and I couldn't recruit Gao Yanting!"
A deep voice could be heard coming from behind the door:
"It doesn't matter if he refused you that meant he would refuse the envoy from that old fellow as well, as long as he doesn't join the other party its ok, what do you think about his troops?"
The kneeling man reported:
"His troop strength isn't of a big number but their quality is rather high, they actually have as many peak sage realm experts as we have!"
The voice didn't appear for a short while before a response came:
"I'm still fighting with that old fellow right now and this is only a strand of willpower I left behind, you cannot mess with them while I'm fighting, after I finish the fight with him I will come back and see this Gao Yanting in person!"
The voice didn't appear again as something happened that cut the connection between the strand of willpower and the owner.
The man remained kneeling there for a few hours before he got up and left.
Yun Jhin looked outside the window of his building as he thought:
"The fight between those top god tigers won't end any time soon, but the winner will surely come to me if I don't comply he would take my head, this is good, soon I will complete the absorption of this planet and I can finally move away from this planet as well, from my knowledge the black tortoise planet should also be the easiest..."
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he sat cross-legged on his mammoth pet, his cultivation base was stuck at the 6th stage of the Emperor realm and it couldn't go any higher, he needed the Icy White Tiger pool for that to happen, he already knew what to do when the winner of the fight would come for him, he could increase his cultivation and make them go to war as well, hitting two birds with one stone!
He wasn't sure when the fight would end but he knew that it could be rather soon, after all, he could feel the envoy from the other tribe slowly approaching his building undetected. It seemed the other tribe did things differently...

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Defying expectations
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin sat on his pet mammoth, seemingly cultivating without any worries, the unseen assailant entered the building. As he made his way inside Yun Jhin could easily feel his gaze stopping onto him and analyzing his weak spots. Yun Jhin chuckled, he would like to see what he would do. Was he here as an assassin?
Yun Jhin waited briefly before the man revealed himself to him, he was a young man with a ferocious gaze, he wore similar clothes to Yun Jhin which showed he had a very high standing in the upper tribe. His ferocious gaze moved to Yun Jhin as he shouted:
"Envoy from the Mao tribe has come to ask some questions from the great sage Gao Yating."
The two strongest tribes were respectively named Mao and Hao, the Hao tribesmen already came before and Yun Jhin refused their invitation.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he looked down at the Mao envoy and told him:
"I will tell you what I have told the Hao envoy as well, I have no wish to join your tribes!"
The young man chuckled as he looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and told him:
"You see, my master doesn't like refusals!"
Suddenly he disappeared from the spot he was previously as Yun Jhin saw him appear near his mammoth pet, however, he couldn't go any further. A formation was blocking his path, he collided with the barrier and was repelled, falling backward for a few meters before he got up with a weird look on his face. He didn't understand what he hit as there was nothing there. White tigers were one of the relatively dumber races so they didn't grasp the art of formations at all.
He tried to attack, again and again, hoping to break the barrier and capture Yun Jhin so he could show him to his master, he wanted to use his intelligence and tactical mind to defeat the other tribes' army while the God Realm experts were fighting.
However, he hit a steel plate at this moment, the formation was repelling his attacks while also alerting the peak sage realm experts of Yun Jhin's tribe which immediately arrived to help their tactician.
The young man now sat on the ground bruised and beaten, his nose was bleeding and scars could be seen on his face, one of his arms was unnaturally bent to the side showing that it was broken if you looked closely you could also see one sharp bone popping out of it.
The man howled at Yun Jhin:
"You won't get away with this, my master will surely win and come to capture you himself, you won't be able to do a thing then!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"It's ok, it doesn't matter if someone as strong as your master will truly come to capture me there is nothing I will be able to do, but I have my own pride, how could I let you walk over my head with only being a peak sage realm expert? Go back and tell your master that I will welcome him with open arms when he comes himself."
Yun Jhin's peak sage realm subordinates threw the man outside the building and their village, the man scoffed as he looked at the entrance of the village before he frowned and continued to enter deeper into the planet's core.
He arrived at a different place, there was a small garden where he arrived, it was full of flowers and green trees, you wouldn't even think that beyond the garden existed a fiery location that would burn you to cinders. The young man kneeled in the garden and waited... 1 day... 2 days... 4 days... 1 month...
A shaky voice could be heard coming from the garden as it said:
"I have won... the price I have paid is enough, we shall now combine the tribes!"
An old man with a big red nose and tattoos all over his body appeared, he wore nothing but a red mammoth skin that dripped with blood, his white hair was disheveled and his eyes showed that he had seen better days.
He looked down at the kneeling young man then he unleashed his soul willpower while saying:
"I guess you have failed to recruit that Gao Yanting?"
The young man nodded before he explained what happened during his assault, the old man eyes narrowed as he heard about what happened as he thought:
"Such abilities... since that old fool has got his ass beaten this time around that means if I play my cards well I should be able to engulf his tribe and make it mine, finally creating the strongest tribe on the planet! Unfortunately, my men are incompetent and I cannot attack those people of lower cultivation..."
It wasn't that he couldn't attack them, but his pride was getting in his way of attacking someone of lower cultivation base than him, there was also the chance the Hao patriarch would go crazy and go out of his healing seclusion to fight the death with him, while he could accept the loss against the old man in a 1v1 fight, he wouldn't sit still if his tribesmen would be attacked by him, that would be very dishonorable!
The old man tamed his disheveled hair making it slick and clean before he looked towards the kneeling young man and told him:
"He says he will welcome me with open arms? Then let's see how good he will welcome me then!"
They both disappeared from the verdant garden to appear near the entrance of Yun Jhin's village.
Yun Jhin got up from his pet mammoth, he could feel that the soul willpower of the old ancestor from the Mao tribe was targeting him directly.
He got out of his building and immediately sent word that the patriarch of the Mao tribe was coming!
This sent a stir through the whole tribe, all 100,000 people started to cook and create a gigantic banquet for the man while Yun Jhin went ahead and invited the old man from the entrance to the village.
Yun Jhin was as humble as he could be as he kept his head bowed while he gave the old man the best seat at the banquet table that was hastily erected.
