As long as there weren't any strange changes like the archdevils and demons changing their locations from the 9th layer to the 1st layer he would be able to easily roam Hell and grow stronger with time, there were also lava pools that he could use to increase his cultivation base, unlike the mortal realm that was separated by the galaxy and there were numerous planets around that each had their own planetary pool, Hell was different, there were 9 layers of Hell that could be considered as big as a quarter of the universe each.
Hell's denizens lived like animals on the lower layers as they didn't have any intelligence, the more they ate each other the stronger they became and the more intelligence they acquired, however, that only applied to demons, devils were born with high intelligence and they were all about crafts and plots, they would occasionally make contacts with people from the mortal realm and devour their souls to grow stronger.
Yun Jhin decided to go to Hell to continue increasing his strength, unlike the mortal realm beings that looked strange would be easily overlooked in Hell where every demon had their relatively unique looks.
However, for that, he would need to go through whatever defenses Yuan Fang had left at the blood throne's sect territory, the entrance to hell was very deep inside the territory and he would need to be quick.
Yun Jhin started traveling towards the blood throne sect and arrived there a kit quicker compared to before due to his new body and special wings.
The moment he arrived Yuan Fang got notified of it, of course considering how paranoid he was at this point he could care less who entered the territory even if it was a big caterpillar or not, he actually found the caterpillar to be strange and suspicious so he immediately sent the team of males after it!
Yun Jhin could feel space around him slowly breaking as he entered stealth and started running towards the deeper territory of the sect's ruins.
The males couldn't see or feel Yun Jhin but they immediately started to run around trying to identify the last location of the strange caterpillar, since their master gave them this mission they couldn't fail it like the last one, who knew maybe the caterpillar was Yun Jhin's pet and they could use it to track him back to his hideout!
Yun Jhin could feel that they were randomly using their stealth breaking technique while looking for him but he wasn't scared of them anymore, at most they could be considered annoying at this point, he was able to run away from them when he was at the 5th stage of the Emperor realm and now that he was at the 8th stage combined with his new wings they were already eating his dirt.
The only reason he didn't want to search for treasuries in his territory was that it would take time for him to break formations and then gather the treasure, time in which the location he was in could be found and encircled which would give him some unnecessary trouble, Yun Jhin wasn't sure how Yuan Fang knew about who entered the territory or not unless he connected his soul with the main formation, which meant that he was now the lord of the sect's ruins.
As the lord of the ruins, he could see through anyone that entered the territory in which the ruins existed and he could send himself or someone he wished through a spatial tunnel that would connect to the owner when one becomes the lord of the formation, this way the owner could teleport to the headquarters whenever he wanted, most big shots had this type of ability tied to the formations that protected their headquarters so when the enemies would attack he would always be able to come back even if he left.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked back at the people who were searching for him, the distance between them was getting so great that they started to become little dots in Yun Jhin's senses.
They really couldn't see him? Yun Jhin didn't know it but due to his carapace his stealth technique had increased by quite a lot, the way it reflected light with its azure complexion made his stealth technique evolve once again, combined with the things he stole from Hao Tian his stealth technique could be considered perfect at this point and it's only weakness would be the technique that Yuan Fang created.
As Yun Jhin went deeper into the territory he could see more and more buildings that were still up, some of them even looked only rather old but they weren't broken, he went even further than the main palace as he went to the edges of the territory.
While Yuan Fang could detect who entered and left the territory, due to the state the ruins were in and how old the formation was he couldn't detect Yun Jhin's actual location and he had to send people to search for him blindly, thus with his current stealth capabilities, there wasn't any need for him to fear them unless he stopped in a place for a rather long time.
Yun Jhin could feel the demonic energy of Hell start to seep out of the entrance as he got closer and closer to it, demonic energy was very corrupting to normal people who couldn't cultivate and it could transform them into demonic slaves, they weren't useful or anything, they could be considered residual infected trash that couldn't even be eaten.
Yun Jhin looked at the entrance to Hell, it was a dark door made out of wood, it was inscribed with runes and the runes made an image of two skulls clashing against each other, one of the skulls had two horns protruding from his head and the other had three eyes but they were both human-looking.
Yun Jhin analyzed the skulls for a little as he thought:
"Demons and devils are fighting each other now? It seems the ole demons finally got tired of being fooled by the devils after so much time. Whatever, this will be rather good for me."
Yun Jhin got closer to the entrance and he could feel the demonic energy trying to invade his body, he let it in as his constitution absorbed it without any problems as it strengthened him!
At this point as long as the energy was high quality enough, it didn't matter what kind of peculiarities it had in it, Yun Jhin could absorb it!
The door slowly opened wide as Yun Jhin got closer to it, it was seemingly inviting him to step into Hell.
Yun Jhin took another look behind him and seeing that the male team still couldn't find him he jumped into the entrance without a care in the world, while beasts and strange-looking creatures could hide in hell as long as they acted well enough, humans would be attacked on sight!
As long as a human would enter or someone who had a human-looking form that wasn't bathed in demonic or devilish energy, they would be attacked by everything that existed in Hell!
Yun Jhin could simulate both energies and he looked strange enough as he was, he could just change his outer color to red and no one would bat an eyelid at his looks.
The entrance behind him slowly started to close as he started to fall to Hell, this was just the start of a new journey for him, his journey started since his first reincarnation and this would be his last attempt because if he failed he would die forever!
This was his last journey to Godhood, and he would do it as a caterpillar!

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Hell's layout
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin could feel his whole body as he fell through the entrance towards Hell, he had been multiple times in Hell and he knew what to do in this situation as he braced his body and started to slowly float.
However, as he got closer to the actual surface of Hell he could feel his body growing heavier at a quick speed as he fell faster, Hell's gravity was considerably high compared to the normal environment outside, combined with the immense heat and the random meteorological events that could happen the environment was really adverse for normal people and cultivators who didn't do any kind of body refining.
The gravity in the upper levels of hell wasn't that high, the lower you went the more it increased to the point that those who didn't have a body refining rank of at least 8,000 wouldn't be able to move at all and they would be crushed into a meat paste on the ground if they ever laid their foot in that layer.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as he felt the sulfurous air in hell, even though he just reached the 1st layer at the moment and there wasn't much sulfur in the air and there weren't any lava pools at this level, the air still changed.
Yun Jhin could feel that hell had the same layout as before, however, he didn't know how the factions in Hell had changed, all he knew was that the demons and devils could be considered butting heads now due to the skulls he saw on the entrance.
He changed the color of his carapace to a deep red as it would blend better in hell.
The first layer was mostly populated by newly born devils and demons, demons evolved from demonic beasts and insects while devils were born as small imps with exceeding intelligence, however, their physical prowess could be considered lacking if you compared it even to normal humans, but their souls were exceedingly strong even though they didn't know how to use them properly.
Yun Jhin saw hundreds of thousands of demons fighting and eating each other below him, they were all fighting to the death with crazed looks in their eyes, these were normal events at the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd layers.
In the first layer demons and devils would be born at the 1st stage of the earthly realm and while they couldn't' cultivate, devouring their own kind would rapidly evolve their beings to the point that they could cultivate if they wished to, but it was still faster to devour each other.
The 2nd Hell layer was where things got a little bit more interesting as the devils there got their souls enhanced by cultivating to the 2nd stage, also demons started to gain basic intelligence which meant they could now be fooled by the devils properly.
3rd layer was where they made contact with ki properly, 4th and 5th were the lower bases of society as they were made from high staged ki cultivating devils and demons and very few King Realm experts.
6,7th layers were where things started to get a little more interesting as blood and lava pools would spawn deep inside those layers and they were especially useful at upgrading one's bloodline and cultivation base while refining the body at the same time, they were rare resources that everyone would want.
8,9th layers were where sages and Gods of hell resided, in the 8th layer there were only sages and above and a few lower Gods while the 9th layer had the late stages Gods and the peak Gods of Hell, the most insidious minds and the strongest muscles of Hell lived in the 9th layer plotting or scheming for the time they would invade the mortal realm again, it seemed that the last invasion could be traced shortly after Yun Jhin died.
As he didn't find any more information about Hell's invasion in these 500,000 years of history that he pieced together from absorbing so many memories, he realized that they must have invaded shortly after his death, after all, he could be considered one of the stronger supporters of the mortal realm despite his evil alignment, while he would do what was considered evil he didn't want to share his piece of the pie with anyone else so he would defend the mortal realm when in need while also trying to make some profit on the side. Yun Jhin wasn't that evil technically speaking from the view of the cultivation world, he was just really honest because most cultivators would the same things as him but plaster righteous faces the moment they did so.
Take for example the fortuned ones, if someone absorbed a person they would say he was evil, but if he killed and absorbed the person who did that it would be justice from the heavens while all they did was continue the cycle of killing, in the end, they weren't much different from the first person.
Yun Jhin didn't need to loiter in the first hells as absorbing these lowly demons and devils wouldn't help him at all, he started to quickly fly away going deeper into the layer, the first layer was basically a wasteland and there wasn't much lava or anything around as it was very close to the surface, the demons and devils were spawned from the surrounding demonic ki that came from the lower layers.
As Yun Jhin went further into the layer he finally found the entrance to the second hell which wasn't much different to the one of the actual hell, he quickly entered it and started falling deeper into Hell as he went to the 2nd layer.
Similar things happened in the second layer, demons fought demons, and devils now started to bewitch and try to fool the dumb demons to absorb their souls or eat their flesh.
As Yun Jhin flew through the place his eyes started to shine as he looked at a small imp that was crouching on the ground while putting both of his hands over his head, the imp was rather short being only 1,35 meters he had a moderate-sized belly and wore no clothes, he had a short spiky tail growing from his tailbone, he had two small horns protruding from his head and two white slitted eyes, around his eyes were two dark circles and he seemed to be scared of what was going around him.
The moment one demon approached him he immediately cowered and started to dig seemingly afraid and ready to run away but the moment the demon jumped on him to eat him a dagger appeared from his rather portly stomach and he stabbed it into the head of the demon before he quickly started to feast.
Yun Jhin found this imp to be quite peculiar, imps were the starting form of the devils and he could feel that his intelligence was very high, considering he was in the 2nd layer the devil should have been in the heavenly realm but surprisingly he was in the lower stages of the earthly realm, and due to his wits he was quickly increasing his cultivation right now!
"Could he be a reincarnated one? Or is he special? I need to get closer to him... maybe he could be useful."
Yun Jhin didn't have a disciple that he could call his own in a very long time, all of his disciples and offsprings disappointed him sorely and unfortunately for him, they also learned from his paranoia and they would look out for him backstabbing them, thus they weren't always on good terms with each other.
Yun Jhin's body disappeared as he used his stealth technique and followed the little imp around trying to see what he would do next, he was interested in the imp's intelligence and craftiness, it reminded him of his first lives.
As Yun Jhin watched the imp going at his business killing and eating he could see his belly getting bigger and bigger, the imp started laughing showing his sharp saw-like teeth, after he filled his belly well enough he dug a deep hole and entered it before he covered it into a layer of dirt, he was closer to the battlefield but no one seemed to see his hiding!
"Hmm? a rudimentary stealth formation?"
"This really got interesting."
Yun Jhin flew down to the hole and caught the imp by the shoulders like a hawk would do to a rabbit before flying away at speeds so fast no one even saw what happened.
The imp cried out in surprise and fear as he felt his shoulders being caught by something strong, when he looked up and saw Yun Jhin's form he blacked out with foam at his mouth due to fear.
Yun Jhin chuckled seeing his reaction, it seemed he wasn't a reincarnated one but was very talented, this was better for him as reincarnated ones were harder to control due to their former lives memories unlocking themselves as time passed and they could scheme against you if you didn't control them properly.
Yun Jhin landed near the entrance to the third layer and woke up the imp, when the imp saw Yun Jhin's form again he fell to the ground and started to back away in fear as he fell to his knees and started to speak in Hell's language:
"Oh please great devil spare me! I'm just a lower imp, I'm just trying to survive!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he approached the Imp and put one of his small feet on his forehead imparting to him a cultivation technique he could use later in life while also giving him some more experience in scheming.
The imp started to kowtow to Yun Jhin as if he was his father while tears dripped from his big eyes, Yun Jhin knew they were all fake but with the knowledge, he also inserted a soul controlling symbol into his soul, because he was so low in his cultivation the symbol will evolve along with his soul and he would always be in Yun Jhin's control.
Yun Jhin nodded as he looked at his protruding belly and said:
"You should evolve soon, at the time you would have broken through the heavenly realm 2nd or 3rd stage and I think you should be able to fight in the 3rd layer, that's why I helped you here, I will be waiting for you further down in hell, I hope you will be able to find me, also here take this."
Yun Jhin gave him a bit of his energy that he could use to summon him later when he entered deeper into the layers.
Yun Jhin flew into the next entry as the gravity around him increased in intensity.
Yun Jhin could see the imp smiling and doing a small dance as he watched him go down in the third layer, Yun Jhin chuckled maybe he would be one of the next paragons of Hell?
Yun Jhin flew deeper and deeper inside Hell as he went through the 4th, 5th, and 6th layers in one go.
As he went deeper into hell he actually had to start fighting as each Demon and devil had unique abilities that made them sensitive to stealth, not everyone got them but especially stronger ones did.
However, considering in which layer he was he easily dispatched them, his target was the 7th layer where the strongest people would be sages around the 2nd or 3rd stage!
Yun Jhin reached the 7th layer after a long while of traveling through hell, unfortunately, he didn't find any pools in the former layers as they were all mostly used and he couldn't go through the whole layer for a pool of low quantity, only from the 7th layer and above one could find the truly good stuff, especially since his cultivation agreed with the environment in hell, actually, the celestial energy that was slowly unfolding in his body was like Yang and the demonic energy in hell was like Yin, if he could combine them properly he could strengthen his body without the need of the pools.
After he reached the 7th layer he decided to find a secluded place where he could cultivate as the demonic energy reached a higher concentration.
As the intelligence of demons and devils increased they started to create societies and sects just like normal people, the 7th layer was full of such places but Yun Jhin didn't want to go towards the populated places yet if his identity was revealed or his blood was seen through he would be attacked by the whole layer, not because he was someone that they would hate, but due to how nutritious and treasure-like his body was!
If they ate him they would skip an evolution and reach the peak of the Sage Realm as long as they were in the Emperor Realm or above, they would also gain a Ying-Yang Celestial-Demonic Physique.
Yun Jhin entered Hell to escape from such a situation of being eaten, and it would be easier to do so in here because the cultivation base of the higher echelons was restricted per layer, but he still needed to not attract much attention if words got to the top dogs of the 9th layer things won't end up for him.

chapters.title: Chapter 142: 7th layer of Hell
chapters.content:
The 7th layer of Hell was the third most expansive place in Hell, as Yun Jhin went down into Hell the layers became bigger and bigger, in total it took him around 10 months to reach the 7th layer and that was because he knew the location of the entrances to the layers if it was someone else it would have taken them years to travel between layers alone!
Yun Jhin could feel that the 7th layer was pretty different than what he remembered it when he last visited Hell, everywhere was an aura of conflict more than usual, as the number of the layers increased the open aggression decreased because of the demons and devils increasing intelligence.
However, the aggression was pretty open around here as Yun Jhin could see some of the demons fighting it out in the open with some devils, even though demons weren't good at plans or schemes they wouldn't be as easily provoked as when they were dumbed around here.
Yun Jhin frowned as he watched from above and kept himself hidden, he hoped to get some information from them to see what changed in Hell while he was reincarnating:
"OFF WITH THE HEADS OF THE DEVILS IN THE NAME OF THE TRI-HORNED MASTER Bujkil Rampel!"
The devils scoffed seeing the charging demons who were attacking the orders of a tall demon with a dark face and blue body, he was muscular and naked but no genitals could be seen around his body.
He had a mane full of dirty blood and his face was as ugly as it could get, full of scars, his nose was cut off and he had piercings on his remaining uncut skin.
The devils could be considered pretty beings as the succubuses also evolved from the normal imps, the devil who instigated this fight between them was a pale man with blonde hair and pale pupilless eyes, he had big claws on both hands and wore a red velvet suit that made his whole body unseeable.
They were both at the 1st stage of the sage realm.
The leaders glared at each other while the underlings fought it down below as they shouted:
"GLORY TO LORD RAMPEL!"
The devils finally had enough of the demons' noisiness and decided to chant a curse technique that they aimed at their heads immediately lowering their already below-average intelligence even further.
However, that didn't affect the demons pretty much, they only attacked with more fervor as their eyes turned a deep red color!
The devils easily swayed through their attacks even though they attacked quicker and with more strength, their power might have increased but their minds were clouded and they couldn't fight properly unlike the smart devils. That didn't mean there weren't any devils that didn't get cut down during the attack, however, compared to the casualties of the demons they were unnoticeable.
Yun Jhin could feel that the hatred that came from both parties was because of their leaders, Yun Jhin didn't recognize the name of Bujkil Rampel and that meant he wasn't an oldie from Yun Jhin's era, nor was he a reincarnated ones, normally when a reincarnated one reaches the peak of his cultivation he likes to use his first name.
Yun Jhin frowned as he concentrated on what the devils muttered:
"This damn trashes, Lord Vanzuel really put us in this much trouble because he found that item in the 9th layer at the same time with Lord Rampel..."
It seemed devils understood more of the story, unlike the demons who listened 3 times and forgot what they heard 2.5 times.
Yun Jhin cloaked form slowly made its way towards the back of the devil's formation as he absorbed 4 or 5 of them as he gained the knowledge of the happenings in the 7th hell and above.
It seemed Lord Vanzuel and Lord Rampel found an item with a high amount of demonic energy concentrated in it and fought for ownership since they found it however, the other archdevils and demons found out about it as well but because these two lords were relative newbies in the 9th layer the others didn't covet their item as it would be useless to them, thus their factions in the below layers were made to fight and the faction who won would get 10% of the item and the rest will go to the lord who won.
Yun Jhin felt that this was the doing of Hell's will, Hell didn't like God Realm experts to fight inside it so it restricted them with rules and regulations, those rules and regulations didn't affect those below the God Realm but those above the God Realm had to stick to them or they would be punished, Hell unlike the mortal realm had a separate consciousness.
The consciousness wouldn't interfere much in anything as it was an amalgamation of pieces of souls of the former God Realm experts who either died or reincarnated and they didn't want Hell to get attacked while they were infighting, it was strange considering Hell was always the one doing invasions but they were always panicky about one.
Yun Jhin already disappeared from the small battlefield as he only took a look because he was nearby, that he knew what the conflict was about he was interested why would the heads of these two faction leaders who were not very high in ranking compared to the other Gods on the entrances to the layers and the one to hell.
Yun Jhin had one speculation about why their faces were on the entrances., they might be the young masters who needed to be groomed in the next lords of demons and devils, that was the most likely explanation, as the door would be inscribed with the faces of the lords, or the strongest persons in hell.
Yun Jhin finally found a secluded corner where there weren't any visible demon or devils that could attack him or disturb his cultivation, he needed to cultivate to the 9th stage and see what type of bloodline ability he would get, as a celestial caterpillar, albeit even a fake one he still needed to keep his mind open to the possibility of a very strong ability!
Yun Jhin started to dig into the ground as he made a small cave for him to work in and then went to work.
Hell's demonic energy started to converge around his body entering it and cleansing his ki pathways, his body was resisting the increased gravity with all it's got, and combined with the energy that was slowly coursing through his whole body, he was slowly getting stronger again!
Yun Jhin could feel the celestial energy in his body rejecting the demonic energy as if it was it's biggest enemy as it started to attack it with ferocity, he frowned as he felt a sweet aftertaste coming to his throat and ready to leave his 'mouth' but he continued cultivating as he tamed his celestial energy and tried to intertwine the celestial and demonic energy together.
Celestial energy was just like a proud woman who wouldn't let herself be conquered by any common man while the demonic energy was like a bum who wanted to eat swan meat, they didn't match at all.
However, Yun Jhin knew that the appearance of the bum was only a disguise as beneath it was a rich CEO!
As Yun Jhin ground through the demonic energy he purified it even further allowing it to be accepted by the celestial energy, Yun Jhin's body started to grow slowly as his cultivation inched towards the 9th stage of the Emperor realm and his body refining rate reaching the early 9,500s.
Yun Jhin breathed in and out as his body expanded and his cultivation increased accordingly, he could feel that the benefits coming from this type of cultivation would be able to lead him to enter the sage realm without the need of any special pools, but making advances would need the energy of the pools or him entering further down in Hell, where there was more high-quality demonic energy.
Yun Jhin could feel the newly created energy seeping into his blood and awakening the innate runes that laid in there!
Those runes were black and unresponsive and they should naturally have grown and cultivated some energy in them by now but due to Yun Jhin not being a true celestial caterpillar, it was unlikely he would get to activate any of them until the God Realm, fortunately, the 9th stage of the Emperor realm was specialized in bloodline awakening.
His azure blood started to boil as the energy entered it and started to fill the runes, they started to light up with crepuscular blue energy that made Yun Jhin's body compress to a stage of being around 1,75 meters but his physical strength increased even further as his body refining reached the 9,700th rank.
He could slowly feel that he was ready to awaken his bloodline ability and reach the 9th stage of the Emperor realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 143: Overpowered bloodline ability
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's body started squirming as his blood heated up constantly due to the continuous increase of demonic ki that went into the bloodline runes.
He could feel the heat traveling through his whole body quickly assimilating something that he didn't fully understand.
His body started to shed one layer, two layers, three layers of skin!
His body was getting enhanced at the same time as his bloodline ability was appearing!
He could feel his body's rank shooting up reaching 9,900 in one shot after he shed those layers of skin.
Also, his ki cultivation was slowly inching towards the 9th stage and the awakening of his bloodline ability was almost there!
Finally, after a while his bloodline runes were filled up with energy and his hot blood stopped rushing through his body at high speeds, it returned to its normal circulation pattern as Yun Jhin's head cooled down and he felt some foreign language and a technique was inserted in his soul from his blood.
"This technique... it's certainly worthy for the celestial bloodline!"
Yun Jhin got out of the ground as he used the technique for the first time, his body sprang up as his thick muscles started to multiply over his body, his bloodline aura intensified slowly overtime as everything around him started to get crushed and absorbed towards him at the same time!
Whatever was getting near him, either it being the surrounding demonic ki or the earth was being absorbed and crushed in his body at the same time.
This was an advanced predatory technique of the celestial caterpillars, while they were omnivores and didn't enjoy eating meat when they had to evolve into the butterfly form they would need to unleash a massacre to gain enough energy to evolve, or they could find a very rare herb but from the knowledge, he gained from the technique most celestial caterpillars would hunt instead of going to search for flowers.
Yun Jhin's technique was basically the gravity of a planet combined with an absorption technique that would make all the energy from the one he crushed and absorbed be fully his!
It was a technique with no weaknesses as it couldn't be disrupted unless he was killed, even if his head was severed and there was still a bit of life force in him, he could use the technique to recover!
Any energy that he didn't need could be used to heal his body continuously and that would consist of any energy he absorbed!
The technique worked up his blue cells so that they could increase his healing factor by 500%, this would exhaust his energy quite fast if he got any type of energy but as long as there were people around he could absorb there wouldn't be any problems.
This was a technique best used when he was besieged or when he ran wild in a crowd, at least the healing part, or it could also be used for extending a fight, if Yun Jhin fought someone that injured him he could rampage on his subordinates recover and wear the person down.
Considering the situation in hell this was a very good technique to have.
Yun Jhin frowned as he remembered about the situation in Hell, everything seemed rather similar to all of the places he had been up to now, they were all in conflict! If you excluded the Brilliance Radiance and Light sect who were living like gangsters and didn't have any problems, the universe was currently in turmoil!
The universe was never a peaceful place but there were too many coincidences, how come those two arch lords have found the treasure around the same time he wanted to enter hell?
As for the other situations they have been slowly unveiled by Yun Jhin but he still felt something was fishy in those regards as well, were the people from the Brilliance Radiance and Light such pussies that they were content only with the black tortoises? From what Yun Jhin knew their greed knew no bounds, were they that injured? Doubtful. Then why would they let the other three planets alone when they were still infighting before Yun Jhin came around?
Yun Jhin wasn't sure about many things even though he reincarnated so many times, he didn't know where the system came from but he accepted it because it was useful to him, but now he started to doubt the origins of the system, could a powerhouse above the God Realm look out for him?
He didn't know how the powerhouses above the God Realm worked or what they were supposed to do after they rose above that boundary but he was sure that there wasn't just one person who achieved this, maybe they controlled and restrained each other and the person which gave him the system didn't like that anymore? Maybe he wanted to break the balance?
Yun Jhin knew that he was being used but there wasn't much he could do in this situation either, he was solely depending on the system to evolve, evolution was a thing that needed time and work, it couldn't be done so quickly just by devouring other people, Yun Jhin knew because he had tried many times in his former lives to achieve evolution but he failed every time until he gave up, he tried with experiments both on the living and dead, on souls and his own families, but every time he made a result, that result would be found to be untrue or temporary.
Yun Jhin felt that the system was a boon to him but unfortunately he couldn't learn anything from it no matter how many times he evolved! He did recognize some patterns on evolution as he scanned his insides changing with his soul but they were so quick that he couldn't truly grasp them properly.
Could the person who gave him the system made it so he wouldn't be able to grasp evolution himself so he wouldn't ditch the system?
Yun Jhin realized that things went a little bit further down the rabbit hole than he knew but he had ignored everything up till now due to his concern of achieving a form that could evolve above the God Realm, now that he had it he could think about things a little bit more clearly than before, and what he realized didn't make him happy at all.
Yun Jhin's muscled body started to fly as it unconsciously absorbed both demonic and celestial ki at the same time, now that he was at the 9th stage of the Emperor realm, his body needed an immense amount of ki of high quality to create an avatar to enter the sage realm.
Yun Jhin looked around, he didn't need any ki pools for the time being as with a little bit of time he would get enough ki to create his avatar, but he could also rush the process to the point that it wouldn't take him more than a few months to breakthrough. But at this point his cultivation and age didn't match at all, he was barely around 100 years by now and the average Emperor at the 9th stage was around 25 to 50 thousand years old.
Only really talented ones could reach such heights at 10,000 years, but Yun Jhin rushed his cultivation a lot, combined with the fact that his body was continuously evolving at the same time made him special in more than one point. Surprisingly Yun Jhin found that his cultivation base didn't have any problems even though he rushed through his cultivation by quite a bit. Could these be the effects of the celestial caterpillar body or the system's working on his evolutions?
Yun Jhin sighed as he tried to find some forms of society, he needed to infiltrate it and gain some more intel, the devils he absorbed back then only knew the surface information that every soldier in the devil army knew, he needed to absorb some higher-ups!
Now that he was at the 9th stage, combined with his new bloodline ability he should be able to easily fight a common 5th stage sage realm expert.
The society in hell was based on strength, this type of hierarchy was pretty normal as everyone thought that the one with harder fists would rule, but in hell, this applied even further, you wouldn't be allowed to exist if you were weak! In other situations, righteous people would say that the weak should be spared but being weak in hell was sin! Regardless if you had treasures on you or not, just your existence would be a sin!
Yun Jhin was currently in the 7th layer and his cultivation base was strong even among upper echelons as the strongest person in this layer was at the 2nd or 3rd stage, the moment devils or demons saw him they would keep their heads down unless they were provoked, they couldn't truly recognize if he was a demon or devil nor which faction he belonged to so instead of provoking him randomly they would keep their heads down and report to their superiors about him.
Yun Jhin knew that if he made himself visible to these people the higher-ups would surely flock to him, but at this point he could pick a faction and say he belonged to it, then help the other faction, helping the demons would mean no ties as the demons were dumb and they would believe him.
However, helping the devils meant he had to deal with people such as him, there was a chance he could make a bigger payout if he played his cards well but there was also a high chance he would be betrayed after the job was done.
Yun Jhin could feel that he was followed by a demon and devil and found it to be pretty weird, people from opposite factions were following him? Demons and devils were easy to identify if you were being tailed, the demon's aura was wild and they couldn't hide it properly, while the devil's aura was oily and it felt like you were being watched by a snake if a devil targeted you.
His body disappeared as he used his stealth technique which made the party of two fluster as they appeared and looked around seemingly searching for him.
Yun Jhin appeared above them as he used his aura to crush both of them in the 7th layer's ground, he looked at them both and analyzed their auras, they were both at the 1st stage of the sage realm and it seemed they broke through recently, the demon's muscles were currently bulging as he tried to resist the aura, the devil was a ravishing succubus that gave Yun Jhin some watery eyes trying to seduce him.
Yun Jhin snorted as he said:
"Why are the two of you following me? And what's up with the two of you being together?"
The succubus tried to move her body to accentuate her big cleavage but Yun Jhin's aura pressed her to the ground so hard she couldn't move at all.
So she took a big gulp making her chest bounce up and down as she said:
"I only arrived at the same time as that big lug over there, our soldiers saw you and my master told me to bring you to the city, he said that you would make a great general, and seeing that you are recently ascended from the lower layers means that you don't know much about the whole situation in Hell."
Yun Jhin waited for the big blue demon that was currently being crushed into the ground say his two-bits as well:
"Urugual thinks you look strong!"
It seemed this demon didn't improve his intelligence much even though he had been through so many cultivation realms, but it was normal for most demons, only the more talented ones would be able to improve their intelligence and strength at the same time.
"Urugual's master said that if I see strong newcomer, Me should bring him over for a clobbering introduction!"
Since Yun Jhin's appearance was strange as if he wasn't a demon nor a devil at the first glance both parties tried to scout him out, this was the perfect opportunity to get more intelligence without alerting the other layers, he could infiltrate their outposts and gain the intelligence he needed...
Yun Jhin frowned, this was a little bit too familiar, something strange was going on as if he was led by the nose directly to a trap, his intuition told him something was wrong with this but he didn't know what, could Yuan Fang's arm reach into Hell at this point, or who else would give him such a dangerous feeling?

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Uncovered danger
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin could feel something was fishy the moment a demon and devil were spying on him without attacking each other, they almost looked to be familiar with each other!
Yun Jhin was almost certain these two people worked for the same person.
The succubus and the demon didn't feel well under Yun Jhin's gravity force field, as they were already under higher gravity in the 7th layer, Yun Jhin's field didn't do simple addition to the gravity that surrounded them, but a multiplication!
It was a miracle they weren't squashed into meat paste, up till now but they both had high body refinery rank.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked at them resisting the gravity, he wondered how much could they endure?
x20, x50, x100!
Their bones started to crack is they were made from dry branches and Yun Jhin realized that he went a little bit overboard, he still needed to question them.
Yun Jhin didn't say anything as he suddenly increased the gravity which made the duo scream in pain and questions him:
"Why are you doing this!"
They were both scared as they realized that Yun Jhin wasn't a fool!
Yun Jhin would have given them a smile at this question if he had lips but he just snorted and said:
"You should understand why I did it."
Yun Jhin's words could be interpreted in many ways thus the duo didn't know what to respond, what if they said something wrong and revealed their intentions?
Thus they kept their mouths quiet and kept enduring, however, their blood vessels could be seen being crushed under their skin, the succubus big mounds started to sag as the increased gravity put a lot of stress on them.
The succubus cried out in both physical and mental pain, her boobs were the source of her food and while her body was certainly sexy she would lose a lot of charm if her boobs became saggy like an old grandma's.
The demon looked weirdly at the succubus, why was she caring about her boobs in this situation? They were both being crushed to death!
The blue demon knew that if spilled the beans he would live so he opened his mouth to talk:
"Ok, ok, Me tell you, stop stop!"
Yun Jhin lifted some of the gravity letting the man breathe properly and then he spilled everything he knew.
"Lord Garvolo Sandro is the leader of demons in this layer, he is at the 3rd stage of the sage realm, he told I should go and trap any strong newbies coming from the 6th layer so they would be conscripted in the army."
Yun Jhin looked towards the succubus and she nodded fervently thinking that his gaze meant if she had the same story as him.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he looked at them, the demon wasn't lying, he would have known, but he still felt that this wasn't the whole story, there was also the fact that Yuan Fang knew he went into hell but not his current aura or appearance, were these two really Yuan Fang's people or was he just getting really paranoid at this point due to his senses going haywire?
Yun Jhin activated his new bloodline ability attracting the duo into his body, they screamed as they were devoured by Yun Jhin didn't care as he went through his memories, suddenly a splitting head-ache came from his skull as he started to roll on the ground, a message came into his mind:
"I knew you couldn't stop yourself from devouring would you Yun Jhin?"
It was Yuan Fang's voice and Yun Jhin could feel as his soul willpower tried to pierce through his defenses and injure his memory core to steal some of his memories, Yun Jhin laughed as he started contesting with the strand of willpower easily overpowering it and crushing it out of existence.
He could feel that a small trace was left inside the soul space that he needed to get rid of, he frowned, it seemed from the memories of the duo they were both marked by Yuan Fang in the 1st layer where they were given cultivation techniques and helped by him, they were just like the little imp he helped back then, people with potential.
And just like he did, Yuan Fang inserted a mind-controlling seed into the core of their souls while giving them instructions on what they should do telepathically, they got some orders sometime before he entered hell which gave them his former appearance and aura and also told them to be vigilant of any weird looking demon or devil that entered the 7th layer that was around the peak of the Emperor realm.
Yun Jhin didn't think that Yuan Fang would do such things as he always preached about justice and righteousness even at the moment his head and soul were severed from his body, it seems he changed to the point that Yun Jhin found his plans and techniques to be as exquisite as his!
Yun Jhin didn't fear anyone in this universe, he was cautious against some people but Yuan Fang started to inspire some fear into him!
He frowned, if a person like Yuan Fang gained his ruthlessness he would be basically unstoppable!
Yun Jhin was pretty envious of his gifts, if Yun Jhin's talents were 95 then Yuan Fang's were 100!
The thing was that a quality difference would be between 95-100 range, every increase from 95 would be so big that the difference would be enormous, Yun Jhin could only close the gap with his enormous experience but if Yuan Fang gained the same amount of experience as him, he could only dance on his palm in a front on confrontation!
He knew some of Yuan Fang's weaknesses but they should have been mended after his first reincarnation, he also had connections everywhere in this life and Yun Jhin didn't know much about his current situation to see if he had any more weaknesses.
Things weren't good for Yun Jhin as he started to roam the 7th layer randomly while expunging the mark that was left in his soul space, he knew the mark was supposed to be used to track his location and Yun Jhin didn't know how many servants Yuan Fang had in hell, but he didn't want to find out this way!
Yun Jhin could feel the eyes following him disappear as soon as the last remaining energy of the mark was destroyed, he sighed as he felt that he made a mistake allowing himself to be seen, he would need to be under stealth during his whole duration in hell!
For now, he would have to search for a pool to quicken his cultivation, he realized that he had to act quick even in hell after the things that happened.
Now that he had to hasten his search for the pool he would have to go deeper into the 7th layer, every layer had an entrance that went below or above, but the layer itself was very big and it could spawn a lot of treasures.
Yun Jhin knew the characteristics of a demonic pool of energy but finding them was a different thing, most of the known ones were monopolized by the strong families of the layer and while none of them would pose a problem to the current Yun Jhin, he was a little bit cautious due to Yuan Fang's doing, it was ok if he had people in the 7th layer, but what if his actions triggered his people of the 8th layer?
Most of the time demons and devils wouldn't interfere with the conflicts in different layers but if they were Yuan Fang's people they would surely report back to him and even come to investigate themselves, he could deal with those at the 5th stage but what those above? All he could do was endure and flee but he couldn't defeat them which annoyed him a great deal, he would have just went on a rampage in the 7th layer if Yuan Fang didn't have many people in hell.
It seemed he would have to search for his own energy for now...
***************************
Yuan Fang was currently wiping his hands and mouth with a clean napkin, there were some green splatters on his hands and at the corners of his mouth, Xing'er stood before him horrified as she looked at him with a strange look on her face, she didn't know he was going to use the nature spirits for this reason!
Behind him a few of his people were doing the same things as him, they were all tall and had an imposing aura around them, they weren't the same males from before, they were all very strong around the 5th stage of the sage realm and above, some of them even had a stronger aura than Yuan Fang!
Xing'er eyes were shaking as he got closer to Yuan Fang and she asked:
"This... this..."
Yuan Fang smiled as he patted her head and ruffled her hair as he told her:
"It's ok, I actually love you, I didn't tell you what we would do with the nature spirits because your father wouldn't have given them to us if he knew, you know that you can't keep your mouth shut around your family, anyways we have to go now."
Xing'er murmured:
"So this is why the father three looked at you like that every time you were in his presence, he had seen through your intentions..."
Yuan Fang shook his head as he told her:
"The nature spirits have a bad life with your people, all I did was liberate them from their suffering while they helped us achieve the body refining rank that we needed, in the future, you will thank me for this, what if I and my people ate their hearts?"
While elves didn't really care about the lives of nature spirits, in general, the father and mother trees would have big control over elves and they loved nature spirits as they were their darlings, now that Yuan Fang and his men were marked by the death of the nature spirits they could feel that the father tree which was sent to sleep multiple times was now waking up again!
Yuan Fang shook his head as he looked towards the back and talked with a tall man who had his hair done in a wild ponytail, he wore a strange blue battle armor inscribed with runes of different colors, he also had a bone necklace around his neck and a monkey tail was hanging around his back showing that he wasn't human.
The man nodded without saying anything as he made everyone approach him and then put two fingers on his forehead, he was ready to launch them away from the planet!
Yuan Fang looked towards Xing'er who was slowly backing away from them before asking:
"Want to come with us?"
Xing'er eyes started to change as they turned a deep green, her pupils disappearing as an ancient voice came out of her mouth:
"Killing so many children, twisting the minds of others and now you want this one to go with you?"
"QUIT DREAMING!"
Xing'er's body exploded into a blast of gore that hit Yuan Fang head-on, his robe was now dirtied with green blood and his eyes glazed over as he looked at his 'love' dying.
He shook his head as another memory appeared in front of his mind when he saw her dying and he disappeared along with the others as he muttered:
"Just like back then with Yun Jhin... unfortunately, I cannot go to Hell due to this body.."
*******************************
Yun Jhin knew someone was talking about him, did Yuan Fang get news about his location?
He shook his head, it didn't matter anymore at this point, he looked around as he felt the energy of a demonic pool quickly growing nearer to him, he avoided the public ones and tried to find one that wasn't claimed by anyone but that was easier said than done, finally, after 3 years of searching, he found a lead and was getting near it.
In these three years, his cultivation didn't stagnate but he was only around 65% there to the condensation of the avatar.
The demonic energy pool would let him quickly condense his avatar and break through the sage realm while also strengthening it a big deal!
Yun Jhin frowned as he got closer to the location of the demonic pool, in his senses he could already feel other people near it!

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Paranoia
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin could feel something wasn't right in this situation, the further one went into hell the higher the gravity and the more adverse the environment was. Yun Jhin was pretty deep in the 7th layer at the moment and very few people could travel this far, and those few people were the ones in leadership positions who couldn't travel due to the ongoing war between factions!
So how could these people be here?
Yun Jhin used his stealth technique as he glided towards the location of the demonic pool to hear if the two people talked or not.
He could hear rough breathing coming from the pool as he guessed what the duo was doing, he got closer to observe and saw a succubus and a devil going at it without any restraints.
Yun Jhin frowned as he watched them go at it for 6 days straight before the devil got bored and stopped their 'interaction'.
Yun Jhin could care less about what he saw, he was very annoyed cause he had to wait for them to talk after they finished their marathon, he was pretty paranoid right now, what if they were Yuan Fang's people?
He frowned as he waited for them to say anything but all they did was gaze at each other seemingly reminiscing of the time they had before, Yun Jhin was already getting annoyed but he stood there without moving, he already learned his lesson, what would happen if he killed them, absorbed their souls and had his location found out again?
That was the last thing he wanted right now.
The male devil finally got closer to the woman and whispered something in her ear:
"It seems we aren't alone darling."
The succubus giggled as he put her hand near her mouth, Yun Jhin frowned, he could hear them and he understood that they must have felt that they were being watched!
But that was impossible... with his current stealth attainments only someone way stronger than him would be able to look through his technique, and those people should be impossible to find in the 7th layer!
Was his stealth technique failing him at this point or were these people just really impressive?
Suddenly the devil appeared near Yun Jhin's location and sniffed the air but he frowned as he felt that Yun Jhin wasn't actually there, the devil looked around and tried to find his actual location but he failed, it seemed he knew that someone was here but he didn't know who Yun Jhin was or his exact location.
Yun Jhin frowned seeing him getting close to him only for him to fail to locate him, could the male devil have a special ability that broke through stealth? It was possible, each demon and devil had one special technique they were born with and it evolved accordingly as they ate and evolved.
Only Yun Jhin was lucky enough to find this duo in the demonic pool he hardly found and one of them had a stealth breaking technique, fortunately, unlike Yuan Fang's technique which made him reveal himself, this technique seemed innate and couldn't be taught, however, if this guy's innate talents were combined with the stealth breaking technique of Yuan Fang he wouldn't be able to use stealth properly at all anymore!
The ability to locate the general direction of the person in stealth combined with the ability to break stealth was a thing that would destroy Yun Jhin's current escaping abilities, he had his secret techniques but he didn't want to rely on them for escaping from small fries.
Yun Jhin suddenly revealed himself as an immense gravity field made the male devil flop to the floor like a fish out of water, he could barely move his hands even though his aura identified him as a powerhouse at the 3rd stage of the sage realm, the man tried to activate his avatar but it didn't budge away from his body as it was sealed there tightly by Yun Jhin's gravity.
The succubus tried to run away, only for Yun Jhin to flicker near her with the male devil in tow putting her face in the ground as well.
Yun Jhin looked at the duo and asked:
"Who are you working for?"
The male devil laughed as he tried to spit at Yun Jhin only for the spit to deviate and hit himself in the head due to the gravity field, the male's face looked as red as it could be even though his skin was purple.
The succubus swallowed a laugh as she looked at the male devil's situation and tried to use her seduction skill on Yun Jhin, even though Yun Jhin wasn't humanoid devils and demons all still retained their base instincts even when they had no intelligent capability, so she thought she could charm him.
Yun Jhin ignored the succubus shamelessly trying to put her breasts up as he looked at the male devil and started to apply more gravitational pressure on him.
The devil frowned as he felt his bones crack and his blood vessels strain due to the increased gravity, if things went like this his body would explode soon!
The male devil immediately looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and said:
"Ok, ok, I'm going to tell, stop the gravity!"
Most devils were cowards when it came to torture and Yun Jhin's methods could even break the sturdy demonic form.
The devil immediately started to explain how he was banished from the 8th layer from his sect so he took his slave girl away with him and descended to the 7th layer, here he luckily found this demonic pool, and with the use of dual cultivation he broke through to the 3rd stage of the sage realm, it seemed the devil was born in the 8th layer and his cultivation talent was sub-par in his sect thus after he reached a certain age and didn't have any good results in cultivation he was banished to the lower layer, it was normal, most demonic creatures in the 8th layer were at the middle sage realm or above, some of them even reached the God Realm.
While the man didn't seem to be lying to Yun Jhin, that didn't mean he was telling the whole story either, so Yun Jhin asked him a question:
"Yuan Fang, does this name mean anything to you?"
The male looked puzzled for a good while before he shook his head indicating that he didn't know anything about a man known as Yuan Fang. Yun Jhin sighed, it seemed his paranoia was getting a hold of him more than he wanted it to, but if he didn't have his paranoia who knew when he would be hit in the back of the head by Yuan Fang?
Yun Jhin decided to give the duo a chance to live as he told them they could live if they both swore to become his loyal servants, the succubus was shameless and immediately swore first while also getting near Yun Jhin and putting her butt up to the sky waiting for his big form to claim her.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he slapped her away, making the relatively big surface jiggle as he fell to the male devil, the male devil gritted his teeth for some time before he used his blood to swear as well.
Then Yun Jhin let them go and instructed them to infiltrate the biggest organization in the 7th layer as they were strong enough to assassinate the leaders and replace them, then use their strength to end the war, winning for the devil's side!
Devils were smart and hated people like Yuan Fang the most, at least that would be if he kept his original righteous airs, who knew how was he now? Was he a hypocrite like most of the other sects in the mortal realm?
But Yun Jhin knew that devils only liked profit and schemes, so if he could come with bigger profit compared to Yuan Fang he would be able to sway them, Demons were dumb and once they learned something they would tread on that path until the end, so if they were controlled by Yuan Fang, Yun Jhin couldn't do anything about them.
He sighed as he let the duo go then decided to enter the demonic pool, he could feel that the pool's energy was around 60% emptied due to the male devil's absorption, but with it, he could break through the sage realm even though he wouldn't be able to strengthen his avatar at all. However, for Yun Jhin it was still good enough considering how much time he searched for the pool.
He dived directly into it as he started to absorb it's contents while meditating upon the upcoming matters.
****************************
Yuan Fang was meditating under a big yellowing tree that was seemingly dying from the core, the tree had a big mouth and eyes that were seemingly crying, it's face was stuck in a horror motion as it looked at Yuan Fang's body below him.
The male with a monkey's tail approached Yuan Fang as he kneeled in front of him and asked:
"Now that we have finished our revenge for Xing'er should we head to hell master?"
Yuan Fang looked up at the dying tree and shook his head as he thought for a little time before saying:
"Paranoia is a strong double-edged weapon for us cultivators, you should already know about this right Yang Qi?"
Yang Qi nodded at Yuan Fang but he didn't know where he was going with this.
Seeing that he didn't understand Yuan Fang ripped a piece of bark from the dying tree behind him and started to scratch it:
"Let's say this bark is a person and I'm paranoia, while I scratch the bark slowly nothing happens to it, you see?"
The bark was quite thick and Yuan Fang's delicate fingers couldn't leave a dent in it even if he didn't use some power.
"I'm not affecting the bark any way right now, but what would happen if the paranoia increased by let's say.. 100x?"
The bark turned into powder in his hands as he said 100x and looked into Yang Qi's eyes:
"Paranoia is good for a cultivator to have as it keeps them weary, but too much of it and it would give them inner demons, you should know why you are supposed to head to Hell anyway, but you don't have to anymore, Yun Jhin's strength is certainly increasing at the moment and if I sent you there you would just become his food, his soul was also pretty much recovered the last time my soul willpower marked him."
"While his soul wouldn't increase his battle power much, you wouldn't be able to kill him anyway, what if he escaped with his soul and he went to reincarnate again? We would lose all of our leads on him up till now."
It seemed that while Yuan Fang knew about Yun Jhin's situation, he didn't know that if he died now he wouldn't reincarnate again.
"If his soul wasn't as strong as it currently was, he might not have been able to escape, but even if I went into hell there was a chance he could still escape, he is a rather slippery fellow, you can attribute it to his immense experience."
Yang Qi still didn't understand why did they have this conversation, what could they do to give Yun Jhin so much paranoia that he would self-destruct?
Seeing that he was puzzled made Yuan Fang chuckled as he said:
"I have already installed the seed into his psyche, all it has to do is bloom now, you don't have to beat your head with these things, I just tried to teach you but it seems you don't understand, you are our wheels anyways, all you have to do is keep yourself at full ki so we can escape or travel when we want to."
The man nodded as he left, Yuan Fang looked at the dying tree and told it:
"How do you like dying you old fart? Do you regret killing Xing'er now?"
The frozen face on the tree started to move as it coughed green phlegm which tried to attach itself to Yuan Fang only for it to freeze in the air then dissipate:
"Oh? Trying to poison me on the verge of death? Quite cliched don't you think?"
The gigantic tree didn't say anything seeing that he failed to injure Yuan Fang, it closed its eyes as it turned deathly gray and all of its leaves disappeared into ashes.
The trunk of the tree also turned gray as it fell to the ground ready to smash Yuan Fang into meat paste, the tree was gigantic and Yuan Fang wasn't even as big as an ant compared to it, but the moment the tree trunk reached him it easily floated to the side seemingly scared of injuring him.
"So my job here is done... as long as I will break through to the God Realm in the following 150,000 years there should be no problems to follow the road of the True Awakening, I only need to get rid of the competition..."
His eyes glowed as he thought about the competition, and mainly about one person that left a big mark on his mind and former body, Yun Jhin!
Yuan Fang grasped his chest as he looked to the horizon, the setting red sun indicating that a tragedy had happened on the elves planet, he muttered to himself:
"Only if you could self-destruct... but all I'm doing is impeding the inevitable... our meeting will still happen sooner or later..."

chapters.title: Chapter 146: The Sage Realm
chapters.content:
The sage realm was where one's battle potential achieved the biggest boost, while the God Realm was the peak of both life and power.
A sage could create an avatar which was like an out of body incarnation that could fuse with the owner's body to increase their battle power from 1.3x up to 1.9x depending on the quality of the avatar and the talent of the person who made it.
Yun Jhin's avatar quality was the highest it could be as he fused celestial energy and demonic energy into it to create a being that was neither celestial nor demon.
In Yun Jhin's body, there was a light that was continuously growing, it was currently in an infant form as it resembled Yun Jhin's caterpillar body but at the microscopic size.
The body started to slowly expand as the energy from the pool was entering inside of it.
The expansion wasn't fast, it could be considered rather slow if you would compare it to Yun Jhin's former breakthroughs, but Yun Jhin wanted to have one of the strongest avatars because in the future when he would reach the God Realm, the avatar would be vital to his battle power!
The avatar had a different look compared to Yun Jhin, it was both demonic and celestial at the same time while it had a strange aura surrounding it, its resemblance to Yun Jhin was uncanny, but the difference between them was that the avatar was an energy construct while Yun Jhin was a being made from flesh and blood.
Yun Jhin bathed in the demonic energy pool as the energy that remained in it slowly started to disappear as the avatar in his body was condensing.
In the sage realm, there were 9 stages just like all of the previous realms, the first 4 realms were meant to strengthen the avatar to the point that it was as strong as the main body, making it exert the power of the main body even though it wasn't near it.
At the 5th stage would create a link between their avatar and themselves thus if the main body died they could resurrect themselves through the avatar at the cost of getting their cultivation weakened.
At the 6th stage, one's avatar would start to show signs of evolution, the evolution of the avatar would set in stone the power upgrade one would get at the God Realm so it was important to focus properly on the evolution when one reached the 6th stage if any problems arose at the breakthrough there would even be problems when one reached the God Realm and their future path could be cut.
At the 7th stage, the avatar evolution would be finished and the end product would appear.
At the 8th stage, the avatar would gain sentience.
At the 9th stage, the cultivator should start fusing with his avatar for the future breakthrough to the God Realm.
The power of the sage realm was unique as it used the foundation in the King Realm and the Emperor realm, so if you had a good foundation in those realms, the battle power that you could be able to exhibit in the sage realm could be either extremely strong or extremely weak.
Most people had weak foundations as they rushed through them or didn't have good quality resources to create their jewels.
However, Yun Jhin jewels were of the highest quality and now their power could be exhibited properly at the sage realm!
He could shuttle through space with less ki, his battle power was higher than almost every normal sage realm expert and even most geniuses would have to bow their heads to his arsenal of techniques and jewel powers.
As the energy surged through his body Yun Jhin could feel that the avatar inside of him grew to kid-size.
The avatar left his main body as it entered the pool and started to absorb the energy by himself, Yun Jhin was also infusing energy from his ki pathways directly into the avatar, he could see the avatar's inner organs and ki pathways slowly getting constructed and strengthened, he was practically creating a new life right now!
Yun Jhin's body started to levitate as the avatar stood in front of him and did the same, the energy inside the pool was almost exhausted as the avatar size grew more and more, from kid to teen and finally to adult.
Yun Jhin could feel that the preparations for the breakthrough were 99% done, so he took in a deep breath and started to concentrate on the avatar!
All he had to do now was breathe life inside the avatar and then put it back inside of his body to achieve the breakthrough to the sage realm!
Yun Jhin spat out a bunch of azure-colored blood that clashed with the avatar chests making a metallic sound. The avatar's eyes started to glow as his body started to turn corporeal from transparent, even though he was an energy being, the energy was solid.
Yun Jhin could feel the completion of the avatar was almost there!
Suddenly the avatar stopped levitating as it started to approach Yun Jhin seemingly as if Yun Jhin was a magnet and the avatar was a metal.
Yun Jhin breakthrough was imminent!
The avatar finally entered his body after a short moment and Yun Jhin started to shake as crimson and azure energy started to engulf his whole body!
His caterpillar form grew to 2,50 meters and his body refinement finally reached the 10,000 ranks!
The moment his body refinement reached the 10,000 ranks a notification appeared in front of him:
[Host has reached the maximum body refinement for the artificial celestial caterpillar and can finally evolve into the Artificial Celestial Butterfly, or host can try to find another evolution path.]
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he felt the internal changes going through his body, and he realized that his avatar could strengthen his battle power by 1.6x times!
The battle power increase was reaching the later stages of what was possible and he didn't even reach the evolution stage of the avatar yet!
Yun Jhin chuckled as his body started to compress and his height lowered, it was time to achieve his human form!
Yun Jhin's bipedal form reached around 1,95 meters in height and he had waist-length wild azure-colored hair, his body was ripped with lean muscles and his azure colored eyes would bore through anyone's soul the moment they pierced into their eyes.
Yun Jhin's naked body was trapped with his Ying-Yang 4 elemental celestial beasts clothes as he felt his cultivation settle down.
He took in a sigh as he looked at the remaining energy in the pool, only a bucket worth remained and he took it and used it to temper his clothes and his halberd.
His body wasn't used to the energy inside the pool but the remaining energy wouldn't be able to help him further his cultivation anymore so he used it to strengthen his equipment.
Yun Jhin started to teleport away from the pool, now that he was at the sage realm he could teleport through space and due to his spatial jewel the consumption of ki for this activity was reduced by 80%, he could also teleport faster and he could rip through space more easily compared to others.
In hell, it was considerably harder to rip through space due to the adverse environment and the gravity that applied itself even to space, but Yun Jhin could still teleport better than the inhabitants of hell due to his spatial proficiency.
This way he would be able to travel through hell way easier than before and find demonic energy pools quicker cutting through time, at this point he could live for almost 250,000 or more, and even though he wasn't even in his thousands yet, time would pass by in a blink of the eye when cultivating!
For his sage realm breakthrough, it took him around 25 years! And it was still considered pretty fast as normally it would take 100 to 250 years for the average person to break through the sage realm.
As Yun Jhin teleported through hell, Yun Jhin's new subordinates, the male devil, and the succubus were currently finishing the long civil war between devil and demons.
The devil side won and the God realm lord from the 9th layer was very pleased, thus he sent one fragment of the treasure he found to the 7th layer for them to enjoy.
Yun Jhin returned to the public city where the devils dwelled after he searched for more demonic pools but failed to find them after 2 more years, his cultivation increased by a bit but he was quite far away from reaching the 2nd stage of the sage realm.
The moment he entered the city, he was escorted to the biggest tribal building where he met the male devil and the succubus who both kneeled to him the moment they saw him.
Yun Jhin waved his hand indicating they could get up and asked:
"Where is the treasure?"
The male devil came forward and took something out of his clothes, it was a piece of multicolored rock-like thing, it was only a small piece of it but Yun Jhin found it to be familiar.
He frowned as he took a bigger piece of that rock from his spatial dimension and compared them, suddenly on the bigger piece a mouth appeared that devoured the small piece in one big gulp!
If Yun Jhin's ears weren't fooling him the smaller piece also let out a cry of pain and fear as it was eaten!
Yun Jhin looked at the multicolored rock as the mouth disappeared from it and frowned, he knew that it was sentient and alive but what was it used for? It seemed it was something of a hell specialty as Yun Jhin didn't know what you were supposed to do with it.
Even though Yun Jhin had dealings with hell he didn't dare to walk in the 9th layer by himself, so he didn't know much about the special treasures there, the devils or demons wouldn't trade their special treasures either so Yun Jhin was in the dark about this piece of rock-like thing.
The male devil looked at the multicolored rock and said:
"The Lord said that the rock would help you to have faster breakthroughs if you won its approval, but he didn't say how that should happen, he only said that it would only approve those that were worthy of it!"
Yun Jhin frowned as he realized what the demon lord meant by those who were worthy of it, that meant those with fortuned constitutions!
Yun Jhin knew that the rock was useless for him so he threw it back into the spatial dimension, Yun Jhin didn't know why Hao Tian couldn't use the rock to quicken his cultivation, maybe even fortuned people needed to get acknowledged by it before it would help them?
Yun Jhin wasn't sure why such a thing existed in hell in the first place, technically speaking Hell had the worst ratio of fortuned ones spawning in the realm!
The mortal realm had a fixed rate of every 500 years which seemed to have broke during his current reincarnation as he found 3 fortuned persons in a span of 100 or so years.
The celestial realm was supposed to be full of fortuned people but Yun Jhin wasn't sure if this information was reliable, even though he had celestial blood running through his veins as a celestial caterpillar, he wasn't actually a fortuned person, even as a celestial caterpillar somehow the universe still hated him, it seemed even the system couldn't fool the universe perception of him.
Yun Jhin shook his head, if he couldn't use the rock he would just let it stay in his spatial dimension, or maybe enslave a fortuned one and then nurture him into his death combat slave.
The building he was currently in had multiple balconies as Yun Jhin chose one and looked at the whole city, everything seemed calm on the surface but things were still boiling under, Yun Jhin could feel hell wasn't as peaceful as it seemed to be in the upper layers, soon something will happen, something monumental!

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Advent of Hell's inheritance
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin decided to settle in the city for some time, now that he had the devil organization under him he could use the natural pool under their jurisdiction which was also recoverable.
Yun Jhin's new human body didn't attract much attention as he was exuding a devilish charm that showed that he was an inhabitant of Hell, from absorbing so much demonic energy he was basically just like the average devil in regards to presence.
The location of the other demonic pool was nearby the city, after all, they constructed the city around the pool's location to make sure no one would use it besides the people they wanted to.
Unfortunately, the pool had been used a few times due to the former war so it was quite depleted, also recovering it took a lot of time so Yun Jhin could only use around 50% of its energy, it wouldn't be enough for him to reach the second stage of the sage realm as it wouldn't strengthen his avatar enough.
Yun Jhin sighed as he watched the half-full pool and jumped into it before starting to absorb the energy inside, it took him around half a year now to finish absorbing, after his cultivation increased so did his absorption speed.
He also sent word to his people so they could search for more pools, but finding them would take a lot of time considering there weren't many people as strong or as stubborn as him in finding pools, he couldn't really force them too much in finding the pools or they would defect, killing too many people would be also useless, he didn't need to absorb devils and his power wouldn't increase much at all as his underlings were all considerably weak compared to him at the moment.
Yun Jhin left the pool behind him as it dried up, what could he do now?
Since he was a sage he could basically go to the 8th layer but he would be the weakest there, cultivation speaking, in case of battle power he would be around the middle-pack and he could get a rather good position in the army of the 8th layer, there were also a lot more resources in the 8th layer.
But going any further into his sage cultivation would take more and more time now, the avatar could be strengthened with the pools but even though he currently didn't build up any resistance to the demonic energy yet, it could happen with time due to his peak body refinement cultivation.
He sighed as he looked at the succubus and male demon who were kneeling to him, he did want to stay more in the 7th layer but there wasn't much he could do in it anymore, he sighed as he told them some things and left them some orders before he got up and tried to leave.
But suddenly the whole 7th layer started to shake like an extreme earthquake was going on, even Yun Jhin with his cultivation fell to the ground let's not even talk about the other two who were weaker, the earthquake also increased the gravity in the 7th layer turning a lot of the weaker people into meat paste.
Yun Jhin frowned as his muscles' veins started to appear around his body, he got up from the ground but even his peak refined body was getting pressured by the new gravity and the shaking earth below his feet.
The other two were currently starting to become pancake-like, blood was also coming out of their 7 apertures and it looked like they couldn't handle much more, suddenly the earthquake stopped but the duo across Yun Jhin was also half-dead.
Seeing that they couldn't live for much longer Yun Jhin shook his head and waved his hand at them making them both disappear as they were absorbed, Yun Jhin could have healed them but he didn't bother with it, he was already known by the majority of his underlings as the boss above those two so he didn't fear any mutiny, and if there was a rebellion he would just quell it easily with his strength.
Now, what was that earthquake about?
Yun Jhin went to one of the balconies of the building and looked outside trying to identify the problem.
He looked around and didn't find anything for a short while before his eyes darted towards the distant horizon, he could see a dark spot there that didn't exist in that location before.
Yun Jhin squinted his eyes as he enhanced their capabilities with ki, if that spot was so small that Yun Jhin had to enhance his already advanced vision it could be considered extremely far away!
Even farther away compared to the pool that Yun Jhin found, as he calculated the distance Yun Jhin realized that he would need 3-4 years with teleportation to reach it! And the thing was also enormous, so big that Yun Jhin didn't know how to explain its size with numbers, after all, it was so far away but it was still visible!
Yun Jhin frowned, what could this thing be?
All of the information he got from absorbing the duo that served him didn't mention anything about this, they were both rather young devils and the male devil was also abandoned by the sect so he couldn't have much secret information.
Yun Jhin had been to the 7th and 8th layers before in his former lives but he couldn't access much information or make a big ruckus back then so he still didn't know what that black spot was.
Could it be a tomb, a tower, or something else that linked it to Hell?
