Yun Jhin wasn't a stranger to the inheriting system as he left some inheritances of the blood throne sect himself in the mortal realm, some of them were meant to revive the sect while others were meant for him to have some resources when he reincarnated, unfortunately, he wouldn't be able to go to them as they were in the location of the blood throne sect's territory and Yuan Fang was a pain in his side that he couldn't get rid of.
He could be considered quite lucky if the tower had a special inheritance he could take advantage of so he decided to set off to the location by himself.
Yun Jhin's teleportation speed was unrivaled in the 7th layer but the constant use of it also meant he had quite the big consumption of ki even though his teleportation took less ki than the average sage's.
Every 3 months he would have to rest and recover his ki for 10 days even through the use of ki recovering pills, the higher one cultivation was the more ki could they have in their bodies and the more ki would burst through their pathways increasing their explosive strength, the way Yun Jhin teleported made use of his immense amount of ki and the explosiveness of the ki pathways circulation to achieve an immense teleportation speed, however, the 7th layer could be considered boundless and only experts at the peak god realm could travel through the whole 9 layers of hell easily.
As Yun Jhin teleported there was a commotion in the 8th and 9th hells.
The peak god realm experts in the 9th layer couldn't care less about the commotion as they cultivated in seclusion but those below the 9th stage were frantic!
Lu Yi, Shang Qui, Bing Baboboey, and Vanzuel were the weakest lords in the 9th layer they were around the 1st 2nd and 3rd stags of the God Realm, Vanzuel got his hands on the piece of special stone but he couldn't use it for cultivation so he was pretty bummed out, he also didn't want to use it on his subordinates or relatives as they would backstab him if they grew stronger than him.
The other God experts were all devils besides Bing Baboboey, he was a demon but he was more refined than the average demon, he could also be considered rather smart as he had the intelligence of the average devil, he couldn't come close to the scheming of the other people around him but he was still quite smart himself.
They just met with each other due to the shockwave and earthquakes they could feel from the 7th layer below them, they knew what this meant as they had awakened their core inheritance memories when they reached the God Realm.
Vanzuel was the strongest lord in their small community so he was the one who started to talk first:
"You should all know why we met here, Hell's inheritance Pagoda must have resurfaced after billions of years!"
The others nodded as Lu Yi interjected:
"We all know why we are here brother Vanzuel, you don't have to tell us, you aren't the one who initiated the meeting even though you are the leader!"
Vanzuel frowned as he felt that Lu Yi's tone was rather disrespectful but he couldn't do much about him, after all the man was only one cultivation stage below him and his battle power wasn't anything to laugh about.
Lu Yi decided to take advantage of him shutting up and said:
"You should all know that to enter the pagoda we need something that brother Vanzuel got his hands on recently, we don't need a big piece of it, and I also heard you have given a small piece of it to your subordinates in the 7th layer?"
Vanzuel nodded, he couldn't hide this from them, the inheritance would be useful for people up to their level but those at the 4th stage and above wouldn't bother with it, after all, it was only the inheritance of the 7th layer, not the one on the 8th or 9th, if the inheritance of the 9th layer appeared, even those sleeping peak God Realm monsters would wake up to get a piece of the pie.
Vanzuel knew they were trying to exhort the piece of multicolored rock from him but he unleashed his aura and started to negotiate with them, even though they were all quite strong and they could beat him if they teamed up, devils rarely worked with each other due to their backstabbing nature. Also, devils would never sign contracts with other devils there were too many ways to slip tricks into a contract.
Vanzuel didn't walk empty-handed from the trade as he got some territory and some pools in the 9th layer while the others each got a piece of the multicolored rock.
While people at the 8th and 9th layers were currently doing their best to find more multicolored rocks Yun Jhin was getting closer and closer to the inheritance pagoda.
As time passed Yun Jhin was already half-way there!

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Entering the pagoda
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin got closer and closer to the black spot he could start to recognize what it truly was!
It was a dark pagoda made out of hellish iron of the highest quality! Even though he was far away he could recognize the iron from a glance, he still remembered how he almost lost his life to a rival of his from hell who wore an armor made from this iron!
The power of this iron was that the more of it existed the stronger the defensive capabilities of it would be, so technically that gigantic pagoda should be impenetrable!
Also, the pagoda shouldn't even exist, the iron was very rare and even those in the 9th layer wouldn't squander it on anything besides heavy armors.
Yun Jhin frowned as he got closer to the pagoda, he could feel other ki signatures appearing in the 7th layer that he was rather apprehensive of, they were all at the later stages of the sage realm and above!
Yun Jhin could feel their presence because they were making sure to expose it and the distance between them wasn't that big, it seemed the inhabitants of the 7th layer weren't the only ones who wanted to get a piece of this inheritance.
Yun Jhin didn't mind the competition, these types of inheritances were extremely hard to get and they grew accordingly harder to the cultivation and battle power of the person who entered.
So if a God realm expert entered he would have tasks that only a God Realm expert could do, the same could be said for the realms below.
As Yun Jhin got closer and closer to the pagoda he felt that the same could be said about the people that came after him, and he wasn't talking about the sage realm experts!
He could feel that his hair was rising due to danger and that only meant one thing, God Realm experts were making their move!
While he didn't mind them entering the pagoda for the inheritance he didn't want to be seen by them or there would be trouble!
He immediately used his stealth technique as he stopped teleporting, teleportation would attract attention due to the energy fluctuations that would pierce through space, fortunately, he wasn't that far from the pagoda anymore and he could fly there.
Yun Jhin looked up and saw spatial cracks appearing in the air, he was currently laying on the hot ground of hell which was almost akin to lava, the lava-like heat didn't really affect Yun Jhin at this point, after all, his body refinement rank was at the maximum possible.
The 5 Gods from the 9th layer appeared and looked around, they felt the fluctuations of space breaking at high speeds that were comparable to themselves and they thought there was another companion from the 9th layer but there was no one here.
They realized that the person who was teleporting didn't want to meet them so they snorted and left with a flick of their sleeves, it wasn't that they didn't want to search for the culprit but they wanted to rush to the inheritance and the first ones to enter so they would have a higher chance of getting to the inheritance first.
Yun Jhin flew at a low altitude at his quickest speed while making sure he didn't emit any ki, he knew that if he let out any fluctuations of ki those three could come back and attack him.
While they wanted to rush to the pagoda and be first, they wouldn't mind taking care of the competition on the way.
Yun Jhin's control over his own ki was as exquisite and perfect as it could be so there was no chance for them to find him if he didn't want them to.
After another while of flying, Yun Jhin arrived at the base of the pagoda, it was stretching endlessly into the red skies of the 7th layer and it was quite imposing, Yun Jhin admired it for 1 second before he started to search for the entrance.
He could see that some sages tried to barge into the Pagoda from time to time but there was no luck on their side
There were no Gods around and that meant they should have entered the pagoda by now.
Yun Jhin looked around the gigantic pagoda and couldn't find any entrance, there were no doors, windows, or any openings that he could exploit to enter it, not even the tiniest one!
It was just a giant pagoda made of dark hellish iron and he really didn't know how the others entered, the inheritance of hell was something foreign to him and all he could do now was try and see how he could enter it.
He tried multiple ways, infusing his ki into the pagoda, trying to hit it with his fists, attacking it with his techniques, but all he did was fail spectacularly, his attempts also riled up the other sages around as they tried to do the same thing as him.
Yun Jhin frowned, if these types of interactions didn't work that meant there would be a need for a key or some sort of sacrifice, considering all of the sages were still around and living that meant there was no need for a living sacrifice.
Yun Jhin thought for a short while before he realized that the multicolored rock might be the key to enter the Pagoda, it was too much of a coincidence for the Pagoda to appear a little bit later after the first multicolored rock was found.
But how the hell did Hao Tian get his hands on such a thing? The mysteries of being a fortuned one...
Yun Jhin took the multicolored rock out of his spatial dimension and the Pagoda immediately reacted as a door opened in front of him, Yun Jhin couldn't even do anything before the door absorbed him along with the rock!
The surroundings were all dark, just like the emptiness one felt right after death or before one was born.
Yun Jhin didn't like this type of environment at all, it reminded him of all of his failures at achieving true eternal life.
He also felt something wasn't right, he tried to look around only to feel that he couldn't move his head nor his body anymore, it was just like back then when he was newly born as a caterpillar.
This wasn't right... what type of test was this?
Yun Jhin tried his best to move or even make a sound but all he did was a small movement with his left foot.
He couldn't hear anything, he couldn't see anything, he couldn't smell anything!
This was a type of torture in itself, however, Yun Jhin started to adapt to this after a short while, he had been in more precarious situations before and this situation could also be used to temper his soul so he could restore them to their former peak.
As time passed Yun Jhin could feel that his body was getting stronger and stronger, with his meditation he could even get some silvers of ki from the void and infuse them into his body to strengthen it.
He could feel that he wasn't connected to the celestial realm anymore as he couldn't cultivate using celestial ki anymore.
However, this could be considered normal as the inside of the pagoda could have technically cut his connection to the celestial realm due to the spatial interference, if he guessed correctly he was just a baby right now!
Yun Jhin wasn't sure what the test consisted of but he was currently unborn with the mind of an adult, this didn't happen in all of his previous lives as normally a soul would enter the baby's body when they would make their first cry.
Time trickled by slowly as Yun Jhin's body increased in size and strength, finally, after what felt like an eternity Yun Jhin could feel the wind tickling his small naked body!
He looked up to see a roughed shaved face of a man who wore a wolf's head like a cap, he gazed into Yun Jhin's eyes as he put his finger on his belly and inserted a fringe of ice-cold ki into it.
Yun Jhin could feel that his vitality was quickly being severed by the finger and that his new life was quickly coming to an end.
The man shook his head seeing Yun Jhin's cooling body as he snorted:
"Another failure, what a bother, when will I get an offspring who can endure the Ice Transformation of Heaven and Earth technique?"
Yun Jhin's eyes were slowly closing as his body went numb, the man also dropped Yun Jhin as he was holding him by the left foot like he was a grape, Yun Jhin could feel time slow down as he was falling to the ground below him, he could identify it as granite meaning his tender brains would sprain on it immediately!
Suddenly a sickly cough could be heard as two arms held him and brought his cooling body to her chest, tears started to pour out of his new mother's eyes as she looked at her dying son.
She looked into the eyes of the male ahead of her and she couldn't do anything as the man glared at her.
Yun Jhin didn't feel anything as he died... things just stopped, reality cracked apart around him only to find himself in the same situation as back then, darkness, no smell nor sense of touch, he was practically a fetus again!
"This is so troublesome... what am I even supposed to do in this situation?"
Yun Jhin was currently stumped by the trial he was given by the pagoda, he thought that he might have to kill something or solve some puzzles just like normal inheritances but it seemed this was rather different to what he thought about...
It was definitely annoying, when he was born would his new-new father kill him too?
There was only one way to find out... and that was to wait.

chapters.title: Chapter 149: This treasure isn't for you (1)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin got used to the darkness and the feeling of being unable to move his body since the first birth, so he just closed his eyes and started to meditate not trying to think about his surroundings and he just let time pass...
Slowly but surely Yun Jhin could fill the wind hit his buttocks as he was born again!
This time he was directly in the arms of his mother who was coddling him and looking at him with tender love, a roughed male who wore a yellow robe was looking down at him and his mother while having a nervous expression on his face.
Yun Jhin looked around as he thought:
"Strange.. last time I was killed instantly but now this looks like a normal family? What is this test supposed to be?"
Yun Jhin then had to drink some milk from his mother as his tummy grumbled, after he had his fill Yun Jhin still didn't know what to do in this situation:
"Should I just live like this? This is such a bother, the pagoda didn't even give me any information regarding what I should do, I'm even wasting time this way, what would the other trials be?"
Each trial was handmade for each person that entered the pagoda and it would be equal regardless of their cultivation base, Yun Jhin wasn't sure what the others got but considering his innate talent and his special body it meant that his trial could be considered harder and easier at the same time.
Yun Jhin slept in his mother's arms as he waited for something to happen, it surely wouldn't be just a normal life right?
He felt that something was wrong but in the end, as time passed Yun Jhin realized that his feelings weren't as accurate anymore, he grew up to be 2 years old or so and there were still no problems!
His father and mother loved him dearly and they also gave him whatever he asked for, they weren't rich but things worked out just fine, his father was a carpenter and his mother was a cook in the small village they lived in.
This looked like the start of something, Yun Jhin knew because a lot of his reincarnations started in such small villages, they would either get pillaged or attacked by bandits and sometimes he would be able to join their efforts to jump-start his cultivation.
But as time passed Yun Jhin reached 6 years old and no bandits were coming at all!
He acted just like a normal child as he hid his budding cultivation, it seemed that even though his senses were getting messed with, he could still use his cultivation knowledge to strengthen himself, right now he was barely at the 3rd stage of the earthly realm. It couldn't be helped, the surrounding ki was very poor and that meant they lived in an inauspicious location.
Yun Jhin hated this, he didn't know what would happen if he went on a rampage and absorbed these people to further his cultivation, all of them were normal people without any bit of cultivation, some of them had rather strong bodies due to their manual work and agriculture but that was all, Yun Jhin could easily snap these strong people necks like they were chickens with his current cultivation.
But if he did that there was also a chance that he could fail again, who knew what would happen if he failed too many times? Would his life be in peril or would he just be ejected out? Things were quite annoying in this regard, inheritances like these who didn't inform you of anything were the trickiest and hardest to do because they made the challenger use 100% of their knowledge and ability at the same time.
Life was a bit too peaceful for Yun Jhin's liking, he wasn't a warmonger but his cultivation base was increasing at a snail's pace, he only felt exhilarated when his cultivation increased at high speeds!
Yun Jhin sighed as he entered his home then sat at the dinner table, his mother was cooking a big fat juicy pig, roasting it then glazing it into honey, while Yun Jhin didn't need to eat when his cultivation was higher, now that he was just an earthly realm practitioner again, food was always welcome!
While ki was faint in his location he could use nutrients from food to increase his cultivation speed.
His father entered the house with a smile as he dropped a pouch of coins on the table with a burst of laughter:
"We are going to the city!"
Yun Jhin's mother cried out in happiness as she watched the silver coins drop on the table, she gave her husband a big kiss and a hug as she waited for Yun Jhin to join them. Yun Jhin laughed too as he gave both of them a hug while he asked:
"How is the city?"
His father immediately started to give him a vivid description of the city, which thought to be very beautiful and magnificent, for a person like his father the city would be magnificent, but as Yun Jhin heard the description he realized that it was a dump, it just relatively better compared to their small village.
Yun Jhin didn't say anything as his father finished the description of the city, he smiled as he watched his parents making their bags so they could move.
Yun Jhin nor his mother asked him how he made the money, they both believed in his honest nature and how he carried himself around them since they knew him.
They arrived in the city three months later then they bought a small house at the outskirts, the house was made of hay and clay, it wasn't anything special, it was almost worse compared to their former house, but Yun Jhin's father had a big smile on his face as he left the house and went to find work in the city.
As time passed the night fell but his father didn't come back, his mother started to mutter to herself as she called Yun Jhin over and asked if his father ever came back while she was out grocery shopping, or if he sent word through someone.
Unfortunately, there had been no such things!
Suddenly there was a knock at the door as a well-built man entered without waiting for a response, the man wore a police uniform that consisted of black armor, military boots, and a cap.
He bowed towards Yun Jhin's mom as he revealed something inside a piece of cloth, it was his father's severed head!
His mother paled as she put a hand towards her mouth, she started to retch as she couldn't stop herself and vomited on the spot.
The policeman frowned then said:
"We found his severed head near the merchant district, it seemed he had borrowed some money and he couldn't give them back in the allocated time."
Yun Jhin knew this was most likely a lie, his father would never borrow money, they might have thought of him to be new blood that they could take advantage of and he was unfortunately killed in the scuffle, even though his father was a simple man who would do honest work, he didn't like to be ripped off.
The police officer shook his head as he continued:
"His body wasn't found, it's unknown who the killer is but we have some suspects, as his last remaining family you will need to come to the police office for us to protect you."
His mother nodded as she couldn't look towards the piece of cloth anymore, she was trembling so hard that it looked she would fall any time, and if Yun Jhin wasn't currently supporting her she would have fallen to the ground by now.
She slowly made her way towards the policeman as they followed him to the police station.
There they talked for a bit while the policeman comforted both of them, Yun Jhin was currently cleaning his small face with his trembling hands, he was truly a very good actor!
A little bit of time passed and the killer wasn't found, as more time passed the police station couldn't keep Yun Jhin and his mother there anymore, so they had to go back to their house, due to the earner of the family dying, Yun Jhin and his mother also had to go and get jobs now.
For Yun Jhin it wasn't hard to scam people and he always came back with some money, this way his mother didn't really have to work as he was supporting her and himself easily, the city location had a little bit more ki so Yun Jhin's cultivation also increased to the 4th stage of the earthly realm.
As time passed Yun Jhin became 11 years old...
He was at an average height for his age and he was around 43 kilograms, under his baggy grey shirt there were muscles packed that would make you think if he was either a midget or dwarf in disguise as a child.
Yun Jhin's scamming was hard to track to and he could disguise himself using regular appliances found around the normal house of a civilian so no one really found him, he didn't have to deal with cultivators either so he could easily make money without any problems.
Yun Jhin still didn't know what he was supposed to do in this situation, were his father's killers going to come after them sooner or later? Would he have to protect his mother? When will this trial really end?
As Yun Jhin put these questions in his mind, he came home to his mother who was currently cooking a feast for him, they had already bought a bigger and better house and they could eat whatever they wanted, his mother knew what he was doing but she wasn't sure how he got such knowledge, however, as a normal person as long as she got what she needed she wouldn't question such things, they lived well and there weren't any problems at all since Yun Jhin started his 'job'.
Actually, there were a few problems at first but Yun Jhin swiftly dealt with them by killing the people that wanted to trouble him, he realized that killing didn't really pose a problem in the trial but he felt that if he killed his parents then there would be problems, it was just like a hunch he had, he needed to protect his mother!
His father was predestined to die but his mother needed to be alive for him to complete the trial.
So while he went scamming he would also ask out for information of any special things, such as glowing flowers or grasses or any types of plants like these, he wanted to increase his cultivation to make sure whatever was going to come to him, he would be ready!
He really wanted that inheritance from Hell it could help his main body's cultivation shoot up by a lot!
He found the trial to be quite strange, hell a location that everyone thought as evil would give out such trials that were meant for righteous scions of the universe? Was he wrong with his regards to protecting his mother?
But his instincts told him that if he protected her he would be able to get the inheritance... so until he got any more information he would trust his instincts.

chapters.title: Chapter 150: This treasure isn't for you (2)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin realized his mission through his instinct, he wasn't truly sure if this was the right thing to do to get the inheritance but he had no other leads!
There were no pieces of information, no guides, nothing! All he had was his brain and instincts, this inheritance trial was harder than it looked on the surface, Yun Jhin was currently going through another life and if it was anyone else they wouldn't have been able to do this.
Yun Jhin's eyes sparkled as he looked at his mother and realized why he was given this trial, it was because he was a reincarnator!
He was given a mission according to his former experiences and memories, if he thought a little harder about it, this situation seemed pretty familiar to him, he needed to go through one of his older memories to remember everything though...
While his mother went to sleep, Yun Jhin feigned going to sleep as well, they lived really well currently and things were going so well that his mother started to lose the fear she had gained from seeing Yun Jhin's father's death those years ago.
He still would think about him and sob from time to time but it seemed she was slowly moving on from him.
Yun Jhin sat on his bed and meditated, even though he had access to an immense pool of memories, they were so many that some of the older ones needed to be accessed manually for him to know about them, he knew they were in his subconscious and things that he knew would seem familiar to him, thus now that he was in a familiar situation he needed to access his older memories.
Yun Jhin's back arched as an influx of memories from one of his older previous lives entered his mind, these were... these were the memories of the previous man that killed his newly born body, that man was him!
It seemed he was forced to relive what he had done to his previous progeny or something among those lines if things were as he suspected.
He thought for a little more time and accessed memories regarding the current trial. his eyes widened as he looked towards the location of his mother's room, so that's how it was, he truly understood now!
He wanted to leave the house and escape but suddenly he felt a gigantic pressure put on his body, he couldn't move at all anymore!
His body which was refined and at the earthly realm couldn't move at all, which meant a cultivator with a higher cultivation base was around!
The door of his mother's room started to crack slowly, his mother came out with a sweet smile on her face as she looked into Yun Jhin's petrified eyes.
He couldn't move any part of his body, not even his eyes!
His mother slowly got near him as she looked into his eyes for a few seconds before saying:
"I knew you are a weird one... being able to cultivate since being in my belly, think I couldn't sense you gather ki inside?"
Yun Jhin's fears were true, his mother was actually himself from a few hundreds of reincarnations ago!
While Yun Jhin enjoyed being a male, he couldn't be one every time, so he had experienced being both genders along with other types of beings.
He knew that his old reincarnation wanted to use him as a sacrifice when he became 15 years old to achieve what was called, a family blood pact. It was used to further one's cultivation in poor locations such as this one, Yun Jhin remembered how he easily succeeded in killing his progeny and drinking his blood for the pact.
And if things went the same way as they did in his previous life that would mean he was going to die here!
His senses were wrong, it seemed his mother was actually manipulating him into thinking that he was supposed to protect her, the reason his father died was that his mother killed him!
His mother frowned as she looked into his brown eyes and told him:
"You are a bit too uncooked right now... I cannot use you."
Yun Jhin didn't have to say these words in his former reincarnation, his child wasn't a reincarnated one and he successfully drank his blood on his 15th birthday.
Yun Jhin remembered the face of pain and betrayal his son had at him the moment he killed him and extracted his blood...
And his fate was going to be similar!
Yun Jhin could feel his chest being pressed on as his mother's dainty hands were currently moving around on it:
"You thought that I wouldn't see through you right? You are so obvious, the way you act, how many reincarnations have you been through up till now, 2? 3? Hahahaha what an amateur."
Yun Jhin didn't keep his guard up thinking this was only a simple test where there wouldn't be any cultivators around due to his location, but it seemed he had made a fatal mistake in this situation!
His body fell to the floor of the house as he was paralyzed, suddenly he could move his head and mouth but he couldn't move anything else, it seemed his mother was ready to torture him, or rather he was ready to torture himself!
Yun Jhin tried to tell her that this was a test and he was herself, but no sound came from his mouth, those words were blocked by the inheritance trial!
His mother's hands entered his chest as it started to slowly make their way towards his heart, the woman sighed as she looked longingly at his face and said:
"Only if you could mature some more... you aren't ripe yet, couldn't you have been clueless for some more time?"
Yun Jhin gritted his teeth as he looked into her eyes and decided to self-destruct!
However, his ki pathways were suddenly closed by a forceful increase in ki output from the woman and she laughed coquettishly as she put her other hand near her mouth and told him:
"Self-Destruction? Want to go and reincarnate again don't you? TOO BAD!"
Yun Jhin felt his air supply being taken as his face started to change into different colors, she didn't want to kill him fast, she wanted him to suffer for delaying her plans!
Yun Jhin moved his hand left and right trying to do anything to escape from her iron grip, but he couldn't do anything, his body was paralyzed!
Yun Jhin suddenly chuckled, so this was the true test, wasn't it?
He would make sure he would pass it the next time he reincarnated!
Seeing his look that turned peaceful and his chuckle made the woman shook her head as she gripped his heart, she gave it a small tight squeeze as Yun Jhin's life was severed from him.
Yun Jhin's last vision was of her mother slowly eating his heart with a begrudging look on her face, seemingly she was dissatisfied with the taste!
Yun Jhin found himself in the same darkness as before, but now he knew what he was supposed to do!
The moment he felt the familiar sensation he would directly search through his memories to see in which reincarnation he was being placed by the trial and as who he was being placed into!
Time passed again, he was born again, and this time as he looked around he realized that he was in a tundra, his body was slowly freezing to death and there were even some wolves who were eyeing him as prey!
He looked up to see his father's visage only to realize that his father was his former reincarnation, he was going to become wolf food!
The wolves growled as they smelled the Yun Jhin's fresh body, he was just born and practically a delicacy for the wolves, his tender meat would taste oh so sweet for them!
His father was keeping him tightly to his chest, but he knew he was contemplating if to throw him at the wolves or not!
Yun Jhin immediately connected to his memory core to see which life was this and he realized that in this one he was the progeny of a princess that he wooed and impregnated while he was younger, due to his birth origin the princess's father and mother shunned him and his sweetheart away, they ended up in the tundra to escape the pursuit of the king's men.
In many lives Yun Jhin ended up dying one way or another, there were very few lives where he ended up really successful, but all the failures built him up to become a more deadly person.
However, what could he do in this situation? He was a baby in the hands of his former reincarnation, fortunately, this was one of the earlier reincarnations and he could try to fool himself!
Yun Jhin sent a soul message towards the wolves, they were simple animals and his current body was quite weak, this was one of those situations that he tried to use the princess to gain cultivation resources but he failed.
Yun Jhin's soul was very strong and even though he was currently in a new born's body he could somewhat influence their thoughts, the wolves turned their tail down as they whimpered and left Yun Jhin, his father, and his dead mother alone.
The birth took too much out of Yun Jhin's mother and she died.
His father which was his former reincarnation looked at the body for a few seconds before glancing at the infant in his hands and sighing:
"My ticket to resources is gone.. all I have is this useless son of mine... should I just abandon him here? But why did the wolves leave?"
He frowned as he felt the wolves leaving and whimpering like that wasn't normal, what could have scared them away like that?
Yun Jhin's baby form didn't move at all as he kept himself as still as possible, things didn't go like this in this previous reincarnation so he wasn't truly sure what his former consciousness would do in this situation, after all, they were fundamentally two different persons due to the experiences that molded him into what he was today, at first he had a little bit of humanity on him and that was what the current Yun Jhin was betting on to escape from this situation, he still wasn't sure what the trial wanted him to do, but he knew that he was pitied against his former reincarnations!
Fight thyself to conquer thyself per se.

chapters.title: Chapter 151: This treasure isn't for you (3)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin realized that he was pitied against his former reincarnations if he guessed correctly, the trial was somehow making him live the lives of those he wronged in the past, no matter if they were his offsprings, women that he used, or men that he used.
He wasn't sure what he was supposed to do in this situation, kill his former reincarnation to finish the trial? Escape from it?
As he was currently in baby form all he could do was rely on his former reincarnation, fortunately, he was an earlier reincarnation and he still had some humanity left in him, he was in the 10 or 20 first reincarnations.
Yun Jhin's baby form looked at his former reincarnation's face with an innocent look, this made him melt up a little bit, he was in a tundra but he still keeping the baby to his chest trying to keep him warm.
Yun Jhin's current situation was quite pitiful, his body was literally freezing to death and there wasn't much he could do in this situation if his father didn't help him, while his soul could influence normal beings it couldn't be useful on cultivators at the heavenly realm or above and his 'father' was currently around the 5th or 6th heavenly realm from what he inferred by his soul scan.
It wasn't a problem with the strength of his soul but his body, technically speaking Yun Jhin's current soul shouldn't be contained in the body of a newborn or it would explode, somehow the trial made it so his soul wouldn't deteriorate the body nor destroy it but if he used even 2% or 3% of his true strength, the body would surely explode!
His father's figure was shaking as the cold was getting to him as well, his cultivation wasn't that high and the tundras cold was surely seeping in his body as well, it was actually a miracle Yun Jhin's current baby body resisted up till now, he should have died by hypothermia tens of minutes after birth but he somehow was still alive.
Yun Jhin could feel some heat in his stomach that was keeping him alive, it was the remaining energy from his mother that she gave him when she died during childbirth, the energy was keeping him alive at this point but the energy would run out sooner or later, and his father was eyeing him with a rather greedy gaze, he wanted to rip his stomach open to get the energy from his small body so he wouldn't die!
Yun Jhin knew that he shooed the wolfs away only to be in the teeth of a tiger, there wasn't much he could do to him, all he could do was try to make himself look as innocent as possible and fool him into taking care of him, hoping to appease to his remaining humanity, the earlier reincarnations killed a lot when it came to adults but they were a little harder to convince on killing children. This was why Yun Jhin was still alive at this point even though he had something his 'father' needed.
But Yun Jhin knew that his thoughts wandered to the energy that his mother left into his body, the energy that he wanted to absorb for himself so he could live a little bit longer thinking that he might escape!
In the end, he did escape from the pursuit of the king, the nation they lived in was rather small and as they got farther and farther away from it the king realized that his troops being away from the nation for too much of a time would let them be ambushed by the rival nations, in the end, Yun Jhin was saved by the dog-eat-dog world characteristic of the cultivation world in this reincarnation.
But would they survive to get out of the tundra at this rate?
Yun Jhin's baby body was starting to shake even though he still had energy inside his stomach, there was a high chance they would both die at this point!
His father's eyes started to wander over his small body as his hands closed into his stomach, he was ready to split it open and take away the remaining energy that was slowly diminishing with time!
Yun Jhin started crying as he felt the cold hand on his belly, seeing him acting this way made the reincarnation reconsider for a few seconds, after all, Yun Jhin was just an innocent baby, could he really kill him to save himself?
As they got further and further into the tundra somehow the cold air started to turn a little bit hotter... his former reincarnation started to run quicker as he could feel his arms and legs again, slowly but surely the surrounding temperature was increasing!
They were reaching 'the eye of the storm' which shouldn't technically exist in a tundra, but this was the same way Yun Jhin survived when he was in this reincarnation.
Actually it took Yun Jhin all his strength to reach this 'eyes of the storm' in his previous life, but now he could influence his former reincarnation using his stronger soul, while he couldn't control or scare him into submission, he could give him small hints with his soul that wouldn't trigger his suspicion.
The heat finally was good enough for them to start resting, Yun Jhin was put to rest in a small haystack that his former reincarnation took out of his spatial bag, Yun Jhin remembered that this hay would have been used to lit up a fire for a diversion to escape from the pursuit who caught up to him when he reached the eye of the storm, now that he was at the eye of the storm faster than in his previous life there was a lower chance they could catch up to him.
Yun Jhin felt his belly rumble, he was finally starting to get hungry!
He needed milk but where could his former reincarnation take milk from? There were no animals that he could milk in the eye of the storm, but there were some fruits here and there.
His former reincarnation went and picked up a few of them and mashed them into a gel-like substance that he inserted his ki into it then fed to Yun Jhin, it was better than motherly milk in nutrients, this was a technique Yun Jhin used in his former lives when he was poorer and had to live in the wilderness.
Yun Jhin's small body started to cough as the energy that his mother left dissipated, it had been around 15 hours since his mother's death and it was impressive the energy she last gave him could be sustained up till now.
Seeing Yun Jhin's rapidly cooling body made his former reincarnation understand that while his body was protected by the energy, the rebound coming to him was quite big, how could a baby not even a few days old resist the power of a cultivator? Not even strong and healthy adults could resist a sudden influx of energy from a cultivator, they could explode from the inside if they weren't talented nor had any unawakened constitutions.
Fortunately for Yun Jhin the energy that was inside his body was very weak and even though it lasted long it wasn't of a high amount, thus if he was treated he could be saved.
But his current reincarnation didn't know any healing techniques!
He was rather poor in knowledge considering the first 100 reincarnations, but as he reincarnated more and more he became a jack of all trades who mastered all of them!
Yun Jhin knew that he would die if he was left like this so all he could do was send some information into his former reincarnations soul that would give him the proper healing technique so he could be helped, he would die anyway, this would certainly be a gamble at this point but there was nothing else to lose and everything to gain.
Yun Jhin looked directly into his 'father's' eyes as he started to send the information through a hastily made soul link, his father's eyes narrowed as he looked directly towards Yun Jhin and said:
"Someone like me? No, he was way stronger in his former life, this is my first time meeting another person who can reincarnate, is this fate? A reincarnated one having a baby who is another reincarnated one?"
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation slowly got near the haystack that he left down while his hands started to burn with red energy, then he used that energy to attack Yun Jhin's body!
Yun Jhin's paling complexion immediately started to turn a little bit rosier as the cold energy in his body that came from the tundra was expelled by his former reincarnation technique.
Yun Jhin sent him some more information creating a fake identity that he used, he also promised him more techniques and ways to grow stronger if he kept him safe.
Yun Jhin's 'father' started to ponder Yun Jhin's proposition, he only had to keep him alive and he could be like a walking library that could teach him whatever he needed!
After a short moment, Yun Jhin's former reincarnation nodded at him and there was a change in the universe, a thunderstorm appeared above them but it disappeared as quickly as it came, Yun Jhin could also feel a strange connection from the universe on his former reincarnation...
Did he just become a fortuned one right now? Fortuned ones could be created like this?
Yun Jhin gained an interesting piece of knowledge right now, but could it be used outside the pagoda's territory?

chapters.title: Chapter 152: This treasure isn't for you (4)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin gauged his former reincarnation aura and narrowed his eyes as he felt that he truly got the qualities of a fortuned one!
The old master trapped in a bottle teaching the main character his overpowered techniques?
Yun Jhin chuckled inside, so this was one way a fortuned one could gain his constitution, up till now he only met with fortuned ones that already gained their constitutions, most ones we're born with the constitution that attracted innate luck from others, but it seemed you could also create fortuned ones in this way...
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation got closer to him as he looked into his eyes and told him:
"I guess you could be helpful, you must have reincarnated more times than me and you have more experience, I guess I could you call you senior but your current body situation makes it rather awkward for me."
Imagine calling your son that was only a day or so old senior... that was quite strange indeed.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he sent more soul messages explaining to him some things that he should look out for to shake off the pursuit, as Yun Jhin used his memories to remember which route the pursuit of the king's men came from, his former reincarnation was slowly digesting the information he had been given.
After a few seconds Yun Jhin sent him more information regarding the location where the troops could come, he also sent a detailed explanation telling him how he inferred that he was being pursued, things that started from the way he looked to the state of his clothes, Yun Jhin's former reincarnation and his current 'father' was wearing very ragged clothes and this was one of the reasons he almost died due to the cold of the tundra.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation bought the explanation, after all, he could be considered still wet behind the ears regarding the reincarnation business at this point, he only had 10 or 20 reincarnations finished and none of them were truly successful! Yun Jhin's early days of reincarnation were the hardest but every failure tempered him and his willpower, fortunately, he only died to opponents around the same strength as his early on when he was a newbie or his soul could have been obliterated and taken out of the circle of reincarnation.
Yun Jhin's father picked him up as he started to walk through the eye of the storm towards the exit that Yun Jhin pointed out after a while of contemplating, Yun Jhin made it look like he needed some thinking time because if he gave responses too fast he would alert his former reincarnation, after all, while he was still behind the ears he was still quite jumpy considered the current situation, he would start to doubt Yun Jhin a little bit if he knew too much information, after all, what was the chance for a reincarnated person to reincarnate on the same continent on the same planet in the same region?
It was almost null!
In Yun Jhin's countless reincarnations there had never been such an instance!
They easily exited the tundra region as time passed one month went by, Yun Jhin baby body finally could talk and he didn't need to send his soul willpower to his former reincarnation anymore, after all, every time he used his soul in his current body there was a high chance his body would collapse, even for those relatively smaller things, the chance was just very low but it was still there!
Yun Jhin and his 'father' were currently talking about cultivation near a campfire, they already had left the pursuit of the Yatul king behind them and they also left the Yatul Kingdom well behind them.
They were currently on a human-dominated planet and it was full of kingdoms and people that were practically coming from the middle-ages, their cultivation knowledge was quite backward but there were a lot of untapped resources on the planet that could be used and Yun Jhin knew the location of some of the more important ones!
Yun Jhin looked into his 'father's' eyes as he told him:
"You already broke through to the 7th stage of the heavenly realm? It seems something changed about you."
His father chuckled as he said and shook his head with a sly smile on his face:
"It just that senior's guidance is a bit too good, you only taught me 3 things and I have been enlightened to such a stage!"
Yun Jhin knew his former reincarnation was trying to butter him up for more knowledge but if he gave him too much knowledge there was a chance he would be backstabbed, even though he was currently in baby form, now that the man ahead of him knew that there wasn't a newborn soul into this shell, he could easily strengthen himself to kill Yun Jhin!
While he would take pity on newborn souls who had no memories, Yun Jhin was practically an adult, even though he had a baby's body he had an adult mind and his former reincarnation could justify his action that way.
So he had to keep him on a tight leash regarding cultivation knowledge, Yun Jhin himself started to slowly cultivate but cultivation couldn't be rushed at the moment, the earthly realm placed emphasis on the body refining aspect by a bit, and his baby body wouldn't be able to withstand the energy from their current surroundings, he would either have to grow older or find a location with pure and gentle ki that could he absorb for cultivation.
Yun Jhin looked towards his 'father's' eyes again as he told him:
"I need to cultivate so I don't have to rely on you, do you know any locations with gentle ki that I can use?"
Yun Jhin knew of a few locations on the planet they were currently on but this was both a test to see if his former reincarnation wanted to help him genuinely and a way to mask his knowledge to let his former reincarnation guard go down a bit.
His former reincarnation thought for a little time and shook his head but then seemingly a lightbulb appeared above his head and he said:
"Actually at first I couldn't think of anything but now that I remember properly there was such a place with gentle ki, it isn't of much use for me as I'm already at the Heavenly realm but for you, with your current body it would be useful for cultivation, unluckily it was quite far away from where we are and it's also controlled by a local sect, it's also quite near the Yatul kingdom so if we are found by a patrol there is a chance a new pursuit team could be assembled to take us in and execute us."
Yun Jhin pondered for a short while before he told his 'father':
"There is no problem, I have a technique that could let us enter the sect without being found as well as easily escape from any patrols of the kingdom, here let me send it to your soul."
Yun Jhin let out a small soul willpower wave come from his head as it inserted itself into his former reincarnation's, then his 'father's' eyes started to shine as he bowed to Yun Jhin and told him:
"Even though I don't like calling you senior you really are something else!"
Yun Jhin gave him the first part of his patented stealth technique, he didn't give him the version which he improved using Hao Tian's bloodline experiences as he couldn't use it anyways, also if he showed too much of a high knowledge there was a chance his former reincarnations greed would get triggered and he would try to absorb his soul thinking that his soul was still at the recovering stage, if he tried to assimilate his soul at this point, his vessel would die but he would be able to annihilate his former reincarnation's soul as well, but that meant the failure of the test.
Yun Jhin knew that he would fail if his vessel was destroyed, just like last time when his 'mother' severed his heart and ate it, his vessel was destroyed and he was sent back to retake the test in another form.
Yun Jhin had his 'father' to practice the stealth technique and with his current fortuned constitution which was boosting his natural talent by quite a lot, he learned it under 2 days, after that they started to walk back the same way they went through.
Food was still a problem but not very much, they already made some supplies when they left the tundra as animals and multiple types of wild fruits could be found after one exited the tundra, so going back through it was easier.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation was also stronger so he could keep Yun Jhin's baby body-safe enough through the cold, after all, even a speck of his dead mother's ki was able to keep him alive through the tundra, fortunately, they didn't encounter any blizzards during their first travel.
But now they weren't as lucky anymore, as they left the eye of the storm, they realized that compared to before temperature was way lower than before. Sharp winds were howling in the tundra as a strong blizzard was created, howls of cultivation beasts could be heard coming from the once silent tundra.
Yun Jhin could feel that the blizzard had awakened the animals that liked this type of environment and frowned, they took a bad time to come back, unfortunately, Yun Jhin didn't know about this, after all, he never came back to the Yatul kingdom after he left in his former life, he only went forward and he didn't even have time to come for revenge, at some point he died on the planet trying to get one of the special resources and had to reincarnate.
So he wasn't aware of the events that were unfolding in this tundra after he left it behind.
Yun Jhin cursed his hastiness as he told his former reincarnation back away into the eye of the storm where they would be safe, the location's heat was something that the beasts in this location who awoke due to the cold wouldn't like at all.
Suddenly the earth started shaking as a furry paw grabbed onto his former reincarnations right leg and dragged him down into the ground along with Yun Jhin who was strapped to his back using a baby basket made from bamboo and flexible wood.

chapters.title: Chapter 153: This treasure isn't for you (5)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's eyes were closed as they were covered by snow, his breathing was shallow and he could feel his chest hurting like it was rammed by a bull, he tried to move his small hands to clear his eyes so he could regain his vision, in his current situation he couldn't use his soul as he would injure his body even further, his soul was putting pressure on his body even while it was healthy, using it in this situation was suicide.
Yun Jhin could hardly move his small chubby hands towards his eyes as he cleared the snow on them, then he looked around, he realized that he was in an underground cave made by the being that dragged them underground, it was pretty spacious and Yun Jhin's former reincarnation couldn't be found anywhere.
He tried to move but his chest hurt too much, it wasn't known where his former reincarnation was dragged by the beast but it seemed he was left behind because he wasn't nutritious enough for the beast to eat, the basket that was tied to his former reincarnations back snapped the moment they were dragged through the snow into the cave so here he was.
Yun Jhin tried to drag his body out of the pile of snow he was currently in but considering he wasn't even a month old yet meant that it was easier said than done... he also took a chest hit when he hit the ground even though he was snuggled in the basket pretty well.
Yun Jhin frowned, what could he do in this situation?
Three yips were coming from nearby and Yun Jhin froze, the being that just dragged them both underground had kids!
Three furry white balls made their way towards Yun Jhin as they sniffed the air, they were pretty cute as they rolled around in the snowy underground cave.
Yun Jhin couldn't move properly so they three balls got near him and started to sniff him, because Yun Jhin was so close to his former reincarnation when he was attacked some of the attackers smell rubbed off on him and his former reincarnation as well. Suddenly one of the white balls started to yip at him while getting closer, he licked Yun Jhin across the face and then started to growl!
Yun Jhin could feel that the lick made his chest feel better, Yun Jhin realized that they were peculiar beasts the moment they appeared but their healing saliva made him realize that they were special Snow Garguans, only Snow Garguans could use their saliva to heal and they could be considered a rare beast that anyone below the God Realm would want as a pet. Adult snow Garguans could heal one from the brink of death if they had enough saliva stored in their cheeks.
Yun Jhin knew the one who licked him started to growl because he realized he wasn't one of their brethren, they were fooled because of that rubbed off smell, but the moment the small fluff ball tasted him he realized that he was a fake.
There wasn't much he could do here, even though the three things were just babies they were way stronger than him and all he could do was wait for his life to be claimed.
Yun Jhin felt his heart stop beating as the three things were slowly inching towards him while growling and baring their small teeth, suddenly they started to make yip sounds as they shook, it seemed they were scared by something!
Yun Jhin watched as his former reincarnation returned, one of his arms were broken and his right eye was closed as a big scar could be seen coming from his temple to his mouth, there was a peculiar aura going around him as he looked at the small fluff balls on the ground.
He put his hand up as he was ready to blast them into smithereens with his ki when Yun Jhin suddenly sent him a soul transmission which told him:
"Don't kill them, you are lucky that you survived against an adult Garguan should have killed you, it seems you have encountered a teen so we could be considered quite lucky, let me tell you the capabilities of Garguans."
Yun Jhin told him all of the abilities of the beasts and this made his former reincarnation ponder for a few seconds before he grabbed one of the fluff balls and dragged his tongue out of his mouth as he used it to bath himself with it.
The little thing was frightened as it yipped for his mother or father but all it got was his tongue stretched out until he had no more saliva left.
His injuries couldn't heal with only one infant's limited saliva reserve so his former reincarnation went ahead and drained the other two of their saliva.
He got his broken arm healed and his scar sealed up leaving only the sequelae behind.
His former reincarnation sighed as he looked at the little fluff balls and didn't know how he could store them, while they were only almost as big as Yun Jhin, he only had one basket, and that one was broken as well, while he could technically make one big basket that he could put on his back, that meant putting Yun Jhin and the little beasts together.
Yun Jhin saw his former reincarnations conundrum and told him he was ok with it and that he had a way to calm the beasts while they were with him, Yun Jhin's way of calming them was using his soul to influence them, he couldn't have used it right now or he would have surely died due to his semi-serious injury on his chest, but if his body was fully healed he could exert himself a bit.
The cave they were in wasn't that big so his former reincarnation could scale the walls and take all 4 of them out as well, it just took a little bit of time, after 6 hours of climbing up and down they were finally out of the cave.
The three fluff balls were too exhausted to resist and even if they resisted what could they do? Their brother or sister was already killed by Yun Jhin's former reincarnation, what could their little bodies do against him?
Yun Jhin looked his former reincarnation up and down as he muttered to himself:
"Making a fortune out of danger? This fortuned constitution is already showing its edge this early?"
Yun Jhin was obviously very envious but considering they were only inside a test he could only hope he could make use of his former reincarnation properly to get through it.
They returned towards the eye of the storm and left it to get some more bamboo and flexible wood to create a bigger basket in which they could put all of the youngsters of the crew.
Yun Jhin was now sitting amongst the three fluffy beasts in a bigger basket which was tied on his former reincarnations back, they were back inside the tundra and fortunately for them, the blizzard was done as they waited before they re-entered.
They went back to the Yatul Kingdom and with the use of Yun Jhin's stealth technique they easily slipped through any patrols eyes and reached the location where the pure ki was located, Yun Jhin smelled the air as he was let down in the clearing where the ki was along with the 3 snowy beasts.
After using his soul to influence them they were thinking of him as the weaker brother of theirs that they had to protect, they were all around him playing and yipping.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he let them play, he sat on the ground as he started to use his breathing technique to start cultivating, his former reincarnation was watching them from above, he was standing in a tree some distance away as he kept watch for the sect's men, this location was good for newbies and the recruiting time of the sect wasn't around yet, but who knew if any patrols made their way here?
Yun Jhin's body was rumbling as the pure ki was running through it, his baby body was suddenly starting to increase in height as he broke through the 1st stage of the earthly realm in one go!
He was forcefully advancing his age with cultivation using the pure ki in his surroundings!
The three small fluffy beasts yipped as they watched Yun Jhin grow almost as tall as them!
As time passed Yun Jhin's cultivation increased more and more, he was galloping through the cultivation realm using the rich and pure ki in their surroundings.
2nd stage, 3rd stage, 4th stage, He only stopped at the 6th stage because he absorbed all of the ki in his surroundings, if he had this type of ki in his former trial he would have been a heavenly realm cultivator or above by his 11 years old age and he could have withstood his 'mother's' attack.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he felt his ki running through his body, he let out a breath as he got up on his feet and started walking by himself, he now looked to be 6 years old even though only 3 months passed since he started cultivating, he was basically around 4 months old now but his cultivation growth facilitated him to look way above his age.
Yun Jhin looked towards his former reincarnation, he kept watching for those 3 months and he appreciated his hard work, he sent him some more cultivation information that could help him later while also leaving some hidden intent here and there to make sure he wouldn't be betrayed, and if he was he would have some backup plan.
The three little beasts around him had grown a little bit in those 3 months as well, they weren't as big as him anymore but as long as they kept growing well they would get bigger than him in no time.
Yun Jhin sent three soul imprints into their souls stealthily, he wanted to have them under his control in the future and while his former reincarnation was contemplating the knowledge he gave him, he put the three beasts under his control!
He waited for a little bit before his former reincarnation finished contemplating then they left the location behind them, Yun Jhin could cultivate normally now and he could take any types of ki into his body without having to fear that his body would explode so now they could travel towards one of the treasures that he remembered about!
There he would have to put himself in action to see if his conjecture of the test was true or not.

chapters.title: Chapter 154: This treasure isn't for you (6)
chapters.content:
The location of the treasure that Yun Jhin wanted to get his hands on was quite far away from their current location, they could have easily got there if their cultivation bases were a little bit higher but with their current power, all they could do was run there.
Yun Jhin could keep up with his former reincarnation speed and he was currently having the three little beasts in the basket tied to his back instead of his former reincarnation, he said that he wanted to use the weight of the basket to continue his training, while the earthly realm consisted of absorbing ki to temper the body, doing normal exercises could also contribute to the increase in the realm, as long as they were intense enough.
As time passed the weight of the three fluffy balls weight started to increase so they could be useful for Yun Jhin's 'training'.
He was just finishing his touches on the mind control of the three beasts this way.
His former reincarnation was still a little bit doubtful of him so he kept a close watch on him, but Yun Jhin's former reincarnation was at a very low level both in knowledge and experience so he could easily slip through his attempts on spying on him, after all, even though cultivation knowledge could be given, the experience couldn't.
The location of the treasure was 1 million kilometers away from their current location and with their current speed it would take them years to arrive!
It didn't help that the location was underwater in the ocean, technically speaking they shouldn't even be able to reach that location with their cultivation base, they would need to be at least at the ki cultivating stage to be able to breathe underwater.
But considering Yun Jhin's knowledge he could easily boost their cultivation to that point and make them arrive faster, even though there weren't many teleportation formations on such a low rung planet like the one they were currently on, Yun Jhin still knew of a few that could cut short their journey.
Yun Jhin found the teleportation formation in a hidden location around a mountainous region where he and his former reincarnation 'coincidentally' arrived.
At first, his former reincarnation was quite suspicious of the teleportation formation, after all, he was a country bumpkin and he wasn't sure what the formation would do, he was immediately convinced after Yun Jhin sent him some more information through the soul link.
After they entered the formation and used it they cut around 60% of the distance that they had to go through.
It took them half a year more to reach the ocean, and their cultivation bases have also increased with the time they used while traveling, Yun Jhin was at the 6th stage of the Heavenly realm while his former reincarnation was at the 2nd stage of the ki cultivating realm, due to having no resources it became harder and harder for his former reincarnation to improve, but his fortuned constitution still gave him an edge that other people on this planet couldn't have.
The ocean was sparkling blue as summer came around, the heat was beating down on the weathered faces of Yun Jhin and his former reincarnation, 3 big buff fluff balls were encircling Yun Jhin like was a VIP and they were the bodyguards.
The little fluff balls had grown in size becoming 2,50 meters tall and dwarfing Yun Jhin who was now 1,65 meters tall.
Their cultivation bases were also in the heavenly realm but they were lower, around the 1st stage.
Yun Jhin did his best to increase their cultivation but he had no resources to work with during their travels, and the resources that he found he could only use for himself, he wasn't overflowing with ki to the point that he would waste anything on the three beasts.
The water was moving slowly in the ocean as Yun Jhin looked over it, his former reincarnation was waiting for any information, he knew that his 'old master' made him walk here because he knew of a treasure that he heard about through some information channels during his former life.
Of course, all of that was a lie. Yun Jhin eyes were closed as he was seemingly meditating on the location of the treasure, his former reincarnation just kept waiting, as time passed he became a little impatient, the prospect of a treasure that could increase his cultivation made his emotion go a bit haywire, after all, in all of his former reincarnations he was always poor or died around the king realm, he never got his hands on a special treasure that he could call his own.
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he pointed towards the general direction of the ocean as he said:
"We will need to dive into the ocean and swim towards that direction, you will need to use your ki cultivating, cultivation base to construct an air bubble around our heads so we could breathe underwater, then I shall be able to guide us towards the location of the treasure, fortunately, it seems that no one has been around and the treasure location isn't known at the moment."
His former reincarnation nodded as he blew out some bubbles using his ki, those bubbles stuck to their heads along with the beast's and then they dived into the ocean!
The oceanic beings looked at them with fear as they scattered, at the surface of the water small fish with no cultivation bases lived, even normal people could fish it for a living.
But the deeper one went the dangerous things became...
Yun Jhin started to dive along with the beasts and his former reincarnation while also going forward...
The light in their surroundings started to darken as they got closer to the ocean floor and the pressure of the water increased accordingly.
All of their bodies were sturdy enough to withstand the water pressure but the darkness started to become a problem, Yun Jhin used his cultivation base to light up a small light ball on his finger that he used to navigate the waters around them...
Suddenly he could feel some eyes watching him from below... they were deep whites with no pupils, sharp fangs could be seen jutting below those eyes... the darkness unveiled itself as a gigantic fish with the face of a man appeared.
There were no screeches, no sounds underwater, the fish with the face of the man opened his fanged mouth and let out a soundless cry that pierced directly into all of Yun Jhin's party souls.
Yun Jhin knew this was the guardian of the treasure, the treasure was quite special as it attracted hte local marine form to protect it from outsiders, during his former life he didn't get to encounter this thing as it was already slain when he arrived at this point.
The things cultivation base was in the ki cultivating stage as light could be seen swimming around his body.
Yun Jhin sent some information on how to kill the fish along with instruction on where to hit it to his former reincarnation then the little ball that gave light to them increased in size and launched itself at the fish' pupilless eyes exploding into a gigantic flash that made him start trashing around!
Even though his eyes were pupilless he still needed them to see in the environment, he could see well in the darkness and any increase in the light around him would attract his attention, such a high intensity of light left the fish blind for sure!
Seeing that Yun Jhin did his job properly, his former reincarnation heaved a mighty shout as a purple ki aura engulfed his body, his left hand was put forward as he charged a gigantic ki ball that he threw towards the big fish trying to fry it to death!
The fish's tail was bony and had one hole going through the center, sensing danger he used his tail and put it forward to absorb the ki attack from Yun Jhin's 'father' and send it back through the hole in the middle!
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation gave out a mighty roar as he used his hand to deflect the ball of ki to above where it exploded into a mini mushroom cloud.
Yun Jhin sent more instructions as he charged his soul willpower into a circular motion to attack the fish's directional ability so the next attack would surely hit and kill him.
The fish started screeching as he felt the male human head start to hurt, he trashed into his surroundings randomly as he roared.
Suddenly another ki ball struck it in its center creating a big hole through its body making it start floating up to the surface, it was dead!
Yun Jhin ignored the dead fish, it couldn't be as useful as the treasure, and surely their battle would have attracted the attention of the other marine beings by now, they had to rush into the underwater cave to get their prize!

chapters.title: Chapter 155: This treasure isn't for you (final part)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin and his former reincarnation along with the three big fluff balls were currently swimming at their fastest speed towards the location of the underwater cave.
The cave was just below the fish that they killed, with a little bit of swimming they reached it and entered.
The natural lights of the cave were pretty bright considering their current location, there were mosses on the walls of the cave that lighted up the surroundings with a fluorescent green light.
Yun Jhin ignored the light as he started to walk forward along with the three little beasts, his former reincarnation knew that he wouldn't act like this unless the treasure that they were going to find would be as good as he said. So he immediately followed behind as he didn't want Yun Jhin to hog all of the treasure for himself.
The cave wasn't deep nor big, it was actually quite stifling, the walls were near each other and Yun Jhin had to hug the wall and walk sideways to go through, he could feel cold breathing come from the other side of the small corridor he was going through.
The three beasts were in front of him, squeezing as best as they could, but due to their big stature, they could barely move through the thin openings.
Behind him moved his former reincarnation who was thinking of attacking him at this point, they were both so close to each other and since he could get the treasure by moving a few more meters in front of him, why would he need Yun Jhin's help anymore?
The thirst and greed of a cultivator was something that everyone got a hold of after they got their first cultivation resource, no matter how small, it would infiltrate the cultivator's brain and soul and transform them into betrayers and backstabbers, cultivation was like a drug, you couldn't stop from doing it unless you got such a high resistance to it that you couldn't get high on it anymore.
His former reincarnation closed his palm into a fist as he looked at Yun Jhin's back but then he thought for a little more as they walked slowly towards the exit of the corridor... what if there was something he couldn't deal with after they exited this narrow place?
Thus he decided against killing him for now, after a while they finally left the narrow corridor to arrive in a big empty chamber, Yun Jhin walked to the end of the chamber as he struck the rock pattern there, 3 times in 3 different ways, then he inserted his ki inside it to open the treasure chamber.
The cold breathing that impacted the both of them when they were traversing the narrow corridor appeared again, now it was so obvious that it was from a living being that Yun Jhin's former reincarnation was glad that he didn't kill Yun Jhin when he could.
The guardian fish from before wasn't put there by the one who left this treasure here, it was just attracted by the treasure's innate aura and made his home near the cave.
The true guardian of the treasure was a gigantic ice golem who was exuding icy breathing from his body.
Yun Jhin body started to burn as his inner ki flames started to appear around his body, at his cultivation base that was the only ki that he could use, he couldn't do anything else besides activating some flames around his body.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation started to throw flames at the icy golem who was slowly activating to attack the intruders.
The three beasts started to take in deep breaths as they absorbed the icy breathing that the golem was exuding, their muscles started to expand as they launched themselves at the golem's big body trying to tackle it down so Yun Jhin and his former reincarnation could transform it into a puddle!
Yun Jhin looked on as the beasts successfully tackled the golem to the ground, he jumped towards the golems circular head and struck it three times with his fire engulfed fists. The head became deformed as Yun Jhin struck it three times in a row and his central control core started to break thus making the golem go on a rampage!
He started to thrash his arms around throwing away the beasts from his body and he launched all of his icy power from his body into his surroundings creating an ice ring that transformed Yun Jhin into an ice sculpture!
The beasts started to roar as their master was transformed into an ice sculpture, the more icy energy entered their bodies the stronger they became as their muscles inflated to the maximum capabilities of their bodies.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation was still charging his ball of fire ki, it became so big that it was slowly reaching the ceiling of the cave, suddenly his eyes started to glitter as he threw the gigantic ball at the icy golem who was on a rampage.
The golem couldn't dodge the gigantic attack in time and half of his body turned into a puddle of water as he fell on one side and practically 'died'.
Yun Jhin remained frozen as the heatwave was absorbed fully by the body of the golem, if he wasn't thawed out of the ice sooner he would die of hypothermia
The three beasts didn't have any fire-based attacks so they couldn't heat the ice, and if they broke the ice with Yun Jhin's current situation there was a chance his body would break as well!
They needed to heat the ice good enough before trying to break it.
They looked towards Yun Jhin's former reincarnation but he already left them behind as he got closer to the treasure that appeared after they defeated the guardian.
It was an urn inscribed with runes that indicated it's usage, it could be used to create pills without the need of fire nor skill, all you had to do was put in the herbs in according to the order of the recipe and it would create the pill!
This was a very good treasure that anyone would kill for, pill masters were very rare and high and mighty, they would have their nose so up into the air that you would need to pay an arm and a leg along with the herbs for them to concoct you the pill you needed.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation was so happy as he looked at the urn that he couldn't help but cheer and punch the air.
He easily took the urn into his spatial bag then put his attention on Yun Jhin's frozen form, he didn't know if he should help him in this situation or not... after all, he already got the treasure and a lot of help from him, he was pondering if to help him or just get rid of him at this point.
Suddenly the three muscled fluff balls were angrily glaring at Yun Jhin's former reincarnation as they started to growl and howl at him.
His former reincarnation frowned as he looked at the three beings, did they understand that he was thinking of killing him? But how close did these three became while he wasn't aware?
He frowned as he put his hand forward wanting to destroy these three beasts first, if they were so loyal to Yun Jhin that meant they would be useless to him.
Suddenly the beasts disappeared from his senses, as some mist appeared in the whole cave things started to become dangerous for Yun Jhin's former reincarnation.
He couldn't see nor hear anything, almost all of his senses were sealed at this point and he didn't know how did these three beasts do this while he took the urn.
Suddenly he felt two furry paws clutching his legs and two more clutching his arms, and another two caught him by the waist, it was as if he was tied to a cross!
A disappointed sigh could be heard from the mist as Yun Jhin appeared in front of his former reincarnation, the mist came from the puddle of water from the icy golem combined with the innate talent of the three beasts.
As for how Yun Jhin got out of the ice? He just overheated his body using his cultivation technique to the point that he injured himself as well.
He had no hair or eyebrows left and there were third-degree burns on his body along with frostbite, but he ignored everything as he looked into his former reincarnation eyes and said:
"I don't think this treasure is meant for you, my friend."
His former reincarnation tried to get out of his holding but suddenly he felt a deep pain inside his head and the beast's hold strengthened as well. Yun Jhin tsked as he continued to look into his eyes and he activated the seals that he put inside the information he gave him attacking his soul and inflicting a huge amount of damage on his measly soul space.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation started to shout as a ki barrier of dark green color appeared around him and forced the three beasts away while severing their limbs.
Yun Jhin looked at the bleeding beasts that continued to stay near his former reincarnation regardless of their situation and shook his head as he said:
"Detonate."
All three beasts exploded at the same time destroying the barrier created by his former reincarnation and engulfing both of them in the explosion.
Yun Jhin coughed as he got up, since he was a little bit farther away and he used all of his ki until his body turned dry he escaped with his life, but one of his arms was crippled and the other was severed from the elbow.
