He was surely going to die in this situation but he didn't care, he dragged his body towards his former reincarnation using his chin and got a good look at him, he was still breathing but he was looking as poorly as he was, he would also die pretty soon from the looks of things but Yun Jhin wanted to end him by himself!
He conjectured that he must kill his own former reincarnation as the people that he wronged for him to pass the test, now was the time to see if it was true or not!
His mouth quickly went towards his former reincarnation neck as he took a huge chunk out of it and then spit it out on his face.
His former reincarnation couldn't breathe anymore and due to the blood loss and the explosion from the self-destruction of three beasts meant that he was dead now!
Yun Jhin felt a pang of pain in his head the moment he killed his former reincarnation but also a liberation of some sorts.. it was like he was freer than before... like some things that he didn't need were forgotten. But then those memories rushed back at him and integrated into his memory palace along with some helpful information about the test.
Yun Jhin smiled as he realized that he was right, and there were also more benefits to the test itself compared to the inheritance!

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Drag you down with me!
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin felt his surroundings starting to shake just as if he was swimming underwater and he remained out of oxygen, it felt just like he was on a boat under a big storm.
That meant he was going on to the next test!
Yun Jhin felt his lungs burning as he looked down at his chest and saw a hand going through it, he felt his head explode as he looked up and saw a familiar face!
It was the face of his reincarnation, number 69!
A woman with a jade-like countenance was currently keeping her hand inside Yun Jhin's chest storming his inner ki pathways with her own ki and destroying his meridians.
Yun Jhin coughed a mouthful of blood as he remembered the situation, in this current reincarnation he had been put in the position of one of the concubines he had to kill to take their position and curry favor with a king for cultivation resources.
Yun Jhin was quite shameless as a female, regarding his body, he had used it to gain whatever favors he could along with cultivation resources, when he had no more uses for the male in question he would annihilate him and absorb his vital yang energy dry.
Yun Jhin was currently in the body of the head concubine of the king in question, he had been ambushed on the way back to the capital by his former reincarnation and fought her way towards a cliff where she finally lost the battle and had her chest pierced into defeat.
Yun Jhin's current cultivation was around the Emperor's realm but it was slowly going down at a visible pace, his former reincarnation was laughing gleefully as her eyes light up seeing the blood flowing down from Yun Jhin's chest like a waterfall. It was obvious she was a poisonous snake ready to end the job.
Yun Jhin could feel his life slipping through his fingers as he grasped the arm that was stuck in his chest and his eyes turned a deep shade of red, he died previously but that part of the test could still be considered to be done, that meant that as long as he killed his former reincarnation, even in a suicidal fashion, he would have completed the test!
Seeing the crazed look on Yun Jhin's face made his former reincarnation immediately try to retract her arm from Yun Jhin's chest, seeing that he was going to do something rather crazy in this situation, after all, he was one step away from death and his former reincarnation knew that cultivators would take extreme actions at this point if they could see no point of breakthrough or escape.
Yun Jhin's body started to glow a deep red as blood flowed from his red eyes, his former reincarnation tried to move backward but her arm was stuck inside Yun Jhin's body!
Yun Jhin contracted his muscles and inner organs trapping his former reincarnation arm inside his body, even though doing this injured him to the brink of death he could still do something here!
Yun Jhin took a few steps backward as he free-fell down the cliff along with his former reincarnation who he forced to follow him!
His former reincarnation used her ability to levitate as she was below the Emperor's realm and she couldn't fly. Technically Yun Jhin shouldn't have been able to kill the main concubine this easily in his former life, but he poisoned her beforehand and still had an epic fight with her before she was pushed to the cliff where she was afterward thrown off.
In the former situation, there was no way for the concubine to purge the poison and escape her fate, even now Yun Jhin could only purge the poison but not reverse the inner injuries that the body got, but he could force the body beyond its limits and take down his former reincarnation with him!
Yun Jhin's body was already unstable, the faster he fell the more he felt his muscles starting to unclench, and if that happened his former reincarnation's arm would be free and she could glide away and free!
Yun Jhin looked directly at his former reincarnation's eyes as he mouthed:
"Detonate..."
Yun Jhin's body exploded into a bunch of gore that disappeared into ashes as the aftermath energy from the explosion reached it, the explosion severed his former reincarnations arm and blinded both of her eyes as she started to fall down the cliff at a high speed.
Yun Jhin's soul was absorbed into the pocket space where darkness prevailed as his head started to hurt again, his former reincarnation didn't die instantly the moment the body he inhabited exploded, after all, the explosion was rather weak because the body wasn't at its full strength and cultivation.
However, the proximity and Yun Jhin's special self-destructing technique meant that she would have surely died anyway!
Especially because she couldn't glide anymore and the moment she hit the ground below the cliff she would have broken every bone in her body...
Yun Jhin could understand what this test was doing right now, it seemed that he was supposed to destroy the wills of his former reincarnations that remained in his memories.
He had control of the memory core as the latest reincarnation, and the strongest to boot, but that didn't mean the former wills accepted that, they were only biding their time until Yun Jhin's soul was weakened enough so they could take over it, this was a major problem with most reincarnated ones, but this problem didn't really appear because most reincarnated persons wouldn't reach the staggering amount of reincarnations that Yun Jhin achieved.
Yun Jhin had so many different personalities and wills inside of him that he couldn't count them anymore, all of them were sealed in the memories of his former lives and his current will was the strongest, they were all basically peasants while the current will was the Emperor.
It would be a lie to say if Yun Jhin wasn't bothered by the fact that he had so many different wills inside him, but the problem was that he couldn't absorb them by himself, his main soul would get polluted by their emotions and inner schemes, but it seemed this trial was helping him with this problem!
When his head hurt as if it felt like it was splitting and his brain was gushing hotly through his ears, it meant that one of the memory cores of his former lives was being separated then purged from the will before being reinserted into his soul.
Yun Jhin wasn't sure how this was done, he didn't have such a high understanding of souls, this was a realm that Yun Jhin thought that he could reach after he broke through the limits of the God Realm.
It seems Hell's will was really special considering this inheritance trial was held by it.
Suddenly a boundless genderless voice exploded into his head:
"Aren't you a smart outsider?"
Yun Jhin knew that after he finished two trials successfully, Hell's will had finally decided to descend upon him.
Yun Jhin could feel an immense pressure upon his soul, which meant even at his peak he wouldn't be able to do anything to this willpower fragment that entered him!
Hell's will was surely above the God Realm!
A snort could be heard coming from inside his head indicating that the willpower was getting tired of his monologuing:
"Oh great Hellish willpower, why have you graced me with your presence?"
A burst of laughter could be heard in his head as the voice told him:
"Enough bootlicking Yun Jhin, I know you since you have first put your foot in hell in your 627th reincarnation, you don't have to sugarcoat your words around me boy!"
"I just descended upon you because you have finally understood what are you supposed to do within this test, to be honest with you I would like you to be the one that inherited my power, after all, you would be the perfect host, both physically and mentally."
Yun Jhin understood what Hell's willpower meant, he was both decisive and could be considered an evil son of a bitch from most of the people's existence, even those that were on his side.
So he could be considered the perfect host for hell's inheritance huh?
Yun Jhin's eyes started to flicker as he thought about something but then the voice boomed in his head again:
"Thinking of sabotaging your competition? I like it but I can't help you!"
"But I can do you a favor and tell you the results of the other participants... you are in the last place currently, the others had found way quicker how to deal with their former reincarnations, you were the slowest because you are too paranoid and too careful."
Yun Jhin sighed, this wasn't something that could be helped... after all, this is the paranoia that he had cultivated over thousands of reincarnations, it couldn't just go and leave him right now, even if he wanted to abandon it for the test. It was something that was now stuck in his soul. It wasn't that he didn't want to be a bit more daring but he feared failure too much, after all, he failed so many times already!
It did build his character but it also made him disgusted with failure, it made him feel that he could do better and that he could easily get over those problems if he could.. thus he dwelled in paranoia.
"I'm actually quite disappointed in you, you have no faults and you are an evil being of high potential... a perfect host, but you aren't chaotic enough, hell is the establishment that puts chaos and survival in the first place, maybe this inheritance isn't for you..."
The voice faded away as Yun Jhin remained alone in the dark again... he could see the light at the end of the tunnel which meant he was being sent head-first into another test!

chapters.title: Chapter 157: I had many lives
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin had so many lives that he had to actively search for the memory cores of his earlier ones or the memories from those lives wouldn't pop into his consciousness, it couldn't be helped, he had access to the memories but he couldn't stuff all of them in his soul, after all, even a peak God Realm expert's soul couldn't handle so many memories by themselves, they could create memory cores and separate them as if they were all different hard drives in a computer.
Yun Jhin could feel his consciousness transfer into another person... as he looked around he realized that he was in a dungeon filled with dead people, all of them were already started to rot, most of the visible meat and skin was dark and filled with maggots, all the blood was dry and there were brittle dry old bones strewn around him.
His hands were tied to a wall with steel manacles and there was nothing around him besides the putrid corpses.
Yun Jhin sealed his sense of smell as he looked around and felt that his whole body was numb which meant his blood circulation was blocked beforehand... did the owner of the previous body died?
Yun Jhin started to search for memories of this particular situation but none came into his head... that meant this person who died here was hurt unintentionally by Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin's actions were far-reaching and this person could have been a son daughter, or relative of someone he killed or enslaved, thus his cronies decided to deal with him to curry favor even though Yun Jhin didn't set out any orders for him to be killed or kidnapped.
Yun Jhin sighed as he started to sense his inner situation, it seemed that his cultivation was half-crippled before the owner of the body died previously, his meridians were shattered but his ki pathways were still strong enough, meridians could be healed with time even for a mortal but if the pathways were severed only those at the sage realm or above could mend them by themselves and that was with the use of precious materials.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he felt the drained ki in his body starting to enliven at his attempts to cultivate, the broken meridians sent sharp bouts of pain through his whole body but he ignored it, it wasn't his main body and this wasn't a test so he could abuse those bodies as much as he wanted as long as he got the results that he needed.
The dungeon Yun Jhin was currently in wasn't that big, the rotting bodies were in a big mound near him and if he moved wrongly they could pile up on him and drown him, there was a small iron door at the end of the dungeon that suddenly opened as Yun Jhin tried to cultivate.
A bald ugly old man came forward, his back was bent from old age and he had liver spots all over his face, he had a dirty goatee that was full of grease and he wore a red effeminate armor, his eyes darted from side to side and saliva was dripping from his mouth which showed that he wasn't fully in his mental capabilities, his face was also flushed which indicated that he was also drunk.
He came closer to Yun Jhin's body as he looked down at it, Yun Jhin closed his eyes and faked death while waiting for the man to get closer to him so he could kill him!
The old man got closer to the mound of bodies but a leg that stuck out from the mound seemingly tripped him, he tried to support himself on the unsteady mount which made the mound collapse on both Yun Jhin and him!
Yun Jhin closed his sense of smell but he couldn't make himself unable to feel the slithery feelings of those putrid bodies, it was quite disgusting but he endured as he waited for the old drunken man to something.
Yun Jhin frowned as he heard snoring, the old man was knocked out by the booze and he felt that the putrid corpses were a great alternative to a quilt.
Yun Jhin became a bit angry at this setback, his ki revolved inside of him as he ripped the steel manacles of his hands with sheer arm strength alone, the dungeon was full of death ki and Yun Jhin had ways to harvest it to return his cultivation to normal which wasn't weak, he was currently at the peak of the ki cultivating realm and he was close to the King Realm.
He searched a bit for the old man who was buried in the mound of corpses and took him out before slashing his neck and absorbing his soul for information. Sorting through the useless information Yun Jhin realized which reincarnation he was in right now.
The owner of the body was previously a prince of the nation that Yun Jhin had taken care of, Yun Jhin killed the king and stole the wife because she was a great incubator for his devilish techniques and decided to take over the kingdom as well in passing, the prince tried to protect his mother with his life but he easily got captured by his former reincarnation's cronies and beaten to a half-crippled state before being thrown in the dungeon with the reminder of dead people or dying people.
Yun Jhin frowned as he remembered the cultivation his former reincarnation would have at this time... it was around the early stage of the Emperor realm which meant that with his current strength even a suicidal attack wouldn't do anything... this would take him a lot of time unless he burnt his potential and used a forbidden formation... but considering the current situation he could do both.
Unfortunately, Yun Jhin's reincarnation could be considered rather experienced by now, if he remembered correctly, this was his 627 reincarnation and he went through a lot of hardships to reach this number, he wasn't a pup like the former one where he let him live until he got greedy enough for the urn treasure.
To create the formation he already had the ingredients, which were human bodies and lives.. the forbidden technique also needed time to prepare which meant he couldn't act immediately and he knew that his former reincarnation would leave the kingdom the moment he finished cultivating using the King's wife as an incubator, absorbing her whole Yin energy dry and thus killing her in the process.
That meant he would have to get to work already!
Yun Jhin started to move the bodies in the dungeon according to the formation's diagram that he drew in his head, he also heated the dry blood until it became crystallized as he used it to create runes.
At the same time he was creating the formation in the dungeon he was also punishing his body using the forbidden technique, expending his life span and talent for a sudden increase in strength at the moment he needed it.
His blonde hair was currently turning silver at a quick pace.
Up above him in the king's bedroom, the queen's cries could be heard through the whole upper part of the castle. The maids were deep red as they heard the queen's moans and they made sure to not get near, they heard her moan like this for hours and it seemed like it wouldn't stop soon!
Suddenly after 5 more hours, the moan's stopped as a gloomy man with dark hair and eyes came out of the bedroom, he slicked back his long hair and tied it in a ponytail as he put on a dark robe made from an unknown metallic material.
He had a dark aura around him that was full of blood, death, and decay, there was even a skull image appearing behind him from time to time as the aura condensed.
Behind him the open doors showed the beautiful queen with blonde hair barely moving, her legs were shaking due to the intense actions that had happened previously in the bedroom and her face was as white as a paper sheet, at this rate he would die in a day or two due to exhaustion.
While her face was white Yun Jhin's complexion was as rudy as possible as he stood there and closed his eyes to concentrate on refining the Yin energy that he stole from the king's wife.
Suddenly a rumbling came from the dungeons which made Yun Jhin's eyes open and flicker as he looked down there.. he frowned as he didn't remember imprisoning anyone strong there... were his cronies that useless that they would let someone that he didn't even bother to learn about escape?
Suddenly a dark palm made of rotten flesh came out of the floorboards and grabbed at Yun Jhin's former reincarnation foot, dragging him through the floors breaking them, and making him arrive forcefully in the dungeon where Yun Jhin was currently, at the same time a barrier surrounded the both of them making them unable to escape, death ki started to rise out of all of the corpses that Yun Jhin put in some peculiar positions around the dungeon.
The death ki then infused itself forcefully into Yun Jhin's body as the bodies around him started to dry like prunes until they transformed into nothing but dust, everything that made from blood to stains to anything that remained from humans disappeared from the dungeon as Yun Jhin absorbed it all to strengthen himself in accord to the forbidden technique.
The formation's use wasn't to trap his former reincarnation, that was only part one of the formation's use, it's main use was to supply Yun Jhin's forbidden technique to give him enough strength to deal the death blow!
His former reincarnation shook his head as he cleared his mind from the dizziness of being dragged through 13 floors by a decayed piece of rotten flesh only to find himself in a dungeon with a crazy old man that looked to be ready to explode at any moment, Yun Jhin's current form was of a hulking abomination with an open stomach where his intestines and organs could be seen, he had crazed red eyes and his skin turned a sickly green, and he was ready to kill his former reincarnation to advance even further into the test!
But a snort came out of his former reincarnation's mouth as he looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and his aura solidified... the skull pattern behind him became fully visible as a sudden pressure appeared to start pressing Yun Jhin's abominable body down trying to transform it into a meat pancake...

chapters.title: Chapter 158: Most of them were like this
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's eyes started to come out of their sockets due to the intense pressure coming from his former reincarnations skull apparition, it was a technique that made use of the Yin energy stole from multiple incubators, it used the coldness of Yin energy to create gravity through friction with the air, the pressure aura that it was created along with the fusion of ki created an improvised artificial gravitational field that was quite small.
If Yun Jhin's body wasn't currently so hulking and big he could easily dodge this weaker version of his bloodline ability, but considering his current cultivation base discrepancy and his gigantic body all he could do was endure the pressure.
His former reincarnation snorted as he looked at his bulging green form and decided to devour his soul to see what was his identity and why he was so noisy.
He put his hand forward inching it closer to Yun Jhin's monstrous green face before saying:
"Rip!"
He was trying to rip Yun Jhin's soul from his body then devour it through a weaker technique than Yun Jhin would use previously in his former lives, Yun Jhin had already improved onto that technique to perfection and he could see many flaws in this old one that his former reincarnation was using, his eyes glittered as he activated his soul unique frequency to disrupt the soul ripping attempt then used the improved technique on his attacker to disrupt his balance!
His former reincarnation felt dizzy as the technique he attempted to use on Yun Jhin backfired and made his head swim, thus his control over the artificial gravitational field was thus canceled and Yun Jhin's hideous green body could get up and give him a big hug!
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation got angered as he fell for this trick and immediately started to shout as he powered up using his ki trying to pry Yun Jhin's meaty hands away from his body, he could feel Yun Jhin was currently full of fluids from different body parts of humans as he sat in the dungeon for quite a long time and he felt disgusted by him!
"GET THE HELL OFF ME!"
With a mighty shout, a purple aura engulfed Yun Jhin as he was bombarded by the aura attack of his former reincarnation, however, he just stood there without caring that his skin was flayed and burned nor that his head was almost pierced by a tentacle-like whip that just appeared from the purple aura.
Yun Jhin just kept hugging his former reincarnation which made it even angrier as he could feel the slimy caked blood sweat and bodily liquids starting to seep into his robe regardless of its metallic properties, at this point he knew that Yun Jhin was doing it on purpose!
Yun Jhin wasn't doing it on purpose but his energy was very low and when he wanted to explode himself the pressure from the gravity had impacted his ki pathways to the point that they almost got sealed, he was currently clenching onto his former reincarnation body trying to buy time so he could unseal them and then explode!
But at some point, he could feel that he couldn't hold on anymore as his monstrous arms were finally cut from the elbow leaving him disarmed.
He fell on his butt, not due to the shock but due to the weakness of his body, if he couldn't use his arm to clench on his former reincarnation his weak body couldn't stay up by itself anymore, the forbidden technique was still taking a toll on his body at the moment and his body was very old, he looked pretty much like a disgusting double mutated grampa hulk now.
"You disgusting thing... using your last amount of life force to sully me! I shall eradicate you right now, your identity is damned along with you!"
Yun Jhin's eyes glittered as his former reincarnation monologued, he used to do that... and he still did it from time to time but only when his enemy was close to death or had no power to defend himself from the death blow. Yun Jhin just realized how dumb his former actions were!
Suddenly Yun Jhin got up from the ground and his mouth bit on his former reincarnation's shoulder holding tight as his ki pathways were unsealed and he could explode now!
Suddenly he looked down at his chest with the corner of his eyes seeing his former reincarnations palm being placed there and a big hole appearing where his heart was supposed to be... he just chuckled as a mushroom-shaped explosion took over the both of them destroying the palace along with anyone that was currently inside it!"
Yun Jhin's soul was ejected from the trial plane as he was back in the darkness, the familiar feeling of pain and his recovering memories that inserted themselves in his main memory core washed over him... fortunately he had succeeded because of his former reincarnation tendency of being dumb in the face having an immense advantage.
Now that he realized that monologuing was dumb unless you had already decapitated your opponent, destroyed their souls, burned their bodies to ashes, and feasted on their decapitated heads to finish the absorption of their flesh and the destruction of their souls... up till now he was rather lucky as no one got his hands on such explosion techniques as he had, or else he would have been a smoking body and a destroyed soul long ago.
A peal of laughter could be heard coming over him as Hell's will descended again... this guy sure was free Yun Jhih thought:
"It seems you sure have a love for explosions, don't you? But I cannot complain, a wise man once said that art is an explosion!"
Yun Jhin could doubt the veracity of that statement, he only resorted to such tactics because of the cultivation of the bodies he ended up into, he didn't really like using such kamikaze attacks.
Seeing that Yun Jhin remained mute after his comment Hell's will made a coughing sound as it continued:
"You are getting closer to the end of the first type of trial... even though I would want you to fully get rid of all of the wills inside of your memory cores it isn't possible within the current pagoda, and I'm not sure you will live enough to reach the appearance of the trial on the 9th layer so you have to live with being able to get rid only of a few willpowers, don't give me that look you are the one who reincarnated so many times."
The voice disappeared as Yun Jhin was thrust once again in a different location of the trial.
He found himself underwater, a cloth sack was put over his head and cement was tied on both of his feet with a steel manacle, he didn't have any cultivation...
"What the hell am I supposed to do in this situation???"
Yun Jhin tried to struggle out of his bindings but his arms were tied to his back using a strong rope, he couldn't do anything as the water was filling his lungs and his oxygen supply was ending... again what was he supposed to do in this situation?
Was Hell's will choosing at random when he sent him inside the trials after analyzing his memories or did it just want to torture him from time to time?
Yun Jhin thought for a few seconds before he realized that this current body was the one of a villager he killed in his 3rd reincarnation, this villager always abused him verbally when he was stealing bread, in the 3rd reincarnation he was a troublesome orphan in a small city on an upper ranked planet, this was one of the most miserable lives he had but he remembered it vividly as he made sure to imprint it in his memory core so he wouldn't forget where he got up from.
Unlike the fortuned ones he didn't have any manors hidden in his pants nor any grandpas hidden in his ears, his soul was also free from any experience besides his former two reincarnations which were actually sealed at the time, as he reincarnated more and more he learned to how to unlock his memories earlier and earlier to the point that the moment he reincarnated he had his memories with him. However, the early reincarnations had to work hard for that to happen.
This was the first kill that triggered some of his memories from his former two lives to flooding Yun Jhin's third reincarnation head.
It could be seen that Yun Jhin was a psychopath even without his former reincarnation memories, but he only applied to adults.. he just hated them with passion after his first reincarnation went through a rather rough experience.
Now that he knew where he was... he remembered that there was a fishing boat nearby that could help him out, when he left this body to sink to the bottom of the ocean in his third reincarnation there was a fishing boat navigating in his surroundings that he ignored.
He sent out a soul call to influence the fishermen who were going to throw their nets to catch fish to catch him. The fishermen above him were in a sizeable boat and they suddenly felt that there could be a large haul around them... they could say that it was their instinct after fishing so many times in these treacherous waters, yeah that was it.
They threw the net down and Yun Jhin was immediately caught in it, seeing that they caught something rather heavy (cement block) they immediately tried to fish it out only to fish out Yun Jhin's shivering and cold body who was almost out of oxygen to their boat... Yun Jhin's face was blue as the sack covering his face was took away and then a brawny scared man came forward and started to give him CPR.
It was stormy weather so no light was shining on the brawny man's bald head... Yun Jhin woke up immediately as he coughed up water making the bald man unable to give him mouth to mouth.
Yun Jhin looked around confused then faked fainting...
The brawny man inched closer thinking that it was time for kissing but Yun Jhin was breathing correctly which made him disappointed... it seemed sailing for so much time made the brawny man be built differently.
Yun Jhin felt his body being carried inside the living quarters of the medium-sized ship, he looked around after he was left alone and sighed only to feel as if shivers were going down his spine as the brawny man appeared from behind a wooden beam of the ship... he was looking at Yun Jhin with eyes of passion as he said:
"Now that I saved you... you should repay me a bit don't you think!"
He went a little bit closer to Yun Jhin and whispered in his ear:
"It costs you..."
"30 silver pieces!"
He put his hand forward near Yun Jhin's eyes as he told him:
"Now pay up!"
Yun Jhin sweatdropped... if he remembered correctly his current body was the head of the orphanage and he did have some money but he also remembered how he first stole everything from his pockets after he knocked him out with a big wooden club during that former reincarnation... what would the man do if he had no money to pay him?

chapters.title: Chapter 159: Children leave the nest to stir trouble
chapters.content:
The burly man tried to exhort some money from Yun Jhin because he saved him, but Yun Jhin was currently penniless...
Seeing Yun Jhin's awkward look made the man understand that he was broke, thus he looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and told him:
"Then you have to work on the ship!"
Yun Jhin didn't have time for this bullshit, with his current adult body he could somewhat unleash his soul and this person in front of him was as ordinary as he could be.
A soul tentacle latched onto this person's forehead without him feeling anything as he said afterward:
"Maybe I was a little bit too harsh on you... after all, you almost drowned and your situation was a little bit suspicious... I guess we can give you a ride to the nearest city free of charge!"
Yun Jhin sat on the bed as the burly man left him alone, if he remembered correctly his former reincarnation would leave the city soon, he had got all of the saved money of his current body and he could finally go to a sect so he could cultivate... all orphaned children dreamed of cultivation as it was the only way they could break free of their destiny and become someone important.
There were also the imperial exams but the location where the exams were held was so far away that becoming a pugilistic warrior was easier and not as costly, as long as you could become an earthly practitioner around these parts you would pretty much become a magnate even if you were a measly bandit.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as his somewhat injured body returned to its peak state before reaching the 4th stage of the earthly realm in one go, his potential was thus done and some of his life-span was reduced due to the immediate consecutive and forceful breakthroughs but this was to ensure he could get a hold of his former reincarnation and snap his neck.
As long as he could find his location he would be able to easily kill him as his former reincarnation was just a child with no cultivation, even with his normal adult physique he could easily break his neck like a twig, let's not even talk now that he was a cultivator.
If he remembered correctly after he threw his current body in the ocean he had returned to get his stack of stolen money from under the floorboards, under his bed at the orphanage... but there he was ambushed by three of his 'friends' who realized what he had hidden there, orphans were innately survivors so they would do anything to get a better life which meant they had a worse moral compass compared to normal people.
Yun Jhin's ship landed on the docks as he disembarked and started running towards the orphanage, he was at the surface when he was thrown so not much time must have passed before his former reincarnation had returned to the city and the orphanage... if he calculated correctly right now he must have been duking it out with his 'friends'!
Suddenly the window of the orphanage building in front of him broke as a skinny kid with a pale complexion was thrown through it, he was holding his neck where there was a small cut when he saw Yun Jhin running towards the orphanage his eyes glowed as he shouted:
"That nameless bastard has hidden money under the floorboards, Head instructor please do something!"
Yun Jhin ignored the bleeding child as he opened the door of the orphanage and entered to see two workers holding back Yun Jhin and two other children, they were bloody and had some fresh scars around their small bodies, their ragged clothes turned into full rags that couldn't be distinguished as clothes anymore due to the fight.
Yun Jhin's former reincarnation eyes widened as he saw Yun Jhin arriving and opening the door before entering the orphanage... he had made sure he was thrown off into the ocean by that burly fellow he hired using some of the money that he stole from him... his feet were tied with cinderblocks and his head was covered with a cloth sack... his arms were tied to his back and he still swam back to the shore and came to the orphanage?
At this point, Yun Jhin's former reincarnation thought that Yun Jhin was a hidden cultivator! And he wasn't wrong about that.
Yun Jhin didn't care about his image as he quickly went to his former reincarnation and looked down at him... suddenly both of his hands latched on his neck as he tried to break it like a twig!
His former reincarnation tried to fight back so did the two female workers at the orphanage but all they could do was watch on as the life was ripped out of Yun Jhin's body and he died like a dog with a broken neck.
Yun Jhin let the body of the boy go and then waited for himself to be taken out of the trial but he realized that he remained there!
The two female workers were looking at Yun Jhin with fear, they knew about the relationship between the two but they didn't think that the Head instructor would snap one day and kill him in front of everyone!
Yun Jhin snorted as he unleashed his cultivation base making everyone panic and then realize that he was a cultivator!
All the people here were normal but they had met cultivators on many occasions and they knew what type of aura they had so they didn't bother with Yun Jhin anymore... the female workers took the body of his former reincarnation and wanted to bury it but Yun Jhin stopped them and told them that he would do it himself... then they left him alone while taking the two other horrified children away from the entrance of the orphanage.
Yun Jhin took the body to the back of the orphanage then glared at it, he knew he was trying to fake his death at this point, it seemed the near-death situation he put him through had made him unlock his memories! If it was any other normal cultivator they would have buried him by now but Yun Jhin knew he was faking it!
Yun Jhin went towards his body as he put one of his hands on his neck and his other hand on the top of his head, then with a mighty pull he ripped his head off with spine and all!
Blood splattered the ground as the body of Yun Jhin's former reincarnation started to move around like a headless chicken which indicated there was still vitality left in it.
But it soon stopped and dropped to the ground again, now he was fully dead!
Yun Jhin has been finally ejected out of the trial once again and the familiar pain and memories rushed back into his main memory core.
He could feel that this was the last trial just as Hell's willpower said, there was no more darkness around him which meant he cleared it and that he was going through to the next trial.
A voice appeared in his head that made a 'tsk' sound before saying:
"You finally finished the first trial... you are still pretty behind though, I'm quite disappointed that you won't be the one who will inherit my treasures... but you aren't a local anyways, just disappointed though, sometimes you are even wilder than the locals and that's what I like about you."
"Anyway back to the main discussion, the next trial won't be as hard as this former one, all you will have to do is climb a mountain of blades, run through a sea of fire without any type of protective gear on and in the end, you will have to fight it out with the God Realm experts who had done the same trials as you... easy isn't it?"
The voice disappeared without saying anything else as Yun Jhin was left there to prepare for a little bit before he would be thrown to climb a mountain of blades and run through a sea of fire.
These things would be impossible for a normal human but they would be rather simple for someone's of Yun Jhin's capability let's not even talk about those God Realm experts... Hell's willpower didn't explain everything.
Suddenly all of his cultivation was ripped out of his body as he was thrown near a mountain made from blades, he could feel his body turning cold as he looked at the gigantic mountain that he had to scale and after the mountain, a sea of fire appeared out of nowhere...
At this point, Yun Jhin realized more than ever that Hell's willpower was a sadist.
He gritted his teeth as he looked at the mountain of blades and then decided to climb it, when he looked down he realized that he was also buck naked!
Well... this was a willpower test, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 160: Scaling a mountain of blades and a sea of fire
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin felt quite awkward as he was fully naked and he had to scale a mountain of blades with no cultivation... but the most important thing here was that he was naked!
Hell's willpower was quite perverted in this regard...
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked at the first blade on the mountain, he had to climb onto it and move on from there if he wanted to scale the mountain, but how would a normal mortal body be able to withstand a blade?
Yun Jhin frowned as he put his leg on the tip of the blade and it entered his flesh, blood started to drop fast out of his leg as he tried to jump from blade to blade using his footwork technique to minimize the impact on the blade, trying to make it feel like he was soaring above them.
Unfortunately, the tips of the blades were quite sharp and all he could do was touch only the tips and not the whole blade to get up the mountain.
He could feel himself getting dizzy as he lost blood and after two more minutes of climbing he fell with his neck being pierced by a blade... the pain was excruciating as he was doing this ordeal with a normal human's body, he couldn't use any techniques to seal the pain or ignore it.
All he could do was endure and try to go on further.. because it was a test of willpower Yun Jhin didn't die even though his neck was pierced by the blade, after all, if he died what would happen? would he spawn at the bottom of the mountain? would he fail the test? While Hell's willpower was perverted it gave a trial that tested one's heart and ability to endure so it made the test extremely hard but not impossible, after all, it still wanted an inheritor.
Yun Jhin used his palms to balance himself back to his feet as he continued to run, as he lost all of his blood from his body he turned deeply pale and he couldn't manage his body very well, it would take him almost 20 to 30 seconds for him to jump from one blade to the other and he was around half of the mountain range when this happened.
At his current speed, it would take him around 2 to 5 years to fully scale the mountain and this was unacceptable... the mountain wasn't extremely big as a normal human wouldn't be able to scale a normal mountain under his current situation, let's not even talk about one made of blades.
However Yun Jhin wanted to minimize the pain by entering a mental state using a semi-meditation technique that even a normal human being could use, this would minimize the pain and restore some of his balance... unfortunately this would slow him down very much, and that would mean that others would get to the inheritance before him...
Hell's willpower did say there would be a tournament at the end of this but maybe he wouldn't even be able to reach it if he was too slow!
He could maximize his speed by fully ignoring the consequences but that meant he would arrive at the other bottom of the mountain in pieces.
His left arm was already quite cut and the soles of his feet were sliced, there were holes in both of his feet and arms and it was getting increasingly harder for him to move forward but he gritted his teeth and then decided to throw caution to the wind as he started to quickly run on the blades without caring about the pain that came from it.
His feet were starting to be diced as only his legs remained... then as time slowly passed only his legs from the knee up remained... then he was just a torso with diced arms and hands...
He finally reached the top of the mountain at that part... he was breathing roughly and he was as bloody as he could be, there was no more skin on his body and his bones were also visible, his bones were also full of cuts and they seemed ready to drop from the meat that was keeping them together.
The pain Yun Jhin was currently experiencing was unexplainable.
Yun Jhin's breathing was rough and quick, one of his lungs fell out of his chest and he then clutched it as the pain increased, while he couldn't die his soul was attacked by immense bouts of pain for every extra injury he had on his body.
He couldn't keep himself straight anymore as he fell to the other part of the mountain of blades he started to roll like a barrel down the hill until he was impaled on a blade near the bottom... he had no more blood in his body so he couldn't vomit anything... he didn't have any stomach left anyways.
All of his remaining flesh and blood was strewn around the middle and upper parts of the other side of the mountain, he remained just a skeleton as immense and continuous pain was assaulting his soul trying to rip it away from the carcass he was currently still tied to...
Since he was all bones the blade couldn't keep him on itself anymore as he used his brittle bones to lift himself a little then throw himself at the bottom of the mountain where his bones cracked and broke into powder!
The powder then reformed itself into a skeleton before meat flesh and blood returned Yun Jhin to his former appearance, his face was still pale and he looked rather weak even though he had his blood back into his body...
"Now for round 2... jump into the sea of fire and transverse it with the same condition as the previous challenge!"
Yun Jhin walked forward unstably as he fell to his knees, there was no more pain on his soul but the immense amount that constantly attacked him since he got his first injury made his soul quite unstable at the moment, his ears were ringing as his surroundings shook, the sea of fire was just in front of him and if he moved a few more centimeters in front he could fall into it!
Yun Jhin caught himself before he could fall... if he lost consciousness in the sea of fire he would surely fail the trial as that would mean that his willpower wasn't up to par for Hell's willpower standards.
This was the first time in all of his reincarnations he took such a huge risk by doing a trial like this one... while he did other trials in his previous lives none of them put so much accent on the will nor were they this hard...
Yun Jhin's naked form took one more step as he entered the sea of fire and his meat started to be baked like a turkey!
He was turning a light brown color as all of his bodily hair was burnt into ashes, the sea of fire was getting constantly hotter the more he walked into it and he was just at the fringes now so even a normal human body could endure it somewhat as the heat started from 37 degrees celsius.
Yun Jhin took a few more steps forward but the pain of being burned couldn't be in the same tier as the one from being cut, burning pain was the highest pain that could be experienced even among cultivators.
Yun Jhin's soul was already quite weakened after the mountain endeavor but he knew taking rests wouldn't give him any advantages over his adversaries... he started to walk quicker as his flesh started to turn from brown to a dark color, he was just like a human-made of coal now as he covered around 30% of the fire sea distance.
As he got closer to the middle he saw his competitors... there were 4 of them in total and they were all barely moving forward as they were no more than skeletons... but from the eye sockets, he could tell that they were trying to meditate to endure the pain while taking one step forward at a time.
Yun Jhin finally reached them as he wobbled unsteadily while all of his flesh from his body became charred, fell, and transformed into dust that disappeared as well. He was just bones like the others now!
He could feel his soul starting to actually burn as he reached the middle of the sea of fire... it seemed that he would now take soul injuries after so much pain was inflicted on his soul, while pain wouldn't injure his soul it would weaken it for quite a long time but injuries meant that his psychic power could decrease and he would be open for others to take advantage of him at soul level!
The others didn't realize that Yun Jhin arrived near them as they steadily took one step, meditated, and then took another.
Yun Jhin knew that he would end up with them in a tournament anyways but then a voice started to rumble into his burning soul transferring him and the others around him some information:
"Since you are all near each other anyway, let's start the tournament right here! The first to leave the sea of fire wins the inheritance and something extra from me!"
The eye sockets of the other four skeletons moved seemingly as if they opened their eyes and looked at each other before turning their gaze to their new addition...

chapters.title: Chapter 161: Skeleton battle royale
chapters.content:
The eye-less gazes on Yun Jhin's skeletal frame made him frown inside, it seemed that as a newbie he would be the first one to be targeted, especially because they didn't know who he was or where he was from.
An outsider would be an unknown factor in the minds of these 4 people so they immediately launched themselves at him, but due to the higher amount of time that they sat in the fire they were more weakened than him, also Yun Jhin's soul was way stronger than theirs at this point, after all, it was the soul of a previous peak God Realm expert, while they were only early Gods.
Yun Jhin could endure way better than them even though his soul was certainly weakened by a huge extent at this point.
Yun Jhin hardly dodged the charge from their attack when one of them used his flaming bones to try and crack Yun Jhin's skull.
Yun Jhin wasn't entirely sure what would happen when his body turned into dust, after all, that part only happened when he finished the first trial and he got resurrected near the entrance to the sea of fire... would he be thrown back at the entrance of the sea or would he be ejected from the trial?
He didn't want to find out!
Yun Jhin dodged the flaming bone by rolling his bones on the magma seafloor which melted most of his chest bones and backbones making his bones almost fail to cling to each other anymore, in this type of situation his skeleton wasn't really normal as a normal person's skeleton wouldn't have been able to endure such a high amount of heat without melting and transforming into dust.
While he had no cultivation Hell's willpower found it boring for them to die fast so he enhanced their skeletons to endure all of the fire while most of the damage went to their souls.
Yun Jhin's burning soul pain was making him almost go mad as flames started to appear in his empty eye sockets.
The other four people couldn't move properly due to the immense pain their souls were in and that meant their movement speed was quite low, Yun Jhin's speed was a little bit faster as he tried to get away from them, fighting in the middle of the sea didn't mean they would complete the trial, Hell's willpower indicated that the first who left the sea would have completed the trial so they didn't have to fight to the death... but the others knew from Yun Jhin's speed of arrival that he would be the first one to leave if they didn't interfere with his progress.
Even though Yun Jhin arrived last, he did complete the other trials faster than them, and it wasn't because he was more talented, his will was just more tempered because he had lived through more hardships than anyone in existence in the mortal and hell realms at this point... excluding Hell's will which was older than him, but technically speaking he did have more hardships than it too!
Yun Jhin's bones creaked and cracked as he took one hit from the other skeletons, it couldn't be helped. In this type of fight, Yun Jhin was alone versus four opponents and he was exhausted as well, while the others were also pretty weakened they were more in number thus more confident in their abilities to take Yun Jhin down.
Yun Jhin didn't have any techniques to rely on, no abilities, no bloodline, and no cultivation explosion, he was a normal person's skeleton only enhanced to endure the fire around him... all he could do was either try to run away or fight it out with them using his higher amount of experience in fighting.
But no matter how much experience he had he couldn't fight a 1v4 situation while he had the same body strength as the others.
He tried to run away and he staggered as his left foot bone was burnt to cinders, as they fought they also moved further in the sea towards the location of the exit and the fire around them increased in temperature and intensity.
Yun Jhin could feel that the others couldn't withstand the heat much anymore, their eye sockets were moving as they analyzed him, they needed to use their zen-state to endure the pain from the fire and the increasing injury on their souls... it wasn't that Yun Jhin could endure more at this point, his soul was literally in flames and since he was this far he would go through it till the end... he just hoped that Hell's willpower would heal his soul after he finished the trial.
The others didn't know what to do in this situation, they could barely move anymore and they couldn't touch Yun Jhin anymore as the distance between them got bigger and bigger, the more steps they took the more pain they endured and their flaming souls made them reluctant to continue.
However, Yun Jhin's soul was a little bit more damaged compared to theirs and he was still going strong regardless of the injuries amounting to his soul.
This showed that his willpower was superior to theirs!
Yun Jhin's silhouette started to disappear in the sea of flames around them and they cursed under their breath as they realized that they had lost the chance of getting their hands on the inheritance of the 7th layer!
Their bones were cracking under the flame's heat around them, they couldn't endure any more!
Their bones turned into the dust which disappeared into the sea of fire and their bodies were ejected from the dark pagoda back into the wilderness of the 7th layer... which was pretty much a wasteland.
The sage realm experts that came from the 7th layer and the 8th layer to try their luck but couldn't get their hands on a piece of multicolored rock were still standing around waiting for any news about the inheritance when they saw 4 pale God realm experts being thrown out of the pagoda made them rather panicky, if Gods couldn't pass the trail then who could? But considering they couldn't even enter they actually felt quite glad that those 4 didn't get the inheritance as well.
Vanzuel frowned as he felt his soul quickly recover after he was thrown outside, it seemed that the damage to the soul wasn't permanent and Hell's willpower wasn't shameless enough for it to not heal their souls after the trial ended.
The other three just looked on with a bitter gaze as they said in unison without waiting for Vanzuel's opinion:
"We shall wait here for that unknown person to leave the pagoda... and snatch the inheritance from his filthy paws!"
Vanzuel couldn't see what kind of cultivation that person who one-upped them had so he was quite reluctant, the other 2 devils were rather mad so they didn't think about the consequences if the person who beat them had higher cultivation than them but Vanzuel did, as a devil who was both smart and cunning he didn't want to offend someone who he shouldn't so he tried to persuade the others:
"Guys... hear me out on this one, but what if the person who went ahead of us had higher cultivation? Due to the test, we don't know what type of cultivation he had but only those in the 9th layer can get multicolored rocks... I doubt those two people would have had the guts coming here knowing I would be on my way here."
What Vanzuel said made sense but the trio was still rather angry due to the situation... they wanted to fight it out with each other in the tournament and see who would get the inheritance that way, after all, while they were backstabbing fiends of hell, in this situation when they wanted to play nice but then one person made them unable to!
This left a bitter after taste in their mouths but they considered Vanzuel's words and decided to add their two cents:
"If he is stronger we will just leave him alone while we hide here, but if he is weaker we should gang up on him and steal the inheritance!"
Vanzuel knew that they were right as well... he was quite scared of the prospect of being devoured by a senior devil in this situation, he had cultivated for a long time to reach his current power and he didn't want to die for the inheritance, the others had lower cultivation bases than him so they were a little bit more desperate to close the gap between them as they hadn't realized the cruel truths of the 9th layer yet, they were basically newbies as they didn't go very far in the 9th layer due to their fear of their 'seniors'.
Vanzuel did go when he was younger and those experiences remained imprinted in his soul which made him more apprehensive and fearful than others.
But they were also four and he was one so he decided to wait and see just like the others said.
Inside the Pagoda Yun Jhin's skeleton returned to its normal form... his azure long hair, his perfect body, and his robe appeared again. Yun Jhin sighed, it sure did feel well to be back into his own body!
What Hell's willpower did when he went through the trials was create a cultivation-less clone that he stuffed his soul into but now he was back into his original body which made him feel as comfortable as ever, his soul was also restored to its normal parameters, which made his gamble worth it!
Yun Jhin waited for a short while before Hell's voice entered into his consciousness again, it was time for the reward he so hardly sought!

chapters.title: Chapter 162: 7th layer inheritance
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's eyes sparkled as he thought about the possibilities of the inheritance, but all he wanted right now was 'cold' cultivation resources so he could break through further into his cultivation so he wouldn't be under so much pressure from Yuan Fang!
He still felt something wasn't right even though he was in hell, but he ignored this feeling, at this point he couldn't do anything to Yuan Fang schemes, it couldn't be helped, after all, he was reincarnated earlier than Yun Jhin so he had an advantage that couldn't be stopped or interfered with.
Hell's willpower voice entered his consciousness and told him:
"Your reward is quite simple... something that you have desired the moment you stepped into the pagoda."
Yun Jhin waited for the response, his breathing stopped as he became too excited, he was just like a child on a Christmas morning waiting to open the gifts under the Christmas tree.
"Your reward is... the body of hell! version 7 of the 7th layer! Along with the armor of hell that fuses with your body of hell the moment you get it! Also, last but not least the most concentrated pool of energy which can be found on the 7th layer!"
Yun Jhin eyes glittered as he listened to the rewards, one was better than the least, he didn't have much knowledge about the body of hell he still felt very excited about the prospect of gaining an ability opposed to his current celestial body, while he didn't know much about the body of hell, he knew hell and the celestial realm could mix like water and oil!
"Normally speaking such a body would make you explode as you have a celestial bloodline and body... but considering your former knowledge of bloodlines and how many experiments you had done, well you should know what to do when I give you the body."
Yun Jhin could feel the purest Hellish energy invading his body the moment the voice stopped booming in his head... the energy was at first gentle like the caress of a lover but the moment he let his guard down the celestial energy in his body went on a rampage!
It was a normal reaction, how could hell be accepted by heaven?
It was impossible.
But Yun Jhin had done the impossible multiple times, actually, his experience in mixing things that shouldn't be mixed was extremely high, all his experiments on his descendants and all those bloodline stealing events paid off right now.
The body of hell was like an exoskeleton that wanted to burrow into Yun Jhin's 'pure' body made from the highest celestial energy that he could absorb, of course, the body would reject the foreign skeleton trying to replace his current 'jade' one.
However, Yun Jhin could trick the blood inside his body using a combination of his mixed ki and his knowledge of bloodlines and special constitution... However, there were complications.
It wasn't that Yun Jhin's knowledge was incomplete, he just wasn't familiar enough with the celestial physique and had no prior knowledge of the Hell's body so problems arose.
Fortunately, he had someone with immense knowledge in Hell, he cried out:
"Give me all the knowledge of Hell's body if you don't want your inheritor to die!"
"Oh blackmailing little old me already? Aren't you daring? But you are right I do need you alive."
An immense amount of knowledge found itself running towards Yun Jhin's soul then it fused with it like a ripple on a lake, the knowledge diffused itself as quickly as possible as it reached Yun Jhin's main memory core, and then his eyes glowed as he started the transformation of his celestial physique.
To accommodate the new Hell's body he had to destroy his current one and create one on the frame of the exoskeleton using the pure hellish energy he was given.
Yun Jhin's current body transformed into dust that disappeared into nothing, the exoskeleton of Hell appeared, it was as dark as night and inscribed with the runes of 7 sins: gluttony, pride, wrath, lust, greed, envy, and sloth.
All of the runes were in the order that Yun Jhin lived his lives up till now.. gluttony was self explicit, his pride was immense even though he curbed it into the ground due to his current circumstances. He had a bad temper during most of his early lives which led him to reincarnate again, his lust was also transformed into something different as he lived longer but it was still there.
His greed... well he could control it somewhat, he wasn't envious and he was never lazy, a lazy person couldn't achieve eternal life!
According to the 7 deadly sins, he created a new body combining the celestial energy coming from the void above him and the current pure hellish energy running from Hell's willpower.
A new body was currently appearing over the skeleton... the bones were covered with flesh and soon skin appeared as well...
His azure hair started to change as it grew back on his head... from a pure azure color, it became half azure and half dark red, his eyes now suffered from heterochromia as one turned azure and one dark red, it was just like back then when he achieved his Ying-Yang form... but now it was more pronounced.
Suddenly over his naked body, a crimson armor appeared which inserted itself painfully into his body, it was assimilated and the pain that came with it wasn't small... Yun Jhin grunted, even with the pain tolerance he had, he still wanted to scream out his lungs!
The armor finally fused with his new flesh and connected itself to his new exoskeleton thus finishing the transformation of the inheritance.
He knew that he shouldn't have just done everything according to Hell's willpower but at this point, he wouldn't be able to leave even if he wanted to... he tried to pierce through space the moment he finished the trial to see if he could leave if he wanted to... but he realized moments later that he couldn't.
Hell's willpower was currently sealing the whole space he was currently in, even though he practically left the Pagoda after he finished the trial and was transported to a different space he was still under the jurisdiction of Hell.
After the transformation finished Yun Jhin fell to his knees as he breathed in and out to stop the immense pain flooding through his new body and soul.
Hell's willpower boomed into his mind:
"Very good... the combination of Hell and Celestial realm made you... different."
Yun Jhin could feel that his cultivation also broke through to the 2nd stage of the sage realm after he finished the reconstruction of his body, somehow his avatar benefited from the change, maybe it was because he used so much energy to reforge it, some of it may have leaked into his avatar.
"Now that you are done with the body... let's dip you into the pool."
Yun Jhin looked down only for him to fall into a boundless pool of demonic energy, the energy was so viscous and pure that the moment he fell into it he realized that the energy started to transform into a type solid matter like jelly and trap him inside!
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he felt his skin absorbing the jelly substance by itself, now that his body was so attuned to hell his cultivation speed had increased by 200%.
His surroundings were made of jelly, everything was jelly... all he could do was absorb it.
His cultivation was quickly increasing the more he stood in the jelly, the quantity of the jelly decreased as time passed... 1 month....2 months.... 3 months... 10 months...
Yun Jhin could finally breathe again as he felt that there was no more jelly around him, due to his new body he absorbed all of that 'boundless' jelly substance in those 10 months of cultivation!
His body stood there motionlessly as he checked his internal situation... his cultivation broke through from the 2nd stage to the 7th stage of the sage realm!
He knew that this was only possible because he absorbed the 'core' of the 7th layer, he realized after some time passed that he was thrown into the core that sustained the 7th layer, and now that he absorbed it, he became the layer's lord!
Hell's willpower appeared out of nowhere... it was a dark green light body that had the shape of a circle, it stood there motionlessly for a long while before the sex-less voice he was familiar with appeared:
"Very good... not excellent nor perfect, but considering how tough your new body is, I can say that it broke through the normal conventions of the so-called body rank and your cultivation isn't that bad either."
"You should know what comes next right?"
How couldn't Yun Jhin know? Why would you fatten a sheep beside for slaughter?
A chuckle could be heard coming from the body of light... then it launched itself directly at Yun Jhin.

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Sealing Hells devouring Heavens (1)
chapters.content:
The body of light was so fast Yun Jhin couldn't have dodged it even in normal circumstances... he could feel his skeleton weighing down on his fleshly body and practically locking him on the spot.
Hell's willpower was really dishonest, it even tampered with his reward but it wasn't something that Yun Jhin wouldn't do either so he couldn't really complain.
The body of light entered his corpse as his connection to it was suddenly severed!
However, he was the main owner of the body and he forced the connection regaining control of his body moments later, forceful possession of the body might have been possible if those normal God Realm experts passed the inheritance test but Yun Jhin wouldn't let his main body be taken over so easily!
At this point in his cultivation, his main body could be reforged if he had enough energy, only his soul needed to be whole he would only 'die' if his connection to the mortal plane would be severed by someone with great expertise in souls or if his soul was destroyed by someone way stronger than him.
In this situation, Hell's willpower was trying to take over his body but it ignored his soul, after all, even though it had gone through his memories, he was sure that it had only read the surface ones that he let out as bait.
Yun Jhin struggled to lift his left arm only for Hell's voice to penetrate his sea of consciousness with a snort:
"Still struggling? Your body is now mine, FUCK OFF!"
A wave of mental energy assaulted the insides of his consciousness trying to push his soul away from his body, Yun Jhin gritted his teeth as he endured the mental energy... somehow it felt that it wasn't that strong, was Hell's willpower bluffing when it was outside his body? Or was its connection to the boundless energy of hell cut right now?
It felt like it was above the God Realm in strength but now it was bearable for Yun Jhin to endure the attacks.
Yun Jhin tried to counterattack with his own mental energy but it missed by a mile... he couldn't actually find the body of light that entered his body, it seemingly disappeared but he could hear its voice taunting him right now:
"You fool, thought you can defeat me because I don't have the support of Hell's essence anymore? As soon as I get control of your body I will leave hell and go to the celestial realm!"
Yun Jhin frowned... hell wanted to go to the celestial realm?
Seemingly sensing Yun Jhin's puzzlement Hell's willpower decided to say:
"I'm in a good mood right now so I will make you understand my wish."
Yun Jhin knew that at this point Hell's willpower was either confident in taking over his body... or it was trying to drag the conversation so it could concentrate on an ultimate technique that needed time. Yun Jhin realized that it was most likely the latter.
So he ignored the words that assaulted his consciousness and decided to attack randomly in his body trying to lure out Hell's body of light.
Yun Jhin's frantic attacks somehow didn't injure his new body at all... it was a bit too sturdy to the point that not even he could injure himself if he wanted to.
Hell couldn't hide in a place that Yun Jhin didn't know about as there were no such places in his own body, even though it had been remolded many times, the moment his consciousness placed itself in the vessel he learned every possible nook and cranny from the body, as he scanned his whole body and attacked randomly he finally attacked a spot that made Hell's body to jump out!
Even though Yun Jhin's attacking capability wouldn't injure the body of light very much, it could drain it of its energy is needed to use to take over his body, there was a limit to how much energy one of those light bodies could accept and if it was drained the body would dissipate and Hell's willpower would be stuck inside Yun Jhin's body!
Yun Jhin knew about that and he was really tempted in 'taming' Hell's willpower, who knew what kind of benefits he would get for taking over and sealing such a behemoth?
However sealing him inside his body was easier said than done, even though Yun Jhin could drain him of his energy and there was a limited amount the body could have at a time, that didn't mean the amount was small!
Yun Jhin could feel his sea of consciousness shaking as Hell's willpower infiltrated it with some tentacle-like transparent mental waves.
Yun Jhin's soul techniques could be considered above average so he could defend himself against the tentacles that were currently whipping around his memory cores trying to destroy them and make him lose his memories.
Yun Jhin's main memory core was hidden deep inside his consciousness so the whips were only attacking the useless cores at the moment, but the more it attacked the more cracks appeared in them and suddenly his 16th reincarnation memory core broke! The memories inside disappeared. As soon as that happened the will imprint that remained in the memory core was absorbed by the tentacles akin to someone drinking a smoothie through a straw!
Yun Jhin's soul shook as immense pain was inflicted on his spiritual body and it started to bleed blue soul essence, memory cores were embedded inside his sea of consciousness which was located in the head of his soul body, now he was bleeding soul essence from his mouth and eyes and he looked quite terrifying as his soul form was gigantic and shown his true colors which were purple and sickly green.
Green flames flickered around his head as the soul essence he bled returned to his soul and fixed the injuries he had taken from the destruction of the memory core as he unleashed a mighty sound-based attack using his throat to drive away from the tentacles from inside his sea of consciousness.
The tentacles were shoved away from his soul and returned to the body of light that was hiding in his physical body as he shoved his soul's arm directly in his physical body heart trying to take out Hell's body of light which was hiding inside it.
Yun Jhin felt his soul's arm tremble as it hit the center of his chest and then gripped his heart, it was his own body so it was a tremendous process to extract something from it while not fusing with it. To explain it more simply, his body was a vacuum and he was trying to remove something from it while it was on and at the highest setting.
Hell's body of light tried to run away from his heart but he felt Yun Jhin's soul fingers grasping on his small ball-like shape and drag him out of his heart before he forcefully shoved him into his body's left arm!
Yun Jhin's soul then fused with his body as he coughed a mouthful of blue blood and then struck his left arm multiple times in three of his meridian points with his finger, his left arm thus became limp and disconnected from his main body, the pathways from it were clogged and the body of light was thus blocked in his left arm and at this point, it also became unusable it just remained there standing straight and looking really stiff, it also turned deeply pale like it was the arm of an undead.
Yun Jhin could feel the screeches of Hell's willpower coming from it, it said something among the lines of junior do you dare? And how he would annihilate him the moment he got out of his bindings, and that he made a big enemy that he couldn't escape from. Yun Jhin had heard these phrases so many times that his ears bled any time he heard them again, unfortunately, he couldn't shut it up, but he could weaken it!
Yun Jhin started to do some one-handed hand-seals as the energy that fluctuated around him started to fly around him like he was a blender then they transformed into a whirlpool of energies that rushed towards his left arm creating a tattoo like formation that etched itself deeply from his hand towards his elbow if Yun Jhin could have felt anything form that arm he might have even shaken a little bit.
Hell's shouts could be continuously heard:
"HOW DARE YOU SEAL ME IN YOUR BODY, I DON'T WANT ONLY YOUR ARM, GIVE ME YOUR WHOLE BODY YOU DAMN ****"
It was obvious Hell was going to have a dirty mouth so Yun Jhin wasn't surprised as tons of insults were hurled his way after those attempts at scaring him didn't work... actually he wondered why it was still trying? It did read his surface memories so it should understand what kind of person he was.
Suddenly Hell's willpower stopped shouting... his surroundings turned eerie silent for a few brief seconds before Hell's voice was heard again:
"Let's come to a consensus shall we friend Jhin?"
An old fogie like Hell's willpower would always be two backed and duplicitous so it wasn't a surprise it came to this.
But Yun Jhin wouldn't let it go now... he wanted to exploit it, trying to take over my body, and then you want to leave without bleeding at least 99% of your life and fortunes? Dream on!

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Sealing Hells devouring Heavens (2)
chapters.content:
The first step in sealing Hell's willpower in his left arm was to first weaken it enough, which meant draining its remaining energy to the point only its consciousness remained.
For him to do that meant he had to attack his left arm and shake the energy that remained in the body of light.
Yun Jhin took a look at his left arm apathetically before he used his right fist to punch it over and over again... it was a pretty simple way, just shake the arm good enough so Hell's willpower could 'barf' up all of the energy it had.
"Hey hey... Yun Jhin, come on? Aren't we birds of the same feather? Please let me out! I can promise you I will never bother with you again and I will also give you some more benefits!"
Yun Jhin snorted, now that this thing was sealed into his left arm it became as docile as a lamb, but that was only because it couldn't go towards the brain of his body so it could vie for supremacy with him again.
To control the whole body Hell's willpower needed to reach Yun Jhin's brain and insert itself there properly while making sure that his soul's connection to his current body was cut off.
Then it would be all normal body-snatching shenanigans from thereon.
It was a good thing that it couldn't achieve its full power while it was disconnected from the environment of Hell.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as he continuously assaulted his left arm to the point that it was almost severed from his body... which was an accomplishment considering he couldn't even damage it much previously, that stemmed from the fact that Yun Jhin didn't acclimatize himself properly to the strength of his newly crafted body but as he pummeled his own arm he realized how to control his newfound strength.
Bits of white-colored light were randomly appearing on Yun Jhin's arm blood vessels as he attacked it with a mad fervor which showed that Yun Jhin's simple and brutal way of solving things was pretty effective.
However, the amount that remained in the body of light could still be considered a lot so he had to beat his own arm for almost 3 weeks before he could hear the feeble voice of Hell's willpower in his consciousness again:
"Ok... Ok, you win please tell me what you want, you drained me off all my energy with all of that arm beating you have done, please have some mercy!"
Yun Jhin and mercy were two words that wouldn't find themselves in the same sentence.
With one last mighty hit on his arm which made it so red and inflated that it looked like it would explode soon the last remaining energy that existed in Hell's body of light dissipated and left through the air!
"AGH!"
This was the only sound that Hell's willpower had done after all of its energy was exhausted.
Yun Jhin sighed as he felt quite exhausted himself, while he could damage his new body, it was quite energy-consuming due to the immense defensive capabilities he got... and he couldn't sever his arm because his new exoskeleton was too though to the point that he could only bruise and batter his arm like it was a schnitzel!
Yun Jhin's consciousness made a quick scan over his left arm and saw a grey and lifeless body of light rummaging around his inflated arm's blood vessels they looked like they could pop any moment but as soon as he stopped bruising his arm he could feel it heal at immense speeds as it automatically attracted Hellish energy from the surroundings.
Yun Jhin didn't have much time to analyze his surroundings but now that he was free he decided to look around... And he found out that he was still in the pagoda may be in a secret dimension separated from the other ones, however, now that no one controlled the surrounding space he could pierce through it and leave.
But first, he needed to finish the sealing.
To fully seal Hell's willpower into his left arm's flesh he needed to fuse it properly by assimilating it, while it couldn't kill it this way because while not having enough offensive abilities due to the lack of energy... as long as Hell existed, Hell's willpower wouldn't dissipate.
So while he could fuse with it, even though how unwilling it was for that to happen, he couldn't destroy nor assimilate it completely which was something that Yun Jhin found quite well annoying.
It didn't take much for Hell's willpower to wake up and barrage him with shouts and personal attacks, even saying that he had xxxxxx his mom a few times which wasn't very nice, Yun Jhin had eaten his mom before Hell's willpower could touch her in this life, as for the other lives... it was even more unlikely.
Yun Jhin's bruised and battered arm returned to its normal silky and lean muscle form soon then he started doing another batch of hand-seals with his free and still working right hand, those hand-seals transformed into living runes that started to etch themselves deeply into his left arm before they entered his flesh and blood and attacked the listless and energy-less Hell's willpower gray body of light.
It immediately screeched acting as if it was a cat that touched water.
Yun Jhin ignored its increasing screeching that was trying to disturb his concentration and continued to create runes with one hand as he inserted them forcefully inside the grey body of light trying to take over it and fuse it with his left arm.
