It wasn't as easy as it looked to be, even though Yun Jhin was successfully branding the body of light with his fusion runes that didn't mean the thing wasn't doing its best to refuse them which increased the difficulty Yun Jhin had to go through before forcefully inserting the runes into its small body.
The resistance increased with the number of runes that he inserted in its body as it realized what the runes were supposed to do the moment the first one touched its body and slithered inside.
How could an old fogie like Hell's willpower want to be fused with someone else? Someone like it would want to have full control of their surroundings and situations at all times and they would feel 'sick' to have someone else control their fate.
But no matter how much it tried to resist it couldn't... that was until a shout like a baby's scream came from it and demonic energy from the surroundings started to attack Yun Jhin instead of letting itself be absorbed anymore...
Hell's willpower broke through its body's limits and started to control the surrounding Hellish energy to attack Yun Jhin, Yun Jhin was half demonic and half celestial thus if Hell's willpower could control the energy to attack its celestial part to break the balance between the energies in his body, it could stop his attempts at forcefully fusing themselves!
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt a stabbing pain going through one-half of his ki pathways, the celestial energy inside was going berserk as it felt itself be challenged by the 'putrid and lowly' demonic energy from the outside, it wanted to leave Yun Jhin's body and attack at any point while the demonic energy inside his body stood there like a docile lamb.
He could feel his right arm turning numb as the celestial energy inside it went on a rampage, while the demonic energy in his body was tamed, the celestial energy was as wild as a horse!
This was a problem, he couldn't concentrate on fusing Hell's body with his left arm this way, and as more time passed Yun Jhin could feel that the energy that dissipated from its body was returning, if enough energy returned to its body it could break the seal he placed on its body and try to take over his body again.
It seemed that at first, it couldn't connect itself properly to the outside and so Yun Jhin could 'bully' it but as more time passed it started to adapt itself to Yun Jhin's body and the connection between hell and itself was strengthened so it could recover its energy and control a limited amount of the surrounding Hellish energy!
This was a piece of bad news for Yun Jhin!
He gritted his teeth as his eyes locked on the rampaging demonic energy outside his body and he shouted as forcefully tried to suppress the celestial energy inside his body while stimulating his demonic energy to absorb all of the surrounding Hellish energy.
The celestial energy needed to be tamed regardless of how wild he was... and if he couldn't tame it he would devour it! What if you were from heaven? You would become my slave even if I'm the worst demon of hell!
Yun Jhin's attempts at enslaving the celestial energy in his body were fruitful after a short while, now that the surrounding Hellish energy couldn't find a proper target anymore it was easily absorbed by his demonic side boosting his energy reserves to their full capacity!
His gaze wandered right back to his stiff left arm as he forcefully continued to insert the runes inside it.
While the energy that the body of light recovered was small it still helped it a bit to endure the barrage of runic energy that entered it... but that was only for a short while as it's defenses crumbled and shortly after it started to shout again as it started to dissipate inside Yun Jhin's left arm flesh and blood!
"You will regret doing this Yun Jhin!"
Yun Jhin snorted... he might regret it in the future but right now there was nothing else he could do to escape from this situation!

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Successful fusion
chapters.content:
The tug of war between the two 'old fogies' Yun Jhin and Hell's willpower ended up with the win of the former, Yun Jhin had successfully taken the body of light apart and fused it with his left arm while keeping the consciousness tightly sealed in the same place.
Now there was no way for Hell's willpower to leave his body unless he let it.
However he couldn't shut it up, the consciousness of Hell had fused with his flesh and its voice could be heard reverberating in his head no matter how he tried to silence it.
"Well it's not so bad but I feel rather stifled in here... why don't you let me out for a walk?"
"Come on great master, I just want to stretch my legs, I feel like I have been incarcerated here for a millennium already!"
The shamelessness of Hell's willpower was off the charts, it even compared itself to a dog for a chance to get out and maybe absorb energy to break their connection, Yun Jhin knew that it felt so bad that it wanted to shut itself down forever for being humiliated in such a way by someone like Yun Jhin. Even though he was a former peak God Realm expert, Hell's willpower used to toy with those type of people when it wished to, that's why it ended up alone and hushed in the 9th layer, it way too overbearing!
Plus it tried to take over some of their bodies as well.
Yun Jhin could access some of Hell's information and memories through the body of light he fused with so he gained quite some important bits of information that he didn't know previously.
The information was about the treasures of the 8th and 9th layers along with the important locations that Hell's willpower would usually protect, now those places were empty and with no protection from anyone... and Yun Jhin was the only one who knew that!
His eyes glittered but the annoying voice of Hell's willpower continued to jar into his ears trying to plead and beg for its freedom, this annoyed Yun Jhin to no end but he couldn't cut the connection between them as the fusion was pretty rushed and Hell's willpower was also pretty strong so he couldn't cut off the connection without injuring each other.
At this point he either had to lose some flesh or have some voices in his head annoy him... and he didn't really like losing flesh for something that he could endure.
"You want to go to my treasure locations, don't you? Even though I'm not there anymore there are quite a lot of traps and you had only got some of my surface memories just liked I did to you, why don't you sign a contract with me and we will each go on our merry way? You free me and I will help you get whatever you want from there?"
"Can you shut up your incessant yapping you goddamn thing, you are already sealed and your destiny is to be my possession from now on, just keep your muff shut and maybe I will let you go wag your tail outside from time to time."
"You... YOU! Thank you!"
Yun Jhin could picture Hell's willpower kowtowing to him so hard for his 'gracious offer' but now that he finished discipline the thing, he had to get out of the pagoda and go to the 8th layer where he would get his paws on some new resources that might help him get to the peak of the sage realm.
To get out of the pagoda Yun Jhin had to break through space and make a 'cut' through the solid parts to leave.
Yun Jhin silhouette disappeared as he used his spatial talents to enter the 'spatial' domain of the pagoda, there he created a purple scythe with his ki weapon technique then with a mighty heave he struck a big hole into the space of the pagoda leaving an opening big enough for him to leave through.
Yun Jhin's body disappeared into the portal he created as the 4 God Realm experts outside were discussing how much time will Yun Jhin stay inside.
Suddenly Yun Jhin was ejected from the Pagoda which made their eyes light up as they encircled him the moment he got ahold of his surroundings.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the god realm experts surrounding him, but he just shook his head as he put both of his hands near his waist before his aura ballooned up and pushed the 4 of the aggressors away from him.
Now that Yun Jhin was at the 7th stage of the sage realm his power had increased by quite a lot, it was to the point that these 4 wouldn't be able to beat him even if they teamed upon him with a formation.
Yun Jhin wasn't in a good mood as the chattering of the voice returned to his head so some veins popped visible on his forehead as he looked at the 4 people blocking his way, he didn't have time for these clowns! Now that he had the knowledge of these locations with treasures he had to rush to get them, who knew if the fogies up in the 8th and 9th layer would wake up and see that their angry landlord is missing?
When the cat is missing the mice dance on the table.
Yun Jhin had to rush ahead and leave these people here if he didn't want his 'loot' to be taken by someone else.
Yun Jhin eyed them as they eyed him warily, even though he was only a sage realm at the 7th stage his aura pushed them back which showed he wasn't a normal opponent at all.
How could the aura of a measly sage push back 4 God Realm experts at the same time?
It wasn't possible in the heads of the 4 people... Yun Jhin stopped being passive as he attacked the weakest of them trying to cripple him directly, he took his halberd out of spatial dimension, and with a mighty heave, he slashed vertically trying to sever the man from the waist.
The sudden attack on him made the God Realm expert quite vexed, just cause I have a lower cultivation base you target me? I will show you!
He shot a crystal out of his fingers trying to parry Yun Jhin's slash only for his fingers to be cut along with the crystal however he blocked the slash that tried to bisect him.
He started to bleed profusely as three of his fingers were severed but the wound closed up with the same crystal encasing his wounds, but he couldn't regenerate his fingers at the moment.
Yun Jhin knew that it was easier said than done to kill a god realm expert but this wasn't the end of his attacks.
He returned his halberd to his spatial dimension as he disappeared from their encirclement employing his stealth technique making them start panicking they couldn't see, smell nor hear him anymore!
They also couldn't sense his life aura or anything that could identify him as living, his soul trace was also gone!
Suddenly the strongest of them Vanzuel dropped to the ground as his eyeballs were ripped from his head and thrown away into the wasteland behind them.
He didn't die but he screamed because of the intense and sudden pain that he had to go through.
Yun Jhin didn't ignore his downed form as he created a gigantic purple ki saber that he used to decapitate him!
The head coughed a mouthful of blood as it rolled towards the feet of the other three before it jumped by itself up and a new body regenerated from it, he had a pale complexion now but it turned for better a few seconds later as the head connected properly with the newly regenerated body.
Yun Jhin didn't appear again but the others were still wary as they looked left and right as if the bogeyman was there ready to jump on them...
Yun Jhin already left them behind as he was rushing directly to the 8th layers entrance which wasn't that far from his current location.
To reach the entrance to the 8th layer and above Yun Jhin had to do something different according to the memories he gained from Hell's willpower.
To go directly to the hidden location he could use a spatial pocket in the entrance, this was a similar situation to the one back in the pagoda but now he had to actively search for the hidden spot instead of slashing space randomly.
Yun Jhin appearance at the entrance took him around 65 days.
He looked at the gate in front of him and shook his head, now that Hell wasn't active anymore there were no more inscriptions on the gate but it was still functional, this type of situation happened before and the netizens of hell were wary of Hell's antics so Yun Jhin hoped no one went to investigate where he wanted to go.

chapters.title: Chapter 166: Treasures frought in danger
chapters.content:
To find the hidden pocket of space that would be his shortcut to the location of the treasures Yun Jhin had to search for a while.
Even though he knew of its existence he didn't know the proper location of it, as Hell said, he only had access to Hell's surface memories and not the exact ones that he wanted either. It couldn't be helped if he forcefully tried to extract memories from Hell there would be a backlash, while they were fused properly now that didn't mean they were one being.
They were like parasitic twins with bot having their individual will, if one wanted to go left and one wanted to go right they would feel a pain like they would be splitting in the middle... so they had to coexist peacefully if they didn't want to feel any pain or maybe even injure themselves to the point that they would be close to death.
Now that he was trying to find the entrance it made Hell's voice to appear in his mind again, now it was trying to goad him with its information and manipulate him into letting him free...
"I guess you still can't understand your position can you?"
Yun Jhin was getting increasingly annoyed with this thing going on... maybe he could find some useful treasures that could shut it up for some time in the special place that it formerly guarded.
Yun Jhin found a white light that resembled an entrance after a while of searching, it was very small and it was integrated into the entrance to the 8th layer at a scale that was almost microscopic.
He had to search for a while to find it, he also had to strain his eyes using his ki enhancing technique so he could see the entrance... now that he found it he needed to enlarge it for enough time so his body could slip through it unharmed.
To increase the microscopic white entrance he had to use his ki as a bridge between the location that it led to and his current location which was the entrance to the 8th layer... he also had to hurry considering that the God Realm experts of the 9th layer would surely come back this way so they could return to their layer after eating this loss.
While he could defeat them if he wanted to, it would take time as the regenerative capabilities of a God Realm expert were a little bit too though to exhaust using his current Sage Realm capabilities he could defeat and kill them but it would take too much time.
He frowned as he kept his hands steady, the connection between the location he wanted to get to, and this one was firmly created with Yun Jhin's proper spatial skills and knowledge.
Now all he had to do was feed this connection with ki for a while before the entrance would enlarge and he could enter it... fortunately as soon as he cut the connection the entrance would disappear so no one else would be able to follow him inside.
It took him around 6 hours of pumping his ki into the 'tunnel' to enlarge the entrance enough for him to enter it without problems... after he entered the entrance quickly snapped shut behind him.
The entrance returned to its microscopic size and disappeared altogether for some reason, now no one would be able to use this entrance to get to where Yun Jhin currently was.
Yun Jhin found himself in a dark abyss... red eyes were looking at him from everywhere, it was like the earth and the skies were full of red eyes, dark mouths were laughing at him showing their pearly white teeth and sharp canines.
Yun Jhin didn't know if this was an illusion or if he was surrounded by creatures of hell... maybe this was one of the formations and trials hell put forward to deter those who wanted to take its important treasures.
"What do you think about my babies Yun Jhin?"
"Hmm...?"
Babies? So they weren't illusions, Yun Jhin couldn't recognize what type of creatures they were but there was also a chance Hell was trying to fool him into thinking they were real. Even with his judgement as a former peak God Realm expert, it was quite hard to see through this, was it illusion or reality?
There was one way to find out. Yun Jhin put his hand forward before launching a small ki ball out of his hand which travelled into the darkness illuminating it and showing... nothing, there was nothing there, all the mouths and red eyes disappeared as if they were never there.
But all he could see around was still nothing as if he wasn't anywhere, it was as if he was abandoned by everyone and nothing remained around him the brightness of his surroundings was actually started to blind him. After darkness came light!
Yun Jhin could see that the principles of Ying and Yang were used in here so he circulated the Ying-Yang talent he had gained in the king realm stabilizing the surroundings around him... then the five elements started to burn, freeze, batter, strike and slash him!
Yun Jhin's body was quickly becoming bloody but he ignored his injuries as he activated his five elemental talent absorbing all of the energies that were assaulting him in his body... with the new toughness and regenerative capabilities of his body, he immediately recovered to his peak bodily performance after he finished absorbing the energies.
Yun Jhin didn't know what other traps were supposed to be ahead so he stood there silently as he mulled upon what he should do to not find himself in a situation that he couldn't escape from:
"Hmmm? Aren't you quite multitalented? Ying-Yang, 5 elemental abilities along with such intricate way of using them?"
"But what else could I expect from a freak like you who had reincarnated for thousands of times?"
Hell's voice turned silent after it mocked/praised Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin turned a deaf ear to what hell said, it was either meant to intimidate him or make him doubt himself at this point.
Doubting himself in this situation could lead to him falling into a deadly trap and losing his life here... in return, Hell's willpower will either die with him or be set free Yun Jhin wasn't sure.. while their fusion was successful it wasn't 100% done, even at this point while their beings were intertwining together, he could feel a deep resistance coming from the body of light that was seeping deep into the cells of his left arm.
But he had done everything he could regarding the fusion... all he could do was leave it to the Heaven's will per se.
To find the treasures Yun Jhin had to through a few more trials so he stopped waiting and started to trudge ahead in the 'nothingness' that surrounded him.
As he moved time seemingly passed at quick speeds... the four seasons passed by him, spring... summer... autumn... winter...
Those four seasons appeared from nothing and surrounded him, spring was gentle and clean, summer was scorchingly hot, autumn was cold and wet and winter was like frostbite was ready to dig into his flesh and rip it from the bone.
He accordingly used cultivation techniques opposed to the elements that discomforted him, besides spring where nothing happened Yun Jhin used cold Yin energy to keep his wits, in the autumn he used some hot Yang energy to keep his body warm and dry... and in the winter he used his inner flames to burn off the ice that was clinging to his shivering form until it melted and he went back to spring.
The second time spring came... it wasn't as gentle and clean as the first time, now winds battered him like they were ready to cut his flesh and drink his blood... but this wasn't' the only thing that happened... the seasons changed faster and faster and the intensity of the damage done to his body was increasing accordingly...
Unfortunately for the formation that was surrounding Yun Jhin, no matter how damaged his body was getting he could walk forward while ignoring the damage... Yun Jhin realized that to get out of this formation properly he had to endure every injury to his body from the changes of the 4 seasons, get in the middle and destroy the formation core!
Hell liked to torture people and surely there would be a guardian at the middle of the formation that would stop him from destroying the core... he would have to battle while being scorched, battered by wind, and wetted by rain, then frozen into a popsicle.
Yun Jhin's body endured everything as it regenerated at a speed that even his eye couldn't see... one moment he was frostbitten, the next one he returned to his normal temperature and the ice fell off his limbs and body... this cycle continued until he reached the middle of the formation and felt the cycle turning even more vicious than before!
In front of him stood a peculiar avatar of a horned man with a long red tail... and closed eyes his horns were dark and engraved with strange words, he wore an outfit that revealed his stomach, only a simple yellow and orange jacket was on his body and the jacket was quite short... he wore blue gi pants with a green sash tied at his waist. He also wore green and blue boots.
Yun Jhin couldn't identify his cultivation at a first glance but the more he looked at him the more he understood that he was going to be a ferocious adversary.
He took two steps forward as he entered a stance and took out his halberd from his spatial dimension, keeping it in front of him with a vice grip, his aura lingered around his skin as an armour manifested on his body appearing above his special defensive clothes increasing their capability of enduring damage.
He didn't use his gigantic form as there was not enough space where he was... he also felt somewhat restricted due to the elements battering his body constantly without rest.
Yun Jhin waited for a few seconds but the avatar didn't open his eyes... Yun Jhin looked at it for a few seconds before he got close to the visible formation core and slashed it into pieces with his halberd!
The four seasons formation broke and the avatar remained in front of him, he took a closer look to it and saw that it had no soul... then he looked at his left arm and chuckled, he will continue then.
Muffled screams of anger from his left arm were currently attacking Yun Jhin's inner ears... but he continued ignoring them and went on.

chapters.title: Chapter 167: Fool me once shame on me
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin continued further into the wasteland he was currently in... step by step he went through deadly situations until he reached a gigantic altar that was the supposed location of the treasure.
The air was putrid and damp and Yun Jhin could almost gag due to the smell that was in his surroundings. Here were the supposed treasures?
Yun Jhin was quite familiar with this type of setup, it was a sacrificial altar meant to boost one's cultivation.
Yun Jhin couldn't' use this altar even if he wanted to because there were no sacrifices to be made!
There were no bodies to be used nor any treasures that he could use to boost his cultivation here... did Hell fool him by feeding him fake information?
Maybe he shouldn't have rushed headlong at the first smell of treasures...
"Feeling cold feet now?"
The voice came from his left arm, it was seemingly mocking him for rushing in without any more information besides what he gleaned from Hell's surface memories.
"Since you are here why don't you remain here?"
Yun Jhin's left arm started to move by itself as somehow it glowed with a red light that was similar to the altar's color.
Yun Jhin tried to back away but before he could an intense pain came from his shoulder as his flesh and blood were basically all taken away from him only his new exoskeleton remaining on the left part of his body.
He breathed roughly as he clutched his left part of his body while applying ki to heal it and restore its former looks.
The pain that was inflicted on him continued to sting his whole left part as he recovered.
"Thought you fused with me right?"
A mouth appeared on his former left arm which smiled wickedly at him, the mouth was full of pink teeth that were sucking on the bone-less flesh and visible muscles.
Yun Jhin looked at the arm as it mocked him:
"You really thought you captured me, didn't you? As you said multiple times in your mind, I'm an old fogie and that has countless tricks while you fused with my body of light you forgot something, if you were smart you would understand what it was!"
Yun Jhin frowned, he overlooked something? He thought he made it so they were like parasitic twins but it seems he was wrong...
"Thinking how wrong you were right? Hmph, previsible even for one who had reincarnated so many times... you lived so many lives but you still act the same in all of them, only using your increased experience to reduce your former mistakes bit by bit... I can see why you have failed to break above the God Realm up till now with all your immense pool of information and techniques."
Yun Jhin took a few steps back, his new arm started to hurt again and the pain was so stabbing that he couldn't control his footing... for someone like him who endured a sea of flames and a mountain of blades, for this pain to make him stagger it showed that it was an immense amount.
"Feel the consequences of the fusion now boy?"
Yun Jhin felt as if his soul and body were both being forcefully separated from each other by some giant pliers, his soul which was properly inserted in his body was getting smaller and smaller from its huge proportion.
Froth started to appear at his mouth as he couldn't endure the pain and started to shout while clutching his head.
On the altar a change was happening to his left arm, it started to grow more flesh from it and a skeleton... slowly but surely it became a second Yun Jhin and the only difference in his looks was that his hair was fully red and his eyes were black with the red sclera. He wore nothing but out of the void, a black and red robe enveloped his body.
He looked down on Yun Jhin as if he was an ant that got in his way it seemed that all that happened up till now was previewed in Hell's plans!
"You know I realize that monologuing would be dumb at this point so I'm just going to end you, Ok?"
Hell placed his pointing finger towards Yun Jhin's head as a small line of purple energy appeared and pierced directly through it.
The line pierced Yun Jhin's brain scattering all of its contents on the ground... out of his lifeless body his soul came out and now that the connection between the two was severed he was practically 'dead' however if he didn't want to he wouldn't be taken to the spirit realm, he still had lifespan in this universe and he could live as a soul and even restore his body with enough energy unless his connection to the mortal plane would be severed ahead of time he would be sent back... After all the higher the cultivation the higher was someone to get killed by anything else besides time.
Yun Jhin's sou looked confused as the skeleton that remained in his body suddenly left it and hovered towards the new body of hell, the skeleton inserted itself in his body as his old one was discarded through his skin.
"Ah finally to be whole again... having a fleshly body feels so good!"
"As for what to do with you... I would like a backstabbing piece of crap like you as my slave but you know... when I look at your mug I don't feel really good."
It seemed Hell still felt humiliated from having his first plan foiled, the reason he even got here was that it wasn't omniscient yet, it might have power above the God Realm but it hadn't touched that realm yet and it wasn't known if it truly could or not.... after all, Hell was a being that was created by the universe, would the universe let it leave it and search for the truth outside?
Hell cracked his knuckles and neck as it approached the paralyzed form of Yun Jhin's soul... it patted its cheeks as he looked at it directly in its transparent eyes and said:
"Tell Buddha that I said hi!"
Yun Jhin couldn't believe that he had fallen for such a low-level trick... he had been the one to do this stuff on people up till now and it seems karma was finally catching up to him, no matter how fast or strong he was he couldn't be able to do anything in this situation... Hell had gained a body and it connected itself to its former quintessence thus now having the abilities of someone above the God Realm!
It seemed this was the end for Yun Jhin.
"Any last words?"
Yun Jhin soul form started to tremble as he laughed and laughed he even started holding his stomach as tears came out of his eyes.
"Finally lost your mind in the end, haven't you? It's ok as a courtesy I won't eliminate your soul and let you meet buddha for another reincarnation. Aren't I magnanimous enough?"
"You wouldn't get it."
"Excuse me?"
"You wouldn't get why I'm laughing."
"Oh please enlighten me I want to have a good laugh as well... I haven't laughed for 500,000 years."
"What do you get from crossing an unstable new body with a source of power too big for it to handle?"
"Hmm... you!!!"
Hell started to clutch his body he could feel it inflating at high speeds due to the energy current that was going through it, even with the exoskeleton he specifically crafted for this situation he didn't take into the calculation that his flesh wouldn't be able to handle the influx of energy from his energy source.
"I... how did you know about this?"
"It seems I'm not the only one who hasn't done his homework am I?"
Hell clutched his inflating body but he shook his head as he laughed as well while looking at Yun Jhin:
"Think you can escape now? Even if my body explodes, my normal light form can still take care of you easily now that I don't need your body anymore!"
"That's true, but do you know about this?"
Yun Jhin's soul started to grow smaller and smaller up to the point that Hell couldn't see it anymore... did he self destruct?
Hell frowned as he tried to sense his soul only to find that nothing remained around... even Yun Jhin's remaining flesh and blood on the ground dissipated into dust that the ground 'ate'.
Hell discarded its new body as it left the shell fall to the ground, the skeleton remained on its feet while the flesh transformed into ashes after it imploded from the immense energy that was transferred into it...
He didn't take into the calculation that as a new body is reconstructed one body refinement would be reset thus his body wouldn't be able to endure the forceful increase in cultivation, this led to Yun Jhin escaping barely... if Hell didn't bother to ask him for that joke he would be dead and he wouldn't come back!
**********************

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Hard to recover
chapters.content:
In the 3rd layer near the 4th layer entrance, a small imp was camping in a self-dug hole, waiting to attack any unsuspecting passersby.
His eyes were glittering with intelligence and some primitive wisdom.
It was the small imp that Yun Jhin blessed and left to his own devices, he was left near the entrance to the 4th layer and he remained there while waiting to ambush anyone who tried to go to the 4th layer, he realized that the stronger prey who wanted to ascend would have to go by here, the moment someone would pass by he would slash their guts open and feast on them!
This imp lived the great life and ate quite a bit of high-quality meals up till now, he had even reached the 6th stage of the heavenly realm right now and he was still going quite strong!
The imp looked to be absent-minded for a while as he didn't do anything, after all, there was no one around him nor did he sense anyone coming from the wasteland in front of him... so all he could do was stay like that and conserve his energy for any further attacks.
Suddenly the imp could feel a pain appear in his head, he clutched his forehead as he growled in pain and anger before his eyes became blank.
Yun Jhin's soul appeared behind the imp as it fused with his small body and he continued clutching his forehead as he frowned deeply.
"Having left this beacon here was a good idea, even though it was unknown that this type of thing would happen being prepared saved me."
Yun Jhin had scattered his soul and replaced it with his avatar, the moment his avatar exploded at the time his soul was sent away from the location and attracted by the beacon he left in the Imp's soul, the beacon was there for him to control him and find his location.
With a reverse summoning technique, he arrived in the body of the imp and took it over easily!
The injuries to his soul were quite big and unfortunately, he wouldn't be able to use any techniques regarding the soul right now... all he could do was inhibit the body of another as he couldn't reconstruct his anymore, he was lacking in an extreme amount of energy and it felt like he had been starved for hundreds of years at this point.
His new body's stomach started to growl as his soul's hunger transferred to the body, he needed energy for the body to withstand his injured soul, even though the current state of his soul was rather bad, it was still the soul of a peak God Realm expert.
Yun Jhin crawled out of the hole that the imp dug and kept the knife the imp had hidden, he was truly weak at this point and he needed to feast on some flesh to recover some of his energy.
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt that he returned to the times when he first reincarnated... well it was still a little bit better here but not by much.
Yun Jhin's steps were slow as he trudged towards a closer battlefield, the lower hells were full of such skirmishes and they were relatively easy to find.
It didn't take Yun Jhin much time to find the battlefield before making himself as conspicuous as possible, the moment they smelled Yun Jhin's weak aura the demons pounced on him as if he was free KFC meal.
Yun Jhin fell dodging the demons' attempts at biting his neck and destroying his new body... his left hand moved quickly slashing the necks of 3 demon wolves and his mouth opened wide taking big bites out of all three of them... a little of his energy returned but it was a drop in the ocean for his current situation.
He knew that he needed to leave hell as soon as possible but he wasn't sure that he would survive the transportation between layers so he needed to heal himself first.
He already hid his aura and his body couldn't be ever compared to his previous one so technically Hell shouldn't be able to find him at this point.
Yun Jhin needed to reach the mortal realm and hide there to recuperate, Yuan Fang was still out there but now that he had a new identity and his aura was changing as he continued to inhabit his body, as long as he played his cards right he might not have problems with Yuan Fang.
Yun Jhin continued focusing as he finished the bodies of the wolves, his ferocity and quick attacks scared the remaining demons and imps, the smarter imps even started to back away with wary looks in their eyes, they could feel that their 'comrade' was quite different compared to them.
Yun Jhin ignored the devils, devils had comparatively weaker bodies and they could hold less energy compared to demons so he didn't need to devour them if they didn't attack him, he couldn't split his attention into two sides at this moment due to his soul injury so he had to focus on the demons.
Yun Jhin gave a side glance to the imps side and snorted as his eyes told them that this was his prey!
The remaining imps looked at each other before they started to run with their tails between their legs not daring to fight anymore, in this situation a starved camel was still bigger than a horse.
The demons were wary of Yun Jhin's strange attacking patterns and even though they were still quite dumb they had achieved the heavenly realm so they weren't completely mindless.
They tried to back away and follow the example of the devils who already ran away, their silhouettes could still be found scattering into the horizon and jumping through some holes in the ground, they all acted as if they were moles.
4 demons were remaining on the battlefield and they all started to take a few steps backward as they growled at Yun Jhin and showed their fangs.
Before they could even let out a howl Yun Jhin appeared in front of them and ripped their throats open using his weapon after Yun Jhin finished feasting on them he felt a little bit better as his soul accommodated the new body. Since he was a foreign existence to this body at first it tried to expel him but considering the difference of strength between them, he subdued it after a short while.
He could feel that his health was a bit better compared to before and he started to trudge towards the location of the exit of this layer... he needed to get out of hell asap even if he felt that Hell's willpower couldn't find him right now.
*******************************
Hell's willpower reconstructed the body using the DNA he harvested from Yun Jhin's arm but he frowned, even though he absorbed quite a bit of DNA in his attempts at constructing a body using Yun Jhin's left arm he felt that he couldn't succeed, it was if the universe itself was going against him!
He realized that even if he inhibited Yun Jhin's body, at one point or another it would expel him or it would explode regardless of how sturdy it was or what combination of energies it was made from. Hell's exoskeleton stood there straight and unmoving as Hell was rampaging cracking the ground around him with his anger:
"This damn piece of shit... you gave me this much strength but you tied me to one location? I WANT OUT, LET ME THE **** OUT!"
"WHY DO YOU LET THAT DAMN CELESTIAL EMPEROR MOVE IN HIS REALM?, WHY?"
It seemed Hell was going through a crisis of its own right now and couldn't have time to look for Yun Jhin.
As for Yun Jhin, he had already reached the exit of the 1st layer and he was ready to leave Hell... but before he needed to change his body a bit so he wouldn't attract attention in the mortal realm, after all, hellish creatures were quite hated up there but the 'righteous' sects would also make deals with them if they were strong enough, it wasn't that Yun Jhin was a devil but that he was too weak to reveal himself right now.
He could also have recovered in Hell but his paranoia was so high that he couldn't control it anymore at this point, he needed to find a safe place where Hell couldn't find him, he knew that it could move only in special locations but Yun Jhin didn't want to try and find out which locations were available to him.
He entered the door that leads to leaving Hell and his surroundings shook as he was thrown outside and into the ruins of the Blood Throne sect.
He was using his stealth technique before he entered so he wasn't sure if Yuan Fang realized that he entered or not... especially that he didn't enter from the same location.
A warm voice could be heard coming from in front of Yun Jhin:
"What do we have here? A fugitive of some sorts?"

chapters.title: Chapter 169: Yuan Fang's forces
chapters.content:
The voice was male and it sounded close to Yun Jhin's location but it wasn't intended for him.
A blonde-haired man with a good complexion, high nose, and pronounced cheekbones his hair was wild and long, reaching his waist it was also very spiky, he wore nothing but a brown armor that covered his chest area and a green gi underneath he also wore sandals on his feet. He was watching the portal that led to hell. He said those words but they weren't targeted at Yun Jhin... it almost seemed as if he was preparing for an act and he was rehearsing.
Yun Jhin felt the man was quite strange so he stood still to not be found and waited for him to continue:
"Ah... the tonality isn't good enough, I need to make sure the dumb imps who leave through here get intimidated and run back in! That would give me a good reason to visit hell but alas..."
He sighed as he shook his head and continued to say the same phrase as before but he changed his tones making the meaning differ from trying to try.
Yun Jhin realized that the man had a few screws loose, most cultivators had their own ticks and craziness in their personality, very few could be considered 'normal'.
The man would most likely be one of Yuan Fang's stronger companions and Yun Jhin could feel his strength even though his senses were a bit impeded due to his injuries.
He was infinitely close to the God Realm as a peak sage, Yun Jhin found him to be rather strange as the aura he was exuding would be fluctuating from time to time his cultivation becoming higher and lower.
He didn't have time for Yuan Fang's man as he tried to step to the side and leave him alone, in this situation he didn't want to get anyone's attention. Even though he couldn't be identified as Yun Jhin anymore, he wasn't sure what Yuan Fang was doing with the escapees and tourists from Hell.
He might start creating his own forces into hell instead of manipulating the current ones... things were really going well for him in comparison to Yun Jhin.
He left the man behind to continue monologuing it seemed he would stop only when someone would actually walk out of the portal.
Yun Jhin took a few steps towards the center of the ruins so he could leave when the portal started to flicker with a red radiance... this didn't happen normally unless a high ranking creature of hell would go through for the first time.
This wasn't right, Yun Jhin would have realized if someone was entering the portal behind him which meant the person who was entering didn't follow him, was it really a coincidence, or was it something else?
The man with a monkey tail appeared, the same person that worked previously with Yuan Fang on the elves' planet.
The man was totally unknown to Yun Jhin but he saw that the blonde man didn't do anything to him which indicated that he was one of Yuan Fang's men.
Suddenly his voice stopped him in his tracks:
"Yo Borgos, I have come with some hot news from Hell connect me to the boss."
His voice was child-like and his face showed that he felt that the news was going to be pretty important to Yuan Fang.
Yun Jhin didn't wait to find out what the news was, it was most likely the fact that he lost his body and was heavily injured by Hell's will, Yun Jhin knew that he was somewhat tailed in Hell, at least he couldn't keep his tracks fully hidden unless he continued to stay in hell, now that he was gone and most likely hell had boasted about his defeat everyone must have known thus his prestige and influence in hell was most likely gone.
In this situation, he couldn't do much so he started to run away so he wouldn't be found out by Yuan Fang. He was always a mysterious person so there was a chance he could be found out through the transmission, unlike his cronies he was actually skilled to the point that Yun Jhin would be pressured in a 1v1 fight, that was why he teamed up with those 'righteous' fools to kill him in his last life.
He left the duo behind to call on their boss and started to fly away slowly while keeping himself invisible so he couldn't trigger any of the formations that were planted around the ruins, while most of them were almost destroyed they could be triggered if he wasn't careful enough.
It didn't take him a lot of time to leave the ruins as he gave out a content sigh then started to move towards the neutral galaxies, his best bet at recovering was finding an unknown little place and meditate in seclusion.
But to find that place would be a little easier said than done, most of the galaxy was pretty much known by now regardless if it was populated by neutral, righteous, or evil forces to find an unknown place and where he wouldn't be harassed by any of the forces was a little impossible at this point.
He needed both time and a location that was pretty packed with high-quality ki so that meant a place with little to no population but with an advanced ki concentration as well, he couldn't go to any random deserted place with average ki concentration.
Even in his past lives, he didn't know of such a place and it wasn't known if such a place popped up in the galaxy.
He changed the imp body through his ki techniques making himself look like an unassuming middle-aged man but he still left out some of his devil-ish features to make himself look a little bit more convincing as a newbie from hell, he had red shaggy hair and if someone moved it a little two little protruding horns could be seen growing from it, his ears were a little more elongated than normal and his eyes were deep red. His mouth was full of sharp fangs and some characteristic runic tattoos of hell were engraved on his 'human' body.
He needed to cement this new identity of his so he could lay low for a while.
He still had the new racial technique of the celestial caterpillar that he could try out but he was a little bit too paranoid to use it in Hell as it could trigger some events that were easily foreseen by him, he could mask the ability as a demonic one and do the same in the mortal realm as well but that was only after he rested enough to make himself a new body, he didn't really like the current borrowed one.
Yun Jhin flew towards a neutral asteroid as he didn't want to land on a planet yet, there he procured some information using the special talents that he cultivated during his numerous lives. It seemed that there was no such planet that he wanted to find so he had to settle for something else.
The elves were small in population compared to the other races in the universe and he could play his act like a demon who was attracted to 'elvish beauties' very well, the pure energy that the world mother and father three could exude would also replenish his injured soul quintessence.
After making sure the elvish planets were in the same location he decided to travel using the local travel and smuggling agency on the asteroid this way he could continue his act as a weak newcomer from hell with low cultivation. As time passed this new body of his could adapt to his soul cultivation and the blood of the celestial caterpillar that was overflowing inside it with the system's help.
Technically speaking such blood should be like poison to the body of the lowly imp but with Yun Jhin's new experience in bloodline mixing, he easily made the body endure.
He embarked on a spatial flying ship after giving out some hell-specific treasures as bribes, currently, he didn't have much capital with him.
The journey to the elvish planet was long and arduous for the broken and run-down ship that Yun Jhin was let on.
It took them almost 3 months in total to reach the planet but Yun Jhin used this time to fully adapt to his new body and push it to the 3rd stage of the sage realm, the reconstruction of his avatar was done using recycled energy, while he self-destructed his avatar and made it disappear in shards, he had kept some of the shards into his soul which he could use to reconstruct it at a lower cultivation base... after all his former avatar made him reach the 7th stage.
The elves' planet was fully green and full of forests, the small inconspicuous ship landed in one of the smaller cities on the planet and Yun Jhin left it going with the crowd of other people that he shared the journey with.
Yun Jhin looked around and identified this planet had the mother tree on it and nodded... the father tree was harder to deal with but the mother tree could be easily swayed to give him what he needed as long as he played his cards right. His eyes glittered as he looked at the supple bodies of the elves around him regardless of gender.

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Back to the basics
chapters.content:
All the elves mostly walked around in groups of twos and they were extremely beautiful... they were a little bit paling compared to the superior natural spirits but they were all beauties in their own regards, the only thing that could be held against their beauty was that they were all pretty skinny so it could be a turn-off for some people with different tastes.
But Yun Jhin wasn't admiring their beauty, his eyes were glittering due to their souls that were infused with healing energy and their bodies full of natural energy, he was looking at them like a farmer would look at cattle before they slaughtered it and barbecued it with chili sauce for the Christmas dinner.
Even though Yun Jhin had nefarious intentions he hid them very well, he had done this countless times and there were no old fogies to trouble him now, the mother world tree was deeply sleeping for some reason that he couldn't identify right now as he would need to get closer to it. The tree had its gigantic eyes closed as its aged face didn't move, the gigantic being was so big that it took 20% of the planet's surface and it was visible from wherever you would be standing.
The gigantic being was as old as the universe itself, the universe created it along with the father tree as the patriarchs of vegetative beings and conferred them a will of their own, they were wonders of the universe and they were practically immortal and unkillable as long as the two were together.
However, as time passed just like a married couple that got bored of each other they had their hassles and disagreements so they split up while creating a new race, the elves, to protect their darlings the nature spirits. Due to the special constitution and temperament of the nature spirits, they were hunted for their capability to help body refiners quickly rise through the ranks and upgrade the body's constitution. Elves were somewhat similar to nature spirits in the regard of their flesh and blood being quite helpful towards other beings as they were created by the same consciousness.
If the nature spirits were the legitimate children of the father and mother world trees then the elves were the illegitimate sons and daughters. Those illegitimate sons and daughters got quite angry with the official ones as they could be considered 'talented' while the official sons were trash young masters who couldn't even tussle with a chicken.
Thus the nature spirits were being treated with contempt and belittled under the noses of the mother and father tree, unfortunately for them, the duo of trees was mostly sleeping these days.
Yun Jhin really needed a new nature spirit as well, his new body which he will have to recreate would start again from scratch regarding body refinement and a nature spirit's heart would boost his recovery by more than 500%.
Yun Jhin walked through the crowd of elves easily avoiding body contact with all of them, but his eyes were marking all of his future victims, this 'city' which they landed in was in the gray areas of the planet which meant the security was lax and most of the people here were battle-hardened people full of ki and spirit, snakes and dragons would be hiding around this place.
Yun Jhin disappeared into an alleyway as his figure turned transparent as he activated his stealth technique.
His first victim was a couple that was slowly walking towards their home to the district of homes that wasn't far away from the ship receiving pad.
The homes were created up into the trees and they were all quite big for two people and from what Yun Jhin knew elves liked to live in couples of no more than two.
Yun Jhin slipped through the shadows as if he was a slippery serpent, its tongue forking out of his mouth to find its way towards its prey.
The couple was unknowing, they were both chatting and laughing happily as if they were the only people in the world.
Yun Jhin liked his victims being unknowing, they could struggle less this way so he wouldn't have to make a mess out of them.
Yun Jhin appearance behind them was instant and they couldn't even process what happened before two palms were put over their mouths as Yun Jhin forcefully dragged them into a nearby alleyway.
No screams were coming from the alleyway, no blood running down the greenery below, nothing was heard as they disappeared in the middle of the day, somehow no one batted an eyelid at what happened as if it was something that happened often, Yun Jhin had already laid down a concealing formation the moment he dragged the duo out of the way to their homes so no one saw what happened.
Yun Jhin walked out of the alleyway with his hands in his pockets, his gait seemed a little bit more stable than before and his face gained a glint of red in it but it wasn't visible unless one was clearly near him.
"These elves are so rich in ki and spirit... it was as if they were fattened up beforehand for this to happen, this is actually rather strange."
Yun Jhin muttered to himself as he looked to his left and right before disappearing again, in Yun Jhin's memories elves were extremely inferior compared to the nature spirits in regards to how much ki and healing properties they could hold into their flesh and blood but these two were quite different. They tasted strange as if they were fed something that forcefully increased their ability to heal.
Could Yuan Fang have a hand in this? He didn't think the other righteous fools would put their hands in this place, fighting with the elves was like trying to hold a hot potato, you could burn yourself quite easily if you didn't handle it with care or had gloves.And these righteous sects didn't know how to use their gloves properly.
Yun Jhin frowned as Yuan Fang was the only one which came to his mind as he realized his claws had stretched to the elves territory already, he was as busy as he was in hell but it seemed he didn't get into complications as he did.
Another couple disappeared into an alleyway as their muffled screams couldn't be heard due to the formation blocking them.
In another four hours, tens of couples disappeared and afterward, Yun Jhin left the city flying towards the east where the mother tree was located. He needed to investigate what happened or he wouldn't feel well, his healing also went on pretty nice due to the immense surplus the otherwise normal elves had in their healing capability. He was almost 60% healed and he would be able to reconstruct his body quite soon as long as he continued eating elves.
Yun Jhin arrived at the base of the mother tree where the biggest city on the planet was in 60 hours there he hid in the crowd and listened to someone who was preaching near the tree quite loudly:
"Don't you see that the outsiders had poisoned our mother? She had never slept for such a long time up till now and they said that they would heal her! What happened is preposterous and these outsiders deserve the death penalty for what they had done!"
This person wasn't weak as he was at the peak of the sage realm and he wore a green loose robe that showed his muscular body and intimidating form. He was the chieftain of the city and a big supporter of the mother tree, he believed that if anything happened to her they would all be doomed which wasn't technically true, the connection between them would hurt them a little but it wouldn't be anything major the connection between a race's creator and the race itself wouldn't affect the race if the creator died unless the creator was the universe itself.
As the man talked Yun Jhin waited and listened, at one point the man described the features of those who arrived to help the mother tree and Yun Jhin recognized one of them, it was the person with the monkey tail!
He came out of hell no long ago but he arrived here before Yun Jhin, of course, Yun Jhin took the long away around but it was still nevertheless impressive as he must have done some more errands for Yuan Fang before he was sent here after all the news needed to be confirmed some way and Yun Jhin was sure that Yuan Fang had the same kind of paranoia as him.
The man flew towards the tree as he put his hand on its bark and started to weep silently, tears started to slide down his cheeks as Yun Jhin watched on unaffected, would Yuan Fang's forces come out of the tree and beat this strange elf to death?
Yun Jhin watched on and waited.

chapters.title: Chapter 171: Infiltration
chapters.content:
The strange elf's form was both shaking and crying at the same time, it could be seen that he was genuinely pained by the things that were going through with the mother tree right now, his connection to her wellbeing was true as he said, but not all elves were like him.
Most of them were ignoring what he was saying after they understood his intentions, he wanted to pity them against those strong outsiders that took over the mother tree and killed the father tree, it was most likely impossible, elves while snobbish and proud they were also mostly cowards.
The man tried to convince people using his words of genuine concern for their race but it didn't work, it just made them look at him with weird eyes as if he was an alien that they didn't know at all, nor did they want to associate with him.
Yun Jhin watched silently as he kept himself concealed in the crowd, he wanted to see what would happen to this person, how was Yuan Fang going to strike him down? Would he go through the easy way or the hard way in dealing with this pest?
Watching what was unfolding in front of him would help him realize a bit more about the changes that Yuan Fang's personality went through, did he truly become a monster like him or was he a righteous person who was ugly on the inside?
The person with the monkey tail came as Yun Jhin guessed, but he didn't do any of the things that Yun Jhin thought about, he didn't beat him up nor did he act arrogant before saying something in a condescending tone which indicated that he was the boss of the planet.
He just gave out a small bow with a sheepish smile on his face and told him loud enough for everyone to hear:
"I'm sorry you guys think about it that way but you will see in the future that your mother tree will become better, as we are speaking our leader is currently administrating a special serum that would help its natural healing speed and in a few years the tree will wake up again!"
Yun Jhin snorted inside:
"Playing the good samaritan while his brother thieves the house."
In this situation, Yun Jhin was sure that after getting a taste from the core of the father tree Yuan Fang realized how important those are and he wanted to get the complete set, it seems he was going in the roundabout way of 'I'm evil but you don't have to know that'.
In this situation there wasn't much he could do about him, maybe he could try to infiltrate his gang but who knew if he was going to be seen through if he met directly with Yuan Fang? He always found him to be quite unfathomable back then and now his powers should have increased even further.
Yun Jhin ignored the man as he entered into the body of the tree saying that he wanted to see for himself, it was most likely he would either never return from the tree any more or come out as a soulless puppet that could be precisely controlled or in the best situation, he would become his slave with a little bit of free will.
He continued to devour random people in the capital but he didn't make any pattern or anything similar so he wouldn't be found out, he only targeted those far away from other people that either had no immediate relatives or were rather old, Yun Jhin surprisingly found out that even the old people had a lot of life force flowing through their veins.
Could have Yuan Fang planted the core of the feather tree on the planet of the mother tree? This was the only way the current elves could have such a highly boosted vitality, when the duo of trees meet they would certainly boost their creations vitality by quite a lot, this was only the beginning of the golden era for the elves. They would first start with increased vitality before their talents would be boosted and lifespan as well. Yun Jhin calculated that an elf would live for almost 350,000 years at peak cultivation with their current life force, and he felt that this wasn't their peak!
What would Yuan Fang get from doing this? Could he even keep these people under his thumb after he boosts them like this? What was he doing to the mother tree?
Yun Jhin head started to hurt as he had these questions, it was a type of foresight that showed him that meddling in these affairs would end up with him on the wrong side which would let him either die or get fatally injured.
Even his paranoia was hinting to him that it wasn't the time for him to get involved in this shit.
But he also knew that Yuan Fang's hatred for him wasn't small, which also showed that the moment he was found he would surely die. The grievance between them was so high that it couldn't be resolved through any normal means.
"I guess I will continue devouring until I can reconstruct my body, but getting my hands on the nature spirits will be easier said than done..."
Yun Jhin couldn't leave the planet empty-handed, he really needed some natural spirits to recover his body refining at a high speed he didn't have any sense of security if his body was too weak and it could be pierced through easily, also even though he acclimatized to his current body it didn't mean he was feeling good in it, after all, it wasn't molded for his own use his soul didn't nestle itself properly in the mind palace of the body and he could feel it cracking if he exerted too much of his recovering soul powers.
Yun Jhin sighed as he slit the throat of the 600th elf then used a technique to absorb him into his body, the nutrients and healing power were contained into his body then the healing power inserted itself in his soul finally recovering it fully.
He also had stored enough nutrients to create a new body.
His eyes glittered as he left the capital digging through the ground to reach an underground area where he would hide until he could recreate his body, while his new body could relatively handle his cultivation it wasn't really possible to fully unleash it due to the incompatibility.
There was only dark soil around him and the underground area was dimly lit, suddenly green flames started to burn on Yun Jhin's devil body as it dissipated into nothing, his soul appeared in its splendor as the energy that he stored was used to create a new body.
The exoskeleton appeared, half-golden and half-dark then the flesh blood organs skin, and finally the body was created in no more than 20 minutes. As long as Yun Jhin had enough energy he could recreate his body even faster but he had to make sure the body was perfectly made to fit his soul. Unlike the one that he was born in, which had gathered quite a lot of impurities from the ever-continuing evolutions.
This new body was a little bit purer, however, it was very weak and it would need time to be nurtured before he could inhibit it, it also didn't have any features as it was faceless and genderless. Yun Jhin had to insert his soul into it to get its features.
Yun Jhin looked the body up and down before he put his hands together as if he was praying, then out of his hands a continuous high amount of soul energy leaked into the body to create its ki pathways and give it a foundation for the cultivation, he had broken through from the system's limits as his body was destroyed and now he could use the system DNA sequencing power to create a new and more perfect power than before!
Because he had reached the sage realm and his soul wasn't cut off from the mortal plane he had learned a lot of new things about bodies through his soul form usage, all of his former reincarnations ended up with him reaching the spirit realm after getting his body destroyed, after all, no one in his right mind would let the soul of the enemy escape, Yun Jhin was only lucky that some strands escaped that he could use to reincarnate in most of the dangerous situations, or those that killed him didn't have any soul extinguishing techniques.
Now the body he was creating wasn't of a celestial beast nor a demonic one... it was human just like he was in his previous life, he always liked the human body the best, even though it had characteristics from quite a bit of race he absorbed it was ultimately a human body.
He always felt that the human form was the one that handled his soul the best.
[Hidden conditions met, caterpillar system had been made useless by the host's ability, the caterpillar system had finished its functions and now it shall cease working immediately!]
A minuscule body of light left Yun Jhin's soul body at a speed that he couldn't glimpse. He felt that his soul was missing something the moment the light left him but he also felt like some invisible shackles on his soul were also released as if the omnipotent one that was looking at him day and day night couldn't look at him as easily as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Body reconstruction and soul restoration
chapters.content:
"This feeling... maybe something really did happen when I was reincarnating, normally I wouldn't have ended up in such sore straits."
Yun Jhin thought.
"Did I encounter a powerhouse above the God Realm in my soul form?"
Yun Jhin couldn't really fathom the thoughts of those that ascended beyond the God Realm. After they reached true immortality what were they doing?
What were their thoughts when they did what they did to him? Were there factions even up there?
It seemed that way.
This system ability of his must have been given to him by the guy who opposed the one that reincarnated him as a caterpillar, now that its job had been done it was retracted back to the one who gifted it to him.
Yun Jhin was unconscious back then and he couldn't know who it was but he knew that things weren't as good as they looked on the surface... only those ruthless and very scheming persons would be able to ascend above the God Realm, so he had been schemed against successfully, back then he didn't really care where the system was from due to obvious reasons, even if he did he couldn't do anything about it, even at this point even if he became paranoid of who gave him the system it still wouldn't help him by much.
Yun Jhin sighed, it seemed no matter what he would do he wouldn't be able to escape conflict when it came to reaching the realm above the God one. If he asked himself he was a man who wanted peace for himself but considering the living conditions in the cultivation martial world all he could do to ensure his peacefulness was murder, thieve, and burn down whoever stood in his path of reaching true godhood.
He looked at his new carcass and gave it a few more finishing touches before just letting the energy he stored to enter it.
Now came the tricky parts, fusing the bloodlines to not let them attack each other just as he did back in hell, due to the body being inactive at this moment the bloodlines laid dormant, one in the left and one in the right part of the bodies, now that the system left him the storage of blood also disappeared, he couldn't draw it out from thin air anymore just as he did before. So if he failed the creation of his body he wouldn't be able to create another. So he would have to be extra careful in this situation!
His soul was back at 100% capacity, it healed nicely with the devouring of the elves natural soul powers, he almost wanted to create a herd of elves that he would slaughter for medicinal efforts now that he found out how good their flesh blood, and souls at healing.
Wait a minute... Could Yuan Fang be doing the same thing? But what would he need so many elves for? Only a large scale war would make him afford such a huge expenditure but a war for what?
Could he have found the way to reach the stage above the God Realm? Would he go to war with the celestial realm or hell?
Yun Jhin could feel his head hurt again in premonition meaning that his guesses were mostly right, as cultivators gained higher and higher cultivation bases they would gain a type of foresight which was activated automatically when they thought about certain things, but this could be blocked if the target they thought about didn't want to leak those things...
Yun Jhin frowned, did that mean Yuan Fang needed his help? Or why would he let him know?
**************************
While Yun Jhin was contemplating whether Yuan Fang was laying down a trap for him or not, the person in question was inside the heart of the mother tree, there below him kneeled an old woman with her back bent so hard that it looked like it would break, her skin was green and it had the texture of wood, cracks were coming along her skin and her hair which was blonde with beautiful flowers in it was quickly turning yellow then brown at a quick speed as she coughed some green substance from her mouth.
Her beautiful blue eyes were currently turning red as her pupils disappeared, it seemed she was really angered as she glared at Yuan Fang's form.
"What is it, you old crone? You didn't want to reunite with your husband so I just helped you!"
"Don't you like the taste of the poison I concocted from researching his core?"
"You damned junior, you don't know what you are doing, if both I and the father tree die at the same time there would be a catastrophic change coming to the universe!"
"Oh, you think I don't know?"
Yuan Fang put his palm over his face as he started laughing, suddenly the monkey tailed man and the blonde-haired man with long spiky hair appeared near him as they kneeled in unison, if a chuuni fan would see him right now they would mutter under their breath 'so cool'.
"Of course I know, don't you think I have done my research before I have done this? This catastrophic change is what I'm after!"
"Don't tell me, you really are thinking to ascend that way!"
Her eyes widened as she coughed another mouthful of green blood which fell to the ground in front of her which was the core of her main body, the poison started to sizzle which hurt her double the amount.
"Ok that was enough talking, I know you are trying to recover so you could skewer me with those wood thorns below us, boys dispatch of her immediately but let her core be whole as I need it."
The duo nodded at him before they got up from the ground, spikes appeared where Yuan Fang previously stood as his figure flickered and disappeared as if he was never there, the duo looked at each other before they dashed at the old crone's unmoving body in unison, with a mighty have they punched her in the gut at the same time!
******************************
Yun Jhin could feel the whole planet shake as he almost lost his footing in the underground cave, even his soul was shaken by the earthquake that was going right now, and this showed that it wasn't any normal earthquake!
"They are already making their move?"
Yun Jhin was almost done with the fusion between bloodlines and he could inhibit the body.
His soul quickly entered the shell as it gained his features, he donned on the special clothes that he kept in his personal spatial dimension as a spare as he felt that this new body of his was quickly fusing with his soul.
It fit him like a glove, since he made the body personally it was even better than the one that he was born in, it was literally molded for his soul!
The fusion was almost instant as his cultivation appeared in his body circulating into it slowly filling it until it reached the 3rd stage of the sage realm and stopped there, his avatar was reconstructed accordingly as it left his body to appear then Yun Jhin breathed some energy into it before refusing with it.
Even though he lost the progress he made in hell due to Hell's willpower, at least he didn't lose his life. That's how he was consoling himself, if he could he would go back in Hell and show it who is boss, but now that he was so weak all he could do was keep his tail tugged between his legs and bark nicely if someone stronger than him decided he was an eyesore.
It seemed he was rather wrong with his assumption, while Yuan Fang did come with the father's core to the planet it seemed it wasn't used for the elves to increase their healing capabilities, maybe he wasn't completely wrong but he guessed this wasn't the main reason, mostly just a side one.
"Now that I'm healed I can get the hell out of here, even though my appearance differs and I changed the living aura of this body to not match what they knew about me who knows if Yuan Fang can see through me or not?"
Yun Jhin's paranoia was in full-blown effect, unless he was at the God Realm he didn't want to meet Yuan Fang face to face.
But sometimes things wouldn't go as you wanted no matter how you prayed or what you did...
Yuan Fang materialized in front of him, his azure hair billowing as his aura was in full-blown power, he looked directly at Yun Jhin as he chuckled and said:
"Thought you could escape my senses didn't you? I have been searching for you for a long while Yun Jhin."
He disappeared as he appeared in front of Yun Jhin and looked into his eyes, Yun Jhin found it strange but he didn't find any hatred nor anger in his gaze as he looked at him... it looked more as if he was reminiscing about something as his gaze moved across his whole body scanning it.
"Do you remember when you cut my head off back then?"
His tone didn't make it look like Yun Jhin was the one who dealt him the death blow in his previous life, it was just like they were two friends talking about their past jokes and dumb actions.
Yun Jhin scanned Yuan Fang back but he couldn't really tell what his cultivation was... Yuan Fang chuckled as he revealed his cultivation fully, he was a little bit stronger than Yun Jhin standing at the peak of the sage realm and moving towards the God Realm, he was basically a half-god at the moment.
"So was I right? You need my help?"
Yuan Fang chuckled as he shook his head, he patted Yun Jhin's chest he put his finger on his chin with his other hand, and said:
"No but I found you quite interesting, normally speaking a soul wouldn't be able to endure so many reincarnations or it would become crazy and explode due to the extreme amount of different wills from previous lives trying to take control of the main control core, how did you not suffer from this? Even I have a hard time controlling the other part of me."

chapters.title: Chapter 173: You wash my back I wash yours
chapters.content:
Yuan Fang wanted Yun Jhin's knowledge on how to stomp the willpower of his first life and he would get it from him one way or another, the man seemed to be rather unstable with how he acted, after all, Yun Jhin would surely not act like this with the person who personally lopped his head off his shoulders.
"Thinking that I'm a little bit too gentle right now don't you? Well, the reincarnation process washed a lot of this current life's hatred towards you... but let's say the previous life willpower does want to do to you what you think I want to do."
"Anyways we can concede in this regard, you wash my back I wash your's type of deal, what do you think?"
Yun Jhin knew that working a deal with Yuan Fang was like asking a tiger for its skin but it could be said to be the same about him as well, what if he gave the wrong technique to him and made him implode as the battle of wills ensued and his ki went out of control inside his body?
It seemed that Yuan Fang was scared that the will from his previous life will interfere with his breakthroughs from now on, at the God Realm and above if any interruptions were made during the breakthrough time one could certainly be crippled!
Yun Jhin didn't have this problem as all his former lives wills were tightly sealed in the memory cores he created but Yuan Fang didn't have his technique so he could only fumble in the dark regarding this.
Yun Jhin never left this technique to anyone so there was no way for him to get it even if he destroyed and searched through the whole blood throne sect's ruins.
It seemed he had already tried that and he must have searched through his son's brain as well as he was desperate enough to work a deal with him.
It seemed Yun Jhin had the high ground in this as Yuan Fang had something that he desperately needed... but Yun Jhin could also be killed easily if the other two came back... as for Yuan Fang while he was indeed stronger than Yun Jhin at this moment there was a difference between experience between them, also while Yun Jhin's cultivation did regress his overall combat power stood at the same place, the only thing that was weaker at him right now was his new body because he didn't have time to refine it properly so his healing capability was a bit lower compared to Yuan Fang's.
Yun Jhin could see that Yuan Fang's body had been refined to its maximum capability. It was actually quite normal considering he had taken over the father tree planet and the mother one... he should have quite a big stash of natural spirits in his hands.
Seeing that Yun Jhin was contemplating his offer made Yuan Fang face remain impassive as he said while getting closer to Yun Jhin:
"I see that your new body is quite weak... why don't I help you out with something that you need? An equal exchange, what do you say?"
A frown appeared on Yun Jhin's face... he still didn't trust him as he couldn't gather anything from his expressions or body actions, it was like he was looking at a still frozen lake.
"Want to read my mind don't you? I will tell you truthfully that I don't have any ill will for you Yun Jhin, actually, I quite admire you, being able to defeat my former will so easily with the help of those old fogies that are neither devils nor normal people, from their narrow mindedness I thought they would have made things a little harder for you but it seems I was wrong, you hid yourself a little bit too well."
"I want to ask you something, since you wanted to work with me so sincerely why did you send your goon troops to me and pitted my son against me? Hmm?"
Yuan Fang's expression remained the same as he answered:
"Well as I increased my cultivation I found out the problem with my willpower and earlier it had a bigger influence on me than I thought, I will say it again, we can have this equal trade and we could go each on our ways."
"Two tigers can't live on the same mountain you know that right?"
Yuan Fang chuckled coldly as he put his hand over his face and shook his head as he said:
"We both know that we want to ascend and the universe can only hold one ascendant at a time both you didn't have to make it so obvious right? Now I cannot really say that you will walk away without anything happening to you."
If Yun Jhin remained ignorant of this fact Yuan Fang would have let him alone thinking that his ambition wouldn't be enough for him to reach the ascendence and if he didn't talk about it there would still be problems in the future, but at least they would postpone the current fight.
"I don't really want to fight during my current situation... that's why I had those two guarding me and the others are currently on their own mission, but I guess I shall fight you for now..."
Yuan Fang threw away his robe only leaving his pants and shoes on, his muscles rippled with strength as they increased in size along with his height, he reached 2,10 meters as his azure hair started to change color to a deep purple.
A devil tail grew out of his spine as it moved around menacingly two antlers grew out of his head and his power spiked up by quite a lot as his visible aura turned a crimson color.
"Interesting, so this is why you had your people go in Hell besides scouting information about me."
"Great minds think alike don't you think? I can see that you have gone towards the same conclusion. Ying and Yang united, Hell and Heaven combined, reach Godhood in one step accumulation towards the spirit realm!"
"Indeed..."
Yun Jhin's eyes clouded over as the irises disappeared and one of them turned black and the other azure... devil wings grew out of his back and sharp horns protruded from his head differently shaped compared to Yuan Fang's, his tail that spurted out of his spine was also sharper and it was of white color.
His hair transformed from its black and azure colors into a deep yellow color as his pupils returned reaching a teal color.
His muscles bulged up but his clothes didn't break nor did he remove them as they could still give him some defensive abilities in this situation.
