He put one leg back and one in front as he hooked his left hand's fingers and put his arm near his forehead while keeping the other back out, he gave out a mighty shout as his aura became visible as well, it was a greenish-purple one which resembled the color of his soul... flames started to randomly appear around his body as his power reached its apex.
They both transformed at the same time reaching their true form and their peak power, while Yuan Fang was a half-god his complexion didn't look as good as it was normal as he started to sweat green blood from his pores, his head veins also started pulsating as he clenched his arms, it seemed that his second older willpower was already attacking his main soul palace trying to drive out the new willpower out of it.
"You still have a chance to back out and give me the technique Yun Jhin, I will make sure it will be worthwhile your time."
He gestured with his fingers as an image of multiple natural spirits appeared in front of him.
Yun Jhin became reluctant as he saw the number and he could feel that their qualities were pretty high, especially the female one's auras were basically inflated... they were especially taken care of for some reason that Yun Jhin didn't really care about.
"See I'm not lying, thought that we ran out of them right?"
Suddenly he coughed a mouthful of blood as he looked down only to see a punch sinking into his gut.
"If I kill you I will have all of them and I will be able to cultivate properly without worrying about my back being stabbed..."
Air pressure came out of Yuan Fang's back as the strength of the strike became evident... behind him the underground cave started to crack as the air pressure hit the walls and they started to get buried!
"Quite presumptuous of you to think that with your lower cultivation don't you think?"
Yun Jhin looked behind him to see that the one he attacked disappeared, the hit mark was still visible on his bare chest but it was quickly reverting to normal, Yuan Fang cracked his neck as he glared at Yun Jhin and said:
"Since you don't want to come along with the easy way.. we shall do it with the hard way then!"

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Battle on a dying planet
chapters.content:
"There is still a chance for you to give up at this point Yun Jhin, we can make it so we didn't hear anything and we can go each on our own ways."
Yun Jhin's body disappeared as he did a roundhouse kick towards Yuan Fang's temple hitting him squarely there as his body flew through the ground and landed outside the underground cave.
"Trying to calibrate your soul with talking? Quite old fashioned."
Yun Jhin appeared on the surface as he looked around but he couldn't see Yuan Fang anymore, he disappeared as he was sent to the surface.
He frowned as he activated his stealth technique only for a wave of ki to disturb his stealth state and a punch to hit him in the head burying him back into the ground.
"You are not the only one who knows how to hide."
A voice came from behind him:
"But I do it better."
"Indeed you do, but you are also previsible."
A black sword went through Yuan Fang's back directly trying to pierce the owner of the voice that was behind him... only for him to pierce an illusion!
The illusory figure of Yun Jhin dissipated as Yuan Fang frowned... he could feel something strange appearing in his bloodstream as he broke the illusion and he chuckled:
"Poison? Our bloodlines are so strong that any type of poison is useless against us and you should know that."
There were no more responses from Yun Jhin.
Yuan Fang easily purged the poison in his body and continued to scan around him, he knew that Yun Jhin wouldn't run at this point he gave him too much of an enticement for him to run! Because of his current situation of his soul, he was at his weakest and Yun Jhin had the best opportunity to claim his life.
His underlings were also trying to take down the mother tree's soul and his other ones were on different missions in the universe, he was truly alone and weakened to the point that even Yun Jhin who was 6 stages below him could fight him equally and even win!
"Trying more assassin stuff Yun Jhin? You know this isn't your forte... your blood must be boiling right now, right?"
Suddenly a gigantic wave of energy exploded from Yuan Fang's body disrupting the surrounding ki and revealing Yun Jhin above him coming directly towards him with his halberd ready to split him into two pieces!
"HA!"
Yuan Fang shouted as his arms turned dark and shiny with big scales, he infused his ki into them to the point that he gained an exoskeleton armor as his bloodline talent activated by itself.
The halberd made a shallow cut on his arms letting some dark blood drip from his wound before it closed itself milliseconds later.
Yun Jhin tried to push the halberd further but he knew that if he pushed too much the weapon might become stuck in his forearm and this wasn't something he needed, he retrieved his weapon as he created a ki saber and threw it at Yuan Fang's neck accurately.
The ki weapon dissipated into sparks of ki that Yuan Fang absorbed as his eyes glowed with azure energy, his celestial bloodline started to revolve as runes appeared on his skin and his aura increased one step further.
"You are pushing me too far Yun Jhin!"
"That's what I want!"
Suddenly Yuan Fang clutched his forehead as a migraine assaulted his soul, his power started to wane increasing and decreasing at intervals that he would resemble a mortal or even go beyond his current cultivation and reach the God Realm!
"STAY BACK THERE YOU RELIC! YOUR TIME IS DONE, YOUR ACTIONS ARE OUTDATED, BEING SO RIGHTEOUS LED YOU TO BE DECAPITATED, SURRENDER YOURSELF TO YOUR NEW WILL!"
Yun Jhin appeared in front of Yuan Fang his hand transformed into a ki blade that went through his chest piercing through his heart and skewering it leaving Yuan Fang's body through his back.
But he didn't die, Yuan Fang had more than one heart and so did Yun Jhin, now that one of them was taken care of Yuan Fang's body weakened by quite a bit and his migraine increased, he had to split off his attention in two directions as he had to take care of both of soul willpower of his former life inside of him and Yun Jhin's relentless attacks on his physical body.
"FUCK OFF!"
A green barrier appeared around Yuan Fang's body as it pushed Yun Jhin away to the point that he couldn't balance his body. Suddenly two ki balls of medium size appeared in front of Yun Jhin body as the second ball was absorbed by the first one creating a gigantic behemoth of energy that threatened to engulf Yun Jhin and vaporize his new body into nothing!
Yun Jhin knew that he couldn't dodge it by going up or backward so he dug into the earth like a mole and disappeared he barely avoided the ki attack as his head turned bald due to his hair being all burnt off by the ki behemoth.
He returned to the surface to see Yuan Fang clutching his chest as the hole he pierced into him closed and from the one glance, he took he could see a new heart slowly growing back into his chest.
"His body refinement is strong to the point that I cannot defeat him unless I vaporize every one of his cells or destroy the connection of his soul to his body just like Hell did to me."
Yuan Fang started to show signs of destabilizing as his eyes turned white without any pupils as his hair spiked up, his bloodline started to run out of control in his body as the demonic and celestial parts of it clashed against each other, but unlike with Yun Jhin when his body was getting destroyed from the outside something different happened.
The bloodlines fused properly as Yuan Fang's muscled body started to slim down and his hair turned a deep blood red color, his pupils returned and they became the same color as his hair and there was a relatively more peaceful look on his face as he looked into Yun Jhin's eyes:
"Thanks for helping me stabilize my cultivation base, now I shall give you a gift!"
He put one of his hands forward as a small blue ki ball that he held in his hand was thrown forward at a slow speed towards Yun Jhin.
The speed was very slow so Yun Jhin tried to get out of the way but with one glance from Yuan Fang's eyes he became immobilized in a crucifix position and no matter how hard he tried to move he couldn't!
The blue ball of ki struck Yun Jhin's body and was absorbed by it... Yun Jhin could feel his inner organs liquefying as the ball entered his body and the pain was so intense he couldn't help but cry in pain!
"AHHH!"
"A nice welcoming gift right?"
Yun Jhin's face was down as he clenched his teeth but then he suddenly smiled as he looked at Yuan Fang's face... Yuan Fang didn't like that smile.
Yun Jhin body which was crucified in the air suddenly disappeared as if he was never there, the connection between them was cut and Yuan Fang couldn't see anything, he tried using another wave of ki to reveal him but it seemed like he wasn't there at all!
Suddenly the air in front of him cracked as space was broken and Yun Jhin appeared, Yuan Fang chuckled as he looked at him but suddenly he found a fist in his gut and a roundhouse kick to the neck that pushed him back a few meters while breaking his bones.
"Time law!!!"
Yun Jhin used his time-skip ability for the first time in a long time, this was one of the only abilities that he could employ in this battle that would be rather useful because this was an ability exclusive to him!
Very few God Realm experts learned the time laws but since Yun Jhin reincarnated so many times he had grasped way more laws than the other experts.
The time around them froze, at least that's what happened for Yuan Fang, for him time was still going moving but Yun Jhin disappeared! The next moment he tried to locate him he could feel a deep pain in his chest as Yun Jhin appeared clutching two hearts in his hands.
The earthquakes on the planet started to increase in velocity as Yun Jhin stumbled and dropped the hearts to the ground where they were both absorbed by it.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked towards the mother tree which was wilting at a visible speed:
"This planet doesn't have much time left..."
It seemed that the mother tree wanted to take everyone here down with her if she died!
While most people above the King Realm could live in space for varying amounts of time, only God Realm experts could barely survive an explosion of a planet!
If the planet exploded while they were all on it they would be doomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Battle on a dying planet (2)
chapters.content:
After having two of his hearts ripped out Yuan Fang's regeneration speed had lowered as the gaps on his chest didn't close as fast as they used to... with one hand he clutched his head and with the other his chest as he vomited a mouthful of dark blood then fell to the ground due to the new earthquake...
But he quickly got up and restored his balance in time to see Yun Jhin get up as well, both of his hearts had been crushed in his hands and not even the paste remained as it was vaporized using his ki.
Then he launched himself again at Yuan Fang while he was trying to seal his injuries... suddenly Yuan Fang grew one more pair of arms that quickly grabbed Yun Jhin by the neck and started choking him!
Yun Jhin's face didn't change as he didn't need air to survive anymore but his neck bones were certainly getting crushed under his grip if his body refinement was high enough he wouldn't have bothered with this attack but his bones were considered rather brittle with his new body.
Yun Jhin's head moved to the side as his neck bones broke but that didn't kill him, at this point, his vitality was so high that only if his connection to his body was severed would his soul be ejected from it... as for him truly dying? That was only possible if his soul was destroyed or his connection to the mortal realm was cut.
Yun Jhin used a blade of ki to cut off both of the hands that broke his neck as he adjusted his head using his arms before making sure it was properly put together, a influx of ki entered his neck area and regenerated the broken bones to the normal standard.
Yuan Fang started to back away as he couldn't control himself anymore, it was a dumb idea to fight in his conditions and he had said multiple times that he wanted to do this peacefully... but it seems Yun Jhin just wanted to bully him, he should know that there was no way he could kill him in his current condition no matter how bad it was because his own condition wasn't that good either cultivation wise.
At most, they would injure each other and waste each other's time.
Yun Jhin still thought that there was a chance for him to kill Yuan Fang... after all, unlike Yuan Fang, he knew how hard it was to deal with the split-will trying to take over your main memory core as he had done it more than a few times.
Suddenly Yuan Fang's body trembled as he tried to leave the battle and stopped, he couldn't move his body as his eyes looked around in fear and puzzlement, did his other will really cut control of his body under this situation? But how desperate it was?
Yun Jhin nodded inside as he saw his situation before he used his time skip ability again, the next moment he appeared in front of him he held both of his arms in his hands which he vaporized into dust before he thrust his hand forward into his chest trying to rip off his remaining 2 hearts!
Yuan Fang could feel Yun Jhin's hands entering quickly into his chest area trying to locate his 2 remaining hearts, while he wouldn't die immediately if he ripped them away his regeneration would halt, and if he wasn't treated in a few days he would die.
Yun Jhin knew that if he escaped he would certainly get treated by one of his many subordinates so he had to deal with him here and now!
He found his two remaining hearts as he ripped them open letting a fountain of blood erupt from his chest that widened due to the continuous ripping that Yun Jhin did, unlike before his healing reduced to a snail's pace as the closure of his chest was so slow that the healing wasn't visible anymore, it might even take him a week or two to heal his chest at this rate, without healing herbs or treasures.
"Gugh!"
Yuan Fang was ready to fall when he suddenly spit something out that collided with his open chest, it was a brown ball that had the texture of wood at first glance, the moment it collided with his chest it turned a deep golden color that exploded into the red as his chest mended itself so fast that Yun Jhin's eyes couldn't see... new arms grew but his face was still pale due to the blood loss and the ki loss.
Instead of a heart, the core of the father tree started to beat inside Yuan Fang's chest, so hard that it resonated with the incoming earthquakes!
The ki of the planet started to converge on Yuan Fang's body as it restored the blood he lost and somewhat his ki, but due to the ki attribute difference, he couldn't absorb the ki fully until he was accustomed to his new heart, so only his injuries healed.
Yun Jhin was extremely annoyed, the cockroach-like ability of a fortuned one of Yuan Fang's caliber was giving Yun Jhin an immense headache, no matter how you severed their heads, destroyed their bodies, or took their hearts they would never die unless their soul was destroyed as well, unfortunately, Yuan Fang's soul was as strong as his and unless he took care of the body first he wouldn't be able to attack it properly unless he exposed a weakness which wasn't most likely because even though the other willpower that was fighting for control would discard the body it wouldn't endanger the soul.
Yun Jhin power was still increasing as he started to clash anew with Yuan Fang's body which started to fight autonomously because he couldn't control it anymore as he fought with his other willpower, thus his battle power decreased by quite a lot to the point that Yun Jhin could easily tear his flesh and ground his bones as the body was only fighting instinctively without any strategy or battle tactics at all.
Finally, one last earthquake arrived so strong to the point that both of their bodies fell to the ground and couldn't move for a while as the gravity of the planet increased at the same time, Yun Jhin adapted extremely quickly as he created an elongated blade of ki that went through Yuan Fang's forehead and destroyed his brain thus somewhat severing the connection between his soul and body. However his soul connected to the body again as he used the natural ki from the planet to restore his brain, unfortunately, he couldn't fully evaporate his brain unless he got close enough and released an immense blast of ki.
"LEAVE ME ALONE!"
He started to trash on the ground as his power increased further and further until it created an enormous explosion around him that eradicated 50 kilometers of the ground around him. Yun Jhin appeared out of a spatial tear as he looked around only to frown as he didn't feel Yuan Fang's ki anymore... did he self destruct? Or did he just leave?
Yun Jhin took a few looks around but he couldn't find him anywhere and he decided that it was time to leave this planet!
He knew that Yuan Fang didn't use any stealth technique as he could recognize the traces of one being used and all of his live signatures disappeared which either mean he disappeared using his soul or he perished which the later one was most unlikely... maybe even one of his cronies escaped with him after he used that gigantic wave of destructive ki.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the sky before an aura engulfed him, his speed increased monstrously as he broke through the atmosphere of the planet leaving it behind him, he took one last look as it transformed into a smoldering pile of space dust as it exploded creating a gigantic shockwave that even pushed Yun Jhin quite far away even though he wasn't near the planet anymore.
"I guess it's time to expand my network for now... I need to reconstruct the blood throne sect."
Yun Jhin realized that the importance of goons was immense in this situation as most likely Yuan Fang was saved by his... he needed to get some unique talents under his wings and fast at that!
******************************
Yuan Fang frowned as he continued clutching his head, the man with the spiky hair and the one with the monkey tail were looking at him with both fear and apprehension.
"Are you okay boss? When you sent the signal for me to come and pick you up you were pretty battered up."
The man with the monkey tail said as he scratched the back of his head and laughed awkwardly.
Yuan Fang didn't say anything as he put his hand forward and waited... the man with the spiky hair came with a deep red ball that resembled the brown one that he used to heal himself, Yuan Fang took the ball and forcefully inserted it into his chest as his aura took a spike upward but he still didn't break through the god realm as he muttered:
"Why do you make things so hard for me... we are the same person."

chapters.title: Chapter 176: A need for talents
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin flew in the starry sky as he navigated towards the ruins of the Blood Throne sect, now that Yuan Fang was critically injured and his soul was in disarray he could go back and get his hands on the formation core rebranding it with his own soul mark.
Even though the ruins were pretty destroyed, they were still rather useful as the formations were still active and all he had to do was reconstruct on them to get them back to 100% capability, it was cheaper to have a foundation already laid compared to just making a new one.
He was also very familiar with the layout of the territory so he knew how to fix it properly.
Thus this was his prime target to reconstruct his organization, at first, he would lay low while reconstructing so he wouldn't attract the ire of the righteous factions but first things first he needed talents...
Rome couldn't be built in a day and certainly not alone, so Yun Jhin needed certain talents to help him with the organization building and the other miscellaneous stuff, he didn't need strong people but people that could be used for that stuff.
Yun Jhin flight speed increased as he got closer to the ruins and he continued thinking where could he even find these types of talents, could he hold something akin to the imperial exams in the mortal's world?
It would certainly be interesting but he needed the carrot and stick for it to work properly... the problem was that he was currently broke and the fate of the treasuries he left behind was unknown... there was a high chance Yuan Fang cleared out all of them already.
After a time of flying at high speeds through the starry sky, he finally reached the territory of the blood throne sect and saw the ruined buildings and other locations... if he remembered correctly the core of the formation that controlled the whole ruins was around the outer skirts in an unassuming building.
He slowly made his way towards the buildings and analyzed them with a critical eye to make sure that we're the ones that he wanted to enter.
There were quite many unassuming patches of rubble that were once buildings where he was so he had to identify the looks of the building by the material that was on the ground in front of him.
The blood throne sect was situated on a large-scale unmoveable meteorite that had been tempered with starlight and sunlight to last for an infinite amount of years and all of the buildings on it were made of especially though alloys and rocks but while the meteorite was practically indestructible the buildings on it were not.
Yun Jhin moved a little bit closer to a building he thought it was the one that he needed to enter only for it to almost fall on his head and bury him in the rubble... he got annoyed as the building that he needed to find was made of the same material as the meteorite he was on so while he hid it by making it unassuming it was very though and it wouldn't have been destroyed... he could have easily found it if he had control of the formation but due to the formation hiding it very thoroughly he was having a harder time.
"This is quite bothersome... I wonder how did Yuan Fang find it in the first place."
On top of it being hard to find due to its looks, it also warped itself around so it wouldn't be easily found so Yun Jhin had quite a big problem trying to identify it.
"Ok so... it must be around here as I made it warp itself around the outer outskirts of the territory."
Suddenly Yun Jhin caught the building in his eyes, he recognized it and immediately teleported near its entrance and barged through, when he looked behind him he realized that the building already warped towards a different location... He continued inside the building as he got to the lower floors and reached the location of the formation core.
The formation core was the head of a strange bird with no beak and no eyes, its feathers were of a deep purple color and it had sharp horns that resembled those of an elk.
Yun Jhin got closer to it but when he reached a certain boundary the empty eye sockets of the thing started to flash a glaring light that attacked Yun Jhin!
Yun Jhin snorted as he easily deflected the light and destroyed it before getting closer to the head, its power was thoroughly exhausted after not being fed for such a long time so its attacks were pathetically weak.
Yun Jhin inserted two fingers inside the eye holes as he rebranded his soul willpower into the head using his ki and one strand of his soul while also removing Yuan Fang's soul willpower... the moment he made contact with it he realized that it was extremely weak and it couldn't give him any problems at this time.
After rebranding the formation core Yun Jhin could feel the ruins cheer as the true owner appeared once again.
Yun Jhin gave the formation some sentience so while it was forcefully being controlled by Yuan Fang it wasn't using its 100% power no matter how weakened it was, the last attack some time ago was Yuan Fang's last attempt at trying to defend the formation.
Yun Jhin disappeared from the location of the formation core as he teleported into the biggest palace where he had stashed some treasures, in the basement where the treasury was located Yun Jhin inserted his ki into a seal that he left behind in his former life only to find nothing besides a piece of paper which said:
"Explosion!!"
And the paper did explode while taking half of Yun Jhin's body with it... Yun Jhin's flesh and blood slowly reattached themselves to him as he regenerated while frowning, he didn't really like Yuan Fang's prank, the explosion wasn't very strong so it didn't injure him critically, it was only a 'surface' injury.
Did all of his treasuries have these notes in them?
Yun Jhin was really annoyed by this, he knew how it felt to be poor but that didn't mean he wanted to endure this, he really needed to make some money to 'hire' people to reconstruct his organization, and for him to get these people he needed capital.
If he had enough capital and made a good name in the universe talented people would naturally flock to him and he wouldn't have to do anything besides taking them in.
He tried to see if the other treasuries had the same booby traps in them and found out that it was indeed the same... which angered him quite a bit...
But then he sighed as he started to think of some ways to make money while also being low-key.
In this situation, he couldn't reveal himself yet as Yun Jhin so he had to make business under the name of an alias and he also needed some capital first to start his new business... as for how he would get it?
By plundering, of course, there was no way for Yun Jhin to waste his time by starting a trading company and get connections quickly so he needed to use his iron fist to make that happen. He could first start by harassing lower businesses with his high cultivation base and then take over other such 'protection' businesses. Of course, he would first have to make a highly detailed analysis of the businesses he had to bully, or else who knows what type of backer they would send after him?
The cultivation environment always had people who wanted to hug the stronger people's thighs for plenty of benefits.
Now Yun Jhin had to become that backer but the benefits they would receive would be their own but just cut as he would take away from them to satisfy his needs.
Yun Jhin wanted to take the soup the meat and half of the bones in this situation.
Now that he had a location where he could create his base of operations he just needed to find his first victim...
Since the blood throne sect's territory was near the grey market it was the best location for him to start. He would also be able to get an information network this way along with a better way to gain cultivation resources. It was certainly a smarter way of gaining wealth than normal plundering.
But at its base, it was the same thing. One needed an indisputable strength to have them!
If you were too weak to hold onto your business someone like Yun Jhin would come along and strip it away from you.
After making sure everything was ok with the formation Yun Jhin decided to visit the grey markets around the blood throne sect's territory.

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Stealing businesses
chapters.content:
The grey areas near the Blood throne sect's territory had been holding strong due to their massive size and the fact that the 'righteous' factions needed a place where they could dump their ill-gotten gains or else the Bazar they created wouldn't have lasted up till now.
Yun Jhin appeared at the corner of a gigantic market where various races were trading or bartering the prices down to what they found to be acceptable to their pockets.
This was one of the many markets planted around the blood throne sect, even though the sect wasn't there anymore which was the biggest profit channel they had... they still made quite a lot of money considering they were a pure 'grey' area.
In this location, you couldn't do actually what you wanted unless you were obviously way stronger compared to the people who protected the establishments as well as their backers from various universal organizations.
Yun Jhin didn't target any of the big businesses that had obviously strong backings that he couldn't offend yet.
"Let's see the smaller businesses first."
Even though the smaller businesses were generally backed by the bigger ones this wasn't a universal rule... sometimes their profits wouldn't be good enough for them to be 'taken in' by the bigger businesses so they were left alone as they were too unprofitable for them to give them 'protection'.
He would first take over the smaller businesses and make his way up from there.
Yun Jhin looked around and identified a good target where he could start.
It was a small shop that specialized in herbs and miscellaneous items, it was akin to a pawn shop where you could buy whatever you needed and sell items as well but its size was rather small and it was obvious from the state of the building that it didn't have any backer.
The building size was quite small and it was pretty run-down as cracks were around the foundation and the paint on it was quite old and worn down.
Yun Jhin wanted to enter it when suddenly an old man threw out a tattooed muscled middle-aged man who wore gangster clothes, the old man clapped his hands to get rid of the inexistent dust on them before snorting and returning to his shop.
Yun Jhin looked on and entered the shop after the gangster muttered something under his breath and left with a limp in his right leg.
The inside of the shop was as good-looking as the outside, it wasn't anything special, the herbs were displayed in square-shaped glass pieces that were inscribed with rudimentary formations that were meant to keep them well preserved. The old man just got back to the counter when he saw Yun Jhin entering and smiled as he thought he was a customer.
The old man got up from the counter and gave out a 'merchant smile' to Yun Jhin as he asked him:
"What is this young master interested in? Could it be our miscellaneous items or would you want some herbs to concoct a pill?"
Yun Jhin took a look around the shop before saying something that made the old man quite angry:
"Actually I'm here for your shop... and you!"
"So you are in cahoots with those gangsters from before aren't you youngster? Let me show you that this old man isn't a piece of easy prey!"
He directly attacked Yun Jhin's chest with a punch that rippled with shockwaves of ki but Yun Jhin casually put his hand forward and grabbed it while dispelling all of the energy in it.
Yun Jhin shook his hand as he let the man go free and chuckled as he said:
"Aren't you quite strong for an old man at the death bed?"
"What are you insinuating?"
Yun Jhin suddenly appeared behind him as he ripped off his face revealing a charming young woman underneath the face of the old man.
The woman clutched her face as she bled from it for some time before she angrily looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and cursed him.
Yun Jhin laughed as he got a better look at her, her face was round and pudgy with freckles but this added a certain charm to her that made you want to tease her, her long blonde hair was revealed after the face-mask was ripped from her face and her figure also changed... her biggest assets could only be described as humongous and her behind wasn't bad either.
As Yun Jhin appreciated her body it made her feel like she was a monkey at the zoo and this angered her quite a bit... she unleashed her aura trying to cut Yun Jhin into pieces with it but Yun Jhin only easily dodged all of the attacks before hitting the pressure point in her neck and knocking her out cold.
Yun Jhin looked around for a short time before he found the body of the true owner... he was faceless and skinless as those were the ingredients needed to create the face mask, this was actually Yun Jhin's techniques, some of his blood throne sect higher disciples used to practice it for recon purposes.
Yun Jhin looked at the downed woman at his feet and wondered where could she have gotten the technique from?
He became a little interested in her, she was rather cruel as she had the same purpose as him, taking over the small businesses in the area and becoming their backer, her cultivation base wasn't bad, it was actually higher than his as she was as strong as Yuan Fang cultivation wise, the thing was that her battle power was lacking due to her constitution being quite weak. She didn't do an ounce of body refinement! Nor was her experience good enough she easily got manhandled by Yun Jhin.
It seemed she was one of those greenhouse flowers who didn't go through life and death battles.
However she was quite insidious, Yun Jhin tutted as he burned the corpse of the old man into cinders, it seemed she didn't have time to do this herself as she must have been solicited by that gangster from before.
Yun Jhin was now the owner of the place as he woke up the woman with two slaps to the face in certain nodes so the paralysis from having her neck would be undone.
She shrieked as she tried to run away from Yun Jhin but her face was smacked by Yun Jhin's forcefield ability making her gasp for air as she was almost turned into a meat pancake on the dirty floor of the building.
"Missy I have a few questions for you, why don't you sit down and answer them for me?"
"Like hell, I will you freak... how are you so strong while you are only at the 3rd stage of the Sage Realm?"
"Hmm, you said something?"
"DAMN YOU!"
She tried to get up only for her bones to start cracking as she went against the force of the gravity and her mouth started frothing due to the immense pressure put on her body:
"I wouldn't recommend that dear, you know your body is quite fragile for your cultivation base."
"Anyways you better talk fast as I'm a man that's rather impatient."
"Make me!"
While the woman wasn't strong her pain endurance threshold was extremely high for some reason, most of the time women would relent faster than men in these situations but this depended from person to person and it wasn't surprising for some men to relent faster too.
"Well since you insist..."
After a few minutes, she opened her mouth and started spouting everything she knew... Yun Jhin learned that the technique was scavenged from the dumpster of an auction house that couldn't seal the technique due to it's 'evil properties' and the fact that it was once the staple technique of the blood throne sect' scouts.
This woman lived all her life in the grey areas so she used her charms to fool men and women alike to gain her current strength, unfortunately, she didn't go through deadly situations as she used her innate charm to get where she was so she wasn't that strong. Most people were slaves to beauty and Yun Jhin had abused this fact in his previous lives as well. However, at a certain cultivation base, people will not care about earthly beauty anymore.
Yun Jhin transcended all physical attractions so he didn't care about her beauty that much, but what he liked about her were her ruthlessness and resourcefulness, she could be one of those talents that he needed so badly.
"I have a proposition for you, you will keep your life as well as the job you currently got."
"All you have to do is give me 90% of the profits and I will also be good for you giving you 'protection'"
The woman's eyes bulged out as he looked at him, but what else could she say besides yes in this situation?

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Starting small
chapters.content:
Now that Yun Jhin had the first little employee he had to instruct him properly to gain 100% efficiency in his new business.
"What's your name?"
"Mia."
"Ok Mia, take this."
Yun Jhin forcefully inserted his hand into her chest leaving a piece of the formation power from the ruins in her so she could contact him that way no matter the distance and also use some of its powers when she was in a pinch. And considering Yun Jhin was the owner of the formation he also got complete control over her as well now.
"What have you done to me?"
Mia asked with a tremble of her lips, she felt weird as if she was connected to something akin to a hive mind where she could get strength from and also communicate with it.
"Something to enhance your efficiency, my dear."
"Now that you are done with this let's go back to what you were supposed to do."
Yun Jhin slapped the face skin mask back onto her and applied a copious amount of ki to meld it back onto her face, her body changed back to the old man's decrepit one and her long blonde hair faded for the grey balding peak.
"You don't have to advertise or anything... sooner or later people will come to buy and sell, we have enough spirit stones to buy what we need right?"
The disguised woman nodded as she thought for a little bit of time before coming back with a spatial bag full of spirit stones that she showed to Yun Jhin... Yun Jhin rummaged through the bag for a few minutes before nodding and letting her keep it, for the time being, this was the investment he had to make into this shop to make it work.
"Whenever you see an item that you don't recognize send me an image through the neural link that I gave you, if you identify something good buy it at a very low price so we can later sell it to make a fortune..."
She grumbled under her breath:
"As if I didn't know that."
"I just reminded you, dear."
Her body shook a bit before saluting and saying:
"Ok boss leave everything to me here!"
Yun Jhin left the shop and waited in the vicinity, now that he had gotten his hands on the shop he wanted to see what kind of black business did that gangster who came for trouble belonged to... he didn't mind getting his hands in the black market as well, after all, he was in a grey area already and the black market was going to be a pretty big and profitable business and considering that there were no morals involved made it even better for Yun Jhin's money-making tactics.
Since they would expect these things and they would play the game as he would do he knew how to counter them properly.
This is the situation that would make Yun Jhin's experience from his previous lives shine the best!
Since the gangster left after being beaten by the old man he would surely come with more of his accomplices to teach the old man a lesson and try to take over his shop again.
So Yun Jhin would wait around and when they came he would introduce himself to them so he could get them to show him the location of their base and boss.
It took them 3 hours to come.
They were in a group of 20 and they were all exuding an aura that intimidated the surrounding people who tried to trade buy or sell things.
There were even people who whispered to each other about what was happening:
"The Crimson Snake gang? What are they doing here? Hmm? They are here for Old Ma's shop! That though old bone old Ma already refused them too many times huh..."
"Poor fellow it seems he will get his legs broken and his intestines made into a pair of gloves and scarf."
"They really do that?"
"Of course I saw it with my own eyes, it was a rather grisly sight, to be honest."
Yun Jhin listened for a bit before shaking his head, the moment they entered the shop he appeared inside it as well, Mia was quite scared because they were quite a lot of people and they weren't that weak either, the strongest was at the 9th stage of the sage realm and the weakest was at the 5th stage the man who Mia beat and threw out.
"Are you scared now you old piece of shit!"
The weakest gangster said as he showed his differently colored teeth in a cruel smile:
"Boys hold him down as an I cut open his gut."
He took out a small engraved knife from his pockets as he waited for the others to make their move.
Suddenly they all fell to the ground as a gravity field made them lose their balance and crushed them to the floor as if they were hit by a road roller.
"Tsk tsk, it seems you guys have been running wild before I took over this establishment."
The strongest gangster at the 9th stage tried to struggle from the ground before shouting:
"WHO ARE YOU, SHOW YOURSELF! Our boss is almost at the God Realm and he will surely avenge us if anything were to happen!"
His voice turned a little bit more mellow at the end as his strength left his body due to the ever-increasing gravity.
"Yeah let us go!"
The others chorused but Yun Jhin shook his head as he appeared in their faces, he squatted near one of them before grabbing him by the hair and giving him two punches in the jaw dislocating it and making him spit a few teeth.
"I was wondering what kind of businesses are you guys into?"
"What do you even mean by that?" Asked the strongest of them
"Eh, you will see..."
Yun Jhin used his fingers as scalpels as he started to dissect them in the order from the weakest to the strongest while keeping them conscious and alive, he also fed them some pain amplification herbs from the shop which made them scream so hard that their throats turned sore and blood started to gurgle from them.
"YOU DEVIL, LEAVE US ALONE LEAVE US ALONE!"
Yun Jhin was playing with the entrails of one of the middle-ranked gangsters as he was making a scarf with them, he was almost done with it when the strongest one started to shout at him again.
"Are you done yet?"
Yun Jhin's eyes were as cold as glacial ice as he looked at the strongest gangster, these eyes made the man almost pee himself if he could as his liver was taken out by Yun Jhin and then fed to him a little time ago.
The man was rather enduring as he only gagged and vomited it out while shouting for a little more before shutting up but it seemed he couldn't handle seeing his subordinates being destroyed like this anymore.
"So ready to speak?"
"No, I'd rather you kill me!"
Yun Jhin frowned, were these people really this enduring?
Yun Jhin looked into the strongest gangster's eyes and narrowed his as he realized that the man wasn't conscious, his body was actually controlled by someone else at this moment!
"Are you so rich that you could discard someone at the peak of the sage realm, Ring leader?"
Most gang leaders were called Ring Leaders and since Yun Jhin didn't know his name he decided to go with the title.
"Oho? You can see through this little possession trick of mine?"
The strongest man chuckled as he started to struggle out of the gravity field only for his bones to crack and for his skin to sizzle as his flesh became visible and he frowned:
"Hmmm? I infused him with so much ki but he still can't get up from this force field?"
The man realized that Yun Jhin wasn't easy to deal with as he cut the connection and decided to abandon them while running away with the wealth he made, gangsters were rather pragmatic persons. Can you bully that person? Yes? Then go and take his house, fuck his wife and enslave him. That guy is rather strong and a distance away from you? Run the hell away!
Yun Jhin shook his head as he took a look at the mindscape of each of the gangsters in front of him and they were all turned into idiots by the Ring Leader, it seemed he was using methods akin to his which was something of a surprise, how could a man that was almost as strong as the other guy here infect them with ki seeds that could control their thoughts or attack their memory cores?
It seemed the man was a true schemer and Yun Jhin needed someone like him in his team as well, regardless of how scheming he was he would turn into a sheep that would be at his beck and call as long as he would use the same technique he used on these people!

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Kindred spirits
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin knew that the man would surely try to escape in this situation so he quickly identified and collected the aura that remained after the man's slaves died so he could track him.
He did a few hand seals and the aura that remained from their psyche rose and appeared visibly in Yun Jhin's hands, he flicked his finger towards the corpses incinerating them into dust that disappeared quickly after.
Now that he was connected to him he could feel his location and it was quite nearby but he was quickly getting farther and farther away.
Yun Jhin left Mia behind so she could continue her role as the shopkeeper before disappearing into a swirl of mist.
"This guy..."
Mia murmured under her breath as her eyes were still looking towards the location of the remains of those gangsters that Yun Jhin destroyed which was now empty.
She shuddered as she thought of his abilities and ruthlessness before making sure she continued her job properly as a shopkeeper and information node for Yun Jhin's organization.
Yun Jhin appeared outside of the Bazar as he felt the aura of the person trying to rush towards the jumping pad formation of the planet. Yun Jhin frowned as he felt that was wrong... he was a person in the sage realm and he could fly in space by himself, he didn't need the help of the formation.
Did he get fooled?
He flew at break-neck speeds at the formation and waited for a few seconds to see a King Realm cronie trying to jump into it. Yun Jhin caught him by the neck and threw him away from the formation under the gaze of the people who were currently walking going to and from the planet.
However, due to the nature of the planet, no one batted an eyelid at what was happening as it wasn't related to them at all.
Yun Jhin dragged the man towards an alleyway before he put his hand over his neck as he sharpened it using ki before asking:
"Where is your boss little piggy?"
The man was quite fat and he immediately started sweating the moment he saw the blade hand on his neck, he started stuttering as a foul smell started to appear from his crotch. Yun Jhin blocked his sense of smell as he continued to push the blade hand deeper into his neck.
"I... I..."
The man didn't know what to say as his life was on the line and Yun Jhin shook his head as he peered into his consciousness trying to see through his memories instead of trying to extract information from him normally, he had no more time left!
"Hmmm?"
"You are actually the boss?"
Yun Jhin found it very strange that this small fat guy was the supposed boss, he thought that he was someone in the Half-God realm just like Yuan Fang as the head gangster said.
Did this man really mess with their heads that bad?
Yun Jhin took a better look at him but didn't found anything special at him, suddenly from the sniveling form of his a dark green blade appeared which he thrust towards Yun Jhin's heart trying to skewer it and kill him instantly.
Yun Jhin snorted as he slapped the blade out of his hands as he easily dodged the assassination attempt, it seemed the man was only playing the pig to eat the tiger and he was pretty good at it too, he even peed himself to make it more realistic!
Yun Jhin was both impressed and disgusted at his ways of playing the character, he would even lower himself to this point to make sure he would run away!
The man eyes turned to normal as he didn't shake anymore, he sighed as he looked at Yun Jhin and said:
"You are strong big bro, why don't we make a deal?"
"Oho? You think you are in the position that you can make a deal with me?"
The man shook his head making his fat move like the water waves in the ocean as he said:
"Of course not big bro, actually I just want to continue having my own will after you enslave me."
This man was rather direct after taking the loss and he also knew what would happen to him after he lost!
He must have realized that Yun Jhin was similar to him in his ways so technically they were kindred spirits!
But these types of kindred spirits like Yun Jhin and this fatty wouldn't ever be friends due to their personalities.
Yun Jhin put a slave seal into his consciousness and surprisingly the fatty didn't resist at all as he embraced the seal as if it was his own mother hugging him.
He found the man to be rather strange but as he looked through the memories he nodded, it seemed he grew up with the others and he had mediocre cultivation talents, due to that the others took care of him up till now, he was an insidious little man on the inside so he hypnotized then took control of his friend's souls.
He had gotten a devilish technique at an auction as they got a little money that he stole from them when they were out on a mission, the moment they came back he used the technique on them as he fooled them into thinking that they were apprehending the thief that stole their savings.
He was the lowest level of scum that existed almost on Yun Jhin's level!
It seemed the man was ambitious and envious of his friend's cultivation talents, his own low talent made him conscious of his friends and thought that at one point they would abandon him so he did this to keep them together until he got a little bit taste of power and he became a power-hungry little man.
Yun Jhin shook him and his spatial bags dropped out of his tight clothes. The man smiled as he kowtowed and waited for orders.
Yun Jhin looked in the spatial bag and smiled as he saw mountainous piles of spirit stones and various ingredients for concocting pills, the man had been running a lot of businesses beforehand and 99% of the profit was going to him while the 1% was used to keep the businesses running and the employees paid.
From this, it could be shown that the income was gigantic as 1% could do all of that. Even his spatial bag was rather special in the sense that its size was enormous, it could hold way more than even the highest quality spatial rings which were an advanced version of the spatial bags.
Yun Jhin was practically as rich as a young tycoon right now!
Now that he had enough money he could do what he wanted to...
And he could use the man who was kneeling in front of him as the figurehead so the money could still be raked in continuously, he could even expand further as he gained more and more employees and his cultivation recovered and increased!
Right now his cultivation was perfect for this organization's size but he couldn't expand anymore or he would get the attention of the higher-ups in the sects, around the 5 strongest sects were acting in the mortal realm.
3 of them were righteous ones and 2 of them were devilish ones, in the past the number was equal with Yun Jhin's blood throne sect but now only 2 of them remained, if Yun Jhin was right they should have also contributed to the sect's downfall indirectly.
It couldn't be helped, the righteous sects would do the same thing if that happened to one of theirs, this was truly a dog eat dog world no matter what type of morals they preached.
Yun Jhin let him go back to his office but kept the bag saying that he should send him the profits back monthly, he also gave him back some of the money so he could invest according to Yun Jhin's instructions, also he needed to buy a multitude of materials so he could repair the formation and construct the new blood throne sect.
While the men he had killed were the main bruisers of the gang Yun Jhin could always hire more and then take control of them.
He easily did that afterward by saying he was hiring some bodyguards at the sage realm and above and people started flocking towards him, in the bazaar people were either looking for work or working.
Yun Jhin hired them then 'slipped' some of the mind-controlling seals into their consciousness but unless they tried to betray him they wouldn't activate.
Afterward making sure that everything was okay he included the small shop where Mia was into the gang's fold while also notifying her.
The materials for the reconstruction were quickly found as they weren't that rare while the ones for the formation would need some time to be gathered but Yun Jhin could wait as he could reconstruct the sect while recovering his cultivation at the same time. The formation while not at 100% could protect him from most assassination attempts as long as he was in the sect's territory, unless a late-stage God Realm expert appeared there wouldn't be problems. And the appearance of such a personage was null as they had to stay in their headquarters to deter their enemies.
Yun Jhin looked at the gigantic caravan of materials as he walked in front of it and started to guide it towards the nearby territory of the sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Construction worker Yun Jhin
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin directed the caravan of materials towards the territory of the blood throne sect which made some of the drivers a bit scared considering the territory was forbidden ground for those in the neutral areas like them. After all, while there could be riches in the ruins they were also full of traps and opportunists like them didn't like to take such big gambles.
But they were paid handsomely and they couldn't go back on their word right now or they would lose credibility on the market, thus a lower amount of customers would come to them for business.
So they gritted their teeth and followed Yun Jhin into the territory, as they got inside deeper and deeper they held their breaths as they thought at any moment they would trigger a restriction that would wipe out the whole convoy.
Yun Jhin found their fear-filled faces to be quite funny as he chuckled to himself while keeping they convoy straight, he gave out instructions to help them reach the location where he wanted to start the repairs and after they reached it he gave them a small tip before letting them leave through the same path.
However, they were scared and they wanted Yun Jhin to guide them again but Yun Jhin refused and slipped some control seals into their consciousness while they were begging him on their knees, considering their mediocre strength in the king realm and weak mentalities Yun Jhin easily took control of them before sending them back on their way.
Yun Jhin looked at the piles of materials that he had gotten and then at the mountains of rubble nearby before starting the reconstruction efforts.
Even though he would need some help to reconstruct all of the buildings of the sect, he could take this building effort as training... somewhat, well he could build and train at the same time but the 'building' wouldn't help him much in his cultivation efforts. Yun Jhin crossed his arms as he glared at some rubble nearby which then transformed into dust.
The rubble was so old that a casual ki infused glance would destroy it as long as it was aimed properly.
Yun Jhin continued to glance at every patch of rubble in his surroundings to get rid of it as he needed space to remake those buildings he remembered.
"So here goes the outer disciples living quarters..."
Since he was at the outskirts of the territory he would first start with the living quarters of the weaker disciples.
Every organization needed its cannon fodder and possible geniuses hidden in the rough.
Yun Jhin took some of the dark beams and started constructing houses with them. It didn't take him much time to make quite a lot of houses but they were all plain dark looking medium-size buildings with nothing special about them.
Yun Jhin nodded as he looked at them, he left them like this so the future disciples would be able to customize their houses how they wanted, as for the ones that will come after them? Yun Jhin didn't really care about them.
Yun Jhin continued to build the outer skirts buildings until there were no more spots on the outskirts afterward he continued to destroy rubble and go further into the territory, it took him around 6 months to use all of the bought materials and he had filled 30% of the total space on the meteorite. His cultivation also recovered to a small extent as he reached the 4th stage of the sage realm.
With the constant absorption of energy and his knowledge of the realms he easily broke through... as for his body refinement, there was a little bit of a problem as he only reached the 3,000 ranks and that was his estimation as the system wasn't there anymore but considering how he compared the feeling of his body and the system numerological counting he could somewhat guess his body rank.
Body refining was rather slow cultivation and Yun Jhin could only quicken it by buying expensive resources... and the best were the hearts of the nature spirits which Yuan Fang had a monopoly of, anyways even if he had the money Yun Jhin wouldn't have been able to buy them which made him a little bit more at peace.
Some information was sent to him by Mia along with the money every month from the fatty who was named Zhu Man but he didn't have time to look through it as he was too concentrated on construction.
It seemed that they attracted the attention of one of the big shots with their actions no matter how low-key they acted, they started to invest smartly according to Yun Jhin's instruction and no matter how slowly they did it, the market owners could still see where the money was from as long as they did a little bit of searching around. Fatty Zhu Man wasn't considered to be a smart person among the grey organization's bosses even though he was an insidious and street smart person that didn't mean he knew how to invest the capital he gained.
He was basically a frog at the bottom of the well, but now that he jumped out of his well and started to throw around his money in ways that he could gain even more money than what he gained at his peak made the bosses of the black market rather suspicious of him, who had taught the dumb fatty how to invest in what's good?
This wasn't something one could learn without having experience which meant that some old fogie decided to give some pointers to him?
The other old fogies gave that Fatty a visit and a beating after their invitation to the 'mysterious old man' was refused by the fatty.
His legs were broken and his arms removed, some of his organs were destroyed and fed to the Weredogs that were shaking their tails outside the bazaar waiting for people to feed them some human flesh that would be sometimes thrown out in the garbage or directly fed to them.
Yun Jhin didn't really care about the fatty so he ignored most of the things that happened to him and concentrated on what he should do in this situation... it seemed he was wrong as the fatty couldn't hide his footsteps and things got traced back to him thus leading to the current situation. While they were kindred spirits it was obvious that the man while insidious and crafty wasn't that intelligent.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the empty caravans and decided to return to the bazaar so he could 'talk' with the old fogies that wanted to see him, as far as he knew they shouldn't be that strong and he could also go and heal the fatty as long as he didn't have any irreversible damage done to his soul, he needed a whole pawn, not a shattered one.
*****************************************
While Yun Jhin was gathering a new force and doing his business, Yuan Fang was currently recovering from his soul damage.
Yuan Fang's body trembled as he kneeled on a yellow praying mat of unknown material.
Red fumes left his head and were absorbed by the praying mat as his downed face suddenly straightened and his eyes burned with a red color, he gritted his teeth as he looked behind him and said:
"We shall hasten the plan to reach Godhood!"
Two thumps were heard as the duo who was with him on the elve's planet fell to their knees and trembled as they said with a shaky voice:
"Understood!"
Yuan Fang trembled as dark blood dripped from his ears and a craze expression appeared on his face... but then the expression froze as he returned to his normal cold and stoic self as he got up from the mat and shook his head as he burned it into cinders and then said:
"Forget about the plan we must perfect it first before we execute it, I will go in closed-door cultivation to break through... these 6 months of enduring finally born fruit!"
************************
Yun Jhin arrived at the bazaar before he went directly to the office of the fatty where he found him bandaged like he was a mummy, two arms missing and his legs were bent at an awkward angle as the people who did this to him didn't let the healing personnel put them back how they were supposed to be.
Yun Jhin easily fixed his legs before feeding him a pill he created from pure ki to regenerate his arms.
He took a better look at him and found that while his soul was a bit injured it was still healable so he realized that the others were still respecting/fearing the backer behind Zhu Man. This would make things a little bit easier for him.
The man immediately started to tell Yun Jhin about the characteristics of those that attacked him.
Yun Jhin listened for a short time before he got the information he wanted, he was invited to a 'tea party' 3 months ago that he failed to show up to but considering he was busy and ignored most of the messages that he got... he could also show up now. From what the fatty said the strongest who attacked him was at the same strength as his former peak crony.
Yun Jhin left the man alone as he walked towards the main building of the bazaar that wasn't a tent or a rundown antique. He prepared himself a little bit before he even entered the bazaar as he changed his aura and looks, he looked like a bona fide 'old master' as he entered the building while swishing his long sleeves, if any junior blocked his path all he could say at that point would be:
"Junior do you dare!"

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Old foggies trying to outdo each other
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin entered the building with a gait that could only be explained as arrogant! His nose was high into the air and he had a sneer on his face as he opened the door of the building and stridden in like he owned the place.
He gave out a small glance to the guards at the forefront before giving out a snort and not saying anything.
The guards were used to this type of acting as they had served 5 old fogies that acted all the same.
Then they looked at each other before transmitting some information towards each other:
"Who is this old fool?"
"Someone the other 5 knows maybe?"
"A lot of old folk walk through here every day how should I remember all of their wrinkle-filled faces."
"Should we just let him in?"
"Eh, what if he is a con artist who wants to get closer to the 5 heads? We were put here to filter in the trash so we still have to ask him."
One of the guards got a little bit closer to Yun Jhin and opened his mouth to ask who he was but suddenly Yun Jhin started to make a scene:
"They beat my man to such an extent and they invite me for tea but they don't even bother to show up themselves, who are these shameless people?"
"Ptui, what kind of retards are these heads of the black market? I swear I'm going to bury all of them in money the next transaction I will do!"
The guards started sweating as the one who approached slowly backed away before quickly running to report the identity of the old man.
When the 5 heads who were enjoying their 'dinner' with 5 young ladies were interrupted by the guard they almost lopped his head off his shoulder but when they heard what kind of insults the old man who they thought would be their new lackey said their faces turned as red as a boiled lobster.
"This damn fool, who does he think he is? He even used that fatty as an in-between, he must be a weakling with experience! We shall show him what the true bigshots do in this situation!"
"Yeah!" The other four chorussed to the old man who said that.
All 5 old men were looking pretty normal at first glance, 2 of them wore glasses and had a clean shaved face while the other three had beards that reached their waists and were bald, their faces were all so wrinkled you could see patterns of certain words on them but their bodies were still looking to be pretty strong for their ages.
Yun Jhin observation told him that they were half a foot in the grave at this point since they were all humans with lower lifespans and their cultivations were only at the lower stages of the God realm so their battle power might have ever receded due to their old age and inactivity in combat.
From their loose attires, Yun Jhin could see that they have been 'enjoying' themselves before he came so they must have been doing this quite often as they wanted to have their last days alive to be enjoyable.
Yun Jhin glance over them was reciprocated as one of the old men with glasses glared at him before saying:
"You are damn shameless don't you think? Using that fatty to intercept our shares in the black market? You were doing it so stealthy as well, if it wasn't for our accountant telling us your movements in the last second you might have become the owner of quite a few important businesses that were our lifeblood!"
Yun Jhin snorted as he told them with a cold voice:
"And? In this type of work there are no friends but only benefits, what type of benefits would I get if I left you alone? And would they beat the benefits of taking over your businesses?"
"You have even beaten him to such a state that you even injured his soul and you invited me to a tea party then you didn't even bother to show up the moment I arrived? Aren't you the shameless ones? You didn't even let that boy heal properly!"
The old men had thick faces so they said:
"As your middle-man, he deserves what he got!"
"Ok since he deserves what he got then why have you invited me here then? Want to do the same thing to me?"
The 5 old men chuckled as they said:
"No, no of course not, we aren't coarse men who would attack someone of your caliber, from your moves we can all see that you are an experienced fellow that would be a great addition to our team. Why don't you join us as the 6th head of the black market?"
Yun Jhin seemed to ponder the invitation for a few seconds before he shook his head and said:
"To be honest it's quite tempting, to say the least, but..."
"But?"
The 5 old men couldn't understand why Yun Jhin would have doubts about their invitation, well they could but they didn't think that he would refuse them, after all, he was currently surrounded.
"But I don't think you guys will be able to handle me!"
Suddenly Yun Jhin's figure disappeared as he appeared behind them with one head that carried glasses on its face the head started to shout in fear as he didn't feel his body anymore and it struggled to get out of Yun Jhin's grasp.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he clenched his hand and destroyed the head breaking it into pieces that he absorbed along with the fallen body.
Everything happened extremely quickly but the moment the 4 felt their compatriot die they immediately entered a formation as they activated the one that surrounded the building creating an energy chain reaction that exploded the place where Yun Jhin stood.
In Yun Jhin's place remained an afterimage as he disappeared using his stealth technique, unlike Yuan Fang, there was no one else who could disrupt this state of his in the mortal realm, the others started to think that Yun Jhin had run away after the semi-successful assassination attempt only for the other man with glasses to disappear right in their faces! It was as if the earth ate him as he just disappeared leaving only empty air!
The other 3 huddled against each other back to back so they would be able to defend each other properly in a triangle formation.
Yun Jhin couldn't have killed the other two so easily if they didn't let their guards down and they were also quite 'exhausted' from their 'activities' they were also taken directly out of their enjoyment which made them irascible, a mind full of emotions couldn't see the mountain in front of it, combined with their old age and receding power made them easy to kill. So while they were both distracted and angered Yun Jhin took two of them out in one move!
But in this situation, their minds were sobered up in one go and their auras flared to life as they opened their eyes wide, their God realm cultivation bases flared to life as they glared at the air around them, they gritted their teeth but they didn't let emotions control them anymore. Now they were back at full power and ready to attack and get rid of Yun Jhin!
Their backs were filled with sweat as they couldn't hear feel or sense anything from Yun Jhin... it was as if he disappeared the same way as their compatriot as if he didn't even exist in the first place!
Yun Jhin's eyes narrowed as he looked at the triangle formation and their strengthened aura, it could get harder and harder to kill them as their potential would recover, anyone who didn't fight for long times and decided to 'enjoy' themselves in debauchery wine and parties would end up rusty but cultivators had a great memory so with enough time and the right situation they could recover their peak battle power quite easily unless their bodies wouldn't be able to handle their peak battle power these old folks would become as strong as the early God Realm stages.
While Yun Jhin could fight on par with the early God Realm experts weaklings such as these folks there was still a cultivation difference so he wouldn't be able to kill them as easily as he did before.
While he did kill two birds with one stone he startled the others near them so it couldn't be said to have been a perfect hunt and if he ever left and tried to come back their defenses would be even better and their cautiousness would be off the chart.
So in this situation, he needed to get rid of the remaining three of them if he wanted to take over the black market properly... while he could control those at the sage realm and below as long as he tortured them enough time this strategy wouldn't work on God Realm experts!

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Taking over the whole bazaar
chapters.content:
The three fogies had an air-tight defense as they stood back to back in the formation and Yun Jhin had to think for some time on how to break their defenses, the three were so wary and scared that if they didn't care about their face so much they would have started shaking. After all, an assassin who could kill God Realm experts so silently and quickly meant that his cultivation was way above theirs!
Yun Jhin's eyes were like a hawk's watching a hare, ready to swoop in and destroy his target with no mercy.
He started to charge some ki into his palm but he only charged it inwardly so they couldn't sense it.
The ki started to swell inside his arm as he continuously charged it from his body to the targeted body part.
After a short while, his arm swelled up to the point that it became as wide as him and it glowed with an unworldly green color. Yun Jhin took a deep breath as he aimed the attack in the middle of them directly in the small gap they had when they stood back to back.
A small green ball of energy left Yun Jhin hand as his arm deflated returning to normal proportions, however, it was still a little bit swollen and red due to the intense pressure the ki had put on his body, normally this wouldn't have happened but Yun Jhin's body still wasn't up to par for the use of his stronger techniques.
The ball was quite small but the trio still saw it, the moment it landed between them a big explosion shook their bodies as blood spurted from their mouths as their bodies absorbed the shockwave coming from the explosion injuring their internal organs in the process.
Their skin was also mutilated as bloody patches appeared on their backs which were then singed and cooked by the unholy fire coming from the explosion.
Yun Jhin took a better look at their situation and shook his head, the explosion was strong but the defensive capabilities of their formation reduced it to 40% of its total strength so they only got light injuries.
Yun Jhin saw as their skin healed back to normal while they all frowned and shook their heads to stop the ringing in their ears.
Suddenly one of them lost his balance and almost fell to his knees due to the injury he got to his inner ear from the explosion.
Yun Jhin didn't attack as he waited for a few seconds and it seemed he was right, the old fogie was acting up making him think that he got injured only for him to fall into a trap.
He could feel the formation gaining strength in the spot before the old man showing that they were preparing for their coup de grace attack.
The full-on attack from the fully powered formation would destroy Yun Jhin's body and injure his soul if it hit him head-on but hitting him was easier said than done, only Hell's willpower could immobilize him and that was when it was in its home territory and at its full power!
He threw a destabilizing wave of ki towards the spot where the energy was concentrated making it explode into a shower of rainbow fireworks which melted the old man who was kneeling there waiting for Yun Jhin to take the bait.
The other two paled seeing their plan being foiled in such an easy way, they were the ones who were connected to the formation and they could feel all of the changes in it so how could Yun Jhin feel them as well?
While Yun Jhin wasn't connected to the formation, the proficiency he had in the arts of formations made him easily understand the functions of the formation even though it was a newer model than what he was used to. While formation models could change the nodes and their uses would forever remain the same unless someone invited a new way to create formations.
The other two realized that they wouldn't end up well if they remained in the building... but if they left they would also lose the protection of the formation and their chances of death would be even higher, they didn't believe they would have enough time to reach their space ship and run away with it.
Their eyes were as small as coins as they felt despair inundating their minds, were they really going to die in this situation? After all the money they made? They only had a short time to live any way but dying by someone's hands and dying by old age was entirely different!
While they could take dying by old age as it wasn't something they could control they wouldn't want to die by someone's hands if they could help it!
The duo turned off the formation as they fell to their knees while they also started kowtowing smashing their bald heads on the floor of the building while shouting:
"Please let us live, we shall become your subordinates and give you all of our wealth!"
Yun Jhin suddenly appeared in front of both of them as he grasped their necks while sealing their whole cultivation base, it seemed they were really sincere as they let their guards down fully and Yun Jhin easily took care of their cultivation bases.
While Yun Jhin wanted to kill them, in this situation having 2 lackeys at the God Realm would be really good for the organization, even as reserve power that couldn't be used willy nilly.
However, making them obedient was another thing. A God's realm soul couldn't be controlled unless the person was branded before he became a God and there was also the fact that God's could break contracts quite easily... only Devil Gods would get huge repercussions for breaking contracts but that was their race inherent penalty due to the many benefits the race got in their early life if they survived it.
While he couldn't control their lives he could do something similar, he could plant a ki bomb in their souls that he could easily trigger as soon as he found them unpleasing to the eye, this wasn't an airtight method as they could remove the bomb with time or wear off the ki in the bomb simply making it unusable.
There was also the fact that if they got too far from Yun Jhin he couldn't detonate it anymore...
It wasn't as good as control over their souls but he could also make them come with him everywhere as his bodyguards just like Yuan Fang had that monkey tailed man and the blonde man with long spiky hair.
Yun Jhin put his hands over their faces as he forcefully inserted a huge amount of ki into them reaching their souls and creating sphere-shaped bombs that would detonate themselves whenever he wanted to as long as they were in range, the range was almost 2 to 3 planets long and most likely they would never get that far away from him.
Yun Jhin patted the duo on their shoulders as he said:
"Get up now and let's be friends from now on."
The duo smiled awkwardly as they felt their cultivation base being unsealed... they both let out a big sigh as they left and returned with all of the ownership certificates for their businesses and all of their riches.
Yun Jhin took a look through the certificate and riches and he could feel that they were enough for him to fully reconstruct the sect and repair the formation almost to 40% of its full power!
He would need 2 or more Bazaars like this one to fully repair the formation but its defensive ability under Yun Jhin's command would let him defend against 4 to 5 God Realm experts at the same time, but that was only if Yun Jhin used it personally anyone else and they would have problems with even 1 peak God Realm expert.
Yun Jhin looked through the certificates and found that they controlled over 60% of the actual businesses in the Bazaar be they medium-size or higher, from what he could see they controlled the slave market, mystical arms dealers, drugs dealers along with the normal pill shops, herb shops, and the other usual businesses, even dipping into the food and entertainment sections.
The other 40% or so were the shares of the other sects be they righteous or evil, they all had a share in the grey market and this was one of the biggest Bazaars in the neutral territory. It was actually quite impressive these 2 old men and the 3 deceased ones could hold over 60% of shares against the 5 strongest sects in the existence of the mortal realm.
"Ok so for now send these materials to the blood throne sect territory along with some men that are proficient in construction, only use trustful connections alright? You are also coming with me so after you are done pack your bags!"
The duo bowed while on the inside they were dying while thinking:
"You already enslaved us, can't you let us play a while longer? You are already going to put our old bones to work?"
Yun Jhin knew what they were thinking but he didn't care as he clapped which indicated that they should hurry as he wanted to finish reconstructing the sect so he could focus on his cultivation afterward, as long as he could create a proper organization the resources would be flowing in by themselves with the combination of the Bazaar workers beings his underlings, all he would do then would be cultivating!

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Reopening the sect
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin watched as the duo left him alone as he pondered about the reconstruction of the sect, with his current influence he might be able to pull some strings to jump-start his sect's reputation along with the recruiting promotion.
A sect needed disciples for it to work properly, the disciples were the lifeblood of the sect which would get him profits and other different things such as slaves or thralls that he could use for cultivation purposes.
At this point, he could get these things by himself but it could cost him time and a headache, if he had others to do it for him he could cut the time he used to gather these things and he could also continue cultivating at his safe headquarters where there would be no chances of random ambushes due to the enemies he made recognizing him. While there was a very low chance for him to be recognized if he didn't reopen his sect, the chance was still there.
After all his reputation was as resounding as thunder in one's ears and even if he changed his looks and acted differently his inherent aura and majesty could still be seen through by people that were familiar enough with him.
