While he wasn't entirely sure, he knew that there must be other reincarnated ones besides him and Yuan Fang, the other ones always liked to play low-key and see the others beat each other before they swooped in and took everything at the expanse of the two fighting parties, they were the ultimate fishermen.
That's how most righteous organizations acted, they made it look like they were neutral in these types of conflicts on the surface but underneath they couldn't bear to wait to pierce their teeth in the meat of the two parties.
The cultivation world was both cruel and profit-oriented.
Yun Jhin didn't need to wait for long as the duo's influence in the black market was pretty much the best, so the materials that he needed were immediately gathered and Yun Jhin flew with the new caravan towards the sect's location.
The two old fogies walked behind Yun Jhin with their heads low which made the people who derived the caravans have bulged out eyes considering everyone knew the identity of these two old men, and the question was where were the other 3 elders?
Yun Jhin ignored the glances he was given as he indicated to the two old men that they should increase the pace so they could arrive faster at the meteorite.
The two old men finally glanced up at the drivers and glared at them as they motioned with their hands to increase the speed up!
The drivers didn't say anything as they increased the throttle of the formation controlled caravans.
In around 3 days they arrived at the outer skirts of the territory and saw the newly constructed houses for the outer skirts disciples.
They then left Yun Jhin alone with the caravans and materials as they were instructed to return to their posts and deliver the same amounts of materials monthly for 7 months, also they were told to find more special materials so Yun Jhin could repair his formation properly.
Now that he had enough materials for construction Yun Jhin went ahead and started as he continued to destroy rubble and create houses accordingly, the houses then turned into palaces and other imposing buildings as he got further into the territory, as time passed, more and more houses and palaces and other types of buildings had risen in the territory as it gotten filled up, even the formation got repaired around to 20% of its original strength as Yun Jhin multitasked.
The sect was getting more and more imposing as the way Yun Jhin placed the buildings created a natural formation and with the formation that was put around the meteorite it created a formation within a formation!
The formation made by buildings was way weaker but it accentuated the strength of the outer formation by 15% when it would be fully done.
Finally, Yun Jhin reached the biggest palace that was whole and demolished it with his hands before constructing a new similar one.
As he got to the furthest into the territory he arrived back at the entrance to hell which was still wide open as the demonic energy seeped slowly through it but not invading the mortal plane by much, only those who would be near it would get influenced.
"You will have to move out of my territory... I don't need you anymore."
The door started to move as if it seemingly understood Yun Jhin but Yun Jhin grabbed it by its frame and started to exert strength against it, the door started to move up and down quickly as it wanted to escape his grip.
The door wasn't sentient but it could move on its own when it perceived danger as it would need a long time to respawn if it was destroyed.
Yun Jhin ignored its struggling as he put more strength into his arms infusing them both with an immense amount of ki which swelled them to the same size as they were when he fought the old fogies in their formation.
The door started to struggle even harder as it tried to pry itself out of Yun Jhin's grasp with all of its strength, demonic ki started to overflow out of the entrance which tried to invade Yun Jhin's new body, corrupt it and devour it!
However the demonic energy was just like a tonic to Yun Jhin as his body started to strengthen at a quick pace breaking through the 4,000 ranks but stopping there as the low quality of the energy didn't help him any further, he also didn't use the energy for his cultivation base as it wasn't pure enough for his likes.
"Ok, that's enough from you!"
Yun Jhin crumbled the door like it was made of paper as he transformed it into a small ball of dark metal that he crushed in his palm until it transformed into nothing!
The connection between the mortal realm and hell was thus thoroughly severed and any mortal who entered hell would be stuck there until the next door opened randomly.
"Now that I have resolved this problem it's time to finish the reconstruction of the sect... only the biggest palaces for the elders and myself are left along with the formation repairing."
Yun Jhin finished the sect in about 3 years, finally remaking the whole sect as it was before, tall buildings of various colors rose on the surface of the meteorite and while some of them looked similar there were also a lot of them which were very different, the similar ones were living quarters while the different ones were palaces and treasuries along with the mission quarters and the other important buildings of the sect.
At first glance, you wouldn't find this sect to be a demonic one but Yun Jhin already started the sacrifices to awaken the river of blood underground, under the buildings Yun Jhin had opened an underground area where a river of blood was flowing in his previous life and the blood river dried up due to not having any fresh sacrifices, the blood river was inherently connected to the formation and it activating would increase the offensive and defensive capabilities of the formation by 50%, it was also the reason Yun Jhin could defend and maybe even beat 5 peak God Realm experts at the same time.
He was the only one who could control it!
The blood river was connected with his soul and it only recognized it alone!
The new sacrifices that he made weren't enough to awaken the blood river but it did start to stir up a little bit, he would need millions of people to be sacrificed for it to wake up and their cultivation bases should only be at the King Realm or above.
Yun Jhin's body was floating above the dried up dark red river of blood as he opened his eyes showing two green pupils that were concentrating on the river below him, in his left hand there was a knife and in his right one a heart that was still beating, the beating heart started to quickly squirm out of his hands but Yun Jhin's grip on it was too strong as he thrust the knife into it letting hot blood flow from it.
The blood river below him started to slowly move as the dark red color started to liven up into a bright one but seconds later it turned back to its original state.
Yun Jhin shook his head as his pupils turned to their normal colors and he flew through an opening in the underground area to appear in a lavish palace made from a dark material that reflected the light coming from outside leaving it in utter darkness.
Yun Jhin moved through the darkness as if the palace was fully illuminated and reached the center of it where the two old fogies from the Bazaar were kneeling on praying mats and meditating.
Yun Jhin's appearance made the duo wake up and they both bowed to him at the same time.
Yun Jhin slowly walked towards the middle of the room where a new throne made of pale white bones was erected, he sat on it while he put his hand over his face and leaned to the left while saying:
"I guess it's time to open the sect, what do you two think?"

chapters.title: Chapter 184: Recruiting disciples to enliven the sect
chapters.content:
A sects lifeblood would first be their defensive capabilities to keep the headquarters alive but secondly would be their disciples!
A sect with no disciples couldn't call itself a proper organization as it would be only an empty shell.
Yun Jhin needed a few things to make the sect attractive to those who wanted to join.
The first and the most important thing would be the carrot and the stick, aka benefits.
There wouldn't be problems to those below the middle stages of the God Realm as he had one whole planetary Bazaar under his thumb which he could use to siphon resources to his sect, he couldn't really drain them as it would be bad for business but there were many businesses that he could take at least 1 or 2 percent out of them which in turn would get him quite a lot of resources.
He could even gain resources for average God experts, at least those below the 4th stage could be accommodated in the sect.
Another thing that a sect needed would be a good reputation or in Yun Jhin's case, a devilish one as his sect could be considered a plague. Every man and woman in his previous life that joined the sect were all notorious rogue cultivators who offended people due to their crimes, they joined him for shelter and the benefits that came with being a sect member.
However a sect wasn't all benefits and no work and those who joined understood that there was no free lunch in the world, they would also have to do missions to get said resources or contribute with some other resources that they didn't need or the like, this was the notorious points system that most sects used but considering it worked properly since the construction of sects no one needed to change it.
One of the most attractive things to those that didn't come from cultivators families would be a multitude of cultivation techniques that could adapt even to their rather untalented bodies... and Yun Jhin had a lot of those techniques body refining ones included.
With Yun Jhin expertise in bloodlines and cultivation techniques, he could even make untalented people reach the sage realm at least if he experimented on them, normally it wouldn't be possible but Yun Jhin could trade lifespan for cultivation strength if he needed to so he could do the same to others through special rituals or surgeries.
As long as he advertised these things properly he would get so many people that wanted to join the sect that he wouldn't have enough space on the meteorite to hold all of them.
But Yun Jhin still had a basic requirement for those that joined. As he wouldn't take in every riff-raff that he saw, as the less talented they were the more resources would be needed to help them in cultivation, and even though he had a steady way to gain those resources they weren't infinite!
Yun Jhin took a look at the two old men below him who were nodding at him with great speed before he shook his head as he told them to send a universal advertisement about the opening of the sect, it didn't matter if the other sects knew that he was back because at this point the formation would be able to defend him, he also made sure that no one knew the connection between the Baazar and his sect thus if the others tried to cut off his supply they would have a hard time to pinpoint where did his resources come from.
The Baazar was basically a whole planet and a lot of the businesses were 'free' on paper and they weren't under the old men jurisdiction even though they were controlled and those righteous fools were tied by their 'morals' so unless they got a serious reason they wouldn't be able to attack those businesses.
While Yun Jhin would become the top tier enemy of the universe after he officially opened his sect some so many people would flock to his sect that it wouldn't matter, he would create a strong army that he could use to defend himself and the sect with while he would give them the resources they wanted.
Yun Jhin waited for a short while before the duo came back saying that they have sent the message to the whole universe using their connections. Yun Jhin didn't have to wait even for 10 days before a line of people appeared at the meteorite waiting for the opening of the sect entrance exam.
Yun Jhin exam was quite easy, he would personally assess the people who approached the formation and see through their talents, if their talents were below his requirements they wouldn't even be able to enter the sect's outer skirts.
Yun Jhin's projection appeared outside the sect, he cut an extraordinary figure as he stood there with his hands behind his back as he said:
"The entrance exam is easy, approach the visible barrier and touch it, if you can go through you are allowed in the sect and you become an outer, inner, core or personal disciple based on your cultivation, all above the 6th sage realm could be considered elders of the sect and God realm experts are Grand Elders that can be appointed to the treasury, martial hall and punishment hall."
Yun Jhin's hands which were before his back came forward as he clapped and the barrier started to glow with an intense black color which indicated that the start of the test had begun!
The people started to quickly rush through touching the barrier as 30% of them were stopped and they couldn't enter no matter what they did while the other 70% entered as they melded with the barrier and arrived on the meteorite's ground.
Yun Jhin had already identified most of their cultivation the moment they went through the formation and they were around 300,000 cultivators at the heavenly realm, 200,000 at the earthly realm, 100,000 at the ki cultivating realm, 50,000 at the King Realm, and 25,000 at the sage realm in total they were 675,000 people approximatively as Yun Jhin counted them, the earthly and heavenly realm cultivators will be outer sect disciples ki cultivating realm and King realm ones will be inner disciples while the sage realm experts below the 6th stage would be core disciples.
There weren't actually many above the 6th stage, they were only 10 and they met with Yun Jhin directly in the biggest palace of darkness.
The moment they saw him and realized that his cultivation was below them they felt that they had made a mistake joining the sect, but then they saw two God Realm experts kneeling to him and they immediately knelt as well before shouting:
"We greet the patriarch and the ancestors!"
They thought that Yun Jhin was the patriarch and the puppet of those two old fogies who could be considered ancestor level figures.
Yun Jhin didn't correct them as he got up from the bone throne and looked down at them, he put his hand on the forehead of each one of them while they kneeled 'blessing them' with some knowledge as a reward for their elder statuses.
They were each given the special cultivation technique of the blood throne sect and considering they joined his sect despite all of the rumours that were known about it they weren't saints at all, their eyes glowed with devilish light and sin as they digested the cultivation technique that Yun Jhin imparted them while he also slipped some controlling seals inside their souls which would fester inside until he would want or need to activate them, he would also be able to see what they would be doing through them.
The ten were then given a palace each as they were elders and they needed imposing homes to assert their dominance over the common disciples.
Yun Jhin watched as they fought over who gets each house at the outer skirts and the inner skirts, it was quite fun to watch them bicker but Yun Jhin only waited for them to settle down before he sent down the rules along with the missions and available resources that could be bought if you gathered enough points. He also added a currency exchange as they could use spirit stones for points or buy directly from the resources pavilion, but using points would end up being cheaper.
Yun Jhin made in such a way that they would rather donate to the sect for points so they would get closer to it and feel like they belonged to it as only disciples could get the discount and point exchange.
Yun Jhin looked over the whole sect as the disciples settled in before immediately rushing back out to do missions, most of these people were rogue cultivators who needed a roof over their heads to shield them from the 'wind and rain' of the universe, they were also wanted people as 95% of them had a bounty on their head and if they joined a sect they would get a backer that would make them shout out something among those lines when they were caught:
"Hey, you should let me go if you don't want to offend the blood throne sect! I'm an xxx disciple!"
They would become arrogant and display their backing offending anyone they wanted and attracting the wrong attention to the sect, but Yun Jhin didn't really care as those dumb disciples will be discarded leaving only the smart ones, while there wasn't any big test or anything like that the true purging will be made by their own hands!
Yun Jhin would actually never back up his disciples unless they were extreme talents similar to him or one tier below.

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Disciples offend powers
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was meditating on his bone throne as he had his eyes closed, on the surface he was cultivating but underneath he was observing the newly appointed elders.
Yun Jhin could split up his attention into 10 parts and watch over all of them due to the seals he had put in their minds.
But he soon came to find that most of them were just trying to cultivate at the moment unlike the others who went to do missions they were a little bit more 'relaxed', after all, they did have an allowance because of their elder statuses so they would either be lazy or think that the allowance would be enough for them.
Yun Jhin couldn't blame them, they must have lived day by day scared that they would be caught by those they offended and their heads lopped off, he guessed that they were quite happy that they didn't have to cultivate with one eye open from now on.
Yun Jhin observed them for a short while before stopping, there was no reason to continue as they were all slowly cultivating the technique he gave them.
The meteorite could hold around 10 million people and the 750,000 he currently got wasn't near the limit at all, all he needed now was to continue recruiting disciples, while 90% of the disciple population could be considered cannon fodder due to their humble origins, Yun Jhin could use them for menial tasks and as long as they did them properly he could strengthen them as a reward which in turn will make the sect stronger as a whole.
He decided to start cultivating as well as he had quite a lot of cultivation materials that he had stocked for himself that he could go through, they were all premium quality the best of the best from the Bazaar but it didn't mean much in his hands as most of them were scavenged by mercenaries and the good stuff was in the hands of the top sects.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he sat cross-legged in the air. As he hovered above the blood river he consumed cultivation resources like a whale would drink water, his cultivation slowly increased as time passed and the dried up blood river below him was starting to glow with a deep red color the more Yun Jhin cultivated above it.
The river had the passive ability to increase the cultivation speed of those around them by 50% and its energy could also be siphoned for cultivation purposes but both abilities were currently sealed due to its dried state, however, Yun Jhin's cultivation increasing also lead to the river getting more lively as they were connected.
The river glow was getting increasingly brighter as Yun Jhin cultivation grew towards a breakthrough, as for the sect he left the two old fogies to work over it and he could still feel their connection while he was cultivating so he wasn't bothered if they would try to escape both of their souls would explode and they knew that as well.
While Yun Jhin was cultivating under the Darkness palace the two old men were continuing the recruitment of people as Yun Jhin gave them control of a part of the formation to let them see the talents of the recruits.
As time passed and Yun Jhin didn't exit his closed-door cultivation the duo started to get thoughts of escaping but the moment those thoughts appeared in their mind the seal in their mind palaces started to prickle their souls, it was the feeling of drinking something carbonated after eating mentos but this slightly uncomfortable feeling made them realize that even though Yun Jhin was cultivating he still had his eyes on them!
All thoughts of escaping left their minds as they fully became involved in the activities that Yun Jhin let them do.
All of the people who joined the sect were notorious small or medium criminals and very few 'clean' people joined the sect, most of them were given the basic cultivation technique of the sect so they would be able to increase their cultivation faster than what garbage technique they had got from going through the trash of auction houses with unsold pergaments and jade slips.
The technique Yun Jhin distributed for them was a rather simple but effective one which used the surrounding bloody ki to strengthen the body and ki pathways thus increasing the cultivation base along with body refining at the same time, it was a jack of all trades technique but it was very good for the cannon fodder to cultivate as they wouldn't have any weakness but not any strengths either.
This way he would be able to make flawless formations with them in the outer parts where they would be able to take all of the damage while dishing it back out.
While the recruits were getting familiar with the technique, the earlier ones from the first batch of 750,000 were returning with successful missions, well not all of them as some of them died and some of them were captured so they would spill out the secrets of the newly created sect.
But the ones who came back had come with the things they needed to give to complete the mission or well the heads of those they had to kill, etc.
Yun Jhin's treasury was filling up with rarer materials that the disciples came back with as they did missions or traded them for points that they could use to buy things that they needed immediately.
Those materials ended up in Yun Jhin's belly or his cauldron as he created pills with them, two of the elders finally made a move 7 months in Yun Jhin's closed-door cultivation.
They left the sect and went to a different Bazaar than the one Yun Jhin had under him to trade, Yun Jhin had already connected his consciousness to the seals in their minds when they left the sect so he could see whatever they saw and hear whatever they heard.
When they arrived at the Bazaar they swaggered in like they owned the place and went to the most important auction house to buy and trade some things that they didn't find in the sect trade list, and as they knew that the closest Baazar to them was under the patriarch's thumbs, it meant that if they went there to shop they wouldn't be able to find what they wanted either.
So logically they went to the other biggest Baazar they could find.
The grey area was heavily business influenced and 5 Bazaars were equal to the one Yun Jhin had conquered, each had different specialties based on their locations, and 3 of them were mostly controlled by the righteous sects while two of them were controlled by the evil sects, Yun Jhin's was a hodgepodge of both righteous and evil while most of it was controlled by the old fogies he took care of.
The moment the duo came and said what their backing was the owner of the auction house immediately came to invite them in, it seemed the Baazar they chose was controlled by one of the evil sects which was an 'ally' of Yun Jhin in his previous life.
Considering the blood throne sect had resurfaced meant Yun Jhin had reincarnated successfully and his cultivation must have been above the God Realm if he was so upfront with his actions, Yun Jhin was an old monster that the evil faction respected and hated at the same time and considering he was back in power they needed to give him the due respect first.
However the duo was a little bit too 'conspicuous' after they found out how big their backing is and they started to become a little bit too arrogant with the boss of the auction house which had the Dead Bones sect behind him, thus the duo offended them, it wasn't actually hard to offend someone in the cultivation world but these two did it even though their backing was rather huge.
It was actually impressive, Yun Jhin was impressed with their idiocy as they were beaten and whipped to half-death before they were sent back to the sect with a message from the owner of the auction house.
Yun Jhin personally got the message as he read it shaking his head, the man wanted compensation for the actions of the two but he wouldn't get jack from Yun Jhin!
He decapitated the duo and sent their heads back to the man with those words:
"If they are talented I will protect them even if they shit over your head, if they are mediocre their heads are yours but that doesn't mean you can trample over the sect!"
Seeing his hard stance over the matter made the boss forgive the transgression considering the offenders were both dead.
With this situation, Yun Jhin showed his stance to the universe about his sect, if they offend you as long as they aren't talented enough you can kill them. However, if they don't offend you and you still decide to take a fight with them the whole sect will be against you!
This way he also scared the disciples who tried to abuse their backing while also advertising the sect rules to the whole universe at the same time!
This also put the other 8 elders in their place as they realized that they couldn't offend people if they didn't have enough strength, but people also couldn't offend them for no reason either!
These were the benefits of a balanced sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 186: The thoughts of the other sects
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's hard stance on the elders' matter made the other organizations who were eyeing the blood throne sect, like hungry piranhas reconsider their intentions.
Normally the other sects were quite wary of the blood throne sects former reputation and they knew that its revival was only a matter of time unless news of Yun Jhin's permanent death appeared.
So they had prepared somewhat for his resurrection but considering that he recreated the sect too fast and too sudden made them unable to act properly after all the grey areas were rather far away from the righteous sects and nearer the evil sects, the evil sects also didn't have much time to check up on the grey area as they were always butting heads with the righteous sects for resources.
The grey area resources were scarce and they were more like an in-between place for the righteous and evil sects to trade normally however most of the time the resources each sect used were opposed to those they needed so their trades were very rare, at least the personal ones could happen once every hundred of years, they would mostly use the old men who controlled the Bazaar to get what they needed instead of going by themselves.
As Yun Jhin only went to one Bazaar which he immediately took over sealing all the news that came from it at the same time, made the sects unable to blitz him and stop him before he created his sect.
The blood throne sects' formation reputation was quite resounding in the universe and no one wanted to test it first, as for war? That was more unlikely as they would need late stage God Realm experts to breach the formation which would leave their headquarters empty and ready to be attacked.
While the sects had alliances with each other those alliances could be easily forgotten in the face of profits, betrayal was an easy thing to happen in the cultivation world and it didn't need much thought to happen.
This was why Yun Jhin always put some form of control on his immediate subordinates, no matter how close one could be considered to another there was still a chance of betrayal happening, even childhood friends or relatives would forget about each other as time passed and they would only become acquaintances at best if money and resources were involved.
What Yun Jhin did by executing those elders showed that he was going to take a neutral stance in the current world and that he wouldn't involve himself with the current events at the moment which gave the others a sense of inner peace, while Yun Jhin was currently a ticking time bomb that others wanted to defuse, they would first have to go through a field of thistles a sea of blades and a mountain of fire before they could defuse the bomb, and making one mistake could make the bomb explode earlier as well. So they didn't want to mess with him... yet.
*****************************
At the Radiance Brilliance and Light headquarters stood a gigantic pavilion made from Sky Blue Bricks of light, it was very imposing and majestic with a tint of imperial aura, a gigantic dragon statue was atop of it in a pose of roaring towards the heavens.
Inside the biggest room where nothing but a prayer mat stood was a middle-aged man with long pierced ears and a big stomach, he had an aura of righteousness around him which made him seem like a sage that would save the masses from hunger by offering his own body if nothing else was to eat.
He had a strange attractive aura to his cerulean blue eyes and he wore nothing but a kasaya robe which covered his rather rotund body, he was looking at the ceiling of the room seemed as if he had nothing on his mind and he was just being bored.
A knock could be heard coming from the oversized doors of the room, they were considerably bigger than the middle-aged man's frame which was only over 1,83 meters tall.
The doors opened and a midget around 1,35 meters tall came in, he had a red nose a long flowing red braided beard and he was bald, he had grey lifeless eyes like those of a dead fish and he wore red armor made from tempered lava iron.
The dwarf male came closer to the daydreaming man and kneeled before saying:
"The calamity has descended on our universe once again Ancestor Biu Wuan, what should we do?"
Biu Wuan closed his eyes as his head moved towards the dwarf's location and he shook it as he said:
"Nothing."
The dwarf continued kneeling before he kowtowed and left the room hurriedly to tell everyone in the sect the information.
The ugly man who sold Yun Jhin those resources had currently made it big becoming a steward of the sect and he was quite scared of the news about Yun Jhin, he didn't even know that the one he sold materials to was the person that currently scared him to the bone!
The moment the news came saying that they weren't supposed to do anything to Yun Jhin he became a little bit disturbed, their Radiance Brilliance and Light sect couldn't do anything to the new sect? Even though the reputation was quite scary it was just newly reconstructed and there was no way it recruited any important personnel!
But considering the order came from high above the ugly man didn't say anything as he continued his job as a steward.
The Brilliance Radiance and Light was the strongest righteous sect so the other righteous sects took after their example and called off any attempts at attacking Yun Jhin, but that didn't mean they didn't send some spies to see what Yun Jhin was currently doing.
*****************************
In the strongest devilish evil sect of the mortal realm, the Dead Bones sect stood a gigantic tower made of pale white bones that contained fragments of bones from every race that could be found both in the mortal realm and hell, they were a sect focused on the control of bones and all of their techniques had the need of bones to be cast.
The gigantic tower made of bones was simple and crude, it looked like it would fall off the next moment a small breeze would pass by but it also had an unquestionable stench of decay and death that also gave it a stable look somehow, it was a rather unnerving feeling.
Inside the top room of the tower stood a gaunt old man who was only bones, there was only a patch of skin over his bones that made him look human but everything else about him made him look like a corpse that crawled up from the coffin.
"You are back old friend? Hmph, I wanted to give you a present for our last encounter but it seems you are rather busy."
The old man talked with himself as if he was crazy as there was literally no one with him in the empty room, the room was full of bones of different sizes and origins but all of them had the same aura around them which indicated they were all under the control of the old man.
The old man shook his head as his vision pierced through the tower but the distance between his sect and Yun Jhin was extremely long, Yun Jhin's meteorite was quite far to the northern part of the universe almost to the border of known chaos, this was also one of the reasons he only gained 750,000 disciples despite the resounding reputation of the Blood Throne sect.
"Ah I would like to give you a visit but If I do those other old fogies would attack my tower..."
****************************
Yun Jhin opened his eyes a shiver went through his whole body and down his spine, it felt like someone rather important was talking about him right now... and this sensation happened more than one time, it actually happened 5 times in a row!
Did the other sects finally put his crosshairs on him?
Yun Jhin wasn't scared of conflict at the moment as they wouldn't be able to send many troops to his sect but he still needed some time to consolidate his position in the universe along with his cultivation, once he reached the God Realm the battle power of his last life would come back quickly even though he couldn't tussle with the peak experts he could still fight it out with the late-stage ones.
For now, his cultivation had stabilized at the 5th stage of the sage realm after continuous use of the resources he gained from the Bazaar but he needed to awaken the blood river so he could get the passive increase in cultivation speed. However, he couldn't let the others know that the blood river was dried or they would have thoughts of attacking, after all the blood river was the main reason they were wary of coming to his base.
And the fastest way of awakening the river was feeding it the pure blood of the innocent!

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Getting blood
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin needed quite a lot of blood to awaken the river fully, the question was where he could get it? Even though the blood of the innocent would awaken the river faster, any type of blood would work but he would need higher quantities of it.
He couldn't sacrifice his disciples yet as they were too few and if word got out no one would come to join the sect anymore as no one wanted to walk into a death trap.
He could give the current disciples the mission of gathering the necessary "ingredients" but people knew about the characteristics of the blood river so they would realize what he wanted to do when his disciples went around to gather people.
So the question was how could he gather an immense amount of people to squeeze them dry and throw them in the river?
And do all of that stealthily.
Yun Jhin hovered over the blood river while sitting cross-legged, his eyes were closed and his hands were moving rhythmically in front of him as the river underneath him started to glow with a crimson color from time to time, the river was dried up and dark red but Yun Jhin's hand movements were enlivening it somewhat.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he stopped his actions:
"This would take too much time, only if there was a way to funnel blood from somewhere... actually there is a way."
Yun Jhin's eyes sparkled as he thought about a way on how to funnel blood towards the river.
He only needed to find a location where many deaths would happen daily and install a siphoning formation there, combined with a spatial formation he could connect the river with that location so whenever someone died there, their blood would be absorbed into the formation and delivered to the river.
But Yun Jhin wasn't up to date with the current universe locations yet, after all, a lot of time passed since he had reincarnated and he only had a small understanding of the overall universe and the new planets that had popped up with time.
He left the blood river and ascended to the castle as he asked the old men duo about dangerous places where people would die daily.
They started to rummage through their minds to think about any such places, they were rather lazy and they didn't care much about such places and only the profits that came from them, sometimes they wouldn't even bother to learn the names of the people who brought out the treasures they sold after they ripped off the actual seller.
"Uh... Um... Actually, I think one of those locations could be the Dead Bones valley? It's under the jurisdiction of the Dead Bones sect and people are sacrificed there daily their bones are extracted while they are alive and then their bodies are boiled in the gigantic cauldron before being fed to their bone beasts."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"I need neutral locations."
"Neutral ones?"
"Master we are not sure about any neutral places, most of these locations are controlled by evil sects of higher status, also they are eyed by the righteous sects as they want to destroy these places, there are no such neutral grounds where people die daily, even though there are some 'dangerous sites' people die there but not as often as you would want."
Yun Jhin frowned then asked them about the latest news and a universal map.
It seemed that the righteous sects had reined themselves in as there had been no attacks whatsoever, Yun Jhin's reputation and former actions had made it so their fear and cautiousness acted against them in this situation.
"Atleast I will have a few hundred years at this rate... but the blood river won't awaken so soon if it doesn't have sacrifices."
"What should I do?"
Yun Jhin had a dilemma, what could he do to awaken the river without getting the wrong attention from the other sects?
He could hold a death tournament with bountiful rewards... that could work?
Yun Jhin knew that he would attract the disciples of his own sect in such a free tournament but you couldn't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs first.
Yun Jhin's eyes shined as he looked at the two old men kneeling in front of him as he decreed:
"We shall host a tournament for future and current disciples and even those from the other sects or rogue cultivators are allowed to attend, this shall be the first big event my sect will host in the universe besides the recruiting efforts. It shall be something that everyone shall enjoy!"
The duo didn't know what to say as they kneeled, they knew that this was mostly a scheme or something similar, how could Yun Jhin be so good to give out free rewards?
"The rules will be as following: there are no rules besides the winning conditions which are killing your opponent or making him surrender."
The duo nodded as they left the palace and sent the invitation to the whole universe using the communication formation that was tied both to the sect and the Bazaar.
Yun Jhin started the construction of the arena personally as he created a gladiator-style arena in 10 days quite easily, it was plenty sturdy and even God Realm experts wouldn't be able to break it easily if they were below the middle stages.
Yun Jhin invitation stirred quite a lot of people awake, most of them knew that Yun Jhin was plotting something but considering they didn't know that the blood river was dormant they still bit the bait.
Most of them were rogue cultivators who didn't want to join sects but they were too tempted by the rewards that Yun Jhin put out, pills, techniques, and the like, the top winner would also be awarded whatever he wanted, well if Yun Jhin had what he wanted, if not he would be given something similar in value that Yun Jhin had in stock.
This put the whole jianghu(martial world) on fire, they all flocked to Yun Jhin's sect as they signed up at the new gladiator arena, they didn't find it weird that there were no rules involved and the signs were mostly hinting that a massive killing was going to happen.
Yun Jhin watched from the underground through the defensive formation which he already repaired to around 40% which was the current maximum with the current resource channels.
"Hmm.. no old fogies are present and very few disciples from the other sects, it's pretty much perfect!"
Yun Jhin's eyes glowed as he looked at the rogue cultivators who joined the tournament up and down, he was analyzing their quintessence and looking through their bloodlines trying to see if there were any good ones worth poaching into his sect.
Most rogue cultivators had mixed bloodlines, no physiques worthy of mention nor any pedigree that the sects wanted but there would always be diamonds in the rough where their mixed bloodlines mutated into something even better than the original bloodlines!
Yun Jhin could even incite such mutations with a low chance of them being successful due to his knowledge of bloodlines.
"Very disappointing, it seems all of them will go into the mouth of the blood river."
The way the tournament was made only the top 1,000 would actually survive if the others didn't surrender and they were killed on the spot, and currently there were around 15,000,000 participants!
While Yun Jhin's sect only got 750,000 disciples the moment they learned that they would be able to participate in a tournament where they wouldn't have to join the sect a lot more people came regardless of the distance.
A lot of rogue cultivators enjoyed their freedom and hated the sect's type of abusing their disciples through the points system. They all thought themselves to be free birds that couldn't be chained down to the sects, but the moment some free benefits came they would flock to the sects like sharks would do when they smelled blood.
They were all opportunists at heart and also not very smart.
Most rogue cultivators could be considered quite dumb as they didn't go through proper education in cultivation and they could only cultivate instinctively with the help of their mixed bloodline inheritance or the things they scavenged, thus gaps in knowledge appeared.
Even though they were rather sly when it came to street smarts they wouldn't be as smart as to understand what the rules of the tournament actually meant, but that didn't mean there weren't exceptions!
A blonde-haired man with a dirty beard and bags under his eyes who wore a dirty robe started shouting outside near the arena:
"GUYS DON'T YOU SEE THAT THE TOURNAMENT IS FISHY?"
"DON'T YOU SEE THAT THEY ARE MEANT FOR US TO SLAUGHTER EACH OTHER?"
"DON'T YOU KNOW THE EVIL REPUTATION OF THE BLOOD THRONE SECT? WHY WOULD YOU EVEN CONSIDER COMING HERE?"
The man was trying to play the hero as he warned everyone here about the nefarious plans of Yun Jhin but everyone looked at him with either anger or annoyance:
"Bro if the patriarch of the blood throne sect wanted us dead we would have already been dead, why are you muddying the water?"
"Yeah what if we have to kill each other for the rewards of the tournament? It's only natural such things happen, after all, even though this is a hosted event it doesn't mean death won't happen in our day to day lives, considering the sect's disciples participate too it must be a tempering trial for them as well!"
"Yeah! You go away if you don't want to participate!"
The dirty blonde-haired man started to curse under his breath as he took out a bottle of alcohol from under his robe and took a swig of it as he hiccuped and left.
Yun Jhin narrowed his eyes as he watched the man leave, that man wasn't a rogue cultivator for sure!
Yun Jhin's body disappeared from above the blood river as he activated his stealth technique and teleported to the outside area of the meteorite, his eyes targeted the dirty blonde-haired man who was at the 8th stage of the sage realm under his disguise that Yun Jhin easily saw through.
"Let's see which sect's disciple is this..."
Yun Jhin appeared behind him as he put his hand over his mouth and a 1,3 meters blue ki sword went through the man's back and exiting his chest, the man looked puzzledly at the ki sword sticking out from his chest before life faded away from his eyes.
Yun Jhin started to absorb his soul as he thought:
"Let's hope it isn't a disciple from any of the stronger sects..."

chapters.title: Chapter 188: Unraveling talents in a bloody tournament
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin body along with the corpse of the blonde-haired man that he killed disappeared as he returned to the blood river underneath the Darkness palace.
The tournament didn't start yet so he could rummage through the guy's memories and feed his body to the blood river first.
Images and memories from the soul he absorbed ran through Yun Jhin's main memory core as he looked through the information he needed, he was a disciple from the Unicron Blue Academy one of the higher-ranked sects in the world but they weren't in the top 10 sects.
Of course, those disciples from the top 10 sects wouldn't use such dumb and obvious ways of disbanding the tournament and he was sure they didn't want the tournament to be canceled either considering they surely wanted to see what type of plan he wanted to unfold.
Yun Jhin dropped the body into the murky dark red river as it disappeared into nothing the moment it touched the surface.
"Ok, if my calculations are correct after this tournament the blood river should awaken with 100% capabilities!"
Yun Jhin looked through the formation at the gladiator arena and waited while cultivating. As time passed the start of the tournament arrived and the participants were all put onto the arena for a battle royale!
The first part of the tournament would start with this fight as having them fight one by one would be too boring for him and the faster they spilled blood the faster his river would awaken.
Such a big crowd of people launching ki-infused attacks at each other made the whole arena start to crack and the damage it had received almost made it unusable anymore.
However the damage was repaired almost instantly with the use of the formation as the blood and bodies that remained on the arena somehow disappeared, this made the participants a little bit suspicious but considering the corpses would cluster their space they were actually happy they disappeared.
These people were dead anyway so most of the participants didn't really care, but the spies from the sects had pale faces as they looked at the corpses disappearing around them, they wanted to report that the guess of the higher-ups was true but the moment they took out a jade slip to transmit what was happening they found out that all communications were cut off!
They frowned as they tried everything they could to reconnect to their headquarters but the moment their guards were let down the others swarmed them like a horde of hungry zombies and their lives were forfeit, after all, the spies were all mediocre disciples from the top sects and not their potentate experts so they were easily killed due to the teaming up and dirty tactics the rogue cultivators used.
Yun Jhin watched as they slaughtered each other like animals and chuckled as he remembered the early days when he used to be as dumb as them. He didn't miss those days.
As the slaughters ensued Yun Jhin started to identify the stronger and smarter contestants, he had his eyes on 4 males and 3 females.
The 4 males were all average-looking on the surface but Yun Jhin knew that they were hiding themselves using their techniques, as for the females they were all celestial beauties but Yun Jhin could see through their disguises, and from what he saw they were all average or ugly.
Living in bad conditions could lead to your outer appearance becoming less desirable and all rogue cultivators lived in those conditions, however, outer appearance could be changed depending on the expertise of the cultivators so it didn't really matter unless one had ways to see through their disguises as Yun Jhin did.
Yun Jhin didn't care much about outer appearance as he focused more on their killing techniques and cultivation bases, they all had a cultivation base above the 5th stage of the sage realm and their techniques were refined with the expertise of those that had been through thousands of battles.
This showed that they were veterans that had fought for long times and people that Yun Jhin needed in his sect as elders, their battle powers were above their cultivation base and their talents were special!
Slaughter continued as the number of participants dropped to 5 million and the corpses continued to disappear as Yun Jhin looked down at the river below his feet.
It started to glow crimson as the dark red color faded and its murkiness turned into a clear state.
Most of the people who tried to send out news had been already killed and only the spectators remained who only got news of what happened around now.
There were spies among the spectators as well so they immediately sent word to the sects.
*************************
The fat man with long ears meditated as he got the news from the dwarf and shook his head:
"It seems he played us really well focusing on our fear and paranoia making us think that he had already activated the blood river... he didn't change one bit."
The dwarf didn't know what to say as he kneeled and left, leaving the fat man alone.
"Ah... Yun Jhin and Yuan Fang, these two people are really a pain in the sides of the universe... but they are too annoying to deal with... what shall I do?"
*******************************
The old man from the Dead Bones sect smiled as he got the news from a raven with red eyes, he chuckled with his sinister voice and looked through the bone tower towards the direction of the blood throne sect as he muttered:
"Ah, Yun Jhin.... you truly are devious, hopefully, I can visit now."
*******************************
Yun Jhin ignored the shivers going through his body as he knew they would talk again about him, after all, he fooled all of them!
It was a mixture of psychological warfare combined with the habits of those old fogies who couldn't keep their hands in their own territories if the big bosses left their headquarters.
Due to the selfishness and nature of the cultivators, Yun Jhin could fully come back as the patriarch of the blood throne sect and expand his sect without any problems now!
He didn't particularly care if they were going to target his disciples as they wouldn't send elders after them, actually, this was a good thing as it would temper his disciples!
Yun Jhin returned his gaze to the tournament as he felt the blood river underneath him starting to bubble with excitement as the crimson color returned to it quickly.
Only 1 million participants were left in the tournament as their bodies disappeared along with all of the blood and organs on the arena.
The 4 men and 3 women had already done their best and now they were using some techniques to hide from the crowd as they were still killing each other with ferocity.
Yun Jhin liked the style of these fellows and decided he would recruit them in the sect even if they wanted to or not, he could see that they were unaffiliated with anyone due to their techniques and actions which screamed rogue cultivators.
Even if there was a chance they were spies specifically trained as rogue cultivators from the other sects he didn't really care as he could kill them any time he wanted with the use of the reawakened blood river.
The blood river underneath him continued bubbling as he looked at the continously descreasing number of participants... in the end they all ended up at 1,000 in number and the blood river started to roar as it awakened fully!
Yun Jhin submerged himself under the river as he felt the purified blood rushing into his body, the river itself cheered as the connection between them was fully awakened and it was like the embrace between a father and son, short but full of emotion.
Yun Jhin got out of the blood river as his eyes burned with a crimson color and his cultivation base started to rush towards the 6th stage where it stopped there.
Now it was time for the 2nd stage of the tournament which was also the last one, the 1v1 fights!
The 1,000 surviving participants looked at each other with both anticipation and a gaze that analyzed each other.
Yun Jhin's appearance projected itself on the biggest wall of the gladiator arena as he looked down at the survivors and the losers who surrendered before they could die, he waved his hand and all of the losers disappeared leaving only the 1,000 winners on the arena.
Seeing his shocking crimson gaze and his analyzing eyes made the participants rather intimidated by him but they all knew he was the patriarch of the sect and he would surely come and give out a speech at the end of the first stage.
Yun Jhin finished looking all of them over and nodded as he identified which ones were spies and which ones were truly rogue cultivators.
He opened his mouth and decided to start with the speech before starting the second stage of the tournament.

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Ending the tournament with no fanfare
chapters.content:
Every survivor from the tournament was watching Yun Jhin's projection with wide eyes as heopened his mouth and started his speech:
"You have fought very hard to reach your current position in the tournament and I'm very happy to see that the blood throne sect still has the reputation that would attract so many talented people to it, regardless if it's for the rewards or not."
"As you all have guessed I shall give out an invitation to all of the top 1,000 survivors of the tournament to join the sect."
The 1,000 people started thinking about the invitation that Yun Jhin gave them, most of them didn't want to be tied to a sect so one of them came forward gave a short bow to show his respect for Yun Jhin then asked:
"Patriarch Jhin, might I ask how your sect works?"
Yun Jhin smiled showing his sharp teeth as he said:
"How it works? It works as all sects work but there's a difference in mine and you should know it by now if you listened to universal gossip or news!"
The man shrank back as he knew what he meant, he wouldn't give protection to those that offended the other sects recklessly which meant his sect was going to have a lower appeal in the face of those second generations of young masters who liked to slap faces relentlessly for no reason rather than they were bored.
Yun Jhin knew these types of people got an enjoyment of slapping faces so he pretty much made them disinterested in his sect due to this rule.
However, this rule didn't apply to these rogue cultivators in front of him. They were all low-key people who knew when to advance and when to back down.
Most of these rogue cultivators didn't really want to join the sect and only joined the tournament because of the resources reward which they couldn't get in other circumstances even if they had the money!
Yun Jhin watched as most of them struggled on what words to use to refuse him, Yun Jhin shook his head as he chuckled and told them:
"I know rogue cultivators like you don't want to be tied to the rules of the sect and you don't have to worry if you don't want to join the sect, I just treasure talent and I hoped that you would be able to join the sect, unlike those untalented folk that has big heads but small brains even if you offended someone outside you could take shelter in the sect with no problems due to your high talent."
Yun Jhin's words made them reconsider considering that they would be protected if anything ever happened to them during missions or if they somehow offended anyone even though the chance was low there were people out there that would feel offended after you looked at them for more than a few seconds.
300 of them became undecided, 300 wanted to join and 400 refused regardless of Yun Jhin's good intentions.
2 of the women were in the undecided ones and 1 of the men, also one of them decided to join while the others refused but it was already a pretty good haul to have someone on the fence and one join.
Yun Jhin nodded as he waved his hand and said:
"Then let's continue the finishing stage so the winners can get their rewards!"
Yun Jhin's projection disappeared from the wall of the arena as some disciples from the sect came with lots to pick so they could have their random fights decided.
The fights were quickly decided and the stronger individuals easily made themselves appear as the fights went on, those that Yun Jhin identified easily won all of their matches thus ending up in the top 10.
The top 100 and top 10 had special rewards that Yun Jhin would give personally but only the top 10 took Yun Jhin's attention!
Those 4 men and 3 women all ended up in the top 10!
The 3 other spots were taken up by 1 middle-aged man, 1 man-beast cultivator, and 1 devil cultivator.
The man who wanted to join was actually faceless under his disguise on his skin filled face there were two long scars in the form of an x and his ears were long and red, his clothes consisted of a simple brown robe that concealed most of his body underneath it only showing his feet.
As rogue cultivators were mostly poor everyone there wore dirty clothes and they had no extra treasures on them besides their weapons.
Yun Jhin appeared in person as he hovered above them and slowly descended on the arena looking at the top 100 and top 10.
He handed them the promised resources directly as he gave each a spatial bag that contained the rewards they sought.
Then Yun Jhin invited the faceless fellow to follow him towards the sect not waiting for the fence-sitter's decision.
His actions made them a little bit flustered as they weren't even taken into consideration and thus some of them decided that they wanted to join the sect.
Yun Jhin smiled as he patted the ones who joined on their shoulders and took them in the sect, the others left with no problems and no fanfare as the tournament ended.
Yun Jhin gave the new disciples the elder statuses and imparted them better cultivation techniques based on their physiques and likes. Afterward, he talked with them for a while to get closer to them before sending them to do what they wanted.
In total he had recruited almost 500 out of the 1,000 survivors, the survivors knew when to forfeit and most of the time in the 1v1 fights it didn't come to any deaths, only 1 or 2 were killed.
Yun Jhin appeared below the palace as he looked at the bubbling blood river and started chuckling, the whole formation started to seethe as the river fused with it properly and Yun Jhin chuckling turned into a burst of full blown laughter!
"Now that everything is done I can start meddling in the universe again... ah you old fogies I must thank you properly for being as paranoid as me!"
Most of the old fogies that were currently alive were the same as the ones who lived in Yun Jhin's previous life, they have reincarnated earlier than him as when he died most of them were in their reincarnation phase so they were considered old at this stage, around half their life span or more if he calculated right.
Yun Jhin's plans for the universe were big as he realized the way on how to achieve the realm above the God one after he got his ass handed to Hell's willpower which had strength above the God Realm and combined with the secrets of the system that remained in his mind even after it left him, he realized that he always did things wrongly in his previous lives when he tried to ascend!
While a perfect body was certainly a way to achieve the new realm it didn't guarantee that you could ascend, the fortuned constitution would also help but it wasn't a surefire way of breaking through the shackles of the god realm.
Yun Jhin realized that the best way to breach the shackles of the universe and free him from the fetters of mortality was... fighting the universe itself!
He needed to steal all of the universal fortunes from the core of the universe and fuse with them to tame the universe and break free of its control!
While the universe wasn't conscious it's core shifted at immense speeds through a special space that only those that reached the 10th stage of the God Realm could feel, the 10th stage was also considered to be half a step into the realm above and Yun Jhin hadn't reached it in any of his lives due to his body not being able to withstand the forceful breaking of cultivation before it being reforged.
He reached the peak of the God Realm which was the 9th stage but he couldn't reach the half a step stage and that was why he was so obsessed with getting a new perfect body.
As for the fortuned constitution that the system was hinting at? It would certainly make it easier to tame and absorb the universal core but Yun Jhin knew that he might die of old age before he would be able to gather all of the fortuned ones and also find the core, fight it and absorb it.
It just wasn't feasible.
Even though he was still rather young right now the breakthroughs in the God Realm would take him a rather long while even though he had his previous experiences.
He sighed as he looked down at the blood river as a red mist started to appear above it, Yun Jhin slowly descended into the mist leaving only the gleam of his eyes visible as he suddenly closed them leaving the underground area silent and creepy, it was time for some intense cultivation so he could finally reach the God Realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Dead bones sect comes bearing gifts
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was cultivating in the blood river while the patriarch of the Dead Bones sect just got the news that the tournament had ended.
The old hunchbacked man who looked to be only bones and skin chuckled as he suddenly disappeared from his bone tower and started to fly at uncalculable speeds towards the location of the Blood Throne sect.
He had a gleeful smile on his face as he flew towards the sect, it wasn't known if the smile was a good or bad thing for Yun Jhin but considering his current defensive measures it wouldn't matter if the old man wanted to attack or not.
Yun Jhin's eyes opened up in the blood mist as he got out of it and felt shivers going through his whole body, this meant that a God Realm expert was going to arrive at the sect!
Yun Jhin's intuition was never wrong when it came to those old fogies actions but he was rather surprised one of them would actually leave their sect behind to come and visit him, it must be one of the ones that he had a better relationship with during his past life.
It didn't take him much time for the duo he enslaved to send him a message that a hunchbacked old man wanted to see him, the duo were scared out of their wits as they shivered while waiting for Yun Jhin to arrive.
The gaze of the skeleton-like person in front of them was really unnerving and the cold and yin evil aura he exuded made him even more intimidating than Yun Jhin when he was angry!
The man was very creepy and even though those two were early Gods they still felt a pressure coming from his aura that indicated his cultivation base was above theirs!
Yun Jhin knew that the man would arrive but his arrival speed was so fast that he didn't even identify him when he entered the territory of the sect!
As he arrived outside the cave where the blood river was he looked at the old man that stood a few meters away from him.
As he analyzed him he realized who he was... the patriarch of the Dead Bones sect! He came personally!
The man chuckled showing his sharp beast-like teeth, he came closer to Yun Jhin as he took a few steps and said:
"It seems you haven't broken through the God Realm yet old friend."
Yun Jhin frowned as the man easily saw through his cultivation base even though he was on his home territory and if he analyzed him properly he realized why he hadn't been able to feel him enter the territory of the sect!
He was here just as a projection and not his main body, while he looked terrifying on the surface he didn't even have the strength of a peak sage realm expert!
It wasn't his avatar but an aura projection coming from his main body and from what Yun Jhin knew about him he usually kept this projection in his tower of bones as a lookout, it was actually quite strange that he would use his projection as a messager.
The man didn't say anything as he stood there while letting Yun Jhin analyze him to his heart content, he chuckled as he looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and said:
"You haven't changed at all, still the same brooding and thinking type with a touch of perfect scheming, anyways I didn't come here today to stir up trouble, I actually have a proposal for you since you are back."
Yun Jhin eyebrows rose as he looked at him and asked with a tinge of curiosity:
"Proposal? Even though our sects were quite friendly back then we didn't have such a close relationship."
"Aiyah, don't be so quick to think that I'm going to fool you Yun Jhin, you know that I'm not like those other old fogies who like to scheme, I'm a little bit more simple-minded and I think a head-on fight is a better way to solve conflicts."
Yun Jhin found his words to be quite untrue as in his last life even though they could be considered allies he surely let his sect go to waste after he died.
Seeing Yun Jhin's disapproving expression made the man chuckle a bit as he said:
"If I died would you take care of my sect in my stead until I reincarnated and came back to reclaim it without any problems?"
"Atleast you could have kept the legacy alive you know? You sure are a backstabbing prick just like the others Gu Manshu."
"You should know best about backstabbing so don't go and be the pot calling the kettle black."
"Yeah yeah, why have you come here anyway? What do you need?"
"I need your help."
The old man's eyes seemed pretty truthful to Yun Jhin but trying to identify the truth from the old fogies was harder than scaling a mountain of blades and going through a sea of fire naked, and Yun Jhin had done both.
"I know you don't trust me but it will be a beneficial cooperation to the both of us just like the good old days, I can also wait for you to break through the God Realm first so you can get your proper powers first but I really need your help."
Yun Jhin really couldn't see through him so he asked directly what he needed help with.
The man directly went to the core of the problem and said:
"It's just that we need to be alone for this kind of conversation."
The slave duo immediately disappeared as if they were never there as they felt the pressure from the higher-ups increasing more and more on their bodies as they talked.
"Ok now that we are alone please do tell me what do you want?"
The man coughed as if he had a bone stuck in his neck and said:
"You should know about my condition better than anyone right?"
Yun Jhin nodded, Gu Manshu could reincarnate earlier than Yun Jhin and more often than him but his lifespan was also shorter standing around 100,000 years maximum regardless of his cultivation.
There were both advantages and disadvantages to this technique of his that he employed, the earlier he reincarnated the bigger the advantage he had over his enemies but his lesser lifespan meant that he had to go first, he came first, and went away first.
In this way, he would have advantages early but in the late game he would still end up being worse than everyone else, Yun Jhin guessed that at this point he realized that his technique was actually pretty trashy and he must have wanted his help to either fix him or create a new technique so he would fix himself rather as he reincarnated.
But it seemed his guess was wrong as he didn't want that.
"I need your help as an ally, the Brilliance Radiance and Light sect has eyed my sect for quite a long time now and they would surely want to attack it sooner or later, I need a war ally!"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"A war ally? With my current disciple count and the extreme lack of talents?"
"While you are lacking talents and disciples that's for now, in the future, you will surely grow to an impressive size maybe even bigger than your former life!"
Gu Manshu decided to do a bit of brown-nosing to convince Yun Jhin but empty words would never work on him and the old man knew that as well.
He took out a small exquisite spatial ring and threw it at Yun Jhin while saying:
"Just a small gift for our happy future alliance."
Yun Jhin knew from the smile of the old man in front of him that there was something rather precious in the ring and he decided to look into it.
His eyes widened as he started to shake, this was something imperative for his breakthrough in the god realm in the spatial ring! His chances of reaching the God Realm would be at least 70 to 80% if he used the item that Gu Manshu gave him!
Inside the space of the ring stood a mountain of blood-colored circular fruits that had tons of warts on them, those warts had the faces of despairing humans, beasts, elves, and a lot of other races.
These were fruits infused with the blood and souls of millions of beings and cultivated with their bones and bone marrow.
They were the perfect items for Yun Jhin's current needs!
Seeing this gift perfectly prepared for him made Yun Jhin unable to say anything for a short while.
Then he looked towards Gu Manshu and asked:
"In how much time do you think you will be attacked?"
Gu Manshu's sharp fangs showed themselves as he smiled and thought that he had captured Yun Jhin's attention with the fruits.

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Taking gifts while giving shallow promises
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin smiled as he took the spatial ring and stashed it safely before his eyes met Gu Manshu's. The old man had made quite the big investment in Yun Jhin even knowing about his personality, he even mentioned earlier how backstabbing he was but he still easily gave out the fruits.
Yun Jhin didn't know if the man really gambled on this one or was did he do something to the fruits?
Yun Jhin wasn't dumb he wouldn't use them until he analyzed all of them properly and if he did do something to them Yun Jhin was pretty knowledgeable about these fruits as he could make them himself, but it would take him a long while combined with the fact that he didn't have the seeds to plant the tree that could bear the fruits nor the ingredients to make them grow.
The growing of such fruits was very tedious even for devilish cultivators who could even kill in their sleep, it wasn't that there was a lack of ingredients but the fact that the number of kills that needed to be done was above what the righteous sects could accept.
Take Yun Jhin's blood river, for example, the number of people he massacred was within the limits of the sect's acceptance but the number of people that have to be killed for the trees to bear fruit was way above what they could endure as it was around 1 billion people or so, it was basically destroying a whole planet. And from what Yun Jhin understood Yuan Fang was already wanted in the universe for what he did so it was obvious what would happen if Yun Jhin who had an unmovable headquarters would do the same thing as Yuan Fang.
Seeing that Yun Jhin took his gift made the old man a little bit happier, considering that in such situations if one took a gift they would have to reciprocate with favor or a gift of equal importance, and considering how precious the fruits were there was no way the current Yun Jhin could give a gift of the same quality.
Yun Jhin was in an awkward place by accepting the fruits at least that's how the old man saw him.
Yun Jhin coughed as he said:
"I can promise you that I will help you but if things get a little bit too hairy for me I can only retreat as I cannot fight the patriarch or the ancestors of the Brilliance Radiance and Light sect, however for those below the peak of the God Realm you can count on me to fight them, anything else you need help with or can I return to my cultivation?"
The old man put his sharp finger on his chin as he thought about it for a short while before he said:
"Actually I need some help with something else, you are a potentate of reincarnation and your techniques are top-notch, I would like your help to fix my problem with the other willpower in my soul."
It seemed the old man was suffering from the same things as Yuan Fang but unlike him, the old man should have already made peace with his other willpower as he already reached the peak of the God Realm and all he wanted to do was get rid of the extra willpowers that were still trying to take over his body, but with his current power they were only annoyances or flies that would buzz above his head.
Yun Jhin had the perfect technique to give him and if he did help him with this he would have an excuse when it came to the time he would have to come and reinforce him.
Seeing that Yun Jhin was ready to accept made the old man quite happy but also wary at the same time, he knew that if he asked too many favors from him he would rescind on some other ones.
He didn't actually think that Yun Jhin would come to him with reinforcements but he first asked for a bigger favor while giving him something that he would need so the next favor he asked of him could be pretty much secured.
Yun Jhin knew that he had been fooled into giving him the technique but it was a better trade-off than him going to reinforce him whenever he will get assaulted by the Brilliance Radiance and Light sect.
Yun Jhin started to give him the soul circulation technique along with the mantra that he had to recite to create memory cores in which he could seal the other willpowers along with a lengthy explanation on how the technique worked, afterward he even asked him to swear on his soul to not give the technique to anyone else!
The old man didn't really like swearing and contracts just like all of the old fogies, they felt like those who asked this of them were looking down on their moral conduct but considering that he was someone from the dao of evil it was a little bit easier to swallow.
And the more he learned from Yun Jhin the more he realized why he wanted to keep the technique a secret from the other people's ears. If all of the reincarnated ones got their hands on this technique they could resolve all of their problems and their cultivation speed in their early stages would skyrocket to Yun Jhin's level!
Most of the time the willpowers from the earlier lives would mess with you while you were weak and your soul wasn't at 100% but the stronger you got the easier it was to tame them, but they would always mess with you when you would breakthrough into a new cultivation realm which in turn could make you enter cultivation deviation and either lose your mind or perish, the first option being perfect for the willpowers who were fighting each other to take control of the body.
Thus after a short while, the man swore on his soul using the Godly laws that he learned that he wouldn't ever share the technique with anyone else as long as he lived.
Yun Jhin found a problem immediately in the man's vow, once he died the vow would break, and after he reincarnated he would surely be able to break the vow and share the information!
However, Yun Jhin didn't say anything, this was his last attempt at reaching Godhood as once he died in this life he wouldn't be able to reincarnate again so he didn't really care what the man would do anymore after his death.
He waved his hand indicating that Gu Manshu could leave now, the man laughed wickedly and disappeared flying away just like a hunchbacked angel of darkness.
Yun Jhin shook his head seeing him disappearing and informed the duo that they could return to the palace as he disappeared below into the cave.
He dropped into the mist emanating from the blood river as he took in a deep breath then took out the spatial ring that he had stashed into his clothes before looking through it once again.
He now analyzed the mountains of fruits with critical eyes as he unleashed his soul willpower to see if Gu Manshu did anything to them so he could hurt Yun Jhin but after tens of hours of analyzation he found out nothing of worth.
He then dissected one fruit and looked at its insides better as he fully focused his soul willpower as if it was a magnifier to look through the DNA chains of the fruit.
After he didn't find anything that could make the fruits bad for him he heaved a sigh, even though he couldn't look through all of them this way he knew how hard it would be to insert something poisonous into the DNA sequence of the fruits after they were done and it was impossible for Gu Manshu to waste his time on doing this.
He still had to cultivate and ponder the rules of the universe as the man wanted to break through the peak of the God Realm into the next just like every other peak God realm expert.
Yun Jhin body sunk under the river as he opened his mouth and a few fruits were bitten clean, the juices and soul fragments of those that were used to nourish the growth of the fruits immediately entered Yun Jhin's system as his ki pathways started to roar to life.
Yun Jhin's eyes opened up as the crimson energy from the river fused with the energy from the fruits and his cultivation started moving quickly, he was going to break through to the 7th stage of the sage realm in one go!
The energy from the fruits was very volatile as they were meant to be used by those that wanted to break through to the God Realm but Yun Jhin could nullify its volatility and use them at the sage realm to basically speedrun it!

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Cultivation time
chapters.content:
Cultivating towards the God Realm was an arduous task that very few have accomplished in the universe, however, most big sects had at least 10 or so God Realm experts or various stages ranging from early to late holding the first with at least 1 peak God Realm expert.
Currently, Yun Jhin's sect could be considered to be in the middle grades as he had 2 early God Realm experts around the 3rd stage of the God Realm or so.
The only reason his sect wasn't attacked by the righteous ones was that he had successfully activated the formation and the blood river which would make him a ferocious figure to fight against, the only problem was that the blood river was stationary and Yun Jhin couldn't take it with him so he was pretty much on house arrest.
Yun Jhin's figure couldn't be seen in the blood mist as he breathed in and out, from time to time he would pop in one of the fruits that Gu Manshu gave him his cultivation had slowly reached the peak of the sage realm after eating thousands of these fruits and the combination of the blood river passive ability to increase cultivation speed.
It had been around 2 years since Gu Manshu came and left with Yun Jhin's memory core technique and he was finally nearing the entrance to the God Realm!
While he cultivated the sect's businesses had been handed to the old man duo and considering they could handle a Bazaar they could also handle the medium-sized sect, the number of disciples had also increased to a total of 5,000,000 halfway to the maximum capacity of the meteorite.
Yun Jhin had way more territory before besides this meteorite but it had been claimed by the other sects and unless he had filled this territory to the brim there was no reason to go ahead and antagonize those sects yet.
Cultivating in the God Realm meant one thing. One had to learn the laws of the universe and apply them onto the mortal body to make it pretty much immortal on one side, as God Realm experts were extremely hard to kill.
They were akin to cockroaches on their ability to survive as even if one cell of their bodies survived they could regenerate from that part to full power! Which meant their body refining cultivation wouldn't reset!
