Early Gods would take a few months to regenerate while middle gods would take around days but late Gods would take minutes to seconds and that was without any resources used!
The devil that Yun Jhin decapitated back at the dark pagoda had used some herbs that he fused with his body to reconstruct his body along with half of the ki in his body but he could have waited naturally for his body to regenerate in one month to 2 weeks or so at most as he was around the middle stages.
The reason for the God Realm expert's extreme vitality was the laws they grasped!
Every law they learned would fuse with their body and elevate its vitality and lifespan to a new level!
Yun Jhin had already prepared with all of the laws he was previously proficient in by the time he was at the King Realm, all those gems that he had remolded into his new crown which fused with his soul would be useful as they were the foundation for the God Realm entrance!
Yun Jhin's body started to glow as he threw all of the fruits from the spatial ring into the air around him as they started to slowly fuse with the blood mist then he opened his mouth and started to suck in the mist from the air into his mouth just like a whale drinking water!
His eyes turned bloodshot as he opened them and started to mutter something under his breath, his soul appeared in full view as green and purple giant behind him, the crown with one gigantic gem in it appeared as the crown started to disappear leaving only the shining gem, Yun Jhin removed the gem from his soul as it started to bleed blue transparent blood and he threw the gem directly into his body!
He already had learned a lot of laws in his previous lives and he only needed a catalyst to activate them, the catalyst being the gem that he had created and evolved during the King and Sage realms.
The gem entered his body as it started to dissolve releasing all of the laws from the items and the laws that he had inserted in the gem from his soul.
The injury from his soul quickly closed up as his body started spasming down in the blood river and the laws from the gem started to dissolve into his body.
The laws would naturally be a burden for a normal body to withstand and Yun Jhin's body cultivation was currently lacking due to him reconstructing his body.
However, this was where the fruits that Gu Manshu gave him would do their magic!
The fruits that he had fused with the blood mist and assimilated into his body finally started to react to the laws that were slowly being absorbed by Yun Jhin's body and destroying it from within, they were like hungry sharks smelling blood and attacking!
The fruit essence took a hold of the laws and started to fuse with them taming them and making them easier to absorb for Yun Jhin's body along with strengthening them.
Every fruit had the fragmented lives and memories of thousands to hundreds of thousands of people in it, every life had an understanding of the laws no matter how small it was.
Technically the universe was governed by those laws but God Realm experts went against the universe and took ahold of the laws so they could govern the universe!
God experts could be considered rebels of the universe if you could count the universe as the Emperor and every living being in it being its vassals.
Yun Jhin's twitching body started to stabilize as his soul oversaw the whole process from above, now that his body was stable he could send his knowledge of laws into his body to remold it into a God body, at this point Gods would have a very hard time to breakthrough as their souls needed to be tempered by the laws they learned as well but Yun Jhin's soul was already recovered and he knew a lot of laws.
The steady stream of a complete law started to descend upon Yun Jhin's body who was now seated at the bottom of the river of blood doing breathing exercises instinctively as glowing runes were inscribed all over his body, even his insides!
Yun Jhin's soul was giddy as he smiled and continued the infusion, if things went well at the end of the session he would have achieved the God Realm!
To increase one's cultivation in the God Realm one had to subdue more laws and have a correspondingly strong body to house those laws, at the 1st stage one had 1 law mastered fully.
As Yun Jhin had already mastered a lot of laws he only needed a strong body to achieve a breakthrough as he could infuse his body with the next law with his accordingly strong soul.
2nd stage - 2 laws
3rd stage - 4 laws
4th stage - 8 laws
5th stage - 16 laws
6th stage - 32 laws
8th stage - 64 laws
9th stage - 128 laws
Yun Jhin had reached the last stage in his previous life and became a huge potentate of the universe learning and mastering 128 laws, unfortunately for the 10th stage to be reached and become half a step into the next realm one needed 256 laws to be learned.
It took Yun Jhin approximately 20,000 years per 10 laws and he could live for around 350,000 years. Considering he was one of the youngest God Realm cultivators only at around 1,500 years old his progress was pretty impressive.
But compared to his previous progress his current one was even better, but it was only enough for him to reach those 256 laws and not more, after all, if Yun Jhin speculations were true he needed to learn and master 512 laws to reach the realm above the God one and this was the only speculation it wasn't known if he would even reach that realm if he mastered 512 laws, as he wasn't even sure how many laws governed the universe!
Yun Jhin sighed as he looked down at his body as the metamorphosis started to happen, he would enter the God Realm!
The runes inscribed in his body started to glow as the word 'elements' appeared in all of the runes, fire, water, earth, wind the four elements started to rampage around Yun Jhin and inside his body, his eyes glowed with the light of the godly fire, seemingly as if a flaming meteorite was reflected in them, his body glittered as if it was made from the water of celestials on the surface it looked to be gentle but on the underneath a tsunami was ready to explode! Strong winds as if a typhoon was ready to descend started to run around his surroundings and the earth below his feet started to shake as if an earthquake was happening.
The law governing the five elements was currently inscribing itself into Yun Jhin's body making it impervious to them and giving him perfect control over them as well! It was at the level of natural disasters!

chapters.title: Chapter 193: The most awaited break through
chapters.content:
The breakthrough towards the God Realm was closer and closer as Yun Jhin's body fused with the natural laws that his soul comprehended, it wouldn't take much time for him to break open the door that would lead him to the next cultivation realm!
He had used up all of the mountains of fruits inside the spatial ring that Gu Manshu gave him and his ki pathways were getting wider as his internal ki was evolving!
The aura of the four elements around him was intensifying as his cultivation growth continued, it was just a matter of time until he would breakthrough!
Yun Jhin's soul sighed above him as he looked at the ongoing transformation of his body, he remembered how he had broken through the first time into the God Realm, it hadn't been easy at all!
***************************
An old man with a hunchback stood cross-legged in an old shack full of dust, the shack was in a forgotten little village where almost no one lived beside the old man.
He had a face full of wrinkles that showed the vicissitudes of time, he had a long beard that reached his chest and it was dirty.
He wore a wrinkled gown of skin color and he had nothing on his feet, his head was moving from the left to right seemingly as if he was listening to a good song.
Every time he moved his head a sound would be heard coming from his cranium as if his brain was so small that the movements of his cranium would rattle it around like a maraca.
He seemed to be a normal crazy old man at first glance but there was something to him more than meets the eye.
Suddenly the old man opened his eyes which were of deep blue color, then the color shifted to green and finally to a crimson red.
A purple and green figure appeared behind him as he sighed and looked down at the body:
"This is my 19,732 attempt at reaching the God Realm... this time it will happen for sure!"
The body of the old man started to go through changes as the figure breathed inside him, worm-like bodies started to enter the old man's body as it went through a metamorphosis...
***************************
"Ah, that was the first successful attempt at reaching the God Realm..."
Yun Jhin stopped reminiscing as he looked down at this body which was started to twitch again, this meant that the body had reached the most important point in the breakthrough to the God Realm which was linking with the universal laws that one mastered and fused with!
Linking with the laws of the universe was the only way one could subjugate them and make them their own.
Yun Jhin had to link with the 4 elements law which was one of the easier laws to link with for cultivators, most of them started with elemental cultivation techniques and they were the most familiar with these things, even though Yun Jhin had mastered the laws that didn't mean the universal laws would accept him, however, he had already got their acceptance in the previous lives and once they understood who he was he would surely link with them again.
Yun Jhin's body started to light up with 4 different colors as they flew into the air and outside of the palace lighting up the universal sky!
The 4 elementals law started to appear in the sky linking with the surrounding stars to create images of the four elements, a fire, a rock, a gust of wind, and a tidal wave.
The four elements started to sense the lights that Yun Jhin had sent up and after a short while the four images started to light up as they entered the 4 elemental lights that Yun Jhin had sent up!
This meant that the elemental laws had accepted Yun Jhin!
To Yun Jhin's soul, this wasn't anything new, his soul aura was inside the beams of light that he had sent up, and considering how familiar the universe was with him the laws that acknowledged him would accept him again with no problems.
As for future breakthroughs in the God Realm? He could just wrestle the control from the obstinate laws that didn't want to acknowledge him, he could just make them submit through sheer force!
He only needed their acknowledgment when he entered the God Realm, after he broke through he didn't need their help anymore!
It was easy to let someone in your home but it was harder to make them leave!
Yun Jhin's soul looked at the returning beams of light and laughed as he fused back with his body and opened his eyes, a different aura started to appear around him, it was tangible but it wasn't the one from the 4 elements law he used to break through to the God Realm.
His aura was infinitely bloody as the air around him turned viscous and ultimately hard just like blood would do when it would coagulate, his body grew in height to 2 meters and stopped there, along with the breakthrough in cultivation his body refinement cultivation had also progressed due to the fruits and blood river passive help, he now reached the 6,500 ranks!
Yun Jhin analyzed his body after he broke through and he found everything as he expected, he smiled wickedly before leaving the blood river dripping his body with a new outfit consisting of a spiked black and red armor with a cape and a helmet with short horns that hid his face.
This armor was the former special clothes that he had crafted with the energy from the 4 beasts planets, it was shattered against Hell's willpower but he had saved all of the broken pieces and reforged them during his breakthrough, his soul multitasked it while he observed the transformations his body went through.
And with the help of the blood river unless he met Hell's willpower personally again no one in the universe would be able to fully destroy the armor! Of course, he wouldn't be able to say that it had a perfect defense but it would neutralize more than 20% of an attacker's power and that was for those that were the same cultivation base as his! For those below him, the armor might even neutralize their attacks fully!
He appeared in the dark palace and looked at the elder duo who were currently talking about the sect's businesses and how it was booming, when they saw Yun Jhin appearing soundlessly near them their hearts almost leaped from their chests to their necks.
Yun Jhin asked about the news of the universe and the sect since he entered closed-door cultivation and he was surprised pleasantly to hear that the sect had fulfilled all 10 million slots of disciples, they also had around 100,000 elders out of the 10 million disciples and even 2 Grand elders appeared with cultivation bases below the duo in front of him.
One of them was assigned to the martial hall and the other was assigned to the medicinal hall due to their proficiency, now that Yun Jhin was awoken he wanted to see those two personally!
The two grand elders were called to the dark palace and immediately came the moment they heard the patriarch of the sect exited closed-door cultivation and wanted to meet them.
The moment they entered the palace and saw Yun Jhin's body on the throne they immediately felt an unknown pressure landing on their bodies and souls, it was as if a deadly predator had put its eyes on them and they realized that Yun Jhin's power was even higher than the two old men that recruited them into the sect!
They both kneeled in front of Yun Jhin as he disappeared from the throne and appeared in front of them just like a soundless assassin, this made the grand elder duo start to sweat intensely as they didn't dare to say anything without Yun Jhin's permission or questioning.
"I have a few questions for you, all grand elders of the sect should answer those when I'm around here..."
The duo nodded and waited for Yun Jhin's questions.
"Why did you join the sect?"
The duo immediately said:
"There were not enough resources for us as rogue cultivators so we decided to join a sect... your sect was the closest and your reputation resounded in our ears so we decided to join the sect."
"Hmm, I see... but did you know that all elders and above should pledge allegiance to me?"
"We um..."
"It's not anything monumental all you have to do is this..."
Suddenly Yun Jhin put his hand in front of their faces as he released a burst of energy that infiltrated their souls before they could do anything, it was different from the remotely detonated bomb in the brains of the other two elders, as his cultivation increased so did his means that were previously locked behind a cultivation wall.
"We are uh...."
The duo started to shake like they had seizures as they fell on the floor of the palace, the elders he subdued at the Bazaar were looking at the grand elders with pity but they were also gloating, they had been in a similar situation before and it was good to see others in the same situation for them.
They shook for a while before they got up, they left a puddle of sweat on the floor but it seemed as if nothing actually happened to them on the surface.
They both bowed and left as if the events that unfolded never happened.
Yun Jhin's eyes turned back to the elder duo who remained in the palace and he appeared in front of them with a smile:
"Shall you two go with the same procedure or you want something different?"
The faces of those two turned pale as their beards started shaking from fear, they really didn't want to experience whatever those two had!

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Turning sect into cult
chapters.content:
The screams of the elder duo died rather quickly around the same time as the other two had, it didn't take much time for Yun Jhin to enter their souls and make them subservient to him, it wasn't mind-control but more of a mind washing technique, Yun Jhin couldn't control God Realm experts or above but he could change their thinking somewhat which wasn't as sure-proof as complete control, they still had their own thoughts and they could control their actions but they would mostly do things that were beneficial to him.
It was something akin to a cult or hive-mind mentality, however that meant that if they found Yun Jhin to be a bad leader or weak leader there was a high chance they would revolt.
Yun Jhin left the two elders alone to continue their job and returned to sit on his bone throne as he thought a little bit about the current situation of the sect.
"Now that the meteorite is full it's time for expansion... but I'm not sure about the current unity of the sect."
The sect hastily rose to its current position and it must have some moles or people that shouldn't be here, now that he had finally finished cultivating to the God realm he could fish out every spy and person that didn't have the good of the sect at heart. At the same time, he could also indoctrinate all of the disciples using his special technique that he just performed on the elders.
Yun Jhin's eyes moved towards the elders and he told them in a cold voice:
"All disciples shall gather at the inner skirts of the sect near the medicinal hall for an inspection and banquet!"
The elders complied and sent the message through the whole sect through the formation.
All the disciples were either happy or suspicious, a banquet? For what reason? Then the message continued as the reason being the patriarch leaving closed-door cultivation successfully, and the fact that he would participate in the banquet to look for a personal disciple who was talented enough to inherit some of his techniques.
This led to a mass gathering with all 10 million people squeezing in a small space trying to attend the banquet! Even those disciples that were out of the sect immediately rushed back as they got information from their compatriots.
Yun Jhin didn't start the 'banquet' immediately as he meditated on the bone throne and waited for every disciple to enter the sect and arrive at the medicinal hall and its surroundings, he already knew which disciples were traitors or not, the technique he gave everyone to cultivate was linked to the blood river and the formation and he could detect which disciple cultivated it or not.
In this situation, those that didn't cultivate his technique were suspicious, after all, with how poor the rogue cultivators were why wouldn't they cultivate a better technique with no strings attached?
Besides the detection when they entered the sect or left it there were truly no disadvantages to the cultivation technique, it was just a small observation and identification for disciples who joined the sect, basically like a badge. Those that didn't want to cultivate it either had a better cultivation technique or had to hide something from Yun Jhin.
Thus it was very easy for him to fish out the moles.
This was the reason he didn't really care for the spies that the other sects sent, maybe it was time to remind them that spies didn't really work on him!
Yun Jhin appeared above the medicinal hall as an extremely long table materialized down below parting the sea of disciples like Moses parted the red sea.
Yun Jhin's eyes were targeting all of the people that didn't have the aura of the technique, his soul willpower moved around the whole crowd as if it was the tentacles of an insidious monster ready to grab its prey and play with it however it wanted, now that he was at the God Realm all of those people that stood before him were only prey in his cold eyes.
He gave out a sunny smile uncharacteristic to him and started with a small speech:
"Now that I have broken through to the God Realm I think it's finally time to get a personal disciple which I can teach him all of my techniques so they could be passed down for the next generations of patriarchs."
"But don't think that my requirements for a disciple are small! I only want the best of the best from all 10,000,000 of you! My intention by hosting this banquet is to find the perfect person that I could take on as my disciple! But this doesn't mean the other disciples don't get to enjoy themselves!"
On the long table delicacies with different cultivation boosting effects appeared from thin air by the use of spatial techniques, all of the disciples who were lucky enough to get near the table and sit at it started salivating unconsciously due to the aroma of the food.
Yun Jhin chuckled seeing their expressions as he waved his hand indicating that they should start eating, his eyes never strayed from the people that were at the table as most of them were the spies!
It seemed these spies were pretty strong as they took quite a lot of seats, from what he could see there were around 3,000 spies in total and every spy was from a different sect!
That meant 3,000 different sects had infiltrated his if their different auras meant anything.
Yun Jhin saw through their disguises with ease while not even alerting them, he looked at how they stuffed their faces with the mind-washing food that he had created and chuckled inside, he didn't really need to kill them making a spy a double agent was better!
Yun Jhin started to spread the food around as he made, even more, appear even for those that didn't get a seat at the table, he made food for everyone present near the medicinal hall and beyond!
All the disciples smelled the delicious food that would help their cultivation speed and immediately started eating not thinking about any type of consequences of the like, why would the patriarch of the sect hurt them?
In the end, all of the disciples didn't know about Yun Jhin's true character as the rumors about how he treated his disciples were always fake due to him employing the same treatment as he did now.
In principle, all the disciples would say how good he was to them and that the blood throne sect only treated outsiders like they were cattle ready to be harvested.
Now that he had successfully given out the altered food he only had to wait for a short while before all of the disciples started to drop down like flies.
The other disciples who only took one or two bites out of the food were immediately alerted as they saw their friends or teammates fall to the ground with foam coming out of their mouths, they looked towards Yun Jhin who was just floating above the medicinal hall with a nonchalant expression and they didn't know what to say as they clutched their throats, they felt something entering their heads through their throats and then infiltrating their souls, it was like a parasite of some sort that was changing how they were thinking on a fundamental level!
Yun Jhin watched everything happening with crossed arms as he waited for a few hours while meditating until some of the disciples started to get up from the ground and looked around as if they were robots who just got a maintenance update.
After they shook their heads they finally saw the floating Yun Jhin and they kneeled to him before starting kowtowing while muttering under their breaths:
"Patriarch! Patriarch!"
They looked at Yun Jhin as if he was the one true God who will bring them enlightenment to the path of immortality, he looked like a benevolent buddha who was ready to sacrifice himself for them in their eyes.
As more and more people woke up the sound of heads hitting concrete was heard more often as they all started to kowtow to Yun Jhin.
In the end, all 10,000,000 disciples were kowtowing to Yun Jhin as the one true ruler of the blood throne sect!
The Elders and Grand Elders appeared and started kowtowing to him as well, now that he had finished getting the sect disciples under his feet he had only a few more things to do now!
Expand the territory of the sect and send all of the spies back when they were supposed to go back... and a get a few more new more important information channels through them!
Yun Jhin looked towards the stars that were the nearest to the meteorite and his eyes glittered with a red light, as he needed to cultivate further into the God Realm he only needed resources to be able to link with further laws, an immense amount of energy was needed to attract the laws and make them submit and Yun Jhin's current businesses weren't enough for him to further his cultivation thus he had to plunder!

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Expanding territory
chapters.content:
Now that he had full control of his sect he was ready to expand his territory!
He looked down at all of the disciples that were pretty much idolizing him at this point due to the mind-washing he had done to them.
It was time to give out the orders of expansion!
Yun Jhin opened his mouth and started:
"This is the time our sect is the most prosperous, disciples are everywhere in the headquarters but it seems that our place is a little bit too small to handle any future recruitments... and you all should understand what I mean by this."
The vast crowd stopped kowtowing as they kneeled to Yun Jhin and they said in unison:
"We shall do as the patriarch commands! For the glory of the patriarch and the blood throne sect!"
All of these people became Yun Jhin's little minions that he could control however he wanted.
Yun Jhin nodded as he smiled at them and waved his hand indicating that they should all scatter and go for the time, he would gather them again when it was time to act.
He would first need to assess the surrounding organizations to see which he could first target and conquer to add more territory, slaves, and prisoners to his sect.
Yun Jhin disappeared along with the elders and grand elders as they went to do their jobs while he arrived below the dark palace with a map and some intel that the 'ancestors' had prepared for him.
The map was filled with small pictures that were the icons of the sects or organizations, there were skulls of different animals or human skulls, birds, swords, or other things like that.
The skull pictures were from the evil sects, the swords or weapons meant that they were either merchants or Bazaars, animals or birds meant that they were miscellaneous sects that could be either righteous or evil.
As he looked over the map he realized that not many good people lived around him which was what he wanted, if he attacked righteous sects they would think he would start a war with them but fighting other evil sects could be considered as infighting and the righteous sects loved seeing infighting.
Yun Jhin shook the map as it disappeared and he appeared above the dark palace, his eyes wandered over the sect grounds as his voice was projected to every disciple in the sect:
"Our first target will be the Baazar that's under the control of the Deer Antlers sect."
All of the disciple's eyes started to glow as they got the information and Yun Jhin started to wave his hands into the air, his ki spurted out of his body like a fountain as he created a gigantic purple ship that could house all 10 million disciples, but he only took around half of them inside as he didn't need that many disciples to take over the Baazar under the Deer Antlers sect control, from what he gathered the Baazar was of a smaller scale than the one he got.
He then absorbed all of the disciples into the ship as it started to fly at immense speeds towards the direction of the Baazar, with taking down the Baazar he would then attack the Deer Antlers sect as well hitting two birds with one stone!
The other disciples got their own jobs to do while the 3,000 spies were all sent back to report both truth and lies to their original masters.
Yun Jhin stood at the prow of the ship overlooking the stars that were disappearing in his vision, he took in a deep breath as the ki of the universe entered the ship passively, after he created the ship he didn't need to continue using his ki to let it exist. The ship was rather fast but it had no defensive capabilities as it was a pure ki construct and it was only meant for quick transportation and ambushes.
As time passed Yun Jhin could finally hear the hubbub of the Baazar, this was his new target and it was called the Auspicious Cauldron Deer Baazar.
It wasn't much different compared to the one he conquered beforehand but it was only of a smaller scale as it was on a medium to the lower-ranked planet and thus it had worse customers and worse products, Yun Jhin decided to start small and make his way up considering that he needed to temper the disciples as well he wouldn't send them on a deadly conquest from the first time or there would be quite a lot of deaths and he didn't want to waste his cannon fodder yet, as he gained more and more resources and conquered more locations his disciple count would increase and he would have an easier time sending them to their deaths for 'tempering'.
Yun Jhin's body started to glow for a short second before the whole ship disappeared as if it was never there, he used his superior stealth technique that had evolved after reaching the God Realm and hid the ship along with him, the ship arrived above the Bazaar as all of his disciples disembarked instantly.
Yun Jhin remained hidden above the planet as he closed his eyes and let the disciples unleash themselves on those below him.
***************************
Fires scattered everywhere as the scent of decay and death appeared in the Baazar, the crazy cultists of the blood throne sect attacked indiscriminately no matter if they were women, children, or elderly.
They killed those obstinate enough to stand in their paths and captured those who submitted just like Yun Jhin's instructed them during the travel time.
It didn't take much time for the guards and people that the Deer Antlers sect had installed at the Baazar to arrive and fight it out with Yun Jhin's people.
Unfortunately, Yun Jhin sect had arrived at the medium ranks even though it was newly created and the Deer Antlers sect could be only considered to be of a lower rank meaning that it only had this Baazar because the other sects didn't find it profitable enough.
But Yun Jhin didn't have a problem with the lack of resources on the planet, he could use his techniques and experience to make the place profitable, even though those people who were now in power were not smart enough nor ruthless enough to use those options that didn't mean Yun Jhin wouldn't do it!
The attack of the guards left by the Deer Antlers sect was like an ant trying to stop an elephant, the disciples of Yun Jhin's sect were extremely ruthless after getting their minds washed.
A few sturdy men from the Deer Antlers sect got ripped in two the moment they tried to stop the rampaging disciples who were either capturing or killing people, the others started to turn green at the grisly sight but they didn't back down as they fought with whatever they could trying to take the attackers down in a kamikaze attack.
Suddenly some of Yun Jhin's people started to die as the boss that overlooked the whole Bazaar appeared!
He was an old man with a sturdy back who looked to be middle-aged at the first glance of his body but his facial features showed that he was truly old along with the fact that both his short beard and crew-cut hair were white.
He wore a green robe and he had deer antlers at the top of his head which showed that he was a hybrid between a heavenly deer and a human.
Yun Jhin analyzed him for a few seconds before shaking his head, his cultivation was only around the 5th stage of the sage realm but his strength was way above Yun Jhin's disciples, after all, only his elders and grand elders were stronger than this person which meant that Yun Jhin had to interfere.
The old man glanced at the attacking offenders who didn't stop even though their comrades were obliterated, it was like they didn't know what fear was!
While Yun Jhin's mind washing was strong it wasn't at the level that these people could forget what fear was but their faith in Yun Jhin was extreme to the level of fanaticism and knowing that he was overlooking them from above made them not fear anything!
The old man opened his mouth to say something as he waved his hand at the same time trying to eradicate more disciples only for his words to be stuck in his throat.
His words tried to come out as he looked in front of him, all he could see was an armored person with a horned helmet, all he could see were his dark red eyes which glowed with a hellish light that inspired so much fear in him that he almost pissed himself on the spot!
Yun Jhin only needed one look to take the man's soul away before his body crumpled to the ground where it was dismembered to pieces by the ravenous disciples of the blood throne sect, all of the brainwashed disciples got the advanced techniques of the sect which required the fresh blood of strong cultivators or blood of special constitutions to be cultivated.
Yun Jhin overlooked the whole thing happening, he had a big smile under his helmet as he glanced down at the continuous death that was happening below him, it seemed that while the Deer Antlers sect was of the lower rung their people were rather hardy and obstinate.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he saw them getting killed, while he didn't mind the disciples getting some power-ups through the cultivation technique he taught them it was better to get slaves and prisoners but some people were harder to mind wash, they also had to eat what Yun Jhin gave them without knowing what would happen to them, considering all of his disciples thought it was just a banquet they all became easily brainwashed.
Yun Jhin waved his hand stopping all of the fires in the surrounding buildings and projected his voice to the whole planet:
"This place is now under the ownership of the blood throne sect! All profits beyond 60% of the annual income of your shops will be handed to the appointed person, every owner of their shops will remain the same but they will have to pay double the taxes they paid to the previous owners!"
While Yun Jhin could take all of the profit from the owners of the shops and kill them while replacing them with his own people it was better for him to leave some spots open or else this would attract unneeded attention at this point. If he was too extremist in his way of doing things it wouldn't matter if the sects he attacked were evil or righteous as he would incur the wrath of everyone.
Yun Jhin's ship appeared again as the suction force took all of the disciples back onto it leaving only one of the stronger ones on the planet as the assigned person.
Yun Jhin looked towards the south as the stars there glittered brighter than normal and he didn't move an eyelid as the ship started flying towards the stars, now that he had taken over the Bazaar it was time to take over the Deer Antlers sect as well!

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Jumpstarting the sect's growth
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin watched as the glowing stars grew bigger in his eyes, the Deer Antlers sect was getting closer and closer and he knew that he would have to act a little bit more here.
All known sects had at least one or two God Realm experts regardless if they were low ranked or not.
While he wouldn't have problems with containing him killing him would be harder, God Realm experts were rather hard to kill when they knew what was coming for them, now that he had attacked the Bazaar first news should have surely arrived at the sect headquarters.
But Yun Jhin didn't really care bout him much, even if he ran away it would only be a loss of a God Realm expert but if he remained he only has to exert himself a bit to capture him.
Yun Jhin didn't do anything as he arrived at the sect headquarters of the Deer Antlers sect, he closed his eyes which made his armored body look like an empty shell as he hovered there and let the disciples go on a rampage.
Just like the Baazar things quickly got out of hand for the disciples of the Deer Antlers sect, they were all of lower cultivation bases as the patriarch of the sect didn't have the same resounding reputation as Yun Jhin, there were also fewer disciples even compared to the attacking ones!
In total Yun Jhin sensed almost 3,500,000 disciples counting their elders, grand elders, and the patriarch himself.
Yun Jhin watched everything unfolding in front of him, everything happened in a pretty similar manner to the previous attack, but in this situation, none of his disciples ran away as there hadn't been any attack from a sage realm expert, Yun Jhin had already taken care of them by exerting his cultivation base on their psyche paralyzing them even from above.
Yun Jhin picked out the brain of one of the sage realm experts from the deer antlers sect before inserting his armored hand into it transforming it into mush that flew over the rampaging disciples below him showering them in bits of grey matter that they slowly absorbed.
The other sage realm experts that Yun Jhin had teleported over to him had their paralysis turned off by him and were watching how Yun Jhin attacked and annihilated one of their people because he started to talk off to him.
Yun Jhin shook his head opening his eyes and turning them towards the remaining sage realm experts that accounted for around 90 people in total.
The sect was rather poor as it couldn't attract more than 90 sages while Yun Jhin had gained quite a lot of them, most of them were around the early stages with only 3 people being above the 4th stage, they could all be considered elders of the Deer Antlers sect.
Yun Jhin wanted to poach them to him or at least intimidate them first so his mind washing technique could work, he needed to instill a feeling of some type of worship or fear into his targets for the technique to work and make him the target of worship or else it would trigger the effect towards the person feared or worshipped the most at that time.
Yun Jhin had already taken into account this when he brainwashed everyone in the sect and used a more potent technique with the food but right now he didn't have the materials needed to create more to feed these people so he had to use the weaker version until he got more materials for future brainwashing attempts.
The 90 people felt chills down their backs as they shouted towards the dark skies:
"PATRIARCH WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!"
However no sound came, no help came, no one came, everything around them was lit on flames, the darkness of the night accentuated the shadows of the blood throne sect's disciples who were currently laughing like little devils as they dusted their hands of blood and bones, all of the important bits were already absorbed by them.
Yun Jhin looked towards the skies and shook his head, it seemed the patriarch of the sect must have used a one-time teleportation formation to run away, it didn't matter much to him, the loss of one God Realm slave wouldn't hurt much as there were a lot more sects that he had to raid which had God Realm experts.
Yun Jhin looked down at the sage realm experts who were in full despair as they gazed at his armored body.
They started to fall to their knees as they gave their allegiance to him, Yun Jhin laughed as he put his palm forward facing them and unleashed a beam of light that engulfed all of them, they started to cry out while clutching their heads but soon enough they stopped and became the same as everyone else, slaves of Yun Jhin's will!
Yun Jhin looted the whole sect before he created a formation to tag it as the territory of the blood throne sect, any future disciples will be sent here to cultivate as the headquarters were full and he would only invite the most talented people or people who had reached a high cultivation base in the headquarters!
Yun Jhin took a look over at the 5 million disciples that were like locusts razing down every building and resources they could find and he decided to leave them here to rebuild this sect in the image of the blood throne sect becoming the branch location of the sect.
Yun Jhin gave out the announcement and let those elders of the Deer Antlers sect here as normal disciples.
He then started to travel back to the Blood throne sect.
On the way back he didn't encounter any troubles as he used his teleportation technique to quickly arrive at the sect without any hitches.
At the sect everything was orderly as he returned to the blood river below the dark palace, he now waited for news from his new spies as he had to see what were the responses from the other sects before he could continue his conquering plans.
**********************
The fat middle-aged man with long ears was sleeping in his room at the top of the building without any troubles as if nothing ever happened.
****************************
The old hunchbacked man narrowed his eyes as he looked towards the direction of the blood throne sect before shaking his head saying something that sounded like: 'it was so Yun Jhin-like to start conquering already'.
*****************************
In a gigantic pond in the universe, an appropriately sized lotus existed, there was situated a gigantic pink palace, 3 meters big swans were flying around in groups above the palace making a lovely view.
A dirty female who wore all black appeared near the pond as she gasped for air and flopped into it to clear herself of the dirt sticking to her and other different goey substances.
After she got all cleaned up her features could be seen more prominently as she was a bird-woman of average looks, her wings unfurled behind her as she started flying with the swans before entering the palace.
An immense pressure appeared on the woman as she entered the gigantic palace that could house tens of millions of people, her breathing turned quicker before she stabilized her condition ignoring all of the looks that were given to her by the women inside.
She went in further and further as she reached the depths of the palace where she met an androgynous-looking person who seemed to be a man and woman at the same time but also not.
A grating voice that sounded the fusion of both the peak of masculinity and feminity came from the mouth of the being as it said in what sounded to be a sweet tone:
"Oh my... dear Laila it seems you have come back with news from that darling Yun Jhin?"
"Indeed my master... there is quite a lot of news."
Laila was one of the spies that Yun Jhin had brainwashed and now she came back to tell half-truths to her 'master'.
The androgynous fellows breathing started to quicken as it hugged itself and shuddered while making a strange face:
"Ah... Yun Jhin you always ran away from my love but you would never think that I would install a spy under your nose right? Oh, who am I kidding, of course, you would..."
Laila felt threatened a bit by her 'masters' words but she didn't say or do anything that would break her identity as a double agent.
"My lady Andonara the news are as following."
Andonara stopped talking to herself as she listened and muttered under her breath:
"Already expanding? Hmmm, it seems he has the same thirst for power as in his previous life."
This Andonara was the leader of one of the top 10 sects, The Beautiful Crane sect!
*********************
Yuan Fang chuckled as he looked at the downed person in front of him, he grabbed him by the neck as he lifted him and looked into his eyes as he said:
"Yun Jhin takes me for a fool? Oh how obvious it is that you have been brainwashed!"

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Small loses for heavy gains
chapters.content:
Yuan Fang clutched the neck of the spy that he had inserted into Yun Jhin's sect with disgust as he muttered to himself:
"What type of technique did he use to turn this fool against me?"
He looked into the eyes of his former subordinate as he clenched his hand harder breaking his neck then he opened his mouth absorbing the soul of the recently deceased pawn.
His eyes glowed for a few seconds before he retched almost vomiting to the ground as he said:
"Mindwashing? This old trick is so despicable but effective... why didn't I think of it first?"
He easily got rid of the downed body below him as he sighed before calling down his two most important cronies which were the man with the monkey tail and the blonde long-haired man.
They both kneeled to him as they waited for instructions:
"It seems our spy was found quite fast, what do you two think of this?"
The monkey tailed man bowed and decided to say:
"It's his own fault master Fang, it must be because his skills were insufficient."
Yuan Fang snorted as he glanced at the monkey tailed man:
"Ukog it seems that you thought a little bit too little of our deceased friend."
Ukog bowed again but didn't say anything else.
The rather talkative blonde-haired man didn't say anything as he looked at the spot where the body of the spy previously laid now not even ashes remained there.
He suddenly said without being asked by Yuan Fang to speak:
"I think Yun Jhin is quite the peculiar fellow, master..."
Yuan Fang nodded as he glanced at him and said:
"It seems Duritz is still smarter than you Ukog."
Ukog shrugged as he didn't really care.
"Yun Jhin's techniques are peculiar and because our spy didn't train in the blood throne sects technique beforehand his identity had been seen through, it can't be helped we don't know how would he control the people with his technique once they cultivated it, no matter how many times he says that there are no strings attached to the technique."
Yuan Fang didn't know much about Yun Jhin besides the surface information that everyone knew, after all, when he was at his peak in his previous life he didn't investigate Yun Jhin much as he had other targets, he only started to investigate him in this life after he reincarnated and he couldn't find much if anything at all about him.
It wasn't that there was no information about him but Yuan Fang didn't have the proper connections to get his hands on it!
He was currently a wanted man for the extermination of the elf race along with the destroying of two planets.
He had to live in hiding until he created his own intimidating sect but up till now he hadn't been able to do so, unlike Yun Jhin he didn't have a proper location where he could erect buildings, he wanted to use the former headquarters of the blood throne sect but his control over the core formation was wrestled over by Yun Jhin...
Yuan Fang sighed as he dismissed the two and looked towards the dark skies:
"You broke through only a little bit later to me but you already behind in the race..."
***************************
Yun Jhin sat cross-legged on the surface of the blood river as he looked into it, images of various disciples from the sect could be seen in the river, even though his technique didn't do anything to those who cultivated it he could easily monitor everyone who did.
He was currently looking at the spies' locations using the blood river as a conduit, he could also do it by himself but there were chances those God Realm experts near the double agents could sense him as his cultivation base was way lower than theirs at the moment, but with the powers of the river he could easily hide and still spy on them.
"Hmm, Andonara is still as crazy as ever, Yuan Fang found out about the spy and the other sects could care less about what happened, it seems that they are still the same as ever, only running after benefits, not wanting to make enemies if there is nothing to get out of it. Ah, the nature of cultivators is truly wretched at the core, but who am I talk about that?"
He waved his hand making the river clear again.
He had lost quite a few spies even though he made sure they didn't leak anything when they went to report, it couldn't be helped considering the leaders who sent them to spy on him were one hundred percent familiar with them so they could see even the tiniest changes in them, Yun Jhin's mind washing technique wasn't perfect and he knew that it would never be so he couldn't create perfect double agents.
"For now let's continue conquering the small sects around before we will move onto the medium ones, afterward things won't be as easy as they are now but I should get enough resources to facilitate another breakthrough."
As Yun Jhin would get closer to his former peak he would be able to do things more 'explosively'.
Right now he could be considered as low-key as he could get or else he would have started an inner-sect war between all the top sects already, he needed the others to be preoccupied with something when he will reach the peak of God Realm and reach the core of the universe. But first things first he had to find the core.
He wasn't sure if the others knew about the way to break through above the God Realm but if they did that meant the way to locate the core of the universe was harder than it seemed to him.
He shook his head as it wasn't time for him to think about these things, he still had quite a lot of things to do before he could go for that search.
For now, he had to focus on absorbing as many sects and other organizations as he could into his.
He memorized the whole map that he had been given previously so he didn't need to open up once again, he looked through his memory for the next target and decided to go for the nearest sect that had the same standing as the Deer Antlers sect.
However for now he would wait until he had enough disciples, he couldn't have empty lots, and absorbing the weak disciples from them wasn't really that good at the moment, he didn't need the cannon fodder yet, there was still a little bit more time until he would have a find for them, but he was preparing something big.
Yun Jhin sat cross-legged over the surface of the blood river as he meditated only moving from there from time to time to get the news that the elder duo gave him with both hands.
Even though he didn't make any moves any more tons of rogue cultivators started to join his sect again as he gained more territory and the sect filled up again with 10,000,000 people, seeing what happened Yun Jhin got another banquet going before he created another ship and loaded 5 million of the relatively less talented disciples for another assault!
His armored body appeared above as he created another ship which loaded all 5 million disciples on it then it disappeared in the universal skies along with him.
His next target was called the Egret Pavillion it was a dual-cultivation based sect which Yun Jhin decided to take over on a whim, his information about them wasn't exactly complete but from what he found about them was that they had quite the fertile lands that produced resources that might even be useful to him, so he would be able to use them for his cultivation and sell them as well making a profit which he could further turn into other resources for cultivation.
The Egret pavilion was located on a middle-ranked blue planet, it was full of water as 94% of it made up the surface of the planet and the land-dwelling people lived on the other 6%.
There were also many aquatic races living in the oceans that Yun Jhin also wanted to subjugate, while the pavilion existed on the land he wanted to take over the whole planet.
Some specialities that he needed were underwater. Since there was a lack of information Yun Jhin had also made up his mind for any surprising things happening but as long as things didn't go wrong he would end up with another planet added to his territory.
It took him 3 days of travelling to reach the planet as it wasn't that far from the Deer Antlers sect, Yun Jhin looked down at the blue planet below him and took in a deep breath as he unleashed his 5 million disciples on that 6% piece of land letting them run havoc when suddenly he felt something was wrong...
The space that he was in was suddenly locked making him unable to teleport if he wanted to!

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Ambush
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin frowned as he used his finger to poke the air around him trying to break the space with his God-like powers but he couldn't!
This meant two things, either someone stronger than him had sealed the surrounding space or they used a treasure of some sort to do it.
If the first happened there would be major problems but if it was the second it would be easier for him to resolve this business.
Yun Jhin wondered who was so bold to attack him after he broke through the God realm.
He put his guard up as he looked around, besides the blue planet below him there was nothing else in the vast universe surrounding him.
"We meet again."
Out of nowhere the Ukog the man with the monkey tail and Duritz the blonde long-haired man appeared!
Ukog had his fingers on his forehead and Duritz had his hand on his shoulder.
Ukog took a few steps backward as he left Duritz alone to face Yun Jhin, it seemed they might have used a treasure as Yun Jhin didn't feel any threatening auras from them, but he could feel that Ukog was rather interesting considering he teleported in without the use of any formations, and it was also exactly to his coordinates to boot!
Yun Jhin eyes turned towards Ukog but the man sheepishly scratched the back of his head before he said:
"You don't want to take your eyes of Duritz or he might get angry, also you won't fight me I'm not good at fights, I'm only a support role."
"Hmm?
Yun Jhin didn't find Duritz too interesting as he didn't feel literally anything from him, last time he saw him he was at the peak of the sage realm, how far could he have gone in his cultivation when Yun Jhin barely reached the God Realm?
Duritz cracked his neck and knuckles as he gave a glance to Yun Jhin's armored body and he snickered:
"It seems you really took a big liking to this 'Grand Emperor of Evil' thing you got on huh?"
Yun Jhin didn't find his taunting amusing as he glanced at him releasing waves of sharp air from his eyes that were meant to slice through him, however, it didn't go as planned as the waves of air were stopped near him only slashing some of his long blonde hair.
Duritz chuckled as he looked at the floating hair around him as it returned to his head and the tufts which were cut turned a light shade of green.
"I guess it's time to start right?"
Yun Jhin knew that even if he asked them how they got here all he would get was some more sarcastic remarks, while Ukog didn't look smart he didn't seem to be dumb to the degree he would chat with the enemy about his special technique.
Yun Jhin really wanted that technique as while his teleportation speed was fast he couldn't teleport to people if someone was in the vicinity while he teleported it didn't mean anything, he was sure they somehow located him and used this monkey-tailed person talent to get to him.
Duritz didn't say anything as his whole blonde hair started to turn to light green, his pupils disappeared as his aura became visible, it was of a light lime color and its size and potency increased every second!
Yun Jhin frowned as he felt something was wrong with this person, how could his power be so immense?
At this point Ukog couldn't help but point out Duritz's power:
"It seems you have grown way stronger after the master had lifted your seals..."
Duritz snorted and didn't bother to look at Ukog.
"Seals? How did Yuan Fang surround himself with such overpowered freaks? Goddamned fortuned one constitution..."
Yun Jhin could feel Duritz's aura turn solid as it increased to a point that he felt extremely threatened by it, he only came here to enslave a planet and not fight to the death with Yuan Fang's cronies, why the hell did he even send them here?
***********************************
Yuan Fang's eyes were closed as he meditated under a dark waterfall, suddenly his eyelids lifted as he looked up letting the dark water hit him in the face, his azure eyes turned into a deep shade of green as he laughed and said:
"This is what you get for mind washing my spies, even though I cannot send me that doesn't mean I cannot annoy you! Let's see how much you like your plans being fucked with!"
************************
Yun Jhin could never know what was going through that fool head, he was a wanted man of even higher degree than him at the moment and he let his subordinates out? These two were also wanted and high rated rogue criminals and if Yun Jhin could catch them he would be able to get a fat bounty for them, of course, he wasn't anything better than them but considering his sect status he had some type of 'political protection' which rogue cultivators didn't have. For example, rogue cultivators would be punished heavier compared to sect cultivators for the same crime.
This was mostly because rogue cultivators didn't have anyone to complain to nor did they have any power in the world, at best they would follow the crowd and join a sect to have any semblance of protection but mostly they were the bottom feeders of the world.
There was a saying that living as a rogue cultivator was worse than being a pig or dog in a sect.
This wasn't that true as quite a lot of rogue cultivators liked being free, however, they were also playing with their lives and the lives of those who were close to them in that way, who knew when an arrogant young master thought you were looking at the woman he fancied and decided to assassinate you? In this society, things like this were pretty common.
Yun Jhin moved his head to the side as he felt something graze his helmet, he could see a small fine slash hole in the helmet as he looked a little to the right, there was something so sharp that it could damage his new armor?
Yun Jhin knew that whatever item or ability this guy had, he was threatening! Not to the point that he could kill Yun Jhin but to the point that he might be able to capture him.
God Realm experts could be hardly killed unless every part of them was destroyed down to their very cells but they could be captured, at the God level deaths were scarce but being taken prisoner was what happened often to the loser in the conflicts at this level.
Yun Jhin started to get serious. His muscles swelled and his armor spikes started to lengthen trying to pierce through Duritz's body.
The spikes were easily dodged by Duritz as he waved his body through them like a light ballerina, his current form and his agile moves made a strange contrast.
Yun Jhin's aura became visible as well as it swelled to immense amounts lighting up the starry sky of the universe with a purple-green light.
His helmet dropped from his head as his half azure half red hair started to spike up however there were no more bodily changes happening to him after that, the stronger he became the less would his body change after he powered up.
He wasn't really up to par as his hair still spiked up and his muscles swelled in size.
Duritz suddenly appeared behind him as he thrust his arm through his back, Yun Jhin looked down at the arm sticking out of his chest and chuckled as drops of blood flow down from his mouth into the abyss of the starry river.
"Are you familiar with this attack Yun Jhin?"
Duritz snickered from behind him as he twisted his arm in Yun Jhin's chest trying to inflict some pain on him.
Yun Jhin snickered as he dashed forward while keeping a tight grip onto Duritz's hand which remained stuck in his chest:
"You think that I don't have a counter for a technique that I have used so many times?"
Duritz screamed as he felt dizzy, his soul was attacked by the ki enhanced dashes that Yun Jhin was doing along with the fact that his arm was somehow getting dissolved in Yun Jhin's body!
"You...!"
Even though Duritz was quite strong to the point that Yun Jhin had some trouble reacting to his attacks now that he had trapped him it was easy to inflict damage on him. After all, Yun Jhin could see that while this person was talented his experience was minimal! He wasn't a reincarnated one nor a fortuned one but he was strong! Which meant he was a talent of this generation!
Generational talents were rather rare as most of the higher-ups in the big organizations were reincarnated ones, it seemed Yuan Fang's luck was through the roof as he got his hands on such a person!
Yun Jhin was truly envious.

chapters.title: Chapter 199: A small failure leads to great anger
chapters.content:
Putting his envy to the side Yun Jhin eyes hardened as he analyzed the powers of Duritz, he seemed to excel at everything in melee combat as he fought with him head-on, his regenerative powers were at the God Realm and his stage seemed to be higher than his for some reason, he wondered what kind of seals were inhibiting him beforehand.
As he fought him back and forth he realized that his stamina also seemed boundless as he didn't get tired at all no matter how many hits he took or how much he fought, he resembled a war god ready to capture nations through rains of blood and fire.
At the middle point in the fight things finally started to heat up!
Duritz's powers reached a plateau and it couldn't increase anymore but his battle power increased constantly as he fought with Yun Jhin back and forth trying to leech his fighting experience and become a better warrior.
Yun Jhin knew this could happen but he hadn't met a genius who could improve in a fight in his countless lives, they mostly improved after the fight and not during it.
Yun Jhin elbowed Duritz in the stomach and then back slapped him into a passing meteorite, he cupped his hands together as he put them in front of his body and launched a transparent sword of energy from them skewering him right through the neck.
Duritz put his hand on the blade of the sword as he forcefully ripped it out of his neck leaving the gaping wound to close slowly due to the intense damage he suffered.
Duritz started to gasp for air as he felt something was wrong, his energy was going down!
He looked down at his chest only to see an arm sticking through his chest, blue pale energy being seeped off from his body, it was his ki!
Yun Jhin was smirking under his helmet as he absorbed Duritz's ki recovering his and weakening the opponent at the same time.
"How do you like being on the opposing side fool?"
Duritz started to shake, his whole body spasmed but Yun Jhin felt something wasn't right as the sound of laughter hit his ears:
"Think you got me, old man?"
Yun Jhin looked down at this arm as it started to blister-like it had been infected by something, his ki was actually poisonous!
Yun Jhin frowned as he took a few steps backward and expelled all of the foreign ki from his body in a gigantic wave of energy that tried to slice Duritz into two pieces.
However, Duritz absorbed the ki back into his body like it was nothing negating the attack ability that Yun Jhin had bestowed upon it when he expelled it from his body.
This Duritz was full of surprises and Yun Jhin didn't really like them as he already unleashed his disciples upon the planet below them and if the God Realm expert of the Egret Pavilion could run through his disciples like a hot knife through butter!
Even though he didn't really care about their well-being to him, he pretty much owned them and he didn't like his 'precious items' to be damaged or destroyed as he still had plenty of uses for them.
Yun Jhin unleashed a sonic wave as he opened his mouth screeching like a bat from hell as the waves that came from his mouth hit the eardrums of Duritz and Ukog who was observing from a relatively safe distance because he wasn't near the center of the damage done to Ukog easily healed but he became a little bit stunned, and at that moment Yun Jhin tried to flash away and capture him!
However, Duritz ignored the spatial restrictions and somehow teleported in front of him putting both of his arms in an x position blocking his attempt at capturing Ukog with his whole body!
Yun Jhin frowned as he flicked his finger towards Duritz's forehead as he stopped himself a few millimeters before hitting him with the charge meant for Ukog.
This fight couldn't last more as Yun Jhin tried to go to the planet and save his disciples, there was no reason to fight with Duritz at this point as Yun Jhin wasn't strong enough to kill or capture him, they were at most equal with the fight going in a stalemate, they were here just to waste his time!
Ukog knew that they made him quite mad, but at this point, he also realized that the disciples that Yun Jhin had sent down must have mostly died so he appeared right behind Duritz as he put his hand on his shoulder and then used his free hand to put two fingers on his forehead and he disappeared along with Duritz!
Yun Jhin felt the surrounding restrictions on space loosen as they disappeared but it didn't gladden him at all as he teleported down to the surface of the planet and what he saw made his blood boil with immense anger!
All of his disciples had been slaughtered and put into mountains of corpses that they used to feed their monstrous Egrets, he took off the helmet from his head as he crushed it into his palm like it was made from paper as he shouted, his aura engulfed the whole planet like it was a deadly smog.
This alerted all of the living beings on the planet and the God Realm expert from the Egret Pavillion appeared in front of him with a scared look on her face.
The expert from the Egret Pavillion was a woman that looked to be in her mid-thirties, she had a big bosom and egret wings growing out of her back, she had a certain beauty about her that made you want to protect her and talk sweet things to her, her jade-like countenance added to her beauty and her long back-length blonde hair made her look like a goddess.
But Yun Jhin easily ignored her looks as he glared at her and didn't say anything as he pointed his finger to her stomach immediately launching a small beam of purple energy that pierced her stomach and injured her insides making her bleed internally.
She coughed out a mouthful of blood as he felt that her insides weren't regenerating as fast as they should be, Yun Jhin snorted seeing the look of surprise and dread on her face as he appeared in front of her and punched her in the head making her skid along the water like she was a pebble.
He then appeared above her as he grabbed her by the neck and looked deeply into her eyes as he used his other arm to insert his hands into her head messing with her brian and brainwashing her to the highest degree he had done up to till this point!
She fell to her knees mid-air as she clutched her head and screamed for her parents and a lot of other stuff that won't be mentioned.
Then Yun Jhin made her get up as he planted his feet on her head humiliating her while she still struggled against the brainwashing he inflicted upon her.
In the end, she succumbed to it and became his puppet!
Now that he had taken over the Egret Pavillion it did minimize his losses a bit but if he wasn't stopped by Duritz and Ukog he wouldn't have incurred any losses! He would be only profiting but at this point, it couldn't be said there was any profit, he still had a few losses!
He was so angry that he wanted to kill this woman that kneeled in front of him immediately but his reasoning wasn't lost due to anger, he shook his head as he scanned her memories and learned everything that could be learned about the Egret Pavillion.
The sect had a population of around 8 million disciples all around the Emperor Realm and above, their cultivation bases weren't that impressive and in total, they had around 2 million sage realm experts, and the only God Realm expert was this woman in front of him which was named Divinity Angela.
In the end, he was at a loss as most of the disciples which came with him right now were elites at the sage realm and there were very few Emperors, his recruitment requirements were quite strict, and very few Emperor Realm experts or below could join his sect.
He was quite annoyed but he didn't unleash his anger on anyone as he made it dissipate with a wave of his hand leaving only cold and calculating thoughts in his head, he made Angela his slave so he pretty much owed the Pavillion now so he let her go and leave things as they were, he didn't have many uses for the disciples of the Pavillion yet but in the future, he would employ them as he wanted.
He sighed as he looked towards the gigantic ocean that spanned for around 94% of the planet and dipped into it, he could feel that she wasn't the only God Realm expert on the planet and he found it strange that the other one didn't attack him when he unleashed his aura around the planet, could he be a scaredy-cat?
Yun Jhin found himself underwater where there was no light to be seen for hundreds of thousands of kilometers, he enhanced his eyes with ki letting him have a type of nocturnal vision that made him able to see through the darkness.
"Ok now let's subjugate this aquatic folk as well... hopefully they would make up for the losses and I can end up with a profit for this conquering attempt... I will also have to see how the hell those two teleported to me and block their ability somehow."

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Underwater capture
chapters.content:
As the darkness dissipated in Yun Jhin's vision he could finally see the underwater civilization and how advanced it was.
As Yun Jhin's gaze traveled through the water he could see houses of different sizes which were made from though corals which were held together by dead marine life bones and different materials that he couldn't identify immediately.
While he took a better look he realized that the buildings were glued together by some green paste that he recognized as draconic plankton.
The draconic plankton was very useful to temper the laws in the body of the God Realm experts at the lower stages but it was rather expensive and hard to find, Yun Jhin had some stashes of draconic plankton back at the sect and when he came back from this conquering expedition he wanted to use them, as in the God Realm there were levels for the stages, Yun Jhin was currently in the middle to later stages of the 1st stair of the God Realm.
Stages could be defined as stairs at the God Realm and normally a normal person at the God Realm would need a long time to transverse those stairs but Yun Jhin could skip that as long as he used the right ingredients because he had enough understanding of laws.
With enough of this plankton, he could surely skip the first stair and go directly to the 2nd or even 3rd!
And these maritime fools were using the ingredient as goddamn construction glue!
Yun Jhin shook his head at the waste of it, while the plankton was certainly very good at gluing things together if turned into a paste this was the crudest way of using it.
As he appeared above the buildings that used the plankton to keep them together he glanced at the people who lived inside through the hardened coral.
They looked like normal humans, they didn't have gills or anything like that, they were practically normal humans who could live underwater through a special cultivation technique.
Yun Jhin knew about such techniques so he wasn't surprised to see them being employed here, he took one or two glances before he stopped and decided to find the God Realm expert of this underwater civilization, the cities and villages spanned 94% of the planet and it was harder to find him because he was hiding around... if he didn't want to be found Yun Jhin couldn't really find him.
However, having an organization could also be an Achilles heel for God Realm experts as they would have to protect it, of course, selfish people like Yun Jhin existed so if their life was in peril they wouldn't care much about their organization, a prime example was the leader of the Deer Antlers sect who left the sect to Yun Jhin's mercy.
So to get him out of his hiding place Yun Jhin decided to go on a rampage in the most populated area that he could find.
His senses stretched covering the whole underwater place of the planet as he found the place populated with the most living beings.
He easily teleported there as he glanced down at his feet seeing pedestrians going to their jobs, there were quite a lot of civilians in this underwater society and not all of them were cultivators, while they had a cultivation base it was quite low as he could see earthly and heavenly realm people made the majority of the people walking below him.
With his stealth abilities and his current cultivation ability no one could see him even though he floated in what was considered bright daylight for these people here, everything was illuminated in this place by phosphorescent moss.
Yun Jhin's silhouette appeared in the 'sky' and it started to attract attention rather quickly as even though these people could be considered weaklings in the cultivation world they were still stronger than normal humans.
Yun Jhin ignored their words as he gave a glance towards the biggest palace that he could see in this metropolitan city and waved his hand, tens of thousands of people below him became pools of blood that dyed the whole waters red attracting the vicious marine life that lived nearby, the guards at the city gates were immediately overwhelmed by the massive amounts of maritime life that turned berserk at the immense amount of blood that dispersed into the water.
Yun Jhin watched as everything became a pandemonium below him and waited for the God Realm expert to present himself to stop what was happening and confront him.
Yun Jhin waited as the time passed seconds turned into minutes and minutes into tens of minutes, his face morphed into a disappointed expression as he looked around, the maritime life that he triggered to attack was almost finishing exterminating the normal people and the army of the palace was only reacting now, it seemed that their leadership left...
He sighed as he realized that the current generation was rather cowardly, or maybe his reputation was too resounding?
Suddenly he felt the water around him starting to turn cold as he became an ice sculpture, he just wanted to go down and make everyone submit when he was attacked!
Attacking when he let his guard down, this made Yun Jhin's sculpture shake as he broke the ice entrapping his body, his eyes were currently glittering as his face turned to the side seeing a humanoid seal, it immediately started to sweat the moment Yun Jhin's eyes met his.
From what Yun Jhin saw in this person his cultivation was around the 2nd stage of the God Realm but his nature seemed rather cowardly, the man averted his eyes the moment he met Yun Jhin's and he looked down, it even seemed as if he was ready to prostrate himself in front of Yun Jhin and give up.
Yun Jhin didn't let his guard down again which made the seal's eyes narrow as it tried to swim away only for its body to start freezing quickly, he was getting a taste of his own medicine!
Yun Jhin recognized the technique that was used on him because it was one of his own!
This planet was under Yun Jhin's feet in his previous life along with a wider area, every top 10 sects owned around 3,4% of the universe besides the dead bones sect, while the rest were either under grey areas or they were too bare in resources for the sects to care, here random sects would be established by rogue cultivators who wanted more rights or banished disciples from other sects.
Somehow it seemed that Yun Jhin's influence didn't disappear from this planet as the seal was using a technique he passed down to one of his personal disciples in his previous life if he remembered correctly his name was Guan Ming Duhan and he was also from the same race as the seal in front of him.
The moment he recognized the technique he remembered everything.
He peered at the seal's consciousness and decided to ask him directly:
"What's your name?"
The seal cowered as its body was getting frozen up to its waist before the freezing stopped, such fine control was something that the seal couldn't do without a high amount of concentration and he realized that his technique came from the man in front of him:
"My name is Guan Hang Muan... your highness please let this little one of this time for offending you, I didn't know you are from the sect that my ancestors served!"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he told him:
"I'm not only from that sect, I'm the patriarch of the sect!"
Guan Hang eye's bulged out as he looked at Yun Jhin up and down, he even wanted to bow and kowtow but his current bodily situation didn't let him.
Yun Jhin didn't remember that direct disciple of his being so cowardly, why was his descendant like this?
Seeing Yun Jhin's expression which was starting to turn into a mocking one made Guan Hang quite embarrassed, it wasn't his fault he was like this!
Yun Jhin didn't care about his life story as he put his hand forward to the immobilized Guan Hang which made his whole body tremble again, he wasn't sure what Yun Jhin was up to!
Yun Jhin smiled at him as he raised his hand until it was near his relatively cute seal face before he placed his palm over his face making him start howling in pain like thousands of ants were crawling inside his brain.
Yun Jhin's eyes turned cold as he looked at him, he took off his hand as the ice that immobilized him broke and he started to trash in the air as if he was getting possessed by something.
"I don't really care you are the descendant of my personal disciple, you attacked me so you have to suffer a bit don't you think?"
The seal-man just howled in pain as he couldn't hear what Yun Jhin said at all, the current brainwashing process was making sure he would forever be Yun Jhin's slave just like everyone else that went through it, albeit while there were some holes in the brainwashing they were so small that they couldn't be exploited easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Draconic plankton and total control
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin watched as Guan Hang's soul finally stabilized and he stopped shouting in pain, his resistance ended up futile as his eyes glazed over for a few seconds before they regained focus.
He immediately kneeled in front of Yun Jhin to show his respects but Yun Jhin ignored him, he already got access to his memories after the brainwashing success so he knew where to go to get what he wanted.
As for the people they were practically all under him already so he didn't care much about them, most of them were weaklings and the army of the nation wasn't anything special so he didn't need them yet, he only instructed Guan Hang to distribute the blood throne's technique through the population.
Then he left him to do whatever he was doing beforehand as he didn't need him anymore.
The draconic plankton was harvested a few kilometers away in the fields by lowly cultivators who became farmers.
For them, the plankton wasn't that useful besides being a construction material and it could also be used as food if you were desperate enough.
Yun Jhin looked down as he teleported to the field full of draconic plankton, there was so much his eyes started to glitter as he waved his hand making all of it disappear into his spatial dimension, he counted almost 600 kilograms of it and combined it with some complimentary materials that he already had he could chew them to break through to the 2nd stage of the God Realm!
No harvests were happening right now because the farmers were resting so he easily looted everything he needed and left.
The planet became needle-sized in his vision as he disappeared by teleportation, he now owned one more planet and his territory expanded once again.
However he didn't feel a sense of safety at all, who knew when would Duritz teleport near him, and what if he came with Yuan Fang to tag-team him?
Yun Jhin didn't really like feeling hunted so he needed to quickly return to the blood throne sect where he had his formation and think out how did they teleport to him.
He started a fast return to the sect using his teleportation technique multiple times in high succession to arrive successfully to the sect.
Fortunately, they didn't decide to attack him again on the way back or he might be in trouble:
