"Just you wait after I break through further Yuan Fang... I will show you that this continuous offense of yours will be paid with your blood!"
He was angered multiple times by his transgressions and this one was the one that topped all of the other ones together!
They were enemies but Yun Jhin didn't go out of his way to make trouble for him this was just a dick move at this point, they were both in the growth stage so they should focus on their plans not fight each other, he was just wasting Yun Jhin's time, and time was the most important thing to a cultivator!
Yun Jhin arrived in the sect with no fanfare as he returned to his dark palace before asking for the recent news from his advisors then he returned to the depths of the blood river for meditation.
In this session he wanted both to break through to the 2nd stage of the God Realm as well as find out how could Ukog and Duritz teleport to him without any formation's help.
He decided to first focus on the more important things, which was his breakthrough! If Duritz and Ukog were dumb enough to teleport to his current location he would welcome them all with open arms!
He took out all of the draconic plankton from his spatial dimension and sent word for the other complementary materials to be sent to him which were:
'Three-eyed star leaves', 'Destructive lava moss', 'The core of a dead tree', 'mandibles of the tricorn', 'heart of the 3 man-killer' and lastly a bit of tender human flesh, the younger the better, it should also be fresh to increase the effects of the combination of the resources.
It didn't take much for everything to be sent to him, slaughtering an infant was done rather quickly by his disciples and he was sent the freshest meat that could be found around.
He gathered all of the things together as he took a good look at them and squeezed some of them while tasting some of them preemptively to see how good their effects would be, afterward he washed his internal palace with ki to get rid of the effects of the herbs and other resources before he sat cross-legged above the blood river and started the ritual.
"Let's start with the tender flesh first..."
The already carved red flesh started to sizzle and quickly darken under Yun Jhin's fiery gaze he cut into it with his sharp fingers as he opened it up, then he used the herbs to spice it up along with the plankton and the other stuff.
In front of Yun Jhin his personal creation appeared, it was a steak specifically made by him, with enough of these he would be able to rise through to the 2nd stage of the God Realm or also said the 2nd stair.
Yun Jhin continued to create these steaks en masse as he used multiple ki hands to speed up the creation process, in the end, he got around 630 steaks in total.
He started to slowly devour them as terrifying evil energy started to converge in his body, the wailing of infants could be heard coming from Yun Jhin's stomach as if the infants that were killed were ready to burst through his stomach due to their intense hatred.
Yun Jhin easily ignored the cries as he continued to consume the 'evil steaks' that he had created, his eyes reddened as he continued to eat and his aura thickened continuously.
After he finished all of the steaks his body started to shake as he opened his mouth and let out a big satisfying burp before he cleaned his mouth using a napkin.
He closed his eyes as the energy inside his ki pathways rampaged around before he easily tamed it with his soul willpower and sent it towards the skies of the sect!
He was calling forth more laws so he could link with them!
He didn't gather enough energy for more than 2 laws but he would be able to reach the 2nd stair of the God Realm and close into the 3rd as he would have 3 laws!
Now he wanted to fuse with the laws of Yin and Yang, he unleashed a dark and white beam out of his body in the starry skies of the universe.
The light naturally attracted the associated laws as they tried to identify who was summoning them, when they felt it was Yun Jhin they easily entered the light as if they were guided there by a loving hand.
As the laws returned to his body they fused into it and elevated his status even further, his body started to slim down the excess muscle as it became more compact, the body refinement stage started to break through the 7,500 stage and beyond and stopped around the 7,800 stages.
His ki cultivation steadily rose as it broke through the shackles of its previous stage, his soul started to ascend upwards as if it was moving up some 'heavenly stairs'.
The higher he went those stairs the harder would it be to go further, in his previous life he reached the 9th step of the stairs and stopped there, but in this life, he wanted to go even further beyond!
His cultivation finally stabilized at the later stages of the 2nd stair as his eyes opened, he let out a long laugh as he got up from his cross-legged position above the blood river and projected his voice through the whole sect:
"I had another breakthrough and it's time for another banquet!"
This time Yun Jhin wanted to hold a banquet for real, he already had mind washed almost every disciple and the new ones were given food with the same effects, he had taught the elders and grand elders how to prepare the food and considering it was his recipe they would worship him.
Yun Jhin laid out the table just like last time and decided to actually look out for disciples that he could accept and teach, now that there was no chance for them to backstab him he decided to be an actual teacher to them as it would strengthen his sect as whole if he trained them.
His soul willpower engulfed the whole gathering of disciples and he looked through to see if there were any that could catch his eye, among the 10 million people present he actually couldn't see anyone that was up to his talent target!
It was quite disappointing but suddenly his eyes lit up with eagerness and curiosity as an emaciated boy entered the crowd wanting to get closer to the table, he could feel a unique aura coming from his body!

chapters.title: Chapter 202: Returning family and getting disciple
chapters.content:
The emaciated boy's aura was glaring in Yun Jhin's perception, which meant that he had a unique constitution or bloodline of some sort!
This young boy's appearance also made him think about his 'family' that he had on the vermillion bird planet, he still felt the connection between his son and daughter that he had created, they were pretty much 'clones' of his with a unique will that was subservient to his, while they didn't have any of his experience nor memories they would mostly act like him.
Quite a bit of time passed so they must be in their teenage years by human standards, while they were conceived when he had the weaker bloodline of a dragon caterpillar they were talents that could reach the God Realm if groomed properly as most of the time the offspring would end up more talented than the parent.
Of course, this was something in reverse for Yun Jhin's bloodline but he could feel when he analyzed their bloodline was equal in purity to his, at the time.
Now that they have grown up their cultivation must have reached at least the heavenly realm by now, with his resources and help he would be able to get two generals under his guidance, they both would have superior IQ as long as he taught them properly, after all, they were his 'clones'.
He got up from his throne as he waved his hand making the emaciated boy appear in front of him, he was rather sickly and he wore the robe of the sect which was dark and had the symbol of a blood river and a bone throne floating above it.
He was rather short and his face was dark and gloomy, he also had freckles.
Under the black hood of the robe, there was a head full of shaggy green hair his purple eyes were confused as he took a look around but then they widened in both fear and respect as he started to kowtow the moment he saw Yun Jhin:
"I greet great patriarch Yun Jhin!"
Yun Jhin waved his hand making him stand up as he made him float near him while announcing towards the whole sect via voice transmission:
"This person will now be my disciple his name is..."
Yun Jhin looked towards the boy and he said with a clear voice:
"Marthon!"
Marthon's voice was heard everywhere in the sect, the brainwashed crowd looked at him with a respectful gaze as he now was the personal disciple of the patriarch that they 'respected and revered so much'.
Yun Jhin's gaze was reaching through all of the secrets of Marthon's body and he couldn't wait to teach him some techniques and analyze him more closely, he could make a great successor!
But it would be better he would teach him at the same time with his son and daughter.
He disappeared leaving the elders and the disciples to the banquet as Marthon appeared with him above the blood river.
Teaching was a very simple thing for Yun Jhin as he inserted all of the information into the youth's brain then threw him into the blood river for him to cultivate what he taught him, as for the other types of training it would come later when he came back with his children and wife.
Yun Jhin closed his eyes as he split into two, the distance between the four planets and his sect was too big and it would take him too much time to return so he had to make a clone that could go to fetch them while he would control the formation back at the headquarters.
He only had left personally because the other locations were quite close so there was a very low chance his headquarters would be attacked as they would need quite the big army that would take time for it to be transported, but if he missed too much time from the headquarters people will get ideas.
After all, they only feared him because of the formation and the blood river.
So while he controlled the formation he could also teach his disciples whenever he would be stuck somewhere in his cultivation while his clone would go to the planet and retrieve his wife and children.
********************
Yun Jhin's clone appeared outside of the sect as it started teleporting immediately towards the direction of the 4 beasts' planets.
A shadow started moving the moment Yun Jhin left his headquarters, then afterward even more shadows started to move across the universe!
They were all other spies that were installed around the sect instead of being inside, while Yun Jhin's method scared the other powers a bit that didn't mean it made them give up completely on monitoring his situation.
They needed to keep an eye open for his actions, who knew he would suddenly start targeting them?
Yun Jhin knew about these people attempts at spying on him but he wasn't omnipotent, he couldn't catch every single rat that stood near him, he had his 'cats' for that if they could catch them it was ok but he wouldn't go out of his way to run to catch them. He had better things to do than hunt for them.
Yun Jhin's clone shuttled through space at immense speeds as he tried to arrive at the vermillion bird planet at his quickest speed.
The quartet planets were situated at the southern place of the galaxy while Yun Jhin's sect was located in the north, the distance between them was quite big and Yun Jhin had to teleport for almost 1 month straight to reach the planets without any stops.
The moment he saw the surface of the planet the clone immediately darted towards it and tried to locate his main body's children through the bloodline connection he had with them, even though his body had been changed and molded several times he could still identify his children through the blood they inherited from him.
It didn't take him much time to find their location as he flew there at speeds unseeable to the eye, there he saw Qinghe and his children, they both had grown up, his son resembling him a great deal for more reasons than one.
His daughter was a spitting image of Qinghe and both of their cultivations weren't bad, Qinghe wasn't a good teacher but they still got to the 6th stage of the Heavenly realm with no resources to boot, after all, they were currently living in the middle of nowhere and they could only secure food around these parts. Yun Jhin selected this patch of land because it was very safe and remote so no one could find them and it was true, more than 10 years had passed and no one found them up till now.
Yun Jhin wasn't interested in the changes happening on the planet as he descended towards them, they were all startled as they saw the current Yun Jhin approach them, he was vastly different physically speaking than the last time they saw him but his face remained the same.
They immediately recognized him after looking at him for a few seconds!
Atleast Qinghe and Yun Lao had recognized him. His daughter was really small and even though she had his personality she didn't have any memories of him, she looked warily at him for a few seconds but seeing her brother and mother quickly running towards him to embrace him made her feel rather strange.
Suddenly her body started to shake as she felt a bloodline resonance coming from him, her eyes widened as she muttered under her breath:
"Father?"
Yun Jhin's clone smiled as he waved his hand towards her indicating that she should come forward to hug him.
She ran towards him with tears dripping down her face as she gave him a big hug along with her brother and mother.
Yun Jhin chuckled good-naturedly seeing their attitudes and told them all:
"It's time to get away from this planet, I have grown a lot through my travels in the universe and I can afford to take you all with me now!"
Yun Lao didn't say anything but his eyes were full of curiosity while Qinghe and his daughter were both interested to see what was further away from this planet, they had lived quite savagely up till now but they didn't miss much, Qinghe actually loved to take care of her children.
She gave Yun Jhin a quick peck on the mouth while asking:
"Where are we going husband?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he created a medium-sized ship and made them all board it before it immediately started flying away from the planet, Yun Jhin didn't really care how the political climate of the planet had changed after the revolution nor did he want to find out as he disappeared away with his family.
Now all he had to do was return with them, put Qinghe somewhere safe, and start teaching his children some serious cultivation!

chapters.title: Chapter 203: On the way back there were complications
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's speedy ship was sailing through the starry sky of the universe while he talked and brought up things that he had done to his family, of course, they were a little bit more simplified so he wouldn't scare them much.
While they were somewhat brainwashed towards liking him Qinghe was still a pretty normal woman, well normal in the regards of cultivators, while she could endure killing and things like that what Yun Jhin was doing was over the top and he didn't think she would be interested in these details.
As for his children, he would go into more detail with them later when they arrived at the sect and their training started.
The ship's flight path was steady as it moved quickly through the universe, however, things weren't as good as they looked on the surface.
Yun Jhin's clone frowned as he felt a disturbance in their surroundings, something wasn't right!
He made sure to change the life force of this clone and its energy signature before he sent it out, he thought that Duritz and Ukog could teleport to him like that but he got the same sensation as before!
That meant the space around him was getting sealed and afterward the duo would surely teleport to him!
Yun Jhin was starting to get annoyed by these guys antics, he growled as he activated his spatial dimension and threw his family in there, his clone had a subsidiary dimension cut off from Yun Jhin's but in his dimension living beings could exist as long as they had enough resources.
He had already filled that dimension with some food as his children would need to eat during the journey.
Yun Jhin glared at the shattering space in front of him as the ship was destabilized and disappeared, Yuan Fang, Duritz, and Ukog appeared!
Yuan Fang smiled as he started clapping showing his pearly sharp white teeth.
He looked at Yun Jhin directly in the eyes and asked:
"So what are you out here for, clone? Got a package you needed to directly pick up?"
Yun Jhin's clone didn't say anything as it glared at Yuan Fang, as a clone there wasn't much he could do versus Duritz alone, now that Yuan Fang was with him as well he might as well forget about his family and just give them up.
********************
In the blood river at the sect, Yun Jhin's main body opened its eyes as it glared towards a distant direction, he frowned as he decided to ask for a favor...
*********************
Out in the middle of nowhere in the universe, Yun Jhin's clone was having a staring contest with Yuan Fang that stopped after 3 seconds when Yuan Fang signaled with his hand to Duritz, the blonde man immediately transformed into his battle mode.
Yuan Fang also started to change but his physical changes were not as accentuated as before as he advanced to the God Realm and learned his own laws, just like Yun Jhin his body wouldn't change much anymore as he got stronger.
"Any words before we deprive you of your package?"
Yun Jhin smiled at them and said:
"Just a few."
"I have reinforcements."
Yuan Fang's eyes narrowed as he heard those words when suddenly all of the space around them started to shake as the imposed restrictions broke like a dropped vase, cracks appeared on the surrounding space as a hunchbacked old man coughed and appeared out of the cracks.
He gave Yun Jhin a small wave then looked at Yuan Fang and the others:
"I guess it would be a big understatement that I would like you gentlemen to vacate the area as quickly as you could."
Yuan Fang gritted his teeth as he glared at Yun Jhin but Gu Manshu coughed making Yuan Fang start to cough blood.
He dominated Yuan Fang only by coughing in his presence!
This was the power of a top God Realm expert, any action that he had done if targeted at someone else the damage that it would do was beyond their ability to resist!
Yuan Fang knew that he couldn't do anything to Yun Jhin as long as he got such an overpowered protector with him.
He glared at Yun Jhin before another crack in space opened near him, it started to slowly absorb him and his cronies as he said:
"I hope the price you listed to old Gu Manshu was worth making me leave!"
Yun Jhin's clone decided to not comment as he didn't look at him disappearing before his eyes targeted Gu Manshu.
The old man smiled showing his mouth full of sharp teeth and said:
"This favor shall cost you a bit Yun Jhin, we could say to be equal after you gave me that technique of yours but now... let's say that you will send me some troops when the time comes and a little bit of assistance from you directly, what do you say?"
While Yun Jhin didn't want to offend the powers that would attack Gu Manshu the same could be said about offending the old man in front of him, now that he got his help he needed to pay one way or another and considering none of the items that he had in his possession would be of interest to the old man all he could do was help him when the time came, he also gave him what technique he needed and as a fellow old monster, he didn't need any other technique from Yun Jhin as he was a walking library.
Yun Jhin sighed as he needed to accentuate the research on what let them teleport to him so easily, he was getting extremely annoyed at their insistence to the point that he wanted to find their hideout and go all-out fighting with them!
But finding their hideout was easier said than done and who knew what kind of defenses Yuan Fang put there? If Yuan Fang decided to attack his sect he would surely fail and considering how Yuan Fang acted he would surely have some similar defensive mechanisms to his.
Gu Manshu disappeared as he left Yun Jhin alone then Yun Jhin took out his family from the spatial dimension and continued to fly, while Gu Manshu 'disappeared' he was actually escorting Yun Jhin to his sect and increasing the speed of his ship at the same time, this was included in the favor or Yun Jhin wouldn't have needed to go personally when the Radiance Brilliance and Light sect would attack.
Yun Jhin's clone sighed as it was escorted back to the entrance of the blood throne sect then the old man truly disappeared, if he only fended off them and they came back to him the favor would be annulated for sure.
Yun Jhin's clone took them under the dark palace to the blood river as he dissipated into particles of light that the main body absorbed.
Qinghe, Yun Lao, and Yun Qinghe looked at everything that happened with curious eyes, Yun Jhin's main body floated above the blood river then descended to them with a smile on his face.
Qinghe gave him another hug along with his children that Yun Jhin reciprocated before he sent her to a different location, he gave her a big palace and some maids to take care of her along with some disciples as 'friends' while he would train Yun Lao and Yun Qinghe.
He wanted to make two battle-hardened generals out of the two of them that would serve under Marthon.
While their talents were great they were actually under Marthon talent-wise while disappointing there was nothing he could do for them as they didn't have systems as he did.
And if they did they would have told him by now.
Yun Jhin called Marthon from the bottom of the blood river, he quickly scampered up as he flew to the surface and looked at Yun Lao and Yun Qinghe with curious eyes, whoever could get close to Yun Jhin was a great person of high standing in Marthon's mind regardless of their cultivation base.
Yun Jhin then introduced them to each other before he started to teach them directly just like Marthon, he inserted his knowledge into their souls forcefully.
They trashed on the ground for a few minutes before they got up then dropped into the river to cultivate.
Yun Jhin nodded seeing their actions as he hovered above the river while getting cross-legged and closing his eyes, any resources he needed would be sent to him at any notification from him Marthon, or his children.
If they found something they didn't understand during cultivation Yun Jhin would come along and give them some enlightenment by explaining whatever they didn't understand.
Time passed fast in this situation and all Yun Jhin did was either cultivate or explain things to his disciples, from time to time when he found that he was in a bottleneck and cultivating wouldn't help anymore he would visit Qinghe or go on a conquest to increase his territory, his cultivation slowly increased and he was almost ready to break through to the 3rd stair of the God Realm through the accumulation of resources and the constant conquering of other sects and organizations.

chapters.title: Chapter 204: Transforming children into killing machines
chapters.content:
Since Yun Jhin needed to stay at the sect to protect it he needed some strong people to take over his expansion missions and while he had gained quite a lot of elders and grand elders as time passed they needed to be kept at the sect for defensive measures, he needed to create another army, a special unit that would be meant only for expansion!
While his children had his 'style' they weren't molded well enough as they haven't gone through life and death battles up till now, they only lived peacefully with their mother while she would usually go out and hunt for food.
They were green flowers without any experience in fighting but first Yun Jhin had to make them strong enough that the moment they stepped out of the sect they wouldn't perish immediately.
With the power of the blood river and the resources that Yun Jhin fed them, along with his personal teaching they were skyrocketing through their cultivation bottlenecks.
In this situation, they would have got unsteady foundations but with Yun Jhin's expertise how could their foundations be unsteady?
He was pretty much a magnate and his children now had golden spoons, they could get what they wanted when it came to cultivation resources or help.
But there was no such thing as a free lunch in this world, the moment they broke through to the Emperor Realm they were sent away from the sect to a secluded wild planet to train further!
It took them around 100 years and Yun Jhin wasn't idle during that time, while they cultivated he also cultivated and he inched near the 3rd stair of the God Realm and he was almost there!
The higher you went the harder it would be to break through, the next breakthrough to the 4th stair might take him more than 100 years of accumulation and he only got here this fast because of his continuous expansionist ideas, he got a lot of resources this way.
Yun Lao looked at her sister as he sighed, even though he had cultivated accordingly to his father's instructions but he still felt that he was slower in cultivation compared to her, he wasn't sure why but she would always excel at things from the first try while he would have to attempt more than 2 or 3 times, his sister even called him slow!
His sister wasn't like that when they lived on the vermillion bird planet but she started to get arrogant the moment their father started to praise her, she started to look down on him.
He never thought of his sister as such a person, she was gentle and loving just like their mother, what was going on?
While both of them respected their father dearly he wouldn't come with such an excuse to talk down to his sister or else he would look both jealous and petty. He also knew his father was encouraging Yun Qinghe because of her talent while he was slowly let to the part... he was giving him less and less advice and when he was sent away with his sister to this damned planet he was currently on he saw from the corner of his eye that he gave her a protective talisman!
He didn't get any such thing! His envy towards his sister increased quite a lot as there was a chance he would die on this planet if he didn't act with caution while his sister would get away scot-free using the talisman!
His blood was boiling inside but not with hatred for his father, but to his sister! Due to the changes that Yun Jhin did to their souls they would never get angry nor blame him for whatever happened to them, they would only think that what he was doing was for their own good.
On the planet they were separated and put through a survival test to temper their temperament and gain loads of life and death experience, Yun Jhin even said that he would let them die but it seemed that sentence was a lie as he gave his sister a talisman!
Yun Lao laid down in the thick grass around him as he tried to catch his breath, reminiscing about all of these things made him rather angry and in the situation, he was currently in, anger was the last thing that he needed.
His body was full of lacerations and bite marks and he had a small hole in his arm which was constantly bleeding.
He felt lightheaded due to the loss of blood and his face was pale, he didn't know how much time he could last as he was being chased by some beasts that he had unluckily run into.
He was both hungry and thirsty as he couldn't find any food or clean water sources up till now, his surroundings were blurry and he could only lay down in the tall grass area to take a rest.
He didn't know what to do, his father didn't give him any instructions before plunging him onto this planet full of wilds beasts.
He started to cough slowly so he wouldn't attract the attention of any beasts, he couldn't stop himself as some phlegm mixed with blood was spat out onto the grass in front of him.
"I need to go on... my father thought that I could withstand this... I also need to meet with Qinghe again... I cannot let her thoughts become true!"
He wanted to go on further as he took a few steps unsteadily only for him to fall to his knees.
Suddenly the tall grass started to shake and Yun Lao's body started to shake, he was scared!
"No... no!"
He started to scamper dragging his body through the tall grass as hard as he could, he needed to escape! He couldn't die here!
Suddenly out of the tall grass Yun Qinghe's dainty form appeared, her eyes were analyzing the surroundings and she saw her scampering brother with a scared expression on her face which made her scoff in disgust.
He got closer to him as she squatted near him and said:
"It seems father really overestimated you huh?"
A beast appeared out of nowhere as it tried to take a swipe at Qinghe's head only for the attack to be blocked by a blue barrier.
Yun Lao's eyes hardened seeing her talisman at work, the attacking beast was rebound by the barrier and Yun Qinghe did quick work on it.
Yun Lao already got up and glared at Yun Qinghe as he said through gritted teeth:
"Your talisman throws the whole objective of this training out of the window!"
Yun Qinghe sneered as she said:
"Father gave me this talisman and he said that I could use it whenever I wanted to because I have superior talent, he actually expressed how he was disappointed your talent wasn't good enough or he would have given you one as well! He said because your talent is insufficient that you would have to fight harder trials to unleash your full potential!"
Yun Lao understood what his father wanted but his jealousy regarding his sister remained, it wasn't that he didn't understand why she was better than him, he just hated her for it!
Seeing his hate-filled eyes made Qinghe chuckle as she took her talisman out of her pockets and waved it around his face:
"What are you gonna do about this?"
Yun Lao's eyes turned scarlet as he saw the talisman being waved in front of his face, he almost went berserk as he glared at her!
Yun Qinghe knew that her brother wouldn't do anything to his darling sister no matter how many times he taunted him so she continued to wave the talisman in front of him, now that she didn't have it in her pocket anymore her barrier was disabled so what she was doing was very dumb, who knew when another beast would attack?
Yun Lao wanted to point this out as he actually learned something from all the running he did around.
But then he shook his head as he tried to get up and leave.
There was no reason to mind her antics.
If she got hurt because of it it would show to his father that he put the wrong faith in her and he would get his graces regardless of his lower talent or not!
Seeing that Yun Lao wanted to leave made Yun Qinghe frown, he couldn't get a rise out of him anymore with only words?
She appeared in front of him as she put her foot on his chest and pushed him down on the grass making his injuries worsen, Yun Lao eyes widened both in surprise and pain as he said:
"Why are you doing this?"
Yun Qinghe licked her lips as she said:
"I can feel something... the more I look at you the more I get this feeling, if I devour you I will become even more talented and my bloodline will be purified, and considering you aren't in father's graces at all I could get rid of you and increase my cultivation at the same time."
Her eyes started to glow with a red light, her actions truly showed that she was Yun Jhin's daughter while Yun Lao had also inherited Yun Jhin's 'clone' qualities he wasn't as ruthless as her towards the family, after all, he saw her grow up into the young lady she was today and he couldn't make himself attack her no matter how hard he hated her talent.
But now things have gone too far!

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Pitting them against each other for tempering
chapters.content:
Yun Lao felt his blood boil seeing his sister's actions, it was one thing to mock him, but physically assault him?
This was over the line!
He tried to squirm out from her foot pressing on his chest but his bones started cracking due to the pressure she put on it combined with his previous injuries not being healed.
He wanted to shout for her to stop as their father wouldn't want this to happen, after all, while he didn't explicitly said that they weren't allowed to kill each other his eyes told him that it was forbidden.
He just got that feeling of protection and love from him that he couldn't understand.
Yun Jhin was observing everything that was happening from above the planet, while he didn't want them to kill each other, hating each other was needed. For starters, they would be able to push each other to the maximum when it came to his love and attention, and secondly, they would never ally with each other thus splitting them into factions.
He needed the secondary army organization to be split as brainwashing wasn't perfect, in the future there was a chance they might start idolizing Yun Lao and Yun Qinghe if he stepped out of the game for too much time considering closed-door cultivation took long times for God Realm experts.
Them hating each other would make them fight bitterly so that they would never think of touching upon his foundation, as his children were partial clones of his being and it was unknown if they were able to break through his control or not, while he believed in his abilities, who knew when they would be on a mission outside the sect and they would get captured and 'helped' to regain their mind?
Yun Jhin had many enemies and while they couldn't deal with him they would try to deal with his family, they knew that he didn't care about them at all so they would try to turn them against him to weaken him from the inside cutting through his army at the same time.
However, with infighting, there was a lower chance they would try to attack the third party (Yun Jhin) as they would be too preoccupied with tearing each other's eyes out.
Of course, Yun Jhin wouldn't let them kill each other as this would jeopardize his whole plan, seeing that Yun Qinghe was ready to deal the death blow to her brother made Yun Jhin send his willpower down to them in the form of a bodily projection.
Yun Qinghe's eyes widened both in fear and respect as she took her foot off her brother and kneeled, Yun Jhin tsked as he shook his head and waved his hand immediately destroying the talisman that he gave her while saying:
"I'm extremely disappointed in you Qinghe, you have shown that you have no familial love for your brother which is rather disheartening for me, while I can endure you beating him black and blue and insulting him, that's only for his own tempering, you cannot kill and absorb him! What kind of little sister are you?"
Qinghe kept her head down as she was berated then said:
"But father I..."
"No buts!"
"You shall continue your trial but without the talisman, and your brother will be healed and continue as well, however you are disallowed to interact with him during the whole trial now! If you do you will be punished, did I make myself understood?"
Yun Qinghe kept her head down as she gritted her teeth and responded respectfully:
"Yes sir..."
She glared at Yun Lao from the corner of her eye as Yun Jhin's projection disappeared and she made a cutthroat gesture with her thumb as she left by running away from the tall grass, Yun Lao felt his chest bones regenerating as his blood flow recovered to a normal state, all the blood he lost had recovered miraculously without Yun Jhin even touching him!
Yun Lao checked his internal situation and found that he wasn't fully healed, only the life-threatening stuff was taken care of and mostly the injuries that had been worsened and inflicted by Yun Qinghe, it seemed that Yun Jhin was serious about his tempering trial.
Yun Lao sighed as he decided to leave the tall grass area, the beast that was chasing him was killed by Yun Qinghe and he could move freely again.
He started to slowly walk away, now that he had experienced that crazy chase by the best he was more careful with his footsteps, who knew if there was a nearby beast and it could hear him with its sharp hearing?
Yun Jhin watched everything happening with a smile on his face, half of this training was for tempering and the other was to make sure they hated each other and it seemed that both were successful!
Now that he had finished the preparations for their 'mental training' and they would gain experience from this adventure, he would be able to make them start the expansion missions again!
As time passed the duo had finished the trial as 3 months of survival on the planet by themselves went past by.
The trial was rather simple but hard to finish due to their inexperience and the fact that Yun Jhin had filled the planet with one of the most annoying species of beasts that he could get his hands on.
Afterward, he made sure that they couldn't cheat by planting observing formations on them, but considering how 'good' they were for him they wouldn't ever cheat nor attack each other after he already warned them once.
Now that they were battle-hardened, while they couldn't be considered veterans they now needed to experience war with intelligent beings to grow further.
Thus the expansion missions appeared again!
Yun Jhin created a gigantic army as he employed a special formation that would increase their battle power the more people were in it, combined with the surrounding ki being absorbed by them as long as they acted properly, Yun Jhin sent his children to war for him so he could further increase his cultivation base while also protecting his headquarters.
The first target was quite far away from the sect so Yun Jhin couldn't leave it anymore as he wouldn't be able to return in time, only if he could have gained the ability to teleport himself just like Ukog, from what he understood the ability seemed to let him transport himself to the energy that he had memorized, it was like tracking down someone's DNA sequence to see their ancestry, it couldn't be stopped unless someone changed their DNA.
However, for Yun Jhin this was as easy as breathing, the moment he realized what the problem was he immediately changed his energy signature and hid it, even if they met him again they wouldn't be able to memorize it again so he wouldn't have to go through the trouble of changing it.
While he could change his energy signature it took time and resources which annoyed him, this was the consumption of resources that wouldn't happen if these people would see to their business.
Unfortunately, Yuan Fang liked to meddle in his business but now that he had blocked his harassing options he would make sure he would silence him forever rather soon, as long as he reached the middle stages of the God Realm which started from the 4th stair and above he would be able to get rid of him as he would unlock the harder laws.
Yun Jhin meditated over the blood river as he looked at its surface which showed the situation on the battlefield of a distant planet that he had sent his children to conquer.
Death was happening everywhere, blue-skinned lizard people were being mercilessly slaughter by Yun Jhin's robed disciples.
The most prominent figures of the battlefield were his children of course.
Yun Lao small body had grown up after a while of wilderness training and his feeble muscles started to harden and grow, he looked way more manly now and he even started to don a small beard trying to differentiate himself from his father physically.
Yun Qinghe had grown in all assets and her beauty had intensified as they were both dragon and phoenix hybrids with a little bit of caterpillar in between they were rather charming, however, that charming aura was almost nonexistent on them as they slaughtered without abandon.
They were like two killing machines as they glared at each other through the mountains of corpses and ignored all of the sticky blue blood that they were currently being literally bathing in.
Their competitiveness had hit insane charts after they were unable to deal with each other due to Yun Jhin's instructions and their cultivation base had skyrocketed as they both broke through in the sage realm 10 years after the wilderness training, with Yun Jhin's resources, their new experiences and his wisdom he could easily make them into sage experts in ten years.
While their talent was rather mediocre with Yun Jhin as a teacher and backer they could reach the God Realm but the early stairs would be their limit, they might not even reach the 3rd stair and they would have exhausted all of their potential.
Yun Lao decapitated one lizard person with a swift slash of his ax as he shouted towards the sky, it was the last warrior on the battlefield and they have won with an extreme advantage almost none of their troops being even injured, there were a total of 0 deaths.
Yun Jhin smiled profoundly as he saw another planet being taken down by his children.
His disciple descended from the dark palace in the cave where the blood river stood and said with a respectful tone:
"Master there has been news regarding that Yuan Fang you wanted to deal with..."

chapters.title: Chapter 206: You fool!
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's attention was immediately taken by the words Marthon had uttered, he had been monitoring Yuan Fang's possible hideout locations 24/7 out of 24/7 as he wanted revenge against all of his plots, he also wanted to get rid of him so he could 'sleep' properly in the future.
Marthon had grown quite a bit from a boy into a man while his power wasn't impressive as his cultivation base was only around the 2nd stage of the sage realm, he was only there as an administrator for the sect. His talent was great but Yun Jhin wouldn't make him his successor willy-nilly.
Only in a life and death situation would he choose a successor and even then he wasn't sure if he would continue the sect line properly, after all, the sect was destroyed after his death in his previous life.
"So where is his location?"
Marthon respectfully replied to Yun Jhin's question:
"Master, he had been sighted around the Third nebula sector of the Ban galaxy."
Yun Jhin made a hmm sound as he thought about the Ban Galaxy:
"This territory is owned by the Gold Loving pirates and its a trench full of evil, killing, looting, and pillaging, it's just at home for the new Yuan Fang but it makes no sense for him to go there unless there is something special happening or he found something he needed."
For God Realm experts, moving from one's territory meant that a supreme resource had been born or they were having a mission that needed their direct action...
"Marthon you are going to be responsible for the sect while I'm leaving."
Yun Jhin started to concentrate as a transparent being similar to him started to leave his forehead and appear into the world, this wasn't a clone but his Godly avatar! The moment the avatar separated itself from Yun Jhin's body it started to turn solid.
With his current cultivation, he would be able to use the avatar to control the formation remotely but its power would be cut down a bit this way, the Ban galaxy wasn't very far from Yun Jhin's headquarters but that didn't mean he would be able to travel quickly, fortunately, he had already laid down some teleportation formation for the nearby galaxies and it would take him around one hour or so to arrive and return.
That would be enough time so his place wouldn't be attacked and his avatar could keep the fort up if anything happened.
Yun Jhin left the underground cave as he appeared above the meteorite and disappeared as he used a teleportation formation he had installed.
Then he started warping from formation to formation to immediately arrive at the Ban Galaxy.
His surroundings were full of spacial ash along with dark and dirty bloody fog, the Ban Galaxy pirates were as worse as Yun Jhin, they did what they wanted when they wanted and no one could truly stop them, the righteous sects tried at first but they gave up just like they gave up on apprehending and executing Yun Jhin.
Because just like Yun Jhin their leader was a reincarnated one with a notorious reputation, his was only a little bit lower than Yun Jhin's but the atrocities he did were pretty similar, Yun Jhin was actually his friend back in the past but they grew apart as they had different philosophies.
Yun Jhin didn't want to meet him directly so he used his stealth technique as he walked directly into the bloody fog and disappeared only to enter the heart of the true galaxy, the ban galaxy was the nightlife of the universe! Casinos, strip clubs, brothels, and the like could be found on the nearby planets.
But Yun Jhin wasn't there for a normal visit.
The intel he got indicated that Yuan Fang wanted to get something from an auction!
It wasn't said which item he needed but there was only one auction house in the whole Ban Galaxy so it didn't matter, as long as he got to the auction house and caught Yuan Fang by surprise there was going to be profit.
Yun Jhin arrived stealthily at the auction house and saw that they were already starting, so he entered without triggering any of the surrounding formations and looked around to identify Yuan Fang's gang, there were a lot of people in the auction hall, almost around 50,000 and Yuan Fang would have surely come disguised.
But Yun Jhin had something to detect him by so he only waited until the auction was done and then left it following a trio who were ready to leave the galaxy through a public teleportation formation, after they paid their tax they disappeared in the formation unknowingly bringing Yun Jhin with them.
After so much time being in closed-door cultivation made Yun Jhin's top-notch skills even better to the point that even the disguised Yuan Fang couldn't be able to recognize his stealth technique, even though he might still be able to break it open by disrupting the ki, that would only happen if he knew that Yun Jhin was there!
Yun Jhin followed them as he waited for the right time to strike, suddenly the person in the middle took something out of his bosom, it was a dark cloth bag that had the item they needed.
Yun Jhin took a few silent steps forward as he took a glance at the bag and tried to identify what was inside.
"Like what you see Yun Jhin?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as he appeared then suddenly morphed into ten people, Yuan Fang narrowed his eyes as their appearance changed to normal.
Yun Jhin's clones exploded into a star formation creating a gigantic destroying wave of energy that engulfed the trio leaving them no space to dodge, Yuan Fang staggered out of the explosion with an empty hand as he glared at the starry sky around him and cursed:
"Damn you Yun Jhin!"
But as he said that there was a smile on his face, he clicked his open palm trying to detonate something only for him to frown, he looked down at his chest and saw the back being stuck to it!
Yun Jhin's voice transmission appeared in his mind:
"You are a fool if you thought I'm going to fall for your obvious plan, this was an ambush in an ambush!"
Yuan Fang howled as the dark cloth bag exploded shredding his body to pieces, Ukog and Duritz were both appalled at what happened as they gathered the remaining pieces of his body sticking them together while infusing them with ki to revive him.
"Watch out Ukog!"
Duritz cried out as he took a yellow beam of energy to the chest piercing directly through his heart and destroying it thoroughly.
"Stop dilly-dallying and take us out of here!"
Ukog started sweating seeing the current situation, Yuan Fang was just a pile of flesh that tried to regenerate after being blasted by his own trap, this was something that never happened before!
Was this their retribution for fucking with Yun Jhin so many times?
They thought that they hid the trap well but it seemed they were wrong!
Ukog felt something arriving at his neck as he grasped it only for his head to fly into the air as a fountain of blood exploded from his body!
Ukog broke through the God Realm as well so his vitality wasn't something to be looked down upon, his head tried to reattach itself to its body, but Yun Jhin appeared like a specter and grabbed his head with one hand:
"Gotcha."
The pile of meat started to shake as it saw its comrades head being taken away as it slowly started to reform into Yuan Fang's body, Yun Jhin stuck his tongue out at him as he pulled his eye making a face at him then disappeared while leaving those words behind:
"You should hide properly in the future because when I will unlock the secrets of this guy's teleportation you won't have another easy day ahead of you!"
The pile of flesh reconstructed itself in a naked Yuan Fang, then he growled towards the space in front of him as he grabbed Duritz by his long hair and berated him:
"Why didn't you do anything?"
"You should have the answer for that yourself, master Yuan Fang."
Yuan Fang grumbled under his breath as he understood why he didn't protect Ukog, it was either him or Ukog, and of course, Duritz would choose him the master.
If he saved Ukog Yun Jhin would surely destroy the pile of meat and absorb Yuan Fang's soul in a blitz attack, he wasn't sure how he did it but Yun Jhin strength had increased to the point that he was getting scared, he remembered the sensation of his head being cut off as he put his hand near his neck and shivered.
Yun Jhin appeared thousand of kilometers away as he broke through space and teleported along with Ukog's head which he sealed in time using the time law that he had comprehended, while he couldn't use it to its full potential as it wasn't linked with his body, as he was in the God realm it was still better than the casual time skips he used in his previous fight with Yuan Fang.
The sole reason he had been able to do that blitz attack without them being able to do anything was that he had overexerted his time law!
He coughed a mouthful of blood as he glanced at the frozen head in his head and laughed, if he extracted the teleportation knowledge from his head he would become practically invincible being able to teleport everywhere regardless of the distance as long as he got the energy code of the person he wanted to teleport to!
He would be able to massively expand his conquering efforts as he would be able to go personally without a fear of his headquarters being raided while he was away!

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Learning a special technique (1)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin gazed at the severed hand he kept in time stasis he was almost back at the headquarters of the sect and he would unseal the head then!
As he teleported with the use of the formations he was still contemplating why would Duritz and Ukog become Yuan Fang's subordinates, they were both talented people that could each make their own sect and raise to prominence.
Yun Jhin felt there was something that he could gain by learning about Yuan Fang's past.
He felt quite disappointed he wasn't able to kill him back there but Duritz would have surely unleashed his full power to stall him thus leaving Ukog to regenerate and in the end, he would have lost the opportunity to gain anything besides injuring Yuan Fang.
Yun Jhin's body materialized outside the meteorite's range as he flew and appeared directly inside the underground cave.
Marthon bowed as he waited for him up till now and Yun Jhin told him:
"Kill all the spies that were observing Yuan Fang's whereabouts, not one of them shall escape or you will be punished accordingly, do you understand?"
Marthon bowed and immediately left to do his master's bidding, while he respected him enormously, he also had lived with him a long time now and he understood when he would be angry or not, he also lived through enough small torture sessions to understand that he didn't want to anger him at all.
Marthon sighed as he appeared in the dark palace and instructed the elder duo to send out the words to the assassin squad of the sect to annihilate the traitors.
While Yun Jhin brainwashed a lot of people he also hired people from the outside to do his bidding, he didn't expect much from them and he knew that he would be betrayed but in this situation, he had been able to plan a double ambush because of their betrayal, basically using their own greedy thoughts against them.
Since he was usually known for brainwashing his subordinates Yuan Fang must have surely done something to those spies so he thought he was going to take him by surprise but in the end the one surprised was him!
Yun Jhin unsealed Ukog's head as it started to struggle out of his iron grip, it tried to jump out of his hand and teleport!
Space started to crack around the head as it tried to forcefully break the restrictions Yun Jhin had laid around the blood river and the sect but unfortunately no matter how broken his teleportation technique was it wouldn't be able to break through so many layers of spatial restrictions stacked on top of each other!
Ukog felt the world around him turn grey as he glanced at Yun Jhin's face, his head and soul were tied together and he couldn't even leave it if he wanted to!
That meant he would surely get tortured until he spilled everything he knew!
Ukog was usually a goofy person who liked to laugh but now all he could do was look serious and endure as he didn't want to betray Yuan Fang.
But Yun Jhin didn't care about the wants or needs of the body-less head in front of him.
He looked at him and asked with a smile on his face which made him look like one of the ugliest demons of hell regardless of how handsome he actually was, considering a person's smile showed their true soul.
Ukog almost felt like fainting in this situation but he couldn't as Yun Jhin was pumping his head full with ki that kept him awake.
Since Ukog didn't say anything Yun Jhin decided to start the conversation:
"You should know what I want, spill it out and I will give you a quick and painless death as a reward."
Ukog gritted his teeth as he tried to self-destruct only for him to cough up a mouthful of blood as Yun Jhin jabbed him in the eye with his thumbs almost poking his eyeballs out.
Ukog however didn't say anything as he easily endured the physical abuse.
Yun Jhin smiled as he saw how brave he was and then decided to go with more advanced torture techniques, his eyes glowed as a field of energy engulfed the head and practically cut him off from his cultivation base transforming him into a living headless normal human.
Then he put a piece of black cloth over his head and started to pour corroding blood from the river over it.
Ukog's skin started to blister and boil as his head was melting and recovering at visible speeds, Ukog could feel his soul crying out in pain as some of the blood started to infest it, Yun Jhin's blood river was helpful for those that cultivated his techniques but poisonous to everything else.
Ukog couldn't resist anymore as he felt his face continuing to melt and heal at the same time.
He started shouting in pain and anger at the same time, he was angry at himself and Yun Jhin at the same time, he felt his weakness was the sole reason that he was captured by Yun Jhin and he blamed himself because he wasn't strong enough to endure even one attack from Yun Jhin!
Yun Jhin ignored his cries of pain and continued to pour blood over his head, he couldn't forcefully brainwash him as he was guarded and he couldn't sort through his memories either, the fact was that he could only try to get the technique out of him through torture.
As Ukog stepped into the God Realm, Yun Jhin was unable to tap into his memories forcefully unless he was a Peak God realm expert.
So while he found the torture to be bothersome and a time-waster, it was the only way for him to extract the information he needed from Ukog's severed head.
"Ready to talk yet?"
Ukog still kept his mouth shut as if it was sewed.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he conjured a purple blade of ki and started to skewer his head like he was a roll of kebab meat.
At this point even if he wanted to shout he couldn't as his vocal cords were impaled by Yun Jhin's blade ki.
"Let's roast you a bit."
Yun Jhin slowly flew down to the blood river as he submerged the skewered head into the river completely.
The place where he submerged the head started to bubble intensely as Yun Jhin removed a pale white skull that had soul fire burning deeply in its eyes.
The skull opened its jaw as a howl coming from its soul tried to attack Yun Jhin only for it to be easily deflected by him, an image of a brown ape appeared behind the skull which indicated the original form of the skull owner's soul.
Yun Jhin chuckled seeing the brown ape and waved his hand cutting into the ape making it start bleeding blue blood.
The ape howled as it started beating its chest but it was obviously massively weakened after that injury.
"Ready to spill the beans yet?"
The ape continued to beat his chest as it seemed to be defying till the end!
"Ok, then I guess I will have to up the level by quite a bit then."
Yun Jhin's eyes turned full crimson as his arm impaled the ape's chest directly taking something out that resembled a yellow sphere and crushing it!
The ape immediately deflated like a balloon, all of its resistance faded away as its head started to shrink.
A small voice came out of the shrank head that said:
"Give it back..."
Yun Jhin chuckled as he created another yellow sphere out of the air and waved it in front of the shrunk head of the ape while saying:
"So what do you say? Your origin core for some measly information? Then you can lay down for eternal rest."
"Give it back...."
"Hmm?"
Yun Jhin didn't think he snatched his thinking core when he inserted his hand into his soul, why was he only repeating those words?
"Give it back, give it back!"
The ape started to turn furious as its deflated head started to return to normal proportions, his brown fur started to slowly change color from brown to a dull crimson as his aura intensified while he glared at Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin looked at what was happening with an interested look on his face as he said:
"Oho? What's this?"
Ukog's soul fused with the white skull as it started to morph from a human one into an ape one, his body suddenly started to reconstruct immediately on the spot but instead of a human body, it was a red-haired ape body!
The ape snarled at him as its muscles flexed and its cultivation skyrocketed to the 3rd stair of the God Realm, it started to beat its chest as it wanted to go on a rampage!
Yun Jhin took another look at the ape's body then clapped as he said:
"I don't think I want to see what you are capable of so I will have to stop you here."
Yun Jhin waved his hand as the blood river beneath him started to bubble.

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Learning a special technique (2)
chapters.content:
The bubbling blood river beneath Yun Jhin and the red-haired ape started to morph, out of the river two gigantic blood hands rose and tried to clamp on the body of the ape who was trying to go on a rampage.
Yun Jhin chuckled as the hands clamped on the ape's body making it as mobile as it could get, while it was indeed struggling in the grasp of the bloody hands but no matter what it did it couldn't get free.
He closed into the ape's face as he put his hand on its neck and started to crush it slowly making it let out whimpers of pain.
No matter how hard it struggled to try to escape from the gigantic hands which were keeping it bound there nothing worked! It even tried to bite at Yun Jhin's hand which was continuously increasing its grip strength trying to cut Ukog's oxygen supply, while his cultivation returned Yun Jhin only needed to short-circuit again for him to become a 'normal person' again.
His transformation gave him a huge strength boost but in front of Yun Jhin's already impressive strength combined with his home advantage that made him able to make a peak God Realm expert run away, there was no chance for Ukog to even kill himself!
"I'm getting bored of this, while it's a little bit enjoyable to see your pained face it already got old after the first few hours,
JUST SPILL IT OUT ALREADY!
"
Yun Jhin created a mind shockwave that he inserted into the ape's head expanding it at multiple degrees trying to shake his soul open so he could search through his memories, he was very obstinate to the point that Yun Jhin already got annoyed with him!
"TELL ME WHAT I WANT TO KNOW!"
Yun Jhin words inserted themselves in the primate's brain like they were hot knives as it started to cry out, wanting to clutch his head in pain but couldn't due to the bloody hands keeping him straight as a lamp post.
"This is enough..."
Yun Jhin finally started to crack onto his psyche as the torture reached another level, the ape started to mutter in human language and Yun Jhin remembered everything that it said, all of its memories being transferred to Yun Jhin.
"Hm... I see I see!"
The teleportation technique was a very unique ancient technique that the ape found when he was a child, he found it with Yuan Fang's help and due to that he became one of his cronies, Yuan Fang was an insidious reincarnate one so he easily tricked Ukog into signing a permanent contract with him.
The technique itself wasn't complicated but hard to use, one had to concentrate on the energy codes of the person that they wanted to teleport to, and that meant their energy code had to be perfectly memorized, or else they wouldn't be able to teleport to that person, it also wouldn't work with places and only with people, so if Yun Jhin wanted to teleport from Galaxy to Galaxy and the Galaxy had no living beings that he knew he wouldn't be able to teleport there.
However, the energy consumption of the technique didn't go accordingly with the distance traveled which meant that no matter the distance traveled it would consume the same amount of ki!
But that was depending on the sensing capabilities of the user, Yun Jhin could currently sense around 3 Galaxies distance away which was around a few trillion kilometers in total but that didn't mean he could pick out a certain energy code from the massive amount of living people in these galaxies, while he could focus on one he wouldn't be able to pick it out if they were at the sage realm and below so he could teleport randomly to people if he wanted to as long as he memorized their energy code properly.
Yun Jhin's eyes were sparkling as he looked at the ape in front of him, it seemed that he truly destroyed his psyche as he continued to mutter without stop, he practically became crazy after Yun Jhin was done with him but that didn't mean his psyche was unhealable, for God Realm experts there wasn't such as thing as unhealable!
However he still wanted to know how Duritz had been captured by Yuan Fang's claws, he was a strong monster that was more talented than Yuan Fang himself, his battle power was even a tad higher than his!
He continued to listen to his muttering and when it came to Duritz he immediately listened more closely to understand everything.
"Oh, so that's how it happened?"
Unlike Ukog's situation, Duritz was a very prideful person, he was the prince of a certain newly born race in the celestial realm, Yuan Fang had put a lot of time and work into making Duritz his, he first infiltrated the race and worked his way up the ranks until he became Duritz's trusted advisor, then he poisoned him during a war meeting before asking for his services in exchange for the antidote.
The finer details were omitted as Yuan Fang didn't tell Ukog everything, Ukog was also there at the time and he heard bits and pieces of what happened while he was hiding around the race's auxiliary tribes.
The race's experts were extremely mad at Yuan Fang's treachery so he was chased away into the lower mortal realm, that was the sole reason Yuan Fang wasn't in the celestial realm anymore, after all, from Yun Jhin's knowledge the celestial realm had the best environment for ascension beyond the God Realm.
****************************
Yuan Fang gritted his teeth as he felt his connection to Ukog's soul blurring out, that meant his soul was either extremely damaged or he died!
Duritz didn't say anything as he stood there in their hideout, everything was dark around them and the only two visible people were the two of them.
"Did Ukog spill everything out, Boss?"
Yuan Fang sighed:
"Of course he did, no matter how high his willpower is Yun Jhin's methods are too good, I didn't experience them personally but I heard a lot of things about them, our wheels are officially gone and Yun Jhin had gained a strong chasing ability now amongst with some info that might help him or not..."
Duritz frowned as he asked:
"Do you think he would want to report us to the Sai tribe in the celestial realm?"
Yuan Fang didn't know what to say, Yun Jhin didn't know how to get to the celestial realm previously but he would surely get the way in with Ukog's memories, and you knew the saying, the enemy of my enemy is my friend, while he left to the lower realms to escape the pursuit of the Sai tribe for 'kidnapping and brainwashing' their prince, they only left him alone because he changed his identity and energy code after he arrived in the lower realms.
"Will I have to run in Hell now?"
Yuan Fang frowned as he didn't know that Yun Jhin destroyed the entrance to hell, Duritz interjected:
"Most likely we can't run there boss, you should know that Yun Jhin has the monopoly over the entrance, and going to his headquarters means certain death!"
"We can't even wait it out for the entrance to change coordinates... as I know Yun Jhin he must already raring to go to the celestial realm! But that means he would have to leave his headquarters open, he doesn't know that the connection between avatar and the main body is cut when one arrives in the celestial realm so this could be to our advantage!"
A cut connection between the avatar and body of the God realm expert would reduce the power of the avatar to around 20% of its original.
************************
Yun Jhin waited until there was no more information than he could squeeze out of the poor Ukog before he cracked his neck and absorbed his soul power, now that he had no more uses he could absorb his soul properly as he couldn't get anything more out of him considering that at the God Realm memory extraction through soul absorption wouldn't work at enemies of similar cultivation, the moment someone attempted that their memories would implode and disappear as a self-defense mechanism.
Yun Jhin looked at the ceiling of the cave as he pondered something intensely, he had a hand on his chin as he thought:
"The celestial realm... the realm closest to leaving this wretched mortal life behind... the power of true immortality lies in there... this is most likely the reason Yuan Fang knew about the uses of the two world trees, unfortunately for him, he already used one seed too early and he needs to wait now."
"I guess there's no beating around the bush anymore... if I leave my avatar here everything should be ok, but just to be sure I will teach the defensive mechanism control to Marthon."
Yun Jhin was making preparations to leave the sect behind safely as he had other thoughts after getting his hands on the condition to open the celestial realm gates along with their location!

chapters.title: Chapter 209: The entrance to the celestial realm (1)
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was finishing the preparations to leave the sect when Marthon came to him with some inquiries about the expansion expeditions that they had sent out already:
"Master, should we cancel all of the expeditions considering you will leave for an unknown period of time?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he told him:
"No, they will know something is wrong if they see my expansion efforts suddenly stop and they will inquire about my situation one way or another, continue the efforts until we cannot physically 'swallow' any more territory, this way they wouldn't think anything when we retreat our troops and stabilize our situation, even though I have thought you cultivation it seems I need to teach you more on how to think strategically or else this sect will go to ruin when I will leave."
Marthon kneeled in front of Yun Jhin as he heard his words, he would never want to disappoint him as he started kowtowing while saying that he would surely learn everything that he needed to keep the sect flourishing.
Yun Jhin told him to get up then left him to do what he was told.
"Things are progressing along nicely... there's only a little bit of time left and I should be able to leave."
As Yun Jhin was finishing his business around the sect Yuan Fang was antsy to run away from the mortal realm.
************************
Yuan Fang felt like thousands of fire ants were drilling in his brain as he waited for news of Yun Jhin's departure, he would occasionally glare at the nothingness in front of him as he waited, and finally after a long while of waiting some news were sent back.
"He is continuing his expansion attempts? Hmph, this is just a front so he could fool the other old-timers, if I wasn't a wanted man I would have gone straight to the Brilliance Radiance and Light sect to denounce him."
Yuan Fang thought that the time to make his move would come soon enough as he was finishing his preparations.
*****************
Yun Jhin was ready to leaves as he took another look at the meteorite under his feet and then disappeared as if he was never there, he wasn't particularly fond of the sect, he found it just another means to an end as it made it easier for him to gain resources and standing in society with the help of the sect.
Yun Jhin started to locate the entrance to the celestial realm with the technique from Ukog's memories.
The entrance to the celestial realm was unlike the one to Hell in the sense that it was always stationary but this led to the question of how no one was able to find it up till now.
From what Yun Jhin understood the gate was made from a special material that only those who visited the celestial realm could sense, the gate could also hide so well to the point that even if you stood in front of it you would never be able to see it if you didn't qualify.
The actual location of the gate was in a desolate galaxy that no one lived in, that was also one of the reasons that no one had found it up till now.
Yun Jhin arrival in the galaxy didn't trigger any attention as he travelled stealthily along with the fact that he didn't tell anyone about the fact that he would leave besides Marthon meant that there was no chance for anyone to know about his absence, he already left his avatar at the sect so even if they attacked they would be reduced to a state where they couldn't penetrate the outer layer of the sect.
As Yun Jhin searched through the empty galaxy for the gate to the celestial realm Yuan Fang finally was going to make his move!
Yuan Fang and Duritz's disguised bodies appeared at the entrance of the blood throne sect as they wanted to infiltrate as rogue cultivators who wanted to join the sect.
The guarding disciple at the outer layer of the sect who was just doing his job regularly looked at the two of them and said in a monotone voice:
"The sect is currently full and takes no more applicants, you can go to a branch sect and join there."
He had to deal with this type of stuff so much time that he had no more emotion in his voice when he said it.
Yuan Fang came forward and said with a smile on his face:
"Ah but you see we are the people that your sect master would look for, our talent is through the roof!"
The guarding disciple sighed, there were tons of people who said the same thing to him and when they took the talent test they ended up being either average or just a little bit above which wasn't anything that Yun Jhin was looking for.
But it was his job and he couldn't deny those two hopeful disciples their right of being tested.
They walked into the formation and the formation immediately started to shine with a glaring red light that resembled viscous blood, the moment they entered the formation bounds Yun Jhin's avatar opened its eyes as he felt rather puzzled:
"They are here? Did their brains short-circuit?"
Yun Jhin's avatar couldn't find any of Yuan Fang's current actions to look sane, even though he might have gotten wind of his main body leaving that didn't mean he couldn't return... it was true that he couldn't use his new technique as the distance between the empty galaxy and where the blood throne sect laid was beyond three galaxies and too far away for Yun Jhin's current capabilities to teleport it wouldn't take him much time to cross that distance and teleport back.
What did they think they could do in such a short time, they might not even be able to enter the sect if he disallowed them too!
But he wanted to see what they were up to so he decided to let them inside as new special 'recruits'.
He didn't care if they went on a rampage and killed people or destroyed buildings as long as he could capture them it would be worth it.
Their research value was off the chars both of them being from the celestial realm!
Yun Jhin watched as they were outfitted with the sect's colours and how they melded in with the crowd that were either out to trade or just relax, as time passed they both disappeared as they appeared in the deeper parts of the sect where they revealed themselves.
Yuan Fang looked around puzzled as he sent a mental message to Duritz:
"This was the location of the portal to hell right? Why is it missing?"
Duritz moved his shoulders indicating that he didn't know, his memory wasn't failing him so the portal must have disappeared!
Yun Jhin realized what they wanted to do the moment they arrived at that peculiar location, he had a smile on his face that he couldn't conceal as he sent them a direct message:
"Looking for the entrance to hell?"
Yuan Fang started to shake as he heard Yun Jhin's voice coming from everywhere around him, he thought that he would be able to jump into the portal and leave before Yun Jhin could identify him and Duritz but the portal disappeared!
His eyes reddened as he glanced at Duritz and sent him another message:
"Do it!"
In Duritz's eyes a hint of reluctance flashed before his form started to morph, he grew to ten meters tall as his muscles inflated to gigantic proportions according to his size, his hair turned white as his body started whitening but his aura increased to the point that Yun Jhin's avatar felt extremely threatened by it!
Yuan Fang shook his head seeing Duritz's situation and started to run away!
Duritz went on a rampage destroying palaces with abandon and killing whoever he could get his hands on, he would chop them up with his hands then open his mouth and absorb their quintessence in himself recovering his albeit crippled form.
Yun Jhin's avatar eyes narrowed as he appeared above the sect, Yuan Fang couldn't be caught if he wanted to take care of Duritz, the man already disappeared going god knows where and Yun Jhin's avatar couldn't split its attention into two fronts at the moment.
"Coming looking for wool and going home shorn."
Yun Jhin shook his head, they wanted to escape using Hell's entrance knowing that he wouldn't want to follow them in due to Hell's willpower being antagonistic against him but they didn't know that he was able to destroy the portal, normally an average God Realm cultivator couldn't destroy or even seal the entrance but Yun Jhin had the methods that he had kept hidden from the eyes of others for such a long time that they didn't even know that some of those methods even existed.
Looking at the rampaging giant in front of him made Yun Jhin frown, his strength was both faltering and increasing at the same time as he ate Yun Jhin's people but Yun Jhin didn't stop him immediately as he closed his eyes and started to move his hands from down to up just like a flowing river.
Out of the cracks in the meteorite, blood started to seep out continuously as the underground river burst forth!
Yun Jhin's avatar had summoned the blood river from the cave so he could fight with it, in this situation he knew that he wouldn't be able to fight this behemoth in front of him with his normal capabilities, not even his main body would be able to do that!
He sacrificed his lifespan to the point that he might fall over and die any moment for this burst of strength, and he wanted to continue keeping Yun Jhin occupied by recovering his life span with bloody sacrifices.
Yun Jhin's avatar eyes hardened as it looked over at Duritz's gigantic form and he engulfed himself in the bloody river as a transformation started to occur as a cocoon appeared!
Duritz felt immense danger as he glanced towards the blood-red cocoon that was hovering in mid-air, his eyes flashed as he lunged towards it ready to crack it open and kill Yun Jhin's avatar which was transforming inside!

chapters.title: Chapter 210: The entrance to the celestial realm (2)
chapters.content:
Duritz could feel the cocoon start to shake the closer he got to it when suddenly a spiked hand-inserted itself in his stomach coming out his back and still going for around 20 more meters before it stopped elongating.
Duritz didn't say anything nor did he react as he took a hold of the spiked hand and tried to take it out of his stomach forcefully.
The cocoon broke open, a bloody gigantic monster that was full of spikes came out, it had a shell that made it look like a hedgehog but inside it was Yun Jhin's avatar which was controlling the whole thing.
The monster roared as its spikes started to shoot from its body and inserted themselves directly into the vital parts of Duritz's body.
As the spikes entered the gigantic body they started to dissolve as they softened and entered his body as a liquid through the newly generated gaps.
Duritz could feel his body starting to move by itself as Yun Jhin's avatar moved his hands accordingly making him feel like a puppet on strings!
It wasn't a good feeling for him, he already hated being under contract for Yuan Fang and that he had to sacrifice himself because of his master's foolishness, who would know that Yun Jhin was able to destroy the entrance to hell?
The fact was that Yun Jhin could only destroy it because he was so familiar with hell considering he had its willpower inside him for some time combined with his wealth of experience and techniques was the sole reason he could destroy the entrance.
While Yuan Fang knew that Yun Jhin became antagonistic with the denizens of hell he didn't have all of the details, he didn't have a perfect information network even though it was considerably wide.
Duritz's aura intensified as he howled to the sky trying to destroy the bindings that were currently installing themselves in his blood.
Yun Jhin's blood technique was very toxic and it could infiltrate the bloodstream of those that it infected very quickly if it reached his heart he would become Yun Jhin's puppet permanently!
Yun Jhin's monster started to sag as if it's lost most of its energy, while the attack was rather deadly the toll on the blood river's energy reserves was rather huge, however, the monster started to become revitalized immediately as the disciples below started to throw herbs, vials and other things into the monster.
The monster's revitalization was slow but its strength increase was obvious as it wasn't sagging anymore, it started to move closer to Duritz's immobilized body slowly trying to take over it with the help of the seeds that he already planted inside him.
Duritz's body started to shake as he tried to expunge the blood that infiltrated his body but he was already at his wit's end, his already short lifespan was running on fumes every second he wasn't devouring any life force.
Duritz could feel his eyes getting heavier as his body was slowly starting to shrink to normal proportions, he shook his head one last time, he had finished his contract with Yuan Fang and saved his life... he was done here.
