Yun Jhin dissipated the monster of blood as it seeped through the cracks in the earth back into the underground cave leaving it there to regain its used energy.
The avatar hovered over Duritz's body which was slowly transforming into ashes as the overdraft life force was destroying him at a cellular level.
His arm directly went into his chest and extracted his heart before pumping it full of ki resuscitating it slowly, the severed heart started beating as blood dribbled down on it stopping its decay and transformation into ashes.
Yun Jhin smiled seeing the heart and then burst into laughter as he disappeared back into the cave below, he had some things to do...
The deaths of the disciples didn't affect Yun Jhin much, around 500,000 died by consumption while quite a lot of them got just injured, it was a pretty good outcome considering he had gained the heart of Duritz who was originally from the celestial realm and he had high research potential.
It was unknown if Yun Jhin could actually reach the celestial realm so it was better to have something else to rely on.
********************
Yun Jhin's main body had been informed about the actions of the duo but it couldn't care less as it was looking for the entrance around the abandoned galaxy.
His senses were tingling the further he flew into the galaxy but he still couldn't find the entrance!
It was as if something was making him unable to reach the place, something was blocking him and he didn't like it!
He concentrated with as much power as he could but he couldn't see anything regardless if he arrived at the location in Ukog's memory or tried to search somewhere else, there was nothing in this galaxy!
He had been running through the whole galaxy at extreme speeds looking through every nook and cranny to find nothing!
But Ukog's memories wouldn't lie, he frowned as he suddenly got some information from his avatar, Duritz had been taken care of and the only one that remained was Yuan Fang and his other cronies that he didn't get to meet, but he guessed that they would be way weaker than Duritz and Ukog if he didn't care to bring them with him when he tried to escape to hell.
Yun Jhin creased brows started to relax as he heard that his avatar got the heart of Duritz... Duritz's tribe could be considered somewhat of royalty in the celestial realm, while it wasn't any high-type of royalty like a ruler of big land, they were still of noble blood, maybe he could use his heart to find the entrance and open it?
Yun Jhin sent a message for his avatar to teleport to him using Ukog's technique which he didn't bother to name.
It took around 5 days for the avatar to arrive with the heart, it looked a healthy red as it was passed to Yun Jhin's main body within a glass container, the heart was beating strongly as it started to react to its surroundings.
Suddenly light started to shine in front of Yun Jhin, the light was of bright blue color and it shined so strongly that it stung Yun Jhin's eyes, which was rather impressive considering Yun Jhin could place his eyeballs in a small sun and they still wouldn't sting at all at his current level.
Yun Jhin protected his sight as he looked away and when the light disappeared he could see a bright blue gate made of unknown materials to Yun Jhin, it was half-opened and the closer Yun Jhin put the heart the more the gate opened, but the moment Yun Jhin tried to step through the door it almost closed with him in it!
Yun Jhin frowned as he took a few steps backward, if he didn't retreat at an opportune time he would have been crushed in the door and who knew what would have happened?
Was his bloodline seen through by the gate? Was it only reacting to Duritz's heart?
Yun Jhin's face scrunched up as he realized that he might not be able to visit the celestial realm as there was no way for him to transplant Duritz's bloodline in his body only with his heart alone, while the heart was good for research it wouldn't be useful for experiments.
It had a good amount of DNA but not good enough for Yun Jhin to work his magic with, even though he had evolved accordingly to a different type of human, one that was both devilish and celestial at the same time with the help of the knowledge that he had gotten from observing the system at work, that didn't mean that his bloodline was recognized by the door in front of him.
From what he could see the moment the door scanned his bloodline and it didn't find it in its database it would close itself immediately, so while it scanned both Duritz's bloodline and his at the same time meant that he couldn't go even if he held Duritz's heart.
If he transplanted it to his body it wouldn't bring him Duritz's bloodline nor would it change his to something that would resemble anything in the door's database.
Yun Jhin glared at the door before sighing and shaking his head left and right, his avatar slowly returned to his body fusing with it, he put the glass container which stored Duritz's heart back into his spatial dimension before taking one more glance at the disappearing celestial entrance before gritting his teeth and leaving.
He put two fingers on his forehead as he started to concentrate on the nearest energy code that he knew before disappearing... it seemed the celestial realm was still out of Yun Jhin's grasp for now... but he would come back as he only gave up on it temporarily.

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Experiments
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin had already set some 'beacons' that could help him teleport through the galaxies, strong individuals from the sect that he left around on certain planets so he could easily teleport from one to another and shorten the time he needed to travel through the universe.
He hadn't been able to install such people on many planets but he already had quite a few of them here and there, there were around 100 planets that had people that Yun Jhin planted and he could move quickly around 6 to 7 galaxies in a matter of minutes, however, if he wanted to spread even further he needed stronger people as sage realm experts wouldn't really do the trick only if they were at the peak and Yun Jhin memorized their energy code perfectly.
After some continuous teleportations Yun Jhin finally returned to the sect, he felt defeated inside, almost depressed.
He really wanted to see how the celestial realm looked with his own eyes and also absorb its pure energy directly, while he could still cultivate with it, as he could still summon celestial energy, he was sure that what he was summoning couldn't be considered even a drop in a bucket, in both quality and quantity.
Yun Jhin sighed as he appeared in the underground cave and laid down in the blood river closing his eyes he started to meditate while lying face up floating in the river.
"What could I do to register my bloodline in the database of the door?"
Yun Jhin's thoughts started to whirl in his mind, was there any chance he would be able to insert his bloodline in that door? There were very low chances if he analyzed everything directly, the celestial realm formation techniques and teleportation techniques should be very advanced if he compared them to the ones of the mortal realm, for example, the teleportation technique that Yun Jhin took from Ukog was from the celestial realm and in the mortal realm, Yun Jhin would have never been able to get such a technique.
As he laid down in the blood river a lightbulb suddenly appeared over his head as he got an idea:
"Duritz's heart... maybe I could?"
While he couldn't transfer the heart to his body to gain the bloodline he could create another body from it!
Yun Jhin eyes started to light up as he got out of the blood river none of the sticky blood being on his body, he took in a deep breath as he took the heart out of his spatial dimension then took it out of its container.
The heartbeat was at normal speeds and he could feel that there was a chance for his plan to succeed.
Yun Jhin started to wave his hands into the air as a blood pillar rose from the river and started to morph into the form of Duritz, slowly but surely Yun Jhin was sculpting a new body in Duritz's image made entirely from the blood of the river.
The face, the attitude, the long blonde hair in his normal form, Yun Jhin captured everything as he modeled it exactly after Duritz, afterward he gently took the heart from his hands and inserted it directly into the chest of the blood sculpture which suddenly hardened.
The hardening was instant the moment that Yun Jhin retrieved his hand from the sculpture, then its bloody design started to change as the color started to change to a pale white, Yun Jhin started to smile as the body started to shake then suddenly stopped moving.
A blank expression appeared on the new bodies' face, it lacked a soul so it was pretty much a puppet to Yun Jhin.
But from its body, bloody colored energy could be felt and it was the bloodline aura of Duritz!
However Yun Jhin wasn't done yet, he wanted to enter personally in the celestial realm and not use a clone, his face suddenly started to scrunch up as a piece of purple and green colored light ripped away from Yun Jhin's main soul and slowly entered into the shell that stood in front of him.
The shell started to shake and move then it looked into Yun Jhin's eyes and smiled as it saluted properly.
Yun Jhin had split a part of his soul and inserted it into the new shell to create an out of body incarnation so he would be able to visit the celestial realm while his main body would expand in the mortal realm and keep cultivating.
The out of body incarnation was basically Duritz but with Yun Jhin's mind and a subservient attitude to the main body.
"Ok, I shall call you Yun Duritz from now on, you should already know what you are supposed to do but first let's help you with your cultivation."
Considering the body was brand new it had no cultivation and even though it had a rank of around 4,000 due to it being constructed from the blood river it wasn't considered strong if it was pitted against a cultivator at the ki cultivating realm and above.
Yun Jhin knowledge of cultivation was really vast so he immediately created a formation above Yuan Duritz then started to pump cultivation resources into him, Duritz having all of the cultivation knowledge from Yun Jhin's soul fragment made it rather easily as he cultivated accordingly to the memories as the resources poured into his body and he quickly started to jump in cultivation...
Time passed slowly but surely... as months passed the cultivation of the out of body incarnation increased daily, the earthly realm... the heavenly realm, the ki cultivating realm, the king realm, the emperor realm, and it stopped only after it reached around the 3rd stage of the sage realm.
While Yun Jhin had an immense amount of cultivation resources he still didn't have enough to make a God Realm person immediately, it took around 5 years of cultivation for his out of body incarnation to reach the 3rd stage of the sage realm and that was only because he fed it resources continuously like a farmer would feed a pig and he also had the passive boost coming from the blood river.
Yun Jhin ended up out of materials that could be useful for those at the sage realm and above as he continuously fed Yun Duritz so even if he wanted to make him cultivate more it was impossible currently, however, the sage realm was enough for the celestial realm, after all, Duritz, Ukog and Yuan Fang were around the same level when he met them the first time.
Even though they left the celestial realm because they were chased, it was mostly because of Yuan Fang, so if Yun Jhin returned as Duritz in disguise he would be able to take control of a strong noble power directly as the direct descendant and prince of the tribe.
Yun Jhin laughed as he slapped Yun Duritz's shoulder and told him to leave.
Yun Duritz nodded as he put two fingers on his forehead and disappeared with a 'pop' sound just like a bubble being broken.
****************
Yun Duritz appeared at the same location where Yun Jhin found the door to the celestial realm, as he got closer and closer to the certain location he could feel his body heat up and his blood rushing through his body, his heart started beating faster and faster and the same azure light started to appear ahead of him.
He shielded his eyes for a few moments until the light died down before he could see the door being fully opened in front of him!
It was seemingly inviting him, the one of noble blood back to the celestial realm, it was as Yun Jhin guessed, as long as he had the needed bloodline the door would open easily for him.
Yun Duritz laughed as he propelled his body directly into the door then the door closed abruptly as his silhouette disappeared into it, the galaxy returned to its blank and gritty look as meteor fragments would from time to time pass by and hit each other transforming into dust...
Yun Duritz felt his head spin as if 100 hammers were hitting him directly on the brain and 100 bells were ringing in his ears, he started to get nauseous as he suddenly vomited on the ground in front of him without warning.
He got up as he looked around and found himself in a beautiful forest the trees had azure leaves the animals around were gorgeous, a bear with a line pattern with red fur, he was looking at Yun Duritz weirdly as he saw his vomit on the ground.
Yun Duritz cleaned his mouth with the sleeves of his robe and took another look around, besides the bear that was looking weirdly at him some blue cute parrots were chattering with one another and pointing their wings at him from time to time.
"So this was the celestial realm?"

chapters.title: Chapter 212: The celestial realm
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's main body woke up suddenly, he looked around and then clenched his chest as he felt something being cut off from him, he frowned as he realized that he couldn't communicate with his out of body incarnation anymore.
He could still perceive its existence which meant it didn't die however he couldn't exert any more influence over it, he couldn't give it ki nor talk with it, if it got into a perilous situation he wouldn't be able to save it.
He sighed, it seemed that the celestial realm was either a higher dimension or a sealed one, or maybe even both.
Right now he didn't know what would happen to his out-of-body incarnation but considering it had the looks, aura, and bloodline of Duritz, as long as he made his way to his ancestral home he should be able to end up well...
********************
Yun Duritz felt light-headed as he saw the bear that was looking at him, it seemed that it was an intelligent beast and it seemed to be amused?
He got up from the ground as he ignored the bear that was looking at him as if he was a clown, he didn't have time to entertain the local wildlife and from his cultivation fluctuations, he was just a weakling at the ki cultivating realm, he didn't care about such weak beings at this moment, considering it was smart and it didn't get in his way he would let it live.
The bear knew that laughing at someone like this was risky but most of the celestial realm people could be considered peaceful, at least the bear never met someone who would attack him because he laughed at him, he might get a scolding or even a beating but he wouldn't be attacked with the intent to kill, it just couldn't help itself.
Yun Duritz started to move through the forest and found himself quickly lost, as he walked in the well-lit forest he found himself to be in a type of tree maze, the further he walked in the more he found himself unable to differentiate left from right.
He found what happened to be very strange as he had a great sense of direction, could his body not be adapted to the laws of the celestial realm yet?
Naturally, the body shouldn't have been rejected by the laws as it had the full bloodline of Duritz flowing inside of it, it didn't matter that the body was made from the blood river as Yun Jhin only created a heartless shell, if the shell had a different heart and Yun Jhin transplanted Duritz's into it, it could have been a problem.
Yun Duritz clutched his head as he felt an intense pain in it, it came directly from the soul fragment that acted as the controller of the body, it felt like his connection to the main body was slowly being removed by the laws of this world and he could feel somewhat strange, however, his thoughts didn't change much besides that he wasn't able to communicate with his counterpart anymore.
Yun Duritz ignored the changes that were happening to his psyche as there was nothing he could do in this situation.
For now, he wanted to get out of this forest and find some civilization as he wanted to return to Duritz's clan and take over it slowly, sooner or later he would be able to open the gate directly and invite his main body in the celestial realm!
He decided to stop wandering through the forest as there was nothing he could do until his sense of direction turned back to normal, for now, he decided to cultivate as he sensed the plentiful and pure energy around him.
Yun Duritz took in deep breaths as he felt his senses clearing up the more he cultivated, his stagnant cultivation started to stir again as the pure azure energy went through his body and circulated through his ki pathways at quick speeds accordingly to the cultivation technique he practiced.
Yun Duritz felt his head clearing up, the energy here compared to the mortal realm was like the difference between heaven and earth, but considering this place had the word 'celestial' in it, it would be quite disappointing if it didn't have high-quality ki filled environment.
As he stabilized his situation he could feel that his cultivation also broke through rather quickly to the 4th stage and if he continued cultivating he might even reach the 5th stage before he left the forest!
As his body acclimatized to the environment of the realm he felt just like a fish back in the water, his power was also increasing every moment he cultivated, his internal substructure was changing every moment to adapt to the bloodline in his body, while his body gained the bloodline of Duritz, it didn't fully assimilate it yet but with the help of the celestial energy, his body was changing to reach the same level that Duritz reached when he was alive!
Yun Duritz's breath stopped for a few seconds then he got back to his feet as he stopped cultivating, his eyes changed to a deep azure color as his blonde hair reached waist length, it was spiky and though, even though his face and body resembled Duritz's his hair and eyes weren't the same up till now.
He stretched his whole body as his bones started to crack making sounds that scared some of the natural fauna around.
Yun Duritz could feel that his body refining improvement was huge due to the changes the bloodline was doing to his body, it was even stronger than the normal body refiners level, if a normal body refiner at the 7,000 ranks had the power level of 1,000 then Yun Duritz's power level would be 2,000 at the same level.
He was 2x stronger body-wise due to his bloodline alone!
He felt like there was more potential to this out of body incarnation than things let on, it might even be able to help him with his ascendance!
He shook his head after this thought went through his mind, it was too early to think about that, now that his sense of direction returned he started to make sense of this forest as he navigated through it and tried to leave.
The forest wasn't extremely big but it was still the same size as the blood throne sect and considering he wasn't at the God Realm anymore it would take him a little bit more time to leave the place.
*******************
In the northern direction 150,000 kilometers away from the forest a big city existed, it was full of nicely decorated streets and tall yellow buildings that glowed in the afterglow of the sun in the afternoon.
In the biggest and most decorated building in the city, a man was kneeling to a tall blonde haired woman, her assets were so big that anyone who looked at them wouldn't be able to tear their eyes away, she was more on the heavy side and she wore a tight-fitting outfit that didn't look to be a good match on her.
The man told her in a serious tone:
"It seems someone has returned from the mortal realm, it's strange considering almost no one had gone through the gate in the last 50 years unless we count that traitor who kidnapped the young master."
The tall woman hummed as she thought about it, it couldn't be the traitor as he was too smart and insidious to return to the celestial realm so soon, as things haven't settled down yet.
Then her eyes started to shine as she thought of something else:
"Could it be our little Duritz? Could have he escaped from that insidious man's control?"
The man continued kneeling as he didn't say anything, he didn't want to give his lady false hope.
*****************
Yun Duritz finally left the forest after a few hours of navigating through it and then he met head to head with a troop of people that were patrolling around, Yun Duritz used his stealth technique as he sensed people ahead and waited nearby one of the trees for them to leave:
"Let's get this going stop lazing around you dogs!"
"Oy captain why are you so tense? No one ever uses the door from the mortal realm, there is literally no chance for anyone to come, this is a leisure job."
"While it's true you know that if we don't at least put up a little work we might be changed from our position, how many top-grade spirit stones have you used to get this easy post?"
"Sheesh man just relax a little, what could happen?"
Suddenly a ringing sound was heard as the captain of the patrol took out an inscribed bamboo piece from his clothes and started talking into it, after a short while he started to give orders:
"There is a chance our young prince is back, encircle the forest but don't attract the attention of the person who used the portal as it might not be our prince, we first need to identify the person before we take further actions."
The man who was talking about taking it easy finally found out that this job wasn't all easy as he was made to encircle the gigantic forest with their troops which wasn't possible at all!
"I know about your doubts but there are only a few exits that you can take from this maze-like forest, actually we are near one right now."
Yun Duritz knew that with his current identity he wouldn't find trouble if he revealed himself to the troops so he slowly made himself look like he just exited the forest.
The captain immediately recognized his face and wild hairstyle, his face sprang up as if he saw a relative and quickly came towards him to give Yun Duritz a big hug.

chapters.title: Chapter 213: Playing it off as amnesia
chapters.content:
Seeing the burly captain of the patrol approaching him made Yun Duritz feel quite unsettled visibly, seeing how he didn't feel well with the captain approaching him, the man took two steps backward and asked surprised:
"Duritz, you still remember me, don't you? We were friends in our childhood."
Yun Duritz moved his head from side to side as he clutched it while he looked at the man.
This made the patrol captain feel something wasn't right as he tried to approach him again and said:
"It's me, Lin Lang, you really can't remember me?"
"Not really... I just know that I had to enter the door that was calling me, I don't know you, I actually don't know where I am..."
Lin Lang looked at Duritz and analyzed him but there was no mistake, he looked exactly like the young prince he used to hang out with back when he didn't have so many things to do, his father was a strong general under the former leader of the city so he was quite close with Duritz, they could almost be counted as cousins.
Seeing that he was forgotten made him quite sad as he tried to pat Duritz on the shoulder but the man took two steps backward with a strange look on his face as he looked into Lin Lang's eyes.
"It's true... it seems you can't remember me but it makes sense if you consider the circumstances you have been through, your cultivation didn't even increase much since you left and it been such a long time, you should have reached at least the God Realm up till now no matter how poor the resources of the mortal realm were..."
Yun Duritz took a step towards Lin Lang and asked with a curious tone:
"You know who I am?"
Lin Lang smiled, it seemed that while Duritz lost his memories he was still the same curious man that he ever was Lin Lang guessed that since Duritz couldn't sense any malice from the troops he decided to trust them considering they talked as if they knew him.
"It seems you haven't changed much old friend, let's get you back to the city so you can talk with our older sister as she might be able to retrieve some of your lost memories."
Yun Duritz took a few steps forward and decided to follow them reluctantly on the surface but inside he was gloating at how easy it was, when he got back to the city he would be able to get his hands on the resources specific to the celestial realm and jump his cultivation speed and in the end, he would take over the whole city creating a base in the celestial realm that he might be able to use in the future to send in his main body.
Time passed pretty slowly as the captain took Yun Duritz and traveled with him to the city of their Lin clan, so to not get bored he decided to try and make him remember some things.
He pointed at a nearby waterfall and whispered to Duritz:
"Remember when we went there to peek at the most beautiful gem in our city, Sun Min?"
Yun Duritz shook his head as he took a closer look at the waterfall and said:
"Was I really a guy that would peek at girls when they bath?"
Lin Lang laughed awkwardly as he continued the journey, it seemed that trying to awaken his memories with his boy memories wouldn't work.
Then he looked towards the nearby prairie that they were passing and said:
"Remember when you hunted your first animal in the prairie with your dad and my dad?"
Duritz made an expression that looked as if he was remembering something, as he looked at one peculiar rabbit that went by he pointed at it and asked:
"Was it this type of animal?"
Lin Lang face changed as he became disappointed and shook his head as he said:
"No, it was a Three-headed celestial lion, your deceased father was very happy to see that you inherited the strongest bloodline in the family and he declared you a man that day, you really can't remember? When we talked after we returned to the city you said that you would never forget that day because it was the day you were given the title of man by your father directly, you were also appointed as the direct prince and descendant of the Lin guarding family of the east."
"That truly sounds important... but I cannot remember it, maybe something really strange happened to me while I was in the mortal realm?"
"You wouldn't know the first half of it brother Duritz... if I could get my hands on that traitorous snake Yuan Fang I would surely torture him for 10,000 years!"
Yun Duritz knew what was going through Lin Lang's mind at the moment, it was obvious as he glared at nothing while spacing out for a few seconds on their journey.
After a few hours of traveling, they finally reached the city where they were immediately ushered into the biggest house after the guards at the entrance of the city saw Yun Duritz's appearance.
As Yun Duritz entered the big house along with Lin Lang he could feel eyes hidden everywhere in the house targeting him, most of them were surprised, and there were very few who were glad and there were also some that gave off the impression that resembled hatred and disappointment.
Yun Duritz walked further into the house until he reached a special place where the tall blonde haired heavy-set woman was, she was sitting on a chair made specifically for her big frame, when she saw Duritz her eyes started to water up as she quickly ran towards him and gave him a bone-crushing hug as she cried out:
"Lil broooooo, I missed you so much, you even made me take over as the descendant of the family because you have been kidnapped by that insidious fellow! Don't ever leave your big sis again!"
Yun Duritz felt his strong bones actually cracking the moment this woman put her full strength in the hug, her body refining rate was capped at the 10,000 ranks and her cultivation base was at the middle stages of the God Realm!
Yun Duritz face started to turn blue as his oxygen supply was cut off by the strong hug and seeing that this was happening made the woman give up on her hug as she said:
"It seems you haven't grown strong at all under the lead of that guy, but it's obvious he must have sealed your cultivation so you wouldn't have overtaken his cultivation base, our Lin clan had prided itself over our cultivation base and strong bodies since our creation, how could that common-born Yuan Fang control you forever?"
Lin Lang coughed a bit as he approached her and told her what happened and how Duritz didn't have his memories anymore.
The woman frowned as she looked at Duritz and pondered for a few seconds before saying:
"It seems you have injured your soul quite a bit if you lost all of your memories to escape from the grasp of Yuan Fang's technique, even though he couldn't get the whole inheritance of the Heavenly Celestial God he did get one core doctrine from it... along with the most important technique of his quickest subordinate."
Yun Duritz's ears started to move as he heard the mention of a title, the strong expert's technique must have been the reason that Yuan Fang had improved so much both in personality and world view, this Heavenly Celestial guy must have surely been an evil cultivator to influence the good-loving Yuan Fang to become as evil as Yun Jhin.
"Anyways since you are back with us it doesn't matter anymore, your big sis Lin Luan Leng will help you get your memories back, and if the damage is too big to be repaired we shall just make some new ones."
She started to laugh boisterously as she slapped Yun Duritz's shoulder and continued:
"First let's try our favorite game since childhood, maybe it will trigger your repressed memories."
Yun Jhin felt that something was fishy when she was talking about repressed memories, a person wouldn't repress their memories unless they were too traumatic for the psyche to handle... what did this woman do to the original Duritz?
A second later he found out as he was face planted on the ground and her whole body was put on his back, his left arm was put behind his back as she took a hold of it and pushed it to the right side:
"Say, uncle!"
Yun Duritz wanted to say uncle but her weight wasn't anything easy to endure as his air was practically flattened out of his lungs, he tried to take in a deep breath only for piercing pain to appear in his chest, some of his ribs were broken due to her weight!
Lin Luan laughed as she said with a reminiscing tone:
"It seems you are as enduring as in your childhood even though I'm going easy on you, let's continue until you say, uncle!"
In this situation, Yun Duritz didn't know if to laugh or to cry.

chapters.title: Chapter 214: A celestial prince's life (1)
chapters.content:
It would be a lie to say that Yun Duritz didn't experience pain from the arm hold his 'older sister' had put on him but what could he do when the difference in strength between them was so huge?
He could either endure until the end or say uncle but considering that their clan seemed to be based on a barbaric power-based hierarchy so if he acted though he would be accepted more easily, and from what he understood Duritz himself was rather though so retaining his personality would be for the best if he wanted to continue fooling them.
"You can continue how much you want big sis but I will never yield!"
That's what he wanted to say but considering his bones were cracking and that his mouth was blocked by the floor all that came out of his mouth was:
"Ugh, con ho bi si ne yiel!"
"Oh, you don't want to yield! Hahaha you are still my Lil bro even without memories aren't you?"
"You really retained that stubborn trait that father had as well and it's ingrained even in your bones!"
Yun Duritz wanted to laugh but his chest would fill up with blood if he did as his chest bones started to poke into his organs.
Sensing his brother's situation made Lin Luan's eyes soften a bit as she took her heavy body off him and said:
"Well I guess it won't really work this way... maybe your memories are lost forever but we can always create new ones!"
Yun Duritz sighed as he tried to get up from the floor only for his sister to help him up and continuing:
"It seems that your body hasn't been sealed any way but it's quite weak... you haven't even reached the final stage of your bloodline yet and your cultivation base while budding is rather weak for your age..."
"You should have at least been a little bit weaker than me or at least as strong as me cultivation wise but you are so pitifully weak..."
Yun Duritz understood already he made a face which indicated that he wasn't happy with her bringing up her cultivation and she understood as she laughed:
"It seems that your pride is still there as well, very good since you came back let's help you cultivate to where you are supposed to be, the prince of the Lin clan can't be weak, after all, you are supposed to replace me! Since you are a male and the one that was supposed to inherit the position you will have to become the clan leader when you reach the adequate cultivation base."
Yun Duritz found that everything was going a little fast but it was all in his benefit so he also felt rather good, he smiled at his 'sister' then asked:
"So about cultivating... how am I supposed to do that?"
Lin Luan almost faceplanted as she said:
"Ok, it seems that you don't even know about cultivation anymore? I understand losing your personal memories but those other ones... the damage is bigger than expected."
To cultivators cultivating became like eating and sleeping, even if they forgot some of their core memories they would always know how to cultivate! After all, they had done the same thing for years and years consecutively so how could they forget how to do it?
"It seems I will have to teach you our cultivation technique..."
"Let's see if this Duritz is genuine or not, if he is he should be able to cultivate our clan's technique, if he is fake his head shall be severed and hanged at the gates of the city!"
Yun Duritz couldn't read minds but he could read the mood, he felt that something wasn't right as his 'sister' looked at him with a strange glint in her eyes but it was pretty normal to doubt him, even though the return was sudden his alibi was almost perfect but all the doubts couldn't be erased perfectly.
"Sure sis I'm waiting."
"Let's not do it here as the technique is confidential."
She glanced at Lin Lang and the man coughed as he left, even though he was the son of the general under Duritz's father that didn't mean he had access to any direct cultivation techniques, but he did get the second-best ones.
Lin Luan started to walk forward exiting the house through the backdoor and Yun Duritz followed her quickly from behind, they arrived in a beautiful garden with a small pool in the back of it.
There were a few flowers planted here and there and as Yun Duritz took in breaths he could feel that his cultivation speed was getting faster and faster!
His discerning eye saw that the flowers were actually arranged in a formation!
Lin Luan chuckled as he saw him eyeing the flowers and breathed in and out:
"While you know the bare basics of cultivation you are still lacking the most important things, it seems that while your memory was affected your cultivation lobe was only destroyed around to 90%."
"Ok now to the teaching."
She waved her hands as a blue barrier blocked everything from outside and inside from coming in or out.
Yun Duritz gave the barrier a few knocks and realized that there was no way he would be able to break it if he needed to escape.
He looked directly at Lin Luan and asked:
"So what do you want to teach me?"
Lin Luan smiled as she got closer to him and pointed at his head, electricity ran out of her pointing finger immediately rushing to Duritz's brain and entering it before stimulating it for a few seconds, new memories started to rush into Yun Duritz's soul as he saw a younger version of Duritz and Luan talking with each other and laughing when suddenly a big burly man with a hairstyle similar to Duritz appeared, besides the hair there wasn't much resemblance between the current Duritz and the burly man but Yun Duritz understood that he was 'his father'.
The cultivation technique started to be unveiled to him by his father as he sat cross-legged in front of Luan and started to make hand seals according to the instructions that Luan sent to his soul.
The hand seals started to move the bloodline in his body as his skin turned red, his hair changed to a pale green color and his eyes opened only for them to reveal only white pupils, Yun Duritz was using the same rampage form that the dead Duritz used in their first fight!
However, he easily controlled his form as he got up and did a few punches, the space around the places he hit started to crack and distort and this was the power of his body alone, he hadn't used any ki to enhance his attacks.
Luan nodded as she saw him successfully and easily cultivating their most important technique, she knew it was impossible to fake a bloodline so his bloodline was genuine, Duritz was a person who wouldn't let his body end up in anyone's possession so if he was going to die he would have surely self-destructed, that meant there was no chance for the person in front of her to be an impostor!
This time as she got close she gave him a genuine hug as tears started to pour out of her eyes while saying:
"It's good to have you back Lil bro!"
Yun Duritz smiled as he reciprocated the hug, his form returned to normal as he said:
"Likewise sis."
She laughed awkwardly as she gave him a punch on the shoulder breaking it:
"Hahaha, you and your emotions."
Yun Duritz didn't laugh as he was in pain, he just gave her a shaky smile as he thought:
"The first one to die will be you, you damn annoying woman."
"Ok then let's get you to your room so you can continue cultivating, and don't come out until you are in the God Realm you understand? I don't want you to shame the name of your clan with your lousy cultivation!"
She immediately became stern as she gave him a glare changing her personality 180* degrees.
Yun Duritz followed her and came to a room specifically made for the inheritors of the clan to focus on their cultivations.
Since Yun Duritz was the sole inheritor the room was made rather small enough to accommodate him, it was simple decorated with a moderately sized bed, a couch, and a table where he could eat if he wanted to, there was a cauldron in the corner of the room for pill refining and a window that let the light of the sun in.
Lin Luan pushed him into the room and then closed it as she said:
"I will send you a man with herbs and resources along with pill recipes so you can improve your alchemy and cultivation at the same time, don't worry we will send you only the highest quality herbs and it doesn't matter if you fail a lot, our family is rich!"
Yun Duritz didn't mind being in-home arrest as he would be fed pills and resources, this meant he wouldn't have to venture into the unknown celestial realm with low strength and possibly die because of his lack of knowledge, he would get both information and resources as the young prince of the Lin Clan.
He looked through the window at the receding back of his 'sister' and smiled as he waited for the first batch of resources to be sent to his room.

chapters.title: Chapter 215: A celestial prince's life (2)
chapters.content:
Yun Duritz sat cross-legged on his new bed as he started to cultivate using the surrounding ki in the air, the ki in his residence was richer than the one he used to cultivate in the forest and its quality was also higher by a few notches.
As he breathed in and out accordingly to the technique that Lin Luan taught him.
Inside the house, Lin Luan got back on the throne meant for the head of the family and rang a bell that was installed on the throne five times in a row with a delay of 2 seconds between the rings.
All of the important elders and guards of the family that were either hiding or either in closed-door cultivation immediately appeared in the room of the house, some of them bowed some of them kneeled in front of her, but they were all showing respect to her as there was no one above the middle stages of the God Realm along with them, the true reserve powers wouldn't bother themselves with such meetings.
She sat on the throne as she looked at everyone from above and said:
"Our Lin family has finally regained its true successor!"
"Our little Duritz is finally back!"
"From now on you shall deliver ten hibiscus tears, ten black-bodied beetles along with water from the pond of longevity at the successor training house behind our clan home, he is confined there until he will break through to the 1st stage of the God Realm."
"Yes, House lady!"
The guards said in unison while continuing to kneel, the elders started to caress their beards as they muttered:
"The young master is back? That's great news! However, it's quite unfortunate he hadn't been able to break through to the God Realm up till now... I wonder what happened to him?"
"Well, who knows what he went through while he was under that slime balls control, what was his name again? Yuan something? He is lucky we cannot leave the celestial realm as its guardians or we would have given him a good walloping and then decapitated him!"
"Anyways we should go meet the young master as well right? We haven't seen him since he had completed his last trial to become a man... I wonder if he still doesn't resemble his father at all?"
Lin Luan knocked on the chair's armrests as she said:
"You can only go there and send him the things that I told you to, you cannot waste his time with questions or trying to see him, you can only see him after he breaks through! Do you understand?"
The bunch of elders shut up as they bowed again and disappeared, since they couldn't see the prince they might as well leave as the job of deliverance was left for the guards and weaker members of the family.
Yun Duritz could feel something change to the substructure of the space around him, it felt like his whole destiny was getting a huge and qualitative change!
"What is this... have I been accepted by the Celestial realm so easily?"
Getting accepted by a realm was when the destiny governing it would flow through your body and embrace it, this would naturally happen when a person was born in the realm and they would gradually realize the destiny is flowing through their body the higher their cultivation was, having a high amount of destiny meant more luck and more luck meant that there was a chance you could become a fortuned one!
Yun Duritz had memories from Yun Jhin's main body so he knew that fortuned ones weren't always born with their constitution and they could also be created but the requirements were either random or they had to be exact so Yun Jhin couldn't create a fortuned one if he wanted to, it was up to luck even if he knew the steps to create one.
"With this amount of destiny flowing into my whole body, I should be able to go to that Soul Emperor's tomb and get out of it unscathed with his whole inheritance!"
His body was so full that it was almost overflowing, being accepted by the celestial realm which was the purest and highest realm in existence meant that the destiny that he had gathered was almost higher than the one accumulated by his main body over thousands of reincarnations!
"Just one action and I'm like the carp that jumped over the dragon gate!"
He could feel that his meridians were getting cleared up as his ki pathways enlarged, his body started to shake as the changes brought by the almost liquid amount of destiny that was currently being infused into his whole body.
"Hahaahahah!"
His muscles started to round up firmly achieving a perfect balance between strength and speed, even though he could be considered rather bulky before just as an apprentice bodybuilder, now he was lean just like a professional swimmer.
His body cultivation was currently jumping up like crazy as he made use of the destiny flowing through his body, unlike his main body who had to steal destiny in small amounts and make sparing use of it because he would get a backlash from the universe if he used too much.
All the destiny his main body got was through plunder and of course, the universe wasn't glad its darlings were killed and looted so Yun Jhin could only use the destiny to temper himself rather rarely and he would rather use other resources instead of incurring some 'tribulations' that shouldn't even exist.
As Yun Duritz made use of the destiny he could feel that his body reached a plateau and it couldn't grow strong anymore, it reached the peak of the peak meaning the rank of 10,000! His bloodline was roiling in his body as red veins appeared around his whole body and engulfed him into a cocoon that filled the whole room.
The first batch of ingredients was sent at the same time he entered the cocoon and when the others looked through the window and saw the red cocoon they started to clear their eyes before asking each other:
"Is our young master a caterpillar? What's with that cocoon?"
"Should we alert the young lady?"
"Uh... I guess we should, who knows how will the young lady react? But first, let's just deliver the items so she won't say we skipped our work."
The door had a moderate-sized hole in it that was covered by a dark green metal, the duo removed the metal and looked through the hole to see tentacles growing out of the cocoon and reaching out for their eyes!
They almost got scared to death as they fall backward and threw the ingredients in the hole before quickly sealing it up with the green metal.
"We need to go now!"
The duo rushed back into the house and immediately alerted Lin Luan.
Lin Luan eyes widened as she heard what happened with her little brother and immediately left the house to arrive directly at the building in the back, looking through the window she started to analyze the cocoon as she muttered:
"This is? Peak body refinement? That was extremely fast! How did he do that?"
She finally looked at the noon sky and saw the currents of air moving weirdly.
"Destiny? What is with this ludicrous amount of destiny! What's wrong with the realm?"
"Could it be? My little bro was chosen?"
"But this didn't happen to our family since the first ancestor's generation... are we really this lucky?"
Lin Luan felt something wasn't right but she couldn't put her finger on it, however, there was nothing she could do in this situation besides looking over her little brother's transformation, she wondered how will he look after the momentous transformation the immense amount of destiny will bring him.
"Let's just wait and see..."
Yun Duritz knew that he was being observed not only by his sister but by some strong ancestors that woke up because of the commotion he caused, but that was what he wanted to do!
If he could rack in huge attention the transition between his ascension as the clan lord and his sister abdicating would be as smooth as butter!
If he showed enough strength and talent the ancestors would surely accept him as the clan lord and afterward, he would be able to do what he wanted as long as he didn't put the clan or its interests at risk!
Yun Duritz had quite a lot of ideas that he wanted to employ after he became the clan lord, from what he understood the Lin clan were the guardians of the eastern gate of ascendance which meant there must be 3 other gates in the celestial realm!
The environment in the celestial realm was too good compared to the mortal realm and he always thought about how much his main body could benefit from entering this realm and he could feel that his main's body strength was continuously increasing even though he couldn't communicate with it or get any help from it anymore.
Yun Duritz's body was continuously changing in the cocoon as his thoughts went elsewhere, he was thinking about the future and there was one word that was always surfacing in his mind:
"INVASION!"

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Evolution of life
chapters.content:
After he stopped thinking about the invasion plan, he started to concentrate on the changes that were currently going through his body after he entered the incubation state he was currently in.
"Hmm... this body was initially made with the blood of the mortal realm but the bloodline from Duritz's heart was slowly modeling it to the ideal body of the celestial realm, but this is an evolution even beyond that!"
He felt that his whole life was flashing in front of his eyes, the memories from Yun Jhin's memory core were flowing in the front of his mind as he realized that there were a lot of instances where he did things wrongly regarding body refinement.
As his body evolved he understood things from a different perspective which was of a higher realm compared to his previous one.
"This shall be really beneficial to the main body..."
If the main body could fix all of the problems that unknowingly arose in his body refining he could perfect his cultivation tree and increase his cultivation speed by up to 300%.
A bright smile appeared on Yun Duritz's face as he realized that, his body started to move in the cocoon as his evolution continued, his organs started to turn more compact to withstand more strain and along with that his heart and blood were purified to an extreme to the point that they both became golden, a natural formation array also appeared on his heart which had the words of 'celestial' imprinted on it.
Now that he was one of the young masters of the celestial realm, the realm branded itself on him to show others who was his backer, if he wanted to he could let out bright golden light from his heart showing that he was a golden son of the celestial realm.
"The evolution is almost done..."
Even though the benefits from the evolution brought him a major bodily change that made him reach the peak of body refinement along with major changes to his organs his ki cultivation didn't benefit as much as he only broke through to the 6th stage of the sage realm in one go, while destiny was useful for body refinement it was less useful for ki refinement, however it could still be used for ki refinement at a lower conversion rate, but Yun Duritz had already used a majority of it on body refinement and evolution while the leftovers were used on his ki cultivation.
But it didn't matter, as his body refinement reached the peak of possibility he broke through the cocoon and absorbed the destroyed leftovers back into his body, his eyes glowed with an azure-golden color as he put some new clothes over his naked body, they were prepared by his sister in cases there would be any explosive accidents with the cauldron and his old clothes would be burned to cinders.
He now wore an azure robe inscribed with the words of Lin Clan on his back, a green sash was keeping his pants tied while a golden one was keeping his robe tied around his waist, he had brown sandals on his feet and his long blonde hair was now tied in a ponytail, while Duritz preferred wild hair, Yun Jhin was now in control of this body and he was annoyed by the wild hair so he straightened it out and tied it into a ponytail.
He looked at the herbs and other ingredients that had been sent, they have been thrown over because the guards were scared of him but they weren't damaged, he went over to the door and grabbed the ingredients from the floor before getting near the cauldron and starting a fire using his inner ki.
While destiny wasn't useful for ki cultivation the herbs and ingredients that Lin Luan had sent over were surely going to help him speedrun through the sage realm just like his main body did.
Actually, if he thought about it, this secondary body might breakthrough even faster!
A pill formula was inscribed on the tray that the ingredients came with, it was a special pill meant to nurture the body and heighten one's bloodline, it was the specialty of the Lin family and it would boost both the body and bloodline at the same time, however, Yun Duritz did not need this pill anymore considering he had reached the peak in both with the use of destiny.
While he was unfamiliar with the ingredients from the celestial realm he could infer their uses after a few scans with his soul willpower and a few tastes, after he identified each use of the herbs in front of him he started to do some hand seals as he threw them into the cauldron in a certain order.
He had a handful of pills that he could create with the current herbs and he knew that the effects would be different considering he was swapping the pill ingredients but all he could think was that the effects would be greatly boosted!
He closed his eyes as he put his hands near his stomach and his hand seals intensified in speed, the ki from his body left in a plume of smoke and entered the cauldron starting to melt the ingredients in there while coalescing into a ball form, the pill was already being created!
After 2 days of continuous refinement under Yun Duritz's inner fire, the ball hardened and transformed into a shiny golden pill.
The pill was called Heaven Returning Dragon Dynasty Pill but considering its name was rather long Yun Jhin only abbreviated it to HRDDP and considering he used celestial items to create this pill, it could now be called the CHRDDP.
Yun Jhin popped the pill in his mouth as it entered his neck and flew directly to his stomach, an explosion appeared in his body as the pill melted and torrents of wild ki flushed his whole body, however with his current body strength the currents didn't do anything besides tickling him, the wide ki pathways accepted the ki into his body as the avatar of his second body grew in strength, his body shot past directly to the 9th stage of the sage realm and stopped thereafter only one pill but he knew that he wouldn't be able to use the same pill for any further progress.
Now that his body had reached the peak of body refinement it could squeeze out every potential bit of medicinal power from pills and herbs but his resistance to them was also extremely high to the point he was immune only after one use.
It was both a good and bad thing, he could use less to achieve more but he would only be able to use those resources for only one time.
He was trading the long road of breakthroughs for bursts, it was better if you had tons of unique resources but if you lacked those resources you would have a hard time breaking further without accumulation.
But luckily for Yun Jhin all he had to do was ask and his 'allowance' would be changed to the things he needed.
His sister came at the moment he finished cultivating as a knock was heard on his door and the worried voice of his sister came through:
"Are you alright bro Duritz?"
Yun Duritz laughed as he flexed his biceps at the window while shouting for her attention:
"I'm actually rather great, I don't know what happened but I suddenly feel like my body is as though as the Dark Martial Iron."
"Hahaha, you are bluffing bro, how could your body be so tough? Even I who reached the peak of body refinement wouldn't be able to make such a claim."
"Then what about a spar? I'm already quite near the God Realm."
"Wait what? But it hasn't even been more than one month, how could you have broken through so fast?"
"Destiny doesn't work on ki cultivation that well and I only gave him the body and bloodline refining pill formula, it would have taken him at least a few days to weeks to learn and master it and even if he ate thousands of those pills his cultivation wouldn't have reached the 9th stage of the sage realm because of the properties of the pill... does my little brother harbor some secrets?"
Yun Duritz waved his hand at Luan and said:
"Celestial realm to Luan, what are you thinking about big sis? Are you just surprised by how awesome I am?"
"You were always a boaster even before you lost your memories but it seems you also kept this part of your personality."
"Ok, I'm going to let you out for a spar but don't cry when I'm going to beat the tar out of you!"
The door of the building opened as Yun Duritz left it with a noble gait, he waved at his 'sister' as he activated his battle mode, his lean muscles bulked up very slightly to the point that there wasn't a big difference, his blonde ponytail turned a pale green as his eyes lost their pupils for a few seconds before they regained them, the color changed from azure-golden to a deep green one.
His aura intensified as the space around him started to crack from his bloodline power alone, his body had advanced so much that he would be able to fight with God Realm experts with it alone! Normally that shouldn't have been possible and even his main body was unable to do this. but the superior celestial bloodline was full of surprises!
Yun Duritz waved his hand at her provocatively telling her to come at him.
"Well, aren't you a bit too daring? I will still go easy on you considering you just broke through and only use a very small portion of my ki, let's see who's body is tougher!"
Her eyes turned eyes as she transformed into the same form as Yun Duritz, but hers was different, her fat body started to lose layers of fat as it turned athletic and fit, her long blonde hair started to shorten until it was shoulder length and it became fully azure, she threw down the overly large clothes that didn't fit on her new toned body anymore leaving herself only in a bra and black training pants, she cracked her neck and knuckles as she pointed at Yun Duritz.
"Here I come Lil bro, let's see if you will endure just like you had done in that silly kid game!"
With one step forward a small crater appeared in the though earth below them, her body strength was easily shown as she appeared in front of Yun Duritz and a wide punch could be seen coming towards him, the punch was full of flaws but it was so fast and strong that the space around Yun Duritz finally broke like glass as he felt his hair stand on end!

chapters.title: Chapter 217: The sucession ceremony
chapters.content:
The punch was rather slow and it came from a straight angle, Yun Duritz should have been able to easily dodge the punch but its slowness was only an illusion!
When things became too fast the body would enter a time slowed event where you could see everything that was in front of you very clearly due to the extreme amount of adrenaline that was going through the body.
In this situation, Yun Duritz's body understood the danger that it went through and slowed everything for Yun Duritz's convenience, however, Yun Jhin's soul fragment knew that the power of this new body was something that wouldn't fall short of the power shown by his 'sister'.
Yun Duritz immediately counterattacked as he punched as well, their punches met in the middle as a blue shockwave appeared between them, a energy ball surrounded the two of them as their ki started to react instinctively to protect them against the destructive power coming from the shockwaves.
They were now in a stalemate as they tried to outdo each other, trying to push with their whole body strength, the shield that covered them both disappeared as Luan gritted her teeth while her muscles started to move on her body.
Her veins looked just like earthworms as blood pumped through her whole body trying to overpower Yun Duritz.
Yun Duritz shouted as his power increased once more, his destiny tempering gave him an immense power up as he tapped into the refined bloodline for a second time!
He reached tier 2 of his transformation as his muscles gained more mass and his height increased by 40 centimeters, this gave him an immense amount of strength for the trade-off a small amount of his speed and stamina.
Luan was being pushed back slowly but surely, she gritted her teeth as a literal fire started to spill from her eyes, her lean body started to bulk up the same way that Yun Duritz's did and she grew even taller than him!
"Think you are the only one who learned this technique and progressed to this stage? While you may have gotten the destiny of the realm you shouldn't look down on your big sis!"
"I wasn't looking down on you 'big sis' but you fell right into my trap!"
"What?"
Suddenly Yun Duritz's body deflated back to its initial state as he let go of the power struggle, due to the inertia Lin Luan couldn't stop her massive body from pushing forward and Yun Duritz could firmly jump on her back and start bombarding her with his fists, his body bulked up again as his weight increased making it harder for her to get up.
His punches were aimed at her vital parts then suddenly he took hold of her right arm and started pushing it doing the same thing she had done to him on their first meeting.
"Say uncle big sis!"
"Eh? You are trying this with your big sis? It seems your training made your guts quite big!"
"Oh, guts aren't the only thing that my training increased!"
He started to push her arm so much that her tough bones that had been refined over and over again started to creak and crack.
The sounds of bones cracking were so loud that even the guards that watched the battle winced.
"Ready to say uncle big sis?"
"Never!"
"That's what I wanted to hear..."
Suddenly his arm inflated three times its initial size as he ripped her arm from her socket and threw it a few meters away.
Luan shouted in pain as her transformation reverted she clutched her stump as blood flowed freely for there for a few seconds before a new arm grew there.
She grimaced as she looked at Yun Duritz who was above her, his form deflated as he returned to his original form, he scratched the back of his head as he chuckled awkwardly before offering her a hand:
"I don't know what went through me at that time big sis but you just didn't want to give up and considering how strong you were I don't think a ripped arm would matter much right?"
She sighed as she got up from the ground and then slapped him on the face:
"The arm doesn't matter but you have done this so sudden without any warning! We are family not enemies it doesn't matter if you want to take revenge but at least give me a warning, the sudden pain wasn't nice at all!"
Yun Duritz put his hand on the place he had been slapped and laughed inside, this was only a little bit of payback.
"Ok big sis I will make sure to announce you next time."
She sighed as she said:
"I guess you don't really need to get to the God Realm to succeed me as the head of the family... you are already strong enough, it seems the destiny really helped you a lot to the point that you can beat me, even though I didn't use my ki wholly you still beat me in body refinement which shows that you can fight on your own with those at the God Realm."
"But why did I need to be at the God Realm anyway?"
"Ah... we didn't even give you the whole information, we were just too happy that you came back that we forgot to even tell you about the family!"
She shook her head as they got out of the crater they created during the battle, as Yun Duritz looked backward at the crater he could see that it was slowly healing itself returning to normal ground levels after 10 seconds.
"Interesting."
They entered the house leaving the guards there who were still slack-jawed at the fight that happened.
"You see our family had been guarding the eastern exit to the mortal realm for... well for since we existed? It's been such a long time that not even our oldest elder knows truly when we were created, since you are going to inherit the patriarch position you just need to know that we need to have a good image for the public and that's pretty much all, we have one of the easiest jobs in the celestial world!"
"Hmm? Why is that?"
"Why? Because no one can come from the mortal realm to the celestial realm and who would want to leave the celestial realm? Even Yuan Fang only left grudgingly after he realized that there was no more place for him on the continent after what he did to you..."
"Only if you still had your memories we could have sent a squad to his location in the mortal realm and annihilated him once and for all!"
Yun Duritz shook his head inside, there was no way to find him even if he had Duritz's memories, would he be dumb enough to remain in the same place after the stunt he pulled?
"Anyways let's get you ready for the ceremony."
********************
Yun Duritz was firmly sitting on the throne meant for the patriarch as he looked down at the kneeling elder's guards and his sister.
The ceremony had been short and uninteresting, he had to get the blessing of the ancestors and some other dumb stuff that he didn't even care about anymore as it was only a formality, he didn't get to communicate with the souls of the ancestors nor get any 'reward' for becoming the head of the house.
Yun Duritz stood on the throne as he contemplated something before suddenly asking:
"So what do I have to do now?"
Everyone almost faceplanted at his question then looked at Luan with a face that asked "Haven't you taught him anything?"
Luan laughed awkwardly as she got up from her kneeling position and said:
"Patriarch Duritz, now that you have ascended to this position you have quite a lot of responsibilities such as..."
"???"
Luan didn't say anything as she scrunched her eyebrows then looked at the elders and other people in the room and bowed while saying:
"What was the patriarch supposed to do again?"
"We uh..."
Yun Duritz felt a headache coming, up till now he hadn't been able to analyze them due to the sudden actions they took against him, making him cultivate and having to fight his 'sister' but it seems he had been given a house of fools!
None of them even knew what the patriarch of the house was supposed to do!
He had to act this way to ensure his identity but they were genuine fools!
"This is better than expected, I can get all of the power as a patriarch and no responsibility! I should just make an expedition to the Soul Emperor Tomb and get those inheritances!"
"So I don't have to do anything?"
Luan put a finger to her chin and thought for a few seconds:
"Well while I was Matriarch I didn't do anything so I guess you don't have to do anything either?"
"To be honest all I had to do was have a cultivation base at the God Realm and considering that I was the daughter of the former patriarch I became the Matriarch since you weren't here."
Yun Duritz got up from the throne and said:
"Well since I don't have to do anything I actually have a proposal!"
"You mentioned the Soul Emperor a few times and how Yuan Fang got some of his techniques, maybe if I go there with some people I will regain my memories? And with my new destiny, I might even be able to get the inheritance!"
"Oh no no, you understood wrongly, Yuan Fang had gone there but before he even met you! There is no way you can trigger any of your memories that way."
Yun Duritz frowned inside but continued:
"What about the inheritance of the soul emperor? Maybe it could help me regain my memories."
"Hmm that sounds plausible but the tomb hadn't been solved by no one even though it stood there even before our family was created officially, we had sent experts there quite a lot of times but they either got lost or came back empty-handed, we were actually extremely surprised to hear Yuan Fang and his friend got the inheritance of the Emperor and one of his stronger subordinates."
"But since you want to get your memories back so badly how could we say no to our Patriarch? We don't have anything to do anyways!"
Yun Duritz could say cultivate but these people looked way more relaxed compared to the people of the mortal realm. They had a different attitude towards cultivation compared to the people in the mortal realm, if such a known tomb was public as they said it would have been raided or destroyed up till now in the mortal realm on the basis that if I can't have it then no one will, or at least it would have been sealed if the materials it was made from were too durable.
"Ok, then we shall create a team of guards for me and go there immediately!"
"Of course, immediately after the congratulatory feast for you!"
"Do we really have to?"
The crowd immediately started to move as they said in unison:
"But of course! A feast is a must for such a happy occasion!"
Yun Duritz shook his head inside, these people's strength was quite high but their personalities were just like those of a normal person's, well albeit a little more extreme due to their immense strength but they didn't have any type of malice in them, it was actually quite interesting in Yun Duritz's opinion... they were also easier to manipulate.

chapters.title: Chapter 218: The easy way to rob a tomb (1)
chapters.content:
Yun Duritz decided to indulge them in their wish for a feast, it wasn't like the tomb would grow legs and leave the location and he wouldn't lose the inheritance either, from their words he knew that for most of the people who knew about the existence of the tomb, it was akin to a dead end as no one came out with the inheritance or just didn't come out at all, the only exception being Yuan Fang and Ukog.
He had some of Ukog's memories so he knew a little bit about the tomb but it was all rather blurry and fragmented so they wouldn't be of much help or any help at all.
The feast lasted exactly for one day and one night, the foods were excellent even for Yun Duritz's standards and the ingredients they were made from were quite rare and precious meaning that Yun Duritz could stabilize his cultivation at the 9th stage of the sage realm and get his way paved to the God Realm to boot!
However, as he got closer to the God Realm he realized that the laws he learned in the mortal realm didn't match the ones in the celestial realm, they were off by a few percentages which meant problems, there was a chance he would be ignored when he tried to summon the laws with the knowledge he got from the mortal realm.
Or the laws would get out of control and destroy his physical body and majorly injure his soul fragment to the point that it might get destroyed.
Or there would be problems when the laws would fuse with his body and he would get crippled.
There were many variants on how things could go wrong and if he didn't fully master the laws of the celestial realm before he attempted the God Realm they could all happen.
From his analysis, during his meditation, he understood that the differences between the laws of the celestial and mortal realms were only minuscule but as mentioned before the differences would be fatal.
The only way to fix this would be to fill the gaps in his knowledge by learning the laws of the celestial realm but even at his best speed, he would be able to learn one law every 100 years. And that was way too slow for his liking.
"I can't go on a massacre with this identity and making enemies of God Realm experts at this stage isn't good... the only way for me to speed up is getting the inheritance of the Soul Emperor, fortunately, no one could get their hands on it up till now."
Yun Duritz sat on his throne as he contemplated, he already gave the order for their strongest team to come up for the expedition and as he thought about how to break the tomb open and get everything he wanted from it a voice broke his reverie:
"Celestial Realm to Lin Duritz, everyone has been gathered just as you ordered!"
Lin Lang came over as he saluted with a goofy smile on his face, he didn't kneel or bow but Yun Duritz didn't say anything, since they were supposed to be 'friends'.
"Ok, then we shall go!"
Yun Duritz got up from his throne as he disappeared along with Lin Lang, appearing outside the house to see a team made up of peak sage realm experts, they were the strongest guards that the family could afford, and most of them were made up of rather experienced hunters since wars were scarce to nonexistent on the eastern parts of the celestial realm they didn't have any war veterans but Yun Duritz would work with what he got.
"Since we are all here which one of you is the most familiar with the way to the tomb?"
Lin Lang immediately interjected:
"That would be Simon, he has the most knowledge of our surroundings as he is the one who hunts the most."
Simon walked forward and took a small bow, he was a man of average height with two scars running in an X on his chin, he had a blade stalk in his mouth and he talked with a rather thick accent showing that he came from humble origins.
"As ya heard da boss mah name is Simon, a pleasure to meet ya, as for ya question I can say that the quickest route is to cross the river so we can get to the mountain the tomb is on, boss."
"River? Mountain?"
"Oh yeah forgot yar noggin isn't working as it supposed to, let's just go I will take the lead."
The man started to fly quickly and Yun Duritz and the others followed him, they were around 50 people in total and all of them were at the peak of the sage realm.
They could be considered a rather unimpressive force but Yun Jhin didn't start with such a strong force when he created his sect!
This was only a backwater place and they already had quite a lot of experts not even counting the hidden ones nor its resource powers!
This showed that the celestial realm was truly way more impressive compared to the mortal realm.
Yun Duritz arrived at the river in question along with his whole team, as he looked over it he admired its golden color and length, it was quite long but not very wide so they could cross it rather easily by flying.
Simon put his hand forward as he smelled the air for a few seconds before saying:
"The Admiral Crocodiles are hibernating, it's good we can cross the river."
As Yun Duritz and the others got closer to the river he realized something, gravity increased exponentially the closer they got to the river and they had to swim through it if they wanted to cross.
The golden color meant that the river was metal attributed.
Actually, the river could be considered a rather insidious living creature as it could hide its metal fluctuations unless you were too close to it, it had a symbiotic relationship with the Admiral Crocodiles.
Simon described everything he knew about the river as he crossed it while Yun Duritz took everything in like a sponge.
The more he knew about the flora and fauna of the celestial realm the easier it would be for him to travel it after he ripped himself away from the Lin family.
After they crossed the river they arrived in a forest that they traversed using Simon's experience Yun Duritz continued to ask him for whatever knowledge he had.
After they traveled through the forest they finally reached a mountain which they scaled normally unlike the two previous obstacles there wasn't anything that Yun Duritz didn't know about scaling mountains.
As they reached the peak of the mountain they finally saw it, the tomb of the soul emperor!
Naming it a tomb was rather incorrect as it looked more like a Buddhist temple, painted in yellow and red it stood there majestically, the doors of the temple were both wide open and nothing could be heard from inside it, it was actually quite eerie.
But Yun Duritz had a team of courageous people with him so they all entered the temple without saying a peep.
Duritz looked around but he was disappointed as there was truly nothing in the temple! Even the prayer mats were missing!
He closed his eyes as he concentrated on the destiny accumulation that fused with his whole body.
The destiny swirled around his body as a snake would then started to travel through the whole temple, the destiny was just like water trying to burst a dam down, the illusion that covered the whole temple started to break as Yun Duritz concentrated with all of his strength, the people around him started to disappear as if he was entering a higher dimension.
He opened his eyes and as he looked around he realized that he wasn't in the same place as before, none of the people that he had been with were around him anymore, it seemed he was right, only the fated ones would be able to enter the true 'tomb'.
The difference between the layout of the temple wasn't changed at all, the only difference was that there was no one around him now.
"Hmmm..."
Where could the inheritance be?
Yun Duritz looked through the whole temple again and this time he did find a few items here and there.
He found a few bells that could shake the souls of those who heard them and some pills that were meant to cleanse the soul, some soul poison, or other things that had to do with souls.
He was actually quite disappointed with the number of items he found but this was only the first layer of the tomb, there would surely be more things to be found.
As he finished the first layer he decided to go to the storage rooms and cellar of the temple there he found some specially brewed wine that was meant to confound the soul... and it was useless, everything in the first layer was useless to Yun Duritz!
He sighed as he decided to advance into the second layer, maybe he could get things he could use in this one.
Duritz closed his eyes again as he started to do the same thing as he had done the first time he entered the true 'tomb' his surroundings changed again but this time he wasn't in the temple anymore...
He was at a waterfall in a beautiful valley, a clear river was near him and as he got closer to it he could see something glittering inside...

chapters.title: Chapter 219: The easy way to rob a tomb (2)
chapters.content:
The intense light from the river immediately attracted Yun Duritz towards it, it was almost like his soul had been bewitched by whatever was in the water.
The shining glow on the river bed was immediately identified as Yun Duritz placed his hand in the water and scooped up a small blue pearl.
The blue pearl was inscribed with runes and Yun Duritz could feel it heat up in his hand, it was getting so hot that it was almost ready to immolate his skin.
However, with an easy application of ki to the hand that was holding the pearl, he easily insulated it making it fire-proof.
The pearl color started to turn red from the normal blue from before, Yun Duritz wasn't really familiar with the pearl as it was something he had never seen before as a specialty of the celestial realm.
He inserted his ki into the pearl but there were no reactions which left him with only one other option, he inserted a strand of his soul willpower in the pill and he could feel it getting burned, but it wasn't painful, it was just like taking a hot bath, actually, his soul was getting tempered by the heat.
The pearl then turned to blue again as a deep coldness attacked his soul, it seemed the pearl could be used to temper the soul using the dualities of Yin and Yang.
As Yun Duritz looked around he could see a lot of those glitters in the water meaning that there were approximately around 5000 pearls.
He popped the pearl into his mouth as he crushed it with his teeth, the hot and cold energies inside it were then rushed towards his mind palace where his soul resided, it was quickly tempered by the assault of dual energies.
His eyes widened as he felt his soul become more 'whole', the soul that controlled this body was only a fragment of Yun Jhin's main soul but the pearl he used made the fragment increase in size, he was basically 1/10th of a soul but now he was 1.5/10th of a whole soul.
The pearls could make this sub-body of his a whole clone!
