This would come with so many benefits that Yun Duritz couldn't list them all at this moment.
His eyes became fiery as he opened his mouth and absorbed all of the pearls into his mouth where he disintegrated them into a river of energy that he sent to his mind palace.
His soul felt like a lone boat on a stormy ocean night, his soul was growing at a visible speed as it grew from 1.5 to 2, 3, 4, 6, and it stopped around at 8.5/10th parts.
Yun Duritz could feel the size of his soul and how his connection to his body was way more secure than before, it was almost as if this body was truly his!
As his soul grew into the shell he created that meant there was no disagreement between the body and soul, if a strong soul entered a weak body it would either need to 'dumb' itself down to the level of the body to not destroy it, this applied in the reverse for a weak soul in a strong body, up till now Yun Duritz couldn't use 100% of his bodily strength due to his soul not being accepted properly by the body.
But now as he clenched his fist he could feel the space around him tremble and cracks appearing in the space-time around him, he stopped clenching his fist as he didn't want to trigger any traps from the tomb and he continued to look around after he consumed all of the pearls there was nothing of worth remaining in the river.
The valley didn't have any herbs or something of worth besides the river and the waterfall so he decided to approach the waterfall and see if there was anything of note near it.
The waterfall was falling at high speeds and Yun Duritz decided to go under it, the waterfall battering his body didn't affect his speed at all as he went through it only to find that there was no cave behind it... in most situations, a cave would be situated behind a waterfall but here he was sorely disappointed to find otherwise.
He found a good rock that he sat on enduring the falling water from above... maybe the waterfall itself was special?
As he endured the pressurized water attacking his whole body with its weight he didn't actually feel anything, his body was tempered to the limit and it couldn't get stronger anymore and the water didn't help his soul strengthen itself nor complete it as it remained at 8.5/10 parts.
Were the pearls the whole thing or was his body too strong to get the benefits from the waterfall?
He shook his head, well it was time to arrive at the last part of the tomb.
The destiny around him reached the peak as he disappeared from where he was and arriving in a dark room full of sarcophaguses.
Each sarcophagus had a vivid human face on it that showed how the dead person looked when he was alive, there were also inscriptions of the history of the person along with a couplet left behind.
Yun Duritz looked at each sarcophagus and read the couplets:
"What life in death but a fleeting moment, cultivation is meant to lengthen the moment but why are we running after eternal life?"
"Eternal life is like the sands of time, always existing but still ongoing, will I be happy if I achieve it?"
"Death doesn't scare but what scares me is the unknown after death, what is the afterlife like?"
"I slew until I couldn't move but in the end, I still fell."
All of the couplets told the last happenings or musings of these people before they died, and Yun Duritz found them to be rather cliched, he had already thought about those questions for a lot of time, and his obsession with eternal life never faltered, he was sure these people didn't even reincarnate once and they were already faltering, they didn't have any backbone!
But he did get something from reading their couplets, he had got some inheritances in the form of cultivation techniques that he didn't really need, these people must have been the underlings of the soul emperor and they were buried with him.
Yun Duritz ignored most of the sarcophagus as he walked further into the darkroom that was only being illuminated by a small light coming from the end of it.
As he arrived at the end of the room he could feel the room's temperature lowering, his teeth started to chatter even though his body couldn't feel the cold due to how strong it was, it was a cold that infiltrated his soul!
"Finally... someone with destiny."
A disembodied voice was heard coming from the light and a vile sarcophagus appeared in front of Yun Duritz's face, the sarcophagus face and his were so close that they were almost kissing, and considering how ugly and disgusting the face was, Yun Duritz would have vomited if he was of a weaker will...
The light was embedded on the forehead of the face, it's closed eyes suddenly opened as the sarcophagus opened and tried to suck Yun Duritz in.
Yun Duritz let himself be sucked in as he was embraced by a mummy, the mummy tried to bite his head only for its rotten teeth to break, Yun Duritz chuckled as he looked at the mummy:
"Only leaving a soul strand behind and trying to take over my fleshly body with such a weak and decrepit reserve body?"
The soul Emperor existence had weakened all of his attempts at reviving himself this way, actually, it wasn't even the soul emperor anymore as the main soul should have either arrived in the afterlife and reincarnated by now, it was just a stubborn piece of soul willpower that didn't want to leave.
Yun Duritz easily broke the mummies body and took out something from its chest, it was an azure tome inscribed with the words of soul emperor doctrines on it.
The soul light tried to possess Yun Duritz's body but it wouldn't have been able to even when he was at 1.5/10 parts.
The light was assimilated into his soul as he easily got the whole inheritance of the soul emperor... well not whole because it was only a part of the soul and it was already very old, but did he get what he wanted, the knowledge of the laws that he needed so much, actually for someone of the celestial realm this would have been a useless endeavor as they would have been born in the realm and by now they would have learned some of the laws in preparation for their advancement to the God Realm.
The soul emperor's treasure stash could be considered rather poor but this was also considering that Yuan Fang must have gone through the same stash once and the things he had left behind were because he either felt they were useless or he was too encumbered by the number of treasures he had on him.
Regardless of everything Yun Duritz got what he needed so it was time to leave, he flexed his body as the sarcophagus broke down and he left it only to see mummies starting to crawl out of all of the other sarcophaguses.
He shook his head as his aura started to materialize:
"I guess I will take all of the inheritances from you, you just have to force my hands don't you? Well, I guess I will take your gifts then!"

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Returning triumphantly with loot
chapters.content:
The mummies stood in groups of 2 and 3 and they were around 300 in total, however, their numbers didn't intimidate Yun Duritz at all.
He had a smile on his face as he walked in their midst like a wolf in a flock of sheep, they were all so old and brittle that all he needed to do was create some strong airwaves with his ki to destroy them when their bodies would dissipate into dust he would casually take whatever was stored in their chests.
This way he got quite a lot of useless inheritances, most of these people were just cannon fodder in the Soul Emperor's eyes but they were still buried with him because they were loyal, most of them actually died before the Soul Emperor.
His direct subordinates couldn't be found among the mummies that Yun Duritz was killing which meant that Yuan Fang should have got their inheritances, Ukog got the teleportation technique that still ended up in Yun Jhin's hands but what did Yuan Fang get? At first, he thought that he might have gotten something from the Soul Emperor but it was obvious the old fogie sarcophagus hasn't been touched.
So what did Yuan Fang get from this tomb?
He was sure he had entered it as he had a fortuned constitution and his destiny must be massive even higher than what he had absorbed in the mortal realm.
As he finished killing the mummies the question continued to plague him, there was no way Yuan Fang would have exited this place empty-handed and he wasn't such a good person to go personally to help Ukog.
He shook his head, at this point he had gone through every nook and cranny of the place and he didn't find any other spot that could have held a treasure or inheritance. Since he couldn't find anything he shouldn't beat his head with the details, he had already beaten Yuan Fang a few times and took care of his two most important underlings, he also got the true inheritance of the soul emperor so he shouldn't care about what Yuan Fang got.
He slowly exited each layer of the tomb and appeared in front of Lin Lang, Simon, and the others.
Seeing how he reappeared made the others glad as they sighed in unison, what could they tell Luan when they would say that they lost the head of the house?
Yun Duritz took a look around his troops and nodded as he said:
"I have found the inheritance and got quite a lot of good stuff, we shall share it with everyone back at the city."
The troops cheered as they took their way back using the same path with no problems, the admiral crocodiles were still hibernating as it didn't take much time for Yun Duritz to clear the tomb.
They reached the city and entered it before going straight to the house of the clan.
There Yun Duritz took his seat on the patriarch's throne before he initiated a meeting.
All of the people that came beforehand appeared again, they didn't seem bothered at all Yun Duritz invited them here again even though normally they should have been angry that they were being disrupted from their cultivation time, it seemed the celestial realm netizens truly had different views on cultivation compared to the mortal realm ones.
"I have been to the Soul Emperor's tomb and I have come back with results!"
The elders and his big sister had wide eyes as they heard what he said, no one had ever come with anything from the tomb up till now and they really wanted to see what Yun Duritz brought.
Yun Duritz took a small pile of jade slips and bamboo parchments out of his spatial dimension as he threw them on the ground in front of him, he waved his hand and said:
"These are all from the tomb."
An old man with braided hair and a small beard came forward and took a bamboo parchment from the pile and started reading it, the moment he read the first few lines on the parchment he immediately became entranced and couldn't stop himself from reading until he had finished the whole thing in one sitting.
"Such exquisite calligraphy, such important insights about the power of the ki energy core... this is a scripture!"
The old man even wanted to kiss the parchment but stopped himself as the others looked at him strangely.
He made a 'humph' sound as he disappeared with the parchment in tow.
The others immediately went ahead to see what the hubbub was about:
"Old Ma looked like he saw his late wife, what the hell was on that parchment? Could it have been an old romance novel?"
"Hey Old Ma isn't such a huge pervert, right? Who knows where that parchment had been after all the young master had taken it from a tomb..."
"Eh, that's for Old Ma to worry about... I will surely not get intimate with mine."
"Why do I feel like your eyes were flickering when you said that?"
"Ahem."
Yun Duritz felt really awkward seeing them talk, it was like he was looking at children, as the saying went, war makes strong men while peace made weak men, this didn't actually apply to their bodily strength but to their mentality.
He sighed then decided to leave them alone with the scrolls, parchments, and slips.
Yun Duritz went to the back of the house and decided to look through the Soul Emperor's technique.
Yun Duritz took the azure tome out of his spatial dimension and inspected it with his soul willpower for a few seconds to make sure it was safe, while the trap would be quite of poor quality due to the immense amount of time it had gone through it should still exist, it was way too easy to acquire the tome so there should be some other fail-safes the emperor had put in case too much time had passed and his original plans became unusable.
The tome opened up as Yun Duritz flipped through the pages but as he looked at them he started laughing:
"The first three pages are empty... so this is how Yuan Fang got some of the inheritance."
"Well let's see what's left."
The tome wasn't very big, it had a total of 30 pages and only its cover was rather thick.
The first three pages recorded one technique so in total there were 10 techniques.
The next 3 pages recorded a technique meant to temper the soul into a weapon form creating weapon willpower instead of the normal soul willpower, Yun Duritz could create weapons with his soul willpower but this technique was meant to temper this aspect of soul usage so he memorized it, the moment he did it disappeared from the tome.
"Hmm, interesting writing technique.. once the technique is memorized it disappears completely from the tome."
The other techniques in the tome were all rather useful so Yun Duritz learned all of them before burning the tome into cinders.
Actually one of the techniques took his attention, it was the last one, and it what he needed in this situation...
A technique specifically made to forcefully control God Realm experts!
He immediately became entranced the moment he saw this technique, this was something he had always wanted the moment he found out that God Realm experts had complete protection from full mind control and they could only be brainwashed or restrained in other ways.
Yun Jhin always had control problems as he wanted everything to be done exactly as he said, and he was actually quite mad he couldn't forcefully control the minds of the others completely otherwise they would explode.
But now he had one way to do what he wanted and he was going to experiment immediately!
He summoned Lin Lang to him under the guise that he wanted to try and regain his memories by chatting with him as the visit to the tomb had triggered something in him saying that he started to remember a few things and reminiscing them with a close friend would quicken the process.
Lin Luan immediately came over with two jugs of wine and laughed as he saw Yun Duritz sitting cross-legged in the garden behind the house, he threw one jug over which Yun Duritz caught easily and downed in a few gulps.
Lin Luan downed his own jug and came closer before sitting cross-legged near him and starting to talk about their past.
However Yun Duritz just stayed there looking at him, directly in the eyes without blinking at all, this unnerved Lin Luan since he knew that Duritz would never act like this normally so he asked:
"Are you ok man? You seem to act weird."
"Me? Oh, there is nothing just something that I have picked up at the tomb, tell me how are the others doing?"
"Hmmm? Your sister and the other elders are still engrossed in the things you have brought back from the tomb, why are you asking?"
"Oh for no reason..."
Suddenly Yun Duritz's hand sneaked upon Lin Lang's chest where a concentrated blast of crimson energy entered him and left through his back leaving a gaping hole through his chest.
The man coughed a mouthful of blood as he fell in surprise and dread as he looked at Yun Duritz and asked with a trembling voice:
"Why??"
"Oh for no particular reason, now go to sleep!"
Yun Duritz's soul willpower entered Lin Lang's soul palace as it crushed the man's soul making it go immobile thus his body went unconscious.
Then he went to work... small blue tentacles left Yun Duritz's soul as they infiltrated Lin Lang's whole body then entered his heart where they left a seed that grew immediately into a blue skull that started screeching then exploded turning Lin Lang's heart blue.
Then the tentacles entered Lin Lang's soul palace where they infiltrated his soul core but they didn't touch any of his important thinking parts nor did they attempt to forcefully take control... they went ahead to the memory part of the core and inserted themselves deeply at the beginning parts of Lin Lang's memories where they left another seed, this time it wasn't a skull that sprouted but a small owl that took flight into Lin Lang's memory core and disappeared as if it was never there.
Yun Duritz then revitalized Lin Lang and let him wake up, when Lin Lang saw Yun Duritz he didn't say anything as if he was never attacked a few seconds ago, he just got up bowed and left according to the mental orders that Yun Duritz gave.
Yes, mental orders... Yun Duritz had applied the technique and now he had full control over Lin Lang even though the man was a 2nd stage God Realm expert, and to boot, he could control him using his soul willpower alone!
Yun Duritz smiled as he looked towards the house... he would make sure he had more time to enslave everyone else so there would be no hubbub when he would open the gate to invite his main body in.

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Yun Jhin is coming
chapters.content:
Yun Duritz knew that the technique wasn't perfected yet, he had used a lot of energy and concentration to enslave Lin Lang so that meant he couldn't do the process with more than one person so he had to enslave them one by one.
Lin Lang transmitted him that they were still looking through the loot he had brought back which meant it wasn't the time to enslave them yet, only when they left to study more deeply by themselves would he make his move.
It didn't take him much waiting time before Lin Lang reported to him that his sister had taken a jade slip and left to her room to study it further so she could gain some enlightenment from it.
"Payback time... I will show you who will say uncle in the end..."
As a rather prideful being who was once at the peak of the God Realm Yun Duritz's soul fragment was quite vengeful even for the smallest things that would be done to him, he was actually quite childish in this regard but he knew when to stop himself, however, he would strike quickly and mercilessly if the opportunity arrived.
And the opportunity was sweetly within his grasp, all he had to do was put his hand over it and grasp it firmly, at this point all of the elders and guards were either rummaging through the pile of antiques or either leaving quickly for their residences to absorb the knowledge.
This was the best time to strike!
Lin Luan's room was near the end of the house just as you left to the garden so he got there rather quickly as he just saw the door of her room closing itself.
Yun Duritz took a few steps towards the door then knocked while saying:
"Big sis, your Lil bro has come for some chatting, I think Lin Lang had informed you already about the things I want to talk to you about."
Some shuffling could be heard from behind the door as it opened shortly, Luan's head sticking out of the door as she said:
"Oh sure Lil bro, come in come in, this was supposed to be your room anyways."
Yun Duritz entered and looked around, it was a scarcely decorated room with a bed a dining table, and a cauldron, it wasn't much different from the room behind the house. The only difference would be that this room had two windows while the one behind the house only had one.
"Lin Lang told me you talked with him that you recovered some of your memories and you want me to help you recover some more?"
"Yeah that's true big sis, some of them came back with the help of the inheritance from the tomb, I haven't been actually that truthful with all of you, besides that pile of manuscripts, jade slips, and other knowledge filled papers I have also got the direct inheritance from the Soul Emperor himself!"
"The direct inheritance? Wow, that's great Lil bro? Mind if you shared it with your big sister?"
"Ah, the thing about that is..."
"Hmm? You don't want to share Lil bro? Do you want to try and say uncle again?"
"It's not that I want but I can't, all of the inheritance had disappeared from the tome that I learned it from then it self-destructed."
"You for real?"
"Yeah but I can try to teach it to you, however, I'm not sure if it would work considering that I learned it very quickly from the tome which showed that there would either be great difficulties teaching it to someone directly or that it's almost impossible unless you... you know absorb my soul with my agreement.
"Then forget it Lil bro, it's good enough you got to learn the techniques yourself, we shouldn't be too greedy, it's unfortunate that you aren't able to teach the techniques to others in the family."
Yun Duritz laughed awkwardly as he got closer to her and said:
"Then shall we talk about our past?"
"Yeah sure let's get going, getting back your memories is a benefit for everyone, you might even break through to the God Realm!"
Then she started to narrate some events that happened to the two of them when they were young, Yun Duritz listened to everything and memorized it as his hand started to sneak towards her chest.
While she was entranced in her storytelling she didn't realize until she felt a little touch on her breasts:
"WHAT ARE YOU DOING LIL BRO? WE ARE BLOOD-RELATED!"
"Oh it's a misunderstanding, I'm not touching you there for that."
"Eh? Then why would you even?"
Suddenly she looked down as blood started to gush from her mouth and a moderately sized hole appeared in her chest:
"You... you aren't Lin Duritz!"
"Too late to realize that you fool!"
The same thing as with Lin Lang happened with Luan, her eyes turned vacant as she became unconscious while Yun Duritz slowly started to take over her soul, this time it took even longer considering she was two stages above Lin Lang's cultivation.
Her eyes opened as a light flickered therein and she bowed towards Yun Duritz while saying:
"Master."
"Another one has been added to my collection, splendid!"
"Tell me the living locations of all of the God Realm elders and guards."
The information was swiftly sent towards his soul as he got what he needed thus leaving her behind with the guise of still learning from the jade slip.
Yun Duritz started to disappear and appear around the house slowly taking control of the whole Lin household, elders, grand elders, and guards that were at the God Realm but below the late stage.
All of the late-stage cultivators were either meditating inside the deepest layers of the house that Yun Duritz couldn't get without attracting their attention, and he wasn't at the God Realm yet with his ki cultivation so it would be a stretch to fight those people yet, either way, he had enslaved all of the surface forces of the family and he was now truly in control of the Lin family, they were also way more serious and Yun Duritz even imparted them some of his cultivation experiences coming from Yun Jhin's memories thus their cultivation bases and battle power had improved by a bit, they only had to digest the experiences and they might even breakthrough in a thousand years or so.
Now that he had whole control of the family he had gone to the library and read every book that could be found in it, then he got his hands on the most important information book that the patriarch could only get with the acceptance of the council of elders but considering Yun Duritz controlled everyone he just shuffled through it and absorbed all of the information without the need of any approval.
"So this is how the bloodlines are inserted into the database of the gate... It seems that those that do not have any connection to the celestial realm can't enter even if they have their bloodline in the records... that's interesting."
Fortunately for Yun Jhin he had a celestial bloodline and his efforts weren't in vain, all Yun Duritz had to do was insert the bloodline into the database of the gate and Yun Jhin would be able to ascend to the celestial realm where he could finally wreak havoc and get continuous breakthroughs due to the especially good environment.
Yun Duritz left the city to return to the gate's location back into the forest where he summoned it according to the instructions he read in the book, he used his blood as a catalyst along with a chant and the door appeared, but it was different compared to the time he saw it in the mortal realm.
It wasn't as shining anymore and a small compartment opened up on the side that had quite a lot of samples of blood in it, each labeled with the names of the families that lived under the control of the Lin house.
"Hmmm all I have to do is insert Yun Jhin's blood here and he would be able to arrive at the celestial realm but the question is... how shall I even tell him he can come?"
"Well, whatever let's finish the job here first."
He still had Yun Jhin's bloodline in his body as he kept it there in case of emergency or if he ever needed the blood for something.
He took it out as he stabbed himself in the chest and let the blood flow into a small container that he got for this occasion, he then inscribed Yun Jhin's name on the container and put it in the opening.
He then closed it and did some more hand seals letting the portal disappear and return to its normal place and activity.
********************
In the mortal realm at the blood throne sect under the dark palace, Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he felt his bloodline resonating with the location of the celestial realm's portal...
"Ah I didn't even have to wait for much time... but what can I expect from myself besides extreme efficiency?"

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Yun Jhin has arrived
chapters.content:
"It seems creating that out-of-body incarnation was the right decision... such a quick and excellent work, I'm impressed with myself!"
Yun Jhin got up from his cross-legged position above the blood river as he called upon Marthon, Marthon arrived immediately as he got the call from Yun Jhin and kneeled in front of him.
"From now on you will be the patriarch of the sect... I have some business to take care of... from now on you will not be Marthon anymore."
"Your highness I? What do you mean by that."
"Oh, just one thing..."
Yun Jhin's arm inserted itself into Marthon's skull as life started to slip away from his eyes, he couldn't leave behind any weaklings to control the sect no matter how brainwashed he was, he was going to create another out of body incarnation to control the blood river!
Not much time had passed since Yun Duritz had arrived in the celestial realm, it was below 1 year and Marthon hadn't grown much, he was around the 8th stage of the sage realm now, even though the resources of the sect had been used on Yun Duritz, Yun Jhin could increase the cultivation of his closer confidantes using blood sacrifices, as the sect population increased there were even more benefits to be reaped, in Yun Jhin's eyes they were all sheep waiting for their wool to be harvested or slaughtered for their meat.
Unlike the previous situation, Yun Jhin could create an out-of-body incarnation with the cultivation at the 8th stage of the sage realm as he wasn't using a newly created body.
Marthon opened his eyes and did another bow before he left not announcing anything, now that he was an out of body incarnation he could control the blood river as well as the original, albeit it would be weaker due to the lack of cultivation base but he would be able to defend the headquarters from the predatory eyes of all of those interested.
Now that he had finished the preparations for leaving Yun Jhin immediately disappeared from the cave and started to teleport to the location of the gate to the celestial realm.
He appeared in the empty galaxy as he took in a deep breath the gate to the celestial realm appeared by itself and started to light up just as before, but unlike before he successfully passed through it!
Yun Jhin opened his eyes to find himself in a beautiful forest, the same bear that first met Yun Duritz was in the same position as before but unlike the laughing expression that he had when he met Duritz he felt as if he was ready to pee himself as Yun Jhin got up from the ground and his aura was unleashed at full power.
"Hahahaha." All of Yun Duritz's memories and current actions were reflected in his mind as his connection with him was restored, he didn't think he would get so much helpful information combined with the techniques from the Soul Emperor this was literally the best day of his current life!
All of the things that happened with Yun Duritz poured into his mind as he got a hold of the laws of the celestial realm, he had the same problem as Duritz regarding breakthroughs and with the laws taken from the soul emperor's tomb, he wouldn't have problems with breaking through until the 8th stage of the God Realm! The inheritance contained only 64 laws because it wasn't complete.
Yun Jhin disappeared after he put two fingers on his forehead and appeared directly in the house near Yun Duritz.
Yun Duritz bowed to him and Yun Jhin laughed as he put his hand forward for a handshake.
Duritz's eyes shined as he shook Yun Jhin's hand, his body started to transform into little light particles that Yun Jhin's body started to absorb, his body refining rank immediately jumped to the 10,000th ranks and catalyzed itself as Yun Duritz's bloodline was absorbed into Yun Jhin's body, as he was an out of body incarnation so whatever he had was Yun Jhin's when Yun Jhin decided it was time to go back to him he would be absorbed and all of his cultivation would be catalyzed into Yun Jhin's body along with his bodily strength.
Yun Jhin let out a breath that contained all of his frustrations from not being able to get into the celestial realm, his body reached the peak once again, he enjoyed the feeling of having the ultimate body strength as the Lin family's bloodline started to run rampant into his body, his muscles grew a little bit as his hair grew in length and changed to a pale green color before these changes reverted.
"Ah this is certainly a good transformation bloodline technique... the power increase is substantial."
Yun Jhin took a liking to the bloodline technique as his aura and face changed to Yun Duritz's.
Even though the absorption was instant and he still needed to play the part in case any of the old folks woke up and wanted to see him.
Now that he was here with his main body it was easier for him to act how he wanted considering his current cultivation was at the 4th stage and with the absorption of Yun Duritz he had recovered his soul power to its maximum and even improved it by more than 50%, he even felt that he was near a breakthrough!
"The 5th stage... yes I should breakthrough soon the oldbies will be alerted that way but that's what I want as they don't know my cultivation and everyone else who did is already mind-controlled, they would surely come to congratulate me and that's when I will strike... taking full control of the Lin family will make me the overlord of these eastern parts and I will be able to move wherever I want..."
Yun Jhin directly went to work as he started to channel the laws that he got from the Soul Emperor... his eyes clouded over as beams of energy left his body towards the skies where the laws were invited.
Because Yun Jhin current body was filled with an immense amount of destiny that he absorbed from Duritz the laws acted as if they were sharks that smelled blood as they rushed directly into his body and fused with it.
8 laws became 16 laws as Yun Jhin's body was enshrouded in a myriad of colors his cultivation finally increased once again!
He opened his eyes as he clenched his hand and punched the space in front of him destroying it thoroughly.
Under the house, 3 old men and 1 old woman suddenly woke up as they looked above and said:
"This is...? Lin Duritz? Wasn't he kidnapped by that Yuan Fang? When did he get back?"
"Hmm... it seems he is back and in his whole minds if no one attacks him and he is on the patriarch's seat, and his cultivation base isn't bad at all, it seems he just broke through and surpassed his big sister!"
"Should we go and grace him with our presence? It's customary for the patriarch to kneel before the ancestors for him to be truly accepted by the family, we didn't have to do this with Luan as she was only there to fill the role but considering Duritz is back we should go."
"Indeed, let's throw a banquet as well, we had been cultivating for such a long time but we still couldn't reach the peak of the God Realm... its unfortunate but we won't be able to join the ranks of the upper families until our deaths... well at least we will be able to hold onto our middle rank."
The 4 people flew through the ground as if they were ghosts and appeared in the throne room directly in front of Yun Jhin as they unleashed their auras.
Yun Jhin looked at them and bowed while saying:
"The ancestors I presume?"
"Indeed Lin Duritz, your act of breaking through had woke us up and we came to... install you properly as the patriarch as well as to party!"
"Oh, there are more things to be done before I'm truly the patriarch? I thought that was everything according to my sister."
"That was everything for her but not for you, you are the rightful successor so you are supposed to do a few more things compared to her who was just filling the status, now come here and kneel to us so we can give you your blessing!"
Yun Jhin took a few steps forward as he kneeled in front of the 4 oldbies before chuckling darkly, the chuckle didn't escape the big ears of the elders in front of him as they asked:
"Mind telling us what's so funny young man?"
"Oh, you wouldn't understand even if I told you... but let's say that we will have a change of pace around here from now on."
"I don't understand what do you mean... you?"
Suddenly a pentagram formation appeared below the feet of Yun Jhin and the elders as Lin Lang, Lin Luan, and a few other elders appeared from nowhere, they were powering up the formation with their own blood as they bleed slowly in the formation nodes to keep the formation going, Yun Jhin got up from his kneeling position as his body muscle mass increased and his transformation commenced.
The 4 elders couldn't move for a few seconds before they broke through the pentagram formation restrictions only for them to realize that while they were not paralyzed anymore they were still weakened by around 20%!
"Junior you dare!"
The 4 old people said in unison as they started to power up making their flaky and weak-looking bodies become just like those of bodybuilders the old woman included, this was the extreme form of the transformation which traded speed for strength fully, considering they were trapped together this was the best form for this occasion. However, Yun Jhin was using the balanced form instead.
Yun Jhin easily moved amongst them as if he was a ghost, he was basically dancing and weaving through their fist, palm, and leg attacks as he finally returned one attack, a leg sweep that made the 4 of them fall to the floor so hard that they left 4 indents on it.
The female elder grunted as she said:
"Occasional gravity outbursts?"
"Ding Ding Ding, you are correct, do you know what's your prize?"
Yun Jhin immediately appeared above her as he drove his leg on her neck cutting her oxygen supply and immobilizing her as he hit three parts of her meridians with his fingers on her chest and arms making her unable to move.
The three old men got up as they glared at Yun Jhin seeing their companion being immobilized on the floor being unable to even talk!
"You made a mistake to rebel, you all don't know that we are needed for the continuation of this family! Why are you doing this? We aren't even interested in secular affairs!"
Everyone kept mum as Yun Jhin didn't tell them to talk.
Yun Jhin appeared near them as his aura intensified and theirs started to diminish:
"Oh, you will see... you will join them in their collective thinking very soon."
The three elders glanced at each other as they suddenly started dancing confusing Yun Jhin as his aura faltered for a second...
Were celestial realm folks really clowns in disguise???

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Total control of the Lin family
chapters.content:
The dance made Yun Jhin stumbled for half a second, they were in a serious life and death situation and now they were doing a comedic dance?
However, Yun Jhin's eyes widened as he realized that the dance didn't mean to have a comedic effect, a curtain of light enveloped the 3 elders as they transformed into motes of light that fused!
Yun Jhin could almost not believe his eyes such a special technique existed, he could only fuse with out-of-body incarnations, clones, or avatars but there was no fusion technique meant to fuse two different individuals into one body, at least he didn't know of any.
But the impossible just happened in front of his eyes!
Yun Jhin was both happy and apprehensive as the fusion process finished almost instantly, out of the light came a rather young androgynous person, when the three of them looked like they had half a step into the grave the person that came out looked middle-aged at best.
It seemed the fusion was successful as the combined voices of three people came out of the middle-aged androgynous person's mouth:
"We shall take you down in the name of the Lin family you impostor!"
Yun Jhin's features turned back to normal as he cracked his neck and knuckles his form started to morph as his muscle mass increased but not to a high amount, it was basically graded 2 on the transformation tier list.
His hair grew in length as it turned pale green and a devilish tail grew out of his tailbone as it started to move menacingly behind him, he put his hand through space as he reached into his personal spatial dimension to take out a long halberd that was red as blood, after many tempering in the blood river his halberd became a Godly tiered weapon!
He could feel a strong pressure coming from the fused being in front of him, it was to the point that he actually needed to get serious for the second time in this life, up till now the only other occasion when he got serious was when he was injured fighting Yuan Fang on that dying planet... this could be considered the second time.
Yun Jhin's spat out a white cloud as his figure was enshrouded in the cloud and disappeared from the view of the fused being.
The fused being looked around trying to identify where Yun Jhin could have gone but a puzzled expression appeared on its face as it realized that Yun Jhin was nowhere in the closed space they were in!
That was impossible considering the pentagram formation cut off the outside and Yun Jhin couldn't exit it until the formation was broken, up till now there was no opportunity for Yun Jhin to leave.
Thus the fused being took a defensive stance as it kept its guard up and continued to look around, it didn't know when or where Yun Jhin would strike from but it was ready for any sneak attacks.
A halberd suddenly appeared from nowhere ready to cleave the fused being in two pieces vertically but the being blocked it by putting its arms in an X only leaving a small gash on its forearms.
That gash suddenly started to flow with green blood as the fused being staggered and its face started to pale:
"You even use poison? But how insidious can you get..."
"You have fused and you have the gall to talk about fairness?"
Yun Jhin couldn't help but retort, fusion was a rather strong technique and if they wouldn't have been trapped in the formation combined with the fact that they were rather reluctant to destroy their surroundings Yun Jhin would have had huge troubles dealing with them.
The halberd didn't stop as it struck from left-right, low and high trying to get the upper hand against the fused being, while the being didn't use any weapon its hands alone were deadly enough to be considered high graded weapons.
The clashes between their hands and Yun Jhin's halberd created sparkles of highly condensed light that started to burn the pentagram formation below them.
However, Lin Luan, Lin Lang, and the others started to dig deeper into their wrists as more blood flowed into the formation keeping it going at any price regardless of how weakened they would become because of blood-loss.
Yun Jhin's clashes with the fused elders increased in intensity as shockwaves started to spread in the formation making it start cracking due to the intense strain it was exposed, it couldn't be helped as the formation had been raised quite suddenly and while it did have many rare materials used for its construction it was battle between near-peak entities no matter how rare the materials were they couldn't handle this much strain without being tempered for a long time.
Yun Jhin coughed a glob of blood as he got hit in the stomach and his internal organs were shaken by the impact but the fused elders took two steps back as they tried to remove the halberd that was impaled in their chest, their strength started to be sapped away by halberd as it glowed with an ethereal bloody light.
Yun Jhin appeared in front of them as he put his hands on the handle of the halberd starting to absorb the bloody light into his body, his rather pale complexion started to return to normal before it became a healthy red color.
The halberd 'blood-sucking' ability had been bestowed by the blood river after being soaked in it for a certain period of time.
"HAAAAAAAAA!"
The fused elders let out a scream as they pushed the halberd out of their chest while inflating their muscles and hardening them afterward to stop more blood from gushing out.
Yun Jhin suddenly disappeared and appeared in front of them without them being able to move a muscle... it was the time skip technique!
The three-in-one person felt their vision swimming as its chest was impaled again with the halberd but this time the halberd came into its chest then out of its back, Yun Jhin closed his eyes as his hands started to vibrate the handle of the halberd immediately messing up the insides of the fused elders.
The androgynous face started to split up and age as their fusion started to run out of juice, their fused body was too damaged to be held together anymore so they split into three people again and the injuries that the fused body withstood were inflicted on their bodies as well but two times as intense!
They fell to the ground with frothing at the mouth as the poison infiltrated their nervous system.
It was a poison meant to deal with God Realm experts so it couldn't be flushed out so easily, all of Yun Jhin's attacks were enhanced with laws so while they could heal the damage dealt by him rather easily it would take time, something that they did not have right now, a fight between God Realm experts was one of endurance but Yun Jhin flipped logic around with his shameless tactics and immense knowledge of various poisons.
The four elders were all immobilized and it was time for them to meet their new master...
Yun Jhin's mind control technique was successfully used on the three of them without any hitch as they were both immobilized and weakened by a lot, even though their cultivation base was 3 stages higher than Yun Jhin's his battle power and strong body made up the gap between them rather inconsequential, while they were old their battle power wasn't anything great nor did they seem experienced. They were actually quite weak if they would be compared with those from the mortal realm but they could be considered country hicks in the celestial realm so if you thought of it a little bit more deeply it wasn't surprising they were rather weak.
As he connected with the minds of the four God Realm experts an immense amount of information assaulted his soul as he smiled in understanding:
"Eastern, western, northern, southern and central... these were all of the parts of the celestial realm and each had a gate that leads to the mortal realm, the families that protected them were all quite similar to the Lin Family only the northern and southern ones being a rank higher them both having peak God Realm experts. The only difference being the central area where the actual Empire and the actual Emperor of the celestial realm was..."
From all of the memories of the four, he learned that the Emperor of the Celestial Realm could be considered the strongest being in existence as he was also a half-a-step into the realm above the God one, he was exactly just like Hell's willpower! But unlike Hell's willpower, he could move around the whole realm if he wanted to and he didn't need a vessel to carry him around. Now all the ramblings of Hell's willpower made sense, it was rather jealous and envious of the celestial Emperor's ability to walk around.
As he took control of the eastern Lin family he controlled around 10% of the celestial realm, the other directions also controlled around 10% while the central realm controlled a whopping 60%.
Naturally, from now on he would have continued to expand firstly getting his hands on the other weaker family before moving on to the southern and northern families but it was quite early for that... he still needed to break through once more and his attack should also be a blitz type attack if he didn't want the central region to realize what was happening, he needed to leave no witnesses or else there was a chance word would leak out.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as he sat on the throne and waved his hand:
"Everything should go on as normal from now on, report to me whatever news you find to be more important but that's all I don't want to be disturbed while I cultivate, have I made myself understood?"
This message was sent telepathically to everyone who was connected to him when suddenly a shout could be heard coming from outside the house.
"Missive, a missive from the central region for the new patriarch Lin Duritz!"
Yun Jhin frowned as his face, aura and body changed to Lin Duritz's and he let the messenger enter the house and arrive at the throne room.

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Invitation for blessing
chapters.content:
The messenger bowed towards Yun Jhin before taking out a sealed envelope from his clothes, the ink seal was of bright azure color and it had the insignia of the imperial household of it which meant the letter came from someone from the household but below the Emperor.
It seemed Yun Jhin's assumptions were incorrect, at first he thought that he would be summoned by the Emperor, but how could the Emperor bother with a small family from the country?
The central area could be considered the place full of cities and the eastern, northern, southern, and western sides were all 'villages' in the eyes of those from the central area. However the messenger surprisingly didn't look down on Yun Jhin or anything like that, he actually looked at him with a respect filled gaze which showed that even though they were considered villagers they were respected for their guarding jobs.
Yun Jhin cracked the seal open before he opened the letter and started to read:
"Estimated lord Lin Duritz, for the occasion of being appointed as the house lord of the Lin family the imperial family had decided to hold a blessing ceremony for you so you can protect the celestial realm's borders even better than before, please sign your current cultivation base on the letter as it would help us prepare for your blessing with the right ingredients and resources." Signed the imperial household's butler Li Shiki
"Hmm, interesting..."
The messenger got up from his bowing position as he said:
"Lord Lin Duritz, if you want to accept the invitation you can travel with me back to the capital as I can guide you the best on the road, you can also take 2 or 3 aides with you, what do you say?"
Yun Jhin made a 'hmmm' sound as he thought about it seriously then asked:
"Will I get to meet the Emperor?"
The messenger shook his head as he said seriously:
"While you are doing a great job ensuring the safety of the celestial realm's borders the Emperor is a very busy man who doesn't have time to see even his closest kin, unfortunately, you wouldn't be able to meet with his highness but you can meet with his highness children and grandchildren if you want to."
Yun Jhin nodded, it was the best situation, refusing the invitation meant slapping the face of the imperial family or going among the lines of "I do not need your kindness." This could either offend them or in the best situation just make them resent him and cut off support from the eastern guardian family.
Both were things that wouldn't end up well for the current Yun Jhin until he took over at least one other family the monthly support coming from the central region was imperative to keep his army fully functional, most of the rarer resources in the treasury came from the support of the empire, they were the pay for the family's hard work.
Actually, the 5 families had the easiest jobs in the whole empire as no one could enter the celestial realm... of course, this changed the moment Yun Jhin put his foot on the land of the celestial realm.
"Get your aides and let's leave immediately Lord Lin Duritz, the faster we get to the capital the faster you can get your blessing."
Yun Jhin nodded as he decided to get his 'sister' and Lin Lang with him, they were the most 'familiar' with him and they were both quite obvious choices.
So Yun Jhin and his 'friends' started to travel towards the capital.
It would be a lie to say that Yun Jhin didn't enjoy the scenery of the celestial realm, unlike the cold and rather dead mortal realm, the celestial realm wasn't separated by huge empty patches of the galaxy.
The celestial realm was filled with picturesque images consisting of beautiful green mountain ranges, long winding rivers filled with carps and other multitudes of colorful fishes, forests filled with gorgeous and cute animals.
On the way to the capital, they had gone through quite a lot of these sceneries and Yun Jhin admired them, he liked the flora and fauna of the celestial realm, not only because it was beautiful, but because it was all beneficial towards cultivation!
From all of the things, he had seen up till now 90% of them would be useful for a God Realm expert or below, even though it wouldn't be useful for him, they would be useful for those in the early stages which meant he would be able to nurture a death squad of God experts!
Even though the cultivators in the celestial realm were more numerous when it came to God Realm experts it was obvious that they didn't have the same experience and battle power as the ones from the mortal realm, so if he used the resources of the celestial realm on his people in the mortal realm he would create an army that would slowly but surely take over the celestial realm!
Owning a realm meant owning its destiny and the celestial realm was the closest to breaking through the ties of the universe... if he could control this realm, he would surely be able to break through above the God Realm even if he didn't get his hands on the core of the universe!
If he realized how the breakthrough could happen in the mortal realm it meant that other peak God Realm experts must have as well, so it was unknown which path was better to take, fight the more numerous but relatively weaker celestial population or the lower in amount but stronger mortal population?
There was the obvious choice... the Celestial Emperor was a pain in his sides at the moment but he must have a weakness of some sort just like Hell's willpower, he was a creation of the universe as well since he was as old as Hell's willpower.
The arrival at the capital didn't trigger any waves as Yun Jhin and his aides were given a few rooms in the outer courts of the imperial palace, then they were told to wait there for a few short minutes as the messenger had to report their arrival.
After a few minutes of waiting the messenger came back and invited Yun Jhin alone in the throne room. While the Celestial Emperor was in seclusion the throne room would be occupied by his oldest son, Markus Oldio Castrono The 3rd.
Yun Jhin entered the throne room of the palace which spanned 5 meters in height and 20 meters in width, the palace itself was around 60 meters tall and it was painted a beautiful baby blue color with inscribing and paintings of different battles being depicted on its inner walls.
Yun Jhin kneeled in front of the prince who was casually sitting on the throne, however, the prince immediately got up with a puzzled expression on his face as he helped Yun Jhin up and said:
"You don't have to kneel in front of me I'm not my father and I'm not sure if I will ever become emperor in my life, I invited you here as a friend and not as a superior as changes in the familial hierarchy happen very rarely, I also heard from your people that you have been kidnapped to the mortal realm for quite a long time before you came back and I thought that it would be helpful for you and your family if you got blessed by the imperial destiny."
The man smiled as he slapped Yun Jhin's shoulder and laughed boisterously:
"After all, you must protect the borders from any invasions that could happen! It's unlikely that the mortal realm netizens would be able to break through the formation of the gate entrance in their whole existence but it's better to have defenders and be prepared! At least that's what my father says, anyways the blessing ceremony will be prepared in a few hours so why don't we take a tour of the capital and the palace?"
Yun Jhin smiled and nodded as he said:
"Sure why not, Even though I have just regained my memories I remember never visiting the capital nor the palace so I guess it would be a novel experience."
"Oh, you have lost your memories before? That's sad to hear but I'm glad you got them back, anyways let's go, I shall be your tour guide! Who else would know the capital and the palace better than the highest echelons?"
As Yun Jhin interacted and visited both the capital and some of the palace's interior rooms he realized what type of person this prince was, it wouldn't have mattered if he refused his invitation as he was one of those very very good people, he was the embodiment of naivety and pureness and he got the look on him as well, he had a baby face and blue eyes, blonde curly hair and he wore an azure robe that wrapped his dainty body, he looked both feminine and the peak of handsome masculinity at the same time.
Yun Jhin actually got sick of how the man acted, he wasn't even faking it, he was a genuinely good guy!
Yun Jhin hated good guys the most, they were the most sheltered people, the people that had gone through no bits of pain nor challenges, it was obvious from his gaze that the man didn't know what pain or loss was, the man didn't know about the struggle of the weak and poor, he was a good noble that would act well regardless of those that were in front of him... but he didn't think much about those below him, while he would act if he would see something going wrong, he would never proactively do something to make things better.
He was good but only on the surface... but he was genuine.
Yun Jhin saw countless people like him but they were very insidious inside, at least he was only half-full as the other part of him felt empty like he wasn't complete.
He found it to be rather strange... was something wrong with this guy?
He started to get second thoughts about the blessing but in the end decided to go with it anyway, at this point unless the Emperor himself came, he would have no problems to deal with or escape from 9th stair God Realm cultivators, especially the ones from the celestial realm.
The prince nodded to himself as he looked towards Yun Jhin and said:
"The preparations are finally complete and we can go to do the ceremony, do you need to do anything before we start, or are you ready to go?"
"Well, could you inform the aides that traveled with me about what is going to happen?"
"Yeah no problem, we don't want to worry them now do we?"
The man clapped and a previously invisible black dove appeared and took the message telepathically from Yun Jhin then flew away to send it to Lin Lang and Lin Luan.
"Let's go then."
"We shall."
Prince Markus took the lead as he slowly went through a few layers of the palace going further and further down until they reached the underground area, where he opened up a hatch and they both went down it, there was darkness everywhere but there was one light to guide them towards the ceremonial table....
There Yun Jhin found out what this ceremonial fuss was all about...

chapters.title: Chapter 225: The power of imperial destiny
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin looked at the ritual that was supposed to bless him with some of the nation's destiny, it didn't look like anything special, a circle had been drawn on the dark ground in front of him and it was the thing that made the eerie glow that guided him and the prince here.
Prince Markus smiled as he said:
"This is the formation that will instill the destiny into you."
He clapped twice in quick succession and out of the darkness that surrounded them two beautiful maids came.
"To absorb the destiny perfectly you will have to discard your clothes and soak into the formation as if it was a hot spring, so you need to take off your clothes, I shall leave you alone for now."
The prince disappeared as if he was never there...
Actually, Yun Jhin got surprised by his sudden disappearance... it seemed that the Celestial Emperor wasn't the only person that he had to look out for.
The maids giggled under their hands as they got near Yun Jhin and said:
"Master Duritz please take off your clothes so we can start the bestowal ceremony."
Yun Jhin wasn't sure what they were playing here but he took off his clothes and entered the circle formation, there he started to feel an immense amount of heat starting to gush out of the ground below him just like a geyser.
It was pure, raw destiny!
It seemed they didn't lie!
It wasn't as much destiny as Yun Duritz had gotten when he was accepted by the celestial realm but it was purer and denser, it was refined in a certain way...
Yun Jhin knew a lot about destiny so he understood that the destiny they were giving him was rather special in a sense.
This was destiny that had to deal with the rise and fall of the imperial dynasty, it came directly from the Emperor's hands!
However, it didn't have any connections with the Emperor which meant it was given rather willingly and with no attachments!
Were these people really foolish or did they truly believe he was Lin Duritz?
As destiny started to flush into his body he could feel it connecting directly with his other pool of destiny and then they started merging.
"This power is... excellent!"
His ki cultivation was getting fueled by the immense amount of destiny and with his knowledge of laws, he was getting ready for another breakthrough!
His ki was boiling inside his body as destiny fused with it and enhanced his power once more!
"Hahaa this is the stuff!"
Yun Jhin couldn't get enough of the destiny that was pouring into his body but good things all had an end.
After twenty minutes of being 'baptized' by destiny, the connection was firmly cut and the gushing destiny disappeared as if it was never there.
He took two steps out of the formation and the maids helped him wear his clothes.
Yun Jhin took another glance at the formation and shook his head inside he was very close to a breakthrough but he didn't want to get any unwanted attention by messing with the formation, he didn't have the courage to do it even if he was alone, and currently, he was being flanked by two busty maids.
"Patriarch Duritz... would you want us to relieve you of your pent-up after-cultivation stress?"
Yun Jhin wasn't in the mood as he waved his hand, he was so close to a breakthrough but it was pretty much removed from his sight forcefully at the end, he needed just 1 more step...
It was almost as if they did this deliberately!
He followed the maids out of the underground area of the palace and met up with Prince Markus again who was still all smiles.
The man patted his shoulder and said:
"Enjoyed the baptism of imperial destiny brother Duritz?"
"Hahaha, I can't say that I have ever experienced such a great deal of pure destiny before."
"Oho? It seems you know your stuff brother Duritz."
"I have been in contact with some destiny once I have taken the position as patriarch of the family but it wasn't anything as pure and strong as the destiny I have gotten here."
"Well, of course, I don't think I will have to explain to you the difference between the eastern parts and the central ones right?"
"Of course sir I know about the differences but living and seeing them directly is something else..."
"Indeed..."
"Now that you are done with your baptism is there anything else you would want from me?"
This was a strange question to Yun Jhin and this made him put his guard up, it seemed that what he thought was true, he only got the destiny stopped at that point because they realized he was at a breakthrough.
What did they want from his identity as Lin Duritz? What could be of use from a guardian and an average family?
Seeing that Yun Jhin's guard went up after that question made the prince drop his act as he put his hand on Yun Jhin's shoulder and said:
"Ok since you know that we didn't invite you here for the blessing alone I will be frank with you..."
"We need you to destroy the gate restrictions of every cardinal direction..."
"???"
It would be an understatement to say that Yun Jhin was as lost as he could be the moment the prince opened his mouth and told him that, he wasn't sure how much time the celestial realm existed for but it was forever hidden from the eyes of the mortal realm and hell, and now it wanted to reveal itself?
At this point he knew that the realm was lacking in true battle-hardened experts so it was would be easy pickings for the bloodthirsty monsters that lived below, Hell was especially mad at the celestial realm and its inhabitants so Hell's willpower might exert a lot of strength and open up a new gate earlier than intended.
"Your highness if you don't mind... why would you ever think about doing that?"
"Oh I understand your concerns, you are actually the first person I went to because of your special circumstances..."
It seems that Prince Markus thought that because he lost his memories he wouldn't have any deep connections to the celestial realm and as long as he got enough benefits he would surely give up on protecting it, after all, he lived amongst those profit-oriented mortal realm commoners for such a long time so some things should have rubbed on him right?
If it was the actual Duritz, Yun Jhin didn't know if he would have let the invasion of the mortal realm and hell commence for some destiny... but Yun Jhin would surely do it, but he still needed to look reluctant on the surface so he could squeeze more things out of the prince.
"Your majesty I don't know... what about the lives of the commoners? What do you think will happen when the restrictions on the gates will be broken?"
"Do I look like I care?"
After he had shown his true colors his face had become as glacial as the top of the mountains.
"If I might enquire..."
"No, you can't enquire about the details about why I need you to destroy the restrictions, all you need to know that if you accept you will be heavily rewarded... and if you decline you won't be able to leave the palace alive."
An immense amount of pressure assaulted Yun Jhin's body to the point that he almost kneeled, however that's when his aura unleashed itself as well countering the pressure and not kneeling in front of Prince Markus:
"Your majesty I might understand the etiquette of kneeling to one's superiors but I don't want it to be forced."
Markus laughed as he said:
"I like you kid, it seems that the destiny you got from your family wasn't in small amounts! I know about your Lin family special physique but yours is even more terrifying than the one of your ancestor's"
After Yun Jhin fused with Yun Duritz his physique evolution wasn't a normal 1+1 but more rather of a 2x5 + the combination of their body refining ranks.
So if Yun Jhin's body was a 2 then Duritz's was a 5 and they multiplied each other then they combined their body ranks to reach a perfect and flawless body.
Yun Jhin's current bodily strength was so high that it even made Markus reluctant in fighting him by himself while they were in his own territory!
The aura that came from Yun Jhin's body dissipated as he said:
"I can listen to your plan, I just hope those rewards won't be withheld due to various reasons."
Markus laughed as he came a little bit closer to Yun Jhin and said:
"While I do not care what happens to those weaklings, how could I treat my strong generals and guards badly? As long as you do your job you will be rewarded accordingly... now for the plan, listen well cause I will be able to tell you only once!"

chapters.title: Chapter 226: A plan made to dethrone the Emperor
chapters.content:
Markus got his mouth a little bit closer to Yun Jhin's ear as he started to whisper his plan, however, nothing came out of his mouth as he used a transmission technique to send all of the information directly to Yun Jhin's brain.
"What's with the posturing if you were going to use a transmission technique anyways..."
"Here's how things will go, I will withhold all help from the central region when you attack the other guarding regions, all you have to do is destroy the portal restrictions so you can let those from the mortal realm and hell flood into the celestial realm, very easy right? Even if your cultivation base is rather low your body should be enough to defeat them."
"But prince Markus... why?"
"Again with the why's, can't you be a good minion and do what you are ordered to?"
"I just want to know prince Markus."
"Ok I will tell you but you will have to sign a contract so you won't be able to disclose anything that you have learned now."
A puff of smoke appeared as Markus clapped his hands and a contract made from red paper appeared.
Yun Jhin took a look at the contract and realized that it was made from a special skin conglomeration and that was why the 'paper' was red.
If Yun Jhin broke the contract he would be cursed and all of the destiny in his body would be siphoned into the dynasty.
He made sure he had read it correctly a few times before making sure there are no hidden penalties in the contract before signing it.
The contract disappeared in a plume of red clouds as Markus put his hands together put on a fake smile and decided to explain to him why he was doing this, after all, he didn't want a confused minion who would doubt his words, at this point he wouldn't be able to force him to do anything and when he said that he wouldn't be able to leave the palace alive he didn't realize how strong Yun Jhin actually was.
"The reason is very simple... I want to be emperor!"
It was such a cliche reason and Yun Jhin couldn't even think why the man would want to dethrone the actual Emperor as he was the determining factor that kept the whole celestial realm up and running properly.
Seeing that Yun Jhin was both puzzled and flabbergasted at the prospect of dethroning the actual Emperor made Markus shook his head as he said:
"I'm one of the older children of the emperor and there is a chance that I won't be able to inherit the throne before the Emperor dies, its unknown how much time he still has left in him but his body is currently weakening."
"However it doesn't matter as his soul willpower will continue living on which means that I will never be able to become Emperor during my natural lifespan."
"Does it really matter if you are Emperor or not as long as the dynasty is prosperous?"
"Of course it does! My dream since I was little was to sit on the seat of the Emperor's throne but realizing that it was an impossible dream made me boil with anger and resent my immortal father, the dynasty continued to flourish but my happiness was nowhere, I always thought about, why am I unhappy when the citizens are happy? Why am I hating every moment that I live as a prince... even though I have power and authority that rival the Emperor? Am I crazy that I want a title that wouldn't help anyone much, even me?"
"The answer was no... I only craved something because I didn't have it, even though I'm near the peak I'm not at it, I just want more because there is more to have, its only human nature that I'm following and I found that I'm not wrong..."
Yun Jhin nodded, this man was similar to him, both wanted more because there was more, he wanted to be Emperor while Yun Jhin wanted eternal life, the goals weren't similar but the ways they wanted to achieve them were practically the same, without any care about anyone!
"I guess I could help your majesty to achieve your dream, to be frank with you I'm an avid follower of the martial path, and cultivation breakthroughs are what I want the most If I could get more destiny after I have done my missions I would be the most grateful."
"Hahahaha, very good Lin Duritz, very good."
"Since you have accepted let me give you a more in detail explanation."
Markus started to explain how the peak god realm experts would surely be tempted the moment the gates would appear and they will go in regardless of the consequences.
So the moment a bunch of foreign peak God Realm experts made themselves visible the Emperor would surely awaken and quicken his body's decay, even though he was half a step into the other realm once his body was lost his power would surely decline, and while he might be able to take care of a Peak God Realm expert in a 1v1 situation what if a dozen ganged upon him?
A soul without a body was certainly weaker by about 20-30% and if you considered the fact that The Soul Emperor was extremely old meant that his power should be ebbing around now, as a universal wonder he didn't reincarnate since the universe had been created so his age couldn't really be known nor calculated.
So just like all old things he would start to expire, Hell's willpower didn't have that problem as it didn't have a body but it was also weaker than when the universe was created.
"Ok now that you know everything ready up your army and invade the western family and capture it first, make it as quickly as possible so they wouldn't be able to send any news to the other families."
Yun Jhin saluted and left the palace then met up with Luan and Lang before leaving the capital and central area altogether.
They got back to the eastern area where they went back to their city, there Yun Jhin rallied up a moderately sized army that he trained personally, as he was connected with their souls he could give them mental training and teach them techniques pretty quickly.
Since they were under his complete control he taught them his patented stealth technique and created a perfect assassination death squad corps!
He had already got a map of the whole celestial realm after he took over the Lin family so he knew where the western family was.
The western family was called the Kun family and they were proficient in medical techniques, this was the reason they were one of the weaker families while the Lin family was weaker because they were a battle maniac family that was battle starved.
The Kun family headquarters were a little bit different compared to the Lin family's, the Lin family wasn't that proficient in anything if it wasn't battle-related so Yun Jhin easily snuck in and took care of the whole family.
However, he could see that the Kun family was proficient in formations from the huge pulsating energy that surrounded their place, being proficient in both medicine and formations showed that the Kun family was worthy of the guardian title.
Yun Jhin didn't want to scare nor alert the family so he was currently waiting at the entrance of the family with his troops all in stealth, waiting for any disciple to leave the family so he could interrogate them and see if there was any way to break through the formation. Unfortunately, even with all of his knowledge in formations he didn't really know what type of defensive formation the one in front of him was, it was mostly due to it being from a different branch of formation compared to the ones in the Lin family and the mortal realm, Yun Jhin was actually quite impressed with the quality of the formation and he wanted to study the blueprints of the formation and whatever knowledge on formations the Kun family got.
It actually took a lot more waiting than Yun Jhin wanted, they stood there in stealth for around 30 days before one disciple left the barrier and started to quickly run towards the direction of the capital.
Yun Jhin easily intercepted him as he jumped down from the tree he was hiding in soundlessly, grabbed him by the neck, and jumped up back in the three with him in tow.
The disciple was scared, he wore a white robe with a red cross on the front of it with the Kun family name's inscribed on the back.
"Let me go right to business, how do we disable the formation?"
The man trembled as he kept his mouth shut not wanting to betray his family.
Yun Jhin shook his head, he was just a sage realm expert, he didn't want to waste his time with soul scourging but since he didn't want to say anything Yun Jhin clamped his hands on the man's skull and forcefully removed all of his memories.
Yun Jhin frowned as he got the knowledge on how to turn off the formation, but he needed to be inside the formation for that to happen and anyone without the bloodline of the Kun family would make the formation react sending an alert to the patriarch of the family.
The patriarch's strength wasn't that high, ki cultivation wise he was at the same level as Yun Jhin which meant that Yun Jhin would wipe the floor with him even if he fought against 10-20 or even 50 of them at the same time.
However the formation was too wide and too strong so if he didn't turn it off there was a high chance he would be entrapped by it, while he wouldn't die his troops wouldn't have an easy time and they would be annihilated.
If no reinforcements came from the capital to capture him it would trigger a series of events where the 3 other families would rebel making the Emperor awaken and the whole plan would be destroyed.
Yun Jhin had his own plan based on prince Markus's plan so he needed to go along with his for some time until he could put his to work.
For now, he had to make up a way to break through the formation surrounding the Kun family's headquarters.

chapters.title: Chapter 227: Kun family is down
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin was currently overlooking the whole formation from the high ground trying to find a way that he could breach the formation and storm the headquarters, if he could get in he would make sure he captured every family member down to the babies.
He couldn't let anyone leave after he broke the barrier and he had a plan, it was fairly simple and it involved another mind-controlled victim since the first person was dead he needed to wait for another Kun family person to get out, it was unfortunate that he had passed away so suddenly, as he still had some uses but Yun Jhin already messed up his soul by forcefully snatching his memories...
Well, he could feel that the place was full of life force which meant it had a pretty good population so he could wait for another person to leave the formation bounds so he could capture them.
He already left someone back at the eastern portal to destroy the restrictions on it on his command, he wanted to destroy all of the restrictions at the same time to create an invasion coming from all directions.
Yun Jhin's waiting proved fruitful as another disciple from the family left the bounds of the formation, but this time he didn't rush anywhere as he warily looked around, it seemed the Kun family had something that notified them of the first disciple's death and this next one was meant to scout out for the danger and confirm that they were getting attacked by humans or by beasts.
The disciple was rather flustered as he looked around, it was obvious he was a low-level grunt in the organization and he was only sent out because if he died nothing of value would be lost.
This complicated things for Yun Jhin a bit as useless cannon fodder like the person here wouldn't really be allowed around the core of the formation, which needed to be accessed to be turned off.
But he could work around this with his skills, he could even impart him some of his cultivation techniques just like he did to the others and sneak into the core, all he needed was the formation to not react to him, and considering he came out of it with no problems he should be able to get right back in with no problems.
Yun Jhin's silhouette disappeared as he jumped down from the tree and melded with his surroundings, appearing behind the unsuspecting scout and striking a blow to the back of his head making him fall unconscious to the ground where he scooped him up and disappeared together.
He arrived a few hundreds of meters away from the formation where he immediately subjugated the weak mind of the scout before sending him down from the tree they were currently in.
The scout went down the tree and walked back to the headquarters as if nothing happened.
The scout's name was Kun Kong and his cultivation base was at the 1st stage of the sage realm.
He wasn't actually a scout but a small apprentice at the apothecary shop in the city that was the Kun family's headquarters.
Considering they were a family made up of mostly medical practitioners the business at the apothecary shop was booming, the sole reason Kun Kong was let to be the scout was that the apothecary shop was near the exit of the city and that as was mentioned before he was only a small apprentice and thus disposable.
It was a surprise when he came back and reported that there were actually no beasts nor attackers outside but this made the people inside the city more vigilant, they didn't think that Kun Kong was a traitor or anything like that but that their enemies were smarter than they let on.
They still weren't sure if they were humans or intelligent beasts but their guards were as up as they could get.
Yun Jhin could see through Kun Kong's eyes and he scoffed at them no matter how guarded they were they would be slaughtered like sheep.
At first, Kun Kong did his job as he was instructed until the night fell and he left for home so he could go and cultivate... but unlike the usual where Kun Kong would go home this time he just disappeared as he used Yun Jhin's stealth technique and started to move towards the formation core.
The location of the formation core wasn't a secret for the higher ranked and middle-ranked inhabitants of the Kong family, fortunately, the person that Yun Jhin got his information from could be considered an apprentice to a rather known doctor in the family so he had some knowledge about the formation even though it couldn't be said that he knew much about it.
But even the small amount of information that he knew was pretty much golden to Yun Jhin!
Kun Kong sneaked towards a heavily guarded palace where he simply just slipped in through the guards and disappeared inside.
A winding maze appeared in front of Kun Kong's eyes which Yun Jhin analyzed and sent a command to Kun Kong's soul on how to solve, Kun Kong then walked directly through the maze walls according to another one of Yun Jhin's techniques.
In the end, he reached the last room where the formation core was, all formation cores were either bound up to an item, person or location and in this case, the core was bound to an item.
Kun Kong saw the core of the formation which was a small white bell made from white painted ceramic.
