There was no one around the bell, at least on the surface because the moment Kun Kong put a foot in the room where the bell was located his stealth was naturally turned off by unknown methods.
Kun Kong's grasp on the technique wasn't as good as Yun Jhin's even though Yun Jhin imparted the technique directly his talent affected his comprehension and combined with his low cultivation base made him a failure.
Yun Jhin frowned as he saw his technique be undone and felt a presence approaching him through their soul connection.
"Huh? Who are you and what are you doing here?"
It was a special guard that was stationed here to protect the formation core, up till now it didn't see or sense Kun Kong but the moment his stealth turned off he was easily identified, the guard came up in front of Kun Kong and narrowed his eyes as he said:
"This isn't a place for civilians, I'm not even sure how you got here, what are the guys outside doing letting you enter?"
Kun Kong kept his head down and shook seemingly frightened, the guard came a little bit closer to him and analyzed his body language before sighing:
"You got here by accident? It's ok you won't be punished, let's get you out of here."
Suddenly the shaking body of Kun Kong started to expand so fast that the guard couldn't react in time, the body exploded into a shower of rays of light and blood as the chunks of meat and organs exploded as well after a few seconds, just like timed bombs.
The white ceramic bell cracked in half and broke while the guard survived with only some third-degree burns that were already starting to heal.
His eyes were wide as two saucer plates as he looked at the broken bell, he knew that he fucked up and his post would surely be taken away from him!
Yun Jhin smiled as he saw the barrier protecting the city starting to disperse by itself and did some hand seals as his assassination squad jumped directly into the city and went to work!
Fires started to appear as the squad incinerated houses and people to create pandemonium, making it easier to kill and enslave.
Yun Jhin was taking in all of the sights of suffering and killings happening all around him as he slowly walked towards the highest building in the city, he waited a few seconds as a middle-aged man and an old man flew out of the building with both anger and fear on their faces.
The moment they saw Yun Jhin they knew that he was the main culprit, he was already flaring his aura and his body was in battle mode.
Yun Jhin didn't have any time to talk with these people so he immediately appeared between them and backhanded each of them directly into the ground below, the moment they touched the ground two green small balls of energy touched their bodies then expanded into two supernovas that exploded on contact almost destroying their physical bodies directly!
Two gigantic holes were created due to the attack, smoke and debris were still in the air as Yun Jhin peered into the two big holes and tried to sense if there was still any life in them.
Seeing that there were still two weak sparks of life coming from the holes made him accelerate down like an eagle trying to sweep up some food as he wanted to capture them and enslave them, while he easily defeated them, it was mostly because they weren't fighters, while Yun Jhin didn't need their medical expertise it couldn't be said the same about those under him.

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Moving from one family to another
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin fished the duo of men from the holes and put his hands on each of their foreheads before he subjugated them into his slaves.
Any type of resistance was futile in front of the Soul Emperor techniques and combined with the fact that they were quite close to death made the subjugation fast and successful.
The duo kneeled in front of Yun Jhin as they called him master and he waved his hand taking away the ki he inserted in his body to reduce their healing factor, thus after a few seconds while they were still a bit exhausted their injuries had been fully healed.
Seeing the patriarch and ancestor of the family kneeling to the invaders made the defenders immediately deflate like a balloon, their morale hit an all-time low as they started to surrender or tried to escape, only for Yun Jhin to raise one hand to the sky and unleash a gigantic barrier that enveloped the whole city making it impossible for anyone to escape.
He started to float into the air as he looked down at each and ever defending person before unleashing a storm of mental willpower, the storm engulfed everyone regardless of gender, cultivation base, or age, their eyes started to turn slack as they all fell to their knees and started to chant Yun Jhin's name.
Finally after a few touches here and there he had properly captured the Kun family city and by extent, the whole western location, all he had to do now was leave the family to continue as they were doing beforehand, on paper nothing would have happened to the family and things would go on as they were supposed to, but after he finished capturing all of the families things would start to run rampant.
No news leaked about the capture of the Kun family as Yun Jhin made sure there were no escapes.
After he repaired the formation and inserted some of his soul willpower into it to take full control, he decided to leave with his squad, which now had a few more members, they were Kun family experts and they would be able to heal his troops in the future conflicts, the southern and northern family were way stronger than both the eastern and western family, even if the eastern and western families joined hands there was still a chance the northern or southern families would be able to take care of them without the help of one another.
Yun Jhin had already gotten some intelligence from the Lin family and combined it with the one from the Kun family and he also got some intelligence from the prince thus he had a complete view of both families.
The northern family was called Han and they were the strongest guardian family, not because of their nature or talents, it was mostly because they were the richest family around, they had connections in the central realm and they were originally a merchant family that rose to power due to their political connections, however, this leads to them being good at business and average at everything else, while they had strong people in the family their battle power was average or below because they were spoon-fed cultivation resources until they reached their talent peak.
So while their strength was high, Yun Jhin could dismantle them like a precise surgeon as long as he fought them alone, if the southern and northern families joined hands things would be a little harder but that meant he had to blitz one family first making sure that they wouldn't send any reinforcements.
As for the southern family, they were called Chen and they were only a little bit weaker than the northern family, they were a family of generals and fighters quite similar to the Lin family but a few degrees lower, they came from a military background from before the celestial realm was united.
They were the original fighting force that worked under the Emperor but due to the Emperor's descendants looking at them with a wariness that they might expand their power in the central area thus creating a new noble family so they were 'assigned' a job to protect the celestial realm at its southern borders, this leads to them being ostracized and depressed, as they had fought with all they had for the Emperor and their descendants had done such a cruel thing to them, leading to their decline in power, however, they didn't decline by much as they got over their depression rather quickly, their average battle power was higher than the northern family but they had a smaller amount of experts and they were only proficient in battle thus they were rather poor as the current era that they lived in didn't need their proficiency.
Yun Jhin actually looked down upon every netizen of the celestial realm, they grew weak and mushy due to their lifestyle and peace, they were squandering their cultivation resources, if he was honest with himself with the current resources he would be able to create thousands of peak God realm experts if he used them on the people of the mortal realm and hell.
As he analyzed the strengths and weaknesses of the Chen and Han families he finally decided on the next target, the Han family had more experts thus it would be harder for him to 'blitz' them and their cultivation bases were higher even though their battle power was lower their stamina was better so they would fight longer, long enough for them to actually be able to slip through his troops and send out for reinforcements, while Yun Jhin defeated the Kun family patriarch and ancestor rather fast, it was because they were not battle experts and their cultivation base was pretty low, only one or two levels above Yun Jhin which meant they were akin to punching bags in Yun Jhin's face.
So Yun Jhin decided to attack the relatively poorer, and weaker Chen family, since they were poor they would also have no such thing as a strong formation like the Kun family so it was even easier to infiltrate amongst their midst and assassinate, subjugate and conquer them.
The south was a rather arid place, as Yun Jhin traveled with his squad the heat around them started to increase by big amounts, their surroundings started to turn from picturesque images to a desert place, cacti plants appeared in their view and vulture-like birds started to circle their party, only for Yun Jhin to glare at them which resulted in fried vultures dropping from the sky into the hands of his squad which they ate.
The further they went into the desert the hotter it became until they reached an oasis, the oasis was quite heavily guarded which indicated they reached the Chen family headquarters, unlike the Kun, Lin, and Han families the Chen family didn't govern any people, they were the only family that had no subordinates as living in the desert was quite hard for the pampered netizens of the celestial realm, the realm was so big and there were so many good locations, why would they choose the dry southern lands that had only one main oasis?
The Chen family only lived here because they were ordered by the imperial family or else they wouldn't endure such harsh living conditions, even though the oasis had some food and water the heat was still there and it sapped the stamina of the guards even though they were under the shade of some palm trees, it wasn't really enough.
Yun Jhin didn't approach the settlement of the Chen family as he did some hand signals indicating for his squad to disappear, he first analyzed the whole place to see what type of defenses they had and if there was surely no formation at hand, their houses looked to be pretty well constructed from the red ground that could be found around the oasis, which was cool in the day and hot in the night.
After Yun Jhin was done with scouting he realized that there was no formation to say, but the troops were aligned in such a way that they created no blind spots that someone could move through, his subordinates stealth still needed some work so it wasn't perfect like his yet, so, for now, he had to go by himself to create some pandemonium, attracting the guards from protecting the entrance to the settlement, before letting his squad enter and start the fight properly!
Now that he had a proper plan he disappeared, even though his surroundings made it harder for him to use his stealth he still did it pretty easily, he reached such a high proficiency in stealth that it didn't matter where he was, he would be able to disappear.
He easily made his way through the guards and entered the settlement, looking around he saw that most of the people wore turbans and wide clothes to keep themselves cool in the day, they were all tanned from living in these conditions for a rather long time but their features were still the same as those of the celestial realm, high noses small jaws and lithe bodies not really packed with muscle.
Of course, the Lin family was an exception because of the bloodline that ran through their veins they were all packed with muscle but it didn't weigh them down much as their bloodline evolved so did their battle form, in this situation as Yun Jhin analyzed the physiques of the Chen family members he realized that they also had some type of battle mode but he wasn't sure what it was, after all, they were coming from a waring lineage, while they didn't have a special bloodline they must have a special technique that everyone could train in.
Yun Jhin wanted both the technique and control over the family... and he was ready to get both at a moment's notice, right now he was just preparing to bleed dry some of the nearby people to start the pandemonium.

chapters.title: Chapter 229: Chen family falls
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin thoughts ran quickly as he formulated the best plan to create the most efficient way to create a distraction big enough to make the whole place collapse like a card house.
He just needed to push the right places for the people around him to run like headless chickens.
His thoughts made him look towards the oasis's water if the waters were to be poisoned or something happened to them, these people would surely go crazy, at this point the water was the only thing keeping the Chen clansmen sane, the heat was really intense and Yun Jhin only resisted it because of his impressive physique.
The heat of the desert was so intense that ki cultivation didn't really protect you from it as it would go directly through any ki shields you would create.
As he looked at the waters he saw that they were guarded but not as much as the entrance, it was more of guarding so everyone could get their quota of water or to make sure no one got extra or stole any.
The Chen family lived rather hard lives but they didn't seem to be really sad about it, they were boisterous as they walked around talked, and even laughed.
Yun Jhin walked around for a short time before he approached the oasis water, the water amount didn't look to be much at first glance but as Yun Jhin enhanced his eyes with ki he saw directly through the bottom of the lake, there he saw a crack in the ground where the water was slowly seeping from to recover the lost amount.
While poisoning could work in this situation Yun Jhin didn't want to waste so many good slaves, increasing the number of agents he had in the celestial realm was imperative for the future battle when the mortal realm and hell would invade.
So for now he decided to cast a very strong illusion technique to make it like the lake was drying up, this would surely take the attention of everyone in the tribe regardless of what other jobs they had.
Yun Jhin looked at the water for a few seconds and it started to disappear seemingly as if his eyes absorbed it all, however, Yun Jhin just put on an illusory formation over the water.
The guards were keeping serious faces as they waited for people to get their water quota but when they looked behind to check on the water their faces turned pale to the point that you might not think they were tanned.
"Aaahhhhhhhhhhhhh!"
"THE WATER HAS DRIED UP!"
The scream of the guards alerted the whole settlement as they all rushed towards the lake, the guards at the entrance immediately rushed in without any regards for any invasions, they had guarded the place since they entered adulthood but there had never been any invasion of some kind, they could go and check their livelihood right?
Yun Jhin's squad did some hand signals as they immediately rushed behind the guards, now that their formation was broken up it was easy to take care of them.
Hidden blades appeared out of the wrists of the assassination squad as they impaled them in the backs of the guards, some of them directly slashed their necks open and infused their ki into the wound making it grow and fester before exploding into a shower of blood and pus.
The sudden deaths of the rushing guards made the remaining ones put their guard up as they were torn between running away to see what happened to the water and defending their people.
Suddenly a child that looked to be around 8 to 9 years old fell to the ground as he tried to run away, his mother cried out in pain and fear as she tried to quickly get him up from the ground and run away with him only for a dagger to insert itself directly through the child skull pinning him to the ground.
The mother's tears started to rush out like a waterfall as her eyes turned fully white, she clutched her chest and died of heartbreak.
Cultivators could get heart demons that had different effects depending on the intensity of the demon if they didn't sever their emotional attachments.
In this case, the woman died from her heart demons as her child was killed right in front of her.
After so many deaths pandemonium struck the Chen family as well, deaths continued to appear while the red buildings were burning to the ground.
This naturally attracted the attention of the higher-ups, they thought that the guards would be able to stop everything but by the time they realized how serious things were the casualties already reached a pretty high number, of course, the deaths were only the weaklings as Yun Jhin's squad picked up only the useless people.
Two strong-looking females with tattoos over their faces who wore tribal clothes appeared in the air the lake of the settlement, they looked around and identified the assailants who wore black robes, they were Yun Jhin's squad, and the moment they saw the female duo they immediately turned their stealth on and scampered, they had done their jobs and now it was Yun Jhin's turn.
"Sister these despicable people... look at what they have done! They must be behind the water disappearance as well!"
The one who said that was a 2,10 meters tall woman, her body was rippling with muscles and she wore a short skirt, and her chest was wrapped in bandages to keep her breasts from getting in her way, she was the definition of an Amazonian woman.
"I don't know sister... this might be a trap, we should be more careful."
The one who replied was a rather short woman standing at 1,56 meters, unlike her sister she wore more conservative clothes that kept her whole body cloaked underneath, her amber-colored eyes looked everywhere down below trying to search for Yun Jhin's squad, only for her to return empty-handed.
She frowned as she felt something above her, she looked up only to be met with Yun Jhin's elbow drop, the elbow hit her directly in the face pilling her into the ground below and angering the tall woman.
"HOW DARE YOU HIT MY BIG SISTER!"
She grabbed Yun Jhin by the face before throwing him directly to the ground creating a gigantic crater not caring about the consequences nor wellbeing of her tribe.
The short woman got out of the ground coughed a mouthful of blood and looked at the crater near her as she shouted at the tall woman:
"SISTER, WHAT ARE YOU DOING?"
This made the tall woman stop her attempt at pursuing Yun Jhin as she realized that her attack had actually killed a few of their tribesman due to the impact shockwave.
Yun Jhin dusted himself as he got out of the crater, he cracked his neck as he looked across the crater to the short sister who got out of the hole that was shaped just like her body.
Yun Jhin pointed at her from afar as a small purple beam of ki pierced directly towards her chest.
The short sister felt imminent danger from the thin and small purple beam of ki that was ready to impale her chest, she tried to dodge the attack only for her tall sister to appear in front of her and tank the attack with her beefy chest.
The tall sister laughed as she pointed at Yun Jhin and said:
"Was that supposed to be an attack? Desert mosquitos bite harder than that!"
Yun Jhin shook his head... this wasn't an attack meant to injure, the short sister immediately got near her sister and put her hand on the small hole that the beam created, they were both at the 8th stage of the God Realm but the wound that opened up didn't close!
Such an insignificant hole would immediately close up the moment it was made but more than a few seconds passed and it was still there!
"Don't bother trying to heal it, your little sister is done for."
The tall woman tried to laugh again only for her to clutch her face, veins started to inflate on her face as she started to shout in pain, she immediately punched the nearest thing which was her sister, the punch made her fly for a few kilometers before she stabilized her body and returned via small teleportation.
Suddenly she felt the space around her tighten as it was sealed thoroughly, from the corner of her eye she saw Yun Jhin finishing his hand seals as the tall woman kneeled in front of him, she was already his slave, Yun Jhin wasn't called the blood throne master for no reason, the moment the purple beam of ki entered the tall sister's bloodstream she basically became his puppet in body, and now when the short sister came back, the tall one was his slave in mind as well.
The short sister knew that something was wrong with her hot blooded family member, she knew that her sister would never kneel even to their parents, Yun Jhin looked at the short sister and flashed her a smile as he whispered something to the tall one, she got up from her kneeling position as she speeds past, blitzing her short sister and grabbing her by the neck.
Tears could be seen streaming down from the tall woman's eyes as she looked at her big sister's face, could be seen that her inner memories were still struggling against Yun Jhin's mind control but unfortunately for her, Yun Jhin snapped his fingers and all of her memories became sealed up, her face morphed into a cold expression as she dragged her big sister behind her like one would do a sack of garbage.
The short sister was then thrown down in front of Yun Jhin, the tall one was making her kneel in front of Yun Jhin as she put her foot on her head and pushed making her even kowtow to him.
The short sister gritted her teeth as she tasted the red dirt, her eyes clouded over as Yun Jhin's hands were inching towards her skull...
Unfortunately for her, her little sister was dumb enough to take an attack from Yun Jhin making her immediately turn against her and losing the advantage, the tall one was proficient in body refining and very physically strong while the short one was ki focused, the moment the tall one was captured was the moment the short one lost her shield and Yun Jhin gained a spear.
The conquering process was finally over as Yun Jhin took over both of the sister's minds, and the only thing left was to take over the minds of the remaining clansmen who were all looking at him from the cracks of their opened doors, hatches, or wherever they hid.
Yun Jhin flashed all of them a smile as he put his hand up, ready to unleash another mind enslaving field just like he did at the Kun family.

chapters.title: Chapter 230: The Han family is troublesome
chapters.content:
As Yun Jhin raised his hand to the sky a mental field arose that engulfed the whole settlement of the Chen family.
Anyone who still lived in the surroundings was immediately subjugated by Yun Jhin's mental field becoming his slaves.
He shook his head as he started to walk towards the building where the two sisters popped out from.
There he took a small scroll out of the ground as he used a particular technique that he had gained from the memories of the sisters.
He opened the scroll and took a look over the technique there, it was useable by everyone and it was the original which meant Yun Jhin could teach it to everyone properly while teaching through the soul link was fast things wouldn't always end up good, this way with the original technique he would be able to impart them his enlightenment and the original parts coming from the scroll would help them better, everyone had their own dao and understanding of the technique if they used Yun Jhin's understanding problems could arise.
Yun Jhin didn't have this problem as he could dissect the technique from the memories of the sister duo and then get his own understanding of the technique but his weaker subordinates needed that.
Yun Jhin decided to stay at the Chen family until all of his subordinates got the technique under their control then they would attack the Han family, any improvements for their battle power would be helpful in the final subjugation attempt.
From what he realized by comparing the families between them the Han family would have stronger people than the Chen family and a formation equal to the one of the Kun family, all they would lack would be a good bloodline.
However, the bloodline wasn't really needed in their situation.
Yun Jhin mediated on mulled on the body technique as well for some time before he called everyone and left after they had made sure everyone learned the technique properly.
The northern region was quite far away from the southern region as they were opposites, they had to fly and teleport for around 2 months before they reached the northern frontier.
The north was freezing cold, snow and ice could be seen everywhere, the coldness seeped into one's bones to the point that they would get crystalized if they were too weak to withstand it, however, unlike the heats in the south the ki barrier would be able to defend against the coldness here.
Thus it was an easier post to mane compared to the south.
Not everyone had the time nor the resources to cultivate their body, also they needed an appropriate technique to do so.
Yun Jhin's vision through the snow was perfect but it couldn't be said the same about his followers so he had to waste some time to guide them but in the end, they finally reached the depths of the northern frontier where they found the bastion that held the Han family members.
It was a gigantic fortress made from dark true ice, Yun Jhin and the others could have seen their reflections in it if they weren't already in stealth.
Yun Jhin analyzed the fortress to see where the formation was positioned but after a while, he realized that the formation was the fortress!
It was a combination of a structural form as the core and the expensive ingredient which was the dark true ice creating a gigantic physical formation, Yun Jhin frowned as he put his hand on the ice only for frostbite to immediately appear on the hand and start to travel towards his body, Yun Jhin immediately took away the hand and used his ki to purge the dark ice that was still clinging to his hand and body.
"This is rather troublesome..."
Yun Jhin knew of the way to disable the formation... which was destroying the fortress, that was literally the only way to destroy the formation.
He did a few more experiments with the formation and realized that while it would generate frostbite and intense pain when it was touched the dark true ice would still melt at the same time as he concentrated his ki properly, thus he could scale the walls of the fortress if he endured the pain and sharp winds that were protecting the tall walls.
Of course, while he would come rather unscathed from this experience his troops wouldn't be able to withstand it, the fortress's gates were closed which meant he would have to do the same thing again, enter by himself, create a mass panic then open the gates.
Yun Jhin decided to scale the walls but as he tried to clutch on the ice walls he realized that they were so slippery that he couldn't actually grab anything from them, they were too smooth as well so there was no chance for him to scale the wall.
This became a problem as he looked at the gates he realized that they wouldn't open any time soon, or at all, if they had a teleportation portal in their fortress they didn't even need to send out people, they could just teleport long-range that way.
Things were rather annoying now, Yun Jhin frowned, how could he make them open the gates?
As he thought about it he got an idea, he could either make some racket at the door making them open it to see what's happening then slip through. He really needed to get inside the fortress, fighting outside would mean being in the range of the attacking ability of the fortress and they would also have a perfect defense meaning that things would be very annoying.
Yun Jhin was a prompt and efficient person, he didn't want to extend a fight that could be won with other means, fighting head-on was never his favorite type of fight, he would only resort to it when there was no other choice.
Then Yun Jhin facepalmed, the Han family was a merchant one so normally they would invite other merchants to trade their goods inside the fortress if he could get to one of their teleportation portals and use it to infiltrate the place in the guise of a merchant it would be easier and more indirect compared to making a ruckus in the front of their place, who knew if they were going to launch some type of attack from the tall walls instead of opening the gates?
Yun Jhin took out a paper bird from his clothes as he whispered something into it, he waited for a few seconds before the paper bird became very lifelike as a voice came out of it, it was prince Markus!
"Lin Duritz, how much I have waited to hear your response and you haven't disappointed me, you are already at the Han family?"
"Yes milord, I have reached the Han family but there's a problem, unlike the other two families this one's geographical location gives it too much of an advantage and I cannot get inside to get the deed done, I need some information about the location of their teleportation formations along with an identity as a merchant."
"Both easy things to do for me, the nearest teleportation formation they use for trading is still in their territory, while the cold is rather fearsome there are some people out there who like the cold because it helps to hasten their cultivation, the city's name is called Karagee and it's 6,000 kilometers away from their fortress, as for the merchant identity things should be already done by the time you get there."
Yun Jhin crumpled the bird into a ball before setting it on fire and throwing it away.
He ordered his squad to follow him as they started to retreat from the fortress.
They arrived at the city around 2 hours later, they already changed their outfits and his subordinates were dragging some carts behind them, they were full of resources scarcely found in the northern parts along with some special weapons and armors.
The moment they arrived in the city they immediately went to those that were responsible for the teleportation portal of the Han family.
When the people that guarded the portal saw the quality goods that Yun Jhin and his squad brought their eyes lit up like a Christmas tree, they eyed the carts for a while before they walked towards Yun Jhin who was dressed rather exquisitely to show his status as the boss of the caravan.
"Yo boss, I know that you want to send all of this to the Han family but you first need to pay some taxes, 10% of everything you got to let you use the portal."
Yun Jhin smiled at the man who told him that before the man's eyes started to slack and he closed his mouth, he activated the portal and let Yun Jhin and his squad through without any hitches.
Yun Jhin found himself in a plaza, in front of him a few men and two women were coming to inspect his goods.
Yun Jhin smiled to himself as they approached and started to crack his knuckles.

chapters.title: Chapter 231: A fight that lead to completion
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's actions went undetected as the men and women who came forward to welcome him were ogling the products that he had brought.
They were mostly premium products for the icy northern frontier and they would make a sweet profit if they bought it then resold it at a higher price using their connections and a little bit of 'persuasion'.
As the guardian family of the north, they were able to push the right buttons to get what they wanted and when they wanted.
The oldest male in the group approached Yun Jhin with a sly smile on his face, it was the smile that every merchant would cultivate at some point, they were so sleazy that even Yun Jhin was impressed somewhat.
"Sir, you are the leader of this caravan?"
Yun Jhin nodded as he asked:
"What do you think the price could be for these goods?"
The man started to rub his hands together under his sleeves as he said:
"Well if we calculate the taxes with the selling bar of premium goods I could say that they were around 20,000 heart grade spirit stones."
Yun Jhin looked indignant at the price as he said:
"20,000 heart grade? I have paid around 25,000 or so spirit stones for this batch of goods and you will buy under the market value??"
"Ehe mister Zhao Yun, I know that you are an up-and-coming new merchant but I don't think you can mess with the prices set by our Han family."
"I recommend for mister Zhao to reconsider our offer unless you don't want things to turn out... a little bit more than you could handle."
The men and women behind the older gentleman took out some weapons from their clothes as they pointed them at Yun Jhin and his men.
Yun Jhin laughed as his body started to morph recovering his original appearance, the moment this happened all of the men who pointed their weapons at him along with the older man who threatened him fell to the ground foaming at the mouth, their eyes rolled to the back of their head while they twitched down on the ground like epileptics.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he put his foot on the head of the older man before a sickly splurge could be heard from below his foot, a curtain of red showered the icy ground below as the man's head exploded like a watermelon, the others head were popped along as well by Yun Jhin's subordinates as they started to disappear when they entered stealth.
Yun Jhin smiled as he looked around while saying:
"Let the panic begin!"
Yun Jhin disappeared as well as he turned on his stealth and looked at everything that was happening from a good spot.
His troops were already unleashing hell on all of the weaker people in the fortress, thus getting the attention of the squads that were installed at the top of the walls of the fortress and the guards that were patrolling around the place.
The moment they saw their people being slaughtered by sheep by invisible invaders made them as mad as they could be.
However unlike the other times where the guards would rush to save their precious people, these guards of the Han family looked for a few seconds before they started to retreat, they realized that they would be overwhelmed by the attackers and thus they didn't interfere, just watching coldly from the sidelines while letting one of them go and report to the higher-ups.
Yun Jhin looked at the guard's apathetic attitude and nodded, they were truly a merchant family.
Yun Jhin didn't let the guard who left to report alone, of course, he wanted to lengthen this as much he could be angering the higher-ups even further that way.
The moment one of the guards moved to report they would sink into the ground as if it was quicksand and Yun Jhin would appear to taking over his appearance and returning in the group of guards who were still looking at everything that was happening while keeping their guard up for any sudden attacks.
Yun Jhin's approach made most of them frown as the captain of the guards asked:
"What are you doing Daryl, haven't I told you to go and report to the elders? Why are you back so soon?"
Yun Jhin approached a little bit closer thus making them put their guards up even further the guard captain narrowed his eyes as he said:
"You... you are acting strange Daryl, why don't you respond to my question?"
"Oh you see captain... that's because I'm not Daryl."
The moment Yun Jhin said those words bone spikes grew out of his arms and impaled the captain through the stomach, the captain vomited a mouthful of blood as his blood started to be extracted from his body and entered the bones making them multiply creating a small bone forest which engulfed the other guards killing them instantly.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked at the guard's remains which were being absorbed by the bone forest, he waved his hand and the bone forest disappeared as if it was never there, the same happened to his actual body as he disappeared as well.
Yun Jhin's actions scared the living daylights out of the hiding people that he ignored as he deemed them too lowly for him to take care of.
The moment they sighed thinking that they escaped one of Yun Jhin's lackeys came by and annihilated all of them letting the snow on the ground becoming fully red.
Yun Jhin orchestrated the whole thing as he waited for the big bad bosses to appear, even if they were enjoying themselves at this moment it wouldn't take much time for them to realize that things weren't normal.
As if on cue an immense amount of pressure descended on the plaza as an angered voice overwhelmed Yun Jhin's hidden pawns:
"WHO DARES TO DO THIS TO MY GLORIOUS HAN FAMILY? I SHALL ANNIHILATE YOUR CLANS AND DRINK FROM THE SKULLS OF YOUR ANCESTORS WHILE I DINE ON THEIR FLESH AND BONES."
Yun Jhin knew that the one who said that was one of the higher-ups of the family, but he could only feel the aura of one person which showed that the other person was hiding in the dark trying to tag-team Yun Jhin when he fought one of them trying to take him by surprise.
Yun Jhin smiled, he decided to play along with them.
The moment that the voice stopped shouting was the moment a heavyset man appeared in the air above the plaza, his eyes were amber colored and he wore blue chain mail armor, he had a helmet on his head that sported two long horns made from gold.
His eyes scanned the plaza below like two lanterns as he tried to identify where Yun Jhin's pawns were along with him.
Yun Jhin speed blitzed behind him as he tried to bifurcate him at the waist only to find his arm stuck inside the chain-mail armor, the heavy-set man laughed as he looked behind as if his neck didn't have bones and said:
"Very good armor don't you think?"
Yun Jhin nodded, it was a very annoying armor but it wasn't that troublesome for him, he clenched his stuck hand, and the chains that grabbed the hand started to crack and break.
The moment the Viking-like person saw what was happening his eyes bulged out to the point that they almost left their sockets, he tried to give Yun Jhin a big bear hug while he was still stuck and succeeded however when he tried to break his bones he found out that it was like hugging a mountain, no matter how hard he tried all he could do was continue hugging the mountain without even being able to move it.
He frowned as he shouted:
"FATHER COME OUT!"
The moment he shouted a man similar to him appeared, he was a little bit shorter with a hunched back and also not as fat as the one who was hugging Yun Jhin but they resembled each other quite a bit.
Yun Jhin laughed inside as he saw the man appearing earlier than they intended, he already made a hole in their plan, the hunched Viking immediately teleported towards his son who was still holding onto Yun Jhin only to frown as he felt something wasn't right.
He then jumped backward away from Yun Jhin as the bone forest from before unleashed itself directly upon the man's son along with his surroundings, the bone forest had increased to around 10 meters in height and 70 centimeters in width, the moment it appeared it impaled everything around beside Yun Jhin, the bones were practically alive as they moved around him like they were made from gum.
The older one was frightened by the sudden attack while the younger one was impaled and his blood was getting drained by the bones as if they were ravenous maggots.
It didn't take much time for the shriveled form of the younger formerly heavy-set man to appear in the midst of the bone forest, he looked as if he didn't eat for weeks and his face was extremely pale just like a dead person's but he was still alive and kicking.
He tried to remove himself from the bone forest so he could regenerate his blood back but the bones were sticking right through him making it hard for him to break them, even though they were very pliable in Yun Jhin's hands they were harder than meteorite metal when it came to someone else interacting with them.
The moment the father saw his son's current situation he started to move away to retreat.
However, Yun Jhin appeared behind him ready to skewer him through the chest only for the old man to smile and mutter:
"Got you!"

chapters.title: Chapter 232: A plan that bears fruit
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin could felt something was wrong as he got his hand stuck again, he tried to remove his hand only for him to find out that it was getting frozen, the old man laughed inside as he looked at Yun Jhin then he sent a ki wave to sever the bonds that were holding his son captive, however, the wave only cut a little bit into the bones before it dissipated by itself.
Yun Jhin severed his hand that was stuck inside the man's back before regenerating a new one, his eyes wandered towards his frozen hand which was slowly getting absorbed into the old man's back, he could feel that after he absorbed his hand that he regained some of his energy.
This was one of the rarer times that Yun Jhin didn't think things through, he would have never thought that the celestial realm would host such techniques of absorption but it seems he was underestimating the evil that these people were capable of. After all the Soul Emperor originated from the celestial realm and by his techniques he wasn't any kind soul.
It seemed that merchants would always be insidious no matter what kind of peak they reached.
Yun Jhin could feel some type of connection being created to the old creep in front of him but he immediately severed it with his soul willpower.
The old man frowned as he felt his attempt on connecting to Yun Jhin's soul fail, he looked towards his back only to find out that Yun Jhin was missing.
"Over here you fossil."
Yun Jhin appeared in front of him as he hit him with a haymaker over the head making his body fall to the ground but before he could hit the ground Yun Jhin appeared below him since he was falling face-up Yun Jhin put his hand up piercing directly into his abdomen combining the force of him being thrown down with a sharp attachment to his hand thus penetrating the man's stomach and putting his hand through his back.
Yun Jhin chuckled as he chucked the man towards the bone forest where the bones started to move as if they were alive, the old man's eyes were wide as he tried to move but his spine was severed when Yun Jhin pierced through his abdomen and he didn't have enough time to regenerate it.
The bones pierced through his whole body as they multiplied while his body started to become shriveled like a dried prune.
Yun Jhin then appeared in front of the father and son as he put his hands on their foreheads creating two more trusty slaves.
The moment he finished enslaving so many families another batch of destiny struck him like an avalanche as his cultivation base was ready for another breakthrough!
He closed his eyes as he raised his hand to the sky unleashing his mental field and conquering every mind of the weaker citizens, the stronger God Realm experts couldn't be controlled this way but his squad already made short work of them, only the patriarch and ancestor were considered to be problems and he took care of both now.
His eyes wandered down towards the plaza as he saw more God Realm experts being brought to the open by his goons, he appeared down as he put his hands on each of their foreheads enslaving them as well...
Now he had full control of all the 4 guardian families!
Now that he had a better overview of the whole history of these families by sharing the memories of the slaves he finally understood why the 4 sacred beasts were thrown down from the celestial realm!
It was mostly because the humans revolted against them, after a while, they were overpowered and thrown out being replaced with the current guardian families, they were the actual guardian beasts of the celestial realm, and back then the gates that lead to the mortal realm weren't as tightly sealed as they were now, everyone could come and go and this leads to the current pitiable situation of the sacred beasts.
Yun Jhin felt there was more to this than these people knew, while the guardians knew a little bit the imperial family had the most knowledge about this event.
However, it wasn't time for him to snoop around for such information, while he was rather curious about the details he already had finished his deals with the sacred beasts and he didn't have much use for them anymore... and if he wanted them on his payroll he would just enslave them just like he did everyone else.
It didn't take much time for Yun Jhin to finish sorting his new troop's combination along with getting whatever resources he found useful from the merchant family, now that he had finished the main plan could go on, but first, since he already gained the destiny of the four families he would be able to break through already, Yun Jhin was sure that the prince didn't think he would be able to get complete genuine control of the families thus getting access to their destiny or else he might have been cursing right now.
Since he still had time to contact the prince he first got himself the best place to have a breakthrough in the ice fortress before he entered closed-door cultivation.
The 6th stage of the God Realm 32 laws that needed to be learned and then fused with the body, however, Yun Jhin already had complete mastery of those laws due to the inheritance of the Soul Emperor, his body started to glow with a multicolored light as he looked towards the ceiling of the cave he was currently in, it was extremely cold and there was darkness all around him, he was the only source of light in the cave.
He was in the cultivation place of the ancestor it had the best feng-shui in the fortress and a huge accumulation of ki.
The ki in his surroundings entered his body as the multicolored light left it being propelled by the ki into the skies to create a beam of energy that attracted the laws of the celestial realm!
The moment this happened everyone would have been alarmed but considering they were all Yun Jhin's slaves and the fortress was rather remote there was no problem.
Yun Jhin could feel the laws of the celestial realm quickly converging above the fortress in the dark cloud-filled skies.
A storm appeared at the top of the fortress as different shapes started to transform into the sky, the laws took the image that they were most associated with before they 'smelled' around Yun Jhin's beam of light.
At first, things went well then the laws started to reject Yun Jhin, he was an outsider and this was also his second breakthrough in the God Realm, the first breakthrough came from the fusion between his main body and Yun Duritz and it was more of natural evolution but now Yun Jhin accumulated destiny and ki while he comprehended the laws of the realm to reach his current breakthrough.
Thus he lived more in the realm than before and Yun Duritz's aura didn't fool the laws anymore, those were also laws that he wasn't really familiar with as he never interacted with them, so they were rather wild. In conclusion, he either had to tame them or forcefully fuse them with his body to breakthrough at this point, or else he would lose all of his accumulation.
The things and beings made of laws above the fortress were sniffing around Yun Jhin's beam then one of them opened its 'mouth' wide trying to take a bite from it.
Yun Jhin snorted as he teleported near it and coated his hand in purple-colored ki before grabbing the law by its mouth and inserting his coated fist into its opened mouth.
The law started to struggle but Yun Jhin was already absorbing the law into his body using the ki coated hand, he was connecting with its quintessence as he unleashed his understanding of the law forcefully taming it while absorbing it with his body, his actions startled the other 15 laws as they tried to run away only for Yun Jhin to snort.
A tall barrier appeared blocking all of the laws from escaping, they rammed themselves in the barrier trying to break it but Yun Jhin's battle power was already nearing the peak of the God Realm so their efforts were pretty much futile at this point.
Yun Jhin's eyes were glowing as he absorbed one of the laws then moved to the others, 2 laws, 3 laws, 4 laws.
7 laws, 15 laws, 16 laws fully assimilated into his body. Yun Jhin clenched his hands as he lifted both of his arms towards the sky expelling an immense amount of ki dispersing all of the clouds around the fortress letting the sun finally shine on the ice-covered fortress.
Bone popping sounds could be heard from his whole body as he broke through reaching the 6th stage of the God Realm, he expelled a breath that created a storm dispersing the clouds 600 kilometers around the fortress and its surroundings.
"Finally, 3 more stages until I reach the peak of the God Realm... I'm getting close and closer to my former peak."
3 unlit stairs appeared behind Yun Jhin, his avatar was 6 stairs above, just 3 more stairs... and he would be able to enforce his plan to reach the realm above and break through the stairs that were limiting him to this mortal shell, no matter how godly or strong he was he still felt time pass, he still felt his body aging, no matter how slow it aged it still happened. This was something he truly hated and despised, he despised his own mortality, so to quicken things he took another paper bird out of his clothes as it was time to finally contact Prince Markus again, it was time for Hell and the mortal realm to invade the celestial realm!

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Let the mending of worlds begin!
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as the paper bird in his hand started to look life-like and prince Markus's voice could be heard coming from it asking:
"Is it done?"
Yun Jhin had mirth in his voice that he quickly hid:
"Yes your majesty, your plan is ready to begin, should I do the honors?"
"Lin Duritz you have done a great job and I will reward you accordingly, you have left contacts in the tribes after you conquered them right?"
"Of course your majesty, the portals are one word away from being open for everyone."
"Then let's invite them here, send the word now!"
Yun Jhin smiled as he sent the order through his neural network link, regardless of the distance as long as they were in the same realm they would be able to take orders from him.
In the Lin family, the restrictions of the portal started to fizzle and pop as one of the ancestors fiddled with it, shortly the portal came to life creating a connection to the mortal realm but unlike before all of the bloodlines that were in the portal were fully removed!
The portal's color changed from deep azure to a normal white and after making sure everything was ok the ancestor disappeared from there not wanting to be present when the first wave of people would arrive.
The same moment that the ancestor of the Lin family was messing with the portal, some of the guards of the Han, Chen, and Kun family were doing the same thing.
The portals sizzled and popped as they all lost their azure color, the next moment the guards disappeared as if they were never there.
Yun Jhin floated atop the dark ice fortress as he kept his eyes closed, his hands were crossed around his chest as he waited there, suddenly his eyes opened as he said:
"Things are done, your majesty."
"Yes I can feel it... the portals had been messed with."
"A very good job indeed... now we only have to wait..."
And wait they did, but they didn't have to for much time.
The moment the portals were opened for everyone a wave of energy appeared near all of the portals attracting the attention of every power in the mortal realm, especially the top ones, these were portals that they have never seen or heard before and they randomly popped up in the four cardinal directions in galaxies that were abandoned.
Thus everyone's attention gathered to them, the spies from hell that infiltrated the organizations of the mortal realm even sacrificed themselves to send the message about the appearance of the gates back to hell.
The ancestor of the brilliance radiance and light sect was the first one to get to his feet, the moment he heard about the appearance of these gates his sleepy looks transformed as he looked as serious as he could ever be, his drooping big ears moved up and down as he floated out of his room and teleported directly to the location of the northern portal.
The northern portal was the closest to his sect so he decided to investigate that one...
The western portal was annexed by the Dead Bones sect Gu Manshu while the eastern one was annexed by the blood throne sect.
The southern one was taken by Andonara the woman that 'loved' Yun Jhin.
The moment they saw the portals they didn't jump straightly into them, who knew where they led? The aura they exuded looked quite neutral at first glance as it was only white.
All of these willy old foxes wouldn't rush headfirst if they were to saw resources pop out of the air, they weren't dumb.
They knew there must be some reason for these gates to appear so at first they looked at them and analyzed the reason before sending in some 'guinea pigs' to see what they would report.
The moment these guinea pigs entered the celestial realm they couldn't believe their eyes at first, then they couldn't believe their senses, the pure and perfect ki energy in the air was cleansing their bodies and elevating them to a higher level.
They were almost so tempted to destroy the portal behind them so no one else would be able to enter so they could enjoy all of the resources there for themselves. Regardless if it was the northern cold, the southern heat, and arid location, it was still a richer environment compared to the mortal realm.
However, no matter how much they wanted to remain in the celestial realm and go cultivate it wasn't possible, their bodies started to move back towards the portal while their brains were unwilling.
They didn't want to share the information about the celestial realm with the people that enslaved them.
The moment they stepped back into the mortal realm and saw the faces of each person that enslaved them they opened their mouths trying to lie their way through but the eyes of each ancestor pierced through their beings like they were made of tofu and they spilled everything they saw.
Ancestor Biu Wuan of the Radiance Brilliance and Light sect looked directly into the eyes of his Guinea Pig as he smiled at him like an understanding Buddha as he said:
"It's ok to covet the things that you are not supposed to have, it's human nature to want better things, you have done your job and I understand what you have seen... it's time to go on your way."
The man did a monk salute while he said:
"Amitabha! Please guide this sinful soul to the afterlife!"
The person in front of him slowly started to turn into ashes that drifted into the universal wind as they disappeared.
Biu Wuan's smile disappeared as he looked at the entrance to the celestial realm as he sent word to his sect for all of the able-bodied people to rush and enter after him!
He took one step inside the portal and disappeared and the same thing happened all over the universe.
The celestial realm was getting populated with the people from the mortal realm!
The moment the people from the blood throne sect entered the celestial realm under the guidance of Marthon, Yun Jhin connected with his out-of-body incarnation and gave out the order to protect the Lin family creating their new headquarters there.
Yun Jhin continued to float above the ice fortress as he waited for a short while... suddenly in front of him the tall middle-aged man with drooping ears and a rudy body appeared.
"Ancestor Biu Wuan, it seems you have enjoyed your arrival in the celestial realm."
The ancestor's face was as plain as it could be, he was calm looking at Yun Jhin but on the inside, he was wondering how the hell did he beat him to the punch, how did he arrive first in the celestial realm? He couldn't be in the northern region if he entered from his eastern region unless all of the portals lead to the same place. Which was most unlikely, why would these portals spawn in different parts of the universe if they were all leading to the same place?
"Cat got your tongue Biu Wuan?"
"Hahaha, no, no I'm just surprised you arrived here before me, brother Yun Jhin, it seems you have grown quite strong, already reaching the 6th stage of the God Realm, you must have enjoyed some of the goods from the celestial realm didn't you?"
"If I did, I did, what is it to you?"
"It's nothing, I was just wondering how did you arrive before me?"
"Ah you don't need to know that, but you do you want to learn something interesting?"
"Hmm?"
Biu Wuan looked rather interested as he looked at Yun Jhin, he knew that he was a master of lies and deceit but at this time he didn't find any lying intent in his gaze nor voice, Biu Wuan was a person who has cultivated the truth sutra so he would know when someone lied or not, Of course, this aspect of the technique wasn't really useful in battles but in such situations, it was a rather good skill to have.
"I don't think I have to beat around the bush, do you want to know the way to transcend the God Realm?"
"Amitabha, this old monk has always wanted to transcend and meet Budha himself so I could get some guidance from him directly, unfortunately, the universe is rather cruel, but would brother Yun Jhin be so nice that you would tell me the way without any difficulties?"
"Oho there would be difficulties, but not only for you."
"Hmm?"
At this point Biu Wuan was getting interested, if there was something Yun Jhin needed his help with meant that it was something rather huge, he knew how Yun Jhin worked as he fought against him for more than a few times in his early days, of course, if he was around the 1st stage of the God Realm he would have struck him here and now but considering he felt a rather small threat coming from Yun Jhin's current cultivation base he would rather work with him. There was no enmity big enough in the face of enormous benefits!
Yun Jhin started to rub his hands just like a merchant would do as he said:
"Do you know about the Celestial Emperor?"

chapters.title: Chapter 234: The celestial emperor is a big piece of meat!
chapters.content:
"The celestial Emperor?"
Recognition came to Biu Wuan's face, he knew about the celestial emperor but up till now he thought that he was only a myth, a legend, just like the celestial realm that he was currently in, but considering he already reached the celestial realm, the emperor of the realm in question should be real as well.
"What about him?"
Biu Wuan asked with a questioning tone, he didn't really know much about him besides that he was a superior expert with great technique and skill, he was a dragon among men and the strongest being in existence besides Hell's willpower.
"Well I already gave you a hint beforehand, you see the celestial emperor is our only ticket towards ascendance."
"Hmm? You really mean that, I guess you need my help to subdue him if you are ready to tell me this precious information."
"Actually only the two of us would be small beans that the celestial emperor could casually crush in his hands, we need the help of everyone."
"Are you really sure about that?"
"Of course I am, I'm going to tell you all of the details after everyone has gathered up."
After their discussion cut off an awkward silence descended upon them.
Because they were generally enemies there wasn't much they could talk about after they have finished their discussion about benefits, and since Yun Jhin didn't want to divulge any more information yet Biu Wuan closed his eyes and decided to meditate until everyone came here, he knew that Yun Jhin would call them here somehow.
Since Yun Jhin already had connections to every place, he knew that those peak God Realm experts would first come for the most populated or most important areas in the place they were teleported.
And Yun Jhin already had people there to leave the message, it didn't take much time for a laugh that sounded to be coming from a ghost came, it was the hunchbacked angel of darkness that Yun Jhin still owed him, Gu Manshu!
He appeared in front of Yun Jhin and Biu Wuan as he looked between them a few times to make sure he was seeing right, then he laughed once again as he said:
"It seems you guys have found something of big importance if you put down your hundreds of thousands of years vendetta."
Yun Jhin didn't say anything besides:
"We will wait until everyone is here before I will tell you what's of such big importance."
"Ok then, keep your secrets."
Gu Manshu didn't really look to be caring as he closed his eyes and mimicked Biu Wuan's meditating, most likely mocking him.
As time passed a shrill voice could be heard coming from the void:
"OH MY GOD, IT'S REALLY YOU, YUN JHIN!"
Yun Jhin shuddered as he heard her voice, Andonara was one of the people that he wanted to see the least, but her strength was also needed.
The moment she appeared she stuck onto Yun Jhin like glue, she had a strange expression on her androgynous face as she chuckled like a fool while drooling over Yun Jhin's body.
From what he knew about her she was a very big fan of his, she started to walk him around his 800 reincarnations as he became infamous due to his actions.
At first, she was a sweet little thing until she found out about Yun Jhin's harem and she massacred it quickly and efficiently before sending the heads to Yun Jhin's throne room.
At that point, he understood that he couldn't keep this crazy woman in his life. He liked his women subdued just like he liked his subordinates and everyone else that was working under him.
At this point, he didn't really care about having children anymore so he only had those two that came from Qinghe. But the expression on Andonara's face told him that she wanted some children.
She always tried to harvest his DNA to get his children one way or another, he wasn't even sure why she was so obsessed with him, but one thing he was sure of was that her soul was either incomplete or somehow messed up.
Biu Wuan opened his eyes as he looked around and said:
"We are all here, ready to tell us what you know Yun Jhin?"
Yun Jhin nodded as he started to tell them what he knew:
"The celestial emperor's body is weakening due to his immense age, sooner or later his shell will expire and he will remain only as soul willpower, this is our only chance of ascending, we can use the destiny gained from the celestial realm to ascend! The emperor's destiny should be so concentrated that it would be liquid by now, if we would be able to strip it away from him we would surely have a chance at ascension."
"Of course I will help my hubby wubby, Yun Jhin," Andonara said while clutching his arm trying to press her chest into it.
Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan looked at each other for a few seconds, they both saw the greed in the eyes of each other but they also knew that Yun Jhin would have never disclosed this information if it was easy to take care of the celestial emperor, this would be the first time the 4 of them would work together!
"You guys should get all of your armies in here, the central region is full of strong cultivators and we need to strike a huge hubbub to awaken the celestial emperor from his nap, if he wakes up now his body will deteriorate even faster."
"My army is already here and they are moving towards the central region."
Yun Jhin waved his hand as Marthon appeared near him then fused with his body disappearing into motes of light.
"Hmm, an out-of-body incarnation?"
"Yes, it was needed for the plan to work, the out-of-body incarnation was the first that entered the celestial realm and I followed soon after."
Yun Jhin was telling a half-truth here but they wouldn't be able to do anything at this point anyway.
"Ok then go and get your armies inside, my army will wait at the border of the central area, they will meet there and we will unleash despair upon the people of the celestial realm, while they have higher cultivation bases their battle power is lacking."
They all nodded and left besides Andonara who was still clutching Yun Jhin's arm, Yun Jhin just glanced at her without saying anything as she saluted him and disappeared as well, she knew she had a job to do and she didn't want to disappoint her hubby.
Yun Jhin called prince Markus once again:
"Your highness, the place is filled with outsiders from the mortal realm, the plan succeeded and they already entering the realm in droves, it seems they are going directly to the central region!"
"I see, I see, you should come back to the capital so I can reward you properly for all the hard work you have done."
"As for the attackers? We should let them wreak some havoc first so my imperial father can finally wake up from his sleep, HAHAHA!"
Yun Jhin nodded and told him that he will come soon.
He destroyed another paper bird before disappearing from the top of the fortress, it was time to go back to the capital.
While his allies will attack the central region from the outside he will do some things inside.
But first things first, he immediately teleported back to the capital as he was welcomed by prince Markus.
He really wanted his destiny reward.
They again went down to the basement of the palace where Yun Jhin soaked into the destiny pool.
He could feel his body fusing with the destiny that was gushing like a geyser from the ground... it was different from the first time, this destiny was way more aggressive and he could feel a hint of willpower in it... he frowned as he immediately jumped out of the pool and saw the two maids that helped him last time look at him with a creepy gaze.
However Yun Jhin ignored them as they both fell to the ground without any life left in them, then they started to slowly transform into dust and disappear.
He looked behind him to see prince Markus clapping while saying:
"It seems you have quite the acute senses but I wouldn't have expected anything else from the man who enslaved the 4 families in the span of 3 months."
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"Quite the unclassy trap isn't it, your highness?"
"While it may unclassy to backstab you, you already know too much, I guess you even predicted this would happen right?"
"Yeah, I kinda did, but have you predicted this?"
Yun Jhin's body and face started to morph as his aura changed as well, he returned to his original appearance, after he talked with his comrades he changed back to the visage of Lin Duritz and now he went back to looking as he originally was.
The moment his appearance changed his aura started to increase and intensify as it fully attacked prince Markus with its whole weight.
Prince Markus felt the increase of gravity around him as he slowly but surely kneeled in front of Yun Jhin, his face was crazed as he looked directly into Yun Jhin's eyes and said:
"You played me like a fiddle didn't you, you are an outsider!"
"Of course I am, what kind of proud celestial citizen would betray his own realm for the grandeur dreams of a power-hungry prince?"
"You... you!!!"
"Ok now you will have to go to sleep... forever, but don't worry your father, mother, and relatives will come and meet you soon so you won't be alone in the underworld!"

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Awakening the celestial emperor!
chapters.content:
Prince Markus felt his life flash in front of his face as Yun Jhin's hand was getting closer and closer to his neck, ready to snap it like he was a chicken grown for slaughter.
He gulped down heavily as he tried to move his body only to find out that the gravity pinned him down so thoroughly that he couldn't move at all.
Sweat trickled down from his forehead as if it was a waterfall, he couldn't help but shout at the last second before Yun Jhin's demonic hand latched on his neck:
"FATHER HELP ME!"
Being put against the wall, in a life and death situation, Markus couldn't think about anything else besides shouting for his daddy!
It was mostly because in his youth his father was a little bit more active and he would act to protect him no matter what he did, he was a young master with both silk pants and a golden spoon in his mouth, but as time passed his father couldn't come out to help him anymore, he couldn't play with him anymore as his body started to weaken, he needed to hibernate.
However, this leads to the prince getting abandonment issues and hating his father, forgetting about the good times that they had together which led to hatred and the obsession of wanting to become emperor, but he didn't actually want to become emperor, he wanted to meet his father again which was the emperor.
The moment the shout traveled through the whole palace, it started to shake as if the biggest earthquake was going on, actually, the palace wasn't the only thing that was shaking, if Yun Jhin concentrated a little bit better he could feel that the whole celestial realm was shaking!
At this point, Yun Jhin actually started to have second thoughts about going against the Emperor, he knew that he was currently awakening and this wasn't even his full power!
This was just the remnant of his aura flaring for one second due to his awakening!
Yun Jhin looked down at the trembling prince and sighed, since he already went this far there was no going back now, his hand clenched prince Markus's neck, breaking it and killing him, his soul tried to escape from his dead body but before it could Yun Jhin opened his mouth and inhaled absorbing the soul directly into his body and assimilating it.
Yun Jhin could feel some scattered memories surfacing on his soul but he discarded all of them, they were mostly useless to him and because he forcefully absorbed the soul he didn't get anything important from him.
The moment he died the shaking of the realm increased in intensity as the celestial emperor hastened his awakening, rage could be felt traveling through the whole realm as it shook, dormant volcanoes woke up as they started to spurt lava inundating villages and killing countless innocents.
As the saying went, if the Emperor is angered the heavens shake!
And the sky was literally shaking and turning red after the death of Markus, things started to change on a cataclysmic level to the point that even Biu Wuan, Andonara, and Gu Manshu realized that things didn't look that well for them, they even wanted to retreat!
However, retreating at this point was impossible, the 4 gates that lead to the mortal realm suddenly stopped at the same time!
The 3 peak god realm experts had left a piece of their soul willpower on the gates to make sure no one else followed them in but now they saw how the gates were being turned off!
Their countenances turned ghastly white as they realized they were stuck here along with whatever Yun Jhin had done to piss the celestial emperor this quickly.
Yun Jhin broke through space creating a hole as he appeared near them, their armies were all converged and ready to attack the central area.
However there was no need for that anymore, the celestial emperor awoke already and the 3 of them looked at Yun Jhin with an expression that seemingly asked:
'What the hell have you done?'
Yun Jhin didn't say anything besides:
"You need to prepare, with this amount of anger his body will decay very quickly, we need to delay until his body disintegrates and he remains only as a soul willpower before we can enter in our attacking stance, for now, we will have to defend!"
"What the hell have you done anyways to piss him this much?"
Yun Jhin looked at Gu Manshu who asked and answered:
"I killed one of his sons."
Gu Manshu nodded as he looked towards the horizon, he saw the red sky intensifying in color as lightning bolts started to strike the earth around them, he sighed as he said:
"Well, here he comes..."
The celestial emperor descended from the sky with a lightning bolt, a crater appeared where it struck as he landed in a super-hero pose, the moment he got up and started to float, his appearance was seen by everyone around.
He was a tall man standing around 2 meters, he wore blue and white clothes that covered his whole body not showing any skin besides his face, he was rather handsome with a short beard and short cut hair, he had an angered look on his face as he glared at every strong person which was Yun Jhin, Andonara, Biu Wuan, and Gu Manshu, he pretty much ignored the gigantic army below as if they didn't even exist.
The moment their gazes crossed in mid-air lightning struck from their eyes, the 4 of them versus the celestial emperor.
The lightning met in the middle and it started to push into each other, however, the four's lightning didn't get to last much before it was pushed back and annihilated, but the lightning beam that came from the celestial emperor was still going strong as it wanted to strike all of them at once!
But their lightning had delayed the celestial emperor's attack for enough time so they could dodge out the way, the lightning struck downwards and killed hundreds of thousands of troops who were already retreating from the central area border, they knew that the fight between these titans wasn't something they could join nor look at.
Yun Jhin skidded a few tens of meters backward to dodge the lightning beam while the others either teleported or used their own special evasion techniques.
The celestial emperor looked at them expecting them to dodge when suddenly he appeared directly in front of Yun Jhin!
"I know you are the one that killed my son, that poor deluded boy, I'm sorry that I couldn't be with him more but he should have understood that I put the celestial realm above my familial ties... but seeing him die, feeling his connection to me be severed by now, made me understand that I have made a mistake, the celestial realm can be damned!"
His arm went directly through Yun Jhin's stomach coming out of his back while clutching his spine.
Yun Jhin then fell to the ground powerlessly as he felt his surroundings darken, however, he gritted his teeth as he vomited countless globules of blood which transformed into clones similar to his visage, they were small beings around being a finger length and width, but the moment they appeared Yun Jhin's countenance which was as pale as paper turned back to normal.
The small people that resembled Yun Jhin carried the corrosive ki that the celestial emperor left in Yun Jhin's body so he couldn't heal.
The moment the corrosive ki was expelled a new spine grew as the gaping hole in his chest closed up, the small Yun Jhin's were then burned into cinders by his inner flame as his body bulked up and he entered his battle mode, initiating Lin's family bloodline.
The celestial emperor glared at Yun Jhin as he saw how he had devoured Lin Duritz and the others through the transformation, being connected with the celestial realm on a higher level meant that he could turn back time and see what happened, he knew that Lin Duritz was a clone as well.
He glared at Yun Jhin as he lifted his hand to the sky summoning a gigantic orb of energy that he wanted to throw towards Yun Jhin but Gu Manshu and Andonara appeared in front of him and behind him as they grabbed him by the arms, Biu Wuan appeared above extinguishing the ball of energy before it could culminate into its most destroying form.
Then he dropped towards the celestial Emperor's head ready to pierce it with a golden needle that shined brightly.
However, the celestial emperor flexed his arms as he threw both Gu Manshu and Andonara far away to the point that they both became shooting stars, then he glared at Biu Wuan as he let out a shout creating a sonic wave that resonated with his golden needle making it shake as if it was a church bell being struck severely, the immensely fast shaking made the needle spin out of Biu Wuan's hand and impale him in the chest before his body transformed into a pool of blood and flesh that dropped to the ground.
Yun Jhin appeared in front of the pile of flesh as he guarded it, he knew that Biu Wuan needed some time to recover, and absorbing him in this situation wouldn't help him at all, he needed the help of all 3 of them if he wanted to take care of the celestial emperor!
The celestial emperor didn't say anything else as he lifted both hands into the air this time, an azure-colored gigantic ball of energy started to converge onto his hands, it expanded at quick speeds as it absorbed the surrounding ki from the whole celestial realm!
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked at the incoming ball of death and cursed:
"Damn it!"

chapters.title: Chapter 236: Destroy the body, release the soul!
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin couldn't stop the ball from being completed, it was way too big and unstable, staying near it meant certain death!
The radius of the incoming explosion wasn't going to be small so he needed to get the hell out of here!
Fortunately, the other two had been thrown away quite far and he had already learned their energy codes, he put one hand on the pile of flesh below him and put two fingers on his forehead as he disappeared moments before the celestial emperor could throw his ball at him.
The moment he disappeared was the same moment that the celestial emperor threw the ball down however he knew that his target had escaped.
The ball drilled into the ground creating a gigantic crater, golden lava spurted out of the ground and burning everything in sight, the celestial emperor looked around and saw how no one was around anymore, the army had already retreated and run away while Yun Jhin and the others were hundreds of thousands of kilometers away from him.
Gu Manshu and Andonara were both surprised Yun Jhin appearing near them with a 'pop' sound.
Gu Manshu even started to laugh heartily as he looked at the pile of flesh that came with Yun Jhin and said:
"It seems that not even your golden needle of the far east can do anything eh Biu Wuan?"
The pile of flesh started to move and squirm as it reconstructed itself in the form of Biu Wuan then he started to crack his neck and knuckles as he stretched.
"It's been a while since my fleshly body had been put through such intense pressure."
Biu Wuan ignored Gu Manshu's insult as he looked towards Yun Jhin and asked:
"What do you think we should do to break his fleshly body?"
"It's easier said than done, even if we make a plan it's hard to say if it will work or not considering his power."
"Wait so you don't actually know how to break his body open?"
Yun Jhin shook his head as he said:
"It will crack open with time, I already said that he was pretty close to bursting and him being awake quickens the process."
"So we only have to wait around?"
"Pretty much, but if he won't be able to find us he would surely go back to sleep, and fighting him on his home territory won't end up well at all, we need to keep him on the surface of the celestial realm until his body breaks down."
"And this is where the hard part comes in..."
Yun Jhin looked towards the sky as he felt the celestial emperor approaching again, it was practically impossible to hide from him for a long amount of time as he was connected with the realm itself, all they could do was hide for a certain amount of time before they were found out and it was quite a lucky event that they had been able to hide for enough time to discuss the plan.
