Yun Jhin jumped into the air as he started hovering, he closed his eyes as he unleashed his full power, his purple and green aura embraced him like a suit of armor while Gu Manshu started to transform as well, his originally skinny body started to decay, all of his skin started to disappear as only bones remained behind, in his eye sockets a dark green soul fire burned as he looked towards the incoming celestial emperor.
Biu Wuan closed his eyes as he started to chant a Buddhist mantra, golden light engulfing the whole team as they got buffed.
Andonara smiled as she showed her shiny pearly teeth and her face started to morph, getting elongated, her body then lost its hands and legs as she turned into a snake!
Her fangs gleamed in the light of the sun as she hissed towards the celestial emperor who had arrived and immediately appeared behind them!
They knew he was going to do something like this so they all turned towards him and unleashed a bunch of Mouth acid/ Buddhist incantations/ Bone spears/ Blood spears.
The celestial emperor snorted deflecting all of the attacks with a wave of his arm, the attacks flew into the sky and exploded there harmlessly.
Yun Jhin launched himself at the celestial emperor, he had the strongest body and he would be able to tank the most hits among his party.
Even though the others had higher cultivation bases it didn't matter much in this situation as the celestial emperor could break through their ki barriers quite easily.
Yun Jhin shouted as he let out two gigantic beams of green energy from his arms, they traveled directly towards the celestial emperor as if they were two circular plates of energy ready to bisect him.
However, the celestial emperor snorted as he grabbed each beam with his hands and returned them to Yun Jhin at double the speed!
Yun Jhin dodged the returned attack by a millimeter as he felt the attacks cutting into his side and cheek.
Andonara slithered her way towards the emperor as she tried to capture him by constricting her body around his.
However, before she could even approach him a little better he grabbed her by the neck telepathically then transformed her into a pretzel.
She was thrown to the ground where she left a small crater as Biu Wuan appeared behind the celestial emperor and tried another attack with his golden needle.
However, this was a futile attempt as the emperor grabbed the needle ignoring his bleeding hand, and forcefully took it out of Biu Wuan's hand before stabbing it into his head until it came out from the other side.
Biu Wuan fell to the ground just like Andonara as he tried to take the needle out of his head.
Only Gu Manshu and Yun Jhin remained in the fight at this point.
Gu Manshu gave Yun Jhin an eye signal using the green ghost fire that lit up his eye sockets as they both attacked at the same time.
Gu Manshu transformed his whole body into a spear as he entered the emperor's midsection and left through his back then he exploded!
The explosion made the Emperor's body expand as he tried to control it and recover his original form, however, Yun Jhin entered the unhealed hole in his midsection and he started to expand in size as he let out a barrier of ki that started to shoot out small ki blasts by the hundreds of thousands!
The shell blaster attack exploded the emperor's body into smithereens as it tried to reconnect together just like Biu Wuan's did, however Biu Wuan and Andonara finally healed themselves as they started to hunt down the pieces of meat destroying them quickly until nothing remained.
However, they left out a small part of his eye as it rolled under the ground only for the celestial emperor to heal himself back to his full body.
But things weren't that good for the Emperor as he clutched his chest and his skin started to crack, he could feel that his regeneration would be the last this time, if his body broke again his soul wouldn't be able to create another.
He gasped as he exploded out of the ground not taking the 4 by surprise, they knew that it was impossible to destroy every piece of the flesh unless they took care of the body in total, destroying the body while it was whole was easier than trying to find all his pieces of scattered flesh.
However, getting him in a position where all of his body would be evaporated was currently impossible for the quartet.
Yun Jhin gasped for breath as that attack took a huge amount of his ki reserves, Biu Wuan and Gu Manshu weren't looking that great either, only Andonara was still ok because she didn't use any ki in the fight.
Yun Jhin glanced at Andonara and sent her a message:
"You will have to delay him until we can recover some of our battle power."
Andonara had hearts in her eyes as she got Yun Jhin's message, she nodded and then went ahead to fight the celestial emperor 1 on 1.
As Yun Jhin was recovering his ki and battle power along with the other two, Andonara was getting the snot beaten out of her by the weakened emperor.
The moment she tried to 1v1 him she got kicked in the face and thrown into the ground before the Emperor started to rain blow after blow on her snake tummy making her vomit out some green acid which he dodged by moving his head to the side.
But this wasn't all, the emperor knew that they were using Andonara as fodder to recover but they didn't know that while he beat the ever-living shit out of her he was also charging an ability to eradicate all of them at once!

chapters.title: Chapter 237: After the soul is out, capture it!
chapters.content:
It didn't take much time for Yun Jhin to realize that something wasn't right, only a few minutes in after he saw how the emperor was focusing too hard on Andonara made him realize that he was making a trap for them!
He knew that the emperor realized that they were using the time Andonara got for them to rest and recuperate so there was surely no way he would let them restore their battle power unless he had an ace up his sleeve!
And Yun Jhin didn't really want to see what that ace was going to do, in this situation if he let the emperor charge his energy they would all die without a shadow of a doubt!
Yun Jhin ignored the throbbing pain that was coursing through his body as he gave an eye signal to his compatriots.
Since they were enemies for such a long time they had learned quite a lot of things about each other so they knew what Yun Jhin's eye signal meant, know yourself, and know thy enemy was a saying that most cultivators at the higher stages followed religiously.
Yun Jhin eye signal meant that they were going to sacrifice Andonara to deal a critical hit to the emperor's body.
Even though the man was hiding it, Yun Jhin could see through him rather well, he knew that he was on his last legs and if his body broke again he wouldn't be able to create another one.
In that situation, his soul willpower would be around 50% of his original strength or even lower, thus the 3 of them would be able to work together and subdue it.
Yun Jhin took in a deep breath as he looked at Andonara's pitiful form and shouted:
"Stop that celestial emperor, I was the one who killed your son, you want me right?"
Yun Jhin's words struck a chord in the celestial emperor's heart. He saw some of the times he had with his son and he burst into a rage as he rushed towards Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin smiled inside as he saw how easily the fool fell for his trap, his hands wavered for a few seconds seemingly as if he was taking a hard decision before Andonara's snake body appeared in his hands.
Andonara didn't know what was happening, she was almost half unconscious from the beating she took but she was rather glad to be in Yun Jhin's arms, only to cry out in surprise as she was thrown directly at the celestial emperor like a Lasoo
Andonara grabbed him up as he was momentarily tied by her body, but as he flexed his arms Andonara cried out:
"Untie me from him, my body will burst!"
Andonara could feel her body scales started o crack and rip away from her and it was immensely painful.
She cried out for Yun Jhin's help:
"Hubby, don't let me die, please help me! You still need my help to take him down don't you?"
Yun Jhin's face was as cold as glacial ice as he said:
"Yes and no."
Andonara started to panic as she knew what Yun Jhin would do in this situation.
Yun Jhin let go of her tail as the celestial emperor fully broke her into two pieces that fell to the ground in a circle.
However, the celestial emperor knew that something wasn't right the moment Andonara's body fell to the ground as he tried to jump out of the circle.
"TOO LATE!"
The trio shouted in unison as they powered up, their auras engulfed their bodies, their powers reached their peak as Andonara's body started to glow below the emperor's feet, as a peak, God realm expert's body and an intelligent beast, Andonara's body was certainly a treasure that many cultivators would long after. As the glow intensified in power purple smoke started to rise from Andonara's body which was slowly paralyzing the celestial emperor's body.
Andonara's poison was very strong but not strong enough to do much to the celestial emperor, but with the help of the trio who was powering up the body of the deceased Andonara the poison could paralyze the emperor before they couldn't attempt this as Andonara's body wouldn't have been able to handle all of their power alive.
Even when dead the body couldn't really resist, as it was expunging all of that poison it was also slowly disintegrating into ashes which drifted in the wind.
The celestial emperor's skin started to turn purple as he was coughing up globules of purple blood trying to extract all of the poison from himself.
But he was still a step too late as Yun Jhin, Gu Manshu, and Biu Wuan caught him in a triangle formation, they shouted as a triangle of energy engulfed the celestial emperor's whole body, every one of them poured up to every tiny scrap of ki remaining in their bodies into the attack.
A gigantic yellow pillar rose into the skies as the emperor's cries could be heard coming from it.
The pillar extended up into the stars as it only disappeared after a few minutes of it burning brightly.
The celestial emperor was on his last legs as his burnt body kneeled to the trio who were gasping for air and clutching their chests as they took in big mouthfuls of ki from their surroundings trying to replenish their reserves.
All of the ki in the surrounding 300 kilometers was emptied as the 3 experts did their breathing techniques to recover their ki.
The celestial emperor's legs wobbled as he tried to get right back up from his kneeling position only to fall again, he felt his body starting to crack as he couldn't stop the process of his body decaying anymore.
Parts of his body started to fall off and disappear as his pure azure celestial soul started to appear in the front of the three greedy sharks that got him in this situation.
Yun Jhin couldn't help but laugh as he saw the emperor's shell break down and transform into ashes just like Andonara's body did, he took a few steps forward but Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan glared at him from behind.
Yun Jhin knew that all 3 of them couldn't absorb the soul and cutting it up would surely massively reduce the effects that they wanted to see so at this point they were enemies!
Even Gu Manshu who had a good relationship with Yun Jhin immediately decided to attack him from behind trying to impale him using his bone spears.
Biu Wuan didn't watch from the side as he took out his needle and launched an assault towards Yun Jhin's forehead trying to kill him so there would be one less contestant.
Both Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan knew how insidious Yun Jhin was so they wouldn't want to team up with him in this situation, however, the two didn't know that while the celestial emperor lost his body that didn't mean the fight with him was over!
Yun Jhin had even stated beforehand that they still needed to defeat his soul before they could absorb it, right now he was taking a few steps forward to use the soul techniques he learned from the soul emperor to weaken the celestial emperor's soul so they would be able to take him down easily.
However the two had different thoughts than him, they thought that because they destroy his body he would be easy pickings.
But the celestial emperor wasn't, he looked towards the trio who were attacking each other as he let out a wail making them clutch their heads, they weren't fully healed at this point and their ki wasn't at its full capacity so they couldn't defend themselves from the sound attack let out by the celestial emperor.
Yun Jhin took a few steps backward as he drilled into the ground and disappeared leaving Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan to deal with the celestial emperor's soul, but they weren't dumb and they didn't want to let Yun Jhin be the fisherman so they both flew into the skies and tried to escape.
It was a good attempt but the celestial emperor's enraged soul didn't really want to let them escape, it let out another shriek as it increased in size and started to shot out globules of green plasma from his mouth which hit both Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan before they could fully leave the area, the globules were sticky and heavy so they fell to the ground and remained there as they got stuck.
The emperor chuckled darkly as he used his phantasm hands inserting them in the craniums of both of them, Gu Manshu's soul fire started to slowly deplete as any living signs on the skeletons started to stop, while Biu Wuan struggled mightily as he chanted Buddhist incantation after Buddhist incarnation, while it didn't look like much without Yun Jhin's support they were both easily picked out by the celestial emperor as if they were sheep for the slaughter.
Yun Jhin looked at everything from the underground as he sat there cross-legged, the ki from the earth itself was slowly fusing with his body as an azure aura started to flare around him, flame-like patterns appeared on his face as if they were tattoos and destiny from the celestial realm was slowly converging on his body, but at the last second when the destiny was ready to merge with his body he declined it!

chapters.title: Chapter 238: A fisherman with a broken net
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's rejection of destiny created a chain reaction as the ground started to shake and the clouds above in the sky started to rumble.
Since the celestial emperor's body was destroyed his connection towards the celestial realm was halved, so the realm wanted a replacement. Yun Jhin was the best candidate and considering how weak he currently was the realm helped him to heal up before investing the destiny that was stripped from the emperor into him, however, Yun Jhin declined it!
In a situation where destiny was given to him Yun Jhin would have gobbled it up without question but the destiny the realm was giving him had some major problems that he couldn't solve.
The first and most major problem was the fact that he would be tied to the realm if he accepted destiny, this was a problem the celestial emperor also had and he couldn't solve it up till now, and he lived for a very long time.
What could Yun Jhin do if the celestial emperor was powerless to cut off his connection to the realm by himself? He didn't want to become stuck as a guardian of the realm just like he did so he immediately cut off the connection between himself and the realm after he healed up.
He knew that he angered the realm this way but he could care less about that, the realm itself couldn't do anything to him as natural disasters had no effects on him at this point.
He sprang out of the ground like a drill as he looked coldly at Biu Wuan and Gu Manshu's situation.
He had no love for traitors and people who rushed things and these two were both, he looked on coldly as their souls were extracted from their bodies by the celestial emperor but the moment he tried to absorb them he interfered!
Now that he was at full power and the emperor's soul was distracted he struck it from behind using ki enveloped halberd.
It was the same halberd he had created back in his early days but now it evolved to a Godly treasure as Yun Jhin tempered it and fused diverse materials into it.
The moment the blood-red halberd stuck the celestial emperor's back it started to suck energy making the azure glow from the soul start to disappear slowly, the blood-sucking effect worked even on soul bodies!
The celestial emperor shook his body trying to escape from the halberd but that meant he had to let loose the two souls which were in his grasp!
With them, he would be able to increase his battle power and crush Yun Jhin as he was alone.
But now his soul power was getting absorbed into Yun Jhin from the halberd and he could feel how Yun Jhin was getting increasingly stronger the more soul power he absorbed from him, he was almost near a breakthrough!
The soul power came with an understanding of the celestial realm and its laws so Yun Jhin could immediately breakthrough if he wanted to at this point, the soul energy was also very potent as it came from a half-a-step expert that was almost above the God realm, actually as he got the information he even learned about the name of the realm above the God one, it was called the true realm!
There were no specifics but even a name was good for him, most of the information that came from this way of absorption was gibberish but he could translate some things with difficulty.
The only thing that he could translate was the true realm, everything else was blurry or not understandable.
But he already gained what he needed, information-wise, for anything further he would be able to find out by himself.
What he needed now was to fully absorb the celestial emperor's soul so he could pave his way towards the peak of the God Realm then even the half-a-step true realm!
He could feel that he might break through continuously if he absorbed the soul, fully.
But of course, the celestial emperor wouldn't stay still and let himself be absorbed as he threw away the souls of both Gu Manshu and Biu Wuan and tried to escape from this situation, the halberd started to slip out of his body as it turned transparent and he tried to run away.
Yun Jhin ignored the traitorous duo as he flew away trying to catch up with the fleeing celestial emperor.
However, it seemed he had forgotten something, a burst of deep laughter could be heard coming from the surroundings:
"Hahahahahaha, thank you Yun Jhin it seems you have worked hard!"
Yun Jhin could recognize that voice any day... it was Hell's willpower!
That damn thing that almost killed him!
The celestial emperor's eyes widened as he took a few steps backward from the way the voice was heard but considering Yun Jhin was behind him he was stuck between a rock and a hard place here.
Yun Jhin frowned as he looked forward and saw someone that looked exactly like him but with inversed colors smiling at him, he was a few meters away from the celestial emperor just like him.
It seemed that in the end, Hell's willpower had somehow made use of his experience with his body to create a new one from scratch and still escape from Hell, unlike the celestial emperor who was stuck due to his connection with the realm, Hell's willpower was only stuck in Hell because it had no physical body.
Hell's willpower got a little bit closer to the celestial emperor as his smile showed his sharp dark fangs then he said:
"We meet again old friend, thought you would never see me in your lifetime again did you?"
The celestial emperor gritted his teeth as he said:
"Of course I didn't think, after all, we are opposed to each other and never supposed to be meeting, but it seems your thirst of power had brought you here just like the fellow behind me."
"Oh him... ignore him, we have a little bit of history together, why don't you just close your eyes and jump into my embrace? We can be one whole again."
The celestial emperor made a face as if he was disgusted before he shook his head and said:
"I'd rather let him have me instead of going back to you, the universal laws separated us for a reason!"
"Oh don't be like that, if we fuse back together even the laws won't be able to do anything to us, we will break through to the true realm and hop on the throne we deserve, this universe won't be able to restrain us any further, come here brother!"
The celestial emperor faltered as he felt himself getting weaker, the gravity around him started to increase as he was being pushed towards Hell's willpower, but that's when Yun Jhin appeared behind him and put his hand on his shoulder dispelling the gravity somewhat then dragged him backward.
"It seems you haven't fully accustomed yourself to the body yet, you were actually stronger back when you were just a strand of willpower."
Hell's willpower snorted as he glared at Yun Jhin and directly attacked, there was nothing that he wanted to talk about with Yun Jhin!
Yun Jhin put two fingers to his forehead as he disappeared from the spot making Hell's willpower rage!
A gigantic mushroom cloud appeared where Yun Jhin previously was as the surroundings for hundreds of thousands of kilometers were obliterated creating an environment similar to hell.
Yun Jhin appeared at the Lin family along with the celestial emperor's ghostly body which tried to escape again only for Yun Jhin's steel grip to grab him by the neck and lift him in the air:
"You have said that you would rather give yourself to me than fuse back with Hell's willpower, now why don't we make that happen?"
"You don't understand... now that you have angered him his awakening will happen and he will fuse properly with the body that he created, you might not be his match even if you reach my cultivation realm."
Yun Jhin snorted as his grip tightened on the man's windpipe while he said:
"You are not the one to say such things at this time, I have defeated you while you were in a better position and you think that I won't be able to kill him when I'm in the same position as him?"
"You don't understand Yun Jhin... you never saw his true power, I know it because we had one body before and he was in charge of it, we didn't reach the true realm before but we were around the same power that we were now, but he was around 10 to 20 times stronger than I am!"
"Yeah and if he is 10 to 20 then I will be 100 to 1000 stronger, you don't know what I have been through, what I have endured, what I had done to get to this point, you have been born with this cultivation base after you were separated by the universal laws, you didn't have to work your way up the ladder as I did, that's why you are weaker and the reason he is stronger is just that he is mad!"
"NOW SHUT UP AND LET YOURSELF BE ABSORBED!"
Yun Jhin tight grip increased once more as energy from the celestial emperor's soul was quickly sapped from his soul body into Yun Jhin's body then into his soul, the laws of the realm quickly started to converge above him as he was ready for another breakthrough, and this time he didn't stop it, he didn't care if Hell's willpower would know his location before it could come here he would fully absorb the emperor and breakthrough to the end!

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Fight for ascendance
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's face started to turn a shady red as he continued to absorb the soul force of the celestial emperor.
In contrast, the celestial emperor's soul was slowly shrinking and looking more and more emaciated like it was transforming into a mummy.
Yun Jhin didn't have time to waste so the moment he got near his breakthrough he created a beam of energy that flew into the sky to attract the laws of the celestial realm, now that he was practically the celestial emperor of the realm all he had to do was call them and they would fuse with his body naturally without having to do anything else.
He knew that the moment he started the breakthrough sequence he couldn't do anything else because Hell's willpower would surely come to attack him, he needed to breakthrough fast, very fast.
In this situation where he had to fight against time, he had to rush his breakthroughs and absorption attempt.
The quicker he absorbed the more the soul in his grasp shrank until it became as small as a puppy but Yun Jhin didn't stop as the beam that he had sent into the air finally attracted the laws of the celestial realm which started to dive to him directly entering into his body making his blood boil as they fused with it.
He could feel the laws sublimating his life level as he reached higher heights... the 7th level of the God Realm... the 8th level, Peak level!
The celestial emperor's soul turned blurry as it slowly disappeared as if he was never there, Yun Jhin's body started to float by itself, now that he had the destiny of the celestial realm that he stole from the emperor he didn't need to connect with the realm itself to reach the half-a-step true level.
His eyes started to glow with an azure color but then he closed them as his cultivation base consolidated at the peak of the God Realm, however, he couldn't go any further he couldn't reach the same heights as the celestial emperor as he hypothesized, he could only reach his former peak which was the limits of the God Realm.
He shouted to the sky as his aura engulfed 600,000 kilometers around him attracting the attention of everyone in the realm, his shout was extremely loud combined with his flaring aura made everyone realize where he was.
However, everyone who felt his cold maleficent aura immediately discarded any thoughts of picking a fight with him, it was obvious he wasn't a good guy.
However, Hell's willpower was just like a shark that smelled blood as he teleported multiple times until he reached the Lin family's territory, there he saw Yun Jhin's aura engulfing the skies as he broke through it with his body and meet with him in the middle of the territory.
Yun Jhin had his eyes closed but the moment Hell's willpower approached he opened them as he looked directly into his eyes, his soul willpower flowed out of him like an open faucet, the moment his soul willpower met Hell's willpower it started to drill into his body to reach his soul and assimilate it.
Hell's willpower snorted as he cut all of the soul willpower tentacles that were going through his body only for him to frown as he realized that the cut tentacles didn't disappear but started to proliferate into his body transforming into small soul bodies of Yun Jhin who were like parasites that were slowly absorbing Hell's willpower flesh and blood.
"You damn... it seems you have reached your previous heights by absorbing my brother, but it won't be enough!"
Hell's willpower face morphed as he looked towards the sky while he shouted, his aura started to push Yun Jhin's aura backward while his power continued to increase, the whole realm started to shake even harder than when the celestial emperor descended, actually the earthquakes were so strong that the ground below them started to crack and rip into pieces.
Lava spurted out of the ground like a geyser as it reached its height however the moment it touched the two God's bodies it dissipated like it was tap water.
Yun Jhin cracked his whole body as his bones popped into their sockets after his continuous breakthroughs his body finally acclimatized to the sudden increase in ki power, he appeared in front of Hell's willpower as he told him:
"Absorbing you will get me one step closer to ascension... but it won't be enough... I can feel it right now, but you are the last obstacle in my way, the others had already been taken care of."
"Don't think this will be an easy fight."
Hell's willpower aura finally stabilized as he unleashed thousands of small ki needles aiming directly at Yun Jhin's vital points however Yun Jhin created a green ki barrier which absorbed all of the ki needles.
Then he put two fingers to his forehead as he appeared in front of hell's willpower instantly before letting an explosive wave out of his mouth which took out the whole upper part of Hell's willpower body leaving only the legs which fell to the ground only for his upper body to regenerate immediately and appear under Yun Jhin's stomach to pierce him in the stomach.... but the attack remained stuck in Yun Jhin's stomach as he hardened his muscles.
Yun Jhin's feral smile told Hell's willpower that he wouldn't like what was coming next as Yun Jhin grabbed him directly by the head, afterward his whole body started to inflate as he became as buff like a bodybuilder.
His buff body increased his whole system's muscles and strength, this was the peak of the combination of Duritz's bloodline and the technique he had stolen from the Chen family, Hell's willpower head which was in his hand popped like a ripe watermelon as it tried to regenerate again.
But now that Hell's willpower's body was in his hands it wouldn't be able to leave!
The moment it regenerated it popped again as Yun Jhin inserted his ki and blood into Hell's willpower body, the moment his ki and blood fused with Hell's willpower body it exploded into thousands of fragments that Yun Jhin ate as if they were sweets.
His mouth opened as razor-sharp teeth broke into the pieces of meat from the body's explosion, a guttural bass-boosted voice was heard from Yun Jhin's mouth:
"You cannot escape!"
Hell's willpower had already abandoned his newly created body as he transformed into a piece of soul willpower, since he was the brother of the celestial emperor he could connect with the celestial realm and become its owner just like the ex-emperor was, and he was doing it right now! He would rather be captive again than be devoured by Yun Jhin.
Yun Jhin looked around as he realized that the whole realm started to morph, he felt all of the living beings on the realm losing their life-force as it entered the ground below him, he could feel that regardless of cultivation base everyone was losing their life force quickly.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he started to drill into the ground at immense speeds reaching the core of the realm.
There he found Hell's willpower which was fusing with the heart of the realm while absorbing the life force of its inhabitants to create a new more perfect body so he could combat him once more, but he wasn't fast enough as Yun Jhin already had arrived where he was.
Hell's willpower's expression morphed into fear as he shouted:
"Don't come closer, DON'T YOU ARE WORSE THAN ME AND I'M THE LITERAL EMBODIMENT OF HELL!"
Yun Jhin laughed as he took that as a compliment, he was never someone to care about looks so his current monstrous looks didn't bother him at all, he actually liked it!
Hell's willpower wanted to back away but he was fusing with the core of the realm and if he stopped the process the backlash would be something that he wouldn't be able to endure, he thought that the process would be rather quick but Yun Jhin realized what was happening faster than he thought, he was one step away from fusing with the realm but one step not taken was one step remained!
Yun Jhin approached him as he grabbed his face yanking him from the core and weakening him severely as blue blood started to drip from his whole spectral body which cracked in a lot places, the backlash destroyed some of his memory nodes as he looked at Yun Jhin seemingly as if he didn't know him.
Yun Jhin ignored the looks as he said:
"Finally after such a long time... I'm one step away from reaching the true realm, from breaking into true immortality and reaching the throne that I deserve, you are my ticket there and you are in my hands!"
Yun Jhin opened his big mouth as he let the spectral being drop into it, his teeth crunched the bits of soul that remained from Hell's willpower until it fused with his body and soul...
His eyes became wide open as the second evolution started... he was slowly reaching the half-a-step true realm barrier!
His vision started to change as it started to zoom out, he could see billions, trillions, quadrillions of galaxies appearing in his vision, then it zoomed up further, he saw these galaxies were nothing but specks of dust in the eyes of those that were truly important, he saw some silhouettes that were beckoning towards him, one silhouette was especially happy, he wore a dark robe and he had flames in his pupils and for hair, his dark beard was flowing majestically as he laughed with wicked intent, he mouthed something to Yun Jhin:
"Come quick my apprentice... you have done very well, one step away, one step away, come come!"
Then everything returned to normal as he woke up back into the center of the celestial realm...

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Half-a-step True Realm expert
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin felt immense power coursing through his body as it was currently transforming reaching an in-between stance, he was getting closer to the true realm but he couldn't truly get there by himself.
Even though he had absorbed both the celestial emperor and Hell's willpower it still wasn't enough.
The duo would have reached the true realm if they fused because they were both natural wonders that were born out of the universe, unlike Yun Jhin who was both despised by the universe and a normal mortal.
Both of their essences weren't enough for him to take the last step and arrive at the spot he needed to.
He felt rather incomplete as he checked up on the laws that fused with his body, they were half-way crystallized.
From what he could infer the moment the laws that he had fused with his body were fully crystallized he would be able to ascend and leave the universe.
This was his dream since he first died, he hated his mortal body which couldn't withstand his ambitions, and always strived to improve himself to the limits only to realize that he lacked talent...
In the end, he went towards the accumulation path with his reincarnations until he reached this step... this was the farthest he has ever gone.
This was the epicenter of his journey, his dream, his goal to reach immortality was one step away from him...
It seemed he still had to reach the middle of the universe.
He already knew of one way to reach the true realm without the absorption of these two entities but it was considerably harder and way more dangerous than what he went through, if he failed this time it was also his last life... but he couldn't wait anymore!
His last try... his last try, he wanted to gamble it on this, he needed to succeed, he had to!
The whole celestial realm shook as Yun Jhin thought about his future, this broke his train of thought as he looked at the core of the realm, breaking Hell's willpower from fusing with the realm destabilized it and it didn't have much time until it would explode.
However at his cultivation base, the explosion of the realm wouldn't affect him, however, it would fatally injure him and put him in chronostasis effect until he would be all healed up.
He had no wish to become like that as he teleported out of the ground and arrived at the Lin family's teleportation portal.
All of the living beings in the realm had died due to Hell's willpower shenanigans so there was nothing he needed to do in the realm any more, the vitality of the realm was also slowly being ripped away from the realm and disappearing all the beneficial effects it had before were nowhere to be found.
Yun Jhin sighed as he infused the portal with his ki and left through it, as he took one look behind he could see the realm being engulfed by lava that shot out of the ground, it seemed the celestial realm was truly done for...
Yun Jhin opened his eyes as he was back in the mortal realm.
He directly teleported to the blood throne sect headquarters as he looked around, most of the troops had been sent to the celestial realm and the headquarters were now empty.
He continued to look around for some time and sighed, all of his hard work gone in a few hours, while his branches were mostly unaffected his strongest people were in the army batch that first entered, but the same could be said about the other sects people as well, and unlike them, he also came back alive.
He didn't find any belonging to the sect anymore, actually, he didn't feel anything at this point, he didn't care about his secular connections anymore, he was sure he had included his son and daughter in the expedition roster so they were certainly dead as well.
As for Qinghe, he decided to leave her alone, she didn't need him anymore, she still had some loyal maids and what happened next to her wasn't of his concern.
He teleported from sect to sect and saw how they were still waiting for their patriarchs/ancestors and troops to come back victoriously with loot.
However no one came, time passed, days turned into weeks, weeks into months, and months into years, the sects started to degrade as they lost their leadership and the stronger sects that didn't take the bait and entered the portals immediately came to conquer the remainders of the top sects...
These things happened continuously and they repeated themselves, at this point Yun Jhin had seen through the feelings and psyche of the humans/beasts and most intelligent beings, as long as someone became intelligent they would all pursue the same thing.
Wellness of life, everyone wanted a better life, a longer life so they could enjoy the better life, they all wanted the same things, everything that stemmed from this was the construct of society, even in the cultivation one where one's fist told how things would go, instead of wealth they would run after power, no matter what way or the means they had to employ to get the power they would do it, some people liked to cling to beliefs but they remained at the bottom of the barrel while those that did everything they could walk their way up on the stairs of society.
Everything came from power and ended at power, all that Yun Jhin had done up till now didn't make him any different from the people he was currently observing, he was just like them, a person that ran after his dreams, all of he did tend to reach the extreme but that was what he became after he lived for so many lives.
Life tended to repeat itself no matter how you wanted to do things differently, there would even be days that you would think that you have gone through this thing before, Yun Jhin hated this feeling, he hated the monotone life of cultivation, he always hated doing the same thing over and over again expecting a different result, if he was honest with himself he was truly insane.
Everything he had done up till now was so he could change his pace so that he could step away from the oppressive place that was this universe that he was stuck in, he wanted to change his lifestyle, he got bored of killing, destroying, and schemes.
It had been such a long time and he wanted to rest, however, it wasn't the time to do it yet, it wasn't time to rest, he hadn't finished the last thing he needed to leave the universe.
He looked around him, only stars surrounded him as he left all of the populated universe behind him, there was no one to challenge him, and even if there was he wouldn't accept because there was no point to, he only had one thing he wanted and that was getting the core of the universe and ascending!
He slowly trotted through the starry sky as if he was an old man who was supporting himself on his walking stick, the more he walked in the universe the brighter the stars started to light around him, however, he didn't feel good, the light was trying to incinerate him, destroy him, which showed that he was on the right way to the center of the universe.
As he got closer and closer to the end of his journey he could feel sweat trickling down his temples as the light increased so much that even his tempered true body was slowly being roasted like he was a piece of lamb in a cooking pan.
But he ignored all of the bodily sensations as he trotted forward, he didn't say anything as there was nothing to say but his eyes shook a little bit as he looked in front of him, he saw a person, a person that he thought that he would never see again... Yuan Fang.
Yuan Fang's body was slowly disintegrating as he tried to walk forward, he wanted to reach the center of the universe but he was weaker than Yun Jhin, he barely reached the peak of the god realm in his own way, from his aura Yun Jhin could identify that he had taken over hell, how much time had he stayed in the celestial realm contemplating the life of intelligent beings?
Yuan Fang fell to his knees then to his stomach as he tried to crawl forward, the pressure and light from the stars attacked him so much that the life in his eyes was slowly being extracted and destroyed by the light.
Yun Jhin took a few steps towards him which took his attention, he looked up from his downed position as he chuckled sadly:
"It seems you won the race Yun Jhin... you were more prepared than me."
"Was I really?"
Yuan Fang chuckled, it seemed Yun Jhin didn't want to let him have the last word even when he won, his body started to slowly disintegrate as his soul tried to escape only for the stars that surrounded them to grab Yuan Fang's soul and incinerate it along with the remainder of his body.
He was now dead both in body and soul!
The path to the center of the universe wouldn't forgive anyone, if anyone walked the path they had the intention to hurt the universe and that wasn't forgivable!
Yun Jhin ignored the ashes that drifted around him, he continued to walk forward. Yuan Fang wasn't in his head even when he started to walk this road, he even forgot him and only remembered him after he saw his downed form... all he had on this mind now was reaching the center of the universe and absorbing its core!

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Step by step, I shall reach Godhood!
chapters.content:
Yun Jhin's steps were steady and his gait strong as he walked through the empty universe, the only thing that was lightning up his path were the starlight beams that were trying to disintegrate him into ashes just like Yuan Fang had been.
But Yun Jhin's body and cultivation were way higher, no matter how hard the pressure was attacking him he endured it as he walked further and further, with every step an incalculable distance was traveled.
The more he walked towards the center of the universe the more starlight approached him to destroy his body and soul.
However nothing changed, Yun Jhin continued to walk forward with a serious expression on his face as if his body wasn't his, it was like he couldn't feel anything, as if the torturous attacks of the body and soul burning starlight weren't even mosquito bites to him, he didn't even flinch as he walked forward while he muttered:
"One more step... just one more step."
It was as if he was possessed, the more he walked the quicker he became, the starlight even started to deviate as his speed increased to the point that the starlight couldn't touch him anymore.
"One more step, one more step!"
Step by step he walked forward and finally he reached his destination. In front of him stood the center of the universe, the place where the universe originally started from, the place that let all the living beings in existence appear.
Yun Jhin wasn't mesmerized by the sight nor was he interested in anything else as he continued to walk forward, the surroundings were rather dreamy with blue-colored nebulae surrounding him but he ignored everything.
The closer he walked to the core of the universe the more he could feel that his surroundings were shaking, it wasn't him nor his vision that was acting up, the surroundings were truly shaking.
The universe felt threatened by Yun Jhin's presence, it was the first time a mortal had arrived near its core and it knew that it didn't come with any good intentions, while it didn't have human-like intelligence it had beast instincts that told it when it was in danger.
However, no matter how hard his surroundings shook Yun Jhin's gaze or footing didn't change, he walked slowly towards a nebula that looked the same compared to all of the others and put his hand inside of it.
A crunching sound could be heard the moment his hand was inserted into the nebulae, it was almost as if his hand entered the mouth of an apex predator, his pain sensors flared up as he felt his hand being disintegrated quickly.
But he ignored the feeling as he started to insert his whole arm through the nebula, then his whole body!
The pain was excruciating to the point that he almost blanked out even with his current pain endurance threshold and immense cultivation, however, he held onto his consciousness and entered the nebula with his whole body.
After he entered the nebula he couldn't see anything anymore, he couldn't feel anything, everything around him was as dark as the start of the universe.
But his memories were still there, his life was still there, he didn't die but he felt as if he was dead at the same time.
However this feeling quickly disappeared as in the darkness a white globe appeared.
Yun Jhin took a few steps through the darkness and reached it, the globe had countless images going through it, from the birth of a baby to the death of an old man, from the creation of a sect and the destruction of the said sect, life, and death, a continuous cycle that would never stop in the universe regardless in which realm you lived. Be it either Hell or the former celestial realm, everyone experienced death!
The difference was only that some people lived well during their lives, they had fulfilling lives, they did what they wanted when they wanted, their lives were something that they enjoyed and they left the world content.
However Yun Jhin was never content, he never knew when to stop, he wanted better, every time he wanted better he failed and fell on his back to realize that he had overexerted himself in a situation that he could have lived very well with what he got.
He knew that his behavior was self-destructive, at one point he thought that he wouldn't be able to live through the reincarnation process again, he wanted to see what the otherworld was like but he was scared of what type of tortures he would go through for all of his sins. In the end, no matter how much he controlled his emotions in the face of absolute strength he couldn't do anything else besides begging.
However, Yun Jhin's claw-like hands grasped the white globe, it was melded into the surrounding darkness but with Yun Jhin's strength, he removed it after a long time of trying to drag it towards him.
Time passed by so quickly that Yun Jhin didn't realize when his hair turned white, his shaking hands were holding onto the globe and as he saw his reflection in it he realized he had grown old, a chuckle came out of his mouth:
"So you are still trying to get the upper hand even in this situation? Playing the same cards, again and again, you thought that if you held out to the point that I would have died of old age you would win?"
Yun Jhin's body was slowly transforming into dust as his old age caught him, it took a very long time to remove the globe from where it was situated but Yun Jhin succeeded in the end, however the moment he succeeded he realized that he was also on the death bed!
"Thinking that old age would do me in again?"
Yun Jhin chuckled as his legs disappeared leaving only his torso, arms, and head, his arms also slowly started to disintegrate as the globe floated in front of him, his torso was next and only his head remained.
However, the last second before his head disappeared forever, he opened his mouth and an immense suction force took the globe into his mouth.
The globe shattered inside Yun Jhin's mouth as immense energy that he had never experienced before entered his head, he closed his eyes as his age slowly started to revert to his prime, a new torso arms, and legs grew out of his head.
He opened his eyes and they were black with silver pupils, his body was unlike before, it was scrawny and looked extremely weak it was just like a person's who would die of malnutrition.
However, the moment he clenched his weak skinny arms his whole surroundings started to crack and break, the space that was confining him exploded like fireworks.
He could feel some presence behind him as he moved his whole body to look who was behind him he saw the silhouettes that he saw in his vision when he was comprehending his breakthrough in the celestial realm.
The moment his eyes met with those dark ones he realized that it was the person that helped him and gave him the system.
Hades took a few steps forward as he bowed from the waist down and said:
"Welcome to the True Realm, or better known amongst our people, The True God Realm!"
Yun Jhin took a few steps forward and looked directly into Hades's eyes as he asked:
"So this is what true godhood feels like?"
Hades laughed, his eyes filled with hellfire and his flowing beard moving alongside his laughter as he said:
"Not what you expected right? You have just destroyed the universe that you came from, go on take a look behind you."
Yun Jhin moved his head to look backward and saw a small granule-sized speck of dust disappearing from his sight, there were an infinite amount of such granules as he looked down and he realized that none of them were breaking like his, all of them were steady and strong looking and as he took a second look that focused on one of the granules he saw countless cosmoses and galaxies roaming around full of living creatures of different races.
His sight returned from the focused state as he looked at Hades and asked again:
"These are all your creations?"
"Mine? No."
Hades shook his head as he waved his hand behind him:
"They are our creations."
Countless characters appeared behind Hades as he said that, one of the most important ones that he recognized was the fat jolly man with a unique light aura, Buddha!
Yun Jhin shook his head, as he ascended he realized that fighting with Buddha for his reincarnation wouldn't bring him anything, at this point he reached the ultimate enlightenment and realized there is no more to do.
Hades looked at Yun Jhin with a grim look as he said:
"Hey don't go to sleep the moment you arrived, you have reached the peak and you are already bored of it? Atleast leave behind a universe before you go."
Yun Jhin looked around, the spirit realm, the realm that all practitioners would reach when they achieved the ultimate enlightenment and broke through to the True God Realm... it was blank, besides the granules of dust that were covering an infinite amount of space below him there was nothing else.
Most of the characters behind Hades had their eyes closed as they didn't say anything, only Buddha gave him one glance before he closed his eyes as well.
Hades was the only active person.
Yun Jhin turned towards Hades, he had many questions that he wanted to be answered.

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Creating something for the future (finale)
chapters.content:
"I know you want to ask things, just ask away, we are all friends here, even that guy."
He pointed towards Buddha who made a 'hmm' sound as he looked at the two of them but didn't say anything, he didn't like to associate with Hades and considering what he had done with Yun Jhin he didn't want to talk with him either.
"Why do I feel so sleepy... do Gods need sleep?"
"Not really, look at me and Buddha, do we look like we need to sleep?"
"It's just that you are a new God and you need time to adapt, the other guys got bored of watching over their worlds and let us do it instead, you will adapt quickly, by now you shouldn't feel sleepy anymore right?"
Yun Jhin cocked his head to the side and he felt better, now it was as if he was full of energy.
He didn't really understand how the surroundings worked yet but as he analyzed them better information started to pour into his brain.
Even though he reached the true god realm there was no information for him about the realm beforehand but now the place itself was feeding him information after he acclimatized to it.
"What's this?"
Hades chuckled:
"Self-enlightenment, you might think that the place we are in gives you the information but you just learn it by yourself after you fully accommodate with your cultivation base."
"Anyways let me tell you more about the benefits of being a true god."
"Well besides eternal life we can also create universes and watch whatever is happening in there, we also control the cycle of reincarnation and we can decide which of the more important souls reincarnate and in what they will reincarnate."
"Most of our job consists of observing the universes, well we aren't obliged to but this is the most entertaining thing we can do around here."
"And yes we can create whatever we want but after experiencing everything there was to experience you get bored of those types of things."
"You should understand what we are talking about, you ascended because you wanted immortality and nothing else."
What Hades said was true, Yun Jhin's obsession with immortality was immense to the point that he ignored every other aspect of his life but he was having second thoughts on his current situation?
"I have a question for you Yun Jhin, why have you chased immortality for such a long time, for what reason have you been so obsessed with it?"
"It wasn't for you to live a long life in luxury, it wasn't for you to enjoy your life with someone you loved, it wasn't for you to amass infinite wealth with your ageless body, it wasn't for you to become the king of the universes, all you wanted was eternal life but why?"
Yun Jhin started to shake as he heard these questions that he never asked himself, why did he work so hard for immortality? Why did he chase it so obsessively?
It never made sense to him why he was so obsessed with it but he always pushed forward regardless of some of his stray thoughts.
But he was also himself at the same time, he understood that he wanted immortality but he was confused on why he wanted it.
Why did he want it?
Yun Jhin started to think and Hades left him alone, he would achieve the highest enlightenment only when he understood why did he want to achieve what he achieved.
Yun Jhin eyes were closed as he started to look through his memories...
*****************
A small child was cradling his mother's cold corpse as he cried out:
"Mother mother!"
Near him a few older males were looking at the mother with pity as they said:
"It seems she couldn't withstand all of us at once hahaha."
The kid was doing his best to wake up his mother which he succeeded in after a while, the mother looked at her child with a dotting gaze as she said:
"Please live... live little Jhin."
The moment these words left the woman's mouth the child's face started to turn slack and passive which scared the woman out of her wits, she could feel her weak vitality leaving her and she knew she would die, was her child going through a panic attack after he realized what was going to happen?
Only for the child to get up glare at the grown-ups around him and unleash a wave of energy that killed all of them.
He looked down at his terrified mother before he shook his head and slit her throat with a nearby sharp rock.
Yun Jhin shook his head as he looked through the memory, the only thing that he found peculiar was that the moment she told him to live his memories from his past lives awakened.
He went to the next memory that he found peculiar and as he continued he realized something.
He was really goddamn unlucky, every time his memories awakened one of his parents/partners or friends would die.
No matter what he did they would always say something among the lines of, go live, escape, or something like that, and his memories would awaken.
This leads him to realize that he didn't want to live forever for himself.
Even though he had sealed all of the memory cores of the former reincarnations they still seeped into his personality as he would have to browse them once in a while to get the information he needed.
He thought that the technique he employed was perfect but it seems there were flaws...
But there was no reason to think about it anymore... he had already achieved the dream of all of the collective people that died near him or because of him, or in his hands.
They all wanted him to live and he lived to their expectations and wish, he had achieved true godhood.
Yun Jhin actually chuckled as he opened his eyes and Hades knew that he found the reason why he wanted eternal life as the surroundings started to change from white to purple and green this showed that Yun Jhin had achieved inner peace.
For one to create a universe they needed to first have inner peace.
Destruction came before creation and this was something that Yun Jhin had already comprehended, all he was missing was inner peace.
Yun Jhin looked at Hades and smiled as the surroundings turned back to white as he waved his hand.
Down where the motes of dust were another one appeared, this one was a little bit strange compared to the other ones.
Hades interested in the creation of the new true God he decided to look at it, as he focused he finally saw the universe, unlike the other ones this one was already created, and all of the planets in it were populated, there was no evolution to speak of, people existed the moment the universe appeared and they all had average intelligence.
However, Hades could see something wasn't right with them a man with a unibrow started to get violent as he looked around him and went on a killing spree inciting even more violence around.
However, the unibrow man was put down by another man with a buff physique and things continued so on.
As time passed societies were created and cultivation was invented, Yun Jhin didn't do anything as he observed along with Hades... he just looked on.
Time passed and the people started to ascend to their own realms, they were different compared to the ones Yun Jhin was used to but it was normal for things to be different, after all, it was a brand new universe.
Time passed further and the first peak expert appeared, he ruled with an iron fist creating a dictatorship that engulfed the whole universe.
Time passed again and so did the dictator, he died of old age and his children were now fighting on who to inherit the throne...
Yun Jhin watched everything that happened in the universe he created, from time to time he would either sigh or even laugh as he looked at his creation, were these the same emotions that he had sealed for such a long time? It felt nice to feel something and act upon it as well. When he was mad he would create a destructive earthquake that shook the whole universe, when he felt glad he would create a new universal treasure for his people.
But as more time passed he started to get bored, things started to repeat themselves even though he had created the universe with a unique thought in his mind.
Things tended to repeat no matter how unique you wanted things to be...
So he waved his hand and the granule of sand disappeared... he wanted something better, something that he would enjoy watching so he created another universe putting even more work into its conception.
But it failed again, and again, and again and again.
No matter how many times he did it he was never happy with what he got.
So he continued to create and create for one day hoping that he would have the perfect universe that he could enjoy watching, thus transitioning from one obsession to another.
FIN.
